śrutaprakāśikā
varadaṃ dviradādrāśaṃ śrīnidhiṃ karuṇānidhim | śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi praṇatārttiharaṃ harim || 1 ||
bahirantastamaśchedi jyotirvande sudarśanam | yenāvyāhatasaṅkalpaṃ vastu lakṣmīdharaṃ viduḥ || 2 ||
samyaṅnyāyakalāpena mahatā bhāratena ca | upabṛṃhitavedāya namo vyāsāya viṣṇave || 3 ||
tasmai rāmānujāryāya namaḥ paramayogine | yaḥ śrutismṛtisūtrāṇāmantarjvaramaśīśamat || 4 ||
vande'haṃ varadāryaṃ taṃ vatsābhijanabhūṣaṇam | bhāṣyāmṛtapradānādyaḥ sañjīvayati māmapi || 5 ||
prapadye praṇavākāraṃ bhāṣyaṃ raṅgamivāparam | parasya brahmaṇo yatra śeṣitvaṃ sphuṭamīkṣyate || 6 ||
śrutyanteṣu śrutaṃ bhāṣye mataṃ dhyātaṃ hṛdambuje | lakṣmīpatiṃ prapadye'haṃ dṛṣṭaṃ śrīraṅgadhāmani || 7 ||
pramāṇaṃ ca prameyaṃ ca pramātāraśca sāttvikāḥ | jayantu kṣapitāriṣṭaṃ saha sarvatra sarvadā || 8 ||
avistṛtāḥ sugambhīrā rāmānujamuvergiraḥ | darśayantu prasādena svaṃ bhāvamakhilaṃ dṛḍham || 9 ||
śrīraṅgeśājñayā labdhavyāsasañjñaṃ sudarśanam | vācāvijjīyanaḥ putraṃ bhāṣyabhaktiracūcudat || 10 ||
gurubhyo'rthaḥ śrutaḥśabdaistatprayuktaśca yojitaḥ | saukaryāya babhutsūnāṃ saṅkalayya prakāśyate || 11 ||
kaḥ kṛtsnaṃ vetti bhāṣyārthaṃ śrutāṃśasthitaye kṛtiḥ | āḍhyaiḥ kākaṇikevaiṣā nopekṣyā bhāṣyavittamaiḥ || 12 ||
bhāṣyaṃ cedvayavṛṇotsvayaṃ yatipatirvyākhyānavācāṃ tathā | gāmbhīryādanavasthitirmitamatirdūre janastadgirām ||
praṣṭavyaḥ kathamīśvaraḥ sa hi na naḥ pratyakṣarūpo dṛśāṃ |
tadbhāṣyaṃ sa ca bhāṣyakṛtsa ca hariḥ samyak prasīdantu naḥ || 13 ||
sarveṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ pramāṇādhīnaprameyaniścayānāmupāditsitajihāsiteṣṭāniṣṭa tatsādhanānāmalaukikapuruṣārthatatsādhanarūpe vastuni śabdaikasamādhigamye, tatrāpyapuruṣaśemuṣīdoṣamaṣīmālinyasya vedākhyākṣararāśereva pradhānataḥ pramāṇatayā āśrayaṇīyatve siddhe, tatra ca paśuputravṛṣṭayannasvargādyauhikāmuṣmikārvācīnaphalatatsādhanapare'vagate pūrvabhāge, paramapuruṣārtāvabodhake ca taduparibhāge pūrvācāryābhimatamuktighaṇṭāpathakaṇṭakāyamānavividhakudṛṣṭijanadurvacanaśatopaplute tadupadarśitakupathapravṛrttini jagati ca momuhyamāne tadujjijīvayiṣayā sadasadvivecanacaturapūrvācāryaparicitaṃ prācīnameva samīcīnamadhravānaṃ niṣkaṇṭakīkṛtya paramapuruṣārthābhyarthijanasārthaṃ kṛtārthayituṃ bhavabhayābhitaptajanabhāgadheyavaibhavabhāvitāvataraṇena paramakāruṇikena bhagavatā bhāṣyakāreṇa śārīrakaśāstraṃ vyācikhyāsitam | paramarṣipraṇītāni vyākhyeyāni, teṣāṃ ca mahirṣipraṇītāni vyākhyānāni ca santi cetānyevānuroddhavyāni | nahyanṛṣeḥ sūkṣmadarśitvam, ṛṣerabhiprāyamṛṣireva svato veditumarhati na tu jaḍamatiritaro janaḥ | ṛṣivacasāmevābhinnavaktṛkāṇāṃ mitho virodhe pūrvapakṣābhiprāyavaibhavavādādibhiravirodho neyaḥ | bhinnavaktṛkāṇāṃ tu virodhe duṣparihare yuktiyuktaṃ grāhyamiti na doṣaḥ | ye punaḥ santyapi tānyanādṛtya vyākhyeyāntarāṇi vyākhyānāntarāṇi ca tadviruddhāni rucayanti teṣāmāgrahagṛhītahṛdayatve paṇḍitamānitve pāṇḍityakhyāpanaparatve ca tatpravṛttireva pramāṇam | itareṣāṃ ca vyākhyātṝṇāmārṣavyākhyānātilaṅghitvam "upāsātraividhyāt " "sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāt" "bhūmāsamprasādādadhyupadeśāt" "dahara uttarebhyaḥ" ityādiṣu spaṣṭataram, iha tu vṛttnanusāraḥ pratijñātaḥ | na ca tatpratijñānamahṛdayamiti śaṅkanīyam; duṣpariharabādhakānupalambhāt | yadyapi karmamīmāṃsāyāṃ ca kvacitkvacidarvācīnavyākhyātṛbhirākulatvamāpāditam, tathāpi tatra prayogamārge skhalanābhāvādanuṣṭhānamātrādhīnāyāḥ svargādiphalasiddherdevatāsvarūpatadyāthātmyasatkāryavādādijñānanairapekṣyam, paramapuruṣārthasya jñānaikasādhyatayā jñānamārgaskhalanasyā''tmahāniphalakatvena tadviparītajñānānāmavaśyapariharttavyatvam | uttarabhāge ca tattadarthaupayikatayā prasaktanāṃ pūrvabhāgārthānāṃ pradarśitayaiva diśānuktanāmapi śikṣaṇīyārthāntarāṇāṃ sukaranirvāhatvaṃ cābhipretya brahmasūtrāṇyeva bhagavān bhāṣyakāraḥ prārabhate vivarītum ||
evaṃ prāripsitasya prabandhasyāvidhnaparisamāptipracayagamanārthaṃ smṛtyācārasiddhamiṣṭadevatopāsanarūpaṃ maṅgalaṃ śrautamācarati  akhiletyādinā ślokena |
maṅgalācārayuktānāṃ nityaṃ ca prayatātmanām | japatāṃ juhvatāṃ caiva vinipāto na vidyate ||
iti hi smaryate |
ācāryate ca tattatprabanddhṛbhiḥ, śrotṛbuddhimanassamādhānārthaṃ śāstrārthasaṅkṣepaścārthataḥ kriyate | yathā codanāsūtreṇa dhamarsvarūpaṃ pramāṇañca śrutyarthābhyāṃ nirūpitam | prasiddhaṃ hi śrotuḥ pratipattisaukaryāya vakturarthapratipādanasya saṅkṣepapūrvakatvam | "iṣṭaṃ hi viduṣāṃ loke samāsavyāsadhāraṇa"miti śāstrātharsaṅkṣepeṇa vastunirdeśo bhavatvityāśīrvādaśca kṛtau bhavataḥ | "vinateti" "bhaktirūpe"ti ca brahmaṇi prahvībhāvāvagamāt praṇatirapi phalitā | ṇamu prahvatve iti hi dhātuḥ | evaṃ trividhaṃ maṅgalamācaritaṃ bhavati | ślokasya prathamapādena pūrvasyādhyāyadvikasyārthaḥ saṅkṣiptaḥ | dvitīyena tūttaradvikasya | karmamīmāṃsāyāṃ pratipādyabhedena ṣaṭkabhedavadatrāpi viṣayaviṣayirūpapratipādyabhedena dvikabhedaḥ | śāstrapratipādyamupāyopeyātmakam tiddhopāya upeyañca brahma | sādhyovāyo bhaktiḥ | tatra saptamyantaiḥ padaiḥ siddhopāyarūpamupeyañca brahmocyate | bhavatīti bhuvanaṃ kāryavarmaḥ | rūḍhiśaktayā tatkāraṇasya kulālādito vyāvṛttiḥ | bhuvanaśabdo hi vipulatarakāryaviśeṣe rūḍhaḥ | akhilaśabdena sarvadeśasarvakālavartīnyaṇḍajātāni vivakṣitāni tena brahmādivyāvṛttiḥ | khilaṃ nāstītyakhilaṃ kāryeṣu brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭayādivyāpārāviṣayabhūtaṃ na kiñcidityarthaḥ | anayā vyatirekoktayā prāyikattvānivṛttiḥ | "ajñātaṃ nāsti te kiñcidi"ti vat | ataḥ sakalamityanvayamukhenānuktiḥ | akāropakramatvasiddhaye nikhiletyanuktiḥ | "a" iti bhagavato nārāyaṇasya prathamābhidhānaṃ bhagavato vācakam, "akāraṃ prayuñjānena kinnāma maṅgalaṃ na kṛta"miti cābhiyuktairabhyadhāyi | atra bhagavadvācitvāvivakṣāyāmapi bhagavadvācakatvaśaktiyogādakāro māṅgalikaḥ | "aiuṇ" ityatrākāravat | naño niṣedhavācitve'pi niṣedhyavaśācchubhatvāśubhatve ato "niṣpratyūhamupāsmaha" ityādinirdeśasyeva śubhataratvaṃ, vaikalyaniṣedhena paupkalyaparatvāt | akhilaśabdena cidacidbhedo'pyabhipretaḥ | "janma" nityanaimittikaprākṛtarūpaṃ, 1"sthemā" sthitiḥ | sā cāntaryāmiviṣṇvavatāralokapālamanvādinṛpamātāpitrādimukhena kriyamāṇā bahuvidhāvivakṣitā | "bhaṅgaḥ" | nityanaimittikaprākṛtarūpaḥ | mokṣasya layāntarbhave'pi śāstrasya paramaprayojanatvādatra sa nāntarbhāvitaḥ | ata evādiśabde'pi nāntarbhāvyaḥ | tasya sādhāraṇatayā sphuṭapratipattihetutvābhāvāt | pṛthageva hi pūvarśca spaṣṭataraṃ nirdiṣṭo mokṣaḥ | "jagadudbhavasthitipraṇāśasaṃsāravimocanādayaḥ" iti | "jagajjanmasthitidhvaṃsamahānandaikahetava" iti ca bhagavān bhāṣyakāraśca tathā nirdiśati | yathā vedātharsaṅgrahe "udbhavasthitipralayasaṃsāranivarttanaikahetubhūta" iti, bhāṣye ca "nikhilagajadudayavibhavalayamahānandaikakāraṇa"miti "vinate" tyādipadena sthemāntarbhūtasvargādisaṃsārikaphalapradatvasya pṛthaguktiranapekṣitā | śāstrāsādhāraṇasya paramaprayojanasya mokṣasyaiva hi pṛthaguktayapekṣā | ādiśabdena sṛṣṭayādyaupathikanmataḥ praveśaniyamanādi gṛhyate | tathā ca bhāṣye svayameva vakṣyati "jagadutpattisthitisaṃhārāntaḥ praveśaniyamanādilīla" miti janmasthemabhaṅgoktayaivāntaḥ praveśaniyamanāderarthasiddhatvāśrayaṇamayuktam | adhyāsapariṇāmapakṣayostasyārthatvābhāvena tadyvāvṛttyarthaṃ svamate pṛthagvaktavyatvācchābdatve sambhavatyārthatvakalpanā'yogādvistareṇoktasyārthasya saṃkṣepoktau vivakṣitatvopapatteśca "līlā" śabdena bhagavataḥ paripūrṇatvānanyapreyartvasvacchandaceṣṭitatvādikamabhipretam | yathoktaṃ mahābhārate "aprameyo'niyojyaśca yatra kāmagamo vaśī | modate bhagavān bhūtairbālaḥ krīḍanakai rive"ti | aprameyatvaṃ paripūrṇatvam | aniyojyatvamanitaracetanapreryatvaṃ | yatra kāmagama ityanena vāyūdakādipreraṇādhīnā'buddhipūrvaparispandādiceṣṭāvyāvṛttiḥ |
svecchākṛtapravṛttividhātavyudāso vā svādhīnalīlopakaraṇatvaṃ vaśiśabdārtaḥ | viśvaṃ vaśe yasya sa vaśī | indriyavyāpārādhīnaceṣṭāvyāvṛttyartho vaśiśabdaḥ, bālakrīḍanakadṛṣṭāntena līlāyāḥ prayojanāntaranairapekṣyamabhipretam | anena rājñāṃ paṇabandhapūrvakadyūtādivyāvṛttiḥ | kāryavargāpekṣayā bhagavanmahimno vipulataratvaṃ "krīḍanakai"rityanena phalitam |
nanu prayojakavyāpāro hi līlā, ato bhaṅgasya līlātve yukte'pi kathaṃ prayojyavyāpāramūrtayorjanmasthityorlīlātvam | ucyate  "bahu syāṃ prajāyeye"ti hi śrutiḥ | ataḥ prayojakavyāpāravat prayojyavyāpārasya ca līlātvakathanenopādānatvaṃ phalitam | līlāśabdena nimittatvaṃ ca | "bhaṅgādī"tyantena prathamādhyāyārthaḥ saṃkṣiptaḥ | avāptasamastakāmasya vyāpārānupapatiṃta pariharitā līlāśabdena virodhaparihāraparadvitīyalakṣaṇārthaḥ sūcitaḥ | evaṃ pūrvādvikoktaṃ kāraṇatvarūpaṃ paratvaṃ saṃkṣiptam | tasyaiva parasya brahmaṇaḥ samāśrayaṇīyatāpratipattyarthamuttaradvikoktamabhigamyatvamokṣapradatvalakṣaṇaṃ saulamyaṃ saṅkṣipyate | "vinate"tyādipadena kevalaṃ paratvaṃ kevalaṃ saulabhyaṃ ca kanakācalaloṣṭaśakalayoriva na samāśraṇīyatvāya kalpata iti tadubhayavyāvṛttyatharmidaṃ padadvayam | viśeṣeṇa natāḥ prahvībhūtā vinatāḥ nyāsopāsanātmakāśeṣavidyāviśeṣaniṣṭhāḥ sarve vivakṣitāḥ | vaividhyaṃ ca "taduparyamapi vā varāyaṇa sambhavāt" "ūrdhvaretaḥ su ce" tyādinā vakṣyamāṇadevatvamanuṣyatvavarṇāśramādibhedena janmavṛttaguṇaiścābhipretaṃ bhagavanajñānena labdhasattākatvaṃ bhūtaśabdārthaḥ | "asti brahmeti cedveda santamenantato vidu"riti hi śrutiḥ | labdhasvarūpāṇāñca "teṣāmevānukampārthamahamajñānajaṃ tamaḥ | nāśayāmyātmabhāvasthaḥ" | "dadāmi buddhiyogantam" | "ahaṃ smarāmi madbhaktami"tyādyuktaprakāreṇa sākṣātkāravirodhinivarttanādikaṃ hi bhagavata eva bhara iti | na svarūpapracyuti sambhavaḥ | bhūtasambandhī vrāto bhūtavrātaḥ | saṃśritasambandhino'pi tata eva kāraṇādamagaktā rakṣyā ityabhiprāyaḥ | yathā "āsphoṭayanti pitaraḥ pranṛtyanti pitāmahāḥ | vaiṣṇavo naḥ kule jātaḥ sa naḥ santārayiṣyatī "ti | "paśurmanuṣyaḥ pakṣī vā ye ca vaiṣṇavasaṃśrayāḥ | tenaiva te prayāsyanti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padami"ti ca |
nanu ṣaṣṭhayantanirdiṣṭānatiriktaviṣayaḥ samudāyaśabdaḥ | yathā "brāhmaṇasamāja" iti | naivam | rājapariṣadityādiṣvatiriktasyāpi darśanāt, samāsāntargatāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhayāḥ sambandhamātraviṣayatvāt ṣaṣṭhayantanirdiṣṭānatiriktatvaniyamasyānuśāsanābhāvācca samudāyaśabde śrute samudāyādinaḥ ke? ityapekṣāyāṃ saṃnihitaśabdavācyaniṣṭhaḥ samudāyaḥ śīghraṃ pratīyata iti brāhmaṇasamūha ityādiṣvanatirekapratītiḥ | rājapariṣadityādiṣvatiriktasyāpi darśanāt tattatsamudāyagrāhakapramāṇānurodhenārthavarṇanaṃ yuktamiti yathokta evārthaḥ | evaṃ ca sati brātaśabdaprayogasyārthavattvaṃ syāt iṣṭaprāpaṇaparyantāniṣṭanivāraṇalakṣaṇā rakṣā tasyāmekadīkṣaḥ pradhānadīkṣaḥ "dīkṣā" saṅkalpaḥ svasattāyā api saṃśritarakṣāsaṅkalpanirvarttanasyātyantābhimatatvaṃ prādhānyam | "apyahaṃ jīvitaṃ jahyā"miti hayuktam | "kāmamātmānaṃ bhāryāṃ putraṃ vāparundhyānnatveva dāsakarmakarami"ti cāpastambaḥ | īdṛśīyaṃ smutiryasyājñā tasyāpi tathānuṣṭhānasyābhimatataratvam "apyahaṃ jīvitaṃ jahyā" mityanenāvagamyate | dīkṣāyāḥ prādhānyena rakṣāprādhānyaṃ phalitam | dīkṣāśabdenāśritasaṃrakṣaṇasya svaprayojanatvaṃ darśitam | vratabhraṃśasamāptyoranarthābhyudayaphalatvaṃ hi vratina eva, saṃśritarakṣaṇaṃ ca tadvratam | yathā "dadāmyetadvrataṃ mame"ti | vinatarakṣāśabdāyāṃ tṛtīyacaturthādhyāyārtho saṃkṣiptau | evaṃ jagatkāraṇatvamokṣapradatve kathite, etadve hi rājñaḥ chatracāmaravad brahmaṇo'sādhāraṇaṃ cihnaṃ | paratvasaulabhye ca saṃśrayaṇīyatānimittatayāvagate yathā "ya enaṃ viduramṛtāste bhavantī "tyupakramya "saṃbāhubhyāṃ namati sampatatraidyāvābhūmī janayan deva eka" iti, sarvalokamaheśvaraṃ suhṛdaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jñātvā māṃ śāntimṛcchatī "ti ca | prameyaśarīraṃ sādhīyaḥ yadi pramāṇamupalabhāmahe ityapekṣāyāṃ dvikadvayaśeṣabhūtacatuḥ sūtryarthaṃ vadan prameyānurūpaṃ pramāṇaṃ darśayati | śrutibhirasi vidīpta iti | śrutiḥ, anenāpauruṣeyatvānnirdoṣatvaṃ vivakṣitam | ata eva pūrvamīmāṃsānyāyānāṃ prāmāṇyādyupayogināmatropajīvyatvaṃ sūcitam, śiraḥ śabdenānanyaparatvaṃ vivakṣitam | paratattvapradhānā mantrabrāhmaṇabhāgā hyupaniṣadaḥ "vidīpte" pūrvabhāge'pi agnīndrādirūpatayā brahmaṇa eva pratipādyatvaṃ "tadevāgnistadādityastadvāyu,rityādinopaniṣadvākyenaiva jñāyata iti | viśeṣeṇa dīptaṃ vidīptaṃ yadvā kṣudrasukhasādhanabhūtaduḥ svātmakapravṛttinivṛttirūpaṃ prayojanaṃ pūrvabhāge dīptaṃ brahma tu svayaṃ niratiśayānandarūpatayā paramapuruṣārthabhūtamuparitanabhāge viśeṣeṇa dīptamiti bhāvaḥ | anena samanvayādhikaraṇārthaḥ sūcitaḥ | tatpūrvādhikaraṇatrayārthaścātra dyotito bhavati vyutpattilakṣaṇasauṣṭhavābhāve śrutiśirovedyattvāyogāt, śrutiśiraḥ śabdasya śemuṣīśabdopādānena jñānakarmasamuccayamatavyāvṛttiḥ | bhaktirūpeti vākyārtajñānavyāvṛttiḥ | "śuddhabhāvaṅgato bhaktayā śāstrādvoḍima janārdanam" | "bhaktayātvananyayā" "jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena "bhavatvi"ti bhaktereva svādutamatayā prārthanīyatā sūcitā; yadvā na hi bhaktiḥ sarvebhyopi svadataityatrāha "mameti" mama pratibandhakapāparahitasya; śāntapittasya hi kṣīre svādutamatābuddhiriti bhāvaḥ | rakṣaikadīkṣe parasminnityantaiḥ saptamyantaiḥ padairupeyabhūta eva siddhopāya uktaḥ"bhaktirūpe"ti siddhopāyaḥ | atra śloke śāstrapratipādyaikadeśabhūtaḥ parapakṣapratikṣepaścārthataḥ sūcito bhavati | janmasthemabhaṅgādiśabdena yugapatsargādikamanabhyupagacchanto bhāṭṭaprābhākarā vyāvarttitāḥ līlāśabdena sākṣimātreśvaravādihairaṇyagarbhavyudāsaḥ vinatetyādipadena jīvānāṃparasparaṃ brahmaṇā ca bhedamanubhyapayantobrahmājñānavādino'pāstāḥ, śrutiśirasītyanena vedabāhyacārvākavuddhārhanmatanirāsaḥ, tenaiva padenānumānikeśvaravādino vyudastāḥ, brahmaṇītyanenābrahmātmakapradhānaparamāṇukāraṇavādisāṅkhayavaiśeṣikādivyudāsaḥ | śrīnivāsa śabdena pāśupatādivyudāsaḥ | anenaiveśvarottīrṇabrahmavādino bhedābhedavādino vyudastāḥ, śemuṣī śabdena jñānakarmasamuccayopāyavādivyudāsa bhaktirūpetivākyārthajñānamātropāyavādivyudāsa ityevamanusandheyam ||
śruterevopāyopeyāvagatau satyāṃ kiṃ bhavatovaktavyamityatrāha "parāśaryeti" prathamaślokena svaprabandhasya paramaprayojanatayā siddharūpaḥ paramaviśeṣayodarśitaḥ sādhyarūpaṃ prayojanaṃ ca rakṣāpadenātisaṅkṣiptam | atha dvitīyena ślokena svaprabandhasyāvāntaraviṣayaḥ, paramparayā brahmaviṣayatvaṃ, svaprabandhaṃ prati samyagjñānasyāvyavahitāvāntaraprayojanatvaṃ, paramparayā mukteḥ paramaprayojanatvaṃ, svavyākhyeyasya pramāṇamūlatākathanena vyākhyeyāntarāṇāmapramāṇamūlatā, svavyākhyeyaviṣayabhāṣyāntaravyāvṛttyarthaṃ svoktārthasya sāmpradāyikatvamityādiśrautamucyate, stutyātmakagurūpāsanarūpamaṅgalācāraścāyartaḥ kriyate "jāyamānaṃ hi puruṣaṃ yaṃ paśyenmadhusūdanaḥ" | "tadviddhi praṇipātena" "dadāmi buddhiyoganta"mityādibhirācāryopasatterapi bhagavatkaṭākṣahetukatvāvagamāt paradevatopāsanānantarabhāvitvaṃ gurūpāsanasya yuktam | tathā ca śrutiḥ "yasya deve parā bhaktiryathā deve tathā gurā"viti | pūrvairapi tathā caritam | yathā bhagavato vaiśampāyanena "namaskṛtya hṛṣīkeśam" namo bhagavate tasmai vyāsāye"ti | yathā ca dramiḍācāryaiḥ | "namaḥ pravaraguṇaikāspadāya sthiratrasakulabījakumbhabhūtāya bhuvanakośasya goptre brahmaṇe namo jaiminaye vedarahasyasampuṭanikūḍhavisphārayitre nyāyaprajvalitacetase namostvācāryebhya" iti | pāścāttyaiśca "viśuddhajñānadehāya" "abhivandya gurūnādā"viti "praṇamya hetumīśvaraṃ muniṃ kaṇādamanvata" iti | pārāśarya śabdena janmotkarṣaḥ "sahovāca vyāsaḥ pārāśaryaḥ" iti śrutisiddhaḥ | tasyaiva vādarāyaṇasaṃjñatvaṃ ca vivakṣitam, yathoktam maharṣiṇaiva "dvīpe badarikāmiśre bādarāyaṇamacyutam | parāśarātsatyavatī putraṃ lebhe parantapa"miti, yadyapi ṛṣyantare'pi bādanārāyaṇaśabdaprayogaḥ, tathāpi sūtrakṛdviṣayo bādanārāyaṇaśabdaḥ pārācaryagocara eva, tathā ca skānde vyaktamuktam |
nārāyaṇādviniṣpannaṃ jñānaṃ kṛtayuge sthitam | kiṃcittadanyathā bhūtaṃ tretāyāṃ dvāpare khilam ||
gautamasya ṛṣeḥ śāpāt jñāne tvajñānatāṃ gate | saṅkṣīrṇabuddhayo devā brahmarudrapuraḥ sarāḥ ||
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurnārāyaṇamanāmayam | tairvijñāpitakāryastu bhagavānpāṣottamaḥ ||
avatīrṇo mahāyogī satyavatyāṃ parāśarāt | utsannānbhagavānvedājjahāra harissvayam ||
caturddhā vyabhajattāṃśca caturviṃśatidhā punaḥ | śatadhā caikadhā caiva tathaiva ca sahasradhā ||
kṛṣṇo dvādaśadhā caiva punastasyārthavittaye | cakāra brahmasūtrāṇi yeṣāṃ sūtratvamañjasā ||
alpākṣaramandigdhaṃ sāravadviśvatomukham | astobhamanavadyaṃ ca sūtraṃ sūtravidoviduḥ ||
nirviśeṣitasūtratvaṃ brahmasūtrasya cāpyataḥ | saviśeṣāṇi sūtrāṇi hyaparāṇi vido viduḥ ||
mukhyasya nirviśeṣeṇa śabdo'nyeṣāṃ viśeṣataḥ | iti vedavidaḥ prāhuḥ śabdatattvārthavedinaḥ ||
evaṃvidhāni sūtrāṇi kṛtvā vyāso mahayaśāḥ | brahmarudrādideveṣu manuṣyapitṛpakṣiṣu ||
jñānaṃ saṃsthāpya bhagavān krīḍate parameśvaraḥ || ityādinā ||
vacassudhāṃ vacaśabdasyārthe tātparye yathā "vedavicchāstravit" ityādau vedādiśabdānāṃ arthābhidhāyakaṃ hi vākyam | vacasaḥ sudhāmiti kecidācāryāḥ rūpakaprakaraṇāt, sudhāśabdalakṣaṇābhayācca; sudheva vaca iti "upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhi"rityādisamāsamapara ācāryā ādriyante | sudhāśabdena bhogyatvamabhipretam | evaṃ matāntaraviṣaya uktaḥ | tarhi kathaṃ brahmaṇo savaṣayatvamiti śaṅkāyāṃ sadvārakaṃ brahmaviṣayatvamityāha  upaniṣaditi | brahmaṇyupaniṣaṇṇetyupaniṣat "upaniṣaṇṇatvādvopaniṣadi"ti hi vākyam | "gahane hīyaṃ vidyā sanniviṣṭe"ti tadviṣayaṃ dramiḍabhāṣyam | "gahane brahmaṇyupaniṣaṇṇe"ti bhāṣyaviṣayā vāmanaṭīkā, advārakabhagavatpratipādakatvaṃ upaniṣaṇṇatvam | dugdha  śabdena pūrvabhāgādapyupaniṣadaḥ sāratvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ yathā "āṇyakaṃ ca vedebhyaḥ auṣadhībhyo yathā'mṛtamiti  abdhi  śabdena ālocitānāmupaniṣadāmānantyādi sūcitam | madhya  śabdena sarvavākyānāṃ mukhyārthāparityāgo'bhipretaḥ, madhyasya sarvaparyantadeśāpekṣayā tulyā hyāsattiḥ uddhṛtaśabdenā'tinimnadeśanimagnoddharaṇamapyabhidadhatāṃ niśśeṣāthargrahaṇaṃ sūcyate | svaprabandhasyāvāntaraviṣayaḥ pārāśaryasūtraṃ tasyāvāntaraviṣayaupaniṣat | tadviṣayabhūtaṃ brahmeti paramparayā brahmaṇaḥ pratipādyatvaṃ bādarāyaṇasūtrāṇāmupaniṣanmūlakatvakathanena sāṃkhyādigranthānāmapramāṇamūlatvāttadanādareṇaitadyvākhyānamiti sūcitam | praṇāḍyā śāstrajanyaṃ paramaprayojanamāha  saṃsāreti |
saṃsārāgniśabdena saṃsārasya kārtsnena tāpatrayarūpatā vivakṣitā, yathā "svargepi pātabhītasya kṣayipṇornāsti nivṛtti"riti | dīpana  śabdenā'saṅkocāt sadābhijvalanavācinā vidyālabdheḥ pūrvaṃ kadācidapyanivāryatvamabhipretaṃ
vaividhyamādhyātmikādirūpeṇa, teṣu triṣvekaikasyāpi śārīramānasādirūpaṣaṇa ca | ātmanāṃ prāṇa paramātmā | "sarvāṇi ha vā imāni bhūtāni prāṇamevā'bhisaṃviśanti" "kohyevānyātkaḥ prāṇyādi"ti śruteḥ gata śabdena tadalābhaḥ, upasargābhyāṃ tasyā'nāditvaṃ vividhatvaṃ ca vivakṣitaṃ, jñānadarśanaprāptiṣvanyatamasyāpyabhāvādalābhasya vaividhyam | sañjīvinī miti jīvanamujjīvanam saṃsāronmūlanam | sa miti kaivalyavyāvṛttiḥ |
atha sāṃpradāyikatvamāha  pūrveti | pūrvaśabdena śaṅkarādyarvācīnavyāvṛttiḥ surakṣitāṃ nopadeśamātreṇa grantharūpeṇa ceti bhāvaḥ | pūrvācāryagranthairarthasvarūpaṃ pratipannaṃ cet kiṃbhavataḥ kṛtya?mityatrāha  bahumatīti | bahvayo matayo bahūnāṃ matayo vā tāsāṃ parasparavyāghātena, tābhiḥ samīcīnārthavyāghātena ca arvācīnajanairduravagamatvamāha  dūrasthitā | iti na yathāvadapratītimātram, anyathā ca pratipattirāsīditi bhāvaḥ | sūtrādyavāntaraviṣayasya viṣayī svagrantha iti parve na kaṇṭhoktaṃ tadāha  ānītām | iti sudhāpakṣe nijākṣarairgāyatryavayabhūtairamṛtākṣarairiti yāvat, ato mamākṣarairityanuktiḥ sumanasaḥ  sārāsāravivekajñā ityuktāḥ anenāsadaparigraho na doṣāyetyuktaṃ bhavati, devādīnāṃ vṛttikāragranthaiḥ sugamatvāt  bhaumā ityuktam | pibantvanvahamiti | rasyatātiśayānnatṛptikarīti bhāvaḥ | phalāntarād bhagavatprāptyupāya eva hi svāduttamaḥ | yathoktam "kva nākapṛṣṭhagamanaṃ punarāvṛttilakṣaṇam | kva japo vāsudeveti muktibījamanuttama"miti | yadvā gambhīratvādanvahaṃ śīlanīyeti bhāvaḥ |
tarhi purātanagranthā eva vācayitavyāḥ kimapūrvagranthanirmāṇatatpravartanayatnagauraveṇeti śaṅkāyāmāha  bhagavaditi | bhagavacchabdena śaṅkarādivadanāptatvannāstītyabhipretam | bodhāyana śabdena pūrvācāryaśabdo'pyarthādvivṛtaḥ vistīrṇāṃ sañcikṣipuḥ ityanenavṛttyādīnāmatratyepvadyatajaneṣvakāryakaratvaṃ sūcitam | bodhāyanena hyativistīrṇīvṛttiḥ kṛtā; dramiḍabhāṣyakārādayo hi parapakṣapratikṣepādyanādareṇā'tisaṃkṣiptānūgranthānaracayan, ativimtīrṇātisaṃkucitagranthānāṃ sāphalyamāyuṣmadbuddhimajjanapracureṣu deśakālāntareṣu eva bhavati nahīdānīntanapuruṣāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śatāyuṣṭvaṃ yāvajjīyaṃ granthapariśramaḥ sahajadhīviśeṣāśca santi | tasmātparamatanirāsādyarthamanativistaratayā sugrahatvārthaṃ ca sūtraṃ vyākhyātavyamiti yāvat | tanmatānusāreṇa  na tu svotprekṣitamatāntareṇa sūtrākṣarāṇi | sūtrapadānāṃ prakṛtipratyayavibhāgānuguṇaṃ vadāmaḥ na tu svotprekṣitārtheṣu sūtrāṇi yathākathañcidyojayitavyānīti bhāvaḥ | vyākhyāsyante vyāṅbhyāmupasargābhyāmapekṣitavistarasaṃkṣepaudyotitau |
nanu "mūhyartho varṇyate yatra vākyaiḥ sūtrānukāribhiḥ | svapāni ca varṇyante bhāṣyaṃ bhāṣyavidoviduḥ" iti hi bhāṣyalakṣaṇam | ataḥ sūtravyākhyānarūpatvābhāvādakhiletyādikaṃ na bhāṣyāntarbhāvīti cenna | sūtratātparyārthaparatvād bhāṣyāntarbhāvyeva | sūtratātparyārthaparatvaṃ ca ślokavyākhyāne spaṣṭam | kiñca gaṅgalācaraṇaṃ prāripsitagranthāviptaparisamāptyādyarthatayā tadupayogīti tadantarbhāvyeva | śāvaraśāṅkarādibhāṣyeṣu namasakakārādaṇarnādatra namaskārakathanamayuktamiti cenna; "namaḥpabaraguṇaikātpadā" iti dramiḍabhāṣye devatāgurunamasakāraśravaṇāt | śābraśāṅkarayostu īśvarānabhyupagamāt jīvabrahmabhedānabhyupagamācca namasyānādaraḥ | atra tu siddhāntānurūpyāt namasyā atyantopapannā | śāṅkaragranthopakrame ca vyākhyātṛbhirnamaskārādyabhāvāt kugranthatvamāśaṅkaya, yuṣmadityādigranthena pratyagarthānusandhānenārthānmaṅgalācāraḥ kṛtaḥ iti pahihṛtam |
athāto brahmavijñāsā | pūrvaṃ padāni vyācikhyāsuḥ prathamamathaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe atrāyamathaśabda ānantarye bhavati iti | "padacchedaḥ padārthoktivirgraho vākyayojanā | ākṣepasya samādhānaṃ vyākhyānaṃ pañcalakṣaṇa"miti hi vyākhyāprakāraḥ |
nanu naitāvathātaḥ śabdau vyākhyeyau prayojanābhāvāt, ajāya saṃśaya viparyayanivṛttyarthaṃ hi vyākhyānam, na tāvadatrājñānaṃ ānantarye prakṛtasya hetubhāve ca, tayo prasiddhatvāt | nāpi saṃśayaḥ, arthāntareṣu satsvapi tayoruktārthaparatvena prasiddhiprācuryāt, na hi mośabdaṃ ṛṇvataḥ sāstrādimati saṃśayo jāyate, ata eva viparyayo'pi dūrotsā rita iti | atra brūmaḥ | ānantarya vṛttahetubhāvaparatvanirṇayasya pūvarvṛttaviśeṣāvagamasāpekṣatvāt tadapratipavyā prasiddhiprācuryasya sāpavādatvāt |
athaśabdasyādhikārādiṣu, etacchabdasya ca "etaduktaṃ bhavatī "tyādiṣu vakṣyamāṇe'rthe, taseśca sarvavibhaktayarthavācinaḥ "ita" ityādiṣu pañcamyarthavyatirikte'rthe ca prayogadarśanāt saṃśayaviparyayau syātāmiti tannirāsāyāthātaḥśabdavyākhyānaṃ yuktam (miti) | atastau vyākhyāyete |
atra tāvadatha śabdasyādhikārārthatvamayuktam | adhikāro hi prastāvaḥ brahmajijñāsā prastūyata iti vaco mandaprayojanam, prāyamyata ityuktivināpi prārambhādeva prārabhyamāṇatavāvagamāt, ucyamānaṃ hi vacanaṃ bravīmītyuktimantareṇāpi sannihitapuruṣeṇocyata ityevāvagamyate na tu nocyata iti, prastotavyatvamucyata iti cet | tadānīmapi nyāyapratipādakasya sūtrasyopadeśajñāpanaparatvābhāvādyuktitaḥ prārambhayogyetyarthaḥ syāt yogyatvamaśābdam | nanvadhyāhāraṇe yojanā syāt, ānantaryamakṣe'pi kartavyeti hyadhyāharttavyamiti cenna, adhikārārthatvapakṣe'dhyāhṛtasyāpi padasyānvayadaurṣaṭhyāt | yathā ca yogyetyukte samuccetuṃ yogyetyartho na śakyābhidhānaḥ, evamatha yogyetyukteṣyadhikartuṃ yogyetyabhidhānaṃ hi na śakyam | ata eva hi mahābhāṣye "śabdānuśāsanaṃ śāstramadhikṛtaṃ veditavya"mityuktam, na tvadhikartuṃ yogyamiti | adhikṛtamityapi phalitārthakathanam | na tu vācanikoktiḥ, cādīnāṃ dyotakatvāt | atra tvadhikṛtamityarthaparatve vaiyathyarmityuktam | śabdānuśāsanopakrame tvadhikārthatvamagatyāśritam | na hyupanītena vedamadhīyānenādhyetavyasya tadaṅgabhūtasya vyākaraṇasyāsādhāraṇo vṛtti viśeṣaḥ sambhavati | iha tu prayojanavadarthāntarasambhavādadhikārārthatvāśrayaṇamayuktam | ānantaryaparatve prayojanavattvaṃ ca vakṣyate | maṅgalaṃ tu nā'thaśabdavācyam | api tu śaṅkhasvanādivacchayamāṇo'thaśabdo maṅgalāvaha ityoṅkārasyevārthāntaraparatve'pi maṅgalaṃ sidhdyati | oṅkāratulyo hyathaśabdaḥ smaryate | "oṅkāraścāthaśabdaśca dvāvetau brahmaṇaḥ purā | kaṇṭhaṃ bhittvā viniryātau tasmānmāṅgalikāvubhā"viti | maṅgalavācitvābhyupagame'pi maṅgalarūpā brahmajijñāseti brahmajijñāsā stutā syāt, tataśca sūtrāsyārthavādatāsyāt, na tu nyāyanibandhanatvaṃ, jijñāsāviśeṣaṇatvābhāve maṅgalaṃ bhavatītivākyabhedaḥ syāt | prakṛtādarthādarthāntaraparatvaṃ cāyuktam | taddhi prakṛtamapekṣya vakṣyamāṇasyārthāntaratvajñāpanam | tacca kalpāntaropanyāsavivakṣāyāmeva dṛṣṭaṃ, atra tu kalpāntaropanyāsābhāvāttadanupapannam | praśnaparatvamapyayuktam | vacanavyakteḥ, praśnaprativacanarūpatvābhāvāt, tathā hi kiṃ brahmajijñāsā karttavyetyuktaṃ syāt sā karttavyeti vākyāntareṇa prativacanaṃ syāt |
na ca prativacanarūpaṃ vākayāntarabhupalabhyate | athaśabdasya kātsnyarparatve kārtsnena sā karttavyetyarthaḥ syāt | so'nupapanna ekadeśakarttavyatāyāḥ śaṅkitatvābhāvāt, karttavyatāmātraṃ hi saṃśayapadaṃ tannirāsārthaṃ ca sūtram | kiñca, adhikārādyarthāntaraparatvamataśśabdānvayo'pi nivārayati | ataśśabdo hi prakṛtamarthaṃ hetutayā parāmṛśannathaśabdopasthāpitaṃ brahmajijñāsāpadasāmarthyākṣiptam parāmṛśati | tatra yadyathaśabdopasthāpitamadhikṛtatvaṃ hetutayā parāmṛśet | tadā adhikṛtatvādadhikarttavyeti, hetoḥ sādhyāviśiṣṭatā syāt | maṅgalasyānabhidheyatayā na padāntaraparāmarśayogtā vācyatvābhyupagame'pi tasya ca prakṛtāpekṣatvasya kārtsnyasya ca pūrvapakṣayuktipratyanīkatvābhānna tāni hetutayā parāmarśanīyāni, na hyamaṅgalatvaprakṛtānapekṣatvākārtsnaiḥ pūrvapakṣotthānaṃ, nyāyasūtrāṇi ca viruddhārthavyudāsaparāṇi, praśnavākyagatapraśnastu tasminneva vākye hetutayā parāmarśānarha evakiṃbrahmajijñāsā karttavyeti vākye'parisamāpte kathaṃ kiṃśabdārtho hetutayā parāmṛśyeta, ato'taśśabdaparāmarśayogyārthaścedathaśabdo'bhyupagamyate tadā'dhikārādyarthatvaṃ na ghaṭate; yadi brahmajijñāsāpadasāmarthyākṣiptasya pūrvavṛttatvena tattadyvākhyātrabhimatasya vastuno'taśśabdena parāmarśa iṣyeta, tadānīṃ jijñāsānupayoginastadākṣeptavyatvāyogāt upayogyarthaeva tadākṣepya iti tatparāmarśinā'taśśabdena jijñāsopayogitayā pūrvabhāvyarthaviśeṣopasthāpanādathaśabdasya svārasikānantaryaparatve sambhavatyasvarasaviphalārthāntarasvīkārona ghaṭate, tataścātaśśabdavat brahmajijñāsāpadasāmarthyamapyadhikārādyarthaparatvanivārakaṃ syāt | evamarthāntarāṇāmanupapannatāmarthato darśayan ānantaryārthatvamapyathaśabdasyopapādayati | atrāyamathaśabda ānantarye bhavatīti "athaśabda ānantarya iti pratijñā, tadupapādakamatrā'yaṃ bhavatīti padatrayaṃ, tatra bhavatīti padena ānantarye svārasyaṃ sūcyate | svārasyāpavādikāṃ pūrvavṛttāpratipatiṃta pariharati "atrāyami"ti | atra vedasyottarabhāgavicārarūpabrahmamīmāṃsārambhasūtra ityarthaḥ | brahmajijñāsāpadasāmarthyāt pūrvabhāgavicārarūpavṛttaviśeṣa ākṣipta itibhāvaḥ | hetvantaramabhiprayannāha "aya"miti | ayamathaśabdaḥ "athaśabdānuśāsanam" "atha yogānuśāsana"mityādisūtrāntargatāthaśabdavyāvṛttaityarthaḥ, ataśśabdaśiraska ityuktaṃ bhavati | vedāntasāre hyayamarthaḥ kaṇṭhoktaḥ, prakṛtaparamarśinaitacchabdena pūrvavṛttasāmānyamabhihitamityabhiprāyaḥ | evaṃ samabhivyāhṛtobhayapadasvārasyāt sāmānyato'bhihitaṃ viśeṣata ākṣiptaṃ ca pūrvavṛttasiddhamitivṛttaviśeṣāpratipattirūpasya svārasyāpavādakasyābhāvādathaśabda ānantaryārtha eveti vākyārthaḥ | evamathaśabdasyottarabhāgavicārārambhasūtragatatvam | ataśśabdaśiraskatvamānantaryasvārasyaṃ ca darśayadbhiḥ ānantaryopapādakairatrā'yaṃ bhavatīti padairevāsmin sūtre arthāntarāṇāṃ gatyabhāvasvīkāryāṇāmanādaraṇīyatvaṃ phalitam |
ataśśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe "ataśśabdo vṛttasya hetubhāva" iti vṛttasyeti prakṛtyartha uktaḥ hetubhāvaiti pratyayārtha, iyaṃ pratijñā atrā'yaṃ bhavatītyanuṣaktaṃ padatrayamupapādakaṃ, prakṛtipratyavayoruktārthaparatvena pradiddhiprācuryaṃ bhavatinā darśitam | atretyasya pūrvavadarthaḥ | anena vṛttaviśeṣastasya hetubhāvārhattvaṃ cākṣiptaṃ, tadarhatvaṃ ca anantarameva vyaktaṃ bhaviṣyati, ayam ānantaryasvarasāthaśabdapūrvakaḥ, anena vṛttasāmānyamākṣiptaṃ, nanvathaśabdārthanirṇayo'taśśabdārthanirṇayasāpekṣaḥ, ataḥ śabdārthanirṇayaścāthaśabdārthanirṇayasāpekṣa ityanyonyāśrayaḥ | naivam | athaśabdasyānantaryasvārasyaṃ hi nātaḥ śabdārthanirṇayasāpekṣam | ataḥ śabdasya vṛttahetubhāvaparatvasvārasyaṃ ca nāthaśabdārthanirṇayasāpekṣam | athaśabda ānantaryaparaḥ svasvārasyāt, samabhivyāhṛtapadāntarasvārasyācca, ataḥśabdopi vṛttasya hetubhāvaparaḥ svasvārasyāt, samabhivyāhṛtapadāntarasvārasyācceti "bhavatyayaṃśabdābhyāṃ" darśitaṃ bhavati | ime cā'bhyuccayayuktī, atra padābhipretabrahmajijñāsāpadasāmarthyādeva padadvayasyoktārthaparatvasiddheḥ, ataḥ svaparapadasvārasyāt brahmajijñāsāpadasāmarthyāccā'thātaḥśabdau yathoktārthaparāviti na doṣaḥ |
nanu athātaḥśabdayoranyatareṇāla'miti cet, na | athaśabdasyānantarakālamupasthāpayato varttiṣyamāṇabrahmajijñāsāviśeṣaṇatayā, ataḥ śabdasya vṛttahetubhāvaparatayā cā'paryāyatvāt, pratijñāheturūpeṇa padayorbhinnaprayojanatvācca | brahmajijñāsā karttavyeti hi pratijñeti cet na | "brahmajijñāse"ti dharminirdeśaḥ | "atheti" sādhyadharmoktiḥ, na karttavyatāmātraṃ sādhyadharmaḥ, apitvānantaryaviśiṣṭaṃ karttavyatvam | evamathātaḥ padayoḥ pratijñāhetvarthatvena vibhāgo "athāto dharmajijñāse"tyatrāpi samānaḥ | evamarthabhedasyāvivakṣitatvena hi "atha yogānusāsanam" "atha śabdānu śāsana"mityādiṣvataḥ śabdāprayogaḥ |
nanu brahmajijñāsāsāmarthyākṣiptatayā buddhisthasya karmavicārasya hetubhāvo'taḥ śabdāvagantavya iti kimatha śabdena | maivam | ānantaryoktimukhena tasya hetoḥ śāstrāntaraśravaṇavyavadhānanairapekṣyadyotanārthatvādatha śabdasya, tataśca vedāntaśravaṇāt pūrvaṃ śākhāntaraśravaṇena vinā saṃpādayitumaśakyatvāt, śāstrāntarāṇāmanavasaragrastatvācca śāstrāntarasāpekṣāṇāṃ nityānityavivekādīnāṃ pūrvavṛttatvavyudāsaḥ phalitaḥ syāt |
nanu na yat kiñcidatītaṃ pūrvavṛttatvena vaktavyam atiprasaṅgāt | ato varttiṣyamāṇopayuktameva pūrvavṛttamatha śabdopasthāpitamiti tasya hetutvamapi śāstrāntaraśravaṇanairapekṣyavattenaiva vastusāmarthyena siddhamiti kimataḥ śabdena? naivam | atha śabdākṣiptahetvasiddhiśaṅkāparihārārthatvādataḥśabdasya hetuśca viśiṣṭaḥ, tasya viśeṣaṇāṃśaviśeṣyāṃśayorasiddhiśaṅkātatparihāraprakārau sūtrakārābhipretau parastāddarśayiṣyete, sati prayojanavattaraṃ padadvayam |
atretipadasūcitabrahmajijñāsāpadasāmarthyasiddhaṃ vṛttaṃ varttiṣyamāṇaṃ tayorhetumadbhāvaṃ ca vivṛṇyan uktamānantaryamupapādayati  adhīteti | karmajñānaśabdena vṛttamuktaṃ, brahmajijñāsāpadena varttiṣyamāṇamuktam | alpāsthiraphalānantasthiraphalaśabdābhyāṃ hetuhetumadbhāvo darśitaḥ | kevalaśabdena brahmajñānapūrvakakarmavyāvṛttiḥ | karmajñānasyaiva pūrvavṛttatvaṃ katham? anantasthiraphalāpātapratītiśca katham? iti śaṅkāyā "madhītetyādipadena tadupādānam | saśiraskavedaśabdena kṛtsnādhyayanasya vihitatvaṃ, vyākhyānapaurvāparyahetubhūtavyākhyeyapaurvāparyaniyamo bhāgadvayasyaikaprabandhatvaṃ ca sūcyate | sāṅgaśabdenānantasthiraphalāpātapratītijanakatvaheturdaśitaḥ | "kṛṣṇapakṣe tathāṅgāni" "upanīya tu yaḥ śiṣyaṃ vedamadhyāpayeddvijaḥ | sakalpaṃsarahasyaṃ ca tamācārye pracakṣata" ityādivacanānyadhītasāṅgasaśiraskavedasyetyatrābhipretāni evamadhītetyādiṣaṣṭhayantaviṇaśeṣaṇadvayeṇa brahmajijñāsāpadasāmarthyānugṛhītāthātaḥ śabdopasthāpito'dhikāriviśeṣaḥ pradarśito bhavati | samadhigatakarmā sāṃsārikaphalanirviṇṇo'nantasthiraphalākāṅkṣī hi śāstramadhikaroti |
anantasthiraphalabrahmajijñāseti | anantasthiraphalarūpasya brahmaṇo jijñāsetyarthaḥ | anantasthiraphalatvasya brahmajijñāsāviśeṣaṇatve jijñāsāyāstathātvamāgamotthavivekādijanyajñānadvāreṇeti dṛṣṭavyam | anantarabhāvinīti  padenāthātaśśabdaphalitaṃ hetoḥ śāstrāntaranairapekṣyaṃ vivakṣitam | karmavicārānantaraṃ brahmavicārasya kartavyatve karmaṇāmalpāsthiraphalāpātapratītirityayaṃ viśiṣṭo hetuḥ | ataḥśabdena vṛttasya karmavicārasya hetutayoktatvāt karmavicārasya sāṅgādhyayanajanyānantasthiraphalāpātapratītipūrvakatvādāvṛttividhānādibhiḥ karmaṇāmalpāsthiraphalatvāvagamahetutvācca | ayaṃ viśiṣṭo hetu "radhigatālpāsthiraphalakevalakarmajñānatayā sañjātamokṣābhilāṣasye" tyanenoktaḥ | atrā "dhigate"ti padena karmaṇaḥ phaladvārāhānāya jñātavyatvaṃ kaṇṭhoktaṃ, svarūpeṇopādānāya jñātavyatvamapi karmavicārapūrvavṛttatve hetuḥ | apekṣitakarmasvarūpajñānaṃ kevalakarmaṇāmalpāsthiraphalatvajñānaṃ ca karmamīmāṃsā'vaseyamiti hi vakṣyate, tatra svarūpeṇopādeyatāpratītiranantasthiraphalāpātapratītyantarbhūtā upāyataditikartavyatāviśeṣaiḥ sahaiva hyanannatasthiraphalāpātapratītiriti viśiṣṭahetvantarbhāvaṃ uparitanagranthāvirodhaśca |
nanu karmavicāro brahmavicārasya nirapekṣahetuścet kṛtakamarvicāraiḥ sarvairapi brahmavicāryeteti svagārthakarmānuṣṭhānābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ | maivam | aśrutamīmāṃsatve'pyupādhyāyādivacanād ye'nutiṣṭhanti teṣāṃ svargārthānuṣṭhānāvirodhāt | śrutvāpi ye svargārthinaḥ, teṣāmadṛṣṭavaiguṇyāt asamīcīnavyākhyānaśravaṇamūlasyāmumukṣatvasya saṃbhavācca | sāṅgādhyayanaṃ karmavicārasya pūrvavṛttaṃ cedadhītasāṅgavedaiḥ sarvairapi karma vicāryeta |
na ca tathā kriyate, vede'dhīte'pyaśrutakarmamīmāṃsā hi bahavo dṛśyante | teṣāṃ karmavicārānadhigatiradṛṣṭadeśakālādivaiguṇyāt na tu sāṅgādhyayanasya purvavṛttatvābhāvāditi cet tadihāpi tulyaṃ, tathā sādhanacatuṣṭayādilābhepyanadhigatabrahmavicārānekapuruṣadarśanāt sādhanacatuṣṭayāderbrahmavicāraṃ prati niyamena hetutvaṃ kathamiti paricodite tatpūrvavṛttatvavādibhirapyadṛṣṭādivaiguṇyādadoṣa iti pariharttavyaṃ, tadihāpi tulyaṃ, duṣpariharadūṣaṇāntarasadbhāvasteṣāṃ vaiṣamyam | tasmād ghaṭaniṣpatteḥ kulālādivad brahmavicārasya karmavicāraḥ pūrvabhāvitvena niyataḥ, dṛṣṭādṛṣṭapratibandhakavirahitasya samīcīnaḥ karmavicāro brahmavicārasāmagrīti na kaściddoṣaḥ | evamathātaśśabdārtho nirūpitaḥ |
atha brahmajijñāsāpadārthe vivakṣustadaikapadyasya samāsanibandhanatvāt prathamaṃ samāsārthaṃ nirūpayati "brahmaṇa" ityādinā, kamartvakaraṇatvādisambandhaviśeṣeṣu itarā vibhaktayaḥ "karmaṇi dvitīye"tyādibhiḥ sūtrairvihitāḥ | "ṣaṣṭhī śeṣa" iti sūtreṇa saṃbandasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī vihitā, atratasyāḥ sāmānyaviṣayatāmāśaṅkaya karmaviṣayatvaṃ niścīyate | tatra sāmānyena samāsasyānekavibhaktisādhāraṇatvādvibhaktayantaraśaṅkāvyāvṛttyarthamiha teṣāmanupapattimabhiprayan padaṃ vigṛṛhṇāti "brahmaṇo jijñāse"ti | caturthīparigrahe prayojanatvasiddhāvapi prakṛtivikārabhāvābhāve caturthīsamāsāyogāttadaparigrahaḥ | "saptamī "ti yogavibhāgād brahmaṇi jijñāseti samāse'pi brahmaṇo viṣayatvamātraṃ syāt, na tu prayojanatvamiti saptamyaparigrahaḥ | śaṅkulayā khaṇḍa itivat tṛtīyāsamāse viṣayatvaprayojanatve na sidhdyete ityabhiprāyaḥ | brahmaṇa iti śabdarūpasya ṣaṣṭhīpañcamīsādhāraṇyāt ṣaṣṭhayāśca'nekārthatvāttannirṇayārthamāha  brahmaṇa itīti | kuta ityatrāha "kartṛkarmaṇo"riti | ṣaṣṭhayāḥ kartṛkarmasādhāraṇyepi jijñāsākartṛtvaṃ tāpatrayāturasyaiva, brahmaṇastu karmatvamityabhiprāyeṇa brahmaṇaiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī tyuktam, karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhīsvīkāre brahmaṇo viṣayatvaprayojanatve siddhayetāmiti bhāvaḥ |
nanu tarhi kathaṃ "yadyapī "tyādeḥ sambandhasāmānyaparigrahaśaṅkāviṣayasya bhāṣyasyotthānaṃyujyate | ucyate | sambandhasāmānyasvīkārepi jijñāsāpadasāmarthyād brahmaṇaḥ karmatvasiddheḥ, paramparayā sambandhināmupāyopāsakapratibandhādīnāmapi jijñāsyatvasiddheḥ, pratipadavihitaṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaniṣedhācca | tatra sāmarthyāt ṣaṣṭhayāḥ karmārthatvasidiṃdha brahmānubandhināmapi jijñāsyatvasya sidiṃdha ca śaṅkate  yadyapīti |
"sambandhasāmānyaparigraha" ityatra pariṇā brahmānubandhināmapi jijñāsyatvasiddhiḥ sūcyate | parito grahaṇena hi paritaḥ sthitānāmapi grāhyatvaṃ labhyate | ata eva tvuttaratra "gṛhyata" ityuktaṃ na tu parigṛhyata iti | tadubhayaṃ pariharati  tathāpīti | atrā'yamarthaḥ pradhānasya brahmaṇo'pradhānānāmanyeṣāṃ ca karmatvasyākṣepasiddhatvādapi pradhānakarmatvasyābhidhānikatvamitareṣāṃ pradhānasambandhādākāṅkṣāvaśācca karmatvasya sāmarthyasiddhatvaṃ ca svīkarttuṃ yuktamiti, ataḥ pratipadavihitā ṣaṣṭhī grāhyā "vilambitadhīhetoḥ śīghradhīheturbalīyāni"tinyāyāt eṣaṣṭhayāḥ sambandhasāmānyavivakṣāyāṃ hi karmatvadhīrvilambitā syāt kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhīvivakṣāyāntu śīghrabhāvinī |
nanu karttṛkarmaṇorubhayorapyarthayoḥ sūtrapratipannatvād vilambitā karmadhīriti cenna | karttṛjijñāsoradhigatakarmaṇaḥ pratipannatvāt karmārthatvameva hi prathamataraṃ dhiyamadhirohet | samāsaniṣedhamāśaṅkaya pariharati  naceti | caḥ śaṅkāsamu ccaye | pratiprasavo'pavādāpavādaḥ, sarpiṣo jñānamityādiprayogeṣu "jñovidarthasya karaṇa" ityādisūtravihitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhayāṃ samāsaniṣedhasya sāvakāśatvaṃ, sarpiṣā pravṛttiriti hi tasya vākyasyārthaḥ | yadyapi jñānapadaṃ kṛdantaṃ tathāpi sarpiṣa iti ṣaṣṭhī na kṛdyogavihitā | sarpiṣā jānīta iti tiṅantapadānvayārhatvāt, dhātorvibhakteśca pravṛttitatkāraṇārthatvācca na ca tatsarvekṛdyogavihitatve siddhayati, ato nā'tra pratiprasavaprāptiriti samāsaniṣedhasya sāvakāśatvam |
nanu neyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī vyākhyeyā aprayuktatvāt | sūtre prayukta eva hi śabdo'rthabodhakaḥ natvaprayuktaḥ, bodhakaśabda eva hi vyākhyeyaḥ, aprayuktāpi smṛtā vibhaktirbodhaketi sā vyākhyeyeti cenna | tatsmaraṇena vināpyarthapratipatteḥ | arthapratipattiśca prātipadikena lakṣaṇayā, lakṣaṇā ca yogyatādinā, ato'nuśāsanena tadyvākhyānamayuktam | ucyate | aprayuktavibhaktayarthasya prātipadikena lakṣaṇā hi samāsaḥ, atra lakṣyārthopalakṣaṇatayā vibhaktiranupraviṣṭā, ato lakṣyārthaviśeṣanirṇayāya vigrahavākyasthā ṣaṣṭhī vyākhyeyā | tarhi nānuśāsanena sā vyākhyeyā, lākṣaṇikārtho hi yogyatādināvasīyate, na hi gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityatrānuśāsanavaśātkūlaṃ lakṣyate api tu yogyatādinaiveti | maivaṃ, sarvāsu lakṣaṇāsu yogayatādinaivārthanirṇaya iti niyamābhāvāt | satu niyamaḥ prātipadikena prātipadikāntarārthalakṣaṇāyām | prātipadikena vibhaktayarthalakṣaṇāyāṃ tvetadvibhaktayartholakṣyaḥ, na vibhaktayantarārtha iti hi niyamo bhavati, sa ca śabdānuśāsanādhīnaiti tadanurodhena tannirūpaṇaṃ yuktam | tatra sambandhasāmānyaṃ lakṣayitvā tena karmatvasyākṣepādapi prathamataeva karmatvasyaiva lakṣaṇā śabdānuśāsanānumatā yuktā, ataḥ samastapadalakṣyārthaviśeṣanirṇayāyā 'nuśāsanānurodhena lakṣyārthopalakṣaṇabhūtā vigrahavākyasthā ṣaṣṭhī vyākhyeyeti | yadvā luptavibhaktikaśabdena vibhaktayarthabodhanaṃ mukhyaṃ syāt | saṃbandhino hi lakṣaṇā dṛṣṭā na saṃbandhamātrasya | vibhaktayarthasya svayaṃ saṃbandharūpaḥ |
na ca sambandhasya sambandhāntarānapekṣatvena svasmin sambandhikāryakaratvāllakṣaṇā sambhavatīti vācyam | sambandhasya svaparanirvāhakatvānabhijñānāmapi vibhaktayarthapratīteḥ | na hi sambandhassvasattayā lakṣaṇāhetuḥ kintu
jñāyamānatayaiva | na cedatiprasaṅgāt | evaṃ lakṣaṇānupapattyā prayogasyānanyathāsiddhatvāt samastaśabdena vibhaktayarthabodhanaṃ mukhyam | amukhyatvepi vā kā naḥ kṣatiḥ |
nanu vigrahavākyepi kathaṃ karmatvamābhidhānikaṃ? prayujyamānāpi hyupapadavibhaktirnirarthikā tadvidhānaṃ dārāḥ kalatramitivatprayogasādhutvāya, arthastvarthasāmārthyākṣiptaḥ, ataeva hi kārakavibhakterupapadavibhakterdaubalyaṃ, samāse tvaprayuktāyā upapadavibhakteḥ kathantarāṃ karmābhidhāyakatmamiticeducyate | ābhidhānikatvavat kṛdantapadaprayogena śīghradhīviṣayatvasāmyādābhidhānikatvoktiḥ | padāntaraśravaṇāpekṣāmātrānnākṣepādivadvilambādhikyam | sāmānyaṣaṣṭhīpakṣe sambandhasāmānyaṃ pratipādya jijñāsāśabdārthagatasakarmakatvasvabhāvālocanayā'rthaviśeṣāvagamādapi kṛdantaśravaṇamātrabhuvaḥ karmatvadhiyaḥ śīghratvāditi kaścitparihāraḥ | "karmaṇi dvitīye"tivat "karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛtī "ti saptamyantanirdiṣṭayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇorabhidheyatvamanuśāsanasvārasyānuguṇamitibhāṣyakārābhipretaḥ parihāra iti sampradāyaḥ, kārakavibhakterupapadavibhaktivaiṣamyaṃ padāntarayogavihitatvarūpamastyeva |
na ca padāntarayogāvagamyatvamābhidhānikatvavirodhī, tasya kvacinmukhyārthavyavasthāpakatvadṛṣṭeḥ, yathā "ādityasya gāvaḥ prakāśayantī "tyādiṣu | na hi tatrādityādipadāntarayogena gośabdasya kiraṇaparatvaṃ lākṣaṇikaṃ padāntaraparāmarśasāpekṣatvena vilambitadhīheturupapadavibhaktiḥ, kārakavibhaktistu tannirapekṣatvācchīrghadhīheturiti prābalyadaurbalyavibhāgaeva, na tu sārthakatvanirarthakatvābhyāṃ vaiṣamyaṃ vibhaktayaśravaṇādamukhyatvantu parihṛtam |
evaṃ samāsāntargatavibhaktayarthe nirūpite samastayoḥ padayoḥ prathamaṃ brahmaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe  brahmaśabdena ceti | brahmaśabdasya pradhānādyarvācīnārthāntareṣu prayogadarśanādi taravyākhyātṛbhirīśvarātiriktavastuparatvena vyākhyātavyā, ddevatāntaraparatvasya kaiścidabhyupagamācca tadyvāvṛttyarthaṃ "brahmaśabdena puruṣotamo'bhidhīyata" itipratijñānīte | puruṣottamaśabdasya rūḍhyā brahmaśabdasya devāntaparatvavyudāsaḥ | avayataḥ śaktayā baddhamuktāvasthacetanavailakṣaṇyamuktam | svetaravailakṣaṇyamātraṃ tṛṇāderapyastīti tadavyāvṛttyarthaṃ "svabhāvata" ityādinā viśeṣaṇadvayena tadvailakṣaṇyaṃ viśinaṣṭi | idaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayaṃ śabdaśakterarthasāmarthyācca brahmaśabdasya puruṣottamaparatvapratipādanopayogitayoktam | na tu pravṛttinimittatayā guṇato'pi bṛhattve sati śabdaśaktayasaṃkocasiddhermumukṣoraśeṣadoṣanivṛttiniratiśayānandaprāptihetutvācca | vādyantaroktasyā'vidyādidoṣānvayasya nirguṇatvasya ca vyāvṛttyarthamupādhyupahitabrahmasvarūpasyaiva karmavaśyatvaduḥ svitvādivyāvṛttyarthaṃ jñānādiśaktiyoga evā'sya svābhāvikaḥ sārvajñyaniratiśayānandādiyogastu kādācitkaiti matasya ca vyāvṛttyarthamidaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayamuktam |
nirastakatipayadoṣatvaṃ nirastanikhiladoṣatvaṃ ca keṣāṃcid baddhānāṃ, nityānāṃ, muktānāmapyastīti tadyvāvṛttyarthaṃ  svabhāvato nirastanikhiladoṣa  ityuktam | nityasiddhānāmapi bhagavannityasaṅkalpādīnāṃ hi nityanirdoṣatvaṃ, svabhāvata ityuttaratrānuṣaṅgaḥ, tena guṇānāmapyavidyākalpitattvapakṣavyāvṛttiḥ "te ye śata" mityatra pūrvapūrvaguṇebhya uttarottaraguṇānāmatiśayaḥ sāvadhiriti tadyvāvṛttyarthamanavadhikātiśaya śabdaḥ, tatra hi brahmaguṇātiśayasya vāṅmanasāgocaratayā 'navadhikatvamuktaṃ, satyasaṅkalpatvāntarbhutā vaśitvādiguṇā iti hi vakṣyate, ataḥ kasmiṃścidguṇe tadvidhābhedarūpatayā guṇānāṃ bahūnāmantarbhāvābhiprāyo gaṇaśabdaḥ | nanvanavadhikātiśayaśabdasya guṇaviśeṣaṇatve gaṇaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvād bahubrīhirna syāt | gaṇaviśeṣaṇatvamapyayuktaṃ, guṇasvarūpasya anavadhikātiśayatvaṃ, na tu gaṇasvarūpasya naivam | gaṇa eva viśeṣyaiti bahuvrīhisiddhiḥ, tathāpyarthavaśād gaṇāntarbhūtaikaikaguṇavyakteranavadhikātiśayatvaṃ phalitaṃ syāt "yathaiṣā pariṣadabhijanavatī śrutaśīlaśālinī "tyatra śrutaśīlādīnāṃ pariṣadviśeṣaṇatve pratīte'pi tadantarbhūtānāmeva śrutādyanvayaḥ natu samūhasya tato nirgatānāṃ śrutādyabhāvaprasaṅgāt | asaṃkhyeyatvamapi gaṇaviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktaṃ, gaṇāsaṃkhyeyatve guṇāsaṅkhyeyatvaṃ kaimutyasiddham | anavadhikātiśaya śabdena nityasiddhavyāvṛttiśca | tadguṇānāṃ jagadyvāpārānanuguṇatvena bhagavadguṇāpekṣayā sātiśayatvāt, teṣāmīśvaratadguṇavibhūtisākṣātkārasyātyantānukūlasya niravadhikātiśayatve'pi tādṛśāsaṃkhyeyaguṇābhāvāttadyvāvṛttiḥ | anuṣaktena svabhāvata itipadena vā nityasiddhavyāvṛttiḥ | teṣāṃ tādṛśaguṇakatvaṃ hi bhagavannityecchādhīnaṃ, svarūpeṇā'navadhikātiśayatvābhāvācca nityasiddhavyāvṛttiḥ, te aṇusvarūpāḥ, atra svarūpasyā'navadhikātiśayatvaṃ garbhitam | vibhutvasyāpi guṇāntarbhāvitvāt, bṛhatvaṃ ca svarūpeṇa guṇaiścetyupapādakagranthoktaḥ | abhidhīyate  mukhyayā vṛttyā bodhyate | asmin granthe "yenākṣaraṃ puruṣaṃ veda satya"miti śrutiścetatsūtrānuvādinyanusaṃhitā bhavati, tatra hi "pravoca tāṃ tattvato brahmavidyā"miti puruṣaparyāyatayā brahmaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ |
evaṃ pratijñātārthaṃ śabdasāmarthyāt prathamamupapādayati  sarvatre tyādinā | tatrā'rthāntareṣu brahmaśabdaprayogasyānyathāsidiṃdha vivakṣustadupayuktaṃ guṇayogaṃ darśayati sarvatreti sarvatra brahmaśabdaprayogaviṣayeṣu sarveṣu bṛhattvaguṇayogostītyarthaḥ | puruṣottame gauṇatvamanyatra mukhyatvaṃ ca kinna syādityatrāha bṛhattvañceti bṛhattvaguṇamātrayogiṣu sarveṣu brahmaśabdāprayogāt svarūpato guṇataścānavadhikātiśayabṛhattvaṃ pravṛttinimittamityarthaḥ |
nanu "bṛhati bṛṃhayati tasmāducyate paraṃ brahma" "bṛhatvād bṛhaṃṇatvācca tadbrahmetyabhidhīyata" iti śrutismṛtibhyāṃ bṛhattvabṛṃhaṇatve ca pravṛttinimittayāvagate kathamiha bṛhattvamātraṃ nimittamucyate guṇato bṛhattve bṛṃhaṇatvasyāntargatatvāditi brūmaḥ "sacānantyāya kalpata" ityādiśrutiprasiddhasakalasaṅkocanivṛttipūrvakaniravadhikajñānavikāsarūpānantyāvahatvaṃ hi bṛhaṇatvaṃ, taddhi sakalaheyapratyanīkatvakṣāntikāruṇyādimokṣapradatvopayikaguṇagaṇavattvaṃ, ata eva hi svabhāvato nirastanikhiladoṣa ityādikaṃ pratijñāvākye'bhihitam |
nanu svarūpato bṛhattvameva nimikṣamastu kiṅgauraveṇeti cet | na | brahmaguṇāderapi svarūpeṇa bṛhattvād brahmaśabdavācyatvaprasaṅgāt | tarhi guṇato bṛhattvamevāstu nimittamiti cenna | śabdaśakterasaṅkocasya svataḥ prāptatvāt svarūpeṇa ca bṛhattvasambhavāt "satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahme"ti hi śrutiḥ |
guṇato bṛhattvannāma sadvārakabṛhattvaṃ guṇādvārā hi tat, svarūpeṇa guṇaiśca niratiśayabṛhattvavadvastu puruṣottamādanyadapi syādanyadeva vā syādityatrāha sa ceti caḥ śaṅkānivṛttau sarveśvaraśabdenaivakāreṇa ca "tamīśvarāṇāṃ paramaṃ maheśvaraṃ" "na tatsamaścābhyadhikaśca dṛśyata" iti vākyayugalārtho vivakṣitaḥ | tataḥ kimitvatrāha ataḥ iti ataḥ anavadhikātiśayabṛhati brahmaśabdasya mukhyatvat, sarveśvarasyaitādṛśabṛhattvaguṇayogitvāccetyarthaḥ | kathaṃ tatraiva mukhyavṛttaḥ anyatrāpi hi brahmaśabdaḥ prayujyataityatrāha  tasmāditi  tasmātbrahmaṇaḥ | sarvatra mukhyaḥ kuto na syādityatrāha  anekārtheti | parasmād brahmaṇo'nyatra prayogasyānyanyathāsiddhatvānna tatra śaktikalpanam | "ananyathāsiddhaḥ prayogaḥ śakiṃta kalpayatī "ti nyāyādityarthaḥ | anekaśaktikalpanaṃ gauṇatvaṃ vā na syād bṛhattvaguṇayogisavarvyaktiṣvekayaiva śaktayā mukhyatvasambhavādityatrāha  bhagacchabdavaditi  tathā ca śrīmati vaiṣṇave purāṇe bhagacchabdaṃ prakṛtyoktaṃ "tatra pūjyapadārthoktiparibhāṣāsamanvitaḥ | śabdoyaṃ nopacāreṇa anyatra hyupacārata" iti, anena prastutacodyasya kaḥ parihāra ukto bhavati? ucyate bṛhatidhātormaninūpratyayāntatvena niṣpannasya brahmaśabdasya pradhānādiṣu dṛśyamānaḥ prayogo nāvayavaśaktinibandhanaḥ, tathā hi sati bṛhanmahacchabdādivadāpekṣikabṛhattvayogiṣu sarvavastuṣu prayogaḥ syānna ca tathā prayujyate, trasareṇumapi hi tatoṇiṣṭhatayā'bhimatadravyāntarāpekṣayā bahimaguṇaśālīti vadanti | na ca tryaṇukādiṣu brahmaśabdaprayogaḥ | evaṃ sarvatra prayogadarśanāt paṅkajaśabdavyavasthāpakakumudādivyāvṛttatāmarasānuvṛttapadmatvajātivadbrahmaśabdaprayogaviṣaye pañcaṣavyaktayanuvṛttānyavyāvṛttākārādarśanādanekaśaktikalpane prāpte, ananyathāsiddhasya prayogasya śaktikalpakatvād brahmaśabdaprayogaviṣayeṣvanyeṣu ca bṛhattvaguṇaleśayogena prayogasyānyathāsiddhatvācca nānekaśaktikalpanaṃ yuktam | tasmātpuruṣottama eva pravṛttinimittapauṣkalyavati mukhyatvam | anyatraupacārikatvaṃ ca | "aupacārikastu prayogaḥ saṅkocasaha iṣṭaḥ na tu sārvatrika" ititamimaṃ nyāyamabhipretya bhagavacchabdasya puruṣottama eva mukhyatvamanyatrāmukhyatvaṃ ca bhagavatā parāśareṇoktam | tathāhi jñānādimātraṃ vā niraṅkuśajñānādikaṃ vā, bhagavacchabdapravṛttinimittaṃ, ādye pipīlikādāvapi bhagavacchabdaḥ prayujyeta, dvitīye tu sarvatra niravadhikajñānādyabhāvāt pravṛttinimittāsiddhernaikaśaktayā sarvatra mukhyatvam | anekaśaktikalpanaṃ cā'yuktaṃ prayogānyathāsiddheriti bhagavatparāśarābhiprāyaḥ |
nanu "utpatiṃta pralayaṃ caiva bhūtānāmagatiṃ gatim | vettividyāmavidyāṃ ca sa vācyo bhagavāni"ti granthokteṣvaupacārikabhagavacchabdaprayogayogyeṣuyadalaukikārthasākṣātkāritmasti tadeva pravṛttinimittīkṛtya bhagavacchabdaḥ sarvatrā'yaṃ mukhyaḥ syāt | naivam | alaukikārthasākṣātkaraṇamātrasya prayogāviṣayavyāvṛttatvābhāvānna hi samādhiparyantayogakāṣṭhāniṣṭheṣu keśidhvajakhāṇḍikyaprahlādādiṣu bhagavacchabdaḥ prayujyate | kiñca pratyakṣamūlavyutpattyā gavādiśabdānāmivā''gamamūlavyutpattyā samagraṣāṅguṇyādimatyeva tasya mukhyatvāvagamāt jñānaśaktibalaiśvaryavīryatejāṃsya śeṣataḥ | bhagavacchabdavācyāni vinā heyairguṇādibhi"riti nirdoṣatvaparyantānāṃ jñānādīnāṃ pravṛttinimittatayā vācyatvamucyate, nirdoṣatvañca nimittatayā vācyetvenocyate, anyathā taduktivaiyarthyāt, na hyavācyaṃ sarve niṣeddhavyamanuktavaiva hyavācyatvaṃ siddhayati |
na ca jñānaśaktayādiṣvekaikasya pravṛttinimittatvaṃ, kintu jñānādisamudāyasyaiva anyathā aśeṣata itipadavaiyarthyādaiśvaryasya samagrasyetyuktatvāt gavādiṣvatiprasaṅgabhayācca prakarṣaviśeṣavatāṃ jñānādīnāṃ samudāyasyaiva pravṛttinimittatvamuktamityabhyupeyam | evaṃ nyāyasiddhārthasyā''gamasiddhārtho bhāṣye dṛṣṭāntīkṛta "bhagavacchabdava"diti tathā bhagavatā pārāśaryeṇa "paraṃ jaiminirmukhyatvāt" "syāccaikasyabrahmaśabdava"dityādisūtreṣu brahmaśabdasya bhagavatyeva mukhyatvamuttaratroktam | ato yathokta evārthaḥ | tathā ca spaṣṭīkṛtaṃ śrīmati gāruṇḍe purāṇe, "vede bhūriprayogācca guṇayogācca śāṅgaṇi | tasminneva brahmaśabdo mukhyavṛtto mahāmune" ityārabhya "yasmin prayujyamāne tu guṇayogaḥ supuṣkalaḥ| tatraiva mukhyavṛtto'yamanyatra hyupacārataḥ" ityevaṃ śabdasāmarthyamupapāditam | atha brahmaśabdasyā'nekārthamukhyavṛttatveṣyetatsūtrasthasya tasyārthasvābhāvyāt puruṣottamaparatvamucyate | tāpatrayāturairiti  sa evāmṛtattvāyeti padai "stamevaṃ vidvānamṛta iha bhavati nānyaḥ panthā" ityādiśrutyartho vivakṣitaḥ | ata eva hi "puruṣottamo'bhidhīyate" ityuktaṃ śruterapi pūrvoktaheyapratyanīkatvakalyāṇakuṇākaratvaviśiṣṭi eva tāpatrayā turairupāsyaḥ, na tu teṣvanyatamaiti na hi kārāgāranigaḍita eva tanmocānāthirbhirabhyarthanīyaḥ, tathā ca vaiṣṇave purāṇe nirdoṣakalyāṇaguṇākarasyaiva mumukṣūpāsyatvamuktaṃ "sa sarvabhūtaprakṛtiṃ vikārān samastakalyāṇaguṇātmakosā" vityādinā tūjajñānamajñānamatonyaduktamityantena, brahmaśabdavyākhyānaṃ nigamayati, atonirdoṣamaṅgalaguṇākarasya sarveśvarasyaiva tāpatrayāturairjijñāsyātvādatra tāpatrayāturajijñāsyatayoktaṃ brahma sarveśvara evetyarthaḥ | yadvā "ataḥ" uktaśabdasāmarthyādarthasāmarthyāccetyarthaḥ |
nanu brahmaśabdo vyutpanno'vyutpanno vā bhagavati mukhyaḥ? avyutpannatve bodhakatvavirahiṇastasya na kvacinmukhyatvam | nāpi vyutpannaḥ sa mukhyaḥ alaukikerthe vyutpattyasaṃbhavāt kathamapratīte vyavahārāviṣaye buddhipūrvikā yādṛcchikī ca vyutpattiḥ sambhavati | ucyate | yathā kāminīcandanabhavanādiṣu prayogeṇa sukhaviṣayatayā vyutpannasya "yasminnoṣṇa"mityādyarthavādapadasamabhivyāhāreṇa laukikasukhaviṣayatayā vyutpattiḥ | yathā loke kvacidapyavyutpannatvepi yūpāhavanīya sphyakapālacapālacaṣālacātvālādiśabdānāṃ vākyāntarapadāntarasamabhivyāhārāttattadarśaviṣayatayā vyutpattiḥ | evaṃ brahmātmeśvarādiśabdānāṃ loke keṣucidartheṣu prayogād vyutpattau satyāmasatyāmapi | "yatovā imāni bhūtāni jāyante" "satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahme"tyādiprasiddhārthavākyāntarapadāntarasamabhivyāhārāt alaukikaparamātmaviṣayatvavyutpattirupapadyate | ato brahmaśabdasyoktarītyā bhagavatyeva mukhyatvaṃ yuktam |
atha jijñāsāśabdasya vyākhyeyatvasphoraṇāya prakṛtipratyayavibhāgaṃ darśayati | "jñātumicchā jijñāse"ti viṣayavailakṣaṇyādhīnāyā icchāyāḥ kathaṃ vidheyatvamityatrāha | "icchāyā" iti | jñānasya vidhānārhatāmāha "iṣyamāṇapradhānatvādi"ti sanvācyāyā dhātvarthaḥ karma, karmaṇaśca kriyā śeṣabhūtā tatsiddhayarthatvāttasyāḥ, yathā vāgīyabrīhyādeḥ prokṣaṇādiḥ | karttuḥ kriyayā āptamiṣṭatamatvaṃ hi karmatvam | ataḥ prakṛtyarthabhūtajñānakamirkecchā tatsiddhayarthā ata icchāyā iṣyamāṇajñānapradhānatvāt iṣyamāṇaṃ jñānaṃ vidheyamityarthaḥ | jijñāsāyāḥ karttavyatve pratīyamāne jñānasya kathaṃ vidheyatvam? ucyate | yathā snātvā bhuñjīta prāṅmukhobhuñjītetyatra bhujidhātorvidhipratyayāntatvād bhojanasya karttavyatve pratītepi snānaprāṅmukhatvaniyamayoreva vidhestātparyamityarthasvābhāvātabhyupagamyate, tayoraprāptatvāt "aprāpte hi śāstramarthavat" tatra bhojanaṃ cānyataḥ prāptamanudyate, evamicchāyā vidheyatvāsambhavāt tadviṣayabhūtaṃ vicārātmakaṃ jñānameva tātparyato vidhīyate | "iṣyamāṇaṃ jñānamihābhipreta"miti hi sāre'bhihitaṃ | sanantanirdeśaśca "nididhyāsitavyaḥ" "vijijñāsitavyaḥ" "tadvijijñāsattve" tyādiśrutyanusāreṇakriyate | śrutiśca upāyadaśāmamṛti bhagavajjñānasya prītirūpatvena icchāviṣayatvāttathā nirdiśati | yadvā "brahmajijñāse"ti sanantanirdeśo vicārasya rāgaprāptatvajñāpanārthaḥ | evameva dharmajijñāsetyatrāpi | atra tarkarūpaṃ jñānaṃ vidheyaṃ tarkānugṛhītavākyajanyapramitirūpajñānaṃ tu phalatvānna vidheyaṃ, pramitirūpaṃ vidheyaṃ tarkarūpaṃ jñānamārthamityapi parairuktam | antarṇītaṃ vicāramākṣipatīti tatopi prāguktapakṣaḥ sādhīyān vedāntārthavicārātmakanyāyanibandhanarūpaṃ hi śāstraṃ brahmamīmāṃseti prasiddhiḥ, pramitiśca phalam | ata eva hi brahmavicāraḥ kartavya iti bhāṣye vakṣyate | sanantasyā'sya jñādhātorjñānasāmānyavācino viśeṣākāṅkṣāyāṃ samucitaviśeṣaparyavasānaṃ hi nyāyyaṃ, brahmaṇo jijñāsā kartavyā na tu kapilasugatādyabhimatānāṃ pradhānāditattvānāmiti jñātavyaviśeṣanirṇayaparaṃ sūtraṃ vyākhyātaṃ yādavaprakāśācāryaiḥ, tadvāvṛttyarthaihaśabdaḥ, ihaasminnupakramasūtra ityarthaḥ | brahmaṇo jijñāsyatvamātre siddhe hi tasyaiva jijñāsyatvasiddhiḥ, na cobhayaṃ sūtrapratipādyaṃ brahma jijñāsyameva brahmaiva jijñāsyamiti vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt |
nanu brahmaṇo mumukṣubhirniyamena jijñāsyatvaṃ tantrāntarasiddhānāṃ pradhānādīnāṃ ajijñāsyatvena vinā na siddhayatīti brahmajijñāsyatvasamarthane pradhānāderajijñāsyatvasamarthanamarthādāpatatīti na vākyabhedaprasaṅga iti cet na | adhītakrameṇa vedārthe nirūpyamāṇe pūrvabhāgavicārānantaramuttarabhāgavicārasya pradhānādinirāsanirapekṣatvāt, na hyekasya prabandhasyaikadeśe nirūpite tadekadeśāntaranirūpaṇasya prabandhāntaraprameyanirāsasāpekṣatā bhavati, na hi pūrvaṣaṭkenirūpite uttaraṣaṭkanirūpaṇaṃ, kapilasugatādimatavyudāsena vinā na sambhavati, yadi vedāntārthasya śraddhārdaḍhimne taditarapakṣanirasanamapekṣitamiha kriyataiti mataṃ, tadanupapannaṃ kṛtakaratvaprasaṅgāt | etaduktaṃ bhavati ihapradhānādīnāmajijñāsyatvaṃ kiṃ vedāntanāmatatparatvopapādanena samarthyate? uta kapilasugatādyāyamāprāmāṇya tatprameyadausthyapratipādanena samarthyate? na prathamaḥ īkṣatyadhikaraṇādibhirvedāntānāmatparatvasya vakṣyamāṇatayā'tra vaktavyatvābhāvāt; na dvitīyaḥ vedaviruddhasmṛtīnāmaprāmāṇyasya pūrvamīmāṃsāyāmeva samarthitatvāt; sāṃkhyasaukatādyabhimataprameyadaussthyasya tarkapāde pratipādayiṣyamāṇatvāt | "vipratiṣedhāccāsamajjasam" "itareṣāṃ cānupalabdheḥ" "etena yogaḥ pratyuktaḥ" "udāsīnānāmapi caivaṃ
siddhiḥ" "antyāvasthiteścobhayanityatvādaviśeṣa" ityādibhiḥ sūtraistaduktamokṣatadupāyanirāsasyāpi kariṣyamāṇatayā cātra vaktavyatvābhāvāt | kiñca "etena sarve vyākhyātā vyākhyātā" ityatra | "anāvṛttiḥ śabdādanāvṛttiḥśabdā"diti śāstrānte ca sūtrābhyāsaphalamanuktāṃśajñāpanam | anuktāṃśaśca sāṃkhyayogāvagamayataiti vadatāṃ mokṣasya sāṃkhyayosamuccayasāpekṣatvaṃ ca pratipādayatāṃ saugatādivat sāṃkhyādinirāsena śārīrakasyaivārambhaṇīyatvapratijñānamiti ca vyāhataṃ sāṃkhyayogayorviruddhāṃśābhiprāyamanādaraṇīyatvakathanamiti cenna | viruddhāṃśānādraraṇīyatvasyavirodhādhikaraṇanyāyasiddhatvādeva, ato yādavaprakāśakṛtaṃ sūtratātparyavarṇanamanupapannamitīhaśabdābhiprāyaḥ | vidhīyata iti ajñātajñāpanaṃ vidhiriha vivakṣitam, na tvapravṛttapravarttanaṃ rāgataḥ pravṛttervakṣyamāṇatvāt | rāgataḥ pravṛttasyāpi pūrvapakṣayuktayā'nārambhaṇīyatābuddhau satyāmārambhaṇīyatvamāpanam hi ajñātajñāpanam ato vidhīyataityasya svayameva pravarttataiti vakṣyamāṇagranthenāvirodhaḥ | itthaṃ padārthā vyākhyātāḥ |
atha sūtrasya vākyārthamāha  mīmāṃseti | atra pūrvavṛttātkamarjñānād anantaraṃ tata eva hetorityathātaḥ  śabdārtha uktaḥ | brahma jñātavyamiti brahmajijñāsāpadārthaḥ  jñātavyam  vicārayogagyam | tata eva tyevakāreṇa śāstrāntarādhigamanairapaikṣyamathaśabdaphalitamabhipretam | uktaṃ bhavatīti śabdato'rthataśceti bhāvaḥ | kathamasya sūtrasyāyamartha iti śaṅkāyāṃ? tadupapādayati  mīmāṃse tvādinā | athātaityādipadānāṃ yathokta evārthaḥ karmabrahmamīmāṃsayoraikaśāstrāt, aikaśāstryaṃ ca niyatapaurvāparyabhāgadvayātmakavedākhyaikaprabandhavyākhyānarūpatvādityarthaḥ | atra vyākhyeyasya pūrvāparabhāvenāvasthitabhāgadvayarūpattvaṃ taddhetukaṃ vyākhyānasya paurvāparyaviśeṣaviśiṣṭabhāgadvayarūpattvaṃ, cobhayaṃ padayojanāyāṃ vākyayojanāyāṃ ca vaktavyaṃ, tathāpi granthalāghavārthaṃ padayojanāyāma "dhītasāṅgasaśiraskavedasye"ti vyākhyeyasya niyatapaurvāparyabhāgavadvayarūpatvamuktam | atra tu vākyayonāyāṃ vyākhyānasya niyatapaurvāparyabhāgadvayarūpatayaikaśāstryamuktam | ubhayatrobhayamanusandheyam | māgaśabdābhyāṃ mīmāṃsādvayasya ekāvayavitvaṃ sūcitam | pūrvoparitanaśabdābhyāṃ kramaniyama uktaḥ | karmabrahmaśabdābhyāṃ vṛttavarttiṣyamāṇakathanam | alpāsthiraphalatvānantasthiraphalatvābhyāṃ tayorhetuhetumadbhāvopapādanam | muktayupāyopayogitayā karmaṇāṃ svarūpeṇopādeyatāpratītiranantasthiraphalāpātapratītyantarbhūtā ataḥ pṛthaganuktiḥ | evaṃ kramaviśeṣaviśiṣṭaikavyākhyeyavyākhyānarūpatayā karmabrahmavicārayoraikaśāstryatvāt sūtrasya yathokta evārthaḥ |
pūrvapratijñātaṃ vṛttikāramatānusāraṃ vṛttigranthena samvādayati  tadāheti karmādhigamasyaiva pūrvavṛttatvaṃ kevalaṃ kaṇṭhoktam aikaśāstroktayākṣiptaṃcetyabhiprayannāha  vakṣyaticeti |
vṛttādityādiḥ saṃhitamityādiśca vṛttirganthau  śārīrakaṃ  brahmamīmāṃsā jagaccharīraḥ paramātmāśārīraḥ "tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātme"ti śruteḥ, tadviṣayaṃ śāstraṃ śārīrakamityucyate "ṣoḍaśalakṣaṇena" ṣoḍaśādhyāyena  saṃhitamiti niyatapaurvāparyaikavyākhyeyavyākhyānarūpatayā saṃhitamiti bhāvaḥ "arthaikatvādekaṃ vākya"miti nyāyena pradhānapratipādyaikyādyvākhyeyasya vedasyaikaprabandhatvaṃ bhavet, taccopapadyate puruṣārthaparatvādvedasya brahmaparatvādvā "sarve vedā yatpadamāmananti" vedaiśca sarvairahameva vedya" iti hi śrutismṛtī vedārthavicārasyānugatatvānmīmāṃsāyā ekaprabandhatvaṃ anenaikaśāstreṇa karmādhigamasya pūrvavṛttatvamākṣiptam |
nanu yadyaikaśāstryaṃ karmabrahmavicārayostarhi upakrame sādhāraṇorthaḥ pratijñāyeta "athāto vedārthajijñāse"ti nacaivaṃ pratijñātaṃ, kintu pūrvabhāgāsādhāraṇa eva pratijñātaḥ"athāto dharmajijñāse"ti | atra brūmaḥ brahmajijñāsetyevobhayabhrāmasādhāraṇārthapratijñā, karmavicārastu brahmamīmāṃsātṛtīyalakṣaṇacaturthapādena saṅgataḥ, brahmavicārāntarbhāvepi pṛthakkararamupapadyate yathā nigrahāntarbhūtacchalajātyorāhikabhedena pṛthaguktiḥ, yathā ca nigrahāntarbhūtahetvābhāsānāmadhyāyabhedena pṛthaguktiḥ, pṛthakkaraṇaṃ ca bahugranthapratipādyatvāt tatra ca pūrvabhāvitvamupajīvyopajīvakabhāvādivakṣyamāṇahetunibandhanam | etaduktaṃ bhavati, arthakramād brahmamīmāṃsātṛtīyalakṣaṇacaturthapādena karmavicāraḥ saṅgataḥ | pratipattisaukayarlakṣaṇakramāttu kamravicārasya pūrvabhāva iti evaṃ vā sādhamyarvaidharmyasamayorjātyoḥ kathanena yathā pratidharmasamobhayānuyāyinyarthasiddhā | evaṃ bhāgadvayāsādhāraṇārthapratijñādvaye kṛte sādhāraṇārthapratijñānamārtha syāt sādhāraṇārthe pratijñāte'pyasādhāraṇārthastu pṛthageva pratijñātavyaḥ, dharmajijñāsāyāṃ pratijñātāyāmapya "thātaḥ śeṣalakṣaṇam" "athātaḥ kratvarthapuruṣārthayorjijñāse" tyādau hyasādhāraṇārthapratijñā kṛtā, ato bhāgadvayāsādhāraṇārthapratijñānena tadanugatasādhāraṇārthapratijñānamārthaṃ syāditi prathama "mathātodharmajijñāseti" pratijñānaṃ na tu vedārthajijñāseti | athavā, athātodhamarjijñāsetyeva sādhāraṇapratijñā, alaukikaṃ śreyaḥ sādhanaṃ hi dharmaḥ, tadanuyāyipratipādyaṃ, dharmaśca sādhyasiddhabhedena dvividhaḥ, siddharūpe vastuni dharmaśabdaprayogo mahābhārate dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā"ye ca vedavido viprāye cādhyātmavido janāḥ | te vadanti mahātmānaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dharme sanātana"miti, tathābhiyuktaiśca laukikatve sati śreyaḥ sādhanatvaṃ dharmaśabdapravṛttinimittaṃ manyamānaiḥ siddharūperthe dharmaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ, dravyakriyāguṇādīnāṃ dharmatvaṃ sthāpayiṣyate | teṣāmaindriyakatvepi na tādrūpyeṇa dharmatetyādau, tatra dravyādisadbhāvepi kriyāprādhānyāt sādhyadharmaparaḥ pūrvabhāgaḥ | upāsanatadaṅgasadbhāvepi brahmapradhānatvāt siddhadharmapara ūrdhvabhāgaḥ | ata ubhayabhāgavicāraṇī prathamapratijñā tatra dharmaśabdasya sādhyadharmaviṣayatayā prasiddhiprācuryeṇa buddhisthatvāt pūrvabhāgapratipannatvena prāthamyāddharmajijñāsāpadenaiva tantreṇa vā arthatovā pratijñātatvopapatteśca, tallakṣaṇamuktaṃ codanāsūtre | siddharūpadharmaviśeṣasya ca sādhāraṇapratijñayaivārthataḥ pratijñātatvepi tasya bahugranthavyavadhānācchabdābodhyatvaśaṅkāparijihīrṣayā ca punaḥ pratijñā kṛtā, tasya lakṣaṇamuktaṃ janmādisūtraiti yuktamaikaśāstryam |
nanu pūrvabhāgasya sādhyadharmapradhānatoktirudāhṛtavacanena virudhyate tatra pūrvabhāgepi siddharūpasya parasya karmārādhyatayā pradhānapratipādyatvāvagamāt tasminvacane vedavicchabdo hi pūrvabhāvabhijñaparaḥ, gobalīvardanyāyāt "viṣṇunāmā sa vedeṣu vedānteṣu ca gīyata" ityanenaikārthyācca |
na ca guṇabhāvena karmaṇāṃ pratipādyatvamityavirodhaḥ, prādhānyena pratipādyatvasya naiminerabhimatatvāt bhavadbhirapi tathoktatvācca, satyam | vastutaḥ prādhānyaṃ paramātmana eva yathā rājñastātparyagocaratālakṣaṇaṃ, śabdaprādhānyantu karmaṇa eva yathā rājapuruṣasya, taccātiraskṛtaṃ tatra tasya paramātmārādhanarūpatvānavagamāt |
na ca tadavagamo'vaśyaṃ sampādyaḥ, antavatsvargādiphalapradatve karmaṇāṃ paradevatājñānanairapekṣyaṃ hi śrutismṛtibhyāmavagamyate "yo ha vā etadakṣaraṃ gārgyaviditvā'smiṃlloke juhoti yajate tapastapyate bahūni varṣasahasrāṇyantavadevāsya tadbhavati" iti "ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca, na tu māmabhijānanti tattvenātaścyavanti te" iti ca atastannairapekṣyalakṣaṇamapi prādhānyamasti karmaṇaḥ, ataḥ pūrvabhāge karmaṇaḥ prāgavagataṃ prādhānyaṃ paścādavagantavyaṃ paramātmārādhanarūpatvaṃ vāviruddham, ataḥ pratijñopapatteḥ śāstraikyaṃ yuktaṃ, yadyapi karmabrahmamīmāṃsayoraikaśāstryamavivakṣitaṃ jaimininā, tathāpi tadaṅgīkṛtya tadekaśāstratayā bādarāyaṇena brahmasūtrapraṇayanaṃ yuktaṃ, ataḥ, atadarthatayā klṛptamapi yogyamapekṣitaṃ tādathyarmarhati, grāme kalpyepūrvataḍāgavad vivakṣitatvasambhavaśca darśitaḥ | ataḥ śāstraikyaṃ yuktam | nanvidamayuktamaikaśāstryaṃ śārīrakaśabdasūcitāt pradhānapratipādyabhedāja jaiminīyaśabdasūcitāt kartṛbhedāt tadubhayaphalitāt prayojanabhedādarthavirodhāccetyāśaṅkāṃ pariharati  ataḥ pratipipādayiṣiteti | ataḥvṛttikāroktādekavyākhyeyavyākhyānarūpatvasambandhādityarthaḥ | ṣaṭkabhedaḥpūrvamīmāṃsāyāmadhyāyabhedastatrottaratra ca nidarśanārthamuktau, arthabhedābhāve hyekaṃ ṣaṭkamekodhyāyo vā syāt, ata ekāvayavitve siddhe satyavāntarārthabhedo na mahāvākyaikatvavirodhī, yathā padārthabhedo vākyārthaikatvāvirodhīti bhāvaḥ | anena pratipādyabhedaḥ parihṛtaḥ | prayojanabhedaścā'rthātparihṛtaḥ | ṣaṭkadvayacintitaprakṛtivikṛtiprayojanabhedasya śāstrabhedakatvābhāvāt, anena vṛttigranthagataṣoḍaśalakṣaṇaśabdatātparyaṃ ca darśitaṃ | pūrvottaramīmāṃsāśabdena jaiminīyaśārīrakaśabdau ca vivṛtau | pratipipādayiṣitaśabdenārthavirodhaḥ parihṛtaḥ pratipādayitumiṣṭaṃ hi pratipipādayiṣitaṃ sa ca tātparyaviṣayo'rthaḥ, viruddhatayā pratīyamāneṣu devatānirāsādiṣu na tātparyamityabhiprāyaḥ | nanvevaṃ kathamabhidhīyate? "āmnāyasya kriyārthatvāditi" siddhaparavākyānāṃ taccheṣatvaṃ hi sūtrakāreṇa kaṇṭhoktaṃ tacca virudhdyata eva, ataḥ śāstrabheda iti | naivaṃ "pade juhoti" "āhavanīya juhoti" "na hiṃsyāt sarvābhūtāni" "paśumālabhete"ti vat | śāstrāntare "karmaṇyaṇ" "āto'nupasarge ka" iti vacca utsargāpavādanyāyena śāstraikyāvirodhāt, sāmānyena siddhaparavākyānāṃ kriyāśeṣatve'bhihite siddhaparavākyaviśeṣasya kiṃ vidhiśeṣitvaṃ naveti vicārya svayaṃ puruṣārthavirahiṇāmeva siddhaparāṇāṃ kriyāśeṣatvaṃ svayaṃpuruṣārthaparyavasāyināṃ tu siddhaparavākyānāṃ na taccheṣatvamiti hi nirṇetuṃ yuktaṃ, yathā homasya sāmānyenāhavanīye prāptatvepi homaviśeṣasya pade karttavyatsaniścayaḥ yathā ca sāmānyato hiṃsāniṣedhepi hiṃsāviśeṣasya karttavyatoktiḥ, tathā ca sāmānyena kamarṇyupapade ghātoraṇi prāpte'pyākārāntāddhātoḥ kapratyayavidhiḥ |
naca tatra śāstrabhedaḥ, tadvad devatānirākaraṇe ca na tātparyam | aśrutavedāntānāṃ karmaṇyaśraddhānirākaraṇāya karmaprādhānyaparatvāttasya "nahi nindā nidyaṃ nindituṃ pravarttate, api tu ninditāditaravat praśaṃsitumiti" hi nītividaḥ, yadvā vedaprāmāṇya karmāvaśyakartavyatātātparyātiśayāt tatpratipakṣanirācikīrṣayā'nvāruhyavādo devatānirāsoktiḥ syāt, abhimatatarārthānādareṇāpi hi vipakṣavyudāso dṛśyate yathā "abhīṣṭātharvyayenāpi jayati kṣetrahāriṇam | labdhakṣetrairna duṣprāpaḥ syādartha iti niścayāt" evamabhimatatareśvarānādareṇāpi vedaprāmāṇyādisamarthane paścādabhimatasiddhirayatnalabhyeti jaiminerabhiprāyaḥ, tatsiddhiprakāraśca taduktarātrisatranyāyādyadhīna ityuttaratra vyaktībhaviṣyati |
naca tatsiddhimabhyupagacchatastadanādaravādavyāghātaḥ tasyānvāruhyakṛtatvāt kathamanvāruhyavādatvaniścayaḥ? ucyate "sampatteriti jaiminiḥ" "anyārthaṃ tu jaiminiḥ" "paraṃ jaiminirmukhyatvāt" | brāhmeṇa jaimini"rityādibrahmasūtraireva jaininerbrahmasvarūpatadguṇatadupāsanatatphalādyabhyupagamasya pratipannatvāt | mahābhārate ca hayaśiraupakhyānādiṣu bhagavadyvāsopadeśalabdhaparamātmatattvajñānatvāvagamācceti | ato viruddhe'rthe tātparyābhāvānnātharvirodhaḥ | nanvarthavirodho duṣpariharaḥ, tathā hi viśeṣātideśanirūpaṇapare aṣṭamādhyāye vikṛtiṣu prakṛtidharmātideśe katravye sati kasmin karmāṇi kasya karmaṇo dharmātideśaḥ prāpta ityapekṣāyāṃ yasya karmaṇo yena karmaṇā dravyasāmyaṃ devatāsāmyaṃ vā bhavati tasmiṃstaddharmottideṣṭavya sati sthitaṃ, tatra yasya kenacid dravyasāmyaṃ kenaciddevatāsāmyaṃ ca bhavati tasmin dravyasāmyavata eva karmaṇo dharmātideśaḥ kṛtaḥ, na tu devatāsāmyavata iti dravyaprādhānyamuktaṃ jaimininā "dravyadevatāsāmye dravyaṃ balīya" iti |
na ca dravyaprādhānyokterativādattvamanuṣṭhānavirodhāt dravyaprādhānyenahyanuṣṭhānandṛśyate, ato dravyaprādhānyaṃ vadato jaiminerdevatānirāse tātparyamastīti | atrocyate | nā'tra dravyadevatayoḥ sadbhāvāsadbhāvābhyāṃ prādhānyāprādhānye vivakṣite, api tu vilambitāvilambitapravṛttipramāṇaviṣayatvādhīne, dravyaṃ hyavilambitapratyayagamyaṃ devatā tu vilambitaśāstragamyā vilambāvilambāveva hi śrutiliṅgādiṣu pratyakṣādiṣu ca pūrvottaraprābalyadaurbalyahetū |
nanu haviṣṭvaṃ śāstraikagamyamiti na dravyasyāpi prādhānyamiticet naivaṃ carupuroḍāśādikaṃ dravyaṃ hi pratyakṣaṃ haviṣṭvākyadharmamātrameva tatra śāstragamyaṃ devatāyāstu svarūpaṃ, śreyaḥ sādhanatvādidharmaścobhayamapi śāstragamyam | ataḥ svarūpato dharmaśca vilambitamānagamyatvād devatāyā aprādhānyaṃ dharmamātrasya śāstragamyatvepi dharmyaṃśenāvilambitamānagamyatyavāddhaviṣayaḥ prādhānyamataḥ prādhānyāprādhānyayoḥ pramāṇadvārakatvena svarūpāsadbhāve tātparyaṃ nāstīti devatānirāsoktiranyaparā | evamarthāntarāṇyapyavirodhena netuṃ śakyāniti nātharvirodhaḥ |
nanu brahmasūtreraiva jaiminipakṣamanūdya pratikṣepādarthavirodho duṣpariharaḥ, tathāhi "phalamata upapatte"rityatreśvarasya phalapradatvoktayā "dharmaṃ jaimini"riti dharmasya phalapradatvamanūdya pratikṣiptaṃ na śrutatvopapattibhyāṃ kālāntarabhāviphalasādhanamātre jaiminyabhihite tābhyāmevātra phalasādhanaviśeṣasiddheruktatvāt |
nanu śeṣatvāt puruṣārthavādo yathā "anyeṣviti jaimini"rityatra vedāntoditātmajñānasya karmaśeṣatayā''tmanāṃ kamarśeṣatvoktiradhikopadeśāditi siddhāntena virudhdyate |
na ca vikalpena nirvāhaḥ sambhavati, vastuni vikalpāyogāt |
na ca jaimininā paramatamupanyastamiti vācyaṃ jaiminimatattvena siddhāntinā pratikṣepāyogāt | naivam | vipakṣanirāsārthasya jaimineranvāruhyavādasya tathopanyāsapratikṣepopapatteḥ | anyathā "paraṃ jaimini"rityādisūtrāṇāṃ mithovirodhaḥ, bhāratoktivirodhaśca, jaimineranyavāruhyavādamajānatāntadukte tattvabuddhiḥ syāditi tannivāraṇāya brahmasūtre tadupanyāsanirāsau kṛtau | ataeva "parāmarśe jaimini"rityatra naiṣṭhikādyāśramapratikṣepopi parihṛtaḥ, tadbhūtasyetyatra naiṣṭhikādyāśramabhraṃśasya jaiminyanabhimatatvābhidhānāt, na hyāśramānabhimatau tadbhraṃśānabhimatisambhavaḥ | ato vītarāgavyatiriktānāmagnihotrādiṣvaśraddhānivāraṇārtha āśramāntarapratikṣepaḥ pūrvavadanvāruhyavādaḥ, sa ca pūrvamīmāṃsāyāmasūtritastathā'pyauḍulomyādimatavadanūdya nirastaḥ |
na ca madhuvidyāyāṃ vasvādyanadhikāroktiradhikāroktayā virudhyataiti vācyam | anatikāroktermadhvādidevatābhyupagamacihnattvena śāstraikyāviruddhatayā taduddhāṭanavaiyarthyād "bhāvaṃ jaimini"rityādisūtroktapakṣāśca śāstraikyaviruddhāḥ karmavicāre teṣāmasamarthanāditi na tatparyanuyogāvakāśaḥ, tasmānnārthavirodhaḥ, kartṛbhedaparihārastu prasiddhatvānnakaṇṭhoktaḥ ataeva caśabdasūcito vā dhūrttasvāmikapardikartṛkasyā''pastambasūtravyākhyānasya vyākhyeyaikyādekaprabandhakatvaṃ hi dṛṣṭam pāṇinīyasūtrapūrvottaravṛttyośca vāmanajayādityakartṛkayorvyākhyeyaikyādekavyākhyānatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tasmādupapannamaikaśāstryam |
astvaikaśāstryaṃ kathaṃ paurvāparyaniyama? iti śaṅkāṃ pariharan vṛttigranthasthaṃ "saṃhita"miti padaṃ vivṛṇoti |
mīmāṃseti  kramaviśeṣānvitamaikaśāstryaṃ saṃhitamityabhipretam ārabhyaivamantamiti paurvāparyāniyama uktaḥ  saṅgativiśeṣeṇeti  atrāmī saṅgativiśeṣā abhipretāḥ pāṭhakramacetanānāṃ trivarge prathamaprāvaṇyasambhavarūpo'rthasvabhāva aupanideṣvaṅgāṅgibhāvapratipādakavākyeṣu yajñādikarmaṇaḥ padāthartvena sambandhaḥ kāsucidvidyāsu yajñatadupakaraṇādīnāṃ dṛṣṭiviśeṣaṇatvoktayā karmabrahmavidyayordṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhāvo vidyākarmaṇorutpādyotpādakabhāvāt taccheṣabhūtavicārayostu tatkramabhāktavopapattirvyākhyānabhūtamīmāṃsāyāṃ ca uttarabhāgasya pūrvabhāgoktanyāyasāpekṣatvaṃ ceti, evaṃ paurvāparyaniyāmakasaṅgativiśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭakramaṃ kramaviśeṣavadityarthaḥ |
nanu bhavatu vedaprāmāṇyasiddhaye prathamādhyāyasya pūrvabhāvittvaṃ dvitīyādhyāyāt pūrvaṃ brahmavicāraḥ kiṃ na syāditi tatra tatroktaiḥ saṅgativiśeṣaiḥ ṣoḍaśalakṣaṇānupūrvīsiddhestadanantaraprāptatvāt brahmavicārasyetyabhipretya saṅgativiśeṣeṇa
viśiṣṭakrama mityuktam | evamatraikaśāstryaṃ paurvāparyaniyamaḥ śāstrasyārambhaṇīyatvaṃ ca trayaṃ pratijñātaṃ | pūrvoktasya sāṅgasaśiraskādhyayanasya pramāṇaṃ darśayan sādhanacatuṣṭayasampādanasyānavasaragrastatāṃ ca darśayan pratijñātārthatrayamupapādayitumāha  tathāhīti |
pratijñātārthatrayopapādanārthamavyayanavidhiṃ nirūpayati  prathamamiti |
nanu vedaprāmāṇyasamarthanamiva karmavicārasiddhamadhyayanavidhinirūpaṇaṃ kinnopajīvyate iti cetna; arvācīnavyākhyātṛbhirarthajñānaparyantatāyāstatroktatvāt | akṣararāśigrahaṇapayarntatvaṃ hi bhagavadbādarāyaṇābhimatam "adhyayanamātravataḥ" iti hi vakṣyate | atastatra vakṣyamāṇo'rthaḥ śāstrārambhaṇīyatvāyātra pratipādyate | adhyayanavidherakṣararāśigrahaṇamātraparyantatve nirūpite śāstrasyārambhaṇīyatvasiddhiḥ; kṛtsnaviṣayatvanirūpaṇena aikaśāstryapaurvāparyaniyamasiddhiḥ ||
kathamakṣaragrahaṇamātraparatve ārambhaṇīyatvam? ittham | adhyayanavidherarthajñānapayarntatve sati, arthajñānasya "adhītya snāyāt", "ācāryakulādvedamadhītyābhisamāvṛtya" iti yajñādyanuṣṭhānaśeṣatvena viniyogādupaniṣatsiddhasya brahmajñānasyāpi karmaśeṣatvāpattestasya ca jñānasya "ātmā vā idaṃ" "brahma vā idam" "ayamātmā brahme"ti trayyantathabrahmaśabdasyātmaparyāparyatvenātmaviṣayatvādātmajñānasya vrīhyādidvārā prokṣaṇāderivātmadvārā karmaśeṣatve sati dvārabhūtavrīhyāderiva dvārabhūtātmanaśca karmaśeṣatvaṃ syāt |
na ca samudradhyānavadātmajñānasya dṛṣṭadvārā karmaśeṣatvāt samudravadātmā na karmaśeṣa iti vācyam | karmaśeṣatayā'vaklṛptasvā''tmano dvārabhāve sambhavatyadṛṣṭakalpanāyogāt, samudrasya tu katūpakārakatvāsambhavena hyadṛṣṭakalpanam | nanvātmanaḥ phalapradatayā śeṣatvamastviti cet | na | sampratipannenātmanātmajñānasya karmaśeṣatve nirūḍhepyasampratipannātmakakalpanāyogāt | na hi jīvavilakṣaṇa ātmā sampratipannaḥ, ato'nuṣṭhānaśeṣabhūta ātmā karmasu kartṛbhūto jīva eveti vedāntānāṃ jīvaparatvena, tadatirikteśvare pramāṇābhāvādaprāmāṇikeśvaravicārarūpaṃ śāstramanārambhaṇīyaṃ syāditi prāpnuyāt, akṣararāśigrahaṇamātraparyantatve tvarthajñānasyānuṣṭhānaśeṣatvābhāvena karmasu kartṛbhūtajīvātiriktātmapratipādanasambhavāt prāmāṇikaparamātmavicārarūpaṃ śāstramārambhaṇīyaṃ syādityato'dhyayanavidhirnirūpyate | tatrā'dhyayanasya saktuhomavat pradhānakarmatvaṃ svarūpeṇa vidheyatvamadhyāpanavidhiprayuktatvamupanayanasyā'dhyāpanāṅgatvaṃ ca prābhākarābhimatamanādṛtyā'dhyayanasyāvaghātavat guṇakarmatvaṃ niyamasya vidheyatvamadhyayanasya svavidhiprayuktatvamupanayanasyādhyayanāṅgatvaṃ ceti kaumārilābhimatamarthacatuṣṭayamubhayānabhimatamakṣararāśigrahaṇamātraparyantatvaṃ ca saṅgraheṇa pratijānīte  prathamamiti | prathamaṃ tāvatprathamata eva "yāvattāvacca sākalye 'vaghaumāne 'vadhāraṇa" iti naighaṇṭukāḥ | prāthamyaṃ śāstrāntaraśravaṇayogyāvasthāpekṣayā pūrvabhāvitvam | garbhāṣṭamopanītasya hyadhyayanaṃ tataḥ pūrvaṃ śāstrāntarapariśramānarhatvādadhyayanavidhiparatantrasya sāṅgādhyayanānantaraṃ karmavicārāvaśyaṃbhāvasyasvarasasiddhatvācca, sādhanacatuṣṭayādipūrvavṛttāntaraniṣpādanasyānavasaragrastatvaṃ prathamaṃtāvadityanena phalitam | laukikākṣaragrahaṇavyāvṛttyarthovedākhyaśabdaḥ vedākhyaśabdena kṛtsnādhyayanaṃ ca sūcitam | na hi vedāntabhāgamātraṃ svādhyāyaśabdavācyam | "adhyayanene"ti nirdeśena guṇakarmatvaṃ sūcitaṃ bhāvārthasyānyaniṣṭhatvapratīteḥ | yadi pradhānakarmatvamavivakṣipyat tadā hi svādhyāyenādhyanaṃ saṃpādyamiti vacanavyaktirabhāviṣyat | evakāreṇa niyamavidhitvaṃ dyotitaṃ, na tu pustakanirīkṣaṇādinetyarthaḥ | "svādhyāyo'dhyetavya" iti adhyayanavidhivākyopādānena svavidhiprayuktatvaṃ sūcitam | na hyadhyāpayediti vākyamupāttaṃ, prāthamyavacanādadhyanasyopanayanāṅgatvaṃ na phalitaṃ, śāstrāntarapariśramāyogyagarbhāṣṭamavarṣābhiprāyeṇa hi prāthamyamuktam | adhyayanasya ca prāthamyama"ṣṭavarpaṃbrāhmaṇamupanayīte" tyupanayanaviṣayatayoktasya kālasya upanayanadvārādhyayanaśeṣatve satyeva hyupapadyate | evamarthapañcakaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa pratijñātaṃ bhavati asminnadhyayanavidhivākye'dhyayanasya prāthamyaṃ sāṅgatvamupanayanāṅgatvaṃ ca na pratītam "upanayīta tamadhyāpayedi"ti vākyāntareṇādhyayanasyādhyāpanavidhiprayuktatvamadhyāpanasyopanayanāṅgatvaṃ ca pratīyataiti śaṅkāyāmāha |
tacceti | caḥśaṅkānivṛttau | tat"svādhyāyo'dhyetavya" iti vākyapratipāditamityarthaḥ "ādye tvadhyayanenaiva kadācidasti phalaśrutiḥ, dhāraṇe japayajñe ca yā sāpyevaṃ nivārite"ti japāderapyadhyayanaśabdavācyatvātteṣu prastutādhyayanasyādhyayanattvaniścayāyāha  kiṃrūpamiti | kiṃ sakṛduccāraṇarūpamāhosvidasakṛduccāraṇarūpaṃ kiṃ vā svatantroccāraṇarūpamutaparatantroccāraṇarūpamityarthaḥ | paratantrāsakṛduccāraṇarūpatve hyādyādhyayanatvasiddhiḥ | kathaṃ  kimaṅgakamityarthaḥ | ityapekṣāyāma  pekṣitāni vidhīyante  ityanvayaḥ | prāthamyaṃ tantroccāraṇarūpatvamupanayanāṅgatvañca darśayitumāha  aṣṭavarṣamiti | aṣṭavarṣamityanenaprāthamyaṃ siddham upanayanadvārā'dhyayanaśeṣatvāt kālasya "brāhmaṇamupanayīte"ti dvitīyāśrutyā māṇavakaśeṣatvāvagamādupanayanasya tadgatādhyayanāṅgatvasiddhiḥ, upanayanasyākartrabhiprāyasūtravihitvācca nādhyāpanāṅgatvasiddhiḥ | "adhyāpayedi"tyanena paratantroccāraṇarūpatvasiddhiḥ |
"dvādaśāhena prajākāmaṃ yājayet" "annādyakāmaṃ yājayet" "niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayedi"ti pratipannasya yājayasyevārthārjanādyarthatayā rāgaprāptasyādhyāpanasyāvidheyatvādadhyāpane 'dhikātiviśeṣāśravaṇāccādhyayananasyādhyāpayitṛpūrvakatvamucyate, ityayamadhyanāṅgavidhiriti bhāvaḥ | upākarmādivrataniyamāṅgatvaṃ sāṅgatvaṃ ca darśayitumāha  āvaṇayāmiti | "arddhapañcamānmāsānityādī "tyatrādiśabdopāttaiḥ "ata urdhvaṃ tu chandāṃsi śukleṣu niyataḥ paṭhet | vedāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi kṛṣṇapakṣeṣu saṃpaṭhedityādivacanairaṅgādhyayanasya kālo darśitaḥ | vrata mupākamarkāṇḍavratādi  niyamaḥ  "padyuha vā etacchmaśānaṃ yacchūdrastasmācchūdrasamīpe nā'dhyetavyami"tyādyuktadeśakālabhakṣyādivyavasthārūpaḥ | adhyāpayedityanena vrataniyamaviśeṣopadeśaiśce"ti pṛthaṅnirdeśaḥ śrutitvasmṛtitvavibhāgādvipratipannatvasampratipannatvavibhāgācca kṛtaḥ | upākarmādivrataniyamavadupanayanamapyadhyayanāṅgamiti bhāvaḥ; kiṃ rūpaṃ? kathaṃ ca karttavyam? ityapekṣāyāmebhiraṅgavidhāyakavākyairapekṣitāni vidhīyante ityarthaḥ | nanu "aṣṭavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇami"tyatropanayanasyādhyayanāṅgatvamavagamyate ityuktaṃ, tadayuktaṃ, tasyopaneyāsattidvārā'dhyetṛsākāṅkṣādhyāpanāṅgatvaṃ hyavagamyate "upanīya tu yaḥ śiṣyami"tyādismṛtivacanācca tadavagamyate | ucyate | "brāhmaṇamupanīyate"tyatra dvitīyāśrutyā upanayanasyamāṇavakaśeṣatvamavagamyate māṇavakaśeṣamupanayanam adhyayanaṃ ca tadgataṃ tatrāntaraṅgabahiraṅganyāyādupanayanamadhyayanāṅgameva | nanu "upanīya tu yaḥ śiṣyaṃ vedamadh yāpayeddvijaḥ | sakalpaṃ sarahasyaṃ ca tamācāryaṃ pracakṣate" iti vacane vaktavāśrutyopanayanasyā'dhyāpanāṅgatvaṃ yuktam | antaraṅgatvaṃ hi vastusāmarthyarūpaṃ liṅgaṃ tataḥ vattvāśrutirbalīyasīti cet na | antaraṅgatvaṃ hi pratyakṣaśrutisiddhaṃ, śrutistu smṛtigatānuvādarūpavacanasthā ca, ato'syāḥ smṛtivacanasthatvānmūlaśrutisāpekṣatvaṃ, anuvādarūpavacanagatatvādvidhyantarasāpekṣatvamiti vilambadvayamasti, śrutiliṅgādiṣu vilambitadhīhetutvaṃ hi paradaurbalyahetuḥ, ato vilambadvayopahatāktavāśrutirna balīyasī | kiñca śrotriyopādhyāyagurvādināmavidhānavat tatprakaraṇasthamidaṃ vacanamupanīyādhyāpayiturācāryanāmavidhānaparamiti ktavāśrutirupanayanasyādhyāpanāṅgattve pramāṇaṃ bhavitumarhati | kiñca "svaritañcitaḥ kartrabhiprāye kriyāphala" ityātmanepade prāptepi "saṃmānanotsañjanācāryakaraṇajñānabhṛtivigaṇanavyayeṣu niya" iti punarvidhānasyākartrabhiprāyārthattvādupanayanasya nādhyāpanāṅgatvaṃ yuktam | "akartrabhiprāyārthoyamārambha" iti hi tadvṛttikāraḥ |
nanu kartrabhiprāyatvaṃ karttaryeva phalasyābhipretatvaṃ, tadavadhāraṇaniṣedhārthaṃ punarvidhānam, ataḥ phalamubhayānvayi, ato māṇavakadvāreṇācāryonvayyupanayanaphalamityadhyāpanāṅgatvaṃ yuktamiti cet | na | "agnīnādadhīte"tyatra kartrabhiprāyasūtravihiteṣyātmanepade phalasyobhayānvayitayā punarvidhānasya niyamaniṣedhārthatvābhāvena kartrabhiprāyatvamātrasya nirṣadhārthatvāt | ato nādhyāpanāṅgatvam | kartrabhiprāyaśabdena kartṛvyatiriktacetane phalānanvayovivakṣitaḥ ato na "agnīnādadhīte"ti vyabhicāraḥ, punarvidhānasya tannivāraṇārthatve phalasyācārye'pyanvayopapatteradhyāpanāṅgatvamiti cet | na | ṛtvijo vṛṇīta ityatra svatiretyādisūtravihite'pyātmanepade phalasya kartṛvyatiriktacetanānvayadarśanena punarvidhānasya niyamaniṣedhārthatvābhāvāt ataḥ kartrabhiprāyamātra niṣedhārthaṃ punarvidhānamiti nādhyāpanāṅgamupanayanam |
ata acāyakasyopanayanakriyānantarabhāvittvābhāvādavyahitaphalasya kartṛgatattvābhāvāccātmanepadasyāprāptau avyavahitaphalasyākatrarbhiprāyatve'pyātmanepadaṃ "sammānanetyā"disūtreṇa vidhīyate | ato'kartrabhiprāyārthatvepi vyavahitācāryakaniṣpattyarthatayā'dhyāpanāṅgatvamupanayanasyāviruddhamiti | cet | naivam | "agnīnādadhīte"tyatra svāritetisūtravihiteṣyātmanepade agnisaṃskāravyavahitāgnitvāpattirūpaphalasya kartranvayitvadaśarnādato'kartrabhiprāyārthaṃ sammānadetyādisūtraṃ phalamātrasya kartranvayanivāraṇārthaṃ saṃskāraviśiṣṭogniḥ phalamityādhānakattarri na vyavahitaphalonvaya iti cet tarhyupanayanasaṃskāraviśiṣṭamāṇavakasiddhirevāvyavahitaṃ phalamiti, kartrabhiprāyasūtreṇaivātmanepadasiddherakartrabhiprāyasūtravaiyarthyaṃ syāt |
yadyevaṃ vyavahitamavyavahitaṃ vā phalamātrakartrabhiprāyasūtreṇa nivāryate tarhyupanetuḥ pravṛttirnopapadyate yataḥ "prayojanamanuddiśya na mandopi pravarttate" iti | naivam | upanayanaphalasya māṇavakānvayitve'pyācāryāya varo deya iti vidhyantaraprāptadakṣiṇāphalalipsayā pravṛttyupapatteḥ |
na caitenākartrabhiprāyatvavirodhaḥ, asādhāraṇaphalānanvayaviṣaratvādakartrabhiprāyasūtrasya | avyavahitakriyāphalasya kartturabhimatattvaṃ kartrabhiprāyatvaṃ, tadanabhimatatvamakartrabhiprāyatvamityapyayuktaṃ, kriyāphalasya kartranabhimatatvavyāghātāt | ācāryakaniṣpattyupayogino māṇavakasaṃskārasyācāryānabhimatattvānupapatteḥ | ata upanayanamadhyeṣyamāṇamāṇavakāsattimukhena nādhyāpanāṅgam, api tvadhyayanāṅgameva | adhyayanaṃ ca nādhyāpanavidhiḥ prayuṅkte, "adhyāpayedi"ti tu "dvādaśohena prajākāmaṃ yājaye"dityādivadityuktam | yadyapi prajākāmamannādyakāmamitivat tatprayojyavyāpārasyādhyayanasyādhikāriviśeṣaṇaṃ phalaṃ na śrūyate tathāpi svādhyāyasiddhiradhikāriviśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, "svādhyāyo'dhyetavya" iti svādhyāyasyādhyayanasādhyatvāvagamāt | yathā "agnīnādadhīte"tyatrāgnīnāmāghānasādhyatvāvagamādagnisiddhiradhikāriviśeṣaṇaṃ, tadvat |
na ca svavidhiprayuktatve'dhyayanavidheranuṣṭhātrabhāvaḥ | santi hi prabuddhādhyetāraḥ | tathāha bhagavānāpastambaḥ "tasminnabhijanavidyāsamudetaṃ samāhitaṃ saṃskārarttāramīpsedi"ti teṣu paravidhiprayuktatve satyadhyayanaṃ nopapadyate | aprabuddhaviṣaye tu svatantrasyādhyayanavidhermāṇavakaviṣayatvaṃ jñātvā hitaiṣiṇo māṇavakamadhyayanādi kārayanti | ataḥ prabuddheṣvaprabuddheṣu ca svavidhiprayuktatvamadhyayanasya yuktam | paravidhiprayuktatve nityasyādhyayanasya kāmyavidhiprayuktatvaṃ syāt, tataścānuṣṭhānaniyamo na syāt | ācāryakakāmo hyadhyāpakaḥ, tasyācāryakakāmanāyā abhāve'dhyayanāsiddheḥ | adhyāpakabāhulanayāttatsiddhiriti cet, na adhyāpakebhyoṣyadhyetṛbāhulyadarśanāt | ādhānasyottarakratuvidhiprayuktatve'pi na kāmyavidhimātraprayuktatvaṃ "vasante vasante jyotiṣā yajeta" "yāvajjīvamagnihotraṃ juhotī "ti nityavidhisadbhāvādityevamādyanusandheyam | ato yathokta evārthaḥ | aṅgavidyupetena pradhānavidhinā'ṅgasvarūpamaṅgisvarūpaṃ ca kathaṃ pratipannamityatrāha |
evamiti | evamaṅgavidhibhiḥ saha pradhānavidhau nirūpite ityarthaḥ | satsantānetyādinā "tasminnabhijanavidye" tyāpastambavacanārtho'nusaṃhitaḥ | ātmaguṇā akrodhādayaḥ| anena samāhitaśabdārtha uktaḥ | vedavicchabdena vidyāsamudita śabdārta uktaḥ | vedavidācāryopanītasyeti ācāryaviśeṣaṇamupanayanadvārā māṇavakārthaṃ, yathā upanayanasyādhyāpanāṅgatve māṇavakaviśeṣaṇamācāryārthaṃ tadvaditi bhāvaḥ | vrataniyamaviśeṣayuktasya vrataniyamaviśeṣavadācāryaviśeṣaṇamapi māṇavakārthamiti bhāvaḥ | ācāryoccāraṇānūccāraṇamiti paratantroccāraṇarūpatā darśitā | akṣararāśigrahaṇaphalamitipadamasakṛdāvṛttirūpatvasyākṣepakaṃ darśayati, yathā "vrīhīnavahantī "tyatra dṛṣṭaphalalavasyāpyaparityājyatvenā'vahananasya vaituṣyaparyantatvād aśrutāpyāvṛttiḥ siddhā, tadvadāpi sāmarthyādāvṛttiḥ siddhā | dṛṣṭaprayojanāparityāgenaiva niyamasya vidheyatvāt | ācāryoccāraṇānūccāraṇamityanena, vedavidācāryopanīnītasyetyanena, cādhyayanasyādhyāpayitṛsāpekṣatvena paratantroccāraṇarūpatvaṃ, svavidhiprayuktattvamupanayanāṅgakatvaṃ coktam | acāryoccāraṇānūccāraṇamakṣararāśigrahaṇaphalamityanena "kiṃrūpa"mityākāṅkṣā śamitā, vedavidācāryopanītasya vrataniyamaviśeṣayuktasyetyanena kathaṃ ca karttavyamitiyapekṣā pūritā, akṣararāśigrahaṇaphalamityanena svādhyāyagrahaṇakāmatvamadhyayanādhikāriviśeṣaṇamityapi sūcitam | "saktūnjuhotī "tyatra puruṣasya saktuhomajanyādṛṣṭabhāktvāt saktuhomo yathā puruṣasaṃskāraḥ tadvadadhyayanasya puruṣasaṃskāratve'syākṣararāśigrahaṇaphalatvannasyāt, apūrvasidhyarthatayā svādhyāyasidhdyarthatvābhāvāt tataścākṣararāśigrahaṇaphalatvābhāvenāvṛtyasiddhaḥ sakṛduccāraṇarūpamevādhyayanaṃsyādityāśaṃkyāha  adhyayanaṃ ce tyupanayanāṅgatvavat svavidhiprayuktatvavadidaṃcopapādanīyamiti cārthaḥ |
