svādhyāyasaṃskāraḥ | na tu saktuhomavadapūrvaviṣayatayā puruṣasaṃskāra ityarthaḥ, kuta ityatrāha  svādhyāya iti tavyapratyayāt karmatvāgamaḥ svādhyāyasya hi karmatvāvagamaḥ, na puruṣasyakarttuḥ kriyayāptumiṣṭatamatvaṃ hi karmatvam ato'dhyayanaṃ svādhyāyasaṃskāro na tu puruṣasyetyarthaḥ nirvartyāderapi sādhāraṇakarmatvaṃ kathaṃ saṃskāratve hetutayocyata ityatra nirvartyavikāryatvānupapattimabhipretya svādhyāyasyetipunaḥ kīrtanam | vastusāmarthyasacivakarmatvāvagamaḥ saṃskāryatve heturitibhāvaḥ | phalantaresaṃbhavati prāpyatvamātraparyavasānaṃcāyuktaṃ | nanu va karmatvavāgamamātrātsaṃskāryatvaṃ "saktūnjuhoti" suvarṇaṃ bhārya"mityatra saktusuvarṇayoḥ saṃskāryatvābhāvāditi śaṅkāyāṃ saṃskārasvarūpaṃśodhayati  saṃskārohīti | hināmābhyāṃ prasiddhiḥ pratiyogyabhyupagamaśca sūcyate | apicetivadanekāvyayatulyarūpa ekaśabdo vā | yadyapi sata utkarṣārthānaṃ saṃskāraiti bhūtabhāvyupayogisaṃskārānugatalakṣaṇaṃ, tathāpi svādyāyasya bhūtopayogitvāsaṃbhavāt bhāvyupayogisaṃskāralakṣaṇamatroktaṃ, saṃskāralakṣaṇānupapattyā "saktūn juhetī "tyādiṣu pratyayasvārasyāvagatamapi karmatvaṃ bhagnamiti bhāvaḥ | atra tu na tathānupapannamityāha  saṃskāryatvaṃ ceti | caḥ śaṅkānivṛttau | kuta ityatrāha | dharmārtheti | puruṣātharcatuṣṭayatatsādhanetyanena pūrvoktavyākhyeyaikatvāya prayojanavadarthāvabodhanamanugatamiti darśitaṃ bhavati, puruṣātharparatvaṃ cānugataṃ, dharmādiṣu hi puruṣārthatvamanugataṃ, iṣṭatatsādhanayorubhayorapi puruṣārthatvāt | yadyapyarthakāmatadupāyeṣu kecillokasiddhāḥ, tathāpi dhaneśasureśādivibhūtirūpātiśayitārthakāmatatsādhanānāṃ, lokasiddhasya paśuputrānnādeścitrādisādhyasya ca laukikapramāṇāgocarattvāt | puruṣārthacatuṣṭayasya vedavedyatvoktiryuktā | avabodhitvāt, anuṣṭhānaupayikabodhajanakatvāditi bhāvaḥ | arthāvabodhakattvasya humādāvavyāptatvādāha  japādineti | svarūpeṇāpi  arthajñānānuṣṭhānābhyāmṛte japyamānenā'kṣaramātreṇāpītyarthaḥ | ādiśabdādadhyāpanagrahaṇam | anuṣṭhānānuguṇaṃ jñānaṃ, japādi, cādhyayanasaṃskṛtena svādhyāyenaivaityuktaṃ bhavati | yadvā puruṣāthartatsādhanāvabodhitvena saha tatsānatvaṃ caśabdena samuccīyate | tatsādhanatvaṃ dvidhājapādinā, dhriyamāṇena svarūpeṇa, ceti | ato'vāntarasamuccetavyasamuccayaparo'piśabdaḥ |
evaṃ niyamavidhitvaṃ copapāditaṃ bhavati | arthajñānaparyantattvaṃ kiṃśabdasvārasyādabhyupagamyate utārthānupapattyā? itivikalpamabhipretya tatra śabdasvārasyaṃ prativadannadhyayanavidhinirūpaṇamupasaṃharati evamiti | mantravaditi | pṛthaṅnirdeśo vratāntarbhāvena vādhyayanopakārakamantrābhiprāyaḥ | asti hi śannomitrādimantrāṇāṃ vratānanupraveśenāpi japamātreṇopakārakatvaṃ, niyamāḥ pūrvoktāḥ | yadvā yathā bālasya upanayanakāle sandhyopāsanādikāle ca vidhīyamānamuccāraṇaṃ niyamavadakṣarapaṭhanameva nārthadhīsaṃpādanam | nahi bālānāṃ mantrārthāvabodhasambhavaḥ, udvaditi | akṣararāśigrahaṇeti | saniyamakoccāraṇamadhyayanaśabdasya mukhyorthaḥ, vedānāṃ kiṃ cidadhītya brāhmaṇaḥ, ekāṃśākhāmadhītya śrotriyaḥ,
aṅgādhyāyyanūcānaḥ, kalpādhyāyī ṛṣiḥ, kalpasūtrapravacanādhyāyī bhrūṇa ityādiprayogāt | nahi nahi svasśāstraikadeśādhyāyino'rthajñānasaṃbhavaḥ, aṅgādhyayanasya pṛthagupādānena tadvirahe arthajñānaprasaṅgābhāvāt | svādhyāyaśabdaśca nārthajñānavācī, api tu svaśākhāmātravācīti tatkarmatvaṃ svādhyāyasyaiva yuktaṃ, na tvartajñānasya | adhyayanasya prayojanatākāṅkṣāyāṃ dṛṣṭe saṃbhavatyadṛṣṭakalpanāyogāt | akṣaragrahaṇasyā''sannatvāddharmādiṣvanugatatvācca tatsvīkāro yuktaḥ | vyavahitattvādasārvatrikattvācca nārthajñānamityabhiprāyaḥ | sakṛduccāraṇāvadhikattvavyāvṛttyarthamatraragrahaṇe paryavasānamuktam | mātracā vidhivyāpārasyārthajñānaparyantatvavyudāsaḥ paryavasyatīti | yathā "agnīnādadhīte"ti vākyamādhānamātraparaṃ na tūttarakratuviniyogaparaṃ, yathā ca kārīryā vṛṣṭikāmo yajeta" itivākyaṃ vṛṣṭisiddhiparyantakarmaviśeṣaparaṃ na tu vṛṣṭayuparitanopayogaparaṃ, tatheti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ śabdasvārasyādarthajñānaparyantatvaṃ nirasatam | athā'rthānupapatiṃta pariharati tridhā cā'nupapattiśaṅkā vidherakṣaraṇagrahaṇamātraparatve grahaṇaśeṣatayā viniyuktasya svādhyāyasyārthaparatve pramāṇābhāvādavivakṣitārthatvaṃ syāt mīmāṃsāyāḥ pravarttakābhāvādanārambhaṇīyatvaṃ syāt, akṣararāśigrahaṇamātrasya duḥsvarūpatayā vidheḥ prayojanaparyavasānaṃ na syāditi | etacchaṅkātrayanirākaraṇamukhenādhyayanavidherarthajñānaparyantatāṃ, tannimittāṃ brahmavicārānārambhaśaṅkāṃ ca vyudasyan vedākhyaikaprabandhavyākhyānarūpatayā dharmabrahmavicārayoraikaśākhyamapi darśayati |
adhyayanagṛhītasyeti | iha sāṅgādhyayanaṃ vivakṣitam adhītasāṅgasaśiraskavedasya | nanu ca sāṅgavedādhyayanāditi purvāparānuguṇyāt tena hi prayojanavadarthopātapratītasiddhiḥ | arthāḥ yajñopāsanādayaḥ, te svargamokṣādiprayojanavantaḥ, prayojanavadartha śabdena kākadantavatparīkṣyatvaśaṅkāvyudāsaḥ | prayojanavadarthāvabodhitvadarśanā dityanena videḥ paramparayā puruṣātharparyavasāyitvamuktaṃ bhavati | adhyayanasya sākṣātprayojanamakṣararāśigrahaṇamityuktaṃ adhyayanagṛhītasyeti padena | ayamarthaḥ | kiṃ sākṣātpuruṣārthaparyavasāyitvaṃ vidhervivakṣitam? uta paramparayā? sākṣātprayojanaparyavasāyittvaṃ vidherarthajñānaparyantattvepi nopapadyate, anuṣṭhānāpurvadvārā svargasyaiva prayojanatvāt, adhyayanavidheḥ svargaparyantatvānabhyupagamāccāparamparayā ced asmatpakṣe'pi sambhavati svabhāvata iti, śabdasya bodhakatvaśaktisvābhāvyādityarthaḥ | vyutpannapadapadārthaṃ prati śabdasyārthāvabodhakatvaṃ svābhāvikamiti lokasiddham | evakāro vidhinairapekṣyaparaḥ, anyatra viniyogastu na svābhāvikaṃ śabdasyārtaparatvaṃ niruṇaddhi japavidhivat "yājayitvā pratigṛhya vā'naśnan trisvādhyāyaṃ vedamadhīyīta trirātraṃvā sāvitrī " vedameva janennityami"tyādividhānaṃ hi na vedasyārthaparatvaṃ nivārayati | svādhyāyaḥ svato'rthabodhakaścet kiṃ mīmāṃsayetyatrāha |
gṛhītāditi | gṛhītāt gṛhītamātrāt, adhyayanagṛhītasyetyukteḥ, tena mīmāṃsākhyetikartavyatārāhityaṃ vivakṣitam, āpātapratīteḥ saṃśayaviparyayasahatvātannirākaraṇāya mīmāṃseti bhāvaḥ | adhyayanagṛhītasyetyādinā vedasya bodhakatvasvabhāvatvamuktaṃ, tatra prayojanavadarthaśabdaḥ paramparayā puruṣārthaparyavasānajñāpanāya, upari tannimittāpātapratītijanakatāyāḥ sahakārivaikalyanibandhanatvam | nahi vedasyāpātapratītijanakatvaṃ svabhāvaḥ, pramitijanakatvasvabhāvatvāt mīmāṃsākhyaparikaraśūnyasya tadabhāvo na śruteḥ pramitijanakatvasvabhāvavirodhī | yathā ālokādisahakārivirahe rūpādyanupalambhaścakṣurādīnāṃ rūpādisākṣātkārajanakatvasya svābhāvikatvaṃ na vihanti tadvad, āpātapratītāvapi prayojanavattvena pratītirastīti darśayituṃ punaḥ prayojanavadarthaśabdaḥ, prayojanavadarthāpātapratītirhi tannirṇayarāmaṃ janayati | nahi niṣprayojanakākadantādyāpātapratītistannirṇayarāgaṃ janayati | āpātato'vagamyamānān dṛṣṭvetyarthaḥ | svātmano buddhyutpatiṃta dṛṣṭvetivat prayojanavadarthāpātapratīteḥ svānubhavasiddhattvānna tadapahnavaḥ śakya iti bhāvaḥ vyākaraṇādiphalasvarūpavilakṣaṇe mīmāṃsāphalasvarūpe darśayati |
tatsvarūpeti | svarūpaviśeṣāḥāṅginaḥ, prakāraviśeṣāḥaṅgāni, pūrvapakṣoktasvarūpaprakārataḥ siddhāntitatsvarūpaprakarayorvaiṣamyaṃ viśeṣa śabdena vivakṣitam | prayojanavadarthasvādhyāyavedamīmāṃsāśabdāḥ pūrvottarabhāgasādhāraṇāḥ svayameva na tu vidhinā tadupapādakamadhītavedaḥ puruṣa iti padadvayam | adhītaveda ityadhyayanavidhivyāpārasyānuṣṭhitāṃśe paryavasitatvānmīmāṃsāyāṃ tasyāpravattarkattvaṃ dyotitaṃ, cetanatvāt phalavadarthāpātapratītyā svayaṃ pravarttata iti puruṣaśabdasyābhiprāyaḥ | nanvakṣararāśigrahaṇaparyantatvepakṣe rāgataḥ pravṛttirnopapadyate "vedāṅgāni samastāni kṛṣṇapakṣeṣu sampaṭhet" "niṣkāraṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo vedo'dhyeyaḥ" "vedamadhyāpayeddvijaḥ" "sakalpaṃ sarahasyaṃ ce"tyādivihitāṅgādhyayanatyāpyakṣaragrahaṇaparyantatayā vyākaraṇāderarthāvabodhābhāvāt prakṛtipratyayādijñānābhāvenāpātapratītyabhāvāt | maivam | vyākaraṇādīnāṃ vedāṅgatvādakiṃcitkarasyāṅgatvāyogāt | dṛṣṭakiṃcitkāre sambhavati tatprahāṇena cādṛṣṭaparikalpanāyogāt padādyavabodharūpadṛṣṭikiṃcitkāra eva svīkārya ityaṅgatvānyathānupapattyaiva vyākaraṇādyarthāvagamasiddheḥ, prayojanavadarthāpātapratītisidhdyā mīmāṃsārambhopapatteḥ | "adhītavedaḥ puruṣaḥ svayameva pravarttata" ityanena "athāto dharmajijñāse"ti sūtramapyarthād vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | viderakṣararāśigrahaṇaparyantatve pravarttakābhāvāt, svādhyāyasyārthaparatve pramāṇābhāvācca, mīmāṃsā nārambhaṇīyeti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ | sāṅgādhyayanānantaraṃ śabdasya svato'rthāvabodhitvadarśanāt pravarttakāntarābhāvepi rāgātpravṛttyupapatte, rārambhaṇīyeti siddhānta iti |
nanu karmavicārasya rāgaprāptatve "'dhītya snāyādi"ti samāvartanasmṛtirbādhikā syāt, vaidhatve smṛterapi śruterbalīyastvāt smṛtiravakāśapradā syāt | naivam adhyayanavidherakṣararāśigrahaṇaparyantatvārthajñānaparyantatvayoḥ kimabhipretyetaduktaṃ yadyarthajñānaparyantatvaṃ tarhyadhītya snāyāditi smṛtigatādhyayanaśabdasya tattulyārthatvānna virodhaḥ | yadyakṣararāśigrahaṇaparyantatvaṃ tato'pi tulyārthatvānna virodhaḥ | kiṃca, virodhe satyapi pratyakṣaśrutirapyasti yathā chāndogye "ācāryakulādvedamadhītya yathāvidhānaṃ guroḥkarmātiśeṣeṇābhisamāvṛtya kuṭumbe śucau deśe" ityādiḥ, tataśca smṛtivacanopetā snānaśrutirbalīyasī tasmād śrutismṛtivacanayoḥ prābalyadaurbalyakathanaṃ nirarthakam | nanvevaṃ śrutyāpi rāgataḥ pravṛttirbādhyata iti cet | na | samāvṛttasyāpi rāgataḥ śravaṇopapatteḥ | nanvadhyayanānantarabhāvitve samāvarttanasya tatpūrvakagṛhasthakarmānuṣṭhānānavaruddhaśravaṇāvasarālābhānmīmāṃsā'nārambhaḥ prasajyate | naivam | samāvṛttasyāpi śrotuḥ śrāvayiturivāvasarasambhavāt | ācāryasya hyadhyāpanaṃ vihitaṃ na tu gṛhasthasya śravaṇamiti cenna, adhyāpanasya yājanapratigrahavadrāgaprāptatvāt, rāgaprāptamapi "pratigrahādinā dhanamarjayedi"tyādiśāstrānumatamadhyāpanamiti cet śravaṇamapi śāstrānumatam aniṣiddhatvādyajñānuṣṭhānopayuktatvācca |
nanu "samvatsare samvatsare dvau dvau māsau samāhita ācāryakule vaset bhūyaḥ śrutimicchanni"ti śvetaketurityārabhya "tacchāstraivirpratiṣiddhaṃ niveśe hi vṛtte naiyamikāni śrūyante" "agnihotramatitaya" ityādinā śravaṇaṃ gṛhasthasya niṣiddhamiticenna sākalyena māsadvayaṃ gurukulavāsasyānuṣṭhānoparodhitvena tasyaiva niṣiddhatvāt | "niveśe hi vṛtte naiyamikāni śruyante" "agnihotramatithama" iti hyucyate ācāryasyāpyanuṣṭhānānuparodhena śrāvaṇasya hi śāstrānumatatvaṃ ato'nuṣṭhānānuparodhoparodhaprayuktānumatyananumativiṣayatvaṃ śrāvaṇasya, śravaṇasya, ca tulyam ata eva hi yudhiṣṭhirādīnāṃ gārhasthyaniṣṭhānāmapi bhīṣmādibhyaḥ śravaṇaṃ bhāratrādiṣu pratipādyate | yadyapi śrāvaṇakāla eva śravaṇakālaḥ, tathāpi śroturudakāharaṇakāṣṭhasampādanādibhiranuṣṭhānoparodha iti cenna | adhyayanavidhiprayuktasyodakauraṇādestannivṛttyā nivṛttatvāt | vittakhyātyādiprayojanāntaraspṛhayā, śiṣyastrehena, ca guroḥ śrāvaṇamupapadyate śrāvayiturjñātārthatvādanuṣṭhānamupapadyate | śroturajñātārthatvānneti cenna | upanayanaprabhṛtyanuṣṭhānavaddhitaiṣivacanādanuṣṭhānopapatteḥ | tarhi hitaiṣivākyameva syātkimarthaṃ mīmāṃsāśravaṇamiti cet hitaiṣivacanasya pramāṇamūlatvaniścayārthaṃ, praṣṭṝṇāmapareṣāṃ svayamupapādanārthaṃ ca, hitaiṣivacanādanūṣṭhānasambhave śūdrādīnāmapyanuṣṭhānaprasaṅgaḥ iti cenna | "na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyāt" "na cāsyopadiśeddharmannacāsya vratamādiśedi"tyādiniṣedhavacanasadbhāvāt nahi yajñādikaṃ brāhmaṇaśśūdrayopadiśanti na ca śuśrūṣādirahitaśūdraviśeṣaviṣayatvenedṛśaniṣedhavacanānāṃ saṅkocaḥ kāryaḥsaṅkocakābhāvātnāī śūdrasya yajñādyarhatvaviṣayaṃ vacanāntaraṃ dṛśyate | kiṃca yajamānena kṛtsnavedasya,mantraviśeṣāṇāṃ, ca japyatāvacanātteṣāmadhyayanalabhyatvā, dadhyayanasyopanayanasāpekṣatvādupanayanasya traivarṇikā'dhikāratvānna, śūdrādyadhikāraprasaṅgaḥ | nanūpanayanavidhistraivarṇikādhyayanaviṣayatayā netuṃ śakyate ataḥ śūdrasyādhyayanamupanayananirapekṣamiti tasya yajamānādyuccāraṇasambhava iti cet na | "tasmācchūdrasamīpe nādhyetavyami"ti "atha hāsya vedamupṛṇvatasmrapujatubhyāṃ śrotrapratipūraṇamudāhareṇa jihvācchedo dhāraṇe śarīrabheda" ityādinā śūdrasya vedaśravaṇāderniṣiddhatvād, adhyayanaṃ cedupanayanāṅgakaṃ tat traivarṇikādhikārameveti na tatra śūdradyadhikāra iti mantraviśeṣoccāraṇamupapatteḥ | na hitaiṣivacanācchūdrādeḥ kratvanuṣṭhānaprasaṅga iti nāpaśūdrādhikaraṇavirodhaḥ | kiṃca yathā "yāvajjīvamagnihotraṃ juhotī "tyādividhiḥ "na svāṅgaṃ svavyavadhāyakami"ti nyāyāt svopayognino'pyarthārjanāderāgaprāptasyāpyavasarapradaḥ syāt ktavāpratyayasya ca samānakarttṛkatvapūrvakālīnatvamātramarthaḥ, na tvānantaryam | nanvānantaryameva vidheyanna cedvidhivaiyarthyaṃ duḥsvātmakagurukulavāsanivṛtteḥ svataḥ prāptatvāditi cet | na | ānantaryaparatvepi vidhivaiyarthyāt tacca gurugulavāsasya duḥsvātmakatvādeva | ataḥ saniyamasaṃskāraviśeṣa eva snānamiti tadvidheyaṃ natvānantaryaṃ tasmādadhītyeti ktavāśruterna virodhaḥ tasmātsvayameva pravarttate |
nanu "yo ha vā aviditārṣeyacchandodaivatena mantreṇa yajati yājayati vā'dhyāpayati vā sthāṇuṃ varcchati gartaṃ vā''padyate pravāmīyate pāpīyān bhavati | yātayāmānyasya chandāṃsi bhavanti | atha yo mantre mantre veda sa sarvamāyureti | śreyāṃśca bhavati ayātayāmānyasya chandāsi mavanti tasmādetāni mantre mantre vidyādi"ti śrutyā "aviditvāṃ ṛṣiṃ chando daivataṃ yogameva ca yo'dhyāpayejjapedvāpi pāpīyān jāyate tu sa" iti smṛtyupabṛṃhitayārthajñānavidhānaṃ phalitam | mantre pratipādyadevatājñānasyātra vihitattvāttulyanyāyatayā daivataṃśabdasya mantraprakāśyānuṣṭheyārthaprakāśanārthatayāca vidhyādibhāgārthajñānasyāpi vidheyatvāpatteḥ | yogo mantrāṇāṃ viniyogaḥ tajjñānasya brāhmaṇabhāgārthajñānasāpekṣatvācceti cet | na pratigrahartusamveśanāderiva rāgaprāptatvanivṛtteḥ | nahi "brāhmaṇaḥ pratigrahādinā dhanamarjayet, ṛtāvupeyādi"ti vacanaṃ rāgataḥ prāptiṃpratigrahāderniruṇaddhi |
kiṃcānenaiva vākyenārthajñānaṃ vihitamityadhyayanavidheratharjñānaparyantatvaṃ nāśrayaṇīyaṃ, yathā kratūnāṃ vidhyantarasiddhatvādāghānavidheruttarakratuvidhiparyantatvaṃ nā''śrīyate tadvat | na cedaṃ vedavākyamadhyayanasyārthadhīparyantattvamavagamayati, naca svayamarthajñānaṃ vidhatte, arthajñānasyā'nyataḥ siddhatvāt | atra mantramātrasya ṛṇyādivijñānavidhānapratīteśca | tataśca vedasya sāṅgatayā'dhyetavyatvaṃ sidhyet na ttvarthajñānaṃ, chandodaivatādijñānasya chandaḥkalpavyākaraṇaniruktādisāpekṣatvānmīmāṃsānapekṣatvācca | viniyogaviṣayasandehe sati mīmāṃsāpekṣā syāditi cet tarhi sandehāpākaraṇāya rāgataḥ pravṛttiḥ syāt "yadadhītamavijñātaṃ nigadenaiva śabdyate | anagnāviva śuṣkaidho na tajjavalati kahiṃcit" itīdamapi vacanaṃ nārthajñānaparyantatvamadhyayanavidheravagamayati | "adhītamavijñāta"tyitraivādhyayanārthajñānayoḥ pṛthaṅnirdeśāt rāgaprāptasya vidhātumaśakyatvācca | "vedānāṃ kiṃcidadhītya brāhmaṇaḥ, ekāṃ śākhāmadhītya śrotriyaḥ, aṅgādhyāyyanūcāna" ityādayaḥ kalpasūtraprayogāśca adhyayanādarthajñānaṃ pṛthagbhūtamavagamayanti | ataḥ śravaṇasya duḥkharūpatvena tandrālutayā vā, arthārjanādyanyaparatayā vā, yo na ṛṇoti tatprarocanārthamidaṃ "yadadhītami"tyādivacanam |
yathā akṣairmādīvyaḥ, kṛṣimutkṛṣasva, vitte ramasva, bahu manyamāna" iti vākyaṃ tandrāluprarocanārthaṃ, prarocanayā hi pravṛttirutkaṭā syāt nahyetāvatā kṛṣerarthājanasya ca rāgaprāptatvabhaṅgena sarvatra vaidhatyameva syāttadvadidamapi vacanaṃ śravaṇasya rāgaprāptatvaṃ na vihanti | tasmādrāgata eva pravarttate | evamanyataḥ pravṛttau sambhavantyāṃ śabdaśaktayullaṅghanena mīmāṃsāśravaṇasya vidheyatvakalpanamayuktam, aikaśāstryaṃ rāgataḥ pṛvṛttiścāstu kathaṃ paurvāparyaniyamastatrāha  tatreti |
tatravede karmavidhisrūpe nirūpita iti karmabhāgasya vedopakramatvādadhītakrameṇaiva nirūpaṇaṃ prāptamiti karmavicārasya pūrvamāvitvamitibhāvaḥ |
nanu nahi karmaṇāmalpāsthiraphalatvamanantasthiraphalatvañca pūrvapakṣasiddhāntarūpeṇa kvacinnirūpitaṃtatkathamalpasthiraphalatvāvagatirityatrāha  svarūpe nirūpite iti | kevalaṃ karmavidhisvarūpameva nirūpitam alpāsthiraphalatvajñānamāvṛttividhānādinā phalitamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā karmavidhisvarūpannirūpitaṃ na tvārādhyaparadevateti bhāvaḥ | tadārādhanatvena kṛte hyanantasthiraphalatvasiddhiḥ |
adhyayanagṛhītasvādhyāyeti | adhyayanasya kṛtsnasvādhyāyaviṣayatvādupaniṣadaśca svādhyāyaśabdāntargatatvāditibhāvaḥ | ekadeśaśabdenaikaprabandhāṃśatvaṃ sūcitam sādhāraṇavedaśabdanirdiṣṭaśabdarāśāvananyaparaṃ pradeśaṃ pṛthaṅnirdiśatyupaniṣacchabdena, vedāntaśabdena vicārapaurvāparyaniyamaheturdarśitaḥ | mīmāṃsāśabdokte vyākhyāne pradeśabhedaṃ viśinaṣṭi śārīrakaśabdena "annavānannado bhavati mahān bhavati prajayā paśubhirbrahmavacarsene"tyādyuktānuṣaṅgikālpāsthiraphalavyāvṛttyarthamamṛtattvarūpaśabdāḥ, ānuṣaṅgikāṇāmalpāsthiratvepi pradhānaphalasyānantasthiraphalatvenāpātapratītirastītyarthaḥ | karmamīmāṃsāsaṃskṛtamanaskatvādatrāpyānuṣaṅgikaṃ pradhānaphalaṃ ca saṃbhavatīti śrotuḥ pratīyata eva |
nanu phalatvādidamapyanityamiti buddhiḥ syāt naivaṃ vipakṣe bādhakābhāvāt, yathā bhaumasukhāt svargādisukhavilakṣaṇaṃ pratipannaṃ tatrāpi parasparavailakṣaṇyaṃ deśakālasvarūpabhedāt pratipannaṃ tathaiva tasmādapi vilakṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ sambhavatītyatīva rāgajananāyā'syāpi pratītiḥsyāt  adhikaroti  adhikārī bhavati, evaṃ karmavicārakṛdevādhikārī bhavati natu sādhanacatuṣṭayavānityabhiprāyaḥ | evamaikaśāstryakramaniyamārambhaṇīyatvānyupapāditāni | kairvedāntavākyairārambhaṇīyatvaupayikāpātapratītirityatrāha  tathāceti  yathāsūtraṃ vyākhyātaṃ tathetyarthaḥ, caśśaṅkānivṛttau prasiddhau vā kevalaśabdena jñānāṅgakarmavyāvṛttiḥ |
nanu karmavicāreṇa nirṇīte'pi karmaphalakṣayiṣṇutve punaścālpāsthiraphalatvapratītijanakavākyāni kimarthamudāhriyante anantasthiraphalāpātapratītijanakānyeva vākyānyudāhartavyāni | ucyate | adhigatakarmaṇaḥ puruṣasya hi nirṇītārthasaṃvādivākyadarśanāt karmaphalāsthiratvavad brahmajñānaphalākṣayitvasya prāmāṇikatvaṃ sambhavatīti śraddhāsthirīkaraṇārthaṃ  tadyatheti | lokyataitilokaḥ phalam | "antavadevāsya tadbhavatītya"nena jñānavidhurakarmaṇo'nekakālānuṣṭhitasya bahuvidhasyāpi kṣayitvamuktaṃ bhavati "yo ha vā etadakṣaraṃ gārgyaviditvāsmiṃlloke juhoti yajate tapastapyate bahūni varṣasahasrāṇī "tyetadvākyapūrvakatvāttasya vākyasya antavadivyukte kriyāsvarūpasyāntavattvaṃ lokasiddhatayā'nupadeśyamiti phalasyaivāntavattvamarthasiddhaṃ sphuṭīkartuṃ pūrvaṃ tadyatheti vākyopādānaṃ, sāṃsārikaphalasyā 'dhruvatvaṃ syāt karmabhireva dhruvaṃ phalaṃ saṃpādyatāmiti śaṅkāvyudāsāya upādatte  na hyadhruvaiḥ prāpyate iti, śruvaṃ taditi vākyakhaṇḍaḥ | tadupapādakatvena pratīyamānaṃ vākyāntaramudāharati  plavā hyete adṛḍā yajñarūpā"iti | saṃsārapāraṃ tārayitunnālaṃ madhye bhaṃguratvādityarthaḥ | sūtrayojanānuguṇataraṃ karmaṇāmalpāsthiraphalatvaṃ, brahmopāsanasyānantākṣayaphalatvaṃ, ca darśayadvākyamupādatte  parīkṣya lokāniti | asminvākye nyāyasiddhārthānuvādena gurūpasattirvidhīyate |
kamracitān karmasañcitān karmasaṃpādyān parīkṣya mīmāṃsānyāyairnirūpya | brāhmaṇaḥ adhītasāṅgasaśiraskavedaḥ, ya ityadhyāhārthaṃ, sa ityuttaratra śravaṇāt | akṛtaḥnityaḥ | atra puruṣo viśeṣyaḥ, liṅgavaśād akṣaraṃ puruṣamityanantarokteśca | kṛtenakarmaṇā nāsti na sidhyati itikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam iti yo nirvedamayāt saḥ tadvijñānārthe gurumevābhigacchet | evakāreṇa niyamavidhitvaṃ gamyate | samitpāṇiḥnariktapāṇiḥ "riktapāṇistu nopeyādrājānaṃ daivataṃ gurūmi"ti hi smaryate | śrotriyaṃśrutavedāntaṃ, brahmaniṣṭhaṃ,brahmasākṣātkāravantaṃ, śrutavedānto'pi rucibhedādabrahmaniṣṭho nopagantavya iti bhāvaḥ | abhigacchedityanvayaḥ śamaḥ bāhyendriyaniyamanarūpaḥ praśāntācittāyetyantaḥ karaṇaniyamanasyoktatayā pāriśeṣyāt | etena śravaṇopayuktamavadhānaṃ vivakṣitaṃ na tūpāsanopayuktātyantendriyajayādiḥ | tasmai sa vidvān provācetyanvayaḥ | "yene"ti nirdeśo vijñānābhiprāyaḥ | tadvijñānārthamiti hi prakṛtaṃ sāmānyataḥ kāraṇābhiprāyo vā liṅgavyatyayo vā; akṣaraṃ svarūpeṇāvikāraṃ, satyaṃguṇato'pyavikāram" ābhyāmacijjīvavyāvṛttiḥ | tāṃ brahmavidyāṃ provāca prabrūyādityarthaḥ iti vedāntasāre vyākhyātam | "chandasi luṅlaṅliṭa" iti liṭ |
nanu "praśāntacittāya śamānvitāye"ti śamādeḥ pūrvavṛttatvaṃ pratīyate | na śravaṇopayogyavadhānamātrasya vivakṣitatvāt | nātropāsanāṅgabhūtātyantaviṣayavaitṛpṇyaṃ vivakṣitaṃ, taddhi "śamadamādyupetaḥ syādi"ti nirūpayiṣyate | ato nirūpyasaṃpādyaistairnirūpaṇāt prāgeva viśiṣṭatvamanupapannaṃ, śrutiśca śāstrajanyajñānavataḥ puruṣasya taduttarabhāviśamādyaṅgakamupāsanaṃ darśayati | "tasmādevaṃvicchānto dānta uparatastitikṣuḥ samāhito bhūtvā''tmanyevā''tmānaṃ paśyedi"ti atra hyevaṃ viditi śāstrajanyajñānavattvamuktaṃ, bhūtvā paśyedityupāsanasya śamādyaṅgakatvaṃ sthāpitam | kevalāntasthiraphalaparavākyānyudāharati  brahmaviditi |
atrānuvāke "yato vāco nivarttanta" iti śravaṇādanantasthiraphalatvasiddhiḥ | prāpyasya brahmaṇo'nantasthiratve'pi prāpteḥ kādācitkatvaśaṅkāvyāvṛttyarthamapunarnivṛttimāha  na punariti | yadvā vidyayānantasthiraphalarūpabrahmaprāptimāha "brahmavidi"ti | vidyayā brahmaprāpteḥ pratibandhanivṛttipūrvakatvamāha "na punari"ti | mṛtyuḥpramādaḥ, moho vā moho mṛtyuḥ saṃmato yaḥ kavīnāṃ, pramādaṃ vai mṛtyumahaṃ bravīmī "tyubhayatra mṛtyuśabdavyapadeśāt | pramādo yathā'vasthitātmasvarūpasyājñānaṃ, mohaḥbhrāntijñānaṃ, diṅmohaṃ ityādivyapadeśāt | na mṛtyunivṛttimātrameva, tatkāryamapi nivartata ityāha  na paśyo mṛtyuṃ paśyatīti | asya vākyasyopari " na rogaṃ nota duḥkhatāmi"ti hi śrūyate | na punarityādivākyaṃ brahmaṇi dṛṣṭe mṛtyupramukhanivṛttiriti jñāpanārtham na paśyo mṛtyumityatrāpi paśyaśabdasya brahmadarśītyarthaḥ | tadekaṃ paśyatītyanantarodāhṛtavākye viṣayasya darśitatvāt "sasvarāḍ bhavatī "ti karmavaśyo na bhavatītyarthaḥ | "svarāṭ svatantro vijñeya" iti naighaṇṭukāḥ | tamevaṃvidvāniti vākyena nirviśeṣacinmātrajñānadevatāntaropāsanādyupāyāntaravyāvṛttisiddhiḥ | puruṣottamopāsanasyaivopāyatayoktatvāt tadupāsanarūpajñānaṃ ca nātmaikyaviṣayam api tu pṛthaktvaviṣayamiti darśayati  pṛthagātmānamiti | matvājñātvā,tataḥpṛthaktvajñānāt tena juṣṭaḥprītiviṣayīkṛtaḥ anugṛhīto 'mṛtatvametītyarthaḥ | ityādīni vedāntavākyānīti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | udāhṛtaspaṣṭārthavākyamātratṛptaḥ kaściccodayati  nanuceti | pūvartra codyāntarāṇāṃ kaṇṭhoktayabhāvepi parihārakaṇṭhoktayā tānyabhipretāni, ataścaśabdena tairarthasiddhaiḥ saha samuccayo yuktaḥ | sāṅgeti  karmajñānapūrvavṛttatvavādināpi sāṅgādhyayanasyāpekṣitatvaṃ svīkṛtamiti tadadhikavyudāsārtha evakāraḥ | adhyayanasya sāṅgatvādaṅgānāṃ cārthajñānahetutvānmīmāṃsānirapekṣaṃ svargādereva kevalakarmaphalatvaṃ, svargādeśca kṣayitvaṃ, brahmopāsanasyākṣayaphalatvaṃ ca jñāyata ityarthaḥ | brahmopāsanasyetyādigrantho dṛṣṭāntābhiprāyaḥ | jñāyata evetyevakāro jñātṛtvasaṃpratipattisucakaḥ | jñānasāmagrī hi siddheti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kiṃ mityatrāha
anantaramiti | karmaṇo'lpāsthiraphalatvajñānena mumukṣāsiddhiyarthaṃ hi karmavicāraḥ, tannirapekṣamevālpāsthiraphalatvajñānānmumukṣāsiddheḥ brahmajijñāsaiva karttavyā, dharmavicāre prayojanābhāvādityarthaḥ | pariharati  evamiti  evaṃ tarhi udāhṛtavākyamātratṛptosi cet | kṛtsnasyeti  brahmaṇopīti bhāvaḥ | vedāntavākyānyapi sphuṭārthāni hyasmābhirudāhṛtāni, teṣāmartho'pi mīmāṃsānapekṣaṃ jñāyate ato'nantastiraphalajñānāyanabrahmavicāraḥ karttavya ityarthaḥ | satyamityarddhāṅgīkāre āpātapratītāvabhyupagamaḥ, brahmavicāranairapekṣye'nabhyupagamaḥ  āpāteti | apātapratītiḥ ajñānanivṛttimātreṇa saṃśayaviparyayasahajñānam | saṃśayaviparyayau ca kāraṇavākyagatasadbrahmātmākāśaprāṇavaiśvānarādiśabdairarthatattvasya durniścayatvāt "vijñānaghana evaitebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tānyevānuvinaśyati" "asadvā idamagra āsīdi"tyādibhirātmānityatvādeḥ pratīteḥ "annavānannādo bhavati mahān bhavati prajayā paśubhirbrahmavarcasene" tyādinā'lpāsthiraphalatvāvagamācca syātām; ataḥ sāṅgādhyayanamātreṇa tayoranativṛttestadvayudāsasya nyāyānugṛhītavākyaphalatvācca brahmavicāraḥ karttavya iti cedityarthaḥ | bhavānanudāhṛtavākyāntaraparyālocanāyāmapi pravṛttastvamiti bhāvaḥ | tathaiva  etayā dṛṣṭayā atrāpi saṃśayaviparyayanirāsasyāpekṣitatvaṃ jānannanudāhṛtavākyāni paśyedityarthaḥ | "akṣayyaṃ ha vai cāturmāsyayājinaḥ sukṛtaṃ bhavati" "pūrṇāhutyā sarvān kāmānavāpnoti, sarvān lokān paśubandhayājyabhijayati" "apāma somamamṛtā abhūma, anantaṃ ha vā apāramakṣayyaṃ lokaṃ jayati yo'gniṃ nāciketaṃ cinute nāsyeṣṭāpūrte kṣīyete | yo'gninnāciketaṃ cinute" ityādīni hi "amṛtatvaṃ bhajante, so'śnute sarvān kāmān, imān lokān kāmānnī kāmarūpyanusaṃcaranni" tyādi brahmavedanaphalavākyairanutulyāni vākyāni dṛśyante | ata aupaniṣadavākyeṣvivānudāhṛtavākyeṣu saṃśayaviparyayabāhulyāttannirāsāya kamarvicāraḥ karttavya ityarthaḥ | evaṃ phaladvārā hānāya karmajñānāpekṣā darśitā |
atha svarūpeṇopādānāya ca niyamena karmajñānāpekṣā'stīti darśayituṃ mumukṣoḥ karmaṇoniyamenāpekṣitatvalakṣaṇaṃ parapakṣamupakṣipati "nanu ce"ti | niyamenāpekṣitatvasya vivakṣitetaragāmitvavyudāsārthaḥ prathama evakāraḥ, dvitīyastu niyamenānapekṣitasya pūrvavṛttatvanivṛttyarthaḥ, tataḥ kimityatrāha "na dharme "ti | kuta ityatrāha "adhīte"ti | ye brahmavidyādhikāriṇasteṣāṃ sarveṣāmavaśyāpekṣitaṃ hi niyamenāpekṣitaṃ, vedāntamātrādhyāyinastu tatraivāpātapratītirbubhutsā ca syāt; tasya karmaviṣayāpātapratītyābhāvāt, na karmavicārasya niyamenāpekṣetyarthaḥ | yadvā adhītakṛtsnavedasyāpi janmāntarasukṛtavaśādvedāntavākya eva butbhusā jāyate cettasya na karmavicārāpekṣeti, tadā "adhītavedāntasye"ti padamayogavyavacchedaparaṃ, nānyayogavyavacchedaparaṃ, kṛtsnavedādhyayanādapekṣitavedāntabhāgopyadhīta evetyarthaḥ | evaṃ hānārthamapi kamarṇo jñātavyatvaṃ niṣiddham upādānārthamapi na jñātavyamityupapādayituṃ vedāntamātrabubhutsāderapi karmavicārāpekṣāṃ śaṅkate "karmāṅgeti" | ekasya sāmnaḥ pañca bhāgāḥ santi, te prastāvodgīthapratihāropadravanidhanākhyāḥ | ete bhāgābhakti śabdābhidheyāḥ | tāsu pañcasu bhaktiṣu prastāvo hiṅkārapūrvaṅgīyate, udgīthaḥ praṇavapūrvaṅgīyate, tatra pañcavidhasāmopāsanaṃ kvacidvidhīyate "lokeṣu pañcavidaṃ sāmopāsīte"ti, kvacitsāmāvayaveṣu pañjasvekaikāvayavāpāsanaṃ vidhīyate, tatrodgīthāvayavabhūtapraṇavopāsanaṃ vidhīyate "omityetadakṣaramudgīthamupāsīte"ti karmāṅgaśrayāṇikarmāṅgabhūtodgīthādiviṣayāṇi, anadhigatakarmaṇa udgīthādyupāsanacintanaṃ na śakyaṃ kartumiti pratijñā | karmāṅgaśrayāṇīti hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇam | karmāṅgodgīthādyāśrayāṇyupāsanānītyukte sati hetāvudgīthaśabdasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt, upāsanamātrasya ca pakṣīkāraḥ pratīyate, ato yathoktaiva vacanavyaktiryuktā | anadhigate karmaṇyudgīthādiviṣayopāsanacintāyā aśakyatvāt karmavicāropekṣitaiticedityarthaḥ | sopālambhaṃ pariharati | anabhijña iti | śāstre pradhānatayā pratipādyaṃ jñānamityatrāha asminniti | bhedaḥjñātṛjñeyajñānarūpaḥ, vaividhvam tadavāntarabhidā bāhulyam, evaṃ vividhabhedadarśanasya heturavidyā | tasyāḥ ko heturityanavasthāparihārārthamanādiśabdaḥ | evamavidyākṛtabhedadarśananimittakaṃ janmajarāmaraṇādikameva sāṃsārikaduḥkham ādiśabdena narakagarbhavāsādigrahaṇam | saṃsāraḥ prakṛtisambandhaḥ tatprabhavaṃ sāṃsārikam, tannirasanīyatvāya duḥsvarūpatvoktiḥ | sāgaraśabdastadānantyaparaḥ | "nimagnasyeti" | duḥkhanivṛttyupāyāpekṣāhetutayoktamadhikārisvarūpamuktam | prayojanamāha  nikhaleti | mithyājñānaṃbhrāntijñānam, "duḥkhajanmapravṛttidoṣamithyājñānānāmuttarottarāpāye tadanantarāpāyā"diti prayogāt, bhrāntijñānaṃ ca bhedadaśarnam | yadvā mithyābhūtamajñānaṃ mithyājñānam, jñānanivatyartvāya mithyāśabdaḥ tasya nibarhaṇāya, tannibarhaṇameva mokṣa ityabhiprāyaḥ | tatsādhanaṃ kiṃmityatrāha ātmaikatvavijñānamiti | saprabhramasya rajjuyāthātmyajñānaṃ hi nivarttakam na kamarviśeṣaḥ, evaṃ bhedadarśanasyāvidyākṛtatvādaikyajñānameva tannivarttakamiti tatreva tātparyaṃ vedāntavākyānāmityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  asya hīti | kvopayujyate na kutracit, jñānasya svarūpopattau tatphalotpattau jñānotpattisādhanānugrahe vā nopayujyata ityarthaḥ | na kevalamupayogābhāvaḥ, pratikūlaphalatvamapyāha  pratyuteti | dvaitavāsanājanakatvādityabhiprāyaḥ | tathāpyupaniṣatsvadhītatvād brahmamīmāṃsāyāṃ nirūpyamāṇatvāccodgīthādyupāsanaṃ brahmavidyāpekṣitamityudgīthādivicāraḥ sākṣātsaṅgata ityatrāha  udgīthādāti | tarhi kathamupaniṣatsvadhyayanaṃ brahmavicāre tadvicāraścetyatrāha jñānarūpātvāviśeṣāditi | jñānasvarūpatvasāmyāt buddhisthatayā kṛtaḥ, na tu pradhānarthopayogitvādityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha "sa tviti" | tuśabdadvayaṃ śaṅkādvayavyāvarttakam | pradhānapratipādyopayuktasyaiva pūrvavṛttatvaṃ nigamayati | ata iti | kimapi karmavicārādanyaditi bhāvaḥ | pradhānārthopayogitvena saṅgatiḥ sākṣātsaṅgatiḥ | yena kenāpyākāreṇa sāmyādbuddhisthatvaṃ prasaṅgātsaṅgatiḥ | ataḥ prāsaṅgikodgīthādyupāsanacintāpekṣitasya pradhānārthasiruddhasya karmavicārasya na pūrvavṛttatā yuktā, api tu pradhānapratipādyātmaikatvavijñānāpekṣitameva kimapi pūrvavṛttaṃ vaktuṃ yuktamityuktaṃ bhavati |
atra bhāskarīyāḥ pratyavatiṣṭhante bāḍhamiti | bāḍhamityarddhāṅgīkāre | yatpradhānaṃ śāstraṃ, tadapekṣitameva pūrvavṛttamityetāvanmātraviṣayo'ṅgīkāraḥ tadapekṣitaṃ ceti pratijñā, tvayāyadanapekṣitamityuktaṃ tadevāpekṣitamityevakārābhiprāyaḥ | kuta ityatrāha  karmasamuccitāditi  samuccitaśabdaḥ sāhityamātraparaḥ, na samuccayaparaḥ | "asmadvidyā ātmavidyā ce"ti samuccityopadeśādityatra samuccitaśabdavat karmajñānābhyāmiti na nirdiṣṭham, api tu karmasamuccitājjñānāditi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena nirdiṣṭham, ato jñānaprādhānyamavagamyate, karmāṅgakājjñānādityarthaḥ | śrutiśca "yajñena dānena" ityādirvivakṣitā | karmaṇovidyāṅgatve sūtrakārābhimatiṃ darśayati  vakṣyati ceti caḥ pratipādakasamuccaye, aṅgatayā karmaṇonuṣṭhānamapekṣitamastu, tajjñānasya kathaṃ pūrvabhāvitvam karmajñānaṃ brahmavicārapāścātyaṃ kiṃ na syāt? ityatrāha  apekṣiteceti  prayājādivanniṣpannasya karaṇasya phalotpattidaśāyāmanugrāhakatvenāṅgatayāpekṣā vivakṣitā | tṛtīyasya caturthapāde samāvṛttākṛtadāramṛtadārādīnāmāśramaviśeṣavarttināṃ ca brahmavidyāniṣṭhānāṃ karmasvanuṣṭheyānanuṣṭheyavibhāgasya nirūpayiṣyamāṇatvamabhipretyoktaṃ kena samuccayaḥ kena netīti | yadvā nityanaimittikayoḥ samuccayaḥ na tu kāmyaniṣṭhayoriti vibhāgo na jñāyata ityarthaḥ | ayamarthaḥpadārthajñānapūrvakaṃ hi vākyātharjñānam "yajñena dānena" ityādiyavākye yajñādikarmaṇāṃ padārthabhūtatvādvākyārthajñānasya ca padārthajñānapūrvakatvādyajñādikamarvicārasya pūrvabhāvitvam nahi "vrīhīnavahantī " tyādivākyārthajñānaṃ vrīhyādipadārthajñānena vinopapadyate, padārthasaṃsagarrūpatvādvākyārtasya | nanu, gāmānayetyādivākyādvayutpattau gavānayanādirūpaṃ vākyārthaṃ pūrvaṃ pratipadyāvāpodvāpamukhena paścātpadārthapratipatterna padārthavīpūrvakatvaniyamo vākyārthajñānasya | ucyate vyutpannācchabdādarthapratipattau sarvatra padārthajñānapūrvakameva vākyārthajñānaṃ, vyutpattidaśāyāṃ tu pramāṇāntareṇa śabdāntareṇa vā vākyārthāvagamaḥ pūrvaṃ syāt, na tu tasmādeva śabdāt, tasyāgṛhītasambandhatvena bodhakatvāyogāt, vyutpattāvapi na vākyārthadhiyaḥ pūrvabhāvaniyamaḥ | ambātātamātulādipadānāṃ padāntarāsaṃsṛṣṭānāmeva prathamavyutpattidarśanāt, asya śabdasyāyamartha iti vyutpattau vākyārthajñānasya pūrvabhāvābhāvācca | na cāsminneva vākye yajñādiśabdavyutpattisaṃbhavaḥ, vividiṣāniṣpattirūpavākyārthasyāpratyakṣatvena gavānayanādāviva vyutpattyanupapatteḥ, ataḥ padārthajñānapūrvakaṃ vākyārthajñānamityuktam bāḍhamityādikaṃ siddhāntinaścodyaparamiti ca vyākhyātṛbhirvyākhyātam, tadānīmapi padārthavākyārthabhāvaḥ kramaviśeṣahetutayā vivakṣitaḥ | kiñca apekṣite cetyaṅgatayāpekṣitatvasya vivakṣitatvāt karmaṇāṃ ca jñānotpādakatayā tadaṅgatvādutpādakotpādyayoḥ paurvāparyaniyamādvicāraviṣayayoḥ karmajñānayoḥ pūrvāparabhāvena taccheṣabhūtayorvicārayorapi tatkramabhāktvaṃ nyāyyamiti cābhiprāyaḥ| śeṣabhūtasya śeṣikramānurodhitvaṃ hi nyāyasiddham, yathā "sārasvatau homau bhavata" iti yugapadutpannayorapi sārasvatahomayoryājyāpuronuvākyāmantrānusāreṇa sarasvatīyāgasya pūrvabhāve sarasvadyāgasya ca paścādbhāve ca prāpte tadaṅgānāmapi tenaiva krameṇānuṣṭhānaṃ nirṇītam | dṛṣṭānte dārṣṭāntike ca, śeṣiṇoḥ kramaniścāyakahetuvaiṣamyameva, tayoḥ krame niścite śeṣasya śeṣikramānurodhitvaṃ tatra cātra ca tulyam | evañcopāsanasyaiva vicāraṃ prati śeṣitvāt tṛtīyalakṣaṇe kṛtasyopāsanacintanasyaiva kamarvicārāpekṣayā paścādbhāva iti na vācyamvidyāviṣayatatphalacintanasyāpi tadapekṣitatvena kṛtsnāyā api brahmamīmāṃsāyāḥ karmavicārapaścādbhāvaprāpteḥ | nigamayati ata iti  bāḍhamityādeḥ siddhānticodyaparatvādapi bhāskaramataparatvamucitam | "karmasamuccitājjñānādapavargaśrute" rityasya granthasya bhāskarīyabhāṣye śrūyamāṇatvāt, aṅgabhāvasya tadabhyutagatatvena tadviṣayasūtropādānāvirodhācca śabdato'rthataśca pratyabhijñānāt, siddhānticodyasyāpi tadantarbhāvācca bhāskarapakṣaṃ yādavaprakāśapakṣaṃ copajīvya "bāḍha"mityādinā pārśvasthaścodayatīti ca nirvāhaḥ sāmpradāyikaḥ | tatraivaṃ yojanā; karmasamuccitāditi samasamuccayo vivakṣitaḥ, karmasamuccitājjñānāditi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena nirdeśo jñānasya mokṣopāyatvaprasiddhiprācuryanibandhanaḥ, śrutiśca "vidyāṃcāvidyāṃce "tyādiḥ | asminvākye mṛtyuśabdaḥ upeyaprāptivirodhikarmavācī, pratibandhanivṛttirbrahmaprāptiśceti sādhyadvayaṃ, krameṇa karma jñānaṃ ceti sādhanadvayamapi hi yādavaprakāśairabhyupagatam; ato "vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ce"ti vākye pūrvakhaṇḍaḥ sādhanadvitvaparaḥ, uttarakhaṇḍastu sādhyadvitvapara iti teṣāṃ nirvāhaḥ "vakṣyati ceti" caśabdaḥ pratipādyasamuccaye aṅgabhāvaṃ ca vakṣyatītyarthaḥ | jñānotpatteḥ paścātkarmaṇo brahmaprāptipratibandhanivarttakatvaṃ, jñānotpatteḥ pūrvaṃ karmaṇo jñānotpādakatayā tadaṅgatvamapi hi tadabhyupagatam | aṅgabhāvaparasūtramupādatte "sarvāpekṣeti" sarvāpekṣetisūtramaṅgāṅgibhāvaparam, "sahakāritvena ceti" sūtraṃ samasamuccayapratipādakamiti hi teṣāṃ prakriyā; aṅgabhāve samuccaye ca śrutivākye sūtre codāharttavyepi granthalāghavārthaṃ samuccaye śrutiraṅgabhāve sūtraṃ codāhṛtam, aṅgabhāvapratipādakavākyaviṣayasūtropādānena bhāskaramataṃ cāvalambitaṃ bhavati, evamubhayathā kvarmaṇopekṣā darśitā | tataḥ kiṃ ityāha  "apekṣiteceti" samapradhānatayā aṅgatayā cāpekṣita ityarthaḥ | anyatsarvaṃ pūrvavat | yadyapi yādavaprakāśamate karmavicārasya pūrvavṛttatva manabhimatam, tathāpi samuccayenāṅgatayā ca karmaṇopekṣitatvasya tadupapāditatvāttāvanmātramupajīvya pārśvasthena matadvayāvalambicodayitrā pūrvavṛttatvāpādānamukhena coditamiti na nigamanagranthavirodhaḥ | samuccayaśabdasya pradhānatayānvaye svārasyādaṅgatvaparasūtropādānāttadanantaraṃ sādhyadvitvasya sādhanadvitvasya ca nirākariṣyamāṇatvācca matadvayāvalambanena coditamiti pūrvācāryairnirvāhaḥ kṛtaḥ |
atra prativadati naitadyuktamiti  hānārthaṃ karmaṇāṃ jñātavyatvaṃ prāgeva pratikṣiptam, vedāntamātrādhyāyinaḥ karmaviṣayāpātapratītyabhāvena karmanairapekṣyavacanāt, sukṛtavaśādvedāntamātrabubhutsāvataḥ karmajñānānapekṣāvacanācca |
atropādānārthaṃ karmaṇo jñātavyatvaṃ nirācikīrṣuḥ samasamuccayenāṅgabhāvena ca dvividhepyupādāne samasamuccayārthamupādānaṃ prathamaṃ nirākartuṃ sādhanadvitvaṃ sādhyadvitvaṃ ca vākyadvayena pratikṣipati sakalaviśeṣe tyādinā | yathā bāḍhamityādigrantho bhāskaramatena siddhāntamatena vā codyaparaḥ, tadānīṃ pūrvapakṣe sambhāvitasamastaprakāreṇa karmaṇo'pekṣāṃ pratikṣeptukāmaḥ kiṃ tvayā samasamuccayo vivakṣitaḥ, utāṅgabhāvaḥ iti vikalpamabhipretya prathamaṃ samuccayapakṣaṃ pratikṣipatīti nirvāhyam | sakalaviśeṣāḥsajātīyavijātīyasvagatavyāvṛttyanvayarūpaviśeṣāḥ, teṣāṃ pratyanīkaṃ sarpādyākārāṇāṃ rajjutvamiva teṣāṃ nivartakamiti bhāvaḥ | cinmātramiti  mātracā jñātṛtvajñeyatvavyāvṛttiḥ | yadvā, sakalaviśeṣapratyanīkaśabdena vijātīyasajātīyabhedapratyanīkatvaṃ, cinmātramiti mātracā svagatabhedaśūnyatvaṃ ca vivakṣitam, pratyanīkaśabdena nityānarhatvaṃ vivakṣitam | na hi śuktiśakalaṃ kadācidrajatatvasambandhārhaṃ, nityānarhatvādeva hi śuktijñānasya rajatatvanivarttakatvam  brahmavijñānādevāvidyānivṛtteriti | rajjutvajñānādeva hi sarpatvanivṛttiḥ, na tu karmaṇeti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ sādhanadvitvaṃ nirastam | kathaṃ sādhanadvitvavyudāsaḥ sādhyadvitvaṃ hi vidyata iti śaṅkāyāṃ sādhyadvitvaṃ vyudasyati avidyānivṛttitve hi mokṣa iti | brahmaṇo nityaprāptatvāt pratibandhanivṛttireva sādhyā na tatprāptiḥ | hiśabdasyāyamabhiprāyaḥ, yā pratibandhanivṛttiḥ karmasādhyatvena tvayoktā saiva jñānasādhyā śrutismṛtisūtrairabhijñātā "tameva viditvātimṛtyumeti" "jñātvā devaṃ mucyate sarvapāpaiḥ" | pāśairiti pāṭhāntaram | "nicāyya taṃ mṛtyumukhān pramucyate kṣīyante cāsya karmāṇi tasmin dṛṣṭe parāvare" "evamevaṃvidi pāpaṃ karma na śliṣyate" "jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi bhasmasātkurute tathā" "tadadhigama uttarapūrvādhayo"rityādibhiḥ, tasmādvākyadvayena na sādhyasādhanadvitvamastītyuktaṃ bhavati | avidyānivṛttireva mokṣo'stu, tataḥ kiṃ karmanairapekṣyasya? ityatrāha  varṇāśrameti | anena padena pūrvoktaṃ karmaṇo bhedāvalambitvaṃ vivṛtaṃ bhavati | ādiśabdena niṣiddhāni, prāyaścittakarmāṇi ca vivakṣyante | anantaśabdena varṇādīnāṃ bāhulyam | vikalpo bhedaḥ | sakalabhedadaśarnanivṛttirūpājñānanivṛtteriti  mūlājñānanivṛtteḥ phalaṃ hi bhedadarśananivṛttiḥ, ato bhedadarśananivṛttirajñānanivṛttyantargatetyarthaḥ | kathamiva sādhanaṃ  na kathañcidapīti yāvat | " na hi vacanavirodhe nyāyaḥ prabhavatīti" niyamāt | śrutisiddhaṃ karmaṇopekṣitatvaṃ na bādhyamiti śaṅkāyāmuktopapatteḥ śrutyānukūlyaṃ darśayati  śrutayaśceti  na kevalopapattiḥ tadanugrāhyamapyavastīti caśabdasya bhāvaḥ | pūrvaṃ bhedāvalambitayā virodha uktaḥ, atra tu phalānityatayā virodhaśca yuktayantaratvena darśitaḥ | anityaphalatveneti  nityaphalasya mokṣasya kathamanityaphaladaṃ karma sādhanamityarthaḥ | śrutaya ityekasmādanekavākyānāṃ prābalyaṃ vivakṣitam | darśayantītyanenāsphuṭārthāt sphuṭārthānāṃ "antavadevasye"ti karmasādhyatve mokṣasyānityatvaṃ nityatve karmaṇastatsādhanatvaṃ vā na syāt kamarṇontavatphalatvaniyamāditi bhāvaḥ | anena vākyena karmaṇāmanityatvamuktam | tadyathe tyanena karmakṣayasya phaladvārakatvamuktam | pūrvavākyamanekakālānuṣṭhitasakalakarmaṇāmantavattvajñāpanārtham " asmin loke juhoti yajate tapastapyate bahūnirṣasahasrāṇi "antavadevāsya tadbhavati" iti hi śrūyate, tata eva karmanairapekṣyavāde asya vākyasya prathamata upādānam brahmavidāpnotīti jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvamuktam | prāpyaprāptṛbhedaniṣedhārthaṃ "brahma veda brahmaiva bhavatī " tyupāttam | "tameve"ti pratibandhanivṛtterjñānaphalatvaṃ jñāpitam | jñānavyatiriktasya karmāderupāyatvaniṣedhaścānena siddhaḥ "nānyaḥ panthā" iti hyanantaravākyam; evaṃ jñānasyaiva mokṣopāyatvaparatarkānugṛhītaspaṣṭārthānekavākyopādānena "vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ce"tisamasamuccayaparatvena paroktā śrutiścātadarthetyuktaṃ bhavati | tasyā ekatvādasphuṭārthatvādatakopetatvācca śrutyantaravirodhena varṇanīyatvāt, evaṃ jñānasyaiva mokṣopāyatve pramāṇatayā śrutaya upapattayaśca darśitāḥ |
atha yajñādiśruteḥ karmāpekṣitatvaparatāṃ vyudasyati  yadapice tyādinā | siddhāntibhāskarayādavaprakāśānāṃ trayāṇāmapi karmābhimatamitīdṛśaṃ prādhānyaṃ sūcayatyapiśabdaḥ, samuccayaparavākyasya śrutyantarānuguṇyena nirvāhe sati yajñādiśrutiśca nirvāhyeti samuccayābhiprāyaścaśabdaḥ, apicetyakhaṇḍoyaṃśabdo vā, tadānīmapyuktaprakāreṇa samuccayaparaḥ| yaduktaṃ "yajñādikarmāpekṣā vidyā " iti, anayā vacanavyaktayā samuccayena vidyāpekṣitaṃ yatkarmoktamityarthaḥ | vastuvirodhaḥ dvaitavāsanājanakatvamanityaphalavattvaṃ śrutyakṣaraparyālocanā sanpratyārthanirūpaṇam | caḥ samuccaye | vividiṣotpattāvupayogaprakāramāha  antaḥ karaṇeti | na phalotpattau na mokṣotpattau | "yajñena dānena tapasānāśakena brāhmaṇā vividiyanti" iti hi śrutiḥ, na tu mucyanta iti bhāvaḥ | akṣaraparyālocanā kathamityatrāha  vividiṣantīti śravaṇāditi | evaṃ ca yajñādiśrutiparyālocanayā ca jñānakarmaṇoḥ samuccayaḥ pratyuktaḥ, na phalotpattāviti phalaśabdasya mokṣe svārasyādevaṃ yojanā kṛtā | yadvā, yajñādikarmāpekṣāvidheti vacobhaṅgayāṅgatayopekṣitaṃ yatkarmoktamityarthaḥ | na phalotpattau na vedaṃnotpattāvityarthaḥ | vividiṣāpekṣayā hi phalaṃ vedanam, anyatsarvaṃ pūrvavat | asyāṃ yojanāyāṃ yajñādikarmāpekṣāvidyeti nirdeśasvārasyamasti, aṅgāṅgibhāvasūtrasmārakatvādasya nirdeśasya | athavā,yajñādīti prayājādivanniṣpannasya karaṇasya phalotpattidaśāyāmanugrāhakatayāṅgaṃ yatkarmoktaṃ tannopayuktamityarthaḥ | na phalotpattau na mokṣotpattau | karaṇabhūtavidyānugrāhakatvena nopayuktamityarthaḥ | asyāṃ yojanāyāmaṅgāṅgibhāvasūtrasmārakanirdeśasya phalotpattāviti nirdeśasya ca svārasyamasti vividiṣantītyuktirasinā jiṣāṃsatīti baditi yajñādervedanopayogitvaṃ syāditi śaṅkāyāṃ vedanotpattau hetuttvaṃ karmaṇa itikattarvyatātvaṃ karaṇatvaṃ cānupapannamityāha  vividiṣāyā mityādinā vākyadvayena | tatra śamādibhiḥ saha samuccayena vikalpena cetikarttavyatātvaṃ prathamaṃ vyudasyati vividiṣāyāmityādivākyena | evakāradvayena karmaṇaḥ samuccayo vikalpaśca vyudasyate, śamādīnāmindriyavyāpāroparatirūpatvena yajñādikarmaṇastatpravṛttirūpatvenānyonyavirodhitvānna samuccaya upapadyata ityabhiprāyeṇa śamādīnāmevetyuktam | tulyabalayorhi vikalpaḥ bhūtvātmānaṃ paśyediti  śamādīnāmātmadarśanaṃ prati sākṣātsādhanatvasya nyāyanairapekṣyeṇa śīghraṃ pratipannatayā balīyastvāt | vividiṣantīti yajñādericchāsādhanatvena svarasataḥ pratipannatvepi svārasyabhaṅgenāsinā jighāṃsatītyādidṛṣṭāntaparyālocanarūpanyāyasāpekṣatayā karmaṇo vidyāsādhanatvasya vilambena pratipannatayā darbalatvācca na vikalpa ityabhiprāyeṇāha śrutirevāheti | tathāpi vividiṣāpekṣitatvāt karma ca jñānopayogi, tatkathametattyajyeta, śamādirūpādīyate? iti śaṅkāyāṃ karmaṇaḥ śamādivaiṣamyamāha  antaraṅgopāyatāmiti | "bhūtvā paśyet" ityantaraṅgatvaṃ spaṣṭam | vividiṣāyāḥ pūrve hi karmopayogaḥ, śamādi tu paścādapyupayujyata ityabhipretya "jātāyā"mityuktam |
jñānaṃ prati karmaṇaḥ karaṇatvamapi nāstītyāha  tadevamiti  karaṇatvaṃ sambhavatītyāśaṅkaya nirasyate, na tvabhyupagatatvāt viśuddhaṃ mano hi karaṇaṃ "manasā tu viśuddhena" iti śruteḥ | tat uktebhyo hetubhayaḥ | evaṃsamuccayena vikalpena cetikarttavyatātve'nupapanne svargādisādhanasya karmaṇo vividiṣāsādhanatvānupapattiparihārāyānabhisaṃhitaphalaśabdaḥ | vividiṣāyā api tatsādhyatvena phalatvāttasyā anabhisaṃhitatvavyāvṛttyarthaṃ  phalaviśeṣe tyuktam | vividiṣāsiddhayarthamidānīmapyanuṣṭhānāya karmajñānāpekṣāśaṅkāvyāvṛttyarthaṃ janmāntara śabdaḥ | "anekajanmasaṃsiddha" iti vacanādidānīmapyanuṣṭheyamityāśaṅkāparihārārthaḥ  śata śabdaḥ | kāryakalpyaṃ hi kāraṇam, idānīṃ vividiṣotpattyadarśanena janmāntaraśatānuṣṭhānaṃ kalpanīyamitibhāvaḥ | tena karmaṇā mṛditakaṣāyasya naṣṭapāpasya | "kaṣāyapaktiḥ karmāṇi jñānaṃ tu paramā gatiḥ" kaṣāye karmabhiḥ pakve tato jñānaṃ pravarttate" iti hi smṛtiḥ | evaṃ vividiṣotpattau satyāṃ jñānotpattikaraṇamāha  sadeveti  sadevetyādikāraṇavākyam "satyaṃ jñāna"miti śodhakavākyam, satyajñānādivākyaphalitavyāvṛttiviśadīkaraṇāya  niṣkala mityādi vākyamupāttam  ayamātmā brahma  ityaikyavākyam |
upakramādiṣaṅvidhatātparyaliṅgopetamaikyavākyaṃ darśayati  tattvamasīti | asmin vākye brahmaṇā jīvaviśeṣasyaikyaṃ śrutam,"śrutamaikyaṃ sarvātmanā"miti jñāpanārthamayamātmā brahmeti vākyam | ityādivākyaṃ jñānotpattau karaṇaṃ,na karmetyarthaḥ| vākyajanyajñānamavidyānivarttakaṃcet śravaṇādipūrvakadhyānavidhivaiyarthyamityāśaṅkayāha  vākyārtheti | caḥ śaṅkāvyāvarttakaḥ | teṣāṃ svarūpamāha  śravaṇaṃ nāmeti  pratipādakāniniṣpādanakṣamāṇi | vākyajanyajñānāditi hyuktam | etadvirodhiātmaikatvavidyāvirodhi | śravaṇādīnyevaṃrūpāṇi yāni syuḥ, kathameṣāṃ vākyārthajñānopayogaḥ? ityata āha śravaṇādibhiriti | vākyārthajñānotpattivirodhinirasanamupayoga ityarthaḥ | itiuktahetoḥ, jñānakarmasamuccayāṅgāṅgibhāvānupapattihetubhya ityarthaḥ | evaṃrūpasya bandhanivṛttau karmanirapekṣavākyārthajñānopakramabhūtasya, na tu prāsaṅgikārthasya | avaśyāpekṣitamniyamenāpekṣitam | apekṣitaṃ ca kimityata āha tacceti  kuta etadapekṣitamityatrāhaanena vineti | jijñāsānupapatteḥvicārānupapatteḥ | anupapattimupapādayati  arthasvabhāvāditi  kathamatharsvabhāvaḥ? itthamnityānityavastuvivekādanityasāṃsārikaphalabhogavirāgo nityapuruṣārthecchā ca syāttataḥ śravaṇādau pravṛttiḥ, manovadhānahetutayā tadupayoginī śamādisampattiriti arthasvabhāvādevapūrvaprakṛtādevetyevakārābhiprāyaḥ | jñānasyaivopāyatvaṃ karmaṇo'napekṣitatvaṃ cārthasvabhāvāddhi pūvarmuktam | yadvā "anena vinā jijñāsānupapatte"riti śamādyatharsvabhāvādityarthaḥ | śamādi, pūrvavṛttamastu, karma ca pūvarvṛttaṃ syādityata āha  arthasvabhāvādeveti | yenārthasvabhāvena śamādeḥ pūrvavṛttatvaṃ, tenaivārthasvabhāvenānyasya pūvarvṛttatvaniṣedha iti prathamasyaivakārasya bhāvaḥ | pūrvavṛttāntarasya vyāvṛttyarthaṃ dvitīya evakāraḥ | atrārthasvabhāvaśabdena śamādyarthasvabhāva uktaḥ, jñānārthasvabhāvaḥ karmārthasvabhāvaścābhipretaḥ, jñānasya karmanirapekṣopāyatvasvabhāvāt karmaṇo bhedāvalambitvena viruddhasvabhāvatvācca śamādernivṛttirūpatvena pravṛttirūpakarmāvirodhisvabhāvatvācca sādhanacatuṣṭayameva pūrvavṛttam; na tvanyadityuktaṃ bhavati | idameva pūrvavṛttamiti jñāyate iti  idamevaśabdāvayogānyayogavyavacchedaparau | idaṃśabdo hi sādhana vatuṣṭayapūrvavṛttatvaparaḥ, evakāraḥ kamarvyudāsaparaḥ, śamādyarthasvabhāvāttadayogavyavacchedaḥ | tasmājjñānakarmaṇorarthasvabhāvāccānyayogavyavacchedaḥ |
sakalaviśeṣapratyanīkaṃ brahma cet kathaṃ saṃsārapravṛttiḥ? kathaṃ vākyārthajñānādevāvidyānivṛttiḥ? antaḥkaraṇasya kena vā mālinyam? kathaṃ karmaṇā nairmalyam? tecāyogānyayogavyavacchedahetubhūtā arthasvabhāvāḥ kathamiti śaṅkāyāmuktārthaṃ saṅkalayya darśayan śaṅkāśca pariharati  etaduktamiti  brahmasvarūpācchādikāśabdena sakalaviśeṣapratyanīkatvapi svarūpatirodhānādbhedadaśarnaṃ sambhavatītyuktam | bhedaḥ jñātṛjñeyādiḥ | apāramārthikaṃ bhedadarśanameva bandhamūlaṃ, na karmetyarthaḥ | karmopi bhrāntimūlakamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā, apāramārthikaṃ bhedadarśanameva, na satyabhūtaṃ kiṃcidapīti bhāvaḥ | tathā sati hi karmapekṣā, bandhaḥjanmajarāmaraṇādiḥ | bandhaścāpāramārthika iti  avidyāmūlāpāramārthikabhedadarśanakāryatvāditi bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kiṃ kamarnairapekṣyasyetyatrāha  sa ceti | apāramārthikatvādeveti  pūrvoktādevāpāramārthyāt karmanairapekṣyasiddhirityevakārābhiprāyaḥ | jñānenaiva  na karmaṇetyarthaḥ | nahmaparamārthasarpanivṛtterajjujñānena vinā vainateyopāsanakarmāpekṣā | evaṃ samasamuccayaḥ pratyuktaḥ jñānaṃ pratyapi karmaṇo na sādhanatvamityāha  nivarttakaṃ ceti | nivarttakabodhaḥ pramāṇajanya iti yāvat | pramāṇajanyaśuktijñānaṃ hi rajatanivarttakam | atra śamāderitikarttavyatātvena karmaṇa itikarttavyatātvamapi virodhānnetyabhipretam | tataḥ kimityatrāha  tasyeti | tasyakarmanirapekṣasya | etasyaadvaitaviṣayasya | tadetacchabdayoḥ prastutavācitvāviśeṣepi dūrasthāntikasthaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaparāmarśitvaṃ hyucitam | advaitaviṣayatve hetumāha  vākyajanyasyeti | tattvamasyādivākyajanyatvādadvaitaviṣayatvamityarthaḥ | kāryemokṣe | tarhi kutropayogaḥ? ityatrāha vividiṣāyāmiti | tuśabdena karaṇetikarttavyatātvavyudāsaḥ | upayogaḥ katham? ityatrāha 
sa ceti | pāpamūletyādinā antaḥkaraṇanairmalyadvāreṇeti pūrvoktaṃ vivṛtaṃ bhavati | rajastamonibarhaṇādikaṃ nāsmin vākye śrutamityatrāha  itīmamiti | abhipretyaśabdena śaṅkāparihāraḥ, iterhetau | vastuvirodhāditikarttavyatātvakaraṇatvādyanupapattihetubhya ityarthaḥ | imam upayogam, rajastamonirbahaṇasattvavivarddhanarūpaṃ paramparayopayogamityarthaḥ | vividiṣantītyuktamityetaduktaṃ bhavatītyanvayaḥ | prakṛtamupasaṃharati  ataḥ karmajñānasyeti | ataḥ hānārthamupādānārthaṃ ca karmajñānasyānapekṣitatvādityarthaḥ | atra vyākhyātṛbhiruktau saṅgrahaślokau 
virodhādapramāṇatvāccittaśuddhayupayojanāt | jñānamātrasya hetutvaśruteḥ sāmarthyato'pi ca ||
śamādyaṅgakatāmnānānna dhīkarmasamuccayaḥ | śravaṇādikramonnidravākyajā dhīrvimocikā || iti ||
virodhāditi karmaṇāmanityaphalatayā bhedavāsanājanakatayā ca virodho vivakṣita sāmarthyata iti jñānasya mirthyārthānivarttakatve karmaniramekṣatvarūpaṃ vastusāmarthyaṃ vivakṣitam |
rāddhāntamārabhate  atrocyata iti | asmin pūrvapakṣe siddhānta ucyata ityarthaḥ | pūrvapakṣokteṣvartheṣvaviruddhāṃśamabhyupagamena prativadati  yaduktamiti  avidyānivṛttiḥpratibandhanivṛttiḥ, sādhyasādhanadvitvanirāso'bhimata ityarthaḥ | yaḥ pratibandhanirāsaḥ karmasādhya uktaḥ tasya "tameva viditvātimṛtyumetī "tyādiṣu jñānasādhyatvamuktam, brahmaprāptistu svataḥsiddhā | evakārābhyāṃ sādhyāntaraṃ sādhanāntaraṃ ca vyāvatrtyate | yadyapyaniṣṭanivṛttiriṣṭaprāptiśca dvayamasti, tathāpīṣṭhatama brahmaprāpteḥ svataḥsiddhāyāḥ pṛthamupāyasādhyatvābhāvāt pratibandhanivṛttireva sādhyā, svata eva sarvasākṣātkārakṣamaṃ jñānaṃ pratibandhake nivṛtte sati brahmasvarūparūpaguṇavibhavādikaṃ sarvaṃ sākṣātkaroti | yathā,setau bhagne jalaṃ svayameva gacchati na kena cinnetavyaṃ tadvat, yathāśmānayane mārgasamīkaraṇatatprāpaṇe ubhe api pṛthagyatnasādhye na tathetyarthaḥ | yadvā, bhāvāntarasyaivābhāvātvādavidyānivṛttireva brahmaprāptirityarthaḥ | sādhyasādhanadvitvanirāsobhyupetaścet vipratipattiviṣayaḥ ka ityatrāha avidyeti  sādhanasvarūpaviśeṣe vipratipattarityarthaḥ | kiṃrūpam  kiṃ karmāṅgatvānarhaṃ bhavaduktaṃ jñānam uta karmāṅgatvārhamasmaduktaṃ jñānamityarthaḥ | kiṃrūpamityabhipretaṃ vivṛṇoti  kimiti  kiṃ vākyādityādinā paramataṃ svamataṃ ca vadati, na tu paramatavikalpaḥ | prathamaṃ parapakṣapratikṣepaḥ kriyate, svapakṣasthāpanaṃ tu paścādityabhipretyāha  na tāvaditi | na tu dūṣyaśirasoranyataradūṣaṇaṃ kriyate, kuta ityatrāha  tasyeti | vidhānamantareṇāpīti  pramāṇajñānaṃ vastutantraṃ na puruṣatantraṃ karttumakartumanyathākartuṃ cāśakyatvāt, ataḥ puruṣatantratvābhāvānna tadvidheyamiti tairevoktamiti bhāvaḥ | vākyādevabrahmasrūpaparavākyādevaṃ | vyutpattimantaṃ puruṣaṃ prati nyāyānugṛhītasya vākyasyātharbodhakatvaṃ svataḥsiddhaṃ, na tu vidhyadhīnaṃ tacachravaṇe puruṣasya pravṛttiśca rāgādevetyupapāditam | yadyapi na rāgāt, tathāpyadhyayanavidhirevādhītakṛtsnavedavākyavicāre pravatarka iti "prajñāṃ kurvīte"tyādividhirnirarthaka eva | na ca pramāṇajñānasya śreyaḥ sādhanatvamalaukikamiti tādrūpyeṇa tasya vidheyatva śuktirūpyādibhramanivarttakajñānasyeva bandhanivattarkajñānasya dṛṣṭārthatvābhyupagamāt; ato vidhivaiyarthyam | tenāsakṛdāvṛttasākṣātkārabhaktirūpatvayāvajjīvānuṣṭheyatvaparāṇāṃ "yāvanna vimokṣye atha saṃpatsye" ityādīnāṃ mukteḥ śarīrapātānantarabhāvitvaparāṇāṃ nāḍīviśeṣaniṣkramaṇavādinīnāṃ mārgaparāṇāṃ cānekaśrutīnāṃ nairarthakyaṃ prasajyeteti evamanekaśrutivirodhasya pradarśanārthaṃ tasya vidhānamantareṇāpītyuktam | atha pratyakṣavirodaṃ darśayati  tāvanmātreṇeti  tāvadaṃśastatodhikepyastīti tadyvāvṛttyarthaṃ tāvanmātreṇetyuktam | bahuśāstravirodhapratyakṣavirodharūpamidaṃ dūṣaṇadvayaṃ vadatā bhagavatācāpastambenāpi vākyārthajñānamātrasya mokṣasādhanatvaṃ nirastam "yathā buddhe kṣemaprāpaṇaṃ tacchāstrervipratiṣiddhaṃ buddhecet kṣeyaprāpaṇamihaiva na duḥkhamu palabheta etena paraṃ vyākhyāta"miti | śāstreriti bahuvacanena parvodāhṛtānekaśrutivirodho'bhipretaḥ | vipratiṣedhodhikabalena pratiṣedhaḥ, na tu prakaraṇasamavat tulyabalena pratiṣedhaḥ, bahuśāstravirodhaḥ prabalataraḥ "bhūyasāṃ syāt balīyastvami"tinyāyābhiprāyeṇa vipratiṣiddhamityuktam | yattu parairasya dūṣaṇasya prativacanaṃ dvedhā kṛtaṃ tadanubhāṣya dūṣayati  na ca vācyamiti  vākyaṃ jñānotpattimidānīṃ na janayatīti kaścinnirvāhaḥ tamāha bhedeti | idānīṃ jñānotpattirdṛśyata iti cet tatparihārāyāha  avidyānivarttakamiti | paścādapi vākyādevāvidyānivarttakaviśadajñānotpattiścedidānīmeva janayatvityatrāha  bhedavāsanāyāmiti pratibandhakābhāvaśca sāmagrayantarbhūtaḥ, ataḥ sāmagrīvaikalyāt jñānamanutpannam, dhyānādividhaya pratibandhakanirāsaupayikā iti bhāvaḥ| anena śāstrapratyakṣavirodhau parihṛtau bhavataḥ, sanakādīnāṃ jñānādhikatvena śrutismṛtiprasiddhānāmapi jñānāmudayo'nupapanna iti śaṅkāyāṃ nirvāhāntaramāha  jātepīti avidyāyā ekatvāt, prapañcapratibhāsasyaikasya brahmaṇaḥ svapnarūpatvācca  sarvasye tyuktam | na doṣāya anivarttakatvaṃ doṣāya na bhavati | jñānodayepi bhramānivṛttau dṛṣṭāntaṃ darśayati  candaikatve iti anivṛttaṃ ced bhedadarśanaṃ bandhakaṃ syāt ityata āha  anivṛttamapīti | chinnamūlatvena  chinnāvidyākhyamūlatvena akāryakaram | yathā, dagdhaḥ paṭaḥ pūrvasaṃniveśena pratīyamānopyācchādanādikāryāyogyaḥ krameṇa vinaśyet, yathā kulālabhramitaṃ cakraṃ bhrāmayitṛvyāpārāparamepi pūrvavegavaśāt kvacitkālaṃ svayameva bhramat krameṇoparamate tadvaditi bhāvaḥ | atreti karaṇasya na vācyamityanenānvayaḥ | prathamaṃ jñānāmutpatiṃta dūṣayati  satyāmiti nyāyānugṛhītavākyameva sāmagrī pratibandhikābhedavāsanāstīti cettatrāhasatyāmapīti  nivataryā vāsanā nivarkṣakotpattipratibandhikā na bhavatītyarthaḥ | ādiśabdādindriyaṃ gṛhyate, yathā cirataratimiravāsitaguhāyāṃ pratīpo na notpadyate tasmin dīpite sadya eva tamo vinaśyet, yathā kvaciddeśe sarpa iti vākyācciraṃ bhramitopi puruṣo na tatra sarpa ityāptopadeśājjānāti, yathā ca vanaṃ na dagdhamiti śrutvā ciraṃ bhrāntasya paścāttatra gatvāṅgārādiliṅgadarśanena dagdhamiti jñānaṃ jāyate, yathā ciraṃ sarpatvena vāsite vastuni samīpagamanānantaramindriyavyāpāreṇa rajjujñānaṃ sahasaiva jāyate tadvadityabhiprāyeṇāptopadeśaliṅgādibhirbādhakajñānotpattidarśanādityuktam | vedāntavākyaṃ hi dārṣṭhāntikam, ata āptopadeśasya prathamopādānam atha dvitīyanirvāhakamanūdya nirasyati satyapīti | mātrayā  alpamityarthaḥ | bhavatā brahmavyatiriktakṛtsnamithyātvavādineti bhāvaḥ | bhavateti sūcitamarthaṃ vivṛṇoti  bhedeti | vāsanāyā api mithyātvāviśeṣāttasyā api jñānena nivṛttatvamavaśyāśrayaṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ | kiṃ jñānotpattāvapi vāsanā na nivṛttetyucyate, uta tannivṛttāvapi nirhetukaṃ bhedadarśanaṃ bhavati? iti śaṅkādvayaṃ hṛdi nidhāya prathamāṃ pariharati  jñānotpattāvapīti  brahmavyatiriktasya kṛtsnasya mithyātvādvāsanāpi jñānaikanivṛtrtyā, nocetnivattarkāntaramapi jñānatvāviśeṣānna nivarttayedityarthaḥ | svayameva vāsanā naśyatīti cet tadayuktam | svayameveti bādhakajñānanairapekṣyasya vivakṣitatve vāsanāyā naśvantyā api satyatvaprasaṅgāt svayameva naśyatīti svenaiva svavināśakaraṇaṃ vivakṣitaṃ cedvadhāpātaḥ | phalopāntyakāraṇanāśādināśyatvepi satyatvaprasaṅgo'varnanīya eva karmaśabdādiṣu tathaiva vaiśeṣikairvaṇitatvāt teṣāṃ ca pāramārthyadarśanāt | kiṃca svaprāryotpattyādivad vāsanāyā mithyātve tadutpattisthitī api mithyābhūte iti tadvināśopi mithyābhūtaḥ, ato vināśaviṣayabhramaḥ punastiṣṭhatīti niśśeṣabhramanivṛttirna syāt | atha dvitīyāyāṃ śaṅkāṃ pariharati  vāsaneti  chinnamūlam chinnavāsanākhyamūlam | bāliśabhāṣitamiti  akāraṇakāryotpattiprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | yadyakāraṇaṃ bhedadarśanaṃ bhavati tarhi muktirapi jñānanirapekṣā syāt, śravaṇādibhirvinā vākyārthajñānaṃ syāt avidyayā vinā jagadbhramaśca syāt, adhiṣṭhānena vinā avidyāpi kāryakarīsyāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu tarhi kathaṃ satyapi bādhakajñāne candradvitvānivṛttirityāha  dvicandreti | tuśabdo vivakṣitārthavaiṣamyaparaḥ | bādhaka sannidhāvapi tajajñāna sannidhāvapi | timirādidoṣasya pāramārthyāt jñānābādhyatvāditibhāvaḥ | tatpāramārthyaṃ vyāvahārikatayāpi pareṇābhyupagantavyam, anyathā āptopadeśānantaraṃ rajjusarpavyavahārocchedanaddoṣo mithyeti vacanānantaraṃ doṣanivṛttyā candradvitvādivyavahārocchedaprasaṅgāt ato doṣasya vidyamānatvātbhedabhramasya sabhūlatvam; anena bādhakasannidhau bādhyasadbhāvaḥ kāraṇakāryotpattiśceti dūṣaṇadvayaṃ dṛṣṭānte parihṛtaṃ bhavati | paramate tu dūṣaṇadvayaṃ tiṣṭhatyeva, tarhyāsopadeśādivaiyarthyamityatrāha  prabaleti | rajanusarpabhrāntimatpuruṣāpekṣayā bhayādikāryanivṛtti phalatvenoktā | ādiśabdāt prasāyanādi gṛhyate, dvicandrajñāne ca svasyāduṣṭakaraṇatvadhīnivṛttirauṣadhādipravṛttiśca phalam; aindrajālikabhramādiṣu bhramahetoḥ prābalyādvastuto bhramatvepyasatyaviṣayatvaniścayapratibandhaḥ syāditi tadyvāvṛttyarthaḥ prabalapramāṇaśabdaḥ  nivarttata iti  pratibhāse vidyamānepi viṣayasatyatvābhāvaniścayadvārā bhayādinivṛttiheturāptopadeśa ityarthaḥ| yadvā, yathāvadarthasvarūpāparokṣyapravṛttidvārā bhayādinivṛttiheturityarthaḥ | tuśabdaḥ śaṅkāvyāvarttakaḥ | jñānānutpattipakṣasya bahvabhimatatvāt siṃhāvalokitakena taṃ dūṣayati  apiceti  nāyaṃ sarpo rajjuritivaddṛṣṭadvārā hi bhedanirāsaḥ, adṛṣṭamukhena ced bhedasatyatvaprasaṅgāt; ato bhūyasyā bhedavāsanāyā alapīyasyā advaitavāsanayā nirāso'nupapanna ityarthaḥ | nanvadṛṣṭadvārā nivartyatve nivartyasya satyatvaṃ nāniṣṭam | dhyānanivṛttyasarpavadyvavahāradaśāyāṃ vāsanāyāḥ satyatvābhyupagamāt; utpanne tu jñāne tadutpattisthitivināśāśca bādhitāḥ syuriti | naivam; dhyānanivatrtyasarpasyānityatvameva, na kadācidapi bādhyatvaṃ siddhamiti, tadvadevādṛṣṭanivatrtyavāsanāyā api vāstavasatyatvaprasaṅgāt | nanvaikyabhāvanārūpaṃ nididhyāsanaṃ pratibandhanivarttakaṃ ceduktadoṣaḥ syāt, tattu na pratibandhanivṛttyai kintu vākyārthajñānodayasahakārīti | naivamsmṛtirūpasya nididhyāsanasyānubhavasāpekṣatayā tasya vākyārthajñānajananasahakāritvāyogāt | nanu yadyapi parokṣānubhavasya dhyānamanupakārakaṃ, tathāpi nididhyāsanasahakṛtaṃ vākyamaparokṣadhīhetuḥ syāt | naivam, nidityāsanasahakṛtatvepi śābdatvādevāparokṣadhīhetutvāyogāt jyotiṣṭomavākyavat evaṃ śāstrapratyakṣavirodhāttadavirodhanirvāhānupapattyā ca vākyārthajñānamātrasya nivarttakatvāsaṃbhavāt pāriśeṣyād vākyārthajñānādanyadeva muktayupāyajñānaṃ vidhitsitamityāha  ata iti  na kevalaṃ pāriśeṣyam | tadanugrāhyāḥ śrutayaśca santītyāha | tathā ceti | vijñāyetyādivākyadvaye jñānasāmānyaśabdaḥ vākyadvayopādānaṃ ca upasargabhedepi vidhipratyayāntatvatadrāhityayoścārthabhedo nāstīti jñāpanārtham | dhyāyatheti  viśeṣaśabdaḥ | nicāyyeti  dhyānasya pratyakṣasamānākāratā darśitā | "cāyṛ darśane" iti hi dhātuḥ | upāsīta  ityanena jñānasyopāsana śabdavācyatvaṃ siddham | anveṣṭavya  iti mananaśiraskaśravaṇoktiḥ | nididhyāsitavyaḥ vijijñāsitavya itvupādānena sanantatvepīṣyamāṇajñānaparaṃ vākyamiti darśitam | sanantapadadvayasyopādānaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdatvāt | ityevamādyā iti  itiśabda upāttaśrutivākyasvarūpamātraparaḥ, evaṃśabdaḥ sanantatvavidhipratyayantatvatadrāhityopasargabhedādiprakāraparaḥ |
udāhṛtavākyeṣu jñānasāmānyavācipadānāṃ viśeṣākāṅkṣāyāṃ vākyārthajñānasvarūpo viśeṣaḥ paryavasānabhūmiḥ syāditi śaṅkānivṛttyarthamāha  atreti | atra upātteṣu vākyeṣu | ityevamādibhirdhyānaṃ vidhīyata ityanvayaḥ | nididhyāsitavya ityādiceti  ādiśabdena sanūrahitajñānaviśeṣavācivākyāntaraṃ vivakṣitam aikārthyaṃ ca sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyāt, sahyanuktākāṃkṣitasvīkāraphalaḥ, tatra "chāgovā mantravarṇāditi" nyāyāt sāmānyavāciśabdānāṃ viśeṣaparyavasānam | "anuvidya vijānāti" "vijñāya prajñāṃ kurvīte" tyatra kena padena vākyārthajñānamanūdyate? kena vā dhyānaṃ vidhīyate? ityapekṣāyāmāha  anuvidya vijñāyetyanūdyeti | anuvādaḥ kimarthaḥ? ityatrāha  dhyānopakārakatvāditi | prajñāṃ kurvīta vijānātīti vākyadvayopādānasya pūrvoktameva phalam | evaṃ smṛtiṣvapi sāmānyaśabdaḥ sati viśeṣopasthāpake tatparyavasito dṛṣṭaḥ |
niṣiddhabhakṣaṇaṃ jaihvayamutkarṣeṇa vaco'nṛtam | rajasvalāmukhāsvādaḥ surāpānasamāni tu ||
ityatra niṣiddhasāmānyasya bhakṣaṇasāmānyaṃ pātityaheturavagatam |
chatrākaṃ viṅvarāhaṃ ca laśunaṃ grāmakukkuṭam | palāṇḍuṃ gṛñjanaṃ caiva matyā jagadhvā pateddvijaḥ ||
ityatra niṣiddhaviśeṣasya bhakṣaṇaviśeṣaḥ pātityaheturdṛṣṭaḥ | atra pūrvagranthaścaramagranthārthe paryavasyati | bhavatu sāmānyaśabdo viśeṣaparyavasāyī, atra tu jñānasāmānyavāciśabdaḥ śrotavya iti śravaṇarūpajñānaviśeṣe paryavasyatvityatrāha | śrotavya iti ceti  caḥ śaṅkānivṛttau samuccaye vā, vijñāyānuvidyetivadayaṃ cānuvāda ityarthaḥ | tatsaṅkṣepeṇopapādayati  svādhyāyasyeti  āpātapratītyā svataḥ prāptiḥ śravaṇasya syāt, mananasya tādṛśahetutvābhāvāttatra payravasānamastvityatrāha  śravaṇapratiṣṭhārthatvāditi  caḥ pūrvavat  tasmādyvānameveti  na tu vākyārthajñānamityarthaḥ| nanu śrotavya iti pustakanirīkṣaṇādivyāvṛttyartho vidhiḥ kiṃ na syāt? naivam vedāntavākyānāmapi pustakanirīkṣaṇādivyudāsasyādhyayanavidhisiddhatvāt, brahmamīmāṃsāyā vilekhanapaṭhanāderapratiṣiddhatvāt, gurūpasattau śravaṇaśabdasya mukhyārthatvābhāvāttasyāścātrāvihitatvepi "gurumevābhigacchedi"tivākayāntarasiddhatvācca | nanu, nyāyopetavākyamātrānavagamyakevalopadeśagamyārthaviśeṣaśravaṇaṃ śrotavya iti vidheyamiti cenna, mananapūrvabhāvitayā'sya śravaṇasya nyāyānugṛhītavākyajanyajñānarūpatvāvagamāt śabdasvārasyācca | na ca mantavya ityālambanasaṃśīlanarūpamananavidhiriti vācyam;śravaṇaśabdasya nyāyopetavākyajyajñāna iva mantavyaśabdasya tatpratiṣṭhāpane prasiddhiprācuryāttasya cāpavādābhāvāt, ubhayoraprāptārthadvayavidāyitve vākayabhedaprasaṅgāt, sati gatyantare viśiṣṭavidhānāśrayaṇasyānyāyyatvācca, vidhirhi padāvagateṣvartheṣvekatropakṣīṇaśaktirlāghavāya taditareṣu svato'nuvādamapekṣamāṇaḥ prāpakābhāvādviśiṣṭe tātparyaṃ bhajate, atra tvanuvādasambhavānna viśiṣṭaviṣatvakalpanaṃ yuktam, tasmādanuvādaḥ, anena śravaṇaśabdasya upāyopeyadaśāsādhāraṇatvādupari niyāmakasphuṭārthavākyāntareṇa saha vyākhyāsyate | nanu na sādhāraṇatvaṃ draṣṭavya iti tavyatādarśanasya vidheyatvapratīteḥ, phalasya cāvidheyatvāt | ucyate, nididhyāsanavaddarśanasya, ca vidhāne vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt, niścitānuvādaśravaṇamananasāhacaryācca vidhitvaniścayapratibandhādupāsyadarśanarūpatvaviṣayapramāṇādarśane viśiṣṭavidhitvāśrayaṇāyogāt "manasaitān kāmān paśyan ramate ya ete brahmaloke parātparaṃ puriśayaṃ puruṣamīkṣate" ityādibhiḥ phaladaśāyāṃ darśanasya prāmāṇikatvācca śrotavya itivattavyadarthamanādṛtya phalasamarpakatvaṃ draṣṭavyaśabdasya śaṅkituṃ yuktamiti ata upariṣṭādyvākhyeyatvam | athopāsanasya vidhitsitatvadraḍimne sūtrakorokiṃta darśayati  vakṣyati ceti  tādṛāsūtrāsambhavavyudāsāya sūtramupādatte  āvṛttiriti  upāsanaśabdāśravaṇāt sūtrasya tatparatvamasphuṭamiti tasyārthamāha  taditamiti | āvṛttidvayatrayavyāvṛttyarthamasakṛditi sautraṃ padam | kasyāvṛttiḥ? ityapekṣāyāmāha  tadidaṃ vedanamiti | tadidaṃ tṛtīyādhyāyāvasāne evaṃ muktiphalāniyamastadavasthānadhṛteriti prastutaṃ mokṣaphalaṃ jñānamityarthaḥ | yadvā,prajñāṃ kurvītetyādisāmānyaśabdoktaṃ vedanaprasakṛdāvṛttirūpamupāsanamityartaḥ | avagamyata  ityantenāvṛttirasakṛditi sūtrāṃśo vyākhyātaḥ, upadeśāditi padaṃ vyācaṣṭe  vidyupāsyoriti  sthalatrayamudāharati  mana iti  mano brahmeti vākyaṃ "rātrīrupeyā"ditivat "pratitiṣṭhanti ha vā ete ya etā rātrīrupayantī "tyatra ya etā rātrīriti satrānuvādavat ya evaṃ vedeti pūrvavihitopāsanasya phalārthamanuvādaḥ | vitaraṇavikramādihetubhedāt kīrttiyaśasorbhedaḥ | mano brahmetyupāsītetyādiprakaraṇe yastadvedetyādiprakaraṇe ca vedanopāsanavāciśabdayorviprakarṣāt prakaraṇaikatvajñāpanāyātretyuktam  anu ma iti yāṃ devatāmupāsse etāṃ devatāmanuśādhi, anupūrvaḥ śāsirvivicya jñāpanārthaḥ, vivicya jñāpayetyarthaḥ | "vyavahitāśce"ti sūtreṇa chandasyupasargāṇāṃ vyavahitaprayogaḥ | na sa vedetyatra sannikarṣādatraśabdāprayogaḥ | na sa vedetyasya "atha
yo'nyāṃ devatāmupāsta" ityetadvākyapūrvakatvādupakramopasaṃhārayorupāsanaśabdaḥ, madhye vedanaśabdaḥ, idaṃ ca pūrvasminvākye upakramopasaṃhāradarśanādityetenābhipretam | yastadveda tasya brahmaṇo veditā yo raikvaḥ, yatsa veda tasya raikasya vedyaṃ yadbrahma, sa veditā raika etadvedyaṃ ca ubhayaṃ tava prayoktamityarthaḥ | sāmānyaviśeṣanyāyena prakaraṇāntaroktajñānasāmānyavāciśabdānāṃ prakaraṇāntaroktaviśeṣe paryavasāyitvaṃ pūrvameva svayameva hi bhāṣyakāreṇa darśitam | sūtravyākhyāne tvekaikaprakaraṇe vyatikareṇopakramopasaṃhāradarśanamupadeśāditi padasyārthatvenoktam | ubhayatrobhayaṃ hetutvena vācyam, tathāpyavistarārthamekaikamuktam; ata eva hi caturthādhyāye ubhayamapi hetutvena vakṣyate | tadidamityādikaṃ sūtravyākhyānam | anyathā taditamapavargopāyatayā vidhitsitaṃ vedanamiti nocyeta, kintu dhyānamupāsanamityevocyeta, itarathāṅkhalitoktiprakaraṇānaucityāt; paścādapi dhyānaṃ ca tailadhārāvadavicchinnasmṛtisantānarūpamiti pūrvaprakṛtadhyānaśabdena nirdeśāt pūrvagranthe dhyānasyopāsanarūpatvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ cet paścādupāsanamavicchinnasmṛtisantānarūpamityupāsanaśabdenocyeta | evaṃ prakṛtasūtrārthe 'vadhṛte pūrvaprakṛtasya dhruvānusmṛtitvamupapādayati  dhyānaṃ ceti  venasyāsakṛdāvṛtiṃta vadataḥ sūtrakārasyāyaṃ bhāvaḥ; yathā jñānasāmānyavācināṃ śabdānāṃ viśeṣaparyavasāyitvenāsakṛdāvṛttirūpajñānaparatvaṃ siddham, evaṃ viśeṣāntaropasthāpakeṣu satsu tadviśeṣaparyavasāyitvaṃ nyāyyamiti | tasmātsūtrakāreṇa kaṇṭhoktaṃ jñānasyāsakṛdāvṛttirūpatāmupapādya tenābhipretaṃ śrutyantaropasthāpitaṃ viśeṣāntaramāha  dhyānaṃ ceti | anena granthenāsakṛdāvṛttervyavahitatvaśaṅkānirāsārthaṃ vijātīyapratyayāntarāvyavahitatvamuktam | atra vicchinnāvicchinnasmṛtisantatisādhāraṇo dhyānaśabdaścet, dhyānaṃ cetyādinā viśeṣāntare paryavasānamuktaṃ bhavati, dhyānaśabdasyāvicchinnasmṛtisantatyasādhāraṇatve dhyānaśabdo vyākhyāto bhavati | avicchinnasmṛtisantatitve vacanamāha  dhruveti | smṛterdhruvatvaṃ nāma vijātīyapratyayāntarāvyavahitasantatitvam, smṛtivyaktīnāṃ kṣaṇikatvāt | apavargopāyatvaśravaṇāditi  tatrāpavargopāyabhūtavedanasyāsakṛdāvṛttiruktā | atrāpi tadupāyatvapratyabhijñānāttasyaivāvicchinnasantatirūpatvaṃ vivakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ | tasyāḥ darśanarūpatvamucyate  sā ceti  na kevalaṃ viṣayaikyataḥ sāmyam, apitvāparokṣyeṇāpītyākāraśabdasya bhāvaḥ| hṛdayasyamanasaḥ granthayorāgādayaḥ | yadvā, mañcāḥ krośantīti vaddhṛdayaśabdastatsthajīvaparaḥ, hṛtsthānamayatīti vyutpattervā, tasya granthiḥprakṛtisaṃbandhaḥ, hṛdayaśabdopalakṣitaṃ vā śarīraṃ granthiḥ | saṃśayaśabdo viparyayasyāpi pradarśanārthaḥ| dehātmābhimānādirūpā'vidyetyarthaḥ | karmāṇipuṇyapāparūpāṇi | avidyāsañcitakarmakṛtaprakṛtisambandhanivṛttidarśanasamānākāropāsanenetyarthaḥ | evaṃ ca satīti  upāyadaśāyāṃ jñānasya darśanarūpatve sphuṭārthavākyāntarasiddhe satītyarthaḥ | caśabdo draṣṭavyaśabdasya phaladaśābhiprāyatvaśaṅkānivṛttyarthaḥ | daśarnaśabdasya jñānasāmānyaparatvasambhavepi "draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ" "ātmani khalvare dṛṣṭe śrute mate vijñāta idaṃ sarve viditam" iti | śravaṇādīnāṃ pṛthaguktatvāddraṣṭavya itipadaṃ sākṣātkārarūpatvaparam, dṛṣṭaśabdaśca tattulyārthaḥ, sa copāyadaśābhiprāyaḥ, tasmin dṛṣṭe hṛdayagranthirbhidyate ityuktatvāt | "yenāhaṃ nāmṛtā syām" "amṛtatvasya tu nāśāsti vittena" "etāvadeva khalvare'mṛtatva"miti pūrvāparavākyeṣu phalasya nirdiṣṭatvāt prakaraṇāntaroktasya sākṣātkāratvasyehāpi vaktumapekṣitatvādapekṣitavidheranapekṣitavidhānadaurbalyācca | nanu dhruvānusmṛtereva darśanarūpatvavidhirayuktaḥ, dhruvānusmṛtidarśanayorbhinnaprakaraṇāmnātayordaharaśāṇḍilyādivedanānāmiva parasparanirapekṣopāyatvaṃ hi pratīyate | naivam, draṣṭavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ ityekavākyavihitatvāt | na ca tatrāpi vidyādvayavidhānaṃ śakyam, rūpabhedābhāvāt, tata eva vākyaikatve saṃbhavati vākyabhedāśrayaṇāyogāt, vidyāntarāṇāmiva tayorvikalpaprasaṅgācca | tayornirapekṣopāyatvavādino vikalpa iṣṭa iti cenna, tasyāṣṭadoṣaduṣṭasya sati gatyantarebhyupagantumayuktatvāt | dṛśyate hi vrīhiyavaśāstrayostasyā
ṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvam | vrīhyanuṣṭāne yavaśāstrasya prāmāṇyatyāgaḥ, avidyāmānāprāmāṇyakalpanaṃ, yavānuṣṭāne tasya tyaktaprāmāṇyasvīkāraḥ svīkṛtāprāmāṇyatyāgaśceti yavaśāstre catvāro doṣāḥ, yavānuṣṭhānavelāyāmeva prathamaprayoge svīkṛtavrīhiśāstraprāmāṇyatyāgaḥ, tadaprāmāṇyakalpanaṃ ca tṛtīyaprayoge vrīhiṣupādīyamāneṣu dvitīyaprayoge svīkṛtavrīhiśāstrāprāmāṇyatyāgastyaktaprāmāṇyasvīkāraśceti vrīhiśāstre catvāro doṣāḥ, ihāpi yathāsambhavaṃ doṣaprāptiḥ | yadvā pratipattibādho 'nuṣṭhānabādo 'pūrvabādhaḥ phalabādhaśceti ekaikaśirasi doṣacatuṣṭayādaṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvam | ato gatyantare sati vikalpāyogācca na dhruvānusmṛtidarśanayoḥ pṛthagupāyatvam, nāpi samuccayaḥ caśabdāśravaṇāt darśapūrṇamāsayoriva dvandvanirdeśābhāvācca, paramātmano'tīndriyatvāttatsākṣātkārasya cakṣuṣā śabdagrahaṇasyeva prakāntayogaṃ pratyaśakyavidhānatvācca, śabdaviṣayayoḥ smaraṇacākṣuṣajñānayoriva samuccayonupapannaḥ | nanu paramātmano yogapariśuddhamanogrāhatvānna taddarśanasya cakṣuṣā śabdajñānatulyateti darśanopāyabhūtasya vyāpārasya vidheyatvopapattessamuccayassambhavatīti | satyam; kastaddarśanopāyaḥ? "tatastu taṃ paśyate niṣkalaṃ dhyāyamāna" iti śruterdhyānameveti cettarhi draṣṭavyanididhyāsitavyapadayoḥ punaruktiḥ syāt, ubhayorapi darśanopāyadhyānavidhiparatvāviśeṣāt | draṣṭavya iti darśanopāye vihite, ka upāyaḥ? ityapekṣāyāṃ nididhyāsanaṃ vidhīyate; draṣṭavyapadābhāve nididhyāsanasya tadupāyatvaṃ na jñāyata iti tajjñāpanārthatvānna punaruktiriti cenna, draṣṭavyapadaśravaṇepi darśanasya dhyānasādhyatvāpratīteḥ, na hi daśarnakāmaneti śrūyate, tathā sati hi svargayāgayoriva darśanaṃ pratidhyānasya dṛṣṭakiñcitkāraḥ, ato na mānātareṇa tayossādhyasādhanabhāvāvagama iti vaiyarthyam | kiṃca dhyānasādhyaṃ darśanaṃ cet dhyānadarśanayoḥ samuccayaśca na sambhavati, darśanaṃprati samuccaye darśanasya darśanaṃ sādhanamityātmāśrayaprasaṅgāt | na ca mokṣaṃ prati samuccayasaṃbhavaḥ, dhyānasya svasādhyadaśarnavyavahitasya mokṣaṃ prati darśanena sahāvyavahitakiṃcitkārāyogāt, na hi yāganiṣpattyarthānāṃ prokṣaṇāvaghātādīnāmapūrvaniṣpattau yogena saha samuccayaḥ, yadi sākṣātkāraṃ prati dhyāyena sahāvyavahitakiṃcitkāropapattaye darśanasamānākāraṃ jñānāntaraṃ vidheyamityucyate tadayuktam svargaṃ prati jyotiṣṭomavratasyeva nididhyānasya sādhyaṃ prati nirapekṣopāyatāpratītisvārasyabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt na hi "jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajete"tivākyapratipannajyotiṣṭomasya svargasādhanatvaṃ karmāntarasāpekṣamavagamyate | nacātra caśabdo dvandvasamāso vā, ato darśanasamānākāratārūpaviśeṣaṇasya kiṃ viśeṣyamityākāṅkṣāyāṃ viśeṣyāntaraṃ ca na dṛśyate, nididhyāsanaṃ ca sannihitam atastadeva darśanasamānākāratayā vidhitsitamiti yuktamabhyupagantum, tataśca vākyabhedopi na syāt, nididhyāsanasya nirapekṣopāyatāpratītisvārasyaṃ ca na bādhyeta | nanu viśiṣṭavidhyāśrayaṇaṃ cedupadeśaikagamyārthaśravaṇaśubhāśrayamananadarśanarūpāviśiṣṭanididhyāsanavidhiḥ kiṃ na syāt? naivamcaturṣveśeṣu tātparyakalpanādapi dvayostatkalapanasya laghutvāt | laghupakṣasambhave gurupakṣāśrayaṇāyogācca, nacāsminvākye vidhānābhāvādaupadeśikārthādhigamālambanasaṃśīlanayorasiddhiḥ śaṅkanīyā, "tasmād brāhmaṇaḥ pāṇḍityaṃ nirvidyabālyena tiṣṭhāset | bālyaṃ ca pāṇḍityaṃ ca nirvidyātha muni"rityanyathāsiddhavākyāntarasiddhatvāt; taddhi nirūpayiṣyate "sahakāryantaravidhi"ritisūtreṇa, tasmāddarśanasamānākāratvaguṇaviśiṣṭanididhyāsanavidhiḥ | nanvevamapi sarvopāsanānāṃ na darśanasamānākāranididhyāsanarūpatāsiddhiḥ | "dṛṣṭavyo nididhyāsatavya" iti vākyasya maitreyībrāhmaṇe satvāt, atastatra pratipādyasyaivopāsanaviśeṣasya tādṛgrūpatā pratipādyā syāt | naivam "ātmani khalvare dṛṣṭe śrute mate vijñāte idaṃ sarvaṃ viditamiti"tatratyenaiva vākyena jagatkāraṇaviṣayasarvopāsanānāṃ darśanasamānākāranididhyāsanarūpatāvagamāt, nahīdaṃ vākyaṃ vidyāviśeṣavidāyakam, kāraṇajñānena sarvajñātatāpratijñāparatvāt, kāraṇameva hi sarvavidyopāsyam, "kaśca dhyeyaḥ" ityupakramya "kāraṇaṃ tu dhyeya" iti kāraṇasyaiva dhyeyatvavidhānāt kāraṇaviṣayaṃcopāsanamatra darśanasamānākāranididhyāsanarūpamavagamyate | asminvākye vijñātaśabdo hi nididhyāsanaparaḥ "draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ" "dṛṣṭe śrute mate vijñāte" iti sthānapramāṇāt | ato'sya vākyasya sarvavidyāsādhāraṇakāraṇamātraviṣayatvāt jagatkāraṇopāsanaṃ ceddarśanasamānākāranididhyāsanarūpamavagamyate | kiñca nānāvidyānāṃ vikalpasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt, gurupakṣaviṣayaśāstravaiyarthyaprasaṅgena gurulaghuyatnavikalpāyogādvastusāmathaṃryasya prakaraṇād balīyastayā ca dhruvānusmṛtirūpatvaṃ, darśanarūpatvaṃ, vakṣvamāṇabhaktirūpatvaṃ, ca sarvavidyāsādhāraṇākārā bhavitumarhanti | nanvindriyajanmano'nubhavasya hyaparokṣatvaṃ tatkathaṃ smṛteḥ saṃbhavatītyatrāha  bhavati ceti | bhāvanāvāsanā darśanarūpatādarśanasamānākāratā "vṛkṣe vṛkṣe ca paśyāmī "tyādiṣvapi darśanasamānākāratvaṃ smṛteśca dṛṣṭamiti bhāvaḥ, tacca viśadatarāvabhāsarūpatvaṃ, nacaitadanubhavāsādhāraṇaṃ smṛterapi tatsadbhāvasya prāmāṇikattvāt | nanu darśanasamānākāratvavidhānamayuktaṃ, darśanavāciśabdena tatsamānākāropasthāpanasyāmukhyatvāt "na vidhau paraḥ śabdārtha" iti nyāyavida iti cennataireva "darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajete"tyatra darśapūrṇamāsaśabdayorlakṣaṇayā, śyenādivākye śyenādiśabdānāṃ gauṇyā vṛttyā, karmanāmadheyatvābhyupagamāt "arddhamantarvedi minuyādarddhe bahirvedī "tyatrāpi madhyadeśalakṣaṇāyā aṅgīkṛtatvācca, viśadataratvasya phalarūpatvādapuruṣatantrasya kathaṃ vidhāna?miti cenna ājyāvekṣaṇasyeva vidhānopapatteḥ | tatrājyasākṣātkārahetubhūtavyāpāraviṣayo vidhiriti cennaihāpi viśadataratvāvahasmṛtisaṃtativiṣayamanovyāpāravidhirityupapannam | atha sūtrakārābhiprāyayidāṃ vacanaṃ darśayati  vākyakāreṇeti | etatsarvamiti  sūtrakāreṇa kaṇṭhoktamabhipretaṃ cetyarthaḥ prapañcitamiti  pūrvapakṣasiddhāntarūpeṇoktamityarthaḥ | prapañcaṃ na vedanamupāsanaṃ syādityādivākyacatuṣṭayena vākyamekaikaṃ vyācaṣṭe  sarvāsūpaniṣatsviti  na kaivalaṃ chāndogyaṃ ityarthaḥ | mokṣasādhanatayā vihitaṃ vedanamiti ghaṭādijñānavyāvṛttiḥ | vihitamityanūditaśravaṇādivyāvṛttiḥ | asyārthasya pūrvapakṣasiddhāntarūpeṇa sphuṭīkaraṇārthaṃ sakṛtpratyayaṃ kuryāditi vākyaśravaṇena vedanamupāsanaṃ syāditi vākyasya pūrvapakṣaparatvaśaṅkāvyāvṛttyarthaṃ ca sakṛdityādikaṃ vyācaṣṭe sakṛditi  sakṛdityādivākyameva pūrvapakṣaparaṃ na tu vedanamupāsanaṃ syāditivākyam anantaramevopāsanarūpatvasya siddhāntitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | tathā siddhāntitatvaṃ darśayati  siddhaṃ tviti  siddhantu siddhāntastvityarthaḥ | yadvā vedamupāsanaṃ siddhamityarthaḥ | upāsanaśabdādityetadyvācaṣṭe  vedanamasakṛdāvṛttamiti  asyāvicchinnasmṛtisantānarūpatvaṃ sūtrakārābhipretaṃ vākyakārakaṇṭhoktaṃ darśayati  upāsanaṃ syāditi  darśanāt loke darśanāt | nirvacanātśrutivākyāt tasyaiveti  mokṣasādhanatayā vihitasyetyarthaḥ | upāsanarūpasyeti hetugarbham upāsanarūpatvāt, upāsanaśabdavācyatvādasakṛdāvṛttasyetyarthaḥ | asakṛdāvṛttaṃ jñānaṃ hyupāsanam evamavicchinnasmṛtisantatirūpatvamupapāditam |
sūtrakārakaṇṭhoktamasakṛdāvṛttirūpatvaṃ tadabhipretaṃ dhruvānusmṛtitvaṃ ca vadato vākyakārasyāyaṃ bhāvaḥ,etattulyanyāyatayā viśeṣānropasthāpakavākye sati vedanādiśabdāstatpayrantāḥ syuriti, tasmāt pūrvoktaṃ darśanasamānākāratvamapi vākyakārābhipretamityabhiprayannāha  seyamiti | seyamasakṛdāvṛttirūpā, dhruvānusmṛtirūpā cetyarthaḥ | darśanaśabdasyārthadarśī tattvadarśītyādiprayogāt parokṣāparokṣasādhāraṇyamāśaṅkayāha  darśanarūpatā ca pratyakṣatāpattiriti | pratyakṣasamānākāratāpattirityarthaḥ | "ātmani khalvare dṛṣṭe śrute mate vijñāta idaṃ sarvaṃ viditam" "ātmā vā'are draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavya" iti śravaṇādiparokṣajñānapūrvasūtreṣvapi pṛthaṅnirdeśāditi bhāvaḥ | sūtrakāravākyakārayoḥ katipayaviśeṣaṃ vadatoḥ sati viśeṣāntaropasthāpake tatparyavasāyitvasyābhipretatvācchatyantarasiddhaṃ viśeṣāntaramastītyāha  evamiti | anena śravaṇādīnāṃ muktayupāyatvaniṣedhānnopāsanasya mokṣopāyatvamiti śaṅakāvyudāsaśca bhavati | evamuktena prakāreṇa sāmānyaviśeṣanyāyena pratyakṣatāpannāmityarthaḥ |apavargasādhanabhūtāmiti  pratīkopāsanavyavacchedaḥ | nāyamātmeti  pravacanaśabde mananaṃ lakṣayati, mananaphalatvāt pravacanasya, mananasyācāryapravacanaphalatvādvā, procyateneteti karaṇavyutpattyā vā pravacanaṃ mananaṃ, meghā nididhyāsanaṃ, pariśeṣāt, asminvākye śravaṇādīnāmanupāyatvaṃ pratītaṃ dhruvānusmṛtiviśeṣaṇatvena na kiṃcitpratipannam | atastadyvācaṣṭe  aneneti kevalaśravaṇamanananididhyāsanānāṃ vakṣyamāṇaviśeṣavirahitānāmityarthaḥ | yathā "na pṛthivyāmagniścetavya" ityatra hiraṇyopadhānarahitapṛthivyāṃ cayanaṃ niṣidhyate, na tu pṛthivīmātretadvaditi bhāvaḥ | vivakṣitaṃ viśeṣaṃ vākyatātparyanirūpaṇena darśayipyanvākyasyārthānvayaṃ darśayati, yamevaiṣa ātmā vṛṇate tenaiva labhya ityuktamiti | varaṇīyena lamyo'stu, tataḥ kathaṃ dhruvānummṛterviśeṣitatva?miti śaṅkāyāṃ taddaśaryituṃ lokasiddhapratītimāhapriyamata eva hīti | prītiviṣayamātrasya na varaṇīyatvaṃ, kintu svayamupasthitasya svīkāra eva, atastadyvāvṛttyarthaṃ priyamata ityuktam | tataḥ kimityatrāha  yasyeti | yamyopāsakasyāyaṃ paramātmā niratiśayaprītiviṣayaḥ sa evāsya paramātmano niratiśayaprītiviṣayo bhavati, cetanatve sati bhagavatā varaṇīyatvaṃ bhagavati niratiśayaprītimata eva | yadvā svataḥ priyatvaṃ varaṇīyatvaṃ ca svasmin prītimata eva, puṇyakṣetrādiṣu bhagavataḥ prītiḥ svasmin prītimatpuruṣavaraṇārthā, patnapuṣpaphalādiṣu tatsambandhanibandhanā | sa evetyevakāreṇa kevalaśravaṇādimadyvāvṛttiḥ | bhagavati prītimata eva bhagavatprītiviṣayatvamiti kathamavagamyate? ityapekṣāyāmatra pramāṇatayā smṛtivacanamarthopanyāsapūrvakaṃ darśayanvaraṇaprakāramapi vivṛṇoti  yatheti  ayambhagavati niratiśayaprītimān | priyamataḥ niraśiyabhagavatprītiviṣayo bhavannityarthaḥ | dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ tamityasyārthavivakṣayā svayameva bhagavān prayatata ityuktam, anena varaṇaprakāro darśitaḥ | bhagavataivoktamityevakāreṇa bhagavadāpyatiśayaḥ sūcitaḥ | satatayuktānāṃsatatayogaṃ kāṅkṣamāṇānāma "āśaṃsāyaṃ bhūtavañce"ti kartariktaḥ, prītipūrvakaṃ dadāmītyanvayaḥ | anena parasparaviṣayaprītirupāsyopāsakayordaśirtā | satatayuktaśabdārthasphuṭākaraṇāyāha  priyo hīti | atyarthamatikrāntābhidheyaṃ, priyatvaṃ vācāmagocaramityarthaḥ | dhruvānusmṛtiṃ viśinaṣṭīti hi pūrvamuktam | atra yo bhagavati prītimān bhavatitasminnupāsake bhagavataḥ prītimattvamuktam, tatkathaṃ dhruvānusmṛterviśeṣitvam? ityata āhaata iti | ataḥ uktārthasya lokasmṛtibhyāṃ siddhatvādityarthaḥ | yadvā, dhruvānusmṛtivacanādvaraṇīyatvavacanādvaraṇīyasya ca bhagavati niratiśayaprītimattvavacanāccetyarthaḥ | sākṣātkārarūpā smṛti rityanena pūrvoktākāraviśiṣṭāyā eva viśeṣāntaramiti darśitam | smaryamāṇātyarthapriyatvena svayamapyatyarthapriyeti | arthenaiva viśeṣo hi nirākāratayā dhiyāmiti bhāvaḥ | svayamapyarthapriyāanubhūyamāno'nubhava itivadayaṃ nirdeśa aupacārikaḥ, atyarthaprītirūpetyarthaḥ | yadvā, atyarthapriyā atyarthānukūlarūpā, smaryamāṇasya bhagavadviṣayasya niravadhikanirūpādhikānukūlatvena tadviṣayānusmṛtirapi hi niratiśayānukūlā bhavati | yadvā dhruvānusmṛtiḥ svayamatyantānukūlatvādayuktāvasthāyāmapi prītirūpajñānena pratisandhīyata iti priyā, ata eva hi "yā prītiravivekānā"mityādinā sā prārthyate, prītirūpadhruvānusmṛterapavargopāyatvamuktam, anyatra bhakterupāyatvaṃ dṛśyate, kathamanayoraikāthyarmityatrāha  evaṃrūpeti | yadvā "śemuṣī bhaktirūpe"ti bhaktirūpajñānasyopāyatvaṃ prāguktam, kathamidānīṃ prītirūpadhruvānusmṛterupāyatvaṃ pratipādyate? ityatrāha evaṃrūpeti | evaṃrūpāsākṣātkāratvaprītirūpatvaparyantā dhruvānusmṛtireva bhaktiśabdavācyetyarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha  upāsanaparyāyatvāditi | upāsanādiśabdānāṃ bhaktiśabdasya caikārthavṛttitvaṃ vivakṣitam, na tu ghaṭakumbhayoriva paryāyatvam | ekārthavṛttitvaṃ ca "sevā bhaktirūpāsti"riti naighaṇṭukoktereva gamyate, "snehapūrvamanudhyānaṃ bhaktirityabhidhīyate | bhaja ityeṣa dhāturve sevāyāṃ parikīrttitaḥ | tasmātsevā buvaiḥ proktā bhaktiśabdena bhūyasī " ityādi cānusandheyam | yadyapi sākṣātkārarūpatvabhaktirūpatvādiparāṇāṃ vākyānāṃ vidyāviśeṣaviṣayaprakaraṇaparigṛhītatvepi sarvopāsanasādhāraṇatvaṃ laghuguruyatnavikalpānupapatteḥ prāptaṃ, tathāpi prapadane tu laghuguruyatnavikalpānupapattirūpanyāyo vacanabalapratikṣiptaḥ | na hi vacanavirodhe nyāyaḥ prabhavati, vacanavirodhābhāvādupāsaneṣu tasya pravṛttiḥ, vedānteṣupāsanaparāṇāṃ vākyānāmaikārthyasidhdyarthaṃ bhaktidaśāpannasyopāsanasyaivāpavargopāyavedanatvamuktam, smṛtivacanapradarśanaṃ ca śrutyarthavaiśadyāya kṛtam | idānīṃ tu śrutismṛtyoraikārthyena muktayupāyavedanasya bhaktirūpopāsanatvamupapādyate  ata eveti | ataevaapavargopāyavedanasya bhaktirūpopāsanatvādevetyarthaḥ | "tameva viditve"ti vākyaṃ śvetāśvetaropaniṣadi śrūyate, tatra "tasmātsarvagataḥ śiva" iti śivaśabdagrahaṇācchivasya paramātmatvaviṣayatvabhramaḥ kasyacinmandadhiyaḥ syāditi tannivṛttyarthaṃ "vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam" "mahān prabhurvai puruṣaḥ sattvasyaiṣa pravattarka" ityupakramopasaṃhāravagataparamapuruṣaparaiva sopaniṣaditi puruṣasūktaikārthyaṃ darśayituṃ tamevaṃ vidvāniti vākyamupāttam, tamevaṃ vidvāniti vākyena nānyaḥpanthā iti paramapuruṣavedanavyatiriktopāyaniṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ, nāhaṃ vedairityādinā tadbhaktivyatiriktopāyaniṣedha uktaḥ, ubhayorapyupabṛṃhaṇopabṛṃhaṇīyavacanayoḥ pramāṇatamatvena sarvāvigītayoraikārthyaṃ vedanādiśabdānāṃ bhaktiparyantatve sidhdyatīti bhāvaḥ | upāyāntaraniṣedhakaṇṭhoktayā jñānadarśanaprāptīnāṃ bhaktisādhyatvakaṇṭhoktayā ca nāhaṃ vedairiti vacanamupāttam | nanu "bhaktayā māmabhijānāti" "tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantara"miti bhaktijanyajñānasyaivāvyavahitopāyatvamavagamyate, na tu bhakteriti śaṅkā ca nāhaṃ vedairityanena parihṛtā bhavati | atra jñānadaśarnayoriva prāpterapi bhaktisādhyatvāvagamāt bhaktayā praveṣṭuṃ ca śakya iti hyanvayaḥ | bhaktayā māmiti vacanepi tato māṃ viśata iti tacchabdaparāmṛṣṭāyā bhaktareva prāptyupāyatvamavagamyate tata iti bhaktiparāmarśābhāse tadanantaramityanena paunaruktayaprasaṅgāt, ataśca bhaktirevāvyavahitopāyaḥ "puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārthe" tyatra ca bhaktayā labhyaiti bhakteḥ prāptisādhanatvaṃ svarasatovagamyate | anena puruṣaśabdapratyabhijñāpitapuruṣasūktapratipādyavastvaikyavat tatpratipannopāyaikyaṃ nyāyyamiti sūcitam |
astvevaṃ vedanasya bhaktirūpopāsanatvasiddhiḥ, tataḥ prakṛtasya karmāpekṣitatvasya kimāyāta? mityatrāhaevamiti | evaṃrūpāyāḥāparokṣyaprītirūpatvaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭāyāḥ | vākyakārasūtrakārābhyāmabhipretāḥ kaṇṭhoktāśca mokṣopāyajñānāvasthāviśeṣāḥ karmasādhyā iti bhāvaḥ | dhruvānusmṛteḥ sādhanānīti  yathā kāsinā jighāṃsatītyatrāserhananasādhanatvaṃ na tvicchāsādhanatvaṃ, tathā yajñena vividiṣantītyatrāpi vidyāsmadhanatvamevoktaṃ na tadicchāsādhanatvam, yajñādervedanecchāsādhanatvena viniyogāyogāditibhāvaḥ | tathā hi sarveṣāṃ puruṣāṇāmavāntarasādhyopāyo pravṛttiḥ paramasādhyecchayā vinā nopapadyate, yathā yāyādyupāyabhūtadravyārjanādau pravṛttiḥ, yāyādisādhyāpūrvādiviṣayecchayā vinā nopapadyate; tathā icchāsidhdyarthamanuṣṭhānamicchāsampādyavedanecchayā vinā nopapadyate; ato vedanecchāyāṃ jātāyāṃ vedanopāyabhūtecchāsidhdyarthānuṣṭhānaṃ, tasyāṃ jātāyāṃ ca tadartamanuṣṭhānamanapekṣitamiti tadanuṣṭhānavidhivaiyarthyaṃ syāt | kiṃca, svasiddhismapekṣā tvasiddhirityātmāśrayaḥ, vedanecchayā icchāsidhdyarthakarmānuṣṭhānam icchāsidhdyarthakarmānuṣṭhānādvedanecchāsiddhirityanyonyāśrayaṇaṃ vā, ato vividiṣāsādhanatvaṃ karmaṇāṃ na yuktam | nanvicchāsidhdyarthakarmānuṣṭhānasyātmānayādigrastatve kvacidapīcchā na sambhavet icchāhetubhūtakarmānuṣṭhānāyogāt | na cecchāyā viṣayavailakṣaṇyajñānamātrādhīnatvaṃ velakṣaṇyajñānepi kasvacidicchānutpattidarśanāt; ataḥ kasyacidicchotpatteḥ kamarhetukatvamāśrayaṇīyaṃ tacca tavānupapannam, naivambhogādṛṣṭodbodhitapūrvavāsanāsacivādviṣayavailakṣaṇyajñānādicchotpattyupapatteḥ, na cājñātasukṛtavaśāddharmarucivadyajñādinā vedanecchāsiddhiriti vācyam; bahvarthavyayāyāsasādhyānāṃ yajñādīnāmajñātasukṛtarūpatvāsaṃbhavāt, yajñena vividiṣantīti vākyasya hyarthaścintyate, ato buddhipūrvakameva yajñādyanuṣṭhānaṃ tatra mokṣopāyavedanecchāyā abhāve
