bahvarthayatnasādhyakarmaṇāṃ phalāntarābhisaṃdhipūrvakatvaniyamānna vividiṣāṃ sādhayati phalāntarābhisaṃdhividhuraṃ tu yajñādikaṃ vedanecchāyā vinā nopapadyate, prayojanānuddeśena prekṣāvataḥ pravṛttyayogāt prakṛṣṭaprayojanatadupāyecchāvirahe kṣudraprayojanaparityāgāyogācca, ato'vāntarasādhyecchāsidhdyarthamanuṣṭhānaṃ paramasādhyavedanecchayā vinā nopapadyata iti svasidhdyarthakarmānuṣṭhānasya svasiddhisāpekṣatvādātmāśrayādidoṣaḥ syādeva  abhi dhāsyata iti  tatropapādayiṣyāma ityarthaḥ | vividiṣāsādhanatve yajñāderātmāśrayādidoṣābhāvamabhyupagamyāha  yadyapīti | tasyaiva icchāviṣayabhūtasya | dhyānarūpasyeti vākyārthajñānavyudāsaḥ | dhyānasyāpyekadinānuṣṭheyatvavyudāsārthamāha  aharahariti | aharaharanuṣṭhānaphalamāha  abhyāseti | aharaharanuṣṭhānepi māsartusaṃvatsarādyavadhitvavyāvṛttyarthamāha  āprayāṇāditi | āprayāṇādanuvarttamānatvepi ekadvitridināntaritavyāvṛttyatharmaharaharanuṣṭhīyamānasyetyuktam, tatrāpi smṛtivicchedavyudāsārthaṃ dhyānarūpasyetyuktam | tadutpattaye vividiṣotpattaye | vedanasyāvyavahitaprakṛtatvepyarthavaśāttacchabdo vividiṣāparaḥ, vividiṣāsādhanatvaṃ hyabhyupagamyocyate | āprayāṇādaharaharupāsanānuvṛttau yāvajjīvaṃ karmaṇopekṣitatve ca kiṃ pramāṇamityatrāha  vakṣyati ceti | caḥ śaṅkānivṛttau | sūtrasandarśane tadviṣayabhūtaśrutivākyamapi darśitaṃ bhavatītyabhiprāyeṇopāsanānuvṛttiparaṃ sūtraṃ darśitam  āprayāṇāditi  "sa khalvevaṃ varttayan yāvadāyuṣa"miti śrutiḥ | yāvacchabdasya sākalyārthatvāt aharaharanuṣṭhānasiddhiḥ, tāvatkarmāpekṣāyāmāha  agnihotreti | āśramadharmāṇāmāśramaśeṣatvepi | vidyāṅgatvamapyastītyāha  sahakāritvena ceti | ityādiṣu sūtreṣu imamarthaṃ vakṣyatītyarthaḥ | uktaṃ karmaṇo vidyāṅgatvamupāsanasya śamādyaṅgatvavirodhānnopapadyata ityāśaṅkaya virodhaṃ parijihīṣustadviṣayaśrutivākya pradarśanenopramāṇatāṃ ca nirīcikīṣumāha  vākyeti | sūtrakārābhiprāyajñairapyevamuktamiti bhāvaḥ | dhruvānusmṛtiśabdena tallabdhirityatra tacchabdo vyākhyātaḥ | vivekādibhya eva na tu kevalakarmaṇā kevalaśamādinā vetyarthaḥ | vākyakāragrantha upādīyate  tallabdhiriti | upāsanaṃ syād dhruvānusmṛtiriti hi prakṛtam, ato dhruvānusmṛti labdhirityarthaḥ | vivekavimokābhyāsakriyākalyāṇānavasādānuddharṣebhya iti dvandva samāsaḥ, sa cetaretarayogārthe epyanyatamena tallabdherduṣkaratvāt samuccaye cātra sambhavāt, evaṃ vivekādividhāyināṃ vākyānāṃ samuccaye tātparyamiti darśayitumitaretarayogadvandvena vākyakāranirdeśaḥ | nanu samuccayādarthāntaramitaretarayogaḥ, tatkathamitaretarayogadvandvena samuccayalābhaḥ | ucyate; anvācayasahapaṭhitāt samuccayādvikalpaprati sambandhisamuccayorthāntaram, ekasminneva kārye mitho nirapekṣasādhakānāmanvayonvācayasahapaṭhitaḥ | vikalpasamabhivyāhṛtasamuccayastvekasmin kārye mithaḥ sāpekṣāṇāmanvayaḥ, sa eva itaretarayoga ityavirodha iti | nivṛttirūpaśamādeḥ pravṛttirūpayajñādeśca virodhānna samuccaya iti cenna, bhinnaviṣayatvena virodhābhāvāt | avihitāpratiṣiddhakāmyaviṣayā hi śamādayaḥ | sambhavāt upapannatvāt | nirvacanācca śrutivacanācca, pramāṇopapattibhyāmityarthaḥ | vivekādayaḥ kiṃ rūpāḥ, kathaṃ vā śamādeḥ karmaṇaścāvirodhaḥ? ityatrāha  vivekādīnāṃ svarūpaṃ cāheti | na kevalaṃ pariṣaṇanāmātraṃ tatsvarūpaṃ ca vākyakāra evāhetyarthaḥ | prathamaṃ vivekasvarūpaviṣayavākyamudāharati  jātyāśrayeti | āhāraviṣayavivecanaṃ vivekaśabdena vivakṣitaṃ bhavati, duṣṭāhārāt sāttvikāhārāṇāṃ vivecanaṃ vivekaḥ, jātiduṣṭāḥ kalañjagañjanādayaḥ | āśrayaḥdravyasvāmipuruṣaḥ, abhiśastapatitacaṇḍālādidravyamāśrayaduṣṭam | ucchiṣṭakeśādyupahataṃ nimittaduṣṭam | etatrividhadoṣarahitāhāravivecanaphalabhūtakāyaśuddhau vivekaśabda upacaritaḥ | yadvā viviktāhārasevayā rājasatāmasāhārāpyāyitadehāt svadehasya vivecanaṃ vivekaḥ | aśuddhebhyo vivecanaṃ hi śuddhiḥ, itiśabdo bhāṣyakārīyaḥ | atra nirvacamiti ca bhāṣyagranthaḥ | nirvacanamniṣkṛṣṭavacanam | apramāṇebhyo niṣkṛṣṭaṃ pramāṇabhūtaṃ vacanamityarthaḥ | āhāraśuddhāvityādi nirvacanaṃ, vimokaḥ kāmānabhiṣvaṅgaḥviṣayamabhuktavā sthātuṃ na śaknoti yena sa vikāro'bhiṣvaṅgaḥ "kāmāt krodho'bhijāyate" ityādivacanāt krodhādyabhāvaścātra phalitaḥ | "śānta upāsīte"ti nirvacane śāntaśabdena rāgadveṣādyabhāvo vivikṣitaḥ | ārambhaṇamālambanaṃśubhāśrayaḥ, tasya saṃśīlanaṃ, kathametatsādhanaṃ sādhyaṃ hīdam na "śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpye"tyādyuktadeśakālaviśeṣābhyasanīyayogaśabdavācyā dhruvānusmṛtirhi sādhyā, idaṃ tu yogakālakarttavyadhyānānugrāhakaṃ sadā saṃśīlanaṃ "sadā tadbhāvabhāvita" iti hi vakṣyati, sadā bhagavatsaṃśīlanābhāve yogakāleṣu kālāntarasaṃśīlitaṃ viṣayāntaraṃ buddhisthaṃ syāt, ato na sādhyāviśiṣṭatvam ārambhaṇasaṃśīlanasya, nirvacanaṃ ca smārttamudāhṛtaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇetyanena pūrvopāttanirvacanānyapi dramiḍabhāṣyoktānīti jñāyate | "atha muni"riti śrautaṃ nirvacanam, tasya nyāyopanyāsasāpekṣatvena "sahakāyarntaravidhi"rityadhikaraṇe vyākhyeyatvāt smārttanirvacanasya spaṣṭārthatvācca smārttanirvacanamudāhṛtam "tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmare"tyevamantaṃ vacanajātamihābhipretam | pañcamahāyajñeti  śaktitaḥna hi śāstramaśakyaṃ vidadhāti | kriyāvāneṣa iti  sanūrahitavākyam | brahmavidāṃ variṣṭhaḥbrahmavidāṃ madhye variṣṭhaḥ, na hi brahmavividiṣūṇāmityuktam | kriyāśabdārthaviśadīkaraṇāyāha  tametamiti  satyambhūtahitam | ārjavammanovākkāyānāmaikarūpyam | dayāsvārthanirapekṣaparaduḥkhāsahiṣṇutvam | ahiṃsākaraṇatrayeṇāpi parapīḍānivṛttiḥ, dānamlobharāhityam | abhidhyāparakīye svatvabuddhiḥ, yadvā niṣphalacintā, athavā parakṛtāpavāracintā, tadrahityamanabhidhyā | satyenetītiyādiśabdena ārjavādipratipādakavākyajātaṃ kroḍīkṛtam  deśetyādi  anavasādānuddharṣayoravasādoddhaṣarviparyayarūpatvādavasādoddharṣalakṣaṇamātramuktaṃ vākyakāreṇa, tadvikaryayarūpo nañartho'rthātsidhyatīti vākyakārābhiprāyaḥ | śokavastuśokanimittaṃ vastu, atītaputramaraṇādi | ādiśabdena bhayanimittamāgāmi vivakṣitam | atītaviṣayo hi śoktaḥ, āgāmiviṣayaṃ ca bhayam | abhāsvaratvamiti dainyaśabdavivaraṇam, abhīṣṭakāryapravṛttyakṣamatvarūpaṃ dainyamityuktaṃ bhavati | bhāsvaratvavirodhīti vā dainyaviśeṣaṇaṃ, caśabdo bhinnakramaḥ, tajjaṃ ca dainyajadainyaṃ cetyarthaḥ | bandhujanadainye dṛṣṭepi hi dainyaṃ syāt deśakālavaiguṇyaśokavastvādyanusmṛtihetukaṃ manaso bhāsvaratvābhāvarūpaṃ bhāsvaratvavirodhi vā dainyaṃ, dainyajadainyaṃ ca manaso'vasāda ityarthaḥ | yadvā, bhinnavākyatayā yojanīyaṃ, deśakālavaiguṇyaśokavastvādyanusmṛtijanitaṃ manaso'bhāsvaratvamavasādaḥ | kimuktaṃ bhavatītyatrāha  tajjaṃ dainyamiti | taccābhāsvaratvaṃ, tajjamuktahetujaṃ dainyamiti vyākhyeyavyākhvānarūpaṃ vākyadvayamiti tadviparyaya ityādirbhāṣyagranthaḥ | balahīnena manobalahīnena | tadviparyayajādeśakālasādguṇyapirayavastvādyanusmṛtijā | tuṣṭiruddharṣa ityetāvadeva vākyaṃ, tadviparyayo'nuddharṣa ityarthasiddham | kathaṃ "svādhyāyaśaucasaṃtoṣatapāṃsi niyatātmavān" ityapekṣitasya tyājyatva?mityatrāha atisaṃtoṣaśca virodhītyartha iti | na kevalamasaṃtoṣa eva virodhī atisantoṣaśca virodhīti cārthaḥ, yathānyaviṣayeṣveva pravṛttiḥ syāttathā santoṣo'tisaṃtoṣaḥ, sa tyājya ityuktaṃ bhavati | nirvacanamapītyapiśabdaḥ sarvanirvacanasamuccaye evaṃ padārthā vyākhyātāḥ | tallabdhirityādervākyakāragranthasya vākyārthamāha  evamiti | evaṃ niyamayuktasyāśramavihitakarmānuṣṭhāneneti pṛthaṅnirdeśena pravṛttinivṛttirūpakoṭidvayavibhāgo darśitaḥ | etena padadvayena kevalaśamādi kevalakarma ca vyāvartitam | śamādi karma ca samuccityāṅgamityarthaḥ | yadvividiṣāsādhanamiti tvayoktaṃ tenaiva vidyāniṣpattirityevakārābhiprāyaḥ | ityuktaṃ bhavati  iti vākyārtho bhavatītyarthaḥ | "vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ce"ti śruteḥ śaṅkarayādavaprakāśābhimatayojanāvyudāsārthaṃ tāṃ vyācikhyāsurupādatte  tathā ceti | anena karmaṇo'pekṣitatve sanrahitaśrutyantaraṃ ca darśitaṃ bhavati | tathā ca śrutyantaraṃ yadanyathā bhavadbhirvyākhyātam, taccāsmaduktārthānuguṇamiti tathāśabdamantaraśabdaṃ ca prayuñjānasya bhāvaḥ | satrahitatayā yajñādivākyavailakṣaṇyañcāntaraśabdābhipretam | asminvākye na karmavāciśabdaḥ śrūyata ityatrāha atreti |
atra śrutivākye | "na tvanātmanyātmabuddhiryā" ityādiṣu,avidyāśabdābhihitaṃ varṇāśramavihitaṃ karmāstu, tataḥ kimuktaṃ bhavatītyāśaṅkāyāṃ padāntarāṇyapi vivṛṇvan vākyārthamāha  avidyayeti | avidyākarmaṇā | vidyayājñānenetyatra ca karmajñānaśabdābhyāṃ "kaṣāyapaktiḥ karmāṇi jñānaṃ tu paramā gatiḥ | kaṣāye karmabhiḥ pakve tato jñānaṃ pravarttate" iti smṛtiḥ svopajīvyārthā smāritā bhavati | karmāṇi kaṣāyapaktiḥ kaṣāyapaktinimittāni | kaṣāya śabdaḥ pāpaparaḥ "dharmeṇa pāpamapanudatī "tyanenaikārthyāt kaṣāyaśabdasya rāgādiparatvepi tatpaktihetutvaṃ pāpanirharaṇadvārā, jñānaṃ paramā gatiḥparamagatyupāyaḥ, ubhayatra kāraṇe kāryopacāraḥ kaṣāye pakte tato jñānaṃ pravarttate  prasaratītyarthaḥ | atropāyavirodhinirāsakatvaṃ karmaṇaḥ spaṣṭam, na hi vividiṣā pravarttate mokṣaḥ pravarttata iti coktam, apitu jñānaṃ pravarttata ityevoktam | asya vākyasyārthamupajīvyāha  mṛtyuṃjñānotpattivirodhīti | na tu brahmaprāptivirodhi, na ca vividiṣāvirodhītyarthaḥ | upeyavirodhikarmaṇo jñānavivartyatvaṃ śrutismṛtiśatasiddham | yathā "tameva viditvā'timṛtyumeti nānyaḥ panthāḥ" evamevaṃvidipāpaṃkarma na śliṣyate" "kṣīyante cāsya karmāṇi tasmin dṛṣṭe parāvare" "nicāyya taṃ mṛtyumukhāt pramucyate" "jñātvā devaṃ mucyate sarvapāpaiḥ" "jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi bhasmasātkurute tathā" iti | evamupeyavirodhino jñānanivartyatvaśravaṇena pariśeṣānnānyaḥ panthā ityupeyavirodhinirāse upāyāntaraniṣedhasvārasyāt samasamuccaya pakṣe karmaṇopyupāyatayā vedavyatiriktakṛtsnagocarānyaśabdasya saṅkocaprasaṅgāt yajñena vividiṣantīti kamarṇa upāyahetutvasya kaṇṭhoktayā "kaṣāye karmabhiḥ pakve tato jñānaṃ pravarttata" iti smṛtyānuguṇyācca sāmānyena mṛtyuśabdena pratipannamapi nirasanīyamupāyavirodhikarmarūpe viśeṣe paryavasyati; tathā vividiṣāsādhanatvasya prāguktānyonyāśrayaṇādinirastatvena pariśeṣādvividiṣantītyatra ca prakṛtipratyayārthayorvedanatadicchayoraviśeṣeṇa yajñādīnāṃ sādhanatve pratītepi "tato jñānaṃ pravarttata" iti smṛtyādyānuguṇyādiṣyamāṇaprakṛtyarthaprādhānyasya nītividbhirnirṇītatvācca prakṛtyarthabhūtavedanasādhanatvaṃ siddham | tasmādupāyavirodhi karmaivātra mṛtyuśabdavācyamavidyānivartyamityabhiprāyaḥ | upāsanarūpaṃnyāsarūpaṃ copeyavirodhinirāsakaṃ jñānam uttarapūrvādhayorubhayorapi nirāsakaṃ syāditi tadyvāvṛttyarthaṃ prācīnamityuktam | upāyavirodhinirāsakakarma prācīnameva pāpaṃ śamayati, na tūttarāghamityarthaḥ | tīrtveti padaṃ vyācaṣṭe | apohyeti  "na tvenaṃ setuṃ tīrtve "tivat prāptivacana ityarthaḥ | avidyayā tīrtveti padadvayavyākhyānena śaṅkaramatayojanāvyāvṛttiḥ, ajñānena saṃsāraṃ prāpya sthita iti hi tadyojanā, tanmate avidyāyāḥ jñātavyatvaṃ ca heyatvena, avidyāśabdo vividiṣāvirodhinivartakarmavācīti vā śaṅkarābhimatayojanā syāt avidyāśabda upeyavirodhinivarttakakarmavācīti yādavaprakāśābhimatayojanā, jñānotpattivirodhīti mṛtyuśabdavyākhyānena tadubhayavyudāsaḥ | ayamavidyāśabdaḥ saṃsārahetubhūtājñānaparaḥ kiṃ na syāt, kathaṃ ca tasya karmavācitva?mityatrāha  mṛtyutaraṇeti | tarateruttaraṇavācitvaṃ svarasasiddham,prāptivācitve tu svārasyabhaṅga ityabhipretam | avidyāśabdasya karmavācitvaṃ darśayati  vidyetaraditi  tadanyārthe nañiti bhāvaḥ, vihitaṃ karmaivetmevakāreṇājñānamavihitaṃ karma ca vyāvartyate, atra "vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ce"ti caśabdāvanukta samuccayaparau | karmānubandhi jayadanukta tatsamuccetavyaṃ, vidyānubandhi śamadavādikaṃ, karmānubandhi phalābhisandhikartṛtvābhimānarāhityādikaṃ tadubhayaṃ caśabdasamuccetavyam | yadvā, "dharme cārthe ca kāme ca mokṣe ca bharatarṣabha" ityatra ca śabdavadatrāpyuktārthavirodhisamuccayaparau caśabdau syātām | vidyāvirodhi karmavirodhi ca caśabdābhyāṃ hānārthaṃ jñātavyatayā samuccite bhavataḥ, vidyābrahmavidyā, tadvirodhitaditaraviṣayajñānatadviṣayarāgādveṣā dikam | avidyāvidyāṅgaṃ karma, tadvirodhisaṃsaraṇa hetubhūtaṃ phalābhisandhyādisahitaṃ karma pāpañca tadubhayaṃ hānārthaṃ jñātavyamiti caśabdayorabhiprāyaḥ | yadvā, pratipadadyotakau caśabdau syātām yathā "dharme cārthe ca kāme ce"ti pratipadaṃ yadabhidheyaṃ tasya samuccayadyotakatvaṃ pratipadadyotakatvaṃ, tadatrāpi syāt, asminvākye avidyātaraṇaśabdayoruktātharparatvasthāpanāyopabṛṃhaṇavacanaṃ ca darśayati  yathoktamiti | jñānavyapāśrayaḥāgamotthajñānavāt | brahmavidyāmadhiṣṭhāya upāsanātmakajñānaṃ sādhyatvenāvalambyetyarthaḥ | jñānavidyāśabdayorarthabhedabubhutsāyāmāgamotthavivekādijanyajñānayoḥ prakṛtatvāt tatparatvānayaṇaṃ hi yuktam | tarttuṃ mṛtyumityanena tarateḥ prāptivācitvaśaṅkā vyudastā, na hi saṃsāraṃ prāptuṃ brahmavidā keśidhvajena nṛpeṇa yajñādikarmānuṣṭhīyate, mṛtyuśabdasya vividiṣāvirodhikarmaparatvamapi na śaṅkanīyam jñānavyapāśraya ityanena śāstrajanyajñānavattāyā abhihitatvāt brahmavidyāmadhiṣṭhāyetyuktatvācca na hi brahmavidyecchāmadhiṣṭhāyetyuktam | kathaṃ jñānotpattivirodhi pracīnaṃ karmeti puṇyapāpasādhāraṇakarmaśabdena karmamātraṃ nirasanīyamuktaṃ, śrutirhi "dharmeṇa pāpamapanudatī "ti pāparūpakarmaviśeṣasya nirasanīyatvamāheti śaṅkāyāṃ tatrāpi pāpaśabdasya puṇyapāpaparatvaṃ darśayituṃ puṇyapāpayorubhayorapi pāpaśabdavācyatvopapādanāya tayorjñānotpattivirodhitvamāha  jñānavirodhiceti | ca śaṅkānivṛttau puṇyapāpe ubhe api jñānavirodhinī cet kathaṃ tayoranyatarasya pāpasya nirasanīyatvamanyatarasya puṇyasya nirāsakatvaṃ ca śrūyate? ityatrāha  ubhayorapīti | tayordvayorapi nivartyatvaṃ phalābhisandhyādirahitasya dharmāntarasyaiva nivartakatvaṃ ca vivakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ | kathamubhayoḥ pāpaśabdavācyatvam? ityatrāha  brahmajñānotpattīti | aniṣṭaphalatayeti  pravṛttinimittasūcanam | alaukikatve satyaniṣṭaphalāsādhāraṇakāraṇatvaṃ pāpatvamiti bhāvaḥ | ata eva śasrādāvīśvare ca nātivyāptiḥ "'vāsudeve mano yasya japahomārcanādiṣu | tasyāntarāyo maitreya devendratvādikaṃ phalam | "ete vai nirayāstāta sthānasya paramātmana" ityādibhiḥ puṇyasyāpi mumukṣuṃ pratyaniṣṭaphalapradatvaṃ siddham | śrutiśca duṣkṛtena saha pūrvanirddiṣṭaṃ sukṛtamapi pāpmaśabdena nirddiśantī nigamayati "naitaṃ setumahorātre tarato na jarā na mṛtyurna śoko na sukṛtaṃ na duṣkṛtaṃ sarve pāpmano 'to nivartante" iti | na cānuktapāpāntaraviṣayaḥ pāpaśabdaḥ, duṣkṛtaśabdasya sampratipannasamastapāpasādhāraṇatayānuktapāpāntarāsambhavena tadviṣayatvāyogāt sambhavepi na tanmātrapāpāntaraviṣayaḥ pāpmaśabdaḥ, uktasarvaheyanivṛttisaṃvāditayopātte "apahatapāpmāhyeṣa brahmaloka" ityanantaravākye pāpmaśabdasya sarvaheyaviṣayatvadarśanāt | na hyanuktakatipayapāpanivṛttyuktau uktasarvaheyanivṛttisaṃvādasiddhiḥ, śokādiṣu pāpyaśabdasyāmukhyatvepi sukṛtaduṣkṛtayoḥ pravṛttinivṛttisambhavānna mukhyatvaṃ tyājyam, kvacidamukhyasya sarvatrāmukhyatvaniyamābhāvāt, ataḥ sarve pāpmana ityatrāgahallakṣaṇācchatrinyāyāt "dharmeṇa pāpa"mityatra tu mukhyatvameva | kathaṃ pāpasya jñānavirodhitvam? rajastamasorhi tadavagamyata iti śaṅkāyāṃ dvāradvāribhāvādavirodhamāha  asyeti | pāpasya rajastamasośca jñānavirodhitve prāmāṇike sati dvāradvāribhāvaḥ kalpyata ityatrāha pāpasya ceti | nanviyaṃ śrutirnirayaninīṣāviṣayā kiṃ na syāt unnayanapratyanīkatvādadhonayanasyeti? brūmaḥ, atra vivakṣitamunnayanahetutvamupāsananiṣpādanarūpam | na connayanamapi svargādinayanamiti śaṅkanīyam "yamebhyo lokebhya unniṣatī "tyavagatasya samastalokebhya unnayanasyāpavargaprāpaṇarūpatvāt tarhi garbhajanmajarāmaraṇādisaṃsāraprāpaṇamaghonayanaṃ syāt na tūpāsanavirodha iti cenna, unnayanasya jñānotpādanadvārakatvāvagamāt "yaṃ tvaṃ manuṣyāya hitatamaṃ manyasa" ityupakramavākyena māmupāssveti vidhitsitasya upāsanasya hyavyavahitopāyatvamavagatam | "nānyaḥ panthāḥ" ityādīni ca śrutyantarāṇi tathāvagamayanti, tacca kamarṇāmaparve pratyavyahitopāyatve virudhdyeta, ata upakramādyavirodhāt sādhukarmaṇāmapavarge pratyupāyatvamupāsanadvārakamavasīyate, ataḥ karmaṇāmunnayanahetutvamupāsananiṣpādanarūpamiti tadviparītamaghonayanamupāsanapratibandharūpamiti sphuṭataramavagamyate | kiñca yadyapyunnayanādhonayane svarganarakaprāpaṇarūpe, tathāpyasādhukarmaṇāṃ jñānavirodhitvaṃ sidhdyati tatha hi unninīṣādhoninīṣayornirhetukatve paramātmano vaiṣamyanaighṛṇyaprasaṅgānnetavyacetanagocaraṃ yadvṛttadvayaṃ gatidvayaninīṣānimittabhūtātiprabhūtapuṇyapāpakartṛviṣayaṃ vijñāyate | tatra ca gatidvayaparyāptottarottarasādhvasādhukarmakārayitṛtvamīśvarasya, na bhūtāveśādivajjīvabudhdyanapekṣitaṃ bhavati | tathā sati jñānacikīrṣādyabhāvādvāyūdakādinunnatṛṇāderiva saṃsāriṇāṃ śāstravaśyatvābhāvena karmaphalabhogānupapatteḥ | evaṃ saṃsāriṇāṃ karmaphalabhoktṛtvānyathānupapattirūpanyāyānukṛhītam eṣa evetyādikaṃ vākyadvayaṃ jñānapradānadvārakakārayitṛtvaviṣayamavasīyate, tathā sati smṛtyanugrahaśca bhavati | "na devā yaṣṭimādāya rakṣanti paśupālavat | yaṃ hi rakṣitumicchanti budhdyā saṃyojayanti tam | yasmai devāḥ prayacchanti puruṣāya parābhavam | budiṃdha tasyāvakaṣanta sopanīto vinaśyati" iti hyucyate | tathā "puṇyaṃ prajñāṃ varddhayati kriyamāṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | naṣṭaprajñaḥ pāpameva nityamārabhate naraḥ" iti ca | tatra buddhimavakarṣanti prajñāṃ nāśayatīti ca samyagjñānahānipūrvaka tadviparītajñāna niṣpattiriha vivakṣitā, anyathā karmāntaraprārambhānupapatteḥ | yadyapīdaṃ vacanajātaṃ sarvadevatāsāmānyaviṣayaṃ, tathāpi bhagavanjñānasya samyagjñānasāmānyābahirbhāvādasādhukarmaṇastadvirodhitvasiddhiḥ | tathā viśeṣataśvocyate "dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te | āsurīṃ yonimāpannā muḍhā janmani janmani | māmaprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yāntyaghamāṃ gatim" iti | evaṃ nyāyasmṛtyupabṛṃhitayā 'nayā śrutyā sāmānyeva jñānavirodhitvamasādhukarmaṇāṃ siddham | asmādapi nirvāhāt pūrvokta upapannaḥ prakaraṇānuguṇyāt, ṣavaṃ pāpasya jñānavirodhitve pramāṇaṃ darśitam | atha rajastamasmerjñānavirodhitve, sattvasya jñānahetutve ca pramāṇaṃ darśayati | rajastamasoriti  tataḥ kiṃ prastutasya karmāpekṣitatvasyetyatrāha  ataśceti | ataḥpāpasya jñānavirodhitvavacanāt | tato'pi kimityatrāha tannirasanañceti | pāpaśabdābhidheyayoḥ puṇyapāpayorubhayorapi nirasanīyatvena pāpanirāsakakarmāsambhavamāśaṅkayoktam anabhisaṃhitaphaleneti | anena svargādiphalapradakarmavyāvṛttiḥ | anuṣṭhitena na tu jñānamātreṇeti bhāvaḥ | tatra kiṃ pramāṇaṃ ityatrāhatathā ca śrutiriti | idānīṃ nirāsakaviśeṣe pramāṇatayodāhṛtasya vākyasyārthanirṇayogitayaitadvākyasthanirasanīyavācipadasyārthaḥ pūrvameva śikṣitaḥ, nirāsakavācipadasyārtho'nantaramuktaḥ | nanvayaṃ dharmaśabdaḥ kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādiprāyaścittarūpadharmamātraviṣayaḥ kiṃ na syāt? anabhisaṃhitaphaladharmaviṣaya iti kuto nirṇīyate? ucyate "yajñena dānena tapasā'nāśakena" śānto dānta uparatastitikṣuḥ" "kaṣāye karmabhiḥ pakve tato jñānaṃ pravarttate" "yajño dānaṃ tapaḥ karma na tyājyaṃ kāryameva tat" "yajño dānaṃ tapaścaiva pāvanāni manīṣiṇām | śamo damastapaḥśauca"mityādiśrutismṛtibhirmumukṣorapekṣitatvenoktānāṃ yajñadānatapaḥ śamadīnāmatra śrūyamāṇatvāt "vijñānādānando bahmayoni"rityādināsya prakaraṇasya brahmavidyāviṣayatvāccāyaṃ dharmaśabdo mumukṣvapekṣitānabhisaṃhitaphaladharmaviṣaya ityavagamyate | atra yajñadānādiparyāyeṣu "dānena dviṣanto mitrā bhavantī "tyādinā sāṃsārikaphalakīrtanam | "annavānnādo bhavatī "tyādivat brahmavedanānuguṇānuṣaṅgikaphalaviṣayaṃ mantavyam, "bhūyo na mṛtyupayāhi vidvān" iti pradhānaphalaśravaṇāt | kiñca yadyapīdaṃ vākyaṃ na mumukṣumātraviṣayaṃ tathāpyamumukṣumātraviṣayaṃ ca na bhavet, pravṛttinimittasādhāraṇyāt na hi kāmyaphaladatvaṃ dharmaśabdārthaḥ, alaukikeṣṭāsādhāraṇasādhanenālaukikāniṣṭāsādhāraṇakāraṇamapanudediti hyarthaḥ syāt, tataśca mumukṣaṃ prati kāmyakarmaṇo'niṣṭaphalatvena dharmaśabdavācyatvāyogāt pāpaśabdavācyāntarbhāvācca pakṣadharmatābalādanabhisaṃhitaphalena dharmeṇa puṇyapāpayorubhayorapanodyatvamuktaṃ syāt | jñānasya karmasāpekṣatvaṃ nigamayati tadevamiti | tatśrutismṛtitadanugrāhakopapattisūtravākyakāravacanebhyaḥ | evamupāvapratibandhanirāsārthaṃ sarvāśramiṇāṃ tattadāśramadharmāṅgakopāsanādhikārasya vakṣyamāṇatvaṃ hṛdi nighāya sarvāśramakarmāpekṣamityuktam | tataḥ kiṃ karmavicārasya brahmavicārapūrvavṛttatva? ityapekṣāyāmunuṣṭhānasya jñānasāpekṣatvāt jñānasya mīmāṃsādhīnatvāñca tadadhikamaḥ pūrvavṛtta ityāhaata iti | ataḥbrahmajñānasya phalābhisandhirahitāśramakarmasāpekṣatvāt jñānaṃ hi hānārthamupādānārthaṃ vā? atra tūbhayārthamityāha apekṣiteti | phaladvārakaṃ hānam, svarūpeṇopādānam | mīmaṃsāśabdasya pūrvottarasādhāraṇatvāt karmamīmāṃsāvaseyamityuktam saiva yā tvayā viruddheti nirastā saivetyarthaḥ | yadanapekṣitaṃ pareṇoktaṃ tadevāpekṣitamityuktam | yattu pareṇāpekṣitamityuktaṃ tasyānapekṣitatvamucyate  api cetyādinā | nityānityavastuvivekādayaśceti  castvarthaḥ pratyuteti yāvat mīmāṃsāśravaṇamantareṇa  karmabrahmamīmāṃsāśravaṇamantareṇetyarthaḥ | na sampatsyanta ityanena paścādbhāvitvamuktam | kuta ityatrāha phaleti | phalaviśeṣaḥbhogamokṣarūpaḥ | karaṇaviśeṣaḥyajñopāsanādiḥ | itikattarvyatāviśeṣaḥprayājādiḥ sādhanasaptakaṃ ca | adhikāriviśeṣaḥbubhukṣurmumukṣuśca | eṣāṃ niścayādṛte, karmasvarūpamsāṅgaṃ yajñātmakamupāsanātmakañca | bhāṣyakāraśca yāgātmakamupāsanātmakaṃ ca karmeti hi vakṣyati "prakāśaśca karmaṇyabhyāsāt" iti ca sūtram "upāsanātmake karmaṇi" iti ca tasya bhāṣyam | upāsanasya karmatvaṃ smṛtisantatirūpatayā tasya prayatnasādhyatvāt "vācikaiḥ pakṣimṛgatāṃ mānasairantyajātitām | śarīrajaiḥ karmadoṣairyāti sthāvaratāṃ naraḥ" | ityatra manuśca "mānasaiḥ karmadoṣai"rityuktavān, phalaṃ cobhayaṃ bhogo mokṣaśca  tatsthiratvāsthiratvātmanityatvādīnāmiti | ādiśabdena ātmanāṃ "nirvāṇamaya evāya"mityuktajñānānandasvarūpatvādikaṃ vivakṣitam | atra sādhyāviśiṣṭatvaṃ hetoḥ pratīyata iti cet, maivammīmāṃsāyāṃ phalakaraṇetikartavyatādīnāṃ pratyadhikaraṇaṃ tattannyāyairyo nirṇayaḥ kriyate sa hetuḥ, evaṃ tattadhikaraṇanyāyānugṛhītaśrutivākyasamudāyajanyā yā pramitirupāyopeyaviṣayā sā sādhyā, tattadavāntaravākyārthaniścayaistatsamudāyarūpamahāvākyārthaniścayaḥ sādhya ityarthaḥ | yathāpadārthaniścayairvākyārthaniścaya ityukte sati na sādhyāviśiṣṭayātadvat; ata eva hi karaṇotikarttavyatādiśabdaiḥ pūrvaṃ pṛthaguktayā paścātkarmasvarūpaśabdenoktam, phalakaraṇetyādibhāṣyasya karmamīmāṃsāmātraviṣayatve tatphalasthiratvāsthiratvātmanityatvādīnāmiti vaktumayuktaṃ, nirupapadamīmāṃsāśabdasya mīmāṃsāśāstramityādibhāṣye bhāgadvayaviṣayatayā prayuktatvācca yathokta evārthaḥ, tasmātkarmabrahmavicā rānantarabhāvī nityānityavastuvivekaḥtata ihāmutraphalabhogavirāgo mumukṣutvaṃ ca śamadamādisādhanasampañca "śamadamādyupetassyā "diti brahmīmāṃsāyāṃ hi śamadamādisvarūpaṃ nirūpyate; asmin catuṣṭaye siddhe brahmavicāraḥ, brahmavicārāt tatsiddhirityanyonyāśrayaḥ syāt, ataḥ paścādbhāvinaḥ pūrvavṛttatvamanupapannam | sāṅgādhyayanajāpātapratītireva nityānityaviveka iti cet? tadayuktam,na hyāpātapratītirihāmutra phalabhogavirāgamumukṣatvayorhetuḥ, nityānityaviparyayapratīteḥ | kiñca āpātapratītirubhayabhāgavicārasādhāraṇī, tatra prathamaṃ karmavicāra eva pravṛttiryaktā, ubhayatra bubhutsāyā avaśiṣṭatvāt prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvācca, śāstrāntareṇāpi nityānityavivekādirnopapadyate; prathamamevādhyayanavidhivaśyatayā puruṣasya śāstrāntarānavakāśāt | kiñcaśāstrāntare paramāṇukāraṇatvābrahmātmakapradhānakāraṇatvagaganādinityatvanimittamātreśvaratvādayo vedāntaviruddhā evārthā bahava upalabhyante; ataḥ śāstrāntarajanyo nityānityavastuviveko vedāntaviruddhatvānna tadvicāraṃ prati pūrvavṛtto bhavitumarhati | kiñca śāstrāntare ṣaṭpadātharṣoḍaśapadārthajñānādīnāṃ mokṣasādhanatvapratipādanena vedāntaśravaṇanairapekṣyācca na tajjanyavivekasya pūrvavṛttatvaṃ yuktam, yato'bhyudayaniśśreyasasiddhissa dharmaḥ | "chalajātinigrahasthānāṃ tattvajñānānniḥ śreyasādhigamaḥ" iti hi tatra tatrocyate | kiñca "tasmādevaṃvicchānto dānta uparaptastitikṣuḥ samāhito bhūtvātmanyevātmānaṃ paśye"diti śrutirevaṃvicchabdena śāstrajanyajñānamanūdya paśyediti pratipannasyopāsanasyāṅgatayā śamādīnupadiśati; ataḥ śamādīnāṃ śravaṇapūrvavṛttatvaṃ śrutiviruddham, "praśāntacittāye" tyādiśrutistu śravaṇaupayikāvadhānaniṣpādanārthetyuktam | itihāsapurāṇaśravaṇānnityānityaviveka iti cet? tarhi tata eva brahmasvarūpāvagamāt brahmavicārasyānārambhaṇīyatvaṃ syāt itihāsapurāṇayorapi saṃśayaviparyayabāhulyāt tannirāsāya brahmavicāro'pekṣita iti cet? saṃśayaviparyayabāhulyādeva nityānityavivekopi tatra dussampādya iti na sādhanacatuṣṭayasya pūrvavṛttatvaṃ yuktam | yattunityānityayorvasantīti nityānityavastūni taddharmā ityārabhya vācaspatinoktaṃ nityasya dharmiṇo nityatvaṃ satyatvaṃ tata evopādeyatvam; anityasya dharmiṇo'nityatvaṃ asatyatvaṃ tata eva heyatvamityevaṃ nityānityayordharmiṇostaddharmāṇāṃ ca viveko nityānityavastuviveka iti | atra brūmaḥ anityasya tāvadasatyatvaṃ vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa nirastaṃ veditavyam, yannityaṃ tadupādeyaṃ yadanityaṃ taddheyamityubhayamapyanupapannam, sukhaduḥkhanivṛttitatsādhanatadupayogināmevopādeyatvabuddhidarśanāt tadyvatiriktasyaivānupādeyatābuddhidarśanācca nityamapi duḥkhasvarūpaṃ duḥkhanimittaṃ vā yadi syāt heyamityeva pratīyeta, anubhayaṃ cedupekṣyeta, anityamapi sukharūpaṃ vā sukhanimittaṃ vā bhavati cettadupādīyate, nirūpakasya tu heyamiti cenna,prakṛṣṭasukhāntaradarśanātyantaduḥkhasādhyatvaduḥkhodarkatvavirahe sati nirūpakasyāpi tatropādeyatābuddhidaśarnāt, kṣīraudanalābhāt kaṇastyajyate, viṣamiśramannaṃ maraṇabhayāttyajyate, srakūcandanādi tu tataḥ prakṛṣṭasukhalābhādādyantayostīvraduḥkhānubandhābhāvācca parimitamapyupādīyate, tasmādanityasya heyatvaṃ nānityatvamātraprayuktam | yadyucyeta nityasya duḥkhāsambhinnasukharūpatvādupādeyatvaṃ tadasambhavādanityasya ca heyatvamiti | ucyatenityasya duḥkhāsaṃbhinnasukharūpatvaṃ kiṃ vyāptyāvagamyate, uta śāstrāt? na prathamaḥ, nityasya kālādeḥ sukharūpatvādarśanāt nityasyātmano duḥkhāsambhinnasukharūpatvādarśanācca ātmano hi duḥkhamupalabhyate ahaṃ duḥkhīti | śāstrataścet, yadi vedāt vedajanyaṃ ca kimāpātajñānam, uta pramitirūpam? prathame karmabrahmabhāgasādhāraṇyāt karmavicārātikrameṇa brahmavicāraṃ prati tasya pūrvavṛttatvānupapattiḥ, niścayarūpaṃ cet mīmāṃsādvayaphalaṃ syāt āgamāntaramūlatve viruddhatayānupayogāt tasyaitannairapekṣyāñca pūrvavṛttatvānupapattiḥ | atrocyate yannityaṃ tadupādeyamiti | naivaṃ pratītiḥ, kintu nityaṃ sukhaṃ sambhavati cet tadupādeyam, sati tasmin anityamanupādeyamiti, tatra tāvannityasukhasambhavajñānasya brahmavicāropayogo nityaphalopāditsādvāreṇeti vaktavyam, śāstrāntareṣu karmakāṇḍe ca nityaphalasambhāvanāyā nivārakābhāvānnityānnityavivekānantaraṃ teṣāmapyārambhaṇīyatā syāt teṣu hi nityaṃ phalaṃ pratīyate, tadasaditi cet, tadasattvamaprāmāṇyādanyaparatvādvā bhavet, tadubhayaṃ kamarmīmāṃsayā vinā na sidhdyatīti tasyāḥ pūrvavṛttatvamabhyupetavyam | ādyasūtraṃ tajjñāpanaparamiti cenna, tasya svaśāstrārambhauyikaviṣayaprayojanaparatvena śāstrāntarāprāmāṇyādipratipādanaparatvābhāvāt | svārthopayogitvāt tadaprāmāṇyādikamabhipretamiti cet, tarhi tasya svopajīvyajñāpanamapekṣitamiti karmavicārasya tarkapādasya ca pūrvavṛttatvamāpadyeta śāstrāntarāprāmāṇyaṃ hi karmamīmāṃsāprathamapādāvaseyam anyaparatvaṃ vākyāntaravirodhādibhiḥ, nityaphalāvivakṣādhyavasāyaśca tatratyanyāyādhīnaḥ śāstrāntaraprameyadausthyañca tarkapāde darśayiṣyate | kiñca ādyasūtrādeva śāstrāntaragatanityaphalāsattvāvagamaścet anyonyāśrayaḥ, brahmavicāre pravṛttasyānyatra nityaphalāsattvāvagamaḥ tadavagamādbrahmavicāre pravṛttiriti | na caivaṃ sati dharmajijñāsāsūtrepyanyonyāśrayaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ, pitrādipreraṇayā kṛtasāṅgādhyayanasya puruṣasya prayojanavadarthāpātapratītyaiva pravṛttyupapatteḥ, yeṣāṃ dharmavicāro vaidhaḥ teṣāmevānyonyāśrayaḥ, vaidhatvajñānādvicāro vicārādvaidhatvajñānamiti | kiñca anityaphalaheyatājñānasya svargādiphalajihāsādvāreṇa brahmavicāropayogo vaktavyaḥ, svargādiphalasyānityatvaṃ duḥkhasambhinnatvaṃ ca kathamavagamyate? śāstrāntareṇa cet, tatraiva nitypuruṣārthasiddhernairākāṅkṣeṇa brahmavicārapravṛttyayogāt tatpūrvavṛttatvānupapattiḥ | yatsukhaṃ tadanityamiti svotprekṣitatarkamātreṇa cet, tenaiva nirastanityapuruṣārthasambhāvanatayā brahmavicāraḥ pratibadhyeta duḥkhanivṛtterantarāhityāt svābhāvikasukhasyānādibhāvātvādantavirahopapatteśca na nityapuruṣārthāsambhāvaneti cenna, duḥkhanivṛttiścet duḥkhānubandhinī duḥkhanivṛttitvāt sampratipannavat, sukhaṃ cet sukhatvādeva kṛtakamityevaṃrūpakutarkotprekṣāsambhavena kevalatarkaśaraṇānāṃ nityapuruṣārthasambhāvanāyā durupapādatvāt, śāstrasiddhanityetaraviṣayo vyāptiniścaya iti cenna, vedāntaśravaṇapūrvako vyāptiniścayaḥ, tatpūrvakaṃ vedāntaśravaṇamityanyonyāśrayaprasaṅgāt, ato brahmavicāraṃ prati nityānityagatadharmavivekopayogāya nityānityavibhāge pratyakṣāpravṛttestarkasyātiprasakteḥ śāstrāntarāṇāṃ brahmavicāranairākāṅkṣyāpādakatvāt tadvirodhenānupayogācca veda eva pramāṇīkattarvye tatrāpātapratīterubhayabhāgasādhāraṇyānnityānityaniścayasya mīmāṃsādvayaphalatvenānyonyāśrayasya dustaratvācca nityānityagataheyopādeyatvajñānaṃ nityānityavastuviveka ityayuktam | nanu śāstrāntareṣu nityaphalasambhāvanāyā nivārakābhāvānnityānityavivekādimatastatrāpi pravṛttiprasaṅga iti yaduktaṃ, tannaśāstrāntaranivārakatvādādyasūtrasya brahmaiva jijñāsyaṃ na prakṛtipuruṣāviti hi sūtrārtha iti | tadayuktam; sādhanacatuṣṭayapūrvavṛttatvavādibhirasyārthasyānaṅgīkṛtatvāt, tāpabramajñānapūrvavṛttatvavādibhirayamartha uktaḥ, na cāyamartha upapannaḥ | tathāhi, na tāvadayamarthaḥ sūtrakṛtopadiśyate, na vājñāpyate kintūpapādyata iti vaktavyam, nyāyanibandhanatvāt sūtrāṇām, upapattiśca śāstrāntaradaurbalyameva vā, svaśāstraprābalyameva vā, samuccitamubhayaṃ vā? sa prathamaḥ svaśāstrasya daurbalye brahmaṇopyagijñāsyatvāt | na dvitīyaḥ śāstrāntarasya prābalye brahmaṇa eva jijñāsyatvāsiddheḥ | tṛtīye sūtravaiyarthyaṃ pūrvamīmāṃsāyāmeva codanāsūtraprabhṛtibhistadubhayasiddheḥ | tata eva tasyāḥ pūrvavṛttatvāpattiśca avaśyāpekṣitatvāt vedaprāmāṇyamātre siddhepi brahmaṇi prāmāṇyaṃ na tāvatā sidhdyatīti cet tarhi yairhetubhirbrahmaṇi prāmāṇyāsambhavaśaṅkāste pariharttavyāḥ, te ca siddhe vyutpattyanupapattyādaya iti tatparihāreṇa brahmaṇi vedāntaprāmāṇyasamarthanaparatve'smīya eva pakṣaḥ parigṛhītaḥ syāt; ata eva duḥkhatrayābhighātajñānasya pūrvavṛttatvamapi nirastam | tathāhi kimaihikaduḥkhajñānaṃ pūrvavṛttam? uta nārakaduḥkhajñānam? uta svargāderapyalpāsthiratayā tāpatrayāntargatatvajñānam? na prathamaḥ āyurvedādibhistannirasanopāyāvagamāt vedāntavicāranairapekṣyāt | na dvitīyaḥ,nirayaduḥ svahetubhūtapāpāpanodakaravrataniyamavidhāyakaśāstrabāhulyādvedāntanairapekṣyāt | tṛtīye tu karmavicārāpekṣā syādeva, prathamata evādyayanavidhivaśyasya śāstrāntarāvagamāvasaravidhuratvāt, satyapyavasare svargādyalpasthiratvajñāpakaistaireva śāstrairmuktayupāyasyāvagatatvena vedāntanairapekṣyāt vedāntaviruddhārthābhidhāyināṃ teṣāmavagamasya vedāntajñānapūrvavṛttatvāyogāt āpātapratītetaratihāsapurāṇayoścālpāsthiratvānantasthiratvaviparyayapratītihetutvācca pūrvaṃ vyākhyeyasvabhāvāt kramaniyama uktaḥ | vyākhyānasvabhāvādapi tatsiddhiridānīmucyate eṣāmiti  eṣāṃ śamādīnām | sādhanatvam, caḥ samuccaye  viniyogāvaseyam | viniyogaḥaṅgatvajñāpanam | tataḥ kimityatrāha viniyogaśceti | tatopi kimityāha  sa ca tārtīya iti | tṛtīyādhyāyokta ityarthaḥ | idaṃ pradarśanārthamuktaṃ karmavicāroktakṛtsnanyāyasāpekṣatvādbrahmavicārasya etāni hi karmamīmāṃsādhyāyānāṃ prameyāṇi | prathame adhyāye pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ vṛttam | dvitīye'dhyāye śāstrabhedaḥ, karmabhedo vā bhedahetavaśca śabdāntarābhyāsasaṅkhayāguṇaprakriyānāmadheyāni | tṛtīye 'ṅganirūpaṇam, aṅgatvajñāpakāni pramāṇāni śrutiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇasthānasamākhyānāni | caturthe kratvarthapuruṣārthabhedanirūpaṇena puruṣārthaiḥ kratvarthānāṃ prayuktinirrūpitā | pañcame kramaḥ, kramapramāṇāni śrutyarthapāṭhapravṛttimukhyakāṇḍāni | ṣaṣṭhe'dhikārinirūpaṇam | saptame sāmānyātideśo nirūpitaḥ | aṣṭhame viśeṣātideśaḥ | navame ūhaḥ | daśame bādhaḥ | ekādaśadvādaśayostantraprasaṅgau | yathoktaṃ "dharmadhīmānabhedāṅgaprayuktikramakarmamiḥ | sātideśaviśeṣohabādhatantraprasaktibhiḥ" iti | etannyāyasāpekṣatvaṃ saṅkarṣasāpekṣatvaṃ ca brahmavicāre tatra tatra draṣṭavyam; tasmāt sa ca tārtīya iti pradarśanārtamuktam | atha karmavicārāpekṣatve abhyuñcayayuktirucyate udgīthādīti  pareṇa prasaṅgāt saṅgatiruktā, atra tu sākṣātsaṅgatirupapādyate  karmasamṛdhdyarthānyapīti | kamarsamṛdhdyarthatve tatprayojanaṃ tannirvacanāditi vākyakāravacanaṃ smāritam  brahmadṛṣṭhirūpāṇīti | abrahmaṇi brahmatvena dṛṣṭhibarrahmadṛṣṭhiḥ, brahmadṛṣṭhirūpatvāt brahmajñānasāpekṣāṇītyarthaḥ | itirheto  ihaiva cintanīyāni  na tu karmavicāre, tānyapi karmāṇi  yatsamṛdhdyarthānyudgīthādyupāsanāni tānyapītyarthaḥ | anibhisaṃhitaphalāni  anabhisaṃhitaphalatvāt brahmavidyotpādakānītyarthaḥ | itirhetau | tatsādguṇyāpādanādisādguṇyaṃ, prabalapratibandhake satyapi śīghraphalapradatvam, tadāpādanānibrahmavidyāṃ śīghraṃ sampādayantītyarthaḥ | etāni  udgīthādyupāsanāni ata ihaiva sutarāṃ saṅgatāni, pradhānānupayogitvena sādṛśyādinā dhīsthatvaṃ prasaṅgāt saṅgatiḥ, anyatarāpekṣayā ubhayāpekṣayā vā saṅgatiḥ sākṣātsaṅgatiḥ, atra tūbhayorapekṣitatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ brahmadṛṣṭirūpāṇīti udgīthādyupāsanasya brahmajñānāpekṣābhihitā | brahmavidyotpādakānīti brahmajñānasya udgīthādyupāsanāpekṣābhihitā etadabhiprāyeṇa sutarāmityuktam  ihaiveti | ubhayāpekṣayā atraiva vidyamānatvāt sutarāṃ saṅgatirihaiva, na tu karmavicāra ityarthaḥ | nanu kathamudgīthādivicārasya brahmavicāra eva sutarāṃ saṅgatiḥ? karmavicārepi sutarāṃ saṅgatirasti, ubhayāpekṣayā saṅgatirhi sutarāṃ saṅgatiḥ karmāṅgaśrayatvādudgīthādidhiyāṃ tadvicārasya karmāpekṣāsti, karmaṇāmapi svasamṛdhdyarthodgīthādyupāsanāpekṣāstītyubhayāpekṣāyā vidyamānatvāt | ucyatekarmasamṛdhdyarthodgīthādyupāsanāpekṣā kevalakarmaṇāṃ vidyāṅgakarmaṇāṃ ca tulyā, ataḥ karmasamṛdhdyarthatvahetuḥ sādhāraṇaḥ, karmāṅgaśrayatvaṃ pūrvabhāgavicārasaṅgaterasādhāraṇahetuḥ, brahmajñānasāpekṣatvamuttarabhāgavicārasaṅgaterasādhāraṇahetuḥ | evaṃ sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇahetudvayavattāsāmyepi, brahmadṛṣṭirūpodgīthādyupāsanānāṃ brahmajñānasāpekṣatvāt tena vinā taccintanamaśakyaṃ pūrvabhāgavicāre na hi karmavicārāt pūrvaṃ brahmavicāra upapadyate, prāguktasaṅgativiśeṣaviśiṣṭatvāttayoḥ, uttarabhāge tu brahmajñānasya sulabhatvāt nirvṛttakarmāvicārasyodgīthādyupāsanacintanaṃ kartuṃ śakyam; ata eva śakyatvādudgīthādyupāsanānyupaniṣadbhāge vihitāni, ata eva brahmamīmāṃsāyāṃ nirūpitāni ca, evaṃ vedāntabhāgavihitatvabrahmamīmāṃsāvicāritatvaśakyatvarūpavaiṣamyatrayaviśeṣitāyā ubhayāpekṣāyā uttarabhāga eva vidyamānatvāttannibandhanā sutarāṃ saṅgatistatraivetyabhiprāyeṇa "sutarāmihaiva saṅgatāni"tyuktam | ayaṃ cābhyuccayahetuḥ, yadapradhānasyārthasyāpi sākṣātsaṅgatatvāttasyāpyavaśyāpekṣitaḥ karmavicāra iti pradhānapratipādyasya niyamenāpekṣitatvarūpaḥ pradhānahetuḥ pūrvamevoktaḥ, tataḥ kiṃ prakṛtānantaryasyetyatrāha  teṣāṃ veti | teṣāmudgīthādyupāsanānām  sarvasammatā  tatsākṣātsaṅgatatve hi vigānam udgīthādyupāsane cintye sati tasya karmajñānāpekṣā sarvāvigītā | yattvadhītavedāntasya karmādhigamāpekṣā nāstītyuktam; tadayuktamvedānteṣvapi upāyaparamuktiparavākyamātrādhyāyinaḥ puruṣasya brahmavicārepi tṛtīyacaturthādhyāyamātraśravaṇaprasaṅgāt tṛtīyacaturthayoḥ prathamadvitīyoktanyāyasāpekṣatvamastīti cet, tarhi kṛtsnasya brahmavicārasya karmavicāranyāyasāpekṣatvāttasyaiva pūrvavṛttatvam janmāntarasukṛtaviśeṣeṇa kasyacid brahmavicāramātrāpekṣeti cet tasya sukṛtaviśeṣeṇa tṛtīyacaturthamātrāpekṣā kiṃ na syāt? athavā sukṛtātiśayāt kṛtsnabrahmavicāranirapekṣatā kiṃ nasyāt? kiñca vedānteṣūpāyaphalaparavākyamātrādhyayanamaśāstrīyamiti tvayāpi vaktavyam, tadvedāntamātrādhyayanasyāpi tulyaṃ kṛtsnasvādhyāyādhyayanasya vihitatvāt ato vidhyatilaṅghināṃ yadapekṣitaṃ tadeva pūrvavṛttamityasaṅgataṃ, kṛtsnādhyāyinopi sukṛtavaśāt kvācitkaśravaṇāpekṣāyāṃ pūrvameva dattamuttaram | virodhādapramāṇatvādityādigranthasaṅgṛhītāni dūṣaṇāni atrocyata ityādinā siddhāntabhāṣyeṇa parihṛtāni | tathā hi, kamarṇāmanityaphalatvena virodho'nabhisaṃhitaphalatvāt parihṛtaḥ, bhedavāsanājanakatvenaikyajñānavirodhastu pṛthagātmānamiti pṛthaktvajñānasya mokṣopāyatvaśrutyā parihṛtaḥ, ayaṃ virodho vakṣyamāṇavastusāmarthyāntarbhūtaśca, mokṣasya sakalamedadaśarnanivṛttirūpatāyāḥ prapañcamithyātvopapādanasāpekṣatvāt aikyajñānasyopāyatvepi karmaṇāmadṛṣṭadvāreṇopayogādavirodhaḥ | apramāṇatvaṃ kriyāvāneṣa brahmavidāṃ variṣṭha ityādisūtrahitaviniyojakapramāṇadarśanāt parihṛtam | vividiṣārthacittaśudhdyupayogastu vedanotpattyupayuktamanonairmalyahetutvopapādanena vividiṣārthatvepi
tasyāharaharutpattyapekṣopapādanena ca pratyuktaḥ, jñānamātrasya hetutvanavaṇaṃ ca sādhanadvitvānabhyupagamād dattottaram | sāmarthyaṃ nāma mithyābhūtabandhasya jñānaikanivartyatvarūpaṃ vastusāmarthyaṃ, tattu prapañcamithyātvadūṣaṇena prativakṣyate, śamādyaṅgakatāmnānakṛto virodhaśca pravṛttirūpayajñādernivṛttirūpaśamādeśca bhinnaviṣayatvenāvirodhāt parihṛtaḥ, śamādayo hyavihitāpratiṣiddhaniṣiddhakāmyaviṣayā ityuktam | vākyārthajñānasyaiva mokṣopāyatvaṃ pratyakṣavirodhaśāstravirodhābhyāṃ nirastam | tatra nivartyavāsanāyā nivarttakotpattipratibandhakatvābhāvena śravaṇāderbhedavāsanānirāsārthamanapekṣitatvāttadvaiyarthyaparihārasyānupapannatvācchravaṇādikramonnidravākyajā dhīrvimociketyetadapi parāstam | sādhanacatuṣṭayasya pūrvavṛttatve vastusāmarthyaṃ nāma heturuktaḥ, sa dubhayaṃ pūrvaṃ na kṛtam || iti laghusiddhāntaḥ ||
atha tadupapādanāyopakramatepūrvamupāyopadeśaparavākyaparyālocanayā vastusāmarthyavyatiriktahetava upanyastā nirastāśca, vidhitsāṃ jñānamiti hyuktaṃ, vastusāmarthyaṃ tu siddhaparavākyasiddhaṃ, vastusvarūpopadeśaparairiti hi vakṣyate, ataḥ svarūpaparavākyaparyālocanāmukhena tadupapādayitumārabhate  yadpyāhuriti | apinā upapādayiṣyamāṇasyārthasya prādhānyaṃ sūcyate, āhuriti granthakārabahutvam, anena asya granthasya tattatprabandhoktasakalāthargarbhitatvañca darśitam | sarve vedāntā ārabhyanta iti yadapyāhustadanādaraṇīyamityuparyanvayaḥ | prathamaṃ brahmaikameva satyamiti pratijānīte  aśeṣeti | aśeṣaviṣayāḥvakṣyamāṇajñātrādayaḥ, vijātīyasajātīyasvagatā vā svagateṣvapyanvayino vyāvṛttirūpāśca viśeṣāḥ aśeṣaśabdena vivakṣitā; tatpratyanīkamsvajñānena nivartakaṃ, śuktiriva rajastasyetyarthaḥ | nirviśeṣatve śūnyatāsyādityāha  cinmātramiti | cicchabdena tucchatvavyāvṛttiḥ, svayaṃprakāśatvaṃ hi cittvaṃ, mātracā jñeyatvavyāvṛttiḥ | yadvā, pratyanīkatvarūpadharmopi mātracā vyāvartyate | yadvā, mātracā vastutaḥ samastaviśeṣaviraho vivakṣitaḥ, brahmaivetyevakāreṇa saguṇabrahmavyāvṛttiḥ | paramārthaḥtattvāvedakapramāṇaviṣayaḥ, saguṇavākyānāṃ na tatparatvaṃ phalaviśeṣārthamupāsane'nyaparatvāditi bhāvaḥ | kathaṃ brahmaṇa eva satyatvam? anyadapi hi pratīyata iti śaṅkāyāṃ brahmaṇa eva paramārthatvasidhdyaye tadyvatiriktasya tajjñānanivattyartvāya ca viśvasya mithyātvaṃ pratijānīte  taditi | "athāta ādeśo neti netī "tyādau "prakṛtaitāvattva"miti sūtraviṣaye kṛtsnasya mithyātvena brahmaṇopi mithyātvaṃ paraiḥ pūrvapakṣīkṛtya nirastamiti tadabhiprāyeṇoktam  tadatirekīti  neha nānāstītyādiniṣedhavākyasya brahmavyatirekepi niṣedhyanānātvaṃ sidhdyatīti darśitam | nānāvidheti  tatkṛtajñānabhedaḥjñātṛjñeyāvacchinnavṛttijñānabhedaḥ, anena vṛttisphuritacaitanyabhedasya svarūpaprayuktatāvyāvṛttiḥ | bhedaśabdenaikaikakoṭiṣu avāntarabhedā vivakṣitāḥ, ādiśabdena nirasnīyaduḥkharūpajanmajarāmaraṇānyucyante | sarvamiti  vakṣyamāṇaśrutigatasarvaśabdasyāyamartha iti bhāvaḥ | tasminniti niradhiṣṭhānabhramapakṣavyudāsaḥ, evakāreṇādhiṣṭhānabahutvaniṣedhaḥ, tathā sati hi prapañcasya tajjñānanivartyatvasiddhiḥ | yadvā, tasminnityekavacanenedhiṣṭhānaikatvasiddhiḥ, nānādhyāsā nānādhiṣṭhānakā dṛṣṭhāḥ, tatkathamekādhiṣṭhānakatmamiti virodhaṃ svayaṃprakāśavastuno'dhiṣṭhānatvavirodhaṃ ca sphorayatyevakāraḥ | mithyābhūtam  mithyābhāvavatvakṣyamāṇamithyātvalakṣaṇavadityarthaḥ | brahmaṇa eva satyatve vyatiriktamithyātve ca kiṃ pramāṇamityatrāha  sadeveti | sade veti vijātīyabhedo vyāvartyate, ekameveti sajātīyabhedaḥ, advitīyamiti svagatabhāvābhāvarūpabhedaḥ, ṣaḍivadhatātparyaliṅgopetasadvidyāgatatvādidaṃ vākyaṃ prathamamupāttam | athaivakāraphalitaniṣedhakaṇṭhoktimatparavidyāvākyamupādatte  atheti | idañca kāraṇatvaśaṅkitadoṣavyudāsopakramakakāraṇavākyaṃ, bhūtayonimityuktavā anantaraṃ tasyaiva prapañcanāt, adreśyamagrāhyampratyakṣagocaro'numānāgocaraḥ, athavā cakṣuragocara indriyāntarāgocaraḥ | agotramanāmakam | avarṇamanailyādikam | acakṣuḥśrotramapāṇipādamjñānakarmendriyarahitam | nityaṃ vibhum kāladeśābhyāmaparicchinnam |
sarvagatam  sarveṇa jagatā'dhiṣṭhānatayā gatamāśritaṃ, vastuparicchedarahitamityarthaḥ | susūkṣmamadṛśyatvaṃ na tucchatvātidūratvādinā, kintu susūkṣmatvādityabhiprāyaḥ, vākyabhedādanekayattacchabdānvayopapattiḥ | atha śodhakavākyamupādatte  satyamiti | anṛtajaḍaparicchinnavyāvṛttanirviśeṣavastuparamidaṃ vākyaṃ, kāraṇavākyakārthyāt śodhakavākyāntaraikārthyāt sāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattyā ceti vakṣyate | niṣkalamkalā avayavāḥ, niravayavamityarthaḥ | tatra liṅgaṃ niṣkriyatvam | śāntamūrmiṣaṭkarahitam; aśanāyāpipāse śokamohau jarāmṛtyū cormayaḥ | niravadyaṃ nirañjanam karmasambandhatatphalarahitam, anena satyajñānādivākyagarbhi tavyāvṛttiḥ sphuṭīkṛtā | atha cinmātraśabdābhipretaṃ jñeyatvavyāvṛttimāha  yasyeti | amatamavijñātamiti śravaṇamananādirūpajñānāviṣayatvoktiḥ | atha jñātṛtvaniṣedhaparaṃ vākyamāha  na dṛṣṭeriti | atrāpi pūrvoktajñānāvasthābhedo vivakṣitaḥ, asya puruṣārthatvāyāsukhādyvāvṛttirucyate  ānando brahmeti | ānandaśabdo'sukhādyvāvṛttimātraparaḥ | ata eva hyānandītyuktiḥ, itthaṃ brahmaṇo nirviśeṣacinmātratve śrutivākyajātamupanyastam | atha vyatiriktamithyātve pramāṇamupanyasyate, tatra prathamaṃ mithyābhūtasya jagato brahmaṇyadhiṣṭhāne'dhyavastatvaṃ darśayatiidaṃ sarvaṃ yadayamātmetisāmānādhikaraṇyena | adhiṣṭhānenādhyasta sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ hi bādhārthaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathārajjusarpa iti | pūrvaṃ sarvaṃ tasminneveti pratijñātaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sarvādhyāsādhiṣṭhānatvañcānena vākyena darśitam | vyatiriktaniṣedhakaṇṭhokiṃta darśayati neha nānāsti kiñcaneti | nānāpaśyannatyantājña iti darśayati  mṛtyoriti | atra mṛtyuravidyā "tamaso vā eṣa tamaḥ praviśatī "tivat, ivaśabdena nānātvasyāpāramārthyaṃ darśitam | mithyābhūtaṃ cet kadācinnivṛttiḥ syādityatrāha  yatra hīti | yatrayadā | dvaitamiva bhavatiivaśabdaḥ pūrvavat | tattadā | itara itaramitareṇa paśyatītyarthaḥ | keneti vakṣyamāṇatvāditareṇetyadhyāhāraḥ | yatra tviti | yatrayadā | asya sarvamātmaivābhūt tattadā | kena kaṃ paśyet ka ityadhyāhāryam itara ityuktatvāt paśyedvijānīyāditi jñānaparvabhedoktiḥ | idaṃ kṛtsnamithyātvaṃ dṛṣṭāntenopapādayantīṃ śrutimudāharati  vāceti | vikāraḥghaṭādisaṃsthānaṃ nāmadheyaṃ ca vācārambhaṇam vāgālambaṇaṃ, vyāvahararikamityarthaḥ | tasmānmṛttiketyeva satyam | brahmaṇi nānātvaṃ paśyataḥ pūrvoktamṛtyuśabdābhihitājñānakāryaṃ bhayañca darśayati  yadā hīti | udaramu avadhāraṇe "tadevartaṃ tadu satyamāhustadeva brahma paramaṃ kavīnā"mitivat | daramalpam | yadvā, ut aram udityasya bhavatītyanenānvayaḥ "vyavahitāśce"ti sūtrāt | aramśīghram yadā hyevetyādeḥ paścādupādānaṃ siddhānte parihārasaukaryārthaṃ, tañca pūrvoktavākayānāmekanyāyaparihāryatvāt, brahmaṇo nirviśeṣacinmātratve vyatiriktamithyātve ca śrutidarśitā, tatra nirviśeṣatve sūtraṃ pradarśayate  na sthānata iti | ubhayaliṅgaṃsākāratvaṃ sākāranirākāratvañca, sarvatra sthitasyāpi brahmaṇo nāsti nirākāramityarthaḥ | anyamithyātve sūtramāha  māyeti | svāpnamarthajātaṃ kārtstena māyāmātram kuta iti cet? anabhivyaktasvarūpatvātdurnnirūpatvāt, bādhitatvādityarthaḥ | svāmārthamithyātvaṃ jaganmithyātvadṛṣṭāntatayā darśitam | asminnarthadvaye upabṛṃhaṇavacanāni darśayati  pratyastamitabhedamiti | pratyastamitabhedamsajātīyavijātīyabhedarahitam | sattāmātramsvagatabhedarahitam, ata eva vacasāmagocaram | tarhi tucchatvaṃ syāt na sarttatyatrāha  ātmasaṃvedyamiti  svayaṃprakāśamityarthaḥ | brahmasaṃjñitamiti  brahmeti saṃjñāmātrameva, na tu brahmatvādiguṇayoga iti bhāvaḥ| nirviśeṣaṃ cet kathaṃ jagadavabhāsa ityākāṅkṣāyāmupādatte  jñānasvarūpamiti | prapañcamithyātvamanena ślokenocyate | atyantanirmalamsakalaviśeṣarahitam | arthasvarūpeṇajaḍasvarūpeṇa | arthanānātvasya bhrāntisiddhatvādeka eva paramārtha iti darśayati  paramārthastvamiti | etadvivṛṇoti ślokadvayena  yadetadityādinā  bhrāntiścet kasvacinnivarttetetyākāṅkṣāyāṃ keṣāñcittannivṛtiṃta daśaryati  ye tu jñānavid iti  jñānasatyatvaṃ jaḍamithyātvañcoktam | atha jñānākāraṇātmanāmaikyokiṃta darśayati  tasyeti | ekamayam ekam | ātmaparinirdeśakṛtabhedaśaṅkāmapi vyudasyati  yadyanyostīti | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha  veṇurandhreti | asyopapāditasyārthasyopadeśaṃ darśayati  so'hamiti | yathopadiṣṭamakarodityāha  tatyājeti | athātmanāṃ brahmaṇaikyokiṃta darśayati  vibhedajanaka iti | atha bhagavadgītāyāṃ sarvātmanāṃ parasparaṃ brahmaṇā ca sahaikyoktimudāharati  ahamātmeti | savarbhūtaśabdena śarīrāṇyucyante, etat sphuṭayati kṣetrajñañceti | sarvakṣetraṣvityanena bhūtaśabdasya śarīraparatvaṃ sphuṭīkṛtam | tatraiva vyatiriktamithyātvokiṃta darśayati  na tadastīti | vastusvarūpopadeśaparaiḥ, na tūpāyaparaiḥ, ananyaparairiti bhāvaḥ | nirviśeṣacinmātramiti pūrvavadarthaḥ | abhidhānādityasyāśeṣetyādipūrvapratijñāvākyena sahānvayaḥ | nanu kimanyatra sato'nyatra khyātatvaṃ mithyātvam? utātyantāsattatvam? bādhyamityatrāha  tatra hīti | aikyagrāhipratyakṣaṃ bādhyamityarthaḥ | tarhi kiṃ prayojakam? ityatrāhaevañceti | tulyatvādīnāṃ prayojakatve'nupapanne sati dvayoriti  pratyakṣayoranumānayorāgamayoḥ pratyakṣānumānayoranumānāgamayoḥ pratyakṣāgamayorvetyarthaḥ | yatsambhāvyamānānyathāsiddhīriti  sāvakāśatvādanyathāsiddhamityarthaḥ | anantaramananyathāsiddhamanavakāśamityukte, viṣayāntaralābho'pramāṇakoṭiniveśo vā sāvakāśatvaṃ, tena svopasthāpitārthaviṣayaprāmāṇyaṃ vināpi sambhāvitodayatvamanyathāsiddhatvam viruddhārthapramāṇābādhenāpi sambhavadudayatvamiti yāvat | ananyathāsiddhamanavakāśamiti  ananyathāsiddhatvaṃ nāma tadarthapramāṇatāṃ vinā'nudayatvaṃ, viruddhārthapramāṇābādhenānudayatvamiti yāvat, taccānavakāśatvāt | anavakāśatvaṃ nāmaviṣayāntarālābho'pramāṇakoṭiniveśābhāvo vā, apramāṇakoṭhyanantarbhāvaviṣayāntarālābhābhyāṃ viruddhārthopasthāpakapramāṇābādhenānudayatvamityarthaḥ | iti sarvatra  uktaprakāreṇa sajātīyayorvijātīyayorvā pramāṇayorvirodha ityarthaḥ | evaṃ bādhyabādhakabhāve prayojakamastu, tataḥ kiṃ prastutaśāstraprābalyasyetyatrāhatasmāditi | tasmāt anyathāsiddhatvānanyathāsiddhatvayoreva bādhyabādhakabhāve prayojakatvāt | anādinidhanāvicchinnasampradāyeti  avicchinnasampradāyatvādanādinidhanam sampradāyāvicchede sati asmaryamāṇakartṛkatvaṃ hyapauruṣeyatvasādhakam | "anādhinidhanā hyeṣā vāgutsṛṣṭā svayambhuvā | ādau vedamayī divyā yataḥ sarvāḥ prasūtayaḥ"| "anādinidhanaṃ brahma" ityādivacanānicānādinidhanaśabdena smāritāni, ata eva asambhāvyamānadoṣam pauruṣeyatvaprayuktaṃ hi bhramavipralipsāpramādāśaktirūpadoṣacatuṣṭayavattvam | ata eva anavakāśam | śāstrajanyaśabdasyāvabodhaśabdenānvayaḥ | bādhyabādhakabhāvāṅgīkārasya virodhasāpekṣatvādvirodhaṃ darśayati  nirviśeṣetyādinā  nityamkālāparicchinnam | śuddhamavidyārahitam tata eva muktaśabdo'vidyākṛtajanmādirāhityaparaḥ | buddhambhāsamānam | svaprakāśaśabdaḥ pūrvaṃ buddhaśabdoktabhāsamānatvasya parādhīnatvavyudāsārthaḥ | svayameva prakāśasvabhāvatvaṃ svaprakāśatvaṃ, tañca cinmātraśabdavājacyatvāt, svayaṃprakāśatvaṃ hi cittvaṃ, citsvarūpatvañca śrutisiddham mātraśabdo jñeyatvavyudāsaparaḥ | brahmātmabhāvāvabodhenaevambhūtasya brahmaṇaḥ svasya caikyāvabodhenetyarthaḥ | sambhāvyamāneti  sambhāvyamānadoṣatvāt, sāvakāśamapramāṇakoṭau labdhaniveśam | ata evānyathāsiddhatvamapi phalitam | anyathāsiddhatvaṃ viparītapramāṇamabādhitvāpyudayasambhavaḥ  pratyakṣādīti  ādiśabdādanumānādikamucyate  vividheti | devādirūpeṇa svakāryajanmajarāmaraṇādirūpeṇa ca vividho jñātṛjñeyādivikalpaḥ, sa eva bandhaḥ, tannivṛttirityarthaḥ | sambhāvyamānaśca doṣaḥ kaḥ? ityatrāha  sambhāvye ceti | bhedaprapañcaḥbhedasamudāyaḥ, yadvā bhedarūpaḥ prapañcaḥ | vividhavikalpaśabdaḥ prapañcaviśeṣaṇaṃ bhedaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā bhedaḥjñātṛjñeyādiḥ, sa ca brāhmaṇādirūpeṇa vividhaḥ devamanuṣyādirūpeṇa vikalpavān | arvācīnāḥ kecit kācatimirādikaṃ doṣamācakṣate tadayuktaṃ, tasya kvācitkatvāt kācādiduṣṭapratyakṣaṃ sapakṣīkṛtya vyatiriktasya kācādiduṣṭatvamanumīyata iti cet na; atiprasaṅgāt | anādinidhanatvena yacchāstramuktaṃ tasyāpi śabdatvādityādinā duṣṭakatrtṛkatvānumānaṃ hi suśakaṃ, tatra karttāyogyānupalambhanirasta iti cet, tadatrāpi tulyamiti kācāderdoṣatvakalpanānupapattyā tadyvāvṛttyarthamāha  anadītyādi | bhedavāsanādirūpāādiśabdena bhedavāsanāhetubhūtaṃ bhedadarśanaṃ vivakṣitam | anayorhetuhetumadbhāve'nyonyāśrayaparihārāya anādiśabdaḥ, bījāṅkuranyāyāditi bhāvaḥ | bhedadarśanaṃ bhedavāsanā ca hi kāryāvidyā, ata uktam bhedavāsanādirūpāvidyeti | "ādityo yūpaḥ" ityādiṣu yūpādityādyaikyādyapratipādanaṃ na pratyakṣavirodhāt, kintvanyaparatvāt "yatparaḥ śabdaḥ sa śabdārtha" iti hi nyāyavidaḥ, anyaparatvañca tātparyaliṅgābhāvādavagamyate ādityo yūpa itivākyaṃ yūpāñjanavidhiśeṣatvādanyaparamiti parasyābhiprāyaḥ | yannirdoṣamuktaṃ tatrāpi bādhyabādhakabhāvanimittabhūto'rthavirodhosti, ato'vaśyamanyatarasya bādhyatvaṃ syāt tatra yadbādhyatve prayojakaṃ duṣṭakāraṇajanyatvaṃ tattu nāsti kathamatra nirvāha ityāśayena codayati  nanviti | prābalyadaurbalyaheturnāstītyāha  anādīti  apirvirodhasūcakaḥ | arthavirodhaṃ darśayati  bhedāvalambina iti | satyamityarddhāṅgīkāre bhedāvalambino bādhyatvamaṅgīkṛtaṃ, duṣṭakāraṇajanyatve'naṅgīkāraḥ, anyathāsiddhatvānanyathāsiddhatvayoreva bādhyabādhakabhāve prayojakatvam pūrvoktaṃ duṣṭakāraṇajanyatvamapi hi anyathāsiddhatvaprakāraviśeṣaḥ | atrāpi mukhabhedenānyathāsiddhimupapādayati  pūrvāparetyādinā  apacchedanyāyādbādhyatvaṃ pratyakṣasyāpi tulyaṃ, tatra doṣamūlatvaṃ ca bādhyatve'dhikahetuḥ, apacchede pūrvāparaśāstrayoḥ paurvāparyaṃ pramityutpattikramāt, na pāṭhakramāt "pañcatvajaḥ samanvārabdhāḥ prasarpanti adhvaryaṃ prastotānvārabhate prastotāraṃ pratihartā pratihartāramudgātā udgātāraṃ brahmā brahmāṇaṃ yajamāna" iti vihitasyānvārambhaṇasya vicchede prāyaścittamucyate "bahiṣpavamānaṃ prasarpatāṃ yadyudgātā'pacchidyeta adakṣiṇaḥ sa yajñaḥ saṃsthāpyastena punaryajeta tatra taddadyāt yat pūrvāsmin dāsyan syāt atha pratirharttāpacchidyeta sarvavedasaṃ dadyāt" iti | tadidaṃ śāstradvayaṃ viṣayaḥ, atrodgātṛpratihartroḥ prayogabhedenāpacchede svaṃ svaṃ prāyaścitta śāstraṃ pravarttate, ekasmin prayoge yaumapadyenāpacchede sati udgātuḥ prāyaścittaṃ pravarttate tasya karmapradhānatvāt, pradhānāpacchedasyaiva samādeyatvāt, vikalpenānuṣṭhānaṃ vā ekasminneva paurvāparyeṇāpacchede pūrvasya prāyaścittaśāstrasya daurbalyaṃ parasya prābalyaṃ ca karmamīmāṃsāyāmuktaṃ "paurvāparye pūrvadaurmalyaṃ prakṛtivata" iti | atrāsañjātavirodhitvena pūrvamudayātpūrvasya prābalyaṃ, parasya sapratipakṣatayaivodayāddaurbalyamiti pūrvapakṣaḥ | rāddhāntastu pūrvasyotpattikāle virodhyabhāvāttadabodhanāpyudayaḥ sambhavati, uttarasya tu svotpattikāle virodhisadbhāvāttadabādhenotpattyanupapattyā pūrvaṃ bādhitvenotpannamityananyathāsiddhatvāduttarasya prābalyamiti pūrvābādhena notpattiruttarasya hi sidhdyatīti hi nyāyavidaḥ nanūttaraśāstramudayeta cet pūrvābādhenānudayaḥ syāt pūrvaśāstramuttarotpattipratibandhakaṃ kiṃ na syāt? naivam;nimittasyotpannatvānnaimittikaṃ śāstramuditameveti tatrottarasyodyataḥ pūrvābādhenotpattyanupapattyā pūrvaṃ bādhitameva | kiñca yathoditadatakṣaṇākatvena karmasamāpanaṃ hi śāstreṇa pūrvameva svataḥ prāptam, tattu prāyaścittaśāstreṇānānyathākṛtam, evaṃ pūrvasiddhārthānyathākaraṇaprakaraṇatvadatrāpi pūvarmeva bādhyamiti karmavicāro niścitam | evamuttaraśāstrasyeva mokṣaśāstrasya niravakāśatvāt bhedāvalambi śāsiṃ pūrvaśāstravadbādhyata ityarthaḥ | paratvañca pāṭhakramādarthakramācca trivargaphalatvena hi karmaṇi prathamaprāvaṇyam nirūpakasya tattvaparasya hi mumukṣā, tādṛśapaurvāparyarahiteṣu virodhagarbheṣu vedāntavākyeṣu saguṇopāsanapareṣu kathaṃ nirvāhaḥ? ityatrāha  vedāntavākyeṣvapīti | apissamuccaye pūrvottarabhāgayorvirodhaḥ parihṛtaḥ, uttarabhāge ca virodhaḥ parihriyata ityarthaḥ | kathamatrāpacchedanāyāvatāraḥ? ityatrāha  nirguṇatvāditi | paraśabdenārvācīnasaguṇabrahmavyāvṛttiḥ | apacchedanyāyāvataraṇaphalabhūtanirguṇatvabodhadarśanāpacchedanayo'vatīrṇa iti boddhavyamityarthaḥ | "jakṣan krīḍān ramamāṇaḥ" ityādiphalaśrutestāttvikatvātāttvikatvanirūpaṇānādareṇa prathamaṃ saguṇopāsane prāvaṇyam, nirūpako hi niguṇaparabrahmavedanādhikārīti paurvāparyamiti bhāvaḥ | upāsanaparasaguṇanirguṇavākyayoḥ phaladvārā paurvāparyamuktam, tattu svarūpaparasaguṇanirguṇavākyayornāstīti kathaṃ tatra bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ? iti codayati  nanu ceti | vidhiniṣedharūpaṃ paurvāparyaṃ hṛdi nidhāyāha nirguṇeti | kāni nirguṇavākyāni, kathaṃ teṣāṃ sāmarthyam? ityatrāha  etaduktamiti | asthūletyādivākyaṃ guṇaviśeṣaniṣedhaparaṃ satyajñānādivākye vyāvṛttigarbhatā, nirguṇamityādivākyaṃ guṇasāmānyaniṣedhaparam ādiśabdena yattadadreśyamityādi gṛhyate | virodhaṃ sphorayati | nirasteti  kūṭasyaśabdo nirvikāratvavācī sarvādhiṣṭhānatvavācī vā kūṭavattiṣṭhatīti hi kūṭasthaḥ, nityacaitanyamityantaiḥ padairudrāhṛtanirguṇaśrutyarthaḥ saṅkṣiptaḥ | itarāṇi yaḥ sarvajñaḥ ityādīni pūrvopāttāni vākyāni cassamuccaye saguṇanirguṇaparatvādubhayavidhavākyavirodhaḥ | tenaiva  pūrvottarabhāgavirodhe ya uttarasya prābalyaheturuktastenaivetyarthaḥ | nirguṇavākyabalīyastvaṃ kutaḥ? ityatrāha  guṇāpekṣatvena paratvāditi | niṣedhyaviṣayo hi niṣedha udeti, na hi nirviṣayo niṣedhaḥ, prāgeva prasaktasya viṣayasya pratiṣedhyatvam | ato niṣedhyasāpekṣatvena niṣedhasya paratvamityarthaḥ | saguṇavākyavaiyarthyamapyupāsanaviṣayatvāt parihṛtamityabhiprāyeṇa na kiñcidapahīnamityuktam | yadvāyaḥ sarvajña ityādivākyānāmapyupāsanaśeṣatvābhiprāyeṇāha  vedāntavākyeṣvapītyādi | upāsanaparāṇāmiti | tānyapi vākyāni phalaviśeṣātharmupāsanaparāṇi, na tu tattvaparāṇīti bhāvaḥ | apacchedanyāyāvatāramupapādayatinirguṇatvāditi | pūrvavadarthaḥ | nirguṇatvamasiddhaṃpūrvāparabhāvābhāvenāpacchedanayānavakāśāt guṇānāṃ bādhyatvasiddheḥ | ata eva saguṇavākyānāṃ vaiyathyarparihāraśca na ghaṭate svarūpaparatayaiva pratipannānāmupāsanaparatvakalpanaṃ hi bādhdyatvasidhdyadhīnamiti codayatinanu ceti | pariharati nirguṇeti | anyatsarvaṃ pūrvavadeva | nirguṇavākyaiḥ sahopāttasya satyajñānādivākyasya saguṇaparatvabudhdyā codayati nanu ceti caścodyasamuccaye satyamānādayo guṇāḥ pratīyanta ityatra satyajñānaśabdau satyatvajñānatvaparau, yathā "hvekayordvivacanaikavacane" itipāṇinisūtrasthadyvekaśabdau dvitvaikatvaparau, anyathā dyvekeṣviti vaktavyam | tathā śrīvatsāṅkamiśrāḥ"guṇāḥ satyamānaprabhṛtaya uta" iti | etadvākyavaiśadyāya prathamaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nirūpyate, taddhi viśadataramupanyastaṃ prameyamālāyāmācāryapādaiḥ | tathā hi bhagavatā pratañjalinā "laṭaḥ
śadṛśānacāvaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe""tatpuruṣaḥ samānādikaraṇaḥ karmadhāraya" ityādisūtrasthasamānādhikaraṇaśabdavivaraṇārthaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇamuktam "bhinnapravṛttinimittānāṃ śabdānāmekasminnarthe vṛttiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ" iti | asyārthaḥpravṛtternimittaṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ, prakṛṣṭā vṛttiḥ pravṛttiḥ, śabdasyārthe vṛttirnāma tadbodhanaṃ, tatra viśeṣyabhūtapradhānārthaviṣayāvṛttiḥ pravṛttiḥ, viśeṣyaprādhānyaṃ ca guṇānāṃ pratipattirhi guṇipratipattyarthetyanena siddham, tasyāḥ pravṛtternimittaṃ dvāraṃ "nimittamātraṃ bhava savyasācin" ityādiprayogāt tañca viśeṣaṇībhūtajātiguṇādikaṃ, samānamekam adhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇānāmādhārabhūtaṃ viśeṣyam | ekasminnarthe vṛttirityekaśabdena samānaśabdasya sadṛsātharparatvaṃ vyudastam, samānaśabdasāmarthyādekaśabdaḥ sādhāraṇaparaḥ, samānaśabdo hi sādhāraṇe prayujyate "samāna karttṛkayoḥ pūrvakāla" iti | arthaśabdaśca viśeṣyabhūtapradhānābhidheyaparaḥ, anenādhikaraṇaśabdo viśeṣyaparatvena vyākhyātaḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavatitrividhāḥ śabdāḥ, kecidviśeṣaṇato viśeṣyataścaikārthāḥ, yathāghaṭaḥ kumbhaḥ nīlaṃ kṛṣṇamityādayaḥ | keciccobhayataśca bhinnarthāḥ, yathāgauraśvo mahiṣaḥ nīlaṃ śuklaṃ paṭamityādayaḥ | kecicca viśeṣaṇato bhinnārthāḥ viśeṣyataścaikārthāḥ, yathānīlamutpalaṃ devadattaḥ śyāmo yuvā lohitākṣa ityādayaḥ | tatra pūrvakoṭidvayavyāvṛttatṛtīyakoṭiniviṣṭānāṃ śabdānāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tatra bhinnapravṛttinimittānāmityanena viśeṣaṇato viśeṣyataścaikārthānāṃ ghaṭaḥ kumbha ityādīnāṃ na sāmānādhikaraṇyamityuktam | ekasminnarthe vṛttirityanenobhayato bhinnārthānāṃ gauraśvo mahiṣa ityādīnāṃ na sāmānādhikaraṇyamityuktam; tasmādviśeṣaṇato bhinnārthānāṃ viśeṣyataścaikārthānāṃ nīlamutpalamityādīnāmeva sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti | tatra pravṛttinimittaśabdayorevaṃ vārthaḥpravṛttirabhidhānaṃ, nimittamabhidheyam arthaśabdaścābhidheyavacanaḥ, bhinnābhidheyānāṃ śabdāmekasminnabhidheye vṛttiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti bhinnaviśeṣaṇābhidhāyināṃ śabdānāmekasmin viśeṣye vṛttiḥ paryavasānaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamityuktaṃ bhavati | bhinnapadasāmarthyena nimittaśabdanirdiṣṭaṃ viśeṣaṇabhūtamabhidheyam ekaśabdasāmarthyena cārthaśabdanirdiṣṭaṃ viśeṣyabhūtamabhidheyamityavagamyate; ata ubhayathāpyanekaviśeṣaṇābhidhāyināṃ śabdānāmekasmin viśeṣye paryavasānaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti bhinnapravṛttinimittānāmityādinā sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇavākyenoktaṃ bhavati | uktādarthādapi pūrvoktassādhīyān samānādhikaraṇapadeṣu prātipadikaṃ viśeṣaṇānvayaparaṃ, tatsamānavibhaktirviśeṣyaikyaparā samānavibhaktayaikyabodhanaṃ vṛttiśabdena vivakṣitam, tena rājā tasya putraśca darśanīyāvityatra rājatacchabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyanivṛttiḥ, tatra hi prakṛtaparāmarśitacchabdaprātipadikādaikyāvagamaḥ, na tu samānavibhaktayā | nanu nīlānyutpalānītyatra nīlatvānadhikaraṇeṣūtpalatvaṃ vartate; atastatra sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapannam atassāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇagrantasya yathokta evārtha iti | atra mṛṣāvādina āhuḥsāmānādhikaraṇyavākyamakhaṇḍārthaṃ, tathā hi, sāmānādhikaraṇyasya tāvadekārthaparatvamavigītaṃ, tatra samānādhikaraṇapadāni kiṃ viśeṣaṇamātraparāṇi, uta viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaparāṇi, uta svarūpamātraparāṇīti vivecanīyam | na tāvadviśeṣaṇamātraparāṇi, viśeṣaṇānāmanekārthatvādekārthatvāsiddheḥ, nāpi viśiṣṭaparāṇi, vikalpāsahatvāt kiṃ krameṇa yugavadvā viśiṣṭārthapratipādanaṃ padānām? na tāvatkrameṇa | tatra kiṃ prathamapadapratipannaviśiṣṭasya padāntaraṃ svopasthāpitaviśiṣṭena tādātmyaṃ vidaghāti; uta viśeṣaṇāntarānvayam? prathame viśiṣṭaikye vidhīyamāne viśeṣyāṃśayoriva viśeṣaṇāṃśabhūtayorjātiguṇayorapyaikya prasajet | dvitīye ca viśeṣaṇānāmanyonyasamavāyaprasaṅgaḥ, prathamamekena viśeṣaṇena viśiṣṭatayāvagatasya vastunaḥ paścādviśeṣaṇāntaraviśiṣṭatayā bodhanaṃ hi viśeṣaṇāntarānvayapratipādanam tatra viśiṣṭaṃ prati viśeṣaṇatayānvīyamānaṃ pūrvaviśeṣaṇasyāpi viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti viśeṣaṇānāmanyonyaviśeṣyabhāvaprasaṅgo hi durvāraḥ | avarjanīyaṃ ca padānāṃ krameṇārthapratipādanaṃ, kutaḥ? uddeśyopādeyavibhāgavattvāt sarvavākyānāṃ, nāpi yugapat uddeśyopādeyavibhāgahāniprasaṅgena yugapat pratipādanāsambhavāt sambhavepi viśeṣaṇānāṃ parasparaikyaprasaṅgācca tathāhiprātipadikānāṃ viśiṣṭārthaparatve prātipadikārthaikyaparasya samānavibhaktinirdeśasya viśiṣṭaikyaparatvamavaśyāśrayaṇīyamiti viśeṣyaikyavadviśeṣaṇānāmapyaikyaṃ pratipādyaṃ syāt; tadanupapattyā viśeṣyasyāpi naikyaṃ pratipādayitumalaṃ samānavibhaktinirdeśaḥ | kiñca sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na sidhyati | kiñca viśeṣaṇānāṃ vyāvartakatvasvābhāvyādviśeṣaṇabhedena viśeṣyabhedaprasaṅgo durvāraḥ | tathāhi bhedakaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ bhedyaṃ viśeṣyamiti hi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayossavarūpavivekaḥ, dṛśyate ca viśeṣaṇānāṃ viśeṣyabhedakatvam; yatā khaṇḍo muṇḍaḥ ghaṭaḥ paṭa ityādiṣu | nanu nīlamutpalaṃ devadattaḥ śyāmo yuvetyādiṣu viśeṣaṇabhedepi viśeṣyaikyaṃ dṛśyate | naiṣa doṣaḥ, atra hi svataḥ prāptaṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ viśeṣyabhekatvaṃ pratyakṣavirodhenāpohyate, pratyakṣā gocare tu brahmaṇi viśeṣaṇabhedaprayukto viśeṣyabhedaḥ kena vāryate? tasmādvastumātraparameva samānādhikaraṇavākyam | nīlamutpalamityādivākya eva satyādi vākyepyekavacanāntadharmipadaikyena viśeṣyaikyasiddhiriti cenna, khaṇḍo muṇḍaḥ pūrṇṛṅgo gaurītyatra viśeṣyabhedāt | nanu viśeṣaṇabhedo na viśeṣyaikyavirodhī,pratyakṣameva tu tadvirodhi, pratyakṣāgocare brahmaṇyekavacanāntadhamirvācipadaikyena svataḥprāptamekatvaṃ durnivāramiti cenna; khaṇḍo muṇḍaḥ pūrṇṛṅgo gauriti parokṣaviṣayavākyepi viśeṣyabhedapratīteḥ, ato na dharmivācipadaikyaṃ parokṣabrahmaṇyaikyapratipādanakṣamam; tasmādviśeṣaṇabhedaprayukto viśeṣyabhedo durvāraḥ, tataścaikārthatvaṃ na sidhdyati, ataḥ pāriśeṣyāt samānādhikaraṇapadānāṃ svarūpamātrapratipādanaparatvamāstheyam | evaṃ tarhi padānāṃ paryāyatvam ekenaiva padena svarūpaṃ pratipannamiti padāntaraprayogavaiyarthyaṃ pravṛttinimittabhedābhāvena sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇahāniśca prasajet | naivamekasyaivārthasya tattatpadārthavirodhipratyanīkatvaparatvena padānāmarthavattvamaparyāyatvaṃ nimittabhedalābhāt sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇasiddhiśca; ata eva jagatkāraṇatvaśaṅkitānṛtatvajaḍatvaparicchinnatvadoṣavyāvṛttiḥ satyajñānādi vākyena kriyate | na ca vyāvṛttirūpadharmavattvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prasajyeta, brahmasvarūpasyaiva sakaletaravyāvṛttirūpatvāt yathāśaukalyādeḥ kāṣrṇyādivyāvṛttistatpadārthasvarūpameva, na dharmāntaraṃ dharmāntarānupalambhāt, tadabhyupagame'navasthānācca; ataḥ kāṣrṇyavyāvṛttaṃ raktimavyāvṛttaṃ śaukalyamitipadānāṃ śaukalyasvarūpamātraviṣayāṇāṃ vyāvṛttyabhedena yathā na paryāyatvamarthavattvamekārthatvañca ata eva sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇavattvaṃ ca, tathā satyādipadānāmapi vyāvartyabhedena na paryāyatvadoṣaprasaktiḥ | nanvevaṃ tattatpadārthavirodhivyāvṛttaparatve lakṣaṇā syāt | naivam, avācyopasthāpane hi lakṣaṇā, yathā gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ prativasatītyatra gaṅgāpadasya kūlopasthāpane, na hi kūlaṃ gaṅgāpadavācyam, atra tu satyādipadānāṃ vācyaikadeśabhūtaviśeṣaṇaparityāge'pi, vācyapradhānāṃśabhūtaviśeṣyasvarūpapratipādanānna lakṣaṇāprasaṅgaḥ, tathāpi viśiṣṭavācinaḥ śabdasya viśeṣyamāpiratve svārasyabhaṅga iti cet, naiṣa doṣaḥ, samānādhikaraṇavākyeṣvekārthaparatvabalāt viśeṣaṇaparityāgena svarūpamātraparatvameva padānāṃ svārasikaṃ, tathā vyutpatteḥ, vyadhikaraṇavākyeṣu padānāṃ viśiṣṭaparatā svārasikī, lakṣaṇābhyupagame'pi na doṣaḥ, vākyatātparyānuguṇā hi lakṣaṇā tadvirodhimukhyavṛtterbalīyasī dṛṣṭā, yathā gaṅgāpade samānādhikaraṇavākyasya hi aikya eva tātparyamiti sarvasammatam | nanu sarvapadānāṃ lakṣaṇā nadṛṣṭā ayuktā ca kenacinmukhyavṛttena tātparye niścite hi padāntaralakṣaṇā yuktā, sarvapadalakṣaṇāṅgīkāre kiṃ tātparyaniścāyakam? ucyatedṛṣṭā tāvat "viṣaṃ bhuṅkṣe "tyādiṣu sarvapadalakṣaṇā, tatra viṣapadaṃ niṣiddhabhojyaṃ lakṣayati, bhuṅkṣeti bhojananivṛtiṃta, tatra yogyatādivaśādvākyatātparyaniścayaḥ, satyādivākyeṣu samānavibhaktibalādaikyatātparyaniścayaḥ, tadavirodhāya prātipadikānāṃ lakṣaṇā svīkṛtā, ekapadalakṣaṇāyāmapi vākyatātparyavirodha eva hi hetuḥ, yathā gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādiṣu tadavirodhe ekasyāpi na dṛṣṭā, yathā gaṅgāyāṃ matsyāḥ prativastītyādiṣu, ato vākyatātparyāvirodhāya ekasyeva savarpadānāṃ lakṣaṇā na doṣaḥ, tasmātsamānādhikaraṇavākyaṃ vastumātraparameveti | etadasabhaprāyeṇa pratyavatiṣṭhate  netyucyata iti | satyajñānādayo guṇāḥ pratīyanta iti codite netyucyata iti vadato'yaṃ bhāvaḥ pratīyanta iti āpātapratītimātravivakṣā cettayā na kiñcitprayojanaṃ, pramitivivakṣā cet na tu pramitirjāyata ityupapādyata iti | kutaḥ? ityatrāha  sāmānādhikaraṇyenaikārthatvapratīteriti | śaṅkate aneketi | yathā vyadhikaraṇavākyeṣu minnārthapayravasāyikārakapadārthāparityāge'pi pradhānārthakāryasyaikatvam "arthaikatvādekaṃ vākyam" ityatra niścīyate tathā samānādhikaraṇavākyeṣvapi viśeṣaṇabhūtaguṇavāciśabdārthāparityāge'pi viśeṣyaikyaṃ sidhdyatītyarthaḥ | codayantamupālabhate  anabhidhānajña iti | vyadhikaraṇasamānādhikaraṇavākyayorabhidhānaviśeṣānabhijña ityarthaḥ | devānāṃ priyaḥmeṣaḥ, ajña ityarthaḥ | pariharati  ekārthatvamiti | ekārthatvaṃ nāmasarvapadānāmekābhidheyaparyavasānaṃ, na tu vākyasyetyarthaḥ | pṛthakpṛthagarthapayravasāyināṃ padānāmekapradhānārthānvayādarthaikatvaṃ vyadhikaraṇavākya eva, samānādhikaraṇavākye tu padānāmevaikārthaparyavasāyitvamuktaṃ bhavati | tataḥ kimityapekṣāyāṃ samānādhikaraṇapadānāṃ viśeṣaṇamātraparatve viśiṣṭaparatve ca dūṣaṇamekagranthenāha  viśiṣṭeti | viśiṣṭetyādinā kṛtsnavākyena viśiṣṭapakṣe dūṣaṇamuktam | viśeṣaṇabhedenaviśeṣaṇānāmanyonyato viśeṣyācca bhedena | viśeṣaṇairviśeṣyeṇa cānekārthatvaṃ syādityarthaḥ | kiñca arthaśabdo viśeṣyaparatayā ca vivakṣitaḥ, tena viśeṣaṇabhedena viśeṣyabhedaḥ syāditi dūṣaṇāntaramuktaṃ bhavati | kiñca viśeṣaṇabhedena viśeṣyabheda ityakte vyatirekavaśādviśeṣyābhede viśeṣaṇābhedaśca syādityuktaṃ bhavati | viśiṣṭaikyapratipādikā samānavibhaktirhi aviśeṣeṇa viśeṣyaikyavadviśeṣaṇaikyamapi pratipādayatītyabhiprāyaḥ | evaṃ viśiṣṭaparatve yugapadabhidhānapakṣe dūṣaṇamuktaṃ bhavati, uddeśyopādeyavibhāgahāniprasaṅgaścārthasiddhaḥ, krameṇābhidhāne anyonyasamavāya ānandamayādhikaraṇe vakṣyate, viśeṣaṇabhedenārthabheda ityetāvatāṃśena viśeṣaṇamātraparatve ca dūṣaṇamuktaṃ bhavati, viśeṣaṇānāmanekatvādekārthatvahānirityarthaḥ | evaṃ padānāṃ pratipādyabhedaḥ prasañjitaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  tataścaikārthatvaṃ na sidhdyatīti | sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇāsiddhirityarthaḥ | ato vastumātraparamiti pariśeṣasiddham, tadanuvādena codayati  evamiti | evaṃ tarhivastumātraparatve | kuta ityatrāha  aviśiṣṭārthābhidhāyitvāditi | anena tataścaikārthatvaṃ na sidhdyatītyatrāha phalitortho vivṛtaḥ | atra paryāyatvacodye pravṛttinimittabhedābhāvāt sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇahāniḥ, ekatarapadavaiyarthyaṃ ceti codyadūṣamabhipretaṃ, parihariṣyamāṇatvāt | uktacodyatrayaṃ parihartumāha  ekārtheti | avahitamanāḥ śṛṇuprativacanasyānekavākyasādhyatvānmadhye na codanīyaṃ, kintvarthasya gahanatvādavaghātavyamiti bhāvaḥ | anupapattitrayaṃ pariharati  ekatvetyādinā | ekatvatātparyaniścayaḥ samānavibhaktayā | arthavattvamprayojanavattvam | vyāvarthabhedakṛtavyāvṛttedādaparyāyatvaṃ vyāvṛttirūpapravṛttinimittalābhāt sāmānādhikaraṇyasiddhirvyāvṛttibahutvāt padānāṃ tattadyvāvṛttirūpaprayojvattvaṃ cetyarthaḥ |
nanu tattvamasyādivākyavadanvayamukhenopalakṣaṇaṃ syāt, kimarthā vyāvṛttiḥ? vyāvṛttibahutvādanekārthatvamāpatitaṃ, vyāvartyākārānantyāt katipayapadairna tadyvāvṛttiḥ śakyate karttuṃ, brahmaṇo yebhyo vyāvṛttiḥkāni tāni vastūni? brahmaṇo'nekavyāvṛttimattvāt sadharmatvam, dharmatvānabhyupagame padānāṃ paryāyatvamityādyanekaśaṅkāparihārārthamāha  etaduktaṃ bhavatīti | lakṣaṇataḥsvarūpalakṣaṇataḥ, na tu taṭasthalakṣaṇataḥ | anena jagatkāraṇatvaśaṅkitadoṣavyāvṛttaye brahmaṇaḥ sakaletaravirodhitvaṃ pratipādayadidaṃ śodhakavākyaṃ vyāvṛttiparaṃ bhavituṃ yuktamityuktaṃ bhavati | bahuvyāvṛttibhiranekārthatvapasaṅgaṃ pariharati  tadvirodhirūpamiti | phalato vyudasyata iti  idaṃ vākyaṃ svarūpamātraparameva, ata aikārthyaṃ, vyudāsastu phalita iti bhāvaḥ | vyāvṛttryākārabahutvāt katipayapadairvyāvṛttirna śakyetyetatpariharati  sarvamanena padatrayeṇa phalato vyudasyata iti | prayojakarūpeṇa vyudāse sarvamapi vyudastaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | virodhīni kānītyatrāha tatreti | jagatkāraṇatvena tucchatā vyāvṛttā | kimarthamasatyavyāvṛttirityatroktam vikārāspadatvenāsatyāditi | stabdhaśītādisādhāraṇajaḍaśabdavivaraṇārthamanyādhīnaprakāśaśabdaḥ | yadyapi satyādiṣvaikaikapadena samastavyāvṛttisiddhiḥ, tathā'pi brahmaṇi śaṅikatatvetatpadārthagatavirodhyākārasyaikapadenānivartanāt padatrayasāphalyam | vyāvṛttibhiḥ sadharmakatvaṃ pariharati  naceti | prābhākarapakṣe siddhāntimate ca bhāvarūpadharmaḥ; vaiśeṣikādimate tu abhāvarūpadharmaḥ | tasmādbhāvarūpo'bhāvarūpo vetyuktam | vyāvṛttirdharmo na cet, kiṃ syādityatrāha  api tviti | śuktayādau hi dharmasya vyāvṛttitvaṃ rajatādivirodhitvādabhyupagamyate, evaṃ brahma ca sakaletaravirodhitvāt svayameva vyāvṛttirityarthaḥ | svarūpasyaiva vyāvṛttitve dṛṣṭāntamāha  yatheti | śauklayādeḥ kāṣṇryādivyāvṛttirna dharmāntaram, anupalambhāt; dharmāntaratve'navasthānāccetyabhiprāyaḥ | tarhi padānāṃ paryāyatvaṃ syādityāśaṅkaya kāṣrṇyavyāvṛttaṃ pītimavyāvṛttaṃ raktimavyāvṛttaṃ śauklayamiti dṛṣṭāntavākyābhiprāyeṇa pariharati  ekasyeti | vyudasanīyavyudāsabhedena padānāṃ prayojanavattvam, tata evāṣaparyayatvamityarthaḥ | pratiyogyavacchinnaveṣeṇa pravṛttinimittalābhāt sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇasiddhiścetyabhipretam | paryāyatvādiprasaṅga parihāra aikārthyavirodhena kṛta ityabhiprāyeṇoktamekārthamiti svarūpamātraparatvādaikārthyaṃ hi rakṣitam | arthavattaramiti  tarappratyayena dṛṣṭāntācchauklayāt bhedavādyamitaguṇaparatvācca prayojanādikyamabhipretam | aparokṣabhūtā hi śauklayādidṛṣṭāntaḥ, tatra spaṣṭārthaṃ kāṣrṇyādivyāvṛttamityādiprayogaḥ | pratyakṣāgocare tupare brahmaṇi sakaletaravyāvṛttivacanamadhikaprayojanamiti dṛṣṭāntāt prayojanādhikyam jagatkāraṇabhūtasya brahmaṇaḥ śaṅkitadoṣavyāvṛttirevāpekṣitā, na tu guṇāntaramiti bhedavādipakṣāt prayojanādhikyam |
evaṃ satyajñānādivākyasyānugrāhakastarka uktaḥ, tarkānugṛhītena vākyena ko'rthaḥ pratipanna ityatrāha  tasmāditi | tasmātuktanyāyānugṛhītatvādasya vākyasyetyarthaḥ | ekamiti  samānavibhaktinirdeśaphalitamaikyamuktam evakāreṇa svarūpata aikyaṃ, guṇato bheda ityaṃśato 'nekārthatvavyāvṛttiḥ | etadviśadayati  nirddhūtanikhilaviśeṣamiti  nirviśeṣasya tucchatāvyāvṛttyarthamsvayaṃjyotiritipadam | ityuktamiti  satyajñānādivākyeneti śeṣaḥ | itthaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattyā satyajñānādivākyasya vastumātraparatvamupapāditam | atha kāraṇavākyaikārthyena śodhakasākyānataraikārthyena hetudvayena vastumātraparatvamupapādyate  evamityādinā | tatra prathamaṃ kāraṇavākyaikārthyaṃ heturucyateevamiti | evamnirviśeṣaparatvena nirvāhe satyeva, kāraṇavākyaikārthyamityarthaḥ | kāraṇavākyaikārthyaṃ kuto'pekṣitam? aikārtye sati kathaṃ vā nirviśeṣaparatvam? ityatrāha  yata ityādi | yato vā imānītyādi lakṣaṇavākyam | etasya kāraṇatvānuvādena lakṣaṇaparatvāt kāraṇatvaprāpakaṃ vākyamāha  sadeveti | upalakṣitasyaupalakṣaṇaṃ nāma candrasya śākheva taṭasthaṃ jñāpakaṃ  satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahmetīti | anena vākyenetyarthaḥ | kāraṇavastunaḥ svarūpaśodhakatvāt kāraṇavākyaikārthyamasyāpekṣitamityuktaṃ bhavati | astu kāraṇavākyaikārthyaṃ, tattu saguṇabrahmakāraṇatvavādibhiḥ "yassarvajñaḥ sarvavit" "yasya jñānamayaṃ tapaḥ" "tasmādetad brahma nāma rūpamannaṃ ca jāyate" "tamīśvarāṇāṃ paramaṃ maheśvaram" "sa kāraṇaṃ karaṇādhipādhipaḥ" ityādivākyaireva syādityatrāha  tatreti | tatrakāraṇavākyaikārthye'pekṣite | sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyo'hyanuktārthasvīkāraphalaḥ, tenātrānuktasyopaniṣadantaroktasyārthasya svīkarttavyatve sati saguṇamātraparāsūpaniṣatsu nirguṇamapi brahmoktaṃ bhavati | tatrāpacchedanyāyena nirguṇavākyānāṃ balīyastvāt sarvatra sajātīyavijātīyavyāvṛttamadvitīyaṃ brahamaiva pratipāditaṃ bhavatītyaprāyaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  jagaditi | jagatkāraṇetyādipadaiḥ kāraṇavākyoktamarthamanuvadati | pratipipādayiṣitamtātparyabhūmiḥ, vastumātra eva tātparyamityarthaḥ | tadavirodhena vaktavyamkāraṇavākyapratipannabrahmasvarūpaśodhakatvāttadavirodhenānena vākyena vaktavyamityarthaḥ | narapatiradvitīya ityādivatsamābhyadhikarāhitye'pyadvitīyatvamupapannamiti tadaikārthye'pi na nirguṇaparatvasiddhirityatrāhaadvitīyatvaśrutiriti | sadeva ekameveti vijātīyasajātīyavyāvartakāvadhāraṇadvayasamabhivyāhṛtatvādidamadvitīyapadaṃ guṇato'pi sadvitīyatāṃ na sahata ityabhiprāyaḥ | evaṃ kāraṇavākyaikārthyāt satyajñānādivākyasya vastumātraparatvamupapāditam | atha śodhakavākyāntaraikārthyaṃ heturucyate  anyatheti | anyathāsatyajñānādivākyasya viśiṣṭaparatve; nirañjanaṃ nigurṇamityādibhirvirodhaḥ syāt, atastadavirodhāyedaṃ vākyaṃ nirviśeṣavastumātraparamityarthaḥ | anyathā nirguṇaṃ nirañjanamityādibhirvirodhaścetyanenādvitīyatvaśruterguṇato'pi sadvitīyatāniṣedhaparatvaṃ cārthādupapāditaṃ bhavati | hetutrayoṇopapāditamarthaṃ nigamayati  ataśceti | ataḥpūrvoktasāmānādhikaraṇyānyathā'nupapattyā paścāduktakāraṇavākyaśodhakavākyāntaraikāthyarrūpahetudvayena cetyarthaḥ | etallakṣaṇavākyamsvarūpalakṣaṇavākyam | akhaṇḍaikarasamnirviśeṣataikasvabhāvameva pratatipādayatītyarthaḥ | atha mukhyārthaparityāgena lakṣaṇāsvīkāradoṣamuddhāṭayati | nanu cetyādinā | svārthapraheṇena svārtho hi viśeṣaṇadvārakaṃ viśeṣyaṃ, tatprahāṇenetyarthaḥ | lakṣaṇātvamabhyupagamyādoṣatāṃ pratijānīte | naiṣa doṣa iti  mukhyārthatvamuttaratrābhidhāsyate | hetumāha  abhidhānavṛtterapīti | tātparyavṛttirnnāmatātparyādāgatā vṛttiḥ tatparatvarūpā vā, sā cātra lakṣaṇāvṛttirvivakṣitā, vākyatātparyavirodhimukhyavṛtterapi vākyatātparyānuguṇalakṣaṇāvṛtterbalīyastvādityarthaḥ | kasminnarthe tātparyam, yadanurodhāya lakṣaṇāsvīkāraḥ? ityatrāha  sāmānādhikaraṇyasyeti | aikya eva tātparyamiti  tātparyaniścāyikā samānāvibhaktiriti bhāvaḥ | ānandamayādhikaraṇe siddhāntinā hyetadvakṣyate | sarvasammatam  viśiṣṭaikyavidibhiranyaiśca sammatamityarthaḥ | gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādiṣu sarvapadalakṣaṇā na dṛṣṭeti codayati | nanu ceti  tātparyaniścāyakakatipayamukhyavṛttyā tadanuguṇamanyeṣāṃ padānāṃ lākṣaṇikatvamānayaṇīyam, sarvapadalakṣaṇāyāṃ tu tanna sambhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ | tātparyāviruddhapadamukhyārthasvīkārastātparyaviruddhapadalakṣaṇasvīkārasyāviruddha ityāśayenāha  tataḥ kimiti | tataḥ kimityabhipretaṃ vivṛṇvan vaktavyamityarthaḥ | narapatiradvitīya ityādivatsamābhyadhikarāhitye'dvitīyatvamupapannamiti tadaikārthye'pi na nirguṇaparatvasiddhirityatrāhaadvitīyatvaśrutiriti | sadeva ekameveti || atha śodhakavākyāntaraikārthyaṃ heturucyate | anyatheti | anyathāsatyajñānādivākyasya viśiṣṭaparatve; nirañjanaṃ nirguṇamityādibhirvirodhaḥ syāt, atastadavirodhāya idaṃ vākyaṃ tatprahāṇenetyarthaḥ | lakṣaṇātvamabhyupagamyādoṣatāṃ pratijānīte | naiṣa doṣa iti | mukhyārthatvamuttaratrābhidhā syate | hetumāhaabhidhānavṛtterapīti | tātparyavṛttirnnāmatātparyādāgatā vṛttiḥ, sammatamityarthaḥ | gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādiṣu savarpadalakṣaṇā na dṛṣṭeti codayati | nanu ceti | tātparyaniścāyakakatipayamukhyavṛttyā tadanuguṇamanyeṣāṃ padānāṃ lākṣaṇikatvamāśrayaṇīyam, sarvapadalakṣaṇāyāṃ tu tanna saṃbhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ | tātparyāvirūddhapadamukhyārthasvīkāraḥ tātparyaviruddhapadalakṣaṇāsvīkārasyāviruddha ityāyenāhatataḥ kimiti | tataḥ kimityabhipretaṃ vivṛṇvan pratibandīmukhena vivakṣitārthaṃ (vipakṣebādhaṃ)darśayitvā pari hartuṃ vipakṣa bādhagarbhāṃ pratibandīmāha vākyatātparyeti | yadi aviruddhapadamukhyārthatvaṃ viruddhapadalakṣaṇāvirodhi, tarhi gaṅgāyāṃ matsyāḥ prativasantītyādiṣu avirodhena ekasyāpi padasya lakṣaṇānaṅgīkārāt gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādiṣvekasyāpi padasya lakṣaṇā na syādityabhiprāyaḥ | gaṅgāyāṃ matsyā iti vākye kārakapadānāmapūrvakāryānvitābhidhāyināṃ tadanvita eva mukhyārtha iti tadanvayaparityāge lakṣaṇaivetyarthaḥ |
nanu gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ prativasetityādiṣu gaṅgāpadasya lākṣaṇikārthatve'pi tadanvitābhidhāyināṃ padāntarāṇāmamukhyatvaṃ na dṛṣṭamiti cennagaṅgāpadalakṣitasya kūlasya vākyārthatvābhāvāt; iha tu vākyasya pradhānapratipādyabhūtakāryārthasamarpakapadasya lākṣaṇikatvāt tadanvitābhidhāyināṃ padānāṃ lakṣaṇā syādeva |ata eva kāryavākyārthavādibhirityuktam | nanu "kamalāni nimīlanti kumudānyunmiṣanti ca" iti vākyārthabhūtanimīlanāderlākṣaṇikatve'pi tadanvitābhidhāyināṃ kamalādipadānāṃ na lākṣaṇikatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti cet anabhiprāyajñaścodayati bhavān | sarvapadānāṃ nimīlanarūpavākyārthaparatvasya kaiścdvayavasthāpitatvābhāvāt nimīlanopasthāpakapadalakṣaṇāyāmapi na tadanvitābhidhāyināṃ lākṣaṇikatāpattiḥ; tvayā tu sarvapadānāṃ kāryakaratvābhyupagamāt tatkāryasamarpakapadalākṣaṇikatve tadanvitārthābhidhāyināṃ lakṣaṇā prāpnopi | tathā hikāyarvākyārthavādinā padānāṃ kiṃ viśiṣṭakāryaikadeśe padaśaktinirścīyate, uta viśiṣṭasthāyikāryaikadeśe? prathame viśiṣṭakāryaikadeśatvāviśeṣāt svārtheṣu kārakapadānā miva liṅādeḥ kriyākārye mukhyatvaprasaṅgaḥ | dvitīye viśiṣṭasthāyikāryaikadeśaparatvaprahāṇasya sarvapadānāmaviśiṣṭa tvāt liṅādeḥ kriyākāyar iva kārakapadānāṃ kriyākāryānvitaparatve lakṣaṇā syāt || padānāṃ viśiṣṭakāryaikadeśa paratve tulyepi liṅādeḥ kriyākārye lākṣaṇikatvam, kāryānvitamātre kārakapadānāṃ mukhyatvamiti cetyadi kāryānvitamātre kārakapadānāṃ mukhyatvamiṣṭaṃ, kriyākārye liṅāderlākṣaṇikatvaṃ katham? || sthāyikāyarparatvena vedaprayuktatvaniścayāllakṣaṇayāpi kriyākāryabodhanasambhavāditi cetkārakapadānāmapi sthāyikāryānvitaparatvena vedaprayogadarśanāt lakṣaṇayāpi kriyākāryānvitabodhanopapatteḥ kriyākāryānvitapratipādanaṃ lākṣaṇikaṃ syāt | nanu gopadasya sāsnādimanmātramukhyatve'pi pramāṇāntareṇa khaṇḍādisiddhivāt liṅādeḥ kāryamātraparatve kāryaviśeṣasya pramāṇāntareṇa siddhayabhāvādubhayatraikaśaktikalpanāyogāt śaktidvayakalpane gauravācca liṅderapūrvakārye mukhyatvamiti kriyākāryapratipādanaṃ lākṣaṇikam; anyathā śabdaśakteḥ kāyarmātraviṣayatvāt pratyakṣādyaviṣayatvācca kāryaviśeṣo niṣpramāṇakaḥ syaditi cennakāryaviśeṣasya prāmāṇikatve tatra śaktikalpanam, śaktikalpane tasya prāmāṇikatvamityanyonyāśrayaprasaṅgāt | kiñca yadi kāryaviśeṣasyāprāmāṇikatvaparihārāya tatra śaktikalpanamtarhi kārakapadānāṃ kāryānvitamātraparatve kāryaviśeṣānvayasya pramāṇāntarāgocaratvāt ubhayatra śaktikalpane gauravācca kāryaviśeṣānvaye pramāṇaṃ na syāditi tatparihārāya kāryaviśeṣānvaye kārakapadānāṃ mukhyatvamiti kriyākāryānvitaparatvaṃ lākṣaṇikaṃ syāt || liṅādisamabhivyāhārabalāt kārakapadānāṃ kāryaviśeṣānvayaparatvasiddhiriti cet tarhi svargakāmapadasamabhivyāhārabalāt liṅādeḥ kāryaviśeṣaparatvasiddhiriti liṅādiḥ kāryamātraparaḥ syāt | tasmālliṅāderapūrvakārya eva mukhyavṛttatvena kriyākāryasyāmukhyatve kārakapadānāmapi kriyākāryānvitaparatvaṃ lākṣaṇikamityevābhyupagantavyam || kārakapadānāmanvayāṃśe lakṣaṇā; na sarvatreti cetsamānādhikaraṇavākye'pi padānāṃ prātipadikāṃśa eva lakṣaṇā na samānavibhaktāviti tulyam | sarvapadalakṣaṇānupapattiparihāramupasaṃharati | ata iti |ataḥsarvapadalakṣaṇāyā upapattisiddhatvāt laukikaiḥ parīkṣakairapyāṅgīkṛtatvāccetyarthaḥ |
yadapyāhurityārabhya kṛtāṃ śāstreṇa svābhimatārthasiddhimupasaṃharati | ata idameveti |ataḥnirviśeṣe vastuni, tasyaiva pāramārthye vyatiriktasya mithyātve tasya doṣaparikalpitatve, doṣasya ca sadasadanirvacanīyatve, jñānamātranivartyatve ca uktairupapattisahitaiḥ śrutivākyairityarthaḥ | idamevārthajātampūrvoddiṣṭamevārthajātam; na tu saguṇavastvādikam | pratipādayanto vedāntāḥ pramāṇamiti | vākyāntarāṇāṃ kālpanikārthaparatvena tattvāvedakatvābhāvāduktārthaviṣayameva vākyajātaṃ tattve pramāṇamityarthaḥ ||
pūrvaṃ pratyakṣavirodhe śāstraprābalyaṃ, śāstre ca bhedābalambinābādhyatvaṃ coktam | atha pratyakṣavirodho nāstītyupapādayituṃ prakamate | pratyakṣādīti śāstrapratyakṣavirodhe śāstraprābalyapratipādakagranthena vakṣyamāṇārthasaṅgatiriti bhāvaḥ | caḥ samuccaye | avirodhapakṣasya ca buddhisthatvāt tasya cānvāruhyoktasya ca samuccayaḥ | virodhābhyupagame'pītyarthaḥ | sati ceti |atra ca śabdo hi śabdārthaḥ | avirodhaṃ pratijānīte | virodha eva na dṛśyata iti | hetumāha nirviśeṣeti | viṣayaviṣayibhāvarūpabhedavyavṛttyarthaṃ sanmātrabrahmetyuktam | pratītivirodhena codayati | nanu ceti | virodhamupapādayati | ghaṭo'stītyādinā | na hi kevalam, astīti pratītiḥ, api tu "ghaṭo'sti" "paṭo'stī"ityeva hi pratītirityarthaḥ | pratīterbhrāntirūpatvasaṃbhavāt tadvyudāsārthaṃ vyavahāravirodhamāha vilakṣaṇeti | pariharati | satyamiti | ghaṭo'sti, paṭo'stītyatrāstitva vyavahārasyaikarūpatvāt tāvanmātre bhedāvabhāsamātra cāṅgīkāraḥ, bhedavyavahārasya pratyakṣabhūlatve bhedāvabhāsasya pratyakṣatve cānaṅgīkāraśca sūcyate satyamityardhāṅgīkāreṇa | tathaiva | yathā sanmātrasyaiva pratyakṣatvamekavyavahārahetutaiva ca syāt, tathaivetyarthaḥ | atra ghaṭādiviṣayasvarūpaviṣayavyavahārasamudāye | vivicyate | yathā idaṃ rajatamityatra idaṃ vyavahārasya pratyakṣamūlatvaṃ rajatavyavahārasya bhrānitamūlatvaṃ, tathā vivicyata ityarthaḥ | tatra idamaṃśarajatāṃśavyavahārayorabādhitatvabādhitatvābhyāṃ vivekaḥ; atra svarūpaviṣayabhedaviṣayavyahārayorubhayorapyabādhitatvāviśeṣe kathaṃ vivekaḥ ityabhiprāyeṇāha kathamiti | yauktikabādho'stītyāśayenāha ghaṭo'stīti | kimastitvaṃ bhedaścaikaḥ padārthaḥ, uta dvau? dvitve ca kiṃ tadubhayavyavahārayoḥ pratyakṣamūlatvam, utānyatarasya? dvayorapi pratyakṣamūlatve pratyakṣaṃ kiṃ yugapadubhayagrāhi uta krameṇa iti vikalpān hṛdi nidhāya, "astitvalakṣaṇasvarūpatadbhedayoraikyaṃ na sambhavati, bhedagrahaṇasya svarūpagrahaṇapratiyogismaraṇasāpekṣatvāt, sanmātragrahaṇasya tannirapekṣatvācca ityabhiprayannāha astitvaṃ tadbhedaśceti | bhinna iti vyavahāraiva ghaṭa ityasādhāraṇavyavahāre'pi ghaṭasya paṭādvayāvṛttatayā pratītau pratiyogisāpekṣatvāt ghāṭavyavahāra eva bhedavyavahāra ityucyate | dvitve ca dvayorapi pratyakṣamūlatvaṃ netyāha na ca dvayorapīti | dvayorapi vyavahārayoḥsvarūpaviṣayabhedaviṣayavyavahārayoḥ | pratyakṣaṃ yugapadvā krameṇa vā mūlaṃ syāditi vikalpamabhipretya yaugapadyaṃ dūṣayati | tayoriti | pratiyogyapekṣānapekṣārūpavaiṣamyādityabhipretam | kramapakṣaṃ pratikṣipati pratyakṣajñānasyeti | caḥsamuccaye | evaṃ yugapat krameṇa cobhavyavahārasya pratyakṣamūlatvamanupapannamiti tayoranyatarasya pratyakṣaviṣayatvamāha tatreti | bhedaḥ pratyakṣaviṣayaḥ syādityatrāha bhede ti | astitvabhedayoraikyāyoge tadvayavahārayorbhinnakālajñānaphalatve ca ya eva hetuḥ, tenaivetyevakārābhiprāyaḥ | pratyakṣasya svarūpamātraviṣayatve kathaṃ bhedavyavahārasambhava ityatrāha  ato bhrāntīti | tathā ca saṃvitsiddhau, "yaugapadyakramāyogādvayavacchedavidhānayoḥ | aikyāyogācca bhedo na pratyakṣa iti yo bhramaḥ ||" iti | vyavacchedaḥ bhedagrahaṇam | vidānam svarūpagrahaṇam |
