evaṃ bhede pramāṇānupapattiruktā ;atha prameyānupapattimāha kiñceti | kiñcetyādinā pramāṇānugrāhakatarkābhāvo'pyupapādito bhavati |durnirūpatvaṃ pratijānīte bhedo nāmeti | vikalpāsahatvāditi bhāvaḥ | nyāyavidbhiḥ | na tvāpātapratītitṛptairiti bhāvaḥ | svarūpadharmavikalpaṃ hṛdi nidhāya svarūpapakṣaṃ dūṣayati bhedastāvaditi | kutaḥ ityatrāha vastusvarūpa iti | svarūpavyavahāravat sarvasmādbhedavyavahāraprasakteriti | pratiyoginirapekṣabhedavyavahāraprasakterityarthaḥ | svarūpagrahaṇasya śabdavyutpattivyupannaśabdasmaraṇanirapekṣatve'pi bhinna iti vyavahārastu tatsāpekṣo yathā bhavati, tathā pratiyogisanmaraṇamapi bhedavyavahārasāmagyrantarbhūttam; atastatsmaraṇābhāvāt tadānīmeva bhedavyavahārābhāvaḥ na tu bhedāgrahaṇāditi paramatamāśaṅkayāha na ceti | kuta ityatrāha svarūpeti | yathā na svarūpagrahaṇe pratiyogyapekṣā, tathā bhedavyavahāre ceti ca śabdārthaḥ | hi śabdo hetau | svarūpagrahaṇa iva bhedavyavahāre pratiyogyapekṣāyā asambhavādityarthaḥ | asambhavaḥ kuta ityatrāha svarūpeti | svarūpabhedayoḥ svarūpatvamaviśiṣṭamastu, tataḥ kiṃ pratiyoginirapekṣabhedavyavahāraprasakteḥ iti śaṅkāyāṃ tadvivṛṇoti yatheti | svarūpapakṣe dūṣaṇāntaramapyāha hastaḥ kara iti | paryāyatve sati sahaprayogastyājyaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | svarūpapakṣe mṛṣāvādibhirdūṣaṇāntarāṇyapyuktāni; udāhṛtadūṣaṇaparihāreṇa tānyapi pratyuktāni bhavantīti bhāṣye na kaṇṭhoktāni | tānyucyantesvarūpapakṣe bhinna iti vyavahartuṃ na yuktam, bhinno hi bhedayogī | etadvayavahārasiddhaye yadi svarūpabhūtabhedāntaraṃ svīkriyate, tatrāpi bhinna iti vyavahārasyāyuktatvāt tatsvarūpabhūtabhedāntaramāśrayaṇīyamityanavasthā | kiñcaśabdāntareṇa dharma ityuktaṃ syāt; tathā ca dharmapakṣadūṣaṇānyāpateyuḥ | kiñcabhedaḥkimanuvṛttaḥ, uta vyāvṛttaḥ,? vyāvṛttaścet sa kiṃ svarūpam, uta dharmaḥ? prathame ghaṭasya bhedavyavahāre kṛte paṭa viṣayabhedavyavahāro na syāt, vyāvṛttatvāt | dharmaścet pūrvoktadoṣo dharmatvaprayuktadūṣaṇāni ca syuḥ | yadyanuvṛttaḥ saca svarūpaṃ cetśabdāntareṇa sanmātramaṅgīkṛtaṃ syāt | dharmapakṣe pūrvavat | kiñcabhididhātorhi vidāraṇamarthaḥ,ekasya vastuno bhedo nāma dvidhā bhāvaḥ, tatkhaṇḍasyāpi tathā syāt | ato vastuni bhedābhyupagame vidāraṇaparamparayā nāśa eva syādityevāmādīni |
atha dharmapakṣaṃ dūṣayati nāpīti | kutaḥ ityātrāha dharmatva iti | svarūpāddharmasya bhedābhāve'niṣṭamāha anyatheti | svarūpadharmayorbhedo'stu; tataḥ kimityatrāha bhede ceti | tasyāpi bhedastaddharmaḥtasya dharmatayā svīkṛtasyāpi bhedasya, svarūpāpekṣayā yo bhedaḥ, so'pi tasya dharmatayā svīkṛtasya bhedasya dharmaḥ | yadvā svarūpāddharmasya yo bhedaḥ svīkṛtaḥ, tasya dharmibhūtāddharmāt bhedo'pi dharmaḥ | anyathā svarūpameva syāt | tadā(thā) ca svarūpapakṣadūṣaṇāni
syuḥ; so'pi bhedo dharmaḥ, tasyāpi svarūpādbhedaḥ ityanavasthetyarthaḥ | evaṃ dharmapakṣe'navasyāmuktā'nyonyāśrayaṇamāha  kiñcetyādinā | tredhā ca tatdharmiṇi pratiyogini ca gṛhīte bhedagrahaṇaṃ, bhede gṛhītedharmipratiyogigrahaṇamiti; dharme dharmiṇi ca gṛhīte bhedagrahaṇam bhede gṛhīte dharmadharmigrahaṇamiti |ayaṃ ghaṭa ityatra idaṃśabdanirdiṣṭasya ghaṭajātīyatvaviśiṣṭagrahaṇaṃ paṭajātīyādbhedagrahaṇapūrvakam,anyathā ghaṭājātīyatvavirodhāt; paṭādbhedagrahaṇam idaṃśabdanirdiṣṭa sya ghaṭajātīyatvagrahaṇapūrvakam, anyathā paṭatvaprasaṅgāditi; evaṃ dharmadharmigrahaṇe dharmitayā pratiyogitayā ca grahaṇe tattajjātīyatvagrahaṇe ca tridhā'nyonyāśrayaṇamuktam |
sādhakapramāṇābhāvamupasaṃharati | ata iti |ataḥsvarūpadharmapakṣoktairdūṣaṇaiḥ, durnirūpatvādityarthaḥ |
itthaṃ sādhakapramāṇābhāva uktaḥ | prameyānupapattirūpastarkaśca taccheṣabhūtaḥ; sāmagrīviṣayeṇārthasvābhāvaviṣa yeṇa vā nirūpaṇena viṣayaviśeṣe pramāṇavyavasthāpanaṃ hi tarkakṛtyam |atha vādhakapramāṇamupanyasyati | kiñceti | tatra anumānaṃ vivakṣurvyāpti śikṣayati ghaṭo'stītyādinā | "vaidharmyācca na svapnādivat" ityatra sūtrakāreṇaiva dṛśyatvānumānasya nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt tannirāsasya mithyātvānumānānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dūṣyatvapradarśanārthatvāt pūrvapakṣe vyāvarttamānatvaheturupanyasyate | anuvṛttatvapradarśanāya ghaṭo'sti paṭo'stītyuktam | sadanumūtyorekatvaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ hṛdi nidhāyānūbhuteranuvṛtiṃta darśayati | ghaṭo'nubhūyate paṭo'nubhūyata iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha atreti | vyāvarttamānata yāuttarottarapratipātiviṣayepvavidyamānatayā | rajjusarpādivatrajjavādivatsarpādivaccetyarthaḥ | tadvivṛṇoti yathetyādinā | bādhitatvābādhitatvābhyāṃ dvayorapi hetvoḥ sopādhikatvaṃ darśayaṃracodayati nanu ceti | upādhinivṛttyā pakṣe sādhyanivṛttimāha atra tviti | viparītopādhisadbhāvācca vyādhāta iti cābhiprāyaḥ | pariharati ucyata ityādinā | prathamaṃ sampratipannāṃśamāha ghaṭodau dṛṣṭā vyāvṛttiriti | sapakṣeṣu sarveṣu vidyamānaḥpakṣe avidyamāno hyupādhiḥ | tatra pareṇopādhitvenoktasya dharmasya pakṣe vidyamānatvakathanena vyāvarttamānatvahetoḥ sopādhikatvaṃ dūṣayiṣyan tadupayogitvena, ghaṭādiṣu dṛṣṭā vyāvṛttiḥ kiṃ saṃvādaphalabhūtā, uta bādhaphalabhūteti vivecanīyamityāha sā kiṃ rūpeti | bādhaphalabhūtatvaṃ darśayituṃ vyāvṛttisvarūpamāha kiṃ ghaṭo'stītyatreti | ghaṭo'stīti pratīte viṣaye paṭābhāva ityarthaḥ | sdiṃdha tarhīti | rajjau bhūdalanādīnāmabhāvo hi bādhitatvamiti bhāvaḥ | tasmāt bādhaphalabhūtaivetyāha ata iti | bādho nāmaaduṣṭakāraṇajā niṣedhabuddhiḥ | tena purovarttinyabhāvo vyāvṛttiḥ | evaṃ nirupādhikatvādvayāvarttamānatvamapāramārthyasādhakamityāha seti | abādhitatvaphalabhūtānuvṛtteḥ paramārthatvaprayojakatvādanuvarttamāne pāramārthyaṃ darśayati rajjuvaditi |abādho nāma avirodhitvam, anuvṛttirnāma tatkṛto viṣayatayā'nvayaḥ; purovarttini sadbhāvo vā | itthaṃ vyāptiḥ śikṣitā | na kevalaṃ tarkaḥ; anugrāhyamapyastītyāha prayogaśca bhavatīti | māyāvedāntino hi jñānamātrapāramārthyavādinaḥ; tatkathaṃ sataḥ pāramārthyasādhanamityatrāha evaṃ satīti | vyāvarttamānatvānuvarttamānatvayorapāramā rthye pāramāthye ca prayojakatve siddha ityarthaḥ | tarhi paramārthadvayaṃ syādityatrāha saiva satīti | atha sadanumūtyorviṣayaviṣayibhāvarūpaṃ bhedamuddhāṭayaṃścodayati | nanu ceti |bhinnatvaṃ sādhyaṃ viṣayatayeti hetuḥ | pariharati naivamiti | tatra sādhyāṃśaṃ dūṣayati bhedo hīti | purastādevajñeyabhadeniṣedhādeva jñānabhedo'pi nirasta ityarthaḥ | hetvaṃśaṃ dūṣayati ata iti | na pramāṇapadavīmanusaratīti | viṣayaviṣayibhāvo bhrāntisiddha ityarthaḥ | bhedasya bhrāntisiddhatvapinā samuccīyate | śrutipratipādyān arthān takaiṇāpi sādhayan, viṣayaviṣayibhāve niraste grāhakābhāvācchūnyatvaśaṅkāñca vyāvartayan svaprakāśatvamupapādayati sā ceti | caḥ śaṅkāyā nivṛttau | tatra vyatirekiṇaṃ hetumāha anubhūtitvāditi | vipakṣe bādhaṃ darśayati anyataḥ siddhāviti | yat anyataḥ siddhaṃ, tat ananubhūtidṛṣṭam; yathā ghaṭa iti vyāptirarthā
ddarśitā |asya vyatirekiṇaḥ parābhimataṃ pratyanumānaṃ sopādhikamiti darśayan arthādanumānāntaramapyāha kiñcetyādinā | anumānāntara kaṇṭhoktam, ārthaḥ pratyanumānanirāso vā syāt | anumānāntarasya kaṇṭhoktatve kiñcaśabdaḥ svarasaḥ | pratyanumānasya kaṇṭhoktatve na śakyā kalpayitumiti nirdeśaḥ svarasaḥ | kiñceti | na kevalaṃ svamatopapattiḥ, paramatānupapattiścetyarthaḥ | anumānāntaraṃ ceti vā'rthaḥ | anubhavāpekṣā ceti | pūrvoktasamuccetavyadvaye kiñcaśabdasamuccitādanyasya samuccayaparaḥ ca śabda: | na śakyā kalpayitum | jñānaṃ paraprakāśam, vastutvāt bhāsamānatvādvā, ghaṭādivaditi pratyanumānam | evamādibhiḥ paraprakāśatvaṃ na vaktuṃ śakyamityarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha sattayaiveti | sattayaiva prakāśamānatvāditi hetorasiddhiśaṅkānivṛttaye taṃ vivṛṇoti na hīti | vidyamānadaśāyāṃ kadācidaprakāśamānatvaṃ parādhīnaprākāśatve prayojakam; ataḥ pratyanumānaṃ sopādhikamityarthaḥ| vidyamānadaśāyāṃ sarvadā bhāsamānatvāditi vyatirekyanumānāntaramiti sphuṭataram | yathā saṃvitsiddhau, "yadyaprakāśamānā dhīḥkadācidavatiṣṭhate" ityārabhya"ghaṭādāviva tatrāpi kalpanīyaṃ prakāśanam" iti | anena granthena svasattayaiva prakāśamānatvāditi hetorasiddhiśaṅkā parihṛtā || vidyamānatve sarvadā prakāśamānatvaṃ sukhādāvapyastītyanaikāntyamiti cennasukhādivyatiriktatve satīti viśeṣaṇasyābhipretatvāt | siddhāntimate sukhāderapi jñānaviśeṣatvena pakṣe'ntarbhāvānnānaikā ntyam | ekamanumānāntaramuktam | śaṅkitapratyanumānasya sopādhikatvañca darśitam ||
atha prākaṣṭayayānumeyapakṣaṃ nirācikīrṣuranuvadati athaivaṃ manuṣa ityādinā | prathamaṃ svasattayaiva prakāśamānatvāditi hetorasiddhimupapādayati utpannayāmiti | anena svoktasya, "vastutvāt" "bhāsamānatvāt" ityādipratyanumānasya sopadhikatvavyudāsaḥ setsyatīti bhāvaḥ | utpannāyāmapyanubhūtau viṣayamātramavabhāsata ityatra ghaṭo'yamitītyadhyāhāryam | ghaṭo'yamiti viṣayamātramavabhāsata ityarthaḥ | ghaṭo'yamiti jānanniti hi vakṣyate | yathā saṃvitsiddhau, "ghaṭo'yamiti vijñāne ghaṭamātra prakāśate na vittiriti yuṣmākaṃ goṣṭhīṣu nanu ghuṣyate ||" iti | ghaṭo'nubhūyata ityasyottaratrānvayaḥ | pūrvatrānvayaścet, "viṣayamātramavabhāsata" ityanena virodhaḥ syāt | kathaṃ viṣayamātrasyāvabhāsaḥ; ghaṭo'nubhūyata iti anubhavo'pi prakāśata iti śaṅkāyāṃ viṣayamātrasyaivāvabhāsamupapādayati | ghaṭo'nubhūyata ityādinā | yadā ghaṭo'yamiti jānāti na hi tadānīmeva ghaṭo'nubhūyata iti jānāti | kuta ityatrāha aviṣayabhūtāmanidambhāvāmiti | aviṣayabhūtāmghaṭaśabdārthavyatiriktām | anidambhāvāmayaṃśabdārthavyatiri ktām | ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭaṃ pṛthubudhnodarākāradravyaṃ ghaṭaśabdārthaḥ | sannihitadeśavartamānakālaviśiṣṭatvamayaṃśabdārthaḥ | ubhayavyatirikto hyanubhavaḥ | sa tu ghaṭo'yamityanubhavavelāyāṃ nānubhūyata ityarthaḥ | aviṣayabhūtāmiti sādhāraṇanirdeśaḥ paṭādīnāmapi pradarśanārthaḥ | ata evāghaṭabhūtāmityanuktiḥ | yadvā ghaṭo'nubhūyata iti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | itirhetau | yato ghaṭa evānubhūtikarma, na tvanubhūtirapi tadānīmanubhūtikarma bhavatitasmādviṣayamātramavabhāsata ityarthaḥ | asyaiva vivaraṇam na hīti | śabdaliṅgālokādīnāṃ prakāśakānāṃ jñātatayaiva prakāśakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam; ato'nubhūtiraprakāśā cet, prakāśakatvamapi na syādityatrāha tasmāddhaṭādīti | sattayā prakāśakaṃ jñāyamānatayā prakāśakañca dvividhaṃ prakāśakam | tatra sattayā prakāśakakoṭiniviṣṭaṃ jñānamityarthaḥ | ka evaṃ niyāmakaḥ ityatrāha tasmāditi | svasattayaiva prakāśamānatvahetorasiddheḥ, asmaduktahetoḥ sopādhikatvanirāsāccetyarthaḥ | yadyanubhūtiḥ svayameva na prakāśate, tarhi kiṃ tasyāṃ pramāṇamityatrāha tadanantaramiti | arthagatakādācitkaprakāśātiśayaliṅgena  kādācitkatvāt kāryaṃ, kāryatvāt sahetukamityanumānena jñāyata ityarthaḥ | viṣayagataprākaṭhyaliṅgena kathaṃ svagatajñānamanumīyata iti cet svasmai prakāśamānatvāt svagatajñānānumānamupapadyate | yadi jñānapaścādbhāvinā prakāśaliṅgena jñāmanumīyate, tarhi ghaṭo'nubhūyata iti vaktumayuktam, ghaṭo'nvabhāvīti vaktuṃ yuktamiti śaṅkāyāmuktaṃ tadanantaramiti | pratyāsattyatiśa yāt vartamānatvavyapadeśa ityarthaḥ | arthendriyasaṃprayogasamanantarabheva ghaṭo'nubhūyata iti pratīteḥ prakāṭyaliṅgena jñānānumānānavakāśatvaśaṅkā cānena parihṛtā tadanantaramiti | padmapatra  bahupatravedhavadanumānaśaighyrāt tathā pratītirupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ | mṛṣāvādī svadarśanaprasidhdyā'niṣṭaṃ prasañjayati evaṃ tarhīti jaḍatvamjñānavyatiriktatvam, acittvamityarthaḥ | iha cānubhūtirajaḍeti viparyaye paryavasānam prasañjanīyasya jaḍatvasyāniṣṭatvaṃ pratikṣeptumajaḍatvaṃ vika lpya dūṣayati kimidamiti | kimidaṃna kimapi; durnirūpamityarthaḥ; anantaraṃ śirodvayapradarśanābhāvāt | dunirrūpatvavivaraṇamuttaragranthaḥ | vikalpaparo vā kiṃ śabdaḥ | ajaḍatvaṃ nāma, kiṃ hetutvenoktaṃ vidyamānadaśāyāṃ sarvadā prakāśamānatvam, uta sādhyatayā'bhimataṃ svayameva svasya prakāśakatvam iti vikalpo'bhipretaḥ | tatra prathame kalpe kimutpattikāle'pi prakāśāvyabhicāro vivakṣitaḥ, utotpattikṣaṇādūrdhvaṃ prakāśāvyabhicāraḥ iti vikalpo'bhipretaḥ | tatrā dye śarasyasiddhiḥ pūrvabhevokteti matvā dvitīye'naikāntikatvamāha sukhādiṣviti | tadvivṛṇoti na hīti | śiro'ntaraṃ dūṣayati | ata iti ataḥhetorasiddhayanaikāntikatvābhyāṃ sādhyamapi netyarthaḥ | anena jaḍatvaṃ nāniṣṭamiti darśi tam | anumānāntareṇa sādhayiṣyata ityatrāha arthāntaramiti | vyāhatatvānna kiñcidapi pramāṇamimamarthaṃ sādhayitumalamityarthaḥ | yathāhuḥ, "aṅgulyagraṃ yathātmānaṃ nātmanā spraṣṭumarhati | svāṃśena jñānamapyevaṃ nātmānaṃ jñātumarhati ||" iti | evaṃ jaḍatvaprasaṅgarūpatarkasya viparyaye paryavāsānābhāvaḥ, vyāptyamāvaḥ, iṣṭaprasaṅgatvam, vyādhātalakṣaṇapratitarkaparāhatatvañca darśitam | itiathaivaṃ manuṣa iti purvatrānvayaḥ || atha svayaṃprakāśatvavādyāha tadidamiti | anākalitānubhavavibhadasya | svavyatiriktasya kṛtsnasya prakāśakaḥ sannanubhavaḥ svātmani ananyananyāpekṣa iti eko vibhavaḥ | prākaṭyahetuko yo vyavahāraḥ "prakāśata" iti, taṃ ca janayitumayameva kṣama ityaparaḥ | evaṃ dvividho'nubhavavibhavo'nākalito yena, so'nākalitānubhavavibhavaḥ; tasya | svamativijṛmbhitam | pramāṇatarkanirapekṣasvotprekṣāmātravijṛmbhitamityarthaḥ | svamatimāhātmyamityadhikṣepo vā | pāriśeṣyāt svayaṃprakāśatvamabhyupagamayituṃ prathamaṃ prākaṭyaliṅgaṃ pratikṣipati anubhūtītyādinā | anubhūtivyatirekiṇa ityanenāsādhāraṇyapratikṣepaḥ phalitaḥ | viṣayadharmaśabdena ātmadharmavyudāsaḥ | tena rūpādivat sādhāraṇyaṃ phalitam | anubhūtivyatirekiviṣayadharmaḥ prakāśaḥ pratyakṣayogyo na vā? na cet, liṅgajñānābhāvāt anumānānudayaḥ | yogyaścet anyairupalabhyaḥ syāt, rūpādiva diti bhāvaḥ || apekṣābuddhijanyasya dvitvāderyathā tattadekapuruṣavedyatvam; tadvat prākaṭyamapi tadekapuruṣavedyamiti cenna; dvitvādisaṅkhyāḥ prāgeva santi | yathaikatra sarvā diśaḥ; tattadupādhyapekṣābudhyabhivyaṅgayā hi tāḥevamapekṣābudhyabhivyaṅgayadvitvādi tasyaiva prakāśate, yadgatamabhivyañjakam | atra tu rūpādivat janyadharmatvābhyupagamāt sarvairupalabhyeta | abhivyaṅgayatve'bhivyañjakavata evāvabhāsate, siddāñjanavato nidhiriva | na tu janyaṃ janakasyaivāvabhāsate; na hi kulālasyaiva ghaṭaḥ prakāśate | kiñca rūpādivaditi | dharmasya nirāśrayotpattyayogādatītānāgatayorarthayorjāyamānayorapi prākaṭyāyogāt prākaṭhyābhāve'pi jñānaṃ pratīyata iti tatra rūpādivat prakāśānupalabdheḥ prākaṭyena jñānānumānaṃ na sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | yathā saṃvitsiddhau, "atīte'nāgate cārthe kathaṃ prākaṭyasambhavaḥ | na hi dharmiṇyasatyeva dharmaḥ sambhavamṛcchati ||" iti || atītānāgatayorapi dvitvādivat prākaṭyaṃ janyata iti cenna; dvitvāderapi nirāśrayotpattyayogāt | tatra dvitvādyanutpattāvapi ghaṭoderiva dvitvāderapi dhīsthatayā vyavahāropapatteśca | ye punardvitvādikaṃ nābhyupagacchanti, na tān prati dvitvādikaṃ pratibandīkāryam || viṣayaviṣayibhāvasambandhasya vidyamānāśrayatvaniyamābhāvādviṣayaviṣayibhāva eva prākaṭyamiti cenna, sambandhasya sambandhibhyāṃ vinā pratītyanupapattyā saṃbandhijñānaṃ ca pratīyata ityanumeyameva na syātiti prākaṭyaṃ liṅgaṃ na bhavati || evaṃ prākaṭyākhyaṃ vastu anupalabdhamapyanyathā'nupapattyā kalpyata ityāśaṅkaya kalpakasyānyathāsiddhi darśayati ubhayeti | anubhūtyetyukte prākaṭyasya nāmāntaramuktaṃ syāditi śaṅkānirāsārthamubhayābhyupetaśabdaḥ | yāṃ prākaṭyajanakatvenābhyadhāḥ, tayaivetyevakārābhiprāyaḥ | aśeṣavyavahāraḥhānopādānādi(vyavahāra)ḥ | tasyānubhūtyaiva saṃbhavānna tena prākaṭyaṃ kalpyam | jñāto ghaṭaḥ, prakaṭo ghaṭaḥ iti vyavahāraśca, iṣṭo ghaṭaḥ dviṣṭo ghaṭa iti vyavahāravadanyathāsiddha ityaśeṣaśabdābhiprāyaḥ | na hīcchājanyenārthagateṣṭatvena icchā'numīyate || ghaṭaḥ prakāśata iti ghaṭakartṛkatayā prakāśaḥ pratīyate; ghaṭamanubhavatīti ghaṭakarmakatayā anyakartṛkatayā cānubhavaḥ pratīyate; evamekasyaiva karmakartṛvyavahārānupapattyā kalpyata iti cennakārakabhedasya dhātubhedanibandhanatvenārthabhedanibandhanatvābhāvāt, yathā "paraśumudyamya vṛkṣe nipātayati", "paraśunā vṛkṣaṃ chinattī" ityuktau paraśoḥ karmatvakaraṇatve śrute; athāpi nārthabhedaḥ; vṛkṣasyādhikaraṇatvakarmatve śrute; tathāpi nārthabhedaḥtathā vyavahārabhedasya dhātubhedanibandhanatvenārthabhedahetukatvābhāvānna vyavahāraḥ prākaṭyakalpaka ityabhiprāyeṇa ca aśeṣavyavahāropapattāvityuktam || ghaṭaḥ prakāśata iti vyavahāro ghaṭagatātiśayena vinā nopapadyate, anyathā paṭe'pi tasya vyavahārasya prasaṅgāt | sa cātiśayaḥ prākaṭyamiti cennayo'tiśayo vyavasthāpakaḥ, sa kathaṃ ghaṭa eva syāt; na paṭe? || indriyasaṃyogavaśāditi cettena jñānameva vyavasthāpyatām, kimatiśayāntarābhyupagameneti ayamartho'pyaśeṣavyavahāraśabdenābhipretaḥ |
yattu ghaṭo'yamityanumavavelāyāṃ nānubhūtyanubhava iti tanna;anubhūyata iti śabdāprayogasyāvivakṣānibandhanatvenānanubhavaprayuktatvābhāvāt | loko hi anubhūtakṛtsnārthavivakṣā'sti cet, taṃ sarvaṃ vadati ekadeśavivakṣā sti cettṅa,lanubhūtaikadeśaṃ vadati | ekadeśavivakṣā'pi nāsti cet, na kiñcidapi vadati | ato'nubhūyata iti śabdāprayogo natadaprakāśatvahetuḥ | idamapyaśeṣavyavahāraśabdenābhipretam; vikalasyāvikalasyāpi vyavahārasyāśeṣa śabdena kroḍīkartuṃ śakyatvāt | evaṃ vyavahārasyānyathāsiddhatvādananyathāsiddhasyaiva kalpakatvāt na prakāśaḥ kalpya ityarthaḥ ||
prākaṭyānumeyatvānupapatiṃta nigamayati ata iti |ataḥanupalabdhivyavahārānyathāsiddhibhyāṃ prākaṭyābhāvāt anubhūtirna prākaṭyānumeyetyarthaḥ | mānasapratyakṣavedyatvānupapattimabhipretyāha nāpi jñānāntarasiddheti | idamatra paroktamanumānamjñānaṃ mānasapratyakṣagrāhyam, kṣaṇikatve sati ātmaviśeṣaguṇatvāt sukhaduḥkhaprayatnādivaditi | ātmaviśeṣaguṇatvādityukte dharmādiṣvanaikāntyaṃ syāditi tadvayāvṛttyarthaṃ kṣaṇikatve satītyuktam | kṣaṇikaviśeṣaguṇatvādityukte śabde vyabhicāraḥ, kṣaṇikātmaguṇatvādityukte ātmanaḥ saṃyoge vyabhicāraḥ syāditi tatparihārārthamātmaviśeṣaśabdau | tadidamanupapannam; kṣaṇikatvaguṇatvayoranyatarāsiddhatvāt | dṛṣṭāntaśca sādhanavikalaḥ | kiñca yat mānasapratyakṣavedyaṃ tat anubhutsitagrāhyaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā sukhādi |ataśca tadviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ niyatamiti vakta vyam | tasmāt ghaṭādijñānaviṣayaṃ yat jñānam, tasyāpyabubhutsitagrāhatyatvāt mānasapratyakṣavedyatvaṃ syāt, tadviṣayajñānasyāpi tathetyanantasaṃvidāvalīsamudayasyāvarjanīyatvāt jñānāntarānavakāśaḥ syāt || mānasagrāhyatvasyāvubhutsitagrāhyatvavyāpyatvaṃ nāsti, svāpādāvucchvāsaniśśvāsaprayatne satyapi tadgrahaṇābhāvāditi cennatadānīṃ jīvātmani prayatnasyaivābhāvāt, dehadhāraṇādayaḥ paramātmasaṅkalpādhīnāstadānīmiti hi vedāntavādinaḥ | "antarābhūtagrāmavat" ityadhikareṇe'yamarthaḥ sunirṇayaḥ | svāpe dehaparivartanādistvaṅgapratyaṅgatodāt ddaśaṃmarākādijanyaduḥkhādinā vā'tyalpabodhe sati bhavati | tadānīṃ ca prayatno dhīviṣayaḥ |ato hetoravyabhicārāt mānasagrāhyaṃ sarvamabubhutsitagrāhyamiti anavasthā syādeva | yadi bubhutsitagrāhyam, tarhyanyonyāśrayaṇaṃjñāne satīcchā, icchāyāṃ satyāṃ jñānamiti | kiñca mānasapratyakṣavedyasya bubhutsitagrāhyatve'pi, sukhādiṣūpalibdhaniyamadarśanāt bubhutsāniyamaḥ kalpya iti tadvadeva jñāne'pi bubhutsāniyamasiddvarupalabdhiśca niyatā syāt |ato bubhutsāntaritajñānaparamparāyā avi ratiḥ syāt || jñānaṃ bubhutsitagrāhyam, sukhādi tu neti cenna; mānasapratyakṣatvāviśeṣe niyāmakābhāvāt || sukhā diṣu ghaṭādiviṣayaprathamajñāne ca bubhutsā; dvitīyādau tu neti cennaniyāmakābhāvāt, mānasagrāhyatvāviśeṣāt prāptāṃ bubhutsāṃ ko vārayet? || mānasagrāhyatve sati hi bubhutsā; sukhādikaṃ ghaṭādiviṣayaprathamajñānaṃ ca mānasagrā hyam; dvitīyādijñānaṃ na mānasapratyakṣavedyamiti cenna; tatrāpi niyāmakābhāvāt | kiñca,kṣaṇikātmaviśeṣaguṇatve satyapi dvitīyādijñānaṃ na mānasagrāhyaṃ cet, hetoranaikāntyam || yadā pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate, tadā mānasagrāhyamiti cet; tarhi pakṣo hetuśca pratyakṣagrāhyaśabdena viśeṣyau syātām | kiñca anyairapyuktāni dūṣaṇāntarāṇyucyanta; yadidvitīyaṃ jñānaṃ na mānasagrāhyaṃ, tasya dvitīyasya niṣpramāṇakatvena śūnyatā ca syāt | tataśca prathamasya, tatastadviṣayaghaṭo derapi śūnyatā syāt | dvitīyādijñānaṃ svataḥsiddhaṃ cet, prathamajñānamapi tathā syāditi | evamādyabhiprāyeṇa nāpi jñānāntarasiddhā ityuktam | atha pāriśeṣyāt svayaṃprakāśatvaṃ siddhamityāha api tviti | sarvamiti | anyathā saṃvidaḥ śūnyatvena tadhdyīnasiddhi sarvaṃ śūnyaṃ syāditi tatparihārāyasvayaṃprakāśatvamavaśyābhyupagantavyamityabhiprāyeṇasarve sādhayantyanubhūtiḥ svayameva siddhayatītyuktam | yathā saṃvitsiddhau "tadevāpaśyatāṃ sarvaśūnyatvāt bibhyatāṃ satām | gatiḥ svayaṃ prakāśatvādṛte nānyopalabhyate ||" iti |
atha tarkānugrāhyaṃ svayaṃprakāśatve pramāṇamupanyasyati prayogaśceti | na kevalaṃ pāriśeṣyāt svataḥsiddhatvaṃ; sādhakapramāṇamapyastīti cārthaḥ | anubhūtirityādinā anumānadvayaṃ granthalādhavārthamavibhāgenoktam | anubhūtirananyādhīnasvadharmāsvasambandhādaryāntare taddharmahetutvāt, anubhūtirananyādhīnasvavyavahārā svasambandhādarthāntare tadvayavahārarahetutvāt ityevaṃ vibhāgaḥ |ata eva hi paratra vyavahāraviśeṣahetoḥ svasminnapi tadvayavahārahetutvamati utta ratra vakṣyate | prākaṭyamabhyupagamya tadupajīvanena prathamānumānamuktaṃ; tadanupajīvyaṃ tu dvitīyam | prākaṭyābhyupagamasya na svaprakāśatāvirodhitvam; tasya jñānānumāpakatvānabhyupagamāt | dharmavattve'nanyādhīnadharmavattve ca sādhye siddhasādhyatā syāt; anubhūtitvādidharmāṇāṃ hetutvantaranairapekṣyāt | na hyanubhūtitvajātirhetvadhīnā; nityatvāt | jātyanabhyupagame'pyanubhūtitvasyānubhūtisāmagrīvyatiriktahetvanapekṣatvāt siddhasādhyatā | ato'nanyādhīnasvadharmetyuktam | svasya dharmaḥsvotpādyatayā svasambandhī dharmaḥ svadharmaḥ | paratrasvasādhyadharmātyantasajātīyadharma ityarthaḥ; arthāntare taddharmahetutvāditi hetūkteḥ | svadharmaśabdanirdiṣṭadharmo hi tacchavdoktaḥ | paratra svasādhyadharmātyantasajā tīyaḥ svasminnavaśyaṃbhāvidharmaḥ svadharmatvena vivakṣitaḥ | ata eva svāsmin rūpitvānāpādanāt rūpasya dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavikalatvaśaṅkā vyudastā syāt; daṇḍāntaranirapekṣaṃ svāsmin daṇḍitvamanāpādayati daṇḍe vyabhicāraśca pari hṛtaḥ syāt | anyaśabdaśca svātyantasajātīyāntaraparaḥ anyathā hetumātranirapekṣatve dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavikalatvaṃ syāt; cakṣurādyapekṣaṃ hi rūpasya cākṣuṣatvam, tādṛśahetvapekṣāniyamarāhityamananyādhīnaśabdena vivakṣitam; anyāpekṣāmātravirahe sādhye parajñānasyānumeyatvadarśanena bādhitatvaprasaṅgāt | na hi jñānāntarāgocaratvametadanumānasā dhyam; api tu svātyantasajātīyānapekṣaprakāśārhatvamātraṃ, tacca parajñānaya sambhavatīti na bādhitaviṣayatvam | ananyādhīnasvavyavahāretyatrāpi vyavahāravattve sādhye siddhasādhyatā; ato'nanyādhīnaśabdaḥ | anyaśabdasyātyantasajātīyaparatvāt tadvāgādyapekṣayā bādhitatvaśaṅkā parihṛtā syāt | ghaṭādīnāṃ hānādivyavahāre svātyantasajātīyānapekṣo heturanubhūtiriti siddhasādhyatvavyudāsāya svaśabdaḥ | sa ca paratra svasādhyavyavahārātyantasajātīyaparaḥ | vyavahārasyātyantasajātīyatvaṃ nāmābhinnapravṛttinimittakatvam | vyavahārānuguṇyamātraṃ hi prakāśata iti vyavahāra sya nimittam parajñānavyavahāre kālātyayāpadeśaparihārāyāpekṣāniyamarāhityavivakṣā |
hetumāha svasambandhāditi | dharmahetutve vyavahārahetutve ca hetau vivakṣite anaikāntyaṃ syāditi tatparihā rāya tacchabdaḥ | svasya yo dharmo vyavahāraśca tadatyantasajātīyo dharmo vyavahāraśca tacchabdavivakṣitaḥ | svasyāgnisambandhāt svasmin pūrvarūpasajātīyarūpāntaratadvayavahārahetughaṭo'gnisādekṣa iti tatra vyabhicāraparihārāya arthā ntara ityuktam | kiñca arthāntaraśabdo nirdiṣṭajātīyādvijātīyaparaḥ; tena parasmin dravye saṃyuktatvatadvayavahārahetordravyasya paradravyasāpekṣatayā anaikāntyaṃ parihṛtaṃ syāt | dravyaṃ hi dravyasyātyantasajātīyam || nanu ghaṭo hi paṭe saṃyuktatvādikamāpādayan svasya tathātve ghaṭāntarāpekṣa ityanaikāntyam | naivam; sajātīyāpekṣāniyamaviraharūpasya sādhyadharmasya tatra vidyamānatvāt | na hi ghaṭaḥ svasya saṃyuktatvādau svātyantasajātīyaṃ ghaṭamevāpekṣata iti niyamo 'sti | putre putratvatadvayavahārahetau pitari svasya putratvavyavahārāya pitrantarasāpekṣe vyabhicāraparihārāya svasambandhādityuktam | vidyamānasvasambandho vivakṣitaḥ | paratra svasambandhatulyakālasvagatadharmātyantasajātīyadharmatatsāpekṣavyavahārahetutvādityarthaḥ | na hi pitrādipravāsanidhanayoḥ putrādau putratvaṃ tadvayavahāraścāpagacchati | ata eva svasmin ananyāpekṣadvaidhībhāvamanāpādayati paradvaidhībhāvahetau dravye vyabhicāraśca dūrotsāritaḥ |
nanu siddhāntino'pyabhimatamidamanumānam | cetanaḥ svasambandhatulyakālaṃ śarīratvaṃ śarīre janayan sva smin śarīratvatadvayavahārayornānanyāpekṣaḥ; api tu paramātmasāpekṣaḥ | paramātmā ca cetanatvādatyantasajātīyaḥ | atastatrānaikāntyamiti | naivam; svavyāpakadharmahetutvasya vivakṣitatvāt | na hi cetanatvavyāpakaṃ śarīratvam; īśvarasya cetanasyāpi śarīratvābhāvāt, ataḥ svadharmaśabdābhipretena svāvaśyambhāvitvena parihāraḥ |
etaduktaṃ bhavatidharmaśabdaḥ prakāśaparo vā, dharmamātraparo vā, anyaśabdaśca anyamātraparo vā svātyantasajātīyānyaparo vā | tatra hetumātrānapekṣaprakāśatve dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavikalatvam; rūpaṃ hi cakṣurādyapekṣaprakāśam | svātyantasajātīyānapekṣaprakāśatve sādhye vyarthaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ hetoḥ; hetutvamātreṇa sādhyasiddheḥ | na hi yasya kasyaciddhetussan ghaṭādiḥ svaprakāśe ghaṭāntarādikamapekṣate | hetvanapekṣadharmatve anubhūtitvādinā siddhasādhyatā; paraśvadhādiṣvanaikāntyañca; kāṣṭhadvaidhībhāvehetoḥ paraśvadhasya svadvaidhībhāve hetvantarasāpekṣatvāt | svātyantasajātīyānapekṣadharmatve cānubhūtitvādinā siddhasādhyatā | viṣayaprakāśake parajñāne liṅgāpekṣaprakāśatvadarśanāt bādhaśca | rūpe rūpāntarānapekṣasvagatarūpitvahetutvābhāvāt dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavikalatā | putragataputratvahetau pitrantarasāpekṣaputratvadharme pitari anaikāntyañca | paradravyagata saṃyuktatvahetai dravyāntarasāpekṣasaṃyoge dravye ce akāntyam | ata evamādidoṣaparihārārthamitthaṃ prayoktavyamanubhūtiḥ svajanyaparagatadharmātyantasajātīyadharmabhākatve svātyantasajātīyāpekṣāniyamarahiteti pratijñā | svavijātīye svāvaśyambhāvidharmātyantasajātīyasvasambandhatulyakāladharma hetutvāditi hetuḥ | tathā anubhūtiḥ svajanyaparagatavyavahārātyantasajātīyavyavahārabhākate svātyanta sajātīyāpekṣāniyamarahiteti pratijñā | svavijātīye svāvaśyambhāvivyavahārātyantasajātīyasvasambandha tulyakālavyavahārahetutvāditi hetuḥ | vyavahārasya svāvaśyammāvitvaṃ nāmāvaśyaṃbhāvidharmanibandhanatvam ||
vyāptiprradarśanapūrvakaṃ dṛṣṭāntamāha ya iti | sādhyasādhanadharmau sapakṣe darśayati rūpādirhīti | pakṣadharmatābalasiddhadharmamāha ato'nubhūtiriti | prakāśata iti vyavahāra iti |anubhūtiḥ prakāśata iti vyavahāre anubhūtiriti
vyavahāre cetyarthaḥ | nanu svasambandhādarthāntare taddharmavyavahārahetutvaṃ sopādhikam sambandhaviśeṣādarthāntare taddharmavyavahārahetutvasyaiva svasmin taddharmavyavahārayorananyādhīnatve prayojakatvāt | sa ca sambandhaviśeṣaḥ āśrayāśrayibhāvarūpaḥ | sa tu rūpādāvasti; na tu pakṣa iti || naitatasya sādhyasamavyāptyabhāvenopādhitvābhāvāt āśrayāśrayibhāvavirahe'pi saṃbandhamātrādarthāntare prakāśata iti vyavahārahetordīpasya svasminnapi tadvayavahāre'tyantasajātīyānapekṣatvaṃ hi dṛṣṭam | pūrvaṃ jñānasya paraprakāśatvavādibhiḥ svasattayaiva prakāśamānatvāditi hetorasiddhirvyāhatiścokte | tatra ghaṭo'yamityanubhavavelāyāmanubhūyata iti śabdasyāprayogāt asiddhiruktā; śabdavyavahāravaikalyapauṣkalyayorvivakṣāviśeṣahetukatvenārthānubhave'nanubhave ca prayojakatvābhāvavacanādasiddhiḥ parihṛtā | vyāhatiśca nāsti | tathā hiaṅgulyagrasya svātmasparśādivyāhatirupalabdhinibandhanā | dīpādiṣu ca prakāśyatvaprakāśakatve dṛśyete | nirūpyamāṇe, karmakartṛbhāvavirodhaśca nāsti | nirāsako (hi)dīpaḥ, nirasanīyaṃ tamaḥ; dīpa utpādakaḥ, jñānamutpādyaṃ; jñānamutpādakam, vyavahāra utpādya iti | kiñca yadyapi karmakartṛbhāvasya svato virodhāt bhedakatvamupalabdhisiddham, tathāpi jñāpakeṣu virodhaniyamābhāvaścopalabdhisiddhaḥ | jñātari manasi, śabdaśabde, padamiti pade, tathedṛśārthāntareṣvapyavirodho hi upalabhyate | utpādakeṣveva tu virodhaniyamaḥ | tatra cākārāntareṇa cenna virodhaḥ || nanu ghaṭādiṣu vyavahārārhatvaṃ svavyatiriktajñānahetukaṃ dṛṣṭam | jñāne vyāptirbhajyate cet, vyavahārasya jñānapūrvakatvavyāptibhaṅgena ajñātasyaiva jñānasya vyavahārāspadatvaṃ syāt || naivam;ghaṭādiṣu jñeyavyavatiriktajñātṛdṛśyatve'pi svenaiva jñātrā jñātari dṛśyatvamiti sarvāvigītamiti tatra pareṇāpi karmakartṛvirodhavyāptibhaṅgo'bhyupantavyaḥ | tathā ghaṭādau svavyatiriktakaraṇajanyajñānadṛśyatve'pi manasi tadbhagnam; svānumāne manasa eva karaṇatvāt | tathā sarvavācyānāṃ svavyatiriktaśabdavācyatve'pi śabdaśabde padapade ca tad bhagnam, ghaṭādīnāṃ svavyatirikta vāgvyavahāryatvepi vāgi ndriye tad bhagnam, ataḥ karmakartṛbhāvasya virodhavyāptirnāsti | vyavahārasya jñānapūrvakatvaṃ na kaiścidapi bhagnam | jñānavyavahārasya jñānakarmatāpūrvakatvavirahaḥ prasajyate cet, nāniṣṭaḥ | avabhāsapūrvakatvasyābhagnavyāptikatvānna tadvirahaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmādavabhāsamānasyaiva jñānasya vyavahārāspadatvam | ataḥ svaviṣayaparaviṣayavyavahārānuguṇyaṃ jñānasya yuktam ||
atha jñātṛjñeyanirasanaṃ jñānasvayaṃprakāśatvañca bauddhapakṣe'pi samānamiti tadvayāvarttakaṃ jñānasya nityatvaṃ sādhayati seyamiti | seyamparamārthabhūtasanmātraikyā pramāṇāviṣayabhūtā cetyarthaḥ; yadvā svayaṃ prakāśatvahetubhūtadharmavattayā prasiddhetyarthaḥ | svayaṃprakāśatvasya nityatāhetutvavivakṣayā svayamprakāśetyuktam | caḥ sādhyasamuccaye; saugatasāmyaśaṅkānivṛtau vā | kuta ityatrāha prāgabhāvādīti | sa ca kathamiti śaṅkāyāṃ grāhakābhāvādityabhiprāyeṇāha tadabhāvaśceti | svataḥsiddhatvena prāgabhāvādyamāvaṃ vikalpamukhena upapipādayiṣurvikalpaśirodvaye'nupapatiṃta pratijā nīte | na hīti | svataḥpakṣe anubhūtiḥ kiṃ satī svābhāvamavagamayati, utāsatī iti vikalpamabhipretya sattvapakṣaṃ dūṣayati anubhūtiriti | kuta ityatrāha tasyā iti | grāhyābhāvādityarthaḥ | anubhūtiḥ kimanumityādirūpā svābhāvamavagamayati, uta pratyakṣarūpeti vikalpe liṅgādyabhāvāt prathamaḥ kalpo na saṃbhavatītyabhipretya dvitīyaḥ kalpo grāhyābhāvāddūṣitaḥ | pūrvābhipretavikalpaśirasorasattvapakṣaṃ grāhakābhāvena dūṣayati evamiti | pūrvatarābhihitayorvikalpaśirasoranyata iti pakṣaṃ dūṣayati nāpīti | anubhūtirananyagocarā syāt; tataḥ kimabhāvāgrahaṇasya? abhāvo hyanyagocaratvamarhatītyatrāha asyā iti | asyāḥ | na hyanyasya prāgabhāvo grāhyaḥ; api tvanubhūtereva; tasmāt tāṃ viṣayīkṛtyaiva tadabhāvo grāhyaḥ; tasyā viṣayībhāvānarhatvānna tatprāgabhāvagrahaṇaṃ śakyamityarthaḥ | evaṃ prāgabhāvābhāvādutpatyamāvaḥ(vaṃ) tataśca pariṇāmādisarvavikārāntarābhāvamapyupapādayati ato'syā iti | ataḥsvataḥ parataḥ pakṣayorubhayorapyabhāvasya durgrahatvādityarthaḥ | vikāramātravirahe sādhye'nutpannatvamantavati prāgabhāve'naikāntikaṃ syāt | ato bhāvarūpavikāravirahasya sādhdyatvajñāpanāya bhāvaśabdaḥ | yadvā bhāvasya vikāra iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | tataśca bhāvābhāvarūpavikāramātravirahe sādhye, prāgabhāve vyabhicāraśaṅkanivāraṇārthaṃ bhāvatve satyanutpa nnatvaṃ vikārāntarābhāve prayojakamiti phalitam | anubhūtirnāntavatī, bhāvatve satyanutpannatvāt; yadantavat tat bhāvatve satyanutpannaṃ na bhavati, yathā ghaṭa iti |
bauddhābhyupagatakṣaṇikatvavyāvṛttyarthaṃ nityatvāya anutpattiḥ, tadvayāptavikārāntarābhāvaśca sādhitau || atha tadabhyupagatā'nekatvavyāvṛttyarthaṃsajātīyabhedaṃ vyudasyati anutpanneyamiti | vyāpakaviruddhopalabdheḥ | nānātvavyāpakotpattiviruddhānutpattyupalabdherityarthaḥ | vyāptiṃ darśayati na hīti | asya granthasya, yadanutpannaṃ tadanānābhūtaṃ dṛṣṭamityartho vaktuṃ na yujyate; brahmavyatirekeṇānutpannasya anānābhūtasya kasyacinmāyāvedāntibhiranabhyupagamāt | yadanānābhūtaṃ tadanutpannamityukte vyāpyanākajanmanivṛttyā vyāpnānātvanivṛttiruktā na syāt | tasmādayamarthaḥyat nānābhūtaṃ tat anutpannaṃ na dṛṣṭam; api tūtpattimadeva dṛṣṭamiti janmano nānātvavyāpakatvaṃ darśitam | anenotpattinivṛttyā nānātvanivṛttirityarthasiddham | yadvāyathā na hyanagni dhūmavaddṛṣṭabhityukte agnimadeva dhūmavadityuktaṃ syāt, tadvat ihāpi anutpannaṃ nānābhūtaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ ityukte utpatimadeva nānābhūtaṃ ityuktaṃ syāt; tataścotpattirvyāpiketyuktaṃ bhavati | anubhūtirnānā na bhavati, anutpannatvāt | yat nānābhūtam, tat utpattimaddṛṣṭam, yathā ghaṭa iti vyatirekyanumānamanubhūtiṃ pakṣīkṛtyoktam | gaganādiṣu vyabhicāro durvacaḥ; teṣāmutpattimattvena vedāntibhirabhyupagamāditi bhāvaḥ | evaṃ sajātīyabhedo niṣiddhaḥ |asmirthe vikārāntarābhāve ca bhedaṃ vikārāntaraṃ ca pakṣīkṛtyānvayyanumānamāha bhedādīnāmiti | ādiśabdena utpattyādayo vivakṣitāḥ | bhedādayo nānubhūtidharmāḥ anumāvyatvāt rūpādivaditi | vyāvṛttirūpadharmo'pi nāstītyupapādayati ato'nubhūteriti | anyo'pivyāvṛttirūpo'pīti bhāvaḥ(?) | yadvāvikāranānātvajaḍatvaniṣedhāt nityatvaikatvasvayaprakāśatvarūpadharmavatvaśaṅkāvyudā sārthaṃ purvoktanānātvādivyudāsārthaṃ ca vyatirekyanumānamāha atonubhūteriti |anyo'pi nityatvādirūpo'pī tyarthaḥ | anubhūtirna vyāvṛttirūpadharmabhāk anubhavasvarūpatvāt | yat vyāvṛttirūpadharmabhāk, tat ananubhūtirdṛṣṭam, yathā ghaṭādīti vyatireki | yadi vyāvṛttirūpadharmaṃ pakṣīkṛtyānubhūtidharmatvābhāvaḥ sādhyaḥ syāt,tadā anubhāvyatvaṃ hetuḥ; yathā rūpādīti sapakṣaḥ | idamanvayi | evaṃ svagatabhedo nirastaḥ; pūrvameva jñeyabhedo nirastaḥ | "atrāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayaṃjyotirbhavati" ityādiṣu vedāntavākyeṣvātmano nityatvasvayaṃprakāśatvādayaḥ pratipannāḥ; atra tu saṃvido nityatvādirucyate; tat kathaṃ saṅgacchate ityatrāha yata iti | nirddhūtanikhilabhedā sakalabhedaniṣedhena vijātīyabhedo'pi nirasta iti vijātīyabhedasya jñāturmithyātvena sa ātmā, api tu paramārthabhūtā saṃvidevātmetyarthaḥ | yadvāvedāntairātmanaḥ pratipāditaṃ sajātīyavijātīyasvagatanānātvarāhityaṃ saṃvida evopapadyata iti saivātmetyarthaḥ | svarūpeti | svarūpātiriktaāśrayo hi jñātā; sa nāstisaṃvitsvarūpātiriktatvādevāparamārtha iti sa nātmeti paramārthabhūtā saṃvidevātmetyarthaḥ | svaprakāśarūpā saivātmeti | vedāntairātmanaḥ pratipāditaṃ svayabhprakāśatvaṃ saṃvida upapannamiti saivātmetyarthaḥ | yadvā tucchatvaśaṅkānirāsārthamuktaṃ svaprakāśarūpeti | svayamprakāśatvaṃ svatantrasādhakaṃ cetyāha ajaḍatvācceti | idaṃ vyatiretisaṃvit ātmā ajaḍatvāt; yannānmā tajjaḍam, yathā ghaṭādīti | etadvivṛṇoti anātmatveti | anātmatvavyāptam | vyāptamiti kartariktaḥvyāpakamityarthaḥ | prāpta itivat ||
tarkeṇa jñātṛtve pratikṣipte ātmano'haṃpratyayagocaratvasya svānubhavapratyakṣa siddhatvena codayati nanu ceti | caścodyasamuñcaye | pratītisiddhāsvānubhavarūpapratītisiddhetyarthaḥ | atrāha naivamiti | pratiterbhrāntitvamāha sā bhrāntisiddheti | anubhavaviṣayatvena pūrvaṃ pratītā rajatatā yathā śuktijñānabādhitatvāt bhrāntisiddhā bhavati, tathetyabhiprāyeṇāha rajatateva śuktiśakalasyeti | bhramādhiṣṭhānatvopapattaye śakalaśabdaḥ | avikalavapuṣaḥ śukterbhramāspadatvāyogāt | yadvā jñātṛtve pratīyamāne tatra jñānāṃśasya pāramārthye kartraṃśasyāpāramārthye ca dṛṣṭāntatayā rajatateva śuktaśakalasyetyuktam | tatra hi idamaśaḥ paramārthaḥ, rajatataivāparamārtha iti | bhrāntisiddhatvamupapādayati | adubhūteriti | tataḥ kimityatrāha ato manuṣya iti | kartṛtvāyogamupapādayati jñātṛtvaṃ hīti | yadvājñātṛtvaṃ nāma kiṃ brahmasvarūpabhūtajñānāśrayatvam, utāntaḥkaraṇakriyārūpajñānāśrayatvam iti vikalpamabhipretya prathamaṃ śiro dūṣayatianubhūteriti | pūrvoktayuktibhiranubhūtereva pāramārthye siddhe, tasyā jñātṛtvaṃ svātmani kartṛtvaṃ syāt; tattu vyāhatamityartha | kartṛtvam āśrayatvam | jñātṛtvaṃ bhrāntapuruṣapratītisiddhatvāccādhyastamityabhiprāyeṇāha ata iti | piṇḍasyotpattyādibhirātmavyatiriktatvasya sampratipannatvādatyantabahirbhūtetyuktam | atha na kevalaṃ svāpekṣayā kartṛtvamanupapannam, api tu svaparavibhāganirviśeṣaṃ kartṛtvamātramevānupapannamityabhiprāyeṇa dvitīyaṃ śiro dūṣayati jñātṛtvaṃ hīti | tataḥ kimityatrāha tacceti | vikriyātmakamutpattivināśayogāt kriyāyāstadāśrayatvamapi kādācitkamiti tat vikārarūpamityarthaḥ | jaḍamjñeyam | ata eva vikāridravyāhaṅkāragranthistham,jaḍatvavikriyātmakatvasāmyāditi bhāvaḥ | granthirnāma bandha syāśaithilyakaro grathanaviśeṣaḥ | ahaṅkārasya sarvabhramamūlatvāt granthirityuktam | etadvirodhirūpamāha avikriya iti | sākṣitvābhyupagamena jñātṛtvamabhyupagataṃ bhavatīti śaṅkāyāṃ sākṣitvamapi jñānasvarūpa tvānuguṇamityabhiprāyeṇa sākṣiṇītyuktam | avidyānubhavarūpatvameva sākṣitvamiti jñānatvāvirodha iti bhāvaḥ | cinmātrātmanisvayaṃprakāśe | jaḍam | jñātṛtvamajaḍasya na saṃbhavatīti bhāvaḥ | kartṛtvādirnātmadharmaḥ,dṛśyadhīnasiddhitvāt | rūpādivadityanvayinamabhipretyāha dṛśyadhīnasiddhitvādeveti | kartṛtvāderityādiśabdenāhampratyayagocaratvaṃ gṛhyate | ya eva bhedādīnāmanubhūtidhamartvābhāve hetuḥ, tenaivetyevakārābhiprāyaḥ | ahamartho hyātmā tena samānādhikaraṇatayā pratīto jñātā ātmā syādityatrāha suṣuptimūrcchādāviti | "nāha ravalu" ityādi" śrutyupajīvanenāhaṃpratyayāpāye'pītyuktam | ātmanaḥ kartṛtvāhampratyayagocaratvābhāve vyatirekyanumānatrayaṃ prasaṅgarūpeṇāha kartṛtva iti | ātmā na karttā, na cāhaṃpratyayagocara iti pratijñādvayam; ajaḍatvāt pratyakatvāt ātmatvāditi hetutra yam; yat kartṛ yat ahaṃpratyayagocaraḥ tajjaḍaṃ parāk ānātmā ca dṛṣṭam, yathā śarīramiti | yadvā ātmā na karttā, na cāhaṃpratyayagocaraḥ, jaḍatvādipraṅgāt dehavaditi | jaḍatvamdṛśyataikasvarūpatvam | parākatvamparasmai bhāsamānatvam |ātmatvampuruṣārthapratisambandhitvam, dehaṃ prati niyantṛtayā vyāpitvaṃ vā; tadabhāvo'nātmatvam | ādiśabdena kṣayitvādikaṃ vivakṣitam | ahaṃpratyayagocasya dehasyānātmatve siddhe hyahaṃpratyayagocarasya karturanātmatvaprasaktirityatrāha ahaṃpratyayagocarāditi | kriyāphala svargāderbhokturityanena dehātiriktatvaṃ siddham | prāmāṇikānāmcārvākavyatiriktānām | anātmanaḥ ahaṅkārasya kartṛtve kathamātmanaḥ saṃsārabhoktṛtvamiti ca śaṅkā śarīrapratibandyā nirastā | svargādibhokturātmatve siddhejñātaivātmā syādityatrāha tatheti | śarīrātiriktātmano'bhyupagamo hi pramāṇabalātkriyate; tathā jñāturapi vilakṣaṇatvena pramāṇasiddhatvāt tathā'bhyupagantavyamityarthaḥ | yadvāprāmāṇikāhaṃpratyayagocaratvena hi śarīrasyānātmatvādi; prāmāṇikāhaṃpratyayagocarasya tu kathamanātmatvādītyatrāha ahaṃpratyayagocarāditi | dehasyāprāmāṇikāhaṃpratyayagocaratvaṃ pramāṇabādhādeva hi jñāyate | evaṃ kamarphalabhokturaupādhikākāravato jñāturātmatvaṃ pramāṇabādhitaṃ cet, ātmanastadvilakṣaṇatvaṃ svīkāryamityarthaḥ |ataḥ prāmārikāprāmāṇikavibhāgābhāvenāhaṃpratyayagocaratvamātramevānātmatvasādhakamiti bhāvaḥ |
avikriyātmanaḥ kathaṃ jñātṛtvasaṃbhavaḥ ityatrāha evamiti | yadvājñātṛtvamahaṅkāragranthisthamiti pūrvamuktam | kathamahaṅkārasya jñātṛtvasambhava ityatrāha evamiti | abhivyañjakatvaprayukto'yamahaṅkārasya saṃvidāśrayabhāva iti bhāvaḥ | abhivyañjako'stvahaṅkāraḥ; kathamasya svāśrayatayā'bhivyañjakatvamityatrāha ātmasthatayeti | svabhāvaśabdena autsargikatvaṃ vivakṣitam | kkacit pramāṇabādhaścet, na tatheti bhāvaḥ | dṛṣṭāntaṃ darśayati darpaṇeti |ātmasthatayā'bhivyañjanaṃ na darpaṇatvaprayuktam, na ca pratibimbatvaprayuktam, abhivyañjakatvamātraprayuktamiti darśayituṃ khaṇḍādigrahaṇam | ādiśabdena muṇḍādi(?) | evaṃ vyaṅktṛvyaṅgayabhāvakṛto jñātṛtvāvabhāsaḥ saṃvida ityāha tatkṛta iti | jaḍasyābhivyañjakatvamayuktam; svaprakāśasya vastuno'bhivyaṅgayatvaṃ cāyuktam; saṃvidabhivyaṅgayasya ca viśeṣeṇa tadabhivyañjakatvamayuktam itīmāmāśaṅkāṃ svayamevotthāpya pratikṣipati svaprakāśāyā iti | kuta ityatrāha ravikareti | karatalasya kiraṇābhivyañjakatvaṃ kva dṛṣṭamityatrāha jālaketi | evaṃ jñātṛtvasyāpāramārthikatvamuktam | etadeva paramārthavastubhāsanavelāyāmanavabhāsanapratipādanena upapādayati yata iti | anena ahaṃpratyayāpāye'pīti pūrvoktārtho vivṛto bhavati | yata iti sādhyasya hetutayā nirdeśaḥ agnimattvena dhūmavattvamitivat | muktisamabhivyāhāreṇa suṣuptāvapyahaṃpratyayāpāyasyāgamasiddhatvaṃ sūcitam | tadā kathaṃ bhāsata ityatrāha tatra hīti | "nāhaṃ svalvayamevaṃ sampratyātmānaṃ jānāti,ayamahamasmi" iti svāpaviṣayā śrutiḥ | "ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham | vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto braṃmabhūyāya kalpate " iti muktiviṣayā smṛtiḥ | "mahābhūtānyahaṅkāro buddhiravyaktameva ca" iti kṣetrāntarbhāvaścocyate ahaṅkārasya | "ahaṅkāravimūḍhātmā karttā'hamiti manyate" iti tasya bhrāntisiddhatvamucyate | hi śabdaḥ śrutismṛtiprasiddhidyotanārthaḥ | na kevalaṃ śrutiḥ suṣuptiviṣayā; parāmarśaśca tathā'stītyāha ata eveti | (ata eva ceti ) | ata eveti sādhyasya hetutvena parāmarśaḥ | kathaṃ sādhyasādhanayorviparītanirdeśaḥ? itthamjñaptau yat sādhyaṃ,tat utpattau sādhanam; yat utpattau sādhanam tad jñaptau sādhyam (sādhanam?) | tasmāt angimattvādeva hi dhūmodgama itivat utpattau hetutvamapekṣya ata evetyuktam |
tataḥ kiṃ prastutapūrvavṛttatvacintāyāḥ ityatrāha tasmāditi | tasmādityanena yadapyāhuraśeṣaviśeṣetyārabhyoktaṃ pramāṇatarkābhyāṃ svamatopapādanamabhipretam | nirastasamastabhedavikalpeti | bhedavikalpaśabdena jñātṛjñeyādibhedasyāvāntaravaividhyaṃ vivakṣitam | nirviśeṣaśabdena svagatanityatvādibhedavyāvṛttiḥ | kuta ityatrāha cinmātraikaraseti | cinmātratvādityarthaḥ | anena śūnyatvavyudāsaśca | kūṭastham nirvikāram; sarvādhiṣṭhānaṃ vā | nityasaṃvideveti | cinmātraśabdaḥ svayaṃprakāśatvaparaḥ, saṃvicchabdo viśeṣyapara ityapaunaruktayam | cinmātrasya kathaṃ bhedasambhava ityatrāha bhrāntyeti | bhrāntyā vivarttata iti karikalabhavannirdeśaḥ | śuddham avidyārahitam | buddham svayaṃprakāśam | muktam paramārthato bhedadarśanajanmādirahitam | evaṃvidhabrahmātmaikatvavidyālabdhaye sarve vedāntā ārabhyanta ityarthaḥ | vedāntānāmārabhmaṇīyatvaṃ nāma tadvicārasyā'rambhaṇīyatvam | sarve vedāntā ārabhyanta iti yadapyāhuriti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | brahmamīmāṃsāśāstraṃ kimanārambhaṇīyam, utārambhaṇīyam iti vicāre, bandhasya paramārthatvena jñānanivartyatvābhāvāt jñānapratipādakavedāntavākyavicārarūpaṃ śāstramanārambhaṇīyamiti pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā, bandhasya mithyātvena jñānamātranivartyatvāt jñānārthaṃ vedāntavicārarūpaṃ śāstramārambhaṇīyamiti hi brahmājñānapakṣe prathamādhikaraṇārthaḥ śikṣitaḥ | ato bandhasya mithyātvena jñānamātranivartyatvāt jñānapradhānasya śāstrasya karmavicāro na pūrvavṛtta ityuktaṃ bhavatīti vaiṣamyam | upāya ātmaikatvavijñānam, upeyaṃ nirviśeṣacinmātraṃ brahma, nivartyaṃ ca mithyābhūtam iti trayaṃ karmavicārasyānapekṣitatvāya pūrvaṃ vistareṇopapāditaṃ nigamanagranthe saṃkṣiptaṃ bhavati ||
atha karmavicārapūrvavṛttatvavirodhivastusāmarthyanirāsārthaṃ paroktānāmupāyopeyanivartyānāṃ pramāṇatarkābhāsamūlatvaṃ pratijānīte(pratijānāti) tadidamiti | svābhimatānāmeva teṣāṃ pramāṇatarkopapannatāṃ ca saṃkṣepeṇa pratijānāti | arthādvahuśāstrajñānāṃ bahugranthakārārāmapi pareṣāṃ skhalanānupapattiśaṅkācca samyagjñānotpattisāmagrīvaikalyapratipādanamukhena pariharati tadidamityādinā | paramapuruṣaśabdenopeyam, varaṇīyatetyādinā upāyam anādītyā dinā nivartyam anadhigatetyādinā parapakṣanairmūlyam nyāyānugṛhītetyādinā svapakṣasya samūlatām arthatā'nekavidvatparigrahañca pratijānīte | tadidamiti anantaravākyaprakṛtaṃ paroktopāyopeyanivartyatrayaṃ vivakṣitam | aupaniṣadaparamapuruṣaśabdena "taṃ tvaupaniṣadaṃ puruṣaṃ viddhi" iti śrutiṃ smārayati; etena asmadabhimatapramāṇaprameyaviśeṣasambandhaḥ śrutyaiva vyakta iti sūcayati | paramaśabdeneśvarātiriktatatvavyāvṛttiḥ | varaṇīyatāhetuguṇaviśeṣavirahiṇābhityanena, "yamevaiṣa vṛṇute tena labhyaḥ" ityabhimatopāyaviśeṣakathanaṃ phalitam; anena padena bahuśāstrajñabahugranthakārāṇāṃ bhramānaupapattiśaṅkā ca parihṛtā bhavati; samyak śāstrārthajñānotpattau bhagavadbhakterapi sāmagrayantarbhāvena kevalaśāstrapariśramasya vikalahetutvāt | yathā "yasya deve parā bhaktiḥ" ityādikā śrutiḥ | smṛtiśca "vidyā rājan na te vidyā mama vidyā na hīyate | vidyāhīnastamodhvasto nābhijānāsi keśavam || dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ | gāvadga(lga)ṇe! te kā vidyā yā te vidyā janārdane | yayā tvamabhijānāsi triyugaṃ madhusūdanam || sañjayaḥ | māyāṃ na seve bhadraṃ te na vṛthā dharmamācare | śuddhabhāvaṃ gato bhaktayā śāstrādvehyi janārdanam" iti atra, "bhaktayā śuddhabhāvaṃ gataḥ śāstrāt janārdanaṃ vehmītyanena yathāvacchāstrārthajñānodayasya bhaktisāpekṣatvaṃ siddham | "jāyamānaṃ hi puruṣaṃ yaṃ paśyenmadhusūdanaḥ | sāttvikaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ sa vai mokṣārthacintakaḥ | paśyatyenaṃ jāyamānaṃ brahmā rudro'thavā punaḥ | rajasā tamasā cāsya mānasaṃ samabhiplutam ||" iti vacanācca tattvārthajñānasyaṃ bhaktiprītabhagavatkaṭākṣasāpekṣatvaṃ jñāyate | nanu "yayā tvamabhijānāsi", "bhaktayā vedmī"ti praśanaprativacanābhyāṃ vidyābhaktāśabdayoraikārthyaṃ pratīyate | bhaktirūpā ca vidyā mokṣāyeti prāgupapāditam | tataśca śāstrajñānamūlā bhaktiḥ, bhaktimūlaṃ śāstrajñānamityanyonyāśraya iti cetnaivam; śravaṇavelāyāmeva padārthatayā avagamyamāneṣu paramātmaguṇādipvanukūlabuddhigocaratvādvidyābhaktiśabdayoḥ | tena samyagvākyārthanirṇayalābhaḥ | pūrvapakṣatayopanyasyamāne'pi sugatābhimatavedāprāmāṇyādau hi bhavati pradveṣo vaidikānām | bhagavadguṇādipvanuraktacittatā bhavati | na caiṣā sākṣātkārakalpanirantaradhyānarūpā bhaktiḥ |ato nānyonyāśrayaḥ | atha śāstrārtha yāthā tmya jñānotpattihetubhūtabhaktivirodhinamāha anādīti | yadvā samyagjñānahetubhūtabhaktayabhāvāt samyagjñānavirodhipāpānubandhamāha anādīti | vāsanāśabdena pāpasya dṛḍhamūlatvena durnivāratvamuktam | vāsanayā pāpaṃ pāpena vāsanā, ajñānena pāpavāsanā pāpavāsanayā ajñānamityanyonyāśrayaparihārāya anādiśabdaḥ | śemuṣī mokṣopayogi jñānam |aśeṣaśabdasyopāyopeyanivartyaviṣayā viśvaśemuṣī dūṣiteti bhāvaḥ | anenārthāt svapakṣe nivatryaṃ coktaṃ bhavati; karmaṇa eva mokṣapratibandhakatvāt | dūṣitaśemuṣīkatvaphalaṃ samyagjñānābhāvamāha anadhigateti | pratyakṣavirodhe śāstraprābalyasya pareṇoktatvāt, padaśaḥ samudāyena ca saviśeṣaparatvaprādhānyena ca prathamaṃ śabdapramāṇamāha padeti | prakṛtipratyayayogena ca padatvaṃ na jñātamiti padaśabdasya bhāvaḥ | vākyasvarūpeti | vākyam anekapadārthasaṃsargaviśeṣa bhidhāyi iti ca na jñātamiti bhāvaḥ | tadarthayāthātmyamtātparyaviṣayaḥ | pratyakṣādīti ādinā anumānam; sakalaśabdena spārśanacākṣuṣādipratyakṣāvāntarabhidā vivakṣitā; anvayavyatirekādyanumānāvāntarabhidā ca vivakṣitā |
yadvā tattadvādyabhimatārthāpattyādipramāṇāntaraviṣayaḥ sakalaśabdaḥ | vṛttambodhanam | taditikarttavyatārūpeti | tarkeṇa pramāṇabādhavacanāt pramāṇānugrāhakastarka iti ca na jñātamiti bhāvaḥ | pramāṇānugrāhakatayaiva hi vayaṃ tarkamaṅgīkurma ityatrāha samīcīnanyāyeti | anugrāhakabudhdyā svīkṛtasyāpi tarkasya pramāṇaviruddhatvāt so'samīcīna iti bhāvaḥ | apacchedanayādisamīcīnanyāyā eva hi svīkṛta ityatrāha nyāyamārgāṇāmiti | ayamapacchedanyāyaviṣayaḥ, ayaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣanyāyaviṣaya iti tattanyāyasañcāraviṣayavibhāgo'navagata iti bhāvaḥ | tarhi kimava lamvya prabandhāḥ kṛtā ityatrāha vikalpāsaheti | kutarkāḥpramāṇaviruddhāḥ mūlaśaithilyamithovirodhādidoṣāntarākrāntāśca tarkāḥ | te ca tricaturapadasthāyino na bhavanti, kintu vikalpitānyataraśiraḥparigraha eva bhaṅgurā ityāha vikalpāsaheti | tarkasya vikalpāsahatvaṃ nāma tadviṣayasādhanādivikalpāsahatvameva | vividheti | brahmaṇo'nubhāvyatve'nanubhūtitvam, pratyakṣaṃ sanmātragrāhi, vedāntavedyaṃ brahma pramāṇāntarāgocara ityādirūpaṃ kutarkāṇāmanyonyavyāhativaividhyaṃ vivakṣitam | īdṛśakutarka eva kalkamasārabhūtam, bauddhairāttasāram jīṣamityarthaḥ | etena kalpitamutkīrṇam | itirhetau | keṣāñcit samīcīnārthāntaraviṣayajñāne'satyapyasyāsamīcīnatvaniścayaḥ kathamityatrāha nyāyānugṛhītapratyakṣādisakalapramāṇavṛttayāthātmyavidbhiriti | anena pūrvoktaviparītākāra uktaḥ | bahuvacanena svapakṣasya bhagavadvodhāyanādyanekaśiṣṭaparigrahaḥ sūcitaḥ | anādaraṇīyamiti | śiṣyaśikṣāsu pūrvapakṣopanyāsakauśalārthamapyādarttumayogyamityarthaḥ | aśeṣaviśeṣapratyanīkacinmātramityārabhya sarve vedāntā ārabhyanta ityantena yadapyāhuḥ tadanādaraṇīyamityanvayaḥ ||
evaṃ saṅkṣepeṇa pratipāditamarthamupapādayitumupakramate tathā hīti | nanu pūrvapakṣiṇā prathamaṃ vedāntavākyāni (kyaviśeṣān)udāhṛtya tatra nirūpaṇīyaṃ sarvaṃ nirūpya paścāt tadvayatiriktapramāṇatarkāḥ pradarśitāḥ | ataḥ siddhānte ca tena krameṇa tatpratikṣepoyuktaḥ | tat kathaṃ prathamaṃ sakalapramāṇāviṣayatvanirūpaṇaṃ saṅgacchate? uttaratra ca kathaṃ pratyakṣādinirviśeṣaviṣayatvanirāsapūrvakaṃ vedāntavākyayojanā kriyate || ucyate | pratyakṣavirodhe śāstraprābalyābhyupagamāt pareṇa vedāntavākyāni prathamamuhāhṛtya paścāt tadanyadvaktanyaṃ sarvamuktam; prabalatayā'bhimatapramāṇapuraskāro hyucitaḥ | siddhāntinā tu pratyakṣavirodhe śāstraprābalyānabhyupagamāt pratyakṣādernirviśeṣaviṣayatvavyudasanapūrvakaṃ tadavirodhena vedāntavākyāni svarasato vyākhyasyante | tatra nirviśeṣacinmātrapāramārthyasya pareṇa prathamapratijñātasya sāmānyena sakalapramāṇabahiṣkṛtatvarūpaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ prathamaṃ pratijānīte nirviśeṣe iti | arthāt pramāṇāsva(pramāṇā)bhāvaśca svapakṣānuguṇo nirūpito bhavati | svapuṇyamapi svānubhavasiddhamiti vaktuṃ śakyamiti tadravyāvṛttyarthamidaṃśabdaḥ | parasampratipattipadaṃ pramāṇaṃ na kiñcidapīti bhāvaḥ | yadvā, na kācidapi pramāṇavyaktirnivirśeṣagocaretyekavacanābhiprāyaḥ | kuta ityatrāha saviśeṣeti || nanu viśeṣā hi nirviśeṣāḥ, | tat kathaṃ nirviśeṣavastuno'prāmāṇikatvam || ucyate | dharmeṇa dharmī saviśeṣaḥ; dharmiṇā ca dharmaḥ saviśeṣaḥ | kasyaciddharmabhūtaṃ dhamir vā yanna bhavati, tat pramāṇaśūnyamiti hi granthārthaḥ | viśeṣaḥ vyāvarttakaḥ | dharmī ca svagatadharmasyāśrayāntaragatadharmādvyavacchedaka iti viśeṣaśabdavācyaḥ | kiñca viśeṣo nirviśeṣa iti śabdau kiṃ paryāyau, na vā? ādye, saha prayogānupapattiḥ | dvitīye tu, na nirviśeṣatvam; bodhyabhedamantareṇāparyāyatvāyogāt || nanu kathaṃ sarvapramāṇānāṃ saviśeṣaviṣayatvam? na hi gandhādigrāhi pramāṇaṃ gandhādikaṃ sāśrayamāvedayati | naivam;āśraya eva viśeṣa iti niyamābhāvāt | saṃvido'pi sarvaviśeṣaṇatayā sarvārthavauśiṣṭayaṃ hyupapadyate | ayaṃ gandho'nubhūyata iti kālādiviśeṣāvacchinnatayaiva gandhādipratīteśca saviśeṣaviṣayatvopapattiḥ | tathā pratītiśca vakṣyate || tarhi na vayaṃ pramāṇāntareṇa nirviśeṣasiddhimabhyupagacchāmaḥ; svānubhavasiddhaṃ hi tadityata āha yastviti | tuśabdena samayaṃ viśiṃṣan samayavaiśiṣṭayamūlaṃ svānubhavalakṣaṇapramāṇavaiṣamyamabhripraiti | svagoṣṭhīniṣṭha iti paravādyasammatatvaṃ darśayati |ātmasākṣikānubhavasya saviśeṣatvaṃ darśayati idamahamiti | viśiṣṭaviṣayatvāditi | viśiṣṭo viṣayaḥ svayamanubhava eva; śilāputrakasya śarīramitivadayaṃ nirdeśaḥ, anyathā svānubhavanirviśeṣatvanirāse ghaṭādisaviśeṣatvasādhanasyānupayogāt | anubhūyamāno'pyanubhava ityuparitanagranthasyāpyevamevārthaḥ; svānubhavasiddhamityanenaikārthyāt | na cānubhavaśabdo'nuvyavasāyaparaḥ | na hyanuvyavasāyarūpaṃ pratyakṣamiṣṭam; atītaviṣayatayā pratyakṣatvānupapatteḥ | parajñānm pramuṣitasaṃskāraṃ svajñānaṃ cānumeyam; anyattu smṛtiviṣayaḥ | na ca smṛtiviṣayatvamiha vivakṣitam; anubhavaśabdasyātadarthatvāt | ato'nubhūyamānatvam avabhāsamānatvam | idamahaṃśabdābhyāṃ sakarmakartṛka evānubhava ityuktam | adarśamityanenāparokṣatvaviśeṣānvayo'bhipretaḥ | atītatvaṃ tvavivakṣitaṃ tadā svataḥsiddhatvāyogāt | kenacidviśeṣeṇeti | ukteṣvapyanyatamaviśeṣaṇamantato gatvā'pyavarjanīyamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā,adarśamitītyatra itiśabdaḥ prakāravacanaḥ prakṛtasajātīyarūpaṃ viśeṣaṃ yāvatsambhavaṃ gṛhṇāti | tena parokṣatvavartamānatvādikaṃ kenaciditi vivakṣitaṃ syāt | parokṣatvaṃ viṣayadvārā | nanu na hi vayamidamahamadarśamiti pratītimapalapāmaḥ | sā tu tarkavyavasthāpitaviṣayā nirviśeṣe pramāṇamityatrāha saviśeṣo'pīti | svavyāghātasya darśayiṣyamāṇatvāt yuktayābhāsenetyuktam | nivirśeṣa iti niṣkṛṣyamāṇa iti | yadā nirviśeṣa iti niṣkṛṣyate, tadānīmevaṃ hi niṣkraṣṭavya ityarthaḥ | kathaṃ niṣkraṣṭavya ityatrāha sattātirekibhiḥ svāsādhāraṇairiti | sattānatirekī cet pakṣāviśiṣṭo hetuḥ syāt | tadayuktaṃ; pakṣavyāvartako hi hetuḥ | kiñca anyasya dravyāntarādvayāvarttakadharmasyaiva vyāvṛttirūpatvasambhavaḥ | svarūpe pratipanne svasyānyatādātmyabhramavirodhinaśca svarūpameva vyāvṛttiḥ, yathā śuktitvādeḥ | brahmaṇastu vastvantarasyānyasmādvayāvartakarūpadharmatvābhāvāt svarūpe bhāsamāne bhramasahatvācca na svarūpa meva vyāvṛttiriti vakṣyamāṇaśaukalyādidṛṣṭāntavaiṣamyābhiprāyeṇa sattātirekibhirityuktam | sādhāraṇaśceddheḥ tu, anaikāntiko bhramāvirodhi ca syāt; yathā śauklayādiḥ |asādhāraṇaṃ śuktitvameva hi rajatabhramavirodhi | ataḥ svāsādhāraṇairityuktam svaśabdena vyadhikaraṇāsiddhiparihāraḥ | svabhāvaviśeṣaiḥdharmaviśeṣaiḥ | evaṃ sāmānyenārthaśarīramu ktam | atastvayā'pi nirāsakahetutayā'bhimatānāṃ sattātirekitvasvāsādhāraṇatve avarjanīye satyabhiprāyeṇa sattātirekibhiḥ svāsādhāraṇairiti punaḥ kathanam, ye ye hetavaḥ saviśeṣaghaṭādivastuvyāvṛttāḥ sāmānyena sakalaviśeṣābhāvasādhakāḥ, te atharsāmarthyāt sāmānyāntargataṃ svātmānamapi nivartayeyurevetyatrāha ataḥ kaiściditi | ataḥ teṣāṃ sattātirekitvasvāsādhāraṇatvayoravaśyābhyupagantavyatvādityarthaḥ | kaiściditi | svāsādhāraṇaiḥ prāmāṇikairityarthaḥ | viśiṣṭasyaiveti | nirviśeṣatvasādhakanivṛttau nirviśeṣatvāsiddheḥ, tadanivṛttau taireva saviśeṣatvaprasaṅgāccetyabhiprāyaḥ | anya iti | nirviśeṣatvasādhakā hetavo yebhyo ghaṭādibhyo vyāvṛttāḥ, tadgatā ihāprāmāṇikāḥ rūpā dayo viśeṣā asminnirasyante; na tu sarvaviśeṣāḥ | anagnimadyāvṛtto dhūmaḥ pakṣe hyanagnimattvameva nivartayati: na tvākārāntaramityarthaḥ | na kvaciditi | svānubhave, pratyakṣādipramāṇāntareṣvapītyarthaḥ | svavyādhātaprasaṅgena sakalaviśeṣanivṛtteḥ sādhayitumaśakyatvāt na nirviśeṣavastusiddhirityuktaṃ bhavati |
evaṃ karmakartṛvyudāsamabhyupagamya saviśeṣatvamāpāditam | atha karmakartṛnirāsa eva duḥśaka ityāha dhiyo hīti | dhītvamviṣayaprakāśatvam | svaprakāśatāananyādhīnaprakāśatvam | etadubhayaṃ svaprakāśavāde sādhanatayā sādhyatayā ca pareṇopanyastam | jñātuvirṣayaprakāśanasvabhāvatayopalabdheriti | niyamena svāśrayaṃ prati viṣayaprakāśakatayā bhāsamānatvāt dhītvasvaprakāśatve sidhyata ityarthaḥ | dhītvaṃ viṣayasādhanatvaṃ; tathāvabhāsamānatvāditi na sādhyāviśiṣṭatā | yadyupalabdhisiddhaṃ sarkamakatvaṃ nāṅgīkuruṣe, tataḥ sarkamakatvahetukaṃ svaprakāśatvamapi na sidhyediti bhāvaḥ | yadvā dhītvaṃ dhīsvarūpamātram | hi śabdaḥ upalabdheḥ sarvasampratipatiṃta darśayati | nanu na karmakartravacchinnaṃ jñānamātmabhūtam; anyadeva tu svāpādyavastānubhūtaṃ nivirśeṣaṃ sādhyata ityatrāha svāpeti |anubhavaḥātmasphuraṇam | na hi tadā dharmabhūtajñānasphuraṇam | svāvasareahamarthasyaivātmatvasamarthane | nipuṇataramparaprayuktayukatyaiveti bhāvaḥ | "sukhamahamasvāpsam", "māmapyahaṃ na jñātavān ityādinā paroktaparāmarśenaiveti yāvat | yadvā nipuṇataraṃ viśadataram | etaduktaṃ bhavatikiṃ tvayā svānubhavādhīnaṃ nirviśeṣatvaṃ kamarkartravacchinnasya jñānasyocyate, utāhamiti bhāsamānasyātmasvarūpabhūtajñānasya, uta(?) taduttīrṇasya vā? ādye karmakartravacchedaniyamādeva na nirviśeṣatvam | dvitīye pratyaktavānukūlatvādibhiḥ saviśeṣatvamavarjanīyamiti vakṣyate | tṛtīye śūnyatvādeva na nirviśeṣatvaṃ sādhamiti || mukhāntareṇa saviśeṣatvamāha svābhyupagatāśceti | ādiśabdena svaprakātvaikatvā'nanda(ta)tvādayo vivakṣitāḥ | te vastumātramiti hyuktamityatrāha te ceti | upapādayati vastviti | bauddhaiḥ kṣaṇikatvamuktam; anena tu nityatvam | vaiśeṣekādibhiśca jaḍatvabahutve; anena tu svaprakātvaikatve svarūpaṃ tu taiḥ sarvairabhyupetam | ato vipratipattiviṣayaḥ sampratipattiviṣayaścaika eveti vaktumayuktamityarthaḥ | vimatyanantarabhāvinā tadupapādanena ca svarūpātiriktaṃtāṃ darśayati svābhimateti | kṣaṇikatvavādinaṃ prati brahmanityatvaṃ sādhayatā tvayā svarūpamātrātirekeṇa kiñcit sādhitamasti, na vā? asti cet, sadharmatvam | no cet, siddhasādhanatvam; svarūpamātrasyābhimatatvāt | saṃvinnityeti pratijñāvākyagatau dharmadharmiśabdau kiṃ paryāyau, na vā? ādye sādhanāyāso niṣphalaḥ | dvitīye svarūpātiriktadharmāṅgī(ntarasvī)kāra iti bhāvaḥ | svamatopapādanānna vastumātramiti śakyopapādanā ityanvayaḥ | pūrvaṃ saviśeṣatvanirāsakahetubhiḥ saviśeṣatvamuktam; anantaraṃ sādhyadharmaiḥ; tataḥ katipayaviśeṣasādhakahetubhiḥ | ete nirāsakasādhyasādhanadharmā: aparamārthā ityatrāha ata iti | ataḥviśeṣavyudāsakatvena sādhyatvena sādhanatvena ca keṣāñciddharmāṇāṃ tvayokta tvāt paramārthabhūtaistaiḥ rviśiṣṭamityarthaḥ | prāmāṇikairityanena kaiściditi pūrvoktasyārthasyāpi viśeṣo darśitaḥ | viśiṣṭameveti | pūrvoktasattātirekitvasvāsādhāraṇatvābhāve bhramocchedo na syāt; nirāsakadharmāpāramārthye, śuktitvāpāramārthye rajatasatyatvavat, nirasanīyākārasatyatvaṃ prasajet; sādhyadharmāpāramārthye, ca nityatvādiviparītākārānityatvaprasaṅgaḥ; sādhanāpāramārthye ca sādhyanityatvādiviparītākāra(sya) satyatvamāpadyeteti bhāvaḥ |
itthaṃ svānubhavaprasaṅgāt tatrāpi saviśeṣatvamupapāditam; atha prathamapratijñātaṃ sarvapramrāṇānāṃ saviśeṣaviṣa yatvaṃ vaktumārabhate; tatra pareṇa pratyakṣādbalīstyavenoktatvāt saviśeṣabodhakatvātiśayasya svābhimatatvācca prathamaṃ śabdasya saviśeṣayatvamāha śabdasya tviti | tu śabdaḥ paroktabalīyastvaśūcakaḥ | viśeṣeṇetipadena saviśeṣavastubodhakatvātiśaya ucyate | yadvā sarvapramāṇānāṃ saviśeṣagocaratve pratijñāte, cidvastuni antaraṅgatayā svaprakāśa vṛtiṃta nirūpya tadanantaramātmani pratyakṣādibhyo'ntaraṅgatvena ubhayavādisammatasya śāstrasya saviśeṣaviṣayatvamāha śabdasya tviti | saviśeṣagocaratve pramāṇāntarebhyo'tiśayo viśeṣeṇetyucyate | tuśabdena tattadaupayikaṃ śabda sya saviśeṣagocarapratyakṣādipūrvakatvaṃ viśeṣa ucyate | pratijñātasya hetumāha padavākyarūpeṇeti | tataḥ kiṃ saviśeṣaviṣayatvasyeti śaṅkāyāṃ padarūpeṇa pravṛtiṃta vivṛṇoti prakṛtīti | tataḥ kimityatrāha prakṛtipratyayayoriti | padasyai veti | vākyaṃ tāvadāstām; padameva saviśeṣaparamiti bhāvaḥ | vākyarūpeṇa pravṛtiṃta vivṛṇoti padabhedaśceti | padabhedaḥpadānāṃ parasparabhedaḥ | na kevalaṃ prakṛtipratyayabheda evārthabhedahetukaḥ, padabhedo'pīti cārthaḥ | anyathā padāntaravaithyarthyāditi bhāvaḥ | padabhedasyārthabhedanibandhanatve'pi vākyaikatvāt nirviśeṣatvasiddhiriti śaṅkāyāṃ vākyasya saviśeṣaviṣayatvaṃ vadan nirviśeṣe pramāṇābhāvamupasaṃharati padasaṅghāteti | tattatpadābhidheyānāṃ saṃsargaviśeṣa eva vākyapratipādyaḥ na tu tattatpadārthaprahāṇena arthāntaramityarthaḥ ||
nanu nirviśeṣaśabdena nirviśeṣaṃ vastu kiṃ pratipannam, uta apratipannam, uta saviśeṣaṃ vastu pratipannam? ādye, nirviśeṣavastunaḥ śabdena pratipādanāt niṣedhonupapannaḥ | dvitīye tu niṣedhyāpratipatteḥ niṣedho'nupapannaḥ | tṛrtī ye tu saviśeṣanirāsaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt || naivam;bhrāntipramitivibhāgāt | nirviśeṣavastuni śabdasya pramāṇamāvo hi niṣidhyate; na tū bhramahetutvam; ato nirviśeśabdajanitā mitho'nvayānarhārthagocarā bhrāntiḥ pramitijanakaiḥ śabdairbādhyata iti yuktam | adhikaraṇatadasādhāraṇaniṣedhyapratipakṣadharmato viśeṣaśabdasya saṅkocānabhyupagame hyadhikaraṇalābhāt niṣedhakaśabdasyānanvaya eva syāt | na hi nirvibhaktikaḥ padāntarānanvito nirviśeṣaśabdo'rthābhidhāyī | ataḥ saṅkocābhāve vyāghātaḥ | yadyapi kathañcidvibhaktayartho na vivakṣitaḥ, tathāpi nirviśeṣapadasya bahuvrīhitvādanyapadārthābhidhānamavarjanīyam | tatpuruṣa(pada)prayoge ca adhikaraṇābhidhānamavajarnīyam |ato yadi nirviśeṣaśabdaḥ pramāṇabhūtavākyasthaḥ, tadā viṣayavibhāgo draṣṭavyaḥ; sakalaviśeṣaśūnyapratipādanāsāmarthyāt | nagare ko viśeṣa ityukte, na kaścidapītyādiṣu | vākyeṣu saviśeṣaniṣedhaḥ saṅkucitaviṣayo dṛṣṭaḥ | tathā śāstreṣvapi, "aviśeṣāstato hi te" iti gandhādiguṇānvitānāmapi pṛthivyādīnāṃ śāntatvadhoratvamūḍhatvarūpakatipayaviśeṣavirahavivakṣayā aviśeṣaśabdaḥ prayujyate ||
evaṃ jñānasvarūpa ātmanyantaraṅgatayā svānubhavaśabdau nirūpitau | atha vyatiriktapramāṇeṣu mūlabhūtasya pratyakṣasya saviśeṣaviṣayatvamupapādayati pratyakṣasyetyādinā | nirvikalpakānubhūtārthasya savikalpake pratisandhānasya vakṣyamāṇatvāttadupayogitvena ca savikalpakasvarūpaṃ pradarśitam | atha nirvikalpakasya saviśeṣaviṣayatvaṃ pratijānīte | nirvikalpakamapīti | ekajātīyapiṇḍeṣu dvitīyādipiṇḍagrahaṇasya savikalpakatvaṃ prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇasya nirvikalpakatvañca hṛdi nidhāya hetūmāha savikalpaka iti | viśiṣṭapratisandhānamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ karmadhārayo vā | svasminnirvikalpake anubhūtajātyādipadārthaviśiṣṭavastuviṣayasya savikalpake pratisandhānasya hetutvādityarthaḥ | prathamapiṇḍasya viśiṣṭatayā'vagatatvamarthalabdham prathamapiṇḍe jātiviśiṣṭatayā pratīte hi dvitīyādiṣu jātyanuvṛttibuddhilakṣaṇaṃ pratisandhānaṃ ghaṭate || kathaṃ pratisandhānam; sakalaviśeṣaśūnyaviṣayaṃ hi nirvikalpakamiti hetvasiddhimāśaṅkayāha nirvikalpakaṃ nāmeti | sakalaviśeṣavaidhuryābhāvamupapādayati tathā bhūtasyeti | sakalaviśeṣaśūnyagrahaṇaṃ kiṃ darśanādabhyupagamyate, kiṃ vā anupapattyā kalpyate iti vikalpya, na tāvat darśanamityāha kadācidapīti | kalpanaṃ vyudasyati anupapatteriti |nirviśeṣajñānabādhikaiva anūpapattirdṛśyate | tatkalpikā tu dūrato nirasteti bhāvaḥ |adarśanaṃ vivṛṇoti kenaciditi prakāraviśeṣaniyamo neti bhāvaḥ | utaratra grahaṇāyogāditi pañcamyā hetutvaṃ sphuṭam | atra pañcamīsthāne hiśabdaḥ | idamitthamiti pratītimeva vivṛṇvan arthāt sakalaviśeṣaśūnyagrahaṇakalpanāmapi vyudasyati trikoṇeti | anupapatiṃta vivṛṇoti grahaṇāyogāditi | adhyāhṛtaśaṅkāvākyena grahaṇāyogāditi pañcamyantānvayaḥ | trikoṇamgomukham | grahaṇāyogātdṛṣṭavyāptivirodhena sakalaviśeṣaśūnyagrahaṇakalpanasyānupapannatvādityarthaḥ | anupapatterityanena vipakṣe bādhakatarko'pyabhipretaḥsaviśeṣaviṣayatvābhāve pratyayatvameva hīyeteti |asya tarkasyānugrāhyaṃ pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣaṃ yogyānupalambhaśca | yadvā anupapatterityanena saviśeṣaviṣayatve sādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ vivakṣitamprathamākṣasannipātajaṃ jñānaṃ saviśeṣaviṣayam, jñānatvāt saṃpratipannavaditi | evaṃ sādhakapramāṇābhāvabādhakapramāṇasadbhāvābhyāṃ vivakṣitakatipayaviśeṣaśūnyagrahaṇaṃ nirvikalpakamiti siddham | anena nirvikalpakaśabdasya saṅkucitavṛttitvaṃ phalitam | sa ca saṅkocaḥ kasmin viṣaya ityatrāha ata iti | ataḥuktādarśanānupapattibhyāmi tyarthaḥ | prathamadvitīyapiṇḍayoḥ savikalpakanirvikalpakaśabdau na saṅketitau; atastayoḥ piṇḍayorvaiṣamyaṃ vaktavyamiti śaṅkāyāṃ grāhyākārabhedaṃ darśayati tatretyādinā vākyadvayena | gotvānuvṛttipratītyapratītyoḥ savikalpakanirvikalpakaśabdayoḥ pravṛttinimittatāṃ darśayati prathamapratītītyādinā vākyadvayena | pūrvagranthoktaṃ gotvaṃ saṃsthānaśabdena viśeṣitam; tena parābhimatavilīnājyagatadhṛtatvāderiva pratyakṣatve vyañjakāpekṣayā vilambo nāstīti darśitam | tadeva saṃsthānamanantaragranthe sāstrādiśabdena nirdiśyate | evamanuvṛttigrahāgrahābhyāṃ savikalpakatvaṃ nirvikalpakatvaṃ coktam | nānuvṛttimātragrahaṇānnirvikalpakatvam, kintu jātyagrahaṇācca | anuvṛttatyagrahaṇe hi jātirevāgṛhṇītā syāditi śaṅkāyāmāha na punaḥ saṃsthānā(narūpajātyādera?)grahaṇāditi | atrāgrahaṇānupapattidyotakaḥ saṃsthānarūpaśabdaḥ | gotvāderasādhāraṇadharmabhūtā'nuvṛttyagrahaṇāt gotvādirna grahīta iti śaṅkāyāmagrahaṇānupapattimeva vivṛṇoti saṃsthānarūpajātyāderapīti | grahaṇakāraṇabhūtendriyayogyatāyāmapi sa eva heturiti dyotanāya punaḥ saṃsthānaśabdoktiḥ | nirvikalpakasya saviśeṣaviṣayatve pramāṇatvena savikalpake nirvikalpakānubhūtārthaviśiṣṭapratyabhijñānaṃ (tyabhijñānaṃ)pūrvamuktam | parābhimatanirvikalpakābhāve yogyānupalambhaḥ pratyakṣaṃ ca pramāṇam | tayoranugrāhakatarkajñānenokto bhavati | kiṃ pramāṇānupapattyā prameyānupapattyā vā vastumātragrahaṇābhyupagama iti vikalpamabhipretya pramāṇānupapatiṃta prathamaṃ vyudasyati aindayikatvāviśeṣāditi | anena pṛthivyapṛthaksiddhagandhavyāvṛttiḥ || kathamaindriyikatvam? samavāyasyānaindriyikatvāt tadayuktamiti cet, tarhi savikalpake viśiṣṭagrahaṇamanupapannam | ato na bhinnendriyāgrāhyatva miti na pramāṇānupapattiḥ | asannihitatvaṃ prameyānupapattiḥ; apṛthaksiddhatvena tannāstīti parihṛrati saṃsthāneneti | anena cākṣuṣatvepi pṛthaksiddhadaṇḍādivyāvṛttiḥ | ekendriyagrāhyatve sati apṛthaksiddhatvāt pramāṇaprameyānupapattirnāstīti sasaṃsthānameva vastu gṛhītamityarthaḥ | evaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃsthānarūpaśabdenābhiprato'rtho vivṛto bhavati | anuvṛttyagrahaṇānna saṃsthānarūpajātyāderagrahaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ; prakāraprakāribhāvena grahaṇopapatteriti bhāvaḥ | prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇe anuvṛttyagrahaṇāt gotvamagṛhītaṃ cet dvitīyapiṇḍe'pi gotvaṃ durgraham; anuvṛttyagrahaṇāt | anekavyaktayanvayārūpā hi anyanuvṛttiḥ | sā cānvayinaḥ padārthasya pūrvavyaktiniṣṭhatāparārjñonaiva dvitīyādiṣu gahyate | ataḥ prathamapiṇḍe gotvāgarahāt tadanvayāparāmarśena dvitīyavyaktayanvayarūpānuvṛttidvitīye'pi durgraheti tatrāpi gotvamagṛhītam, evaṃ prathamadvitīyavyaktayanvayāparāmarśe (rśāt)tṛtīyepyanuvṛttiragṛhīteti gotvamagrahītam, evaṃ vyaktayantareṣvapi gotvaṃ durgrahaṃ syāt | ataḥ prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇa eva gotvagrahaṇamabhyupetavyam | evaṃ sakalaviśeṣaśūnyavastugrahaṇaṃ vyudastam | "jātyādayo viśeṣyaṃ ca pṛthak nivirkalpake gṛhītam; savikalpaka eva viśiṣṭatayā grahaṇam" iti pakṣaścārthānnirasto bhavati | viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyaṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak gṛhītamiti kathamavagatam? daṇḍakuṇḍalādiṣu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ prathak prathaggrahaṇapūrvakatvadarśanāditi cettatra kimapṛthaksiddhivelāyāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇam? uta pṛthaksthitivelāyām? na prathamaḥ, viśiṣṭatvenaiva grahaṇāt | pṛthaksthitivelāyāṃ tu viśiṣṭagrahaṇameva nāstīti na tatpratītihetutvam | ataḥ pṛthaggrahaṇasya viśiṣṭagrahaṇahetutvābhāvānna gotvādau pṛthaggrahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ ||
nanu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasya sapratiyogikatvāt tajjñānasya pratiyogisvarūpajñānamapekṣitamiti viśiṣṭapratipatterjātyādipadārthasvarūpamātragrahaṇapūrvakatvaṃ svīkāryam || ucyate | pratiyogijñānāpekṣā nāma kiṃ viśiṣṭa jñāne pratiyogyavabhāsaniyamaḥ? uta tadjñānasya viśiṣṭajñānahetutvam? prathamamabhyupagacchāmaḥ | dvitīye, ca jātyādayaḥ padārthāḥ prathamaṃ mitho vyāvṛttatayā gṛhītā na vā? na cet, avyāvṛttatayā gṛhītānāṃ pūrvottarajvālānāmiva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvapratiyogitāpratītirnopapadyate | yadi vyāvṛttatayā gṛhītāḥ tadā vyāvṛttiśca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena pāratantrādilakṣaṇena tadaupayikākārāntareṇa vā yadi na syāt, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyatyāsapratītiḥ prasajyate || vastusāmarthyādvāstava eva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ pratīyata iti cet tarhi vastucasāmarthyaṃ nāma viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva rūpaṃ tardopayikākārāntararūpaṃ vā syāt | vastusvabhāvasya sattayopakārakatve vastusvabhāvādeva viśiṣṭapratītisambhavāt svarūpamātragrahaṇakalpanamayuktam | jñātatayopakārakatve tena svabhāvena vyāvṛttatayā viśeṣaṇasya prāgavagatirastīti prathamata eva viśiṣṭapratītirabhyupagatā syāt | ato varaṃ dravyasyaiva prathamaṃ viśiṣṭatayā pratītyabhyupagamaḥ | tasyāpi svabhāvasya svaviśeṣyabhūtaṃ viśeṣanaṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvaṃ na prathamamavagatam; kintu svarūpamātramiti cettarhi viśeṣaṇatatsvabhāvayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyatyāsaḥ pratīyeta | tatparihārāya tasya vastusvabhāvasyākārāntarābhyu pagame anavasthā | yadi vyatyāsaviśiṣyapratītiprāthamyaprasaṅgaparihārāya jātyādīnāṃ svarupameva viśeṣaṇabhāvaḥ viśeṣyabhāvaśca, na tvākārāntaramityabhyupagamyatetadā prathamapratipattirviśeṣaṇatayā viśeṣyatayā ca syāt; tadapratipattau svarūpasyāgṛhītatvaprasaṅgāt | tathaiva pratītau prathamata eva viśiṣṭapratītiḥ syāt; ekasyāṃ pratītau viśeṣaṇatayā viśeṣyatayā ca jātyādīnāṃ pratipannatvāt |ataḥ prathamata eva parasparapratiyogikaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvapratītiḥ saṃbhavatītyabhyupagantavyam | evaṃ sati viśiṣṭagrahaṇasya pṛthaggrahaṇapūrvakatve bhinnasāmagrīvedyavastugocaratvamupādhiḥ syāt | pakṣavyatiriktavyavacchedyābhāve'pyuktatarkabalāt pakṣavyavacchekatvasiddherupādhitvaṃ yuktam | yathā pradhvaṃsābhāvasyādimattvādantavattve bhāvarūpādimattvamupādhirbhavati, bhāvonmajjanaprasaṅgarūpatarkabalāt; yathā agnimattvāt dhūmānumāne ārdrendhanamupādhiḥ sarvatrāgnimati dhūmopalambhaprasaṅgatarkabalādbhavatitadvat | ataḥprathamapiṇḍagrahaṇa eva gotvaṃ gṛhyate; dvitīyādiṣvanuvṛttigrahaṇama(mitya?)bhyupetya(tavya)m |ato yathoktasvarūpe eva nirvikalpakasavikalpake ||
anuvṛttigrahāgrahau hi savikalpakanirvikalpakayoḥ prayojakau kathitau; tat kathaṃ dvitīyādigrahaṇasya savikalpakatvamityatrāha ata iti | ataḥprathamagrahaṇa eva sa saṃsthānavastugrahaṇāt | anuvṛttigrahaṇavidhuraprathametaragrahaṇe kathaṃ savikalpakatvam? ityatrāha dvitīyādīti | dvitīyādipiṇḍagrahaṇeṣudvitīyāditvena piṇḍagrahaṇeṣu | anena saṃskārasacivagrahaṇaṃ savikalpakam, itarannirvikalpakamiti siddham | etena na kevalaṃ jātyanuvṛttyaiva savikalpaka tvam; jātiguṇādiṣvanyatamānuvṛttiviśiṣṭagrahaṇamapi savikalpakamiti siddham | savarvidhānuvṛttivikalagrahaṇameva nirvikalpakam | yathā ekavyaktau prathamākṣasannipātajaṃ jñānam || nanvekavyaktāvapi saṃskārajanyaṃ deśakālādyanuvṛttiviśiṣṭagrahaṇaṃ savikalpakaṃ syāt || syādeva; saṃskārajanyatvaanuvṛttigocatvāviśeṣāt | ekajātīyadravyeṣu prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇamityuktistu jātyanuvṛttipradarśanārthā | saṃsthānivatsaṃsthānavaditi dṛṣṭāntapradarśanaṃ spaṣṭīkaraṇārtham | piṇḍadharmaḥ saṃsthānam, tadvarmo'nuvṛttiriti dharmadharmibhāvarūpasāmyanibandhanañca dṛṣṭāntadvayopādānam | evaṃ savikalpakanirvikalpakayoḥ saṃskārasacivatvatadvirahau sāmagrīvaiṣamyam,gotvādyanuvṛttitadvirahau grāhyākāravaiṣamyamityuktaṃ bhavati || dvividhasyāpi pratyakṣasya saviśeṣaviṣayatvaṃ nigamayati ata iti |
prasaṅgāt bhedābhedaṃ nirākaroti ata eveti | ata evaprathamapiṇḍagrahaṇasya viśiṣṭaviṣayatvasamarthanena | sarvatrapiṇḍadvayajātivyaktiguṇaguṇikriyātadvatkāryakāraṇeṣvityarthaḥ | kathamityatrāha idamitthamiti | bhedābhedavādinā,piṇḍānāmanyonyabhedābhedasamarthane idamidaṃ na bhavatīti bhedaḥ, idamidaṃ bhavatītyabheda ityekasyaiva yugapat bhāvābhāvarūpavyāhatiparihārārtham, jātyātmanā abhedo vyaktayātmanā bheda ityākāradvayena bhedābheda upapāditaḥ | jātigato abhedaḥ vyaktagato bhedaśceti naikasya dvayātmakateti śaṅkāparihārāya jātivyaktayoścānyonyabhedābheda uktaḥ | tannirvahaṇāyākārāntarānvayādarśanāt pratītireva śaraṇamityāśritā | atastannirāsāya prathamaṃ jātivyaktayorbhedenaiva pratīterabhedasya pratītivirodhaṃ darśayati idamitthamiti | idambhāvo viśeṣyam; itthambhāvo viśeṣaṇam | itthamaṃśaḥ kaḥ; idamaṃśaḥ ka ityatrāha tatreti | atra jātivyaktayorbhedābhede catvāro hetavaḥ paroktaḥ prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇe abhedena grahaṇam, ekaśabdānuviddhapratyayaḥ, mattvarthīyapratyayanirapekṣasamānādhikaraṇapadaprayogaḥ, sahopalambhaniyamaś ceti | atra sahopalambhaniyamasamānādhikaraṇapratyayau bhedābhedasādhakau; anyau dvāvabhedasādhakau | idaṃ hetucatuṣṭayamāśaṅkayāha tathā hīti | tān hṛdi kṛtvā prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇeabhedena grahaṇaṃ vyudasyati prathamamevetyādinā | sakaletaravyāvṛttamsakalavijātīyavyāvṛttamityarthaḥ | tataḥ kiṃ bhedena grahaṇasya ityatrāha vyāvṛttiśceti | gotvādisaṃsthānaviśeṣaviśiṣṭatayā itthamiti pratītervyāvṛttiśca niścīyata ityarthaḥ | anenākhaṇḍavākyātharbhaṅgaścārthataḥ kṛto bhavati; śauklyādivaidharmyasyehābhipretatvāt | tacca pūrvaṃ darśitam || gotvādiviśiṣṭatayā pratītirastu, tathāpyabhedaḥ svapramāṇena prasajan na (prasajyate cet, na) nivāryata ityatrāha sarvatreti | sarvatragotvatadāśrayādiṣu, daṇḍakuṇḍalādiṣu ca | daṇḍadaṇḍinoriva jātītadvatorapi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva eva abhedavirodhītyarthaḥ | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāveti | gotvavyaktayoranuvṛttivyāvṛttyagrahe'pi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvarūpeṇā'kārāntareṇa bhedo gṛhītaḥ; na hyekenaivākāreṇa bhedagraha ityasti niyama iti bhāvaḥ | ubhayatrā'tyantabhedo'sti cet, mattvarthīyapratyayanirapekṣasāmānādhikaraṇyamekaśabdānuviddhapratyayaḥ sahopalambhaniyamaśca kathamekatra dṛśyate nānyatretyata āha tatreti | tatragotvatadāśrayadaṇḍadaṇḍyādivarge | pṛthaksaṃsthānaviśiṣṭasvaparyavasitakādācitkaviśeṣaṇabhāvo matvarthīyapratyayasāpekṣasāmānādhikaraṇyapratyaye prayojakaḥ | dravyasaṃsthānatayaiva padārthatvena tatparyantatvāt tadviśeṣaṇatayaiva sthitirmatvarthīyapratyayanirapekṣasāmānādhikaraṇye prayojikā | sahopalambhaniyamatadabhāvayorapṛthaksiddhatvapṛthaksiddhatve eva prayojake; na tu bhedābhedāvityarthaḥ | sahopalambhaniyame, dvayoreva sahabhāvāt sahopalambho dvitvasādhakaḥ; tanniyamastubhinnayorekasminnapi nāstītyasādhāraṇānaikāntikatvādanubhayasādhakaḥ | kiñca viruddha eva; dvitvasādhakasahopalambhaniyamo hi dvitvasya niyamaṃ darśayati | ekaśabdānuviddhapratyayastu eko daṇḍītyādiṣu daṇḍyantaravyāvarttakatvadarśanena dharmyantaraniṣedhaparatvānna dharmadharmiṇorabhedasādhaka iti bhāvaḥ | yadyevaṃ jātikuṇḍalādervaiṣamyam, yadi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasāmyādubhayatra bhedaḥ sādhyate, tarhi sahopalambhaniyamādivaiṣamye(ṇa) ekatvamapi syādityata āha ubhayatreti | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvā(di)viśeṣāt tatprayuktabhedapratipattiranivāryā; viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve sati bhedasyāpi saṃpratipatteḥ | sahopalambhaniyame aikyaṃ hi vimatam |ato na sampratipannabhedaviruddhābhedaḥ kalpyaḥ | yathā śītatvoṣṇatvādyavāntaravaiṣamyaṃ na dravyatvādisādhāraṇākāravirodhyadravyatvakalpakam, evaṃ sahopalambhaniyamo na bhedavirodhyākārakalpaka iti bhāvaḥ | yadvāpṛthaksthitānāṃ daṇḍādīnāmaviśeṣaṇānāmeva satāṃ kadācit sahabhāvamātrāt viśeṣaṇatvamadhyastamityatyantabhinneṣu viśeṣaṇatvābhāvādviśeṣaṇatvaṃ nātyantabhedasādhanasamarthamityatrāha ubhayatreti | vyāvṛttapratītau vyāvarttakatayopayujyamānatvaṃ viśeṣaṇatvam | tacca daṇḍādiṣvapi mukhyamiti viśeṣaṇatvādatyantabhedo yujyata iti bhāvaḥ || gotvatadāśrayādiṣveva sahopalambhaniyamaḥ, nānyatreti vyavasthāsidhdyarthamaikyaṃ kalpanīyamiti cettatrāha iyāṃstviti | iyāneva; na tvadhikaṃ kalpanīyamityarthaḥ | yadi sahopalambhaniyamavyavasthārthamaikyaṃ kalpyatetadayuktam; tatraivaikyaṃ, nānyatreti vyavasthārthamarthāntarakalpanaprasaṅgāt | yadyaikyaṃ tatra svābhāvikam, tarhi sahopalambhaniyamaḥ svābhāvika iti na pratipannaviruddhārthāntarakalpanāgauravamāśrayaṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaprayuktabhedapratipattiryathobhayatra tulyā, tathā sahopalambhaniyamo daṇḍadevadattādāvapi syāt, jātivyaktayorvā sa na syādityatrāha iyāniti |
na hi sādhāraṇākāre'bhyupagate'vāntarabhedastyājya ityarthaḥ | ghaṭe paṭasyābhāvo bhedaḥ, tatra tasya sadbhāvo abheda iti bhāvābhāvavirodhasya, "na hi dṛṣṭe'nupapannaṃ nāma" iti nyāyāt pratītiparāhatatvamāśaṅkayāha ata iti | ataḥitthaṃ bhedasāmānādhikaraṇyenābhedasya pratītyabhāvāt || kathaṃ pratītiprakāra ityatrāha pratītiprakāro hīti | yadi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoraikyamasti tarhyanyataradeva pratīyeta | anyatarapratītirvā'stutathā'pi naikyam; yathā pūrvānubhūtayoḥ puruṣayorekasmin dṛṣṭe na hi puruṣaikyam || jātivyaktayoḥ sambandhaniyama evaikyamiti cet na; bhedasādhakasambandhaniya masya bhedaniyatasambandhaniyamyatvāt | dvayorhi saṃbandhaḥ; tanniyama aikyaṃ cet, sambandhasvarūpabhaṅgaprasaṅgaḥ | evaṃ bhedābhedanirāsasya sūtrakārābhimatatvamāha tadetaditi |
atha pramāṇāntarāṇāṃ pratyakṣamūlatvāt teṣāmapi saviśeṣaviṣayatvamāha ata iti | pratyakṣādidṛṣṭadhūmādisambandhaviśiṣṭāgnyādiviṣayatvādityarthaḥ | svābhimatamuktaṃ pramāṇatrayam | pramāṇāntarāmyupagame'pi teṣāṃ saviśeṣaviṣayatvamāha pramāṇasaṅkhayetyādinā | pramāṇāni saviśeṣaviṣayāṇi syuḥ, tāni tarkaparāhatānīti saṅkāyām asmin sarvapramāṇasaviśeṣaviṣayatvavistaroktisamaye'pi pūrvaṃ tatsaṅgrahoktāviva, buddhisthasvasiddhivāde'pi na nirviśeṣatvasiddhiriti jñāpanāya, "saviśeṣatvabādhakatayā paroktayuktayamyupagame'pi yuktirūpaviśeṣaiḥ saviśeṣatvamavarjanīyam" iti pūrvoktaṃ smārayan virodhaṃ ca darśayati vastugateti | yadvā pūrvaṃ svānubhavasiddhe viśiṣṭe nirviśeṣatvani ṣkarṣo niṣkarṣakaḥ dhamaiḥ saviśeṣatvāpādanena dūṣitaḥ; tat sarvaṃ pramāṇanirviśeṣatvaviṣayatvaniṣkarṣe'pyatidiśativastugateti ||
evaṃ nirviśeṣacinmātrapāramārthyavyatiriktāpāramārthyapratijñābādhaḥ sāmānyena sarvapramāṇasaviśeṣagocara tvena darśitaḥ |atha paroktaṃ pramāṇatarkajātaṃ viśeṣato dūṣayitumupakamate | śāstrabalīyastvamicchatā pareṇa prathamaṃ śāstramupanyastam tadanicchatā pratyakṣāvirudde'rthe śāstraṃ pramāṇayatā siddhāntinā pratyakṣasya sanmātraviṣayatvaṃ nirākriyate | tatra pratyakṣasya sanmātraviṣayatva, bhedasya durnirūpatve ca paroktaṃ kutarkamanūdya nirasyati yattviti | yattvityādinā granthadvayena (pramāṇānupapattiprameyānupapattyanubhāṣaṇam) | tadapīti | na kevalaṃ saviśeṣaviṣayatvopapādanam, nirviśeṣaviṣayatvopapādanānupapattiśceti apiśabdasya bhāvaḥ | yadvāna kevalaṃ bhinnaviṣayatvaṃ sthāpitam; sanmātraviṣayatva mapi dūrotsāritamityapiśabdasya bhāvaḥ | jātyādereveti | svaparanirvāhakatvāt vyāvṛttirūpadharmāntaranirapekṣasya pratiyoginirapekṣasyaiva ceti bhāvaḥ | dūrotsāritam | pratiyogismaraṇakṛtavilambe satyapi jñānasya yāvatkāryasiddhi sattvaṃ(sthiratvaṃ) kalpyam | tathāpi pratiyoginirapekṣajātyāderbhedatvena, ekakṣaṇavarttitve'pi pratyakṣasya, bhedasya sugrahatvāt dūrotsārimiti bhāvaḥ | jātyāderevetyabhipretaṃ bhedasya svaparanirvāhakatvaṃ paroktayukatvaiva darśayati saṃvedanavadityādinā | saṃvedacavadrūpādivaccetyanena paroktapakṣasapakṣau dvāvapi sapakṣīkṛtau | anena paroktadūṣaṇasya parihṛtatvaṃ darśayati ata eveti |atra prathamacaśabdasya svaparanirvāhakatvopapādanena dūṣaṇaparihāraśca siddha iti bhāvaḥ | dvitīyaścaśabdo dūṣaṇadvayasamuccaye || anavasthāparihārasiddhau tadatharsvaparanirvāhakatvasiddhiḥ, tadarthasvaparanirvāhakatvasiddhau anavasthāparihāra ityanyonyāśraya iti cenna; bhramanivṛttyanvayavyatirekābhyāmeva svaparanirvāhakatvasiddheranavasthāparihārāt | pratyakṣajñānasya tricaturakṣaṇamātravarttitve'pi ekakṣaṇavarttitvamabhyupagamya pariharati ekakṣaṇavarttitve'pīti |
atraivamanusandheyamkiṃ bhedapratītiḥ anarayupagatā, utāṅgīkāre'pi mūlaṃ nāsti, kiṃ vā mūlaṃ durnirūpam; iti viṣayo vā kiṃ nāsti, uta sannapi durnirūpa iti | tatra prathamaṃ (?) pratītyanabhyupagamo nopapadyate; vedāntānāmanārambhaṇīyatvaprasaṅgāt; vādiprativādirūpeṇa kathānupapatteśca | mūlamapyasti; kāyarsya sampratipannatvena kāraṇasya kalpanīyatvāt | "kāryaṃ hi pratītaṃ kāraṇakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇam; na punaḥ sphuṭāvadhāritaṃ kāryaṃ kārakanirūpaṇāyāpahnavamarhatīti nītividaḥ | durnirūpatvamapi nāsti; kāryotpattyanurūpatvaṃ hi kāraṇasya sunirūpatvam | kāryotpa ttyā kāraṇasya tadanurūpatvaṃ siddhamiti na durnirūpatvam | viṣayo'pyastyeva | yadi na viṣayaḥ, tarhi tvayaiva tat anuyuktena vaktavyamprapañcasya vādhyatvajñānaṃ kiṃ saviṣayam? utāviṣayam, iti | saviṣayatve, viṣayo'ṅgīkṛta eva | no cet vādhyatvamapi neti prapañcapāramārthyaṃ syāt | ato'styeva viṣayaḥ | na ca bādhyaviṣayatvam; tathā sati bhedabādhakapramāṇajanyapratīterapi mithyāviṣayatvena bhedapāramārthyaprasaṅgāt | etān pratyāhuḥ |
"svaśāstranirṇaye satye satyāḥ syurlokanirṇayāḥ | svaśāstranirṇaye'satye satyāḥ syurlokanirṇayāḥ ||" iti | uktavikalpeṣu pūrve catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ apicetyādinā bhāṣyeṇa vakṣyamāṇenābhipretā iti teṣāṃ nirastatvaṃ tatra jñāsyate | atra prathamaṃ pañcamaṃ bādhyaviṣayatvapakṣaṃ prādhānyāt parijihīrṣatā bhāṣyakāreṇa pratyakṣabādhastāvanna dṛṣṭa iti, yauktikabādhaḥ parihriyate | tatra pratiyoginirapekṣajātyādereva bhedatvena tadviśiṣṭaviṣayatayā kṣaṇāntaragrāhyābhāvāt kramayaugapadyavikalpāyogarūpā pramāṇānupapattiḥ parihṛtā | evaṃ pramegrānupapattau svarūpapakṣe pratiyoginirapekṣabhedavyavahāraprasaktiśca iṣṭatayā parihṛtā; hānopādānādirūpasya gotvādiśabdāvalambinaśca vyavahārasya pratīteśca pratiyoginirapekṣatvāt śabdavyavahāraviśeṣe pratiyogisāpekṣatvasya dārāḥ kalatramāpaḥ ityādiṣu strītvanapuṃsakatvabahutvādivat, śabdasvabhāvāyattatvānnārthadūṣaṇatvam | vyāvṛttādiśabdaprayogeṣveva pratiyogisāpekṣatvadarśanāt, gotvādipratipattivyavahāreṣu tadabhāvāt śabdavyavahāraviśeṣasya pratiyogisāpekṣatvaṃ śabdaviśeṣasvabhāvādhīnamityanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ niścīyate | śabdasvabhāvaśca pravṛttinimittasādhāraṇyāttadavacchedakopādhipuraskāreṇārthaviśeṣapratītihetutvam | gotvaśabdo hyasādhāraṇo gotvaṃ svarūpeṇa darśayati | bhedaśabdastu vyāvṛttibuddhihetutvarūpapravṛttinimittasādhāraṇyāt tadavacchedakamahiṣādipadārthāntararūpopādhipuraskāreṇa gotvaṃ darśayati | paryāyatvaprasaktiśca parihṛtā; vyāvṛtirūpe pare brahmaṇi brahmaśabdena saha svarūpābdavat adhikārārthāvivakṣāyāmapi bhinnaśabdasya prayogasaṃbhavāt | upādhi śabdānāṃ hi vācyanatirekepi taṭasyopādhibhedāt aparyāyatvaṃ upapadyate | tatra aicchau prayogāprayogau | bhedasya vyāvṛttyanuvṛtti vikalpopi parihṛtaḥ; vyāvṛtta ityabhyupagame svarūpavyāvṛttaśabdayoriva bhedaśabdasyānuvṛttaprayogasambhavāt "bhinnohi bhedayogī" ityetacca svarūpasyaiva jātyādibhedaviśiṣṭatvena bhinnaśabda prayogasaṃbhavāt parihṛtam | dharmabhūtajātyādeṣu bhinna iti prayogo bhavanmate vyāvṛttirūpe brahmaṇi vyāvṛttaśabdavadaupacārikaḥ; dharmāntararāhitye'pi tadyogakāryavyāvṛttibuddhihetutvāt | dharmapakṣe'navasthā'nyonyāśrayaṇe ca parihṛte; pratiyoginirapekṣajātyādereva bhedatvāt tasyaiva svaparanirvāhakatvābhyupagamācca || avidyāyāḥ brahmaṇo bhedo'sti vā, na vā? na cet, brahmaṇo jaḍatvādiprasaṅgaḥ; asti cet, sa bhedaḥ svarūpaṃ vā dharmo veti vikalpe dūṣaṇaparihārasāmyaṃ draṣṭavyam | kiñca svarūpadharmavikalpadūṣaṇaparihārā abhede'pi tulyāḥabhedaḥ svarūpaṃ cet, pratiyoginirapekṣābhedavyavahāraprasaṅgaḥ | "paramātmanā bhavatyabhedī", "ghaṭadhvaṃse ghaṭākāśo na bhinno nabhasā yathā" ityādiṣvabhedaḥ sapratiyogiko hyavasīyate | brahmādvitīyamiti padānāṃ paryāyatvaṃ syāt | dharmaścet, saviśeṣatvm | tataścāpasiddhānta iti |
itthaṃ viṣayadurnirūpatvapakṣe pratikṣipte bhedapratītyanabhyupagama eva pareṣāṃ śaraṇamiti taṃ nirākaroti api cetyādinā | prathamaṃ pratipattivirodha ucyate sanmātreti; yadicetyādinā vyavahāravirodhaḥ; sarvāsvityādinā śabdavirodhaḥ || nanvekatra smaryanta eva sarve śabdāḥ, sarvapratītīnāṃ sanmātraviṣayatvābhyupagamāt || naivam,ghaṭe pratipanne tatra paṭavyavahārāprasaṅgasyabhipretatvāt | atra pratidūṣaṇaṃ sanmātraśabdānuvṛttirdūṣyortho'yameveti smaraṇārthā | kiñcetyādinā pratītyavāntarajātiviśeṣavirodha uktaḥ | atra sanmātraśabdāprayogaḥ kiñcaśabdena dūṣyārthapratisandhānāt | dhārāvāhikajñāneṣu kālabhedo 'stīti tadvayāvṛttyarthaṃ viśeṣābhāvādityuktam | smṛtivailakṣaṇyaṃ na syāditi | jñātatayaiva parāmarśaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ || dhārāvāhikabuddhiṣviva jñātatāpārāmarśābhāvopapattiriti cenna; tatrāpratisandhānasya tādātvikabubhutsābhāvādhīnatvāt | atra tu satyāmapi bubhutsāyāṃ jñātatayāparāmarśābhāvo viṣayabhedameve vyavasthāpayati | pratisaṃvedanamiti | viśeṣābhyupagamaśaṅkā parasya gatyantarābhāvadyotanārthā | sarveṣāmityādinā karaṇavyavasthā'bhāvaprasaṅga uktaḥ | karaṇānāṃ vyavasthāsidhdyarthaṃ viṣayabhedānāha na cetyādinā | atra pūrvoktaviśiṣṭaviṣayapratipattivirodhavivaraṇam akāraṇatvadurnirūpakāraṇatvanirasanaṃ ca kṛtaṃ bhavati | rūpaikārthasamaveteti | rūpasamānāśrayasamavetetyarthaḥ | samavetaśabdo viśeṣaṇataikasvabhāvaparaḥ | viśeṣyata iti viśeṣaḥ | tena sanmātravilakṣaṇaparasparabhinnaviṣayatvasiddhiḥ || nanu sarvaṃ pratyakṣaṃ saviśeṣaviṣayamityuktam; śabdagandharasānāṃ sāśrayatayā dharmāntaravattayā vā grahaṇābhāvāt tadagrāhiṇaḥ pratyakṣasya kathaṃ saviśeṣaviṣayatvam || naitadevam; guṇakarmaṇorapi tattatsaṃsthānavattayā kālaviśiṣṭatayā ca saviśeṣatvena gṛhyamāṇatvāt | etacca nirvikalpakamapekṣyoktam | savikalpake tu deśādīnāṃ bahūnāṃ viśeṣaṇatvaṃ saṃbhavatyeva | indriyāṇāṃ lokasiddhahetubhiḥ sanmātraviṣayatvapratikṣepamupasaṃharati ata iti | pratyakṣasya sanmātraviṣayatvaṃ parābhyupagatārthāntaraviruddhaṃ cetyāha nivirśeṣeti | śāstrasyāprāptaviṣayatayā'rthavattvam, lokasiddhatvāt bhedasya śāstraviṣayitvaṃ vadadbhiḥ parairevābhyupetam | śrutiprāmāṇyavirodha uktaḥ;
