parābhimatārthāntaravirodhamāha sanmātrabrahmaṇa iti | tataḥ phalitamaniṣṭamāha tata iti | evamupapāditaṃ pratyakṣasya sanmātragrāhitvapratikṣepaṃ svābhimatārthāntaravyutpādanāya pratyakṣasya viśiṣṭaviṣayatve paryavasāyayati ata iti |ataḥ ityādibhāṣye'rthadvayamu ktamvastusaṃsthānarūpā jātiḥ, jātyādireva bheda iti ca | tatra prathamaṃ saṃsthānameva jātirityupapādayati saṃsthānetyādinā | kiṃ darśanena anupapattyā vā uta saṃsthānātiriktajātyabhyupagama iti vikalpabhipretya, darśanaṃ netyāha saṃsthānātirekiṇa iti | ayaṃ sāsnādimān ayamapi sāstrādimān,ayaṃ pṛthubudhnodarākāraḥ, ayamapi tadākāra iti sāsnādiranuvṛttabuddhivyavahāraviṣayoḥ dṛśyate; tadatirikto'nuvṛttadhīvyavahāraviṣayo na kaścidṛśyate; tasmādi tyarthaḥ | yadvā jātitayā svābhāmatāt saṃsthānāt parābhimatajāterasādhāraṇaṃ rūpamuktam ekākārabuddhibodhyasyeti | kalpanamapyanupapannamityāha tāvateti | vyutpattiranugataprayogaśca vyaktijātiviśeṣādiśabdā nāmiva gavādiśabdānāmapi susadṛśopādhivaśādupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ | nāmāntareṇa parābhimatajāterabhyupagatatvaśaṅkāvyudāsāyāha atirekavāde'pīti | parairavayavino'samavāyikāraṇatvena saṃsthānaṃ svīkṛtam | kimidaṃ saṃsthānaṃ nāma? kimavayavasaṃyogaviśeṣaḥ, uta svarūpamātram? utānyat kimapi? prathame, niravayaveṣvātmasu saṃsthānābhāvādātmatvādijātirna syāt | dvitīye pratyakṣasya viśiṣṭaviṣayatvaṃ na syāt; anugatavyavahāraśca na syāt; jātimātrocchedaśca syāt | tṛtīye gatyābhāvāt asmatpakṣāṅgīkāra iti śaṅkāyāṃ niravayaveṣvapi jātivyavahārasidhdyarthaṃ jātyajātisādhāraṇaṃ saṃsthānamātraṃ(?) darśayati saṃsthānaṃ nāmeti | ghaṭasya dravyatvaṃ saṃsthānaṃ mābhūdityasādhāraṇaśabdaḥ | rūpamapṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇam, tena garbhadāsādivyavacchedaḥ ||
nanu svāsādhāraṇamityatra svaśabdaḥ kiṃ vyaktiparaḥ? uta sajātīyaparaḥ? vyaktiparatve ca kimekavyaktiparaḥ? uta sarvavyaktiparaḥ? prathame, ekavyaktayatiriktavyaktiṣu gotvaṃ na syāt | svaśabdasya sarvavyaktiparatve, mahiṣavyaktā vapi gotvaṃ syāt | asādhāraṇaśabdaśca niṣphalaḥ | sajātīyaparatve jāteḥ saṃsthānaviśeṣatvāt samānasaṃsthānaviśeṣāṇāmasādhāraṇaṃ rūpaṃ saṃsthānamityuktaṃ syāt | tataścātmāśrayaḥ; saṃsthānanirūpaṇasya tatpratipattisāpekṣatvāt || naivam; svaśabdasya prakṛtaparatvāt prakṛtatvañca tadvayavahāragocaratayā buddhisthatvam || evaṃ tarhi khaṇḍe buddhisthe gotvaṃ tadasādhāraṇamiti muṇaḍe gotvaṃ na syāt | khaṇḍasya vā goḥ gotvaṃ saṃsthānaṃ na syāt; muṇḍe'pi vidyāmanatayā gotvasya khaṇḍa sādhāraṇatvābhāvāditi cennakhaṇḍaṃ prati gotvasya saṃsthānarūpatvābhāvāt | khaṇḍatvameva hi khaṇḍasya saṃsthānam | kiṃ tava khaṇḍo buddhisthaḥ? uta gauḥ? uta khaṇḍo gauḥ? prathame khaṇḍatvameva khaṇḍāsādhāraṇamiti na muṇḍe gotvābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ | ata eva khaṇḍaṃ prati gotvasya saṃsthānarūpatvābhāvaśca nāniṣṭaḥ | dvitīye, gorgotvamasādhāraṇamiti mahiṣādau gotvaṃ nivartate, goṣu ca vatarta iti na kaściddoṣaḥ | tṛtīye, yathā nīlotpalasya nīlatvaviśeṣitamutpalatvamasādhāraṇam evaṃ khaṇḍasya goḥ khaṇḍatvaviśeṣitagotvamasādhāraṇamiti muṇḍe khaṇḍatvaviśeṣitagotvameva nivartate, na gotvamātramiti na kācidanupapattiḥ | nīlatvaviśeṣitamutpalatvamindīvaraśabdapravṛttinimittatvādekaṃ saṃsthānam | khaṇḍatvagotve tu mitho viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve'pi naikaṃ saṃsthānam, ekaśabdapravṛttinimittatvābhāvāditi bhidā | ataḥ svāsādhāraṇarūpaṃ saṃsthānam || kastarhi jātirūpasāsthānānāṃ śauklyādibhyo bhedaḥ | svabhāvatāratamyābhāvāditi brūmaḥ | śauklayādiṣu hi śuklaṃ śuklataramiti tāratamyaṃ vidyate | śabdādiṣvapyupādhito vā svato vā tīvrataratvāditāratamyamupalabhyate | kharatvamṛdutvādisvabhāvatāratamyaṃ sparśādiṣvapyasti | saṃkhyāsvapi nyūnādhikabhāva upalabdhaḥ | parimāṇe ca sphuṭataraḥ | evaṃ gotvādiṣu gotaro gotama iti tāratamyaṃ nopalabhyate | emamādivaiṣamyaṃ draṣṭavyam | (saṃsthānasāmānyalakṣaṇapakṣaṃ tyukatvā ) jātirūpasaṃsthānalakṣaṇamiha vivakṣitaṃ cetprakṛtākāreṇa susadṛśavyaktayaḥ samastāḥ svaśabdena vivakṣitāḥ | prakṛtākāreṇeti ātmāśrayaḥ pari hṛtaḥ; saṃsthānanirūpaṇasya saṃsthānapratipattinairapekṣyāt | susadṛśaśabdena mahiṣādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ parihṛtaḥ | samasta śabdena muṇḍādiṣvabhāvaprasaṅgaḥ parihṛtaḥ | khaṇḍāsādhāraṇatvābhāvāt gotvasya |
nanu vyāvṛttaṃ saṃsthānamanuvṛttavyavahārasya kathaṃ niṣpādakam? ucyateyathā vyaktitvajātivirahe'pi bahvīṣu vyaktiṣu vyaktiśabdaprayogaḥ, yathā gotvāśvatvādijātiṣu jātyantarābhāvepi jātiśabdaprayogaḥ, bhinneṣu bhinnatvajātyabhāve'pi bhinnaśabdaprayogaḥ, khaṇḍādiṣu khaṇḍatvādijātyabhāve'pi khaṇḍādiśabdaprayogaḥ, yathā ca nityadravyeṣu viśeṣamicchatāṃ viśeṣeṣu viśeṣatvābhāve'pi viśeṣaśabdaprayogaḥ tadvat gavādiśabdavyavahāra upapadyata iti | kiñca ko'yamanuvṛttavyavahāraḥ iti nirūpyam | gakāraukāravisarjanīyānāmānupūrvīṃ yāvadākāśabhāvināṃ deśataḥ kālataśca nopapadya iti tasyā uccāraṇanibandhanatvāduccāraṇasya ca vināśitvādānupūrvī ca pratiyogivināśinītyānupūrvīviśeṣaviśiṣṭasya śabdasya kathamanuvṛttiḥ? || susadṛśatvameva śabdānāmanuvṛttiriti cet arthānāmapi gotvādīnāṃ tathābhūtānuvṛttirityaṅgīkriyatām || nanu kimidaṃ sausādṛśyam || ucyate | sadṛśabyavahārāsādhāraṇaheturviṣayadharmaḥ sādṛ śyam | sa ca bhrātṛtvavat pratiyoginirūpyapadārthaḥ prativyakti vyāvṛttaḥ | ato na vṛttivikalpādidaurdhaṭyam | nirdiṣṭākārapauṣkalyataḥ sādṛśyaṃ sausādṛśyamiti | viśeṣyavāciśabdapravṛttinimittapauṣkalyaṃ nirdiṣṭakārapauṣkalyaṃ vivakṣitaṃ pauṣyakalyaśabdena | gavayaniṣṭhagosādṛśyaṃ na sausādṛśyamiti sidhyati | nanvevaṃ tarhi prathametaragovyaktiṣu gavā susadṛśa ityeva prayogaḥ syāt; na tu gauriti iti cet yadi vivakṣā, tadā prayujyatāmayaṃ gauḥ, ayaṃ gavā susadṛśa iti prayoge'rthabhedābhāvāt || kiṃ tarhi na prayujyata iti cet vyavahāragauravāditi brūmaḥ, gauriti vyavahāre hi lāghavāt saukaryamasti | nanu tarhi tatsadṛśi tacchabdo māṇavake'gniśabdavadaupacārikaḥ syāt || na; sausādṛśyalakṣaṇānuvṛttyabhāvanibandhanatvādaupacārikatvasya | na hi māṇavakāgnyoḥ sausādṛśyam; kintu sādṛśyaleśamātram |
pakṣe tu sausādṛśyalakṣaṇānuvṛttirupalabhyate, tasya ca mukhyatāhetutvaṃ vṛddhavyavahārasiddham, yathā jātyādiśabdānām | ato'nuvṛttaprayoga upapannaḥ | kasmiścidarthe kasyacicchabdasya vyutpattiḥ tatsusadṛśe'rthe susadṛśasya tasyaiva śabdasya prayoge heturiti yathādarśanamabhyupagantavyam | apratipannamarthāntaraṃ kalpayitvā vṛttivikalpādidoṣāṇāṃ pratītiśaraṇatayā parihārādapi paridṛṣṭa eva vastuni pratītibalena codyaparihāro lāghavanyāyādupapadyate | vyāptigrahaṇañca sausādṛśyalakṣaṇānuvṛtterevopapadyata iti tadapi na tvadabhimatajātikalpakam | ataḥ saṃsthānānatiriktā jātiḥ ||
nanu saṃsthānasyāsādhāraṇākāratvāt tena vinā saṃsthāninaḥ pratītyanupapatteśca śuktayādau rajatādibhramo na syāt | na hyasādhāraṇākārasphūrtau bhramaḥ saṃbhavatīti cetna; kenā'pi saṃsthānena pratipannavastunipratipannasaṃsthānāvirodhyākāraviṣayabhramopapatteḥ | pratipannasaṃsthānavirodhyākārabhramasyaiva hyutpattyasambhavaḥ | idaṃ śuklamiti pratītau na kāṣrṇyādibhramaḥ | śauklayaṃ hi śukalasyāsādhāraṇam, na śukteḥ | ato'sādhāraṇākārapratītirbhrāntiścopapadyate || evamāpekṣikaṃ cedasādhāraṇyam, tarhyasādhāraṇaśabdavaiyarthyaṃ syāt | na hi kimapi rūpaṃ kasyacidasādhāraṇaṃ na bhava tīti cennaśuktayapekṣayā śauklayasya saṃsthānatvavyudāsārthatvādasādhāraṇaśabdasya | ataḥ svāsādhāraṇarūpaṃ saṃsthā nam; tato nātiriktā jātiriti siddham |
itthaṃ saṃsthānameva jātirityupapādya gotvādereva bhedatvaṃ pūrvaprastutamupapādayati jātigrahaṇeneti | pratiyoginirapekṣo gotvādiḥ pratiyogisāpekṣe bhedo bhavituṃ nārhati; ataḥ pratiyogisāpekṣataretarābhāvo gotvādyatirikto bhedo'bhyapagantumucita iti śaṅkāyāmucyate | jātigrahaṇenetipratiyoginirapekṣo gotvādiḥ pratiyogi sāpekṣo bhedobhavituṃ nārhati | ataḥ pratiyogi sāpekṣetaretarābhāvo gotvādyatirikto bhedobhyupagantuṃ ucita iti śaṅkāyāṃ ucyate | jātigrahaṇenaiva bhinna iti vyavahārasambhavāditi | ayamarthaḥgotvādivyatiriktabhedamaṅgīkurvatāpyabhāvābhāve pratiyoginirapekṣabhāvarūpapadārthasyaiva pratiyogisāpekṣābhāvatvamaṅgīkṛtam; anyathā'navasthānāt anupalambhācca | tadvadatrāpi saṃbhavati; pratiyogisāpekṣatvasya pratiyoginirūpitaveṣapravṛttinimittakaśabdasvabhāvādhīnatvenārthasvarūpabhedahetutvābhāvāditi | evamanupapattirnāstītyuktam; darśanañca netyāha padārthāntarādarśanāditi | nāmāntareṇetaretarābhāvābhyupagamaśaṅkāyāṃ vyudasyati arthāntareti |arthāntaravādināitaretarābhāvarūpo bhedo'pyastīti vadatetyarthaḥ | pūrvaṃ pratiyogyapekṣayā bhedavyavahāra ityuktam; atra tannirapekṣagotvādirbheda uktaḥ | tarhi bhedavyavahāro'pi pratiyoginirapekṣaḥ prasajedityabhiprāyeṇa codayati nanu ceti | ekārthaviṣayānekacodyaparaḥ īdṛśaścaśabdaḥ | satyamiti | pratiyogyanapekṣabhedasvarūpavyavahāre'bhyupagamaḥ,bhedaśabdādivyavahāraviśeṣe tvanabhyupagamaḥ | bhedaśca vyavahniyata eveti | na kevalaṃ gṛhyate, pratiyoginirapekṣaṃ vyavahniyate ceti cārthaḥ | upapādayati gotvādivyavahārāditi | kathaṃ gotvādivya hāre sati bhedavyavahāra ityatrāha gotvādiriti | gotvādireva kathaṃ vyāvṛttirityatrāha gotvādāviti | nirdiṣṭasāmānyānantaraparasāmānyāpekṣayā tadviśeṣāṇāṃ sajātīyatvaṃ vivakṣitam | atra tiryakatvena sajātīyo mahiṣādigotvavyavacchedyaḥ | vyāvṛtteḥ sajātīyabuddhivyavahāranivṛttihetutvamastu; tataḥ kiṃ vyāvṛttebhedatve ityatrāha bhedagrahaṇenaiva hyabhedanivṛttiriti | abhedanivṛttiḥabhedadhīnivṛttiḥ | evaṃ gotvādeḥ pratītau hānopādānādau gotvādiśabdavyava hāre ca na pratiyogyapekṣetyuktam; tarhi katham,yamasmādbhinna ityatra pratiyogyapekṣeti śaṅkāyāmāha ayamasmāditi | na hānādivyavahāre; nāpi śabdavyavahāramātre;api tu śābdavyavahāraviśeṣa eveti jñāpayati tu śabdaḥ |
bhedaśca vyavahniyata evetyādinā bhedagrahaṇenaiva hyabhedanivṛttirityantena kasyacidvastuno vastvantarādvyāvartakadhamarsyaiva svayameva svavyāvṛttirūpatvasambhavaḥ; paranirvāhakatvābhāve svanirvāhakatvāsambhavāt | svarūpe
prakāśamāne bhramavirodhinaśca na vyāvṛttirūpadharmāntarāpekṣetyuktaṃ bhavati | evañca sati brahmaṇaḥ kasyacidvastuno vastvantarādyāvartakadhamarrūpatvābhāvāt, svarūpe bhāsamāne adhyāsasahatvācca na svarūpameva vyāvṛttiriti sidhyati ||
nanu dharmiṇaḥ svarūpameva tadgatabhāvābhāvarūpasakaladharmāntarāpekṣayā bheda ityantato gatvā'bhyupagantavyam, bhedāntarābhyupagame tasmātsvarūpasya bhedāpekṣāyāmanavasthāprasaṅgāt || satyam | sa tu svarūpabhedo nādhyāsavirodhī; tannivṛttau dharmāntarānvayasāpekṣatvāt | paṭadravyasya rūpāvyatirekabhramo hi sparśasāmānādhikaraṇyabuddhinivatrtyaḥ | ato dharmisvarūpasya svagatadharmāpekṣayā bhramavirodhibhedo dharmāntarānvayaḥ | ato dharmaṇāṃsvarūpasyaiva svāśrayasya svaviruddhadharmāntaradhamaryantarāpekṣayā'dhyāsavirodhibhedatvasambhavaḥ | viśiṣṭasya tu vastunaḥ svarūpameva viśiṣṭaṃ svaviruddhaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭavastvantarādvayāvṛttiriti ca yuktam ,arthāntaraikyabhramavirodhitvāt | tatra viśeṣaṇāpekṣayā viśeṣyasya svarūpameva bhedaḥ | viśeṣyāpekṣayā viśeṣaṇasya svarūpameva bhedaḥ | tadubhayāpekṣayā ca sambandhasya svarūpa meva bhedaḥ | viśiṣṭasya viśiṣṭāntarāpekṣayā svarūpameva bhedaḥ | svarūpasya bheda iti nirdeśastu padārthasvarūpamitivadanatiriktārthaḥ | tattadasādhāraṇaśabdavācyaṃ svarūpam | sa ca śabdo vyutpattisiddhaḥ | pratiyogitayā'bhimatārthāntaraikyadhīvirodhi vā svarūpam | ataḥ kasyaciddharmatvābhāvāt dharmaviśiṣṭatvābhāvāt svarūpe bhāsamāne'pi bhramasahatvācca brahmaṇaḥ svarūpameva jaḍatvādyadhyāsavirodhinī vyāvṛttirbhavituṃ nārhatīti siddham ||
itthaṃ pramāṇaprameyānupapattī parihṛte; atha paroktamanumānamanūdya dūṣayati yatpunarityādinā | punaḥśabdaḥ kevalatarkādanumānasya vaiṣamyaṃ dyotayati | dṛśyatvānumānasya sūtrakāraireva dūṣayiṣyamāṇatvād vakṣyamāṇadūṣaṇasya mithyātvaviṣayasarvānumānānāṃ dūṣyatvapradarśanārthatvācca vyāvartamānatvānumānamiha dūṣyate | sādhāraṇadūṣaṇāni kālātyayāpadeśasopādhikatvavyāghātāḥ |
tatrāśrayaḥ pratīto na vā? na cet, āśrayāsiddhiḥ | pratītatve, pratītiśca pratyakṣādipramāṇaiḥ satyatveneti tasya mithyātvasādhanaṃ dharmigrāhakapramāṇabādhitam pratipannopādhau bādhitatvasya mithyātve prayojakatayā sopādhika tvañca vakṣyate | tatra deśakālaviṣayabhrameṣvapi vastvantarasyopādhitvāt anuditabādhakajñāneṣu bhrāntiṣvapi(?) codayitṛpuruṣajñānena bādhitatvācca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyāṃśasiddherviśiṣṭopādhisiddhiriti vistareṇa vakṣyāmaḥ |
sādhyadharmasya pāramārthyāpāramārthyavikalpe kṛte, pāramārthyaṃ cet,advaitahāniḥ; dṛśyatvahetoranaikāntyañca; paramārthe'pi tasya vṛtteḥ | apāramārthye, prapañcasatyatā; "bādhakabādhe bādhyasvarūpābādhaḥ" iti nyāyāt | ata eva hi, "dvau nañau prakṛtamartha sūcayataḥ" iti śābdaprasiddhiḥ | "dharme dharmāntarāropaṇena pratyavasthānādiyaṃ nityasamā jātiḥ" iti na vācyam; aprāmāṇikadharmaparamparāpādanena dūṣaṇaṃ hi nityasamā | mithyātvamithyātvaṃ prāmāṇikam; mādhyamikoktasya jñānabādhyatvasya bhavatā bādhyatvābhyupagamāt; paramārtharajjau rajjubuddheḥ sarvabudhdyā bādhyatvasya bādhyatvadarśanācca || tarhi satyatve'pi satyatvaṃ kimasti, uta nāsti? na cet, asatyaṃ jagatsyāt | asti cet, tasyāpi satyatvamityanavastheti cennasvaparanirvāhakatvābhyupagamāt | yadi tvayā mithyātve'pi svaparanirvākatvamaṅgīkriyate, tarhi mithyātvasyaiva svamithyātvanirvāhakatvāt mithyātvaṃ mithyātvāntaramanapekṣya svayameva mithyeti prapañcaḥ satyaḥ syāt || sādhanasya pāramārthyāpāramārthyavikalpe kṛtepāramārthye, advaitahāniḥ; apāramārthye, dhūmabu ddhayā gṛhītabāṣpavat asādhakatvamiti vyāghātaḥ || bhedavādināpi hi na prapañcasatyatvahetusatyatvasādhanapūrvakamanumānānyupanyasyante; tathāpi tadupapadyate; tadvanmamāpīti cennasatyatvāsādhane'pi nāsmākaṃ svābhyupagamavyāhatiḥ; tava tu mithyātvābhyupagamasādhakatvābhyupagamavyāhatiriti vaiṣamyāt || nanu na sādhanadharmapāramārthyamapekṣitam | nāśake mudgare naṣṭe'pi pūrvanaṣṭo ghaṭo naṣṭa eva dṛṣṭaḥ, notpannaḥ | tadvat bādhakajñānasya mithyātve'pi tadbādhitasya mithyātvaṃ tiṣṭhatyeveti cennakārakajñāpakayovaiṣamyāt | nāśako hi kārakaḥ | atastannāśyasya tasminnaṣṭe'pi nāśa eva; tathā darśanāt bādhakañca jñāpakaḥ | tasmin bādhite tadvādhyaṃ ca satyameva syāt | apavarakasthaghaṭābhāve kenacidukte astīti vacanena bādhite ghaṭasatyatvadarśanāt || nanu bādhakabādhe pūrvabādhitasya satyatvaṃ vaktumayuktam; bṛntaviṣayabhramaratvabhramabādhe'pi bhramaratvabuddhibādhitasya palāśapuṣpaviṣayāgnibhramasya abādhitatvadarśanāditi cettatra kiṃ vastunivṛttiḥ buddhinivṛttirvocyate? na prathamaḥ; dāvatvasya paramārthabhūtavṛntabādhyatvadarśanāt | buddhinivṛttiścet, sā na bādhakādhīnā | jñānānāṃ kṣaṇikatvāt svayaṃ nivṛtteḥ | bhramarabuddhistūtarakālīnadāvabuddhayutpattipratibandhikā | tatpratibandhakatvañca bhramarapāramāthyarbuddhereva | anyathā pūrvabhramanivṛttyabhāvadarśanāt | tataśca tvanmate kadācidapi na niśśeṣabhramanivṛttiḥ sidhyati | buddhinivṛtterbādhakavijñānajanyatvapakṣepi nivarttakajñānānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhrāntirūpottarottaranivarttakajñānāpekṣatayā bhramaparamparāpatteḥ | uttarasya kasyacit jñānasya svayaṃ nāśe kālpanikaghaṭādināśasyeva tannāśasya kālpanikatvāt nāśaklṛptirūpabhrāntiḥ sthireti niśśeṣabhramanivṛttirūpo mokṣo'nupapanna iti kṛtsnamithyātvaniśśeṣāvidyānivṛttivyāghātaḥ | evamādivyāghātā anusandheyāḥ | sopādhikatvaṃ cānantarameva vakṣyate |
dṛśyatvavyāvartamānatvayorasādhāraṇaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇyanaikāntyam | adhyastaṃ svādhiṣṭhānasamānādhikaraṇatayā vedyaṃ, yathā idaṃ rajatamiti | evaṃ ghaṭassan paṭassannityadhiṣṭhānasya sataḥ prapañcasya caikadhīvedyatvād dṛśyatvamanaikāntikam | yadyapi nabho malinamityadhyāse nabhaso acākṣuṣatvādekadhīvedyatvamadhyastādhiṣṭhānayorna niyatam, tathā pi sanmātrasya pratyakṣagrāhyatvaṃ paropagatamiti siddhamanaikāntyam || nanu dṛśyatvaniyamo'tra hetutayā vivakṣitaḥ | sa tu dṛśyatvaniyamaḥ sato nāsti; sataḥ svayaṃprakāśatvāt || tadapi katham | sadanubhūtyorbhedābhāvāditi cennaanyonyāśrayaṇāt; sadanubhūtyorbhedābhāve siddhe sataḥ svayaṃprakāśatvena dṛśyatvaniyamāsiddherdṛśyatvahetoranaikāntyaparihṛtiḥ, anaikāntikatve parihṛte bhedabhāva iti | yadyanumānāntareṇa bhedaniṣedhaḥ, tarhyasmin siddhasādhdyatā | evaṃ paropagamenaikāntyamuktam | kiñca brahmaṇo dṛśyatvaṃ śrutisiddham, "dṛśyate tvagrayayā buddhayā" "ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ" iti | anubhūtitvādityādyanumānena dṛśyatvābhāve sādhye kālātyayāpadeśaḥ | "yattadadreśyam" iti vākyāddṛśyatvaśrutirbā dhyeti cenna, dṛśyatvasāmānyaniṣedhaparatvāt tasya; "dṛśyate tvagrayayā buddhayā sūkṣmayā sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ" ityasya dṛśyatvaviśeṣavidhānaviṣayatvācca; "na cakṣuṣā gṛhyate nāpi vācā "nānyairdevaiḥ", "manasā tu viśuddhena" ityādau dṛśyatvaviśeṣaniṣedhadaśarnādadreśyamityādisāmānyaniṣedhasya tatparyamasāyitvācca || adreśyamityādisāmānyaśrutyā dṛśyatvābhāvasādhakānumānena ca brahmaṇo na dṛśyatvamiti cenna; tarhi "na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni" iti sāmānyaniṣedha śrutyā hiṃsātvādityanumānena ca agnīṣomīyarhiṃsānivṛttiprasaṅgāt | ato brahmaṇi dṛśyatvamanaikāntikam | anaikāntike (katve?)parijihīrṣite brahmaṇo mithyātvaṃ vābhyupagantavyaṃ syāt || dṛśyataikasvabhāvatvaṃ hi hetutvābhimatamiti nānaikāntyame; brahma hi svayaṃprakāśamiti na dṛśyataikasvabhāvamiti cennatadānīṃ hetorbhāgāsiddhiḥ syāt; cidacidātmake prapañce jīvāṃśasya svayaṃprakāśatvāt | acidaṃśamātrapakṣīkāre hetorjīvagatanityatvādidharmeṣvanaikāntikatvam | te hi dharmabhūtajñānavedyā eva, paramārthabhūtāścā || vyāvarttamānatvamapi brahmaṇyanaikāntikam; anṛtādibhyo vyāvṛttatvenābhyupagamāt | tacca svarūpamātramiti na śakyaṃ vaktum, brahmaṇaḥ kasyaciddharmatvābhāvāt adhyāsasahatvācca | vyāvarttamānatvasya svarūpatve'pi tat svakāryakaram anubhūtitvavat | hetoḥ svarūpānatireke 'pi sādhanadaśāyāṃ kāryakaratvam, na tu dūṣaṇadaśāyāmiti niyāmakābhāvāt | kiñca brahmaṇi svarūpaṃ vyāvṛttiścet, ghaṭādiṣvapi tathā'stu | yadi brahmaṇi svarūpātiriktā sā, tarhi ghaṭādiṣvapi tathā syāt | sarvathānaikāntyamavarjanīyam | jaḍādivyāvṛttatvaṃ brahmaṇo'paramārthaścet vastuto brahma jaḍameva syāt | aparamārthaśabdaśca niṣphalaḥ; ghaṭādā vapi vyāvarttamānatvasya mithyātvena vyāvartyābhāvāt | tataścānaikāntyaṃ sustham; aparamārthasyaiva hetutayā tvayāṅgīkṛtatvāt tasya ca vipakṣe'pi varttamānatvāt | kiñca anuvarttamānasya sanmātrasya niṣedhasya tatparyavasāyitvācca | adreśyaminyādi sāmānya vyāvarttamānebhyo ghaṭādibhyo vyāvṛttirasti vā na vā? asti cet, tata eva vyāvarttamānatvahetubrahmaṇyanaikāntikaḥ | no cet, ghaṭādiṣviva vyāvarttamānatvaṃ brahmaṇi syāt; vyāvarttamānebhyo vyāvarttamānatvābhā vāt | yathā rajatādivyāvṛttaṃ rajatam, tathā vyāvarttamānādavyāvṛttamapi hi vyāvarttamānameva bhavati |ata ubhayathāpi brahmaṇyanaikāntyam || nanu brahma jaḍādivyāvṛttameva; vyāvarttamānatvaṃ ca satyam; tacca svarūpamiti nādvaitahāniḥ | tasya ca satyatvānna jaḍatvādi brahmaṇaḥ | tataśca nānaikāntyam | aparamārthabhūtaṃ ghaṭādigataṃ vyāvarttamānatvaṃ hi hetu riti cetyadyaparamārthabhūtaṃ ghaṭādigataṃ vyāvarttamānatvaṃ hetutayā vivakṣitam, tarhi asiddho hetuḥ; ghaṭādīnāṃ mitho vyāvṛtterasatyatvopagamāt |
yatpunarityādinā sopādhikatvaṃ pratijānīte | pūrvaṃ pareṇa bādhasyāpi pakṣād(da?) vyāvṛttyupapādanenopā dhitvaṃ pratyuktam; tadvayudāsāya pakṣe bādhābhāvaṃ darśayituṃ bāghaṃ śikṣayati dvayoriti | virodhe satyeva bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ; na tvasnāstītipratyayamātrayorityarthaḥ | bādhitasyaiva vyāvṛttiriti | pratipannopādhau bādhitasyaiva mithyātvasā dhikā vyāvṛttiḥ; na tvagṛhītatvamātraṃ mithyātvasādhakamityarthaḥ | atra vyāvṛttiviśeṣo vyāvṛttiśabdoktaḥ uttaratra vyāvartamānatvamātramiti mātracpratyayasadbhāvāt | tataḥ kiṃ pakṣe bādhābhāvasyetyatrāha atreti | deśayoḥ kālayośca bhede sati avirodhaṃ darśayituṃ tayoraikye virodhabādhau darśayati yasminniti | bhāvābhāvavirodhādanyatarasya bādhyatve sati balavato bādhakatvamitarasya bādhitatvāt nivṛttiścetyarthaḥ | ca evārthe | bādhitasyaiva tvadabhimatavyāvṛttiviśeṣa ityarthaḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇyānarhatvaṃ virodhaḥ | aduṣṭakāraṇajanyā niṣedhadhīrbādhaḥ | aduṣṭakāraṇajanyatve sati niṣedharūpatvaṃ bādhakatvam | purovartini abhāvo'navabhāso vā satyatvāvabhāsābhāvo vā nivṛttiḥ | pakṣe ghaṭādau deśakālabhedena virādhabādhābhāvāvupapādayati deśāntareti | virodhabādhābhāvāt tatphalabhūtanivṛttirapi netyāha anya treti | anyatra nivṛttasya | anyatravirodhabādharahitasthale nivṛttasya | anyatra virodhabādharahitasthale | yadvā anyatra svadeśakālavyatiriktadeśakālayoḥ | anyatra svadeśakālayoḥ | etadvaidharmyaṃ dṛṣṭāntena vivṛṇoti rajjusarpādiṣviti | tuśabdo ghaṭādivaiṣamyaparaḥ | ityaṃ dūṣaṇopayoginī vyāptiḥ śikṣitā; athānumānadūṣaṇasidiṃdha daśaryati iti deśakālāntareti | itirhetau | mithyātvaṃ vyāpakam; vyāvartamānatvaṃ vyāpyam | vyāvartamānatvamātramiti mātraśabdena virodhabādhahetukavyāvṛttirvyāvatrtyate | yadvā, vyāvarttamānatvahetorasidiṃdha pratijānīteyatpunarityādinā | tadarthaṃ bādhamūlaṃ virodha ityāha dvayo riti | pakṣe tadabhāvaṃ darśayati atreti | virodhābhāvamupapādayati yasminniti | tatphalanivṛttimāha anyatreti | dṛṣṭānte tadvaidharmyaṃ darśayatirajviti | evamasidiṃdha vaktuṃ vibhāgo darśitaḥ | athāsiddhimāha iti deśakālāntareti | sopādhikatvamārtham |
ayamarthaḥkiṃ paṭo'stītyatra ghaṭābhāvaḥ siṣādhayiṣitaḥ uta ghaṭo'stītyatrāpi tadabhāvaḥ? prathame siddhasādhyatā | dvitīye vyāvarttamānatvaśabdena kiṃ vyāvṛttibuddhibodhvatvaṃ mithyātvahetutayā vivakṣitam, uta pratipannopādhau bādhitasya vyāvṛttiḥ | prathame sopādhikatvam | dvitīye hetvasiddhayā ghaṭādeḥ satyatvamiti || nanu bādhārhatāyā upādhitve sādhyāviśiṣṭatā syāditi bādhikatvamevopādhiḥ syāt; tasya na sādhyasamavyātiḥ | asahāyena gacchatā pathi dṛṣṭasya rajjusarpasya kenāpnyabādhitatvāditi cetnaivam,īśvarādijñānena bādhitatvaniyamāt | anabhyupagateśvarā dīnāṃ pakṣe'pyamupādhireva; kiṃ tvayā tasya pathi dṛṣṭasya rajjusarpasya mithyātvaṃ pramāṇato'vagatam, na vā? na cet, samyak sarpa eveti tatrāvṛttirna sādhyasamavyāptyabhāvāya syāt | avagataṃ cet, tata eva jñānāttasya bādhitatvaṃ siddhamiti sādhyasamavyāptisiddhiḥ || nanu kiṃ pratipannopādhau bādho mithyātve prayojakaḥ; uta kevalabādhaḥ? prathame, deśakālayorupādhitvāt deśakālabhramasya deśakālopādhikatvābhāvena sarvasapakṣānanuyāyitvena sādhyasamavyāptyabhāvāt pratipannepādhau bādhau nopādhiḥ syāt | dvitīye kṛtsnamithyātvamiti || atrocyatena hi deśakālāveva upādhiriti niyamaḥ; kintu vastvantaramapi upādhiḥ | upādhiḥ avacchedakaḥ | atarāva hi deśakālādipratipannopādhau abādhitatvādityatrādiśabdena vastvantarasyāpyupādhitvaṃ bhāṣyakārairvakṣyate | tasmāt deśakālabhrame vastvantaramupādhiḥ | deśakālābhramasya vastvantaramupādhikatve'pi vasubhramasya deśakālopādhikatve nānyonyāśrayaḥ, bhramavyaktibhedāt | tasmāt yadavacchedakāvacchinnaṃ yat pratipannam, tadavacchedakāvacchinnasya bādho mithyātve prayojakaḥ | yadvāāropitena sāyantvādinā tannivarttakena divātvādinā ca vinā kriyāntarāvacchinnakālasya bhrāntyupādhitvam; evaṃ deśe'pīti na kaściddoṣaḥ | evaṃ viśiṣṭopādhau viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyāṃśayoḥ patihṛtā'nupapattikatvena viśiṣṭopādhisiddhiḥ | ato na vyāvarttamānatvamātramapāramārthyahetuḥ | kaiścidevamuktam ghaṭo'stītyatra kiṃ ghaṭostiśabdau paryāyau uta na? paryāyatve saha prayogo na syāt | no cet, sadvilakṣaṇo ghaṭa iti || naivam; "asti brahmeti cedveda"ityādau ca astibrahmaśabdayoḥ paryāyatve paunaruktyam; no cet, brahmaṇo'pi sadvilakṣaṇatvamiti | umayatrāyaṃ parihāraḥsvaśabdaprāpta sya svabhāvasyaiva niṣedhārthānuvādaśaṅkāparihārāyāstiśabdena niyamaḥ kriyata iti ||
atha pāramārthyasādhakatvenoktamanuvarttamānasvaṃ dūṣayati yattvityādinā | pramāṇasambandhārhatattadghaṭādisvarūpasya sacchabdavācyasya kiṃ pāramārthyaṃ sādhyate, uta udhiṣṭhānatayā'nuvṛttasvārthāntarasya iti vikalpe dvitīyaśirasyāśrayāsiddhimābhipretya prathame sirasi siddhasādhanatvaṃ dūṣaṇamuktam | nanu sadeva paramārtha iti hi granthakārābhiprāyaḥ, tat kathaṃ siddhasādhanatvamiti || ucyate | etadanumānaṃ kiṃ sataḥ pāramārthyasādhakam, uta vyatiriktāpāramāthyasya, utobhayasya? | prathame siddhasādhyatā | dvitīye vyadhikaraṇa'siddhatā (ca) | tṛtīyeaṃśe siddhasādhyatā, aṃśe vyadhikaraṇāsiddhiśceti | nigamayati ata iti | pareṇa pramāṇaprameyānupapattikṛtaṃ bhedadūṣaṇamupajīvya anubhūteḥ sato(anubhūtisatoḥ) bhedo'pāstaḥ | atra ca bhedadūṣaṇahetvābhāsanirāsamupajīvyānubhūtisatorabhedaśca nirasyate anubhūtītyādinā |anubhūtisadviśeṣayorityatra viśeṣaśabdena anuvarttamānatvahetorāśrayāsiddhiḥ sūcyate; sacchavdavācyasya vastuno vyāvattatvādanuvṛttārthāntarābhāvācca || sacchabdaḥ pramāṇasambandhayogye hi varttate | ghaṭaḥ san paṭaḥ sannityanuvṛttavyavahāro vyāvṛttaśabdavat upapanna iti pramāṇasambandhārhāḥ padārthāḥ parasparavyāvṛttāḥ sacchabdavācyāḥ ||
atha parokte svayaṃprakāśatve'bhimate tatrāpi śikṣaṇīyāṃśo'stītyabhiprāyeṇāha yattvanubhūteriti | tuḥ pakṣavaiṣamye | vaktavyāṃśamāha tat viṣayaprakāśanavelāyāmiti uttaratra varttamānadaśāyāmiti hi vakṣyate | tasya jñānasya nityadravyatvena sadā varttamānatvāt varttamānadaśāyāmiti padaṃ nirarthakamiti śṅkāpanuttaye viṣayaprakāśanavelāyāmityuktam | varttamānadaśāśabdena viṣayasambandhaprasarasya varttamānatā vivakṣitetyavagamyate | na tu sarveṣāmityetadupādayati parānubhavasyeti | (na?)sarvadetyetadupapādayati svānubhavasyāpīti | anubhūtiścedityanena svāśrayaṃ prati viṣayaprakāśanavelāyāmityuktavaiṣamyaviraho garbhitaḥ | evamanubhūteranubhāvyatvasambhavamupapādya tadasaṃbhave paroktamanumānaṃ dūṣayati anubhūteriti | kuta ityatrāha svagateti | parānubhāvanumeyatvānabhyupapagame laukikavyavahāravirodhamaniṣṭamāha pareti | atha vaidikavyavahāravirodhamāha ācāryasyeti | parānubhavānumānānabhyupagama ityādinā cārvākanirāsacca phalitaḥ; anumānānabhyupagame śabdārthasaṃbandhagrahahaṇāyogāt | evaṃ bādha uktaḥ; atha vyāptiṃdūṣayati na cānyeti | na hyasādhāraṇākāro dharmigrāhakamānasiddhiḥ sādhāraṇākāre sati ayapagacchatītyabhiprāyeṇānubhūtirūpaṃ śikṣayati anubhūtitvamiti | atrānubhūtiśabdo jñānamātraparaḥ; na tu smṛtivilakṣaṇaparaḥ | prakāśamānatvamityukte ghaṭāderapyanubhūtitvaṃ syāditi tadvyāvṛttyarthaṃ svāśrayaṃ pratītyuktam | aṇutvanityatvādhyātmadharmāṇāṃ jñānāntaraprakāśyatvāt tadvayāvṛttyarthaṃ svasattayaivetyuktam | atītānubhavavyāvṛttyarthaṃ varttamānadaśāyāmityuktam | yadyapyatītānubhavasya jñānāntaramantareṇa prakāśānupapatterarthāt (asaṃbhava) vyavacchedaḥ; tathā'pyatītasya jñānāntareṇa sidiṃdha parānabhimatāṃ vyutpādayitumidiṃ viśeṣaṇam | viṣayasambandhasya vartamānadaśāyāmityarthaḥ | varttamānadaśāyāṃ svasattayaiva prakāśamānatvamityukte parānubhave tadasaṃbhavāt tadvayāvṛtyarthaṃ svāśrayaṃ pratītyuktam | etallakṣaṇaṃ svayamprakāśatvavādināmeveṣṭamiti sarvasampratipannaṃ lakṣaṇamāha svasattayaiveti | svāśrayaṃ prati vartamānadaśāyāmiti padadvayānukarṣasyopalakṣaṇaṃ svasattayaiveti padam | sādhanamityukte daṇḍacakrāderapi tathātvāt tadvayāvṛttatyarthaṃ viṣayasādhanetyuktam | cākṣuṣajñānaṃ śrāvaviṣayaṃ na sādhayatīti sarvaviṣayasādhanatvāsaṃbhavāt tadvāvṛttatyathar (sarvaviṣayāsādhanatvāsaṃbhavavyāvṛttyarthaṃ)svaśabdaḥ | indriyavyāvṛttatyarthaṃ svasattayaiveti padam | tadasambhavāttadvayāvṛttyartaḥ svāśrayaṃ pratītyuktam | cākṣuṣajñānaṃ śrāvaṇaviṣayaṃ na sādhayatīti sarvaviṣayasādhanatvāsambhavavyāvṛttyartha svaśabdaḥ | indriyavyāvṛttyartha svasattayaiveti padam | indriyādikaṃ hi na kevalaṃ svasattayā prakāśakam; api tu jñānotpādanadvārā | varttamānadaśāyāmityatītānubhavavyāvṛttiḥ svāśrayaṃ pratīti parānumavavyāvṛttiḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha te ceti | evamananubhāvyatvalakṣaṇasādhyadharmapratikṣepekṣaṇānubhāvyatvenānubhūtitvasya sāmānādhikaraṇyadarśanāt ananubhāvya tvena vyāptirnarākṛtā; tarhi kathamanubhāvyatve'nanubhūtitvadarśanamiti śaṅkāyāṃ sopādhikatvamāha ghaṭādestviti | ananubhūtitvamanubhūtiśabdena vyavahartavyatvābhāva iti na sādhyāviśiṣṭatā | yadvā uktayorlakṣaṇayoranyataradanubhūtitvam; na tu samuccitamubhayam; anyonyanirapekṣatvāt; vāśabdaprayogācca | na hi caśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ | tatrānyataralakṣaṇārāhityarūpam ananubhūtitvam anyatarākāravirahaprayuktamiti sopādhika(tva)mityuyarthaḥ | atha pratitarkaparāhatimāha tathānubhūteriti | yadvā ābhāsasamānayogakṣematvamāha (tathānubhūteriti)| gaganakusumāderananubhūti tvasya upādhyantarasattvaṃ śaṅkate gaganeti | ghaṭāderananubhūtitvasyāpyupādhyantaramajñānāvirodhitvamāha evaṃ tarhīti | prakāśaniyamābhāvāvirodhitvam ajñānāvirodhitvam | na ca sukhādāvabhāvāt sādhyasamavyāptyabhāvaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ,; sukhāderjñānaviśeṣatvenānanubhūtitvābhāvāt | ajñānāvirodhitvasyopādhitva nirāsāya pakṣe tat prasañjayati anubhūteriti | tat bhavatpakṣe'pi tulyamityāha ananubhāvyatve'pīti | anubhūteranubhāvyatve'nanubhūtitvasya upādhitvenoktamajñānāvirodhitvamananubhāvyatve'pi prasajyata ityarthaḥ | anubhāvyatve'nanubhūtitvamajñānāvirodhitvañca yaduktam, tat ananubhāvyatve'pi gaganakusumāderiva prasajyata ityuktam || gaganakusumādāvananubhūtitvamajñānāvirodhitvaṃ cāsattvaprayuktam, nānanubhāvyatvaprayuktamiti cetananubhāvyatve tadvat asattvamapi prasajyate || gaganakusumāderasattvaṃ nānanubhāvyatvamātraprayuktam; api tu svayamprakāśatve sati ananubhāvyatvavirahaprayuktamiti anubhūterananubhāvyatvamātrānnasattvaprasaktiriti cetananubhāvyatve tadvat asvayamprakāśatvamapi prasajyate(prasajati) | ataḥ asvayamprakāśatve sati ananubhāvyatvaprayuktamasattvamanubhūterduvāram || asattvaṃ tu dharmigrāhakapramāṇaviruddhamiti cet; anubhāvyatve'nanubhūtitvamapi tathetyevamanusandheyamiti bhāṣyābhiprāyaḥ | khapuṣpodāharaṇe tu nāśrayavaikalyadoṣaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ,khyāternāsaditi vyatirekadṛṣṭāntatvasya paraiḥ svīkṛtatvāt | "śabdajñānānupātī vastuśūnyo'vabhāso vikalpaḥ; sasvabhāvastvavabhāsaḥ pratītiḥ" iti hi tairucyate | tatrābhāsapratītasyāpi niṣedhādhikaraṇatvaṃ yuktamiti bhāṭṭāṅgīkṛtañca |ataḥ paramataprakriyayā khapuṣpamudāhṛtam | upahāsyamsamīpasthairapi hāsyamityarthaḥ |
atha paroktaṃ nityatvaṃ vyudasyati yattvityādinā || nanu jñānanityatvamabhyupayadbhiḥ kathaṃ tannirasanaṃ yuktam? ucyate;jñānāśrayabhūta ātmā | tadāśritaṃ ca saṅkocavikāsārhaṃ nityaṃ jñānadravyaṃ parasyānabhimatam | yattu prastutamindriyasaṃyogādyanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyi pratyakṣatvaparokṣatvapramāṇatvāpramāṇatvāvasthaṃ lokasiddhaṃ jñānam, tasya yadi nityatvamupapādyate, tat vyudasyate viṣayasambandhijñānasya hi svayamprakāśatvaṃ pareṇa samarthitam | svayamprakāśatvasamānādhikaraṇaṃ ca nityatvaṃ parasyeṣṭam, svatassiddhatayā nityatvasamarthanāt | atastannirāso yuktaḥ | tatra ca mṛddravyasya siddhatvepi ghaṭatvādyavasthamṛddṛvyānityatvavāt | jñānākhyadravyasya nityatve'pi smṛtitvānubhūtitvādyavasthajñānānityatvaṃ yuktamiti na svapakṣavirodhaḥ | svayamprakāśatvepi kiñcidupādeyatvamastīti tadvayāvṛttyarthastu śabdaḥ | andhasya jātyatdhena yaṣṭiḥ pradīyata iti | asiddhamatyantāsiddhena hetunā sādhyata ityarthaḥ | tatra hi grāhakābhāvāt grāhyābhāvācca prāgabhāvābhāva uktaḥ; tamāśaṅkaya grāhako'stītyāha prāgabhāvasyeti | tatra vikalpe pūrvapakṣiṇokte, satyevāvagamayatīti pakṣaṃ sthāpayituṃ tatroktaṃ virodhaṃ śaṅkate kathamiti | tadānīmityabhāvaviśeṣaṇam; na kriyāviśeṣaṇam | pariharati nahīti | svasamakālavarttitvaniyamaḥ kiṃ grāhyasāmānyaprayuktaḥ? utahatadgrāhyaviśeṣaprayuktaḥ iti vikalpābhiprāyeṇa prathamaṃ grāhyasāmānyaprayuktatvapakṣaṃ prativadati | na hyanubhūtiriti | yadvāvarttamānagrahaṇaniyamaḥ kiṃ grāhakānubhūtisvabhāvāt? uta grāhyānubhūtyabhāvasvabhāvāditi vikalpamabhipretya prathamaṃ dūṣayati na hīti | hi śabdo hetau | neti pratijñā adhyāharttavyā |
grāhyaviśeṣapakṣaṃ dūṣayituṃ śaṅkate atha manyasa iti | grāhyaviśeṣasya samakālavarttitvaniyamoktirdarśanapūrvi kaiva syādityabhiprāyeṇāha kiṃ tvayeti | kkacitanubhūtau | vyāptigrahaṇabhūmitvenābhāvasya dṛṣṭatvātprāgabhāvo durapahnava ityāha hanta tarhīti | prāgabhāvasya samakālasiddhyā vyāptiranubhūtiprāgabhāvarūpe dharmiṇi gṛhīte hi sidhyatītyarthaḥ | ādiśabdaḥ pradhvaṃsaparaḥ | samakālavarttitvaniyamamabhyupagamya dūṣaṇamuktam | samakālavarttitvaṃ cānupapannamityāha tatprāgabhāvañceti | yadi svasamakālavarttigrahaṇaniyamo'nubhūternāsti, tarhyavidyamāne ghaṭe'pi cākṣuṣaṃ jñānamupapadyetatatrāha indriyajanmana iti | pratyakṣaśabdena pratyakṣajñānamucyate | ayamabhiprāyaḥsvasamakālavarttigrāhakatvaniyamo na jñānamātrasya; na ca tadavāntarabhedapramāṇajñānasya; na ca tadbhrāntarabhedapratyakṣasya; api tu pratyakṣaviśeṣarūpa sya aindriyikajñānasyeti | na sarveṣāṃ jñānānāṃ pramāṇānāṃ ceti | caśabdena pratyakṣasya cetyuktaṃ bhavati; upapādakagranthānuguṇyāt | kuta ityatrāha smaraṇānumāneti | smaraṇaśabdena sarvajñānāmāṃ samakālavarttiviṣayatvaniyamavyudāsaḥ | anumānāgamaśabdena pramāṇamātrasya tanniyamavyudāsaḥ | yogipratyakṣādiśabdena pratyakṣamātrasya tanniyamavyudāsaḥ | ādiśabdena īśvarapratyakṣaṃ gṛhyate | prameyasadbhāvo na cet, pramāṇāpramāṇajñānayoḥ kathaṃ vaiṣamyamityatrāha ata eveti | ata evajñānamātrasya samakālavarttigrāhakatvaniyamābhāvena | prameyāvinā'bhāvaśca siddha ityarthaḥ | anyathā varttamānaviṣayālābhādasamakālavarttigrāhiṇā tattatpramāṇānāṃ prameyāvinābhāvo na sidhyediti bhāvaḥ | tatsiddhiḥ kathamityapekṣāyāṃ tamevāvinābhāvaṃ vivṛṇoti na hi pramāṇasyeti | pramāṇasyārthasambandha ityanvayaḥ | tarhi prameyāvinābhāvaḥ ka ityatrāha apitviti | yaddokālādītyādiśabdena saṃsthānamucyate | mithyātvapratyanīkatā | mithyātva sya pramāṇaṃ pratyanīkaṃ bhavati; tasya bhāva ityarthaḥ | yadvā mithyātvapratyanīko'rtho bhavati | tasya bhāvo mithyātvapratyanīkatā | sā pramāṇasyārthasambandha ityanvayaḥ | ata evetyādibhāṣyasyaivaṃ vā'rthaḥata evapramāṇatvena sampratipannānāṃ kālāntaravarttigrāhakatvadaśarnāt tatrāpi prameyāvinābhāvaḥ kalpyata ityarthaḥ | kathaṃ tatrāvinābhāvaḥprakāraḥ ityatrāha na hītyādi | anenaiva pramāṇaprameyāvinābhāvarūpaviṣayaviṣayibhāvarūpaśikṣaṇena bauddhaikadeśibhiruktaṃ smṛternirviṣayatvaṃ nirasyata ityaśyābhyupetavyamidamityabhiprāyeṇāha ata idamapīti |
evamanubhūtireva prāgabhāvagrahaṇakṣametyupapāditam; atha tadgrāhiṇā'nubhavena pratyakṣādyanyatamena bhavitavya miti, tadasambhavena pramāṇābhāvāt prāgabhāvābhāvaṃ (va iti)śaṅkate athocyeteti | liṅgādyabhāvāditi ādi śabdena anumānaśabdau vivakṣitau | tadvivṛṇoti na hītyādinā | nigamayati ata iti | upamānasya pratipannavastusādṛśyasaṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhayoranyataramātragocaratvenāpratipannapadārthapratipādanāsāmarthyādanupanyāsaḥ |
pariharati yadīti | yadiśabdaḥ kimarthaḥ | cecchabdo yadyarthaḥ | svaparipāṭī vihāya śāstramaryādāyāṃ kimavatīrṇo'pi; tathā cedityarthaḥ | pramāṇamāha yogyānupalabdhyaiveti | pareṇābhāvapramāṇasyāṅgīkṛtatvāt yogyānupalabdhyaivetyuktam | svapakṣaparyālocanāyāmapi jñānasya yogyānupalabdhirnāma bhāvarūpāvasthāntaropalabdhiḥ | piṇḍatvādyupalabdhireva hi dhaṭasya yogyānupalabdhiḥ | ato'tītakālāvacchinnajñānābhāvo nāma jñānasya saṅkocaḥ arthāntarajñānaṃ vā | pūrvakālīnagajajñāne bubhutsite tatkālīnasvāpādipratisandhānaṃ ghaṭādijñānapratisandhānaṃ vā gajajñā nasya yogyānupalabdhiḥ | sā ca liṅgatayā pūrvakālīnajñānābhāvaniścāyikā | yaduktaṃsaṃvidaḥ iyamiti viṣayīkārānarhatvena abhāvo durgrahaḥ ititadayuktam;tathā sati prāgabhāvanirāsānupapatteḥ | na hyanyasya ghaṭādeḥ prāga bhāvo nirasyate; api tvanubhūteḥ | tasmādanubhūtim iyamiti viṣayīkṛtya tasyāḥ prāgabhāvo nirākaraṇīyaḥ | iya miti viṣayīkārābhāve'pi tatprāgabhāvo nirākartuṃ śakyate cet; tadabhāve'pi prāgabhāvaḥ sādhayituṃ śakyate | yadi tvayā viṣayīkṛtā, tadvadasmābhirapi viṣayīkṛteti tadabhāvaḥ susāgha ityanusandheyam | uttaratra nityañcediti granthe hyayayamartho'pyabhipretaḥ |
evaṃ prāgabhāvasya yogyānupalabdhisiddhatvamabhidhāyārthāpattimapyāha kiñcetyādinā | jñānasya svāvabhāsāsthiratvalakṣaṇayogyānupalabdhyā anityatvamuktam; atha viṣayaprakāśanirūpaṇamukhenāpi tadupapādyate | aviśeṣeṇa jñānābhāvasya grahaṇamupapannamityuktam | atha kiṃ bhavatā nityatvaṃ saviṣayajñānasya viṣādhayiṣitam, uta nirviṣayasya iti vikalpamabhipretya saviṣayapakṣaṃ dūṣayati pratyakṣetyādinā | sarvadāghaṭasattākāle savasman(ghaṭo?)na pratīyata ityarthaḥ | ghaṭādeḥ pūrvottarakālasattā na pratīyatām; tataḥ kimityatrāha tadapratītiśceti |apratītiḥjñānasya ghaṭavyāvahārānuguṇyābhāvaḥ | ato na sādhyāviśiṣṭatā | niyamena svasamakālavarttigrāhiṇaḥ pratyakṣajñānasya pūrvottarakālayorvidyāmāne'pi ghaṭe tadaprakāśakatvaṃ tadānīṃ svābhāvādevetyarthaḥ | evaṃ viṣayavyavahārānuguṇyakādācitkatvānyathānupapattyā jñānānityatvamuktam | arthāpattyantaramā(mapyā)ha ghaṭādiviṣayameveti | viṣayasamakālavarttinaḥ pratyakṣasaṃvedanasya nityatve ghaṭādirapi nityaḥ syāt; ato ghaṭādyanityatvā'nyathānupapattyā jñānānityatvamityarthaḥ | arthāpattyantaramāha nityañcediti | saṃvido nityatvasādhanaṃ saṃvidiyamiti viṣayīkṛtyaiva karttavyam | svataḥsiddhatveneyamiti viṣayīkārānarhatvāt svayameva nityamiti pratīyeta, na ca tathā pratīyate; tasmādanityatvamevetyarthaḥ | evaṃ nityatayā'navabhāsānyathā'nupapattyā jñānānityatvamuktam || anityatayā'navayāsāt nityatvamiti cenna; pūrvāparāvadhisāpekṣasya anityatvasya sadbhāve'pi avadhidvayāsvayamprakāśatvādeva anityatvāprakāśatvopapatteḥ | yadvā ghaṭādinityatvaprasaṅgo nityatvenāvabhāsaprasaṅgaśca viṣayavyavahārānuguṇyakādācitkatvānyathānupapatteranugrāhakatarkata yoktau bhavataḥ ||
athānumānādiviṣayāṇāmapi nityatvamaniṣṭaṃ prasañjayati evamiti | evampratyakṣajñānanityatve viṣayanityatvaprasaktau satyāmityarthaḥ | kuto nityam,atrāha (nityatetyatrāha) saṃvidanurūpeti | yathā saṃvit svaviṣayaṃ darśayati, tathābhāvāditi tadarthaḥ || nanu pratyakṣasya samakālavarttiviṣayatvaniyamāt tannityatve viṣayanityatvaprasaṅga upapannaḥ | anumānādisaṃvidām atītānāgataviṣayatvasambhavāt kathaṃ tannityatve viṣayanityatvaprasaṅgaḥ || ucyate | atītānāgatate hyāpekṣike vartete | tataḥ saṃvidapekṣayā hi viṣayasyātītatvānāgatatve | saṃvido nityatve tadapekṣayā viṣayasyātītatvānāgatatve saṃvinna darśayatīti kālānavacchinnatayā pratītau (tāḥ)viṣayā nityāḥ syuriti | kālānavacchinnatvamevānugataṃ nityatvalakṣaṇamityabhiprāyeṇa kālānavacchinnāḥ nityā ityuktam || nanu na saṃvidapekṣayā viṣayasya'tītatvāgāmitve; kintu liṅgādyarthāntarāpekṣayā | tato viṣayasya liṅgādyapekṣayā'tītatvamāgāmitvañca saṃbhavatīti na nityatvaprasaṅgaḥ || ucyateliṅgādeḥ pratyakṣajñānaviṣayatvāt tannityatvena tadviṣayabhūtaliṅgāderapi nityatvāpātāt tadapekṣayānumānaviṣayasyātītatvamāgāmitvañca saṃvinna darśayatīti kālānavacchinno nitya eva viṣayaḥ syāditi || evaṃ pūrvoktadoṣamupajīvya anumānaviṣayanityatvaprasaktirityabhiprāyeṇa evamityuktam; |
evaṃ pūrvoktavikalpe saviṣayānubhavasya nityatvaṃ nirākṛtam; atha nivirṣayānubhavasya nityatvapakṣaṃ nirākaroti na ceti | kuta ityatrāha anupalabdheriti | na kevalaṃ nirviṣaya saṃvidanupalabdhereva, saviṣayasaṃvida eva pareṇa svayamprakāśatvasamarthanāt tadabhyupagamaprakāreṇāpi nirviṣayā saṃvinnāstītyāha viṣayeti | tataḥ kitityatrāha saṃvido viṣayeti | saviṣayajñānottīrṇāyāḥ saṃvidaḥ kadācidapi viṣayasambandhābhāvena svayamprakāśatvāsiddherjñānāntarābedyatvācca tucchatetyarthaḥ || nanu yadi viṣayaprakāśakatayā svayamprakāśatvamupapādyate, tadā'yaṃ doṣaḥ syāt | viṣayasambandābhāve'pi anubhūtitvādityanena sādhyasvaprakāśatvasiddhiriti cetkimidamanubhūtitvam? kiṃ svataḥ siddhatvam? tadā sādhyāviśiṣṭatā syāt | yadi viṣayaprakāśakatvamanubhūtitvam, tadānīṃ muktadoṣaḥ syādeva | vidyamānadaśāyāṃ sarvadā bhāsamānatvamapi na tvayā hetutvena vācyam; sukhaduḥkhecchādau jaḍatvena tvadabhimate vyabhicārāt | ato viṣayaprakāśakatvamanupajīvya svayaṃprakāśatvaṃ duḥsādhamityuktadoṣānativṛttiḥ | kathaṃ svaprakāśatvarūpasādhyadharmanivṛttau dharmibhūtasaṃvidasiddhirityatrāha anubhūteranubhavāntarānanumāvyatvācceti | nanvekasyā eva saṃvidaḥ antaḥkaraṇavṛttidvārā viṣayasambandhaḥ kādācitkaḥ | tadvigamepi svapādidaśāsu svaprakāśā saṃvicchakāstīti na tucchatāprasaktirityatrāha na ceti | kevalaśabdena nirāśrayatvamucyate | kuta ityatrāha yogyeti | tadevopapādayati tāsva pīti | viparyaye paryavasānaṃ darśayati | na ca tadastīti | vyāpakābhāvo hi vyāpyābhāvasādhakaḥ | smaraṇañca nānubhavavyāpakam | atastadabhāvo na anubhavābhāvasādhaka ityāha nanviti | pathi gacchatā spṛṣṭatṛṇādīnāṃ prāgjanmānubhūtārthā(dī)nāṃ cāsmaraṇāditi bhāvaḥ | pariharati ucyata itiyādinā | viṣayāntaravyāsaṅgādirasmaraṇamātrahetuḥ | viṣayavaicitrīvirahaḥ, niṣprayojanatayā tātparyābhāvaḥ, tādātvikatīvrasaṃvedanāntaram, anubhavānabhyāsaśca asmaraṇamātrahetutayā hi prasiddhāḥ | ato niyamaśabdaḥ | asmaraṇaniyama ityukteḥ | janmāntarānubhūtasyāpyanubhavābhāvaprasa ṅgāt tadvayāvṛttyarthaṃ nikhalasaṃskāretyuktam | dehavigamādītyādiśaśabdena nārakaduḥkhaprasūtivyasanakālavipra karṣā vivakṣitāḥ | yathā saṃvitsiddhau, "prāyaṇānnarakakleśāt prasūtivyasanādapi | cirānni(ti)vṛttāḥ prāgjanmabhana smṛtigocarāḥ " iti | dehavigamādīnāṃ nikhilasaṃskāratiraskṛtikaratvaṃ svabhāvaḥ | puṇyaviśeṣādapavādāt kasyacidekasya jātismṛtiḥ | prabalaśabdovyāsaṅgādyapekṣayā prābalyaparaḥ | uktatiraskārakābhāve kadācidapi smaraṇamanubhavavyāpakam | atastadabhāvo'nubhavābhāvasādhaka evetyarthaḥ | na kevalamanubhavasādhakābhāvaḥ, bādhakapramāṇāntaramapyastītyāha na kevalamiti | siddheriti anubhavābhāvasyetyanuṣaṅgaḥ | athāsmaraṇaniyamasyānyathāsiddhimāśaṅkate na ceti | ahaṅkāravigamaḥahaṃ pratyayavigamaḥ | pariharati arthāntareti | ghaṭānanubhavaḥ paṭavināśaśca anubhūtakuḍyādyasmaraṇakāraṇaṃ na dṛṣṭamityarthaḥ | nanu kuḍyādeḥ smaraṇaṃ prati ghaṭāderakāraṇatvāt tadabhāvo nāsyāḥ smaraṇahetuḥ; iha tu smaraṇakāraṇasyābhāvo'smaraṇahetureva || naivam; kuḍyādismaraṇaṃ prati ghaṭāderiva jñātṛjñeyayorapi smaraṇaṃ prati akāraṇatvamakāmenāpi svīkāryāmityabhiprāyeṇa hyarthāntaraśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ | ayamarthaḥjñātṛjñeyayoḥ smaraṇaṃ prati kāraṇatvaṃ dṛṣṭatvādaṅgīkriyate cet, dṛṣṭatvādevānubhave'pi jñātṛjñeyayoḥ kāraṇatvamaṅgīkāryam | yadi jñātṛjñeyayordṛṣṭatve apyanubhavakāraṇatvaṃ nāṅgīkriyate smṛtāvapi kāraṇatvaṃ na syāt | atastadabhāvānna smaraṇābhāva iti etaddūṣaṇamahamarthābhāvamabhyupagamyoktam | ahamarthābhāvopi nāstītyupapādayiṣyata ityāha tāsvapīti | anuvarttateprakāśate | tato heturasiddhaścetyarthaḥ ||
pūrvaṃ saviśeṣo'nubhavaḥ svapādidaśāsvastītyuktamiti tadālamvya vyāghātābhiprāyeṇa codayati nanviti | a trāha satyamuktamiti | sa tvātmānubhavaḥ | nānubhūtyanubhava ityarthaḥ | anubhūtivirahe sa ātmā nirviśeṣaḥ syādityatrāha sa ceti | pratyakatvānukūlatvaviśiṣṭa ityarthaḥ | iha kiṃ niṣidhyata ityatrāha iha tviti | śabdāntareṇāsmanmatamaṅgīkṛtamiti śaṅkate kevalaiva saṃvidātmānubhata iti cediti |ātmānubhavekevalātmānubhavadaśāyām | svāpādidaśāyāṃ yā saṃvit tvayā nityatayā abhyupetā, sā prasaraṇābhāvena viṣayāvacchedavirahāt tadānīṃ kevalā nirviśeṣā asmaduktaiva syāditi | pariharati sā ceti | sā cadharmabhūtā saṃvit | viṣayavirahitā'pi(vā) vā sāśrayetyarthaḥ | kevalaivetyāderevaṃ vārthaḥātmānubhavarūpā ātmasphuraṇarūpā yā saṃvit, sā kevalaiveti cetasmadukta(ktā?)sakalaviṣayādiviśeṣaśūnyaiveti cedityarthaḥ | pariharati sā ceti | sādharmisphuraṇarūpā yā saṃvit; sā sāśrayeti vakṣyate | sphuraṇaṃ hi sphurato dharmaḥ | yathā prabhāśrayasya dīpasya dharmiṇaḥ aujjavalyaṃ dīpākhyadharmigato dharmaḥ, tadvadityarthaḥ | dharmisvarūpabhūtajñānasya sphuraṇaṃ nityam | tacca bhāsamānatā; vyavahārānuguṇyam | dharmabhūtajñānasya sphuraṇaṃ viṣayasambandhajanyaṃ tadānīmeva; na tvanyadā | tata eva hi viṣayaprakāśanavelāyāmiti pūrvamuktam | "puṃstvādivattvasya" ityatra ca vakṣayate | svāpādau tu tasya sarvaviṣayasambandhārhatā pratibaddhā, vahnerdāhakatvaśaktivat | ato na tadā sphuraṇam |
atha prāsaṅgikamātmānubhavaṃ parisamāpya prastutaprāgabhāvasiddhi nigamayati ata iti | ataḥnirviṣayajñānasyāprāmāṇikatvāt davacchinnajñānanityatvasyoktānupapattiparāhatatvāt prāgabhāvagrāhakasamarthanāccetyarthaḥ || kathamanubhūtiḥ satī svaprāgabhāvaṃ sādhayet || itthamsmarttavyāsmaraṇaliṅgena iyantaṃ kālaṃ na kiñcidahamajñāsiṣamiti suṣuptyavasthāparāmarśena jñānasāmānyābhāvagocareṇa tadantargatasvābhāvopi svenaiva viṣayīkṛta iti svataḥ pakṣe prāgabhāvasiddhiruktā | parataḥpakṣepi sidhdyatītyāha anubhūteriti | atha prāgabhāvābhāvahetukānanutpattidūṣaṇamupasaṃharati tasmāditi |
athānutpattyā vikārāntaranirasanaṃ dūṣayati yadapītyādinā | anutpattirūpahetvasiddhyā vikārāntaranirāso'nupapannaḥ | tadabhyupapagame'pi, hetorvyabhicāmāha prāgabhāva iti | tadvivṛṇoti tasya hīti | bhāvaśabdopādāne, tadvirahe'pi, vyabhicārasāmyābhiprāyeṇa bhāvaśabdopādānamupālabhate bhāveṣvitīti | nātra (natu)pratijñā ntaraṃ dūṣaṇamucyateṃ | taddhi uktidūṣaṇam: na tvarthadūṣaṇam | bhāvarūpatve vyabhicāraṃ darśayati tathā ceti | tathāśabdena bhāvarūpatvaṃ vivakṣitam; tairbhāvarūpājñānasya samathirtatvāt | tatra parihāraṃ śaṅkate tadvikārā iti | asya viśeṣaṇa sya vyāvartyābhāvānnairarthakyamāha kiṃ bhavata iti | vyāvatyarmasti cetadvaitahāniḥ | na cet viśeṣaṇavaiyarthyamityarthaḥ | kiṃ vikāramātrābhāvaḥ sādhyate, uta paramārthavikārābhāvaḥ? prathame'naikāntyam | dvitīyenubhūtiḥ paramārthavikārarahitā ajatvādityuktaṃ syāt | yat paramārthavikāravat tat utpannam, yathā ghaṭa iti vyatirekodāharaṇaṃ vācyam | ghaṭasya paramārthavikārānabhyupagamāddṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyāvyāvṛtta iti hetorvyāpyatvāsiddhirbhavediti bhāvaḥ ||
athājatvāt nānātvaniṣedhaṃ prativadati yadapīti |atra kiṃ bhedamātraṃ dudūṣayiṣitam? uta vijātīyabhedaḥ? uta vijātīyabhedaḥ, uta svagatabhedaḥ, iti pakṣeṣu hetvasiddhayā nirasteṣvapi hetutvābhyupagamena prathamaṃ dvitīyaṃ śiraśca dūṣayaṃścārvākavyatiriktasarvavādisammatasthale vyabhicāraṃ darśayati ajasyaiveti | mṛṣāvādyabhimatasthala eva hetoranaikāntyamāha avidyāyā iti | "tamaḥprakāśayoriva viruddhasvabhāvayoritaretarābhāvānupapattau tamaḥprakāśayoriva viruddhasvabhāvayoritaretarabhāvānupapattau satyām" iti hi tadgranthaḥ | tadvibhāgasya mithyātvamāśaṅkaya tadabhyupagamena pariharati sa vibhāga ityādinā | janmapratibaddhaḥutpattivyāptaḥ | ghaṭādiṣu paramārthavibhāgasyaiva utpattivyāpyatvābhyupa game ghaṭādivibhāgasya pāramārthyaprasaṅgāt, tasyāpāramārthye viśeṣaṇavaiyarthyāduktadoṣaḥ syādevetyarthaḥ | hetudūṣaṇasya bubhutsāyām, dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavyāvṛttatvamukhena vyāpyatvāsiddhirabhipretānusandheyā | yat paramārthavibhāgavat utpannam | yathā ghaṭa iti hi vyatirekadṛṣṭāntaḥ | ghaṭasya paramārthavibhāgavattvānabhyupagamāt sādhyāvyāvṛttatvaṃ hi spaṣṭam | vibhāgasya mithyātve dūṣaṇāntaramāha avidyāyā iti |atha sajātīyabhedābhāvaṃ vyudasyati abādhiteti | pūrvaṃ pramāṇaprameyānupapattimithyātvānumānānirāsamukhena dṛśyabhedaḥ samarthitaḥ | tattulyanyāyatayā darśanabhedo'pi siddha ityarthaḥ | avacchedakagato bhedaḥ, na tvavacchedyagata iti ghaṭakarakā'kāśadṛṣṭāntamāśaṅkayāha chedyabhedāditi | yathā saṃvitsiddhau, "pratipramātṛviṣayaṃ parasparavilakṣaṇāḥ | aparokṣaṃ prakāśante sukhaduḥkhādivat dhiyaḥ || saṃbandhivyaṅgayabhedasya saṃyogecchādikasya tu | na hi bhedaḥ khato nāsti nāpratyakṣaśca saṃmate ||" iti | pratipramātṛviṣayaṃ jñānabhedoparokṣaḥ | parajñānaṃ parokṣatayā bhāsate; svajñānamaparokṣatayā | ghaṭādiviṣayajñānānāṃ parasparavailakṣaṇyaṃ cāparokṣam | atastadbhedāpalāpaḥ svānubhavapratyakṣabādhita iti prathamagranthārthaḥ | sarvamekaṃ jñānaṃ jñātṛjñeyarūpāvacchedakasambandhabhedādbhedena pratīyata itya trāha sambandhīti | sambandhivyaṅgayabhedasyeti śaṅkābījānuvādaḥ | na ca jñātṛjñeyarūpasambandhivyaṅgayatvamātreṇa jñānasya bhedaḥ sambandhibhedakṛta iti aupādhikaḥ syāt; saṃyogāderapi saṃbandhivyaṅgayatvamātreṇa ghaṭakarakāvacchinnākāśavadekatvaprasakteḥ | saṃbandhī hi dvedhāsattāheturvyaktihetuśceti | yasya saṃyogādeḥ sambandhivyarirekeṇa svarūpe pramāṇaṃ nāsti, tasya saṃbandhī sattāhetuḥ; yasya tu śabdākāśāderasti, tasya tadupādhiko bhedāvabhāsaḥ; na svataḥ | tasmāt jñātṛjñeyavyatirekeṇālabdhasadbhāvasya jñānasya svābhāvika eva bhedaḥ | tasmānna sajātīyabhedāpalāpa ityarthaḥ | etadabhipretya chedyabhedādityuktam ||
atha svagatanityatvaikatvādibhedanirāsārthaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā anubhūtiṃ pakṣīkṛtyoktam anubhūtitvāditi vyatireki, dṛśyaṃ pakṣīkṛtyoktaṃ dṛśyatvādityanvayi ca dūṣayati yadapītyādinā | anaikāntikamiti | aniyatam; vyāptiśūnyamityarthaḥ | dṛśyatvādityanvayinaḥ pakṣatrayavṛttitvalakṣaṇamaniyatatvam; dṛśitvāditi vyatirokiṇaḥ sādhyavyāvṛttāvapi sādhanāvyāvṛttilakṣaṇamaniyatatvamātram | anubhūtirna dṛśyadharmavatī dṛśitvāt; yad dṛśyadharmavat tanna dṛśiḥ, yathā ghaṭaḥ iti hyanumānaśarīram |atra dṛśyadharmavattvasya adṛśitvavyāptiranubhūtau bhagnā, tasyāḥ dṛśitvanityatvādidharmavattvāditi bhāvaḥ | nityatvādimithyātve nityatvādiviparītākārānityatvaṃ prasajediti tatparihārāya teṣāṃ svarūpamātratvamāśaṅkaya pariharati na cetyādinā | teṣāṃ svarūpamātratvaṃ kimanvayarūpāṇām, uta vyatirekarūpāṇāmiti vikalpamabhipretya, anvayamukhena svarūpamātratvaṃ saṃbhāvitaṃ śira iti dūṣitam; na tu parābhyupagamāt | hetumāha svarūpabhedāditi | svarūpādbhedaḥ teṣāṃ parasparaṃ bhedaśca vivakṣitaḥ | anena pūrvaṃ vidhābhedavivādadaśarnādityuktaṃ vivṛtaṃ bhavati | saṃvedanatvasvayamprakāśatvayoḥ svarūpabhedamāha svasattayetyādivākyadvayena | prakāśyate'neneti prakāśanam; vyavahārānuguṇyāpādakamityarthaḥ | ubhayatrānugataprakāśaśabdātharmāha prakāśaśceti | cidacidaśeṣapadārthāḥ tadā hi vyavahārānuguṇāḥ, yadā tadvayavahārahetuṣu jñānaṃ sannidhatte | tatrācidaṃśasya svavyavahārasāmagrayantarbhūtajñānavattvaṃ vyavahārānuguṇyam | vedyatve cidaṃśasyāpyevam | svaprakāśatve tu svavyavahārāsāmagrayāṃ jñānāntarānapekṣayā svasyāntarbhāvaḥ | yadvā, evañcāhuḥ,vyavahārānuguṇyaṃ vyavahārapratisambandhitvam, prakāśa ityarthaḥ | tacca jñaptijñātroḥ svataḥ | jñeyasya tu jñānāpādyam | ataḥ purovarttino ghaṭāderapi tadeva prakāśaḥ; na prākaṭyam, tadatiriktābhyupagame'pi na jñānasya svaprakāśatvavirodhaḥ; tasya tannirapekṣasidditayā prākaṭyasya jñānānumāpakatvānabhyupagamāt | yadvā jñānagataprakāśāsādhāraṇaṃ lakṣaṇamāha cidaciditi | cidacidaśeṣapadārthāpekṣayā sādhāraṇaṃ jñānagataṃ cidvayavahārānuguṇyañca prakāśaḥ; svaparavyavahārānuguṇyaṃ prakāśa ityarthaḥ ||
nanvacito viṣayatvamavigītam; tacca bhāsamānatvam | acito vyavahārānuguṇyaṃ hi jñānagataṃ cet, ghaṭaḥ prakāśata iti vyavahārāmukhyatvaṃ syāt; jñānagataprakāśasya tatsambandhinyupacaritatvāt | na ca jñānasambandha eva ghaṭādervyavahārānuguṇyam; vyavahārānuguṇyāpānasvabhāva iti jñānalakṣaṇakathanāyogāt | saṃbandhasya dviniṣṭhatayā purovartino ghaṭoderapi taddhetutvena sambandharūpavyavahārānuguṇyāpādakatvaṃ hi jñānajñeyasādhāraṇaṃ syāt || ucyate | vyavahārakarmatvarūpaṃ vyavahārānuguṇyaṃ sādhāraṇam | taddhi vyavahārapratisaṃbandhitvam | tadeva bhāsamānatvam | ghaṭaḥ prakāśata iti vyavahāraśca tannibandhanatayā mukhyaḥ | vyavahārapratisambandhitvaṃ prati hetutvarūpavyavahārānuguṇyaṃ jñānasyaiva | tatra pratyakatvānukūlatvaikatvalakṣaṇasya svasya vyavahārapratisambandhitāṃ prati hetutvarūpaṃ vyavahārānuguṇyaṃ jñātṛsvarūpabhūtajñānasyaiva svasvarūpasvagataikatvaparāktānukūlatvādyākārakhāśrayatatsambandhasvaviṣayatatsambandhānāṃ vyavahārapratisambandhitve hetutvarūpaṃ vyavahārānuguṇyaṃ tu dharmabhūtajñānasyaiva |ataḥ svaparavyavahārānuguṇyaṃ jñānāsādhāraṇaprakāśalakṣaṇamiti yuktam ||
atha nityatvamāha sarveti | yadyapi kālānavacchinnatvamanugataṃ nityatvalakṣaṇaṃ prāguktam | sadakāraṇatvañca nityatvaṃ prasiddhamtathāpi saṃvidaḥ kālavyatiriktatvāt kālavyatiriktārthanityatvaṃ kṛtsnakālasambandhavyāptamiti tenāpi saviśeṣatvāpādanāya kālavyatiriktārthanityatvalakṣaṇamatroktam |
dharmāṇāmabhāvarūpatve'pyanaikāntyamāha teṣāmiti | abhāvarūpāṇamapi svarūpānatiriktatve dūṣaṇamāha saṃvidi tviti | tuśabdena prāguktaśauklayādidṛṣṭāntavaiṣamyabhihābhipretam | tasya kasyaciddharmatvena svaparanirvāhakatvāt, svarūpe pratipanne bhramavirodhitvācca svarūpameva vyāvṛttiḥ | brahmaṇastu kasyaciddharmatvenānabhyupagamāt, svarūpe pratipanne'pi bhramasahatvācca puro'vasthitaśuklabhāsvaraśakalasyeva na svarūpameva vyāvṛttiriti | saṃvidastītiśabdo nityasvayaṃprakāśādiśabdāśca kimadhikārthāḥ utānadhikārthāḥ? adhikārthatve saviśeṣatvam; anyathā padāntaravaiya rthyam, svarūpamātrasyāvigītatvāt | nityatvādisādhanairhetubhiḥ kiṃ saṃvinmātraṃ sādhyate, uta tadatiriktaṃ kiñcit |
prathame siddhasādhyatvam; dvitīye saviśeṣatvamityevaṃ samānādhikaraṇapadaprayogānupapattirnityatvādisādhakahetūnāṃ siddhasādhanatvaṃ cābhipretam | yathā saṃvitsiddhau, "na vedyaṃ vittidharmaḥ syāditi yat prāgudīritam | tenāpi sādhitaṃ kiñcit saṃvido'sti na vā tvayā | asti cet pakṣapātaḥ syāt na cet te viphalaḥ śramaḥ || " iti | nityatvādidharmāṇāṃ parasparabhedānabhyupagame ekenaiva dharmeṇa sādhitenālam; na tu dharmāntaraṃ sādhyam; tasya pūrvaprasādhitadharmānatiriktatvāt | na hi nityatve prasādhite kālāparicchedaḥ punarapi sādhyo'vatiṣṭhate | evaṃ nityatvādīnāṃ svarūpādbhedaḥ parasparabhedaśca siddhaḥ |
pareṇa saṃvido nirbhedatvāpādanamukhena tasya ātmatvaṃ saṃdhitam | atra nirbhedatvanirākaraṇamukhena saṃvidātmatvaṃ nirākartumāramate api cetyādinā | tatra saviśeṣatvamāpādayituṃ vikalpayati saṃvitsidhyati vā na veti | kiṃ pratītā utāpratītetyarthaḥ | prathamaṃ śiro dūṣayati sidhyati cediti | sarvapramāṇānāṃ saviśeṣaviṣayatvasya pūrvamupapāditatvāditi bhāvaḥ | yadvā sidhyadvastu siddherāśrayatayā saviśeṣaṃ syātsiddhiḥ prakāśaḥ; vyavahārānuguṇyadharmayo gī syādityarthaḥ | śirodvayāpādi(padi)tadoṣaparihārāya paroktaṃ śaṅkate siddhireveti | siddheḥ siddhayantarānapekṣa tvāt pramitiviṣayatvaprayuktaṃ siddhisambandhitvarūpaṃ saviśeṣatvaṃ na syāt | athāpi tucchatvaṃ ca na bhavet; na ca śaśaśṛṅgaṃ siddhirūpamiti bhāvaḥ | tatrāpi saviśeṣatvamāha kasyeti | pratītiścet, kasyacidāśrayasya kiñcidviṣayaṃ prati bhavediti tadubhayaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ | vipakṣe bādhakamāha yadīti | tadvivṛṇoti siddhirhīti | pitṛḥ sthāne viṣayaḥ, putrasthāne āśrayaḥ, putratvasthāne siddhiḥ | putratvasya hi putraḥ āśrayaḥ | kasyacidityuktaṃ jñātrapekṣāpratikṣepaṃ śaṅkate ātmana iti cediti | ātmānaṃ pratītyarthaḥ | ātmaśabdaḥ svavācī | anena pratyaktvaṃ phalitam | siddhipratisaṃbandhī svātmā hi pratyak | svasmai bhāsamānatvaṃ pratyaktvamiti hi vakṣyate | tacca saṃvido'nupapannamityabhiprāyeṇāha ko'yamātmeti | ayaṃśabdaḥ siddhipratisambandhitvaparaḥ | siddhipratisambandhyātmā kaḥ | kiṃśabdaḥ kṣepe | saṃvinna siddhipratisambandhyātmā | saṃvidaḥ pratyuktamanupapannamityarthaḥ | saṃvidātmatvasyopapāditatvānnānupapannamiti codayati nanviti | pariharati satyamuktamiti | saṃvidātmatvasya duruktatvaṃ saṃvidātmatvanirākaraṇamukhenopapādayitumārabhate tathā hīti | karmanirdeśo dṛṣṭāntatvena | arthajātamiti | dharmadharmirūpapuñja eva pramitiviṣaya iti bhāvaḥ | siddhirūpā prakāśarūpā; ata eva tadubhayasambandhinī | kathamiti |ātmadharmabhūtā saṃvit svayaṃ kathamātmetyarthaḥ |
siddhiśabda utpattijñaptisādhāraṇa iha kimarthaḥ? prakāśaścediha vivakṣitaḥ, | sa kaḥ? tasya karmakartṛsambandhitve kiṃ pramāṇam? vṛttijñānaṃ hi sakarmakartakam, saṃvittu kevalā | iha karmanirdeśe kiṃ phalamiti śaṅkāyāmāha etaduktaṃ bhavatīti | anubhūtirityanena jñaptiparatvamuktam | svāśrayaṃ prati svasadbhāvenaiva kasyacidvastuno vyavahārānuguṇyāpādanasvabhāva ityanena tatsvarūpamuktam | evaṃ siddhiśabdārtha uktaḥ | jñānāvagatisaṃvidādyaparanāmetyanena jñānasaṃvicchabdayoḥ paryāyatayā vṛttijñānasaṃvidovirbhāgasya niṣpramāṇakatvaṃ phalitam | ghaṭamahaṃ jānāmītyādinā, ātmasākṣikaḥ prasiddha ityantena karmakartṛsambandhasya svānubhavasiddhatvaṃ jñānasaṃvidoḥ paryāyatvañcoktam | tatra svānubhavasiddhatvamuktam | jñānasaṃvicchabdayoḥ paryāyatvamupapāditañca | karmakartṛsaṃbandhe parabhyupagatimāha etatsvabhāvata yeti | ātmanaḥ svayamprakāśatvaṃ sādhayatā karmakartṛsambandhijñānasya svayamprakāśatvaṃ sādhitamiti sakarmakaṃjñānaṃ jaḍarūpamātmabhūtajñānādanyat vṛttirūpamityabhyupagamo'nupapanna iti bhāvaḥ | asyetyādinā karmanirdeśasya phalaṃ darśitam | nanu na vayaṃ saṃvidaḥ karttṛtvamicchāma iti kathamayaṃ prasaṅgaḥ || ucyate | saṃvida ātmatvaṃ vadatā pratyakatvamabhyupetavyam |
pratyaktvañca jñānāśrayasyaiveti saṃvido jñātṛtvamavarjanīyam | tacca durghaṭamityarthaḥ | karttṛtvamāśrayatvam | dhātvarthāśrayo hi kartā |
evaṃ dharmadharmabhāvena pratītyā saṃvidātmatvaṃ nirākṛtam | atha sthiratvāsthiratvavaidharmyeṇa tad vyudasyate | tatheti | hirhetau | tathāśabdena cārthena hetvantaramucyate | kartṛsthairyamupapādayati karttṛsthairya tāvaditi | pratyabhijñāyamānatvāddhi ghaṭādeḥ sthairyasiddhiḥ; tadvat tatra ghaṭapratyabhijñākāle pūrvaṃ mayā anubhūta iti karturapi pratyabhijñāviṣaya tvāt sthairyasiddhirityarthaḥ | atha jñānasyotpattisthitinirodhān darśayati ahamityādinā | jānāmītyanenotpattisthitī siddhe | ajñāsiṣamityatītatvapratītiḥ | evadvaiśadyāyānantarapūrvakālasañjātajñānaviśiṣṭatvaparāmarśadyotanārthaṃ jñātureva mametyuktiḥ | utpattyādaya iti ādiśabdena sthitinirodhagrahaṇam | saṃvida utpattirnāma tricaturakṣaṇasthāyinyāḥ tasyāḥ prathamakṣaṇayogaḥ; kṣaṇāntarasambandhaḥ sthitiḥ | saṃvidaḥ svaprakāśatvāt te pratyakṣe | ghaṭasaṃvido niro dho nāma paṭasaṃvit | sā ca pratyakṣā | itirhetau | sthiratvā sthiratvavaidharmyeṇa na tadaikyamityarthaḥ | evaṃ pratyabhijñāviṣayatvenā''tmanaḥ sthairyabhuktam | atha pratyabhijñāśrayatvena sthairyamucyate evamiti | pūrvatra pratyabhijñāpratyakṣasiddhamityuktam; atra pratyabhijñā na ghaṭata ityuktam |ayamabhiprāyaḥpratyabhijñāviṣaye jvālādau yatra kkacidanyathāsiddhiḥ saṃbhavet, tatra na sthaiyarsiddhiḥ | atra pratyabhijñāviṣayatvānyathāsiddhāvapi pratyabhijñāśrayatvasyānanyathāsiddhatvāt bhrāntirūpapratyabhijñāyāmapi tadāśrayasya sthairyamananyathāsiddhamiti pratyabhijñāśrayatvaprayuktaṃ sthairyaṃ duṣprakampamiti | pratyabhijñāśrayatayā sthairyaṃ vivṛṇoti anyeneti |
evaṃ sthirasya jñāturdharmatvenāsthiratvena ca pratītatvāt asthiratvanibandhanātpratisandhānāsaṃbhavācca saṃvidātmatvaṃ nirastam; atha sthiratvābhyupagame'pi pratisandhānāsaṃbhavādātmatvaṃ vyudasyati kiñceti | anubhūterātmatvābhyupagame tasyā nityatvepīti | ātmatvābhyupagamaupayikatayā saṃvido nityatvābhyupagame'pītyarthaḥ | na kevalamanityatvapakṣa eva saṃvidātmatvānupapattiḥ; nityatve'pi ityapiśabdārthaḥ | ātmā hi pratisaṃdhatte; pratisaṃdhānamatra na saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ | tadasaṃbhavamupapādayati pratisandhānamiti | tadudāharati ahamiti | tataḥ kimiti śaṅkāyāṃ tasya parāniṣṭatvamāha bhavata iti | na kevalaṃ bhavadanabhyupagamaḥ, anubhūteranubhavitṛtvaṃ gamanakriyāyā gantṛtvavat anupapannaṃ cetyabhiprāyeṇāha anubhūtiriti | mātracā anubhavitṛtvavyāvṛttiḥ | nanu dharmatvāsthiratvāpratisandhātṛtvaiḥ saṃvido nātmatvaṃ yaduktam, tanna vaktavyam; anubhavitṛtvasyātmākāratvenānabhyupagamāt; viṣayāśrayaśūnyāyāḥ saṃvido guṇabhāvābhāvāt tadubhayasambandhaprayuktānityatvaprasaṅgābhāvāccetyatrāha saṃvinnāmeti || nanu kathaṃ viṣayāśrayaśūnyajñānābhāvaḥ? svarūpabhūtaṃ jñānaṃ viṣayāśrayaśūnyaṃ tvanmate || ucyate | sthaviṣṭhamidaṃ codyam | kiṃ tvayā jñātureva jñānaśabdavācyasyājaḍatvanityatvādikaṃ viṣayāśrayaśūnyatvamātmatvaṃ ca sādhyate? tat siddhasādhanam | yadi jñātṛvyatiriktasya jñānasya, tarhi jñātṛvyatiriktaṃ viṣayāśraya virahitaṃ jñānaṃ sūnyamiti brūmaḥ | jñātṛjñeya tadavacchinna jñānasvarūpatrikātiriktaṃ jñānamanupalambhanirastamityarthaḥ | bauddhaikadeśibhiḥ dharmikalpanāto varaṃ dharmakalpaneti lāghavanyāyāt, jñātrātmavādinā jñānātmavādinā ca sampratipannā saṃvidevātmetyuktam | tadāśaṅkaya pariharati ubhayeti | kalpanāyāmeva lāghavanyāyaḥ; na tūpalabdhau | anyathā atyantalāghavārthaṃ mādhyamikamatānusāreṇa jñānañca tyajyeta || kalpane tu lāghavanyāyaḥ; saṃvittūpalabhyata iti cetjñātā'pi tathopalabhyate |ata upalabdhiparāhatatvāt saṃvidātmatvamanupapannamityarthaḥ | sāśrayaiva saṃvidupalabhyate; tathā'pi yuktibhirnirviśeṣatvaṃ sādhitamityatrāha anubhūtimātramiti | yadvā saṃvidaḥ paramārthatvenobhayavādisammatatvāt saivātmetyuktamityāśaṅkaya dūṣayati ubhayeti | upalabdhiparāhatampratyak
tvalakṣaṇasyātmatvasya ahaṃ jānāmīti jñātṛtvasāmānādhikaraṇyenopalabdhyā parāhatamityarthaḥ | jñātureva pratyagātmatvamupalabdhisiddhamityuktam | tasyā upalabdhernirviśeṣasaṃvidātmatvasādhakayuktibhirbādhitatvamāśaṅkayāhaanubhūtimātramiti |
pratyagartho hyātmā | pratyakatvaṃ ca ahamarthatmatve tu na sidhyati, saṃvidātmatvapakṣa eva setsyatīti coda yati | nanu ceti | ahaṃ jānāmītmasmatpratyayeasmatpratyayatvena parābhyupagate | yaścityadārthaḥ, sa ātmā; kuta ityatrāha anidamaṃśa iti | idamaṃśavyatiriktaḥ parāgarthavyatiriktaḥ pratyagarthaḥ | hetugarbhamidam; pratyagarthatvādityarthaḥ | pratyakatvaṃ ca kuta ityatrāha prakāśaikasya iti | svayamprakātvādityarthaḥ | hetvabhiprāyaścicchabdaḥ | jñānatvāt svayamprakāśatvamityarthaḥ | pratyukatvaṃ svasmai prakāśamānatvam | svayaṃprakāśatvamananyādhīnaprakāśatvam | ahamarthastu yuṣmadarthalakṣaṇaḥ | yuṣmadarthalakṣaṇatvāt parāgarthaviśeṣohamartha ityarthaḥ | yuṣmadartha lakṣaṇatvaṃ kuta ityatrāha tadvaleti | tadvalanirbhāsitatvātjñānādhīnaprakāśatvāt | tacca cinmātrātirekitvādityarthaḥ | asmiścodyagranthe saṃvidātma tve vyatirekitrayam, ahamarthānātmatve anvayitrayañcābhipretam | tatra vyatirekiṇāṃ vyatirekidṛṣṭānto'nvayināṃ sapakṣaśca yuṣmadarthaśabdena sūcitaḥ | anubhūtirātmā, pratyakatvāt; yadanātmā tanna pratyak yathā ghaṭaḥanubhūtiḥ pratyagbhūtā svayaṃprakāśatvāt, yanna pratyak tanna svayamprakāśam, yathā ghaṭaḥanubhūtiḥ svayamprakāśā, anubhūtitvāt, yanna svayaṃprakāśam(svatassiddhi), na tadanubhūtiḥ,yathā ghaṭa iti vyatirekitrayam | ahamartho jñānādhīnaprakāśaḥ cidvayatiriktatvāt ghaṭavat; ahamarthaḥ parāk jñānādhīnaprakāśatvāt ghaṭavat; ahamartho nātmā parāktvāt ghaṭavadityanvayitrayam | svayamprakāśatvameva saṃvidātmatve sākṣāddhetutayā pūrvamuktaṃ pūrvapakṣopanyāse; atra tu tena pratyakatvaṃ sādhayitvā tenā''tmatvaṃ sādhitam | etat pariharati naitadevamiti | saṃvitsvayamprakāśatvamiṣṭam; śikṣaṇīyāṃ śaśca śikṣitaḥ(ścoktaḥ) | ataḥ svatassiddhatvasādhakahetoḥ siddhasādhyatā | jñātuḥ asvatassiddhatvasādhakahetościdanyatvasyāsiddhirvakṣyate | itarānumānacatuṣṭayamiha nirasyate | saṃvidātmatvādi kiṃ pratītyā'bhyupagatam, uta pratyaktvasidhdyanupapattyā, uta śrutyarthāpattyā, uta śrutismṛtisūtrasvārasyāt iti vikalpamabhipratya prathamapakṣe pratyakṣapratītivirodhamāha ahaṃ jānāmīti | etena paroktānāṃ jñānapratyakatvātmatvajñātṛtvaparākatvānātmatvasādhakānāmanvayavyatirekyanumānānāṃ kālātyayāpadeśa uktaḥ | ahaṃ jānāmītyatrāhamarthaḥ svāvabhāse'pi ghaṭāvabhāsa iva pratisambandhitayā ahamiti pratīyate | dharmītayā avabhāsādeva na jñānaśeṣatāvabhāsaḥ | ataḥ sa pratyak; ātmā ca | jñānaṃ dhamartayā pratīyamānaṃ sukhādivadanyasmai bhāsata iti na pratyak ātmā ca | jñānaṃ dharmatayā pratīyamānaṃ sukhādivadyasmai bhāsata iti na pratyak nāpyātmā ,apitu parāk anātmā ca | ataścaturṇā hetūnāṃ pratyakṣabādha ukto bhavati |
atha pratyakatvaṃ viparītasādhakaṃ cetyāha kiñceti | svasmai prakāśamānatvarūpaṃ pratyakatvaṃ parasmai prakāśamānatvaṃ parāktvaṃ cāhamidambuddhimyāṃ hi vibhajyate | tasmādahambuddhivigame prayyakatvameva na setsyatīti pratyakatvamahamarthasyaivātmatvasādhakamityarthaḥ | saṃvidi pratyakatvābhāvādātmatvasādhakahetorasiddhiśca phalitā | ahamarthasya parākatvābhāvādanātmatvasādhakahetorasiddhiśca siddhā | ahambudhyetyanena yuṣmadasmatpratyayagocarayoriti svoktivirodhaśca, "ko'hamityeva nipuṇaḥ", "śabdo'hamiti doṣāya nātmanyeṣa" ityādyāgamavirodhaśca garbhitaḥ; hi śabdasya prasiddhiparatvāt | hetau vā, anubhūtiḥ parācī, ahamarthavyatiriktatvāt ghaṭavaditi | pratyakatvahetorasidghidārḍhya, tatpratyakatvasādhakasya svayamprakāśatvahetoḥ satpratipakṣatvañca, anubhūtiranātmā ahamarthavyatiriktatvāt ghaṭādivaditi saṃvidātmatvasādhakasya pratyakatvahetośca satpratipakṣatvaṃ cābhipretamityavagamyate; ahambudhdyā parāgarthāt pratyagarthasya bhedasamarthanāt | hiśabdāccātra saṃvitpratyakatvahetorasiddhinca sidghā | śrutyarthāpatiṃta vaktuṃ mumukṣorabhisandhimāha nirasteti | tataḥ kimityatrāha ahamarthavināśa iti | yatsambandhitvena duḥkhajñānaṃ yatsambandhinī duḥkhavinivṛttiryatsambandhinī sukhaprāptiścepsyate, tadvināśo mokṣaścet, adhikārivirahādapramāṇyaṃ bhavet | pramitijanakatvaṃ hi śāstra sya prāmāṇyam | bubhutsitagrāhyasya śāstrasya puruṣārthaparyavasāyitvābhāve śravaṇamananādyadhikārī na sidhyet | na hi śāstraṃ śravaṇādinirapekṣaṃ kasyacit pramitiṃ janayati | ato'dhikārivirahāt prāmāṇyaṃ na bhavediti śāstraprāmāṇyānyathānupapattirūpaśrutyarthāpattiruktā | ahamarthe naṣṭe'pi jñaptirnityā tiṣṭhatītyatrāha mayi naṣṭe'pīti | na hi mayi naṣṭe'pi stambhastiṣṭhatīti svaśiraśchedaḥ puruṣārthaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | na hi kevalasaṃvidaḥ śravaṇādau pravṛttiḥ, apitvahamarthasyaiva; ataḥ pravartamāno'yaṃ svanāśāya na pravarttate | ahamarthavigame jñaptyavasthānamabhyupagamya dūṣaṇamuktam | atha tadavasthānameva nāstītyāha svasambandhitayeti | sāmānyākāraḥ sattā; vijñaptitāviṣayaprakāśatvarūpaviśeṣākāraḥ | ādiśabdena svayamprakāśatvaṃ vivakṣitam | sattāyā āśrayasambandhādhīnatvāt, svarūpalābhe sati jñaptitvādisambhavācca sarvaṃ tadadhīnamityarthaḥ | ato yatsambandhāyattā sattā, tatsaṃbandhiviyoge jñaptisattaiva netyāha svasambandheti | ghaṭakarakākāśadṛṣṭāntavyāvṛttyartha viṣayāśrayasambandhasya sattāhetutve dṛṣṭāntamāha chetturiti | chedanāderi ādinā sattā tatphalaṃ dvaidhī bhāva ityādi vivakṣitam |
evaṃ pratyakṣavirodhāt asiddhatvāt viparītasādhakatvāt satpratipakṣatvācca saṃvidātmatvānupapatteḥ śrutyarthā patyā cāhamarthātmatvamāha ata iti | pūrvottarahetūnāmiyaṃ pratijñā | śrutismṛtisūtrāṇi darśayati vijñātāramiti | jñātavyasyātmano jñātṛtvamuktaṃ, "vijñātāramare kena vijñānīyāt" iti | jñātṛtvasya svābhāvikatayā muktāvapi jñātṛtvamastīti darśayati jānātyeveti | "jño'ta eva" ityatra jñaśabdanirdiṣṭa ātmeti jñāpanārtham, "nātmā śruteḥ" iti sūtramupāttam; tvayā anityatayā abhyupetasyā'hamarthasya nityatvakathanamapi tasyaivātmatvasādhakamiti ca jñāpanārtham | ato nātmeti saṃvidātmatvapratikṣepanigamanāt | pūrvoktāhamarthātmatvapratijñāyāṃ saṃvidātmatvapratikṣepe ca yathāyathamuktahetavo'nusandheyāḥ |
dūṣaṇāntaraṃ vyāhatirapyastītyāha ahaṃpratyayetyādinā | ahaṃpratyayasiddha iti siddhaśabdena svatassiddhiḥ sūcitā | ata eva hyanyatra yuṣmatpratyayaviṣaya ityuktam | ahaṃpratyayasiddho hīti hi śabdenāsmadarthayuṣmadarthaśabda taśca yuṣmadasmatpatyayagocarayoriti tadvanthaprasidiṃdha darśayati | jñānameva svayamprakāśam; tadvayatiriktatvādahamartho'nyādhīnaprakāśaḥ, ato nātmeti śaṅkāyāṃ hetorasiddhimabhiprayan ahamarthasya prakāśāntaranairapekṣyaṃ pratijānīte na cāsāviti | kuta ityatrāha svayamprakāśatvāditi | prakāśaḥvyavahārānuguṇyam | svata eva vyavahārānuguṇyaśaktiyuktatvādahamarthaḥ prakāśāntaranirapekṣa ityarthaḥ | tacca kathamityatrāha caitanyasvabhāvatā hi svayamprakāśateti | cetanā jñānam, tadbhāvaścaitanyaṃ jñānatvam; tatsvabhāvatvaṃ jñānatvaguṇakatetyarthaḥ | jñānatvameva hi jñānasya svayamprakāśatvam, tadvadatrāpi jñānatvaṃ prāmāṇikaṃ cet, tadeva svayamprakāśatvaṃ bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati | ahamarthasya caitanyasvabhāvatve śrutiṃ pramāṇaṃ vakṣyan tadanugrāhakatarkamupanyasyati yaḥ prakāśasvabhāva ityādinā | ātmadīpadhamarbhūtajñānaprabhayoḥ sākṣādvā praṇālyā vā yādṛśavyavahārānuguṇyam, tādṛśaṃ vyavahārānuguṇyamiha prakāśaśabdena vivakṣitam | dīpasya tamovirodhi rūpamaujjavalyaṃ prakāśaḥ; jñānasya tu sphuraṇam | yaḥtatsvabhāvaḥtaddharmakaḥ svaḥ yavahārānuguṇyāpādana śaktiyuktaḥ saḥ ananyādhītaprakāśaḥ svadharma nirapekṣaprakāśa ityarthaḥ | prakāśasvabhāvatvāsiddhirna śaṅkanīyā; yathā prabhāśrayasya dīpasya ojvalyaṃ pratyakṣasiddhaṃ tathā jñāturapi svata eva vyavahārāguṇyasya vakṣyamāṇa śrutisvārasyānugatatvāt | prakāśasvabhāvasya svadharmabhūta prakāśānapekṣa prakāśatvaṃ upapannamityetāvadeva hi ucyate anena granthena | atha cakṣugarrāhyatve sati prabhāvyatiriktatvāt dīpo ghaṭādivat prabhābalanirbhāsya iti dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavaikalyamāsaṅkayāha nahīti | na ca cakṣurgrāhyatve sati prabhānyatvāt ghaṭādiriva dīpaḥ prabhāvabhāsyaḥ,andhakāre vyabhicārāt | ato na dīpasya prabhāpekṣetyamiprāyaḥ | aprakāśatvamanyādhīnaprakāśatvañceti | svayamaujjavatayadharmakatvābhāvaḥ tatkṛtaprakāśāntarasāpekṣatvañca nāstītyarthaḥ | (arthasiddhaṃ) arthasthitiṃ vaktuṃ akāśaṃṅkṣāṃ darśayati kiṃ tarhīti | uttaramāha dīpa iti | dīpo na kevalaṃ svātmānameva prakāśayati, api tu svaparikareṇa anyānapi prakāśayatītyatiśayamāha anyānapīti | evaṃ vā'rthaḥdīpaḥ prabhānirapekṣaprakāśaścet, prabhāvat viṣayānapi prakāśayedityatrāha anyānapīti | viṣayaprakāśanakṣamepi svarūpasya kvacitkatayā viṣayasambandhābhāvāt svarūpeṇa na prakāśayati, kintu viṣayasambandhinyā svaparikarabhūtayā prabhayetyarthaḥ | "yathā prakāśayatyekaḥ kṛtsnaṃ līkaṃ imaṃ raviḥ" ityādinirderśā'bhipretaḥ |
yadvā anagumānavivakṣayā''ha caitanyasvabhāvatā hīti | caitanya svamāvatā jñānadharmakatvam | etadeva hi svayaṃprakāśatvam | jñānadharmakatvāt svayaṃ prakāśatvam ityuktaṃ bhavati | yathā dhūmavatvaṃ hyagnimatvābhityukte dhūmavatvādagnimatvaṃ ityuktaṃ syāttadvat | ayaṃ cānvayī hetuḥ | vyāptiṃ darśayati ya iti | prakāśa svabhāvaḥ prakāśa dharmakaḥ | yo dharmyantarāparokṣāvabhāse sākṣādvā paramparayā vā bhāsamānatayaiva hetuḥ, so'nanyādhīna (sa iha) prakāśaśabdavivakṣitaḥ rūpitatsa mavetārthacākṣuṣatvanimittasya rūpasya, svāśrayetaradravyānumāpakadūmādeśca prakāśatvavyudāsāya dharmyantaraaparokṣaśarbdo | indriyavyavacchedārthaḥ bhāsamāna śabdaḥ | pakṣasapakṣayoḥ anugatatvāya sākṣādvā paramparayā vetyuktam | jñātā svadharmabhūta prakāśanirapekṣasiddhiḥ prakāśadharmakatvāt dīpavadityanumānaśarīram | bhāsamānatayā sākṣādvā paramparayā vā dharmyantarāparokṣāvabhāsahetudharmakatvāditi hetuvāciśabdārthaḥ | dīpasya svadharmabhūta prabhānapekṣaprakāśatvavat jñāturapi svadharmabhūtamānanirapekṣaprakāśatvaṃ bhidadhamiti pakṣadharmatāvalāt svayaṃprakāśatva siddhiḥ | dṛṣyānte sādhyānvayaṃ dharśayati nahīti | sādhanānvayaṃ darśayati anyānapīti |
anumānaparatvādapi granthasya śrutyanugrāhakatarkaparatvaṃ yuktam; uttaratra tathā hi śrataya iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | pūrvamanumānaṃ vivakṣitaṃ cet, tathā ceti hi vaktavyam | upakrame caitanya svabhāvatā hi svayaṃ prakāśateti samānādhikaraṇanirdeśasvārasyācca | pañcamyarthatve hi svārasyaṃ bhajyate | nigamane ca cidrūpatāhi svayaṃprakāśatetyuktam | cidrūpaśabdo jñānasvarūpatparaḥ; na tu jñānadharmakatvaparaḥ; anantarapūrvagranthe cidrūpa eva caitanya guṇaka iti (jñānadharmakatvasya pṛthaguktatvāt) evaṃ nigamane svayamprakāśatāpadasamānādhikaraṇasya cidrapatāśabdasya jñānadharmatvasya pṛthaguktatvāt | evaṃ nigamane svayamprakāśatāpadasamānādhikaraṇasya cidrūpatāśabdasya jñānasvarūpatāparatvadarśanāt, pūrvamapi svayamprakāśatāpadasamānādhikaraṇasya caitanyasvabhāvateti padasya jñānasvarūpatāparatvasya samuccitatvācca caitanyasvabhāvatetyādibhāṣyaṃ śrutyanugrāhakatarkaparam | evamanugrāhakatarkasya śrautatve sati anumānamapyarthasiddham; jñānadharmakatvajñānasvarūpatvokteḥ; ekajātīyadravyorniyatadharmadharmibhāve prabhāprabhāvaddṛṣṭāntokteśca |
jñānasya dravyatve dvayorjñānayorniyamena dharmadharmibhāvo nopapadyate; anyatrādarśanāt | guṇatve tu na jñānāśrayatvasambhavaḥ guṇānāmaguṇatvāt | na ca dravyatve'pi niyatāśrayāśrayibhāvaḥ prabhāprabhāvatardṛśyata iti vācyam; prabhāyā viśīrṇadīpāvayavatvādityāśaṅkayāha etaduktamiti | yathaikameva tejodravyaṃ prabhāprabhāvadrūpeṇāvatiṣṭhate, evamātmācidrūpa eva caitanyaguṇa iti yathāśabdasyottaratrānvayaḥ | prathamaṃ prabhāyā viśīrṇāvayavānyatvaṃ pratijānīte ekameveti | ekamekajātīyam (sajātīyam)| niyatadharmasya kathaṃ dravyatvamityatrāha yadyapīti | guṇabhūtāparatantrabhūtā; ayutasiddhiviśeṣaṇabhūtetyarthaḥ | tejodravyameveti pratijñātadravyaviśeṣatvasiddhayarthaṃ prathamaṃ dravyatvamupapādayati svāśrayāditi | dravyatvamastu; tatrāpi tejastve kiṃ pramāṇamityatrāha prakāśavattvāditi | prakāśaḥtamovirodhyākāraviśeṣaḥ, aujjavalyam | prakāśavattvamupapādayati prakāśavattvaṃ ceti | svaviṣayaparaviṣayajñānavirodhitamonirasanarūpakāryadarśanādityarthaḥ | tarhi kathamasyā guṇatvavyavahāra ityatrāha asyā iti | tuśabdaḥ śauklayādivaiṣamyaparaḥ | atha viśīrṇāvayavānāṃ prabhāvattvaṃ pratikṣipati na ceti | kuta ityatrāha maṇīti | pratikṣaṇaṃ vināśaprasaṅgādityarthaḥ | tadabhyupagame maṇyādyanupalambhaprasaṅgaparihārāya pratikṣaṇotpattirabhyupetyā | pratikṣaṇotpattivināśāmyupagamaścānupa pannaḥ; dīpasyeva utpattivināśasāmagrayanuvṛttyabhāvāt | tadabhāve'pi tejastvasāmānyāddīpa iva pratyabhijñābādhena pratikṣaṇaṃ vināśādikalpane sattvadravyatvādibhiḥ ghaṭādāvapi kṣaṇikatvaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | ratneṣu kṣaṇikatvaṃ ratnaśāstraviruddham; kālaviśeṣe tadutpattyādyavagateḥ | ādityādiṣu ca kṣaṇikatvaṃ śrutiviruddham, "sūyocandhramasau dhātā yathāpūrvamakalpayat" "nāgnīṣomau na sūryaḥ" iti kālaviśeṣe tadutpattivināśavagateḥ | na ca sūryādisṛṣṭipralayaparavākyānāṃ santatyupakramocchedaparatvaṃ vācyam; ratnasūryādimātrakṣaṇikatve pramāṇābhāvāt | tejastvaṃ hi (tu) tejaḥparamāṇumicchadbhiḥ na hetutayā vācyam; tejaḥparamāṇuṣu vyabhicārāt sattvādibhiḥ kṣaṇikatve jagatkṣaṇikatvaṃ syādatyu ktam || nanu karpūrādīnāṃ dūropalabdhagandhānāṃ gandhāśrayabhūtāvayavaviśaraṇasyāvarjjanīyatvāt uttarakālopalambhācca pratikṣaṇotpattivināśavabhyupagantavyau; tadvanmaṇyādiṣvapīti || naivam | samudgakasampuṭādinivātadeśanihitadṛḍhapihitadhanasārādeḥdūre gandhopalambhābhāvāt āśrayāvayavaviśaraṇābhāvena yathāpūrvaṃ sthityupalambhopapatteḥ na pratikṣaṇotpattivināśau kalpyau | savātadeśasthadhanasārādīnāṃ dūropalabhyamānagandhānāmalpāvayavaviśaraṇamastyeva | vayavini ca sūkṣmaparikṣayo vidyata eva; tulayā parīkṣaṇe'pyalpālpaparimāṇāpakaṣardarśanāt | ataḥ pratikṣaṇamavayavāntaropanipātaviśleṣahetukotpattivināśau kalpyau | kalpane'pi paritaḥ keṣāñcidavayavānāmupalabhyamānagandhāśrayatvena ubhayavādisampratipannānāmeva sthitimātraṃ kalpyam; tāvatā gandhopalabdhyupapatteḥ | aneka dharmitadutpattivināśāaparidṛṣṭatadubhayasāmagrīkalpane gauravācca | yadvā ghrāṇasyāpi cakṣuṣa iva raśmidvārā saṃbandhāt dūrasthapadārthagatagandhagrāhitvaṃ kalpyam | gauravābhāvāt | na kevalaṃ kalpyaṃ raśmimattvam | uktañca bhārate, "na hyātmā śakyate draṣṭumindriyaiḥ kāmagocaraiḥ | pravarttamānairanayairdurddharṣai rakṛtātmabhiḥ || teṣāṃ tu manasā raśmīn yadā samyaṅniyacchati | tadā prakāśate hyātmā dīpo(?) dīpyannirākṛttiḥ ||" iti | indriyāṇāṃ pañcīkṛtabhūtāpyāyanaiḥ rvāyutejaḥprabhṛtibhiḥ sambandhāt raśmimattvaṃ copapadyate ||
nanu agnyātapasambandhāt (tapatapta) salilaśilāderauṣṇyatāratamyopalambho'gnyātapādyavayavasaṅkrāntiṃ vinā nopapadyate | salilādeḥ svata auṣṇyābhāvānnirāśrayadharmasaṅkramaṇāyogācca auṣṇyāśrayabhūta agnyātapāvaya vasya saṃkrāntirabhyupetyā | evamavayavasaṅkrāntiśca viśaraṇena vinā nopapadyate | gatvarāṇāṃ raśmīnāṃ caraṇatalānā miva kathaṃ viśaraṇena vinā kkacit saṅkramaḥ avayavatāratamyāccauṣṇyatāratamyam iti || ucyate | agnitapteṣu agnyavayavasaṅkrāntyaiva auṣṇyopalambhaḥ | salilādau saṅkrāntimanto'gnyavayavā eva prabheti na vācyam; dīpaprabhayā ahorātrasaṃvṛte(pṛkta')pi salilabhūtalādāvaupṇyānupalambhāt | ātapatapteṣvapi na kiraṇaśiraṇādavayavasaṅkramaḥ, tuhinakaṇānāmiva ravikiraṇopāttamuktānāmagnayavayavānāṃ saṃkramaṇāduṣṇopalambhopapatteḥ | na cātra kalpakamanveṣṭavyam; nāpi kalpanāgauravaṃ prasajati; āgamasiddhatvādasyārthasya | tathāhi mātsye purāṇe kathyate, "vasante grīṣmake raśmiśataiḥ santapati tribhiḥ | śaradyapi ca varṣāsu caturbhissampravarṣati || hemante śiśire caiva himamutsṛjate tribhiḥ" iti | yathā varṣāsu hemante ca ravikaraṇamuktā salilakaṇāḥ tuhinakaṇāśca na viśīrṇakiraṇāvayavāḥ;kintu kiraṇopāttavimuktā āpyāvayavā evaevaṃ(vasante?) grīṣme ca ravikiraṇājanyaṃ santāpanaṃ na tadviśīrṇāvayavakāryam, kiṃtu tadupāttamuktāgnyavayavakāryamiti pratīyate | tathā "agniṃ vā vādityaḥ sāyaṃ praviśati", "udyantaṃ vāvādityamagniranusamārohati" iti śrūyate | atra cā''dityatirodhānadarśanāvacchinnakālaviśeṣaparau sāyaṃprātaḥśabdau | kālasya sāyambhāvaprātarbhāvau raviviprakṛṣṭasannikṛṣṭatattadeśaviśeṣavṛttipuruṣāpekṣayā sarvadopapadyate ityayamartho bhuvanakośe spaṣṭataraḥ | tataśca praviśatītyanenāmnāvādityasya vyāptirucyamānā dūrasthitasya svarūpeṇa nopapanneti kiṇa dvārā bhavati | agniranusamārohatītyanena agnyavayavānāmādityenopādīyamānatvamucyate | na cāgnyadhiṣṭhātṛdevatārohaṇaparamidaṃ vākyam; "tasmāddhūm evāmnerdivā dadṛśe" ityanantaravākyenāgnarādityopasarpaṇanimittatejomāndyakathanāt | anyathā sāyaṃprātassamayayoḥ sarvadā sambhavena agnerāditye sarvadāroharam agnāvādityasya sarvadārohaṇeñca prasajet | tataścāmnyādityayoḥ svānavivimayena sarvadāsthitiruktā syāt | sā ca pramāṇāntaraviruddhā |ata ādityasyāmnau kiraṇadvārā vyāptiḥ kiraṇaiḥramnyavayavopādānaṃ ca vākyadvayoktam | ataścopāttāmnyavayavavarṣeṇa tāpanaṃ mātsyoktam: utsarjanaprakaṇasvārasyāt |atastuhinakaṇānāmiva ravikiraṇamuktānāmāgneyāvayavānāṃ viśīrṇakiraṇāvayavatvābhāvāt ravikiraṇeṣu tanmaṇḍale ca pratikṣaṇavināśotpattiklaptiranupapannā | ato na viśīrṇāvayavāḥ prabhā |
dūṣaṇāntaramāha dīpepīti | avayavapratipattyanupapattimupapādayati nahīti | dīpaḥ kiṃ viśaraṇasvabhāvaḥ uta sthirasvabhāvaḥ? viśaraṇasvabhāvatve piṇḍībhāvo mūrtadravyapratibandhanibandhanaḥ syāt | sthirasvabhāvatve viśaraṇaṃ mūrtadravyapratihatihetukaṃ syāt | atrobhayamanupalambhahatam || viśaraṇasvabhāvatve piṇḍībhāvo vātinopapadyata iti cettarhi yuvāte piṇḍībhāvo na syāt | stimitasūkṣmavāyunā piṇḍībhāvaścetviśaraṇaṃ na syāt | tacca sūkṣmavāyunā cet, ekasya viruddhasvabhāvadvayāyogāt piṇḍībhāvaviśaraṇahetubhūtavāyudvayamabhyupetyam | tayomirthaḥ pratidhātukatvādanyataravigame piṇḍībhāva eva vā viśaraṇameva vā syāt | tatparihārāya parasparāntaritaviruddhasvabhāvavāyudvayaparamparayā saṃnnidhivigamaparikalpane gauravaṃ syāt | tatkalpane'pi tiryaggatvarāṇāṃ vāyvavayavānāṃ nodanāmātrahetūnāṃ paritaḥ pratibandhakatvāyogāt piṇḍībhāvo na syāt |
nanu poṣaṇadravībhūtapārthivāvayavasandaṃśāt piṇḍībhāvaḥ, tatastadavayavagatastrigdhatvāpagamena saṃdaṃśakatvābhāvādagnyavayavaviśaraṇamityatrāha na hi viśaraṇeti | yadyagnyayavā udgamanasvabhāvāḥ,tarhi viśaraṇe tiryagnatirna syāt | yadi te tiryaggatisvabhāvāḥ tarhi prathamamūdrdhvagatirna syāt | ekajātīyadravyasyopādhinā vinā viruddhasvabhāvatvāyogāt | upādhiśca na dṛśyate | dīpaprabhayorbhinnāvayavitve tu viruddhasvabhāvatvamupapadyate | kiñca caturaṅgulādiparimiti(māṇa) tāratamyaniyāmako'pi nāsti | viśaraṇe ca pārśve'pi viśaraṇaṃ sambhavati | samantato yugapadviśaraṇeniyāmakābhāvādityabhiprāyaḥ | kiñca viśīrṇānābhāvayavānāṃ pāṃsūnāmiva ṝjuprasaraṇa niyamate ca na hetuḥ | prasaraṇasya ārjavaniyamaśca tirodhāyakaṃ padārthaṃ prati ṛṛjudeśa eva cchāyāyogādavagamyate | chāyāvaipulyaṃ tu nivāryamāraraśmīnāṃ pṛthvagratvakṛtam, nā'nārjjavakṛtam | chāyākauṭilyaṃ tu tirodhāyakakauṭilṭakṛtam; na tu prasaraṇā(sārā)nārjavakṛtam | tacca ṛjuprasāritvasādhakam | viśīrṇāvayavatve reṇūnāmiva pavanānutsārthamāṇatvaṃ na ca ghaṭate |
prācīnajālakaniṣkrāntā hi prabhādakṣiṇānilena notsāryate | anyathā rajasāmapi tatra nodanaṃ prasajet | jālakaniṣkāntaprabhāyāśca pavanānutsāritvaṃ tataḥ parasmin bhittyādau prabhā saṃsargādevagamyate | ato dhanuṣi ātatāyāḥ maurvyā iva prabhāyā na viśīrṇāvayavatvamiti |
tataḥ kimityatrāha atassaprabhākā eva dīpāḥ pratikṣaṇamutpannā iti | tejastvena maṇyādivināśāmyupa game atiprasaṅgāt, viśaraṇasvīkāre piṇḍībhāvayugapadviṣvagniḥśaraṇaṃ ṛjusaraṇādyanekaniyamavyavasthāpakābhā vāt yathādṛṣṭābhyupagame virodhābhāvācca saprabhākā eva dīpāḥ pratikṣaṇamutpannā ityarthaḥ | tarhi kathaṃ pratikṣaṇotpattivināśāvityapekṣayām, yathā maṇyādīnāṃ pratikṣaṇavināśo na prasajati, tathā dīpakṣaṇikatve hetudvayamāha puṣkalakāraṇakramopanipātāttadvināśe vināśācceti | pṛthaksthitadaṇḍacakrādivyāvattyarthaṃ puṣkalaśabdaḥ | vartyavayavāgnisaṃyogasya dīpasāmagrītvaṃ prathamavartyavayavāgnisaṃyogedṛṣṭam | na ca prathamāvayavāgnisaṃyogasyaiva kāraṇatvaṃ śaṅkanīyam; caramamadhyāvayavayorapyagnisaṃyoge sati dīpotpattidarśanāt | ataḥ pratyavayavamagnisaṃyogāt puṣkalakāraṇaparamparā dṛṣṭeti pratyavayavamagnisaṃyogāt dīpa utpadyate eva | tatra pratikṣaṇamutpattau satyāṃ yugapadanekadīpānupalambhāt vinā śopi siddhaḥ | pratikṣaṇāvināśasya pṛthaganumāpakamucyate tadvināśe vināśacceti | vartvavayavavināśasya dīpavināśasāmāgrītvaṃ caramavartyavayavavināśe dṛṣṭam | evaṃ vināśakāraṇānuvṛttidarśanāt pratyavayavavināśaṃ dīpo vinaśyatyeva | evamutpattivināśasāmagrayanuvṛttibhyāṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ tāvanumīyete ityarthaḥ | prabhā viśīrṇāvayavāḥ; na cet, dīpasamīpe tasyā auṣṇyādhikyādikaṃ katham? viśaraṇapakṣe hyavayavabāhulyavairaulyābhyāmāṣṇyādhikyamāndyādikamupapadyata ityatrāha prabhāyā iti | prakāśādhikyamauṣṇyādhikyamityādīti ādiśabdenāśrayaviprakṛṣṭadeśe prakāśamāndyamauṣṇyamāndyañca vivakṣitam | upalabdhivyavasthāpyatve dṛṣṭāntamāha agnyādīnāmiti | uktaṃ dārṣṭāntike'tidiśati | evamiti | cidrūpa eveti | rūpaśabdo dharmisvarūpaparaḥ | tataḥ kiṃ svayamprakāśatvasyetyapekṣāyāṃ cidrūpatvaṃ vivṛṇoti cidrūpatā hīti | anena vakṣyamāṇaśrutivākye jñānādiśabdo vivṛto bhavati ||
evamanugrāhakatarkamupanyasya pramāṇamāha tathāhi śrutaya iti | sa yathā saindhavadhana iti | anantaraḥantaraṅgavyatiriktaḥ | abāhyaḥbahiraṅgavyatiriktaḥ | evaṃ vyatirekanirdeśena niśśeṣagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam | tadevāha kṛtsna iti | dārṣṭāntikaviṣayo bāhyaśabdo dharmiparaḥ; anantaraśabdo dhamarparaḥ; kṛtsnaśabdastayorekadeśajaḍatvaśaṅkāvyudāsārthaḥ | atra sarvatraikarūpyameva dṛṣṭāntopajīvyam, na tvanyat | dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikaviṣayavākyadvaye'pyanantaro'bāhya iti hyuktam | śarīritvāvasthāyāmapi jñānātmakatvaparaṃ vākyamupādatte vijñānadhana eveti | ghanaśabdoktanairantaryasya jaḍāṃśamiśratvaṃ vyāvartayatyevakāraḥ | jñānatvaṃ nāma svayamprakāśatvamiti jñāpanārtham atrāyamitivākyopādānam | dharmadharmibhāvaṃ jñāpayati na vijñāturiti | jñātṛsaṃbandhijñānasya nityatve kathite jñānamātrasya(?) nityatvaśaṅkāvyudā sārthaṃ jñāturevātmatvaṃ darśayati atha ya iti | ekavākyena jñānaguṇakatvasvasvayaṃprakāśatvayoḥ sahapratipādakaṃ vākyamāha katama iti | jñānaguṇakatvajñānasvarūpatvapratipādakavākyamāha eṣa hīti | jñātavyasya niṣkṛṣṭāntmasvarūpasya jñātṛtvamāha vijñātāramiti | anena jñātṛtvaṃ svābhavikamiti phalitam | na kevalaṃ saṃsṛtidaśāyām;
