muktāvapi jñātṛtvaṃ jñāpayati jānātyevāyamiti | avadhāraṇāsaṅkocānmuktāvapi jñātṛtvasiddhiḥ(jñātṛtvaṃ siddham) | muktau jñānaniṣedhaśrutīnāṃ viṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati na paśya iti, sa utama iti ca | puruṣaṃ prāptasya muktasya jñātṛtve'nuvartta māna eva dehendriyavigamaṃ darśayati evamiti | antaḥkaraṇottīrṇasya jñātṛtvamāha tasmādvā iti | asyārthasya sūtrakārāmipretatvamāha vakṣyati ceti | pūrvaṃ sūtropādānamahamarthātmatvaṃ sūtrakārābhimatamiti jñāpanārtham | atropādānaṃ jñānaguṇakatvajñānasvarūpatvavādinīnāṃ śrutināmavirodhaḥ sūtrakārabhimata iti jñāpanātharm || jñānatvāt jñānaṃ na jñānāntarāśraya iti cetyadi vyāptyanurodhenaivamucyate, tarhi dharmatvena svīkāryam | yadi śrutibalāt svātantreṇa svīkriyate, tarhi śrutibalādeva jñānāśrayatvamapyaṅgīkriyatām | na ca vyāptivirodhaḥ; dharmabhūtajñānatvaprayuktatvāt jñāne jñānānāśrayatvasya | śrutyā jñātṛḥ svayaṃprakāśatvasidiṃdha nigamayati ata iti ||
nanu ghaṭamaha nānāmītyatra jñānasya jñātṛ(jñātṛsva?)sambandhaḥ pratīyata ityabhyupetyam | anyathā svajñānaparajñāna vibhāgasya durgrahatvaprasaṅgāt | svasambandhitayā pratītaṃ jñānaṃ sambandhā pratītau kathaṃ svajñānamiti vyavahriyate? ataḥ svasambandhaḥ pratīyata eva | tatpratītiḥ na tāvadahamarthādbhavati | "ahamarthaḥ pratyakatvenānukūlatvenaikatvena ca sva to bhāti; na hyarthāntaramahamartho viṣayīkartumalam" iti bhavatāṃ prakriyā | ato dhamarbhūtajñānenaiva sambandhapratītiḥ | sambdhaśca sambandhibhyāṃ vinā na pratīyata iti jñātṛjñānayorapi sambandhaprakāśakajñānāntaravedyatvaṃ syāt | tataḥ svato'vabhāso jñānāntareṇāvabhāsaścetyavabhāsadvayābhāvāt, jñānāntareṇaiva prakāśyatayā svaprakāśyatvāsiddheḥ,rjñātuśca jñānasya ca jaḍatvaṃ syāt | kiñca, jñānāntareṇa sambandhapratītiḥ avaśyambhāvinī cet, saṃbandhaviṣayajñānena saha jñātṛsambandhasyāpi jñānāntareṇa pratītyavaśyambhāvāt sambandhajñānaparamparāprasaṅgaḥ | avaśyambhāvābhāve sarvajñāneṣu ahaṃ jānāmīti jñānajñātṛsambandhapratītirna syāt || naivam; svayamprakāśapratyakṣeṇaiva sambandhapratīteḥ | niyataviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo hi sambandhaḥ | ahamartho viśeṣyataikasvabhāvaṃ svātmānaṃ prakāśayati | dharmabhūtajñānaṃ ca viśeṣaṇataikasvabhāvaṃ svātmānaṃ prakāśayati | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasya parasparapratiyogikatvaṃ ca jñātṛjñānayoḥ sahāvabhāsādeva pratīyate || nanu sambandhapratītau sambandhinoḥ sahāvabhāsañca ekajñānagamyatayā vinā nopapadyata iti jñātṛjñānayorjñānāntaravedyatvaṃ syāt | surabhi puṣyamityādau bhinnasāmagrīvedyayorapi gandhapuṣpayāḥ sambandhapratītivelāyāmekajñānagabhyatvaṃ hi dṛśyata iti cennatatra sambandhinoḥ sambandhena saha ekajñānagamyatvasya sahāvabhāsaprayuktatvābhāvāt | saṃbandhino jaḍatvaprayuktaṃ hi tatraikajñānagamyatvam | atra svayamprakāśatvāt svayameva sahāvabhāsamānaryojñātṛjñānayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyataikasvabhāvatvarūpasambandhagraho jñānāntarānapekṣa upapadyate | ataḥ sambandhāgrahasvaparajñānavibhāgābhāvasambandhajñānaparamparāprasaṅgāḥ dūrotsāritāḥ | evaṃ jñātṛtvasvayamprakāśatvopapādanena cinmātravyatiriktatvāditi jaḍatvayādhakahetuḥ nirasto bhavati | jñānavyatiriktatvājjaḍatvaṃ vadatā kiṃ svayamprakāśavyatiriktatvaṃ heturuktaḥ, uta viṣayaprakāśakānyatvam | prathame sādhyāviśiṣṭatvam | dvitīye brahmaṇyanaikāntikam; śrutyādibādhaśca |
atha sāśrayatve tarkamāha prakāśatvādeveti | prakāśatvātviṣayeṇa sākṣātsambadhyasākṣāt paramparayā vā jñāyamānatvenā'parekṣavyavahārānuguṇyahetutvādityarthaḥ | anena svarūpabhūtajñānendriyaliṅgādivyāvṛttiḥ | hetvantaramapyāha saṃvidanubhūtīti | sambandhiśabdatvaṃ śabdasvabhāvāyattamityāśaṅkayāha na hi lokavedayoriti | yatra'rthasvarūpasyānyathātvaṃ dṛśyate; tatra śabdasvabhāvāyattatvamāśrayaṇīyam | yathā dārā ityādiṣu bahutvādeḥ | yatra nānyathā tvam, tatrārthasvabhāvāyattatvameva, yathā bhāryetyādiṣvekatvādeḥ | tathā lokavedayoḥ sakarmakartṛtvadarśanāt arthasvabhāvāyattameva sambandhiśabdatvamityabhiprāyaḥ | yadvākarmakartṛsambandhitvaṃ vyutpattinimittamastu; na pravṛttinimittam | tattu jñapti(?)mātramityatrāha nahi loketi | prayogādhīnaṃ hi pravṛttinimittāntarakalpanam | prayogaśca saṃbandhinyevārtha iti nārthāntarakalpanā syāt | svarūpabhūtajñānavāciśabdānāṃ sambandhiśabdatvaṃ tvanmate'pyanupapannamiti cenna, svarūpagocarāṇāṃ svayamprakāśatve rūḍhānāṃ jñānādiśabdānāṃ anubhūtyādiśabdebhyaḥ śabdāntaratvāt | ataḥ(?) sambandhiśabdatvopa(tvavyapa?) deśastu dharmabhūtajñāne sāvakāśe'smanmate | viṣayāśrayasambandhijñānasyaiva viṣayāśrayasambandhabādhena nirāśrayatvanirviṣayatvābhyupagamāt tvanmate sambadhiśabdatvopadeśo nirarthaka iti bhāvaḥ |
athājaḍatvāt saṃvidātmatvasamarthanaṃ dūṣayitumanuvadati | yaccektamiti | atha ajaḍatvaṃ kiṃ svasattāprayuktaprakāśatvam, uta avyabhicaritaprakāśasattākatvam, uta svasmai prakāśamānatvam, uta svasmai svayamprakāśatvam, uta svayamprakāśatvam, iti pañcavā vikalpamabhipretyāha ajaḍatvamitikimabhipretamiti |ahaṃ jānāmīti pratyakṣa bīdhaḥ sarvasādhāraṇaṃ dūṣaṇam | prathamaṃ svasattāprayuktaprakāśatvapakṣaṃ dūṣayitumāha svasattati | svasattāprayuktaḥ prakāśo yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ | vakṣyamāṇāsiddhidūṣaṇopayogimedajñāpanārthaṃ svasattāprayuktaśabdaḥ | anaikāntyamāha tathā satī ti | svapakṣe jñāturātmatvātsapakṣabhūte tasmin, vipakṣe anātmani dīpe ca vṛtyā'naikāntyaṃ pakṣatrayavṛttitvalakṣṇamu ktam | parapakṣeaniyatvamevānaikāntyam; sapakṣābhāvāt | dūṣaṇāntaradūyamāha saṃvidatirikteti | saṃvit pratyojikā prakāśaḥ prayojya iti tadatirekeṇānabhyupagamādasiddhiḥ |abhyupagame nirviśeṣatvavirodhaḥ | imīvasiddhivirodhau vikalpitasarvāśirassādhāraṇāvanusandheyau | yadvā, virodhaḥ pakṣavipakṣayāreva varttamānatvam; pakṣabhūtasaṃvidi vipakṣe dīpādau ca vṛtteḥ | paramatamātraparyālocanāyāṃ virodha uktaḥ | atra svasattāprayuktaprakāśatvamityatra prakāśaśabdena kiṃ sā kṣādvā paramparayā vā vyavahārānuguṇyaṃ vivakṣitam, uta paramparayaiva, uta sākṣādeveti vikalpo'bhipretaḥ | prathamaṃ śiraḥsvaparadarśanaparyālocanayā abhihitayoranaikāntyavirodhayoranyatareṇa nirastaṃ bhavati | dvitīye tvasiddhiḥ, paramparayaiva vyavahārānuguṇyasya jñaptau ubhayavādyanābhimatatvāt | tṛtīye sattā(sanmātrā)tiriktaprakāśānabhyupagamanibandhanā saddhiḥ nirviśeṣatvavirodhaśca syātābhityabhiprāyaḥ | dvitīyaṃ pakṣaṃ pratikṣipati avyabhicariteti | na vyabhicarati prakāśo yasya sattāyāṃ so'vyabhicaritaprakāśasattākaḥ | prayojyaprayojakatvābhāve'pi vidyamānadaśāyāṃ sarvadā prakāśamānatvamityarthaḥ | tasyānātmatvena saṃpratipanneṣu sukhaduḥkhādiṣu vyabhicāra uktaḥ | atha tatpayihāramukhena svasmai prakāśamānatvapakṣamupakṣipati tadyucyeteti | pariharati jñānaṃ veti | kasyetyatrāha tadapīti | parasmai bhāsamānatvamupapādayati ahamiti | tasmādevaṃrūpājaḍatvamasiddhamityāha ata iti | atha caturthaṃ śiro dūṣayan asiddhimāha tasmāditi | svayaṃprakāśatvapakṣe'pi svayaṃprakāśatvaṃ nāma kiṃ jñānakarmatāmatareṇa vyavahārānuguntvam uta jñānāntaranirapekṣaprakāśatvam ityabhiprete vikalpe prathamaṃ śiraḥ tasmāditi granthena dūṣitam | iha itarātmavyāvṛttyarthaṃ svātmānamityuktam | svasattayaiva sidhyannityanena svayamprakāśatvamuktam | svasmai svayaṃ bhāsamānatvaṃ ahamarthasya adhi kam | svarūpai svayaṃbhāsamānasya svayambhāsamānatvamapyastītyabhiprāyeṇa svātmānaṃ prati svasattayaivetyuktam | tena, jñānakarmatāmantareṇa vyavahārānuguṇatvaṃ jñātaryapyaṃstīti tat vyabhicaritam svapakṣe anātmani jñātaryapi vipakṣabhūte vṛtteriti darśitam | jñānāntaranirapekṣaprakāśatvaṃ saṃvidyasiddham; tasyāḥ svarūpabhūtajñānādhīnatvāt; ahamarthasyaiva tadityabhiprāyaḥ svasattayaivetyanena sūcitaḥ | tameva vivṛṇoti jñānasyāpīti | tatsambandhāyattatvamupapādayati tatkṛtameva hīti | jñānasphuraṇasya aśrayasambandho'pi sāmagrayantarbhūta iti bhāvaḥ | ajaḍatvāt saṃvidātmatvāsidiṃdha nigamayati ata iti |
athāhamarthasya bhrāntisiddhatvaṃ dūṣayitumanuvadati |atha yaduktamityādinā | saṃvidapi mithyā kiṃ na syādityatrāha niradhiṣṭhāneti | anubhūtivyatiriktāpāramārthyasiddhavatkāreṇāyaṃ heturuktaḥ | dūṣayati tadayuktamityādinā | adhiṣṭhānasāmānādhikaraṇyenādhyastapratītiṃ dṛṣṭāntenopapādayati puro'vasthiteti | pakṣe tadviparyayaṃ darśayati atra tviti | pṛthagavabhāsamānāvyadhikaraṇatayā avabhāsamānā | tathā pratīti darśayati tathā hīti | tataḥ kimityatrāha tadevamiti | tadevamuktaprakāreṇa dharmadharmibhāvapratītau | viśeṣaṇatayā pratipanne tadviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasyādhyāso'nupapanna ityarthaḥ | tatra na sambandhamātrādhyāsaḥ; tathā sati sambandhino jñātuḥ pāramārthyaprasaṅgāt | na ca tathābhyupe tam || nanu viśeṣaṇe viśiṣṭādhyāso dṛśyate; yathā prabhāyāṃ maṇyadhyāsa iti || idaṃ codyaṃ pṛthagavabhāsamānetyanena parihṛtam | nahi tathā vaiyadhikaraṇyena viśeṣaṇībhūtā prabhā, kintu ayaṃ maṇiriti maṇyadhyāsādhiṣṭhānabhūtā | prabhā maṇisāmānādhikaraṇyenaiva hi bhāti || nanu anubhavasāmānādhikaṃraṇyena pratītiprasañcanamayuktam; dikṣu mālinyam, nabhasi rāga sati vaiyadhikaraṇyenāpyadhyāsadarśanāt || naivam;padadvayapravṛttinimittayorekāśrayavṛttitvaṃ hi sāmānādhikaraṇyam | iha dikatvamālinyayoḥ nabhastvāruṇyayośca ekāśrayavṛttitvāt arthataḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamasti | vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ tu śabdagatam | diśo malināḥ, dikṣu mālinyamityatra ko'rthabhedaḥ? adhyāseṣu dharmyaikyapratītiravarjjanīyā | ataḥ saivātrāpadyate anubhūtirahamiti pratīyeteti || nanu,anubhūtirahamitipratītiprasaṅgo durvacaḥ | anubhūtitvaṃ hyadhiṣṭhānāsādhāraṇākāraḥ | tadasphuraṇaṃ bhramānuguṇameva | na hi, śuktī rajatamiti pratīyata iti || evaṃ tarhyanubhūternirviśeṣatayā rūpāntareṇa sphuraṇābhāvāt anubhūtitayā sphuraṇe virodhācca tadadhikaraṇādhyāsānudayaḥ |avi rodhena kṛtsnādhyāse granthoktasāmānādhikaraṇyapratītiprasaṅgo durvāraḥ | etadabhiprāyeṇa hi puro'vasthitabhāsvaradravyākāratayā rajatādirivetyuktam || nanu, adhyāsānudayo darvacaḥ, viṣayopaśliṣṭāranubhūtiḥ ahaṃ jānāmītyatra jñātradhyāse pratīyate | sā tu nādhiṣṭhānam | nirviṣayā nirāśrayānubhūtirevādhiṣṭhānam | tadaprakāśādadhyāsodaya iti || ucyate | tatra'pratipannasya adhiṣṭhānatvāyogāt viṣayāśrayaśūnyasaṃvido yogyānupalabdhinirastatvāt, viṣayaprakāśakasaṃvida eva ātmatvābhyupagamena tvayā svayamprakāśatvasamarthanācca saivādhiṣṭhānamiti tadavabhāse tasyāśca śuktitvavat bhramavirodhitve'dhyāsānudaya iti ||
dehātmābhimānavato jñātṛtvapratibhāsāt tanmithyetyuktamanūdya dūṣayati yadapyuktamityādinā | tadabādhāde veti jñātṛtvasyābādhitatvaṃ muktāvapi jñātṛtvaparaśrutivākyāt | jñātṛtvasya vikriyātmakatvaṃ nirākartuṃ tadanuvadati yadpyuktamavikriyasyeti | jñānasya dhātvarthatayā kriyātvam | tatkartṛtvaṃ ca vikārarūpam |ata eva jaḍaṃ ca | avikriyasyājaḍasyātmano na saṃbhavati | vikriyātmakatvājjaḍatvācca tādṛśāhaṅkāragranthisthamityarthaḥ | sarvādhyāsamūla tvāt granthitvam |atha hetvantareṇa ca jñātṛtvasyāntaḥkaraṇadharmatvamupapādayati kartṛtvādiriti | dṛśyatvādityarthaḥ | ātmano jñātṛtve'niṣṭaṃ prasañjayati kartṛtva iti | atra vyatirekyanumānānyabhipratānīti pūrvamevoktam | pariharati naitaditi | dehasyetyādinā antaḥkaraṇasya jñātṛtvābhāvopapādanam | ādiśabdādantavattvagrahaṇam | cetanāsādhāraṇetyādinā ātmano jñātṛtvopapādanam | jñātṛtvābhāvaḥ sādhyo'bhipretaḥ |antaḥkaraṇaṃ dharmi | acetanatvādayo hetavaḥ | dehasyeveti sapakṣo darśitaḥ | jñātṛtvasya cetanāsādhāraṇatva kathanāt vyatirekavyāptiśca kathitā | evaṃ paroktavyatirekiṇāṃ pratyanumānānyuktāni bhavantiantaḥkaraṇaṃ na jñātṛ acetanatvāt prakṛtipariṇāmatvāt dṛśya tvāt parākatvāt parārthatvāt dehavaditi | nanu,acetanatvāt ajñātṛtva sādhye sādhyāviśiṣṭatā || naivamacetanaśabdenānātmatvasya vivakṣitatvāt | puruṣārthapratisambandhitvam, dehaṃ prati niyantṛtayā antaḥpraviṣṭatvaṃ vā ātma tvam; tadabhāvo'nātmatvam | prakṛtipariṇāmatvaṃ prakṛtikāryatvam | dṛśyatvaṃ niyamena jñānāntarāthīnasiddhitvam | parākatvam parasmai bhāsamānatvam | parārthatva paraprayojanaikaphalatvam; jīvopakaraṇatvamityarthaḥ |ātmano jñātṛtve sādhye amī hetavo yathāsaṃbhavaṃ tarkkāḥ yojanāyāḥātmano jñātṛtvābhāve dehasyevānātmatvaprasaṅgaḥ, parārthatvaprasaṅga iti | nanu yathā ghaṭadehayoracetanatvādike tulye'pi indriyākṣayatvādikaṃ dehāsādhāraṇaṃ bhavati tathā dehāntaḥkaraṇayoḥ acetanatvādike tulyapi jñātṛtvamantaḥkaraṇāsādhāraṇadharmaḥ syāt | ata indriyāśrayatvābhāvasyeva jñātṛtvābhāvasyāpyacetanatvādikamaprayojakam |acidviśeṣatvameva prayojakam | tathā''tmano jñātṛtvābhāve'pi pratyakatvādirupapadyatāmityubhatrāpi vipakṣe bādhakābhāvamāśaṅkaya pariharati etaduktamiti | yena dṛśyatvādiviruddhadharmeṇa dehasya draṣṭatvādyanupapattiḥ, tenāntaḥkaraṇasyāpi taddravyatvāt draṣṭṛtvādyanupapattirityarthaḥ | jñātṛtvāmāvaṃ prati acetanatvādikamaprayojakaṃ cet, dehasya jñātṛtvaprasaṅgaḥ | tataśca cārvākaṃ prati dehātmabhedastvayā'pi durupapādaḥ | na ca dehasya dehatvādajñātṛtvam, ghaṭādau dehatvabhāve'pi jñātṛtvābhāvāt | ataḥ tatrācittvādikasya jñātṛtvābhāvaprayojakatvamabhyupagantavyamiti kkacit jñātṛtvābhāvāprayojakasya tasyācittatvādeḥ kkacidaprayojakatvamayuktam |ato'cittvādibhirddehasyeva antaḥkaraṇasya draṣṭṛtvādyanupapattirityarthaḥ | pratyakatvāderiti ādiśabdādajaḍatvagrahaṇam | vivicyate | pratyakatvādidharmmaiḥ sambandharahito'vagamyata ityarthaḥ | taireva hetubhistasmādvivicyata iti | parākatvādibhirdehasya jñātṛtvābhāve ukte parakatvaṃ vyāpyaṃ jñātṛtvabhāvo vyāpaka iti sidhyati | tataśca svābhāvavyāpteṣu parākṣu niravakāśaṃ jñātṛtvaṃ yadi pratyagvastunyapi na syāt, tadā nirāśrayaṃ prasajediti pūrvoktavyāptisthāpanāya vipakṣe bādhakastarko'trāpyabhipretaḥ | tasmādvividhyata ityetaduktamityanvayaḥ |ato'cetanatvajaḍatvādisvabhāvavirodhānnāhaṅkārasya jñātṛtvamityāha ata iti |
nahi vayaṃ draṣṭṛtvādyanupapattyā dehātmavivekaṃ vrūmaḥ | sa tu paramatānusārātkṛtaḥ | vayaṃ tu dṛśitvānupapattyeti śaṅkāyām draṣṭṛtvābhāvasyaiacetanatvādiprayojyatve mṛṣāvādyasādhāraṇapratibandīmāha dṛśitvavaditi | tadeva vivṛ ṇeti yatheti | dṛśyatvādyaviśeṣe'pi dehasya ghaṭādivilakṣaṇasyendrāyāśrayatvavat antaḥkaraṇasya dṛśitvaṃ upapadya tām || antaḥkaraṇasyāpi dṛśyatvādinā dehasyeva dṛśitvaṃ nopapadyata | iti cet tathādṛśyasya antaḥkaraṇasya dṛśyatvādinaiva deharsyava dṛṣṭatvamapi nopapadyate | ato dṛśitvābhāva iva draṣṭṛtvābhāve'pi acetanatvādikaṃ prayoja kam; anvayavyatirekayostulyatvāt upāyāntarādaśarnācceti bhāvaḥ |
ahampratyayagocaratvamanātmatvasādhakaṃ dehasyeveti yaduktam, tadayuktam; bādhitāhampratyayagocaratvasya pakṣe vṛttyabhāvāt abādhitāhampratyayagocaratvasya sapakṣe dehādāvabhāvācca | yadyahampratyayagocaratvamātreṇātmani ayanātmatvādiprasaṅgaḥ, tarhi rajatapratyayagocaratvamātreṇa bhrāntavat (abhrānta) samyagrajate'pyarajatatvagulīyakanirmāṇānarhatvaprasaṅgaḥ syāditi asaṅgatam | śrutibhiḥ pratyakṣeṇa ca kālātyayāpadeśaśca | anātmatvādiprasañjakaṃ kartṛtvaṃ kiṃ prayatnādhāratvam uta spandarūpakriyāśrayatvam uta dhātvarthamātrāśrayatvam | prathame, vyāptyabhāvaḥ; prayatnādhāratvānātmatvayoḥ kkacit sahadarśanābhāvāt | paramātmanyanātmatvādiprasaṅgaścet, "kartāramīśaṃ puruṣam" ityādinā kālātyayāpadeśaśca | jīve cet, "sādhukārī sādhurbhavati", "kartā śāstrārthavattvāt", "yataḥ svakṛtabhuk pumān" ityādibhiḥ pratyakṣeṇa ca kālātyayāpadeśaśca | dvitīye,paramātmanyasiddhiḥ | jīve tūtkrāntyādiśrutibhiḥ kālātyayāpadeśaḥ | tṛtīye, bhramāśratayā svābhimatātmanyanātmatvaprasaṅgaḥ || bhedadarśanaṃ tadāśrayatvaṃ cāpāramārthikamiti cetkiṃ paramārthabhūtadhātvarthāśrayatvamanātmatvasādhakam utāparamātharbhūtadhātvarthāśrayatvam? prathame ghaṭādāvapi paramārthabhūtadhātvarthānvayānabhyupagamāt vyāptyabhāvaḥ | dvitīye, tvadabhimatasya bhramāśrayasyā''tmano'pyanātmatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
atha vikriyātmakatvaṃ netyāha na ceti | tadupapādayati jñātṛtvaṃ hīti | guṇā(kriyā)śrayatve'pi tat kādācitkaṃ cet kriyāśrayatvavat vikriyātmakaṃ syādityatrāha jñānaṃ cāsyeti | dharmasya svābhāvikatve'pi dharmī anityaścet dharmo'pyanityaḥ syāt | dharminityatve dharmaḥ sopādhikaścet, upādhivigame dharmo naśyatītyanityaḥ syāt |
ubhayavyāvṛttyarthau nityasvābhāvikaśabdau | avasthāviśeṣeṇa kadācitkatvaṃ tu prāmāṇikatvādiṣṭam | anena padadvayena, "na hi vijñāturvijñātevirparilopo vidyate avināśitvādātmanaḥ" iti śrutyartha ukto bhavati | asyāḥ śruterayamarthaḥjñātṛsaṃbandhi vijñānaṃ nityam; kutaḥ? avināśitvādātmanaḥ | viśiṣṭasya nityatvena viśeṣaṇabhūtajñānasyāpi nityatvāt | yadvā dharminityatvena tatsvābhāvikadharmasyāpi nityatvāditi | ātmano nityatve jñānasya tatsvābhāvikadharmatve ca pramāṇaṃ smārayan pūrvabheva śrutivākyopādānāt sūtramudāharati nityatvaṃ ceti | sūtrodāhara ṇena tadviṣayabhūtā śrutirapi hyarthato darśitā syāt | sūtraṃ ca pūrvaṃ jñānaguṇakatvapradarśanāyopāttam; idānīṃ nityatvajñāpanāyopāttam | "jño'ta evetyatra jña iti vyapadeśasya vivaraṇam, "yāvadātmabhāvitvācca na doṣaḥ" iti sūtram | atraḥ svābhāvikatvasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | jñānasvarūpasya jñānāśrayatvaṃ kathamityatrāha asyeti | jñānaṃ svābhāvikanityadharmaścet, sarvadā sarvajñatvaprasaṅga ityatrāha svayamiti | svayaṃ svataḥ | "sampadyāvirbhāva" ityādisūtre upapādayiṣyāma ityarthaḥ | anantarameveti vā'rthaḥ | tarhīdānīmapi kadācit savarjñatvam, muktau ca kadācid jñānasaṅkocaḥ kiṃ na syāt | yadi kṣetrajñāvasthāyāṃ saṅkocaḥ,tarhi sarve'pyajñāḥ syurityatrāha ataḥ kṣetrajñeti | ataḥsaṅkocavikāsārhatvāt | karmaṇeti saṅkocakopādhiḥ | kṣetrajñāvasthāyāmiti | tadānīmeva saṅkoca ityarthaḥ | sarveṣāmajñatyaprasaktiśca karmatāratabhyātparihṛtā | tāravamyaśabdena, "tayā tirohitatvācca śaktiḥ kṣatrajñasaṃjñitā | sarva bhūteṣu bhūpāla tāratamyena vartate" iti vacanaṃ smāritaṃ bhavati | karmaṇetipadena tayati padaṃ ślokasthaṃ vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | tayā karmarūpāvidyayetyarthaḥ | "avidyā karmasaṃjñā'nyā tṛtīyā śaktiripyate | yathā kṣetrajñaśaktiḥ sā veṣṭitā nṛpa ! sarvagā || saṃsāratāpānakhilānavāprotvatisaṃtatān" iti hi prakṛtam | jñānasya nityatvena anutpattikatvāt indriyanairapakṣyaṃ syādityatrāha tacceti | yadvā syāvareṣvapi jñānavikāsaḥ syāditrāha tacceti | indriyadvārākatvaṃ saṅkocavikāsārthamityarthaḥ | tarhyutpattivināśavyapadeśo na syādityatrāha tamimamiti | prasarānvayavyatirekāvapekṣya udāyāstamayavyapadeśa ityarthaḥ | yadvā prasṛtāṃśaḥ prasaraḥ | tasya prasaraṇasaṅkocāvudayāstamayāvi tyarthaḥ | saṅkocavikāsābhyupagame vikriyātmakatvaṃ syādityatrāha jñānaprasare tviti | tādṛśavikriyātmakatvaṃ prāmāṇikatvāt iṣṭamityarthaḥ | acetanavat pariṇāmo hyanabhyupagata ityevakārābhiprāyaḥ |anena bhāvikāraśrutīnāṃ viṣayo darśitaḥ | mukhāntareṇāpyavikāraśrutīnāṃ nirvāhaṃ darśayati tacceti | svābhāvikavikāraniṣedhaparā avikāraśrutaya ityarthaḥ | svābhāvikaṃ rūpaṃ kathamityatrāha avikriyeti | svarūpamsvābhāvikarūpam | avikāritvavākyāni upādhivimuktasvābhāvikarūpaparāṇītyarthaḥ | prasaraṇakartṛtvamapi vikārarūpatvāt antaḥkaraṇasyaivetyatrāha evaṃrūpavikriyātmakamiti | svadharmabhūtajñānaprasaraṇakartṛtvalakṣaṇavikāritvamevaṃrūpaśabdena vivakṣitam | jñānasvarūpasya |jñānameva svābhāviko dharmaḥ yasya sa jñānasvarūpaḥ | svadharmabhūtajñānaprasarakartṛtvalakṣaṇavikāraḥ taddharmakasyātmana eva saṃbhavati, na tu jaḍatvāt ataddharmasyāhaṅkārasyetyarthaḥ | evaṃ vikriyātmakatvāt jñātṛtvasya ātmadharmatvānupapattinirastā |
atha paroktān jñātṛtvanirvāha prakārān nirasyati | jñātṛtvaṃ cicchāyāpattikṛtam, citsaṃparkakṛtam, cidabhivyañjakatvakṛtamiti trayaḥ pakṣāḥ | tatra prathamaṃ cicchāyāpattipakṣamāśaṅkate jaḍeti | dūṣayati keyamiti | keyaṃdurnirūpetyarthaḥ | vikalpayati kimiti | cicchāyāśabdayoḥ samāsāntargatā vibhaktiḥ ṣaṣṭhī vā saptamī veti bhāvaḥ |
ahaṅkāracchāyāpattissaṃvidaḥ | ahaṅkāre saṃvidgatajñātṛtvacchāyāpattirityarthaḥ | saṃvicchāyāpattirahaṅkarasyeti | saṃvidi ahaṅkāragatajñātṛtvacchayāpattirityarthaḥ | prathamaṃ dūṣayati na tāvaditi | śiro'ntaraṃ vyudasyati nāpīti |
pūrvamacetanatvaprakṛtipariṇāmatvādibhirahaṅkārasya jñātṛtvavyudāsamabhipretyāha uktarītyeti | dūṣaṇāntaramāha dvayora pīti | tadvivṛṇoti na hīti | citsaṃparkaṃ dūṣayituṃ śaṅkate atheti | pūrvavadvikalpya dūṣayati naitaditi | iyaṃ sādhā raṇī pratijñā | ahaṅkāre saṃvitsamparkāt jñātṛtvaṃ vyudasyati saṃvidīti | ahaṅkārasamparkāt saṃvida jñātṛtvaṃ dūṣayati ahaṅkārasya tviti | sutarāmiti | jñānasyājaḍatvāt jñānāśrayatvaṃ svamate na saṃbhavati | ahaṅkārasya jaḍatvena vastuto jñānāśrayatvasya svaparapakṣayorubhayorapyasambhavānna tatsamparkāt saṃvidi jñātṛtvamiti bhāvaḥ | rumāgatakāṣṭhādīnāṃ lavaṇasambandhāllavaṇatvotpattirdṛśyate; ayaḥpiṇḍe'gnisamparkāduṣṇatvamupalabhyate |ato jñātṛtvaṃ tadupalabdhirveti pṛthaguktam | nanu pūrvokte pakṣadvaye jñātṛtvasya chāyāpattisamparkau nirastau | jñānacchāyāpattisampakau kasmānna nirastau || vakṣyamāṇābhivyaktipakṣāntarbhāvāditi vrūmaḥ | jñānasyāhaṅkāre chāyāpattirnāma darpaṇe mukhasyeva tadādheya tayā abhivyaktatā | saṃparkapakṣe'pyadhiṣṭhānatayā saṃparkau jñātṛtvapratītyanupayuktaḥ | ata ādheyatayā saṃparko vaktavyaḥ | sa ca tatsthatayā'bhivyaktāvantargataḥ | atastatrā(da?)nupanyāsaḥ | kiñca chāyāpattiḥ saṃvido'cākṣuṣatvenaiva nira stā | saṃparkaścopammānuguṇyena vaktavyatvāt apṛthaksiddhadharmadharmibhāvena vaktavyaḥ | sa ca nopapannaḥ; acetanasya caitanyasya ca tathāvidhadharmadharmibhāvāyogāt | daṇḍadevadattayoriva jñānajñātroḥ pṛthagavasthānādarśanāt apṛthagavasthitayossamparkaśca anupapanna ityanusandheyam | athābhivyaktipakṣamanubhāṣituṃ chāyāpattisamparkapakṣayorabhivyaktipakṣasya cānyonyavaiṣamyaṃ darśayati ubhayatreti | vastuta iti | chāyāpattyādinā āpādyamānādadhyāsātpūrvameva siddhatvaṃ vivakṣi tam; na tu pāramārthikatvam | alātacakrāderapi pratibimbadarśanāt,uṣṇajalasamparkādanuṣṇe'pyau ṇopalambhācca | ekatra pūrvasiddhajñātṛtvādhyāsādanyatra jñātṛtvanivārhaḥ pūrvasmin pakṣadvaye; abhivyaktipakṣe tu jñātṛtvasya pūrvasiddhimanapekṣya jñānādhyāsāt jñātṛtvanirvāha iti vaiṣamyam | abhivyaktipakṣamāha ahaṅkārastviti | dūṣayati tadayukta miti | kuta ityapekṣāyāmātmano abhivyañjakāpekṣā ca nāsti, ahaṅkārasyābhivyañjakatvaśaktirapi nāstītyāha ātmana ityādinā | svoktārthasya sāṃpradāyikatvapradarśanārthaṃ, dṛṣṭāntena tadviśadīkaraṇārthaṃ cātmasiddhigranthamāha taduktamiti |
śāntāṅgāra ityādikaṃ ślokaṃ vivṛṇoti svayamiti | svayamprakāśaśabdena abhivyañjakāpekṣāyā abhāva uktaḥ | anubhavādhīnasiddhaya ityanena ahaṅkārasyābhivyañjakatvābhāva uktaḥ | acidahaṅkāra ityanena cinmātrātirekitvāt tadāyattaprakāśa iti paroktahetuḥ sūcitaḥ | anuditānastamitasvarūpaprakāśam | kadācidaprakāśaṃ cet, tadā abhivyañjakāpekṣā syāt; tadabhāvāt kadācidapi vyañjakāpekṣā nāstītyarthaḥ | aśeṣātharsiddhihetubhūtam | tvayā viṣayaprakāśakatvena hi svayamprakāśatvaṃ samarthitamiti bhāvaḥ | parihasantīti | īdṛśamanubhavamīdṛśo'haṅkāro'bhivyanaktīti tvadīyā eva tvatsamīpasthā eva hasantīti bhāvaḥ |
ahaṅkārānubhavayorabhivyañjakatvābhivyaṅgayatvānabhyupagamena dūṣaṇamuktam | tayorabhivyañjakatvam bhivyaṅgayatvañcāstu, tatparasparaṃ nopapadyata ityāha  kiñceti | svabhāvavirodhātanubhavasyāśeṣārthasiddhihetutvaṃ tadvayatiriktatvenāhaṅkārasyāsya tadadhīnasiddhitvaṃ ca virodhaḥ | yathā pitāputrayoranyaṃ prati putratve pitṛtve ca satyapi parasparaṃ pitṛtvaputratvavyatyayo nopapadyate, evamanyāpekṣayā tayorvyaṅktṛvyaṅgayabhāva saṃbhave'pi parasparaṃ nopapadyata ityarthaḥ | dūṣaṇāntaraṃ cāha anubhūterananubhūtivaprasaṅgācceti |
asminnartheapyātmasiddhigranthaṃ darśayati yathoktamiti | pratikūlyataḥ pūrvokta svabhāvavirodhaśabdena pratikūlyaśabdo vyākhyātaḥ | tadvayaṅgayasyaiva tadvayañjakatve paroktadṛṣṭāntaṃ dūṣayiṣyannāha na ceti | dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavikalatvamāha tatrapīti | tatra tathātvasyānyathāsidiṃdha darśayati | karataleti  nahi brahmaprasaraṇasvabhāvaṃ dravyam, atastadvāhulyahetutvamahaṅkārasyā'nupapannamityarthaḥ || tathā ahaṅkāreṇāsyābhivyakiṃta tri(tre)dhā vikalpya dūṣayati kiñcetyādinā | kiṃ rūpākiṃ śabdaḥ kṣepārthaḥ | dunnirrūpetyarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāpekṣāyāṃ abhivyaktirnāma kimutpattiḥ, uta prakāśanam, utānubhavasādhanānugrahaḥ iti tri(tre)dhā vikalpamabhipretyotpattipakṣaṃ dūṣayati na tāvaditi | anutpannasya ghaṭāderabhivyaktayasambhavāt utpādakasyāpi daṇḍacakrādeḥ utpādanadvārā abhivyaktihetutvāt utpattirapi vikalpaśirasi niveśitā | kiñca vyaṅgayaprakāśotpādanaṃ vyañjanam | saṃvidaḥ svayameva prakāśarūpatvāt tadutpatti reva tatprakāśotpattirūpābhivyaktiriti vikalpaśirasyutpattiniveśaḥ | svataḥsiddhatayeti |tathā hi prāgabhāvābhāva uktaḥ | anāditvāditi vārthaḥ | atha dvitīyaṃ vyudasyati nāpīti | prakāśanamanubhavaviṣayaprakāśotpattiḥ |
atha tṛtīyaṃ prativakti tata iti | tata evaprakāśānupapattereva || nanvanantaragranthotthānamanupapannam; anugrāhakadvaividhyasya tannirāsānupayogitvāt | uttarātrātmasiddhigranthodāharaṇaṃ ca na saṅgatam; indriyāsambandhavācitvenānugrahadvaividhyānupayogāt || atrocyate | pūrvamanugrāhyajanyaprakāśaviṣayānubhūtiparyālocanayā tadanubhavasādhanānugraho dūṣitaḥ | idānīmanugrahaprakāraviśeṣaparyālocanayā dūṣaṇamāha sa hīti | dvividhasyāpyanupapatiṃta darśayituṃ prathamaṃ dvaividhyamāha jñeyasyeti | śamadabhādeḥ śāstrānugrāhakatvoktiḥ paramatena | taddhi upāsanānugrāhakam || nanu sa hi dvidha ti vaktumayuktam; anugrahasya koṭidvaye'pyanantabhāvāt | anumānādeḥ rvyāptigrahādiranugraho'pyastīti || ucyate |karaṇānugrahaḥ kartranugrahaśceti koṭidvayameva | vyāptigrahaṇamapi karaṇānugrahāntarbhūtam | yadvā dṛṣṭamukhena cānugrahaḥ adṛṣṭamukhena ceti dvidhā | vyāptigrahaṇamapi dṛṣṭamukhenānugrahaḥ | tasmādindriyasambandhahetutvenetyetat karaṇānugraha sya dṛṣṭamukhenānugrahasya copalakṣaṇam | tatrāhaṅkārābhivyaṅgayāyāḥ saṃvido'numānaviṣayatvāsaṃbhavāt indriyasambandhahetutvenetyuktam | boddhṛgatakalmaṣāpanayaneneti kartranugrahasyādṛṣṭamukhenānugrahasya copalakṣaṇamuktam | ātmasiddhigranthe'pyayameva bhāvaḥ | evaṃ dvaividhyadarśanena dvidhābhūto'pyanugraho'haṅkārasya na suvaca ityanuṣaṅgeṇa yojanā | kathamatra dvividhasyāpyanugrahasyānupapattiriti śaṅkāyāmātmasiddhigranthamāha yathoktamiti | "karaṇānāmabhūmitvāt na tatsambandhahetutā" iti hetutvalakṣaṇānugrahaḥ anupapanna iti darśitaḥ | boddhṛgatakalmaṣāpanayanalakṣaṇānugrahānupapattirna granthasthā | atra kecidācāryā evaṃ vyācakṣate śamāderanugrāhakatvaṃ śāstrasiddham, na tathā ahaṅkārasyānugrāhakatvaṃ śāstrasiddhamiti sphuṭatvānna granthe kaṇṭhoktayā nirāsa iti | pūrvārdhaudāharaṇena ślokasyottarārdhai boddṛgatakalmaṣāpanayanalakṣaṇānugrahānupapattirdraṣṭavyetyācāryāḥ | tadidamuttarārdhaṃ ahamarthasya boddhṛtvānna sa tenaiva śodhyate" iti | ekasyaiva svapratiyogitayā śodhyatvaṃ śodhakatvaṃ cānupapannamityarthaḥ | ayaṃ tu bhāṣyābhiprāyaḥahamarthasya boddhṛgatakalmaṣāpanayane kartṛtvaṃ kiṃ svarūpeṇa utādṛṣṭakiñcitkāramukhena | prathame karmakartṛvirodhaḥ, ekasyaiva svāpekṣayā śodhyatvaśodhakatvānupapatteḥ | dvitīye niṣpramāṇakatvam | na hyantaḥkaraṇasyādṛṣṭavaśādantaḥkaraṇaśuddhirityatra pramāṇama stīti |
pūrvamindiyagocaratvānabhyupagamena dūṣaṇamuktam; athānubhāvyatvābhyupagamena dūṣaṇamāha kiñceti | anugrahasvarūpaṃ śikṣayati sahīti || vyaktidarpaṇādāvanugrahaprakārāntare dṛṣṭe api kathaṃ pratibandhanirasanarūpānugraha eva pariśeṣitaḥ || ucyate | jātivyaktayoniyatadharmadharmibhāvena, vyaktiḥ jāteḥ rvyāñjikā | na tathā ahaṅkārānubhavayoḥ niyatadharmidharmabhāvo'sti | sa tu pareṇaiva nirastaḥ | mūrtadravyabhūtaḥ cākṣuṣaraśmipratihatihetuḥ darpaṇomūrtadravyabhūtacākṣuṣaraśmi mukhena sambandhayati; na tathā ahaṅkāro mūrtadravyaṃ kasya citpratihatiheturiti vakṣyamāṇāmihānugrahaprakārāntarānupapattimabhipretya pratibandhanirasanarūpānugraha eva pariśeṣitaḥ | īdṛśānugrahe dṛṣṭāntamāha yathā rūpādīti | tataḥ kimityatrāha na ceheti | tadumapāyati na tāvaditi | kiṃ prāgabhāvarūpamajñānam kiṃ vā bhāvarūpam utānyannirasanīyamucyata iti śirastrayamabhipratya tāvacchabdaḥ prayuktaḥ | na tāvaditi granthena anyannirasanīyaṃ nirastam | yadvā ahaṅkārasyājñānanirāsakatvamajñānasya saṃvitsambandhitvaṃ cobhayamanupapannamityabhipretya prathamamahaṅkārāpaneyatvamajñānasya pratikṣipati na tāvaditi | ahaṅkārapaneyamajñānamastīti śaṅkate asti hīti | dūṣayati neti | ajñānaśabdo bhāvasarūpasya cābhāvarūpasya ca sādhāraṇaḥ | dūṣaṇamapi sādhāraṇam; dvividhasyāpyajñānasya ahaṅkārāpanodyatvābhāvāt | kiṃ nivartakamityatrāha jñānameva hīti | prāgabhāvasyāpi jñānotpattirnivartikā | bhāvarūpasyāpi jñānanivartyatvaṃ parābhyupetam |
evamajñānasya saṃvidāśrayatve satyapyahaṅkārāpanodyatvāyogāt tannirasanarūpānugraho na sambhavatītyuktam; athājñānasya saṃvidāśrayatvaṃ cānupapannamityāha na ceti | saṃvidāśrayatvam | saṃvitsambandhitvamityarthaḥ | āśraya ṇam sambandhaḥ | saṃbandhaśca karmatvenāśrayatvena ca ityubhayavidhasambandhapara āśrayaśabdaḥ | "āśrayaścetaso brahme" ityādiprayogāccāśrayaśabdena viṣayasyāpyupasthāpanaṃ yuktam | saṃvido ajñānasambandhaḥ kim āśrayatayā kiṃ viṣayatayā? ubhayathā'pi saṃbandho'nupapanna ityarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha jñāneti | tataḥ kimityatrāha jñātṛbhāveti | sākṣiṇi | draṣṭu reva sākṣitvam; jñaptestu sākṣitvamapi vyāhataṃ bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ | bhavitumarhatīti rnirdeśena āśrayatayā viṣayatayā vā sambandhamātraṃ vivakṣitam | anena vyatirekavyāptirdaśitā bhavati | saṃvidāśrayatvābhāve anvayavyāptiṃ darśayati yatheti | ajñānāśrayatvaṃ (hi) jñānaprāgabhāvāśrayatvamanirvacanīyājñānāśrayatvaṃ vā | tat ghaṭādau nāstītyarthaḥ | jñānāśrayatva prasaktīti | jñāturapyajñānāśrayatvaṃ jñānāśrayatvaṃ ca kālabhedādaviruddhamiti bhāvaḥ | jñānātyantābhāvāśrayatvaṃ hi dhaṭādeḥ | jñānaṃ nājñānaśrayaḥ; na cājñānaviṣayaḥ | ajñānāśrayatve tadviṣayatve copagamyamāne jñātṛtvajñeyatvaprasaṅga iti pratikūlatarka ukto bhavati | evamajñānāśrayatvānabhyupagamena dūṣaṇamuktam | tadabhyupagamena dūṣaṇamāha saṃvida iti | avacchinnajñānasyānubhāvyatve'ṅgīkṛte'pyanavacchinnasyātmabhūtasya jñānasyānubhāvyatvānabhyupagamādityābhiprāyeṇāha ātmatayā'yupagatāyā iti | jñānaviṣayasyaivājñānanivṛtiṃta sadṛṣṭāntamāha jñānaṃ hīti | yadyaviṣaye'pyajñānanivṛttiḥ tarhi śuktijñānena sarva(rpa)bhramanivṛttiḥ syādityabhiprāyaḥ | evaṃ jñānanivartyājñānāśrayatve jñānaviṣayatvaprasaṅga ityuktaṃ bhavati | āśrayatvābhyupagamenoktadūṣaṇaṃ nigamayati ata iti | tvayā ahaṅkārāpohyatvenoktamajñānaṃ kiṃ sadasadanirvacanīyam uta jñānaprāgabhāvarūpam iti vikalpyā''ha asyeti | dvitīyaṃ prativakti jñānaprāgabhāveti | virodhiśabdena pratibandhakatvaṃ vivakṣitam, na sahānavasthānamātram, | abhivyakterdurnnirūpatvaṃ nigamayati ata iti | kenāpi prakāreṇa |utpādakatvena vā prakāśakatvena vā tadanubhavasādhanānugrāhakatvena vetyathaḥ |
atha svātmasthatayā'bhivyakiṃta dūṣayati na ceti | vyabhicāramāha pradīpādiṣviti | hetvantaraṃ cāha yathāvasthiteti | pratītiḥ vyavahārānuguṇyam; tadanuguṇāt jñānādīnāṃ svabhāvādityarthaḥ | tadeva upapādayati | tacceti |
pramāṇyāprāmāṇyaviṣayāścatvāraḥ pakṣāḥ | prāmāṇyāprāmāṇye dve ca parataḥ, dve ca svataḥ, prāmāṇyaṃ parataḥ anyat svataḥ, prāmāṇyaṃ svataḥ anyat parata iti | prathamamanupapannam,niḥsvabhāvatvādiprasaṅgāt | prāmāṇyāprāmāṇye anyatra vidyete cettatsambandhāt jñānasya tathātvam, tatsambandhābhāve'nubhayatvaṃ ca yuktam; anuṣṇāśītavat | anyatra tayoravidyamānatvāt paratastvamanupapannam | prāmāṇyabubhutsāparamparayā'navasthāprasaṅgācca | dvayorapi svatastvamanupapannam; viruddhadharmatvena vyādhātāt | na ca vyaktibhedādavirodhaḥ; iyaṃ prāmāṇyāśrayavyakti iyaṃ neti niyāmakābhāvāt |
aprāmāṇyasyaiva stastvamanupapannam; prāmāṇyasyaiva bhūyastvāt anyasyābhūyastvācca | bhūyasaṃ svatastvaṃ alpīyasa au(sāmau)pādhikatvañca hi yuktam | ghaṭapaṭādijñāneṣu, śuktirajātādijñānānāmidamaṃśeśaṣvapi prāmāṇyadarśanāt tasya bhūtastvam | ataḥ svataḥ prāmāṇyaṃ parato'prāmāṇyamiti |
kkacidātmasthatayā'bhivyañjanamabhyupetya vyabhicāra uktaḥ | atha kkacidapi tannāstītyāha na ceti | tarhi mukhadarśanāya darppaṇādikaṃ nopādīyetetyatrāha api tviti | pratiphalanasya doṣatvamanyathājñānahetutvādityāha taddo ṣeti | kastatrābhivyañjaka ityatrāha abhivyañjakastviti | ahaṅkārasya mūrttasvacchasthūladravyatvābhāvāt saṃvido jñeyatvābhāvādacākṣupatvācca ahaṅkāreṇa saṃvidi aviṣayabhūtāyāṃ tadgrahakavastupratiphalanadoṣo na sambhavatītyāha na ceheti | vyaktau jātipratītirniyatadharmadharmibhāvāt na tu vyaṅgayatvādityāha vyakteriti | etat darpaṇavyaktinirvāha dvayaṃ hṛdi nidhāya pūrvaṃ pratibandhanirasanarūpānugraho dūṣitaḥ | dharmadharmibhāvena vastutaḥ tātsthenopalabdhirvyaktau; daparṇe tu pratiphalanarūpadoṣāt | evaṃ parapakṣe na saṃbhavatītyāha ata iti | vastutaḥ kāraṇaṃ dharmadharmibhāvaḥ; doṣastu tātsthyenopalabdhikāraṇaṃ mūrtasvacchasthūladravyatvam | ubhayamapyahaṅkāre nāstītyarthaḥ | vastutaḥ kāraṇābhāvānna jñātṛtvaṃ vidyate, doṣarūpakāraṇābhāvānnopalabhyate cetyabhiprāyeṇāha nāhaṅkārasya jñātṛtvaṃ tathopalabdhirveti | jñāturātmatvaṃ nigama yati tasmāditi | jñapterātmatvamayuktam, ahaṃ tvābhāve pratyakatvāyogādityāha ahambhāva(na?)vigama iti | ahamiti vyavahārānuguṇabhāsanavirahe svasmai bhāsamānatvaṃ na syāt | ataḥ pratyakatvamapyahamarthasyaivātmatvasādhakamityarthaḥ |
atha suṣuptāvahamarthasphuraṇamastīti sādhayitum "vedāntāvalambibhiḥ sarvaiḥ svayaṃjyotiṣṭvaśrutyanusārāt suṣuptāvātmasphuraṇamabhyupeyam | tatra, "nāha svalvayamevaṃ saṃpratyātmānaṃ jānāti ayayamahamasmi" iti śrutyā, "māmapyahaṃ na jñātavān iti parāmarśācca nāhamarthānubhavaḥ | ato'nubhūtisphuraṇameva tadānīm iti śaṅkāyāmahamarthasyāviśadasphuraṇamastīti sopapattikaṃ pratijānīte tama ityādinā | castvarthaḥ śaṅkānivṛttau | tamoguṇābhibhavahetukāt parāgarthānubhavābhāvāt sphuṭāvabhāsābhāvaḥ | viviktapratibhāsaḥvyāvṛttapratibhāsaḥ | anekaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭāvabhāsaḥ sphuṭāvabhāsaḥ | vyāvarttakabrāhmaṇatvādibāhyadharmaviśiṣṭatvena buddhisukhādyāntaradharmaviśiṣṭatvena ca pratibhāsābhā vāt, sakaletaravyāvṛttatayā sphuṭatayā ca pratibhāsābhāvaḥ | kenākāreṇa sphuratītyatrāha ahamityekākāreṇa sphuraṇāditi | ahamiti na śabdānukāraḥ; apitvetadvācyārthānukāraḥ | pratyakatvākāreṇa sphuraṇādityarthaḥ | eka śabdena ahambhāvāvigamo vivakṣitaḥ | yadvā ekākāreṇasarvātmasādhāraṇākāreṇetyarthaḥ | pratyakatvādiko hi sarvātmasādhāraṇaḥ | sukhaduḥvādayo devatvādayaśca na hi sarvātmasādhāraṇāḥ | suṣuptau bhāsamāna ātmanyahambhāvaḥ sādhyaḥ; tathā sphuraṇaṃ hetuḥ | viśadāvabhāsābhāvādahamarthasphuraṇaṃ nāstītyatrāha bhavadabhimatāyā anubhūterapīti | na kevalamahamarthasphuraṇe eva avaiśadyadoṣaḥ; anubhūtisphuraṇe'pi sa tvayā vācyaḥ (sa tulayaḥ) | ato viśadāvabhāsābhāvāt nāstitvaṃ cet, jñaptyātmano'pi tadānīṃ sphuraṇaṃ na syāt | "jñātṛjñeyopaśleṣavirahāt sphuṭānavabhāsaḥ" iti hi tadabhyupagama ityabhiprāyaḥ | mṛṣāvādibhirvādyantarairapi jāgaritāvasthāyāmeva aviśadāvabhāso nirvikalpake'ṅgīkṛtaḥ | te yadi viśadāvabhāvābhāvadahamarthāsphuraṇaṃ vrūyuḥ, tatrāpinirvikalpake pṛthakpṛthagvastumātrāvabhāsābhyupagamo nopapadyate | aviśadavastumātrāvabhāsaḥ parairaprāmāṇiko nirvikalpake svīkṛtaḥ; atra tu, "atrāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayaṃjyotirbhavati" ityādiśrutyanusārādaviśadāvabhāsaḥ prāmāṇikaḥ svīkṛta iti bhidā | ataḥ suṣuptāvātmasphuraṇābhyupagame aviśadāvabhāsābhyupagame ca tulyepi bhṛṣāvādimatādapi svapakṣe pramāṇānuguṇyaṃ vivakṣuḥ parapakṣe pramāṇānanuguṇatvaṃ darśayati na hīti | ahambhāvaviyuktaarthāntarapratyanīkākārājñātṛjñeyādisamastaviśeṣaparahitetyarthaḥ | pratyakatvasidhdyarthaṃ jñaptirahamiti atrāhaṃśabdopādānam | svapakṣe parāmarśānuguṇyamāha evaṃ hīti | ayaṃ parāmarśaḥ suṣupti kāle sukharūpatayā'nubhūtātmagocaraḥ | atītakālasambandhasvāpau tu pūrvakālānubhūtārthapratyabhijñānayogyānapalabdhibhyāmanumeyau | svato'nukūlatayā'vabhāsamānasya ahamarthasyā'numānikakālasvāpavaiśiṣṭayagocarapratyabhijñāviśeṣo'yaṃ parāmarśaḥ sukhamahamasvāpsamiti | evaṃ svaparamatayoḥ parāmarśanuguṇyatadabhāvarūpavaiṣamyabhuktam | śrutisvārasyaṃ ca asmanmate; "atrāyaṃ puruṣaḥsvayaṃjyotiḥ" iti puruṣaśabdaśravaṇāt | puruṣaśabdo na saṃvinmātraparaḥ | "eṣa hi draṣṭā śrotā rasayitā dhrātā mantā boddhā vijñānātmā puruṣaḥ" iti jñātṛreva puruṣatvaśravaṇāt; lloke jñātari puruṣaśabdaprasiddheśca | pratyakatvasiddhiścāsmanmata eveti vakṣyate | uktaparāmarśaphalitamarthamāha aneneti |
sukhamahamasvāpsamiti parāmarśe sukhamityanena tadānīmanukūlatayā bhāsamānatvamusaṃhitaṃ bhavati ha ahamityanena svasmai bhāsamānatvarūpapratyakatvaṃ cānusaṃhitaṃ bhavati | yathā mandamagaccham, madhuramagāyamiti parāmarśena pūrvaṃ gamanagānābhyāṃ saha tadānīntanaṃ māndyaṃ mādhuryaṃ cānusaṃhitaṃ bhavati, tadvadityarthaḥ | svasmai svayamanukūlamityānukūlyapratiyogitvābhiprāyeṇa sukhitvamityuktam; svasmai bhāsata iti bhāsanapratisambandhitvarūpapratyakatvābhaprāyeṇa jñātṛtvamityuktam; na tu dharmabhūtajñānasphuraṇāt | tattu, "viṣayaprakāśanavelāyāṃ jñāturātmanastathaiva; na sarveṣāṃ sarvadā tathaiva" iti bhāṣyasvārasyaviruddham | "puṃstvādivattvasya sato'bhivyaktiyogāt iti sūtrasvārasyaviruddhañca | asmaraṇaniyamādhyupapattiviruddhañca | saṃsāradaśāyāṃ manovyāpāravirahe'pi jñānasyā'tmaviṣayatvam, "tañcendriyadvāreṇa vyavasthitam" iti bhāṣyasvārasyaviruddhaṃ ca | anyathā eṣāṃ sūtrabhāṣyavacasāṃ saṅkocaḥ syāt | sa ca saṅkocakābhāvādanupapannaḥ | tasmāt tadānīmātmā pratyakatvenānukūlatvenānusaṃhita iti parāmarśaphalitārthaḥ || sukhamahamasvāpsamiti sukhasya svāpakriyāviśeṣaṇatve pratīyamāne kathamātmaviśeṣaṇatvamucyata iti cetnaivam | kriyāyāḥ sukhāśrayatvāyogena puruṣadvārā kriyāviśeṣaṇatvasya yuktatvāditi | ātmanastadānīṃ "na kiñcidavediṣam" ityajñānasākṣitvena sthitiṃ vadatā ajñānāśrayabhūtāhamarthānubhavā'bhyupagantavyaḥ; yathā prātaścatvareṃ gajo nāsīditi parāmarśe pūrvaṃ gajābhāvāśrayabhūtaṃ catvaramanusaṃhitaṃ bhavati, tadvat | asvāpsamiti parāmarśena mandamagacchamityatra gamanavat svāpo'pi tadā'nusaṃhitaḥ syāditi cenna; yathā prātaścatvare gajo nāsīdityatra pūrvaṃ gajā bhāvānanusandhāne'pi evaṃ parāmarśopapattiḥ, tadvat sakalajñānanivṛttirūpasvāpasya tadānīmananusaṃhitatve'pyevaṃ parāmarśepapatteḥ | tatra hi prātaścatvaramevānubhūtam, na gajābhāvaḥ; pratiyogibhūtagajāsmaraṇāt paścāt, "gajaḥ kiṃ sthitaḥ" iti pṛṣṭena yogyārthānanusmaraṇaliṅgena abhāve'numīyate | tadvat sakalajñānanivṛttirūpasvāpo'pi yogyānanusmaraṇaliṅgenābhāvo'numīyate || nanu sukhamahamasvāpsamiti parāmarśasvarūpe sati svāpādetadānīmananubhavaḥ sukhitvāderanubhavaśca kathamucyate? sarvamapyanubhūtaṃ syāt; na vā syāt || naitat || sukhamahamasvāpsamityatra yasminnaṃśe pratītisvārasyāpavādakamasti, tadviṣayapratipattisvārasyabhaṅge'pyanapoditāṃśaviṣayapratipattisvārasyabhaṅgāyogāt | tatra svāpadaśāyāṃ yo'rtho nānubhavituṃ śakyaḥ, tadviṣayapratipattisvārasyaṃ bhajyate | yastu tadānīmanubhavayobhyaḥ, tadviṣayapratipattisvārasyaṃ tiṣṭhatyeva | bāhyantaḥ(ntara?)karaṇajanyasamastajñānābhāvarūpatvāt svāpaḥ tadā'nusandhātuṃ na śakyate | anusandhānamastīti cetsvāpa eva na syāt; aindriyikasamastajñānanivṛttyabhāvāt | naivaṃ sukhādeḥ pratipattyanupapattiriti yathokta evārthaḥ |
athā'sya parāmarśasya paroktānyathāsiddhimanūdya pariharati na cetyādinā | atadrūpatvāditi | evamarthaḥ kiṃ pratipakṣisvārasyāt utānupapattyā'bhyupagamyate iti vikalpya, atadrūpatvāpratipatteti pratipattisvārasyaṃ parihṛtam; yathā mandamagaccham madhuramagāyamiti parāmarśavacanasya | na hi tatra, yathedānīṃ māndyaṃ mādhuryaṃ ca bhavati tathā agacchamagāyamityarthaḥ upapadyate | apitu gatigānasamakālatvameva māndyamādhuryayorupapannam | tadvat pratyakatvasukhitve api svāpasamakālīne ityarthaḥ | athānupapatiṃta pariharati na cetyādinā | anupapattiścā''tmanaḥ asthiratvamanubhavābhā vo vā | tatra parāmarśena sthiratvamāha yata iti | mayedaṃ kṛtamityādayo mānasavācikakāyikatrividhavyāpāraviṣayaparāmarśaparāḥ | athāhamarthānanubhavasādhakaniṣedhasāmānyaviṣayaṃ parāmarśaṃ (rśaviśeṣaṃ) śaṅkate etāvantamiti | ahamartha sya niṣedhaviṣayatvābhāvābhiprāyeṇā''ha tataḥ kimiti | paravivakṣitaṃ śaṅkate na kiñciditi | pariharati neti | vedyaviṣayaḥvedyapratibhāsaviṣayaḥ | kṛtsnaviṣayatve'niṣṭamāha na kiñciditi | nānubhūtiniṣedhaḥ, tasyā anuvṛtterityāśaṅkayāha suṣuptisamaye tviti | bhavatpakṣasya viparīto'yaṃ parāmarśa ityarthaḥ | yathā prātaścatvare gajānubhavaṃ pṛṣṭena paścāt yogyānanusmaraṇaliṅgena catvare gajābhāvaṃ vadatā puruṣeṇa pūrvakālīnacatvarānubhavena vinā gajābhāvo na vaktuṃ śakyatetathā ajñānāśrayamahamarthaṃ vadatā svāpavelāyāmahamarthānubhavo'bhyupagantavyaḥ | athāpyahamarthanivṛttijñānānuvṛttikathanaṃ catvaranivṛttigajāvasthānavacanatulyamiti bhāvaḥ | devānāmeva sādhayatu | arcārūpā hi devāḥ | prativacanamakurvatāmityarthaḥ | kṣamāvatāmiti vā, prativādyasannidhāviti vā, ullokamuktamiti vā'rthaḥ ||
atha niṣedhaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ parāmarśamāha māmapīti | pariharati svānubhaveti | svānubhavavacanayornānyonyaṃ virodhaḥ; kintūbhayorapyahamarthānuvṛttiniṣedhaśabdena virodhaḥ ityarthaḥ | anubhavaikadeśayorvacanaikadeśayośca mitho virodha iti vā'rthaḥ | virodhañca darśayati ahamiti |ahaṃ na jñānavānityatra ajñānasākṣitvena ahamarthānuvṛttiḥ svānubhavasiddhā, vacanamapi tadanuguṇamityanubhavavacanābhyāmaharthānuvṛttiniṣedhavākyavirodha ityarthaḥ | niṣedhaśabdattadarthānubhavayorvirodha iti vā'rthaḥ | tatra māmiti padasya arthaṃ vaktuṃ parapraśnamanubhāṣate māmitīti | pūrvaṃ viruddhārthakathanamasādhu; arthatattvapraśnaḥ sādhurityabhivaprāyeṇāha sādhviti | niṣedhānuvṛttyorviṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati taducyata ityādi nā | ahaṃ māmityubhayorapi padayorviśiṣṭaviṣayataivocitā nītibhedaprasaṅgātyatrāha ahaṃ māmiti | vidhiniṣedhayorekaviṣayatve vyāghātaḥ syāditi tannivṛtyarthaṃ viṣayavibhāgaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | viṣayavibhāgaviparyāsaśaṅkāyāṃ viṣayavibhāgamucitaṃ darśayati jāgariteti | yat sāmagrayabhāvāt tadānīṃ na prakāśate, tadeva niṣedhaviṣayaḥ | yat ananyā pekṣaṃ svayaṃ prakāśatae tadevānuvarttata iti, aprakāśamānasyānuvṛttiḥ prakāśamānasya niṣedhaścānupapannāvityarthaḥ | evaṃ viṣayavibhāgānuguṇamanubhavaṃ darśayati atreti | śabdaprayogo vivakṣāvaśāt dhīsthaṃ sarvaṃ vadati vā; tadekadeśaṃ vadati vā; na kiñcidapi vadati vā | ataḥ śabdaprayoge vaivakṣike'pyanubhava ekarūpaḥ | sa punaḥ evaṃviṣaya vibhāgānuguṇa evetyarthaḥ | anena "nāha svalvayemevaṃ sampratyātmānaṃ jānātyayamahamasmi" iti śrutivākyasthāyaṃśabdo vyākhyātaḥ ||
paramatenemamarthamupapādayati kiñcetyādinā | sākṣitvenātmā'bhyupagamyeta, tataḥ kimityatrāha sākṣitvaṃ ceti | sākṣājjñātṛtvamsākṣātkārarūpajñānāśrayatvam | asākṣātkāriṇi sākṣiśabdaḥ prayuktaścet, aupacārikaḥ | upapādayati na hīti |ajānataḥajñāturityarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha jñātaiva hīti | śabdaprayoganiyāmakaṃ lakṣaṇamāha smaratīti | sākṣiśabdaṃ smaratītyanvayaḥ | tataḥ kimahamarthasyā'tmatva ityatrāha ya ceti | asminnarthe anumānamutta ratra vistareṇa vivakṣitam; atra śaṅgraheṇāha ātmane svayamiti | ātmane svayamavabhāvamāno'hamityevāvabhāsata" iti vyāptivacanam; jāgradātmā sapakṣaḥ; svasmai prakāśamānatvāditi hetuḥ | nigamayati svāpādīti | aviśadāvabhāsasya sarvābhyupagatatvāt śrutisvārasyāt parāmarśasvārasyāt sākṣitvopapatteḥ pratyakatvasiddheśca suṣuptāvātmā ahamiti sphuratītyuktaṃ bhavati ||
atha muktāvahamarthānanuvṛttimanūdya dūṣayati yattvityādinā | turarthagauravaviśeṣe | apeśalam asādhvityarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha tathāsatīti | saugatān jñānasantatyucchedaṃ mokṣaṃ vadataḥ svarūpanāśasya apuruṣārthatvena dūṣayatā tvayā śabdāntareṇa svarūpanāśa evoktaḥ syādityarthaḥ | naiyāyikādyukte mokṣe'pyapuruṣārthatvaṃ tulyam | duḥkhanivṛttiḥ sukhaprāptiścobhayaṃ puruṣārthaḥ | atrāpuruṣārthābhūtaduḥkhābhāvātpuruṣārthānvayaḥ, mukhābhāvādapuruṣārthānvayaśceti mukteḥ puruṣārthāpuruṣātharmiśrayatvaṃ hi syāt |ahamartho hyāromitaḥ; atastadvigame svarūpanāśo na prasajyedityatrāha na ceti | kuta ityatrāha ahamiti | ahamarthadharmatayā jñānapratītereva | pūrvoktahetorevetyarthaḥ | ahamarthātmatvasamarthanopajīvanena svarūpanāprasaṅga uktaḥ | evaṃ dharmadharmibhāvena pratītyā anuvṛttirupapāditā |atha śrutyarthāpattimāha apicetyādinā | pūrvamahamarthasyātmatvasamarthanāya śrutyarthāpattiruktā; idānīmahamarthasya muktāvanuvṛttyupapādanāya tāmeva śrutyarthāpatiṃta vistareṇā''ha | yaḥ svātmānaṃ duḥkhinamanusandhatte, sa eva tannivṛttisādhane pravarttate | sa cāhamartha eva | duḥkhitvaṃ bhrāntisiddhamiti cetyaḥ svātmānaṃ bhramantamanusandhatte sa eva bhramanivṛttisādhane pravatarte | sa cāhamarthaḥ | dvicandrajñānādibhrāntimato'pi svabhramanivṛttirevāpekṣitā; na tu svavināśaḥ |ato'hamarthavināśo'puruṣārthaḥ ityabhi prāyeṇa paramārthato bhrāntyā vetyuktam | anusandhatta ityantena, "nirastākhiladuḥkho'ham"ityatrāpekṣitaṃ vaktavyamuktam | nirastetyādiślokaṃ vivṛṇoti | savarmetadityādinā | anākulaḥ svastho bhaveyamiti | apunarbhavamapohyetyetatphalitamuktam anākula iti | āgāmiduḥkhaśaṅkayā manaḥkṣobhaḥ ākulatvam; tadabhāvo'nākulatvam | svasthaḥsvasmin sthitaḥ, svabhāve sthitaḥ, yathāvasthitātmanānubhavaparaḥ | anantānandabhāgiti phalam | sa evapūrvaduḥkhita eva | utpannāniṣṭanivṛttīṣṭaprāptyabhilāṣaḥ sa evetyarthaḥ | śravaṇādāviti pūrvamuktatvādiha tatsādhana ityetāvaduktam | apasarppedasāvityādigranthena phalitamarthamāha tataścādhikārīti | śravaṇādyāyāsasādhyasya śāstrasyāpuruṣārthaparyavasāyitve śravaṇādyadhikārivirahāt śravaṇādisāpekṣasya śāstrasya pramitijanakatvalakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ na syādityarthaḥ | "mayi naṣṭepītye"tadvivṛṇoti | ahamupalakṣitamityādinā | buddhipūrvakārītyanena kasyāpīti padaṃ vivṛtam | śrutyarthāpatiṃta nigamayati ata iti | ahamarthavigame jñaptisiddhirapyanusandheyā | anumānamāha sa ceti | kiñca anumānamapyastīti cārthaḥ | anvayavyāptimāha yoya iti | tathā'vabhāsamānatvenasvasmai prakāśamānatvena | vyatirekavyāptiṃ darśayati yaḥ punariti | upanayamāha svasmā iti | nigamanamāha tasmāditi | svasmai prakāśamā natvaṃ hetuḥ,ahamiti vyavahārārhatvaṃ sādhyamiti na sādhyāviśiṣṭatā | ahamityeva prakāśateahamiti vyavahārārhaṃ prakāśata ityarthaḥ |
sādhyaviparītaviśeṣasādhakatayā viśeṣaviruddhatvaṃ śaṅkate na ceti | ādiśabdāt rāgadveṣaduḥkhādi vivakṣi tam | nanu vyāpakaṃ hi prasañjanīyam | na ca kāryaṃ kāraṇasya vyāpakam || satyam | kāraṇajātīyasya tu kadācitkāryaprasaktirvyāpikā | ato'haṃpratyayenātmano'tvādiprasañjanam | ajñatvādiprasaktiḥ śrutiviruddhetyāha mokṣeti | "na paśyo mṛtyuṃ paśyati na rogaṃ nota duḥkhatā"miti hi śrutiḥ | ato yathā sahadarśanamātreṇa parvate bhāṇḍādiprasaktiḥ pratyakṣabādhāt vāryate, tadvat kālātyayāpadeśa ityarthaḥ | sopādhikatvamāha ajñatvādīti | saṃsāritvāhamarthatvayoḥ sahadarśanamātreṇa muktāvapi saṃsāritvādiprasaṅgaścet, anubhavasyāpi tatsahabhāvadarśanāt tvatpakṣe'pi muktau saṃsāritvaprasaṅgaḥ || tat mokṣagrāhipramāṇavirodhāt kālātyayāpadiṣṭa(tva?)m, saṃsāritvāderanubhavaprayuktatvābhāvāt sopedhikatvaṃ ceti cettadasmatpakṣe'pi samānamityabhiprāyaḥ | anena ahamiti bhāsanaṃ na svasmai bhāsamānatvaprayuktam, apitvajñatvaprayuktamiti hetoḥ sopādhikatvañca śrutibalena vyāpterbhagnatayā sahadarśanamātrameveti parihṛtaṃ bhavati | evaṃ kālātyayāpadeśasopādhikatve ukte | tatra sopādhikatvamupapādayitumajñānatvena saṃbhāvitaśirāṃsi vikalpayati ajñānaṃ nāmeti | dharmyaikye sati prakārāntarāropaṇena jñānamanyathājñānam; yathā pītaḥ śaṅkha iti | idaṃ rajaḥkāryam | dhamyarntarasya dharmyantaratvena jñānaṃ viparītajñānaṃ; yathā śurko, idaṃ rajatamiti | idaṃ tamaḥkāryam | "ayathāvat prajā nāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha! rājasī || adharmaṃ dharmamiti yā manyate tamasā vṛtā || sarvārthān viparītāśca buddhiḥ sā pārtha! tāmasī" iti smṛteḥ | ahaṃpratyayasya svarūpajñānarūpatvāt tatprāgabhāvānyathājñānaviparītajñānāni virodhādevāpagatānītyāha ahamityeveti |ahamityevātmanaḥ svarūpamahamiti vyavahārabudhdyarhamevātmanaḥ svarūpamityarthaḥ | ahampratyayasyājñatvādiprayojakatvadūṣaṇenājñatvāderavidyānvayaḥ evopādhirityarthāduktaṃ bhavati | athavā kāryakāraṇabhāvena vyāptimaṅgīkṛtva pareṇājñatvādiprasaṅga ukta iti, vyāptipratikṣepāya kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ pratikṣipati ajñātvādyahetutvāñcetyādinā | ajñatvaphalamapi nāstītyāha kutaḥ saṃsāritvamiti ||
nivṛttāvidyānāmapi ahamityātmapratipattidarśanena ahampratyayasya muktāvṛttimāha brahyātmabhāveti | taddhaitatpaśyan iti brahmātmakatvasākṣātkārakathanena nirdhūtaniravaśeṣāvidyatvaṃ gamyate | brahmaṇo'pi tathā pratipattimāha sakaletareti | sakaletarājñānavirodhinaḥna hi sakaletaraviṣaharaṇanipuṇasya vainateyasya viṣavaśyatvasambhava iti bhāvaḥ | sacchabdapratyayamātrabhājaḥsacchabdasya saditi pratyayasya ca viṣayabhūtasya | mātra cā pāśacātyanāmarūpabhākatvavyāvṛttiḥ | anenāhaṅkārasṛṣṭeḥ pūrvamapyahampratyayaṃ jñāpayati | ahampratyayasphuṭīkaraṇāya "ahamimā" iti vākyaṃ pūrvamupādatte | bahu syāmiti vākye "asmadyutama" ityuttamapuruṣabalādahamiti pratyayassiddhiḥ | ahamimāstistra ityatrāhaṃśabdaḥ kaṇṭhoktaḥ | na hyahaṅkārasya nāmarūpavyākartṛtvamiti bhāvaḥ | bahūpaniṣatsu ahamiti nirdeśajñāpanāyopādatte sa īkṣateti | sṛjā ityuttamapuruṣeṇāhaṃśabdākarṣasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | smṛtiṃ darśayati tathā yasmāditi | yasmāditi vacanaṃ kṣarākṣarātītasvābhāvikarūpeṇāhampratyayajñāpanārthamupāttam | na hyahaṅkāraḥ kṣarākṣarātīta | ato asmītyuttamapuruṣeṇāpyahamarthasiddhiḥ | ātmano ahampratyayaṃ jñāpayatiahamātmeti | na hyahaṅakāraścidacidantarātmā | svābhāvikanityarūpe'hampratyayaṃ darśayati na tvevāhamiti | na hyahaṅkāro nityaḥ | mṛtyuvirodhimuktiprado'pyahampratyayaviṣaya ityāha teṣāmiti | na hyahaṅkāro muktipradaḥ | evamanekaśrutismṛtivacanopādānaṃ paravivakṣitaddhitratādṛśavacanāpanodanārtham | ebhirahaṃśabdaiścinmātramupalakṣyate cet aneka vākyasthāhaṃśabdalakṣaṇaiva doṣaḥ |
"mahābhūtānyahaṅkāra" iti kṣetrāntarbhāvavacanamekam, "ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham | vimucya nimarmaḥ śānto brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||" iti tyājyatvaparaṃ vacanaṃ dvitīyam, "ahaṅkāravimūḍhātmā" ityaparam; etattrayamanudāhṛtamapyabhipretam utaratra prarihārāt | pūrvametadvacanābhiprāyeṇa, suṣuptimuktayornānvetītyuktam | imamarthamavala mvya codayati kathaṃ tarhīti | pariharati ucyata iti | ahamarthāhaṅkārayorabhedabudhdyā pareṇa codite prakṛti pratyayayorarthavibhāgavyutpādanāya prakṛtyarthabhūta ātmanyahabhbuddheḥ prāmāṇikatvasthairyaṃ darśayati svarūpopadeśeṣviti | anyathāsidiṃdha darśayan tatrāhaṅkāraśabdavivakṣitamāha avyakteti | avyaktapariṇāmabhedasyeti | na tvahamarthasyetyarthaḥ | "athāto'haṅkārādeśa" ityādiṣu śuddhasvarūpasyāhaṅkāraśabdenābhidhānābhyupagame'pi na virodhaḥ; sa tvahaṅkāraśabdo'hamarthaviṣayabuddhiparaḥ | yadyahaṅkāraśabdavācyatvamātrāt pratyagātmā'pi kṣetra(jaḍa)bhedaḥ syāttarhi hariśabdavācyatvasā myāt siṃho maṇḍūkaḥ syāt | ato'nekārthābhidhāyiśabdaikatvamarthabhedāvirodhīti bhāvaḥ | yathā āgamaprāmāṇye "tathā ca hariśabdasya dṛṣṭā maṇḍūkavācitā iti | " tacchabdavācvatvātsiṃho maṇḍūka eva kim || tathā gośabdavācyatvācchabdaścāpi viṣāṇavān" iti | athāhaṅkāraśabdasyāvyaktapariṇāmaviśeṣavācakatvaprakāraṃ darśayati sa tviti |
ahambhāvaḥ ahamiti buddhiḥ | bhāvaśabdasya buddhivācakatvamabhiprāyaparatayā prayogādavagamyate | sarvatrāhaṃ śabdārthamekarūpamaṅgīkṛtyāhaṅkārābdasyāvyaktapariṇāmavācitvaṃ śabdānuśāsanaprakriyayopapādayati asya tviti | cvipratyayasya sarvalopaḥ | kṛmaḥ karaṇe dhañ" | kṣetrāntarbhāvopadeśasya nirvāhaḥ kṛtaḥ | "ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpamiti tyājyatayopadeśasya nirvāhaḥ kriyate ayameva tviti | ayaṃśabdena prastutāhambhāvo vivakṣitaḥ; na tvahambhāvakaraṇahetuḥ; garvāparanāmeti vacanāt | na hi mahadahaṅkārayoranyataro'haṅkāro garvāparaparyāyaḥ | ato'trāhambhāva evāyaṃśabdavivakṣitaḥ | praśastadehe'hambuddhirutkṛṣṭajanāvāmānahetuḥ | ahaṅkāraḥ ahambuddhiḥ | mānasavyāpāravācinaḥ karoteḥ buddhiparatvaṃ yujyate | yathā "tadekāvayavaṃ devaṃ cetasā hi punarbudhaḥ | kuryāt" iti | manasā karaṇaṃ hi vedanam | ato'hambuddhira haṅkāraḥ | cvipratyayārthagarbhatvāt atahami ahambuddhigamau imau ahaṃbhāvāhaṅkāraśabdau | atra bhāve vyutpattiḥ; pūrvatra karaṇe vyutpattiḥ | "garvobhimāno'haṅkāra" iti naidhaṇṭukāḥ || nanu kathaṃ bhāve (heye?) vyutpannasyāhaṅkāraśabdasyopādeyagocaratayā prayogaḥ "athāto'haṅkārādeśa" iti | ucyate | sa tvahaṅkāraśabdaḥ sākṣādahamarthabuddhivācī; na tvanātmanyātmabuddhiparacvipratyayārthagarbhaḥ | heyopādeyarūpeṇa śabdapratipannayorahambudhdyorviṣayavibhāgaṃ nigamayati tasmāditi | asminnarthe pramāṇamāha yathoktamiti | tatraiva purāṇe nātmaviṣayāhambuddhivacanayorbhrāntatvamātmaviṣayetva bhrāntatvaṃ ca spaṣṭam | yathā, "ākāśavā'vabhnijalapṛthivībhyaḥ pṛthaksthite | ātmanyātmamayaṃ bhāvaṃ kaḥ karoti kalevare || pañcabhūtātmake dehe dehī mohatamovṛtaḥ | ahaṃ mamaitadityuccaiḥ kurute kumatirmatim ||" iti | ādibharatacate "ātmanyeṣa na doṣāya śabdo'hamiti yo dvijaḥ | anātmanyātmavijñānaṃ śabdo vā bhrāntilakṣaṇaḥ ||"iti | etadvacanārthamapyahamarthātmahetutvenāha yadīti | anātmanīti | anātmanyahampratītiḥ kathamātmābhimāna ityarthaḥ | ahamarthātmatvaṃ nigamayati tasmāditi |asminnarthe ātmasiddhigranthamudāharati | taduktamiti | dharmadhamirbhāvena pratītiḥ, pratyakṣasiddhiḥ, sthiratvāsthiratvādivaiṣamyam śrutyarthāpattiśca nyāyaḥ | āgamaḥ udāhṛtopaniṣadvākyāni | avidyāyogaḥanantaroktabhrāntiyogaḥ | ahamarthasyānātamitve sthūlo'hamiti bhrānterayoga iti vārthaḥ | jñāturātmatve saṃvādigrantho darśitaḥ | jñapteranātmatve cātmasiddhigranthamāha tathā ceti | dhībhyo'nya ityetadatropayuktam | sādhanaśabda(pada?)syotpādakajñāpakasādhāraṇatvāt tat vyācaṣṭe ananyeti | jīvasvarūpavibhutvaśaṅkāvyudāsārthaṃ vyāpīti śabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe atīsūkṣmeti | purāṇeṣu vyāptiśabdaprayogāt sa evātra śloke prayuktaḥ | yatra yatra jīvasya vyāptivācinaḥ śabdaḥ, tatrāyemevārtho draṣṭavya iti bhāvaḥ | jīvasya dharmabhūtajñānena vyāptirātmasiddhāvevocyate, "vyāptirapi caitanyamātreṇaiva na svarūpeṇe"ti | ato yathokta evārthaḥ ||
atha śāstrapratyakṣavirodhe śāstraprābalyamanūdya nirasyati yaduktamityādinā | pareṇa pūrvam, "mūlamūlibhāvaparokṣāparokṣarūpatvādirnna bādhyabādhakabhāve kāraṇam; jvālābhedānumānena vyabhicārāt | "ādityo yūpa" ityādāvapi yūpādityaikyādyapratipādanaṃ na daurbalyāt; api tu yūpāñjanavidhiśeṣatvenaikye tātparyābhāvāt ityuktam | tatra jvālābhedānumānāt śāstrasya tridhā vaiṣamyamasti pramāṇāntareṇa doṣamūlatvāniścayādanyonyāśrayaḥ, bādhyabādhakayostulyadoṣatvam, mūloccheditvañceti; etattrayaṃ jvālābhedānumāne nāsti | tathāhi,ekavartikāvarttitvanibandhanasādṛśyākhyadoṣasyā asatyapyaikye aikyapratītihetutvam aciranirvāpitāropitapradīpe dṛṣṭamiti, cakṣuṣā jvālaikyapratipatteḥ kkacit doṣamūlatvaniścayāt anyatraikyapratipattāvapi doṣamūlatvasambhavājjavāt avālaikyapratyakṣaṃ śaṅkitaṃ na niścayajananakṣamaṃ parīkṣakasya bhavet | jvālāyāṃ sādṛśyarūpadoṣasya asatyapyaikye aikyapratītihetutvaṃ pramāṇānta reṇa na dṛṣṭaṃ cet, anyonyāśrayaḥ syātanumānasya prābalyāt pratyakṣasyānyathāsiddhiḥ, tadanyāthāsidhdyā'numānasya prābalyamiti; aikyapratīteranyathāsiddhisambhavaḥ pramāṇāntaradṛṣṭa iti nānyonyāśrayaḥ | atra na tathā pramāṇāntareṇa bhedavāsanāyā doṣatvaṃ dṛṣṭam | kiñca dīpe bādhyasya jvālaikyajñānasya sādṛśyākhyadoṣamūlatve bādhakasya jvālābhedānumānasya na sādṛśyadoṣamūlatvaṃ dṛṣṭam | atra tu bādhyasya pratyakṣasya bādhakasya śāstrasya cobhayoḥ parābhyupetadoṣamūlatvamaviśiṣṭaṃ vidyata iti tulyadoṣatvam | kiñca tatra jvālākhyadharmigrāhiṇaḥ pratyakṣasya ca prathamavartyavayavāgnisaṃyoge caramavartyavayavasya vināśe ca utpattivināśayorvyāptigrāhiṇaḥ pratyakṣasya, pratyavayavamagnisaṃyogavartyavayavavināśākhyaliṅgagrāhiṇaḥ pratyakṣasya ca na bhedānumānabādhyaviṣayatvam | aikyapratipattereva tat | atra tu śabdākhyadharmigrāhiṇaḥ tasya nirdoṣatvasādhakaliṅgagrāhiṇaḥ talliṅgavyāptigrāhiṇaṣadvidha tātparyaliṅga grāhiṇaśca pratyakṣasya teṣāṃ tārtpayaliṅgānāṃ ca śāstreṇaiva bādhopagamānmūloccheditvamiti tridhā vaiṣamyam | etadvaiṣamyatrayamupapādayiṣyan pūrvapakṣamanuvadati doṣamūlatveneti | sakalabhedāvalambipratyakṣasyeti | atrāyaṃ bhāvaḥtattvaśuddhikārādibhiḥ kaiścit kācatimirādireva pratyakṣasya doṣa uktaḥ | sa nopapadyate; kācatimirādeḥ kkācitkatvāt | etena pratyakṣāntarāṇāṃ doṣamūlatvamanumīyate cet, śabdatvāt śāstrasyāpi doṣamūlatvamanumīyatām || śāstre doṣasya yogyānupalambhanirāsaścet, pratyakṣe'pi tathaiva syāt | kiñca āyurvede doṣāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ tannivṛttyupāyādikaṃ ca nirūpitam | sarvapratya kṣasya doṣamūlatvānumānaṃ tadviruddhaṃ ca | kiñca sarvapratyakṣasya dāṣamūlatve sanmātragrāhiṇaḥ pratyakṣasya ca doṣamūlatvāt sanmātramapi mithyā syāditi dūṣayati ko'yamityādinā | ko'yaṃ doṣa iti vaktavyamiti | ko'yaṃ doṣa itya nayā vacanavyaktayā doṣarūpaṃ mūlaṃ yayduktaṃ, tat kimiti pṛṣṭe ayaṃ doṣa iti vaktavyamityarthaḥ | yadvā yacchabdasāma rthyāt tatretyākṣepasiddham | doṣamūlatvenetyādinā yadarthajātamuktam, tatra ko'yaṃ doṣa iti pṛṣṭe, vaktavyamityarthaḥ | kuto vaktavyamityatrāha yanmūlatayeti | na hi doṣamanukatvā'nyathāsiddhiḥ suvacetyarthaḥ | doṣamāha anādīti | svarūpasampratipattipara evakāraḥ | hi śabdena doṣāntarāsambhavasiddhavatkāraḥ | svamate doṣatvasampratipattyabhimānādvā hi śabdaḥ | doṣatvaṃ hi viparītajñānahetutvam | ato viparītajñānahetutvena vyāpteradṛṣṭatayā bhedavāsanāsvarūpasampratipattāvapi doṣatvāsampratipatteḥ pṛcchati bhedavāsanāyā iti | timirādivaditi ādiśabdena sādṛśyādi vivakṣitam | taddhi jvālāyāmaikyabhramahetuḥ | anyatra jñātapūtarvatvasya durvacatvācchaṅkate anenaiveti | dūṣayati neti | evaṃ pramāṇāntareṇa doṣatvāniścayenānyonyāśrayaṇāpattirūpavaiṣamyamuktam | atha tulyadoṣatvaṃ bādhyabādhakayorāha kiñceti | atha doṣamūlatve tulye'pi paratvādvādhakatvaṃ śaṅkate atreti |apacchedādiṣu, idaṃ rajatm, nedaṃ rajatamityādiṣu ca bādhakaṃ dṛṣṭam; ato niṣedhyopasvāpakamānāpekṣayā niṣadhakasya paratvāt balīyastvamityarthaḥ | evaṃ bahmapratipādakaśāstrasyāpi vyutpattyādeḥ pratyakṣādimūlatayā tatpūrvakasya tasya pratyakṣāvapekṣayā paratvāt tatpratipādyanirviśeṣavastusatyatvamapi tulyanyāyatayā siddham | taddūṣayati tanneti | paratvasyākiñcitkaratvamupapādayati rajjusarpeti | uttarajñānasya doṣamūlatvena prāmāṇyā'niścayādbhayānivṛttiḥ | nanu bhrāntatve jñāte paratvamakiñcitkaramastu; atra tu bhrāntatvajñānaṃ nāstītyatrāha śāstrasya ceti | jñātatvamupapāyati śravaṇāvagateti | śāstrasya bhedavāsanāmūlatvaṃ tāvatsampratipannam | tasyāśca doṣatvaṃ bhedamithyātvajñānādavagamyate | tanmithyātvāvagatiśca jñānanivartyatvāvagamāt jñānanivartyatvāvaga maśca brahmātmaikatvajñānasya nikhilabhedopamarditvāvagateḥ | ata īdṛśanivarttakajñānābhyāsarūpamananaṃ kurvatā śāstrasya doṣamūlatvamavagatamityarthaḥ |
evaṃ bādhyamādhakayostulyadoṣatvarūpaṃ vaiṣamyamuktam |atha mūlaccheditvamāha api ceti | idaṃ śāstramiti śabdarāśivyāvṛttiḥ | asambhāvyamānadoṣamiti bauddhāgamādivyāvṛttiḥ | tvayāpramāṇaprameyādikaṃ tātvikatve
nānabhyupagacchatā | na tāvaditi | svatassiddhatvena nirddhūtanikhilaviśeṣatvam | etadviśeṣaṇaṃ nirviṣayatvapradarśanārtham | kuto nāvagamyata ityatrāha tasyā iti | sarvaviṣayaviraktatvāt | nirviṣayatvādityarthaḥ | na hi vijñānam asaṃbadhya viṣayaṃ prakāśayati | vastuto nirviṣayāpi bhrāntyā avidyamānamapi śāstraprābalyamavagamayatītyatrāha śāstrapakṣapātavirahācceti | asambandhāvidyamānatvāviśeṣāt saugatādiśāstrāntaraprākāṇyamapyavagayamayedityarthaḥ | pratyakṣādikaṃ nāvagamayatītyāha nāpīti | bhogipratyakṣāderapyaindriyikapratyakṣamūlaśāstrajanyajñānahetukādṛṣṭakāryatvādaindriyikapratya kṣaṃ prathamamupāttam | tanmūlatvātbhedavāsanāmūlapratyakṣamūlatvāt | evaṃ prakṛtagocaratayoktaṃ pramāṇābhāvaṃ parābhimatasarvagocaratvenopasaṃharati ata iti | na svābhimatārthasiddhiḥ | svābhimatam, pratyakṣadaurbalyaśāstraprābalyādikam |
etata khaṇḍakārādyuktakutarkanirasanopalakṣaṇārthamuktam | tatra pramāṇavyāptyādibhaṅgaḥ kriyate | tatredaṃ praṣṭa vyamsvābhimatavyatiriktārthaparaṃ śāstrāntaramaparamārthārthakamityasminnarthe kiṃ tava pramitiḥ, tatsādhanaṃ nāsti, uta nāsti? asti cet, na pramāṇādibhaṅgaḥ | nāsti cet, tata eva na pramāṇādibhaṅgaḥ | pramititatsādhanādikamastyeva; tat vyāvahārikamiti cetkimidaṃ vyāvahārikatvam? kiṃ paramārthatvam, utāparamāthartvam? aparamārthabhūtaṃ pramāṇaṃ kiṃ sādhakam, utāsādhakam? sādhakaṃ cedaparamārthasaṃjñitam, anyeṣāṃ ca pramāṇaṃ tattatpakṣasādhakameva syāt | athāsādhakam, tato nitarāṃ vādyantarābhyupagatapramāṇādikaṃ sādhakaṃ bhavet | tvaduktaṃ pramāṇādikaṃ paramārthabhūtaṃ cet, dvaitī vijayī syāditi | svapakṣaparapakṣabhedaḥ kiṃ paramārthaḥ, utāparamārthaḥ? paramārthaścat, na bhedamithyātvam | aparamārthaścet,parapakṣa eva tvayā'ṅgīkṛtaḥ syāditi bhedapāramārthyaṃ tvayaivoktaṃ syāditi | evamādivyāghātaḥ savartrānusandheya ityabhiprāyaḥ ||
atha svapakṣasādhanāpramāṇābhāvaṃ prativivakṣuścodayati nanviti | ko'yamityākṣipati | vyāvahārikasva rūpaṃ darśayati āpāteti | dūṣayati kiṃ teneti | sādhyaniścayarūpaprayojanaṃ netyarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha pramāṇatayeti | yuktayā bādho yauktikabādhaḥ; dhūmabuddhayā gṛhītabāṣpādeḥ sādhyaniścayāhetutvadarśanādityarthaḥ | evaṃ mūloccheditvaṃ vaiṣamyamupapāditam |
evaṃ pūrvaṃ paroktaṃ paratvādvaiṣamyaṃ dūṣitam || athāsmāt parasya kasyacidbādhakasyābhāvaṃ vrahma pratipādakaśāstrasya pratyakṣādvaiṣamyaṃ śaṅkate athocyeta ityādinā | bādhadarśanābhāvarūpaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ śāstrasya vaktuṃ pratyakṣaviṣayasya bādhadarśanamāha śāstreti | pratyakṣaviṣayāt śāstraviṣayasya vaiṣamyamāha śāstraviṣayatveti | pāścātyabādhādarśanābhyupagamena dūṣayati tadayuktamiti | kuta ityatrāha abādhitasyeti | "yasya duṣṭaṃ kāraṇaṃ yasya ca mithyeti pratyayaḥ, sa evāsamīcīnaḥ pratyayaḥ" iti(hi) nītividaḥ | ato duṣṭamūlatvabādhakapratyayau pratyekaṃ mithyātvasādhakau || vyāhatamidam, yat abādhitasyāpyapāramārthyaniścaya iti | aparamārthatvena niścitatvaṃ hi bādhitatvamityatrāha etaduktamiti | ajñātasvatimirasyeti padaṃ kkaciddṛśyate | doṣajñānanibandhanaparokṣavādhakajñānodayavyudāsaḥ prayojanam | jñātasvatibhirasyeti tu pāṭho lekhakaskhalanakṛtaḥ | sa hi puruṣāntarāgocaratvoktiviruddhaḥ | bādhakābhāve kathaṃ mithyātvamityatrāha doṣo hīti | bhrāntisamānāśrayabādhakajñānābhāve'pi puruṣāntarajñānena mithyātvaniścayo na vyāhata ityarthaḥ | tiraścāṃ yāvajjīvaṃ bādhodayāmāve'pi dehātmadhīrmithyārthaviṣayā; tasyāḥ saṃsargarūpadoṣamūlatvāt | bāhya bhrameṣu spaṣṭodāharaṇasya vivakṣitatvādeva tadanuktiḥ | nanu tiraścāṃ dehātmabhramo nāsmākaṃ pratyakṣaḥ; kāryānavagamāt bhramakāraṇadoṣo'pi duravagamaḥ; tat kathaṃ doṣamūlatvasambhāvanājñānamātreṇa mithyātvaniścayaḥ || ucyate |asmadādeḥ śāstraśravaṇātpūrvaṃ dehātmabhramadarśanāt teṣāṃ ca śāstrādhikārābhāvāt dehātmabhramastanmūladeha saṃsargarūpadoṣavattvaṃ cānumīyate; doṣamūlatvaniścayānmithyātvaniścayaḥ | evaṃ taimirikajanasya timirānvaye āptavākyādikamanveṣṭavyam; tato mithyātvaniścayaḥ | evaṃ sapakṣe śikṣitamarthaṃ dārṣṭāntike nigamayati tatheti | jñānamithyātvaṃ paramatābhyupagamāduktam | pāścātyabādhādarśanamutaratra nirasiṣyate | śāstrasyāvidyāmūlatvābhyupagame aniṣṭaṃ prasañjayati bhavantītyā dinā | vyāpti pradarśanavacanatvāt prayogā ityuktam | pratijñādṛṣṭāntaheturūpeṇa kathanam, "aniṣṭaprasaṅga evamapi nyāyyaḥ" iti jñāpanārtham | jñānaviṣayatvamātrameko hetuḥ, eko duṣṭapuruṣajñānaviṣayatvam, eko mithyābhūtasāmagrījanyajñānaviṣayatvamiti bhidā | pūrvaṃ sapakṣībhūta evārthotra sapakṣa ityevakārārthaḥ || nanvasatyahetujanyadhīviṣayatvamanyatarāsiddham | prapañcavaditi dṛṣṭāntaśca sādhyavikalaḥ | kathamevaṃ prasaṅgaḥ || ucyate | "brahmaṇo'nanubhūtitvaṃ tvaduktayaiva prasajyate" iti vat prasañjakaprasañjanīyadharmavyāptiṃ paramatenābhyupagamya dūṣaṇamuktamiti na virodhaḥ |
nāsatvahetujanyajñānaviṣayatvādasatyatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ; asatyādapi satyaprati pratirddaśyata iti śaṅkāmanūdya pariharati na cetyādinā | kimasatyasya satyotpattihetutvānupapattiḥ, uta tajjñaptihetutvānupapattiḥ iti vikalpamābhi pretya utpattihetutvejñaptihetutve codāharaṇāni darśitāni | tatra svāpnaviṣayāṇāṃ satyatve'bhimate'pi viṣayāsatyatvamabhayupagamya pariharati svāpneti | jñānasya satyatvamupapādayati tatra hīti | avadhāraṇaṃ kathamityatrāha teṣāmeveti | jñānasyābādhaṃ darśayati na hīti | kathaṃ jāyata ityatrāha darśanaṃ tviti | anyaviṣayo bādho nānyatra sañcārayituṃ yukta ityarthaḥ | atrānekodāharaṇapradarśanaṃ tattajjñānasāmagrīviśeṣāṇāṃ satyatvajñāpanārtham | tacca jñānasatyatvanirvahaṇā rtham | svapnakāraṇaṃ pūrvānubhavasaṃskāraḥ satyaḥ | prasiddhatvāt tadanuktiḥ | māyāvina iti | atra mantraiṣadhādiprabhavamityanena kāraṇasatyatvamuktam | māyābhayammithyāviṣayamityarthaḥ; vicitraviṣayaṃ vā | viṣayetyādi | viṣayadoṣaḥ sādṛśyādiḥ; indriyadoṣaḥ kācādiḥ; ādiśabdena deśagatadūratvādidoṣa ucyate | doṣaśca satyaḥ | satyaiveti | sarppasannidhānaṃ kāraṇaṃ satyam; draṣṭabuddhiśca satyā; śaṅkāviṣabuddhāvapi sāmagrī satyā; nirviṣoragadaṃśanaṃ vā andhakāreaśmaloṣṭhādinipīḍanaṃ vā satyaṃ hi bhavati | vastviti | jalādi satyam | tatkṛtacākṣuṣatejaḥ pratihatiśca satyā | saṃvedanānāṃ satyatve niścite hyuktodāharaṇeṣu satyātsatyapratipattirityatrāha eṣāmiti | utpattimattvamarthakriyākāritvaṃ ca dvayamapi pratyekaṃ satyatve sādhakam | na hi śuktau rajatamutpattimat; na ca kāryakaram | atha jñānasatyatvaṃ viṣayasatyatāvyāptamiti tannivṛttyā jñānasatyatvanivṛttiriti śaṅkate hastyādīnāmiti | abhāvepratipannopādhau tathātvābhāve | jñānasatyatvaṃ sālambanatvamātravyāptam; abādhitatvāditi pariharati naitaditi | sālambantvamātraśabdena satyālambanatvavyāvṛttiḥ | mithyābhūtasyālambanatvaṃ kathamityatrāha arthasyeti | ālambanamviṣayaḥ | pratibhāsamānatvamena hyālambanatve'pekṣitamiti | pratibhāsamānatvameva viṣayatvamirtthaḥ | avidyamānasyāpyatītānāgatādeḥ pratibhāsamānasyālambanatvadarśanāt vidyamānasyāpyapratibhāsamānasya tadabhāvācceti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe pratibhāsamānatvamapyastītyāha pratibhāseti | pratibhāsamānatāsaṃvidapekṣayā pratisambandhitvam || avidyamānasya vidyamānatayā bhāsanāt tena rūpeṇāsatyatā | tathā sākṣādavabhāsamāno viṣayo'pi jñānahetuḥ syāt; saṃpratipannavidyamānaviṣayavat vidyamānatayā bhāsamānatvāviśeṣāt; tathāsati asatyotsatyātpekṣirityatrāha doṣavaśāditi | avidyamānasya vidyamānatayā bhāsanaheturdoṣa eva; na tvavidyamāno viṣayaḥ | avidyamāno viṣayo na jñānasya hetutayā'pekṣitaḥ kevalaṃ viṣatayā, vidyamānastu tathātvena bhāsamāno viṣayatayā hetutayā cāpekṣitaḥ, ato vastuto vidyamānatvameva viṣayasya jñānahetutve upādhiḥ | niyatapūrvakālavarttino hi hetutvaṃ dṛṣṭam | tasmādavidyamānasya hetutvāyogāt doṣa eva heturiti nāsatyātsatyotpattirityarthaḥ | prātabhāsamānatve dvayorapyaviśiṣṭe kathamanyarasyāsatyatvaniścaya ityatrāha sa tviti |
buddhirapyasatyā kiṃ na syādityatrāha abādhiteti | viṣayāsadbhāvena jñānasyāsatyatākathanaṃ kālātyayāpadiṣṭami tyarthaḥ ||
nanu svāpnādiviṣayajñāne kiṃ jñānamātraṃ śubhāśubhapratipattihetuḥ, uta jñānaviśeṣaḥ? jñānamātrapakṣe'tiparasaṅgaḥ | jñānaviśeṣaścet, kastasyāvacchedakaḥ? viṣayaścet,kiṃ viṣaya upalakṣaṇatayāvacchedakaḥ uta viśeṣaṇatayā? yadi viśeṣaṇatayā,viśeṣyeṇa saha kāryānvayi hi viśeṣaṇam, atohastyāderapi śubhāśubhapratipattihetutvādasatyātsatyapratipattiḥ | yadyapalakṣaṇatayā,upalakṣyabahirbhūtaḥ upalakṣyapratītyupāyo hyupalakṣaṇam | atoviṣayasya jñānapratipattihetutvādasatyātsatyapratipattiḥ || jñānānāṃ tattadyayavahārānuguṇyalakṣaṇasvabhāvaviśeṣairvyāvṛttatvānnātiprasaṅga iti na ca vācyam; vyavahārānuguṇyamātrasya vyāvarttakatve'tiprasaṅgāt | vyavahāraviśeṣānuguṇyasya vyāvarttakatve tadviśeṣaśca tatsaṃgrāhakaviṣayādhīna iti vyavahārāvacchedakatayā anṛtasya satyahetutvamiti ||
ucyatevyāvṛttameva jñānaṃ śubhāśubhādyanumāpakam; vyāvṛttiśca svā(sāā)lambanena | avidyamānasyāpyālambanatvaṃ doṣavaśādityuktam | anyathā khyātipakṣe'pyālambanasatyatā sarvajñānānāmiṣyata eva; viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatatsaṃsargāṇāṃ kkacitsasatyatvāt | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayostathātvanirvāhakaḥ saṃsargaḥ svasya tadīyatve saṃsargāntaranira pekṣaḥ | sa tu saṃsargaḥ purovattirni bhramādhiṣṭhāne pratīyamānaḥ purovartyapekṣayā svayaṃ svasya saṃrgārūpatva nirvahaṇā'bhāyarthyāt purovartiti nāstīti purovartyapekṣayā saṃsargo'paramārthaḥ; na tu svarūpeṇa | ālambanatve ca sannihitatvarūpamanapekṣitam, asannihitāsyāpyālambanatvadarśanāt | ataḥ satyena rūpeṇālambanatvamiti hastyārohaṇādijñānānyapi satyabhūtahastyādyālambanāvacchinnāni paramārthabhūtayā svapnāvasthayāvacchinnatvājjāgradavasthājñānavilakṣaṇāni śubhāśubhapratipattinimittāni | ato nātiprasaṅgaḥ, nāsatyātsatyapratipattiśca | na ca pratibimbāt bimbānumitāvasatyātsatyapratipattiḥ; pratibimbapratibhāsasya satyasyaivānumāpakatvāt | paramārthatastu tatra nānumāpakānumeyavibhāga, darppaṇādipratihataiścākṣuṣatejobherbimbasyaiva darpaṇasthatayā gṛhyamāṇatvāt | ataḥ kkacidarthāt pratipattiḥ, kkacit tatpratibhāsāt tattadarthapratipattiriti nāsatyasya liṅgatvam | kiñca asatyātsatyapratipattiḥ kiṃ bhavatpakṣeṇocyate, utāsmatpakṣeṇa | na tāvat bhavatpakṣe sā sidhyati; śubhāśubhayorapi mithyātvena asatyādasatyapratipattireva hi syāt | na cāsmatpakṣe; yarthāthakhyātyabhyupagamāt satyādeva satyapratipatteḥ | eṣāṃ svāpnahastyādijñānādīnāṃ śubhāśubhapratipattyādihetubhūtānāṃ ṣaṇṇāmudāharaṇajñānānāṃ saṃskārādisatyasāmagrīkatvaṃ spaṣṭam; jñānānāṃ satyatvamupapāditam | ata utpattau jñaptau ca hetusatyatvaṃ siddham ||
atha jñānavyatiriktāsatyahetunā satyapratipatau hetusatyatvamupapādyate rekhayetyādinā | hetorasatyatvaṃ darśayam̐ścodayati nanviti | pariharati naivamiti | varṇātmakatā kiṃ sattayo varṇapratipatterupāyaḥ, uta pramitatayā, uta pratītatayā iti vikalpamabhipretyāha asata iti | asatyatvātsattayopāyatvamanupapannamityasata iti padasyābhiprāyaḥ | asataḥsadvayatiriktasyetyarthaḥ | asattvādeva pramitatayopāyatvaṃ cānupapannamiti nirupākhyaśabdābhiprāyaḥ | upā khyāpramitiḥ; tadaviṣayatvaṃ nirupākhyatvam | pratītiviṣayatayopāyatvānupapattistu vakṣyate || sattāpramityorabhāve'pi varṇātmatāyā upāyatvamastīti kalpyate cet, tadanupapannam; vyāptivirodhāt | vyāptyanuguṇaṃ hi kalpanaṃ prava rttata ityabhiprāyeṇāha anupapannaṃ ceti | atha bhrāntita pratītāyāḥ varṇātmatāyā varṇapratipattihetutvapakṣe'pi budhdyaṃ śasya hetutve parasyānupapatiṃta darśayitumāha atheti | dūṣayati evaṃ tarhīti | kuta ityatrāha buddheriti | dūṣaṇāntaramāha upāyeti | tadupapādayati ubhayoriti | budhdyaṃśasya hetutve dūṣaṇamuktam | varṇātmatāṃśasya hetutve siṃhāvalokitakena dūṣaṇamāha rekhāyā iti | avidyamānavarṇātmanāavidyamānavarṇātmatvenetyarthaḥ | atiprasaṅgaparihārārthaṃ śaṅkate atheti | tatrāpi svamatāsiddhimāha hanteti | tadupapādayati rekhāyā iti | udāharaṇāntaraṃ pariharati rekhāgavayādapīti |
sphoṭavādāvalambanena ucyamānaṃ udāharaṇāntaraṃ pariharati na caikarūpasyetyādinā | "nādaiḥ sphoṭhyate iti vyutpattyā sphoṭa ekarūpaḥ śabdaḥ; tadabhivyañjakanādaviśeṣāḥ bahavaḥ; katvasvatvādibhedo vyañjakagataḥ śabde āropito'rthaviśeṣapratipattihetuḥ; tatrāsatyātsatyotpattiḥ"ityapi na yuktamityarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha nānānādeti | katvasvatvādiviśeṣānvitatattannādakṛto'bhivyaktiviśeṣaḥ satyaḥ; tadviśiṣṭaḥ satyaḥśabdo'tharpratipattiheturityarthaḥ | yadyapi katvasvatvādivauśiṣṭayaṃ śabdasyāropitamtathāpi tajjñānaṃ satyabhevārthapratipattihetuḥ | jñānasya ca satyenaivālambanena svāpnajñānavadvayāvṛttiranusandheyā | katvādyālambanābhivyaktiviśiṣṭarūpeṇa sphoṭasyārthapratipattihetutvasambhavāt katvādivaiśiṣṭayasyāsatyasyārthasya nārthapratipattyupayogaḥ | evaṃ śabdasyaikarūpatvamabhyugamya parihṛtam | atha tadanabhyupagamena pariharati śabdasyaikarūpatvamiti | kuta ityatrāha gakārāderiti | ekakāreṇaikarūpaḥ śabdo vyāvatrtyate; na tu dundubhiśabdādiḥ | sa tvanabhivyaktaviśeṣākāro gakārādireva | "atha gaurityatra kaḥ śabdaḥ? gakāraukāravisarjjanīyā iti hi bhagavānupavarṣaḥ" iti gakāredereva bodhakatvaṃ vyācakhyuḥ | nanu "tasmistasmistu tanmātraṃ tena tanmātratā smṛtā" iti śāstravaśādekarūpaṃ śabdamātramabhyupagantavyam; tat kathaṃ tatpratikṣepaḥ || naivam; tanmātrāvasthāsūkṣmabhūtakāraṇaguṇānāmindriyagrāhyatvāyogāt | pañcīkṛtabhūtaguṇānāmeva hyaindriyikatvam | kiñca, dadhyavasthāyāṃ dugdhāvastheva tanmātrāvasthā |ākāśaguṇabhūtaṃ śabdatanmātraṃ sthūlākāśasṛṣṭe paścānna vidyate | yathāmahābhūtatṛtīye tejasi śukalakṛṣṇādivarṇavyatirekeṇa rūpatanmātraṃ kiñcidasti, śukalakṛṣṇādayaścābhivyañjakagatāḥ ekarūpe āropitā iti ca vaktumayuktamevamidānīmekarūpaśabdasya vidyamānatvaṃ tatrābhivyañjakagatānāṃ katvasvatvādīnāmāropitatvañca sargapratipādakaśāstrānusāribhirabhyupetumayuktam |
atrāyāmabhisandhiḥvarṇātitikta ekarūpaḥ śabdaḥ kiṃ sphuṭapratipannatvādabhyupagamyate, uta kalpanāvaśāt | na prathama:, gakārādivyatiriktasya kasyacidanupalambhāt | na dvitīyaḥ, kalpakābhāvāditi || nanu varṇānāṃ vācakatvānupapatteḥ, ekaṃ padabhityādipratyayasya varṇeṣvanupapatteḥ, bhinneṣu varṇeṣu śabdaḥ śabda ityanuvṛttibuddhivaśācca varṇātiriktapadasphoṭasiddhiḥ; tata eva nyāyāt padasaṅghātātiriktavākyasphoṭasiddhiścatyatrāha gakārāderiti | gakārādivarṇānāmeva samuditānāṃ vācakatvam | ekaṃ padam, ekaṃ vākyamiti pratyayaśca vaṇarsamudāyaviṣayaḥ | śabdaḥ śabda ityanuvṛttibuddhiśca śrotragrāhyatvopādhinibandhanā |ataḥ kalpakānāmanyathāsiddhatvānnaikarūpaśabdasiddhirityarthaḥ ||
nanu na kalpakānyathāsiddhiḥ | tathāhi,na tavadekaikasya varṇasya vācakatvaṃ varṇāntaravaiyarthyāt; gakāramā treṇa gogavayagajādyapratipatteśca | nāpi varṇasamudāyo vācakaḥ; kramoccāritaśrutānāṃ varṇānāṃ yaugapadyābhāvena vṛkṣādīnāmiva samudāyabhāvānubhūtavarṇaviṣayasmaraṇā nupapatteḥ | na ca pūrvapūrvavarṇaśravaṇajanitasaṃskārasacivo'ntyavarṇo vācaka iti yuktam; varṇānubhavajanyasaṃskārāṇāmanubhūtavarṇaviṣayasmaraṇahetutayā'nanubhūtārthāntarapratītihetutvābhāvenākiñcitkaratvāt | tatsācivyavirahitāntyavarṇasya ca arthapratyāyakatvāyogāt | tathā varṇānāṃ bhinnatvāt ekaṃ padamiti pratyayaśca tadatiriktārthaviṣayo bhavitumarhati | na ca vanasenādipratyayavat samudāyaviṣayatvamekatvapratyayasya yuktam, ekapradeśasambandhitvādivat ekīkāranimittopādhyabhāvāt || ekasmṛtyārūḍhatvamupādhiriti cennadve pade, trīṇi padāni, bahūni vākyānītyanekeṣāmekapratyayārūḍhatvadarśanāt | na caikārthāvacchinnavarṇasamudāya ekaṃ padam; varṇānāṃ vācakatvānupapatterevaikārthapratipādanābhāvāt | kiñca bahuvarṇeṣu ayaṃ śabdo'yaṃ śabda ityanuvṛttaḥ śabdaśabdo varṇātiriktārthaviṣayo yuktaḥ | ghaṭakarakāpavarakakādibhede'pyekārthaviṣayasyokāśaśabdasya hi ghaṭakarakādyatiriktārthaviṣa yatvaṃ dṛṣṭam | na ca śrotragrāhyatvopādhinā śabdaśabdānuvṛttiriti yuktam,śrotrasya śrotragrāhyatvāt yogena śrotragrāhyatāyā api śrotreṇa grahītumaśakyatvāt | mānāntareṇa śrotragrāhyatāpratītau avilambitaśabdasākṣātkārānupapattiḥ | ataḥ kalpakānyathāsidhdyabhāvādvarṇātiriktaḥ śabdaḥ sphoṭa iti |
atrocyate | na tāvat varṇānāṃ vācakatvānupapattyā sphoṭasiddhiḥ; teṣāṃ sphoṭābhivyañjakatve'pi codyayarihārayostulyatvāllāghavanyāyena varṇānāmeva vācakatvāśrayaṇasya nyāyyatvāt | tathā hina tāvadekaikavarṇaḥ sphoṭavyañjakaḥ, dvitīyavarṇavaiyarthyāt; gakāramātreṇa gavayādipadasphoṭābhivyaktiprasaṅgācca | nāpi varṇasamudāyo vyañjakaḥ; kramoccarirataśrutānāṃ varṇānāṃ yaugapadyābhāvena samudāyabhāvānupapatteḥ | na ca pūrvapūrvavarṇajanitasaṃskārasacivo'ntyava rṇo vyañjakaḥ, varṇānubhavajanyasaṃskārāṇāmanubhūtavarṇasmṛtimātrahetutayā'nanubhūtasphoṭapratītihetutvāyogena tatsaṃskārānupakṛtasyāntyavarṇasya ca tadabhivyañjakatvāyogāt | yadyucyetapadaṃ tāvat pratīyate |atastatpratītyanurūpaṃ kāraṇaṃ kalpyam | kramabhāvināmapi saṃskārāṇāṃ yugapatkāryakaratvaṃ yuktam; kramadṛṣṭayorapi ghaṭayoḥ tau ghaṭāviti smaraṇadarśa nāt | ato yugapadbhāvipūrvavarṇamaraṇasacivo'ntyavarṇo vā yugapatsmaryamāṇasarvavarṇasamudāyo vā sphoṭābhivyañjaka itievaṃ tarhi sphoṭābhivyañjakatayā abhyupetāyāḥ sāmagrayā arthābhivyañjakatvamāsthīyatām; codyaparihārayostulyatvāt; anyathāsiddhasyārthāntarakalpakatvāyogāt varṇānāmeva vācakatvasaṃbhave tadatiriktakalpanānupapatterlāghavanyāyasya balīyastvācca | varṇānāṃ bhinnatve'pi yugapadbuddhisthaikavibhakatyantānekavarṇasamudāyaviṣayatayā padaikatvabuddhirapi nārthāntarakalpikā | na cārthaikatvāt padaikatvaṃ padaikatvādarthaikatvamityanyonyāśrayeḥ; ekavibhakatyantavarṇa samudāyasyaikapadatvaniścayāt | "sutiyantaṃ padam" iti hi padaniṣkarṣaḥ | tasya coktābhiprāyatve sati avyāptirnna syāt | ekavyutpattisiddhaikārthaprītītyupayuktavarṇasamudāyasva vā padatvam | bahuvarṇeṣu ayaṃ śabdo'yaṃ śabda iti pratyayo'pi śrotragrāhyatvopādhinibandhanatvādanyathāsiddha iti nārthāntarasiddhiḥ | na ca śrotragrāhyatāyā api śrotreṇa grahaṇā pekṣā, yathā cākṣuṣāṇāṃ dhavalimanīlimapītimnāṃ cākṣuṣatvajñānena cakṣurapekṣā | idaṃ cākṣuṣam, idaṃ cākṣuṣamiti vyavahāraśca cākṣuṣatvajñānanibandhana eva | pramāṇāntarāvagatacakṣuśśrotrādyanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyijñānagocara tvena cākṣuṣaśrāvaṇatvādijñānam | na hi sahasaiva śabdo'yamiti jānanti | prathamaṃ gakārādirūpeṇa śabde'vasite vyutpannaśabdasmaraṇapūrvakameva śabda ityavagamyate | ataḥ śabdena smaraṇakṛtavilambavat śrotragrahyatā(śrotrā)numānavilambopyabhyāsapāṭavakṛtāt śaighyrānna vivicyate |ato varṇasamudāya eva padaṃ padasamudāya eva vākyamiti sthi tam |
asatyātsatyapratipattinirākaraṇamupasaṃharati ata iti | satyapratipattihetuṣu satyatayā abhimateṣu yādṛśaṃ satyatvam, tādṛśaṃ satyatvaṃ śāstrasyāpyastītyabhiprāyeṇa codayati nanviti | gaganakusumavaditi yuktibādho hyuktaḥ | na tvidānīmeva laukikapuruṣairnāstīti pratipannatvam | ataḥ tādāmasatyatvaṃ netyarthaḥ | hetumāha sadduddhibodhyatvā diti | saditi bodhyatvameva kāryakatvānuguṇam; na satyatvamityarthaḥ | tarhi sadadvaitabhaṅgaḥ syādityatrāha utpanna iti | tarhi na bodhakamityatrāha na tadeti | pariharati naivamiti | naivamupāyakāle'pi satyatvaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ | jñānasya mithyātvaṃ mithyārthaviṣayatvāt | jñānasya doṣamūlatvādviṣayamithyātve nidarśanamāha yatheti | pūrvaṃ paścāttanabādhādaśarnamabhyupetya dūṣaṇamuktam | idānīṃ tadeva nāstītyāha paścāditi | tadupapādayati śūnyamiti | tadvākyaṃ tatprāmāṇyamapi bhrāntisiddhamiti śaṅkate tattviti | tulyatvamāha etadapīti | pāścātyabādhādarśanasya prāmāṇyahetutvavacanaṃ sarvaśūnyavādina eva sādhakam; tataḥ paraṃ niṣedhyābhāvena niṣedhānudayādityāha pāścātyeti | prāmāṇyādīnāṃ doṣamūlatvaṃ dvayorapi tulyam; pāścātyabādhādarśanaṃ tu śūnyavādino'dhikamityarthaḥ || sarvaśūnyavādino'pi paro niṣedho'sti; sarvamastīti vacanaṃ hi tanniṣedha iti cettarhi prapañcamithyātvavacanasyāpi prapañcasatyatāvacanaṃ niṣedhaḥ syāt | nāstīti vacanameva niṣedha iti cettattu śūnyavādina eveti bhāvaḥ | idañca vedāprāmāṇyaṃ mṛṣāvādināṃ saugatānāṃ ca samānam | yadāhuḥ "vedo anṛto buddhakṛtāgamā'nṛtaḥ prāmāṇyametasya ca tasya cānṛtam |
boddhā'nṛto buddhiphale tathā'nṛte yūyaṃ ca bauddhāśca samānasaṃsadaḥ ||" iti |
nanu viṣayasatyatvarūpaṃ śāstraprāmāṇyaṃ vidyata iti mahadiha(daṃ) vaiṣamyamasmākamiti cenna | kiṃ katipayaviṣayasatyatvaṃ vivakṣitam, uta kṛtsnaviṣaya satyatvam | katipayaviṣayasatyatvaṃ buddhāgamasyāpyasti; saṃvitsvayamprakāśatvādeḥ sampratipannatvāt | kṛtsnaviṣayasatyatvaṃ tu śruterapi tvayā na svīkṛtamiti | kiñca viṣayasatyatvaṃ durva cam; satyatayā'bhyupetasya brahmaṇaḥ pramāṇaviṣayatvānabhyupagamāt |
yattu "ādityo yūpaḥ" ityatra yūpādityaikyāpratipādanaṃ tātparyaliṅgābhāvāt, na tu pratyakṣaprābalyādityu cyatetatra tātparyaliṅgābhāvo'bhyupeta eva | tena pratyakṣāviruddhārthapratipādanākṣamatvamavarjjanīyamāpatati | na hi vedāntibhirarthavādāderanyaparatvāt svārthe prāmāṇyaṃ tyajyate | mantrārthavādānāmapi svārthe prāmāṇyasya bhavadbhirevopapāditatvāt |ataḥ stutiparatvāt yūpādityaikyāpratipādanaṃ ityapasiddhāntaḥ || arthavādānāṃ svārthe prāmāṇyamastīti kathaṃ tat yūpādityaikyāprati pādanamiti cetucyate | pramāṇāvirodhaśca tātparyaliṅgam upakramopasaṃhārādiṣvapūrvatva mapi tātparyaliṅgatayā hyuktam, "abhyāso apūrvatāphalam" iti | apūrvatvaṃ sādhakabādhakapramāṇāgocaratvam yathā''huḥ, "asannikṛṣṭavācā ca dvayamatra jihāsitam | tādrūpyeṇa paricchittistadviparyayato'pi vā" iti |
ataḥ pramāṇāntarāgocaratvalakṣaṇaṃ tātparyaliṅgamatra nāstīti yūpādityaikyāpratipādanam; na tvarthavādatvena svārthe prāmāṇyābhāvāditi |atastātparyaliṅgābhāvo nāma pratyakṣādivirodhe paryavasthita iti śāstraṃ na tadviruddhārthapratipādanakṣamam | śāstraprābalyanirasanaṃ parisamāpayati alamiti | yadvā, yattu pratyakṣamityādinā nyāyamukhena kṛtaṃ parapakṣapratikṣepamupasaṃharati alamiti | pramāṇaviruddhastarkaḥ kutarkaḥ | ata evāpratiṣṭhitatvam | svaviruddhabauddhamatopayuktayuktikathanātparihasanīyatvam ||
pareṇa pratyakṣādapi śāstraprābalyaṃ vadatā prabalatayā'bhimataṃ śāstraṃ puraskṛtya paścāt tarkaḥ pratipāditaḥ | siddhānte tu prabalatayā abhimatalaukikapramāṇagatiṃ prathamaṃ nirūpya paroktadustarkaṃ nirasya laukikapramāṇavirodhe śāstraprābalyaṃ ca pratikṣiptam | śāstrasya lokikapramāṇaviruddhārthapratipādanāsāmarthyopapādanena śāstrasya saviśeṣapara tvaṃ sāmānyataḥ sāmarthyāt siddham | viśeṣeṇa śabdasya padavākyarūpeṇa pravṛttyā saviśeṣaparatopapādanācca śāstrasya saviśeṣaparatvaṃ sāmānyena siddham | athāpi ye vākyaviśeṣāḥ pareṇa nirviśeṣaparatvenodāhatāḥ, teṣāṃ saviśeṣaparatvaṃ vākyatātparyaparyālocanayā pratipādayitumārabhate yaduktamityādinā | tatra nirviśeṣaparatvaṃ saṅgaheṇānuvadati yaduktamiti | jñānaikarasatvena śodhakavākyeṣu pratipannatvānnirviśeṣatvam | tacca kāraṇavākyeṣu pratipannam | vastumātraśabdena anyatra saguṇabrahmaṇi tātparyābhāvassūcyate | ityādīnītyukte tasyāmevopaneṣadi paryavasyatīti tadvayāvṛttyarthamityevamādīnītyuktam | tat dūṣayati tadayuktamiti | kuta ityatrāha ekavijñāneneti | yenāśrutamityādivākyena eka vijñānena sarvavijñānaṃ pratijñāyate |
asyāyamarthaḥ, yena śrutena matena vijñātena aśrutamamatamavijñātaṃ śrutaṃ mataṃ vijñātaṃ bhavatīti, na tu brahmaṇassattayā sarvaṃ jñātaṃ bhavatītidārṣṭāntikasāmarthyāt, mṛddṛṣṭāntasāmarthyācca | na hi brahmasattayā mṛtpiṇḍasattayā vā tattatkāryaṃ jñāyate | "kasminnu bhagavo vijñāte sarvamidaṃ vijñātaṃ bhavati" iti muṇḍakopaniṣadi, "ātmani svalvare dṛṣṭe śrute mate vijñāta idaṃ sarvaṃ viditam" iti bṛhadāraṇyake ca śravaṇācca | ato yathokta eva pratijñāvākyārthaḥ | na hi ghaṭajñānena paṭajñānasaṃbhava ityekavijñānena sarvavijñānaṃ na saṃbhavatīti śaṅkāyāṃ kāryakāraṇayostad dṛṣṭamityāha yathā saumyeti | tatrāpyasatkāryavādamukhena ekavijñānena sarvavijñānānupapattiśaṅkāṃ pariharativācārambhaṇamiti | vācā | vākśabdo'jahallakṣaṇayā vākpūrvavyavahāraparaḥ | vāceti tṛtīyayā prayojanatayā hetutvaṃ vivakṣitam | ārambhaṇamiti karmaṇi lyuṭ; ārabhyate ālabhyate ityārambhaṇam | "ālambhaḥ sparśahiṃsayoḥ" mṛtpiṇḍenetyarthasiddham | vikāraḥ ghaṭatvadravyatvādyavasthā | vākpūrvakahānādivyavahārārthaṃ mṛtpiṇḍena nāmarūpe spṛśyete, mṛtpiṇḍo nāmarūpa bhāg bhavatītyarthaḥ | kāryakāraṇayorekadravyatve pramāṇamāha mṛtiketyeva satyamiti | mṛdayaṃ ghaṭa iti pratyabhijñayā mṛṇmayaṃ ghaṭādikamapi mṛddravyatvenaiva prāmāṇikamityarthaḥ | buddhiśabdādibhedāḥ ghaṭādiṣu dravyabhede'pi dṛṣṭāḥ;
