na tatra āste śete sukhyahaṃ duḥkhyahamityādiṣu dravyaikyepi dṛṣṭāḥ; ataste sādhāraṇāḥ | tatra āste śete sukhyahaṃ dukhyahaṃ ityādiṣu dravyaikyaniyāmikā yā pratyabhijñā, saivātrāpi dravyaikyaniyāmiketi bhāvaḥ | atra mṛttikāmātrasya pāra mārthyaṃ vikārāsatyatvaṃ ca vivakṣitaṃ cet itiśabdavaiyarthyaṃ syāditi | tadā mṛtikaiva satyeti hi vācyam; vikārāsatyatve dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyavikalaḥ; satyatvapratipatteḥ || ghaṭādisatyatvaṃ vyāvahārikamiti cetpiṇḍasyāpi satyatvaṃ vyāhārikamiti na kāraṇasatyatvasiddhiḥ || kāraṇasya vyāvahārikameva satyatvamabhitaṃ cettad ghaṭāderapi tulyaṃ syāt | kāryakāraṇadravyaikyāt kāraṇavijñānena kāryavijñānamupapannamastu; tathā'pi loke vividhakāryavargasya vividhopādānakatvadarśanādekavijñānena savarvijñānamanupapannamiti śaṅkāyāṃ jagato brahmaikakāraṇatāmāha sadeva somyedamagra āsīditi | śrutigatasacchabdārthamabhipretyātra śacchabdavācyasyetyuktam | saguṇabrahmaparamidamityanyathāsiddhirdurvacetyabhiprāyeṇa parasya brahmaṇa ityuktam | agasṛṣṭeḥ pūrvamityarthaḥ; anantaraṃ sṛṣṭervakṣyamāṇatvāt | vijātīyasajātīyasvagatanānātvavyāvṛttiḥ | atra vivakṣitā cet, agra iti vaktumayuktam | na hi brahmaṇaḥ kālaviśeṣe nirviśeṣatvam; vaiṣamyanairvṛṇyaparihārāya jīvavahutvatatkarmapravāhatadanāditvānāmabhyupagamyatvācca || tadvahutvamapāramārthikamiti cetpāramārthikabahutvasya idānīmapyabhāvādagraśabdavaiyarthyāt | na cāgraśabdasyāvivakṣitārthatā; ana ntaraṃ sṛṣṭayukteḥ | ataḥ kālarūpavijātīyabhedaścetanarūpasajātīyabhedaḥ sārvajñyādisṛṣṭayanuguṇaguṇarūvasvagatabhedaśca tadānīmastīti vijātīyāditrividhabhedanirāsaparatvaṃ viruddham; kāraṇavākyatvāt | na cedidaṃ kāraṇavākyam, īdṛśānāṃ vākyānāṃ sarvaśākāraṇavāpratyayanayāt vijātīyādibhedanirāsaparatvena kāraṇaparatvābhāvāt brahmakāraṇatvamapramāṇaṃ syāt | avadhāraṇavācina evakārasya svayaṃ vyāvatrtyaviśeṣopasthāpanāsamarthasya samabhivyāhṛtapadāntarārthavirodhivyāvartakatvaniyamadarśanāt sadevetyavadhāraṇamasatkāryavādavyudāsaparam | na hi ayaṃ vidvānevetyavadhāraṇaṃ brāhmaṇatvaṃ vyāvarttayati; api tvavidvattvameva | ataḥ śabdasvārasyāt sadeveti nirasanīyamasattyameva; na tu vijātīyabhedaḥ | yadyapi sadvijātīyamasattathā'pi tasya vyāyartyatvaṃ na vijātīyatvākāreṇa; api tu sadvirodhitvarūpe ṇā | sadeva; na tu kadācidapi asadityarthaḥ | sacchabdo hi mānasambandhayogyatālakṣaṇaṃ sattvaṃ pravṛttinimitīkṛtya paramātmani vatarte |ayaṃ sacchabdo viśeṣyabhūtaparamātyavācako'pi kāraṇaviṣatvasāmarthyāt kāraṇatvaupayikaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ prakṛtipuruṣakālaśarīrakaṃ paramātmānamupasthāpayati | ekabheveti avibhaktanāmarūpakāraṇāvasthaṃ brahyocyate | kāraṇatvāvasthāyāmetvātvāvadhāraṇasya bahu syāmiti strakṣyamāṇakāyarbahutvapratiyogyekatvaparatvāt; "ekena mṛtpiṇ ḍena savar mṛṇmaya" ityuktadṛṣṭāntasāmarthyāt | "taddhedaṃ tarhyavyākṛtamāsīt tannāmarūpābhyāṃ vyākriyata" iti śrutyantaraikyārthyāccāyamevārthaḥ | vaiśeṣikādibhirnnityatayoktānāmākāśādīnāmapi saṃhārābhiprāyaḥ evakāraḥ | evamavibhaktanāmarūpatvāddrahmaṇa upādānatvaṃ siddham | bhāvyavasthāviśeṣavataḥ prāgavasthāyogo hyupādānatvam | advitīya miti nimittāntaraneṣedhaḥ; upādānasya prastutatvena nimittasya buddhisthatvāt; paratantrarūpaviśeṣāṇāṃ vihitatvāt niṣedhasya ca vihitavyatiriktaviṣayatvāt; uparitanavākyasaṅgaterapekṣitatvācca | ekameveti śabdasyāvibhaktanāmarūpatāparatvaṃ bahusyāmityanenāvagamyate | "tadaikṣata...tattejo asṛjate" ityanena ādvitīyapadasya nimittāntarābhāvaparatvamavagamyate | parasya brahmaṇaḥ sarvadā sattvena sadevetyavadhāraṇamasatkāryavādavyudāsaparamiti uparitanena, "kathamasataḥ sajjāyeta" ityādi vākyenāvagamyate | "kathamasataḥ" ityādivākyaṃ vaiśeṣikamatanirāsaparam; na tu kṣaṇikavādinirāsaparam, na śūnyavādinirāsaparaṃ ca; kṣaṇikaśūnyavādinirāse kṛte apyekavijñānena sarvavijñānasya vaiśeṣikamatanirāsasāpekṣatvāt; "taddhaika āhuḥ asadevedamagra āsīt" iyārabdhatvācca | na hi kṣaṇikatvaṃ śūnyatvaṃ ca kālaviśeṣe bhavati | ato'satkāryavādanirāsaparaṃ taddhaika āhurityādi vākyam | "kutastu khalu saubhyevaṃ syāt" itimṛda utpannasya mṛdātmakatvat asata utpannasyāsadātmakatvaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | utpattirnāma dravyasyāvasthāntarāpattirityamartho vācārammaṇamityanena śikṣitaḥ | tadu(mu?)pajīvyocyate, kathamasataḥ sajjāyeteti | kathaṃ nirāśrayātasyāsambhava ityarthaḥ |
tadaikṣateti sarvajñatvam, asṛjateti nimitatvam, bahu syāmityupādānatvam, tadubhayānuguṇaṃ sarvaśaktitvam, satyasaṅkalpatvañca, anena jīvenātmanā'nupraviśyeti sarvāntaratvaṃ coktaṃ bhavati | jīvenātmanājīvaśarīrakeṇa mayetyarthaḥ | "siṃhena bhūtvā bahavo mayāttā vyāghreṇa bhūtvā bahavo mayāttāḥ" ittivat | savarjñatvādiguṇakasya tadviparītākārajīvaikyāsaṃbhavāt, "yasyātmā śarīram" ityādivacanāt, "tadanupraviśya" iti acetana iva jīve'pyanupraveśaśravaṇacca | śarīravāciśabdasya śarīripayarntatvamukhyatāyā upapannatvāccāyamevārthaḥ | "sadāyatanāḥ" ityanena sarvādhā ratā, tata eva sarvaniyamanañca siddhim | "etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane gārgi ! dyāvāpṛthivyau vidhṛte tiṣṭhataḥ" iti praśāsanena dhārakatvaśravaṇāt | evaṃ sarvādhāratvasarvaniyamanasarvāntaratvaiḥ śarīrilakṣaṇairjjagaccharīrakatvaṃ brahmaṇa uktam | ādiśabdena sṛṣṭayupayoginaḥ śrutyantarasiddhā guṇā gṛhyante | aitadātmyamityanena kṛtsnasya jagataḥ tadā makatā cāvagamyate; tatsatyamiti tadātmakatvenaiva jagataḥ prāmāṇikatvam | jagataḥ svaniṣṭhatvena pratītirbhrāntiri tyarthaḥ | ataḥ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ sa ātmā | "aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ sa ātmā" iti nirdeśaḥ "rāmānujaṃ lakṣmaṇa pūrvajaṃ ca" itivat anyonyasambandhitvatātparyātiśayakṛtaḥ | yadvā, "sa ta ātmā'ntarvāmyasṛtaḥ" itivat kṛtsnajagadantaryāmitvāt tavātmā sa ityarthaḥ | tasmāt tvaṃśabdatadarthatadbuddhayaḥ tatparyantā iti tattmabasītyasyārtha ityāha evambhūteti | evambhūtaśabdena tatpadasya prakṛtaparāmarśitva sūcitam |
asyāḥ sadvidyāyāḥ saviśeṣavastunyeva ṣaḍivavatātparyaliṅga vidyateupakrāme tāvat, "uta tamādeśamaprākṣyaḥ" ityatra ādeśaśabdena praśāsitā'bhidhīyate | atra ślokāvācāryapādairuktau "chāndogye kecidāhurdiśatiḥ "uta tamādeśamaprākṣya" ityatrāṅpūrvastūpadeśaṃ prakaṭayati sato na praśāsti ghañantaḥ |
no karttaryasta karmaṇyagaṇi ghañiha sat kartṛ śāstau na kamar syāt syā(ta)tkarmopadeśe tadidamudita (tadidam utata)mādeśavācopadeśyam ||
atra vrūmaḥ praśāsti vadati diśirasāvāṅmukho nopadeśaṃ śāstau (śāstā) so'tiprasiddho na hi para iha cāpekṣitārthaprasaṅgaḥ |
yukto'sādhāraṇoktayā ghañagaṇi karaṇe'pyatra vaivakṣikatvaṃ śābdoktaṃ kārakāṇāṃ nanu karaṇatayā kartari syādvivakṣā ||" iti |
ādeśaśabdenopadeśyamucyate | prakṛtyartha upadeśaḥ; pratyayārthaḥ karmatvam "akatarri ca kārake saṃjñāyām" iti kartṛvyatiriktakārake ghaño vihitatvāt | upadeśe brahmaṇaḥ karmatvopapatteśca; praśāsane tu brahma na karma | api tu kartṛ | kartṛvyatiriktakārake hi ghañpratyayavidhiḥ | nātra karttari kapratyaya upapadyate; "kiṅti ce" iti guṇapratiṣedhādādeśaśabdarūpāsiddheḥ | nāpi pacādyacpratyaya upapadyate; diśighātorigupadhatvena "igupadhātkaḥ" ityapavādasūtreṇa kapratyayaprāpterguṇābhāvāt | ato ghañpratyayānta evāyamādeśaśabdaḥ | sa ca pratyayaḥ kartaryavihita iti karmārthatvasyaiva yuktatvādupadeśyamevādeśaśabdavācyamiti | atrocyateprakṛtyarthaḥ śāsanam; prasiddhiprācuryāt | anyathā svārasyabhaṅgāt | "āṅpūrvo diśatirniyoktṛprayojanavacanaḥ, upapūrvastu niyojyaprayojanavacanaḥ" iti hi nyāsakāraḥ | niyoktari prayājanaṃ yasya, tasyārthasya vācaka ityarthaḥ | evamanyatrāpi | kiñca upadeśyatvaṃ laukikālaukikakamarbrahmabhāgārthasādhāraṇam; śāsitṛtvaṃ tu brahmaṇo'sādhāraṇam; "antaḥpraviṣṭaḥ śāstā janānām", "etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane gārgi" ityādibhirnirupādhikapraśāsanasya brahmāsādhāraṇatvaśravaṇāt || niru pādhikopadeśyatvaṃ brahmaṇo'sādhāraṇamiti cennaiṣṭaprāptyaniṣṭativṛttitatsādhaneṣu sādhāraṇyāt | yadyapyaparimitasukhaprāptiduḥkhanivṛttyādi sākṣādupadeśyaṃ syāttathāpi saṃsāranivṛttibrahmatadupāsanānāmupadeśyatvaṃ sādhāraṇam | praṣṭavyasyopadeśyatvamarthasiddham | ata upadeśyatvakathanavaiyarthyañca | nanu "yenāśrutaṃ śrutam"mityanenaikavākyatvātsvajñānenānyajñānahetutāviśeṣitamupadeśyatvamasādhāraṇamiti cettathāpi tādṛśamupadeśyatvaṃ pratijñāvākyena, praṣṭavyatvoktayā cārthasiddhamityanapekṣitopadeśyatvakathanādapyapekṣitaṃ praśāsitṛtvameva vācyamiti yuktam | "yenāśrutam" ityupādānatve siddhe praśāditṛtvena hi nimittatvaṃ sidhyet | nimittāntare sati ekavijñānaṃ sarvavijñānaṃ nopapadyate | ataḥ pratipipādayiṣitavastuno vivikṣitāsādhāraṇākāraviśiṣṭatayaiva pratipādanamucitam | ghañpratyayasya tu karaṇe vyutpannatvāt, "vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ" iti śābdoktanyāyena karttaryeva karaṇāntaranairapekṣyeṇa sādhakatamatvavivakṣayā tathā prayoga upapadyate, akarttarītisūtr sya prayojanaṃ karaṇatvavivakṣayā vinā karttaryasādhutvena prayoganivṛttiḥ | upadeśapakṣe prakṛtyarthāsvārasyaṃ pratyayasvārasyaṃ ca, praśāsanapakṣe tu pratyayāsvārasyaṃ pradhānabhūtaprakṛtyarthasvārasyamarthaucityaṃ ceti vaiṣamyam | ataḥ praśāsitaivādeśaśabdābhidheya iti svīkartuṃ yuktam | evamupakame nirupādhikapraśāsanaguṇayoga uktaḥ | tathā jagadupādānatvaṃ nimittatvaṃ tadanuguṇasārvaśsarvaśaktisvādikañcāvagatam |
upasaṃhāre ca tattvamasīti sāmānādhikaraṇyena jīvāntaryāmitvaṃ nāma guṇaviśeṣa uktaḥ | asyaivārthasya bahuśa āvatirtatvādabhyāso'pyasti | evaṃ brahmaṇo jagatkāraṇatvajagadantarātmatvādiguṇānāṃ pramāṇāntarāpratipannatvādapūrvatā siddhā | evamupāsakasya, "tasya tāvadeva ciraṃ yāvanna vimokṣye atha sampatsye" iti śarīrapātāna ntaraṃ mokṣaśravaṇāt phalamapi vidyate | pituḥ putraṃ prati prativacanarūpatvādarthavādaśca labdhaḥ | mṛtpiṇḍādidṛṣṭāntopapādanādupapattiśceti |
asmin dṛṣṭāntatraye'pi vivartapakṣānuguṇaḥ ko'pi dṛṣṭānto na dṛśyate; api tu pariṇāmapakṣānuguṇa eva dṛśyate | dārṣṭāntikaviṣayavākye'pi tattajo'sṛjatetyuktam, na tu tadabhramāditi | ato asyāṃ śrutau vivartapakṣaprasaṅgo'pi nāsti | śrutyantareṣu ca "tadātmānaṃ svayamakurute" ityādikaṃ śrūyate; na tu, vyavarttateti | sūtraṃ ca "pariṇāmāt" iti; na tu, vivartāditi | smṛtiṣu ca, "kaṭakamukuṭakarṇikādibhedaiḥ kanakamabhedamapīṣyate yathaikam | kṣititalaparamāṇavo'nilānte" ityādiṣu pariṇāmapakṣā(kṣa?) eva dṛśyante(te?) | ataḥ śrutismṛtisūtrasvāra syāt pariṇāma evābhyupagantavyaḥ | sa ca pariṇāmaḥ sadvāraka eva bhavitumarhati; nirvikāratvanirdoṣatvaanupraveśaśarīraśarīribhāvādiviṣayānekaśrutisvārasyāt | anyathā tadvirodhaprasaṅgācceti |
ekavijñānena sarvavijñānāpratijñāvākyaṃ kim; kathaṃ tadupapādanamityāśaṅkāyāmetadvistaro vedārthasaṅgaha ityāha prapañcita iti | atrāpekṣitārthaḥ kathaṃ jñāsyata ityatrāha atrāpīti | nipuṇataramtasyādhikaraṇasyaitadarthaikaviṣayatvāditi bhāvaḥ ||
anantarodāhṛtāyāḥ paravidyāyāḥ saviśeṣaparatvamāha atha paretyādinā | apāṇipādamityantānāṃ padānāṃ viṣayamāha prākṛtāniti | prākṛtāḥprakṛtisambandhinaḥ, anena kkacitsiddhasya hi kkacinniṣedhaḥ iti niṣedhyānāṃ kkāpi siddhirdarśitā bhavati | prakṛtigatāḥprakṛtisaṃsargaprayuktāḥ jīvagatā doṣāśca prākṛtāḥ | adreśyamagrāhyam pratyakṣāgocaramanumānādyagocaram | yadvā cakṣuragocaramindriyāntarāgocaram | agotramavarṇamprākṛtanāmarūparahi tam | acakṣuḥśrotram indriyādhīnajñānaṃ na bhavati | apāṇipādamindriyādhīnaceṣṭaṃ na bhavati "apāṇipādo javano ahītā"paśyatyacakṣuḥ sṛṇotyakarṇaḥ" iti śruteḥ | anena padaddhayena jīvagataheyaniṣedhaḥ, indriyādhīnajñānatvaṃ tadadhīnapravṛttitvamapi hi jīvadharmaḥ | sarvagataṃ susukṣmamiti pāṭhakamaḥ, tathā'pyarthakrameṇa vyākhyātam sūkṣmatvasarvagatatveti | sūkṣmatayā hi vyāptiḥ | nityatvena kālāparicchedaḥ | vibhumprabhum prabhutvaṃ niyantṛtvaṃ jagaccharīrakatvaṃ phalitam; anena vastvaparicchedasiddhiḥ, sarvagatatvena deśāparicchedaḥ | avyayatvaṃ vyayaśabdopalakṣitadoṣavirodhitvaṃ nāma guṇa ityabhiprāyeṇa kalyāṇaguṇaiḥ saha tannirdeśaḥ | yadvā avyayatvamekarūpatvaṃ pūrṇatvaṃ vā | bhūtayonitvamjagatkāraṇatvam; etatprakaraṇasthena "yassarvajñassarvavit" ityanena vākyena sārvajñyamuktam | sarvajñassarvavit sarvaṃ svarūpato vetti sarvaṃ prakārataśca vettītyarthaḥ | parasya brahmaṇa ityasya pūrvavadarthaḥ |
atha śodhakavākyeṣu satyajñānādivākyasyākhaṇḍārthatvaṃ nirasyati satyaṃ jñānamityādinā | sa khalvevamupanyastaḥ pratipattisaukaryāyācāryapādaiḥ | tathā hisatyādivākyaṃ satyatvādiguṇaviśiṣṭameva brahma pratipādayati; nīlamutpalamityādiṣu samānādhikaraṇavākyeṣu viśiṣṭaikārthaparatvavyutpatteḥ, satyādivākyasya ca samānādhikaraṇa tvācca | tathā ca sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇaṃ "bhinnapravṛttinimittānā"mityādinoktaṃ śābdaiḥ | tatra yaduktaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyasyaikārthyaparatvavyutpatteḥaikārththasya ca padānāṃ viśeṣaṇamātraparatve viśiṣṭaparatve cāsiddheḥ svarūpamātraikyaparatvaṃ satyādisāmānādhikaraṇapadānāmāstheyamititadayuktam; vikalpāsahatvāt | kiṃ satyādipadāni tattatpadātharvirodhivyāvṛttimātraparāṇi, uta svarūpamātraparāṇi, uta virodhivyāvṛttyavacchinnasvarūpaparāṇi iti vivecanīyam | na tāvādvirodhivyāvṛttimātraparāṇi; vyāvartamānāmanekatvenaikārthatvāsiddheḥ | vyāvartyānekatvāt vyāvṛttayo hyanekāḥ syuḥ | nāpi svarūpaparāṇi; tathāsati padānāṃ paryāyatvaprasaṅgāt, pravṛttinimittabhedābhāvena sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇahāniprasaṅgāt eke(ka)tarapadavaiyarthyaprasaṅgācca | nāpi tadavacchinnasvarūpaparāṇi; vikalpāsahatvāt | kiṃ virodhivyāvṛttīnāṃ svarūpāvacchedakatvamupalakṣaṇatayā, viśeṣaṇatayā vā | na tāvadādyaḥ kalpaḥ, ekenopalakṣaṇena svarūpaṃ pratipannamiti upalakṣaṇāntaravaiyarthyāt | upalakṣyādvrahirbhūta upalakṣyapratītyupāyo dharmaḥ upalakṣaṇamiti hyupalakṣaṇavidaḥ | tathā ca śākhādiṣu dṛśyate | atha eke(ka)taravaiyarthyam | pravṛttinimittabhedābhāvena sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇahāniśca || kathaṃ tarhi bhavatpakṣe janmādibahūpalakṣaṇatvamekasyaiva brahmaṇo'bhyupagamyata iti cetucyate | tatra hyupalakṣyasya dharmiṇo brahmaṇa ekatve'pi pratyupalakṣaṇamupalakṣyadharmabhedo janmasthityādyanuguṇajñānaśaktayādirūpo'smābhirabhyupagamyate | anyathā tatrāpyanekopalakṣaṇavaiyarthyaṃ prasajyata eva | tva tpakṣe tuanekopalakṣaṇopalakṣyadharmabhedānabhyupagamāduktadoṣo durvāraḥ, tadabhyupagame hi brahmaṇaḥ saviśeṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ | nāpi dvitīyaḥ; viśeṣaṇabhūtānāṃ vyāvṛttīnāmanekatvenaikārthatvāsiddheḥ | viśeṣyāntarbhūto viśeṣyapratītyupāyo dharmo viśeṣaṇam || viśeṣyāntarbhāvo nāma jñāpyāntarbhāvaḥ || viśeṣaṇabhūtārthabhedo'pi viśeṣyabhūtapradhānārthaikyādaikārtha(tva?) siddhiriti cet, tat sakhaṇḍavākyārthavādino'pi samānam || kastarhi viśeṣa āvayoriti cetayameva viśeṣaḥyadekasya mate padānāṃ lākṣaṇikatvam, itarasya pakṣe teṣāṃ mukhyatvamiti |
yaccoktamviśeṣaṇāntaraviśiṣṭe vastuni viśeṣaṇāntarānvayādviśeṣaṇānāmanyonyasamavāyaprasaṅga iti tadasat;vikalpāsahatvāt | "padajātaṃ śrutaṃ sarvaṃ smāritānanvitārthakam | nyāyasampāditavyakti paścādvākyārthabodhakam ||" ityuktaprakriyayā hi vākyamarthamavabodhayati | tatra kiṃ padānāṃ padārthasma(smā)raṇadaśāyāmanyonyasamavāyaprasaṅgaḥ, uta parāmarśadaśāyāma, āhosvit vākyārthābhidhānadaśāyām | na tāvat prathamaḥ kalpaḥ; smaraṇadaśāyāṃ pṛthakpṛthak padārthasmaraṇena mitho'nvayaprasaṅgābhāvāt | nāpi dvitīyaḥ; ekasmin vastunyaviruddhānekaviśeṣaṇasamavāyasya pratyakṣādyavagatasya yathāvasthitavastuparāmarśadaśāyāṃ parāmṛśyamānatvāt | nāpi tṛtīyaḥ; vākyārthābhidhānadaśāyāṃ (vākyasya?) sarvaiḥ padairyugapadanekaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaikavastuviṣayaikajñānajanakatvena kramābhidhānaprayuktānyonyasamavāyaprasaṅgābhāvāt | yathaiva hi dvecakṣuṣī jātiguṇādyanekaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaikavastuviṣayaikāṃ dhiyaṃ yugapajjanayataḥ, tathaivānekapadāni yugapadeva tarttadviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaikavastuviṣayaikajñānajanakāni bhavanti | krameṇābhidhāne'pi nānyonyasamavāyaprasaṅgaḥ; padāntaropātte viśiṣṭe viśeṣyāśaṃsyaiva padāntaropāttaviśeṣaṇena viśeṣyamāṇatvāt | tacca yathādṛṣṭaviṣayatvāt padānāṃ vyutpatteḥ | anyathā bhavatpakṣe vyāvṛttirūpaviśeṣaṇānāmanyonyaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ kramābhidhānaprayukto durvāraḥ | ato yathokta eva parihārastavāpi śaraṇam || krameṇābhidhānānabhyupagame kathamuddeśyopādeyavibhāgasiddhiriti cetucyate | jñātājñātavibhāgo hyuddeśyopādeyavibhāgaḥ | sa ca yugapatpratipādane'pi nāpaiti | ekena vākyenaikavastuno'nekaviśeṣaṇānvaye yugapatpratipādye, tatra ekaviśeṣaṇānvayaḥ prāgeva jñātaḥ, viśeṣaṇāntarānvayastvajñāta iti jñātājñātavibhāgaparāmarśaḥ parāmarśadaśāyāṃ saṃbhavatyeva |
yadapyuktamviśiṣṭaikyapratipādane viśeṣyaikyavat viśeṣaṇaikyaṃ prasajyata ititadapi na sādhīyaḥ;viśeṣyamātraikya paratvāt samānavibhakteḥ | tacca vyutpatisiddham | vyutpatiśca pratyakṣamūlā | pratyakṣaṃ ca viśeṣyaikyamevāva gamayati; na tu viśeṣaṇānāmaikyam; yathā gaurityādyekapadaprayoge'pi prātipadikāvagataviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyaikyaṃ tadgatameka vacanaṃ nāvagamayati, kintu viśeṣyaikyamevāvagamayati | pratyakṣamūlā vyutpattireva hi tatra kāraṇam | tathā samānādhikaraṇapadasaṅghātasthasamānavibhaktirapi viśeṣyaikyamātraparatvenaiva niyāmikā | anyathā bhavatpakṣeṣyasatyādipratiyogivyāvṛttirūpaviśeṣaṇaikyaprasaṅgāt || prātipadikānāṃ tattatpratiyogivyāvṛttiviśiṣṭasvarūpaparatve'pi samānavibhakteḥ prātipadikārthaikadeśabhūtaviśeṣyamātraikyaparatvavyutpattyā na viśeṣaṇaikyaṃ prasajyata iti cettadasmatpakṣe'pi samānam |āvayovirśeṣastu prāgevoktaḥ |
yaccoktamviśeṣaṇabhede viśeṣyabhedaprasaṅga ititadayuktam; viśeṣaṇabhedamātrasya viśeṣyabhedakatvābhāvāt | tacca, devadattaḥ śyāmo yuvetyādiṣu viśeṣaṇabhede'pi viśeṣyaikyadarśanāt || viśeṣaṇabhedasya svataḥprāptaviśeṣyabhedakatvaṃ pratyakṣeṇa tatrāpodyata iti cettanna; dharmivācipadaikyāt samānavibhaktinirdeśāccaikyapratīteḥ || khaṇḍo muṇḍaḥ pūrṇṛṅgo gaurityatra dharmivācakapadaikye samānavibhaktinirdeśe satyapi viśeṣaṇabhede viśeṣyabhedaḥ pratīyata iti cetnai(mai)vam; yataḥ svataḥ prāptaṃ tayorviśeṣyaikyapratyāyakatvaṃ pratyakṣeṇa tatrāpoditam || parokṣaviṣaye khaṇḍo muṇḍaḥ pūrṇaśṛṅgo gaurityādivākye prayukte khaṇḍatvādiviśeṣaṇabhede viśeṣyabhedapratītirdṛśyata iti cetparokṣaviṣaye'pi devadattaḥ śyāmo yuvetyādivākye prayukterayāmatvādi viśeṣaṇabhede'pi viśeṣyaikyapratītirdṛśyata iti samānaścarcaḥ || ko nirṇāyaka iti cetyajjātīyaviśeṣaṇānāṃ niyamena bhinnāśrayatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ pratyakṣeṇa, tajjātīyaviśeṣaṇānāṃ parokṣatve'pi viśeṣyabhedāpādakatvam, yathā khaṇḍatvādīnām; yajjātīyaviśeṣaṇānāṃ bhinnāśrayatvaniyamo na dṛṣṭaḥ, tajjātīyaviśeṣaṇānāṃ dharmivāci padaikye samānavibhaktinirdeśa caikaviśeṣyaniṣkarṣakatvaṃ yuktam, yathā nīlatvādīnāmiti |
yaccoktamsamānavibhaktayavagataikyavirodhādviśeṣaṇaparityāga ititadapyayuktam; prātipadikābhihitaviśeṣaṇānvayavirodhādaikyaparityāgāpatteḥ | tathā hiyadi samānavibhaktayanvayāvagatatvā(ktayanvayā)daikyaṃ na hātuṃ śakyate, tarhi prātipadikāvasitaviśeṣaṇānvayaḥ kathamiva hātuṃ śakyate, yathā nīlamutpalabhityādau || tatra pratyakṣasiddhatvādaṅgīkriyata iti cettatraikyapratītirapi tathaiveti kiṃ na syāt || samānavibhaktinirdeśe parokṣe'pyaikyapratītiśābdīdṛśyate iti cettathaiva, prayoge parokṣe'pi prātipadikāvagataviśeṇānvayapratītirdṛśyata eva || tasmādaikyapratītiḥ śābdīti cetviśiṣṭapratītirapi śābdīti na kaścidviśeṣo'nyatrābhiniveśāt | kiñca prātipadikāvagataviśeṣaṇānvayaparityāgahetubhūtasamānavibhaktayavagatamaikyaṃ kiṃ svarūpam, uta tadatiriktam? atiriktapakṣe saviśeṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ | anatariktapakṣe hetvasiddhiḥ | prātipadikāvagatasvarūpātirekeṇa samānavibhaktayā kasyacidaikyasyāpratipādanāt | na hi svarūpamātra virodhādviśeṣaṇaparityāgaḥ; vyadhikaraṇavākyeṣvapi tattyāgaprasaṅgāt | prātipadikāva gataṃ svarūpaṃ niviśeṣamiti pratijñāya samānavibhaktaraikyāvagamādityukte svarūpāvagamādityuktam syāt | tataśccaikyāvagamavirodharūpahetvasiddhiḥ | svarūpaṃ tu viśeṣaṇānvayāviruddhaṃ vyadhikaraṇavākyeṣu viśeṣaṇānvayāvagamādiyu ktam | kiñca samānavibhaktayavagatamaikyaṃ prātipadikārthaikadeśabhūtaviśeṣyamātrasyatyuktatvāt tasya ca viśeṣaṇabhedāvirodhitvānna tadvirodhanibandhanaviśeṣaṇatyāgo yuktaḥ | ato na nirviśeṣatvaṃ vastunaḥ |
kāṣrṇyavyāvṛttaṃ pītimavyāvṛttaṃ śauklayamityādiṣu pratiyogabhedasya tattadvayāvṛttasvarūpasya ca śabdopātta tvānna lakṣaṇāprasaṅgaḥ, satyādivākyeṣu na tatheti viśeṣaḥ | evaṃ śauklayādidṛṣṭāntavākyāt satyādidārṣṭāntikavākyasya śabdadvārakaṃ vaiṣamyamuktam | arthadvārakaṃ ca vaiṣamyaṃ pūrvoktaṃ draṣṭavyam | kathamiti cet; ittham | śauklyādeḥ kasyacid dravyasya dravyāntarādvayāvattarkadharmatayā dharmāntarānapekṣatvaṃ yuktam; brahmaṇastu na tathātvamiti svarūpātiriktavyāvarttakadharmā(ntarā)pekṣā'styeva | na hi paranirvāhakatvānabhyupagame svanirvāhakatvasambhavaḥ | kiñca śauklyādisvarūpasphuraṇe sati na kāṣrṇyādyadhyāsaprasaṅgaḥ | atastatra svarūpameva vyāvṛttiriti yuktamabhyupagantum | brahmaṇaḥ svarūpasphuraṇe taditarādhyāsābhyupagamāt rajatādivyāvarttakādhiṣṭhānasvarūpāttirikta śuktitvādivat sarvādhyāsādhiṣṭhānabrahmasvarūpātiriktasakaletaravyāvṛttirūpadharmo'vaśyābhyupagamanīyaḥ |
yaccoktamvācye pradhānāṃśasya pratipādanānna lakṣaṇetitadapyasat; viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa viśeṣyaparyavasāyinaḥ śabdasya dvārānabhidhāne dvāryabhidhānāsiddheḥ | alākṣaṇikatve'pi viśiṣṭābhidhānasvarasasya śabdasya viśeṣyamātraparatve svārasyāhāniravajarnīyā | sā ca na virodhābhāve yuktā | yaccaviṣaṃ bhuḍkṣvetyādiṣu sarvapadalakṣaṇā dṛṣṭeti | tacca vidhipratyayāṃśasya mukhyārthatvādayuktam | tatra vidhipratyayavyatiriktaśabdalakṣaṇā ca mukhyārthatve pramāṇāntaravirodhāt svīkriyate | prastute virodhābhāvānna sā yuktā ||
vimataṃ vākyamakhaṇḍārthaṃ samānādhikaraṇavākyatvāt sampratipannavaditi īdṛśyanumānoktiranupapannā, vākyamakhaṇḍārthamiti padayorartha bhedo'sti, na vā | asti cetpratijñāvākya eva hetoranaikāntyam | na cetakhaṇḍā rthatvaṃ pratijñātameva na syāt | dṛṣṭāntasya ca sādhyavaikalyamavarjanīyam; prakṛtipratyayātmakapadapuñjarūpatvāt sarvavākyānām | yadi bhāvarūpākhaṇḍārthapratipādanāsamarthamiti pratijñā, tarhi sādhyadharmavacanāntargatayoḥ samānādhikaraṇayorbhāvarūpakhaṇḍaśabdayoranaikāntyam | tasmāt satyādivākyaṃ satyatvādiviśiṣṭameva brahma pratipādayatīti siddham | tadidamucyatesatyaṃ jñānamanantamityādinā | tatra nirviśeṣaparatvābhāvaṃ sopapattikaṃ pratijānīte satyaṃ jñānamiti |
sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇapratyabhijñāpakaiḥ śabdairhetvaṃśaṃ vivṛṇoti pravṛttīti | tataḥ kimityapekṣāyāmanvayamukhena vyāvṛttimukhena vā pravṛttinimittabhedasyāvaśyāśrayaṇīyatvamāha tatreti | tatra ko viśeṣa ityatrāha iyāniti | avaśyāśrayaṇīya ityatrābhipretaṃ vyāvṛttīnāṃ svarūpamātratve dūṣaṇamāha naceti | sāmānādhikaraṇyāsiddhimupapādayatiekasminniti | paryāyatvaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ spaṣṭamiti na kaṇṭhoktam | viśeṣaṇabhedenānekārthatvāt | sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇahāniṃ nirasyati na ca ekasyeti | viśiṣṭatābhedāttattadviśeṣaṇānvayabhedāt | tathāvidhamanekāthartvaṃ na virodhi; pratyutānukūlamavetyarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha bhinnapravṛttīti | viśeṣaṇato bhinnārthatve viśeṣyataścaikārthatve sati hi sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇapādguṇyamityarthaḥ | samānādhikaraṇaṃ vākyaṃ kiṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyasambandhaparam; uta viśeṣyaikyaparam, uta ubhayaparam? | prathame viśeṣyaikye pramāṇaṃ na syāt | dvitīye viśeṣaṇānvayo niṣpramāṇakaḥ syāt | tṛtīye sambandhadvayasyaikavākyena bodhayitumaśakyatvāt vākyabhedaprasaṅgaḥ" iti keciccodayanti | tanna; prātipadikenaiva viśeṣaṇānvayasya bodhyatayā samānavibhaktinirdeśena viśeṣyaikyapratipādane vākyabhedaprasaṅgābhāvāt |
evaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyasyānyathaivopapattyā satyajñānādivākyasya nirviśeṣaparatvaṃ nirastam; atha kāraṇavākyaikārthyānnirviśeṣaparatvaṃ nirākartuṃ tadanuvadati yaduktamityādinā | sadeva ekameveti vijātīyasajātīyabhedavyāvarttakāvadhāraṇadvayasamabhivyāhṛtamadvitīyapadaṃ pāriśeṣyāt svagatabhedābhāvaparamiti guṇato'pi sadvitīyatāṃ na sahata ityarthaḥ | "yaḥ savarjñaḥ sarvavit "yasya jñānamayaṃ tapaḥ | tasmādetat brahma nāma rūpamannaṃ ca jāyate"ityādisaguṇaviṣayakāraṇavākyaikāthyarmastītyatrāha ata iti | sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyānnirguṇakāraṇavākyeṣu saguṇatvaṃ saguṇakāraṇavākyeṣu nirguṇatvañcoktaṃ syāt | tatrāpacchedanyāyena nirguṇavākyaprābalyāt savarkāraṇavākyāni nirguṇaparāṇītyartheḥ | kāraṇavākyaikārthyaṃ kuto'pekṣitamityatrāha kāraṇatayopalakṣitasyeti | jagatkāraṇatvaṃ taṭasthalakṣa ṇam; na tu svarūpalakṣaṇamityabhiprāyeṇa upalakṣitarayetyuktam | kāraṇatvaśaṅkitadoṣavyāvarttakatvādaikāthyarmavarjanīyamityarthaḥ | atha śodhakavākyāntaraikārthyānnivirśeṣaparatvaṃ nirācikīrṣuranuvadati anyatheti |anūditamarthaṃ dūṣayati tadanupapannamityādinā | tatra prathamaṃ kāraṇavākyaikārthyaṃ saviśeṣaviṣayatve satītyāha jagaditi | tathaiveti | ādvitīyapadaṃ yathā adhiṣṭhātrantaranivāraṇaparameva bhavati, tathaivetyarthaḥ | vicitraśaktiyogameveti | uttaravākyamupādānabhūtasyaiva brahmaṇo'dhiṣṭhātṛtvaśaktiyogamevāvagamayati; na tu nirguṇatvamityarthaḥ | śaṅkate aviśeṣeṇeti | sarvaniṣedha sya nimittāntaraniṣedhasya ca sādhāraṇamadvitīyapadam, nirupapadatvāt | kiñca upakrame sadevaikameveti sajātīyavijātīyabhedayornniṣiddhatvādekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñāyāḥ sajātīyavijātīyabhedamātramithyātve'nupapannatvācca advitīyapadamupakramānuguṇyena svagatabhedaniṣedhaparaṃ syāt; na tūtaravākyānuguṇaṃ syāt upakramaprābalyāditi sākṣātpūvarpakṣicodyam |nimittatvopādānatve ubhe apyuttaratra śrūyate; tatropādānāntaramadvitīyapadena niṣedhyam; na tu nimittāntaramiti pārśvasthacodyam | tatrāha sisṛkṣoriti | anena śaṅkāṃ dvayaṃ parihṛtaṃ bhavati | tadaikṣatetyanantaroktatvādasya vākyasya kāraṇaparatvaṃ nāpalapanīyamityabhiprāyeṇa sisṛkṣorityuktam | kāraṇaparatve ca sati agraśabdena vijātīyakālasadbhāvasiddheḥ, jīvānāditvaśruteḥ akṛtābhyāgamakṛtavipraṇāśādiśrutyarthāpattyā, vaiṣamyanairdhṛṇyaparihārāya jīvānāṃ karmasūkṣmabhedasya pralayadaśāyāmabhyupagamāt ekatvāvadhāraṇatya jīvasūkṣmabhedasahatvasya parairabhyupagantavyatvāt sārvajñyasarvaśaktitvādīnāṃ sargaupayikatvācca vijātīyasajātīyasvagatabhedābhāvasya durvacatvāt ekavijñānena sarvavijñā napratijñāyāścoktārthāvirodhena nirvāhyatvāt paratantrabhedasya vihitatvāt niṣedhasya ca vihitavyatiriktaviṣayatvāt, svatantrarūpabhedaviśeṣasya "na tatsamaścābhyadhikaśca dṛśyate" ityadibhirniṣiddhatvāt, sāmānyaniṣedhasya ca tatparyavasānasya nyāthyatvācca advitīyapadasya svatantrabhedaniṣedhaparatve prāpte sati avibhaktanāmarūpatāpratipādakenaikamitipadenāpādānatvasya siddhatvāt nimittāntarasya buddhisthatvācca nimittāntararūpasvatantravastuniṣedhaparamadvitīyapadamityarthaḥ | sarvaniṣedhe'niṣṭamāha sarveti | sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyasya nivaṣatvavādaviparītatvamāha sarvaśākheti | atranirguṇa vāde | atra bhavata ityupālambho vā | sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyanuktaguṇasvīkāraphalaḥ, na tūktaguṇatyāma phala iti tvatpakṣaviparītaphala ityarthaḥ | saviśeṣaparatve kāraṇavākyaikārthyaṃ nigamayati ata iti | na kevalaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattyā; kāraṇavākyaikārthyācca saviśeṣaparamivyapiśabdasya bhāvaḥ ||
atha śodhakavākyāntaraikārthyaṃ nirviśeṣaparatvahetuṃ nirasyati na ceti | pareṇāpacchedanyāyena hi nirguṇasaguṇavākyavirodhaḥ parihṛtaḥ | atra bhinnaviṣayatvāt virodha eva nāstītyāha prākṛteti | nirguṇamitiguṇasāmānyaniṣedhaḥ, niṣkalamiti śarīrasāmānyaniṣedhaḥ, niṣkriyamiti kriyāsāmānyaniṣedhaḥ || na guṇaniṣedhaḥ saṅkocayitavya; ārthaguṇaniṣedhabalena sarvaguṇavirahāvagamāt | jñānasya jñānādiguṇāśrayatvādaśarnāt brahmaṇo jñānamātratvapratipādanena nirguṇatvaṃ hi phalitamiti śaṅkāyāmārthaguṇaniṣedhaṃ parihartuṃ śrutipratipannamarthamanubhāṣate jñānamātreti | tataḥ kimityatrāha na tāvateti | kuta ityapekṣāyāmkiṃ jñānatvāt jñānānāśrayatvamucyate, kimekajātīyadravyayorniyatadharmadharmibhāvānupapatteriti vikalpe, prathamaṃ prativakti jñātureva jñānasvarūpatvāditi | ayamarthaḥjñānasya jñānādiguṇāśrayatvābhāvaḥ kiṃ vyāptyā kathyate, uta śrutibalāt | vyāptyā cetjñānānāśrayabhūtaṃ viṣayaprakāśakaṃ jñānaṃ kasyaciddharmabhūtameva dṛṣṭamiti dharmatvenāṅgīkriyatām | yadi śrutibalāt svatantratvena aṅgikriyatetarhi nutibalādeva jñānāśrayatvamapi aṅgikriyatamiti | jñānānāśrayatvaṃ dharmabhūtajñānatvaprayuktam; na tu jñānatvamātraprayuktamiti sopādhikatvam | ato vyāptivirodhaśca nāsti | yadvā jaḍasya ghaṭāderiva jñātṛtvāyogāt jñātṛtvenaiva jñānasvarūpatvamarthasiddham | dvitīyaṃ prativakti jñānasvarūpasyeti | ekajātīyadravyayornniyatadharmadharmibhāva upapadyata ityarthaḥ | śrutyā jñānāśrayatve siddhe hi tathābhyupagama ityatrāha jñātṛtvameva hīti | yadvā jñātureva jñānasvarūpatvāditijñāturjñānasvarūpatvāvirodhādityarthaḥ | ekajātīyadravyayornniyatadhamirdharmibhāvānupapattyā virodhaṃ pariharati jñānasvarūpasyai veti | jñānatvāt jñānānāśrayatvaṃ pariharatijñātṛtvamena hīti | pūrvavadabhiprāyaḥ | jñātṛtvaṃ yathā phalitaṃ bhavati, tādṛśaguṇaparāśca jñātṛtvakaṇṭhoktimatyaśca śrutayaḥ sarvaśabdavivakṣitāḥ | bahuvacanena bahūpaniṣadvākyāni vā vivakṣitāni | evakāreṇa jñātṛtvasyānanyathāsiddhirabhipretā | hiśabdo hetau | jñātṛtvasya śrutisiddhatvānna kācidapyanupapattirityarthaḥ | kāḥ punaḥ śrutaya ityapekṣāyāmārthaguṇaniṣedhaparihārārthaṃ nirguṇaśrutisaṅkocasiddhyarthaṃ saguṇaśrutīnāmāvidyakaguṇaviṣayatvaśaṅkāpanodārthaṃ ca śrutīrdarśayan tābhiretatprayojanatrayasidiṃdha ca darśayati yaḥ sarvajña ityādi nā | yaḥ savarjñaḥ sarvavitsarvaṃ svarūpataḥ prakārataśca jānātītyarthaḥ | jñānasya sarvaviṣayatvam, tasya samaṣṭivyaṣṭisṛṣṭayupayogitvam, ātmasambandhitvaṃ ca darśayati | tadaikṣatetyāditrayeṇa | nityo nityānāmityatra cetanabahutvamuktam; kāmapradatvañca | jñājñau dvāvajāvityatra jñātṛtvamīśvaratvaṃ ca | tamīśvarāṇāmityatra īśvaratvadevatātvapatitvāni; īśvaratvamniyantṛtvam | niyāmyaviṣayajñānavata eva niyantṛtvāt niyamanasya jñānaviśeṣarūpatvācca | niyantṛtvena jñātṛtvāsiddhiḥ | devatātvam kārmārādhyatvam | patitvam śeṣitvam | na tasyeti | kāryam śarīram | karaṇamindriyādi; "kāryakāraṇakartṛtve" iti prayogāt | samābhyadhikaniṣedhaścātra śrūyate | tena advitīyamiti sāmānyaniṣedhasya, "chāgo vā mantravarṇāt"iti nyāyādīśvararūpadvitīyaviśeṣaparyavasāyitvavaṃ sūcitam | parā' syeti jñānaśaktayādīnāṃ svābhāvikatvamuktam | kriyāniyamanam | eṣa ātmeti viśeṣavidhānam; viśeṣaniṣedhaśca | ārthaguṇaniṣedhasya parihartavyatāmabhipretya jñānasvarūpasyaivetyuktam | āvidhikatvanirākaraṇāya svābhāvikānityuktam | samastaheyarahitatāṃ cetyanenapi avidyikatvaśaṅkā arthātparihṛtā |
kiñca jñātṛtvapramukhān kalyāṇaguṇān samastaheyarahitatāṃ cetyanena nirguṇavākyasya saṅkucitavṛttitvaṃ copapāditaṃ bhavati | tathā hikalyāṇaguṇānityasyāyābhiprāyaḥguṇaviśeṣavidhānaṃ guṇasāmānyaniṣedho na bādhituṃ prabhavati; api tu tadvayātiriktaviṣaya eva bhavati; anyathā "na hiṃrayāt sarvā bhūtāni"iti sāmānyaniṣedhena, "agnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabheta" iti hiṃsāviśeṣavidhānabādhaprasaṅgāditi | samastaheyarahitatāṃ cetyasyāyamarthaḥyathā "paśunā yajeta", "chāgasya vapāyāḥ" ityādiṣu, "chāgo vā mantravarṇāt" iti sūtro ityuktanyāyāt sāmānyaśabdo viśeṣadarśane sati tatra payarvasyati, tathā guṇasāmānyaniṣedho viśeṣaguṇaniṣedhe paryavasyatīti | kiñca sāmānyaśabdā nāṃ viśeṣaparyavasāyitvaṃ vyutpattisiddham; yathā gāmānaya, gāṃ badhānetyādiṣu sāmānyaśabdo viśeṣakaṭākṣeṇa prayojakavṛddhena prayujyate | tata eva hi tatra prayojyavṛddhaśca na sarvā govyaktīrānayati, kiṃ tu vivakṣitavyaktiviśeṣamevāna yati | tathaiva hi tatra vyutpattiḥ | evaṃ jñātṛtvapramukhān kalyāṇaguṇānityanena samastaheyarahitatāṃ cetyanena ca utsargāpavādanyāyassāmānyaviśeṣanyāyaśca abhipretaḥ | upāttaviśeṣavyatiriktaveye sāmānyaśabdasya virodhaparihārāya saṅkoca utsargāpavādanyāyaḥ, avirodhe'pi vaiyarthyaparihārāya saṅkocaścedgovalīvardanyāyaḥ, upāttaviśeṣaviṣaye tasya saṅkocassāmānyaviśeṣanyāya iti bhidā |
kiñca, adhyātmaśāstreṣu guṇaśabdassattvarajastamassu prasiddhaḥ | "na hi tasya guṇāḥ sarve sarvairmunigaṇairapi | vaktuṃ śakyā viyuktasya sattvādyairākhilairguṇaiḥ |", "sattvaṃ rajastama iti guṇāḥ prakṛtisaṃbhavāḥ |" "nirguṇasyāprameyasya" "guṇā guṇeṣu vartante", "kāraṇaṃ guṇasaṅgo'sya", "nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca", "nānyaṃ guṇebhyaḥ kartāram", "daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā", "vinā heyairguṇādibhiḥ", "guṇādidoṣāśca mune vyatītaḥ", "guṇakaluṣasya sadātanasya tena" ityādiṣu | evaṃ kevalaguṇaśabdasya sattvādiparatvena prasiddhiprācuryāt nirguṇābdāḥ sattvādiniṣedhaparāḥ |
ayaṃ viṣayavibhāgo na kevalaṃ asmābhiḥ bhinnopaniṣadvākyeṣu guṇaviśeṣavidhāna guṇaviśeṣaniṣedhadarśanānniścīyate, ekasminneva vākye viṣayavibhāgo dṛṣṭa ityāha nirguṇeti | guṇasāmānyaniṣedhavat guṇasāmānyamātravidhānābhyupagamena nirguṇavākyānāṃ saguṇavākyānāṃ cetyuktam | na hi śrutiṣu guṇasāmānyavidhānaṃ kkaciddṛśyate | guṇaviśeṣā eva hi śrūyante | doṣasamabhivyāhṛtaguṇaśabdastūpādeya(tama)guṇaparaḥ | "varṣāyutairyasya guṇā na śakyāḥ", "sa te guṇānāmayutaikadeśam", nāntaṃ guṇānāṃ gacchanti" ityādismṛtivacanābhiprāyeṇa vā saguṇavākyānāmityu ktam | tatra guṇaśabdo doṣapratipakṣavacanaḥ; loke tathā prasiddheḥ; prakaraṇavaśācchāgapaśunyāyena kalyāṇaguṇarūpaviśeṣaparyavasānasya nyāyyatvācca | uktanāyadvavena virodhābhāvādapacchedanvāyasyāviṣayatvamāha iti saguṇanirguṇavākyayoriti | itiśabdena pūrvoktasarvahetavo vivakṣitāḥ | utsargāpavādanyāyān sāmānyaviśeṣanyāyāt adhyātmaśā streṣu guṇaśabdasya sattvādiṣu prasiddhiprācuryāccetyarthaḥ | saguṇanirguṇavākyayoriti | atra tu viṣayavibhāgānna virodha iti nāpacchedanayaḥ pravatarta iti bhāvaḥ | anyatarasya mithyāviṣayatāśrayaṇamapi nāśaṅkanīyamiti | saguṇavākya syeti na hyuktam; kiṃtu anyatarasyetyuktam | saguṇena nirguṇavākyasya vā nirguṇena saguṇavākyasya vā bādhāśrayaṇamanupapannamityarthaḥ |
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ,pūrvaṃ virodho nāstīti parihṛtam | idānīṃ virodhābhyupagame'pi nāyamapacchedanyāya viṣayaḥ, api tu virodhādhikaraṇanyāyaviṣaya eveti | tathāhiapacchedanyāyo hyaniyatavirodhapaurvāparyaviṣayaḥ, udgātṛprītahartrorubhayorapacchedaniyamo nāsti | tatrāpi krameṇāpacchedo'pyaniyataḥ | tanniyame sati hi sarvasva dakṣiṇākatvādakṣiṇākatvavirodhaniyamaḥ | ubhayorapyapacchede tasya kramabhāvitve, "udgātrapacchedaḥ pūrvabhāvī, itarastu caramabhāvī" iti vā vipayaryeṇeti vā niyamo('pi) nāsti | ato'pacchedanyāyaviṣayaḥ prayogāvadhikavirodhaḥ | saguṇanirguṇavākyavirodhastu svarūpaprayuktaḥ; vidhiniṣedharūpatayā niyatapaurvāparyaśca | ato virodhābhyupagame'pyaniyatavirodhapaurvāparyaviṣayo'pacchedanayo nātra pravartate; api tu virodhādhikaraṇanyāya eva pravartate | tadviṣaye hi paurvāparyaniyamo virodhaniyamaśca vidyate | tathāhi"audumbarī spṛṣṭvodbhāyet" iti pratyakṣaśrutiḥ | ainaik "audumbarī sarvā veṣṭayitavyā" iti smṛtiḥ | tatra śrutiḥ prathamata eva pramitiṃ janayati, nirapekṣapramāṇatvāt | smṛtistu svamūlabhūtaśrutyanumānasāpekṣatayā vilambitapravṛttiḥ | atastatra paurvāparyaṃ niyatam | audumbarīsparśatadveṣṭanayorvirodhaśca niyataḥ | tatra pūrvameva pramityāṃ jātāyāṃ tadviruddhārthaḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭaḥ syāt | ataḥ, "vilambitadhīhetoḥ śīghradhīheturbalīyān" iti nyāyāt pūrvasyāḥ śruterbalīyastvaṃ ityuttaratra śāstrānudaya eva || nanvatrādhītameva hi uttara mucaraśāstramiti cettataḥ kim? pramityanudayo hyanudayaḥ; na tu śabdānudayaḥ | ādityo yūpaitivat || nanu tatra smṛtitvaśruvitve bādhyabādhakabhāvaprayojake || naivam; smṛtitvaśrutitvayoḥ paurvāparyahetutvātt | tena siddhaṃ paurvāparyameva bādhyabādhakabhāvaheturiti nyāyasāmyāt saguṇavākyabalīyastvamiti |
yadvā mābhūdvirodhādhikaraṇanyāyaḥ; atra upakramādhikaraṇanyāya eva pravarttate; virodhapaurvāparyaniyamāt | ataḥ saguṇavākyapratibaddhatvāt nirguṇaśāstrānudaya eveti || "nanu prathamapravṛttaṃ vilambitasyotpattipratibandhakaṃ cet nedaṃ rajatamiti jñānodayam, idaṃ rajatamiti dhīḥ pratibadhnātu" iti cetna; sattayā jñāyamānatayā ca jñāpakayoratyantavaiṣamyāt | sattyā jñāpakaṃ hi pramāṇaṃ pūrvāparaparāmarśanirapekṣaṃ jñānaṃ janayati | tatrotpannaṃ jñānam, "pūrvābādhena notpattiruttarasya hi sidhyati" iti nyāyāt pūrvaṃ bādhitvaivodeti | jñāyamānatayā jñāpakaṃ tu yogyatāparāmarśādisāpekṣaṃ pramitiṃ janayati | tatra parāmarśadaśāyāṃ pūrvapramāṇena viruddhapramitiścet, sā pramitiruttarotpatiṃta pratibadhnātīti vaiṣamyamiti || evaṃ tarhi, nedaṃ rajatamiti jñānasya idaṃ rajatamiti parāmarśasāpekṣatvāt pūrvajñānena pratibaddhasya nedaṃ rajatamiti jñānasyānudayaprasaṅga iti cennaindriyasya pratyabhijñetarajñānajanane pūrvaparāmarśanirapekṣatvāt | ihāpi śuktiriyamiti śuktitvaviṣayā hyuttarapramitiḥ | śuktitvapratīteśca na rajatapratipattisāpekṣatvam | śuktitve gṛhite sati tadgrahaṇa phalabhūto nedaṃ rajatamiti vyavahāro nañjul likhitatvāt pratiyogi sāpekṣaḥ pravartate | tatsāpekṣatvaṃ ca śabdasvabhāvādhīnam | ataḥ śuktijñānaṃ rajatajñānanirapekṣamudayamānaṃ pūrvaṃ bādhitvaivodeti |
ato niyatavirodhapaurvāparyaviṣayaḥ upakramādhikaraṇa (virodhādhikaraṇa) nyāya evātra (virodhādhikaraṇa nyāya upakramadhikaraṇanyāya eva vā atra?) pravartate; na tvapacchedanayaḥ | sa cedṛśasthale yadi pravartate, paśvālambhanamakartavyaṃ syāt; caramabhāvinaḥ, na hiṃsyāditi niṣedhasya prabalatvāt | tataścānuṣṭhānavirodhaḥ | saguṇanirguṇavākyayorvirodhapaurvāpayarniyamaḥ pareṇaivoktaḥ | ato'pi virodhādhikaraṇanyāyaviṣayatvenātra apacchedanyāyānavakāśāt saguṇavākyānāṃ balīyastvaṃ siddhamiti | etadabhiprāyeṇa anyatarasyetyuktam |
upādhyanuktipūrvakaśrutyuktānāṃ guṇānāṃ nirupādhikatvasya svataḥprāptatvāt, svābhāvikatvaśruteḥ, "nānyo heturvidyata īśanāya" iti īśanasyāhetukatvaśravaṇena tadaupayikaguṇānāmapi nirupādhikatvasiddheḥ, jñānaśaktayāditāratamyopādhibhūtakarmasaṃbandhaniṣedhapūrvakasatyakāmatvādyukteḥ, "ta ime satyāḥ kāmāḥ" iti svarūpavat satyatvaśruteḥ, "parā'sya śaktiḥ", "te ye śatam" ityādibhirguṇānāmaparicchinnatvapratipādanena karmasaṃbandhavyāpakaparicchedanivṛttyā
vyāpyakarmasaṃbandhanivṛtterarthasiddhatvāt, svābhāvikatvakaṇṭhoktirahitaguṇaparavākyeṣvapi sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyena guṇānāṃ svābhāvikatvasiddheḥ, "ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ" ityāditātparyaliṅgaprācuryāt, utsargāpavādanyāyasāmānyaviśeṣanyāyābhyāṃ viṣayavibhāgāt ekasyāṃ śrutāveva viṣayavibhāgasya, dṛṣṭatayā ca virodhābhāvāt, apacchedanyāyāviṣayatvāt, virodhe satyapi virodhādhikaraṇanyāyena saguṇavākyaprābalyāt, "yassarvajñaḥ" ityādiṣūpāsanavidhirahiteṣu vākyeṣu svarūpavat pratipannatvāt, mānāntarāgocaratayā anuvādaviṣayatvāsaṃbhavena niṣeddhumaśakyatvāt, "ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ", "satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brehma yo veda", "ātmānamanuvidya vrajantyetāṃśca satyān" kāmān iti kkacidupāsyatvaśravaṇasya svarūpe'pi tulyatvāt, adhyātmaśāstreṣu satvādau(diṣu) guṇaśabdasya prasiddhiprācuryācca nirguṇavākyaviṣayatvābhāvāt, bāhyatarkāṇāṃ kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvāt, avadhāraṇadvayasahitādvitīyaśrutijñānānandasvarūpatvavāṅmanasanivṛttijñeyatvaniṣedharūpārthaguṇaniṣedhānāṃ parihṛtatvācca nirupādhikāḥ brahmaguṇa ityuktavakṣyamāṇārtha saṅgrahaḥ pravṛtti(pratipatti?) saukaryāya daśirtaḥ |
satyaṃ jñānamiti jñānapadena sidhyan ārthaguṇaniṣadhaḥ pūrvaṃ parihṛtaḥ | athaitadanuvākopasaṃhāre ca, "yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā saha" iti vāṅmanasanivṛttyabhidhānānnirguṇatvaṃ phalitam | atastadaikārthyācca satyajñānādivākyasya nirviśeṣaparatvamiti śaṅkāyām, ārthaguṇaniṣedhaparatayā paroktasyāsya vākyasyoktārthānuguṇyamupapādayatibhīṣā'smādityādinā | bhīṣā'smādityanena ājñāpayitṛtvamucyate | kṣetrajñānandātiśayamukatveti | atra nirviśeṣatvaṃ pratiṣipādayiṣitaṃ cetguṇānāṃ krameṇa nyūnatāṃ pratipādya sarvābhāve paryavasiṃtaṃ yuktam | atra tu krameṇa guṇānāmādhikyamukatvā vāṅmanasanivṛttyabhidhānamānantyādevetyabhiprāyaḥ | yathā, "saṃkhyātuṃ naiva śakyante guṇā doṣāśca śāṅgaṇi | ānantyāt prathamo rāśirabhāvādeva paścimaḥ ||" iti | prathamaṃ manuṣyānanda mārabhya krameṇātiśayo daśirtaḥ |
sādhu yuvādhyāyakaḥ | sādhuyathāvidhi samyaksaṃpradāyasiddhatayā svaravarṇādibhraṃśarahitaṃ vā | yuvaśabdena pratyagratvaṃ vivakṣitam | avismaraṇānnityanavaṃ yathā bhavati, tathā adhyayanavānityarthaḥ | yadvā svasamavayaskānāṃ sarveṣāmadhyāpakaḥ | tadadhikajñāna ityarthaḥ | āśiṣṭhaḥāśutarakriya; | yadvā aśanakṣamaḥ; aroga ityarthaḥ | yadvā āśīrvādaviṣayamabhūtaḥ; sarvānurañjaka ityarthaḥ | "sarvān devān namasyanti" itivat | baliṣṭhaḥmanobalavān; draḍhiṣṭha iti śarīrabalasyoktatvāt | yadvā draḍhiṣṭhaḥdṛḍhataraḥ; na tvavyavasthitasvabhāva ityarthaḥ | baliṣṭhaḥśārīramānasasarvavidhabalavān | vittasya pūrṇāvikṣena pūrṇā | "pūraṇaguṇasuhitārthasadavyatavyasāmānādhikaraṇena" iti ṣaṣṭhayanujñā nāt | sa eko mānuṣa ānandaḥ | evaṃ guṇasamudāyaṃ vibhūtipauṣkalyaṃ cokatvā, "sa eko mānuṣa ānandaḥ" iti śrutyā svarasataḥ tasyaivānandatvamuktam | anukūlatvaṃ hyānandatvam | nivartyāniṣṭatveṣṭatveṣṭasādhanatvānapekṣamiṣṭatvamunakūlatvam | uktalakṣaṇayogāt guṇavibhūtyorānandatvamupapadyate | tadviṣayajñānasyāpyanukūlatvaṃ viṣayānukūlatvakṛtamityanvayavyatirekasiddham | evañca sati śrutisvārasyañca siddhayati | guṇavibhūtiprakarṣamukatvā, "sa ānanda" iti hyuktam; na tu tadviṣayajñānamiti | yuvatvādyanekaguṇān vibhūtimapyukatvā tatsamudāyamānandaśabdena nirdiśya tasyānandasya niratiśayatvapratipādanāt sarvaguṇānāṃ vibhūteścānavadhikātiśayatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ bhavati | anukūlajñānatvamevānandatvamiti guṇavibhūtiviṣayajñānasyānandatve'pi tasyānandasya niravadhikātiśayatvoktayā guṇavibhūtyorapyanavadhikātiśayatvamarthāduktaṃ bhavati; tadānantyasya guṇavibhūtyānantyanibandhanatvāditi | āramyetiupakramānuguṇamupasaṃhṛta(ti?) (saṃhāra)vākyaṃ neyamiti bhāvaḥ | trotriyasya vākāmahatasyeti vakyaiḥ muktānandasya bhagavadānanda sākyaṃ uktaṃ bhavati | baha daśāyāṃ niratiśayānandāsaṃbhavāt | śrotriyaḥbrahmaniṣṭhaḥ | akāmahataḥnivṛttāvidyatvāt samastasāṃsārikabhogānupahataḥ | "sa ekaḥ prajāpaterānandaḥ" ityantena kṣetrajñānandātiśaya uktaḥ | "sa eko brahmaṇa ānandaḥ" iti bhagavadānda ucyate | caturmukhānandaparatve bahmaśabdāsvārasyāt (bdasvārasyāhāniḥ); "paraṃ jaiminirmukhyatvāt", "syāccaikasya brahmaśabdavat" iti brahmaśabdasya tatraiva mukhyavṛttatvasya sūtritatvāt; bhāṣye prathamasūtrasthabrahmaśabdavyākhyānāvasare prapañcitatvācca | "brahmavidāpnoti", (anantaṃ bahma") "brahmaṇā viṣaścitā", "āndaṃ brahmaḥ", "asadvra hmeti veda cet", "asti brahmeti cedveda" iti prakaraṇasthabrahmaśabdānāṃ brahmaparatvāt prakaraṇavirodhaśca | ānandaṃ brahma ṇo vidvāniti pūrvatrottaratra ca ānandapratiyogiṣaṣṭhayantabrahmaśabdasvārasyavirodhaśca | "saiṣā''nandasya" iti prakrāntabrahmānandasya caturmukhānandenopasaṃhārānupapattiśca | "tadapyeṣa śloko bhavati" iti brahmānandaṃ prakṛtya vakṣyamāṇasya ślokasya uktaviṣayatvavirodhaśca | "sa ekaḥ prajāpateḥ" iti nirupapadaikavacanāntaprajāpatiśabdasvārasyābhaṅgaśca | na ca tat jātyekavacanam; bahutvaikatvavivakṣāyāṃ bahuvacanaikavacanarnirdeśaprakaraṇatvāt | manuṣya gandharvāṇāṃ devānānaṃ devagandharvāṇāṃ indrasya, bṛhaspateḥ, prajāpateriti hi nirdiśyate | ataḥ prajāpatiśabdaścaturmukhaparaḥ | "sa eko brahmaṇaḥ" tyatra brahmaśabdo bhagavatparaḥ || "te ye śatam" "sa eka" iti bhagavadānandasya kathaṃ paricchinnatvamiti cetna paricchinnatvam | ekakṣaṇārdhe bahūni yojanāni gacchatorevaḥ "kṣipteṣuriva sarpati" ityādiṣu sāmyakathanaṃ yathā gatimāndyanivṛttiparam, na tu paricchinnatvaparamtadvat "te ye śataṃsa ekaḥ" iti nirdeśo'pi caturmukhānandādhikyābhiprāyaḥ, na tu paricchedapara iti | yadvā te yeḥ śatamiti sa eka ityasya nirdeśasya saṃkhyāviśeṣaparatve'pyānandasyāparicchanna tvaṃ phalitam | "aṇḍānāṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇyayutāni ca | īdṛśānāṃ tathā tatra koṭikoṭhiśatāni ca ||", "romakūpeṣvanantāni brahmāṇḍāni bhramanti te" ityādivacanairaṇḍānāmanantatvena tatratatra caturmukhānāmapyānantyāt | kālatravartisamastabrahmāṇḍagatacaturmukhānandāpekṣayā śataguṇatvāt, "merorivāṇuryasyaitadbrahmāṇḍamakhilaṃ mune" ityuktatripādvibhūtimattayā ca bhagavadāndasyātyantamānantyasiddheriti | kalyāṇaguṇānantyamiti | na hi krameṇa guṇāpakarṣa uktaḥ; kintu guṇānāṃ prakarṣa evoktaḥ | ato guṇaprakarṣasya niratiśayatvādvāṅmanasanivṛviriti bhāvaḥ | atyādare ṇeti brahmasvarūpādapi tadguṇeṣvādarātiśaya uktaḥ | "ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān" iti hi śrutiḥ; na tvānandānvitaṃ brahma vidvānitīti bhāvaḥ | iyaṃ śrutiriti | nirguṇaparatvena tvayoktaitatprakaraṇasthā śrutirapyasmaduktārthānuguṇaiveti bhāvaḥ | evamārthaguṇaniṣedhanirāsadvārā prakaraṇagatavākyāntareṇa guṇānantyapareṇaikārthyāt satyajñānādivākyasya saviśeṣaviṣayatvamuktam | atha svavākyaikadeśenāpi saviśeṣaparatvamupapādayati so'śnuta ityādinā | phalamavagamayadvākyamiti | "brahmavidāpnoti param" iti brāhmaṇe brahma tadvedana prāptiḥ prāpyaṃ ceti catuṣṭayamuktam | etadvivaraṇaṃ satyajñānamityādimantreṇa kriyata iti śrutirevāha tadeṣāmyukteti | tadeva brahmābhimukhīkṛtya ṝgeṣā'dhyetṛbhiruktetyarthaḥ | mantrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇavivaraṇarūpatvadarśanāt upakramādhikaraṇaviṣayavākyayoriva āpātavirodhapratītyabhā vāt mantrabrāhmaṇayornityanirdoṣatvāviśeṣācca mantrāpekṣayā brāhmaṇaprābalyavādo'nupapannaḥ | sphuṭapratipattihetutvatadabhāvāveva prābalyadaurbalyaśabdavivakṣitau cetna virodhaḥ | "satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma" iti brahmaśabdo vivṛtaḥ, "yo veda nihitaṃ guhāyām" iti vicchabdaḥ, "parame vyoman so'śnute" iti prāptiḥ, "sarvān kāmān" ityādinā prāpyam; tatra paraśabdārthavivaraṇamataditi darśayituṃ parasya vipaścito brahmaṇa ityuktam | vipaścittvamapi bhogyaguṇatvenoktam | vākyasyārthaṃ vaktuṃ padānāmanvayaṃ daśaryati vipaściteti | kimatra guṇavācipadamiti śaṅkāyām, "yadā sarve pramucyante kāmāye'sya hṛdi sthitāḥ" iti tyājyatayoktakāmavyāvṛttyarthamavayavaśaktyā vyācaṣṭe kāmyanta iti | brahmavedanaphalatayā muktānubhāvyatvādiha tyājyakāmaparatvānupapatteḥ, kāmyatvasya brahmasvarūpe'pi saṃbhave satyapi vyatirekanirdeśāt bahuvacanāntatvāt avayavaśakteḥ taduktabhogyatvasya ca guṇeṣu saṃbhavāt "sa vā etena divyena cakṣuṣā manasaitān kāmān paśyan ramate ya ete brahmaloke", "ya ihātmānamanuvidya vrajantyetāṃśca satyān kāmān", "ta ime satyāḥ kāmāḥ" ityādiśrutyantaraikārthyācca kāmaśabdavācyāḥ kalyāṇaguṇā ityarthaḥ | kasyeme guṇāḥ? sahabhāvaśca bahmaṇaḥ, putreṇa sahaudanaṃ bhuṅkta" ityatra putrasyeva kiṃ bhoktṛtayā, uta kṣīreṇa sahaudanaṃ bhuṅkta ityatra kṣīrasyeva bhogyatayā? iti śaṃkāṃ ca pariharan vākyārthamāha brahmaṇeti | asya vākyasya prāpyavāciparaśabdavivaraṇarūpatvāt, sarvān kāmān saha brahmaṇeti bhogyavācipadenāvyavahitaprayogasvārasyācca sahaśabdo bhogyasāhityaparaḥ | sannihitaṃ brahmaiva ca guṇānāmāśrayaḥ | ato'nantaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ brahmānubhavatītyarthaḥ | "saha yukte'prādhāne" iti śabdānuśāsanavaśāt sahaśabdenāprādhānyaṃ brahmaṇa āśaṅkaya tatparihārāya sahaśabdaprayojanamāha dahareti | "yo veda" iti vihite vedane guṇānāṃ prādhānyasūcakaḥ sahaśabdaḥ | daharavidyāyāmupāsane hi guṇaprādhānyamuktam | tathā atrāpyupāsane guṇaprādhānyaṃ vaktuṃ sahaśabda ityarthaḥ | phaladaśāyāṃ guṇaprādhānyaśravaṇādupāsane guṇaprādhānyaṃ kathaṃ sidhyatītyatrāhaphalopāsanayoriti | phalopāsanayorubhayorapi saguṇatvaṃ guṇaprādhānyaṃ ca tulyaprakāramityarthaḥ | guṇaprādhānyaṃ vaktumityanenāpi sahaśabdasya bhogyasāhityaparatvaṃ siddham | anyathā bhoktṛprādhānyaṃ hi sidhyet, na tu bhogyaguṇaprādhānyamiti | śrutyaivetyevakāreṇa uktanyāyasya puruṣabudhyutprekṣānirapekṣaṃ śrutyā kaṇṭhoktatvamabhipretam ||
atha saguṇānāmeva jñeyatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti jñeyatvaniṣedhe nirguṇatvaṃ phalitamiti jñeyatvaniṣedhaparatvena paroktaṃ vākyamupādatte | yasyeti | kiṃ jñānamātrāviṣayatvam, uta upāsanātmakajñānāviṣayatvam, uta saguṇopāsanātmakajñānāviṣayatvaṃ vivakṣitamiti vikalpatrayamabhipretya, prathamaṃ jñānamātrāviṣayatvaṃ dūṣayati brahmaviditi | brahmaṇo vedyatve śruterādarātiśayaṃ darśayati asanneveti | na brahmaṇavedanamapavargopāyaḥ, api tu prapañcamithyātvajñānameva tadu pāya iti parairucyate | "vidyayā'mṛtamaśnute", "tathā vidvānnāmarūpādvimuktaḥ", "tato jñānaṃ pravartate", "jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi" ityādiṣvanirdiṣṭaviśeṣaviṣayeṣu vākyeṣvapavargopāyatayā śrūyamāṇasya jñānasya brahmaviṣayatvaprapañcamithyātvaviṣayatāsādhāraṇyāt tadāśaṅkayāha ata iti | ataḥkeṣucidvākyeṣvapavargopāyajñānasya brahmaviṣayatvadarśa nāt | sarvāḥ śrutayaḥanirdiṣṭaviṣayaviśeṣāḥ, "vidyayā'mṛtamaśnute" ityādikāḥ śrutayo'pi sarvaśākhāpratyaya nyāyena brahmaviṣayameva vedanamapavargopāyatayā vidadhatītyarthaḥ | yadvā keṣucidbrahmaviṣayatve śrute jñānamātropāyaparāḥ śrutayaśca sāmānyaviśeṣanyāyāt tatraiva paryavasyantītyabhiprāyaḥ | athopāsanātmakajñānāviṣayatvapakṣaṃ dūṣayati jñānaṃ ceti | "tadeva brahma tvaṃ viddhi nedaṃ yadidamupāsate" iti śrutirupāsanātmakajñānāviṣayatvaśaṅkābījam | vākyārthajñānasyopāyatvānupapattyupapādanāt parihṛtamityarthaḥ | "nedaṃ yadidamupāsata ityasyāyamarthaḥyadidaṃ pratīkamupāsate, tanna; tadeva paraṃ brahma tvamupāssveti | atha saguṇopāsanāviṣayatvapakṣaṃ pratikṣipati upāsyañceti | nirguṇaparatvena paroktāyāḥ sadvidyāyā eva saguṇaviṣayatvopapādanāditi bhāvaḥ | yadvā jñānaṃ copāsanātmakam" iti | jñānaviśeṣaviṣayatvakaṇṭhoktayā jñeyatvamātraniṣedho dūranirasta iti bhāvaḥ | upāsyaṃ ceti | jñeyatvanivṛttyā siṣādhayiṣitā guṇanivṛttirguṇavidhānabādhitā | tataścājñeyatvaṃ bādhitvā jñeyatvamākṣipatīti bhāvaḥ | tarhyavijñātatvāmatatvaśrutyoḥ ko'rtha ityatrāha yato vāca iti | anantaśabdena satyaṃ jñānamityādivākyaṃ smāritam | anantasyeti svarūpānantyamuktam | aparicchinnaguṇasyeti guṇānantyam | asminnarthe"na hi tasya guṇāḥ sarve sarvairmunigaṇairapi | vaktuṃ śakyā viyuktasya sattvādyairakhilairguṇaiḥ", "nāntaṃ guṇānāṃ gacchanti tenānanto'yamucyate", "tavānantaguṇasyāpi ṣaḍeva prathame guṇāḥ", "varṣāyutairyasya guṇā na śakyā vaktuṃ sametairapi sarvalokaiḥ | mahātmanaḥ śaṅkhacakrāsipāṇerviṣṇorjiṣṇorvasudevātmajasya", "caturmukhāyuyadi koṭivaktro bhavennaraḥ kkāpi viśuddhacetāḥ | sa te guṇānāmayutaikadeśaṃ vadenna vā devavara prasīda", "yathā ratnāni jaladherasaṃkhyeyāni putraka | tathā guṇā hyanantasya asaṃkhyeyā mahātmanaḥ iṣukṣayānnivirtante nāntarikṣakṣitipāt | matikṣayānnivarttante na govindaguṇakṣayāt" ityādi draṣṭavyam | paricchinnatvajñāne kathaṃ dharmiṇo brahmaṇo'jñātatvamityatrāha aparicchinnatvāt brahmaṇa iti | brahmaśabdavācyasya svarūpato guṇataścāparicchinnatvādityarthaḥ | na kevalaṃ śrutyantarāvirodhārthamevamartha uktaḥ, itarathā svavākyavyāhatiprasaṅgāccetyāha anyatheti | tatraivasvavākya eva |
jñeyatvaniṣedhe parihṛte jñātṛtvaniṣedhaṃ pariharati yattvityādinā | dṛṣṭermateriti pañcamyantatvābhiprāyeṇa vyatiriktapadādhyāhāreṇa kiṃ yojanā, uta ṣaṣṭhayantatayā vyatiriktapadānadhyāhāreṇa yojanā tvayā kriyate iti vikalpamabhipretya prathamamadhyāhārapakṣamanuvadati na dṛṣṭeriti | pariharati taditi | prasaktasya hi pratiṣedha iti śaṅkāyāṃ prasaṅgaṃ darśayati kutarkasiddhāmiti | kutarkaḥ kathamupanyastaḥ ityapekṣāyāṃ svarūpajaḍatve paroktaṃ hedudvayaṃ saṅgraheṇopapādayati āgantukacaitanyaguṇayogitayeti | āgantukatvādguṇatvācceti hetudvayam | āgantukatvātanityatvāt jñānaṃ nityasyātmano na svarūpaṃ bhavitumarhati; guṇatvācca na svarūpamiti | yadvā caitanyaṃ nāma viṣayaprakāśa tannityaṃ sva rūpaṃ cet, sarvadā viṣayaprakāśaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | dṛṣṭiśrutimatinididhyāsanānāṃ jñānaviśeṣāṇāṃ karturātmanaḥ svarūpasya dṛṣṭayādirūpatve vidhīyamāne ātmanaḥ svarūpasya na jñānāvāntarabhedaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ | teṣāṃ jñānaviśeṣarūpāṇāṃ svayaṃprakāśatvalakṣaṇaṃ jñānatvamaviśiṣṭamiti tāvanmātrameva svarūpasya vivakṣitaṃ bhavati | ayaṃ parihāraḥ parapakṣe'pi samānaḥ | sākṣādyojanāmāha athaveti | dṛṣṭiśrutimatinididhyāsanānāṃ kartāraṃ jīvātmānaṃ pratiṣidhya paramātmānamupāssvetyayamartha ukta ityarthaḥ | yadvā abhidadhātī (tītī?)tyanuṣaṅgaḥ | jīvātmānaṃ pratiṣidhya paramātmānamupāssvetyabhidadhāti śrutiḥ | iti vākyārtha iti vākyāntaram | yadvā pratiṣidhyaparityajyetyarthaḥ | ataḥ samānakartṛkatvopapattiḥ | "yaḥ prāṇena prāṇiti yo'pānenāpāniti eṣa ta ātmā sarvāntaraḥ" iti prastutatvāt prāṇena prāṇitṛtvādi jīvātmanaḥ saṃbhavatīti tadupāsyatvaśaṅkāvyāvṛttyatharm, na dṛṣṭerdraṣṭāraṃ paśyerityādyucyata iti ayamevārthaḥ | anyathā śrutyantaravirodhamāha anyatheti | guṇatvamasiddham, jñānasya svarūpatvena śrutipratipannatvāt | mānaṃ cet, āgantukamiti na vācyam; īśvarajñāne vyabhicārāt | asmadādijñānasyāpyāgantukatvaṃ kālātyayāpadiṣṭam, "na vijñāturvijñāterviparilopo vidyate" iti śruteḥiti hetudvayaparihāraḥ | viṣayapravaṇatvaṃ dharmabhūtamānasyaiva; sarvasādhāraṇaṃ jñānatvaṃ svaprakāśatvam | ato na sarvadā viṣayaprakāśaprasaṅgaśca ||
jñeyatvaniṣedhaparihārānantaraṃ buddhisthatvāt jñātṛtvaniṣedhaḥ parihṛtaḥ | atha ārthaguṇaniṣedhāntaraṃ parihriyate ānanda ityādinā | pūrvoktaṃ parihāramatratidiśati tat jñānāśrayasyeti | kathaṃ tenedaṃ parihṛtamityatrāha jñānameva hīti | tarhi śrutiṣu vijñānānandaśabdayoḥ samabhivyāhāro nopapadyata ityatrāha vijñānamiti | svayaṃprakāśatvānukūlatvarūpapravṛttinimittabhedādupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ | tathaiva bhavadbhirabhyupagatamityāha ata eveti | ata evajñānānandaśabdayorekaviṣayatvādevetyarthaḥ | ānandasya ānandāśrayatvānamyupagamaḥ kiṃ śrutyā, uta vyāptyā? vyāptyā cet, kasyaciddharmaḥ syāt | śrutibalāt svatantratvamiti cettata evānandāśrayatvamabhyupagamyatām | dharmabhūtāna ndasya hi ānandāśrayatvābhāvo dṛṣṭaḥ | ato vyāptivirodhaśca nāsti | ataḥ svatantratvavat guṇāśrayatvamapi śrutisiddhatvāt svīkāryamiti bhāvaḥ | ubhayatra pramāṇe sati hi nyāyasañcāra ityāśaṅkāyāṃ dṛṣṭāntabhūmau pramāṇasya darśitatvamāha asyeti | dārṣṭāntike'pi kaṇṭhokiṃta darśayati tadvaditi | jñātṛtvavat ānanditvamapi kaṇṭhoktamityarthaḥ | jñātṛtvaśrutirapyānanditve pramāṇamityabhipretyāha jñātṛtvameva hyānanditvamiti | jñātṛtvātiriktānanditvavyudāsa para evakāraḥ | hiśabdastadupapattisūcakaḥ | anukūlajñānāśrayatvameva hyānanditvamityarthaḥ | jñātṛtvaśrutirjñānāśrayatvaniṣedhasya ānandāśrayatvaniṣedhasya ca virodhinīti bhāvaḥ |atha bhedaniṣedhaparatvena paroktāḥ śrutīryojayitumanuvadati yadidimiti | yatra hītyādivākyābhyāṃ bhedaniṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ | bhedapratipāvanarthaṃ darśayatimṛtyoriti | "tamaso vā eṣa tamaḥ praviśati" itivat | nityānuvṛttasya bhedasya kathaṃ bhrāntisiddhatvamityatrāhayatra tviti | uktavākyeṣu vacanabhaṅgīvaividhyābhiprāyeṇa bahudheyuktam | bahuśa iti pāṭhe niṣedhakriyā''vṛttirarthaḥ | pariharati taditi | tacchabdasya parihṛtamityatrānvayaḥ | samastaheyapratyanīkatvena samastakalyāṇaguṇātmakatvena ca śrutyantaraprasiddhasya brahmaṇo vikārāspadekleśakarmādiheyaparavaśajagadaikyaṃ vyāhatatvācchatirna pratipādayati || na vyāhatiḥ; heyānāmapāramārthikatvāditi cetapāramārthikatvepi etānnirasanīyaṃ navā nacet tannivṛtyarthaṃ śāstraṃ anarthakaṃ syāt | nirasanīyaṃ cet nirasanīyasaṃbandha eva heyasaṃbandha iti tatpratyanīkasya tatsambandhitvaṃ vyāhatam | kiñca, bahu syāmiti saṅkalpapūrvakaṃ bahubhavanaṃ śrūyate | sarvajñasya svecchayā svasmin heyopāda(yopādā)namananvitamiti tatpratipādanamaśakyam |
asarvajñatve, "paśyatyacakṣuḥ sṛṇotyakarṇaḥ", "svābhāvikī jñānabalakriyā ca", "yaḥ sarvajñaḥ" ityādiśrutivirodhaḥ | heyasyāpāramārthye'pi svasaṅkalpena svasyānantāpuruṣārthabhramāpādanaṃ sarvajñasya nopapadyate | sārvajñyasyāvidyāparikalpitatvābhyupagamāt avidyāpūvarkameva bahubhavanabhramarūpaṃ sārvajñyamiti na vācyam; svābhāvikīti śruteḥ; "ta ime satyāḥ kāmāḥ" iti satyatvaśruteśca | svasārvajñyamāvidyikatvena mithyeti na jānātīti cetsārvajñyaṃ na syāt | jānātīti cettenaiva jñānena bādhitatvāt sārvajñyaṃ na syāt | tataśca pūrvajagadākāraparyālocanena svasaṅkalpapūrvakaṃ jīvakarmānuguṇasṛṣṭirnopapadyate | ataḥ sārvajñyasyāvidyikatvamanupapannamiti sarvajñasya tasya svagataheyopādanaṃ (yepādānaṃ) na ghaṭate | kiñca heyaṃ svagatatvena jānataḥ sarvaśaktestasya satyasaṅkalpasya sahasaiva svagataheyānirāsakatvamapi nopapadyate | aśaktatve, "parā'sya śaktirvirvidhaiva śrūyate svābhāvikī" ityādiśrutivirodhaḥ || īdṛśavirodho nāsti; śrutibalādaviruddhatvasyābhyupagantavyatvāditi cettarhi vijñānaghana evaitebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tānyevānuvinaśyati", "na jāyate mriyate vā vipaścit", "vāyuścāntarikṣaṃ caitadamṛtam", "ātmanaḥ ākāśaḥ sambhūtaḥ", "na namo na bhūtirneme dyāvāpṛthivī", "antavadevāsya tadbhavati", "nāsyeṣṭāpūrte kṣīyete" ityādiśrutyuktasyātmādīnāṃ nityatvānityatvāderapi śrutipratipannatayā virodhābhāvādubhayamapyupagantavyam | tataśca sarvatra yathāpratipannasvīkāre hi mīmāṃsārambhavaiyarthyaṃ syāt | prastutabhedābhedaśrutyorapi pāramārthikāpāramārthikaviṣayatvena sopādhikanirupādhikaviṣayatvena vā vibhāgakalpanamanupapannam; tasya virodhaparihārārthatvāt; virodhasya cābhāvāt | tataśca bhedapāramārthyasiddhaḥ | ato virodho'bhyupagantavyaḥ | iha ca virodho'vagamyate, "mṛtyossa mṛtyumāpnoti ya iha nāneva paśyati" iti bhedapratipatteḥ saṃsārahetutvaṃ śrūyate | "pṛthagātmānaṃ preritāraṃ ca matvā juṣṭastatastenāmṛtatvameti", "juṣṭaṃ yadā paśyatyanyamīśamasya mahimānamiti vītaśokaḥ" iti bhedajñānasya mokṣopāyatvaṃ śrūyate | "dvaitino'tathyadarśinaḥ" ityādismṛtiviruddham, "dvāvimau puruṣau", "āviśya vibhartyavyaya īśvaraḥ...yasmāt kṣaramatīto'hamakṣarādapi cottamaḥ" ityārabhya, "yo māmevamasaṃmūḍho jānāti puruṣottam" iti bhedajñānavato'saṃmūḍhatvaṃ smarthate | evamādivacanapratipannasya bhedasya lokasiddhatvābhāvāt, niṣedhārthaṃ bhedo'nūdyata iti vādo'nupapannaḥ | kiñca yadi bhedamātrasya lokasiddhatvāt, aprāpte hi śāstramarthavaditi nyāyāt, abheda eva śāstravedya ityucyatetarhi so'yaṃ devadatta ityādāvabhedamātrasya ca lokasiddhatvāt aprāpte śāstrasyārthavattvācca śāstreṇābhedapratipādanamayuktam || devadattādyaikyaṃ hi lokasiddham, na jīvaparayoḥ | atastayorabhedaḥ śāstrapratipādya iti cettarhi ghaṭapaṭādibheda eva lokasiddhaḥ, na tu jīvaparayoḥ | niyāmyatvaniyantṛtvadhāryatvadhārakatvaśeṣatvaśeṣitvavyāpyatvavyāpakatvādilakṣaṇabhedo na lokasiddha iti na bhedaḥ śāstrapratipādyaeva | yathoktamācāryapādaiḥ "na dvaitaṃ pratipādayantyupaniṣadvācaḥ prasiddhaṃ hi tat kintvadvaitamananyagocaratayā tadvedyamāsthīyatām |
aprāpte khalu śāstramarthavaditi vyarthaḥ prayāso yataḥ prakhyātādaparastu śāstraviṣayo bhedastvadadvaitavat" ||
iti | ayañcārtho'nantarameva bhāṣye vakṣyate | ataḥ, anuvāda iti nirvāho nopapadyate ||
bhedaśrutirupāsanārthā, na tu tattvaparā, "pṛthagātmānaṃ preritāraṃ ca matvā", "juṣṭaṃ yadā paśyatyanyamīśam" ityupāsanavācipadaśravaṇāditi cettathāpi tāttvika eva bhedaḥ; tajjñānasya mokṣopāyatvokteḥ | tattvajñānena hi mokṣaḥ | na ca phalaviśeṣāyopāsanārthatvāt bhedaśrutīnāṃ bhedasyātāttvikatvaṃ vācyam; ekyasya copāsanārthatvādasatyatvaprasaṅgāt | śrūyate hyabhedasyopāsanārthatvam"atha yo'nyāṃ devatāmupāste anyo'sāvanyo'hamasmīti na sa veda", "ātmetyevopāsīta" iti | aikyasyopāsanārthatvaṃ bhedasya ca tāttvikatvaṃ yuktam | vainateyadhyānena hyaikyamāropitaṃ dṛṣṭam; bheda eva hi narendravainateyayostātvikaḥ || vidhiśeṣabhūtavyatirikteṣvapi vākyeṣvabhedaḥ pratīyata iti tasya tāttvikatvamiti cettarhi "kṣaraṃ pradhānamamṛtākṣaraṃ haraḥ", "pradhānakṣetrajñapatirguṇeśaḥ", "jñājñau dvau", "ṛtaṃ pibantau", "dvā suparṇā", "nityo nityānām" ityādi avidhiśeṣabhūtavākyāvagatatvādbhedasyāpi tāttvikatvamavarjanīyam | upāstiphalabhūtamuktidaśāyāmabhedāt abhedapāramārthyaṃ cetmuktidaśāyāṃ bhedaśravaṇādbhedatāttvikatvasiddhiḥ | ata upāsanārthatvādaparamārthaviṣayatvena bhedaśrutinirvāho nopapadyate | bhedābhedayorniyatapaurvāparyavirodhavattvādapacchedanyāyaviṣayatvaṃ saguṇatvanirguṇatvayoriva na saṃbhavatīti virodhanayādupakramanayādvā parabhūtabhedaniṣedhotpattipratibandha eva syāt | idaṃ ca pūrvameva prapañcitam |
evaṃ nyāyānugṛhītaśrutyantaravirodhasyāvarjanīyatvam, eṣāṃ nirvāhāṇāmanupapannatvaṃ ca pradeśāntaroktamihābhipretya, samīcīnanirvāhaṃ darśayati taditi | jagata iti padaṃ brahmapayarntam | tasya brahmakāryatayeti padena aikyāditi padena cānvayaḥ | tadantaryāmikatayetyatra sāmarthyājjagata ityadhyāhāraḥ; tena sakṛtprayuktasya ca (?) jagacchabdasya niṣkarṣakatvāniṣkaṣarkatvavirodhaparihāraḥ | "sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma tajjalān" ityuktaṃ jagatastajjatvaṃ tallatvaṃ copajī vyāha brahmakāryatayeti | brahmaśabdaḥ kāraṇāvasthacidaciddhiśiṣṭaparaḥ | tadanatvamupajīvyāhatadantaryāmikatayeti | tacchabdo viśeṣyaparāmarśī; viśiṣṭe prakṛte viśeṣyāṃśasyāpi prakṛtatvāt | yathā "sanmūlāḥ, sadāyatanāḥ" ityatra sacchabdasya viśiṣṭaparatvaṃ viśeṣyaparatvañca, tadvat | tat brahma antaryāmi yasya, tat tadantaryāmikam; tadbhāvenetyarthaḥ |
kathaṃ tadanatvena tadantaryāmikatvasiddhiḥ? ucyate | ananaṃ sthitiḥ brahmaṇo jagatsthitihetutvañca antaḥ praviśya praśāsanena dhārakatvam "sanmūlāssomyemāssarvāḥ prajāssadāyatanāssatpratiṣṭhāḥ" ityatra sanmūlāḥ satpratiṣṭhāḥ iti padadvayaṃ sacchabdavācyabrahmādhīnotpattilayaparam | pratiṣṭhāniṣṭhāparyavasānamlayaḥ; na tu sadādhāratvam; sadāyatanā iti punaruktiprasaṅgāt; evaṃ brahmaṇa utpattilayahetutvavācipadadvayamadhyagatena sthitihetutvavācinā sadāyatanā iti padena dhāyakatvasiddheḥ, "etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane gārgi! dyāvāpṛthivyau vidhṛte tiṣṭhataḥ" ityatra tiṣṭhatidhātūktasthiteḥ praśāsanena dhāraṇādhīnatvāvagamāt, "antaḥpraviṣṭaḥ śāstā janānām" iti dhāraṇahetubhūtapraśāsanasyāntaḥpraviśyakriyamāṇatvaśravaṇāt, "tadyathā areṣu nemirarpitā nābhāvarā arpitāḥ, evamevaitā bhūtamātrāḥ prajñāmātrāsvarpitāḥ prajñāmātrāḥ prāṇe arpitāḥ", "mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva" iti śrutismṛtibhyām aranābhimaṇigaṇasūtradṛṣṭāntābhyāmantaḥsthisya dhārakatvāvagamāt, "tat sṛṣṭvā tadevānuprāviśat" ityuktānupraveśasya sṛṣṭayanantarabhāvitvādudāhṛtaśrutyaikārthyācca sthityarthatvāt, "tat sṛṣṭvā tadevānuprāviśat" ityuktānupraveśasya sṛṣṭayanantarabhāvitvādudāhṛtaśrutyaikārthyācca sthityarthatvāt, "sapta prāṇāḥ prabhavanti" ityādivākyoktaprakriyayā sṛṣṭasya ca jagataḥ "tenedaṃ pūrṇaṃ puruṣeṇa sarvam" iti vākyena sthitivelāyāṃ vyāpakena paramapuruṣeṇa pūrṇatvāvagamāt, sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyena vyāpananiyamanadhāraṇeṣvanyatamoktāvanyatamasya siddhatvācca anupraviśya praśāsanena dhārakatvaṃ sthitihetutva miti hyavagamyate | evaṃ tajjalāniti vākyamupajīvyoktaṃ jagato brahmakāryatayā tadntaryāmikatayā ceti tadantaryāmikatvamubhayaliṅgasya brahmaṇaḥ paramātharjagadupādānatvānyathānupapattisiddham, ghaṭakaśrutisiddhañca |
caśabdasyottaratrānvayaḥ, tadantaryāmikatayā tadātmakatvena ceti | sa ātmā yasya tat tadātmakam; tadantaryāmikatvarūpeṇa tadātmakatvenetyarthaḥ | antaḥpraviśya niyantā hyātmā | brahmakāyartayā tadantaryāmikatayā tadātmakatvena cetyukte hetutrayaśaṅkā syāditi tadvayudāsārthaḥ caśabdasya prākprayogaḥ | evamubhayavidhaikyasya vihitatvādityarthaḥ |
nanu aikyasya kāryakāraṇabhāvanibandhanatve kāryāvasthajagādviśiṣṭasya kāraṇāvasthacidacidviśiṣṭabrahmaṇā svarūpaikyaṃ yuktam | tadantaryāmikatvanibandhanatve tu na brahmaṇā aikyam, kintu prakāriṇo brahmaṇa ekatvasaṃkhyānvaya eveti aikyaśabdasyārthabhedaḥ syāt | tataśca jagatastadātmakatvenaikyāditi vaktumayuktam, prakāraprakāriṇorbhinna tvāt || naivam; jagadvrahmaṇobhirnnatve'pyatra jagacchabdo jagadviśiṣṭabrahmapara ityuktatvāt | aikyaśabdasya ca nārthabhedaḥ; ubhayathā'pi viśiṣṭaikyaparatvāt | tathāhikāryakāraṇabhāvanibandhanamaikyaṃ nāma avasthādvayāpannacidacidviśiṣṭavastvekatvam; yathā rūpasparśādiviśiṣṭaghaṭasya tādṛśamṛddṛvyeṇaikyam | cidacidātmakajagadviśiṣṭasya svarūpeṇa guṇaiśca niratiśayabṛhattvaviśiṣṭasya caikyaṃ prakāryaikyam; yathā nailyaviśiṣṭasya utpalatvaviśiṣṭasya caikyam | na ca viśeṣaṇāṃśaikyābhāvādvastvaikyahāniḥ; mṛdghaṭādāvapi svarūpasya rūpasparśādīnāṃ kāryatvakāraṇatvāvasthayoścaikatvābhāvāt | iyān viśeṣaḥkāryakāraṇabhāve bhinnakālīnāvasthārūpasadvārakaviśeṣaṇāśrayadharmyaikyam, yathā sa evāyaṃ taruṇo'bhūditi | anyatra samakālasaṃbandhyadvārakānekaviśeṣaṇāśrayadharmyaikyam, yathā'yaṃ vedavidvrāhmaṇa iti | bālyayauvane bhinnakālīnasadvārakāvasthe | vedanaṃ brāhmaṇaśarīraṃ ca samakālavartyadvārakaviśeṣaṇam | evamubhayavidhaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭadharmyaikatvamaikyaśabdārthaḥ | ato jagacchabdavācyadharmyaikyāt jagata aikyāditi nirdeśa upapannaḥ |
yadvā kṛtsnasya jagata iti niṣkarṣakaḥ śabdaḥ; brahmaśabdo'pi viśeṣyamātraparaḥ; kāryāvasthāṃ prati ādhāratvāt | ādhāratvaṃ ca sākṣādvā paramparayā vā mukhyameva | ato brahmakāryaṃ jagat | tadantaryāmikaśabdo vyākhyātaḥ | evaṃ brahmakāryatayā tadantaryāmikatayā ca jagataḥ tadātmakam | tadātmakatvaṃ nāma jagatastatprakārataikasvabhāvatayā pṛthagavasthānābhāvāt tadantargatatvam | tena prakāreṇaikyam; na tu svarūpaikyam | viśiṣṭāntarbhāvaevaikyamityarthaḥ | tatpratyanīkanānātvamini | vihitobhayavidhaikyapratyanīkanānātvaṃ niṣidhyata ityarthaḥ | kāryakāraṇabhedaḥ kutarkamūlabhrāntiviṣayaḥ svaniṣṭhabhedo laukikapratītimūlabhrāntiviṣayaḥ | ato bhrantimūlatvāviśeṣāt vihitaikyapratyanīkatvāviśeṣācca tenākāreṇobhayavidhaṃ bhedaṃ nānāśabdena parāmṛśya niṣidhyata iti na vākyabhedaḥ | tatpratyanīketi | aikyavidhiśeṣabhūto bhedaniṣedhaḥ; anvayamukhenoktārthasthirīkaraṇārthatvādvayatirekokteḥ | aikyavidhiśca, "neha nānāstī"ti prakaraṇe śrūyate, ekadhaivānudraṣṭavyamiti | ekadhāekatayā paramātmaśarīratayaikaprakāreṇetyarthaḥ | tathā "ahamekaḥ prathamamāsaṃ vartāmi ca bhaviṣyāmi ca | nānyaḥ kaścinmatto vyatiriktaḥ", "ātmā vā idameka evāgra āsīt | nānyatkiñcana miṣat", tathā "paramārthastvamevaiko nānyo'sti jagataḥ pate", "ahaṃ hariḥ sarvamidaṃ janārdano nānya ttataḥ kāraṇakāryajātam", "tadacyuto nāsti paraṃ tato'nyat" ityādiṣu caikyavidhiśeṣatayā bhedaniṣedho dṛśyate | śeṣatvaṃ ca vihitaikatvasthirīkaraṇalakṣaṇakiñcitkāreṇa bhavati | yādṛśamaikyaṃ vihitam, niṣedhasya tādṛśaikyavirodhibhedaviṣayatve sati tatsthirīkaraṇārthatvaṃ siddhayet | na tvavirodhyarthāntaraniṣedhastadupayuktaḥ | na hi mṛdeva ghaṭa ityukte ghaṭadvitvaniṣedho mṛdghaṭaikatvopakārakaḥ, ghaṭadvitvasya mṛhyaṭaikatvārirodhitvāt | nāpyeko ghaṭa satyukte ghaṭamata rūpapariṇāmādi niṣedho ghaṭāravya dhamaikyavidheḥ upakārakaḥ rūpaparimāṇādibhedasya ghaṭavyaktayaikyāvirodhitvāt | vidheyavirodhyarthaniṣedha eva hi vidhyupakārakaḥ | kiñca na kevalamupakārābhāvaḥ; aikyavidhiviruddhaṃ ca kṛtsnabhedaniṣedhaparatvam; samānādhikaraṇavākyenaikyavidhānāt | bhinnaviśeṣaṇābhidhāyiśabdānāmekaviśeṣyavṛttitvaṃ hi sāmānādhikaraṇyam | na ca prakārabhede tiṣṭhati kṛtsnabhedaniṣedha upapadyate | ato bhedaniṣedhasyaikyavidhiśeṣatvāt kāryakāraṇabhedaḥ svaniṣṭhabhedaśca niṣidhyata ityabhiprāyaḥ | kiñca, "na cāsya kaścijjanitā na cādhipaḥ", "na tatsamaścābhyadhikaśca dṛśyate", "tenārhati brahmaṇā sparddhituṃ kaḥ", "na tvatsamo'styabhyadhikaḥ kuto'nyo lokatraye'pyapratimaprabhāva" ityādibhiḥ svatantrarūpavastuviśeṣaviṣayaniṣedhadarśanāt sāmānyenāvagato bhedaniṣedhaḥ tatra chāgapaśunyāyena paryavasyatītyartha siddham | tatpratyanīkanānātvamityuktatvāt; keṣucidvākyeṣu tasya kaṇṭhoktatvācca |
atha utsargāpavādanyāyamabhiprayannāha na punariti | brahmaṇaḥ kāyarrūpeṇa nānātvaviṣayaśrutivākyodāharaṇaṃ prakāranānātvaviṣayavākyānāmapi pradarśanārtham | "ekaḥ san bahudhā vicacāra", "eko devo bahudhā niviṣṭaḥ" "tvameko'si bahūnanupraviṣṭaḥ", "yo'vyaktamantare sañcaran yasya mṛtyuḥ śarīram eṣa sarvabhūtāntarātmā apahatapāpmā divyo deva eko nārāyaṇaḥ" iti prakāranānātvaṃ prakāryekatvaṃ ca hi spaṣṭaṃ śrūyate | yadvāchāndogye taittirīye ca bahu syāmiti prakaraṇe, "anena jīvenātmanā'nupraviśya", "tadanupraviśya sacca tyaccābhavat niruktañcāniruktaṃ ca nilayanaṃ cānila yanaṃ ca vijñānaṃ cāvijñānañca" iti cidacidanupraveśapūrvakanāmarūpabhākatvaśravaṇāt ubhayaliṅgasyā(pya)vyavadhānena jagadupādānatvānupapatteśca | bahu syāmityatrāpi brahmaṇo bahunāmarūpabhākatvasya sadvārakatvasiddheḥ śarīratayā prakārabhūtacidacinnānātvamarthasiddhamityabhiprāyeṇa bahusyāmiti vākyamudāhṛtam | evaṃ kāryanānātvasya prakāranānātvasya ca vihitatvāt, sāmānyaniṣedhasya ca vihitavyatiriktaviṣayatvācca kutarkasiddhakāryakāraṇabhedaviṣayāḥ laukikapratītisiddhasvaniṣṭhabhedaviṣayāśca bhedaniṣedhaśrutaya ityarthaḥ |
nānātvaniṣedhādaparamārthaviṣayatvaṃ śaṅkate nānātveti |iyamśrutiḥ niṣedhārthamanūdyata iti bhāvaḥ | pariharati neti | aprāptasyānuvādāyogāt |ato viṣayavibhāgādavirodha eva nyāyyaḥ etaduktamācāryapādaiḥ, "yad brahmaṇo guṇaśarīravikārabhedakarmādigocaravidhipratiṣedhavācaḥ |
anyonyabhinnaviṣayā na virodhagamdhamarhanti tanna vidhayaḥ pratiṣedhabādhyāḥ ||" iti |
samastaheyarahitasya heyākarastvaikyāsaṃbhavāt, heyasyāpāramārthye'pi tasya nirasanīyatayā heyatvasyāvarjjanīyatvāt, tatpratibhaṭatayoktasya tatsaṃbandhārhavastvaikyavyāghātāt, sarvajñasya brahmaṇaḥ svasaṅkalpena svagataheyatadviṣayabhramāpādanāyogāt, asarvajñatve rsāvajñyaśrutivirodhāt, sarvaśakteḥ svagataheyānivārakatvāyogāt, aśaktatve sarvaśaktiśrutivirodhāt, śrutibalādīdṛśavirodhābhāve "tānyevānuvinaśyati" "na jāyate mriyate vā" ityādivākyapratipannanityatvānityatvanirguṇatvasaguṇatvādeḥ śrutibalādvirodhābhāvena kkacidapi nyāyasañcārānapekṣatayā mīmāṃsānairarthakyāt, bhinnatvābhinnatvayośca virodhābhāvena pāramārthikāpāramārthikatvena vibhāgasyānabhyupagantavyatvāt, "pṛthagātmānaṃ preritāraṃ ca matvā juṣṭastatastenāmṛtatvameti", "juṣṭaṃ yadā paśyatyanyamīśam" iti pṛthakyatvajñānasya mokṣopāyatvaśravaṇāt, "yasmāt kṣaramatīto'ham" ityādinā bhedajñānavato'sammūḍhatvasmaraṇāt, jīvaparayorniyantṛtvaniyāmyatvādilakṣaṇabhedasya ghaṭapaṭabhedavat pramāṇāntarāgocaratvenānuvādāsambhavādvihitasya niṣedhāyogāt upāsanārthatvāśrayaṇasya "atha yo'nyāṃ devatām" ityādivākyapratipannaikye'pi prasaṅgāt, aikyasyāvidhiśeṣavākyapratipannatve bhedasya ca tulyatvāt, niyatapaurvāparyavirodhatayā apacchedanyāyāviṣayatvāt, virodhādhikaraṇanyā yena bhedaśruteḥ parabhūtaniṣedhotpattipratibandhakatvāt, aikyavidhiśeṣasya bhedaniṣedhasya vihitaikyavirodhibhedaniṣedhakatvopapatteḥ, anyathā sāmānādhikaraṇavākyapratipannasvaśeṣibhūtaikyavirodhitvaprasaṅgāt, utsargāpavādanyāyena niṣe dhasya vihitabhedavyartiriktaviṣayatvāt, chāgapaśunyāyena bhedaniṣedhasya sāmānyena svatantrabhedaviśeṣaniṣedhaparyavasāyitvācca bhedaniṣedhaśrutayo'brahmātmakanānātvaniṣedhaparāḥ; na tu bhedamātraniṣedhaparā iti saṅgrahaḥ |
yatrahītyādivākyānāmayamarthaḥyatra yadvā dvaitamiva bhavatisvaniṣṭhabheda iva bhavati | ivaśabdaḥ svaniṣṭhabhedasyātāttvikatvadyotakaḥ | kathamivetivat vākyabhaṅgirityavivakṣitārtho vā | tattadā | itara itaramitareṇa paśyati | keneti vakṣyamāṇatvāditareṇetyadhyāhāraḥ | itaraḥsvaniṣṭho draṣṭā | itaramsvaniṣṭhaṃ draṣṭavyam | svaniṣṭhadarśanasādhanena paśyati | yatra tuyadā | asyaupāsakasya | sarvamātmaivābhūtaparamātmasāmānādhikaraṇyena sarvaṃ sākṣātkṛtam | na hi pūrvamanātmabhūtamidānīṃ sarvamātmā bhavati | ataḥ sākṣātkārābhiprāyaḥ abhūditi nirdeśaḥ, asyetyukteḥ | tattadā | ka ityadhyāhāraḥ; itara ityuktatvāt | tattadāsvaniṣṭhaḥ ko draṣṭā svaniṣṭhena kena darśanasādhanena svaniṣṭhaṃ kaṃ draṣṭavyamarthaṃ paśyet | jñātṛjñeyajñānasādhaneṣu svaniṣṭhaṃ kiñcidapi nāstītyarthaḥ | pramitaniṣedhāyogādāpātapratītisiddhasyaiva niṣedhyatvāllaukikapratīteśca svaniṣṭhatāviṣayatvāt tena rūpeṇaiva niṣedhaviṣayatvopa patteḥ | yadi draṣṭṛdṛśyādimātraṃ niṣidhyate, tadānīṃ "taddhaitat paśyan ṝṣirvāmadevaḥ pratipede ahaṃ manurabhavaṃ sūyaśca" iti paramātmasākṣātkāradaśāyām ahamiti draṣṭurātmano manusūryādidṛśyapadārthānāṃ ca sākṣātkāraśravaṇaṃ virudhyate | tasmāt laukikapratītau draṣṭṛdṛśyādikaṃ prakāribhūtaparamātmāpratipattestatsāmānādhikaraṇyamantareṇa svaniṣṭhatayā bhāti | yogadaśāyāṃ tu prakāriṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ pratīyamānatvādahaṃśabdavācyaparamātmasāmānādhikaraṇyena prakāśata iti vaiṣa myam | na tu draṣṭṛdṛśyādīni pratiṣidhyanta ityakyupagantavyam; anyathā vāmadevādidaśarnasya bhrāntitvaprasaṅgāt |
neha nāneti | ihaprapañce | lokadṛṣṭaprakāreṇa nānābhūtaṃ svaniṣṭhatayā bhinnaṃ kiñcidapi nāstītyarthaḥ | svaniṣṭhadarśanena pratyavāyamāha mṛtyoriti | "tamaso vā eṣa tamaḥ praviśati" itivannirdeśaḥ | nānevasvaniṣṭhamiva | ajñānādajñānamāpnotītyarthaḥ | dehātiraktiviṣayājñānaṃ prāgeva siddham tato'pyatiśayitamajñānaṃ svaniṣṭhatayā tadvastudarśanamityabhiprāyaḥ |
yadā hyevaiṣa ityādiśrutimupādāya tatra brahmaṇītyādinā pūrvapakṣiṇoktamarthamanūdya dūṣayati tadasaditi | tadasatbhayaprāptihetutvaṃ netyarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha sarvamiti | brahmaṇaḥ kāyarjagadrūpeṇa nānātvānusandhānaṃ muktiheturiti siddhāntārthaḥ | idānīṃ paroktaṃ śāntihetutvamabhyupagamyoktam | kathaṃ tatra nānātvānusandhānapratītiḥ, kathaṃ vā tasya bhayaprāptihetutāvirodhitvamiti śaṅkāyāmetadvivṛṇoti tathāhīti | atra nānātvānusandhānapratītiṃ darśayati sarvasyeti | na hi kevalaṃ brahmetyuktam; pravṛttinimittabhedenaikārthavṛttitvaṃhi sāmānādhikaraṇyamityupapāditatvāt bādhārthatvasya vakṣyamāṇadūṣaṇopahatatvācca | atha codyapūrvakametacchatyarthamāha idamucyata iti | adṛśya ityacidvayāvṛttiḥ | anātmya iti baddhavyāvṛttiḥ; nanu yadā hyevaiṣa ityatra pratiṣṭhāvicchedo'rthaścet, etasyāmiti strīliṅgatā syāt || aditiḥ pāśāniti nyāyāt vibhakyavagatanapuṃsakatvāvivakṣeti cettathāpyasvārasyamavarjanīyam | tacca svarasārthe saṃbhavati nopapadyate | saptamī cāsvarasā | tasya viccheda iti hyuktiḥ svarasā; yathā rājye pratiṣṭhita iti | prathamapratipannapratiṣṭhāpadasyārthabhaṅgaścānupapannaḥ | pūrvasiddhaikyāvagatiparatvāt vindatidhātvarthasyāsvārasyañca | saptamī cāsvarasā; bhedapratiyogitvāvadhitvasambandhavivakṣāyāṃ tṛtīyāpañcamīṣaṣṭhīnāmeva svārasyāt | karoteḥ pratipattyarthatvādasvārasyañca | manasi kuruta iti yojanāyāmadhyāhāraḥ | eṣa hyevānandayātīti pūrvavākyapratipannabhedavirodhaśca | anantaraṃ ca bhīṣāsmāditi praśāsitṛtvena bheda ucyate | ato madhye bhedaniṣedhaścānupapannaḥ | "ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvānna vibheti kutaścana", "kadācana" iti pūvāparavākyeṣu guṇaviśiṣṭavedanasyābhayahetutvokteḥ brahmaṇi bhedaniṣedhasyābhayahetutvakathanaṃ ca viruddham | brahmavidāpnotīti vidyupakramatvācca brahmaṇi pratiṣṭhāyā vedanarūpatvameva yuktam; nāhaṃ tadāyattāsthitirityarthaḥ | lokadṛṣṭaprakāreṇa nāhamādhāraḥ, api tu saṅkalpamātrādityāha na ceti | niṣedhasya vihitavyatiriktaviṣayatvādayamevārthaḥ | yogamaiśvaramīśvarāsādhāraṇaṃ sarvaśaktiyogamityarthaḥ | na ca matsthānīti dhārakatvapāramārthyaniṣedhaścet yogamaiśvaraṃ paśyeti viruddham | mama bhrānti paśyeti hi tadā vaktavyam | yogamaiśvaramityetadvivṛṇvan imamevārthamāha bhūtabhṛditi | mamātmāmama saṅkalpa ityarthaḥ | ātmaśabdo hi mativācī, "yatne'rke'gnau matāvātmā" iti | ato'tra ātma śabdaḥ saṅkalparūpajñānavācī | "mamātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ" ityanena "na ca matsthāni bhūtāni" ityasyārthaḥ spaṣṭīkṛtaḥ | bhūtabhāvanaḥbhūtānāṃ sattānuvatarkaḥ | arvācīnasyeśvarasya hi saguṇatvamiti śaṅkāyāṃ kāraṇātiriktavastuniṣedhapradarśanārthaṃ lakṣaṇapradarśanārthaṃ ca jagatkāraṇatvamāhaahamiti | prabhavaḥ pralayaścoktaḥ; atha purāṇavacanānyupanyasyante | tatra pratyastamitabhedamityasya vacanasyārthaṃ vyācikhyāsuḥ tadupayogitvena tadupakramopasaṃhārayoḥ saviśeṣaparatvaṃ darśayiṣyan upakramavacanānyupādatte sa sarveti | tatra prathamagrantho heyapratyanīkatva paraḥ | sarvabhūprakṛtim pradhānam | vikārān mahadādīn | guṇādidoṣān sattvarajastamohetukān doṣān | te doṣāḥ kleśādayaḥ | vyatītaḥviśeṣeṇātītaḥ; niyamena (a)tatparavaśatayā sambandhānarha ityarthaḥ | atītasarvāvaraṇaḥ | āvaraṇamprakṛtisaṃbandhakarmavāsanādikam | tat sarvamatītaṃ yena, sa ityarthaḥ | yadvā sarvaviṣayajñānāvaraṇaṃ sarvāvara ṇam | sarvaviṣayajñānasaṅkocama(cā)tīta ityarthaḥ; jñānaśaktyādisavarguṇasaṅkocakātīta iti vā''rthaḥ | akhilātmatvaṃ vivṛṇoti teneti | na tu mṛdātmako ghaṭa itivadityarthaḥ | bhuvanāntarāleubhayavibhūtyantarāle | atha divyātmasvarūpasya maṅgalaikatānatvamāha samasteti | samastakalyāṇaguṇātmaka iti kalyāṇaguṇavattvamucyate cet, ātmaśabdaḥ svabhāvavācī syāt | evaṃ saṃkṣiptārthasya tejobalaiśvaryetyādinā vistaraḥ kriyata iti vibhāgaḥ (nirvāhaḥ) | asmādapi nirvāhāt divyātmasvarūpaparatvaṃ yuktam; apekṣitavidheranapekṣitavidhānaṃ durbalamiti nyāyāt | tadā kalyāṇaśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ | samastakalyāṇatvaṃ guṇaḥ svabhāvo yasya sa samastakalyāṇaguṇaḥ; yathā "dvayekayordvivacanaikavacane" iti sūtrasthadvayekayoritipadaṃ dvitvaikatvaparaṃ vyākhyātam | anyathā dvayekeṣviti vācyam; na tu dvayekayoriti | tacca bhāvapradhānanirdeśasya sādhutvajñāpanāya kṛtam | tata eva hi, "guṇāḥ satyajñānaprabhṛtayaḥ" ityabhiyuktairu ktam | samastakalyāṇaguṇaḥ ātmāudharmisvarūpaṃ yasya, sa samastakalyāṇaguṇātmakaḥ | bahuvrīhiraupacārikaḥ; śilāputrakasya śarīramiti nirdeśavat | divyātmasvarūpameva stauti svaśaktīti | svāṃśaleśāt dhṛtabhūtasargaḥ | yadvā śaktiḥsāmarthyam, svaguṇalavadhṛtabhūtajāta ityarthaḥ | bhūtasargaḥbhūtasamūhaḥ | yadvā sṛjyata iti sargaḥ kāryavastujātamityarthaḥ |abhiprāyaviśeṣeṇa ṣāḍguṇyaṃ paścādvakṣyan prathamaṃ divyavigrahamāha iccheti | abhimatatvamabhimatyarhatvam; svānurūpatvamiti yāvat | arhārthe niṣṭhā, yathā "adṛṣṭo draṣṭā aśruta" śrotā iti | tatra hyarhārthīyaḥ ktaḥ; adreśyamagrāhyamityādyaikārthyāt | abhimatasyānanurūpatvam, anurūpasyānabhimatatvaṃ ca loke dṛśyate | tadvayāvṛttyartham | icchāgṛhītābhimataśabdau | nirupapadecchāśabdo nityecchāyā avatārasamayajanyecchāyāśca sādhāraṇaḥ; asaṅkocāt |
athāvatāradvāreṇa sādhyaṃ vigrahaprayojanamāha saṃsādhiteti | atha ṣāḍguṇyavattāmāha teja iti | nātra kramavivakṣā | mahāśabdasuśabdau sarvaguṇasādhāraṇau | mahattvamaparicchinnatvam | yathā "mahotsāho mahābalaḥ mahābuddhirmahāvīryo mahāśaktirmahādyutiḥ" iti | yathā "prakṛṣṭaṃ vijñānaṃ balamatulam" ityādi | suśabdena teṣāṃ maṅgalatvamucyate | evaṃ svarūpato vigrahato guṇataśca para ityāha para iti | guṇādidoṣānityatra doṣaśabdārthaṃ vivṛṇoti na yatreti | kleśādayaḥkleśakarmavipākāśayāḥ | avidyā'smitārāgadveṣābhiniveśāḥ kleśāḥ | karma puṇyāpuṇyātmakam | jātyāyurbhogāḥ vipākāḥ | āśayavāsanā, saṃskāraḥ | "kleśakarmavipākāśayairaparāmṛṣṭaḥ puruṣaviśeṣa īśvaraḥ" iti yogasūtraṃ smāra yati sa īśvara iti | yogaśāstrādapi vedāntārthavaiṣamyamāha vyaṣṭīti | pūrvaṃ bhedaśrutyartha uktaḥ, ataikyaśrutinirvāhārthaṃ ghaṭakaśrutyartha ucyatevyaṣṭīti | vyaṣṭisamaṣṭiśabdābhyāṃ kāryakāraṇā(ṇabhāvā)vasthaścetanavarga ucyate | rūpamśarī ram | svarūpamsvāsādhāraṇaṃ śarīram | śarīrilakṣaṇaṃ sūcayati sarveśvara iti | īśvaraḥniyantā | anena niyāmyatvaṃ śarīratvaṃ siddham; niyāmyaviśeṣo hi śarīram | sarvadṛk sarvavettāsvarūpataḥ prakārataśca sarvaṃ jānātītyarthaḥ | yadvā viśvataścakṣurityādiśrutiprakiyayā sarvatodṛgbhavan sarvaṃ vettītyarthaḥ | yadvā sarveṣāṃ dṛk sarvavettā ca; "cakṣurdevānāmuta martyānām" iti śruteḥ | cakṣuḥjñānapradaḥ | sarvaṃ vindatīti vā sarvavettā; avāptasamastakāma ityarthaḥ | samastaśaktiḥ | śaktiḥkāryopayogyapṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇam | uktaprakāreṇa sarvaśarīrakatvādasya sarvamapṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ | parameśvarākhya iti paramaśabdena ananyeśvaratvaṃ siddham (anyeśvaratvaṃ niṣiddham) | paro mā asyeti hi paramaḥ | evaṃvidheśvaraviṣayajñānasyaivāpavargopāyavedanatvamāha sa jñāyata sati | saṃjñāyata iti pāṭhe astadoṣamityādi brahmaviśeṣaṇam | yena śāstrajanyajñānena vijñāyate, yenopāsanātmakena saṃdṛśyate, yena paramabhaktirūpeṇānubhavarūpeṇa ca prāpyateanubhūyata ityarthaḥ | "bhaktayā tvananyayā śakya ahamevaṃvidho'rjuna | jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca parantapa" iti vacanāt | sa jñāyata iti pāṭhe astadoṣamityādi brahmajñānaviśeṣaṇam | "arthenaiva viśeṣo hi nirākāratayā dhiyām" iti vacanāt jñānasyāstadoṣatvādikaṃ viṣayadvārā | astadoṣamiti doṣāspadācidviṣayajñānād vyāvṛttiḥ | śuddhamiti "aśuddhāste samastāstu" ityādyuktakarmavaśyāśuddhabaddhajīvaviṣayajñānādvayāvṛttiḥ | paraṃ nirmalamatyantanirmalam; anena kadācitkarmasaṃbandhārhatārūpamalānvitamuktaviṣayajñānādvayāvṛttiḥ | ekarūpamiti nityamuktaviṣayānekarūpajñānādvayāvṛttiḥ | anayā diśā brahmaviśeṣaṇatve'pi vyāvṛttirdraṣṭavyā | brahmaviśeṣaṇatve ekarūpamityāśrayaṇīyatvopayogiviśeṣaṇaṃ ca bhavati; sthirasvabhāvam; āśritasaṃrakṣaṇādipratijñāyāṃ dṛḍhataramityarthaḥ | ajñānammokṣopāyajñānādanyat tadvirodhi vā; "sā vidyā yā vimuktaye" iti vacanāt | yadvā ajñānamjñānābhavaḥ; brahmaparyantatvābhāvena ayathāvasthitavastuviṣayatvāt | brahmaviśeṣaṇatve ekavākyam; jñānaviśeṣaṇatve vākyadvayam |
"pratyastamitabhedam" ityādiśloke pratyastamitabhedapadaṃ hṛdi nidhāya saviśeṣatve vacanāni darśatāni || atha agocaraṃ vacasāmityetadvayācikhyāsayā śabdāgocaratve vacanāni daśaryati śuddha ityādinā | tatra aśabdagocarasyetyādike pūrvaśloke muktātmani bhagavacchabda prayogaḥ aupacārika ityuktam; tat kathamityapekṣāyāṃ muktātmavya vartakaṃ bhagavacchabdapravṛttinimittamāhaśuddha iti | yatra pravṛttinimittapauṣkalyam tatraiva hi mukhyatvam, nānyatreti bhāvaḥ | śuddhe | "siddhe śabdātharsambandhe" ityatra siddhaśabdavacchudvaśabdo'vadhāraṇagarbhaḥ | śuddha evanityaśuddhe ityarthaḥ | "abbhakṣaḥ" itivat siddhaśabdasyāvadhāraṇagarbhatvāt siddhaśabdo nityaparatvena hi vyākhyātaḥ; tadvat | anena nityaśuddhatvena sakalacetanavyāvṛttiḥ; nityasiddhānāmapi nityaśuddhatvasya bhagavannityecchāyattatvāt | mahāvibhūtyākhye | vibhūtibhūtasya mahāvibhūtitvāyogāt ubhayavibhūtiśeṣitvaṃ samastacetanavyāvartakam | pare brahmaṇītyanena ca cetanavyāvṛttiḥ; siddhā | apa(va?)rātmā hi kevalabrahmaśabdenoktaḥ, "aśabdagocarasyāpi tasya vai brahmaṇo dvija" iti | uttaratra tu(?) "paramabrahmabhūtasya" iti hi paramātmā vakṣyate | pradeśāntare'pi parabrahmaśabdaḥ paramātmapara eva dṛśyate | ato'paramātmavyāvṛttyarthaṃ, "mahāvibhūtyākhye pare brahmaṇī"tyuktam | savarkāraṇakāraṇatvañca bhagavata eva | jagadvayāpārarahito hi muktātmā | evamuktapravṛttinimittapauṣkalyāt sarveśvara eva bhagavacchabdo mukhyavṛttaḥ, nānyatretyarthaḥ |
iyamarthaṃ vivṛṇvannakṣaraśaḥ samudāyaśaśca bhagavacchabdārthamāhasaṃbhartetyādinā | śuddhatvam, vinā heyaiḥ iti vivṛtam | bhogyasampadvācakena aiśvaryasyasamagrasyatiślokasthaśrīśabdena bhogavibhūteḥ, sambharaṇādyuktayā līlāvibhūteśca darśitatvānmahāvibhūtitvaṃ vivṛtam | sarvakāraṇakāraṇatvaṃ copari spaṣṭam | ata eva jñānaśaktyādibhiśca niratiśayabṛhattvāt parabrahmatvaṃ sphuṭam | ata uttaragranthānāṃ śuddha ityādiślokavivaraṇarūpatvaṃ yuktam | bhaśca gaśca bhagaśca vaśceti vibhajyārtha ucyate | eteṣāṃ padānāṃ tattaddhātuṣu "anyeṣvapi dṛśyate" iti ḍapratyaye ṭilope ca kṛte evaṃ rūpaṃ bhavatīti | bhārthamāha samityarddhena | sambhartā | saṃbharaṇamupakaraṇasaṃvidhānam | prakṛtipuruṣakālān kāryotpattiyogyān karotītyarthaḥ | mahadādisṛṣṭiḥ aṇḍarūpakāryotpattyupayuktā sambharaṇamiti vā vivakṣā | bhartāsvāmī;
