dhāraṇasya vakāravācyatvāt poṣakatvasya gakāravācyanetṛtvāntarbhāvāt apekṣitavidheranapekṣitavidhānadaurvalyācca svāmitva miha vivakṣitam | yadyapi pratyayaviśeṣayuktasya bharateḥ svāmini rūḍhatvam, tathāpi pūrvoktayuktisacivāṣavacanavalāt dhātumātrasya svāmi(tva?)vācitvaṃ niścīyate | itikaraṇena saṃbhartṛtvabhartṛtve pravṛttinimitte niṣkṛṣyocyete | ata eva arthadvayānvita ityuktam | uttaratra tu pravṛttinimittatraye satyapi itikaraṇena teṣāmaniṣkṛṣṭatvāt pravṛttinimittatrayaviśiṣṭo dharmī eka evārtha uktaḥ | gakārārthamāha neteti | upasargasphuṭīkṛtānāmarthānāṃ dhātulīnatvāt udgamayitā saṅgamayitetyevaṃrūpapadānāmarthamāha neteti | straṣṭetyanena udgamayitṛśabdārtha uktaḥ | neteti gamayitṛśabdārtha uktaḥ | sthitikartetyarthaḥ | gamayitṛśabdena saṅgamayitṛśabdārtha uktaḥ | sa ca saṃhāraḥ | yathā "yasminnidaṃ sañca vicaiti sarvam" ityatra vyeti sametīti sargasaṃhārāvucyete, tadvat | yadvā kāraṇabhūtaṃ svātmānaṃ gamayitā; svasmin kāryavargasya kayakartetyarthaḥ | upasargāprayoge'pi arthānāṃ dhātulīnatvādevaṃ vyākhyātaṃ bhagavatā parāśareṇa | atha vakāravyākhyānātpūrvameva bhakāragakārasamudāyasyārthamāha aiśvaryasyeti | samagraśabdaḥ sarvatrānveti | paricchinnacaturmukhādyaiśvaryavyā vṛttyarthaḥ samagraśabdaḥ | yaśaḥ guṇavattāprathā | śrīḥ bhogyasaṃpat | vairāgyaṃ viraktiḥ; paripūrṇatvādanādaratetyarthaḥ | yathā "avākyanādaraḥ" iti | matuppratyayasya prasiddhārthatvād na tad vyākhyātam | atha vakārārthamāha vasantīti | "anyeṣvapi dṛśyate" iti ḍapratyayasyānekārthatvādadhikaraṇe kartari ca vyutpattiḥ | bhūtātmani bhūtānāmātmani | akhilātmani ākhilaśarīrake | yadvābhūtaśabdena kāryamucyate; tasyātmani, akhilātmani kāryānantarbhūtānāṃ nityamuktānāmātmanītyarthaḥ | atha samudāyaśaktiviṣayamarthamāha jñānaśaktīti | pāṭhakrame tu "evameṣa" ityādiślokadvayānantaraṃ jñānaśaktibalaiśvaryetyādi ślokaḥ paṭhyate | tathāpi pravṛttinimittavācitvasaṅgativaśāt "evameṣa" ityādi ślokadvayātpūrvaṃ jñānaśaktītyādiśloka ihopāttaḥ | "utpatiṃta pralayaṃ caiva" ityādiślokasya prastutānupayuktatvācca evamupādānaṃ kṛtam | bhagavacchabdavācyānipravṛttinimittatvena vācyānītyarthaḥ | aśeṣataḥ | na pratyekaṃ pravṛttinimittāni; apitu samuccityetyarthaḥ | aśeṣaśabdena ṣāṅguṇyāvāntara(bhidā)rūpaṃ śīlādiguṇajātaṃ ca kroḍīkṛtam | yadyapyaiśvaryavīryajñānāni pūrvaṃ kaṇṭhoktāni, tathāpi katipayasamudāyyāvāpodvāpaprayuktasamudāyabhedādapunaruktiḥ | na cātra samudāyaśaktiḥ kalpyate, yenānuktaguṇamātragocaratā syāt | vacanabalādeva śaktisvīkāraḥ | pūrvamakṣarārthakathanena bhakāragakāravakārāḥ vyākhyātāḥ; atha an ityasyārthamāha vineti | kaśyapaḥ paśyako bhavatīti nyāyāt annityanena netyuktaṃ bhavati; niṣedhyaṃ ca heyamityarthaḥ | evaṃ pravṛttinimittapauṣkalyādbhagavatyeva mukhyavṛttatvamāha evamiti | mahārthagarbhatvānmahāśabdatvam | muktātmavyāvṛttyarthaṃ paramabrahmetyuktam | kathaṃ tatraiva mukhaṃyṛttatvam; anyatrāpi tatprayogo dṛśyata ityatrāha tatreti | pūjyapadārthoktiḥ pūjyānāmavayavārthānāmuktiḥ; paribhāṣā rūḍhiḥ; tābhyāṃ samanvitaḥ | yogarūḍhibhyāṃ viśiṣṭaḥ | ata eva nopacāreṇa | mukhyavṛtta ityarthaḥ | anyatrāmukhyatvamityāha | | muktātmanyaupacārikatvoktayā arthāntaraprayogeṣvapyaupacārikatvamarthāt darśitamiti hiśabdābhiprāyaḥ | bhagavacchabdaprayogaviṣayeṣu sarveṣu prayoge anyathāsiddhe'pi na hi śaktibhedakalpanaṃ yuktam | yatra jñānādayo niraṅkuśāḥ, sa eva mukhyārthaḥ | guṇaleśayogādapi prayogasaṃbhavādanyatra vṛttiraupacārikātyarthaḥ |
atha tasminneva yogaprakaraṇa upasaṃhāre'pi saviśeṣaparavākyāni darśayan divyavagrihavatvaṃ cāha samastā iti | baddho muktaḥ karmarūpāvidyā ca śaktayaḥ | tattadabhimānidevatādvāreṇa tatra tāsāṃ pratiṣṭhitatvam; yatretyanuvādasya purovādasāpekṣatvāt; astrabhūṣaṇādhyāye yathoktaprakāreṇapurovādācca | tadviśvarūpavairūpyamiti saṃniveśavailakṣaṇyamuktam | anyaditi dravyāntaratvamuktam | mahadityaparicchedyatvam | vilakṣaṇasaṃniveśasya sakaletaravisajātīyasya kathaṃcantayituṃ śakyatvamityatrāha samasteti | kena hetunetyatrāha svalīlayeti | līlāyāḥ prayojanatvāt tadabhisandhirhetuḥ | na tu karmaṇetyarthaḥ | kiṃ prayojanamityatrāha jagatāmiti | na tu svakarmaphalabhogāyetyarthaḥ | etadvivṛṇeti na seti | vyāpinī deśaniyamarahitā; yathā vaidikaputrānayanādiṣu | vyāpanaśaktatve'pi pratibandhaḥ saṃbhavatītyatrāha avyāhatātmikā | na tasyāḥ pratihatirastītyarthaḥ | yadvā vyāpinīsarvāvatārānuguṇā | avyāhatā(tmikā?) deśakālavastukṛtapratibandharahitā |
evaṃ pratyastamiteti ślokasya paramātmaparatvābhyupagamepi nirviśeṣaparatvanirācikīrṣayā upakramopasaṃhārayostasminneva prakaraṇe saviśeṣaparatvaṃ darśitam | athāsya ślokasya pariśuddhajīvātmasvarūpaviṣayatvaṃ pratyastamitabhedādipadānāṃ katipayaviṣayatvaṃ ca vivakṣuḥ, tadarthaṃ paramātmaviṣayabhedaniṣedhādīnāṃ katipayaviṣayatvābhidhāyīni vākyāni darśayiṣyan, paramātmaviṣayakatipayabhedaniṣedhaparavacanodāharaṇena muktātmaviṣaye kimāyātamiti śaṅkāyāṃ muktasya paramātmasāmyapratipattaye muktaguṇān paramātmanyatidiśantaṃ ślokaṃ darśayati | evamprakāramiti | etacchlokodāharaṇena pratyastamitetyādiślokānantaraṃ pūrvapakṣe paṭhitasya "jñānasvarūpa"mityādeḥ prathamāṃśopakramaślokasya catuḥślokyāśca saviśeṣaparatvapratipādanāya prathamāṃśopasaṃhāre'pi saviśeṣaparatvaṃ darśitaṃ bhavati | upasaṃhāravacanopādānamupasaṃhārasya buddhisthatvāt kriyate | evamprakāram | muktātmānaṃ prati "nirvyāpāramanākhyeyam" ityādinā yaḥ prakāra uktaḥ tadupetamityarthaḥ | evaṃ bhagavati muktātmaguṇātideśaḥ kṛtaḥ | bhedarāhityasya sattāmātratvasya vacasāmagocaratvasya ca muktaguṇasya nirvyāpāramityodinoktasya bhagavatyatidiṣṭatvāt bhagavati ca teṣāṃ niṣedhānāṃ katipayaviṣayatvasya prāmāṇikatvācca te niṣedhā muktātmanyapi tathāvidhā iti katipayaviṣayatvaṃ siddhamiti bhāvaḥ | atha paramātmano'dhikān guṇānāha | amalammalapratibhaṭam | sopādhikaheyavirodhinamityarthaḥ | nityamuktākāreṇa nityam | malapratibhaṭatvaṃ nityamityarthaḥ | vyāpakamsvarūpeṇa vyāpakam | akṣayamsvata eva dharmato'pi vikārarahitam | muktasya hi pūrvāvasthāyāṃ mānasaṅkocavikāsarūpavikāro vidyate | nityasiddhānāmapi tathātvaṃ parā(tadā)yattamiti tadvayavacchedaḥ | samastaheyarahitam | pūrvaṃ heyapratyanīkatvamuktam; atra heyarāhityamuktam | svato heyābhāvo'pi muktasya nāsti; paramātmaprasādādhīnatvāt tasya | padyata iti padam | divyātmasvarūpamparamapadaśabdasya divyaloke muktātmani ca prayogāt tadvayāvṛttyarthaṃ viṣṇvākhyaṃ ityuktam |
atha prathamāṃśopakrame'pi saviśeṣaparatvaṃ darśayati paraḥ parāṇāmiti | anena śāstropakramasyāpi saviśeṣaparatvamuktaṃ bhavati, anena pratyastamitabhedamityādipadānāṃ katipayabhedaniṣedhaparatvaṃ ca siddhamiti trividhaṃ prayojanam | anena paraḥparāṇāmityādigranthajātasya avikārāyetyādisaṃgraha ślokavivaraṇarūpatvāt jñānasvarūpamityādiślokaṃ prati upakramatvamarthakrameṇa siddhamiti tasyāpi saviśeṣaparatvasiddhiḥ | yadvā prathamāṃśopakramopasaṃhārayoḥ saviśeṣaparatvādupakramopakramabhūtasyāpi jñānasvarūpamiti ślokasya mahāvākyakhārasyavirodho na nyāyya iti tasyāpi saviśeṣaparatvaṃ sidhyati | yadvā namaskāraślokasya śāstropakramaśeṣabhūtatvāt taccheṣabhūtastadanuguṇārtho varṇanīya iti sidhyati || upakramopakramabhūtanamaskāraślokārthānuguṇaṃ "paraḥ parāṇāt" ityāderartho varṇanīya iti cet, na; tasyāpyupakramabhūtapraśnottaravaralābhakathanaślokānuguṇaṃ tadarthasya vācyatvādityabhiprāyaḥ |
atra brahmaṇaḥ kṛtsnajagatkāraṇatvasiddhayarthaṃ vedānteṣu "satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma" ityādivākyairānantyamuktam | tacca trividhaparicchedarāhityam | na hi deśakālādibhiḥ paricchinnānāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ kṛtsnasya sarvavidhakāraṇatvaṃ dṛṣṭam | kālatrayavartikāryajātakāraṇatve sarvadeśagatakāryakāraṇatve ca deśataḥ kālato'pyaparicchedāvapekṣitau | upādānatvasiddhayai vastvaparicchedo'pekṣitaḥ | na hi vastutaḥparicchinnaḥ kulāla upādānaṃ bhavati; mṛtpiṇḍakulālayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāsaṃbhavāt | ataḥ kṛtsnakāraṇatvasiddhayarthaṃ trividhaparicchedarāhityaṃ vistareṇa vivakṣuḥ "paraḥ parāṇāmi"tya dhaina tat saṅgraheṇa pratijānīte paraḥ parāṇāṃ parama iti | anena kālānavacchedaḥ siddhaḥ; adhikakālavartitvasya paraśabbdavācyatvāt | paramātmeti deśāpariccheda uktaḥ | āpnoti hyātmaśabdavyutpattiḥ | ātmasaṃsthitaḥsarveṣāmātmatvena sarvavastubhirviśiṣṭaḥ | yadvā ātmatvena saṃsthitatayā sarvaśarīrakatvāt svasmin paryavasthitaḥsvaniṣṭhaḥ | anyat sarvaṃ tanniṣṭham; śarīratayā viśeṣaṇatvāt | ataḥ sarvaparyavasānabhūmiḥ svaniṣṭhaḥ iti vastvapariccheda uktaḥ | sarvavastusāmānādhikaraṇyārhatvaṃ hi vastvaparicchedaḥ idamidaṃ na bhavatīti hi varatuparicchedaḥ | yadvā nityatvavibhutvavyatiriktaguṇaiḥ samābhyadhikarahitatvaṃ vastvaparicchedaḥ | svaniṣṭhaṃ paramātmānamapekṣya tanniṣṭhānāmanyeṣāṃ samatvābhyadhikatvāsaṃbhavādātmasaṃsthita ityanena vastvaparicchedasiddhiḥ | evaṃ saṃkṣiptamarthamupapādayatirūpetyādinā | tatra kālāparicchedaṃ prathamaṃ vivakṣuḥ kālaparicchinneṣu vatarmānaṃ pañcakalpanānvitatvaṃ brahmaṇi nāstītyāharūpeti | rūpaśabdena jātirucyate | "jātiguṇau ca rūpiṇāṃ rūpe" iti hi nītividaḥ | varṇaśabdo rūpākhyaguṇaviśeṣaparaḥ | ādiśabdena gandharasādiḥ, āsanaśayanādikriyā, viṣāṇādyavayavavatvaṃ ca vivakṣitam | rūpavargādīti pāṭhe rūpaśabdo nīlapītatvādiguṇaparaḥ, vargaśabdo devamanuṣyādivargaparaḥ; jātiparaḥ | iti arthaḥ | tannibandhanastadviṣayo nirdeśaḥ śabdaḥ | śabdavācyāsta eva viśeṣaṇāni tairvivarjitaḥ | yadvā rūpavarṇāditadvāciśabdarūpairviśeṣaṇairviva rjitaḥ | evamanityatvavyāpakaṃ kamarkṛtaṃ rūpādimattvaṃ brahmaṇi nāstīti karmakṛtarūpādinivṛttyā tadvyāpyakālaparicchedanivṛttirityarthaḥ | yadvā anityatvavyāpyakarmakṛtarūpādyabhāvānnānityatvaṃ brahmaṇyanumātuṃ śakyamityarthaḥ | anena "pratyastamitabhedam" ityasya padasya viṣayo darśitaḥ |
athānityatvavyāpakatvādvikārāṇāmanityatvanivṛttaye tadvayāpakavikārarāhityamāha apakṣayeti | jāyate, astītyavasthādvayaṃ janmaśabdena vivakṣitam | utpattisthitināśānāmekaikatra vidhādvayena vikāraṣaṭkasiddhiḥ | tadvivarjitatvāt sadā'stīti vaktu śakyate | sadāśabdena kādācitkāstitvavyā(ni)vṛttiḥ | na tu utpadyata ityadiśabdairiti kevalaśabdābhiprāyaḥ | anena sattāmātramityasya viṣayo darśitaḥ | agocaraṃ vacasāmityasya ca viṣayo darśito bhavati; rūpavarṇādipravṛttinimittābhāvādutpattyādipravṛttinimittābhāvācca kalpanāvikāravāciśabdainar vaktuṃ śakyata iti tasya padasyārtha ityabhiprāyaḥ | agocaraṃ vacasāmiti sarvaśabdāgocaratvamucyate cet, vacasāmagocaraṃ, sattāmātramityapi vaktuṃ na śakyate |
atha deśāparicchedaṃ nāmanirvacanamukhenāha sarvatreti | brahmaṇa īśvarātiriktatvaniṣedhārthaṃ devatāntaravyudāsārthaṃ ca nāmanirvacanamukhena taduktiḥ | auṇādikapratyayasyānekārthatvādadhikaraṇe kartari ca vyutpattirvāsudevaśabdasyocyate sarvatreti | vedānteṣu parabrahmaṇo hi nirvikāratvādikamuktam; tat kathaṃ vāsudevasyocyata ityatrāha tadvrahmeti | "śaityaṃ hi yat sā prakṛtirjalasya" itivat taditi nirdeśaḥ | "nirdiśyamānapratinirdiśyamānayorekatvamāpādayanti sarvanā māni paryāyeṇa talliṅgamupādadate" iti hi śābdāḥ | nityamiti kāyarmātravyāvṛttiḥ | ajamakṣaramavyayam ekasvarūpamiti savikāranityapradhānavyāvṛttiḥ | ekasvarūpaśabdena vṛddhipariṇāmarāhityaṃ vivakṣitam | heyābhāvācca nirmalamiti baddhavyāvṛttiḥ | sadeti muktavyāvṛtiḥ | paramamiti nityasiddhavyāvṛttiḥ | yadvā ekasvarūpamiti baddhavyāvṛttiḥ, sadetyādinā muktavyāvṛtiriti | evaṃ svavyatiriktasamastavastuvilakṣaṇatvenopaniṣatsūktaṃ brahma vāsudeva evetyarthaḥ | trividhāparacchedavācinī śrutirapi devatāviśeṣaṃ niracinot anantamiti | anantaśabdo yogarūḍhaḥ | ato nārāyaṇādiśabdaparyāya trividhānantyayogini bhagavati mukhyo vartate | satyajñānādivākye anantamiti padaṃ pulliṅgaṃ dvitīyāntam; yo vedeti vedanaśabdenānvayāt prathamāntatve tadyo vedeti | tatpadādhyāhāraḥ syāt; vākyabhedaśca syāt | atastatra yathokta evārthaḥ | tasmāt tadanusāreṇātrāpi aparicchedakathanasamaye devatāviśeṣo nirṇītaḥ |
vastvaparicchedamāha tadeveti | sarvamevaitaditi vyaktāvyaktapurumaṣakālasamudāya ucyate | vyaktāvyakta (puruṣakāla?) svarūpametat sarvaṃ tad brahmetyarthaḥ | anena vastvapariccheda uktaḥ | sarvavastusāmānādhikaraṇyārhatvaṃ hi vastvaparicchedaḥ | sarvavastusāmānādhikaraṇyārhatvenaiva cidaciccharīrakatvahetubhūtavyāpanabharaṇādiguṇataḥ samābhyadhikarāhityasiddheśca vastvaparicchedasiddhiḥ | na hi brahmavyatiriktasya kasyacit samastacidaciccharīrakatvasaṃbhavaḥ |
evaṃ śāstropakrame vāsudevākhyamubhayaliṅga vastu pratipādyamuktam | śāstropasaṃhāre ca tathoktamidaṃ darśayati prakṛtiryete | paramātmaśabdasya kkacirjjīve'pi prayogadarśanāt tadvayāvṛttyarthaṃ sākṣātparamātmalakṣaṇaṃ jagatkāraṇatva muktaṃ līyete paramātmanīti | sa ceśvarānatirikta iti jñāpanārthaḥ parameśvaraśabdaḥ | īśvaraśca na devatāntaramiti jñāpa nāya viṣṇunāmetyuktam | atra paramātmā ādhāraḥ parameśvaraḥ iti padaiḥ śarīrilakṣaṇaṃ spaṣṭam | evaṃ śāstropakramopasaṃhārayoravāntaraprakaraṇopakramopasaṃhārayośca heyapratyanīkakalyāṇaguṇātpadaṃ nārāyaṇa eva paraṃ brahmeti pratipādyata iti darśitam |
atha avidyāsambandhādayaśca brahmaṇa eva hi pratipādyante | tat kathaṃ yathoktasvarūpasya brahmaṇa upapadyata iti śaṅkāyām"kāṭhinyavān yo bimarti" itivat dvāradvāribhāvenopapadyata iti vaktaṃ paramātmano jīvānāñca ātmaśarīrabhāvena sambandhaṃ teṣāmavidyāsambandhādikaṃ ca vakṣyan prathamaṃ jīvabrahmaṇoḥ śarīraśarīribhāvarūpasambandhaṃ darśayati dve rūpe ityādinā | mūrtaṃ cāmūrtameva ceti | baddhaśca muktaścetyarthaḥ | etadvivṛṇoti kṣarākṣarasvarūpa iti | jñānasaṅkocātmakakṣaraṇavat asaṅkucitajñānaṃ cetyarthaḥ | sarvabhūteṣu ca sthite | arharthe ktaḥ | sarvabhūtasthityarhesūkṣmataratayā vyāpanakṣame ityarthaḥ | yadvā baddhasya svarūpeṇa sarvabhūtasthitiḥ, muktasya tu dharmabhūtenavimujñānadvāreṇeti | akṣaraṃ tatparaṃ brahmeti | tat muktasvarūpamakṣaram | kṣaraṃ sarvamidaṃ jagatidaṃ baddhasya rūpaṃ kṣaramityarthaḥ | rūpatvaṃ viśinaṣṭi ekadeśeti | śaktiḥapṛthagbhūtaṃ kāryopayogi viśeṣaṇam | ekadeśasthitasya, vistāriṇīti viśeṣaṇadvayena asaṃṅkīrṇasvabhāvatvamuktam | asmin śloke akhilaṃ jagaditi cidacidātmakaṃ jagaducyate | tulyanyāyatvādakṣarasyāpi śaktitvasiddhiḥ | yadvā akhilajagacchabdenākṣarasyāpi kroḍīkāraḥ | tripādvibhūterapi lokaśabdavācyatvāt tatsamānārthatvājjagacchabdasya; akhilaśabdasya saṅkocakābhāvācca | kṣaraṃ sarvamityatra kṣarasāmānādhikaraṇyamapavādaḥ; iha tadabhāvādakṣarasyāpyabhidhānamupapadyate | idaṃśabdasya prakṛtavācitvāt kṣarākṣaraparatvaṃ yujyate ||
nanvatra kṣarākṣaraśabdau kāryakāraṇa rūpeṇāvasthitaparabrahmaparau; parabrahmaśabdamukhyārthasiddheḥ | anyathā brahmaśabdānāmekaprakaraṇasthānāmarthavairūpyaṃ ca syāt | jagato jyotsnāsthānīyatvañcopapadyate; prabhāyāḥ viśīrṇāvayavatvena agnikāryatvopapatteḥ || naivam; brahmaṇo rūpe iti vyatirekanirdeśasvārasyabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt | sa ca kāryakāraṇayorbrahmavyatiriktatvābhāvāt | yadi ṣaṣṭhīsvārasyāya mūrtatvāmūrtatve vivakṣite, tadā mūrtāmūrtaśabdasvārasyaṅgaḥ | bhāvapradhānatvāvivakṣāyāṃ rūpaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāyogaḥ | yadyucyetabrahmaṇo dve rūpebrahma hi mūrtamamūrtaṃ cetitadā prathamāntabrahmaśabdādhyāhāradoṣaḥ syāt; ṣaṣṭhayantabrahmaśabdasya mūrtāmūrtaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāyogāt | kiñca sarva bhūteṣu ca sthite" iti cānupapannam; sarvabhūtaśabdasya kāryavācitayā tatra kāryasthitāvucyamānāyāṃ svasmin svavṛttiprasaṅgāt; kāraṇasyāpi kāryādananyatayā svavṛttiprasaṅgācca | avasthādvayasya sarvabhūtasthitiriti ca na vācyam; dharmiparyantakṣarākṣaraśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāyogāt; tayorapyavasthāparatve svārasyabhaṅgāt | avasthāvadvācijagacchabdabrahmaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāyogācca | tasmin soḍhe'pi kāraṇāvasthāyāḥ kārye vidyamānatvāyogācca śaktiśabdasya kāyarvācitvāyogācca ślokasya nāyamarthaḥ | upacārato'pi kāryopayogiviśeṣaṇaṃ (hi) śaktiśabdena vyapadeśamarhati; kāryopayogiviśeṣaṇatvasya sāmānyāt | śaktirhi śaktaṃ pratyapṛthagbhūtaṃ kāryopayogiviśeṣaṇam, kāryaṃ tu na kāraṇasyāpṛthagbhūtaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ kāryāpayogi ca bhavati; kāryakāraṇayorananyatvāt svasya svayameva viśeṣaṇatvāyogāt || kāyartvaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti cet, satyam; tathāpi dharmivācino jagacchabdasya kāryatāvācitvābhāvāt śaktiśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyamupacārato'pi nopapadyate | kāryopayogyapṛthagbhūtaviśeṣaṇaṃ śaktiriti mukhyatvamasmanmate saṃbhavet | kṣaraśabdasya kāryaparatve dṛṣṭāntavaighaṭyañca syāt;; tacca jyotsnāyā viśīrṇāvayavatvābhāvenāgnikāryatvābhāvāt | na ca "kṣaraṃ pradhānamamṛtākṣaraṃ haraḥ" iti prayogānusāreṇa cetanācetanaparatvaṃ yuktam | acidaṃśasya svasmin svavṛttiprasaṅgena sarvabhūtasthityanupapatteḥ || cidacitsaṅghātarūpeṣu bhūteṣu dvayoravasthānamupapannamiti cenna; samudāyinoḥ samudāyaniṣṭhatvānupapatteḥ | samudāyo hi samudāyiniṣṭhaḥ | uparitanagranthavairūpyaṃ ca syāt | uttaratra hi, "bhūpamūrtamamūrtañca" iti mūrtāmūtarśabdābhyāṃ rūpadvayaṃ prastutya hiraṇyagarbhādīn nirdiśya, "mūtarmetaddhareḥ rūpaṃ bhāvanātritayānvitam " iti mūrtaśabdavācyarūpasya bhāvanātrayānvayakathanāt | na hyacetanasyakarmabrahmabhāvanānvayaḥ | "so'kṣaraḥ paramaḥ svarāṭ" ityatra hīndrādibaddhavilakṣaṇācitvāt, "sa svarāḍ bhavati" itivat muktavācisvarāṭchabdasāmānādhikaraṇyācca akṣaraśabdo muktātmaparaḥ | atastadanurodhenākṣaraśabdo'trāpi muktātmaparaḥ | brahmaśabdārthavairūpyaṃ tu, "tapasā cīyate brahma", "tasmādetat brahma nāmarūpamannaṃ ca jāyate" iti śrutāviva anekopapattibalāt yujyate | ato yathokta evārthaḥ | brahmaṇo'vidyāsambandhadvārabhūte jīvātmani avidyānvayaṃ darśayati viṣṇuśaktirityādinā | sarvagācaturmukhādipipīlikāntasarvaśarīrasthā | jātāvekavacanam | yadvā dharmabhūtajñānena svataḥ sarvaṃ vyāptuṃ kṣamā, (yayā?) karmaṇā veṣṭitākarmaṇā saṅkucitajñānetyarthaḥ | tarhi sarve ajñāḥ syurityatrāha tayeti | karmatāratamyānuguṇaṃ jñānatāratamyavatī kṣetrajñaśaktirityarthaḥ | sarveṣāṃ jñānanityatvasya muktau sarvaviṣayakatvasya ca prākāṇikatvāt baddhāva sthāyāṃ saṅkocavikāsau siddhau | tattāratamyañca, "puṃsaḥ śakatyupalakṣitaḥ", "tacchakatyā paśavo'dhikāḥ" iti spaṣṭīkṛtam | jātīnāmapyapṛthaksiddhadharmatvena rūpaśabdavācyatvācca tadvayāvṛttyarthaṃ prastutaṃ rūpatvaṃ nimāmyatvalakṣaṇamityāha pradhānañceti | cidacitoḥ paramātmaniyāmyatvadhāryatvavyāpyatvanityatvādeḥ pramāṇāntarāgocaratayā vihitatvānniṣedhyatvamayuktamiti niyāmyatvādidharmāṇāṃ pāramārthyena tadāśrayabhūtayościdacitośca pāramārthyāt nityatvoktayā ca tayorbhramaviṣayatvāsaṃbhavaśca darśito bhavati | na hi dharmisatyatvena vinā dharmasatyatvaṃ yuktam | nāpi bādhyasya nityatvaṃ yuktam | sarvabhūtātmabhūtayāsarvabhūtavyāpikayetyarthaḥ | viṣṇuśaktayāviṣṇorniyamanaśakatyā | anyathā, "śaktiḥ sā'pi tathā viṣṇoḥ" ityanantaroktivirodhāt | tayā vṛtauvyāptau | niyamanena ca dhāraṇaṃ śrutisiddham | "etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane gārgi! dyāvāpṛthivyau vidhṛte tiṣṭhataḥ" iti hi śrūyate | ato vibhartītyuttaraślokasāmañjasyam |
saṃśrayadharmiṇaubhagavadapṛthaksthitidharmakau | pṛthagbhāvaḥupakaraṇopakaraṇitvalakṣaṇasaṃbandhaviśeṣarāhityam; saṃhāraḥ | tatra hi karaṇakalevaraṃ nāsti | saṃśrayaḥkaraṇakaraṇitvena sambandhaḥ; sṛṣyirityarthaḥ | yadvā saṃśrayaḥtayoḥ sambandhaḥ, saṃsāraḥ | pṛthagbhāvo mokṣaḥ | tat sarvaṃ bhagavanniyamanādhīnamityarthaḥ | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha yatheti | kāraṇāt kāryasya vibhāge dṛṣṭāntaḥ | jalasya kaṇikāḥ tasmādbhedena vibharti vāyuḥ | saṃyojakatvaviyojakatvayorvā dṛṣṭāntaḥ | parasparaṃ saṅkalitā asaṅgalitāśca bimarti vāyuḥ | yadvā prakṛtipuruṣagatadoṣaleśarāhitye dṛṣṭāntaḥ | vāyurhi kaṇikā śataṃ tatsvabhāvāspṛṣṭo bimarti | pradhānapuruṣātmanaḥpradhānapuraṣayorātmanaḥ | samastucadacidvastujātamiti karma adhyāhatarvyam | yadvā pradhānaśabdānantarapuruṣaśabdo baddhaparaḥ | ātmaśabdaḥ prakṛtisaṃsargarahitamuktātmaparaḥ | tān bimartīti | evaṃvidhasya jagataḥ paramārthatvamāha tadetaditi | mithyā hi bādhyatvenānityam | pāramārthye sati hi nityatvasaṃbhavaḥ | udāhṛtavacanārthān saṅkṣepeṇāha ityādineti | nirastanikhiladoṣatvaṃ kalyāṇaguṇātmakatvañca "sa sarvabhūtaprakṛtim", "samastakalyāṇa" ityādiślokārthaḥ | jagadutpattyādilīlatvaṃ bhagavacchabdanirvacanasiddham | antaḥpraveśaniyamanādītyādiśabdena adhyakṣatvānumantṛtve ucyete | ityādinetyādiśabdena "krīḍato bālakasya" ityādivacanaṃ vivakṣitam | tadartho līlāśabdena vivakṣitaḥ | sarvāvasthāvasthitasyakāryakāraṇāvasthitasya, baddhamuktāvasthitasya cetyarthaḥ | pramāṇāntaragocarasyārthasya hi niṣedhārthaṃ bhrāntisiddhatvenānuvādasaṃbhavaḥ; paramātmaniyāmyatvādikaṃ tu pramāṇāntarāgocaratvāt vidhitsitameveti vihitasya niṣedho'nupapanna ityabhiprāyeṇa pāramarthikasyaivetyuktam | niyantṛtvaniyāmyatvādipratipādanasiddho'rthaḥ śarīratayā rūpatvam | tadeva sarvamevaitadityatra tacchabdasāmānādhikaraṇyam | dve rūpe brahmaṇastasyetyādinoktamarthamāha śarīrarūpatanvaṃśeti | pratipāditamitīti | evaṃ śāstropakramopasaṃhāreṣvavāntaraprakaraṇopakramopasaṃhāreṣu ca pratipāditatvādityarthaḥ | jñāyata ityantenoktavacanārthasaṅgrahaḥ kṛtaḥ | udāhṛtavacanairvastunaḥ saviśeṣatvaṃ jagataḥ satyatvañca sthitam ||
atha parodāhṛtavacanāni pūrvodāhṛtavacanārthānuguṇyena vyācikhyāsuḥ prathamaṃ pratyastamitabhedamityādiślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe pratyastamiteti | "duḥkhājñānamalā dharmāḥ prakṛteste na cātmanaḥ" iti, "pumānna devo na naro na paśurna ca pādapaḥ | śarīrākṛtibhedāstu bhūpaite karmayonayaḥ" ityādiṣu prakṛtirdevādiśarīraṃ copādhitvena pratīyata ityubhayavidhavacanārthaṃ saṃghaṭayituṃ devamanuṣyādiprakṛtipariṇāmaviśeṣetyuktam | prakṛterityatra prakṛtiśabdanirdeśaḥ śarīrasya prakṛtipariṇāmarūpatvādityabhiprāyaḥ | devamanuṣyādiśabdena pratiṣedhyabhedasya śarīre vidyamānatā darśitā || nanu muktānāmupāsyatvābhāvāt upāsakasvarūpasya acitsaṃsṛṣṭatayā pratyastamitabhedatvāyogācca tādṛkatvopadeśāyogādasya ślokasya pariśuddhātmaviṣayatvānupapatteḥ paramātmaviṣayatvaṃ syāditi śaṅkāparihārāya coktaṃ devamunuṣyādiprakṛtipariṇāmaviśeṣasaṃsṛṣṭasyāpīti | idānīṃ saṃsarato'pi svābhāvikākārasya tirohitasya vidyamānatvādāvirbhaviṣyatastasya tathā(tathātvā)nusandhānāyopadeśa iti bhāvaḥ | "tasyātmaparadeheṣu sato'pi" ityetat smārayituṃ saṃsṛṣṭasyāpītyuktam | apirvirodhe | pātakisaṃsargāt pātakitvaṃ bhavati; rumāsaṃsargāt padārthānāṃ lavaṇatvaṃ bhavati; ato virodhaḥ | tadgatabhedarahitatvena | bhedo rūpavarṇādiḥ | anena pratyaṃstamitabhedaśabdo vyākhyātaḥ | pratyastamitabhedaśabdena bhedasyāpunarudayavināśo'bhipretaḥ | tataśca pralayakālavyāvṛttiḥ | tadbhedavācidevādiśabdāgocaramityanena agocaraṃ vacasāmiti padaṃ vyākhyātam | jñānasattaikalakṣaṇamiti jñānapadaṃ sattāmātramiti ca padaṃ vyākhyātam | sattaikalakṣaṇamityatra ekaśabdena sattāmātramiti padagatamātrajarthaṃ vivṛṇvatā jāyate'stītyādivikārā vyāvṛttāḥ | sattāmātramityukte kenākāreṇa sattetyapekṣāyāṃ jñānasattaikalakṣaṇamityuktam | jñānatvākāreṇa sattetyarthaḥ | vacasāmagocaratve sattāvyāghātaparihārārthaṃ nyāyavaiśeṣikoktajaḍasvarūpatāvyudāsārthaṃ ca ātmasaṃvedyamiti padasyārthamāha svasaṃvedyamiti | yadvā agocaraṃ vacasāmityantaiḥ padaiḥ kalpanāvikārarāhitye tadvāciśabdāgocaratve cokte bhedakadharmābhāvāt kathaṃ svavyāvṛttigrahaṇamiti śaṅkāyāmāha ātmasaṃvedyamiti | pratyakatvena bhāsamānatvaṃ svavyāvartakam | anye hi idantayā bhāsanta ityarthaḥ | jñānapadaṃ dharmadharmiṇoraviśeṣeṇājaḍatvamāhadharmabhūtajñānasya bṛhattayā pariśuddhātmasvarūpasya brahmaśabdavācyatvam, "brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhā'ham" ityādiṣvivopapadyate | yogayukprakrāntayogaḥ | evaṃ prakāramamalamiti vacanena paramātmani muktasvabhāvasyātidiṣṭatvena muktasya paramātmasāmyapratipatteḥ, paramātmanaśca "apakṣayavināśabhyām", "rūpavarṇādinirdeśa" ityādivacanaiḥ katipayabhedarāhityasya ṣaḍbhāvavikārarāhityasya ca spaṣṭatvāt tadānuguṇyenānativistaraṃ śloko vyākhyātaḥ | asya ślokasya muktātmaviṣayatvaṃ tasya ca prakrāntayogasyāgocaratvaṃ ca kathaṃ jñāyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha kathamidamiti | prakaraṇādevāvagamyata iti pariharati taducyata ityādinā | asmin prakaraṇe | na hyayaṃ muktavkaślokaḥ, api tu prabandhasthaḥ | ataḥ "pūrvāparā(paurvāparyā?)parāmṛṣṭaḥ śabdo'nyā kurute matim" iti tatparihārāya pūrvāparamarāmarśenaivārtho varṇanīya iti bhāvaḥ | saṃsāraikabheṣajatayā yogamabhidhāyeti ekaśabdena "kleśānāṃ ca kṣayakaraṃ yogādanyanna vidyate" ityasyārtho'bhipretaḥ | vākyārthajñānamātrasyāpavargopāyatvanirāsaśca sphoritaḥ | yogāvayavān pratyāhāraparyantāniti, "prāṇāyāmena pavane pratyāhāreṇa cendriye | vaśīkṛte tataḥ kuryāt sthitaṃ cetaḥ śubhāśraye" satyādivacanārthaḥ | saṃkṣiptaḥ | parasya brahmaṇo viṣṇoḥ śaktiśabdābhidheyamiti | "viṣṇuśaktiḥ parā proktā" ityatra viṣṇureva śaktirbrahmaṇa iti kecidvadanti; tadvayāvṛttaye viṣṇo riti vyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ "parasya brahmaṇaḥ śaktiḥ", "paramabrahmabhūtasya vāsudevasya", "tataḥ sa vāsudeveti", "tadbrahma paramaṃ nityam", "paramātmā ca sarveṣām", "viṣṇunāmā sa vedeṣu vedānteṣu ca", "parabrahmasvarūpasya viṣṇoḥ śaktisamanvitam", "śaktiḥ sā'pi tathā viṣṇoḥ" ityadibhirviṣṇoreva parabrahmatvaṃ jagatastacchaktitvaṃ tacchaktini(tanni?)yāmyatvaṃ coktamiti tatpratipādakatattadvacanavirodhāt tadayuktamityabhiprāyaḥ | śaktiśabdābhidheyam | apṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇaṃ hi śaktiḥ | brahma ca na kasyacidviśeṣaṇam | ato viṣṇoreva śaktiḥ | sa hi brahmaśabdavācya ityabhiprāyaḥ | atra "nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brahma", "viṣṇustadā''sīt harireva niṣkalaḥ", "patiṃ viśvasyātmeśvaram", na tasyeśe kaścana", "na tatsamaścābhyadhikaśca dṛśyate", "yasmāt paraṃ nāparamasti kiñcat" "na tvatsamo'styabhyadhikaḥ kuto'nyo loka traye" ityādiśrutismṛtayo'nusandheyāḥ | śaktitrayāśrayo divyavigraha upāsyatvenocyate | viṣṇureva śaktaścetkathaṃ viṣṇorvigrahaikadeśo viṣṇorevāśrayaḥ | tadāśrayabhūto vigraho na hi brahmaṇo'stītīdaṃ ca dūṣaṇaṃ phalitam | śaktiśabdābhidheyaṃ rūpadvayamiti | parāparasaṃjñasyāsya rūpadvayasyottaratra parāparaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇaśaktiśabdena parāma rśāt parasaṃjñarūpagocaraḥ śaktiśabdo na paramātmaviṣaya ityabhiprāyaḥ | "tacca viṣṇoḥ paraṃ rūpam", "viṣṇuśaktiḥ parā proktā" iti hyucyate | "bhūpa mūrtamamūrtañca" ityādivacanārthamabhipretyāha mūrtāmūrtavibhāgeneti | "avidyākarmasaṃjñā'nyā tṛtīyā śaktiriṣyate" ityasyārthamāha tṛtīyeti | tṛtīyeti mūrtāmūrtavibhāgenetyuktatvāt mūrtākhyavibhāgamiti vibhajya nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ | niṣpannayogidhyeyatayeti | na vidyarthe kṛtyapratyayaḥ, apitu śakyatvābhiprāyaḥ | yogidhyeyaṃ paraṃ padamityatrāpi sa evārthaḥ | niṣpannayogidhyeyatayā prakrāntayogasya dhyātumaśakyatvaṃ phalitam | svataśśuddhivirahā diti | atra na śuddherasvābhāvikatvamucyate; api tvaupādhikadoṣanirāse svayamaśaktatvena bhagavatprasādasāpekṣatvaṃ vivakṣitam | śubhāśrayatvaṃ pratiṣidhyeti | svataḥśuddhivirahādityanena śubhatvaṃ pratiṣiddham, anālambanatayetyanenāśrayatvaṃ pratiṣiddhamiti śubhāśrayatvapratiṣedhaḥ | śubhatvamheyavirodhitvam; na tu heyarāhityamātram | "cintyamātmaviśuddhayarthaṃ sarvakilviṣanāśanam" ityuktatvāt | śaktitrayāśrayatvakathanāya śaktitrayamanuvadati pareti | atra, "samastāḥ śaktayaścaitāḥ" iti vacanārtho vivakṣitaḥ | etāḥ śaktaya iti bahuvacane satyapi samastapadaṃ bahuvyaktikroḍīkārārtham | paraśaktireva paramātmano rūpamiti paraśaktirūpam; paraśakatyātmakaṃ vā | evamuttaratrāpi | bhagavadasādhāraṇamiti caturmukhādiśarīravyāvṛttiḥ; bhagavadadhiṣṭhitatve'pi tattajjīvaviśeṣābhimānaviṣayatvāt teṣāṃ śarīrāṇām | śrutimūlatāṃ darśayati ādityeti | mūrtarūpamityanena "mūrte bhagavato rūpe" iti vacanārtha uktaḥ | ukteṣvartheṣvayaṃ ślokaḥ kiṃviṣava ityatrāha atreti | śubhāśrayatānarhatvakathanārthamucyate cet, anyatrāsyānarhatvakathanaṃ vastvantarasya tadarhatvakathanaṃ ca
draṣṭavyamityatrāha tathāhīti asminnarthadvaye vacanadvayamupādatte na taditi | yogayujāprakrāntayogena | anālambantvamanena granthenoktam; svataḥśuddhivirahaśca prakaraṇasiddha ityabhipretaḥ | "anye tu puruṣavyāghra! cetaso ye vyapāśrayāḥ | aśuddhāste samastāstu devādyāḥ karmayonayaḥ" ityādinā bhagavadvigrahavyatiriktānāṃ hi śuddhiviraha uktaḥ | anyasya rūpasyārhatākathanaṃ cāsyarūpasyānarhatvavivakṣāsūcakamiti caśabdārthaḥ | anyetviti granthena karmasaṃbandhalakṣaṇāśuddhikathanāt karmasaṃbandhavinirmuktānāmapi svataḥśuddhivirahaḥ sūcitaḥ | teṣāmapi śubhāśrayapadasthaśubhaśabdena vyavacchedyatvaṃ spaṣṭayitumāha tatheti | paścādudbhūtabodhāścetyetat vyākhyātaṃ svasvarūpāpannānāmiti padena | ābrahmastambaparyantā ityatra āṅ abhividhau; stambasamabhivyāhārāt | stambo hi karmavaśyaḥ | "pumānna devaḥ" ityārabhya "bhūpaite karmayonayaḥ" ityukteḥ | "teṣāmapyanyato yataḥ" ityevamantasya granthasyārthaḥ | pūrvamuktaḥ |atha, tasmāttadamalaṃ brahmetyāderarthamāha parasyeti | svāsādhāraṇamityasya pūrvavadarthaḥ | pratyastamitetyādiślokasya bhedaniṣedhaparatvābhāvaṃ nigamayati ata iti |
atha jñānasvarūpamityādi ślokasya bhedamithyātvaparatvābhāvamāha jñānasvarūpamitīti | apiḥ samuccaye | kṛtsnamithyātvapratipādanābhāvamupapādayati jñāneti | jñānasvarūpasyārthākāratayā'vabhāse bhrame sati arthākārasya tathātvenanāvabhāso na bhramo bhavatītyarthaḥ | tameva dṛṣṭāntenopapādayati nahīti | dṛṣṭāntāt vaiṣamyamukhena codyaṃ śaṅkate jagadbrahmaṇoriti | tatra hi sarvaṃ rajatajātaṃ na śuktikāśakalena samānādhikaraṇaṃ dṛṣṭam; api tu vyadhikaraṇatvena pramāṇapratipannam | ato na kṛtsnasya rajatajātasya śuktitvena virodhaḥ; api tu samānādhikaraṇarajatasyaiva virodhaḥ | tatra virodhāt samānādhikṛtarajatasya mithyātvam, aviruddhasyāsamānādhikṛtarajatasyāmithyātvañca | atra tu brahmavyatiriktaṃ kṛtsnaṃ brahmasamānādhikaraṇaṃ pratīyate | ato jñānākārasyārthākārasya ca virodhe kṛtsnasyārthajātasya mithyātvaṃ phalitamiti | etat pariharati tadasaditi | tatra prathamaṃ paroktārthasya prabandhavākyārthavirodhamāha asmi nniti | brahmaṇo'vidyānvayo jagato mithyātvaṃ cātra viruddham | "samastaheyahitaṃ viṣṇvākhyaṃ paramaṃ padam", "tataḥ sa vāsudeveti", "tad brahma paramaṃ nityam", "heyābhāvācca nirmalam", "tāni sarvāṇi tadvaṣuḥ", "vibhūtayo hareretāḥ" ityādivacanādityarthaḥ || "bhrāntidarśanataḥ sthitam", "viṣṇuṃ grasiṣṇum" iti viṣṇoḥ saguṇasya bhramāśrayatvamucyate | atastat yuktam; parabrahma hi nirdoṣamiti śaṅkāvyāvṛttyarthaṃ parasya brahmaṇo viṣṇorityuktam | nirastājñānādinikhiladoṣagandhasya samastakalyāṇaguṇātmakasyetyābhyāṃ padābhyāmavidyānvayānupapattiruktā | avidyā saṃbandhe sati nirastasamastaheyatvaṃ samastakalyāṇaguṇātmakatvamapi hyanupapannaṃ syāt | mahāvibhūteriti jaganmithyātvānupapattiruktā | jagato bhagavadvibhūtitvaṃ hi na pramāṇāntarasiddham, yena niṣedhārthamanuvādaḥ syāt | ato vidhīyata eva | vidhistu na bhramaṃ janayati; tathā sati niṣedhavacanasyāpi sato bhedasyāsattvaviṣayabuddhirūpabhramaparatvasyānirvāyatvāt | prāmāṇyaṃ hi vākyadvayasya samānam | tasmādvihito'rthaḥ paramārtha eveti na jaganmithyātvami tyarthaḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇyenaikyapratītau satyāṃ jñānākārārthākārayorvirodhādanyataramithyātvaṃ syāt, yathā śuktireva rajatamityatreti śaṅkāyāmāha sāmānādhikaraṇyeneti | bādhāsahamna kevalamākāradvaye; anyatarabādhanirapekṣamapi sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ saṃbhavati; kintu bādhaṃ na sahate; ākāradvayāsiddhau sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇāsiddherityarthaḥ | tarhyekasmin vastunyākāradvayavirodhaḥ kathaṃ parihriyata ityatrāha aviruddhañcetīti |ākāradvayāṅgīkāre'pyaikyapratipādanamaviruddham; sadvārakatvāditi bhāvaḥ | anantaramevana tvadhikaraṇāntare ityarthaḥ | prathamaścaśabdaḥ śaṅkānivṛttiparaḥ; dvitīyaḥ samuccayaparaḥ | mithyātvaparatvābhāvaṃ nigamayati ato'yamiti | evaṃ jñānasvarūpamiti ślokasya prapañcamithyātvaparatvamanupapattyuddhāṭanena nirastam | atha ślokaṃ svapakṣe vyākhyātumupakramate tathā hīti |
atha kimarthaṃ praśnaślokavyākhyānam? || ucyatejñānasvarūpamiti śloke dvitīyāntapadānāṃ viśeṣyo viṣṇuriti na pratīyate; teṣāṃ praṇamyeti padenānvayaśca na jñāyate; ślokasya viśiṣṭārtha(viśiṣṭa)paratvaṃ ca prakaraṇasya viśiṣṭaparatvena vinā nāvagamyate; ato namaskāraślokāḥ vyākhyātavyāḥ | teṣu vyākhyātavyeṣu, dvitīyādhyāyārambhe namaskārakaraṇaṃ kiṃnibandhanam; prathamata eva hi kartavyamiti śaṅkā jāyate | śāstrasya praśnaprativacanarūpeṇāvatīrṇa tvāt prathamaṃ praśnānāṃ saṅkṣepeṇa prativacanaṃ kṛtvā vistāravivakṣāyāṃ dvitīyādhāyāyārambhe namaskāraḥ kṛtaḥ | anyathā praśnānantarameva namasyāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyām asmatpraśranasya kimucyata iti śiṣyabuddhervyākulatā syāditi pūrvoktaśaṅkānirasanamukhena namaskāraślokasaṅgatipradarśanārthaṃ praśnaślokā vyākhyātāḥ | "jñānasvarūpam" ityasmin upakrama granthe nirviśeṣavastuvyatiriktasya bhrāntisiddhatvadarśanāt tadanuguṇa evārthaḥ uttaratra varṇanīya iti śaṅkāpariharāya upakramopakramabhūtaiḥ praśnottaravara lābhaślokaiḥ śāstrapratipādyaḥ savibhūtikadevatāviśeṣaḥ na tu jñāptimātramiti śāstratā tparya jñāpanārthaṃ ca praśnaślokavyākhyānam | vyācikhyāsitaślokoktabhrāntyanvayasya sadvārakatvasiddhaye sāmānādhikara ṇyaṃ śarīraśarīribhāvanibandhanamiti yanmayamiti mayaṭpratyayena jñāpanārthañca praśnaślokā vyakhyāyante |
tatra kimayaṃ śrutavedāntapraśnaḥ; utāśrutavedāntapraśnaḥ iti vikalpe aśrutavedāntasya viśeṣapraśnānupapattiḥ, śrutavedāntasya śrotavyābhāvāt praśnānupapattiriti śaṅkāyāṃ śrutavedāntapraśna ityāha yato vā imānītyādinā | ava tite satītyanena brahmamīmāṃsāśravaṇaṃ kṛtamityuktam || śrutavedāntasya kathaṃ praśnopapattiriti śaṅkāyāṃ śrutavedāntasyetihāsapurāṇaśravaṇavidhiṃ darśayati itihāseti | itihāsetyādi śloke vedaśabdo vedāntaparaḥ | pabraṃhaṇāni, itihāsa purāṇāni uparitana bhāgo vādepavṛhaṇaparāṇīti vibhāgaḥ | sa ca smṛtyadhikaraṇe vyaktībhaviṣyati | tatra dharmaśāstreṣu brahmapratipādanaṃ karmaṇāṃ tadārādhanarūpatvajñāpanārtham; itihāsapurāṇeṣu karmapratipādanaṃ karmaṇāṃ brahmopāsanāṅgatvapratipādanārtham | itihāsasya purāṇebhyo'bhyarhitatvaṃ viśeṣaḥ | alpāctaramiti purāṇaśabdasya pūrvanipāte prāpte, abhyarhitaṃ pūrvaṃ prayoktavyamiti pūrvanipātitasyetihāsasyābhyarhitatvapratīteḥ | asya ślokasya prathamārghaṃ vyācaṣṭe upabṛhaṃhaṇaṃ nāmeti | ṣaṣṭhayantaviśeṣaradvayena āgamotthaṃ vivekajaṃ ca jñānamastītyuktam | tattvārthānāmiti bahuvacanaṃ kapilamatādapi itihāsādīnāṃ prābalyadyotanārtham | vyaktīkaraṇamajñātaviśeṣaiḥ saha svāvagatārtha niṣkarṣaḥ | yathā vedena kartavyatayā vihitasya sandhyopāsanādeḥ śarīraśutaddhiprakāradantadhāvanasnānādiviśeṣaiḥ saha niṣkarṣaḥ, evamupaniṣadbhāge'pyarthaniṣkarṣaḥ sampādyaḥ | upaniṣadarthaniṣkarṣo brahmavicārasiddha iti nopabṛṃhaṇāpekṣeti śaṅkāyāmutta rārdhaṃ vyācaṣṭe sakaloti | pūrvārthavihitopavṛṃhaṇakāryatopapādakamuttarārdham | upabṛṃhaṇaṃ nāma anadhīta śākhāntarārthaiḥ saha adhītaśākhārthaniṣkarṣaḥ | ato nopabṛṃhaṇavicāranairapekṣyamityarthaḥ |
nanu yathā āpātapratītyā phalavadarthāvagamāt karmavicāre, tadanantaraṃ brahmavicāre ca rāgataḥ pravṛttiḥtathā adhīyamānaśākhāntargatena, "anantā vai vedāḥ" iti vākyena vedānāmānantyāvagamādadhītaśākhānavagatānāṃ tadaviruddhānaṃ viruddhānāṃ cārthānāṃ sambhavāt, "smṛteśca", "api smaryate", ityādisūtreṣu vedāntārthanirṇayasyopabṛṃhaṇasāpekṣatvadarśanāccopabṛṃhaṇasāpetatva śravaṇe rāgataḥ pravṛttirupapadyate | tatra pūvarbhāgopabṛṃhaṇeṣu dharmaśāstreṣau śruteṣu upaniṣadbhāgopabṛṃhaṇarūpetihāsapurāṇetvapi rāgātprattṛttiriti vidhivaiyarthyam | aprāpte hi śāstrasyārthavatvam | na ca guroreva śrotavyamiti niyamavidhiḥ; asmin vacane tadvāciśabdābhāvāt | itihāsapurāṇayoḥ śravaṇapravṛttasya etadvacanārthajñānam, tasmāditihāsapurāṇaśravaṇe pravṛttirityanyonyāśrayaśca | ataḥ upabṛṃhayediti vidhiranupapanna iti || satyam; bhāratādiprabandhaviśeṣa śravaṇāya tanmadhyagatenānena vacanena nyāyasiddhaṃ sāmānyata upabṛṃhaṇasyāpekṣitatvamanūdyate | upabṛṃhaṇaṃ kāryamiti vijñāyata ityasyāyamarthaḥ,nyāyasiddhamupabṛṃhaṇasya karaṇīyatvamanena vacanenāpi jñāyata iti | upabṛṃhaṇaṃnāmetyādibhāṣyeṇa nyāyaprāptireva pradarśyate | yadvā samanvayavirodhaparihāralakṣaṇābhyāmeva tattvasthiternniścitatvāt, vastuni viruddhākārāsaṃbhavādadhīyamānaśrutinirṇītaviruddhārthapratipādakapradeśāntarasaṃbhave vedasya bhrānti jalpitāyamānatvaprasaṅgācca nirṇītatattvaviruddhārtha pratipādakapradeśa(prasaṅga)nasaṃbhavāt, brahmaṇyanavagataguṇavibhūtiviśeṣasadbhāve'pyupabṛṃhaṇasahasrairapi tadiyattāpratipādanāyogāt, avagatakatipayaguṇaviśeṣopāsaneṣvanyatamenaiva puruṣārthasiddhayupapatteśca upabaṃhaṇaśravaṇanirapekṣaṃ prati upabṛṃhayediti vidhānaṃ yujyate ||
nanvevaṃ tarhi nyāyānugṛhitavākyāvagateṣvartheṣūpabṛṃhaṇaniṣkraṣṭavyābhāvāt niṣkraṣṭavyāṃśasya sūtrodāhṛtavacanaireva niṣkṛṣṭatvāccopabṛṃhaṇavidhiradṛṣṭārthaḥ syāt | na ca dṛṣṭe saṃbhavati adṛṣṭakalpanaṃ nyāyyam | dṛṣṭārthatvañca vacanaṃ darśayati "māmayaṃ pratariṣyati" iti | vedasya pratāraṇaṃ nāma tadabhipretaviparītārthavarṇanameva | atastannivṛttirūpaṃ dṛṣṭaphalaṃ vācanikam | sati tasmin adṛṣṭakalpanamayuktam | tarhi tadeva dṛṣṭaṃ phalamiti cettadapyayuktam; tattvaviparyāsapratipādanāsaṃbhavasya tvayaivoktatvāt; sākalyena brahmavibhūtyanavagamasya samastatadavāntaraviśeṣānavagamasya ca vedapratāraṇarūpatvābhāvena tannivṛtteḥ phalatvāyogācca ||
ucyate | yadyapi paratattvatadupāsanapratipādaneṣu viparyāsāsaṃbhavaḥtathāpi, "kiṃ te kṛṇvanti kīkaṭeṣu gāvo nāśiraṃ duhre na tapanti gharda(rmya)m | ā no bhara pramagandasya vedo naicāśākhaṃ maghavan randhāyānaḥ" ityādivākyapratipannapramagandādivṛttāntasyeva paramātmasṛjyasuranaratiryagādiviśeṣatadutpattitadvṛttaviśeṣāṇāṃ śruti sāmānyapratītatvena vākyāvivakṣitatvaṃ manyamānaḥ ahalyājārādivākyānāṃ paṇḍitamānibhiritarairuktamarthamiva vedapūrvarbhāgopaniṣadbhāgagatānāṃ mantrārthavādānāmanyathārthatvaṃ manyate cet, aśrutopabṛṃhaṇatayā vedaṃ pratārayatyevāyamiti tatparihārāyopabṛṃhaṇavidhirupapadyata iti | na cānyonyāśrayaḥ; svādhyāyavidhivākyasya svādhyāyāntarbhāve'pi, adhyayanādvidhyavagamaḥ vidhyavagamādadhyayanamiti yathā nānyonyāśrayaḥ, tadvat | tatra hi vidhyabhijñapuruṣapreraṇāt, tadanuṣṭhānadarśanādvā māṇavakapravṛttiḥ | evamupabṛṃhaṇavidhyabhijñaśiṣṭajanavādaprasiddhayā, tadabhijñasvaguruvacanena vā,
tenopabṛṃhaṇādhigamapravṛttapuruṣāntaradarśanādvā upabṛṃhaṇajñānasya saṃpādyatājñānāt śiṣyasya praśnaḥ upapadyate | ata upabṛṃhaṇavidhirupapannaḥ |
tatra svaguroḥ parāśarasya sārvajñyaprasiddheḥ tenaiva sarvavidyāsthaleṣu svasya kṛtaśikṣatvācca maitreyasya tatpraṇītapurāṇaśravaṇapravṛttyupapattiḥ |
purāṇāntarebhyo'sya purāṇasya vaiṣamyaṃ vadan praśnān avatārayati tatreti | asya tāvat purāṇaratnasya prācyodīcyādisarvavidvajjanaviditasya purāṇāntarebhyo'pi prasiddhiprācuryāt, dharmaśastreṣu mānavasyeva, vyākaraṇeṣu pāṇinīyasyeva ca sajātīyaprabandhebhyaḥ prakarṣātiśayo nāpahnotuṃ śakyate | tata eva prasiddhiprācuryāt kaurmāderiva naṣṭakośatvaśaṅkā dūrotsāritā | anativistaratvācca prakṣepaśaṅkā nāvatarati | anyaparoktiprasiddhaparigrahātiśayaṃ cedam "ṣaḍai parāsarasaddam" (paṭhati parāśaraśabdam ) iti |
"agneḥ śivasya māhātmyaṃ tāmaseṣu prakīrtyate | rājaseṣu ca māhātmyamadhikaṃ brahmaṇo viduḥ || sāttvikeṣvatha kalpeṣu māhātmyamadhikaṃ hareḥ | teṣveva yogasaptaṃsiddhā gamiṣyanti paraṃ gatim | yasmin kalpe tu yat proktaṃ purāṇaṃ brahmaṇā purā | tasya tasya tu māhātmyaṃ tatsvarūpeṇa varṇyate" iti samyajjñānaniṣpādakasattvamūlatvāt, anyathājñānaviparītajñānahetubhūtarajastamomūlatvābhāvāt duṣṭakāraṇapurāṇāntarasāmyaṃ na saṃbhāvanīyam | sattvasya yathārthajñāna hetutvaṃ rajastamasoścānyathājñānaviparītajñānahetutvam, "sattvāt sañjāyate jñānam", "ayathāvatprajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha! rājasī", "sarvārthān viparītāṃśca buddhiḥ sā pārtha! tāmasī" iti ca vacanāt prasiddham | "sattvaṃ laghu prakāśakamiṣṭam upaṣṭambhakaṃ calaṃ ca rajaḥ | guru varaṇakameva tamaḥ" iti, "sarvāstā niṣphalāḥ pretya tamoniṣṭhā hi tāḥ smṛtāḥ" iti ca prasiddham ||
nanu caturmukhaśivādipratipādakapurāṇānāṃ rajastamomūlatvaparavacanasya rajastamomūlatvena prāṇāṇyābhāvāt sāttvikapurāṇaprābalyāsiddhiḥ | asya vacanasya sattvamūlatve pramāṇaṃ nāsti | ata eva tadvacanamātrasyāprāmāṇyaṃ vaktuṃ yuktam, na bahūnāṃ purāṇānām; bhūyasāṃ balīyastvāt || ucyate | na tāvadasya vacanasya prāmāṇye vimatirnyāyyā; bādhakādarśanāt svatassiddhaprāmāṇyasyānapoditatvāt | "yo ha khalu vā asya rājasoṃśaḥ, so'sau brahmacāriṇo yo'yaṃ brahmā | yo ha khalu vā asya sāttvikoṃśaḥ, so'sau brahmacāriṇo yo'yaṃ viṣṇuḥ | yo ha khalu vā asya tāmasoṃ'śaḥ, so'sau brahmacāriṇo yo'yaṃ rudraḥ" iti, "mahān prabhurvai puruṣaḥ sattvasyaiṣa pravartakaḥ" iti ca śrutyānuguṇyena tattadguṇamayatvenāvagatasya tattattattvasya tattatkalpeṣu tattadguṇamayena brahmaṇā teṣu teṣu purāṇeṣu pratipāditatva parasya vacanasyopapannārtatvācca | sakalaśāstrārthavyavasthāpake mahābhārate ca mokṣadharme, "jāyamānaṃ hi puruṣaṃ yaṃ paśyenmadhusūdanaḥ | sāttvikaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ sa vai mokṣārthacintakaḥ (niścayaḥ)" ityādinā bhagavatkaṭākṣeṇa sattvaguṇamūlasamyagjñānaniścayamuktvā, "paśyatyenaṃ jāyamānaṃ brahmā rudro'thavā punaḥ | rajasā tamasā cāsya mānasaṃ samabhiplu tam" iti caturmukhaśivāyoḥ kaṭākṣeṇa rajastamomūlakāluṣyapratipādanācca caturmukhaśivapratipādakaprabandhānāṃ rajastamomūlatvamupapadyate | asya vacanasya rajastamomūlapurāṇasthatve'pi nāprāmāṇyaṃ śaṅkanīyam,brahmaśivādipratipādanābhiniviṣṭasya prabandhasya bhagavatprakarṣoktau āgrahāsaṃbhavenāsya vacanasya tattvaparatvopapatteḥ | svapratipādyadevatāyāmeva hi vakturāgrahasaṃbhavaḥ, na tvanyatra| tasmānnāsya vacanasya kāraṇadoṣasaṃbhavaḥ |
yaduktamanekapurāṇāprāmāṇyāt etadvacanamātrāprāmāṇyaṃ yuktam; bhūyasāṃ balīṃyastvādititadayuktam; sākṣādarthavirodhābhāvāt | na hi vidhiśivapratipādakaprabandhānāṃ rajastamomūlatvaṃ neti teṣu purāṇeṣvavagamyate || tattatprabandheṣveva pramāṇatayā pratipannānāṃ teṣāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ rajastamomūlatvaṃ ca viruddhamiti paramparayā virodhaḥ phalitaḥ; tatra bhūyasāṃ balīyastvamiti cetyadi kevalametadvavacanamātravirodhena teṣāmaprāmāṇyam, tadā syādayaṃ doṣaḥ | purā ṇānā parasparavirodhena sarveṣāmaviśeṣeṇa prāmāṇye'nupapanne, sarvāprāmāṇyādapi katipayaprāmāṇyasiddhayanuguṇani rvāhe nyāyye sati, kasyāprāmāṇyaṃ kasya ca prāmāṇyamityapekṣāyāṃ viṣayavyavasthāmātraparatvādasya vacanasya | ato 'nena sattvādimūlatve jñāpite sati aduṣṭamūlaiḥ prabandhairduṣṭamūlaprabandhabādhaḥ | ato na bhūyasāṃbalīyastvanayena tadvacanabādhaḥ || bhagavatpratipādakapurāṇebhyo vidhiśivapratipādakapurāṇabāhulyāt tatprāmāṇyamiti cet,idaṃ tāvat vacanamabādhitam; iha bhūyasāṃbalīyastvanayānavatārāt | evaṃ bādhakarahitenānena vacanena sattvādimūlatve purāṇānāmavagate sati duṣṭamūlapurāṇabāhulyamaduṣṭamūlamekamapi purāṇaṃ na bādhituṃ prabhavati | na hi bhrāntapuruṣasahasravacanairekasyābhrāntasya vacanaṃ bādhyate | ato bhagavatpratipādakatvena sattvamūlatvānna kāraṇadoṣaḥ |
tathā purāṇāntarāṇāmivāsya bādhakapratyayo na dṛśyate; nārāyaṇasyaiva paramakāraṇatvapratipādanāt | pratyakṣaśrutiṣu hi nārāyaṇasyaiva sāmānyaśabdaviśeṣaśabdābhyāṃ kāraṇatvamukatvā, "na cāsya kaścijjanitā na cādhiṣaḥ", "na tatsamaścābhyadhikaśca dṛśyate", "na hyetasmāditi netyanyatparamasti", "yasmātparaṃ nāparamasti kiñcit" iti kāraṇabhūtāt tasmādanyasya paratvaṃ ca niṣidhyate | " na brahmā neśānaḥ", "tatra brahmā cartumukho'jāyata", "tryakṣaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ puruṣo'jāyata", "tato yajña ugrastveṣa nṛmṇaḥ", "virūpākṣāya...brahmaṇaḥ putrāya", "ajasya nābhāvadhyekamarpitam", "sa prajāpatirekaḥ puṣkaraparṇe samabhavat", "yannābhipadmādabhavanmahātmā prajāpatiḥ" iti brahmaśivayośca nārāyaṇādutpattiḥ śrūyate | laiṅge tu brahmaviṣṇū prati, "yuvāṃ prasūtau gātrebhyo mama pūrvaṃ sanātanau" iti rudroktyā rudrāt haricaturmukhayorutpattyavagamāt purāṇāntarāṇāṃ śrutivirodhaḥ sphuṭataraḥ | yadyapi kaiścit trayāṇāṃ devānāṃ sāmyamaikyaṃ cābhyupagatam, tatrāpyayaṃ virodho duṣpariharaḥ; tulyānāmekībhūtānāmapi teṣāmutpattipratipādane bhagavataścaturmukhaśivayorutpattiśrava ṇāt rudrāditarayorutpatteḥ kkacidapi vākye śravaṇābhāvācca | kāraṇavāciśivādiśabdānāmākāśādiśabdānāmiva kāryatayā'vagataprasiddharudrādiparatvābhāvācca | "sarve viṣṇumayā vedāḥ sarve viṣṇumayā ga(gu)ṇāḥ | na hi ;viṣṇu samā kācidgatiranyā vidhīyate | ityevaṃ satataṃ vedā gāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ ||" iti laiṅgādāvapi vedānāṃ bhagavatparatvapratipādakatvābhyupagamācca | ato nārāyaṇasyaiva paramakāraṇatvaparābhiḥ pratyakṣaśrutibhirbādhakapratyayavadvayaḥ purāṇāntarebhyo vailakṣaṇyaṃ sphuṭam |
tathā nārāyaṇameva paramakāraṇaṃ pratipādayadbhirmānavādidharmaśāstrairaṣyaikārthyaṃ spaṣṭam | "āpo nārā iti proktāḥ, "tadvisṛṣṭaḥ sa puruṣo loke brahmeti kārtyate", "vidyāttu puruṣaṃ param", "nārāyaṇaḥ paro'vyaktāt" ityādibhirnārāyaṇasyaiva hi kāraṇatvaṃ teṣūcyate | purāṇāntarāṇi tu dharmaśāstraviruddhāni ca | tathā vaktṛvailakṣaṇyaṃ ca pratyakṣaśrutisiddham, "sa hovāca vyāsaḥ parāśaryaḥ" iti | atra parāśarātmajatvena hi vyāsotkaṣar ucyate | tathā laiṅge'pi parāśaravailakṣaṇyaṃ pratīyate; yathā tatra dvitīye'dhyāye, "parāśarasyāvatāro vyāsasya ca śukasya ca | vināśaṃ rākṣasā nāṃ tu kṛtaṃ vai śaktisūnunā" iti | atra parāśarasyāvatāraḥ ityuktirhi prakarṣātiśayārthā | anyathā "parāśarasya cotpattirvyāsasya ca śukasya ca" ityapi hi vaktuṃ śakyate |
pulastyavasiṣṭhavaradānalabdhaparadevatāpāramārthyajñānavattvaṃ ca mahat vailakṣaṇyam | varadāne sati etatpurāṇapramāṇyam tatprāmāṇye sati tatpratipannavaralābhasatyatvamityanyonyāśraya iti na vācyam; varalābhavacanasya "parā śaro na labdhavaraḥ" iti bādhakapratyayābhāvena svatassiddhaprāmāṇyasyānapoditatvāt | laiṅgai ca devatāpāramārthyajñānalābhaḥ parāśarasyāvagamyate | yathā tatra dvitīye'dhyāye, "devatāparāmārthyaṃ ca vijñānaṃ ca prasādataḥ | purāṇakaraṇaṃ caiva pulastyasyājñayā guroḥ" iti | tatraiva triṣaṣṭitame'dhyāye, "atha tasya pulastyasya vasiṣṭhasya ca dhīmataḥ | prasādā dvaiṣṇavaṃ cakre purāṇaṃ vai parāśaraḥ" iti ca | tadanantaraṃ ca, "ṣaṭprakāraṃ samastārthasādhakajñānasaṃśrayam | daśasāhastrama sitaṃ sarvavedārthasaṃyutam" ityanenāsya purāṇaratnasya sarvavedārthasaṃyutatvam, ata eva samastapuruṣārthasādhakajñānaprasādha katvaṃ cocyate | ato vaktṛvailakṣaṇyaṃ prabandhavailakṣaṇyaṃ ca purāṇāntarasiddhamiti tat durapahnavam |
idaṃ cāparaṃ sumahat vailakṣaṇyamyat sāmānyapraśnapūrvakaviśeṣaniṣṭhaprativacanarūpatvam, "so'hamicchāmi dharmajña! śrotuṃ tvatto yathā jagat | babhūva bhūyaśca yathā māhabhāga! bhaviṣyati | yanmayaṃ ca jagat brahmana! yataścaitaccarā caram ||" ityādinā sāmānyena pṛṣṭe, "viṣṇoḥ sakāśadudbhūtam" iti viśeṣaniṣṭhaprativacanaṃ hyavagamyate | viśeṣe pṛṣṭe sati, prativacanasya pṛṣṭaviśeṣapakṣapātena tadutkarṣakathanaṃ prasasāmātram, na tattvaparamiti śaṅkanīyaṃ syāt | sāmānyena pṛṣṭe sati prativacanamarthavaśādviśeṣeparyavasitamiti tattvaparatvameva syāt | ataśca, "tasmādbhavantaṃ pṛcchāmaḥ sūta! paurāṇikādya tu | purāṇasaṃhitāṃ puṇyāṃ liṅgamāhātmyasaṃyutām" iti viśeṣaniṣṭhapraśnopakramatatprativacanarūpapurāṇāntarebhyaḥ prakarṣātiśayaḥ spaṣṭatamaḥ |
etatpurāṇārthaśca laiṅgādiṣu kvacit kvacidaṅgīkriyate | yathā laiṅgai dvitīye purāṇārthānukramaṇe, "sarvāvarteṣu viṣṇośca jananaṃ līlayaiva tu | viṣṇoḥ prasādājjiṣṇośca viṣṇoścaiva tu sambhavaḥ ||", tatra līlayā caiva kṛṣṇena svakulasya ca saṃhṛtiḥ | jarakāstracchalenaiva gamanaṃ svecchayaiva tu" iti | bhagavadavatārasya bhūlokaparityāgasya ca līlāmātranibandhanatvaṃ hi tatrocyate | ata eva etatpurāṇārthasya anyatrābhyupagatatvādaprakāmpyatvamavagamyate || tarhi etadaikārthyāt tānyapi purāṇāni pramāṇāni syuriti cenna; kātsarnyenāviruddhatvābhāvāt | bhagavadutkaṣarpratipādakāṃśastu āgrahāsaṃbhavādādaraṇīya iti pūrvamevoktam | asya ca purāṇaratnasya kārtsnenā'nāgrahamūlatvaṃ copakramagatapraśnasvābhāvyādavagatamiti coktam || ato'nyatra baddhāgrahairapyādaraṇīyasvoktārthatvamaprakampyatāhetuḥ |
kiñca purāṇāntareṣvivāsya purāṇasya na svavyāhatārthapratipādakatvaṃ dṛśyate; kārtsnena bhagavatprakarṣasyaivāvagamāt | purāṇāntareṣu vyāghātaḥ pratīyate; yathā laiṅge, "yuvāṃ prasūtau gātrebhyo mama pūrvaṃ sanātanau | ayaṃ me dakṣiṇe pārśve brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | vāmapārśve ca me viṣṇuvirśvātmā hṛdayodbhavaḥ" iti | tatra, "tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ sumanāḥ praṇipatya maheśvaram | prāha nārāyaṇo devaḥ saliṅga liṅgavarjitam | yadi prītiḥ samutpannā yadi deyo varaśca nau | bhaktirbhavatu nau nityaṃ tvayi cāvyabhicāriṇī" iti hariviriñcayoḥ śivādutpattitadārādhanavaravaraṇādikamuktam | tatra kvacit, "tvatkopasambhavo rudrastamasā ca samāvṛttaḥ | tvatprasādājjagaddhātā rajasā ca pitāmahaḥ" iti caturmukhaśivayorbhagavatprasādakopasambhavatvamuktamiti svavyāghātaḥ | na ca vasudevāderutpattivat kailāsayātrādivacca rudrādutpattitadārādhanarūpalīloktirityavirodheḥ; purāṇaratnabhāratādau, "manasaiva jagatsṛṣṭiṃ saṃhāraṃ ca karoti yaḥ | tasyāripakṣakṣapaṇe kiyānudyamavistaraḥ | tathāpi yo manuṣyāṇāṃ dharmastadanuvartanam | kurvan valavatā sandhiṃ hīnairyuddhaṃ karo tyasau | sāma cāpi pradānaṃ ca tathā bhedapradaśarnam | karoti daṇḍapātaṃ ca kvacide(vaṃ?) palāyanam | manuṣyadehināṃ ceṣṭāmityevamanuvartate | līlā jagatpatestasya cchandataḥ saṃpratartate | īśannapi mahāyogī sarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ | karmāṇyārabhate kartuṃ kīnāśa iva durbalaḥ | tena vañcayate lokān māyāyogena keśavaḥ | ye tameva prapadyante na te muhyanti mānavāḥ ||" ityādibhiriva tatra tatra prasaktāpakarṣaparihāragranthādarśanāt; bhāratādiṣu daśarathavasudevādīnāṃ rāmakṛṣṇādyapekṣayā paratvasya jagatkāraṇatvādimukhena pratipādanābhāvāt, iha ca bhagavadapekṣayā rudraparatvasya pratipādanācca | ataḥ svavyāghāto duṣpariharaḥ | na ca tathā atra svavyāhatiḥ pratiyata iti idañca mahadvailakṣaṇyam | uktalakṣaṇaprakarṣavato vaiṣṇavapurāṇasya kāraṇadoṣabādhakapratyayasvavyāhatimatprabandhāntarasya ca virodhe sati purāṇaratnasya prābalyam, anyeṣāṃ daubarlyaṃ ca suspaṣṭam |
evaṃ prasiddhayatiśayalabdhasajātīyaprabandhaprakarṣavattvāt, tata eva naṣṭakośatvābhāvāt, anativistṛtayā prakṣepaśaṅkārahitatvāt, anyaparokti(pra)siddhiparigrahātiśayavattvāt, sāmānyapraśnapūrvaprativacanarūpatvena anāgrahamūlatvāt, ata evedṛśavailakṣaṇyarahitakāraṇadoṣabādhakapratyayasvavyāhatimatprabandhāntarāṇāmetadvirodhe sati dorbalyasyāvarjanīyatvācca śrīmadvaiṣṇavamidaṃ purāṇaṃ pramāṇatamam | etat sarvaṃ hetujātamabhipretya pradhānabhūtayuktaṃ kaṇṭhokatyā pradarśayan tanmukhena prabandhavailakṣaṇyaṃ vadan praśnamavatārayatitatreti | pulastyavasiṣṭhavarapradānalabdhaparadevatāpāramārthyajñānavata ityatra devatāpāramārthyaśabdena tamaḥkāryaṃ dharmyantaratvena dharmyantarasya pratītirūpaṃ viparītajñānaṃ vyāvarti tam | anena devatāpāramārthyaṃ ceti vacanaṃ smā(spho)ritam | praśaṃsārthena matuppratyayena rajaḥkāryaṃ prakārāntaropetasya tadviruddhaprakārāntaraviśiṣṭatāpratītirūpamanyathājñānaṃ vyāvartitam | anena yathāvadityasyārthaḥ sūcito bhavati | devatāśabdena karmaṇā upāsanena vā ārādhyatvaṃ phalapradatvaṃ ca vivakṣitam | anena saviśeṣatvasiddhiḥ | yathāvaditi prakārakathanenāpi saviśeṣatvasiddhiḥiti varalābhakathanaṃ saviśeṣatvopapādakamityabhiprāyaḥ | bhagavacchabdena jñānavattvamuktam | varalābhāt tadatiśayasiddhiḥ | so'hamityādi | so'hamtvayaiva sarvavidyāsu śikṣitapūrvo'hamiti bhāvaḥ | dharmajña"viśeṣo'sti na satāṃ śiṣyaputrayoḥ" ityevarūpadharmajña | yadvā "ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmaḥ" iti dharmajña | ānṛśaṃsyamāśritasaṃrakṣaṇaparatvam | "āśritetyānṛśaṃsyataḥ" iti vacanāt | mahābhāga | paripūrṇakṛtyaṃ hi parasaṃrakṣaṇam | kiñcitkāramapyanapekṣya rakṣakastvameveti bhāvaḥ | yathā yato babhūva | brahmarudrāṃdiṣu kaḥ kāraṇamiti jñātuṃ yata iti praśnaḥ | kiṃ vivartādhiṣṭhānatvaṃ kāraṇatvam, uta pariṇāmitvam? tatrāpi kiṃ sadvārakapariṇāmitvam, utādvārakapariṇāmitvamiti prakārabhedajijñāsayā yatheti praśnaḥ | kalpabhedena sṛṣṭivaiṣamyaśaṅkayā bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ | vṛścikasya gomayavṛścikopādānakatvadarśanāt kalpabhedena upādānādibhedaśaṅkā hyupapadyate | tatrāpi yato yatheti padayoḥ pūvarvadarthaḥ | yato yathā vabhūveti ekapraśnatvaśaṅkā yanmayamiti praśnāntaravyavadhānena nirasyate | (taccha ?) yathā kāraṇaṃ jñātavyam, tathā sṛṣṭiprakāro'pi prathag jñātavya iti jñāpanārtham | jñātavyatve'pi prādhānyadyotanāya prakārapraśnaḥ pūrvameva kṛtaḥ | yata iti hetau pañcamī | ato nimittopādānayostantreṇa praśnaḥ | antassthityādyupayuktātmaśarīrabhāvapraśnaḥ yanmayamiti | mayaṭpratyayaḥ prācuryārthaḥ | anena vyāptirdaśitā | vyāpyāt vyāpakaprācurthaṃ hi ghaṭākāśādau dṛṣṭam | ātmatayā hi vyāptiḥ | ātmatvañca dhārakatvam | ato'ntaryāmikṛtasattānuvṛttilakṣaṇasthitipraśnaḥ phalitaḥ | yanmayam | yenāntaryāmiṇā dhārakeṇa pracuraṃ jagat sthitamityartha ukto bhavati | antaḥ pravi śya praśāsanena dhārakatvaṃ sthitihetutvamiti hi prāgeva viśadīkṛtam | caśabdāt bahirbhūtapoṣakādikṛtā poṣaṇādilakṣaṇā sthitiḥ, mātāpitrādibhiḥ kāryā iṣṭaprāpaṇāniṣṭanivāraṇalakṣaṇā sthitiśca pṛṣṭā bhavati | yata ityupādānasyāpi pṛṣṭatvāt mayaṭ prācuryārtha eva | na ca govalīvardanyāyena yata iti pañcamyarthaḥ saṅkocayitavyaḥ, balīvardaśabdavat mayaṭo'nanyathāsidvatvābhāvāt saṅkocakatvānupapatteḥ | padāntaravaiyarthyaparijihīrṣayā padāntarārthasaṅkoco gobalībardanaya iti hi nyāyavidaḥ | atra tu mayaṭo'rthāntarasaṃbhavāt nāyaṃ saṅkocakaḥ | yata iti padaṃ nimittamupādānaṃ ca bodhayituṃ śaktam | sthitipraśno'pekṣitaśca | ato'pekṣitavidheranapekṣitavidhānaṃ durbalam | "yato vā imāni" ityādiśrutāvapi yata iti padenaiva nimittopādānayoruktatvāt śruticchāyānuvidhānācca yata iti tantreṇa praśna iti,
yanmayamiti sthitipraśna eva kriyate | arthāntarasvīkāre apekṣitāvacanamanapekṣitavacanaṃ ca syāt | nāpi svā rthiko mayaṭaśra; pratyayasyārthavattve saṃbhavati | tatparityāgasyānyāyyatvāt | ato yathokta evārthaḥ | layasthānapraśno layaprakārapraśnaśca anadhītaśākhāntareṣu sthānabhedaprakārabhedaśaṅkayā kṛtaḥ | devatāntarasya layasthānatvaṃ tatrāpi sadvārakatvādvārakatva kāyarbhramanivṛttirūpatākhyaprakārabhedaśca hi śaṅkāspadaṃ bhavati | bhūtabhaviṣyatpraśnaśca kalpabhedena layasthānaprakārabhedaśaṅkayā kṛtaḥ | cakārāt layakartṛpraśnaśca sūcitaḥ | sa ca kartṛbhedaśaṅkānibandhanaḥ | svarūpapraśnaślokadvayaṃ vyācikhyāsitaślokāpekṣitatvenodāhṛtya ādiśabdena praśnāntaraślokāḥ kroḍīkṛtāḥ | viṣṇossakāśā diti ślokasyārthāntarapraśnottararūpatvaśaṅkāvyudāsārthaṃ teṣāṃ ślokānāmarthaṃ saṃgraheṇāha atreti | brahmasvarūpeti svarūpaśabdo vibhūtyādivyāvartakaḥ | svarūpaviśeṣaśabdo brahmādivyāvartakaḥ | vibhūtibhedānāṃ prakāro vibhūtibhedapra kāraḥ | sa ca jyotiścakrabhuvanakośādipraśne'ntargataḥ | varṇāśramadharmādipraśnena tadārādhanasvarūpaṃ pṛṣṭam; prativacane phalaviśeṣoktidarśanāt | "prativacanaprakāreṇa praśnārtho vijñāyate" iti nītyā phalaviśeṣaścātra pṛṣṭo bhavatīti pūrvokteṣu praśnepvantarbhāvita ityabhiprāyeṇa phalaviśeṣāśca pṛṣṭā ityuktam | saprayojanamārādhanaṃ pṛṣṭamiti tatra tadantarbhāvaḥ | ayamevārthaḥ sakalaśrutītihāsapurāṇānāṃ pratipādya iti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kiṃ prastutaślokārthasyetyapekṣāyāṃ yanmayamiti padasyārthaṃ sopapattikamāha brahmasvarūpeti | sṛṣṭisthitilayakarmabhūtamiti padaṃ sṛṣṭipralayayoruktatvena sthitikathanasyāpekṣitatvajñāpanārtham | sthitilayaśabdābhyāṃ rakṣāsaṃhārau vivakṣitau; sthitilayayoḥ prayojyavyāpāratvena tadāśrayatvena tatkarmatvābhāvājjagataḥ | sṛṣṭisthitilayakarmabhūtaṃ jagat sthityarthaṃ kimātmakaṃ bhavatīti praśnārthaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha tasyaceti | jagacca sa iti sāmānādhikaraṇyapratipannaṃ tādātmyaṃ svarūpaikyalakṣaṇamāśaṅkaya pariharati idaṃ ceti | idamsāmānādhikaraṇyapratipannamityarthaḥ | gaganādau vyāptimātreṇa tādātmyaṃ na dṛṣṭamiti tadvayāvṛttyarthamātmatvaṃ vivṛṇoti antaryāmirūpeṇeti | antaḥpraviśya niyantṛtvaṃ hyātmatvam | vyāpyavyāpakayoriti | jagadbrahmaṇorvyāṣyatvena vyāpakatve ca śrutisiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ | na tu vastvaikyakṛtamiti pratijñāmupapādayati yanmayamiti | vikārārthatvamāśaṅkaya pariharati yanmayamiti mayaḍiti | kuta ityatrāha pṛthagiti vikārārthatve upā dānaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ syāt | na ca tat praṣṭavyam; yata iti pañcamyantapadena upādānasyāpi pṛṣṭatvāt | ataḥ pṛthakpraśnavaiyarthyam | na ca gobalīvardanyāyaḥ, arthāntarasaṃbhavāditi | apekṣitavidheranapekṣitavidhānaṃ durbalamiti nyāyaścābhipretaḥ | brahmājñānavādino'bhimataṃ svārthikatvapakṣaṃ dūṣayati nāpīti | na tu bhedābhedapakṣābhyupagatam | tattu dūṣayiṣyate | na hyarthe saṃbhavati nirarthakatvāśrayaṇamupapannamiti bhāvaḥ | śrutārthasvīkāreṇāśrutakalpanaṃ hyucitam; na tu śrutaparityāgaḥ | brahmājñānavādinā'bhyupagatasya svāthirkatvasya asādhāraṇaṃ dūṣaṇamāhajagaditi | svārthikatvapakṣe yadidaṃ jagat tatkimityuktaṃ syāt | yadidaṃ jagat tatkimityukte jñātasya jagadrūpamātrasya praṣṭavyatvāyogāt praśnāvaiyartyāya, tat kiṃ satyam uta mithyā iti pṛṣṭaṃ bhavatītyabhyupetavyam | tatra mithyetyuttaraṃ vaktavyam | tatrānyatarākāropasthāpake ākārāntaraniṣedhake ca śabde vaktavye ākāradvayopasthāpakaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamanupapannamityarthaḥ | bādhārthaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti cettannāsti, mātā me vandhyetivat "sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bādhārtham" iti vyāhatatvāditi bhāvaḥ | tarhi kathamuttaraṃ syādityatrāha tadā hīti | viṣṇurityanyatarākāropasthāpakaḥ śabdaḥ, ākārāntaraniṣedhakaśabda evakāraḥ | sākṣādarthamāha ata iti | ataḥsvārthikatvavikārārthatvayoranupapannatvādityarthaḥ | śabdānuśāsanānumarti darśayati taditi | prakṛtamprakarṣeṇa kṛtam; prabhūtam; pracuramityarthaḥ | "annamayo yajñaḥ", "śakaṭamayī yātrā" iti hi tasyodāharaṇam | kimatra prācuryamastītyatrāha kṛtsnañceti | antarbahiśca vyāpyetyādiśrutestadupapannamiti bhāvaḥ |
sāmānādhikaraṇyasya śarīrātmabhāvanibandhanatvaṃ pratipipādāyiṣitamupasaṃharati tasmāditi || yanmayamityasya prācuryārthatvena tasyottaratvāt jagacca sa iti sāmānādhikaraṇyasya śarīrātmabhāvanibandhanatvam; tena svārthikatvanivṛttyā yanmayamiti mayaṭpratyayasya pracuryārthatvamityanyonyāśraya iti cetnaivam; mayaṭpratyayasya svarthikatvanivṛtteḥ prācuryārthatvanirṇayasya ca sāmānādhikaraṇyasya śarīrātmabhāvanibandhanatvānapekṣatvāt | svārthikatvaṃ tāvat arthavattve saṃbha vati nirarthakatvasvīkārāyogādapāstam; jagacca sa iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena ca apāstam | svārthikatve sati ākāradvayopasthāpaka sāmānādhikaraṇyasyottaratvāyogāt; na tu śarīrātmabhāvanibandhanatvāyogāt | na ca sāmānādhikaraṇyasya pravṛttinimittabhūtākāradvayopasthāpakatvaṃ mayaṭpratyayasya svārthikatvanivṛttisāpekṣam, sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇasvabhāvādeva tasyākāradvayopasthāpakatvasiddheḥ | ato mayaṭpratyayasya svārthikatvanivṛttiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasyākāradvayopasthāpakatvādityatra nānyonyāśrayaḥ | evaṃ svārthikatve vyudaste, pṛthak praśnavaiyarthyena vikārārthatve'nupapanne, pariśeṣācca sthiteḥ praṣṭavyatve sati, sthitisvābhāvyāt anuśāsanānurodhācca mayaṭpratyayasya prācuryarūpārthaviśeṣaparatvasiddhiḥ | tato jagacca sa iti sāmānādhikaraṇyasya śarīrātmabhāvarūpapravṛttinimittaviśeṣasiddhiriti nānyonyāśrayaḥ | evaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyasya mṛṣāvādyabhimataikyaparatve mayaḍānarthakyaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattiśceti dūṣaṇadvayam, svarūpaikyaparatve'rthavirodhaḥ yanmayamityuktapraśnottaratvānupapattiśceti dūṣaṇadvayaṃ ca darśitaṃ bhavati | svoktārthaparatvānabhyupagame dūṣaṇamāha anyatheti | anyathā kathaṃ praśnaprativacane syātāmityatrāha tathā hi satīti |
sāmānādhikaraṇyasya bhedābhedavādyabhyupagataikadravyatāparatvaṃ dūṣayati jagaditi | asminnapi pakṣe jagat yanmayaṃjagat yaddravyamiti pṛṣṭaṃ syāt | tadānīṃ mayaḍvaiyarthyamastīti draṣṭavyam; yata ityupādānasya pṛṣṭatvāt | adhikaṃ dūṣaṇamāha satyetyādinā | satyasaṅkalpetyādinā jīvagatadoṣaḥ, sarvāśubhetyādinā prakṛtigatadoṣaśca brahmaṇi prasajyata ityuktam | yadvā ubhayaliṅgakatvahānirviparītākāraprāptiścetyarthaḥ | śarīravācipadasya śarīri paratve mukhyatvaṃ na syādityatrāha ātmaśarīreti | sthāpyatesthāpayiṣyata ityarthaḥ | anantarabhāvitvāt sthāpyata ityuktam |
evaṃ prakṛtaślokavyākhyānaupayikārthaḥ prapañcitaḥ | atha śāstrātharsaṃgrahānantaraṃ vistaropakrame saptaślokīṃ namaskāraviṣayāmavatārya vyākhyeyaślokasya namaskāraślokāntaraiḥ saṅgatiṃ darśayitum avikārāyetyādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ vākyārthamāha ata iti | ataḥpraśnaprativacanāditiḥ śāstrasya savibhūtikasaguṇavastuparatvāvagamāt, sāmānādhikaraṇyasya viśiṣṭavastuni mukhyavṛttatvācceti bhāvaḥ | ata ityasya vyaṣṭirūpeṇāvasthitaṃ ca namaskarotītyanenānvayaḥ | yadvā śāstravākyārthasyaivaṃrūpatvāt "viṣṇoḥ sakāśāt" ityasya saṅgraharūpatvam, "paraḥ parāṇām" ityādīnaṃ vistārarūpatvaṃ ca siddhamityarthaḥ | viṣṇoḥ sakāśādityatra sakāśāditi padaṃ ṣaṣṭhayāḥ pañcamyarthatvasaṃpādanārtham | yathā asya kṛte ityukte, kṛte iti śabdasya caturthyarthatvasaṃpādanaparatvamtadvat | yadvā sakāśātsasaṅkalpāt | kāśanamprakāśanam, saṅkalparūpajñānam; tadvata ityarthaḥ | anena nimittatvasiddhiḥ | yadvā sakāśaśabdaḥ pārśvava canaḥ | tena śarīramupalakṣitam | "so'bhidhyāya śarīrātsvāt " itivat śarīrādityarthaḥ | tatraiva ca sthitamiti layasthānapraśnottaram | tatra sthitamiti sthitamniṣṭhāṃ gatam | anena jagato nityatvam avasthānāmāgamāpāyitvaṃ ca sūcitam | layasthānapraśnasyottaramuktam; atha layakartṛpraśnasya bāhyasthitipraśnasya cottaramāha sthitīti | jagacca sa iti, yanmayamiti phalitasya kṛtsnāntaryāmirūpakṛtasattānuvṛttilakṣaṇasthitipraśnasyottaram | yadvā yanmayamiti phalitasthitipraśnasyāpi sthitisaṃyamakartetyevottaram | jagacca sa iti tu yanmayamiti kaṇṭhoktasyātharsyottaram | idaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamātmatayā vyāptinibandhanamiti pūrvamevopapāditam ||
nanu niṣkarṣakaśabdānāṃ śaukalyādīnāṃ dharmiparyantatvaṃ na dṛṣṭam | yanmayaṃ jagadityanena jagacchabdasya niṣkarṣakaśabdatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti dharmiparyantābhidhāyitvābhāvāt jagacca sa iti sāmānādhikaraṇyamanupapannamiti cetucyate | niṣkarṣakaśabdā hi dvividhāḥ, niyataniṣkarṣakāḥ vaivakṣikaniṣkarṣakāśca | tatra śauklayādiśabdā niyataniṣkarṣakāḥ; manuṣyaśuklādiśabdā vaivakṣikanekarṣakāḥ; prayogasya niyāmakatvāt | anyathā niṣkarṣakāniṣkarṣakavibhāgo'pi nopapadyate | tathā jagacchabdo'pi vaivakṣikaniṣkarṣaka iti |ata eva yanmayamiti vaiyadhikaraṇyena praśnasya jagacca sa iti sāmānādhikaraṇyenottaramarthabhedābhāvādupapannam; śuklaguṇasya āśrayaḥ kaḥ iti praśnasya śuklaḥ paṭaḥ ityutta ravat | evaṃ saṅkṣepeṇoktasya vakṣyamāṇamahāvistarasyārthasyeṣadvistararūpeṇa ślokairnamaskāraḥ kriyata iti namaskāraślokasaṅgatiḥ | svainaiva rūpeṇāvasthitamnatu prakṛtyādiviśiṣṭamityarthaḥ | parabrahmaṇo hi heyasaṃbandhābhāvaḥ, na tu viṣṇoriti śaṅkāyām "viṣṇunāmā sa vedeṣu", "samastaheyarahitaṃ viṣṇvākhyaṃ paramaṃ padam" iti vacanāt brahmaṇa eva viṣṇuśabdavācyatvāt viṣṇoreva bhagavacchabdavācyatvācca viṣṇārheyasambandho'nupapanna ityabhiprāyeṇa parabrahmabhūtamityādiviśeṣaṇamuktam |
avikārāya | vikāraśabdo dharmiparo dharmaparaśca; "ṣoḍaśakaśca vikāraḥ" ityādiprayogāt | svayaṃ kasyacidvikārabhūtaḥkāyarbhūto na bhavatītyavikāraḥ | anena kāryācidvayāvṛtti| | yadvā vikāraḥavasthā mahatvāhaṅkāratvādiḥ; nityaṃ tatsambandhavirahādavikāraḥ | ato vikāravatī prakṛtiravikārapadena vyāvartyate | evaṃ tatpuruṣabahuvrīhibhyām avikārāyeti padena kāryakāraṇarūpobhayāvasthācidvayāvṛttiḥ | śuddhāyeti baddhavyāvṛttiḥ | ni tyāya śuddhatvena nityāya | anyathā avikārāyetyanena punaruktiḥ syāt nityapadaṃ(nitya) śudiṃdha viśiṃṣadeva śuddhamadvastuviśeṣaṇam; yathā mahodāra ityatra mahacchabda audāryaṃ viśiṃṣanneva dāturviśeṣaṇam, tadvat | ato muktavyā vṛttiḥ | paramātmane iti nityamuktavyāvṛttiḥ | te hi paravantaḥ | na tu paramāḥ | "pradhānapuruṣavyaktakālānāṃ paramam" iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | avikārāyetyādinā padacatuṣṭayena pradhānapuruṣāvyaktakālavyāvṛttiriti kecit | nimeṣādyavasthakālasya vyaktasyāpyavikārapadavyāvartitatvāt puruṣatraividhyasyaiva prāmāṇikatvāt viśeṣaṇānāṃ tadvayāvartanasamarthatvācca yathoktānāmevārthānāṃ vyāvartitatvamucitam | vilakṣaṇavigrahavattayā'pi samastavailakṣaṇyamāha sadaikarūparūpāyeti | prathamo rūpaśabdaḥ svabhāvavācī; ekasvabhāvamityarthaḥ | paravyūhavibhavādisarvāvasthāsu sakalaheyapratyanīkatvamaṅgalāspatvadhyeyatvādisvabhāvo'pracyuta ityarthaḥ | yadvā ekarūpamdivyātmasvarūpeṇa samānasvabhāvam | tenāpi heyapratyanīkatvādisiddhiḥ | ebhiḥ padairīkṣatyānandamayādhikaraṇaantarādityavidyārthaḥ vivakṣitāḥ | pūrvoktamātmatvaṃ na "mṛdātmako ghaṭa" iti vadbhavatīti tadvaiśadyamavayavaśakatyā kriyate viṣṇuśabdena, sarvajiṣṇava iti padena ca | padadvayena nṛpanabhovyāvṛttiḥ, | antaḥpraviśya niyantṛtvaṃ hi śarirītvam | ata evamātmatvaṃ vivṛtaṃ bhavati | viṣṇuśabdasya rūḍhatvāddevatāviśeṣanirṇayaśca siddhaḥ | yadvā viṣṇuśabdenaiva niyamanaparyantavyāptiruktā, vyāptikṛtatadgatadoṣasparśaśaṅkāṃ vyudasyati sarvajiṣṇava iti |
kathaṃ viṣṇoḥ kāraṇatvam; hiraṇyagarbhādīnāṃ hi sṛṣṭayādikāraṇatvamavagamyata ityatrāha nama iti | tattaccharīrako viṣṇureva sṛṣṭayādikaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | "rakṣārthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viṣṇutvamupajagmivān" ityuktaviṣṇvākhyāvatāravigrahadvārā bhagavatpayarnto hariśabdaḥ | hiraṇyagarbhaśaṅkaraśabdau jīvadvārā bhagavatparyantāviti"brahmādyāḥ sakalā devā manuṣyāḥ paśavastathā | viṣṇumāyāmahāvartamohāndhatamasāvṛtāḥ" iti, "hiraṇyagarbhādiṣu ca brahma kamātmikādvidhā" iti "hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān" ityārabhya "mūrtametaddhare rūpaṃ bhāvanātritayātmakam | aśuddhāste samastāstu devādyā| karmayonayaḥ" ityādyetatprabandhasthaślokatātparyānurodhāt, "etau dvau vibudhaśreṣṭhau prasādakrodhajau smṛtau | tadādarśitapanthānau sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakau", "tavāntarātmā mama ca ye cānye dehisaṃjñitāḥ | sarveṣāṃ sākṣibhūto'sau na grāhyaḥ kenacit kvacit" iti bhāratādivacanaikārthyācca niścīyate | hiraṇyagarbhādisāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vyāptikṛtamiti sūca yati vāsudevāyeti | brahmaśivamadhyastho'pyapracyutasvabhāva ityāha tārāyeti | yadvā teṣu triṣvapyayameva mokṣaprada ityarthaḥ | "atha kasmāducyate tāram? yasmāduccāryamāṇa eva garbhajanmajarāmaraṇasaṃsāramahābhayāt tārayati, tasmāducyate tāram" iti śruteḥ | "brahmaviṣṇuśivāḥ brahman ! pradhānāḥ brahmaśaktayaḥ" ityādibhiḥ viṣṇoḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ viṣṇoturmukhādisāmyaṃ ca na śaṅkanīyam | śakiktarapṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇam | tatra dharmiṇyasamānavibhaktinirdiṣṭe dharmiparyantasyāpi śabdasya dharmamātraparatvaṃ dṛṣṭam, paṭasya śukla ityādiṣu | tathā viṣṇuśabdo viśeṣaṇabhūtavigrahamātraparaḥ; asamānavibhaktinā brahmaśabdena dharmiṇaḥ pṛthaṅnirdiṣṭatvāt | brahmaṇaḥ śaktayo hi brahmaśaktayaḥ | ato'samānavibhaktinirdiṣṭatvamiti | yadvā bhagavato devamanuṣyādiśabdavyapadeśavat śaktivibhūtyādiśabdavyapadeśo'pi vibhūtisājātyāt iti | yathā''huḥ śrīvatsāṅkamiśrāḥ, "sajītāyasteṣāmiti tu vibhākhyāmapi bhajan" iti | ato yathokta evārthaḥ |
atha kevalaprakṛtikāraṇavyāvṛttyarthaṃ prakṛtiviśiṣṭaṃ paramātmānaṃ namaskaroti ekāneketi | kāraṇāvasthāyāmekaḥ, kāryāvasthāyamanekaḥ | atha dhīsthāṃ kāryāvasthāmāha sthūleti | tathā buddhisthāṃ kāraṇāvasthāmāha avya kteti | tatrāpyapracyutasvabhāvatvamāha muktihetava iti |
atha kālaviśiṣṭamāhasargeti | kālasya vakṣyamāṇaviśeṣaṇopapatteḥ prakaraṇasya viśiṣṭaparatvādviśeṣaṇāntaraviśiṣṭatāyāḥ pratipāditatvena kālaviśiṣṭatākathanam pāriśeṣyāt tadapratipādane apekṣitavidhyabhāvaprasaṅgāt kevalaṃ brahmasvarūpakāraṇaparatve aṇḍāntargatasargāderuktatvādaṇḍabahirbhūtatattvasargādervakṣyamāṇatvācca paunarukatyaprasaṅgāt, vistare ca "pradhānapuruṣavyaktakālānām", "vyaktaṃ viṣṇustathā'vyaktaṃ puruṣaḥ kāla eva ca", "tathā ;puruṣa rūpeṇa kālarūpeṇa ca sthitam", "brahma dakṣādayaḥ kālaḥ" ityādibhirvyaktāvyaktādibhiḥ saha vakṣyamāṇatvādayaṃ ślokaḥ kālapara eva | acidviśiṣṭavāciślokānantaryādasya ślokasya kālaparatvamucitam | uttaraślokaḥ samaṣṭijīvaparaḥ, vyaṣṭijīvaparaślokasāhacaryāt | kālasya sargasthitivināśamūlabhūtatvaṃ "brahmā dakṣādayaḥ kālaḥ" "viṣṇurmanvādayaḥ kālaḥ", "rudraḥ kālo'ntakaścedyādiṣu" ityādiṣu siddham | jaganmayaḥavacchedakatayā avacchedyatayā ca jagatpracuraḥ |
atha kṣetrajñasamaṣṭayātmanā'vasthitaṃ namasyati ādhārabhūtamiti | acetanasya cetanaḥ svarūpeṇādhārabhūtaḥ "evamevaitā bhūtamātrāḥ prajñāmātrāsvarpitāḥ", "jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho ! yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat" iti vacanāt | aṇīyastvamprakṛterapi vyāpanayogyasūkṣmatvam | yadvā "vikāsāṇusvarūpaiśca" ityuktaprakāreṇa sargadaśāyāmiva jñānavikāsābhāvādaṇīyastvamevetyarthaḥ | sarvabhūtasthambhavatīti bhūtam; pṛthivyanteṣu savartattveṣvavasthitam | anantaraṃ kṣetrajñavyaṣṭiviśiṣṭaṃ namaskaroti jñāneti |
hiraṇyagarbhetyadibhāṣye nirdiṣṭeṣvartheṣvayaṃ ślokaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭaparamātmapara iti śaṅkāyāṃ samāsāntargataṃ prastutaślokārthaṃ vivicya darśayati tatreti | paramātmanaḥ sadvāraka eva bhramānvaya ityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha tasmāditi | nirviśeṣajñānapatve praśnottaravaralābhakathanānupapattimukhenopakramavirodha uktaḥ | athoparitanādhyāyagatacodyaparihārānanuguṇatvamucyate yadīti | yadvā śāstrārambhopayogipraśnottarānupapattiruktā | idānīmetatpraśnottaraviśeṣānupapattirucyate yadīti | pūrvādhyāye, "juṣan rajoguṇam" ityādinā guṇānvaye kathite'pi nirguṇasyeti codayato'yamabhiprāyaḥguṇānvayasya sadvārakatvāt svayaṃ nirguṇa iti | nivirśeṣapakṣe aprameyasyetyādipadavaiyarthyam nirguṇasyeti padenaiva nirviśeṣatvasiddheḥ; paripūrṇatvādiguṇānabhyupagamācca | aprameyādipadāntarasamabhivyāhāra eva nirguṇapadopasthāpitaniṣedhasya saṅkucitaviṣayatvasādhakaḥ | na ghaṭata iti | "sargādyā bhāvaśaktayaḥ" iti sarvaśaktiyogena codya sya parihārāt nirviśeṣapakṣānanuguṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ | tarhi kathaṃ codyaparihārau syātāmityatrāha tathā hi satīti | nirguṇasya brahmaṇa ityanena padāntaravaiyarthyamabhipretam | nirviśeṣasya kartṛtvānupapatticodye kṛte, "kartṛtvasya pāramārthye sati hi tadanupapattiḥ, aparamārthatvāddurghaṭatvameva bhūṣaṇam" iti parihāro vaktavya ityarthaḥ | kimarthāvimau codyaparihārau, yadyayamartho na pratipādyata iti śaṅkāyāmsvayameva taccodyaparihāraśarīramāha utpattyādīti | nirguṇasyetyādiviśeṣaṇānāṃ viparītākāraiḥ kartṛtvasya vyāptiṃ kathamityanenābhipretāṃ daśaryati sattvādiguṇayuktetyādinā | sattvādiguṇayuktāparipūṇarkarmavaśyatvāni nirguṇatvādīnaṃ yathākramaṃ viparītākārāḥ | amalātmana ityasya viparītākāro 'pi karmavaśyetyanenārthasiddhaḥ | amalātmatvamamalasvabhāvatvam, karmasambandhānarhatvam; tadviparītākāraḥ karmasambandhārhatvam | tacca karmavaśyaśabdenārthasiddham | karmasambandhārhatvakāryaṃ hi karmavaśyatvam | nirguṇasyetyādipadā nāṃ yathākramamarthamāha sattvādiguṇarahitasyetyādipadaiḥ | karmasaṃbandhānarhasyetyanena amalātmana iti padaṃ vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | akarmavaśyatvaṃ muktasyāpi vidyate | sa pūrvāvasthāyāṃ karmasaṃbandhitvāt tadarhaḥ | atastadvayāvartakaṃ karmasaṃbandhānarhatvamamalātmatvam | akarmavaśyatvamkarmakṛtasukhaduḥkhabhākatvābhāvaḥ | karmavaśyavisajātīyatvaṃ karmasambandhānarhatvam | sargādikartṛtve guṇatrayavaśyatvasāpekṣatvakarmādhīnaphalabhākatvakarmasaṃbandhārhatvaprasaṅga iti viśeṣavirodhaprasañjanena codyam | agnerdravyatve'nuṣṇatvaprasaṅga itivat ayaṃ tarko dharmigrāhakapramāṇabādhitaḥ | ato visajātīyadharmiṇo visajātīyadharmavattvaṃ yuktam; āgnitve satyapi vaidyutārgnerjalanirvāpyatvābhāvavat | ataḥ savarvisajātīyasya brahmaṇaḥ sarvaśaktiyoga upapadyata iti parihāra ityarthaḥ | śaktayaḥ sarvabhāvānām ityasya granthasyāyamakṣarārthaḥacintyajñānagocarāḥatarkyapramitisiddhāḥ sargādyāḥ sargādigocarāḥ, bhāvaśaktayaḥvastuśaktayaḥ | brahmaṇaḥ vastuśaktaya iti nirdeśo brahmatādātmyamitivat | yadvā brahmaṇo bhāvaśaktayaḥvastuśaktayaḥ | brahmaṇo vastutvaprayuktāḥ sattāprayuktā nirupādhikāḥ śaktaya ityarthaḥ | yadvā bhāvaśabdaḥ svabhāvaparaḥ; svābhāvikyaḥ śaktaya ityarthaḥ |
atha catuḥślokīṃ vyācaṣṭe paramārtha iti kṛtsnasya brahmaparyantatvena taccharīratvāt kṛtsnaśīraraṃ brahmaiva paramārthaḥ; atatparyanto mithyetyarthaḥ | jagataḥ pate ityākāśavyāvṛttiḥ yena vyāptamiti nṛpavyāvṛttiḥ | anena jagataḥ śarīralakṣaṇaṃ darśitaṃ bhavati | niyāmyatvadhāryatvaśeṣatveṣvanyatamaṃ vyāpyatvasahacaraṃ hi śarīralakṣaṇadyotakam | jagaccharīraka ! tvadanyo nāstītyukte atatparyantasvatantravastvantarasyaiva mithyātvaṃ syāt; na tu jagatastaccharīrabhūtasya | yathā he bhūṣate ! tvadanyo nāstītyukte, na bhūrmithyā bhavati; tattulyarājāntarasyaiva tu mithyātvamtadvat | yadvā ekaśabdaḥ prādhānyaparaḥ | "ekādākiniccāsahāye" ityatrāsahāyapadavyavacchedyaṃ hi prādhānyam | brahmaṇaśca prādhānyaṃ jaga tprati viśeṣyatvarūpam | tadānīṃ nānyo'stīti pradhānabhūto'nyo niṣidhyate;na tvapradhānamarthāntaram | uktārthasyopapādakaṃ vyāpyatvapratipādakamuttarārddhamityāha tadeveti | tatra phalitamarthamāha yeneti | yenayasmādityarthaḥ | tvada nyaḥatvadātmakaḥ | tvayā ātmatayā vyāptatvāt sarvaṃ tvadātmakaṃ tvaccharīramiti tvadanyaḥatvadātmako nāsti | tasmāt sarvaśarīrastvameva paramārthaṃ ityarthaḥ | tavaiṣa mahimeti ślokārdhaikadeśaścoktārthopapādaka ityāha ata iti | mahimno vyāptirūpatvāt, yā sarvavyāptirityuktam | na tu vyāptau tātparyāt | vyāptermahitamatva eva tātparyam |
yadvā vyāpteruktārthopapādakatvaṃ mahimasamabhivyāhārādityāha ata idamucyata iti | tasya paraprātikūlyaṃ daśaryati anyatheti | vyāpyavyāptyādermithyātve, "sarvavyāptistava mahimā"iti na vācyam, api tu bhrantiriti vaktavyami tyarthaḥ | kṛtsnopāramārthyaparatve dūṣaṇāntaradvayamāhajagataḥ pata iti | lakṣaṇāadhiṣṭhānalakṣaṇā |
abrahmātmakatvena svatantratāyāḥ pratyakṣasiddhatvāt tadviruddhaṃ brahmaparyantatvaṃ na śāstraṃ pratipādayati, "ādi tyo yūpaḥ" itivaditi śaṅkāyām, anyathāsiddhāyā aparokṣarūpāyā api svātantryapratipatteḥ parokṣarūpāpyananyathāsiddhā pāratantryapratipattirbalīyasītyabhiprāyeṇa dvitīyaślokamavatārayati yata iti | pāratantryapratipattiḥ paramātmapratipattisāpekṣā, tadabhāvāt tatpratipattyabhāva ityanyathāsiddhā svātantryapratipattirityarthaḥ | kevaladevamanuṣyādirūpamiti | paramātmaśarīratvarahitajagadrūpamātramityarthaḥ | ayamarthaḥyathā dehātmabhramo'parokṣo'pi parokṣaśāstra jñānena bādhyate, tathā svātantryabhramo'pīti |
dehātiriktaṃ svātmānamapyajānataḥ paramātmapāratantrāpratipattiḥ kimpunarnyāyasiddheti ca darśayituṃ tṛtīyaślokārambhaḥ | taṃ vyācaṣṭe na kevalamiti cidacidātmake jagati cetanarūpaṃ jagadvivakṣitaṃ jñānasvarūpamakhilaṃ jagaditi jagacchabdena; yathā, "tribhirguṇamayairbhāvairebhiḥ sarvamidaṃ jagataḥ | mohitaṃ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ paramavyayam" iti | atra jñānasvarūpasya jaḍarūpārthasvarūpatvabuddhirbhrama ityukte arthasvarūpasyārthasvarūpatvabuddhirna bhramaḥ syāditi ca siddham | dehātmabhramaśca saṃsargakṛtaḥ, jalamuṣṇamitivat | ātmāsādhāraṇadhamarjñānasphuraṇe'pi tasyāsādhāraṇatvājñānāt bhramopapattiḥ |
caturthaṃ vyācaṣṭe ye punariti | vijñānañcāvijñānaṃ ceti vijñānaśabdasyātmavācitvāt jñānasvarūpātmavida ityuktam | abuddhayaiti pūrvaślokoktārthapratiyogitvena jñānavida ityuktamiti smārayati buddhimanta iti ayogina ityasya pratiyogitvena śuddhacetasa ityuktamiti sūcayati yogayogyapariśuddhamanasa iti | yogayo gyatve hetuḥ pariśuddhatvam | manasā tu viśuddhena hi bhagavatsākṣātkārarūpopāsananiṣpattiḥ śrūyate | manoviśuddhiśca karmayogena | yogena yogyatā pariśuddhiriti vā'rthaḥ | pūrvaślokeakhilajagacchabdena cetanarūpaṃ jagat vivakṣitam; asmin śloke akhilajacchabdena acidrūpaṃ jagat vivakṣitam | kṛtsnāpāramārthyaṃ vivakṣitamiti pakṣe prathamaślokasaṅkṣiptadūṣaṇamanuktadūṣaṇena saha vistareṇa sarvaślokasādhāraṇamāha anyatheti | svāntryabhramo dehātmabhramaśceti vibhāgābhāve paunaruktyamityarthaḥ | lakṣaṇāparameśvara, jagataḥ pate, tava, mahimā, tvamityādiśabdānāṃ lakṣaṇā | tvaṃśabdo hi svābhimukhāhamarthāntaravācī | atastasya lākṣaṇikatvam | arthavirodhaḥ pratyakṣādibhiḥ abādhyatvena sidhyato'satyatve pramāṇa virodhaḥ nirodhānānupapattiḥ | tarka virodhaḥ ubhayaliṃgatva virodhaśca prakaraṇavirodhaḥstutivirodhaḥ "romāntarasthā munayaḥ stuvanti" iti hi prakṛtam | stotṛṇāmadvaitajñānattve stutyanupapattiḥ; tadabhāve ca nitarām | śāstratātparyavirodhaḥupakramopasaṃhārāvantaraprakaraṇopakramopasaṃhārādivirodhaḥ ||
athādibharatacatuḥślokīṃ parasparavyavahitāṃ vyācaṣṭe tasyetyādinā | brahmādvaitaṃ jīvādvaitañcetyadvaitaṃ dvividhaṃ śāstrapratipādyam | tatra brahmadvaitaṃ prakāryadvaitaṃ | jīvādvaitaṃ prakārādvaitam || ko'tra niyāmaka iti cetucyate | brahmaprakaraṇeṣu sāmānādhikaraṇyena brahmādvaitapratipādanāt sāmānādhikaraṇyasya ca prakārabhedaviśiṣṭaprakāryekatvaparatvāt, "ekaḥ san bahudhā vicāra" iti prakārabahutvasya kaṇṭhoktatvāt, aikyavidhiśeṣasya, "neha nānāsti" ityādibheniṣa dhasya vihitaikyavirodhibhedaviṣayatvāt, sāmānyaniṣedhasya ca vihitavyatiriktaviṣayatvena prakāribahutvaniṣedhaparatvāt, "na tatsamaścābhyadhikaśca dṛśyate" iti brahmatulyaprakāryantaraniṣedhakaṇṭhoktayā ca prakāryadvaitameva brahmādvaitam |
jīvātmabahutvasya śrutisiddhatvāt anyathā baddhamuktavyavasthānupapatteḥ upadeśānupapattaḥ sukhādivyavasthānupapatteḥ "pumānnadevo na naro na paśurna ca pādapaḥ", "caturvidho'pi bhedo'yaṃ mithyājñānanibandhanaḥ | devādibhede'padhvaste" ityādibhibhaidaviśeṣaniṣedhasya kaṇṭhoktatvāt muktānāṃ sāmyavacanāt, "ahaṃ tvaṃ ca tathā'nye ca", "tatra tvamahama pyatra "tanmanaḥ samatālambi" ityādiprākaraṇikavacanānurodhāt eko vrīhiritivat ekaśabdasyaikajātīyaparatvo papatteḥ vakṣyamāṇaślokastha śabdasvabhāvācca jīvādvaitaṃ prakārādvaitameva || "nityo nityānāṃ cetanaścetanānāmeko bahū nāṃ yo vidadhāti kāmān" ityasya vākyasya kāmavidhānaparatvānna nityatvabahutvayostātparyamasti; asti cet vākyabhedaprasaṅgāditi cetna; "yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ" ityatra aṣṭākapālatvaviśiṣṭāgneyapuroḍāśa(yoga?)vidhivat viśiṣṭavidhiparatvādvākyasya, nityabahucetanaviśiṣṭakāmapradānavidhiparaṃ hīdaṃ pratīyate | anityānāmalpānāṃ kāmapradānādapi nityānāṃ bahūnāṃ kāmapradāne kathite hi kāmapradānasyātiśayo bhavati || jīvabahutvasya lokasiddhatvānna tatra śāstrasya tātparyam;aprāpte hi śāstramarthavaditi cennasaṃsṛṣṭasya hi bahutvapratītirlokasiddhā | pariśuddhātmasvarūpabahutvasya lokasiddhatvābhāvāt tatra hi śāstratāparyaṃ saṃbhavati | aupādhikākārasyānityatvāt niṣkṛṣṭasvarūpasya natyatvāt nityatvasamānādhikaraṇabahutve'bhihite pariśuddhātmasvarūpabahutvaṃ hyuktaṃ bhavati | upadeśo'pi na saṃbhavati | gururbhrāntaścetnopadeśaḥ | abhrāntaścetdvaitapratītyabhāvānnatarām | dvaitapratītāvapi darpaṇasthaṃ svātmanaḥ pratibimbaṃ prati vivakṣitasya nopadeśaḥ saṃbhavatīti | sukhaduḥkhādivyavasthayā cātmabhedasiddhiḥ | nanu sukhaduḥkhavyavasthā nāma kiṃ sukhaduḥkhavyaktibahutvam, uta tadāśrayabahutvam | ekasyaivānekasukhaduḥkhavyaktidarśanāt sukhādisvarūpabahutvaṃ nātmaikyavirodhīti na vyavasthā | āśrayabhedaścet, sādhyāviśiṣṭo heturiti cetna;tvaduktobhayaprakāravilakṣaṇatvādvayavasthāyāḥ | saṃpratipannaikāśrayeṣu sukhaduḥkhādiṣu pratisaṃdhānaṃ dṛṣṭam; pratibandhakābhāve sati ekāśrayatvena sukhaduḥkhādipratisandhānābhāvo vyavastheti parihāraḥ | ekamayamityatra mayaṭ svārthikaḥ | yadvā ekaśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ, aikyam; tatpracuramekamayam | śuddhāvasthātmano hyaikyaprācuryam; na tu saṃsṛṣṭasya; tasya, buddhisukhaduḥkhādyāntarabhedena devatvādibāhyabhedena caikyaprācuryābhāvāt | ekaśabdaḥ samānavācī; "eko vrīhiḥ suniṣpannaḥ supuṣṭaṃ(ṣṭāḥ) kurute prajāḥ" ityādiṣu tathā prayogadarśanāt | devamanuṣyādiprakṛtipariṇāmaviśeṣarūpetyanena "duḥkhājñānamalā dharmāḥ prakṛteste na cātmanaḥ", "pumānna devo na naro na paśurna ca pādapaḥ | śarīrākṛtibhedāstu bhūpaite karmayonayaḥ" iti vacanayoraikārthyaṃ darśitam | "piṇḍaḥ pṛthak yataḥ puṃsaḥ śiraḥpāṇyādilakṣaṇaḥ" iti prākaraṇikavacanaṃ smārayati piṇḍaśabdaḥ || ekamayamityātmanyekatvaṃ vidhāyabhede niṣidhyamāne ātmasvarūpabheda eva niṣedhyaḥ syāditi cetsyādevam, yadi vidhīyamānamekatvaṃ vyaktayaikyaṃ syāt | tattu prakāraikyam | ato bhedaniṣedho vaijātyaniṣedha eveti bhāvaḥ || "dvaitino'tathyadarśinaḥ" iti sāmānyenokte kathaṃ devādidvaitaniṣedha ityucyata iti cetkathaṃ sāmānyena dvaitaniṣedhe pratīte ātmadvaitaniṣedha ityacyate; na piṇḍātmanorbhedanibedhaḥ || piṇḍātmanorbhedasya prāmārikatvāditi cetātmabhedasyāpi prāmāṇikatvānna tadbhedaniṣedhaḥ; apitu devādibhedaniṣedha iti bhāvaḥ | ātmagatadvaitamapratiṣiddhaṃ cet"ātmāśuddho'kṣaṇaḥ śāntaḥ", "vijñānaṃ yajñaṃ tanute" ityekavacanaṃ nopapadyate jātāvaikavacanaṃ cetdehaśabde'pyekavacanaṃ syāditi śaṅkā ca devamanuṣyādipadena parihṛtā | devādiṣvavāntarabhedavivakṣayā vividhaśabdaḥ | tatrāpyanekavidhatvavivakṣayā vicitra śabdaḥ | ātmasujātyekatvādekavacanam, piṇḍeṣvavāntarajātibahutvādvahuvacanamityabhiprāyaḥ | sāmye pramāṇamāha yathoktamiti | bahutvasya vihitatvāt sāmyapratipādanāccā''tmavyaktibhedaniṣedho'nupapanna ityarthaḥ | hetvantaraṃ cāha tasyeti | anyathā'rthaścet, etacchalokasthapadānāṃ vyāghātaḥ syādityarthaḥ | uktatvāditi | samamityartha ityanvayaḥ |
ekavacanoktau hi jātavekavacanamiti nirvāhaḥ; anyaniṣedhaparasya vacanasyānyathānirvāhāyogādātmaikatvasiddhiriti śaṅkāyāṃ yadyanyo'stītyādi(deḥ)ślokasyārthamāha yadīti | ekasminnarthe dvau dvau śabdau prayuktau sthānatraye; tenānyataraśabdasyākāraparatvānnātmabhedaniṣedha iti parihrayate | tatra dvayoḥ śabdayoḥ ko'thar ityatrāha tatreti | paraśabdena dharmiṇamanūdya tasya śabdāntaropasthāpitākārāntarānvayo niṣidhyata ityarthaḥ || eṣo'ham ayañcānya iti vaktumaśakyatvaṃ katham, pratyaktavaparāktave bhedakadharmau hi vidyete iti cetnaivam; pratyaktavaparāktyoḥ svaparāpekṣayā sarvātmanā(na) sādhāraṇatayā vyāvartakatvābhāvāt | pūrvaṃ devādiṣyantamo'yamityabhiprāyeṇa tadviśeṣabubhutsayā hi sauvīrarājena ādibharataḥ pṛṣṭaḥ | ato devādyākāraniṣedhaparā ime śabdā iti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ padārthe sati ślokena kimu ktaṃ bhavatīti śaṅkāyāṃ vākyārthaṃ yojayati etaduktamiti | eṣa iti śabdasyārthamāha evamākāra iti | anyaśabdārthamāha anyādṛśākāra iti | ākāraikyaṃ nāma ākārāṇāṃ sausādṛśyamityabhiprāyeṇa evamākāraḥ anyādṛśākā ityuktam | anyathā svarūpamātrapratipattirekenaiva padena siddheti padāntaravaiyathyaprasaṅgāt padāntaramākāraparamityarthaḥ | asyārthasya viparyaye paryavasānamuttaraślokoktam | so'nudāhṛtaḥ | tadarthamāha na caivamiti | ayaṃ hi sa ślokaḥ, "yadā samastabhūteṣu pumāneko vyavasthitaḥ | tadā hi ko bhavān so'hamityetat viphalaṃ vacaḥ" iti | atraikaśabda ākāraikyaparaḥ | svayamprakāśatvanityatvāṇutvādiḥ sarvātmasādhāraṇaḥ | vyāvartakadevādyākārastu nātmanyasti | vyāvartakābhāvāt tadvāciśabdena nirdeśa'nupapannaḥ | pratyakatvaparākatvaparokṣatvāparokṣatvādīni na vyāvartakānīti ko bhavāniti praśnastadatiriktākārābhiprāyaḥ | na hi, bhavāniti praśnaḥ | bhavacchabdo dharmimātraparaḥ | kiṃśabdo vyāvartakadevādyokāraparaḥ | tasmāt tadāriktākārābhāvena na tadvāciśabdena nirdeśa upapadyata ityarthaḥ | jñānaikākāratvena samānatvādeveti |
