pūrvoktādeveti bhāvaḥ | uktanirvāhāgocaradṛṣṭāntamukhenādvaitaparatvena paroktasya ślokasyārthamāha veṇurandhreti | svata ekākārāṇāmupādhivaśādavāntarabhedasadbhāvamātra dṛāṣṭāntopanyāsaḥ | anyathā sarvathā sādharmyābhyupagame hi ātmano'cittvākāśakāyartvādikamapi syāt | taddhi pramāṇāntaravirodhāt tyajyate; tathā dṛṣṭāntagatamākārāntaramapīti bhāvaḥ | tathā'sau paramātmana ityukte ṣaḍjādiśañjñābhedo mā bhūdityabhiprāyeṇāha evamātmanāṃ devādisañjñābheda iti | bhedavṣaḍjādisañjñita iti pāṭhe satyapi ṣaḍjādisañjñābheda iti vyākhyātam, duravagamaṣaḍjādirūpabhedapratipavisaukaryasya sañjñābhedādhīnatvāditi bhāvaḥ(?) dārṣṭāntike'pi tathaiva | dṛṣṭānte vyaktibahutvaṃ śaṅkāyāṃvāthvaṃśānāmanekatvaṃ tarkeṇa sādhayati taijaseti | spaśarvaddravyatvāditi bhāvaḥ | yatra tvākāśadṛṣṭānta uktaḥ, tatrāpyekasyātmano dṛṣṭāntatvenākāśamukatvā ātmantare tathātvamiti mantavyam "sitanīlādibhedena yathaikaṃ dṛśyate nabhaḥ | bhrāntadṛṣṭibhirātmāpi tathaikassan pṛthak pṛthak3 iti | nabhasaḥ sitanīlādibhedaḥ śaratprāvṛṭsanvyāsamayeṣu meghopaśliṣṭasya tasya yathā kramabhāvītathaikasyātmano'pi devādibhedaḥ kramabhāvīti | yadvā tatrāpi pradeśabhedāṅgīkāreṇa sarvātma dṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt ākāśasya pradeśabhedānabhyupagame ghaṭadervibhutva ākāśasya alpatvaṃ vā prasajet | kiṃ ghaṭādeḥ kṛtsnākāśena saṃbhandhaḥ uta pradeśa bhedena | pūrvasmin pakṣe ghaṭādervibhutvamākāśasyāltpaparimāṇatvaṃ vā | dvitīye pradeśabhedāṅgīkāra iti | vedāntibhirnabhaso niravayavatvavādo'pasiddhānta; vedānteṣu syāṃśabhedena pañcīkaraṇopadeśāt; ekāṃśena vāyutvena pariṇāmavādāt; utpattilayadarśanācceti | ata eva, "ghaṭadhvaṃse ghaṭākāśo na bhinno na bhaso yathā | brahmaṇā heyavidhvaṃse viṣṇvākhyena tathā pumān" iti śaunakavacanamapi, nabhasyaṃsābhedābhiśaprāyeṇa jīvasya parasmādātmana aupādhikavaiṣamyavirahe dṛṣṭāntasamarpaṇaparaṃ veditavyam; yathā'gniragnau saṃkṣiptaḥ samānatvamanuvrajet" iti tatraiva sāmyadṛṣṭāntābhidhānāt |
athā''dibharatanigamanaślokamāha so'hamiti | pūrvoktamadhyāyacatuṣṭayoktam | sa iti padasya jñānākāraviśiṣṭavastuvācitve'pi viśeṣaṇāṃśe tātparyaṃ darśayituṃ sarvātmanāṃ jñānākāra(tva)miti viśeṣaṇāṃśasya niṣkṛṣṭa nirdeśaḥ | anyathā tatsāmānādhikaraṇyenetyanantaroktivirodhāt | jñānamevākāra ityupasaṃharanniti | so'hamityādiślokānantarapūrvaśloka, "ekaḥ(kaṃ) samastaṃ yadihāsti kiñcit tadacyuto nāsti paraṃ tato'nyat" ityardhena sarvātmanāṃ bhagavaccharīratvasyoktatvāt so'hamityādiślokasya bhagavadātmakatvanigamanaparatvaśaṅkā syāt | taccāyuktam; prakaraṇasya śarīrātmavivekaparatvāt | tannigamanasya cāpekṣitatvāt tannigamanaparaślokāntarābhāvādapekṣitavidherapekṣitavidhānāyogācca ātmanāṃ dehavyāvatarkajñānaikaikākāratvanigamanaparo'yaṃ śloka ityabhiprāya| | tyaja bhedamohamityaṃśasyārthamāha devādyākarābhedenātmasu bhedamohaṃ parityajeti | devādiśabdo bhedaśabdavivaraṇarūpaḥ | dehagatadevatvādyākārabheda ātmani bhedamohahetuḥ; taṃ bhedamohaṃ parityajetyarthaḥ | kṛtsnabheniṣedhaparatve'niṣṭamāha anyatheti | na ca ahaṃtvamādiśabdāḥ deḍahaparāḥ | na hi tacchabdenātmānaṃ parāmṛśya tenā''tmanā dehānāmaikyamupadiśyate | nāpyantaḥkaraṇaparāḥ | na hyantaḥkāraṇānāṃ paramātmanaikyaṃ parasparaikyaṃ vopadiśyate | nāpi dehaviśiṣṭāntaḥkaraṇaparāḥ | na hi dehaviśiṣṭānāmantaḥkaraṇānāmaikyamupadiśyate (padyate?) | ato'haṃtvamādiśabdāḥ dehātiriktātmaparā ityabhiprāyeṇa dehātiriktetyuktam | ahaṃtvamityādipadānāmupalakṣaṇatvādupalakṣye vastuni na bheda ityāśaṅkya pariharati ahamiti | ahaṃtvamādīti ādiśabdena sarvaśabdo vivakṣitaḥ | upalakṣyeṇetyaupacārikanirdeśaḥ; upalakṣyavācipadenetyarthaḥ | sarvametadātmasvarūpamityaneneti | ahaṃ tvaṃ sarvamiti trayāṇāmapi padānāmātmasvarūpaśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ phalitam, teṣvanyatamena ahaṃtvamarthasajātīyārthavācinā sarvametaditi padena ātmasvarūpaśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyanirdeśāt iti jñāpanārthaṃ sarvametadātmasvarūpamityupādānaṃ kṛtaṃ bhāṣye | śloke sarvametadātmasvarūpamiti pradarśanārthamuktam | ato'haṃtvamādiśabdānāmupalakṣyavācakābhimatātmasvarūpaśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyādahaṃtvamādiśabdavācyānāmarthānāmupalakṣaṇatvamasaṅgatam | na hi, candraḥ śākhā, sārasaḥ kedāra ityupalakṣaṇopalakṣyavāciśabdānāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ mukhyatayā dṛṣṭamityarthaḥ | lakṣaṇayā'stviti cetlakṣaṇaiva doṣa iti bhāvaḥ yadvā ane neti padamupalakṣyaviśeṣaṇam | sarvametadadātmasvarūpāmityātmaśabdanirdiṣṭenānenopalakṣyeṇāhatvaṃmādiśabdānāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyādupalakṣaratvamasaṅgatamityarthaḥ | asyāṃ yojanāyāmahaṃtvamādisajātīyārthavācisarvapadasāmānādhikaraṇyanirdeśasya hetutvamarthasiddham | yadi ahaṃtvamādiśabdā upalakṣyaparyantavṛttayaḥ, tadānīmevamarthatayā upalakṣyavācinā ātmasvarūpamiti padena sa iti pṛthaksāmānādhikaraṇyadarśanādupalakṣaṇavācakāhaṃtvamādisāmānādhikaraṇyavaiyarthyar miti | ahaśabdasyopekṣikapratyaktavaṃ pravṛttinimittam;tvaṃśabdasyaca cetanatve sati abhimukhatvam; ātmaśabdasya ca vyāpanakṣamatvam; sa iti padasya prakṛtajñānākāraḥ || nanu sa ca sarvametadātmasvarūpamityatra kathamātmasvarūpaviśeṣaṇasya tacchabdasya pum̐lliṅgatvam || ucyate| "ātmā śuddho'kṣaraḥ śānta(nto nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ karaḥ?)" ityādiṣu (prakṛti?) parajñānamayatvena prakṛta ātmā hi tacchabdena parāmṛśyate | ato na virodha iti | acitsaṃsṛṣṭaṃ devādirūpeṇa pratīyamānaṃ sarvametadātmasvarūpaṃ jñānaikākāraḥ sa ātmetyarthaḥ | caturthapādaṃ vyācaṣṭe sopīti | na jīvabrahmādvaitaparamidaṃ prakaraṇam; na cātmasvarūpabahutvaniṣedhaparam; prakāraikyaparam iti kathaṃ jñāyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha kutaśceti | pariharati dehātmeti | tadapi kuta ityatrāha tacceti |
dehātmavivekaparatvopapādanena jīvaparaikyaparatvamātmabahutvaniṣedhaparatvaṃ ca dattottarameva | atha śāstropasaṃhāragatasya vibhedajanaka ityādiślokasyārthaṃ vakṣyan arthāntaraparatvaṃ ca dattottarameva | atha śāstropasaṃhāragatasya vibhedajanaka ityādiślokasyārthaṃ vakṣyan athāntaraparatvaṃ vyudasyati vibhedetyādinā | prathamaṃ kim ātmasvarūpaikya param uta jīvaparaikyaparamiti vikalpya dūṣyate | atra caśabdābhāvādātmabrahmaśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ sambhāvi tam | tathāsati brahmaśabdaḥ śuddhāvasthaparaḥ syāt | evaṃ śuddhāvastha(sthāt)jīvasya bhedo nāstīti jīvasvarūpaikya muktaṃ syāt | ataḥ śaṅkāspadībhūtamātmaikyaparatvaṃ dūṣayati ātmeti | uktarītyāśrutismṛtyarthāpattilaukikārthāpattyādibhirityarthaḥ | dvitīyaṃ pakṣaṃ dūṣayati jīveti | dehātmanoriveti | viruddhadharmatvādityarthaḥ | pratyaktvaparākatvājaḍatvanityatvapariṇāmitvādibhirviruddhadharmairyathā dehātmanorbhedaḥ, tathā jīvaparayorapi heyārhatvobhayaliṅgatvaniyāmyatvaniyantṛtvādiviruddhadharmairekyaṃ hi nopapadyate | viruddhadharmatve pramāṇamāha tathāceti tathāviruddhadharmatva ityarthaḥ | co hyarthaḥ hetuvācī | vakṣyamāṇahetūnāṃ pañcamīprayuktā; tatsthānīyo'yaṃ caśabdaḥ | samānaṃ vṛkṣamśarīram | piṣpa lamkarmaphalam | abhicākaśītisvayamanaśnattvādāśayitṛtvācca bhṛśaṃ bhātītyarthaḥ ||
nanu kathamasya mantrasya jīvaparamātmabhedaparatvam? antaḥkaraṇajīvaparo hyayaṃ mantraḥ, paiṅgirahasyabrāhmaṇena asya mantrasya tathā vyākhyātatvāt | yathā"tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādvattīti sattvam | anaśnannanyo abhicakaśīti anaśnannanyo'bhipaśyatīti(kṣetra)jñaḥ | tāvetau sattvakṣetrajñau" iti | svādvattītyantena sattvamuktam abhicākaśītītyantena vākyena anaśnannanyo...jña iti kṣetrajño'bhipaśyatītyuktamiti vyākhyātatvamavagamyate | na ca sattva śabdo jīvaparaḥ, kṣetrajñaśabdaḥ paramātmaparaḥiti vācyam; sattvakṣetrajñaśabdayorantaḥkaraṇajīvaparatayā prasiddhatvāt, "tadetat sattvaṃ yena svapnaṃ paśyati | atha yo'yaṃ śārīra upadraṣṭā sa kṣetrajñaḥ | tāvetau sattvakṣetrajñau" iti sattvakṣetrajñaśabdayorantaḥkaraṇajīvaparatvena tatraiva vyākhyātatvācca | yena paśyatīti karaṇatvapratīteḥ sattvaṃ hyantaḥkaraṇam; svapnadraṣṭṛtvāditaraḥ kṣetrajño hi jīvaḥ | ataḥ dvā suparṇā iti mantro'yamantaḥkaraṇajīvaparaḥ; na tu jīvaparatamātmapara iti ||
ucyate | na tāvat jīvaparamātmaparatvamasya mantrasya āpādayituṃ śakyate | anena mantreṇa tulyārthatayā pratyabhijñāyamāne, "samāne vṛkṣe puruṣo nimagnaḥ" ityanantaramantre jīvaparamātmanoḥ pratipannatvāt; asya mantrasya tadaikārthyācca | "samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pariṣasvajāte", "samāne vṛkṣe puruṣo nimagnaḥ" iti tayoraikārthyaṃ hi pratīyate | samāne vṛkṣe" iti mantre ca puruṣo jīvaḥ | antaḥkraṇasya puruṣaśabdavācyatvābhāvāt | "śocati muhyamānaḥ", "paśyati vītaśokaḥ" iti padānāmasvārasyaprasaṅgācca | anyaśca paramātmā; īśaśabdavācyatvāt; svaviṣayajñānena vītaśokatvahetutvācca | na kevalamuttaramantraikārthyāt dvāsuparṇetimantrasya jīvaparamātmaparatvam; kintu tasminneva, "svādvatti", "anaśna nnanyaḥ" iti bhokattṛtvābhokattṛvaśravaṇācca tadavasīyate | cakṣuḥśrotrādīnāṃ draṣṭṛtvaśrotṛtvādivat antaḥkaraṇasyāpi karaṇatvādeva bhoktṛtvaṃ na saṃbhavati | jīvasya ca vṛkṣaśabdoktadehapariṣvaṅgadaśāyāmeva anaśnattvamapi nopapadyate || tarhi paiṅgirahasyabrāhyaṇasya ko'rthaḥ || ucyate | sattvaṃ baddhajīvaḥ; "dravyāsuvyavasāyeṣu sattvamastrī tu jantuṣu" iti naighaṇṭukapāṭhāt jantuparatvāvagateḥ | jantuḥcetanaḥ; "prāṇī tu cetano janmī jantujanyaśarīriṇaḥ" iti pāṭhāt | "na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ | sattvaṃ prakṛtijairmuktaṃ yadebhiḥ syāt tribhirguṇaiḥ" iti prayogāt, "vanyān vineṣyanniva duṣṭasattvān" ityarvācīnaprayogācca | kṣetrajñaśabdaścātra paramātmaparaḥ, arthāntaraprasiddhākāśaprāṇaśabdavat arthānupapattyā paramātmaparatvopapatteḥ; "viṣṇornāmasahasraṃ me" ityupakramya"kṣetrajño'kṣara eva ca"iti prayogāt; kṣetra jānātītyavayavārthasya tasminneva puṣkalatvācca | mokṣadharme, "tatastraiguṇyahīnāste paramātmānamañjasā | praviśanti dvijaśreṣṭha ! kṣetrajñaṃ nirguṇātmakam |", "sarvāvāsaṃ vāsudevaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ viddhi tattvataḥ", "viśvamūrddhā viśvabhujo viśvapādākṣināsikaḥ | ekaścarati kṣetreṣu svairacārī yathāsukham || kṣetrāṇi ca śarīrāṇi bījāni ca śubhāśubhe | tāni vetti sā yogātmā tataḥ kṣetrajña ucyate" iti prayogāt; "yo'syā''tmanaḥ kārayitā taṃ kṣetrajñaṃ pracakṣate | yaḥ karoti ca karmāṇi sa bhūtātmeti cocyate" iti prayogācca | yena svapnaṃ paśyatītyatra yenetītthambhāve tṛtīyā | yena viśiṣṭaḥ paramātmā svapnaṃ paśyatītyucyate | tataśca "kāṭhinyavān yo bibharti" iti pṛthivīdvārā kāṭhinyavat svapnadraṣṭṛtvaṃ jīvātma dvārā paramātmaviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti na virodhaḥ | śārīraśabdaśca, "tasyeṣa eva śārīra ātmā" itivat svavyatiriktasamastacidacidvastuśarīrake paramātmanyupapadyate | upadraṣṭeti nirupādhikadraṣṭṛtvaṃ ca sarvajñasya tasyaivopapadyate | ato dvāsuparṇeti mantro jīvaparamātmaparaḥ ||
ṝtaṃ pibantāviti | pānakriyāyāṃ jīvaparayoḥ prayojyaprayojakabhāvenānvayaḥ | pibantāviti śatṛpratyayaḥ kartṛmātraparaḥ; na tu kartṛviśeṣaparaḥ | tena prayojyaprayojakau dvāvapi kartṛviśeṣāviti tāvaviśeṣeṇa kroḍīkṛtau bhavataḥ | anyathā anaśnannityādivirodhaḥ syāt | yadvā chatriṇo gacchantītivadajahallakṣaṇā | sukṛtasya ṝtamphalam | yadvā sukṛtasya loka ityanvayaḥ, tadā sukṛtam ṝtam | tatphalamucyate lakṣaṇayā, "evaṃ puṇyasya karmaṇo dūrādagandho vāti" ityatra "evamanṛtādātmānaṃ juguṣset" iti puṇyapratiyogitvena anṛtaśabdaprayogāt | guhāmhṛdayaguhām | parame parārdhye iti lokaviśeṣaṇam | jīvaparaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā; chāndasatvāt liṅgavyatyayaḥ | chāyātapauajñasarvajñau, "jñājñau dvāvajāvīśanīśau" ityanenaikārthyāt brahmavidaḥadhyātmavidaḥ | pañcāgnayaḥ triṇāciketāśca karmaviśeṣaniṣṭhāḥ | te vadanti; yathā, "ye ca vedavido viprā ye cādhyātmavido janāḥ | te vadanti mahātmānaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dharmaṃ sanātanam" iti |
ṝtaṃ pibantāvityetadvaiśadyāyāha antaḥbapraviṣṭa iti | ityādyā śrutirityanvayaḥ | na kevalaṃ śrutisvāra syāt; asminnapi prabandhe dṛśyate ityāha asminnapīti | sa sarvabhūtetyādinā heyapratyanīkatvakalyāṇaguṇākaratve kathite | jīvasya heyāspadatvamavidyetyādinā uktam | sarvageti bhedavyapadeśāditi pūrveṇa sambandhaḥ | na tu sūtropādānam; uparyasya sūtrasya viṣayavākyānupādānāt; udāhṛtapurāṇavacanānāṃ hetutvakathanasāpekṣatvācca | śrutivākya sya hetutvaṃ hi caśabdenoktam | ubhaye'pītyādyupāttasūtradvayasya viṣayavākyaṃ ya ātmanīti | adhikaṃ tvisyādi sūtrasya viṣayavākyaṃ prājñeneti | sūtreṣvābhiḥ śrutibhirevamarthanirṇayādityarthaḥ |
evamupaniṣatpurāṇasūtrairjīvaparayorviruddhadharmatvamupapāditam | atha, brahma veda brahmaiva bhavatītyādivākyāni hṛdi nidhāya asyānyathāsidiṃdha śaṅkate nāpīti | tat dūṣayati avidyāśrayatveti | avidyāśrayatvayogyatvam | avidyāśabdaḥ samastaheyapradaśarnārthaḥ; āśrayatvaśabdaḥ sambandhaparaḥ; heyasaṃbandhātyantābhāvānadhikaraṇatvaṃ tadyogya tvam | heyasambandhātyantābhāvādhikaraṇatvaṃ tadanarhatvam | "anaśyannanyaḥ" iti śrutyā paramātmanastadanarhatvaṃ siddham | deśakālasannikarṣe satyapi tadasparśo hi svabhāvasannikarṣābhāvāt | svabhāvasaṃnikarṣābhāva eva hyayogya tvam | yathā nabhasaḥ kledanadahanādyanarhatvam | ato heyārhatadanarhayorheyāpagame'pi na svarūpaikyaṃ saṃbhavati | nigrāhyasya paścādanugṛhītasya hi nigrahyatvāpagame'pi nigrahānugrahakatrrā puruṣeṇa naikatvasaṃbhava ityarthaḥ (?) kārāgṛhanirmuktasya niyantrā narapatināna svarūpaikyaṃ na saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ |
asminnarthe purāṇavacanamāha yathoktamiti | yogaśabdaṃ aikyaparaḥ | anyathā, anyaddravyaṃ hi taddravyatāṃ naitīti pratikṣepānupapatteḥ | nanu mithyaitadityuttaratrānvayaḥ, paramātmātmanoryogaḥ paramārthaḥ, anyaddravyaṃ taddravyatāṃ naitītyetat mithyetyarthaḥ iti cetnaivam; anyasyānyadravyatānāpattessatyatvāt | itarathā jaḍājaḍayostādātmya prasaṅgaḥ | "ṝgyajussāmaniṣpādyaṃ yajñakarma mataṃ tava" itivat iṣyata ityanena pūrvārdhoktārthasya paramatatvadyotanāt | anyathā iṣyata iti padavaiyarthyāt | kiñca "paramārthastu bhūpāla ! saṅkṣepācchayatām" iti vakṣyamāṇapakṣavyatirikta pakṣāṇāṃ nirākaraṇaparatvācca prakaraṇasya, etacchalokapūrvārdhoktaikyasamarthanaparatvamuttarādharsya nopapadyate | "dharmāya tyajate" ityādigranthaistattadarthānāṃ paramārthatvaṃ hi nirasyate | svataḥ prakṛtārthe svarasasya etacchabdasya prakṛtārthe satyapi vakṣyamāṇaparatvāśrayaṇamapyayuktam | kiñca anyaddravyaṃ taddravyatāṃ naitīti yat, etanmithyeti hi tadānīmarthaḥ | tathāsati yataśśabdasvārasyabhaṅgaḥ | yataśśabdasya hi hetuparatvaṃ svarasasiddhama; na tu yacchabdavat prakṛtārthaśarīramātraparāmarśitvam | anyaddravyaṃ taddravyatāṃ naitītyetanmithyeti yataḥ, tata aikyaṃ paramārtha ityanvaye itiśabdadvayādhyāhāraprasaṅgaḥ | sa cānadhyāhāreṇa nirvāhe sati nopapadyate || yaducyetapūrvaṃ pṛthagbhūtayoḥ paramātmātmanoraikyaṃ paramārtha itīṣyata iti cetmithyaitat; anyaddravyaṃ hi taddravyatāṃ naitīti yataḥ | tasmāt pūrvamapi paramātmātmanorbhedo nāstītinaivam; pūrvaṃ bhrāntyā pṛthagbhūtayorityasyāśrutatvenādhyāhāraprasaṅgāt | sa cānadhyāhāreṇa nirvāhe saṃbhavati nopapadyate | kiñca "tasyāt pūrvamapi bhedo nāsti" ityaśrutavākyāntarādhyāhāreṇa vākyasya pūraṇīyatvaṃ syāt | tacca tannirapekṣanirvāhe saṃbhavati nopapadyate | tasmāt prāgapi bhedo nāstīti vākyaṃ nādyāhartavyam || (nādhyāhatarvyam;?) pūrvaṃ bhinnayoḥ paramātmātmanoḥ paścādabheda iti pakṣanirākaraṇamātraparatvādgranthasya iti cetkiṃ tena prayojanam || pūrvamapyaikyasidiṃdhariti cetna; pūrvaṃ pṛthagbhūtayoḥ paścādaikyāyoge'bhihite sati paścādapi bhedasiddheḥ | ataḥ svarasasiddha evārthaḥ svīkāryaḥ |
athabrahma veda brahmaiva bhavatītyādivākyanirvāhaṃ bahuśrutyantarāvirodhena vakṣyan muktasya sāmyāpattimāha muktasyeti | tatraikyaśruteḥ pratikūlārthā sāmyaśrutirdarśayiṣyata iti matvā, vyākhyeyatayā prakṛtasyopabṛṃhaṇavacanasya sajātīyaṃ parābhimatārthapratikūlārthaṃ smṛtivacanaṃ darśayati idamiti | muktaparatvavaiśadyāyopādānaṃ sarge'pīti | na kevalaṃ śāstrāntare, atrāpi muktasya bhedapratiparttirastītyāha ihāpīti | ihayogaprakaraṇe yogasaṅkhepakathanārambha ityarthaḥ | "saṅkṣepavistarābhyāṃ tu; kimanyat kriyatāṃ tava" iti hyuktam | ātmanaḥ śakatyā vikāryamavasthā ntaraṃ neyam, dhyāyinamenaṃ tadbrahma ātmabhāvaṃ nayati, ātmanaḥ śakyayā vikāryaṃ lohamākarṣako yathetyanvayaḥ |
ākarṣako vahniḥ; doṣamākarṣatīti vyutpattyā | "yathā'gniruddhataśikhaḥ kakṣaṃ dahati sānilaḥ | tathā cittasthito viṣṇuryogināṃ sarvakilviṣam" iti hyattaratra vakṣyate, śrīviṣṇudharme ca, "yathāgnisaṅgāt kanakamapadoṣaṃ viṣṇuryogināṃsarvakilviṣam" iti hyuttaratra vakṣyate; śrīviṣṇudharme ca, "yathāgnisaṅgāt kanakamapadoṣaṃ prajāyate" iti | so'gniḥ ātmabhāvamātmanaḥ svabhāvamnirdoṣatvaṃ lohaṃ nayati; tathetyarthaḥ | ayaṃ samyagarthaḥ | yadvā ātmaśabdaḥ svavācī san anyayogavyatirekaparaḥ | yathā'gnirloham ātmabhāvamsvabhāvamsvataḥ siddharūpaṃ nayati, tadvadityarthaḥ | yadvā ākarṣakaḥ ayaskāntaḥ, lohamātmabhāvaṃ nayatistvavyāpāraṃ lohaṃ kārayati; svamanukārayati "sthitaḥ sthitāmuccalitaḥ prayātām" itivat | ayaskānajatastiṣṭhati cet, lohastiṣṭhati; dhāvati cet; tamanudhā vati; evaṃ kāmānnī "kāmarūpyanusañcaran", "sarveṣu kāmacāro bhavati" ityādiśrutyanuguṇaṃ paramātmā upāsakaṃ svaceṣṭāmanukārayati; samānaceṣṭitaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | yadvā ātmaśabdaḥ svavācī niṣkṛṣṭasvarūpaparaḥ | upāsakaṃ paramātmā atmabhāvaṃ nayatiprakṛtisaṃbandharāhityena śuddhatāṃ nayati, kevalatāṃ nayati | yathā ayaskānto dārunimagnaṃ lohaṃ tasmāt dāruṇa uddhṛtya kevalatāṃ nayati tadvadityarthaḥ | yadvā"bhūḥ prāptāvātmanepadī" iti vacanāt bhāvaśabdaḥ prāptivacanaḥ |
ātmaprāptiṃ nayati, yathā lohamayaskāntaḥ svaprāptiṃ nayatītyarthaḥ | prāptiṃ nayatīti nirdeśaḥ odanapākaṃ pacatītivat | jīvasya paramātmaśakatyā vikāryatvaṃ yuktam; jīvasya bandhamokṣayorjñānasaṅkocavikāsarūpavikārārhatvāt |
atra śloke tādātmyapratipattyabhāvaṃ darśayati na hīti | ākaṣarkasvarūpāpattirākṛṣyamāṇasyeti nirdeśaḥ uktasarvārthasādhāraṇaḥ | agnisuvarṇadṛṣṭāntavivakṣāyāmākṛṣyamāṇaśabdo vikāryaparaḥ | samāno jyotiṣeti | jyotiḥ paraṃ brahma; "paraṃ jyotirupasampadya", "atha yadataḥ paro divo jyotirdīṣyate" iti śruteḥ | dramiḍeti | aśarīraḥmuktaḥ; karmakṛtaśarīrābhāvāt | siddhiḥanubhavaḥ | muktau jīvaparayorbhedaśrutīrdaśayati śrutayaśceti | āpnotiparamanubhavatītyarthaḥ | etadvivaraṇarūpaṃ vākyaṃ darśayati so'śnuta iti | anusañcarannityanena bhedo darśitaḥ | raso vai sa itya nena sāmyam ānanditvākāreṇetyuktaṃ bhavati | paramasāmyopayoginīṃ vaidharmyanivṛtiṃta daśaryati yathā nadya iti | nadīnāṃ nadītvākarāprahāṇena samudrasaṃsargāt vaidharmyaprahāṇena saṃsargo dṛṣṭānte upajīvyaḥ | prākṛtanāmarūpaprahāṇapūrvi kā hi paramātmaprāptiḥ | na ca tāvatā bhedanivṛttiḥ, "puruṣamupaitī"ti karmakartṛbhāvāvagamāt | sāmyāpatiṃta darśayati tadeti |
nanu paramaṃ sāmyamupaitītyaikyāpattirucyate, samaśabdasya samānaśabdaparyāyatvāt; samānaśabdavadaikye prayo gācca | samaśabdasyaikye prayogo dṛśyate, samakālavartītyādiṣu | tathā samaśabdaparyāyatayā'vagatasamānaśabdo'pyaikye prayujyate, "samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pariṣasvajāte" iti; "ekasminnarthe vṛttiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam" iti ca | ekādhikaraṇyaṃ hi sāmānādhikaraṇyam; ekasminnartha ityukteḥ | tatparyāyaśca samaśabdaḥ | yadyapi sādṛśyasyāpi samaśabdo vācakaḥ, tathāpi muktivākyasthasāmyaśabda aikyaparaḥ, "brahma veda brahmaiva bhavati" ityādiśrutyantaraikārthyāt; layasāyujyaśabdaśravaṇāt; nadīsamudraghaṭākāśamahākāśādidṛṣṭāntaśravaṇācca | "sādharmyamāgatāḥ" iti smṛtistu saguṇaprāptiviṣayā | anyathā pratyakṣaśrutivirodhe svarūpaikyaviṣayabahuśrutivirodhe ca taddaurbalyāt | ata aikyāpattireva anena vākyena pratipāditā | aikyasya ca pāramyaṃ nāma punarbhedabhramaprarohavirahitatvamiti ||
atrocyate | atra sāmyaśabdaḥ sādṛśyamevābhidhatte, na tvaikyam; aikyasya mukhyārthatve'bhyupagate'pi svārasyābhāvāt | sādṛśya eva hi (ca?) samaśabdasya prasiddhiprācuryam | tasya cāpavādābhāve sati asvarasārthasvīkāro'nupapannaḥ | apavādahetavaśca tvaduktā anantarameva parihriyante | na ca samādhiśabdānāmaikyaṃ mukhyārthaḥ; ekatvavivakṣāyāmeko ghaṭa ityādau samo ghaṭa ityādiprayogābhāvāt; mukhyatve hi ekaśabdasyeva pratiyoginirapekṣaprayogaḥ prāpnoti | yastu"sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ" "samakālavartī"tyādiṣu samādiśabdaprayogaḥ, sa tu sādhāraṇyārthaḥ ,na tvai kyārthaḥ | sādhāraṇye'pi prayogo na mukhyaḥ, prayoge'nyathāsiddhe śaktikalpanānupapatteḥ | tathā hianekapratiyogikaikarūpasambandhavattvaṃ sādhāraṇyam | yathādhanaṃ devadattayajñadattau prati śeṣatvena sambandhitayā sādhāraṇam | tayośca dhanaṃ prati śeṣitayā''ste sādṛśyam | tābhyāṃ sambandhi dhanam | tathā nīlatvotpalatve apekṣya ādhāratayā saṃbandhi dravyaṃ sādhāraṇam | tayośca dravyaṃ prati ādheyatayā''ste sādṛśyam | tābhyāṃ sambandhi dravyam | tathā dvābhyāṃ saṃyogitvenāvacchedyāvacchedakabhāvena vā sambandhī kālastayoḥ sādhāraṇaḥ, tatkālasambandhitvākāreṇa tayorapi sādṛśyamasti | tābhyāṃ saṃbandhī kālaḥ | ato mithassadṛśapadārthasaṃbandhitayā dravyakālādiṣu samasamānādiśabdā lakṣaṇayā vartanta iti na mukhyāḥ | ata aikye prayogābhāvāt samaśabdasyaikyaṃ na mukhyārthaḥ | mukhyārthe saṃbhavati lākṣaṇikārthasvīkāro nopapadyate | ataḥ sāmyaśabdaḥ sādṛśyamevābhidhatte | muktātmagocarasāmānādhikaraṇyopapattiścānantarameva bhāṣye vakṣyate |
yaduktaṃ sāyujyaśabdena muktāvabheda ititadayuktam; sāyujyaśabdasya samānaguṇayogavācitvāt | yujyata iti yukchabdo guṇaparaḥ | dharmiṇi hi guṇaḥ saṃbadhyate | samānaguṇakaḥ sayuk, tasya bhāvaḥ sāyujyamiti hi vyutpattiḥ |
prayogavirodhācca naikyaṃ sāyujyam; "etāsāmeva devatānāṃ sāyujyaṃ sāṣṭatāṃ samānalokatāmāpnoti " iti bahvībhirdevatābhirekasya sāyujyāpattiḥ śrūyate | na hyekasya niravayavasyācchedyasyātmano bahvībhirdevatābhiraikyaṃ saṃ bhavati | kramabhāvitvādavirodha iti cet, tarhyagninaikībhūtasya varuṇasāyujyāpattau agnitvopādheḥ prahāṇādagnerdeva tāyā abhāvaḥ syāt | agnitvopādhau sthite, varuṇaikyāpattyanupapattiḥ | aupādhikabhedaprahāṇaṃ hyaikyāpattiḥ | na tu pūrvamavidyamānamaikyamutpadyate || agnau sthita eva tataḥ pṛthagbhūtasya varuṇasāyujyamiti cet, ekībhūtasya pṛthagbhāvo hyupādhitaḥ syāt | upādhiśca dehāntaḥkaraṇādiḥ | tatsambandhasyāhetukatve'tiprasaṅgāt heturvācyaḥ || karmaiva heturiti cet, agnisāyujyāpattidaśāyāṃ tat karma naṣṭaṃ na vā? naṣṭaṃ cetpunarupādhyanu dayenāgnitaḥ pṛthagbhāvāyogāt agnitvopādheścāprahāṇāt pūrvopādhiprahāṇarūpavaruṇasāyujyāpattiḥ krameṇāpi nopapadyate | anaṣṭaṃ cettatkṛtopādheranaṣṭa tvāt nāgninaikyāpattisaṃbhavaḥ; aupādhikabhedasya tatprahāṇarūpaikyāpattivirodhitvāt || anaṣṭamapi tatkarma āgnisāyujyāpattidaśāyāṃ tato bhedakamupādhiṃ na janayati karmaṇāṃ kāyarkāritvasya kālaviśeṣaniyatatvāditi cettathāpi vyavasthitakarmaviśeṣapariṣvaktasya jīvasya tatkarmāpariṣvaktādagnitastadeva karma bhedakamiti nāgninaikyāpattirupapannā | kiñca pṛthivyā ekībhūtapṛthagbhūtaghaṭasyeva agninā ekībhūtapṛthagbhūtajīvasyājatvanityatvānupapattiśca | ato bhede sthita eva agnyādisāyujyam |
samānalokatāsāhacaryācca naikyaṃ sāyujyam, na hyekasya svena samānalokatvasaṃbhavaḥ | ata samānalokatva vat bhede siddha eva sāyujyaṃ bhavati || samānalokatāprāptyanantaraṃ sāyujyāpattiḥ, na tu yugapadeva; atastayoravirodha iti cenna, "sāyujyaṃ sāṣṭatāṃ samānalokatām" iti sāyujyasya pūvarśrutatvāt || arthakrameṇa pāṭhakramabādha iti cenna; avayavaśakatyupasthāpitārthasya pāṭhakramānuguṇatvāt, arthāntarakalpanasyāhetukatvācca | yadi pāṭhakramabādhārthaṃ sāyujyaśabdasya aikyāpattilakṣaṇārthaviṣayā rūḍhiśaktiḥ kalpyate, tadā'nyonyāśrayaḥ syātsāyujyasyaikyāpattilakṣaṇatvaniścaye pāṭhakramabādhaḥ, pāṭhakramabādhe sati sāyujyasyaikyāpattilakṣaṇatvaniścaya iti || "eteṣāmeva salokatāṃ sāyujyamaśnute" iti vākyāt pūrvodāhṛtavākyasyakramabādha iti cet, na; viruddārthaviṣayāya rūḍhiśakteraklṛtatayā virodhāsphuraṇāt |
kiñca "agnervā etāni nāmadheyāni | agnereva sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti...vāyoreva indrasyaiva bṛhaspatereva prajāpaterevabrahmaṇa eva sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti" iti bhūyasāṃ vākyānāṃ balīyastvāt tvaduktakrama eva bādhyaḥ | kiñca "eteṣāmeva salokatāṃ sāyujyamaśnute | agnereva sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti" ityādivākyāni karmavidhiśeṣārthavādarūpāṇi | karmaphalatvāccāgnyādityādidevatāsāyujyamanityam | ataḥ karmaphalāvasāne'gnyādibhyaḥ tatsā yujyaṃ prāptānāṃ pṛthagbhāvasyāvarjanīyatvāt āmokṣājjīvabhedasthiterbhavatāmapīṣṭatvāt agnyādisāyujyadaśāyāmapi bhedasthitiravarjanīyā || agnyādisāyujyaṃ gatānāṃ tataḥ pṛthagbhāvaḥ punarapyupādhita iti cetdattamuttaram | na cāgnyādisāyujyoktirarthavādatvādanādaraṇīyeti vācyam; vedāntibhirarthavādānāṃ pratīyamānārthe prāmāṇyābhyupaga māt | ato na sāyujyamaikyam, api tu samānaguṇayoga eva |
layo'pi na svarūpaikyam; layaśabdasya tadarthatvābhāvāt | prayogānuguṇaṃ śabdārthavyavasthāpanaṃ kāryamiti | nityanaimittikamahāpralayeṣvapi layaśabdaḥ prayujyate; na tatra svarūpaikyāpattiḥ | na tāvannityapralaye; svarganarakādi
gamanāgamanaśāstrāt | nāpi naimittike; pūrvakalpapralīnānāṃ nāradādīnāṃ prāgjanmapratyabhijñānavatāmeva punarutpattyavagamāt | nāradena pūrvakalpe svajanmavṛttādikamiha kalpe'bhihitamiti purāṇeṣvavagamyate | nāpi mahāpralaye; vaiṣamyanairghṛṇyaparihārāya jīnityatvabahutvakarmavāsanānāṃtadānīṃ vidyamānatāyā abhyupagantavyatvāt | tathā "prakṛtiryā mayā''khyātā vyaktāvyaktasvarūpiṇī | puruṣaścāpyubhāvetau līyete paramātmani" iti vadatā bhagavatā parāśareṇaiva, "hiṃstrāhiṃstre mṛdukrūre dharmādharmāvṛtānṛte | tadbhāvitāḥ prapadyante tasmāt tat tasya rocate", "pradhānakāraṇībhūtā yato vai sṛjyaśaktayaḥ", "teṣāṃ ye yāni karmāṇi prāk sṛṣṭayāḥ pratipedire" ityādibhistadānīṃ savāsanakarmānvitajīva bahutvaṃ ca darśitam | ata eva bhedaprahāṇaṃ ca na layaśabdārthaḥ | na ca prākṛtapratisañcaramokṣaviṣayapralayaśabdayorartha vairūpthaṃ vaktumucitam; śaktibhedakalpanaamukhyatvayoranyataraprasaṅgāt | na ca tatrāpi mahāpralayādiṣu layaśabdasyāmukhyatvaṃ vācyam; bahuṣvartheṣvamukhyatvāśrayaṇādapi muktimātraviṣayapralayaśabdasyaivāmukhyatvāśrayaṇopapatteḥ | ataḥ sarvaprayogānuguṇo'rthaḥ svīkāryaḥ | ato visadṛśāvasthāprahāṇena kāraṇatvadharmiṇā dravyeṇa vibhāgasyāpādānabhūtena saṃśleṣo layaḥ || tasmāt aikyaṃ na layaśabdārthaḥ |
ghaṭākāśādidṛṣṭāntopanyāsaścaupādhikavaiṣamyābhāvanibandhanaḥ | ākāśāditattvānāmapi sāṃśatvāt | teṣāṃ pañcīkaraṇavacanena pradeśabhedavattā hi vedāntibhirabhyupetyā | ato mokṣaviṣayāsu śrutiṣu svarūpaikyaṃ kvacidapi nāvagamyate | nirguṇaprāptiviṣayā śrutiḥ kācidapi nāstīyayamarthaḥ anantaramevopapādyate | ata;, "sādharmyasmaraṇasya saguṇaprāptiviṣayatvānna paramamokṣaviṣayatvam; anyathā nirguṇaprāptiviṣayaśrutivirodhe smṛterdaurbalyaprasaṅgāt" ityapi duruktam |
tasmāt yadā paśyaḥ iti vākye sāmyaśabdaḥ sādṛśyaparaḥ | yenākāreṇa sāmyam, tasyākārasya niravadhikatvaṃ paramaśabdābhipretam | ata idaṃ vākyaṃ parabrahmaprāptirūpaṃ paramamokṣaṃ tatsāmyāpattilakṣaṇameva pratipādayati |
atha guṇopāsakasya saguṇabrahmaprāptiṃ vadantyetāḥ śrutayaḥ, na tu (para)brahmavidaḥ parabrahmaprāptimiti śaṅkāyāmāha paravidyāsviti | paravidyāsubrahmavidyāsvityarthaḥ | sarvāsupareṇa saguṇaviṣayatvena nirguṇaviṣayatvena coktāsu daharavidyāsadvidyādiṣvityarthaḥ | "adṛśyatvādiguṇakaḥ" iti paravidyāvākyaviṣayasūtrasvārasyāt tasyāḥ saguṇaviṣa yatvaṃ pratīyate | ānandādayaḥ pradhānasya iti sūtramupāsyasya saguṇatvāyodāhṛtam | vikalpo'viśiṣṭaphalatvāt iti sūtraṃ prāpyasya saguṇatvāyopāttam | ayamarthaḥpareṇa nirguṇaviṣayatvenābhimatānāṃ "satyaṃ jñānam", ānando brahma" ityādivākyānāmānandādiguṇaviśiṣṭaviṣayatvaṃ teṣāṃ ca guṇānāṃ sarvavidyānuyāyitvaṃ cokatvā, tāsvekaiva vidyā phalāyālamiti vidyāvikalpaścoktaḥ | ataḥ pareṇa nirguṇasaguraviṣayatvenābhimatāsu sadvidyādahāvidyādiṣūpāsyaṃ phalaṃ ca saguṇamiti saguṇaprāptyatirekeṇa nirguṇaprāptiḥ pramāṇaśūnyā | ato muktau bhedaparāṇāṃ śrutīnāmanyathāsiddhirnopapadyate, prāpyavaiṣamyābhāvāditi |
sūtrakārābhiprāyavidāmukiṃta darśayati vākyeti | yuktaṃ tadguṇakopāsanāditi | yuktamguṇayuktameva prāpyam; kutaḥ? tadguṇakopāsanādityarthaḥ | vidyāvikalpaśca tatraiva draṣṭavyaḥ | saccitaḥ sadvidyāniṣṭhaḥ | tarhi muktāvabhedaśruteḥ ko'rtha ityata āha brahmeti | "sa yo ha vai tatparamaṃ brahma veda brahmaiva bhavati" iti, prakṛtasya vediturbrahmaparyantasvarūpāvirbhāvaparamidaṃ vākyāmiti yathā setsyati, tathā vakṣyate | iha tvarthāntaramucyate | prākṛtanāmarūpaprahāṇajñāpanāya nāmarūpādvimukta iti śrutirudāhṛtā | sāmyapratipattyarthaṃ nirañjana iti vākyamupāttam | tasyaiva sāmyasya svābhāvikatvajñāpakaṃ paraṃ jyotiriti vākyam | tarhyamukhyatvaṃ syādityatrāha prakāraikye cet || so'yaṃ vrīhirityāderupalakṣaṇamidamudāharaṇam | "yathartuṣvṛtuliṅgāni nānārūpāṇi paryaye | dṛśyante tāni tānyeva tathā bhāvā yugādiṣu" ityādiprayogo bhāratādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ | dṛṣṭānte prakāraikye'pi tattāvyavahāro mukhyo'pyasvarasa, pūrvadṛṣṭe gavi vyakatyaṃśaprahāṇādasvārasyam, jātyaṃśasya sausādṛśyalakṣaṇaikyānmukhyatvam; dāṣṭintike tu gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa iti gaṅgāpadavat kārtsnena pravṛttinimittaprahāṇābhāvāt paramātmanīva pravṛttinimittapauṣkalyābhāvācca pravṛttinimittaikadeśānvayini muktātmani mukhyakoṭirityabhiprāyeṇa mukhya evetyuktam | lākṣaṇikagaṅgāpadavannātyantāmukhya ityarthaḥ | na hi muktasyāparicchinnajñānānandatve'pi jagatkāraṇatvānuguṇaguṇabṛhattvaṃ svarūpabṛhattaṃ cā(vā')sti | ākāraikye'pi tattāvyavahārasyātyantāmukhyatvābhāve seyaṃ(so'yaṃ) gauriti dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
na kevalaṃ yogasaṅgrahārambha; vistare'pyavyavahiteṣu pūrvaślokeṣu bhedapratipattirastītyāha atrāpīti | na kevalaṃ muktaviṣayaprakaraṇāntareṣu; asmin prakaraṇe'pīti vā'rthaḥ | asmin śloke tathaiveti brahmasādharmyopadeśe upayujyate | tathaivetyetadvayākhyānaṃ parabrahmavadityādi | prakṣīṇāśeṣabhāvanaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe karmabhāvaneti | parabrahmavat prakṣīṇāśeṣakamarbhāvana iti pāṭhe karmaśabdo yāgādikriyopāsanasādhāraṇānuṣṭheyamātraparaḥ | tadā karmaśabdena "trividhā bhāvabhāvanā" ityatra bhāvaśabdo vyākhyāto bhavati | atrāyamarthaḥprāpyaparabrahmaviṣajñānasya prāpakatvāt śuddhasvarūpamapi prāpyamiti tadanusandheyamiti | ayaṃ ca, "vyatirekastadbhāvabhāvitvāt" ityadhikaraṇārthaḥ | tatra baddhasvarūpaṃ cintyamiti pūrvapakṣīkṛtya muktasvarūpaṃ cintyamiti hi siddhāntitam | asya ślokasyaikaprakaraṇatvajñāpanāyānantaraśloko'pi vyākhyāyate kṣetrajña iti | yāvat kṣetrajñāvasthaḥ tāvat karaṇī upāsakaḥ, tasya karaṇaṃ jñānam, karaṇabhūtaṃ jñānaṃ muktikāryaṃ niṣpādya nivartayet, na tu mukteḥ pūrvameva nivartayedityarthaḥ | na hi muktasyopāsananivṛttirvidheyā; ato yāvanmokṣamanuṣṭheyatvamuktamiti bhāvaḥ | tadbhāvabhāvaśabdena brahmasāmyāpāttijñāpanārtham, "vibhedajanake'jñāne" ityatra jñāne iti padacchedaśaṅkāvyudāsārthaṃ ca tadbhāvabhāvamiti śloko vyākhyāyate | tadbhāvetiśloke tadbhāva ityupamānabahuvrīhiḥ | tadbhāva iti padāntargatau tacchabdabhāvaśabdau vyākhyātumāha tadbhāva iti | bhāṣyasthastadbhāvaśabdo na bahuvrīhiḥ; kintu tatpuruṣaḥ, samāso vyācikhyāsite sati hi bahuvrīhiviśiṣṭarūpeṇa padopādānam; tacchabdabhāvaśabdamātrasya vyācikhyāptitatvāt bahuvrīhiviśiṣṭarūpeṇa padasyānupādānam | tacchabdena brahmocyate, prathamabhāvaśabdena svabhāva ucyata ityarthaḥ | "bhāvo līlākriyāceṣṭābhūtyabhiprāyajantuṣu | padārthamātra sattāyāmātmayonisvabhāvayoḥ" iti naighaṇṭukāḥ | yadvā bhāṣyasthaḥ tadbhāvaśabdo'pi bahuvrīhiśiṣṭaḥ | tadbhāvaḥbrahmaṇo bhāvaḥ sva bhāva iti | tadbhāva iti pade tacchabdavācyabrahmasambandhitayā pratipanno bhāvaḥ svabhāva ityarthaḥ | athavā śloke'pi tadbhāvaśabdastatpuruṣaḥ | dvitīyabhāvaśabdaḥ sattāvācī | vyāvartyamāha na tviti | kuta ityatrāha tadbhāveti | hetvantaramāha pūrvoktārthavirodhācceti | heyapratyanīkatvaheyārhatvādivirodho'rthavirodhaḥ | evaṃ śabdaparyālocanayā arthaparyālocanayā ca bhāvaśabdasya svabhāvavācitvamupapāditam | svabhāvaśabdavācyañca pūrvaślokoktaṃ prakṣīṇāśeṣabhāvanatvamityāha yaditi | tacchabdasāmarthyāt yadvṛttamākṣiṣya vyācaṣṭe yadaivamiti | abhedītyatra bhedaśabdavyākhyānārthaṃ bhedaśabdaṃ nañpratyayābhyāṃ vibhajya nirdiśati bhedarahito bhavatīti | yadvā bhedarahito bhavatina tādātmyavāniti bhāvaḥ | anyathā bhedaśca tasyājñānakṛtaḥ ityanantaranirdeśo na ghaṭate | devādibhedābhāvaḥ kathamiti śaṅkāyāṃ bhedaśca tasyetyādi vyācaṣṭe jñānaikākāratayeti | "paramātmanā bhavatyabhedīti paramātmanaḥ prastutatvāt ātmano brahmaṇa ityatrāpi pañcamīvivakṣayā ca tasmādbheda ityuktam | brahmaṇo muktātmanaścākārāntareṇa bhedasya pramāṇasiddhatvāt nirasanīyabhedaviśeṣasya vacanāntarasiddhatvācca bhedo devādirūpa ityuktam | karmarūpaśabdena ajñānaśabdo vyākhyātaḥ |
jñānavirodhīti vyutpattirityarthaḥ | "avidyayā mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā" iti hi śrutiḥ | atrāpi, "avidyā kamarsaṃjñā'nyā" iti hi paṭhyate | tataḥ kiṃ bhedarāhityasyeti śaṅkāyāṃ bhedaśca tasyājñānakṛto bhavedityanenārthasiddhamabhipretaṃ kāraṇābhāvaṃ viśadayan kāryābhāvamupapādayati sa tviti | bhedasya devādirūpatve ajñānaśabdasya ca karmaparatve pramāṇa māha yathoktamiti | ādibharatacarite'yaṃ ślokaḥ | tatra pūrva dehendriyādibāhyabhedarahitatvamātmana uktaṃ sitanīlādītyādinā | asmin śloke buddhisukhaduḥkhecchāntarabhedo'pi nāstītyucyate | ekasvarūpeti | karmaiva vṛtiḥ karmavṛtiḥ | bāhmamāntaraṃ ca karma dvividham | āntaramātmaprāvaṇyahetuḥ karma | bāhmaṃ bahirviṣayaprāvaṇyahetuḥ karma | yadvā bāhyamaravābhāvikaṃ karma | tadeva vṛtiḥ | tayā prakarṣeṇa jātaḥ ekasvarūpa bhedaḥ bādyakarbha śarīradvārakaṃ ekasvarūpasya ātmanaḥ āntaraṃ bhedaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | dvārabhūta devādi śarīrabhede naṣṭe sati ekasvarūpabhede naṣṭe sati āntaro bhedo nāsti || kathaṃ vā devādibhede naṣṭe karmavṛttihetukāntarabhedanāśa ityatrāha anāvaraṇo hi sa iti | saḥnivṛttadevā dibheda ātmā, karmāvaraṇarahito hītyarthaḥ | yadvā karmavṛttiḥkarmajanyā vṛttiḥ, devādiśarīram; tatsaṃbandhajaḥ āntarabhedaḥ | devādibhede'padhvaste sa nāsti | kathaṃ karmajanyavṛtihetukāntarabhedo devādibhedāpadhvaṃse nāstītyatrāhaanāvaraṇo hi sa iti | karmajanyavṛtirdevādiśarīrabhedarūpetyarthaḥ | etadevabhadeśca tasyājñānakṛto bhavedityuktamevārtham | "vibhedajanaka" ityādiślokena "anāvṛttiḥ śabdāt" ityadhikaraṇārtha ucyate; parasmādvrahmaṇa ātmano devādibhedasya pranaṣṭasya punarāvṛtiṃta kaḥ kariṣyatītyucyate | vibhedaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe vibhedo vividho bheda iti | bhedasyadevādirūpatve pramāṇāntaramāha yathoktamiti | mithyājñānanibandhanaḥmithyājñānam ātmaviṣayabhrāntijñānam | tat karmadvārā uttarottaradevādibhedaheturityarthaḥ | asyottarārddham, "devatiryaṅmanuṣyākhyastathaiva nṛpa ! nārakaḥ" iti | vyākyeyaślo kasya vākyārthamāha ātmanīti | brahmaṇa iti padasya pañcamyantatvasūcanāya parasmādityuktam | ubhayorapi padayorvaiyadhikaraṇyena ṣaṣṭhayantatvamayuktam; ca śabdābhāvāt | anantarapūrvaśloke paramātmanā bhavatyabhedīti paramātmanaḥ pratiyogitayā nirdeśācca | ata eva samānādhikaraṇaṣaṣṭhayantatvamapyayuktam; pūrvaprapañcitārthavirodhācca || pañcamyantvaṃ ṣaṣyantatvaṃ ca viparyayeṇa syāditi cenna; parabrahmaṇo'pi heyārhatvāpatteḥ svābhāvikatvaprasaṅgāt | ataḥ parasmāt brahmaṇa ityuktam | asantamsacchabdaḥ paramārthaparyāyaḥ, "anāśī paramārthaśca" iti atraiva hyuktamanityabhityarthaḥ | tena svābhāvikanityabhedavyāvṛttiḥ | anityatvaṃ kādācitkatvam | anityatvāt hetvapekṣo devādibhedaḥ | taṃ kaḥ kariṣyati; na kaścidapi | hetvabhāvātkarmarūpahetvabhāvādityarthaḥ | na kevalamekārthaviṣaye "bāhyakarmavṛttiprajaḥ", "ajñānakṛto bhavet" ityajñānakarmaśabdayoḥ prayogādajñānaśabdasya karmārthatvam; asmin prakaraṇe ca kaṇṭhoktami tyāha avidyā karmasaṃjñā'nyeti hyatraivoktamiti | ātmana aupādhikabhedaḥ upādhyupagame naśyatīti ślokārthaḥ | upādhyabhāvādavidyamānaṃ bhedaṃ ka utpādayediti vā'rthaḥ | ayaṃ śloko mṛṣāvādināmatyantāsvarasaḥ, tathā hivibhe dajana ityatra janakaśabda utpādake svarasaḥ; na tvadhyāsahetau | ajñānaśabdasya anirvacanīyaparatvaṃ lokataḥ śāstrataśca na vyutpannam | karmavācitvavyutpattirasmin prabandha eva darśitā | nāśaśabdasya bādhavācitvamamukhyam | asantamiti padañca vyavacchedyābhāvādaphalam; sato bhedasyānabhyupagamāt | tadabhyupagame hi tatsāphalyam | kariṣyatīti padamapyasvarasam; adhyāsavācitvābhāvāt |
athādvaitaparatvena paroktaṃ bhagavadgītāvacanaṃ vyācaṣṭe kṣetrajñaṃ cāpīti | parābhimatārthasya pūrvāparavirodhaṃ darśa yati anyatheti | na kevalam, "uttamaḥ puruṣastvanyaḥ" iti bhedapratipādanāt tadvirodhena svarūpaikyaparatvābhāvaḥ,
sāmānādhikaraṇyopapādakamantaryāmitvaṃ kaṇṭhoktamapītyāha antaryāmīti | "īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛddeśe'rjuna ! tiṣṭhati" ityatra bhūtaśabdasyātmaparyantadehaparatvam "bhrāmayan sarvabhūtāni" iti asyottarārdhenāvagamyate; "na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni" ityādiprayogācca | "sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi saṃniviṣṭaḥ" ityatrāpi sarvaśabdasyātmaparyantatvaṃ "mattaḥ smṛtirjñānamapohanaṃ ca" ityanenāvagamyate | hṛdeśehṛddeśasthe ātmanītyarthaḥ | "sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi" ityapi tatha" | "aha mātmā guḍākeśa" ityatrāpyantaryāmitvaparatāmāha ahamiti | kuta ityatrāha bhūtaśabdo hīti | pūvardarśitasarvaśabdaikārthyācceti bhāvaḥ | anvayarūpeṇoktasya sarveṣāṃ bhagavadātmakatvasya śeṣabhūto'yaṃ "na tadastī"ti vyatirekanirdeśastadanuguṇa evetyabhiprāyeṇāha yataḥ sarveṣāmiti | avinābhāvaśabdasya saṃbandhaniyamavācitvāditi bhāvaḥ | hetvantarañcāha bhagavaditi | "etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca" iti prakramāt vibhūtiparatvamavagamyate | ataḥ upakramānuguṇa eva upasaṃhāra ityarthaḥ | na hi vibhūtitvaṃ vidhāya tadeva niṣeddhuṃ śakyamiti bhāvaḥ | prakaraṇasya vibhūtiparatvaṃ darśayati yadya diti | vibhūtimatniyāmyavat | śrīmatbhogyasamṛsiddhamat | ūrjitambalavat; kalyāṇaguṇārambheṣu uktam | tejaḥparābhibhavanasāmarthyampraśāsanam | tejoṃśasaṃbhavamniyamanaśaktimadājñālavādhīnamityarthaḥ | śāstrasya paroktātharparatvābhāvamupasaṃharati ata iti | ataḥśrutiyojanāprabhṛti pratipāditairnyāyairityarthaḥ | bhrāntatvaṃ bhrāntisiddhatvam | jagadbrahmaṇorekadravyatvapakṣe brahmaṇaḥ saviśeṣatvaṃ jagatsatyatvañcopapannamiti śaṃkāyāṃ tadvayudāsārthamāha nāpīti | cetaneṣvaciddharmabuddhiḥ, paratantreṣu svatantrabuddhiśca bhramaḥ; na tu svarūpabhedadhīrityabhiprāyeṇa nasvarūpabhedaniṣedha ityuktam | athavā mṛṣāvādinamevoddiśya jīvaparayo svarūpabhedaniṣedhābhāvamāha nāpīti | acidupādānaṃ dṛṣṭāntatayā ||
<2>
athāvidyāṃ dūṣayituṃ tadviṣaye paroktamarthamanuvadati | yadapīti | nirviśeṣasya kathaṃ bhramasaṃbhava ityatrāha  doṣeti | brahmavyatiriktadoṣo'sti cet, advaitahānirityatrāha  doṣaśceti | asminnarthe paroktāḥ śrutismṛtyarthāpattīrdarśayati anṛteneti | sadasadvilakṣaṇatvamupapādayati  sā tviti | bhrāntibādhayorayogāt bhrāntiviṣayatvabādhaviṣayatvayorayogāt | pramitibhrāntibādhānyathānupapattyā sadasadanirvacanīyatvamityarthaḥ | "sadbhāva evaṃ bhavato mayoktaḥ" itivat, na paramatamiti darśayituṃ  tattvavida ityuktam |
dūṣayati  tadayuktamiti | āśrayānupapattitirodhānānupapattisvarūpānupapattianirvacanīyatvānupapattipramāṇānupapattinivṛttyanupapattibhirdūyayiṣyan prathamamāśrayānupapattimāha  sā hīti | kimāśritya | na kiñcidapītyarthaḥ | kiṃ jīvamāśritya, uta brahma iti vikalpābhiprāyeṇāha  na tāvaditi | jīve siddhe avidyāsiddhiḥ, avidyāsiddhau jīvasiddhirityanyonyāśraya ityarthaḥ | jīvājñānavādanirāsaḥ uttaratra vistareṇa vakṣyata iti atra saṃkṣepaḥ | atha brahmāśrayatvapakṣaṃ dūṣayati  nāpīti | virodhitvaṃ kathamityatrāha  sā hīti | brahmaviṣayājñānasya tatprakāśabādhyatvāt virodhaḥ |
atra nāthamunibhiruktān ślokānāha  jñānarūpamiti | svaprakāśatvaṃ vivakṣitam | jñānanivartyatve hetumāha  mṛṣātmakamiti | na hi svarūpajñānamajñānavirodhi, api tu pramāṇajñānameveti pakṣamanūdya dūṣayati  jñānamiti | brahmavat tatprakāśatvātsvarūpānatiriktaprakāśatvādityarthaḥ | na hi śuklabhāsvaradravye gṛhīte, āptavākyādibhiḥ śuklabhāsvaradravyamityetāvati śataśaḥ pratipanne'pi bhramanivṛttiḥ | dūṣaṇāntarañcāha  jñānamiti | tataḥ kimityatrāha  brahmaṇa iti | eṣu ślokeṣu prathamaślokasyārthaḥ pūrvaṃ jñānabādhyābhimatetyantena bhoṣyeṇoktaḥ | dvitīyaślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe  jñānasvarūpamiti | brahmasvarūpaprakāśatve sati  svarūpaviṣayajñānatve satītyarthaḥ | viśeṣānavagamātviṣayavaiṣamyābhāvādityarthaḥ | kathaṃ viśeṣānavagamaḥ; pramāṇajanyatvaṃ viśeṣo'stīti cetkiṃ tena? viṣayavaiṣamyaṃ hi na vidyate | kiṃ svarūpabhūtajñānānnivartakajñānasya viṣayavaiṣamyam? asti vā | na vā | asti cetsaviśeṣatvam | no cetsvarūpameva nivartakaṃ syāt | pramāṇajanyajñānamanivartakaṃ vā syāt, puro'vasthitabhāsvaravastuviṣayajñānavat | pramāṇajanyajñānatvaṃ na nivartakatve prayojakam; idaṃ śuklabhāsvaradravyamiti vākyajanyasya jñānasya nivartakatvābhāvāt | tasmāt bhramasahakārādatiriktākāraviṣayatvaṃ nivartakatve prayojakam ||
nanu viṣayavaiṣamyābhāve'pi kasyacit jñānasya bhramāvirodhitvaṃ kasyacidbhramavirodhitvaṃ ca dṛṣṭamabhijñāpratyabhijñayoḥ| ayameko devadatta ityabhijñāyā ekaviṣayatve'pi, pūvardṛṣṭādayamanya iti puruṣadvitvabhramo dṛṣṭaḥ; pratyabhijñāyāstu so'yameko devadatta iti devadattaikyaviṣayatve'pi dvitvavirodhitvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti viṣayavaiṣamyābhāve'pi pramāṇajñānasya bhramanirvatakatvaṃ yuktamiti śaṅkāyāmāha  etaduktamiti | satyatvajñānatvādisvabhāvo'stīti cetsa ca svarūpānatirikta iti darśayituṃ svabhāvaśabdaḥ | anenābhijñāpratyabhijñayorapi viṣayavaiṣamyamuktaṃ bhavati | abhijñāyāmekasya dharmiṇi ekadeśakālasaṃbandhitvaṃ pratipannam, na tu kāladvayadeśadvayasaṃbandhitvam | tattu pratyabhijñāyāṃ pratipannam | ekadeśakālasaṃbandhitvapratītirna dvitvavirodhinī | ekasya dharmiṇaḥ kāladvayadeśadvayasaṃbandhitvaṃ hyaikyam | tattu dvitvavirodhīti tatpratipattirdvitvabhramaṃ nivartayati | atastatrāpi viṣayavaiṣamyamastīti phalitam |
atha tṛtīyaślokārthasya viparyaye paryavasānamāha  kiñceti | pramāṇajñānatvaṃ nivartakatvavyāpakam | ato'dhiṣṭhānabhūtabrahmasvarūpasya pramāṇajñānatvābhāvānna bhramanivatarkatvam | adhiṣṭhānatvāt śuktayādivat brahmasvarūpaṃ na bhramavirodhīti pramāṇāntarajñānamapekṣata iti śaṅkayāmāha  śuktayādayastviti | adhiṣṭhānatvasya jñānāntaraviṣayatvaṃ vyāpakam | ato vyāpakanivṛttyā adhiṣṭhānatvanivṛttiriti, adhiṣṭhānatvādeva brahmasvarūpasphuraṇe'pi pramāṇāntaramapekṣeta | naivam | jaḍatvādeva hi śuktayādeḥ svarūpasphuraṇe'pi pramāṇāntarāpekṣā, nādhiṣṭhānatvāt | ato'dhiṣṭhānatvaṃ sopādhikam | atra tvajaḍatvāt svarūpasphuraṇe pramāṇāntarāpekṣā nāstīti cettarhi jaḍatvādeva bhramanivṛttau śuktayāderjñānāntarāpekṣā, nādhiṣṭhānatvāt | atastat sopādhikam | tasmādajaḍe tu pramāṇāntarāpekṣā bhramanivṛttau ca na syādityabhiprāyaḥ | śuktayādayastvityatra tuśabdo brahmaṇaḥ śuktayādivyāvṛttiparaḥ |
dvayī hyadvaitināṃ gatiḥbrahmaviṣayapramāṇajñānaṃ bhramanivartakam, prapañcamithyātvaviṣayajñānaṃ bhramanivartakamiti ca | tatra prathamapakṣo dūṣitaḥ | atha dvitīyapakṣaṃ dūṣayituṃ śaṅkate athocyeteti | dūṣayati  netyādinā | idamiti | nanu kathaṃ prapañcasatyatvamajñānamityucyate? ajñānaṃ hi jñānapratibandhakam | na hi prapañcasatyatvaṃ kasyacit jñānaṃ pratibadhnāti | satyam; ācchādakājñānamevambhūtam | prapañcasatyatvaṃ tatpratibhāsaśca vikṣeparūpājñānamiti parābhyupagamādevamuktam | prathamaṃ śiro dūṣayati  ataditi | kathamatadviṣayatvāt brahmasvarūpājñānāvirodhitvamityatrāha  jñānājñānayoriti | virodhe hi nivṛttirityarthaḥ | dvitīyaṃ śiro dūṣayati  prapañceti | prapañcamithyātvajñānena brahmasvarūpājñānanivṛtteḥ phalitatvamāśaṅkate brahmasvarūpeti | sadvitīyatvam sadvitīyatvajñānamityarthaḥ | na hi sattayā sadvitīyatvaṃ brahmasvarūpājñānaṃ bhavati, apāramārthyāt | sadvitīyatvaviśiṣṭabrahmagocarājñāne nivṛtte viśeṣyāṃśagocaramapi jñānaṃ nivṛttamiti svarūpasiddhiḥ kathamityatrāha  svarūpaṃ tviti | dūṣayati  neti | advitīyatvaṃ kiṃ svarūpam, uta dharmaḥ iti vikalpābhiprāyeṇa prathamaṃ svarūpapakṣaṃ dūṣayati  neti | dharmapakṣe apasiddhāntamāha  advitīyatvamiti | āśrayānupapatiṃta nigamayati ata iti | virodhādevapūrvoktādevetyarthaḥ | evamāśrayānupapattiruktā ||
atha tirodhānānupapattimāha kiñceti | nanu bhavatpakṣe'pi kṣetrajñānāṃ nityaṃ sphuraṇamasti | tathāpi teṣāṃ svarūpatirodhānena vinā na dehātmabhrama iti tulyā anupapattiḥ | satyam | svarūpasphuraṇamastyeva | na tasya tirodhānamabhyupagamyate | na ca svarūpasphūraṇaṃ bhramavirodhi; kiṃ tu nityatvāṇutvaniravayavatvādīnyeva bhramavirodhīni | tānyāgamagamyāni teṣāṃ tirodhiḥ tadviṣayajñānaprasarābhāvarūpaḥ saṅkocaḥ | ataḥ svārūpātiriktākārāntaratirodhānābhyupagamāt nā''tmano nāśaprasaṅgaḥ | jñānasyātmāsādhāraṇākārasya sphuraṇādbhramānupapattiriti cenna; tasyāsādhāraṇatvāsphuraṇāt | asādhāraṇatayā sphurato hi dharmasya bhramavirodhitvaṃ dṛṣṭam | yathā śuktitvādeḥ | śuktitvaṃ hi śuktayasādhāraṇatayā pūrva jñātaṃ paścāt bhramaṃ nivartayati | na tāvat jñānaṃ dehātiriktātmāsādhāraṇadharmatvena kvaciddṛṣṭacaram | ato bhramaḥ saṃbhavati | ātmāsādhāraṇadharmatvādarśanādadhyāsaḥ, adhyāsādasādhāraṇadharmatvāgrahaṇamityanyonyāśrayo'nāditayā parihṛtaḥ | dharmabhūtajñānasya nityatvaṃ tirodhānaṃ ca bhavadbhirabhyupagamyate, tadā jñānanāśaprasaṅga iti cenna | jñānaṃ hi dravyam | tasya svarūpātirekeṇa saṅkocavikāsātmakamavasthādvayamabhyupetam | atastattirodhānaṃ kamarṇā tatsaṅkocaḥ | tannivṛttistu prasaraḥ | sa eva prakāśaḥ | sa cānityaḥ | tasyānityatve'pi nityasya jñānadravyasya svaprakāśatvavādaḥ svaprakāśanarūpaprasaraṇārhatvanibandhanaḥ | ato'vasthādvayasyā''gamāpāyitvāt dravyaṃ nityameva | asmadavasthāsthānīyo hi bhavataḥ prakāśaḥ | sa eva svarūpam | tasmāt tirodhānaṃ tannivṛttirevaitīmamarthamabhipretya prakāśaikasvarūpa brahmetyuktam | ataḥ svarūpātirekiprakāśatirodhānākhyāvasthādvayānabhyupagamāt svarūpanāśa eva tirodhānaṃ syādityarthaḥ ||
atha svarūpānupapattimāha apicepi | jñātṛtvādīnāmaparamārthatayā hi doṣāntarāpekṣā | tadvadihāpīti dṛṣṭāntatayā vakṣyamāṇanavasthopayogitvena nirviṣayetyādiparipāṭīprakaṭanaṃ kṛtam | yadvā viṣayāśrayabhedānāmasattvapratibhāsayoruktirdoṣakalpanākāraṇatvena kṛtā | anabhyupagamāditi | paramāthartve hyadvaitahāniprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | aparamārthapakṣaṃ dūṣayituṃ koṭitrayameva saṃbhāvitamityāha  tathāsatīti | aparamāthartvāt mūladoṣāntarāpekṣayā'navastheti dūṣaṇaṃ koṭitrayasyāpi sādhāraṇam | dṛśitvapakṣe adhikaṃ dūṣaṇamastīti darśayati | na tāvaditi | kimanavacchinnā dṛśiḥ, utāvacchinnā? dṛśeranavacchinnatve kiṃ svarūpātiriktā, uta svarūpameveti vikalpamabhipretya, anavacchinnapakṣe svarūpātiriktapakṣaṃ dūṣayati  dṛśisvarūpabhedānabhyupagamāditi | anavacchinnadṛśidvayānabhyupagamādityarthaḥ | anavacchinnapakṣe svarūpadṛśipakṣaṃ dūṣayati  bhrameti | avacchinnadṛśidūṣaṇatvena vakṣyamāṇānavasthā anavacchinnapakṣe'pi samānā; atrādhikadūṣaṇadvayasadbhāvāt sā noktā | avacchinnadṛśitvena draṣṭṛtvena dṛśyatvena cābhyupagamaṃ dūṣayati  draṣṭṛdṛśyayoriti | kālpanikatvena  aparamārthatvenetyarthaḥ | doṣāntarāpekṣāheturidaṃ kālpanikatvam | avacchinnadṛśipakṣe'pi svarūpatadvayatiriktavikalpe svarūpapakṣepi tulyamanabhyupagamadūṣaṇam; brahmasvarūpasyāvacchinnatvāpāramārthyānabhyupagamāt | ato'vacchinnapakṣe na vikalpitam; svarūpātiriktapakṣe'navasthoktā | athaitaditi | aparamārthatve'navasthā, paramārthatve advaitahānirityetaddoṣaparijihīrṣayetyarthaḥ | anubhūtereva doṣatvānnādvaitahāniḥ, tasyāḥ pāramārthyāt nānavastheti ca bhāvaḥ | etaddūṣayati  brahmaiveti | apāramārthyāddoṣāntarasāpekṣatvasāmyamabhipretya prapañcatulyaśabda uktaḥ | ataḥ  pratiśiro'bhihitairdūṣaṇairityarthaḥ | anirmokṣaprasaṅgaparihārāya brahmavyatiriktatvam, anavasthāparihārāya pāmārthikatvam |
parairanavasthā tridhā parihṛtā | jīvajñānavādinā bījāṅkuranyāyāt pravāhānāditvena parihṛtā; avidyayā jīvaḥ jīvādavidyeti hi tanmatam | brahmajñānavādinā svarūpānāditvena parihṛtā | ubhābhyāṃ ca durghaṭatvena parihṛtā  durghaṭatvamavidyā bhūṣaṇam, na tu dūṣaṇamiti | paramārthasya hyupapattyapekṣā | prāsādanigaraṇādiṣvalpāsyena vipulaprāsādanigaraṇamanupapannamiti yuktirna pravartate | ata upapattinirapekṣatvamapāramārthyasādhakam | doṣasya svaparanirvāhakatvena doṣāntaranairapekṣyācca nānavastheti |
atrocyatepravāhānāditvaṃ brahmājñānavādinaiva dattottaram, jīvanityatvaśrutibhirakṛtābhyāgamakṛtavipraṇāśādirūpaśrutyarthāpattyā ca āmokṣājjīvasya sthāyitvamiṣṭaṃ hīyeteti | apāramārthye svarūpānāditvamapi nānavasthāparihāraḥ; tathāsati mādhyamikapakṣavijayaprasaṅgāt | tatra, "adhiṣṭhānasya bhrāntisiddhatve tasyāḥ bhrānteradhiṣṭhānāntarāpekṣā syāt, tasyāpi bhrāntisiddhatve anavasthā syāt" ityanavasthayā hyadhiṣṭhānapāramārthyaṃ sādhitam | mādhyamikenāparamārthādhiṣṭhānasya svarūpānāditve svīkṛte anavasthā parihṛtetyadhiṣṭhānāpāramārthyameva syāt | kiñca svarūpānāditve'pi mūladoṣāpekṣā'styeva, jīvasyānāditve'pyavidyāparikalpitatvasya bhavadbhiraṅgīkṛtatvāt |
durghaṭatvaṃ cānupapannam | durghaṭatvaṃ nāma upapattinirapekṣatvam | tat apāramārthyasādhakaṃ cet aparamārthasya prapañcasya durghaṭatvenopapattinirapekṣatvānmūladoṣāpekṣā ca na syāt | nivartakajñāne satyapi sā'vatiṣṭheta | virodhānna tiṣṭhatīti cet; tarhyupapattyanuvartinvavidyā syāditi | paramārthatvaprayuktopapattiraparamārthatvaprayuktopapattiriti dvividhā upapattiḥ; tatra dugharṭatvaṃ nāma paramārthatvaprayuktopapattinirapekṣatvam; aparamārthatvaprayuktopapattirhi doṣānekṣā; ataḥ prapañcasya mūladoṣaparikalpanaṃ yuktamiti cettarhyaparamārthatvaprayuktopapattirūpadoṣāpekṣā aparamārthabhūtadoṣasyāpi syāt | tato'navasthā tadavasthaiva | durghaṭatvamanavasthāparihāraścetadhiṣṭhānāpāramārthyepyanavasthā parihṛtā syāt | tatrāpāramārthyaprayuktopapattiravarjanīyeti adhiṣṭhānāpekṣā syādevetyanavasthitiriti vaktavyam | tadatra doṣe'pi tulyamityanavasthā duṣpariharā | pravāhānāditvapakṣe'pyadhiṣṭhānāpāramārthye'pyanavasthā suparihārā; pitṛputrādiparamparāvadadhiṣṭhānaparamparānāditvābhyupagamāt |
jīvājñānavādinaṃ prati brahmājñānavādinā yat durghaṭatve dūṣaṇamuktam, tad brahmajñānavādepi tulyam | yathāavidyāyā durghaṭatvaṃ cetmuktān paraṃ brahma cāśrayedavidyā | śuddhasvarūpaṃ brahma aśuddhasvarūpā avidyā virodhānnāśrayatīti cet tarhyupapattimatī avidyā | tasmāduktānyonyāśrayaṇādidūṣaṇāni āpateyuriti hyuktam | tat tavāpi tulyam | mokṣe'pi brahmāśrayedavidyā | na hi bādhakajñāne sati aparamārthabhūtā avidyā tiṣṭhatīti cetbādhakasaṃnidhau na bādhyasiddhirityevaṃrūpopapattimatyevāvidyeti asmaduktāni anavasthādidūṣaṇānyāpateyuriti hi vaktuṃ śakyate |
doṣasya svaparanirvāhakatve adhiṣṭhānamapi tathā syāt | paraṃ pratyadhiṣṭhānatve siddhe hi svanirvāhakatvamiti cetparaṃ prati doṣatve siddhe hi svanirvāhakatvam, tadeva nāstīti tulyaṃ syāt | adhiṣṭhānoropyayorbhedo dṛṣṭaḥ | tatrādhiṣṭhanasya svaparanirvāhakatve adhiṣṭhānādhyastayoraikyaprasaṅga iti cetdoṣatatkāyaryorapi timiracandradvitvayorbhedo dṛṣṭaḥ | doṣasya svaparanirvāhakatve doṣādhyastayoraikyaprasaṅga iti tulyamiti | etadabhiprāyeṇa yāvadbrahmavyatiriktapāramārthikadoṣānabhyupagamaḥ, na tāvadbhrāntirupapāditā bhavatītyuktam | yathoktamācāryapādaiḥ
"svarūpānāditvasvaparaghaṭena durghaṭanatā pravāhānāditvaṃ punariti casasro hi gatayaḥ |
asatyāvidyāyā gaditumanavasthāparihṛtau matāstvetāstulyāḥ sphuṭamasadadhiṣṭhānasaraṇau ||" iti ||
athānirvacanīyatvānupapattimāha anirvacanīyatvañceti | anirvacanīyatā  vidvatsannidhau durupapādatvam | kathaṃ pramāṇaśūnyatvamityatrāha  etaduktamiti | sarvaṃ sarvapratīterviṣayaḥ syāditi | sadasadvilakṣaṇamiti yā pratītiḥ; tatrāpi sadasadeva viṣayaḥ syādityarthaḥ | pratītyanuguṇaṃ hi nīlapītādi vyavasthāpyate | tasmāt sadasadākārāyāḥ pratīteḥ sadasadākāra eva viṣayaḥ, na sadasadvilakṣaṇaḥ | yathā khyātiviveke, "na hyanyat avabhāsyam, anyo viṣayaḥ; avabhāsanavyavasthāpyatvādviṣayasya" iti | ekasya viṣayasya sadasadākāratvamanupapannam, vyāptivirodhāditi cetsadasadvilakṣaṇatvaṃ ca vyāptivirodhādanupapannam | sato'sadvilakṣaṇatvamasatassadvilakṣaṇatvañca hi dṛṣṭam, na tvekasyobhayavelakṣaṇyaṃ dṛṣṭamiti vyāptivirodhaḥ | ayaṃ viśeṣaḥsadasadvilakṣaṇatvaṃ kvacidapi na dṛṣṭam; sadasadātmakatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti | yathā saṃvitsiddhau 
"nāsūta pratīterbādhāñca na sadityapi yanna tat | pratītereva sat kiṃ na bādhānnāsat kuto jagat ||" iti | arthasthitau sattvamasattvaṃ vā syāt; na tadvilakṣaṇatvam | sato ghaṭādeḥ sadasadvilakṣaṇatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti cetna; tathāsati brahmaṇo'pi sadasadvilakṣaṇatvaprasaṅgāt | anyataratvasahaṃ sadasadvilakṣaṇatvamiṣṭameveti cettulyam | īdṛśaṃ sadasadvailakṣaṇyaṃ vadatā, śabdāntareṇa sattvamevāṅgīkṛtaṃ bhavati | atastvadabhimataṃ sadasadvilakṣaṇatvaṃ virodhādapāstam | astīti pratipannatvaṃ sattvam, nāstīti dhīviṣayatvaṃ bādhitatvamityekasyaiva sattvāsattvavirodhaḥ sadasadvilakṣaṇatvakalpaścetsarvatra pūrvapakṣasiddhāntapratītyoḥ parasparaviruddhākāraviṣayatvādubhayākāravilakṣaṇa evārthaḥ sādhyata iti siddhāntasamarthanavaiyarthyaṃ syāt | tataśca bhedaḥ sunirūpa iti pūrvapakṣīkṛtya durnirūpa iti tvayā siddhāntite pratītidvayavirodhāt sunirūpadurnirūpavilakṣaṇaḥ syāt | evaṃ savitsatyatvamithyātvajaḍatvājaḍatvanityatvānityatvādivādeṣu pūrvapakṣasiddhāntākāravilakṣaṇatvaṃ saṃvidaḥ syāt | taccānabhimatam | ataḥ parasparaviruddhākārapratītyoḥ pratipannākāravailakṣaṇyakalpakatvaṃ vyāptiviruddhamiti na sadasadvelakṣaṇyasiddhiḥ |
tarhi khyātibādhānyathānupapatteḥ kaḥ parihāra ukta iti cetanyathaivopapattiruktā bhavati; sattve sati anyathākhyānādibhistattadvādyabhimataireva khyātibādhopapatteḥ | sataḥ kathaṃ bādhaḥ | anyatra khyātatvāt | nanvanyatra saccet, na bādhaḥ; na saccet, asatkhyātiprasaṅga iti cennaanyatra sattvāt | anyatra sato'nyatra khyātatvaṃ hyanyathākhyātatvam | anyatra sato'nyatra khyātirdoṣavaśāt | doṣasyānyatra khyātihetutvaṃ na dṛṣṭamiti cetdoṣasyānirvacanīyā(yatayā)vabhāsahetutvaṃ ca na kvacidvimatipadādanyatra dṛṣṭamiti tulyam | mitho viruddhapratipannākāradvayavailakṣaṇyamekasyāviruddhamityetat tavādhikam | akhyātipakṣe sattve sati bhedāgrahaṇe khyātivādhopapattiḥ | sata evāgṛhītabhedatayā khyātiḥ | bhedagaahaśca bādhaḥ | bādhyatvaṃ ca pravṛtteḥ | yathārthakhyātipakṣe tu śaktijanasvapnārthādau sattvāt prācuryābhāvāt sthiratvadekānubhāvyatvāgrahācca khyātibādhopapattiḥ | purovartini sata eva rajatasya khyātiḥ | śuktiprācuryagraho bādhaḥ | tena pravṛttirbādhyā | tadbādhaśca pravṛttyanupapattiḥ | alātacakrādau tu akhyātipakṣa iva tadupapattiḥ | ato'nyathaivopapattiḥ siddhetyanirvacanīyatvakalpanamayuktam |
evamāśrayatirodhānasvarūpānirvacanīyatvānupapattaya uktāḥ | atha "na hi dṛṣṭe'nupapannaṃ nāma" iti nyāyāt pramāṇasiddhārthasya tarkeṇa bādho na yukta ityabhiprāyavatā pareṇa pramāṇapratijñā śaṅkayate | atha syāditi | pūrvadūṣitākārān sādhayitumāha  vastusvarūpeti | anenatirodhānamuktam | āntarabāhyeti svarūpamuktam | adhyāsopādānatvena hi mithyātvaṃ phalitam | sadasaditi anirvacanīyatvamuktam | śāstreṣvetatpratipādakaśabdapratyabhijñānārtham avidyājñānādipadavācyamityuktam | siddhāntinā dūṣayiṣyamāṇamākārāntamapi sādhyatvenāha  vastuyāthātmyajñāneti | tadupahiteti āśrayaśca | āntarādhyāsaḥ kaḥ, bāhyaḥ kaḥ, kathaṃ cāvidyopādānatve brahmaṇa upādānatvamityatrāha  tadupahiteti | niṣkṛṣṭabrahmaṇa upādānatvānupapatiṃta sūcayati  avikāre svaprakāśacinmātravapuṣi pratyagātmanīti | avikāratvāt svaprakāśatvāt pratyaktavācca vikārāspadajaḍaparāgrūpapariṇāmo nopapadyata ityarthaḥ | svaprakāśasya kathamadhyāsasaṃbhava ityatrāha  tirohitasvarūpa iti | tirodhāyakaṃ kimityatrāha  tenaiveti | tenaivaadhyāsahetunaivetyarthaḥ | ahaṅkāro'jñānaṃ cāntarādhyāsaḥ, jñeyaṃ bāhyādhyāsaḥ | adhyāsarūpeadhyastarūpekarmaṇi ghañtasyaivadoṣasyaiva avasthāviśeṣeṇakādācitkāvasthāviśeṣeṇa rajjusarpādyadhyāsaḥ (ityanvayaḥ?) | evaṃ niṣkṛṣṭabrahmaṇa upādānatvānupapattiruktā | doṣasyopādānatve upapattimāha  kṛtsnasyeti | suvarṇajātīyasya bhūṣaṇasya svarṇameva hyupādānaṃ dṛṣṭam, tadviti bhāvaḥ | hetubalātkāryakāraṇayotsajātīyatvadadaśarnalakṣaṇāt | atha pratyakṣamāha  kāraṇeti | ahamajña ityasya vivaraṇam māmanyaṃ ca na jānāmīti | ahamajña ityajñānasvarūpakītarnam | tasya māmanyaṃ ca na jānāmītyācchādanarūpakāryakathanam | kāraṇaśabdena kāryarūpājñānavyāvṛttiḥ | tasmāt sauṣuptikamajñānaṃ vivakṣitam | jāgaritādyavasthāyāṃ ghaṭādyavacchinnamajñānaṃ pratīyate savikalpakapratyakṣeṇa; suṣuptau tu anavacchinnakāraṇājñānapratītiriti tattvaśuddhikārādimiruktam | jāgaritāvasthāyāmevājñānānubhavo'yamiti saṃpradāyaḥ; anyaṃ ca na jānāmītyukteḥ | na hi svāpe'nyaparāmarśaḥ | na jānāmītyācchādakatayā pratīyamānasyājñānasya kāraṇatvāt kāraṇājñānaviṣayamityuktam | aparokṣāvabhāsa iti parokṣarūpānumānādipramāṇavyāvṛttyarthamuktam | jñānaprāgabhāvaviṣayatvamāśaṅkaya pariharati  ayaṃtviti | bhavatvayamapi ṣaṣṭhapramāṇaviṣaya ityāśaṅkayāha  ayaṃ tviti | parokṣapramāṇāni pratyakṣavyatiriktāni | tasmāt parokṣapramāṇaviṣayaḥ prāgabhāvo nāparokṣapramāṇaviṣayabhūtamajñānaṃ bhavitumarhatītyarthaḥ | bhāvagrāhipramāṇenābhāvasya vedyatve'pi dūṣaṇamāha  abhāvasyeti | hetumāha  anubhaveti | abhāvasyānubhavavelāyāṃ jñānaṃ vidyate, na vā? vidyate cet, grāhyābhāvānnābhāvapratītiḥ | na cet, grāhakābhāvānna tadabhāvapratītirityarthaḥ | bhāvābhāvayorekaviṣayatve hi virodhaḥ | atra virodho nāsti | abhāvaviṣayakajñānasya vidyamānasya grāhakatvāt itaraviṣayajñānasyābhāvapratiyogitvenāvidyamānatvāditi śaṅkāṃ pariharananubhavavelāyāṃ jñānasya vidyamānatvam, avidyamānatve jñānābhāvapratītyanupapattim, bhāvarūpatve virodhābhāvaṃ ca vivṛṇoti  etaduktaṃ bhavatīti | jñānaprāgabhāvasya grāhyatve anicchayāpi bhāvābhāvayorekaviṣayatvamāpatitamityabhiprāyeṇāha  ahamiti | jñānasya ceti | jñānaśabda ātmaviṣayaghaṭādiviṣayajñānasādhāraṇaḥ | iha bhūtale ghaṭo nāstītyādiṣu abhāvagrahaṇe pratiyogidharmiṇorjñānāpekṣā dṛṣṭā | tasmādatrāpyabhāvadharmitayā
ātmano jñānamastīti vaktavyam | abhāvavyatirikto hyātmā | ataḥ tadviṣayajñāne satyapi abhāvavyatiriktaviṣayajñānamabhāvapratiyogīti vacanaṃ vyāhataṃ syāt | abhāvadharmipratiyogirūpatritayavyatiriktaviṣayajñānamabhāvapratiyogīti cettadānīmabhāvapratiyogitayā jñānasyāpi pratītirastīti vaktavyam | pratīyamānaṃ jñānaṃ svaviṣayāvacchinnaṃ pratīyata iti viṣayāṇāmapi pratītirasti | evamabhāvapratiyogijñānāvacchedakatayā viṣayeṣu jñāyamāneṣu tadviṣayajñānābhāvo'nupapanna iti bhāvaḥ | abhāvasya pramāṇāntaraviṣayatve'pyuktadūṣaṇamatidiśati  jñānābhavasyeti | pramāṇāntarāṇāṃ vidyamānaviṣayatvaniyamābhāve'pi vidyamānatayā darśayitumaśakyamiti (?) bhāvaḥ | ahamajña iti vartamānatayā hyajñānaṃ pratīyate ! asmin pakṣe adhikaṃ dūṣaṇāntaraṃ pūrvamuktam aparokṣasya parokṣarūpapramāṇaviṣayatvānupapattirūpamarthasiddham | bhāvarūpatve uktadūṣaṇaṃ nāstītyāha  asyeti | dharmipratiyogiviṣayajñānaṃ dharmipratiyogijñānam | na tena bhāvarūpājñānasya virodhaḥ, ghaṭācchādakamajñānaṃ ghaṭajñānena hi virudhyate, na tu ghaṭajñānaviṣayajñānena, dharmijñānena cetyarthaḥ |
vastuyāthātmyajñānanivartyamajñānaṃ vastuyāthātmyāvabhāsarūpeṇa sākṣicaitanyena virudhyata iti codayati  nanu ceti | pariharati  maivamiti | yāthātmyaśabdena niṣkṛṣṭamadvitīyatvalakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ vivakṣitam | prapañcamithyātvasiddhavatkāreṇa hetumāha  anyatheti | anyathāsvasākṣisvarūpaprakāśamātrasyaiva vastuyāthātmyaviṣayatve ityarthaḥ | (ajñānaviṣayatvābhāve iti vā) ajñānaviṣayatvamastu; tataḥ kimityatrāha  nahīti | na hi rajataviṣayajñānena rajataṃ nivartyamityarthaḥ | dṛśyaviśeṣaṇasya rūpāderapi dṛśyatvaṃ dṛṣṭam | dṛśyājñānāvacchedakasyāsmadarthasya dṛśyatvānabhyupagamāt asmadarthāvacchinnamajñānaṃ na viṣayīkriyata ityabhiprāyeṇa punaścodayati  nanu cedamiti | viṣayaviśeṣaḥavacchedakaviśeṣaḥ | sa iti sa eva parāmṛśyate | pariharati  naiṣa doṣa iti | asmadartho'pi sarvaśabdavācyāntarbhūtaḥ | jñātatayā ajñātatayā vājñānāntarasāpekṣaṃ tannirapekṣaṃ vā | sākṣicaitanyasya viṣayabhūtamsākṣicaitanyena pratibhātītyarthaḥ | asmadarthasya sākṣicaitanyaviṣayatvamaupacārikam; svayamprakāśasya svasya viṣayatvāyogāt | jaḍasya svayamprakāśatvāyogāt pramāṇādhīnasiddhi sat (tat?) dṛśyaviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati | asmadarthastu svayamprakāśatayā svayameva sidhyan ajñānāvacchedaka ityarthaḥ | dṛśyāvacchedakatvāddṛśyamiti codyam; tat jaḍatvaprayuktamiti sopādhikamiti parihāraḥ | tasmāt abhāvarūpatvapakṣe uktavirodhāt, bhāvarūpatvapakṣe tadabhāvāccetyarthaḥ | nyāyopabṛṃhiteneti | pakṣadvaye'pi virodhatadabhāvarūpanyāyānugṛhītenetyarthaḥ | evaṃ pratyakṣeṇa nyāyānugṛhītenājñānasya bhāvarūpatvam, na janāmītyanenātmāśrayatvaṃ ca siddham | śāstreṣvajñānaśabdavācyatayā parābhimatakarmavyāvṛttiḥ pratyakṣatayā siddhā | asya ca śāstreṣvajñānādiśabdavācyatvaṃ jñānavirodhitvāt, ahamajña iti pratipannatayā ca siddham |
atha svaviṣayāvaraṇatvasvanivartyatvābhyāṃ saha upapāditākāraviśiṣṭaṃ cājñānamanumānenāpi sādhyate vivādādhyāsitamityādinā | jñānamityukte brahmasvarūpasya vastvantarapūrvakatvāsaṃbhavāt tadyvāvṛttyarthaṃ pramāṇajñānamityuktam | tathā'pi dhārāvāhikajñāne uttarottaravijñānānāṃ siṣādhayiṣitavastvantarapūvarkatvābhāvāt tadvyāvṛttyarthaṃ vivādādhyāsitamityuktam | tajjñānaṃ kimityapekṣāyāṃ vyaktyarthaṃ pramāṇajñānamityuktam | avaṃ (evaṃ?) dharmī darśitaḥ | atha sādhyadharmamāha  svaprāgabhāvetyādinā | vastvantarapūrvakamityukte ghaṭādisvaviṣayapūrvakatvena siddhasādhanaṃ syāditi tadvyāvṛttyarthamāha  svadeśagateti | svāśrayagatetyukte dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavaikalyaṃ syāt | na hi tamo dīpagatam | ataḥ svadeśagatetyuktiḥ | dharmādharmavyāvṛttyarthamāha  svanivartyeti | nanu kathaṃ svanivatyarśabdena dharmādharmavyāvṛttiḥ? jñānotpattihetubhūtamadṛṣṭaṃ jñānotpattyā hi naśyati | maivam; sarveṣāṃ dharmādharmāṇāṃ jñānaphalakatvābhāvāt jñānotpādakavyatiriktadharmādīnāṃ pūvarkṣaṇe svadeśe vidyamānatvācca | yadvā svanivartyapadena saṃskāravyāvṛttiḥ; na hi saṃskāro jñānena nivartyaḥ | bhayādivyāvṛttyarthamāha  svaviṣayāvaraṇeti | prāgabhāvasyaivaṃvidhatvāt tadyvāvṛttyarthamāha  svaprāgabhāvavyatirikteti | iyaṃ pratilomavyāvṛttiḥ | vastvantarapūrvakamityukte abhāvasyāpi padārthatvena vastuśabdavācyatvāt tadyvāvṛttyarthamāha  svaprāgabhāvavyatirikteti | ghaṭādisvaviṣayavyāvṛttyarthamāha  svaviṣayāvaraṇeti | kuḍyādivyāvṛttyarthamāha  svanivartyeti | vedyagatavittyabhivyaktiprāgabhāvādavyāvṛttyarthamāha  svadeśagateti | pramāṇajñānenājñāne niraste vedyagatacetanyamabhivyaktaṃ bhavatīti hi tatparipāṭī | abhivyaktiprāgabhāvasya viṣayāvaraṇatvaṃ prakāśavirodhitvam; na tu tatpratibandhakatvam | ityanulomavyāvṛttiḥ |
hetumāha  aprakāśiteti | sākṣādvā paramparayā vā avādhyavyavahārānuguṇyahetutvaṃ prakāśakatvamiha vivakṣitam | sākṣādvā paramparayā vetyukte hi dīpaprabhāyāṃ jñāne ca hetvanugamasiddhiḥ | idaṃ rajatamiti jñāne'tivyāptiparihārāya abādhyavyavahārānuguṇyahetutvamityuktam | prakāśakatvādityukte dhārāvāhikajñāne uttarottarajñānānāṃ prakāśakatve'pi siṣādhayiṣitadharmābhāvāt hetoranaikāntikatvaṃ syāditi tadyvāvṛttyarthamāha  aprakāśitārthaprakāśakatvāditi | indriyeṣvanaikāntikatvavyāvṛttyarthaṃ bhāsamānatve satīti heturviśeṣyata iti mantavyam | dṛṣṭāntamāha  andhakāra iti | pradīprabhāvadityukte uttarottarapramāṇāmaprakāśitārthaprakāśakatvābhāvāt sādhanavikalatā syāt, svanivartyavastvantarapūrvakatvābhāvāt sādhyavikalatā ca syāt iti tadvyudāsārthaṃ prathamotpannapradīpaprabhāvadityuktam | tathāpi divā dīpaprabhāyāstathāvidhatvādarśanāt tadyvāvṛttyarthamandhakāra ityuktam |
dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavikalatāmāśaṅkaya pariharati  āloketyādinā | āloke sati ulūkādīnāmandhakārasaṃbhavādanuyāyinamākāramāha  rūpadarśanābhāvamātraṃ veti | yadvā nimīlitākṣasya tamaḥpratipratinirvāhārthamāha rūpadarśaneti | atra naiyāyikādibhiruktaṃ dūṣaṇamanusaṃdhatetatra utpādakajñāpakānupapattyā dravyāntaratvaṃ dūṣitam | rūpavattve'pi paramāṇūnāmeva anutpādyatvam | tamasastu rūpavattvādbṛhaccotpādyatvaṃ syāt | tatra rūpavattvāt tadrahitāni vāyvākāśādīni notpādakāni bhavanti | sparśarasagandhavirahātnānyānyapi dravyāṇi | kāraṇaguṇaprakrameṇa hi kārye vaiśeṣikaguṇārambhaḥ | iyamuttpattyanupapattiḥ | ālokānanugṛhītatvāt cakṣurna grāhakam | ālokasaṃnidhau anavasthānānnāsya grāhyatvam | rūpavattvapratītistu bhrāntireva, nimīlane nīlapratibhāsavaditi jñaptyanupapattiḥ | atra parihāro vārttikakārairuktaḥ, "tamaḥ khalu calaṃ nīlaṃ parāparavibhāgavat | prasiddhadravya(dharma)vaidharmyānnavabhyo bhettumarhati" iti | sa evotrocyate | tatra parāparaśabdārtho bahulatvaviralatvaśabdenoktaḥ ādiśabdena calatvam; rūpavattayeti nīlaśabdārtha uktaḥ; dravyāntaraśabdena daśamadravyatvamuktam | navadravyasvīkāro hi teṣāṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ dravyāṇāmanyonyavaidharmyāt svī(?)kriyate | anyathā pṛthivyeva dravyaṃ nānyat gandhavattvābhāvāditi vaktuṃ śakyate | evaṃ dve dravye ityādi | taccānabhimatam; dravyāṇāṃ parasparavaidharmyātevaṃ navadravyavaidharmyāt daśamamaṅgīkāyarmiti vārttikārthaḥ | nimīlane nīlapratimānaṃ bādhitaviṣayam; idaṃ tvabādhitatvānna tathā bhavitumarhati | tathāpi rūpopalabdhivelāyāmanupalabdhernimīlanavadapi saṃbhavatīti śaṅkitaṃ pratyakṣamiti cetna; ulūkādīnāmasmadādirūpopalabdhivelāyāṃ rūpānupalabdhau tadrūpopalabdherapi śaṅkitatvāpātāt; ulūkādirūpopalabdhivelāyāmasmadādeḥ rūpānupalabdhyā asmadādirūpopalabdherapi śaṅkitatvaprasaṅgāt | āgamasvārasyācca śaṅkāyā nirastatvāt tamaso daśamadravyatvamavasīyate"tamaḥ sasarja bhagavān", "nāho na rātrirna nabho na bhūmirnāsīt tamo jyotirabhūnna cānyat", "yasya tejaḥ śarīram", "yasya tamaḥ śarīram" iti sṛjyatvasaṃhāryatvaśarīratvādīni hi śrūyante | ālokanairapekṣyaṃ yathā jñātṛviśeṣaprayukta dṛśyate tathā jñeyaviśeṣaprayuktamapyupapadyate | kāryaṃ hi yathā loke pratītaṃ tathā kāraṇakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇam; na punaḥ sphuṭāvadhāritaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇanirūpaṇāyāpahnavamarhatīti nyāyādabādhitapratīti siddhasya tamasa utpādakaṃ kalpyamiti notpādakānupapattirjñāpakānupapattirvā | yathā (āhurasmādācāryāḥ ?)
"tamo nāma dravyaṃ bahuviralaṃ mecakacalaṃ pratīmaḥ(taṃ) kenāpi kvacidapi na bādhaśca dadṛśe |
ataḥ kalpyo hetuḥ pramitirapi śābdī vijayate nirālokaṃ cakṣuḥ prathayati hi tat darśanavaśāt ||"
tamo dravyamityeva bhāṣyakāramatam; siddhānte tasyādūṣitatvāt; sṛjyatvasaṃhāryatvaśarīratvaśravaṇācca | svacchadravyatvādākāśakāryaṃ tamaḥ | rūpavattvaṃ pañcīkaraṇādupapadyate | yadvā tejaḥ kāryaṃ tamaḥ; rūpavattvāt; sparśānulambhaḥ svacchadravyatvāditi |
iti niravadyamiti | pramāṇasiddhatvena tarkabādhānupapattyā niravadyamityarthaḥ ||
atha siddhāntaṃ vaktumupakramate atrocyata iti | kevalena ca pratyakṣeṇeti dṛṣṭāntatayoktam | upapattidūṣaṇe kṛte kevalapratyakṣaṃ na sādhakamityarthaḥ | upapattirhi jñānaprāgabhāvaviṣayatve virodhaḥ; sa bhāvarūpatve'pi tulya ityāha  yastviti tulyatvamupapādayati  viṣayatveneti | pratipannaśabdena bhāsanamucyate | tatsvarūpajñānanivartyamiti | svarūpajñānamsvarūpāvabhāsaḥ | svato vā pramāṇāntareṇa vā svarūpāvabhāsanivartyamityarthaḥ | idaṃ rajatamityatra idaṃ śuklabhāsvaramityevaṃrūpapramāṇajñānaśate jāte'pi bhramānivṛttidarśanāt pramāṇajñānatvamaprayojakamiti siddhavatkāreṇa tatsvarūpajñānanivartyamityuktam | vyāvartakāśrayaviṣayajñānaśūnyamāśrayatayā viṣayatayā ca vyāvartakaḥ pratyagarthaḥ; tadavabhāsaśūnyam | viṣayatvenetyādinā bhāṣyeṇa svātmaviṣayājñānapratipattau virodhatulyatvaṃ darśitam | ghaṭādiviṣayājñānapratītāvapi ajñānasya viṣayatvena vyāvartakatayā ghaṭaḥ pratipannaḥ, na vā | pratipannaścet, ghaṭasvarūpajñānanivartyaṃ ghaṭājñānaṃ tasmin ghaṭe pratipanne kathamiva tiṣṭhiti; ghaṭo'pratipannaścet, vyāvartakaviṣayajñānaśūnyamajñānaṃ kathamanubhūyetetyarthasiddhau virodho draṣṭavyaḥ |
evaṃ pareṇa bhāvābhāvayorvirodhe darśite tatpratibandītvena nivartyanivartakavirodha uktaḥ | atha viśadāviśadavibhāgādavirodhaṃ śaṅkate atheti | pratyagarthasya pramāṇajñānenāvabhāso viśadāvabhāsaḥ; sa svapakṣe'pi tulya ityāha  hanta tarhīti | viśadasvarūpamavacchedakaṃ yasya sa viśadasvarūpaviṣayaḥ | viśadasvarūpasya prāgabhāvāvacchedakatvaṃ svaviṣayajñānadvārā | jñānaprāgabhāvo'pi viśadasvarūpajñānāvacchinna ityarthaḥ | jñānasya cābhāvāvacchedakatvaṃ pratiyogitayā | viśadasvarūpajñānaṃ prāgabhāvapratiyogīti yāvat | avirodhasiddhaye vidyamānajñānasya tato'rthāntaramāha  āśrayeti | ānayapratiyoginojrñānamāśrayapratiyogijñānam | aviśadasvarūpaviṣayamiti | āśrayamānasyāviśadasvarūpaviṣayatvam aviśadapratyagarthaviṣayatvam | pratiyogijñānasyāviśadasvarūpaviṣayatvam abhāvapratiyogibhūtāviśadajñānaviṣayatvam | sva(sa)viṣayaṃ nivartakajñānam abhāvapratiyogitvenedānīṃ jñānamavalambate | tatra nivartakajñānaviṣayasya pratyagarthasyedānīmaviśadatvād nivatarkajñānasyedānīmavidyamānatvācca pratiyogino jñānasyāviśadatvam | vidyamānaṃ hi sāśrayaṃ jñānamaparokṣāvabhāsarūpam | atastasyāviśadatvamavidyamānatayā bhavati | evamāśrayatayā bhāsamānaṃ svarūpamaviśadam, pratiyogitayā smaryamāṇaṃ jñānamidānīmaviśadaviṣayatvādavidyamānatvācca aviśadamiti tadubhayaviṣayaṃ jñānamaviśadasvarūpaviṣayam | tacca vidyate | viśadajñānaṃ tvavidyamānamabhāvapratiyogīti na virodha ityarthaḥ | ayamarthaḥajñānanivartakābhimatapramāṇajñānābhāvastāvat tvayā'bhyupagantavyaḥ; anyathā pramāṇajñānanivartyājñānānubhavāsaṃbhavāt | tataśca tvadabhyupagataḥ pramāṇajñānābhāva eva ahamajña iti pratipatterviṣayo bhavitumarhatīti nābhāvagrahaṇānupapattyā bhāvarūpatvaṃ kalpyamiti | pūrvapakṣoktavirodhaḥ kathaṃ parihṛto bhavatīti cetittham | tatra hi yadarthāvacchinnaṃ jñānamabhāvapratiyogitayocyate, abhāvapratiyogijñānāvacchedakatadarthapratipattau satyāṃ tajjñānābhāvo'nupapanna iti hi virodhaḥ |
tatrāyaṃ parihāraḥabhāvapratiyogijñānaṃ smṛtyārūḍhaṃ pratiṣidhyate | yathā ghaṭasākṣātkāro nāstīti niṣedhe ghaṭasākṣātkāraḥ smaryate | smaryamāṇasya smṛtisamakālavarttitvaniyamābhāvānniṣedhavelāyāṃ smaryamāṇasya nābhāvapratiyogitvavirodhaḥ | tvayā ca smṛtyārūḍhasya nivartakajñānasya smṛtisamakālavartitvābhāvādajñānāvacchedakatayā pratipattāvapi smṛtyārūḍhanivartakajñānaṃ nājñānavirodhīti vaktavyam; tasmādātmaviṣayaṃ ghaṭādiviṣayakañca pramāṇajñānaṃ svaviṣayeṇātmanā ghaṭādibhiśca saha smṛtyārūḍhamaviśadatayā pratipannamabhāvapratiyogi bhavatītyupapannataramiti | anubhūtasya hi smaraṇasaṃbhavaḥ, pramāṇajñānaṃ kenānubhūtamiti cetbhavato vā nivartakajñānaṃ kenānubhūtam | āgamāditi cetasmākamapyātmasākṣātkārastadvidhāyakavākyāvagataḥ | ghaṭādisākṣātkārastu pratyakṣādiṣu yena kenāpyanubhūtaḥ | merusākṣātkāraḥ kathaṃ niṣidhyate? sa hi na kenāpi mānena pūrvamanubhūtaḥ | ucyate | ihādṛṣṭacara(ṣṭacatvara)dviradena puruṣeṇa kathamiha catvare gajo (catvaragajo ?) nāstītyucyate | saṃsargānanubhavepi saṃsargiṇoranubhavamātreṇānyatrānyataraniṣedha upapadyata iti cetevaṃ tarhi sumerusākṣātkārasaṃsargānanubhave'pi merusākṣātkārayoḥ kenāpyavagamāt tatsaṃsarganiṣedha upapadyate | pramāṇajñānānāmabhāvapratiyogitvādabhāvasya tadānīṃ grāhakaṃ nāstīti yaduktamtat sarvapramāṇajñānābhāvānāṃ yugapadanubhavāsaṃbhavāt katipayamānajñānābhāvasya mānāntareṇa grahaṇopapatteśca parihṛtam | evaṃ bhāvarūpapakṣe virodhaparihārasāmyaṃ darśitam |
nanu virodhasāmyaṃ vaktumaśakyam | ajñānasya nañarthapratiyogyavacchinnatayaivāvagantavyatve sati hi nañarthapratiyoginastasya jñānasya svaviṣayāśrayabhūtapratyagārthāvacchinnatvena bhātatvāt viṣayāśrayabhūtapratyagarthajñāne sati tannivartyājñānasthitivirodhaḥ | na hi bhāvarūpasyājñānatya jñānapratipattyapekṣā; svarūpeṇaiva pratipattisaṃbhavāt na hi bhāvarūpasya ghaṭasya ānayapratiyogijñānasāpekṣatvaṃ dṛṣṭamityatrāha bhāvarūpasyeti | kathaṃ sāpekṣatvamityatrāha  yadyapīti | bhāvarūpamajñānamapi svarūpeṇa sidhyatītyatrāha  bhavadabhimateti | mugdho'smi, mūḍho'smīti svarūpeṇa siddhiriti cenna; kasyacitpuruṣasya kasmiṃścidviṣaye hi mohaḥ | "sa vimalamatireti nātmamoham", "diṅmohālātacakrādibhrāntayaśca kathaṃ punaḥ" ityādiṣu viṣayāśrayāvacchinnatvena hi moha upalabhyate | mugdho'smītyanenāśrayāvacchinnatvaṃ pratīyate | viṣayo'pyarthavaśāt siddhaḥ | idaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ "saṃvit sidhyati vā na vā" ityatroktayā diśā phalitam | tataśca svātmaviṣayamajñānaṃ viṣayāśrayabhūtapratyagarthapratipattisadbhāvahatam | ghaṭādyajñānaṃ tu viṣayabhūtaghaṭādyavagamaviruddham | māyāśabdādibhirajñānapratipattau viṣayāśrayāpekṣā neti cenna, māyādiśabdānāmapi vyutpattinairapekṣyeṇa bodhakatvasaṃbhavādajñānādipadaparyāyatvena ca vyutpannatvāt svarūpeṇa siddhirdurvacāityabhiprāyeṇa na kadācitsvarūpeṇa sidhyatītyuktam | nanu svarūpāvacchinnājñānapratītau nañarthapratiyogijñānāvacchinnatayā siddhāvapi na nivartyanivartakavirodhaḥ; svarūpabhūtajñānādanyatayā tatsiddheḥ svarūpajñānaṃ hi nāvidyānivartakam, kiṃtu pramāṇajñānameva; ato na virodha iti | naivam; māmanyaṃ ca na jānāmīti viṣayāśrayasaṃbandhijñānāvacchinnatayā pratīteḥ | na hi svarūpabhūtajñānaṃ sāśrayaṃ saviṣayaṃ ca tava matam | svarūpaṃ kim āśrayatayaivājñānasyāvacchedakam, uta viṣayatayāpi? ādye, na tvadabhimatasiddhiḥ | tadānīṃ pratyagarthasya svasmādanyena kenāpi viśiṣṭatvameva hi sidhyati | viṣayatayā'vacchedakatve pratyagarthasyājñānamāvaraṇaṃ syāt | āvaraṇatvaṃ ca tadviṣayakajñānapratibandhakatvam | atastadviṣayapramāṇajñānapratītyavaśyambhāvāduktivirodho'nativṛttaḥ | ataḥ svarūpabhūtajñenāvacchinnapratītyabhyupagamo'nupapannaḥ |
ubhayatra sādhanadūṣaṇayostulyatvādbhāvarūpamajñānaṃ pahigṛhyatāmityāśaṅkaya lāghavanyāyena pariharati  jñānaprāgabhāvastviti | abhyupagamyate | ahamajña iti pratipannasya abhāvarūpatve hi vipratipattiḥ; na tvabhāvānabhyupagamaḥ | anyathā pramāṇajñānasya prāgabhāvābhāvādanāditvena tannirasanīyabhāvarūpājñānānudayaprasaṅgāt | ato jñānābhāvastvayā'bhyupagata ityarthaḥ | pratīyate ca | loke tattajjñānābhāvavivakṣayā jñānaṃ nāstīti vyavahāradarśanāt apratipanne ca vivakṣānupapatteḥ jñānābhāvapratītirastyevetyarthaḥ | ataḥ saṃpratipannena jñānābhāvenaiva ahamajña iti pratītyupapatteratiriktakalpane hetvabhāvāllāghavena sa eva ahamajña iti pratīterviṣayatayā'bhyupagantavya ityarthaḥ | nanu ubhayābhyupagato'bhāvo nāma kaścinnāsti | bhāvāntaramabhāvaḥ svamate; paramate tu bhāvātiriktaḥ | tat kathamubhayābhyupagatena ahamajña iti pratītyupapattiḥ | ucyate | na hyubhayābhyupagata ityuktam; kintu bhavatā'bhyupagamyata ityuktam | abhāvaśabdavācyatvena kaścidartha ubhābhyāmabhyupagataḥ | sa ca bhāvarūpastadatirikta iti iyadeva vimatam | atra bhāvatvena yaḥ svābhimataḥ yaśca tadatiriktatvena abhāvaśabdavācyatayā parābhimataḥ, tayoranyatareṇāhamajña iti pratītyupapattestadubhayātiriktārthakalpanamanupapannamityuktaṃ bhavatīti na virodhaḥ | nanu bhāvāntarabhāvamicchatā tvayā jñānaprāgabhāvaśabdena bhāvarūpājñānamaṅgīkṛtaṃ syāt | maivam; siddhāntadvayānabhijñānakṛtaṃ hīdaṃ codyam | svayaṃprakāśasyaiva jñānasya saṅkocarūpamavasthāntaraṃ prāgabhāvaśabdavācyatayā'smadabhimatam; svaprakāśajñānavyatirekeṇa bhāvarūpamajñānaṃ parābhimatam; atastayoḥ kathamaikyam | tarhi jñānasaṅkocarūpāvasthāṃ parityajyājñānaśabdavācyatvena paroktaṃ bhāvarūpamajñānaṃ svīkriyatām, bhāvarūpatvāviśeṣāditi cetprāmāṇikaṃ parityajya aprāmāṇikaṃ svīkriyatāmitīdamanupapannam | "na vijñāturvijñāterviparilopo vidyate", "sarvaṃ ha paśyaḥ paśyati", "tayā tirohitatvācca śaktiḥ kṣetrajñasaṃjñitā | sarvabhūteṣu bhūpāla; tāratamyena vartate", "aprāṇimatsu svalpā sā" ityārabhya"hiraṇyagarbho'titarāṃ puṃsaḥ śaktayupalakṣitaḥ" iti śrutismṛtisiddhatvāt jñānanitvatvaṃ tatsaṅkocādikañca prāmāṇikaṃ kathaṃ tyatyeta? bhāvarūpājñānaṃ tu kalpyam | kalpakaṃ cānyathāsiddhamiti tadaprāmāṇikaṃ kathaṃ svīkriyate | kalpanāyāṃ hi lāghavanyāyaśca pravartate, na tu pramāṇapratipanne'rthe | ato'hamajña iti jñānaprāgabhāva eva pratīyate |
evamahamajña iti pratyakṣasya bhāvarūpājñānaviṣayatve bhāvarūpapakṣopapattiabhāvarūpapakṣānupapattirūpānukūlatarkābhāva uktaḥ; atha pratikūlatarkaparāhatirucyate nityeti | nityamuktasvaprakāśacaitanyaikasvarūpasyeti padaṃ hetugarbham | nityamuktatvam paramārthato doṣāsaṃspṛṣṭatvam | ataḥ paramārthadoṣo na saṃbhavati | svānubhavasvarūpatvādaparamārthaparānubhavo na saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ | anyānubhavarūpapradeśabhedābhāvācceti ekaśabdābhiprāyaḥ | ekaśabdena jñeyatvābhāvaśca vivakṣitaḥ | abhipretaṃ hetugarbhatvaṃ vivṛṇoti  svānūbhavasvarūpatvāditi | avidyānivṛttidaśāyāmanuvartamānam avidyāvabhāsapratyanīkaṃ svānubhavaikasvabhāvatvaṃ hetutayā vivakṣitam; na tu bhramavelāyāmapi vidyamānaṃ svayaṃprakāśatvamātram; ataḥ svānubhavaikasvabhāvatvasya prāgapi vidyamānatvādityarthaḥ | svānubhavasvarūpasyāpi tirodhānādajñānānubhavaḥ saṃbhavatīti śaṅkate svānubhaveti | abhipretaṃ vivarītuṃ tirodhānaśabdasyārthāntaraṃ nāstīti jñāpanārthaṃ praśnapūrvakaṃ tirodhānaśabdārthamāha  kimidaṃ tirohitasvarūpatvam? apramāśitasvarūpatvamiti cediti | svānubhavasvarūpasyāprakāśitatvaṃ vyāhatamiti buddhayā dūṣayati svānubhaveti | anyato'prakāśitasvarūpatve pūrvoktadūṣaṇamatidiśati evaṃ tarhīti | dūṣaṇāntaramāha  kiñceti aparamārthatvānna sattayā tiraskārakam, api tu pratīyamānatayā tiraskārakamiti anubhavapūrvakastiraskāraḥ; tiraskārapūrvako'nubhavaḥ atiraskṛtya svānubhavasvarūpasya brahmaṇo'jñānānubhavāsaṃbhavāt ityanyonyāśrayaṇamityarthaḥ | etatparijihīrṣayā anubhavapūrvakaṃ tiraskāraṃ śaṅkate  anubhūtameveti | tatra dūṣaṇamāha  yadīti | atirohitasyāpyajñānānubhavasaṃmavāt tadarthatirodhānakalpanā tadarthamācchādakāvidyākalpanā ca niṣphaletyarthaḥ | tadupapādayati  brahmaṇa iti | yathā atirohitasvarūpasyāpi aparamārthabhūtājñānānubhavasaṃbhavaḥ, tathā aparamārthabhūtaprapañcānubhavo'pyatirohitasya saṃbhavatīti tadarthā tirodhānakalpanā tadarthācchādakāvidyākalpanā ca niṣphaletyarthaḥ | anubhavapūrvakatiraskārapakṣa eva vikalpamukhena dūṣaṇamāha  kiñceti | svataḥpakṣe dūṣaṇadvayam anirmokṣo brahmasvarūpanivṛttiśca | rajatānubhavasyāpītyapiśabdena rajatasya ca nivṛttiḥ sūcitā | anyataḥpakṣe'navasthā | tiraskārapūrvakānubhavapakṣaṃ śaṅkate brahmeti | tiraskṛtyānubhavaviṣaya ityukte sattayā tiraskārakamityuktaṃ syāt, na tu pratīyamānatayā | tadānīṃ kācādivat paramārthatvena jñānanibartyatvaṃ na sidhyatītyarthaḥ | atha tiraskārānubhavayoryaugapadyaṃ śaṅkate  athedamiti | naitadityādinā dūṣayati | svānubhavasvarūpasyeti hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇam | svānubhavasvarūpatvaṃ svābhāvikamiti parānubhavo hetunā vinā nopapadyata ityarthaḥ | hetvantareṇa tiraskṛtimāśaṅkaya dūṣayati  hetviti | yaugapadyapakṣe pūrvoktapakṣadvayadūṣaṇamapyāpatatītyabhiprāyeṇāha  anavasthā ca pūrvokteti | jñānānivartyatvadūṣaṇasyāpyupalakṣaṇamiyanavasthā; anantarapūrvokteḥ | svarūpatiraskṛtimantareṇa sākṣitvāpādane'niṣṭamāha atiraskṛteti | pūrvaṃ viśadāviśadāvabhāsamabhyupagamya dūṣaṇamuktam, idānīṃ tu tameva dūṣayitumupakramate  apiceti | vikalpayati  avidyayeti | pūrvoktaṃ dūṣaṇamatiśayati  pūrvasminniti | uttarasminniti | kiṃśabdaḥ kṣepe | anupapannamityarthaḥ | saccidānandādiśabdānāmapi svarūpamātraparatvenābhyupagamāt tiraskṛtātiraskṛtavibhāgo'nupapanna iti bhāvaḥ | ko'yamaṃśaḥ tiraskriyate ko vā prakāśata iti | "ko vā viśeṣastiraskriyate ko vā prakāśate" ityasyāpyupalakṣaṇārthamidam; niraṃśe nirviśeṣe ityanantarokteḥ | ko'yamaṃśa iti | aṃśabhedo vaktumaśakya ityabhiprāyaḥ | tadupapādayati  niraṃśa iti | prakāśamātre | mātracā aviṣayatvaṃ vivakṣitam | aviṣayabhūta ityarthaḥ | yugapanna saṅgacchete iti | na hi tvayā kālabhedena prākaśatiraskārāvucyete; api tu yugapadeva | tadānīmaṃśabhedābhāvādākārabhedābhāvācca tau na saṅgacchete iti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ prakāśatiraskārayoryaugapadyānupapattau satyāmapyaviśadaśabdena pratyavatiṣṭhate atheti | athaśabdo'numatipradāne vartate | dūṣayati  prakāśeti | kiṃrūpā | anupapannetyarthaḥ | kathamanupapattiriti śaṅkāyāṃ vaiśadyāvaiśadyasvarūpaṃ śikṣayitum atra tadanupapattiñca daśaryitumāha  etaduktamiti veśadyasvarūpaṃ śikṣayati  yassāṃśa ityādinā | jñāne tadanupapattimāha  tatreti | prakāśābhāvādeva prakāśāvaiśadyaṃ na vidyata iti | dharmyabhāvāddharmābhāva ityarthaḥ | jñeye'pi jñātāṃśasya viśadatbādajñātāṃśasyājñātatvācca kvacidapyavaiśadyaṃ na saṃbhavatītyāha  viṣaye'pīti | ekasmin vastuni katipayāṃśasya katipayākārasya vā anavabhāsaḥ samuditarūpasyāvaiśadyam; na tu tatrāpi prakāśamānāṃśasyetyarthaḥ | tasmāditi | svarūpe prakāśamāna ityasya na brahmaṇīti pūrvatrānvayaḥ; api tūttaratra | vastusvarūpe prakāśamāne katipayaviśeṣāpratipattirūpamavaiśadyaṃ brahmaṇi na saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ | katipayaviśeṣāpratipattiśabdaḥ katipayāṃśāpratipatterapyupalakṣaṇārthaḥ | mukhāntareṇa dūṣaṇamāha  apiceti | avidyākāryaṃ tannivṛttiśca na syātāmiti | viśadasvarūpasyāvidyāvirodhitvāditi bhāvaḥ | mokṣasya kāryatayeti | mokṣasyamuktasvarūpasya | bhāvarūpatve sati kāryaṃ hyanityam | vaiśadyaṃ ca bhāvarūpam | ataḥ paramate tvayoktaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ tavaivāpatatītyarthaḥ | prāgasataḥ paścādutpannasya vaiśadyasyānityatvaprasaṅgaḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭaḥ, śāstreṇa tasya nityatayā pratipāditatvāditi cettadā brahmaṇaḥ saviśeṣatvaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ |
pūrvoktamāśrayānupapatiṃta paroktapratyakṣapramāṇasya pratikūlatarkatvenāha  asyeti | svarūpānāditvādimukhena parihārāṇāṃ pratibandītvaṃ hṛdi nidhāya dūṣaṇāntaramāha  apiceti | yathā doṣādoṣāśrayatvāderapāramārthye'pi bhramasaṃbhavaḥ, tadvadhiṣṭhānāpāramārthye'pi bhramaḥ saṃbhavati | adhiṣṭhānāpāramarthye tasyāpi prapañcavadapāramārthyena adhiṣṭhānāntarāpekṣayā'navasthā syāditi cettarhi doṣasyāpi prapañcavadapāramārthyena doṣāntarāpekṣayā'navasthā syāt | doṣasyāpāramārthyepi svarūpānāditvānnānavastheti cettarhi adhiṣṭhānāpāramārthye'pi svarūpānāditvānnānavastheti | pravāhānāditvena dugharṭatvena ca parihāro'pi tulyaḥ | doṣaḥ prapañcadarśanasya svadarśanasya ca svayameva nirvāhaka iti na doṣāntarāpekṣayā
anavastheti cennaaparamārthasyāsya svaparanirvāhakatvāsaṃbhavāt | na hi svapne dvicandrajñānahetubhūto'ṅgulyavaṣṭambhaḥ svakalpane doṣanirapekṣaḥ | aparamārthasya svaparanirvāhakatvaṃ saṃbhavatu tathāsati adhiṣṭhānāpāramārthye'pi svaparanirvāhakatvādanavasthā na syāt | aparamārthasya paraṃ prati adhiṣṭhānatve siddhe hi svanirvāhakatvasiddhiriti cetaparamārthasya paraṃ prati doṣatve siddhe hi svanivāhakatvamiti tulyam | mithyābhūtajagadavabhāsāt doṣatvaṃ siddhamiti cettarhi tata evādhiṣṭhānatvamapi siddhamiti svaparanirvāhakatvamadhiṣṭhānasya sidhyati | adhiṣṭhānāpāramārthye bhramo na dṛṣṭa iti cetdoṣadoṣāśrayatvāpāramārthye'pi bhramo na dṛṣṭa iti tulyaścarca ityabhiprāyaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  tataśceti | evam ahamajño māmanyaṃ ca na jānāmīti pratyakṣasya pratikūlatarkaparāhatiruktā | atra kecidāhuḥsuptetthitasya na kiñcidavediṣamiti parāmarśānyathānupapattiḥ bhāvarūpājñāne pramāṇam | kathamanyathānupapattiḥ | ittham | na kiñcidavediṣamiti parāmarśo na jñānābhāvaviṣayaḥ; svāpe jñānābhāvasyānanubhūtatvāt | jñānābhāvānubhave hi pratiyogibhūtajñānasya viṣayāvacchinnasyāvabhāso'bhyupagantavyaḥ | tadabhyupagagame suṣuptivyāghātaḥ | na cāsmaraṇaliṅgajanyaṃ jñānābhāvaviṣayamanumitirūpajñānamidamiti vācyam; asmaraṇasyānanubhavavyāpyatvābhāvāt | pathi gacchatā spṛṣṭaṃ hi tṛṇādikaṃ na smaryate | ataḥ suṣuptānanubhūtaṃ bhāvarūpamajñānaṃ smayarte, na kiñcidavediṣamiti | atastadanyathānupapattyā bhāvarūpājñānasiddhiriti |
