naitadupapadyatebhāvarūpatve'pyajñānasya pratiyogyapekṣatvopapādanāt pratiyoginaśca suṣuptāvanabhāsāt ajñānānubhavābhāvena tatsmaraṇānupapatteḥ | pratiyogyavabhāse suṣuptivyāghātastvayaivoktaḥ | na ca tadanyavāsacanañarthapratiyogisvarūpabhūtaṃ jñāyaṃ tadānīmavabhātamiti vācyam, na kiñidavediṣam māmanyaṃ ca na jānāmīti viṣayāvacchinnajñānasya pratiyogitvāvagamāt | atastadanavabhāse ajñānānubhavāyogāt tatsmaraṇānupapattiḥ | kiñca suṣuptau nirvikalpakena vā savikalpakena manovyāpāreṇa vā bhāvarūpājñānanubhavaḥ? prathame, svābhimatanirvikalpakasya sākṣicetanyāvabhāsarūpasya saṃskārādhāyakatvānabhyupagamāt pratisandhānamanupapannam | na dvitīyaḥ; suṣuptivirodhena tadā manovyāpārāsaṃbhavāt | ataḥ, na kiñcidavediṣamiti jñānaṃ na smaraṇam; kintu asmaraṇaliṅgakaṃ jñānābhāvaviṣayamanumitirūpam | na ca pathi gacchatā spṛṣṭatṛṇādyasmaraṇena vyabhicaraḥ; anyavyāsaṅgādisaṃskāravirodhyabhāvaviśeṣitasyāsmaraṇasya vyabhicārābhāvāt |
"tadanyadhīratātparyaṃ paṭutvaviraho dhiyaḥ | duḥkhādi tīvramunmādo'nabhyāso dīrghakālatā ||
etaiścādṛṣṭavaiguṇyaṃ kalpyaṃ saṃskārarodhiṣu | eteṣvasatsvasmaraṇāt jñānābhāvo'numīyate ||"
pathi gacchatā spṛṣṭatṛṇādikaṃ paṭutarasaṃskārodayavirodhisadbhāvānna smaryate, pathi gacchan hi gantavyadeśakāryacintādivyāsakto bhavati | tṛṇādāvādaraśca nāsti; prayojanābhāvāt | tadabhāve'pi gajādidaśarnasyeva na paṭutatvaṃ tṛṇādijñānasya; viṣayavaipulyavaicitryādyabhāvāt | janmāntarānubhavajasaṃskārastu prāyaṇanarakaprasūtijanyatīvraduḥkhābhibhavādanudbaddhaḥ | unmādaśca saṃskārodbodhavirodhī | anabhyāsaśca tathā; tasya vismaraṇahetutvadarśanāt | kāladairdhyamapi tatpramoṣakaṃ dṛṣṭam; bālye'nubhūtānāṃ vṛddhāvasthāyāmasmaraṇāt | na caite hetavaḥ suṣuptau santi | na ca kimapyadṛṣṭaṃ saṃskārodbodhavirodhi kalpyam; kalpakābhāvena sauṣuptikājñānasya tadviṣayārthasmaraṇavirodhyadṛṣṭasya ca kalpanāyogāt | yadi kiñcitkalpakatayotprekṣyeta, tadāpyakaptyā nirvāhe saṃbhavati na kalpanamupapadyate | evamanyaparatvādisaṃskāranirodhakahetuvirahaviśeṣitāsmaraṇaliṅgena jñānābhāvānumitirūpamidam, "na kiñcidavediṣam" iti jñānam | tvayā'pi jñānābhāvaḥ suṣuptāvabhyupagataḥ | sacoktaliṅgānumeya evetyabhyupagantavyam | tadasmākamapi tulyam | ataḥ smṛtitvānupapatteranumitirūpatvopapādanācca na kiñcidavediṣamiti jñānamanyathaivopapannamiti na tato bhāvarūpājñānasiddhiriti |
īdṛśadurvādānāmanupapannatvaṃ bhāvarūpājñānaviṣayapratyakṣapratikṣepataḥ siddham ||
athānumānaṃ dūṣayati  yaduktamityādinā | anumānāsaṃbhavāditi | tvaduktamanumānamābhāsa iti bhāvaḥ | kathaṃ duruktatvamityatrāha  ajñāne'pīti | kathamajñānāntarasādhanamavaśyambhāvi; tasya kathamanabhimatatvam ityāśaṅkāyāṃ tadavaśyambhāvamupapādayati  tatreti | ajñānasyānabhimatatvamupapādayati  sādhane ceti | tataḥ kimityāha  tataśceti | asya pramāṇajñānasya aprakāśitārthaprakāśakatvāt svaviṣayāvaraṇājñānāntarasādhakatve sati tadajñānaṃ brahmasvarūpācchādakaṃ siṣādhayiṣitamajñānamāvṛṇoti | tenā''vṛtatvāt tadajñānaṃ brahmaṇā na sākṣātkriyate | aparamātharsyāpratīyamānasya kāryakaratvāyogādajñānakalpanā niṣphalā (syāt) | tirodhānarūpakāryārthaṃ hi tatkalpanā | yadi asākṣātkṛtameva kāryakaram, tadā sattayā kāryakaramiti kācādivat satyatvāt jñānanivatrtyaṃ na syāt | evamajñānasya jñānānivartyaniṣphalatve, kāraṇatayā'nabhimatājñānāntarasādhakatvam, tadasādhane cānaikāntyamuktam |
nanūktahetujanyaṃ jñānaṃ samyaṅniścayarūpaṃ cettadvirodhādeva na hetoranaikāntyam | yadi na samyak, tathāpi na hetvanaikāntyam, aprakāśitārthaprakāśakatvahetostatra vṛttyabhāvāt | ucyate | hetvanaikāntyaparihāraḥ sādhyaviṣayajñānasya pramitirūpatvaṃ pratikṣipati; jñānasamyaktvaṃ tu hetvanaikāntyaparihāraṃ pratikṣipati | ato jñānasya samyaktve tasyoktahetujanyatvaṃ vyāhatam; hetoranaikāntyāt | na hi samyagūjānaṃ duṣṭahetujanyam | uktahetoranaikāntyaṃ na cet tasyāsamyaṅniścayarūpajñānajanakatvaṃ vyāhatam; aduṣṭahetorasamyagjñānajanakatvāyogāt | evaṃ hetvanaikāntyaparihārajñānasauṣṭhavayoḥ parasparavirodhena tayoriha samuccityāsiddheranyatarābhāve'pi sādhyasiddhayabhāvādanumānamasamañjasamityabhiprāya iti | nanu na hetvanaikāntyam; sādhyaviṣayajñāne hetoravṛtteḥ | na hyaprakāśitamajñānamanena prakāśyate | kiṃ tarhi? sākṣicaitanyasiddhasyaivājñānasya, abhāvādvivecanamātraṃ kriyate | naivam; ahamarthadharmabhūtaprakāśottīrṇena svarūpacaitanyenājñānasiddhāvanumānaprāmāṇyam, tatprāmāṇyena bhāvarūpājñānasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau jñāturapi tatkalpitatvāt tadurttīrṇasākṣicaitanyenājñānānubhavasiddhiriti cakrakāpatterdustaratvāt |
dūṣaṇāntaramāha  dṛṣṭāntaścetyādinā | tatra kiṃ sākṣātprakāśakatvam, uta paramparayā, uta sākṣādvā paramparayā vā prakāśakatvamātram, uta svaviṣayāvaraṇanirāsakartva prakāśakatvamiti catvāraḥ kalpāḥ | tatra prathame kalpe dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhanavikalaḥ | dvitīye tu, pakṣe asiddhiḥ | tṛtīye tu, indriyeṣvavaikāntyam | teṣāṃ svanivartyavastvantarapūrvakatvābhāvāt; sākṣādvā paramparayā vā prakāśakayoranyataratvāt teṣām | indriyāṇyapi pakṣīkṛtya teṣāmapi tathāvidhavastvantarapūrvakatvakalpanamayuktam | āhaṅkārikāṇāmindriyāṇāmutpatteḥ svaviṣayāvaraṇasvadeśagatavastvantarapūrvakatvābhāvāt | āloka eva hi tādṛśaḥ | caturtha pakṣe tu, sādhyāviśiṣṭatā ityabhipretya prathamakalpe dūṣaṇamāha  dṛṣṭāntaśca sādhanavikala iti | kathaṃ jñānasyaiva sākṣātprakāśakatvamiti śaṅkāyāṃ tadupapādayati  satyapīti | jñānasyaiva hi prakāśakatvamityanena dvitīyakalpe hetoḥ pakṣe asiddhiḥ phalitā | indriyāṇāmityanena tṛtīyapakṣe indriyeṣvanaikāntyaṃ vivakṣitam | dīpaprabhāyāḥ paramparayā'pi prakāśakatvaṃ dūrata ityāha  pradīpeti | prakāśakatvavyavahāraḥ kathamityāha  prakāśaketi | caturthapakṣaṃ śaṅkate  nāsmābhiriti | nirasanapūrvaketi | nirasanadvāraketyarthaḥ | sādhyāviśiṣṭatvamāha  na hīti | jñānasya viṣayāvaraṇanirasanarūpaṃ prakāśakatvaṃ na hyasti | taddhi sādhyam; na saṃpratipannamityarthaḥ | mātracā'rthaparicchedavyudāsaḥ | hiśabdena viṣayāvaraṇanirāsakatvasya sādhyatvaṃ phalitam | tatra saṃpratipannaṃ prakāśakatvamāha  apitviti | paricchedaśabdasya parimitiparatvaśaṅkāvyāvṛttyarthamāha  vyavahāreti | vyavahārayogyatā  vyavahārapratisaṃbandhitvam | nanu na sādhyāviśiṣṭatvaṃ hetoḥ | svaprāgabhāvanirāsakatvaṃ svaviṣayāvaraṇanirasanaśabdena vivakṣitam | tena bhāvarūpanirasanīyapūrvakatvaṃ sādhyamiti | na; svaprāgabhāvanirāsakatvasya hetorindriyasahaprayoge anaikāntikatvāt | bhāsamānatve sati aprakāśitārthaprakāśakatvāditi hetau viśeṣite'pi pūrvavadvikalpaḥ syāt | tatra sākṣātpakṣe dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhanavikalaḥ | praṇāḍyeti pakṣe hetvasiddhiḥ | tṛtīye liṅgādau vyabhicāraḥ | caturthe sādhyāviśiṣṭatā; bhāsamānatvaviśeṣitasya viṣayāvaraṇanirāsakatvasyāsaṃpratipatteḥ |
athāsyānumānasya pratikūlatarkaparāhatimāha  pratiprayogāśceti | tarkasyāpi vyāptimūlatvāt prayogā ityuktam | svadeśagatatvasvaviṣayāvaraṇatvasvanivartyatvānāṃ pratikūlaṃ yathākramamanumānatrayam ajñānaṃ pakṣīkṛtyocyate | vivādādhyāsitambrahmāśrayamatadāśrayamiti vivādadhyāsitamityarthaḥ | tataśca śuktayādyajñānavyāvṛttiḥ | taddhi jīvāśrayam, aprāmāṇikamapi bhāvarūpamajñānam, jñānamātraṃ brahma cābhyupagamya pratikūlatarkā ucyante | śuktayādyajñānasya jñānānāśrayatvaṃ kathamityatrāha  jñātrāśrayamiti | evaṃ vyāptirdarśitā | ajñānatve jñānānāśrayatvaprasaṅga ityuktaṃ bhavati | pratikūlatarkāntaramāha  vivādeti | vyāptiṃ darśayati  viṣayāvaraṇamiti | ajñānatve jñānānāvaraṇatvaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | tṛtīyepi prayoge, jñeyānāvaraṇatve jñānānivartyatvaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | atha brahma pakṣīkṛtya pratikūlatarkatrayamucyate brahmetyādinā | ajñānāśrāyatve brahmaṇo jñātṛtvaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | dvitīye'pi prayoge, brahmaṇo'jñānavaraṇatve jñeyatvaprasaṅgaityarthaḥ | tṛtīye'pi brahmaṇo jñānanivartyājñānatve jñeyatvaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ |
atha pramāṇajñānaṃ pakṣīkṛtya prāgabhāvavyatiriktatvasya pratitarkamāha  vivādādhyāsitamiti | pramāṇajñānasve prāgabhāvātiriktājñānapūrvakatvābhāvaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | yadvā anumānamevedam | dhārāvāhikajñāneṣu prathamasya pakṣatvamuttarajñānānāṃ sapakṣatvamapi hyupapadyate | jñānaṃ na vastuno vināśakamityādinā vyatirekyanumānamuktam; vyatirekavyāptiṃ dvidhā darśayati  yadvastuna iti | śaktiviśeṣopabṛṃhaṇavirahe sati jñānatvāditi viśiṣṭo hi hetuḥ | tatra śaktiviśeṣānupabṛṃhitajñānavyatiriktatvāviśeṣāt śaktiviśeṣopabṛṃhitaṃ jñānaṃ śaktiviśeṣānupabṛṃhitamajñānaṃ ca dvayamapi vyatirekavyāptibhūmirityubhayatra vyāptirdarśitā |
bhāvarūpamajñānaṃ pakṣīkṛtyāha bhāvarūpamiti | bhāvarūpatve jñānamātranivartyatvaṃ na syādityarthaḥ | bhāvarūpatvajñānanivartyatvayorna vyāptiḥ; bhayāderbhāvarūpasya jñānanivartyatvadarśanāditi vyāptibhaṅgamāśaṅkate athocyeteti | pūrvajñānotpannānām pūrvabhrāntijñānotpannānāmityarthaḥ | bādhakajñānodayāt prāk bhayānuvṛtteḥ, tadutpatteḥ paścādbhayādinivṛtteśceti bhāvaḥ | pariharati  naivamiti | phalavināśayāni hi svāśrayavināśādhīnanaśvara(dhīnanāśavad ?)vyatiriktakṣaṇikāni | uktaviśeṣaṇena jvālāvyāvṛttiḥ | tathā bhayādyapi kampādikāryaṃ janayitvā svayaṃ naśyatītyarthaḥ | na bhayādeḥ kṣaṇikatvam, ciropalabdheriti cenna; kāraṇabhūtabhrāntijñānādyanuvṛttyā bhayādisaṃtatyutpatterhi ciropalabdhiḥ | tarhi sadā bhayasantatirupalabhyeteti cedatrāha  kāraṇanivṛttyā ca paścādanutpatteriti | kāraṇabhūtabhrāntijñānādinivṛttyā kāryabhūtabhayādisantatyanutpatterna sadopalabdhirityarthaḥ | paścādanutpattiriti pañcamyāḥ kṣaṇikatveneti pūrvatrānvayaḥ | kāraṇanivṛttyā ca paścādanutpatteḥ siddhena kṣaṇikatvena svayameva vināśādityarthaḥ | yadvā na kṣaṇikatvamiti śaṅkāyām upapannaṃ kṣaṇikatvamityarthavaśādākṛṣṭena vākyenānvayaḥ | evaṃ kṣaṇikatvānubandhicodyaparihāraḥ kṛtaḥ | yadvā  naivamiti dūṣaṇapratijñāmupapādayitum, yāvadbādhaṃ bhayasvarūpānuvṛtterasiddhimāha  kṣaṇikatveneti, bādhakajñānānantaranivṛtteranyathāsiddhimāha  kāraṇanivṛttyā ceti | tatkṣaṇikatvaṃ kutaḥ siddhamiti śaṅkāyāṃ tadupapādayati kṣaṇikatvaṃ ceti | sthāyino hi ghaṭādayo daṇḍacakrādikāraṇanivṛttāvapanayupalabhyante; na tathā jñānadīpajvālādiḥ | tathā bhayāderapi kāraṇasaṃnidhānatannivṛttyanuvidhāyisadbhāvāsadbhāvatayā kṣaṇikatvaṃ niścitamityarthaḥ | vipakṣe bādhamāha  akṣaṇikatve ceti | sthāyino hi ghaṭādayaḥ pratikṣaṇamutpadyamānā bahavo yugapadupalabhyante; tathā'trāpi prasajediti bhāvaḥ | ato na bhayādikaṃ jñānanivartyam; svayameva kṣaṇikatayā naśyati | bhayasantatyucchedo bhrāntijñānaparamparārūpakāraṇanivṛttyā | tannivṛttiśca doṣanivṛttyā | nāyaṃ sarpo rajjureṣeti jñānaṃ svaviṣaya vyavahārahetuḥ; na tu sākṣādbhayādinivṛttihetuḥ | rajjutvaṃ hi sarpavyāvṛttiḥ | ataḥ sarpavyāvṛttirūparajjutvajñānābhāvena sarpabuddhayanuvṛttyā pāścātyabhayānuvṛttiḥ, sarpavyāvṛttirūparajjutvajñānena sarpapāramarthyābhimānanivṛttyā bhayanivṛttiriti sarvābhyupagataprakāreṇa dūṣaṇamuktam | syapakṣe tu jñānaviśeṣa eva bhayādiḥ kṣaṇikatayā svayaṃ naśyati | bhayādirūpajñānānuvṛttistu doṣāt sarpādibhramānuvṛttimūlā tannivṛttyā ca tatsaṃtatinivṛttiriti parihāraḥ |
evamarthadūṣaṇamuktam; atha prayogadūṣaṇamāha  svaprāgabhāveti | svaśabdaḥ prākśabdo'bhāvavyatiriktaśabdo'ntaraśabdaśca nirarthakāḥ | vastuśabdo hi bhāvavācī | anumānena bhāvarūpājñānāsidiṃdha nigamayati ata iti | śrutyarthāpattibhyāṃ tatsiddhimāśaṅkayāha  śrutīti |
anirvacanīyatve paroktahetuṃ vistareṇa dūṣayati  pratītīti | pratītiḥ bhrāntyabhrāntisādhāraṇarūpā | bhrāntiḥ vidyamānabhedāgrahaṇapūvarkasādhāraṇākāragrahaṇajanyā svaviṣayānyathātvaviśeṣitā pravṛttyādihetubhūtā | bādhaḥ āropitaviruddhādhiṣṭhānākārāvagāhinī buddhiḥ | na tathābhyupagamanīyamnānirvacanīyatvenābhyupagamīyamityarthaḥ | pratītibhrāntibādhānāṃ svaviṣayollekhamātreṇa vā anyathānupapattyā vā anirvacanīyasiddhiriti vikalpamabhipretya prathamaṃ dūṣayati  pratīyamānamiti | pratīyamānaṃ pratītyullikhyamānam | na hi nīlollekhaḥ pītollekhatayā aṅgīkāryaḥ; tathā sati sarvopaplavaprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati  ābhiriti | ābhiḥ  pratītibhrāntibādhaśabdopāttābhiḥ pratyakṣapratītibhiḥ | pratītyantareṇa  pramāṇāntarajanyena | yadvā ābhiḥlaukikapratītibhiḥ | pratītyantareṇaāgamajanyena | yadvā ābhiḥ pratītibhiḥ | ekādhiṣṭhāne sarpabhūtalanāmbudhārādibahutvābhiprāyaṃ bahuvacanam | pratītyantareṇabādhajñānena | saṅkṣiptasya dūṣaṇasya vistarārthaṃ paramatamanuvadati  śuktayādiṣviti | anyasyānyathābhānāyogācceti |
nanu kathamanyathābhānāyogaḥ | ucyate | na tāvat dharmadharmiṇormithastādātmyamānamanyathākhyānam | puro'vasthitaśuklabhāsvaraśakalaṃ na rajatatvajātitayā pratīyate | rajatatvañca na bhāsvaraśakalatayā pratīyate | śakalaṃ ca śakalatvena, jātiśca jātitvena patīyate | tasmānnānayoranyatarasya taditaratvamānamiti | nāpi dharmyantarasya dharmyantaratādātmyamanyathātvam | tat kiṃ viṣayagatam, uta jñānagatam | viṣaye tadanyathātvamasti cetyathārthaiva pratītiḥ | nāsti cetasatkhyātiprasaṅgaḥ | yadi jñānagatam, viṣayo'nyaḥ jñānamapyanyadeveti nopapadyate | na hi ghaṭajñānasya paṭajñānatvasaṃbhavaḥ | ātmakhyātiprasaṅgaśca, jñānākāratvādrajatādeḥ | svasmin asatā ākāreṇa khyānamanyathākhyānamiti cenna; asatkhyātiprasaṅgāt | anyatra sato'nyatra khyānaṃ khyānasyānyathātvamiti cenna; khaṇḍe dṛṣṭasya gotvasya muṇḍe darśanasyāpi bhramatvāpātāt | anyatraiva sato'nyatra khyānamanyathātvamiti cetanyatraiva sattvaṃ kathaṃ niścīyate | iha bādhāditi cenna; bhrāntijñānabādhitasya satyarajatasyāpyatrāsattvaniścayaprasaṅgāt | pravṛttibādhādanyatraiva sattvaniścaya iti cenna; mantrauṣadhādipratibaddhasyāgnerapi sphoṭajananādipravṛttibādhena mithyātvaniścaprasaṅgāt | duṣṭakāraṇajanyajñānaviṣayatvādiha bādhyata iti cetkathaṃ duṣṭakāraṇajanyatvaniścayaḥ | bādhakajñānodayāditi cetpūrvajñānameva bādhakaṃ syāt | paratvasyākiñcitkaratvaṃ hi darśitam | pūrvajñānasya duṣṭakāraṇajanyatve niścite pāścāttyajñānasya bādhakatvaniścayaḥ, tasya bādhakatve niścite pūrvasya duṣṭakāraṇajanyatvaniścayaḥ ityanyonyāśrayaśca syāt | kiñca yat tāvat rajataṃ purovartini bhātam, tasyaivānyatra sattve kiṃ pramāṇam? na tāvat pūrvajñānam; atra sattvena hi tadavagamayati | na bādhakajñānañca; taddhi parovartinyasattvamavagamayati | nāpi rajatagrāhakapramāṇam; tat khalvāpaṇe rajatasattāmavagamayati; na tu tasya, purataḥ khyātasya caikyam |
kvacidapyasataḥ khyānāyogāt anyatra sata eva khyātatvaṃ niścīyata iti cenna; asataḥ khyānāyogasya saṃbandhe parityaktatvāt | na hi purovartini rajatadharmisaṃbandho rajatatvajātisaṃbandho vā anyatra vidyate | nanuanyatra saṃbandhamātramasti; tadiha prakāśate  iti anyatra sata evānyatra khyānamiti cennasaṃbandhadvayānavabhāsāt | anyatra sataḥ saṃbandhāsyānyatra khyāne sambandhina iva saṃbandhāntaramapekṣitam | saṃbandhāntarāvabhāse cānyatra sataḥ khyānaṃ na syāt; dvitīyasaṃbandhasya kvacidapyasattvāt | saṃbandhasya saṃbandhāntarānapekṣatvāt saṃbandhāntarābhāve'pi purovartini bhānaṃ yuktamiti cetevaṃ tarhi saṃbandhyantarasaṃbandhaḥ purovarti ca nirantaraṃ bhātamiti yathārthakhyātirevoktā syāt; khyātāṃśasya sattvāt asataḥ kasyacit khyātatvābhāvācca | kiñca śuktiśakalasyaiva rajatajñānaviṣayatvaṃ rajatopāyānyatve sati rajatārthipravṛttiviṣayatvāditi sādhayitumapyayuktam | tathā hiidamarthasya rajatatvajātiviśiṣṭatājñānaviṣayatvaṃ hi sādhyam, tat abādhitapravṛttiviṣayatvaprayuktamiti hetossopādhikatvam | śuktinar rajatatayā bhāti śuktitvāt sampratipannavaditi ca bādhaḥ | evamādidūṣaṇābhiprāyeṇa anyasyānyathābhānāyogāccetyuktam |
dūṣayati neti | anyatraiva satā ākāreṇa purovatirno viśiṣṭatājñānam anyathābhānam | pratipannākārasya parovartinyabhāvaniścayaśca pravṛttibādhasacivāt nāstīti pratyayāt | na hi pratibaddhāgneragnitvaṃ nāstīti pratyaya iti prasiddham | kathaṃ tatpalpanāyāmapyanyathābhānasyāvarjanīyatvamityapekṣāyāmāha  kalpyamānaṃ hīti | anirvacanīyamityeva pratītyabhyupagame pratīterbhramarūpatvaṃ bādhaḥ pravṛttiśca na syuḥ | anirvacanīyaṃ nirvacanīyatvena pratītaṃ cetanyasyānyathāvabhāso'varjanīyaḥ syādityarthaḥ | tasyāparihāryatvācceti | tasya  anyathāmānasya | ayamabhiprāyaḥ"nānyasyānyathābhānam; vidyamānasyaiva pratīteḥ | alaukikaṃ sat laukikaṃ sacceti dvividhaṃ sat | anirvacanīye cālaukikaṃ sattvamasti | atra tadalaukikaṃ sat rajataṃ pratīyate" iti cetkimalaukikaṃ sat alaukikasattvena pratīyate, uta laukikasattvena? prathame bhramatvabādhapravṛttyasaṃbhavaḥ | alaukikaṃ laukikaṃ saditi pratītaṃ cetanyasyānyathākhyānaṃ syāt | alaukikasato laukikasatā bhedāgrahāt pravṛttyādisaṃbhava iti cettarhi tatrānirvacanīyaṃ vastu kalpayitvā tatra bhedāgraheṇa pravṛttibādhabhramatvopapādanādapi prathamata eva saṃpratipannarajatācchuktitvarūpabhedāgraheṇa pravṛttibādhabhramatvopapādane kalpanālāghavādanirvacanīyaṃ vastvanupapannam ityādipadakaparamparāmabhipretya tasyāparihāryatvāccetyuktam | yarthārthakhyātivyatiriktapakṣeṣvanyathākhyātipakṣaḥ prabala ityabhiprāyeṇāha  khyātyantareti | sudūramapi gatvāpadakaparamparāmuktavā'pītyarthaḥ | tadupapādayati  asaditi | kathaṃ mādhyamikapakṣaḥ | kimasadityeva pratīyate, uta saditi | asaditīti cet, bhramatvabādhapravṛttyasaṃbhavaḥ | saditīti cet, anyasyānyathābhānaṃ syādityarthaḥ | ātmeti | ayaṃ yogācārapakṣaḥ | ātmaśabdo jñānaparaḥ | kiṃ jñānamityeva pratītam, utārtha iti | prathame pravṛttibādhabhramatvāsaṃbhavaḥ | dvitīye'nyasyānyathābhānamityarthaḥ| akhyātipakṣa iti | idaṃ rajatamiti kimekajñānam; uta jñānadvayamiti vikalpamabhipretya ekajñānamiti pakṣe jñeye anyathākhyātiṃ prasañjayati anyaviśeṣaṇamanyaviṣaṇatveneti | idaṃ rajatamityekatvena saṃpratipannasamyagrajatavat āropyaliṅgānuvidhāyiprayogānuguṇasāmānādhikaraṇyena pratītatvādanyaviśeṣaṇamanyaviśeṣaṇatvena pratīyata ityāpāditam; na tu tatpakṣa upanyastaḥ | jñānadvayamitipakṣe jñāne'nyathākhyātiṃ prasañjayati  jñāneti | jñānadvayaṃ kiṃ jñānadvayamityeva pratītam; utaikamiti iti vikalpe pūrvavaddūṣaṇam | viṣayāsadbhāveti | kimavidyamānatvena pratīyate; uta vidyamānatvena pratīyate? prathame pravṛttyādyasaṃbhavaḥ | dvitīye'nyathābhānamityarthaḥ |
atha akāraṇatvamupapādayati  kiñceti | tasyāḥpratyakṣapratīteḥ | tadviṣayatvenavidyamānaviṣayakāraṇakatvena | kāraṇaṃ hi niyatapūrvabhāvīti bhāvaḥ | mahatāmidamupapādanamiti | tasya vṛttijñānasya viṣayarahitāvasthāsvīkāreṇa kāraṇatvābhyupagame'pasiddhāntāpātāt, nirviṣayakhyātivādināmiva tatprabhāvena pavṛttyādisiddhau anirvacanīyakaptivaiyarthyāt, viṣayarūpakāraṇena vinotpattivacanāt, viramyavyāpāravacanāccātyantamanupapannamityarthaḥ | athendriyādīti | ādiśabdena viṣayagatadoṣaḥ, puruṣasyānavadhānaṃ vā gṛhyate | tasya puruṣāśrayatveneti | dūratvādidoṣasya viṣayagatatve'pi puruṣagatatvasyāpi saṃbhavādubhayatra kāryamutpādyam; na viṣayamātre; niyāmakābhāvāt | ataḥ puruṣa iva viṣaye'pi na saṃbhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ | nanu cakṣuṣaḥ puruṣāśrayatve'pi cākṣuṣaraśmeḥ prasṛtasya viṣayasaṃbaddhasya tatra kāryakaratvaṃ dṛṣṭam | na; tatkāryasya jñānasya puruṣāśritatvāt doṣāṃśasyākāryakaratvāt | nanu viṣayamātragatāḥ sādṛśyādayo doṣāḥ santi | teṣāṃ tatraiva kāryakaratvamupapadyate | maivam; sādṛśyāderyāvaddravyabhāvinaḥ sadotpādakatvaprasaṅgāt | āgantoranyasya tatrādṛṣṭeḥ | indriyasaṃyogasya puruṣagatajñānātiriktahetutvāsiddheḥ | dṛṣṭiviṣādinyāyasyātrāsaṃbhavāt | saṃbhave'pi sarvairupalambhaprasaṅgācca | nanvindriyāṇi yathā puruṣaviśeṣasaṃbandhāt tatraiva kāryaviśeṣamutpādayanti, evaṃ viṣayaviśeṣasaṃbandhāt tatraiva kiñcijjanayantu | tatrāha  nāpīndriyāṇīti | puruṣagatajñānākhyakāyarkaratvamanvayavyatirekāvasitam | viṣaye tvindriyajanyaṃ kāryāntaraṃ na dṛṣṭam | tatkaptiranyathaivopapattyā nirasteti bhāvaḥ | tathāpi duṣṭapuruṣasaṃnidhānāt yathā deśādiṣu doṣāḥ prāduṣyuḥ, tathā duṣṭendriyasaṃnidhānādviṣaye kāryaviśeṣaḥ syādityatrāha  nāpi duṣṭānīti | anvayavyatirekādikamatilaṅghaya dṛṣṭāntamātreṇa na kiñcit sādhayituṃ śakyamiti bhāvaḥ | kimatra hetvantaragaveṣaṇayā? anādibhāvarūpājñānameva viśvopādānabhūtaṃ śuktirajatādyapi vicitrakāryaṃ janayedityatrāha  anādīti | tasya svarūpānāditvāt | kāryamapi prāgeva syāt | sahakāritvena śaṅkanīyamindriyādikaṃ tu nirastam | mithyābhūtasya cārthakriyākāritvamayuktam | āśrayānupapattyādayaśca pūrvamevoktā iti bhāvaḥ |
evamanirvacanīyasya rajatāderutpādakānupapattimuktavā tadutpattāvapi rajatādibuddhiśabdānvayaniyamānupapattimāha  kiñceti | tadyvavasthāpakaṃ śaṅkate rajatādīti | prātibhāsikasya rajatāderarthakriyākārivyāvahārikarajatādisādṛśyādityarthaḥ | uktasya vyavasthāpakatvābhāvamabhipretya sādṛśyasya yathādarśanaṃ sādhyāntaramāha  tarhīti | yadi tatsadṛśe tadbuddhiḥ, tadā gavaye gobuddhivadanyathākhyātiḥ syādityevakārābhiprāyaḥ | sādṛśyasyānirvāhakatve'pi tajjātiyogasya tadbuddhinirvāhakatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti śaṅkate  rajatādīti | sārajatādijātiḥ | aparamārthānvayāyogātaparamārthavyaktyanvayāyogādityarthaḥ | vyaktibādhe'pi jāterabādhitatvaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | jātirapi hi bādhyate | na hi, vyaktirnāsti jātirastīti pratītiḥ | jātirapi nāstītyeva hi pratipattiḥ | na ca prākpratipannāyā api jāteḥ paścādapratītirabhivyañjakavyaktayabhāvāt; na tu jātyabhāvāditi vācyam; abhivyañjakavati pūrvakāle pratipannāyā api jātestatkālasaṃbandhitayaiva nāstitāgocaratvādbādhakapratyayasya | pratipannopādhau nāstīti pratyayo hi bādhaḥ | aparamārthapakṣaṃ dūṣayati  nāpīti | paramārthānvayāyogātāpaṇastharajatavyaktayanvayāyogādityarthaḥ | vyaktayavasthāne'pi jāteḥ kadācidbādhitatvaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | na hi kadācidapyāpaṇastharajate rajatatvaṃ bādhyate | paramārthavyaktayanvaye bādhakamāha  aparamārtha iti | paramārthabuddhiśabdayoḥ | paramārthavyaktau jātirananvitā cettasyāḥ kvacidapi paramārthabuddhiśabdahetutvādarśanāt bhrāntisthale'pi paramārthabuddhiśabdanirvāhakatvaṃ na syādityarthaḥ | yadvā jātyapāramārthya eva dūṣaṇāntaraṃ buddhiśabdānvayānupapattimāha  aparamārtha iti | tadānīm paramārthabuddhiśabdayoḥparamārthabhūtabuddhiśabdayorityarthaḥ | asatyāt satyotpattinirāsamupajavavyedaṃ dūṣaṇamucyate | vyaktestannirvāhakatvāyogaṃ darśayitumaparamārtha ityuktiḥ | aparamārthajāteḥ paramārthabhūtabuddhiśabdanirvāhakatvāyogāt jātyapāramārthyamayuktamityarthaḥ | buddhiśabdayośca pāramārthyaṃ tadbādhakādarśanādeva siddham ||
atha vakṣyamāṇāyā yathārthakhyāteḥ svasiddhāntatvaṃ darśayati  athaveti | tasyāḥ sāmpradāyikatvaṃ darśayan tāṃ pratijānīte  yathārthamiti | venadavidāmbhagavadbodhāyananāthamuni(yāmuna ?)miśrādīnāmityarthaḥ | kuta itya trāha  śrutismṛtibhya iti | śrutiṃ daśaryati  bahu syāmitīti | ādiśabdena nāmarūpavyākaraṇamucyate | yadvā sanmūlā ityādivākyoktaṃ sthitipralayādikaṃ gṛhyate | sṛṣṭayādirupakramo yasya prakaraṇasya tasmin sṛṣṭayādyupakrame |
idaṃ śralokārddhaṃ kimarthamiti cetucyate | pāṭhakrameṇāṇḍasṛṣṭeḥ paścāt trivṛtkaraṇamiti jñāyate | aṇḍasṛṣṭeḥ prāgapi trivṛtkaraṇamasti; aṇḍasṛṣṭayarthatvāt trivṛtkaraṇasya | trivṛtkaraṇamupāyaḥ; aṇḍasṛṣṭiḥ phalam | utpattau tatphalaṃ paścādbhavati; saṃṅkalpe tu pūrvabhāvi | upāyastūtpattau pūrvabhāvī, saṃkalpe paścādbhāvīti lokasiddham, kiṃ kena kathamityādau | ataḥ "nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi | tāsāṃ trivṛtaṃ trivṛtamekaikāṃ karavāṇi" ityasmin vyaṣṭisṛṣṭisaṅkalpavākye paścānnirdiṣṭamaṇḍasṛṣṭayupāyabhūtaṃ trivṛtkaraṇam | "nāmarūpe vyākarot tāsāṃ trivṛtaṃ trivṛtamekaikāmakarot" ityutpattivākye pūrvanirdiṣṭasyāpi nāmarūpavyākaraṇasya phalabhūtatvāt trivṛtkaraṇasya phalarūpasṛṣṭeḥ pūrvabhāvo niścīyate; arthakrameṇa pāṭhakramabādhasya nyāyyatvāt | "agnihotraṃ juhoti yavāgūṃ pacati" itivat | asminnarthe nidarśanam, upakrame "bahu syāṃ prajāyeya" iti vākyam | atra bahu syāmiti phalasaṅkalpaḥ; prajāyeyeti tadupāyasaṅkalpaḥ anena, na kevalam kiṃ kena kathamityādilokaprasidhdyā atra trivṛtkaraṇasya phalabhūtasṛṣṭeḥ pūrvabhāvitvaniścayaḥ, upakramabhūtasaṅkalpavākyānuguṇyācceti jñāpitam | evaṃ trivṛtkaraṇasyāṇḍasṛṣṭeḥ prāk sadbhāvaṃ jñāpāyitumupakramagatasaṅkalpavākyasya tadanuguṇatvajñāpanāya bahu syāmityādyardhamupāttam |
aṇḍāntarvartyagnyādiṣu trivṛtkaraṇasya pradarśanādaṇḍasṛṣṭeḥ pañcāt trivṛtkaraṇamiti śaṅkāyāṃ śruterarthamāha  evaṃ hi pratyakṣeṇopalabhyata iti | agnyādiṣu katipayavyaktiṣu trirūpatvapradarśanaṃ neyatābuddhayā; apitvaṇḍāntarbhūtasyaiva pratyakṣayituṃ yogyatvāt pūrvoktatrivṛtkaraṇasaṃbhāvanāpradarśanārthamiti bhāvaḥ | aṇḍasṛṣṭeḥ prāgeva trivṛtkaraṇamastīti spaṣṭaṃ jñāpayati purāṇe ceti | asyāmupaniṣadi bhūtatrayasṛṣṭeruktatvāt sṛṣṭatayoktānāṃ miśraṇamuktam | idaṃ tattvāntarasṛṣṭipratipādanaprakaraṇeṣu teṣāmapi miśraṇasya pradarśanārthamiti jñāpanāya (ca) purāṇavacanodāharaṇam | vaiṣṇava ityanena sāttvikatvāt prāmāṇyaṃ sūcitam; "sāttvikeṣu ca sarveṣu viṣṇormāhātmyamiṣyate" iti vacanāt | saṃhatatvaṃ samāgatatvañceti avasthādvayamasti | saṃhatatvaṃ nāma pṛthaksthityarhasaṃyogamātram; samāgatatvaṃ pṛthaksthityarhasaṃśleṣaviśeṣā, etaddvayābhāvāt sraṣṭuṃ nāśaknuvannityāha  nānāvīryā iti | etadubhayaprāptyā asṛjannityāha  sametyādi | ekaikasmin bhūte sarvabhūtāni santi cet, sarve śabdāḥ sarvatra prayujyerannityatrāha  paramparasamāśrayā iti | anyeṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ samāśritānāmekaṃ bhūtaṃ samāśrayaḥ | āśritāśrayabhāvaśca nyūnādhikabhāvanibandhanaḥ | tatkṛtā śabdavyavastheti bhāvaḥ | upāttavacanānantaraṃ "samprāpyaikyamaśeṣataḥ" iti kṛtsnaśaḥ samāgatatvamuktam | mahadādaya iti pāṭhe satyapi vṛttabhaṅgaparihārāya svasandarbhe mahadādyā ityuktaṃ bhāṣyakāraiḥ | ayameva śrutyabhiprāya iti sthāpayituṃ sūtrakārokiṃta darśayati  sūtreti | tataḥ sūtrakāro'pyavadadityanvayaḥ | tataḥasyārthasya śrutismṛsiddhatvādityarthaḥ | evaṃ prathamaṃ bhūte bhūtāntarasadbhāva uktaḥ, vakṣyamāṇasya sadṛśe sadṛśāntarasadbhavasyopayogitvāt | tenābhidhābhidābhūyastvenābhidhānavyavasthetyarthaḥ | sadṛśe sadṛśāntarasadbhāvamāha  someti | nyāyavidaḥparīkṣakāḥ | "somābhāve pūtīkānabhiṣuṇuyāt" ityayaṃ vidhirniyamārthaḥ | somābhāve tatsadṛśadravyāntareṣu svataḥ pravṛtteḥ | etattulyānyāyasiddhārthamāha  vrīhīti | vrīhibhāvataḥvrīhyavayavasadbhāvataḥ | tataḥ kathaṃ sadṛśe sadṛśāntarasadbhāva ityatrāha  tadeveti | anena śuktayādau rajatādyavayavasadbhāvaḥ phalita ityāha  śuktayādāviti | śrutyaiva bodhitaḥpratinidhiśrutyaivābhihitatvena phalitaḥ | yadvā trivṛtkaraṇaśrutyaiva bodhitatvaṃ phalitam | tenaḥpracurarūpyāṃśaḥ śuktau trivṛtkaraṇāt sidhyatītyarthaḥ | kathaṃ śabdavyavasthetyatrāha rūpyeti | śaktirūpyayoḥ sādṛśye sati hi śuktau rūpyasadbhāvasiddhiḥ, śabdavyavasthāyā bhūyastvahetukatvasiddhiścetyatrāha  rūpyādīti | yadvā śuktau rajataikadeśasadbhāve pramāṇāntaramāha  rūpyādīti | tataḥ kimityatrāha  ata iti | pratīteḥrūpyasadṛśatayā pratīteḥ | śuktayādau rajatādyavayavasadbhāvaścet, sadā gṛhyeta; pravṛttiśca sadā syāt; bādhaśca nopapadyetetyatrāha  kadāciditi | doṣaḥ śuktayaṃśāgrahahetuḥ | pracuragrahaṇābhibhūtatvābhāvādadṛṣṭavaśācca rajatagrahaṇam | adṛṣṭavaśāccāmbuno grahaṇāditi hi vakṣyate | udāharaṇāntareṣvapyupajīvyatvāya hi tatra taduktiḥ | bhūya stvena bādhyabādhakābhāva iti | śuktibhūyastvena tajjñānasya bādhakatvam | tata eva rajatālpatvaṃ siddham | tena rajatajñānasya bādhyatvamityarthaḥ | bhūyastvenetyukte bhrāntijñānasya rajatabhūyastvāt tena śuktijñānasya bādhyatvaśaṅkāvyāvṛttyarthaṃ bhūyastvena bādhyabādhakatvamupapādayati  śuktīti | nanu sākalye satyapi vaikalyaṃ gṛhītaṃ cetanyathākhyātiriti | naivam | na hi vaikalyasya graho vaikalyagrahaḥ; kintu śuktibhūyastvavaikalyena grahaḥtatsahitatayā grahaḥ | tayorgrahayoḥ rūpāt svabhāvāttathāvidhagrahaṇātmakatvādityarthaḥ | bahuvrīhirvā | bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ | pūvottarajñānayostathārūpatvāt bādhyabādhakabhāva ityarthaḥ | jñānasya bādhyatvaṃ na svarūpataḥ; na ca viṣayataḥ; kintu bādhyapravṛttikatvam | uttarajñānasya ca bādhakatvaṃpūrvajñānajanyapravṛttinivārakatvam | anyathākhyātivāde'pi jñānasya svarūpeṇa bādhyatvamanabhimatam; kintu viṣayabādhyatvamevābhimatam | asmākaṃ tu jñānaphalabhūtapravṛtterbādhyatvamiti bhidā | pravṛtteśca bādhitatvaṃ pratibaddhotpattikatvaṃ viphalatvaṃ vā | nāta iti | mithyārthasatyārthaśabdābhyāṃ parābhimatamithyātvasatyatve vivakṣite | evamiti | sarvasya sarvatve'pi vyavahāravyavasthitiḥhānopādānādiniyamaḥ evambhūyastvasākalyavaikalyābhyāmityarthaḥ |
sādhāraṇākāragrahaṇabhedāgrahadoṣādṛṣṭāni sarvavādibhirabhyupetavyāni | tāvatā pravṛttyādisaṃbhave'pi adhikakalpanāyāmanyeṣāṃ gauravaṃ syāt | tatreṣṭarūparūpinirantarabhānātpravṛttiḥ; dviṣṭarūparūpinirantarabhānānnivṛttiḥ | rūparūpiṇordharmyantaraniṣṭhatvavirodhidharmāntarāśritatvabhānaviraheṇa bhānaṃ nirantarabhānam; ata eva, "bhedagrahātpravṛttiścet, rajjusarpabhedāgrahe nivṛttirna syāt" ityādīni codyāni nāvakāśaṃ labhante | yaḥ paramate khyātyantaraheturabhyupetaḥ, sa evāsmākaṃ pravṛttyādihetuḥ | prābhākarairmantrārthavādārthatātparyānabhyupagamāt kevalabhedāgrahaṇaiva nirvāhaḥ kṛtaḥ | atra tu mantrārthavādayoḥ pratīyamānārthe prāmāṇyābhyupagamādupaniṣadbhāgāvagataṃ trivṛtkaraṇaṃ tatpradarśitaṃ pañcīkaraṇam īśvarakartṛkaṃ sargaviśeṣaṃ tathā pratipidhinyāyaṃ bhedāgrahamapyupajīvya nirvāhaḥ kṛta iti vaiṣamyam |
tatra bhūte bhūtāntarabhramasya trivṛtkaraṇena nirvāhaḥ sphuṭataraḥ | sadṛśe sadṛśāntarabhramasya tu pratinidhinyāyenaiva nirvāhaḥ, na tu trivṛtkaraṇenopayogu iti kecidācāryāḥ |trivṛtkaraṇamapi vijātīyabhūtārabdhe sadṛśe vijātīyabhūtārabdhasadṛśāntarabhramanirvāhaupayikamiti ca sampradāyaḥ | śrutismṛtibhyaḥ sarvasyetyādigranthānāṃ svārasyāt tathā'vagamyate | atastrivṛtkaraṇaśravaṇapañcīkaraṇasmaraṇābhyāṃ pratinidhinyāyācca sadṛśe sadṛśāntarabuddhiyāthārthyaṃ nirūpyate | nanu kathaṃ sadṛśe sadṛśāntarabhramasya trivṛtkaraṇenopayogaḥ | na hi trivṛtkaraṇātpūrvaṃ rajatādyavayavāḥ santi | tathāsati hi trivṛtkaraṇanibandhanaṃ śuktau rajatādisaṃmiśraṇaṃ syāt | na ca tadasti; trivṛtkaraṇasyāṇḍasṛṣṭeḥ pūrvabhāvitvāt | ucyate; pāñcabhautikeṣvapi padārtheṣu kiñcitkāryaṃ kenacitpracureṇa bhūtena pariṇāmaviśeṣavatā ārabdham | tatra yādṛśapariṇāmayuktayadbhūtapracuraṃ yat kāryam, tasya tādṛśapariṇāmavato bhūtasya kāryāntareṣvapi vidyāmānatvāt teṣu tathāvidhatadbhūtapracuratatkāryaviṣayabuddhirupapadyate | yadyapyavāntarākāraviśeṣastrivṛtkaraṇadaśāyāṃ nāsti, tathāpi trivṛtkaraṇena kāryānupraviṣṭasya tasya bhūtasya kāryāntovayavasamānaparimāṇasaṃbhavādbhautikāntare bhautikāntarabuddheryāthārthyaṃ ghaṭate | tathā (tatha ca ?) trivṛtkaraṇena śuktāvantargatasya tejoṃśasya śuktabhāsvararūpeṇa pariṇāmavato rajatasausādṛśyāt rajatāvayavatvamupapannam | tādṛśākārayuktatattadbhūtaviśeṣavanta eva hi samyagrajatādayo nirīkṣyante | ataḥ śuktayādau rajatādyavayavasadbhāva upapadyate | nanu kathaṃ śuktayādiṣu pratīyamānānāmavayavānāṃ rajatādyavayavatvam | na hi te rajatādibhya ānīya niveśitāḥ | ucyate | sampratipannarajatādyavayavasusadṛśākāratvameva teṣāṃ rajatādyavayavatvam; na tu rajatādibhya ānīya niveśi tatvam | yathā saṃpratipannarajatādyavayavānām | na hyāpaṇastharajatādyavayavāḥ kutaścidrajatāntarāderānīya niveśitāḥ | evameva pūtīkādiṣu pratīyamānānāṃ somalatādyavayavānāmapi somādyavayavatvaṃ nāma sampratipannasomalatādyavayavasusadṛśatvameva | tacca sphuṭatarapratītisiddhamabādhitañca | na hi śuktiśakalapūtīkādiṣu rajatasomalatādisādṛśyaṃ nāstīti bādhakapratyayaṃ udeti | teṣāmavayavānāṃ vijātīyāvayavaprācuryādakāyarkaratvam, pracurakṣīraniviṣṭālpasalilasyeva pracurakanakasaṃsṛṣṭālparajatasyeva ca saṃbhavati |
nanvevaṃ śuktitayā'bhimatapuñjasya śuktitvamapuṣkalaṃ syāt, vijātīyāvayavasaṃsargāt; puruṣamṛge puruṣatvavat | puruṣamṛgatvaṃ nāma puruṣatvamṛgatvavilakṣaṇaṃ jātyantaram, na tu vikalaṃ puruṣatvaṃ mṛgatvaṃ ceti cettarhi śuktitayā'bhimatapuñjasyāpi śuktitvarajatatvavilakṣaṇajātyantaravattvaṃ syāt | tataśca puruṣamṛge puruṣavyavahāravat śuktivyavahāro na mukhyaḥ syāt | vijātīyasaṃsṛṣṭāyāḥ bhramādhiṣṭhānabhūtāyāḥ śukteḥ, puruṣeṇa puruṣamṛgasyeva, śuktayantareṇa sausādṛśyābhāvāt | sausādṛśyatve sati hi tattāvyavahārasya mukhyatvam | tadabhāvāddhi siṃho devadatta ityasyāmukhyatvam | śuktayavayavaprācuryācchuktitvaṃ puṣkalam; tata eva tadvayavahāraśca mukhya iti cettarhi rajatāṃśasyāpracuratvādeva rajatatvaṃ nāstīti rajatabuddheryāthārthyaṃ na syāt |
ucyate | puruṣatvavat śuktitvasyāvayavasaṃghātaviśeṣavṛttitvābhāvādaṇumātre'pi śuktitvaṃ puṣkalam | puruṣatvasya tu saṅghātaviśeṣavṛttitayā saṅghātavaikalyāt tadapauṣkalam; jānyantaraṃ vā tatra syāt; śuktitvaṃ tu na tathetyuktam | ataḥ śuktayavayaveṣu śuktitvatadvayavahārāvupapannau | tatra viruddhajātyanvayābhāvāt | śuktitayā'bhimatasaṅghāte tu śuktayavayavaprācuryādarthakriyāvyavasthā śabdavyavasthā copapadyate | pracuraśuktayabhibhūtatvena rajatāṃśasyāgṛhītatvāt gṛhītaśuktivivakṣayā tadviṣayatvena prayuktaḥ śabdo mukhya ityupapannam | na ca bhramādhiṣṭhānabhūtāyāḥ śuktervijātīyāvayavayogitayā śuktayantarasausādṛyahāniḥ, śuktayantarasyāpyalparajatāṃśamiśratvāt | rajatāṃśābhibhavena śuktayantarasausādṛśyapratītirupapadyate | śuktayavayavānāṃ tu parasparasausādṛśyamupapannataram | uktarītyā rajatāṃśasya ca rajatatvaṃ mukhyam | tasminnaṃśe viruddhajātyanvayābhāvāt rajatāntarāvayavasausādṛśyaṃ ca | bhramadaśāyāṃ gṛhyamāṇasya tasya pracuraśuktigrahaṇābhibhūtatvābhāvādrajatāntarāvayavasausādṛśyapratītirupapadyate | ata eva rajatavyavahāraśca mukhyaḥ | ataḥ śuktayādau rajatādibuddheryāthāthyarmupapannam |
alpasya rajatasya pracuratayā grahaṇe'nyathākhyātiprasaṅga iti cenna; prācuryagrahaṇābhāvāt, alpatvāgrahaṇameva hi tatra vidyate | prācuryasya pratiyogyapekṣatvāt pratiyogibhūtaśuktayagrahaṇāt tadgrahaṇe pravṛttvasaṃbhavācca śuktayapekṣayā rajatāṃśasya prācuryaṃ na gṛhītamiti nānyathākhyātiḥ | nanvalpatvāgrahaṇaṃ nāma pracuratvagrahaṇaṃ syāt | bhavanmate hi bhāvāntaramabhāvaḥ | ato'nyathākhyātatvamiti cetna; alpātvāgrahaṇaṃ nāma na prācaryagrahaṇam, api tu alpatvaviṣayajñānasaṅkoca iti anyathāgrahābhāvāt | nedaṃ rajatamityatra nañarthaḥ kaḥ iti cetśuktitvameveti brūmaḥ | yadākāragrahaṇena pūrvajñānotpannāyāḥ pavṛtternivṛttervā nivāraṇam, sa evā''kāro nañarthaḥ | sa cā''kāraḥ pratiyogisāpekṣaiḥ nedaṃ rajatamityādiśabdaiḥ, tadanapekṣaiḥ śuktayādiśabdaiśca vyavahriyate ||
evaṃ bhūte bhūtāntarasadbhāvāt, sadṛśe sadṛśāntarasadbhāvācca śuktirūpyādibuddheryāthārthyamupāditam; na hi svapnā rthānāṃ sadṛśe sadṛśāntarasadbhāvo vā bhūte bhūtāntarasadbhāvo vaktuṃ śakya ityatrāha  svapne ceti | kathaṃ kecit sukharūpāḥ kecit duḥkharūpā ityatrāha  puṇyapāpānuguṇamiti | bhagavataivajagatsraṣṭraiva | tarhyanyairaṣyupalabhyeta, sadā copalabhyetetyatrāha  tattaditi | kathaṃ dṛṣṭavisajātīyāḥ ityatrāha  tathā bhūtā iti | śrutiṃ darśayatitathāhīti | svapnaviṣayatvamasya vākyasya kathamiti śaṅkāyāṃ svapnaṃ paśyatīti pūrvavākyaṃ smārayati  svapnaviṣayeti | rathayogāḥaśvādayaḥ | na bhavantidṛṣṭasajātīyā na bhavantītyarthaḥ | ānandā mudaḥ pramuda iti | sādhāraṇabhogyadarśanajā pratīrmut; asādhāraṇabhogyatvajñānajā prītiḥ pramut; viniyogajā prītirānandaḥ | yadvā vilakṣaṇaviṣayadarśanajā prītirmut; tasya svaviniyogārhatvajñānajanyā prītiḥ pramut; viniyomajā prītirānanda iti | etaiḥ śabdairviṣayāḥ lakṣyante | mukhyārthatve dṛṣṭavisajātīyatvāyogāt | veśāntāḥgṛhāḥ | yadvā veśāntā(veśāntāḥ?) palvalānītyarthaḥ | kathamupapadyata ityatrāha  sa hi karteti | sarvaśaktirhi kartā; kimanupapannamiti bhāvaḥ | tacchabdo na prakṛtajīvaparaḥ; api tu prasiddhaparamātmaparaḥ | vyāghātapaunaruktayaśaṅkāparihārātharmasyāḥ śruterarthamāha  yadyapi sakaleti | sṛjata iti padavirodhaparihārāya, na bhavantīti niṣedhasya saṅkoco hi utsargopavādanyāyena kṛtaḥ | ataḥ kālāntarasthāyitvapuruṣāntarānubhāvyatvākāraviṣayo niṣedhaḥ; na tu tatkālatatpuruṣamātrānubhāvyattayā svarūpaniṣedhaḥ | ato jāgradavasthānubhūtavastusajātīyāḥ anekapuruṣānubhāvyāḥ kālāntarasthāyinaśca na bhavantītyarthaḥ | sa hi kartetyetatkhaṇḍam uktārthopapādakatvena vyācaṣṭe tasyeti | svāpnārthasṛṣṭerīśvarakartṛkatvasphuṭīkaraṇārthaṃ śrutyantaramāha  ya eṣu supteṣviti | svapnārthānāṃ pāramārthyaṃ pūrvapakṣīkṛtyāpāramārthyaṃ sūtrakāreṇa siddhāntitamiti vyākhyātṛmatabhedena asyāḥ śruternāyamartha iti śaṅkāvyudāsārthamuktārthasya sūtrakārābhimatatvamāha  sūtreti | sūtrārthamāha  svāpneṣviti | jīvasyāpi svapnadaśāyāṃ satyasaṅkalpatvādyāvirbhāvaḥ kalpyata ityatrāha  tasmiṃllokā iti | ananyathāsiddhasyaiva hi kalpakatvam | paramātmaliṅgaśravaṇena svāpnārthadṛṣṭeḥ parātmanaivopapannatvāt na jīvasya svarūpāvirbhāvaḥ kalpyata ityarthaḥ | kathamapavarake śayānasya deśāntaragamanādeḥ pāramārthyamupapadyata ityatrāha  apavarakādiṣviti | svayameva svaduḥkhāvahavastusṛṣṭayanupapatteśca na tadā jīvasya svarūpāvirbhāvaḥ kalpyata iti cārthasiddham; śiraśchedādaya ityuktatvāt | sarūpe dehāntare śayānadehavyavahāro bhedāgrahakṛtaḥ; na tvanyathākhyātikṛtaḥ | evaṃ svāpnārtheṣu tattadekapuruṣānubhāvyatvatattatkālāvasāyitvarūpabhedāgrahāt pravṛttyādirbhavati ||
pītaśaṅkhādāvīśvarasṛṣṭatvaśrutirdarśayituṃ na śakyata ityatrāha  pīteti | pītimavat śauklyamapi pratīyetetyatrāha  tatreti | tarhi pārśvasthairapi pittadravyaṃ grāhyamityatrāha  pitteti | tarhi sūkṣmatvāt tenāpi na pittaṃ grāhyamityatrāha  pittopahatena tviti | dūrasthaśaṅkhasyātisāmīpyābhāvāt kathaṃ tatrasthaṃ pittadravyaṃ gṛhyata ityatrāha  tadgrahaṇeti | yathā atidūramutpatitaḥ patago na draṣṭuṃ śakyate, tathāpi saṃnikarṣotpatanakālādārabhya nirantaramavekṣyamāṇastajjanitasaṃskāravadybhāṃ cakṣurbhyāṃ dūre'pi gṛhyatetadvadityarthaḥ | prābhākaraiḥ pittapītimā śaṅkhadravyaṃ ca nirantaraṃ gṛhyete ityuktam; atra tu rūpavad dravye cakṣuṣaḥ sāmarthyāt pittadravyaṃ gṛhyata ityuktamiti viśeṣaḥ | suvarṇānuliptaśaṅkhavaditi dṛṣṭānte cāyaṃ bhāvaḥ | nanu yadi pittadravyaśaṅkhayorbhedāgrahāt pītaśaṅkhavyavahāraḥ, tarhi paṭe pītavyavahāraḥ kathaṃ na syāt | anyathākhyātau vā kathaṃ paṭe pītavyavahārābhāvaḥ | bhrame sati tanmūlanirūpaṇā kāryā | na tu sarvatra bhrameṇa bhavitavyamiti cettulyam ||
japākusumasphaṭikādau cākṣuṣadoṣasaṃsargo durvaca ityatrāha  japeti | japākusumasphaṭikamarīcikājalaalātacakradiṅmoheṣu dravyāntareṇa saṃbandhān yathārthā pratītiriti nirvāhaḥ | japākusumapabhāsaṃbandhāt raktapratītiścet, tatsaṃbandhāt pāṣāṇādiṣvapi tathā syādityatrāha  svaccheti | marīciketi | adṛṣṭasya niyāmakatvaṃ sarvairapi khyātyantaravādibhirabhyupetavyam, anyathā sarveṣāṃ sarvadā sarvatra sarvaviṣayabhramaprasaṅgāt; kadācidapi bhramābhāvaprasaṅgācca | alāteti antarālāgrahaṇātpūrvottarakālabhāvinoḥ tattatpradeśaviśeṣālātasaṃyogayorantaralāgrahaṇāt kramāgrahaṇādityarthaḥ | antarālāgrahaṇe sati kathaṃ yāthārthyamityatrāha  cakreti | cakrapratītiḥsamyakcakrapratītiḥ | ko viśeṣa ityatrāha kvaciditi | darpaṇādiṣviti | savyadakṣiṇaviparyāsaḥ kathamiti cetucyate | āpekṣiko hi savyadakṣiṇabhāvaḥ | tatra svābhimukhatayā viparyastasavyadakṣiṇabhāvasya daparṇasya, mukhasya cāntarālāgrahaṇameva | viparyāso darpaṇadeśagataḥ | tenākṛhītāntarālaṃ mukhamiti abhimukhasya darpaṇasya mukhasya cāntarālāgrahaṇādābhimukhyapratīteryāthārthyam evaṃ malinatvālpatvādi(de?)śca | diṅmohe'pīti | sarvadiksadbhāve'pi prācyādivyavahāraḥ pratiyogyapekṣayā | tatra digantarapratiyogino digantarasya ca nirantarabhānam | ato yarthārthaviṣayatvamiti | diśāṃ bahutvaṃ ca, "padbhayāṃ bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāt" ityavagamyate |
dvicandreti | tataḥ kimityatrāha  tatraiketi | svataḥ ṛjuprasāriṇo'pi cākṣuṣatejaso vakratvaṃ saṃbhavati | darpaṇādinā taddarśanāt | ihāpyaṅgulyavaṣṭambhādṛṣṭādinā tadupapattiḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  ata iti | candradeśau dvāviti pratītyabhāvahetuścandaikatvāgrahaṇam | deśāntaragatasya tadviśeṣaṇakatvaṃ kathamityatrāha  deśeti | tataḥ kiṃ pratīteryāthārthyasyetyatrāha tatra sāmagrīti | tena deśadvayaviśiṣṭacandragrahaṇadvayaṃ ca pāramārthikamiti | grahaṇadvayamatiśaighyrādagṛhītakramam, ata evāgṛhītaparasparabhedaṃ ceti bhāvaḥ | viśeṣaṇadvayaviśiṣṭaviṣayaprahaṇadvaye'pi viśeṣyaikyaṃ kathaṃ na pratīyata ityatrāha  tatreti | na hi kevalaṃ cakṣuḥ aikyapratipattisamarthaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ devadattādiṣa, api tu saṃskārasaṃskṛtameva samarthaṃ dṛṣṭam | saṃskārasya vilambitabhāvitvānna tadānīmaikyapratipattirityarthaḥ | cākṣuṣajñānaṃ tathaivāvatiṣṭhata iti | agṛhītaikatvacandramātraviṣayamavatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ | tasyaiveti pāṭhe candramātrasyaiva grāhakatayā tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ | ekasāmagrībhūtayoścakṣuṣoḥ kathaṃ dvisāmagrītvamityatrāha  dvayoścakṣuṣoriti | svato nirdoṣasyendriyasya sadoṣatvaṃ hi kāryakalpyam | tathā sāmagrīdvitvamapīti bhāvaḥ | tarhi sadaiva candradvitvaṃ gṛhyetetyatrāha  apagate tviti | kathaṃ doṣāpagame aikyapratipattiriti śaṅkāyāṃ dvitvapratipatteraupādhikatvamāha  doṣakṛtamiti | grāhyākāradvitvamiti | svadeśaviśiṣṭatvameka ākāraḥ | agṛhītāntarālaṃ pradeśāntarameka ākāraḥ | tasyā''kāratvaṃ viśeṣaṇatvam | na cānākārasyā''kāratvenānyathākhyānam | agṛhītāntarālatve satyapradhānatayā bhātasyaiva viśeṣaṇatvāt | netravṛttirvittigatadvitvaṃ candraṃ cāgṛhītabhedaṃ gṛhyatīti prābhākārāḥ | yathā saṃvitsiddhau prābhākaramatopanyāse, "netravṛttirdvidhābhūtā dve tu vittī vitanvatī | dvitvaṃ candraṃ ca yugapat nirbhāsayati tatra naḥ" iti | deśagatadvitvaṃ candraṃ cāgṛhītabhedaṃ gṛhṇātīti tato'tra vaiṣamyam | cākṣuṣatejogatibhedarūpasāmagrīdvayajanyam atiśaighyrādagṛhītakramamagṛhītabhedaṃ ca jñānadvayam agṛhītaikatvaṃ candramagṛhītāntarālaṃ deśāntaraṃ ca nirantaraṃ gṛhṇāti | ato dvicandravyavahāra ityarthaḥ | iti niravadyaṃ yathārthakhyātisamarthanamityarthaḥ | khyātyantaradūṣaṇānāmanyonyam uktānāṃ svābhimatatvāt tatra yatnābhāvamāha  khyātīti |
athavā kimanenetyādipāṭho bahuṣu kośeṣu dṛśyate | vyākhyātṛbhirvyākhyākhyātaśca | tatra parāgarthaviṣayāparokṣabhrameṣvekenaivottareṇa parihāraḥ kṛto bhavati | kiṃ na setsyatītyanena pramāṇe'stitvamuktam | kiṃ nopapadyata ityanena upapattiruktā | kiṃ pramāṇam, kathamupapattirityatrāha  bhagavatāhīti | akhilaṃ jagat sṛjatetyanenāsyārthasya śrutimūlatvaṃ sūcitam; kṛtsnakāryakāraṇatvād brahmaṇaḥ | "idaṃ sarvamasṛjata" iti hi śrutiḥ | pratīyamānatvāviśeṣādidamapi tatsṛṣṭamityarthaḥ | tarhi bādhyabādhakabhāvavyavasthā kathamityatrāha  tatreti | na hi tattadekapuruṣānubhāvyānāṃ tattatkālāvasāyināñca sukhādīnāṃ mithyātvamiti bhāvaḥ ||
atha śrutiśrutyarthāpattibhyāmanivarcanīyasidiṃdha dūṣayituṃ prathamaṃ śrutivākyāni yojayati  yatpunariti | anṛtenetyādiśrutiṃ vyācaṣṭe  anṛteneti | pūrvanirastaprakāreṇānirvacanīyasyāprāmāṇikatvāt tatra vyutpattirnāstīti bhāvaḥ | anṛtaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe  ṛtetaraviṣayo hyanṛtaśabda iti | hiśabdena ṛtetaraviṣayatvasampratipattiḥ sūcitā | ṛtābhāvasya ṛtavirodhinaśca ṛtabhūtabrahmāśrayatvānupapattyā tadanya eva nañarthastvayāpi vaktavya iti bhāvaḥ | anṛtaśabdārthaṃ niṣkraṣṭuṃ ṛtaśabdārthamāha  ṛtamitīti | karmavācipuṇyakarmavācītyartaḥ; na tu satyavācīti bhāvaḥ | kuta ityatrāha ṛtaṃ pibantāviti | asmin vākye, "sukṛtasya loke" iti hyuktamiti bhāvaḥ | evaṃvidhavākyāntareṣu prasiddhiścābhipretā, "yathā vṛkṣasya saṃpuṣpitasya dūrādgandho vāti, evaṃ puṇyasya karmaṇo dūrādgandho vāti" ityuktavā, "evamanṛtādātmānaṃ jugupset" iti puṇyapratiyogini anṛtaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ | tasmāt ṛtaśabdaḥ puṇyavācī | puṇyamapi hi mokṣavirodhi; tat kathamanṛtaśabdoktapāpamātrapratyūḍhatvamiti śaṅkāyāṃ mokṣaprakaraṇoktaṃ puṇyaṃ vivinakti ṛtaṃ karmeti | mumukṣoḥ sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtamubhayaṃ hi virodhītyatantaddvayaṃ pāpam | ato nañsamāsāntargata ṛtaśabdo'nabhisaṃhitaphalakamarpara ityarthaḥ | paramapuruṣārādhanaveṣaṃ tatprāptiphalayityanena, "svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya sidiṃdha vindati mānavaḥ" ityetat sūcitam | anṛtaśabdasya brahmaprāptivirodhiparatve sati ṛtaśabdasya bandhaketarakarmavācitvasiddhiriti tadarthaṃ tatpūrvavākyenopapādayati  etamiti | ṛtānṛtaśabdayoḥ, "evamanṛtādātmānaṃ jugupset" ityādiṣu śrutiṣu puṇyapāpaparatvena prasiddhatvāt, "na sukṛtaṃ na duṣkṛtaṃ sarve pāpmāno'to nivarttante", "kṣīyante cāsya karmāṇi" ityādiṣu sukṛtaduṣkṛtayorapi mokṣavirodhitvaśravaṇāt mokṣaprakaraṇeṣu mumukṣoḥ saṃsārākhyāniṣṭaphalapradatvenobhayorapi pāpaśabdābhidheyatvāt asyānṛtaśabdasyāsmin vākya eva brahmaprāptivirodhitvaśravaṇāt "tasyāntaro maitreya" ityādiṣu puṇyapāpakarmaṇoḥ mokṣavirodhiphalatvaśravaṇāt, anṛtaśabdasyānirvacanīyavācitvena vyutpatyabhāvāccānṛtaśabdastadanyavyutpattyā mokṣavirodhikarmapara ityarthaḥ |
nāsadāsīdityādi | atra, "anādi matparaṃ brahma na sattannāsaducyate" iti brahmaśabdavācyaśuddhātmasvarūpaviṣayaḥ sadasacchabdaprayogaḥ prativandītvenānusandheyaḥ | sadasacchabdayościdacidyvaṣṭiviṣayatvamupapādayati  utpattīti | utpannasya hi pralayaḥ utpattiśca cidacidacidyvaṣṭayoḥ śrutisiddhā | atastayoratra pralaya ucyata ityarthaḥ | sattyacchabdābhyāṃ "sacca tyaccābhavat" iti vākyaṃ smāritam | kāryāvasthacetanasya sacchabdoktatvādiha sacchabdena, tadanyavācakenāsacchabdena ca kāryāvasthacetanācetananiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ; vākyāntaraikārthyādityarthaḥ | "tama āsīt tamasā gūḍham" iti tadanantaravākyābhiprāyeṇācitsamaṣṭibhūte tamaśśabdābhidheye vastunītyuktam | hetvantaraṃ cāha  sadasatoriti | na hi kālaviśeṣe anirvacanīyamabhyupagamyate | acitsamaṣṭestamaḥśabdavācyatvamupapādayati atreti | "tama āsīt", "māyāṃ tu prakṛtim" ityanayorvākyayoḥ pūrvaṃ krameṇopādānavivakṣāṃ codyarūpeṇa darśayati  satyamiti | prakṛtiśabdavācyā māyetyabhiprāyaḥ | pariharati  naitadevamiti | kuta ityatrāha  māyeti | itirhetau | māyāśabdavācyā prakṛtirityabhiprāyaḥ | aindrajālikādiṣu māyāvitvaprayogadarśanāt māyāmithyāśabdayoḥ paryāyatvāt anirvācyasya ca mithyātvācca māyāśabdavācyatvamityabhiprāyeṇa śaṅkate māyeti | pariharati  tadapi nāstīti | māyāśabdasya mithyāparyāyatvameva nāsti | tathā'bhyupagame'pi anyathākhyātibhedāgrahayoranyatareṇaivopapannatvāt na tadviṣayatvaṃ yuktamityanirvacanīyavācitvaṃ nāstīti bhāvaḥ | tadupapādayati  nahīti | māyāśabdaprayogaviṣayeṣu sarveṣu mithyātvānanuvṛtterityarthaḥ | satyeṣu māyāśabdaprayogaṃ darśayati  yathoktamiti | na hi jñānabādhyānāmekaikaśaḥ śastracchedyatvamasti | tasmādekaikaśo māyānāṃ chedyatvavacanānmāyāśabdasya satyaparatvamiti | anuyāyina eva pravṛttinimittatvāt māyāśabdaprayogaviṣayeṣu sarveṣvanugatamāścaryatvameva māyāśabdapravṛttinimittamityāha  ata iti | āścaryatvam vismayanīyatvam | tacca vicitrārthasargakaratvāt | vicitraśabdo nānāvidhavācī | nānāvidhakāryakaratvāt prakṛtervismamayanītvam | māyāśabdo hyāścaryavācīti vakṣyate | tasmādārścayatvameva pravṛttinimittam | asatyeṣu satyeṣvapi māyāśabdaprayogaviṣayeṣvārścayatvaṃ vidyate | prakṛterārścayatvameva māyāśabdābhidheyatvanibandhanamityāha  prakṛteriti | tadupapādayati  asmāditi | vicitrakāryakaratvāt prakṛterāścaryarūpatvamiti na māyāmātrasūtraviṣayabhāṣyavirodhaḥ | evaṃ māyāśabdārtha uktaḥ | atha bhagavato māyāsaṃbandhaśravaṇāt tadvaśyatvaśaṅkāvyudāsāya māyītipadagatamatvarthīyapratyayārthamāha  paramapuruṣasya ceti | māyītipadokto māyāsaṃbandho na tattirobhāvyatvam; api tu taccheṣitvam | jīvasyaiva tu tattirodheyatvam, tasyaiva tathātvaśravaṇādityarthaḥ | māyābhibhavo jīvasyaivetyetasminnarthe paroktameva vacanamāha  anādīti | "indro māyābhiḥ" ityatra anekavicitraśaktayabhidhāyitvaṃ bahuvacanādavagamyate | mameti | spaṣṭam | nigamayati itīti | māyāśabdasya mithyābhūtaviṣayeṣu prayogo dṛśyate cet, tatra lākṣaṇikaḥ syāt; arthasya satyatvābhāvena tasyāścayatvābhāvāt | pratibhāsastu dvitvādiviṣayatvādāścaryarūpaḥ, mantrauṣadhādiścāścaryarūpa iti tatsaṃbandhāllākṣaṇikatvam |
atha śrutyarthāpattyā anirvacanīyasidiṃdha dūṣayati  nāpīti | pratijñātamupapādayati  nahīti | ajñānāparikalpane anupapattirnāsti; tatkalpana evānupapattiḥ, viruddhadharmaśravaṇādityabhiprāyeṇa tacchabdāvagataviśeṣaṇāni uktāni | samānavibhaktiśrutisiddhatayā hyaikyāparityāgaḥ, tathā śrutahānasyānyāyyatvāt tacchabdāvagataviśeṣāḥ svīkāryā iti bhāvaḥ | aikyopadeśānupapattiriti cettatrāha aikyeti | jīvaparayorheyasaṃbandhatadanarhatvābhyāṃ hyaikyavirodhaḥ | jīvaśarīrakasya paramātmana aikyābhidhāne jīvavāciśabdena taccharīrakaparabrahmābhidhānamamukhyamiti cettatrāha  aneneti | śrutyarthāpattyasidiṃdha nigamayati  ata iti | itihāsapurāṇayorbrahmājñānaparatvābhāvaṃ pratijānīte itihāseti |
nanvityādi | brahmaikameva tattvamiti pratijñāyeti | jaḍājaḍayoḥ svarūpaikyāyogena sāmānādhikaraṇyasya bādhārthatvāt uttaraślokeṣu tadvayatiriktasya mithyātvakathanāccetyabhiprāyaḥ | vijñānavijṛmbhitāni | vividhaṃ jñāyate yena, viparītaṃ jñāyate yeneti vā karaṇe vyutpattiḥ | vijñānamavidyā | yadā tu śuddhamityādinā tasya hi vyatireko vakṣyate | vijñāne (vijñānena) vijṛmbhitānīti yojanā tvayuktā; asvārasyāt | vijaambhitānīti puṃsakasya (napuṃsakāntapadasya) pum̐lliṅgabhedaśabdaviśeṣaṇatvāyogena vijṛmbhitaśabdasya bhāvārthapratyayāntatvasya yuktatvena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasya yuktatvācca | brahmavyatiriktasyāvidyāparikalpitatvaṃ vyatirekamukhena sthirīkarotītyāha  yadā tviti | śuddhamavidyārahitam | nijarūpi  tatkṛtabhedadarśanarahitam | apāstadoṣamrāgādidoṣarahitam | saṅkalpataroḥ | samantātkalpyate'neneti saṅkalpaḥ doṣaḥ | vastuṣu vastubhedā ityatra vastuṣviti bahuvacane na tātparyam | jaḍopalakṣite vastuni jaḍagatabhedā na saṃbhavantītyarthaḥ | yadvā eko vastuśabda ākāraparaḥ, | jaḍagatākāra(rūpa?)bhedā na bhavantītyarthaḥ | vastvasti kim, mahīghaṭatvamiti ślokadvaye prathamenārthasvabhāva uktaḥ, dvitīyenodāharaṇaṃ darśitamiti bhidā | tatra kuto hi tattvamevaṃ sati kutaḥ paramārtha ityarthaḥ | kṛtsnamaparamāthartvenopalabdhaṃ cet, kathaṃ tatra prāmāṇyamiti śaṅkāyāmucyate  svakarmastimitātmaniścayairiti | tattvārthaniścayavirodhikarmavaśādityarthaḥ | yadvā na kevalamātmavidbhirevāsatyatvamupalabhyate, api tvajairapīti bhāvaḥ | na kevalaṃ śāstrapramāṇena, laukikajaḍagrāhipramāṇenāpi tasya mithyātvaṃ sidhyatītyuktaṃ bhavati | tasmānna vijñānamṛte iti ślokārdhamanātmabhūtavijātīyabhedaniṣedhamupasaṃharatītyāha  tasmāditi | vijñānamekamityardhaṃ sajātīyarūpātmabhedaniṣedhaparam | bhedadarśananimittājñānamūlaṃ nijakarmaivetīti | bhedadarśanamsajātīyabhedadarśanam | tat uttarottarabhāvikāryājñānahetuḥ; tasyāpi pūrvakarmaivetyarthaḥ | yo devādiśarīrabhedahetuḥ, sa evetyevakārābhiprāyaḥ | yadvā devādiśarīrabhedapratītihetukājñānamātmani devatvādyākārāropaṇarūpam; tasya hetuḥ karmaivetyarthaḥ | anātmani ātmabuddherapyajñānaśabdavācyatvaṃ yuktam; tasyā api mūlājñānakāryatvāt; "śrūyatāṃ cāpyavidyāyāḥ svarūpaṃ kulanandana | anātmanyātmabuddhiryā" iti tasyā ajñānaparyāyāvidyāśabdavācyatvācca | jñānaṃ viśuddhamiti svagatabhedaniṣedhaḥ | viśuddhaṃvimalamitiavidyātatkṛtabhedadarśanarahitamityarthaḥ | tatkṛtaśokādirahitamityāha viśokamiti | ekaṃ sadaikamiti sajātīyavijātīyabhedavirahānuvādaḥ | yadvā ekamiti sajātīyavijātīyabhedaniṣedhānuvādaḥ, sadaikamiti uktaprakāreṇa svagatabhedarāhityamucyate | paramapareśādiśabdavācyaṃ cinmātramevetyāha  parama iti | nedaṃ paramatam, tattvamevoktamityāha  sadbhāva iti | saṃvyavavahārabhūtamsamantādyvavahārārhabhedam | bhuvanāśritam bhuvanenādhiṣṭhānatayā śritamevaitadvarttate (iti yat?) tatrāpi heturajñānamevoktamityarthaḥ | yadvā bhuvanāśritambhuvanamāśritam, saṃvyavahārabhūtamvyāvahārikam, etatlokasiddhaṃ satyatvaṃ yat, tatrāpi kāraṇamavidyetyuktamityarthaḥ | etadabhiprāyeṇa hi tasya bhuvanādeḥ satyatvaṃ vyāvahārikamitītyuktam | iti hyupadeśo dṛśyata iti | tasmāditihāsapurāṇayorbrahmājñānavādo na dṛśyata iti vaktuṃ na śakyamityarthaḥ |
etat pratikṣipati naitadevamityādinā | naitatcinmātrabrahmaṇo'vidyāsaṃbandhitvamavidyākalpitatvena prapañcasya mithyātvaṃ ca yaduktam, na tat prāmāṇikamityarthaḥ | tathāsati arthavirodhāt prakaraṇavirodhāt śāstratātparyavirodhāt aśeṣamūrtirbhagavānityādipadānāṃ lākṣaṇikatvāt prapañcadharmigrāhakapramāṇavirodhāt śruteḥ saviśeṣavastuparatvopapādanena smṛtestadviruddhārthaparatvāpātāt pūrvoktatarkavirodhācca tadabhāvaḥ | atrārthavirodho nāmasarvajñatvādiguṇasyājñānādiprasaktivirodhaḥ, avidyāyā āśrayatirodhānādyanupapattiśca | prapañcasya vistareṇa pratipādanavaiyarthyaṃ prakaraṇavirodhaḥ | anyattu spaṣṭam | daśaślokyāmastināstisatyāsatyajñānājñānādiśabdā ātmānātmaviṣayā iti nātra vigānam | tatra nāstyasatyaśabdayoḥ kiṃ jñānabādhyatvaṃ pravṛttinimittam, uta pariṇāmitvamiti vicāropariṇāmitvapakṣe svārasyamasti; mahī ghaṭatvamityupapādanāt | ajñānaśabdasya ca nānirvacanīyaparatvam; api tu karmaparatvameva; yajñaḥ paśurityādisvārasyāt | anyatra, "śarīrākṛtibhedāstu bhūpaite karmayonayaḥ", "avidyākamarsaṃjñā'nyā", "bāhyakarmavṛttiprajñaḥ" ityādivacanācca |
cidacidviveko'tra kriyata ityabhipretya tadanuguṇasaṅgatimāha  atreti | atraasmin dvitīyāṃśe | vistīrṇamiti svarūpaviśeṣaṇam | vistīrṇaśabdena sthaulyaṃ vivakṣitam | saṃsṛṣṭasthūlarūpamuktavā viyuktaṃ sūkṣmarūpamucyata iti bhāvaḥ | yadvā vistīrṇamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam | uttaratra mithyātvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ cetpūrvaṃ vistareṇa kathamanupapannam | na hi, pūrvameva bhrāntasya bhramāntarāpādanaṃ kāryam | tasmāt pūrvaṃ vistareṇa bhuvanakośasya kathitatvānna mithyātvaṃ vakṣyata iti bhāvaḥ | vakṣyamāṇamādibharatacaritaṃ hṛtsthaṃ vistararūpam | tatsaṅkṣepaścāyam | vakṣyamāṇasaṅkṣepa uktasaṃkṣepaśca dṛśyate; ata uktasaṃkṣepaśaṅkāvyāvṛttyarthamāha  anuktamiti | anuktaṃ saṃsṛṣṭarūpāntaraṃ kathyata iti śaṅkāvyāvṛttyarthamāha  rūpāntaramiti | viyuktamityarthaḥ | mithyātvavyatirekeṇa vaktavyaṃ (rūpāntaraṃ) sakalamuktam | tasmādanuktaṃ vaktavyaṃ rūpāntaraṃ nāma mithyātvam, nānyaditi śaṅkāyām, mithyātvaṃ vinā'nuktaṃ rūpāntaramāha  cidacinmiśra iti | cidacinmiśre jagatītyanena, saṅkṣepaḥ śrūyatāṃ punarityatra punaḥśabdo vyākhyāto bhavati | cidacidātmake jagati sthūlarūpa(tva)muktam; tatraiva jagatīdamapi rūpāntaraṃ punarucyata iti tasyārthaḥ | "sattāmātramagocaram | vacasāmātmasaṃvedyam" ityādivākyoktaṃ viśeṣaṇamāha  cidaṃśo vāṅmanaseti | "dvaitino'tathyadarśinaḥ" ityādivākyānāṃ bhedaniṣedhaparāṇāmarthaṃ hṛdi nidhāyāha  aspṛṣṭeti | yadi cidaṃśasya jñānaikākāratvamacidaṃśasya pariṇāmāspadatvaṃ ca vivakṣitam, tarhyastināsti satyāsatyādiśabdapravṛttinimittatvena kimarthamucyata iti cetucyate | śākhāviśeṣeṣu "sacca tyaccābhavat", "vijñānaṃ cāvijñānaṃ ca", "satyaṃ cānṛtaṃ ca satyamabhavat" ityādivākyeṣu astināstisatyāsatyādiśabdānāṃ śrūyamāṇānām anadhītaśākhāgatānāṃ ca kiṃ jñānabādhyatvābādhyatve pravṛttinimittabhūte; uta pariṇāmitvāpariṇāmitve iti śaṅkāṃ nirākartum "pariṇāmitvāpariṇāmitve eva nāstyasatyādiśabdārthaḥ, na tu jñānabādhyatvābādhyatve" ityadhītānadhītaśākhārthajñāpanārthamiti | pṛthivyāditattvānāṃ saṅghātaviśeṣāvasthāyāmeva jīvaṃ prati śarīratvaṃ dṛṣṭam; na tvaikaikasya | manuṣyādiśarīrāṇāmapi tādṛśapiṇḍāvasthāyāmeva śarīratvaṃ dṛṣṭam; na bhasmādyavasthāyāmiti cidacitoḥ pratyekamavasthāviśeṣeṣu bhagavaccharīratvābhāvaśaṅkāvyāvṛttyarthamāha  ubhayamiti | cidacidrūpamanyonyasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ niṣkṛṣṭaṃ ca bhagavaccharīramityarthaḥ | niṣkṛṣṭasya bhagavaccharīratvapratipādanāt bhagavantaṃ prati śarīratvasya nirupādhikatayā svarūpaprayuktatvaṃ phalitamiti muktāvasthāyāmapi jīvasya bhagavaccharīratvasiddhiḥ | etadrūpamayamākāra ityarthaḥ | etadupapādayati tathāhītyādinā daśaślokyāṃ na bhagavadātmakatvamasādhāraṇaṃ pratipādyam | tattu sarvaprakaraṇasādhāraṇam | asādhāraṇapratipādyaṃ tu prakṛtipuruṣaviveka eva | śāstrasyopaniṣadarthopabṛṃhaṇaparatvāt sāṅkhayādimatavyāvṛttyarthaṃ savarprakaraṇeṣu bhagavadātmakatvamucyate | atrāsādhāraṇapratipādyaḥ prakṛtipuruṣaviveka evetyabhiprāyeṇa hi pūrvamanuktaṃ rūpāntaramityuktam | bhagavadātmakatvasya sarvaprakaraṇasādhāraṇyaṃ hi, pūrvamapakayetadasakṛduktamiti uttaratra ca vakṣyate | daśaślokīsthasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ śarīrātmabhāvanibandhanamiti jñāpayituṃ pūrvaślokamupādatte  yadambviti | ṛṣiṇā'bhipretaṃ phalitamarthamāha ambuno viṣṇoriti | na hi bālyāvasthāyāṃ śarīrabhūtasya vastuno'vasthāntare cetanena svarūpaikyamasti, api tu sarvāvasthamapi tadvastu śarīrameveti bhāvaḥ | tasya ca viṣṇurātmetīti | abhipretyetyarthaḥ | evaṃrūpaśarīrātmabhāva iti vārthaḥ | sakalaśrutigatatādātmyopadeśopabṛṃhaṇarūpasyeti | anadhītaśākhāsvapi tādātmyopadeśo'sti, tasyāyamevārtha iti jñāpanaṃ tādātmyopadeśasyopabṛṃhaṇam | yadvā pratyakṣasakalaśrutigatatādātmyopadeśopabṛṃhaṇaṃ nāma anadhītaśākhāsu tadviruddhārthapratipādanaṃ nāstīti jñāpanam | atra itiśabdatrayasya anena ślokena bhagavānimamarthamabhipretyāyamartha ityāhetyanvayaprakāraḥ | nakevalamatra samaṣṭisṛṣṭiślokagatavyadhikaraṇanirdeśena vyaṣṭiślokagatasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ śarīraśarīribhāvanibandhanamiti vijñāyate, api tu pradeśāntareṣu vyaṣṭayavasthānāṃ bhagavantaṃ prati śarīratvaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyasya śarīraśarīribhāvanibandhanatvaṃ cāsakṛt kaṇṭhoktamityāha  asminniti | śarīrātmabhāvasya sāmānādhikaraṇyahetutvaṃ kaṇṭhoktam viśvarūpo yato'vyayaḥ iti | tathā anyatrāpi, "sarvagatvādanantasya sa evāham", "sarvaṃ samāpnoṣi tato'si sarvaḥ" ityādi draṣṭavyam | tadidamityādinā jyotīṃvītyādiśloke pādatrayasyārtha ucyate | saṃsṛṣṭasya bhagavadātmakatvamuktamityarthaḥ | pradhānādiviśeṣāntaṃ cetanācetanātmakamityuktatvāt jyotirityādiśabdāḥ saṃsṛṣṭajīvavācinaḥ | atha uttaraślokasaṅgatyarthaṃ viśiṣṭavākyārthānuvādena caturthapādārthaṃ darśayati  atrāstyātmakamiti | yadambu ityādiślokena vaiyadhikaraṇyena samaṣṭayavasthacidacitorbhagavadātmakatvamuktam | vyaṣṭayavasthayorasaṃsṛṣṭayoḥ saṃsṛṣṭayorapi (sthayoḥ saṃsṛṣṭayoḥ, asaṃsṛṣṭayorapi ?) tayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena bhagavadātmakatvamucyate jyotīṃṣītyādinā ślokena | tatra pādatrayeṇa vyaṣṭayavasthayoḥ saṃsṛṣṭayosatadātmakatvamuktam; caturthapādena tu niṣkṛṣṭayorapi tadātmapatvamuktamityarthaḥ | anantaraślokamavatārayati idamiti | acidaṃśasya nāstyātmakatvanibandhanameva tātparyaviṣayaḥ | acidaṃśasya hi mithyātvaśaṅkā vyudasanīyā | atastasya pariṇāmitvāt nāstyātmakatva eva tātparyam | cidaṃśasya tvapariṇāmitvādastyātmakatvaṃ phalitaṃ syādityabhiprāyeṇa asya ca nāstyātmakatve heturayamityāhetyuktam | vyākhyeye pratīkamupādatte jñānasvarūpa iti | atra jñānasvarūpo bhagavāniti sāmānādhikaraṇyasya śarīraśarīribhāvanibandhanatvaṃ na kevalaṃ pūrvaśloke "yadambuvaiṣṇavaḥ kāyaḥ" ityuktatvādavagamyate, asminnapi śloke aśeṣamūrtirityanenāpi jñāyata ityabhiprāyeṇa vyācaṣṭeaśeṣeti | aśeṣaśabdenācito'pi vivakṣitatve bhagavantaṃ prati tasya mūrtitvaṃ vihitaṃ syāt, aprāptatvāt | tataśca " na tu vastubhūta" iti devamanuṣyaśailābdhidharādivastubhāvaniṣedho'nupapannaḥ | ato'śeṣaśabdaḥ kṣetrajñaviṣaya ityabhiprāyeṇāśeṣakṣetrajñātmanetyuktam | atra jñānasvarūpādiśabdānāṃ paramaviśeṣyaparyantābhidhāyitve'pi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣaṇe vākyasya tātkaryam | ato jñānasvarūpatvaṃ viśeṣaṇabhūtajīvasyaiva vidhīyate | yathā "lohitoṣṇīṣā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti" ityatra viśeṣaṇagataṃ lauhityameva vidheyaṃ paramparāyā ṛtvikpracārakarmaviśeṣaṇamtadvat | "kāṭhinyavān yo bibharti", "nṛsiṃhamūrtirbhagavān śvetaḥ" ityādyudāharaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam | jñānasvarūpa ityatra divyātmasvarūpasya jñānasvarūpatvamucyata iti na śaṅkanīyam; "sarvakarmakṣaye jñānamapāstadoṣam" iti vivaraṇānupapatteḥ | na hi divyātmasvarūpasya karmatatkṛtarāgadveṣādiheyasaṃbandhaprasaṅgaḥ | na tu vastubhūta ityasyārthamāha na devamanuṣyādīti | śailādisthāvaroktiḥ sarvaśarīrāṇāmupalakṣaṇamiti jñāpanārtho devamanuṣyādiśabdaḥ | uttarārddhaṃ vyācaṣṭe  yata evamiti | śailābdhidharādibhedāt vijñānavijṛmbhitāni jānīhītyanena phalitaṃ hetuhetumadbhāvaṃ vivṛṇoti tadvijñānetyādinā | vijñānaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭetasyeti | vijñānamvividhajñānam | kathaṃ śailābdhidharādibhedasya vaividhyānusandhānamūlatvam; "nijakarmabhedabhinnabhittaiḥ" "sarvakarmakṣaye" iti kamarmūlatvena vakṣyamāṇatvāt karmaiva hi mūlamityatrāha  devādīti | vahavidhyānusandhānasya devādibhedahetutvaṃ sadvārakam; uparitanagranthaikārthyāt; "avidyāsañcitaṃ karma" "bāhyakarmavṛttiprajaḥ", "bhūpaite karmayonayaḥ" ityādivacanāntarāccetyarthaḥ | pūrvam idamastyātmakamityādinoktaślokavākyārthaḥ kathaṃ ghaṭata ityatrāha  yataśceti | jñānasvarūpaḥ, vijñānavijṛmbhitānītyanena tathā phalitamityarthaḥ | tadeveti | pūrvapakṣayojanāyāmukteṣvartheṣvapekṣitāṃśopajīvanena siddhāntayojanā kriyate | vijñānavijṛmbhitatvameva vyatirekamukhena vivṛṇotītyarthaḥ | pūrvaśloke devādibhedānāṃ svātmavaividhyānusandhānamūlatvaṃ sadvārakamiti vyākhyānamanantaraśloke vyatirekamukhena vivaraṇe karmahetutvaśravaṇanibandhanamiti spaṣṭayannāha  devādyākāreṇeti | nirdoṣamityādipadānāmarthavibhāgaḥ "jñānaṃ viśuddha"mityādiślokavyākhyāne viśadayiṣyata iti granthalāghavārthamatra na vistṛtaḥ | nirdoṣam śarīrasambandharahitam | pariśuddham tatkṛtarāgadveṣasukhaduḥkhādirahitam | nijarūpi āvirbhūtasvarūpam | saṅkalpaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe  ekīkṛtyātmakalpanāśabdena | "samityekīkāre" iti hi śābdāḥ | pūrvavat sadvārakamiti vyācaṣṭe ātmakalpanāmūlakarmaphalabhūtā iti | dehātmanorekīkṛtyānusandhānaphalaṃ devādyākāreṇa svātmavaividhyānusandhānam | tayoraikaikaṃ vijñānaśabde saṅkalpaśabde'pyarthasiddham | sukhaduḥkhe hi karmaphalam | tat kathaṃ vastubhedasya kamarphalatvamiti śaṅkāyāṃ tadbhogārthā ityuktam | sukhādibhogadvārabhūtatvāt devādibhedāḥ karmaphalamityarthaḥ | "bhoktā bhogyaṃ preritāraṃ ca matvā" ityādiṣu bhogyaśabdārthaḥ spaṣṭīkṛto bhavati tadbhogārthā ityanena | bhogāsthānabhogopakaraṇānāṃ bhogasiddhiprayojakatvameva bhogyatvamityarthaḥ | saptamyantavastuśabdo jīvaparyantadehaparaḥ; dvitīyavastuśabdo devādiśarīramātraparaḥ | vastubhedāḥdevādiśarīrabhedāḥ | atra vastubhedaśabdena bhedasya vasturūpatvāt pāramārthyamapi phalitam | atrānviteṣu padeṣu vyākhyeyapadavyākhyānārthamāha ye devādiṣviti | devādiṣu vastuṣu ātmatayā'bhimateṣu | prathamavastuśabdo jīvaparyantadehapara evetyabhiprāyaḥ | saṃsṛṣṭākāre hyātmābhimānaḥ | tadbhogārthā iti pūrvoktasya padasya vyākhyeyaṃ padamudāharati  bhogyabhūtā iti | bhogyabhūtā ityanena vastubhedā iti padasyācidaṃśamātraparatvamuktam; na tu vastubheda ityuktatvāt | pūrvaślokoktabhedā evātra vivakṣitā ityāha  devamanuṣyeti | kāraṇābhāvātkāryābhāvo hi vyatirekaḥ; taṃ spaṣṭayati tanmūlabhūteti | paramaprakṛtārthasya phalitatvamāha ityacidvastuna iti | pūrvaślokaphalitārthakathane ātmano'stiśabdavācyatve heturanuktaḥ; atra tu tasyāpi phalitatvamāha itarasyeti |
jagadupalabdhiprakāreṇāpi vastubhedānāṃ pariṇāmitvamupapādyate ślokadvayena | tatra prathamasya vākyārthamāha  pratikṣaṇamiti | ślokasya nāstiśabdābhidheyatāparatvaṃ yadasti yannāstītyupakramāvagatam | asmin śloke prayojakaśikṣā | vastvasti kimityarthayojananaupayikatayā'trābhidheyaṃ yadasti yannāstītyupakramavaśātsiddhamarthamāha  astiśabdeti | satataikarūpatayā astiśabdavācyatve sati hi pūrvārddhoktasya tadabhāvasya nāstiśabdābhidheyatāhetutvasiddhiḥ | pūrvārdhaṃ vyācaṣṭe  acidvastviti | kimanena nāstiśabdābhidheyatvasyeti śaṅkāyāmuttarārddhamavatārayati tataḥ kimityatrāheti | yātīti vartamānanirdeśasyābhiprāyamāha  pratikṣaṇamiti | bhṛyo na tattathetyasyātharmāha taditi | uttarottarāvasthāprāptyeti bhūyaḥśabdārthaḥ | na tattathetyasyārthamāha  pūrvapūrvāvasthāṃ jahātīti | tatretyasyārthamāha  pūrvāvasthasyottarāvasthāyāmiti | kutastattvamityasyārthamāha  na pratisandhānamiti | tattavamtasya bhāvaḥ | tadidamiti pratisandhānānarhatvaṃ phalitamityarthaḥ | nanu tattvaṃ kutaḥpūrvāvasthatvaṃ kuta ityuktam | kathaṃ pratisandhānaniṣedhaḥ | ucyate | kutaḥ śabdaḥ pramāṇapratikṣepaparaḥ | parvato'gnimānityukte kuta iti pramāṇākāṅkṣā hi dyotyate | ataḥ pratikṣepaparaḥ kutaśśabdo'pi pramāṇapratikṣepaparaḥ | kutaḥ pramāṇādityarthaḥ | pūrvāvasthasya bhūyastathātve pramāṇaṃ ca pratyabhijñā | ataḥ pramāṇe pratikṣipte pratisaṃdhānaṃ niṣiddhaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | anyathā na tattathetyanena paunaruktayaṃ syāt | hiśabdena phalitamarthamāha ata iti |
nāstiśabdavācyatve prayojakaśikṣā kṛtā | śikṣitamatharmudāharaṇena darśayatyanantaraśloka ityabhiprāyeṇāha  tathā hīti | mahī ghaṭatvamiti ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe  svakarmaṇetyādinā | mahīghaṭatvamityatra yātīti pūrvaślokādanuṣaṅgaḥ | karmaṇa ātmaniścayavirodhitvaṃ sadvārakamityāha  devamanuṣyādibhāveneti | devādidehasaṃsargeṇetyarthaḥ | stimitampratibaddham | asthire bhogyatvabuddhiḥ sthiratarasukharūpātmaniścayastaimityāditi bhāvaḥ | yadvā ātmajñānarahitairapyacidvastuno'sthiratvamālakṣyata ityāha  tathāhīti | ālakṣyata iti cākṣaṣajñāne prayogaprācuryāt tadyvāvṛttyarthamanubhūyata ityuktam | ślokavyākhyāna parisamāptiṃ dyotayati ityartha iti | brūhītyāderarthamāha  evaṃ satīti | anena atredipadaṃ vyākhyātam | acidvastvitipadena ślokasthavastuśabdo vyākhyātaḥ | astiśabdārhamityādittiśeṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyasiddhatayoktam | athavā (?) ślokadvābhiprāyamāha  evaṃ satīti | na tu vastubhūtaḥ iti purāṇagranthe, kimapakayacidvastu, acidvastu kiñciditi bhāṣye ca acidviṣaya (ye?) vastuśabdaprayogāt "tadvastu nṛpa tacca kim" iti granthasthavastuśabdatulyatvaṃ na śaṅkanīyam | asti kimityanena ślokasthasyāstiśabdasya bhavatyarthatvamuktam | ata eva yadastītyastiśabdavat nātmasvarūpaparatvaṃ śaṅkanīyam | phalitamāha  na hīti | evaṃ asti kiṃ na hyastiiti bhāṣyasvārasyena ślokadvopakramagatasya asti kimiti vākyasya pratyabhijñānasya bhavatyarthatayā vyākhyātatvaṃ pratīyate | yadvā astiśabdābhidheye ityanena vastvasti kimityatrāstiśabdo vyākhyātaḥ | "yadasti" "tasmānna vijñānamṛte'sti" ityādinaikarūpyāt | vastvasti kim, mahī ghaṭatvamiti ślokadvayasya pratyekamukto vākyārthaḥ pūrvapakṣayojanāyāmupajīvyaḥ | uttaraślokasya prathamārdhaṃ vyācaṣṭe  yasmāditi | yasmādevaṃ tasmāt pariṇāmitvādeva, na tu jñānabādhyatvādityarthaḥ | acidvastuśabdena vastujātaśabdārtha uktaḥ | jātaśabdaśirasko vastuśabdo na nityavācīti bhāvaḥ | kevalāstiśabdavācyamiti | etacchlokasthāstiśabdo na bhavatyarthaḥ; jñānavyatiriktasya tadetadakṣayaṃ nityam ityādinā nityatvenoktasya niṣedhyatvāyogāt, yadastītyupakrāntasyopasaṃsāraucityācceti bhāvaḥ | prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsābhāvavato'cidvastuno nāstiśabdābhidheyatvamavacchinnāstiśabdavācyatvaṃ ceti tadyvāvṛttyartha kevalaśabdaḥ |
evamātmavyatiriktavastuno nāstiśabdābhidheyatvamupasaṃhṛtam | vijñānamityādi vyācaṣṭe  ātmā tviti | tuśabdo'cidvaiṣamyaparaḥ | sarvatrasarvaśarīreṣu | ekaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe  jñānaikākāratayeti | "eko vrīhissuniṣpannassuṣuṣṭaṃ kurute prajāḥ" itivat ayamekaśabda ākāraikyaparaḥ | sa cākāro vijñānaśabdoktaṃ jñānatvamityabhiprāyeṇoktaṃ jñānaikākāratayeti | bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ; jñānatvaikākāratayetyarthaḥ | svarūpato rdhamataścāviśeṣeṇa jñānatvaṃ sadvārakamadvārakaṃ cā''kāro hi bhavati | jñānaikākāratayetyatra ekaśabdena saṅkocavikāsaduḥkharūpatvādivyudāsaśca | devādibhedapratyanīkasvarūpo'pīti ekasvarūpatvādbhedapratyanīkatvam | nijarmādipadaṃ vyācaṣṭe devādīti | bhedaśabdārthamāha vividheti | buddhiśabdena cittaśabdārtha uktaḥ | buddherbhedaśca ātmanyāropyamāṇadevādyākārarūpaviṣayabhedāt | bahudhā  devatvādibahuprakāraviśiṣṭatayā'bhyupetamityarthaḥ | bahudhāśabdasyākāraikyaparatvaṃ spaṣṭam | phalitamarthamāha  nātmasvarūpaprayuktamiti | aupādhikamityarthaḥ | upādhivimokṣe kīdṛśaṃ svarūpamityatra anantaraślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe  ātmeti | viśuddhapadaṃ vyācaṣṭe  karmarahitamiti | vimalapadaṃ vyācaṣṭe  tata eveti | vimalapadavyākhyānamiti spaṣṭīkartuṃ malarūpaśabdaḥ | malarūpaprakṛtisparśarahitamityanena, "sarvakamakṣaye jñānamapāstadoṣam" ityasyārtho'vagataḥ; karmakṣayavācipadānantarapadasya śarīrasaṃbandharahitaparatvena vyākhyātatvāt | tathā ca śrutiḥ, "aśva iva romāṇi vidhūya pāpaṃ candra iva rāhormukhāt pramucya | dhūtvā śarīramakṛtaṃ kṛtātmā brahmalokamabhisambhavāmi" iti | atra hi pāpaṃ vidhūyetyuktavā, dhūtvā śarīramityuktam | uparitanapadāni vyācaṣṭe  tataśceti | tata evetyarthaḥ | hetornairapekṣyasūcakaścaśabdaḥ | nirastāśeṣalobhādisaṅgamityarthaḥ | ekamiti padaṃ vyācaṣṭe  upacayāpacayānarhatayaikamiti | upacayāpacayau  vṛddhikṣayau; tadarhatvam sāvayavatvam; sāvayavatvābhāvādeva ekaśabdavācyatvam | niravayavatvamekatvamityarthaḥ | tata eva sadaikarūpamiti | niravayavatvātsāvayavatvaprayuktavṛddhikṣayarahitamityarthaḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vyācaṣṭe  tacceti | "yadambu vaiṣṇavaḥ kāyaḥ", "aśeṣamūrtiḥ" ityuktatvādayamevārthaḥ | na yato'nyastītyetadyvācaṣṭe  ataditi | yataḥ yasmādvāsudevāt | anyat svaparyavasitaṃ vastu, nāstītyarthaḥ | yadvā vāsudevāditi padamadhyāhṛtya yojanā; vāsudevādanyannāstīti yataḥ, tata ityarthaḥ | asyāṃ yojanāyāṃ tacchabdaḥ prasiddhaparāmarśī | ato'pi pūrvayojanā sādhīyasī; tadvṛttasya yadvṛttapratinirdeśarūpatvasvārasyāt; pañcamyantādhyāhārānapekṣatvācca | jñānasvarūpaḥ, yadvā tviti ślokau cidacitsādhāraṇau, vastvastītyādisārdhaślokadvayamacidasādhāraṇam, vijñānamityādisārdhaślokaścidasādhāraṇa iti vibhāgaḥ | na paramatamuktam, tattvamevoktamityabhiprāyeṇa sadbhāva ityādyardhamuktam | tatra yathāśabdārthamāha  cidaṃśa iti | yathāyena prakāreṇa | pariṇāmitvāpariṇāmitvarūpeṇa; na jñānabādhyatvābādhyatvarūpeṇetyarthaḥ | evaṃrūpeti | śarīraśarīribhāvarūpeṇa yena prakāreṇa bhagavadātmakatvam; na tu svarūpaikyenetyarthaḥ | śloke yathāśabdapratiyogī evaṃśabdaḥ | satyaṃ jñānamasatyamanyacca yathā avasthitam, evaṃ sadbhāva ukta ityanvayo'bhipretaḥ | ataḥ satyāsatyaśabdavācyatvanirvāhakāpariṇāmitvapariṇāmitve bhagavadātmakatvañca yathāśabdavivakṣitaṃ bhavati | anyadupakrāntam, anyadupasaṃhṛtaṃ bhavati; astināstiśabdenopakramya satyāsatyaśabdenopasaṃhārādityatrāha  atreti | upakramopasaṃhārayoḥ śabdāntaranirdeśasyāyamabhiprāyaḥanyeṣvapi śabdeṣu kvacidevaṃ śruteṣu teṣāmapi pravṛttinimittamidameveti | uttarārddhasyārthamabhipretyāha  etaditi | pratyastamitabhedam, agocaraṃ vacasāmityanayorarthamabhipretyāha  jñānaikākāratayā samam aśabdagocarasvarūpabhedamiti | evakāreṇa virodhaḥ, sūcitaḥ | bhuvanāśritatvasya ghaṭakaṃ padamāha  acinmiśramiti | bhuvanāśritamaṇḍāntargatam, bhogasthānagatamityarthaḥ | saṃvyavahāraśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe  samyagvyavahārārhabhedamiti | samyakchabdaḥ spaṣṭatvaparaḥ | tat karma kimityākāṅkṣāyāmuttaraślokasya tadvivaraṇaparatvamāha  tadeva vivṛṇotīti | svargamayaśca kāmaḥ | svargaviṣayecchetyarthaḥ | phalasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | devatāyāḥ phalasya ca yaṣṭavyatvena sādhyatvena ca karmāntarbhāvaḥ | ityādiśabdena dānahomādikaṃ ca pāpaṃ coktaṃ bhavati | bhūrādiśabdena pāpaphalamapyuktaṃ bhavati | paśvādiparikarayukto yajña eva (kaṃ) karma | evaṃvidhayajñātmakaṃ dānahomādyātmakaṃ ca karma tatra hetuḥ | āśritamārgadṛṣṭam | taistairāśritā mārgā varṇāśramāḥ | teṣu dṛṣṭamityarthaḥ |
nantaraślokārthamāha jagaditi | karmavaśyaḥ sarvatra vrajati hi | yadvākarmavaśyo hi sarvatra vrajati | tasmādevaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | nigalita eva hi sarvatra kārāgṛhe carati, atastanmocanāya yateteti bhāvaḥ | dhruvamacalaṃ sadaikarūpamsvarūpato guṇataścekarūpamityarthaḥ | yadvā svarūpato guṇato rūpataścaikarūpamityarthaḥ | tasmānnaitadevamiti pūrveṇānvayaḥ |
evaṃ ślokānāṃ svoktārthānuguṇyamupapādya paroktārthānanuguṇatvamupapādayati  atretyādinā | kiñcidapi padaṃ nadṛśyata iti na vācyam; paramapareśādiśabdānāṃ bhavatpakṣe mukhyārthāsiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | hetvantaraṃ cāha  astināstisatyāsatyeti | prathamaścaḥ tvarthaḥ | svoktayojanāyāmanuguṇasya śabdasya parapakṣānanuguṇatvarūpaṃ vaiṣamyamastīti bhāvaḥ | astisatyaśabdau dṛṣṭātārthau | yathā astisatyaśabdau na sadvilakṣaṇaparau, tathā nāstyasatyaśabdāvapi nāsadvilakṣaṇaparāvityarthaḥ | kathamanirvacanīyavastvabhidhānāsāmarthyamityatrāha  nāstīti | arthadvārako virodhaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha ataśceti | yadvāanirvacanīyavastvabhidhānāsāmarthyāditi vyutpattyabhāva uktaḥ | parasparaviruddhārthatvamatra hetvantaratayoktam | caḥ samuccaye | tathāpi sattvābhāvāt tucchatvaṃ mithyātvaṃ vā uktaṃ bhavatīti cettatrāha  atreti | kathaṃ nināśitvaparāvityatrāha  vastviti | vināśitvameva hi mithyātvamiti śaṅkāyāṃ vināśitvasvarūpaṃ śodhayati  aikeneti | ekenākāreṇa kālāntare'nubhūtasya kālāntare ākārāntareṇopalabdhirastu; tataḥ kathaṃ vināśitvaṃ tucchatvamithyātvavyāvṛttamiti śaṅkāyāṃ tucchatvādisvarūpaṃ śodhayati  tucchatvaṃ hīti | pariṇāmādineti | pariṇāmaśabdaḥ pariṇāmasāmānyaparaḥ tadviśeṣaparaśca | yathā vādaśabdaḥ sarvakathāsādhāraṇaḥ vītarāgakathāmātraparaśca, tadvat | atrāyaṃ pariṇāmaśabdo vardhamānāvasthāvācī; "pariṇāmarddhijanmabhiḥ" iti prayogāt | "yattu kālāntareṇāpi nānyasaṃjñāmupaiti vai | pariṇāmādisaṃbhūtām" iti vakṣyamāṇavacanakaṭākṣeṇaivamuktam | pariṇāmaśabdasya vikāramātraparatve ādiśabdaḥ pradeśāntaragamanaparaḥ | kālāntarānubhūtasya kālāntare nāstītyupalabdhiḥ kathaṃ na bādha ityatrāha  kālabhedeneti | virodhe hi bādhaḥ, bādhyatvaṃ hi mithyātvamityabhiprāyeṇāha ata iti | pariṇāmitvapariṇāmitvayorarthayorna hi nāstyasatyādiśabdāḥ pāribhāṣikāḥ; tat kathaṃ tadabhidhānaprakāraḥ? pariṇāmāspadasyāpi vastuno nityatvāt nāstiśabdābhidhetvaṃ cānupapannamityatrāha  etaduktaṃ bhavatīti | sadaikarūpatvamastiśabdapravṛttinimittam | vināśagarbhatvaṃ nāstiśabdapravṛttinimittamityarthaḥ | ghaṭāvasthāyāṃ piṇḍo nāsti, kapālāvasthāyāṃ ghaṭo nāsti, cūrṇāvasthāyāṃ na kapālasatteti sadā nāśagarbhatvam | uttarāvasthāprāptirhi pūrvāvasthasya vināśaḥ | tadavasthasya saivotpattiḥ | tasmāt nāstiśabdābhidheyatvamacidvastunaḥ | cidvastunastu avasthāntarāpattyavasthāntaraprahāṇābhāvenaikarūpatvānna vināśagarbhatvam | atastadastiśabdavācyameva | yat sadā'styeva, tadastiśabdavācyam | "siddhe śabdārthasaṃbandhe" ityatra siddhaśabdavat avadhāraṇagarbho'yaṃ śabdaḥ | tatra hi siddha eveti vyākhyātam "avbhakṣaḥ, vāyubhakṣaḥ" ityādi dṛṣṭāntīkṛtya | tathā atrāpītyarthaḥ | astināstītiśabdānāṃ pravṛttinimittamidamevetyasminnarthe pramāṇamāha  yathoktamiti | asadasatyasatsatyādiśabdānāṃ mithyātvāmithyātvayoḥ prasiddhisvārasyamastīti śaṅkāyāṃ mithyāgarbhitatvamapi darśayati  deśeti | karmaviśeṣāpekṣayeti | pālanarañjanādisadbhāvāsadbhāvābhyāṃ rājatvapitṛtvādirūpeṇa astitvaṃ nāstitvaṃ ca karmāpekṣam | aupādhikāstitvayogini vastuni svābhāvikāstitvayogitvabuddhiviṣayatvaṃ na paramārtha ityarthaḥ | aparamārthatvagarbhāstyarthopetatvādacito nāstyasatyādiśabdavācyatvamityuktam | ātmanaḥ svābhāvikāstitvayogāt tatra taddhīviṣayatvaṃ paramārtha ityāha  ātmana eveti | padaśo daśaślokyāmuktamarthaṃ śroturanuvādaprakāreṇa draḍhayati śrotuśceti | pradhānataḥ | "dvayekayoḥ" itivat bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ; prādhānyenetyarthaḥ | prādhānyam utkarṣaḥ | anubhāṣaṇaślokapūrvārdhaphalitamarthamāha jyotīṃṣīti | tadekadhāryadravyatvaṃ hi śarīralakṣaṇam | ato viṣṇvādhāramityanenā''tmaśarīrabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | uttarārdhaphalitamatharmāha  cidaciditi | jñānaprādhānyaṃ kaṇṭhoktam; tenācidvastuno'prādhānyasyārthasiddhatvādāha  acidvastunaśceti | prādhānyāprādhānyeutkarṣāpakarṣau | tau cāpariṇāmitvapariṇāmitvalakṣaṇau; nāmithyātvamithyātvalakṣaṇau | dharmiṇi sati hi prādhānyāprādhānye | pratītimaratrasiddhaṃ hi mithyā | ato na tatrāprādhānyaśabdaḥ svarasa ityabhiprāyaḥ ||
atha nirviśeṣabrahmātmaikyajñānasya nivartakatvaparatvena paroktaśrutīnām atadarthatvaṃ vaktuṃ paroktamanuvadati yaduktamiti | pariharati tadasaditi | tatra jñānasya nirviśeṣavastuviṣayatvaṃ tenātmaikyaviṣayatvaṃ ca parihariṣyan prathamaṃ nirviśeṣavastuviṣayatvaṃ vyudasitumupādatte  vedāhamiti | anena vigrahādiviśiṣṭaviṣayajñānamevopāyaḥ, nānya ityuktam | etatsamānārthatvādāha  sarve nimeṣā iti | tatra hi, "adbhyaḥ saṃbhūto hiraṇyagarbha ityaṣṭau" iti pratīkopādānaṃ kṛtam | (viśeṣaṇena) anena vidyucchabdaśca vyākhyāto bhavati | vidyutaḥvidyudvarṇādityarthaḥ; ādityavarṇamityanenahakārthyāt | "na tasyeśe kaścana" ityanena upāyabhūtaṃ jñānāntaraṃ nāstīti phalitam; adhikajñeyāntarābhāvāt | uktākāraviśiṣṭapuruṣavedanasyopāyatvaṃ darśayati  ya enaṃ viduriti | eṣāmanyeṣāmapyādiśabdagṛhītānāñca vākyānāmupādānam anekavākyavirodhapradarśanāya | nanu "sadevaekameva" ityādikāraṇavākyeṣu nirviśeṣasya pratipannatvāt tajjñānameva sākṣānmokṣopāya iti saguṇajñānasyopāyatvaṃ tadvyavadhānena syāt | yadvā saguṇajñānopāyatvaparavākye'pi na saguṇatve tātparyam; vastumātrameva lakṣyata iti cettatrā''ha brahmaṇa iti | sadvidyādiṣvapi saguṇaviṣayatvopapādanāt yathāvasthitasvarūpaviṣayajñānasyaiva mokṣopāyatvāt tānyapi saviśeṣajñānopāyatvaparāṇītyarthaḥ | tarhi śodhakavākyairvirodha ityatrāha śodhaketi | evaṃ jñānasya nirviśeṣaviṣayatvaṃ tadviruddhavacanodāharaṇena pratikṣiptam ||
atha tattmasyādisāmānādikaraṇyānyathānupapattyā nirviśeṣajñānamevopāya iti śaṅkāyāṃ tasya jīvaparaikyaviṣayatvaṃ vyudasyati  tattvamasyādīti | śodhakavākyeṣu sāmānādhikaraṇyamatadvayāvṛttimukhena vastvaikyaparam; tattvamasyādiṣu jīvabrahmaṇossāmānādhikaraṇyamanvayamukhenopalakṣitavastvaikyaparam; acidbrahmaṇostu "sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma" ityādāvatāttvikarūpāropaṇena sāmānādhikaraṇyam; "jyotīṃṣi viṣṇuḥ" ityādau bādhārtham iti caturdhā hi paraiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tatratatrābhyupetam | tatra tattvamasyādivākye anvayamukhena vastumātraparatvaṃ gatyabhāve bādhārthatvaṃ cāśaṅkaya nirākriyate | tatra prathamaṃ vastvaikyaparatvaṃ dūṣayitumāha  na nirviśeṣavastvaikyaparamiti | kuta ityatrāha tattvamiti | tacca kathamityatrāha  tatpadaṃ hīti | hirhetau | sarvajñātvādiguṇakapratipādanaṃ kathamityatrāha  tadaikṣateti | tacchabdasya prakṛtasarvākāraviśiṣṭavastuparāmarśitvaṃ vyutpattisiddham, yathā śuklā śobhanākṣī madīyā pūrṇṛṅgā ghaṭoghnī gauḥ; tāmānayeti nanu gaustiṣṭhati tāmānayetyādau ānayanādikriyānahrasthityādiviśeṣaṇavidhuravastuparāmarśitvaṃ dṛśyate; tacca mukhyam | naivam, ānayanasamakālānvayayogyenāpi sthityādiviśeṣaṇena pūrvakālavaiśiṣṭayasya vivakṣitatvāt | anyathā dhāvato'pi gopiṇḍasyānayanaprasaṅgaḥ | viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyavastuni yathānvayārham, tathā'nvitasya tasyāparityāgo hi vivakṣitatvam | prakṛtasarvaviśeṣaṇeṣu ekasyāpi parityāge prakṛtatvameva hīyate | śuklā śobhanākṣī madīyā pūrṇṛṅgā ghaṭoghnī gauḥ, tāmānayetyukte śauklayetarasamastaviśeṣaṇānvitavyaktyānayane'pi prakṛtavyakterānītatvābhāvāt | ataḥ saviśeṣe prakṛte nirviśeṣasya prakṛtatvaṃ dūrotsāritam | na ca prakṛtasarvaviśeṣaṇaparityāge'pi dharmyaikyena prakṛtatvasiddhiḥ; sarvākāraprahāṇe pratisandhānānarhatvāt | na hyapavarake ghaṭo'sti, tamānayetyukte ghaṭatvāvivakṣāyāṃ mṛnmātrasya siddhiḥ prakṛtatvasiddhiḥ | kathamekākāraparityāge'pyasaṃbhavat prakṛtatvaṃ sarvākāraparityāge saṃbhavati | aṅgulīyakatvaprahāṇe'pi kanakaṃ pratisaṃdhīyata iti cetsatyam, pratyakṣeṇa | tacchabdastu prakṛtākāraprahāṇe pratisaṃdhānameva janayituṃ na śaknoti | ata eva hi, yadaṅgulīyakaṃ tadānayetyukte kanakamātraṃ nānīyate | ataḥ prakṛtasarvākāraprahāṇe pratisandhānānarhasya vastunaḥ prakṛtatvameva nāstīti tacchabdasya vastumātraparatvaṃ lākṣaṇikaṃ syāt | tatpadopasthāpitasārvajñyādīnāṃ tvampadopasthāpitājñatvādīnāṃ ca virodhānnirviśeṣaparatvamiti cettatrāha tatsamānādhikaraṇamiti | ghaṭasya śukla ityādivyadhikaraṇavākyeṣu dharmavācipadasya dharmiparyantatvābhāvāt tadyvāvṛttyarthaṃ tatsamānādhikaraṇamityuktam | acidviśiṣṭajīvaśarīrakamiti | ajñatvādiguṇānāṃ sarvajñatvādiguṇake paramātmani virodhaḥ sadvārakatayā parihṛta ityarthaḥ | tvampadapravṛttinimittasaṃbodhanīyārthatvarūpābhimukhyaviśeṣaprayojakopalakṣaṇābhiprāyeṇa acidviśiṣṭajīvetyuktam | samānādhikaraṇatve sati kathaṃ tvampadaṃ jīvaviśiṣṭabrahmaparamityatrāha  prakāradvayeti | prakāradvayāvasthitamprakāradvayaviśiṣṭam | prakṛtatattmpadapravṛttinimittaparaḥ prakāradvayaśabdo nyūnatvanivartakaḥ; na tu prakāratritvādivyavacchedaparaḥ | tadupapādayati  prakāradvayaparityāga iti | dūṣaṇāntaramāha  dvayoriti | avirodhena mukhyatayā nirvāhe saṃbhavati ekasyāpi padasya lakṣaṇā na yuktā; virodhe satyapyekapadalakṣaṇayaiva avirodhaḥ sidhyatīti padadvayalakṣaṇā anupapannetyarthaḥ | nanu padadvayalakṣaṇā na dūṣaṇam; so'yaṃ devadatta ityādiṣu dṛṣṭatvāt | tatra hi deśakālaviśiṣṭākāre deśakālāntarānvayavirodhāllākṣaṇikameva padadvayam | tatrāha so'yamiti | kimekasya deśadvayasaṃbandhe virodhaḥ, uta kāladvayasaṃbandhe? iti vikalpamabhipretyāha  bhūteti | na hi viśiṣṭākāre viśeṣaṇāntarānvayaḥ, api tu viśeṣyamātre | ataḥ kāladvayasaṃbandho na viruddhaḥ | yadi viruddhaḥ, tarhi bauddhoktaṃ kṣaṇikatvamevā''padyeta, anekakālasādhyadharmavidhānaṃ phalaprāptiśca nopapadyeyātāmiti bhāvaḥ | deśabhedeti | yadyekasya deśadvayasaṃbandhavirodhaḥ, tarhi viṣṇukramaṇatīrthasnānādividhirnopapadyate; pratyabhijñāvirodhaśceti bhāvaḥ | yaugapadyaṃ kathaṃ saṃbhavatīti cettaducyate | deśadvayasaṃbandhasya kāladvayasaṃbandhasya vā na yugapadbhāvaḥ, tatpratipattereva hi yaugapadyam | pratipattistu deśadvayakāladyasaṃbandhaṃ kramabhāvinameva darśayati | ato na virodhaḥ | anyathā, atītānāgataviṣayajñāneṣvatītānāgataviṣayayorvartamānatvaṃ jñānasyātītānāgatatvaṃ vāprasajyeteti | dūṣaṇāntaramapyāhatadaikṣateti | upakramādhikaraṇe hyupakramaprābalyamuktamiti bhāvaḥ | upakramopakrame aikyasya pratipannatvānnopakramavirodhaḥ | ekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñāvākyaṃ hi "tadaikṣata bahu syām" iti vākyāt pūrvamityatrāha  ekavijñāneneti | tatra nimittatvopādānatvatadanuguṇasārvajñyasarvaśaktayādiguṇasiddherityarthaḥ | viśiṣṭameva kāraṇam; tadeva sthūlāvasthaṃ kāryamiti dravyāntaratvābhāvāt kāraṇajñānena kāryajñānamupapadyate | mṛṣāvādinastu kāraṇajñāne kāryasya viṣayatā'ntarbhāvo'bhimataścetvirodhaḥ; satyaviṣayajñāne mithyārthasya viṣayatvāyogāt | mithyātvenetyadhyāhāraśca syāt | anantarbhāve tu ajñāte jñātatvavyavahāro na mukhyaḥ syāt | ato'smatpakṣa eva pratijñāvākyaṃ svarasam | śrutyantaravirodhamāha  jñānasvarūpasyeti | jñānasvarūpasya sarvajñasyetyanena dharmidharmabhūtajñāne vivakṣite | sarvajñasyājñatvam nirastanikhiladoṣasya samastakalyāṇaguṇātmakasya anantāpuruṣārthāśrayatvamiti virodhaḥ | jñānasvarūpasyetyanena tirodhānānupapattiśca sūcitā |
itthaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyasya nirviśeṣavastvaikyaparatvaṃ dūṣitam | atha bādhārthatvaṃ dūṣayati  bādhāthartve ceti | rajjuḥ sarpa ityevaṃrūpaṃ bādhārthaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyameva nāsti; sāmānādhikaraṇyasya ekasmin viśeṣye prakāradvayopasthāpakatayā bādhārthatvavirodhāt | ataḥ padadvayamukhyāthartve'bhimate bādhārthaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na sidhyet | saparśabdena nañarthaṃ lakṣayitvā asarpo rajjuriti nirvāhaṃ dṛṣṭāntavākyasyāśaṅkaya dārṣṭāntikavākyasya tato'pyadhikaṃ dūṣaṇamāha  bādhārthatve
