ceti | tvaṃtatpadayorityatra na kramavivakṣā | tatpadamadhiṣṭhānamātraṃ lakṣayati; tvampadaṃ jīvabhāvanivṛtiṃta lakṣayati | yadvā tvampadenādhiṣṭhānalakṣaṇā; tatpadena nivṛttilakṣaṇā | ādiśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇahāniḥ upakramavirodhaḥ ekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñānupapattiḥ śrutyantaravirodhaśceti dūṣaṇāni vivakṣitāni | uktadṛṣṭāntādupalakṣyasāmānādhikaraṇyācca dūṣaṇamatraradhikamityāha  iyāṃstu viśeṣa iti | bādhārthatve viśeṣo na pūrvoktadūṣaṇahāniḥ, api tu taissaha vakṣyamāṇādhikadūṣaṇadvayāpāta eva viśeṣa ityarthaḥ | adhikaṃ dūṣaṇamāha  nedaṃ rajatamitivadapratipannasyaiva bādhasyāgatyā parikalpanamiti | śuktireva rajatamityatra pramāṇāntareṇa nedaṃ rajatamiti bādhasya pratipannatvādbādhakalpanam, atra bādhasyāpratipannatve'pyagatyā bādhakalpanamityarthaḥ | tatpadenādhiṣṭhānātirekidharmānupasthāpanena bādhānupapattiśceti | śuktireva rajatamityatra śuktitvarūpaṃ viruddhadharmaṃ śabda evopasthāpayati | atastatra bādhakalpanam | atra tvadhiṣṭhānamātraṃ lakṣayatā tatpadena śuktitvavat viruddhadharmānupasthāpanāt bādhakalpanamanupapannamityarthaḥ | virodhaparihārārthaṃ lakṣaṇā cetanyatarapadalakṣaṇaiva virodhaparihārāyālam | tadā saviśeṣatvaprasaṅga iti cārthasiddham | pramāṇāntareṇa bādhasya pratipannatvāt śabdena viruddhadharmopasthāpanācca bādhakalpanam; atra tūbhayābhāvāt tadanupapannamityuktam | tatra viruddhākāropasthāpanaṃ śaṅkate  adhiṣṭhānaṃtviti | tadadhiṣṭhānamatirohitasvarūpaṃ yathā bhavati, tathopasthāpyata iti kriyāviśeṣaṇam | aprakāśitavirodhiprakāśanaṃ hi bādhakalpanam; na tu dharmopasthāpanameva bādhakalpanamiti niyamo'sti | atastatpadena prāgaprakāśitavirodhyadhiṣṭhāsvarūpaprakāśanādbādhakalpanamityarthaḥ | atrāha  neti | kiṃ virodhirūpamadhiṣṭhānaṃ prakāśate, uta neti vikalpya, aprakāśapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha  adhiṣṭhāneti | tadāśrayetyāśrayaśabdo viṣayaparaḥ | yadvā, tadadhiṣṭhānakabhramabādhayorityarthaḥ | prakāśapakṣaṃ śaṅkate bhrameti | bhramāśrayamadhiṣṭhānamityatra pāṭho nirīkṣaṇīyaḥ | āśrayaśabdo viṣayaparaḥ | bhramāśrayamityatra bhramasyāśrayaṇaṃ viṣayīkaraṇam yatreti vaiyadhikaraṇyena vā, bhramaḥ āśrayaḥ āśrayaṇīyaḥ saṃbandhanīyo yeneti sāmānādhikaraṇyena vā kathañcidbahuvrīhitvamapi nirvoḍhuṃ śakyam | āropyākārādhikaraṇabhūtamadhiṣṭhānamiti vā''rthaḥ | bhramāśrayatvāyātirohitamiti cedityarthaḥ | dūṣayati  tadeveti | kimidamadhiṣṭhānaṃ virodhirūpam, uttāvirodhi iti vikalpābhiprāyeṇa virodhītipakṣe dūṣaṇamuktam | avirodhitvapakṣe bādhakalpanānupapattirbhramānucchedaśceti dūṣaṇaṃ spaṣṭamiti na taduktam | ata iti | pāramārthikaśabdasyāyamabhiprāyaḥ bhramavirodhyākārasyāpāramārthikatve adhyastarūpameva satyaṃ syāt; yathā śuktitvāpāramārthye rajatatvaṃ satyaṃ bhavatīti |
yadidaṃ codyamvirodhyākārasyāpāramārthye'pi bhramanivṛttirupapadyate; yathā palāśapuṣpaviṣayadāvabhramavato bhramarasya vṛndaviṣayabhramarabhrameṇa palāśapuṣpaṃ śliṣyataḥ palāśapuṣpaviṣayadāvabhramo vṛntaviṣayabhrarabhramaśca nivṛtta iti | yathā''huḥ, "bhramarī bhramarabhrameṇa vṛnte yadadāvabhramamāśliṣat palāśam" ititadayuktam; tatrāpi paramārthavirodhyākāreṇaiva bhramaviṣayanivṛtteḥ | dāvatvavirodhipalāśapuṣpatvākāraḥ paramārthaḥ | bhramaratvavirodhivṛntatvākāraśca paramārthaḥ | aparamārthatve dāvatvaṃ bhramaratvaṃ ca satyaṃ syāt | śuktitve aparamārthe rajatatvamiva | vṛntaviṣayabhramarabhrameṇa dāvatvabhramanivṛttiriti cettataḥ kim? dāvatvabuddhinivṛttirbhramaratvasya satyatvapratipattikṛtā; tataścāsatyena satyatvaviṣayabhramāntaraṃ tiṣṭhati; tannivṛttirapyasatyaviṣayasatyatvabhramāntareṇeti bhramaparamparayā niśśeṣāvidyānivṛttyanupapāttaḥ | kiñca dāvatvaviṣayadhīnivṛttāvapi dāvatvanivṛttirna bhramarabhrameṇa; apitu paramārthapuṣpatvākāreṇaiva | anyathā paramārtharajate aparamātharśuktitvabudbayā rajatadhīnivṛttyā rajatasyāpi śuktitvaprasaṅgāt | bhramāntareṇa bhramāntaranivṛttāvanavasthā ca syāt, nivartakabhramāntarasyāpi nivartakāntarāpekṣatvāt | yathā rajjuviṣayasarpabhūdalanāmbudhārābhramaparamparāyāḥ | kiñca bhramarabhramanivṛttyanantaraṃ nivarttakāpāramārthyajñānādāpatad(n?) dāvabhramaḥ paramārthapalāśapuṣpatvagrahaṇenaiva pratinivṛttaḥ |
ato niśśeṣāvidyānivṛttilakṣaṇamokṣavādinā bhramaparamparāparyavasānārthamantato gatvā paramārthākāro'bhyupagantavyaḥ, rajjutvavat | caramabhramaḥ svayameva na syāditi cenna; svayaṃ svabādhakakarmatve karmakartravirodhaprasaṅgāt | kiñca bādhakasya satyātmakatvāt bādhyasya mithyātvāt ekasyaiva nivartyanivatarkatvābhyupagame tasyaiva mithyātvaṃ satyatvaṃ ceti virodhaḥ syāt | kiñca prapañco'pi bādhakānapekṣaḥ svayameva svātmānaṃ nivartayet | svayaṃ nāśe vināśasyāvasthāntararūpatvādavidyā sūkṣmarūpeṇa sthitā syāt | nāśakalpakāvidyāntaraṃ ca syāt | paramārthaviruddhadharmatattirodhānābhāve bhramabādhāsaṃbhavaṃ dṛṣṭāntenopapādayati  adhiṣṭhāne hīti | atra rājakumārasamādhirbhagavato bhāṣyakārasya |
evaṃ bādhārthatvaṃ dūṣitam; atha svapakṣe imāni dūṣaṇāni na santītyāha  jīvaśarīraketi | mukhyavṛttamityanena lakṣaṇāhāniruktā; prakāradvayetyanena sāmānādhikaraṇyasiddhiḥ | nirastanikhiladoṣasyetyādinā tatpadoktaguṇavirodhaḥ, upakramānukūlatā ceti, "sadeva somyedam", "tadaikṣata" ityupakramāvirodha uktaḥ | ekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñopapattiḥ kathamityatrāha  sūkṣmeti | viśiṣṭaṃ kāraṇam, tadeva kāryamiti, pratijñopapattirityarthaḥ | śrutyantarāvirodhamāha tamīśvarāṇāmiti |
vākyaṃ cet uddeśyopādeyavibhāgavat | uddeśyaṃ hyavagatam; upādeyaṃ vidheyamanavagatam | atra tatpadaṃ noddeśyasamarpaṇaparam; sārvajñyādiguṇakatvasya pratyakṣādyagocaratvāt | tvaṃśabdasya cāntaryāmiparatve sati uddeśyasamarpakatvamanupapannam, antaryāmiṇaḥ pratyakṣādyaviṣayatvāt | tasmāt tvaṃśabdena jīvamātramuddiśya tasya tatpadena brahmabhāvo vidhīyata ityabhyupagantavyam | tatra virodhānnirviśeṣavastvaikyaparaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ saṃbhavatītyabhiprāyeṇa codayati  tattvamasītyatroddeśyopādeyavibhāgaḥ kathamiti cediti | pariharati  nātreti | pramāṇāntarāgocarātharsya kathamavidhānamityapekṣāyām, na kevalaṃ pratyakṣādyavagatārthaviṣayameva vākyamanuvādakam, apitu vākyāntarapratipannārthaviṣayamapyanuvādakamityabhiprāyeṇa vākyāntaraprāptiṃ darśayati  aitadātmyamiti | asminneva prakaraṇe prathamapratipannanāmarūpavyākaraṇaśrutyaiva paramātmaśarīrabhūtacidacidvācakaśabdānāṃ paramātmaparyantābhidhāyitvaṃ ca jñātamiti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  aprāpte hīti | apratipannārthaviṣayaṃ śāstramajñātajñāpanarūpaprayojanavadityarthaḥ | ataḥ tadevoddeśyopādeyavibhāgavat; na tu prakṛtanigamanarūpaṃ vākyam | ato'sya nigamanavākyasya pratipannārthaviṣayatvānnoddeśyopādeyavibhāgavattvamityarthaḥ | nanu nigamanavākyasyāpyuddeśyopādeyavibhāgavattvaṃ pratīyate | yathā "tasmācchabdo'nityaḥ", "tasmādayamagnimān" iti | atra śabdaparvatādyuddeśena anityatvāgnimattvādikaṃ hi vidheyatayā pratīyate | naitadyuktam; pratipāditārthaviṣayasya nigamanavākyasyāpratipannārthaviṣayatvavyāghātāt | pratītistu vidhāyakavākyasthoddeśyopādeyasamaparkapadapratyabhijñānāt nirdeśe prathamacaramabhāvādisārūpyāccoddeśyopādeyavibhāgavattvabhrāntireva | "yadvṛttayogaḥ prāthamyam ityādyuddeśyalakṣaṇam" iti hi nītividaḥ |
nanu savartroddeśyānuṇā tiṅvibhaktiḥ | ata eva hi yuṣyadasmadoḥ padāntarasāmānādhikaraṇyena parasparasāmānādhikaraṇyena ca prayogeṣūddeśyānuguṇā madhyamottamapuruṣavyavasthā dṛśyate, "tvaṃ bhūtānāmadhipatirasi", "ahamasmi prathamajā ṛtasya", tathā "yadagne syāhaṃtvam, tvaṃ vā syā ahamsyuṣṭe satyā ihāśiṣaḥ" ityādiṣu | agne ahaṃ tvaṃ yadi syāmtvamiva devatā syām, tvamahaṃ yadi syāḥahamivārthī syāḥ, tadā te tavā''śiṣaḥ satyāḥ syurityarthaḥ | tasmāt tattvamasītyatrāpi madhyamapadaprayogāt tvaṃpadasyoddeśyasamarpakatvaṃ tatpadasya copādeyasamarpakatvamakānāpi svīkāryam | naivam; padadvayāvagatārthasya pūrvavākyaprāptatvādeva | tarhi madhyamanirdeśaḥ kathamiti cetucyate | tattvampadayorubhayorapi prayuktatvāduddeśyopādeyavibhāgābhāvācca prathamamadhyamapuruṣayoraviśeṣeṇa prāptau, nigamanavākyasya prāpakavākyānurodhitvasya nyāyyatvāt tatra ca idaṃ sarvamiti nirdiṣṭajagadantargatacidviśeṣaviśaṣṭa paramātmavācinastvampadasya prāpakavākyasthoddeśyavācipadavācyaikadeśaviṣayatvāt tadanurodhena madhyamanirdeśa iti |
nanu "aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvam" ityacetane brahmānupraveśamuktavā tattvamasīti jīvabrahmaṇoḥ svarūpaikyamucyata iti śaṅkāyāmāha  idaṃ sarvamiti sajīvaṃ jagannirdiśyeti | sarvaśabdo nācetanamātraparaḥ | saṅkocakābhāve'pi svārasyabhaṅgāyogāt | "sanmūlāssomyemāssarvāḥ prajāssadāyatanāḥ satpratiṣṭhāḥ" iti pūrvavākye sarvaśabdena prajānāṃ viśeṣitatvāt | prajāśabdasyācitsaṃsṛṣṭacetanaviśeṣaparatvāt; "idaṃ sarvamasṛjata" ityādivākyāntare vijñānāvijñānaśabdavācyacidacidātmakasya jagataḥ sarvaśabdena nirdeśācceti bhāvaḥ | aitadātmyamiti padaṃ vyācaṣṭe  tasyaiṣa ātmeti | idaṃ sarvamiti padadvayamuddeśyasamarpakam | aitadātmyam | etadātmakatvaṃ vidheyam | viśiṣṭasya brahmaṇaḥ kāraṇatayā prakṛtatvepi etacchabdaḥ cidacidvilakṣaṇaviśeṣyāṃśaparaḥ; arthavaśāt | tadātmakatvaṃ mṛdātmako ghaṭa itivat svarūpaikyakṛtaṃ syādityatrāha  tatra ca heturukta iti | sadāyatanā ityanena ādhārādheyabhāva uktaḥ | anena śarīraśarīribhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | cetanena yāvadātmabhāvitayā dhāryadravyaṃ hi śarīram | asmin vākye hetutvamaprakaṭamiti tadvaiśadyāyāha  sarvaṃ khalviti | atrāpi prāṇanena sadāyatanatvaṃ phalitam; sanmūlā ityādivākyenaikārthyāt | tatra sanmūlā iti tajjatvam, satpratiṣṭhā iti tallatvam, sadāyatanā iti tadanatvaṃ cocyate | tacca antaḥ praviśya praśāsanena dhārakatayā sthitihetutvam | "antaḥpraviṣṭaḥ śāstā janānām", "etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane gārgi sarvamidaṃ vidhṛtaṃ tiṣṭhati" ityādiśruteḥ | evaṃ niṣkṛṣṭabrahmasvarūpasyopādānatvalayasthānatvāyogāt, sarvasya tadanatvoktayā ca cidaciccharīrakatvaṃ siddham | ataḥ savarśabdaḥ kāryāvasthacidaciccharīrakaparamātmaparaḥ, brahmaśabdasya asaṅkocena svarūpaguṇairniravadhikabṛhattvavācitvāt niṣkṛṣṭabrahmaṇaḥ kāraṇatvānupapattirūpārthasāmarthyācca brahmaśabdaḥ kāraṇāvasthacidadviśiṣṭaparaḥ | evamubhayāvasthacidacitprakāriṇo brahmaṇa ekatvaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyapratipādyamiti kāryakāraṇāvasthaprakāryekatvamasya vākyasyārthaḥ | cidacitprakāritvaṃ pratipadikabodhyam | avasthādvayaviśiṣṭavastvekatvaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyabodhyamiti na vākyabhedaḥ | ato yathokta evārthaḥ | atha sarvaṃkhalviti vākyapratipannasya tādātmyasya śarīraśarīribhāvanibandhanatvaṃ niyantṛtvaniyāmyatvādine śarīraśabdena ca viśadayituṃ śrutivākyāni darśayati  tatheti | "antaḥ praviṣṭa śāstā" ityetat sarvātmaśabdavyākhyānarūpam | anena śarīrātmabhāvaḥ phalitaḥ (uktaḥ) | antaḥ praviśya niyāmyatvaṃ hi śarīratvam | tatspaṣṭīkaraṇārthamudāharati  yaḥ pṛthivyāmiti | "yaḥ pṛthivyām", "ya ātmani" iti paryāyadvayena cetanācetanayorbhagavantaṃ prati śarīratvamuktam | ātmani tiṣṭhannityukte vedyāmagnistiṣṭhati, tile tailaṃ tiṣṭhatītivat bahirabahiḥsthitisādhāraṇyāt tadvaiśadyārthamāha  ātmano'ntara iti | antaro yamayatītyanena śarīralakṣaṇamuktam | tasmāt tanniyāmyaṃ taccharīramityarthaḥ | na ca śilāputrakasya śarīramitivat ayaṃ nirdeśaḥ, apavādakābhāve vyatirekanirdeśasvārasyabhaṅgāyogāt | "yasya pṛthivī śarīram" iti vyatirekanirdeśasvārasyabhaṅgābhāvasya prakaraṇasiddhatvāt tadapavādā(dakā)bhāve tatrā(ai?) pyaupacārikatvāśrayaṇāyogāt; adhikaraṇādhikartavyabhāvavyāpyavyāpakabhāvājñaprājñabhāvaniyāmyaniyantṛbhāvarūpaviruddhadharmaiḥ svārasyabhaṅgasyātyarthamapoditatvācca | yaṃ pṛthivī na vedeti dṛṣṭāntātharm | yathā acetanaṃ na veti tathā cetano'pīti bhāvaḥ | ya ātmanīti paryāyeṇa pariśuddhātmano bhagavaccharīratvamucyate; nakṣatracandrādityādīnāmacitsaṃsṛṣṭacetanaviśeṣāṇāṃ paramātmaśarīratvasya pṛthaguktatvāt; "yaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhan" ityanuktānāmapi saṃsṛṣṭajīvānāṃ paramātmaśarīratvasya pṛthaguktatvācca | na ca bhūtaśabdaḥ pṛthivyādyacinmātraparaḥ, "yasya pṛthivī śarīram, "yasyāpaḥ śarīram" ityādinā pṛthivyavādīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ pṛthaguktatvāt | yamātmā na vedeti iyattayā vedananiṣedhaḥ; bhagavatprasādena vinā tajjñānasya śakyatvaniṣedho vā kriyate | kāraṇāvasthamapi bhagavataḥ śarīram, śarīrī ca nārāyaṇākhyo devatāviśeṣa iti jñāpayitumāha  yaḥ pṛthivīmantare sañcaranniti | mṛtyuḥtamaśśabdavācyā prakṛtiḥ; tatraiva tamaśśabdasthāne mṛtyuśabdapāṭhāt | śarīraśarīribhāvastattannāmabhāktavanirvāhaka ityāha  tatsṛṣṭveti | na kevalaṃ śrutyantarānurodhādaitadātmyaśabdārtho niścīyate, svaprakaraṇavākyādapītyāha  atrāpīti | anena jīvavācakaśabdasya paramātmaparyantatvamapi śvetaketunā'vagatamiti siddham | jīvenātmanājīvaśarīrakeṇa mayā; "vyāghreṇa bhūtvā bahavo mayāttāḥ" itivat | nāmarūpe iti padaṃ vyācaṣṭe  vastutvaṃ śabdavācyatvaṃ ceti | tattaddevādivastutvaṃ devādiśabdavācyatvaṃ cetyarthaḥ | acidbrahmaṇostādātmyamanupraveśakṛtamastu; jīvabrahmaṇostu svarūpaikyakṛtameva syāt, jīvena mayeti śravaṇādityatrāha  tadanupraviśyeti |
nanu jīvamanupraviṣṭasyāpi brahmaṇo nāmavācyatvaṃ na vyākaraṇāt sidhyati; nāmarūpavyākaraṇaśruternāmavācyatvapratipādanaparatvābhāvāt | yathā rūpavyākaraṇaṃ rūpaniṣpādanamātram, na tu svasya tadbodhyatvāpādanam | evaṃ nāmavyākaraṇamapi śabdasṛṣṭireva; na tu tadbrodhyatvāpādanamiti |
naivam; "taddhedaṃ tarhyavyākṛtamāsīt | tannāmarūpābhyāṃ vyākriyata" iti samānavākye idaṃśabdavācyajagadātmabrahmaṇaḥ pralayadaśāyāmupasaṃhṛtanāmarūpasya sṛṣṭidaśāyāṃ nāmarūpābhyāṃ vyākṛtatvaśravaṇāt | nāmarūpābhyāmiti itthaṃbhāve tṛtīyā | nāmarūpābhyāṃ viśiṣṭamakriyatetyarthaḥ | na ca nāmakartṛtvameva nāmaviśiṣṭatvam, na tu nāmavācyatvamiti vaktuṃ yuktam; sañjñāsañjñisaṃbandhavyutpādake nāmoccārayitari ca puruṣe ghaṭādināmaviśiṣṭatvāprasiprasiddheḥ | nāmavācyasyaiva hi nāmaviśiṣṭatvaprasiddhiḥ | uccārayituḥ śabdopādānatvābhāvāt nāmaviśiṣṭatvāprasiddhiḥ | kṛtsnopādānasya tu brahmaṇaḥ śabdopādānatvayogāt rūpaviśiṣṭatvavat nāmaviśiṣṭatvopapattiriti cenna  nabhasi ghaṭādināmaviśiṣṭatvāprasiddheḥ | na hi ghaṭādināmaviśiṣṭatve kathite nabhaso nāmitvaṃ svarasataḥ pratīyate | vācyatvena śabdasaṃbandhinyeva hi nāmitvapratītisvārasyam | na ca lakṣaṇādivṛttyā''pi tattannāmabodhyatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ saṃbhavatīti vācyam; lakṣaṇāgauṇavṛttigocarayoḥ kūlamāṇavakayorgaṅgāpadāgnipadāpekṣayā nāmitvāprasiddheḥ | nanu śyenaśabdasya yāgaviśeṣaṃ prati gauṇanāmatvaṃ nirṇītam | satyam, prāṇahāritvaguṇasāmyāt prayogānyathāsiddheḥ | "yathā vai śyeno nipatyā''datte" iti hi śrutiḥ | mukhyasyaiva hi śabdasya nāmatvapratītiḥ svataḥ prāptā | atra tu svataḥ prāptasya mukhyatvasyāpavādā(dakā)bhāvānna tatprahāṇaṃ yuktam | ato'nena vākyena nāmavācyatvaṃ śabdasvārasyādavagamyate | etadaikārthyāt "nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi" ityatrāpi brahmaparyantaṃ nāmarūpavyākaraṇameva vivakṣitam |
kiñca tāvat varṇasṛṣṭipratipādanaśaṅkā'pi bhavitumarhati; nāmaśabdasya varṇamātraparyāyatvābhāvāt | brahmavyatiriktasamastatattatpadātharsvarūpaniṣpādanasya rūpavyākaraṇoktisiddhatvena gaganāsādhāraṇarūpaśabdanieṣpādanasyāpi rūpavyākaraṇoktayaiva siddhatvāt tatpratipādanavaiyarthyaṃ ca syāt | na ca rūpaśabdasya gobalīvardanyāyena saṅkocaḥ, saṅkocakasya nāmavyākaraṇanirdeśasyānyathāsiddhatvāt | ato niṣpādyamānatattadrūpavācakaśabda vyutpādanameva nāmavyākaraṇaṃ syāt |
tatra bahu syāmityanena srakṣyamāṇabahutvasya brahmaviśeṣaṇatvāvagamāt, asmin vākye'pi vyākaraṇasyānupraveśapūrvakatvapratipādanācca vyākriyamāṇarūpasya brahmaviśeṣaṇatvamavagamyate | ato brahmaviśeṣaṇarūpasamabhivyāhārānnāmno'pi brahmaviśeṣaṇatvamavagamyate | nāmno viśeṣaṇatvaṃ vācakatayaivetyupapāditam | kṛtsnasya rūpasya brahmaviśeṣaṇatvāvagamāt tattadrūpapravṛttinimittakatvācca nāmnāṃ brahmaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ tasya vācakatayaivetyavagamyate; srakṣyamāṇabahutvaviṣayasya bahuśabdasya upakrame brahmaparyantatvena prayogadarśanādupakramoktabahutvāvāntarabhidārūpatattadrūpavācināṃ ca nāmnāṃ brahmavācakatayā tadviśeṣaṇatvamavagamyate "tat teja aikṣata", "tā āpa aikṣanta" iti prakaraṇe tejaḥ prabhṛtiśabdānāṃ paramātmaviṣayatayā prayogadarśanācca nāmnāṃ brahmaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ tadvācakatayetyavagamyate | "vacasāṃ vācyamuttamam", "harirakhilābhirudīryate tathaikaḥ", "natāḥ smaḥ sarvavacasāṃ pratiṣṭhā yatra śāśvatī" ityādismṛtisvāssyācca nāmavācyatvamavagamyate | tataśca "nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi" iti śrutiḥ cidacidviśiṣṭasya brahmaṇastannāmavācyatvameva pratipādayatīti siddham |
aitadātmyaśabdārthavyākhyānaṃ nigamayati  ata iti | śarīravāciśabdānāṃ śarīriparyantatvaṃ nigamayati  tasmāditi | tasmātudāhṛtavākyaiḥ śarīraśarīribhāvapratipādanāt tasya tattannāmabhāktavanirvāhakatvāccetyarthaḥ | nanu na tatparyantābhidhānamupapadyate | loke tattadvastumātraparyantatvena vyutpannatayā vyutpattibhaṅgaprasaṅgāt; brahmaṇa ekatvena dvitvabahutvānupapatteścetyatrāha  atassarvaśabdānāmiti | lokavyutpattiśabdasyāyaṃ bhāvaḥ,netra vyutpattivirodhaḥ, vyutpannārthāparityāgāt | brahmaṇo laukikapramāṇagocaratayā tatparyantavyutpattyabhāvaḥ, na tvavācakatayeti so'nyathāsiddhaḥ | yathā liṅāderapūvarvācitvaṃ vedavyutpattyā'vagamya lokato vyutpattyabhāvaparihāraḥ kāryavākyārthavādibhirucyate, tadvat | tattatpadārthaviśiṣṭaśabdena brahmaṇo'pi dvitvabahutvādikaṃ sadvārakamupapannamityuktaṃ bhavati |
tattvamasītyasyopasaṃhāravākyatāmāha  ityaitadātmyamiti | sāmānādhikaraṇyena viśeṣe upasaṃhāra iti | vaiyadhikaraṇyena pratijñātasya sāmānādhikaraṇyenopasaṃhāraḥ, sāmānyena pratijñātasya viśeṣa upasaṃhāra ityarthaḥ | "tadaikṣata" ityādinā tacchabdārthaḥ pratipannaḥ; "aitadātmyam" ityādinā jīvasya brahmātmakatvaṃ pratipannam; "anena jīvena" ityādinā jīvavāciśabdānāṃ brahmaparyantatvaṃ ca pratipannamiti nātroddeśyopādeyavibhāgaḥ | ayaṃ hyaprāptārthapratipādakavākyānām; na tu nigamanavākyānām, teṣāṃ prāptaviṣayatvāt | nigamanaṃ coktārthapratiṣṭhārthatvādapekṣitaṃ dṛśyate | tasmānnigamanavākye'smin uddeśyopādeyavibhāgamukhena codyasya nāvakāśa iti parihāra ukto bhavati | yatra tvaprāptārthaparavākye jagadbrahmaṇoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tatra brahmaṇastadrūpanāmabhāktavaṃ vidheyaṃ jñātavyam |
evaṃ bhedaśrutighaṭakaśrutyavirodhārthaṃ "tattvamasi" iti vākyasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ śarīraśarīribhāvenopapāditam | śarīravāciśabdānāṃ śarīriparyantābhidhānaṃ jātiguṇapadayorvyaktiguṇiparyantābhidhānavat saṃbhavatītyākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyenopapipādayiṣuḥ śarīravāciśabdānāmākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyaviṣayatānirūpaṇarūpasya "aṃśo nānāvyapadeśāt" ityadhikaraṇasya pūrvapakṣabhūteṣvartheṣu dūṣaṇamāha  ata iti | ataḥjagadbrahmaṇoḥ śrutibhiḥ śarīraśarīribhāvapratipādanāt tasya ca tattannāmabhāktavanirvāhakatvāccetyarthaḥ | bhedābhedavādiśabdena aupādhikasvabhāvikabhedebhedavādinordvayorapi tantreṇoktiḥ | kevalabhedaśabdena svaparyavasitabhedo vivakṣitaḥ | tadvādinaśca vaiśeṣikādayaḥ | vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ ca, asyaiṣa ātmā ityevaṃrūpatvādupadeśasya | brahmātmabhāvopadeśaparityāgaḥ kathamiti śaṅkāyāṃ mṛpāvādipakṣe tadanupapatiṃta vaktumāha  ekasminniti | śaṅkate  tasyaiveti | prativakti  taditi | svavākyena  "satyaṃ jñānam" ityādinā svarūpaparavākyena | svavākyena pratipannādadhikārthapratipattirasti vā na vā? | prathame saviśeṣatvam; dvitīye tādātmyopadeśavaiyarthyamiti bhāvaḥ | punaḥ śaṅkate  kalpiteti | dūṣayati  taditi | prakāradvayopasthāpakatvāditi bhāvaḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇyatādātmyeti | sāmānādhikaraṇyena tādātmyopadeśāvaseyamityarthaḥ | na kevalamasādhakatvam, viruddhamapītyāha  sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tviti | aupādhikabhedābhedavāde tadanupapattimāha  bhedābhedeti | kleśakarmādyaspaṣṭaḥ sārvajñyādiguṇako hīśvaraḥ | ata īśvarasya nirdoṣasya tadanarhānīśvaratādātmyavyāghātādīśvaratādātmyopadeśo viruddha ityarthaḥ | parityaktāḥ syuḥ | parityāgaḥ phalita ityarthaḥ | svābhāvikabhedābhedapakṣe tadanupapattimāha  svābhāviketi | guṇavaddoṣāśca svābhāvikā bhaveyuriti | brahmaṇa īśvarāṃśena sārvajñyādiguṇā iva jīvāṃśena doṣāśca svābhāvikā bhaveyuḥ; "anādirbhagavān kālo nānto'sya dvija vidyate | anvayucchinnāstatastvete sargasthityantasaṃyamāḥ" iti saṃsārapravāhānantyena doṣā nityāḥ syurityarthaḥ | yadvā tattaddoṣasaṃbandhārhatvaṃ svābhāvikaṃ syādityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  iti nirdoṣeti | sadbrahmātmādiśabdānāṃ nārāyaṇaśabdaparyavasāyitveneśvarātiriktavastuniṣedhādibhirīśvarasyaiva brahmatvaṃ siddhaṃ kṛtvā, niravadyaṃ nirañjanamityādiśrutyuktaṃ brahmaṇo nirdoṣatvaṃ cābhipretya nirdoṣabrahmatādātmyopadeśavirodha uktaḥ | nirdoṣaśrutivirodhaḥ phalitaḥ | tarhi nirdoṣaśrutivirodha iti vaktavye kimarthaṃ nirdoṣabrahmatādātmyopadeśo viruddha ityuktam | ucyate | heyānarhatādātmyaṃ hi puruṣārthaḥ | svarūpaikye ca brahmaṇo heyārhatvāddheyārhabrahmatādātmyadhīrna heyāpahā | tattādātmyānubhavo'pyapuruṣārthaścetyupāyatvaprāpyatvavirodhāt tādātmyopadeśaparavākyasya na prayojanaparyavasānaṃ syāt | na hi asinā chidyamānasya kālāgninā dahyamānasya ca puruṣasyopāsanamupāsakānarthaṃ pariharati | na ca tattādātmyadhīḥ kasyacitpuruṣārthaḥ, tadvaditi jñāpayāya tādātmyopadeśo viruddha ityuktam | svaniṣṭhabhedapakṣaṃ dūṣayati  kevaleti | atyantabhinnayoḥprakāraprakāribhāvarahitayorityarthaḥ | kenāpi prakāreṇa | viśeṣyāṃśato'pyaikyāsiddhirityarthaḥ |
evaṃ pūrvapakṣacatuṣṭaye'pyanupapattimuktavā svapakṣe vaiṣamyamāha  nikhileti | samyakchabdena mukhyatvaṃ vivakṣitam | kathaṃ mukhyatvamityatrāha  jātiguṇayoriti | daṇḍādivyāvṛttyarthamāha  śarīrabhāvena viśeṣaṇatveneti | kathaṃ mukhyameva dṛṣṭacaramityucyate; amukhyatve'pi hi prayogaḥ saṃbhavati | amukhyatvaṃ ca śarīrasya dravyatvāt | na hi daṇḍakuṇḍalādiśabdānāṃ viśeṣyaparyantābhidhānaṃ dṛṣṭam | tasmādadravyatve sati viśeṣaṇatvam, jātiguṇayoranyataratve sati viśeṣaṇatvaṃ vā matvarthīyapratyayanirapekṣasāmānādhikaraṇye prayojakamiti śarīravāciśabdasya viśeṣyaparyantābhidhānamamukhyamityatrāha  jātiguṇayorapīti | evakāreṇa jātiguṇayoranyataratvādeḥ prayojakatvavyudāsaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāhamanuṣyatvāditi | atra prakāraśabdo viśeṣaṇamātraparaḥ | evakāreṇa daṇḍakuṇḍalādivyāvṛttirabhipretā | sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ anugatamitīti | sāmānādhikaraṇyasyānugatatvādanugatameva tatprayojakaṃ vācyamityarthaḥ | jātitvaguṇatvādeḥ pratyojakatvaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha  na paraspareti | parasparavyāvṛttāḥ  parasparānanuyāyinaḥ | jātyādayaḥjātitvādayaḥ | ayamabhiprāyaḥgaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādiṣu pravāhakūlayorgaṅgāpadapravṛttinimittabhūtasyānuyāyinaḥ ākārasyādarśanāt tatra lākṣaṇikatvaṃ yuktam; atra tu yatra yatra viśeṣyaparyantābhidhāyitvena prayogo dṛṣṭacaraḥ, tatra tatra prayogaviṣayeṣvanuvṛttākāradarśanāt ananugatākāraprayojakatvāśrayaṇena kvacillākṣaṇikatvaṃ vaktumayuktam | anyathāadravyatve sati viśeṣaṇatvaṃ viśeṣyaparyantādhāne prayojakamityapi na vaktavyam; jātitvaṃ guṇatvaṃ vā prayojakamastu, anyallākṣaṇikaṃ syāt | na ca tathā bhavadabhimatam; jātiguṇavācināmubhayaṣāmapi hi śabdānāṃ viśeṣyaparyantavasāyitvena prayogadarśanāt | tasmāt śarīravāciśabdānāmapi viśeṣyapayarntābhidhāyitvena prayogadarśanāt prayogeṣu sarveṣvanuvṛttaikākāradarśanācca ananuvṛttākārāntarasya prayojakatvakalpanenānyatarasyāmukhyatvakalpanāyā ayuktatvāt idamapi sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ jātiguṇavāci śabdānāmiva mukhyameveti | nanu prakārabhūtadravyavācipadānāṃ matvarthīyapratyayanirapekṣaviśeṣyaparyantābhidhāyitvaṃ daṇḍādiśabdānāṃ tathātvādarśanādanupapannamiti śaṅkāyāṃ prakāratayaiveti pūrvamabhipretaṃ vivṛṇoti  svaniṣṭhānāmeva hīti | apṛthaksiddhaprakāravācitvameva matvarthīyapratyayanirapekṣasāmānādhikaraṇyaprayojakamityarthaḥ | yatrayatra niyataprakāratvam, tatra tatra sahopalambhaniyamo dṛṣṭaḥ | śarīre tu sahopalambhaniyamābhāvādapṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇatvamanupapannam | tasmāt sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ lākṣaṇikamityabhiprāyeṇa codayati  yadi gauraśva iti | pakṣe vyāpakaviparyayaṃ darśayati  na caivamiti | tat vivṛṇoti  nahīti | tataḥ kimityatrāha  ata iti | pariharati  naitadevamiti | sahopalambhaniyamasya niyataprakāratvaprayojakatve dūṣaṇaṃ vakṣyan prathamaṃ śarīrasyāpṛthagviśeṣaṇatvaṃ pratipannamiti daśaryati  manuṣyādīti |
ātmaikāśrayatvatadekārthatvayoranyatarānvitaṃ prakāratvamapṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇatvamityarthaḥ | yadvā prakāratvaśabdena prakāratayaiva pratītirvivakṣitā; uttaratra prakāratvavivaraṇe ātmaviśeṣaṇatayaiva pratīteriti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | tena viśeṣyapratipattisaṃbhave daṇḍakuṇḍalādivat pṛthagavasthitatvena pratipannatvābhāvaḥ phalitaḥ | tadekāśrayatvaṃ tadekaprayojanatvaṃ viśeṣyapratītisaṃbhave pṛthaksthitatvenāpratītatvaṃ cāpṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇatve prayojakamityarthaḥ | teṣu triṣu ātmaikāśrayatvaṃ pakṣe darśayati  ātmaikāśrayatvamiti | tadekaprayojanatvaṃ darśayati  ātmaiketi | na ca duḥkhaikaphalanārakaśarīreṣvavyāptiḥ; duḥkhasyāprayojanatve'pi teṣāṃ pāpakṣayarūpaprayojanahetutvāt | na ca patyādiprītihetuṣu bhṛtyādideheṣu tadekaprayojanatvādativyāptiḥ śaṅkanīyā; tatprayojanasādhanatvenavinā sthityabhāvasya vivakṣitatvāt | krayavikrayādyarhasya tadekaprayojanatvaṃ hi na sidhyati | tatkarmaphalabhogārthatayaiva sadbhāvāditi hyuktam | atastadekaprayojanaśabdasyāpyayamevārthaḥ | atha tatprakāratvaṃ darśayati  tatprakāratvamapīti | viśeṣyapratītisiddhau tatpṛthaksiddhatvena pratītyabhāvastatprakāratvaśabdena vivakṣita ityarthaḥ | pañcamīnirdeśastvaupacārikaḥ | yadvā, tata eva tatprakāratvenoktamityarthaḥ | athavā pṛthaksthitatvapratītyabhāve pratītiviśeṣo hetutayodāhriyate | etat tadekāśrayatvāditritayaṃ sapakṣe'pi darśayati etadeva hīti | vipakṣavyāvṛttatvaṃ darśayati  etatsvabhāveti | īdṛśaprakāratvameva pakṣe matvarthīyapratyayanirapekṣasāmānādhikaraṇyaheturityāha  devamanuṣyādīti | sahopalambhanimasyānyathāsiddhimāha  jātivyaktayoriti | sahopalambhaniyamastvekasāmagrīvedyatvaprayuktaḥ, na tvapṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇatvaprayukta ityarthaḥ | cākṣuṣatvaṃ pradarśanārtham | upādherapakṣasthatvaṃ darśayati  ātmanastviti | ekasāmagrīvedyatvamapṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇatve prayojakamiti tadabhāvāt nāpṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇatvamityāśaṅkayāha  pṛthaggrahaṇeti | svaṃ rūpaṃ svarūpamdharmaḥ | prakāratvameva dharmo yasya tat prakārataikasvarūpam | ekaśabdena kadācidaprakāratvasya vyudāsaḥ | tataśca daṇḍakuṇḍalādivaiṣamyam | kimapṛdhaksiddhaviśeṣaṇatve prayojakāntarābhāvādekasāmagrīvedyatvaṃ prayojakamucyate, utāsyānuyāyitvāt idamapi prayojakamucyate iti vikalpamabhipretya prathamaṃ śiraḥ prativadati  jātyādīti | prakārataikasvabhāvatvāvagamādityatra svabhāvaśabdenaiva prakāratvaniyame siddhe'pyekaśabdaprayogaḥ ekasāmagrīvedyatāsvabhāvatvavyāvṛttyarthaḥ | yadi tadekāśrayatvādirevāpṛthagviśeṣaṇatve prayojakaḥ, kathaṃ tarhi jātyādau sahopalambhaniyama ityatrāha  sahopalambheti | anena pūrvaṃ cākṣuṣatvoktirekasāmagrīvedyatvapradarśanārtheti spaṣṭam |
atha (tra) pūrvoktavikalpe dvitīyaśirasi cāpṛthagviśeṣaṇatvaprayojakatayocyamānamidaṃ kiṃ matvarthīyapratyayanirapekṣasāmānādhikaraṇyaprayogaviṣayeṣu sarveṣvanuyāyi, uta bhavadabhimatajātiguṇeṣvevānuyāyīti vikalpo'bhipretaḥ | tatra na prathamaḥ; dehātmanorekasāmagrīvedyatvābhāvāt | tataśca anugataprayojakasadbhāvādapṛthagviśeṣaṇatvasyāpyanugatatvena sāmānādhikaraṇyaprayogāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ mukhyatve saṃbhavatyapi ananugatamākāraṃ prayojakatvenāṅgīkṛtya, apṛthagviśeṣaṇatvamapi saṅkucitaṃ kṛtvā, taddvārā sāmānādhikaraṇyaprayogāṇāmamukhyatvāśrayaṇamanupapannamityarthasiddham; prakārataikasvabhāvatvāvagamādityatraikaśabdena ekasāmagrīvedyatāsvabhāvatvasya vyudastatvāt | atha parābhimatasthalānuyāyitvarūpe dvitīyaśirasi gandhādau vyābhicāreṇa dūṣaṇaṃ vadan ekasāmagrīvedyatvasyāpṛthagviśeṇatvāvyāpakatvamāha  yatheti | na hyacākṣuṣasyāpi gandhasya pṛthivīniyataprakāratvahāniḥ | evaṃśabdo yathāśabdapratinirdeśarūpaḥ | kasmādagrahaṇamityatrāha  ātmagrahaṇa iti | vyāpakatvābhāvaphalamāha  naitāvateti | etāvatācakṣuṣā grahaṇābhāvamātrāt | na tatprakāratvasvabhāvahāniḥ | ekasāmagrīvedyatvasyāpṛthagviśeṇatāvyāpakatvābhāvāt, tadekāśrayatvādiprayojakāntarasadbhāvācceti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  tatprakārateti | ekaśabda ekasāmagrīvedyatāsvabhāvatvavyudāsaparaḥ | evakāraḥ sahopalambhaniyamavyudāsārthaḥ | apṛthagviśeṇatve sati śarīrasya, kenāpi pramāṇena tat tathopalabhyetetyatrāha  ātmeti |
śabdopi na śarīriparyantābhidhāyīti codayati  nanu ceti | pariharati  naivamiti | imau codyaparihārau ākṛtyadhikaraṇe'pi samānāvityabhiprāyeṇāha  yathā gotvamiti | niṣkaṣarkaśabdānāṃ viśeṣyaparyantābhidhāyakatvābhāve cetanācetanavācinaḥ śabdāḥ na brahmaparyantābhidhāyino bhavanti; "yasyātmā śarīram", "yasya pṛthivī śarīram" ityādiṣvātmādiśabdānāṃ niṣkarṣakaśabdatvāvagamāditi cetucyate | niṣkarṣakaśabdo dvividhaḥ, vaivakṣikaniṣkarṣakaḥ niyataniṣkarṣakaśceti | tatra śarīrādiśabdāḥ niyataniṣkarṣakāḥ, ātmādiśabdā vaivakṣikaniṣkarṣakāḥ, gotvādiśabdavat śuklādiśabdavacca; prayogasya vyavasthāpakatvāt | niṣkarṣakāniṣkarṣakavibhāgo'pi hi prayogādhīnaḥ | tadvadayamapi vibhāgastanmūlaḥ | nanu śuklādiśabdāḥ niyataniṣkarṣakā eva | guṇiparyantatā tu "guṇavacanebhyo matupo lug vaktavyaḥ" iti smaraṇāt | maivam; jātivāciśabdavat apṛthaksiddhaviśeṣavācitvāviśeṣācchuklādiśabdānām | pratyayastu dviśabdasthadvivacanavat prakṛtyanatiriktārthaḥ triliṅgatayā śabdasādhutvāya, svaraviśeṣāya ca bhavati | tata eva hi, "guṇe śuklādayaḥ puṃsi guṇiliṅgāstu tadvati" iti naighaṇṭukāḥ | yataḥ svato guṇiparyantānāmeva guṇavācipadānāṃ liṅgasvarārthaṃ matublopasmaraṇam; na tu guṇyabhidhānaśaktivirahiṇāṃ guṇyabhidhānārtham ata eva hi rāgaśabdasya raktapadatulyatayā prayogābhāvaḥ | ataḥ śuklādiśabdā vaivakṣikaniṣkarṣakāḥ | niyataniṣkarṣakāṇāmapi tathātvaṃ pratiyogiviśeṣasāpekṣam; na tu sārvatrikam | "raso'hamapsu kaunteya prabhā'smi śaśisūryayoḥ | puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca" iti (rasa ?)gandhādiśabdānāmapi parātmaparyantatayā prayogāt | ataḥ pṛthivyādyapekṣayaiva gandhādiśabdānāṃ niyataniṣkarṣakatvam |
śarīravāciśabdānāṃ śarīriparyantatāṃ nigamayati  ato gavādīti | ātmaparyantāḥātmaparyantaśaktayaḥ | śarīravāciśabdairātmabodhanaṃ śaktinibandhanatayā mukhyatvamityarthaḥ |
nanu yadyapi śarīravāciśabdā ākṛtinayagocarāḥ, tathāpi taiḥ śarīribodhanaṃ lākṣaṇikam; gavādiśabdairapi vyaktibodhanasya lākṣaṇikatvāt | saṃbandhānupapattibhyāṃ hi lakṣaṇā | jātimātrasyā''nayanādyanarhatvāt vyaktisaṃbandhācca gavādiśabdairvyaktirlakṣaṇayā bodhyate; prayoge anyathāsiddhe śaktikalpanānupapatteḥ | naivam; ayutasiddhaviśeṣaṇavāciśabdatvasya viśeṣyalakṣaṇāpratibandhakatvāt | anyathā jātyādiśabdānāmapi sambandhānupapattyaviśeṣeṇa kvacidyvaktiparyantaprayogaprasaṅgaḥ |
"ākṛtireva śabdaśaktiviṣayaḥ | vyaktibodhastvarthasāmarthyāt | pratyabhijñāyāṃ saṃskārasacivendriyavat arthasāmarthyasacitā śabdaśaktirviśiṣṭabodhasāmagrī " ityapi na yuktam; jātyādiśabdaśravaṇe'pi viśiṣṭabodhaprasaṅgādeva | na hi satyāṃ sāmagrayāṃ pāryānudaya upapadyate |
nanu gavādiśabdāḥ jātervyāktiparatantratārūpamamidadhati | atastrairvyaktiparyantabodhaḥ | jātyādiśabdāstu jātisvarūpamātram | atastairvyaktiparyantabodhābhāvaḥ | naivam; jātyādiśabdairdravyapāratantrāpratipattau dravyavilakṣaṇatayā jātipratītyanupapatteḥ | nanu na jāterdravyaprakārataikasvabhāvatvarūpapāratantrābodhanaṃ vivakṣitam, kintu viśeṣaṇāntarānvayakārakabhāvānarhatvarūpapāratantrābodhanamiti | ucyate | gavādiśabdaiḥ tādṛktavabodhanamekapadena viśeṣyābhidhānanibandhanam | na hi, kuṇḍalītyukte kuṇḍalasya ruciratvādiviśeṣaṇānvayaḥ, kuṇḍalena bhuṣita itivat kārakabhāvaśca bhavati | evaṃ ca sati pāratastrābodhanād vyaktayabodhane'bhyupagamyamāne anyonyāśrayaḥ syātpāratantrābodhanādviśeṣyābodhanam, tadabodhanāt pāratantrābodhanamiti | kiñca gavādiśabdānāṃ viśeṣyabodhanaśaktivirahe jātyādiśabdānāmiva pāratantryabodhanāsāmarthyaprasaṅgaḥ | dharmibodhanāsāmarthyavyāpakatayā jātyādiśabdeṣu dṛṣṭaṃ pāratantryabodhanāsāmarthyaṃ gavādiśabdebhyo nivartamānaṃ svavyāpyaṃ dharmibodhanāsāmarthyaṃ kathaṃ na nivartayet | dravyāṃśe śaktirmā bhūt; jātervyaktipāratantryamapi gavādiśabdā bodhayeturiti na vācyamdravyāṃśe śaktivirahitairjātyādiśabdairapi dravyapāratantryabodhanaprasaṅgāt | ataḥ śabdaśaktinibandhanaiva gavādiśabdairdravyapratītiḥ |
kiñca yadi jātimātrameva mukhyārthaḥ, tarhyamukhyabhūtadravyapayarntaprayogādapi jātimātre gavādiśabdānāṃ pracuraprayogaprasaṅgaḥ; mukhyārthatadgataguṇasaṃbandhiviṣayaprayogādapi mukhyārthe pracuraprayogadarśanāt | gaṅgāgnisiṃhādiśabdānāṃ kūlamāṇavakādiviṣayaprayogādapi mukhyārthe pracuraprayogo dṛṣṭaḥ | na tu vyaktiniṣṭhā gauḥ, vyaktiniṣṭho mahiṣa iti prayogaḥ | jātireva mukhyārthaścetgavādiśabdānāṃ jātimātraviṣayaprayoge tvatalādinairapekṣyaṃ ca syāt | na hi gaṅgādiśabdāḥ pravāhādiviṣayaprayoge bhāvapratyayāntāḥ prayujyante | pracuraprayogābhāvo bhāvapratyayāpekṣatvaṃ ca gavādiśabdānāṃ vyaktau nirūḍhalakṣaṇāyogāditi cenna | pracuraprayogānugatirhi lakṣaṇāyā nirūḍhiḥ | tataśca pracuraprayogābhāvātpracuraprayogābhāva iti parihāro na ghaṭate | prasaṅgasya prasañjanīyāmāvaparihāryatvābhāvāt | na hyagnimattvaprasaṅgo'gnyabhāvāt parihriyate | bhāvapratyayānapekṣatvaprasaṅgaśca duṣpariharaḥ; śuklādiśabdānāṃ guṇibodhane nirūḍhalakṣaṇābhyupagame'pi paṭasya śukla iti guṇamātrapāprayoge bhāvapratyayānapekṣatvadarśanāt | śuklādiśabdānāṃ hi luptamatubarthalakṣaṇā parairabhyupagatā; yathā samāseṣu prātipadikenāprayuktavibhaktayarthalakṣaṇeṣyate | lakṣaṇāyā nirūḍhirnāma sarvaprayogānugatiriti cenna; gośabde tadabhāvaprasaṅgāt | anuvṛtto govyavahāra iti gotvamātre'pi hi gośabdaḥ kvāpi prayujyate | kiñca sarvaprayogānugatā vṛttirlakṣaṇaiva na syāt; ākṛtiviṣayavṛttivat | nanu ananyathāsiddhā vṛttirmukhyā | satyam; ananyathāsiddhiśca darśitā; ayutasiddhaviśeṣaṇavāciśabdānāṃ viśeṣyalakṣaṇāsāmarthyābhāvasyopapāditatvāt | nanu tvatpakṣe dharmivācipadānāṃ bhāvapradhānanirdeśeṣu mukhyaikadeśe lakṣaṇā'bhimatā; asmākaṃ tu gavādiśabdānāṃ vyaktau lakṣaṇā | tatra śakterviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyagocaratvakalpane bhavatāṃ gauravaṃ syāt | syādeva | sa tu nātra doṣaḥ, lāghavena nirvāhāyogyasthale gauravasya doṣatvābhāvāt | lakṣaṇāśrayaṇānupapattirhi darśitā |
kiñca gāmanayetyādiṣu vyaktipratītirarthasāmarthyādbhavati cettarhi vivakṣitayā jāteḥ pratisaṃbandhibhūtaṃ dravyamupasarjanatayā pratīyate | tataśca putraḥ pitetivat khaṇḍo gaurayamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt | putramānayetyatra hi mayetyanukte'pyarthavaśāt vivakṣitaputrapratisaṃbandhipitṛtvena pratīyamāno devadattaḥ putraṃ prati guṇatayā pratīyate; na tu viśeṣyatvena pradhānatayā; tadavacchedārthatvāt tasya | gavādiśabdeṣu tu dravyameva pradhānatayā pratīyate | gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityatra pravāhasyāvivakṣitatvāt kūlasya tadupasarjanatayā pratītyabhāvaḥ | chatriṇo gacchantītyatra tu acchatriṇāṃ chatripratisaṃbandhitayā pratīyamānatvābhāvāt chatriguṇabhāvena pratītyabhāvaḥ | ato vivakṣitārthapratisaṃndhitayā pratīyamānatve'pi pradhānatayā pratīyamānaṃ dravyaṃ śabdaśaktayaiva pratīyate; ayaṃ putrītyatra putriśabdena pratīyamānaputrivat |
kiñca viśeṣyāṃśe śaktimatā rūpiśabdena rūpapratipattidarśanāt tadrahitena rūpaśabdena viśeṣyapratipattidarśanābhāvācca śabdaviśeṣopaśliṣṭaviśeṣyapratītiranvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdaśaktinibandhanetyadhyavasīyate | ato gavādiśabdānāṃ viśeṣyabodhakatvaṃ śaktinibandhanam |
nanu vyaktīnāmānantyāt tābhiḥ saṃbandhagraho'nupapannaḥ | ekasyāṃ vyaktau śabdavācyatāvyutpattiścetvyaktayantarasya gośabdavācyatvaṃ na syāt | naivam; yatra jātistatrāyāṃ śabda ityevaṃrūpatvādvayutpatteḥ | ato vācyatānimittasyaikatvāt pratyekavyutpattyanapekṣā, yugapatsarvavyaktīnāṃ vācyatāvyutpattiḥ, ekaikavyaktau vācyatānimittasya puṣkalatvādekaikavyaktervācyatvasiddhiśca ghaṭate | kathamanantānāṃ vyaktīnāṃ buddhāvāropaṇaṃ śakyamiti cetvyaktīnāṃ śabdavācyatvaṃ pratiṣedhatā tvayā vyaktayaḥ pratipannāḥ, na vā? na cettāsu śabdavācyatvaviṣedho'nupapannaḥ | "labdharūpe kvacit kiñcit tādṛgeva niṣidhyate" | pratipannāścetkiṃ katipayavyaktayaḥ pratipannāḥ uta sarvāḥ? prathame sarvavyaktīnāṃ śabdavācyatvaniṣedhāyogaḥ | dvitīye tvamiva sarve sarvā vyaktīḥ patipadyeran vyutpadyeraṃśca | ato gavādiśabdāḥ svaśakhktyaiva vyaktibodhakāḥ | tadvat śarīravāciśabdānāmapi svaśaktayaiva śarīriparyantabodhakatvaṃ siddham |
evaṃ śarīravāciśabdāḥ śarīriparyantāḥ syuḥ; tataḥ kiṃ paramātmacicidvāciśabdānāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyasyetyatrāha  evamiti | prayojakākāraṃ vadan nigamayati  ata iti | evaṃ tattvamasītivākyena cidaciccharīrakasya kāraṇāvasthasya kāryāvasthasya ca brahmaṇa ekatvaṃ pratipāditam | na ca prakāryaikyaṃ kāryakāraṇaikyaṃ cetyarthabhedadvākyabhedaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ; prakāritvasya padāvagamyatvāt | tatpadaṃ hi prakṛtavācakam, prakṛtaṃ hi sārvajñyādiguṇakaṃ jagaccharīrakaṃ kāraṇam; "tadaikṣata" "ekameva" "bahu syām" "tattejo'sṛjata" "anupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi" "sadāyatanāḥ satpratiṣṭhāḥ" ityādibhirīkṣitṛtvaikatvānupraveśapūrvakanāmarūpavyākaraṇadhāraṇaśravaṇāt | atastatpadaṃ sārvajñyādiguṇakajagaccharīrakabrahmaparam | tvampadaṃ ca kāryācitsaṃsṛṣṭajīvaviśeṣaviśiṣṭabrahmaparam | ata ubhayāvasthasya brahmaṇaḥ cidacitprakāravattvaṃ padāvagatam | padadvayasthasamānavibhaktyā kāraṇāvasthasya kāryāvasthasya ca brahmaṇa ekatvamavagamyate | ato na vākyabhedaḥ | ataḥ kāryakāraṇāvasthaprakāryekatvaṃ tattvamasīti vākyena pratipāditam |
paramātmānaṃ prati jagataḥ śarīratvaṃ katham? asmin siddhe śarīritvaprayuktā doṣāḥ syuḥ | uktasyānugrāhakasya nyāyasya kimanugrāhyaṃ pramāṇam? kathaṃ vyutpattivirodhaparihāra ityādiśaṅkāyāmāha  ayamartha iti |
pareṇa svarūpaikyaparatvenodāhṛtaṃ sūtraṃ vākyakāravacanañca vyācaṣṭe  idamevetyādinā | atrāyamarthaḥ saṅkalayyānusandheyaḥmṛṣāvādibhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyanirvāhāḥ bahudhā kṛtāḥ | tatra sāmānādhikaraṇyasyātadvayāvṛttimukhena vastumātraparatvaṃ satyādivākyanirūpaṇena nirastam; vyāvṛttīnāmupalakṣaṇatāpakṣe padāntaravaiyarthyāt; viśeṣaṇatvābhyupagame mukhye saṃbhavati lākṣaṇikārthasvīkārāyogācca | tattvamasīti vākye cānvayamukhena svarūpamātraparatve tatpadasya prakṛtaparāmarśitvabhaṅgaḥ, padadvayalakṣaṇā, pravṛttinimittabhedābhāvātsāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇahāniḥ, upalakṣaṇarūpapravṛttinimittāśrayaṇe padāntaravaiyarthyam, "tadaikṣata" ityādyupakramavirodhaḥ, upakramopakramavirodhaḥ, śrutyantaravirodhaḥ, tirodhānādyupapattirūpatarkavirodhaśceti dūṣaṇānyuktāni | bādhārthatve ca svarūpalakṣaṇā nañarthalakṣaṇā ceti padadvayalakṣaṇādayo doṣāḥ | pratyakṣeṇa bādhādarśanādbādhaparatvānupapattiḥ, padāntareṇa virodhidharmānupasthā(pa)nena virodhābhāvādbādhakalpanānupapattirityadhikaṃ dūṣaṇadvayañcoktam | tathā "sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma" ityatra sāmānādhikaraṇyasya ca atadākārāropaṇanibandhanatvamayuktam, sarvatvabrahmatvayorekāśrayatvābhāvena sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇābhāvāt; paramārthata aikādhikaraṇyena saṃbhavati aparamārthaikyaviṣayatvāśrayaṇānupapatteśca | aikyaparamārthye hi sāmānādhikaraṇyavākyabrāmāṇyaṃ hīyate; pratipipādayiṣitasyaikyasya mithyātyāt | evamacidbrahmaṇoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ satyānṛtayoraikyābhāvādayuktam |
antaḥkaraṇacinmātrayoraikyābhāvāt "brahmāhamasmī"ti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na ghaṭate | ahaṃśabdasya antaḥkaraṇopahitajñaptivācitvāt tadupapattiriti cenna; ahaṃśabdasyāntaḥkaraṇopahitajñaptivācitvābhāvāt, yathā ahamicchāmi dveṣmītīcchāderahamarthaviśeṣaṇatayā vyavahārāt ahaṃśabdasya nāntaḥkaraṇopahitecchādivācitvam evamahaṃ jānāmīti prayogāt tadupahitajñaptivācitvamapyahaṃśabdasyānupapannam | na hi jñaptireva jñaptyā viśeṣyate | jñātṛjñeyatadavacchinnajñānātiriktasya kasyacit jñānasya śaśaviṣāṇāyamānasya laukikabuddhayagocaratvāt na tadvivakṣāyā'haṃśabdaprayogopapattiḥ| ataḥahaṃ brahmāsmīti sāmānādhikaraṇyamayuktam | antaḥkaraṇadvayaikyābhāvāt ahamādiśabdānāṃ pūrvoktanyāyena tadupahitajñaptivācitvābhāvācca ahaṃ manurabhavamityādisāmānādhikaraṇaṃñcānupapannam | prāṇādyacetanajīvayoraikyābhāvāt, "prāṇo'smi prajñātmā", "ahamevedaṃ sarvam", "mattaḥ sarvamahaṃ sarvam" ityādi cāyuktam | "ahaṃ hariḥ sarvamidaṃ janārdanaḥ" iti jīveśvaravācinoḥ acidīśvaravācinośca śabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamayuktam; jīveśvarayoḥ pṛthivyādīnāṃ ca cinmātre kalpitatvāt | na hi rajjukalpitasarpabhūdalanāmbudhārāvācināṃ śabdānāṃ mithaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam |
ahaṃ hatiḥ sarvamityādiśabdānām adhyastavācināmadhiṣṭhānabhūtabrahmaparatvādekārthavṛttitvamiti cenna; ākṛtivācināṃ vyaktiparyantatayeva adhyastavācināṃ śabdānāmadhiṣṭhānavācitvena vyutpattyabhāvāt | na iha rajataśabdasya śuktitvāśrayadravyavācitvena vyutpattiḥ | tadabhāvaśca śuktiśakalādau rajatādiśabdapravṛttinimittabhūtarajatatvāderabhāvāt | nanu ayastavācinaḥ śabdāḥ adhiṣṭhāne mukhyavṛttāḥ, idaṃ rajatamiti vṛddhavyavahāramūlavyutpattisadbhāvāditi cetucyate | yadarthavivakṣayā śabdaprayogo'nanyathāsiddhaḥ, tasya tadvācitvaniścayaḥ | tatredaṃ vaktavyamadhyastavācinaḥ śabdasyādhiṣṭhānaparyantatve kiṃ bhrāntaprayogo mūlam, uta prabuddhaprayogaḥ? | na prathamaḥ, rajatapurovarttinoranadhyastatvānadhiṣṭhānatvabuddhayaiva tatra rajataśabdaprayoga iti tasyādhyastavācino'dhiṣṭhānaparyantatvāsādhakatvam | na hyadevadattatvājñānāt devadattaśabdaprayogo devadattaśabdasya yajñadattavācitve mūlaṃ bhavati | dvitīye ca rajjuḥ sarpa iti prayogaḥ sarpaśabdasya prāganāropitabuddhimūlaprayogānuvādarūpatvāt āropitaviṣayaśaktikalpena mūlaṃ na syāt | nanvapṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇavāciśabdānāṃ viśeṣyaparyantatvamiṣṭam | adhyastañca adhiṣṭhānasyāpṛthagviśeṣaṇam, tasmin sati avabhāsāt tena vinā tadanavabhāsācceticetna; anyatra sato viśeṣaṇasya purovasthittaṃ prati apṛthaksiddhayabhāvāt | akhyātipakṣe cādhyastatvādhiṣṭhānatvayorevābhāvāt | mṛṣāvādipakṣe ca mṛddhivartasya ghaṭādeḥ kanakaṃ pratīva avidyākhyadoṣavivartasya rajatasya purovasthitaṃ prati apṛthagviśeṣaṇatvāyogācceti |
ato jīveśvarasāmānādhikaraṇyamayuktam |
kiñca tattvamasyādivākyeṣu brahmavācakapadasamabhivyāhṛtaṃ tvamādijīvavācipadaṃ kiṃ mukhyārthaprahāṇena samānādhikaraṇam, uta tatprahāṇena? | prathame vastunaḥ saviśeṣatvam, doṣārhatadanarhayoraikyānupapattiśca | dvitīye jīvabrahmaṇoraikyaṃ na sidhyet | jīvabhāvasya mithyātvenādhiṣṭhānamātrapāramārthyaṃ ca na sidhyet | prakṛtyaṃśavivakṣitārthaikatvaparāyāḥ samānavibhaktestadavivakṣitārthaikatvapratipādanāsāmarthyāt; tadavivakṣitaviśeṣaṇamithyātvapratipādanāsāmarthyācca | na hi prahṛṣṭo janapadaḥ, agnirmāṇavaka ityatra janapadapraharṣavatoragnimāṇavakayoścaikatvaṃ janapadatvāgnitvayormithyātvena tadadhiṣṭhānamātrapāramārthyaṃ ca sidhyati | janapadaśabdena vācyabahirbhūto lakṣyate, tvaṃśabdena tu vācyaikadeśo lakṣyata iti, tasya tattāvidyāne'dhiṣṭhānaikyaṃ virodhāt jīvabhāvamithyātvaṃ ca sidhyatīti cennatvamādiśabdānāṃ jñātṛpadasamānādhikaraṇānāṃ jñaptivaiyadhikaraṇyena jñaptivācitvāsiddhayā vācyaikadeśalakṣaṇāyā durvacatvāt | tatsiddhāvapi nādhiṣṭhānaikyamitarākāramithyātvañca sidhyet | na hi dūrasthasyaparvatasyāgre jvalantamagniṃ dṛṣṭvā parvato jvalita ityukte parvatāgnyorekatvaṃ sānvādipradeśāntaramithyātvenādhiṣṭhānamātrapāramārthyaṃ ca sidhyati | ato vivakṣitaikatvajīvabhāvamithyātvāsiddhiḥ | ataḥ sarvaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ mṛṣāvādināṃ viruddham |
aupādhikabhedābhedapakṣe'pi mukhyayā vṛttyā sāmānādhikaraṇyamanupapannam | tathā hiīśvara eva hi brahma tanmate | jīveśvarayoracidīśvarayośca kleśakarmādyarhatvatadanarhatvapariṇāmitvāpariṇāmitvalakṣaṇaviruddhasvabhāvayogāt tadvāciśabdānāṃ ghaṭapaṭādiśabdānāmiva na sāmānādhikaraṇyam | bhedavat abhedavasyāpi vidyamānatvāt tadupapattiriti cet, na; satyapi kenāpyākāreṇaikye pravṛttinimittabhāvābhāvalakṣaṇe viśeṣyāṃśabhede pratīyamāne samānavibhakterekatvapratipādanāsāmarthyāt | yataḥ prathamapadapratipannaviśeṣyāt padāntara(pratipanna?)viśeṣyasyāṃśato'pi bhedāsahamabhinnatvameva sāmānādhikaraṇayāvabodhyam, tat eva hi khaṇḍamuṇḍayorvyakjiātyātmanā, ghaṭaśarāvayoḥ kāryakāraṇarūpeṇa, gopucchayorekadeśaikadeśibhāvena bhinnatvavat abhinnatve'bhyupagamyamāne'pi khaṇḍo muṇḍaḥ, ghaṭaḥ śarāvaḥ, gauḥ pucchamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ |
nanu cidacitorbrahmaikadeśatvāt śuklaḥ kṛṣṇo raktāścāyaṃ paṭa itivat "vyaktaṃ viṣṇustathā'vyaktaṃ puruṣaḥ kāla eva ca" ityādisāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyate | naivam; ekadeśaikadeśibhāve satyapi aṅguliḥ puruṣa iti sāmānādhikaraṇyādarśanāt | nanu śuklādiśabdatulyatvaṃ kiṃ na syāt | ucyate; paṭasyāṃśabhede śuklādiśabdānāṃ paṭaśabdaśravaṇātprāk mithassāmānādhikaraṇyabhāve ca satyapi śauklayādīnāmapṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇatayā śuklādiśabdairviśeṣyaparyantaissaṃhatya citraśabdenevābhihitādviśeṣyāt paṭaśabdābhihitaviśeṣyasyāṃśato'pyanatirekāt sāmānādhikaraṇyam | hastādīnāmekadeśānāṃ chedanādyarhāṇāmekadeśinaṃ prati apṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ nāsti; chedanādāvapīndriyāṇāmavināśitvāt tattadgolakasyāpracyutasvarūpatvācca | evañca sati chinnaastādivat mṛtaśarīrasyāpi apratyutasvarūpopalabhbhādātmānaṃ prati tasya nāpṛthaksiddhiḥ syāditi cetna; śarīrākhyasaṅghātaśaithilyānantarameva ātmokramaṇāt | paścāccharīrabuddherdagdhapaṭe paṭabuddhinyāyena bhrāntirūpatvāt | astādīnāṃ tu chedanadaśāyāmaśithilasvāṃśānāṃ paścācchaithilyamiti viśeṣaḥ | atastadvāciśabdānāṃ hastādimātravācitvāddhastādyavayavasaṅghātātmakasyaikadeśino hastādimātrātirekādanatirekalakṣaṇamekatvaṃ pramāṇaviruddhatayā samānavibhaktirna pratipādayituṃ śaknoti |
nanu hastatvādayo dharmāḥ śauklayādivadapṛthaksiddhāḥ ghaṭasyeva śarīrāderekadeśe vartante | ataḥ śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ paṭa itivat hastaḥ pādo manuṣya iti yuktaṃ vaktum | yuktyanabhijñatvālloko na prayuṅkte | ucyate | yuktayanabhijño'bhijño'pi (vijño'pi) lokaḥ śuklādiśabdān viśeṣyaparyantān prayuṅkte; na tu hastādiśabdān ekadeśiparyantān | ato'bhijñānabhijñaprayogānuguṇavyavasthāpakaṃ vaktavyam | tad brūmaḥ | kecidapṛthaksiddhadharmāḥ kasyacidekadeśa eva niyamena vartante; ekadeśe vā'nyatra vā kecidaniyamena vartante | tatra nitaikadeśavṛttidharmavācinaḥ śabdāḥ tattadekadeśabhūtadravyamātre vartante; ekadeśatvapratītyutpādananiyamāt | ekadeśatayaiva hi hastādayaḥ pratīyante | ekadeśavṛttiniyamarahitadhamarvācinaḥ śabdā ekadeśatvapratītiniyamamapahāya viśeṣye vartante | ataḥ śuklādiśabdairekadeśatvaṃ hitvā tadāśrayamātropasthāpanāt tadupasthāpitāśrayāt paṭatvāśrayasyānatirekāt paṭaśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ yuktam | ekadeśamātropasthāpakairhastādiśabdairekadeśino'nupasthāpitatvena hastādiprātipadikapratipannaviśeṣyātirekāt sāmānādhikaraṇyamayuktam | yadi kvacit sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vidyate, tatra hastādiśabdasya tadvati lakṣaṇayā vā manuṣyādiśabdasya tadekadeśalakṣaṇayā vā prādhānyādyabhiprāyeṇopacāreṇa vā syāt | chidramākāśa ityatra tvākāśatvasya samudāyavṛttitvābhāvena chidre puṣkalatayā naikadeśalakṣaṇā | jīvatvācittvādidharmāśca tvanmate brahmaṇo nitaiyakadeśavṛttaya iti na tadvāciśabdairīśvaravāciśabdānāṃ mukhyayā vṛttyā sāmānādhikaraṇyam |
nanu śiraḥ pāṇirudaraṃ pādaśca śarīramiti dṛśyate prayogaḥ | satyam; prabhūtakṛtsnāvayavopādāne'vayavinastadatirekāt sāmānādhikaraṇyasaṃbhavaḥ | pratyekaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tu ekadeśalakṣaṇāprasaṅgādamukhyameva | evaṃ cidviśeṣavāciśabdeṣvaikaikasyeśvaravācipadasāmānādhikaraṇyamayuktaṃ syāt | ekadeśavāciśabdānāmekadeśini śaktayabhāvāt, "vyaktaṃ viṣṇustathā'vyaktam", "jyotīṃṣi viṣṇurbhuvanāni viṣṇuḥ", bhūtāni viṣṇuḥrbhuvanāni viṣṇuḥ" iti hi pratyekaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam | "ahaṃ sarvam" ityacijjīvavācipadayorapi tadvadeva sāmānādhikaraṇyamayuktam | sarvatrāmukhyayā vṛttyā brahmopasthāpanena sāmānādhikaraṇye sa eva doṣaḥ mukhyasāmānādhikaraṇye saṃbhavatyamukhyavṛttyāśrayaṇasyānyāyyatvāt |
svābhāvikabhedābhedapakṣ'pi bhoktṛbhogyaniyantṝṇāṃ trayāṇāmapi brahmāṃśatvābhyupagamādacijjīvayoracidīśvarayorjīveśvarayośca sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ghaṭaḥ śarāva itivadanupapannamityetadavasthitam | aṃśato'pi viśeṣyabhedāsahasyaivābhedasya sāmānādhikaraṇyabodhyatvāt teṣāṃ brahmasāmānādhikaraṇyamapi cintyam | brahmavācipadānāṃ sattvadravyatvavādiḥ sādhāraṇākāraḥ pravṛttinimittaṃ cet, tattvamasītyukte, sadasi dravyamasītyuktaṃ syāt | tadānīmupadeśavaiyarthyam | na hi kaścitahamasat, ahamadravyamiti manyate | sadantaraikatvamupadeṣṭavyamiti cenna; tasya sāmānādhikaraṇyabodhyatvābhāvāt | sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ hi pūrvanirdiṣṭasya viśeṣyasya padāntaropasthāpitaviśeṣaṇānvayamavagamayati; na tu tadviśeṣaṇānvitavastvantaraikyam | na hi brāhmaṇastmasītyukate tvaṃśabdanirdiṣṭasya brāhmaṇāntaraikyaṃ pratipāditaṃ bhavati | kiṃtu tasya brāhmaṇatvaviśeṣaṇavaiśiṣṭayameva | ato vivakṣitaikatvāsiddherupadeśavaiyarthyameva | yadi aṃśaviśeṣāsādhāraṇākāraḥ pravṛttinimittam, tadā brahmādiśabdānāṃ taditarāṃśavācipadasāmānādhikaraṇye virodhaḥ syāt | tadā niratiśayabṛhattvaṃ pravṛttinimittam, tadā tattvamasītyukte niratiśayabṛhadasītyuktaṃ syāt | tataścāṇorjīvasya niratiśayabṛhattvavirodhaḥ | tvaṃ niratiśayabṛhadvastunoṃśa ityarthaścet, ekadeśalakṣaṇā | na hi brahmaśabdasya bṛhadekadeśo mukhyārthaḥ | evamasādhāraṇākārāntarasya pravṛttinimittatve'pyanupapattirdraṣṭavyā |
ataḥ kudṛṣṭitrayapratyanīkaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhāṣyakārapakṣa eva mukhyam |
vyākhyānāntaroktanirvāhāt bhavaduktanirvāhasya kiṃ vaiṣamyam | kiñcaātmabhede siddhe hi śarīraśarīribhāvaḥ | sa eva nāsti; kālaviśeṣe aikyapratipādanāt; "puruṣaścāpyubhāvetau līyete paramātmani", "sakāśādātmanastadvadātmānaḥ prabhavanti hi" ityādibhiścidacitorutpattipralayapratipādanāt kāryakāraṇayorekadravyatvācca | na hyekameva vastu śarīraṃ śarīri ca bhavati tasmāt svarūpapariṇāmapakṣeṇaiva nirvāho varamiti śaṅkāparihārārtham, sakalaśrutīnāṃ mukhyārthatvajñāpanārtham, teṣu teṣu pradeśeṣu viprakīrṇam uktānāmarthānāṃ saṅkalayya pradarśanena sugrahatvāpādanārthañcā''rabhate atredaṃ tattvamiti | bhogyatvena bhoktṛtvena ceti caśabda īśitavyatvena tayorekakoṭiniveśāt | "asmānmāyī" ityatra māyāśabdārthaṃ niṣkraṣṭumupādatte māyāṃ tu prakṛtimiti | anyaśabdavācya ātmeti spaṣṭayitumāha  kṣaraṃ pradhānamiti | arthāntarabhramahetutvāt haraśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe pradhānamiti | atra "vyaktāvyaktaṃ bharate viśvamīśaḥ" iti pūrvavākye śravaṇāt dhāryatvadhārakatvalakṣaṇabhedo'pi siddhaḥ | īśvareśitavyatārūpabhedaṃ darśayati sa kāraṇamiti | karaṇādhipādhipaśabdavyākhyānārthamāha  pradhāneti | guṇeśaḥguṇānāṃ sattvarajatastamasāṃ niyantā | ananyeśvaratvaṃ darśayati  patimiti | anena śeṣaśeṣitvalakṣaṇabhedo'pi siddhaḥ | na ca"pā rakṣaṇe" iti dhātorvyutpannatvāt patiśabdo rakṣakavācī, na śeṣitvavācītivācyam; śeṣiṇi rūḍhatvāt | anyathā "gamerḍoḥ" iti ḍopratyayāntagamidhātorniṣpannatvāt gośabdasya manuṣyādivācakatvaprasaṅgaḥ | gatimatsu sarveṣu prayogābhāvāt, tiṣṭhatyapi gavi prayogāt tatra rūḍhiśaktayāśraya iti cetevam, "vṛddhau ca mātāpitarau sādhvī bhāryā sutaḥ śiśuḥ | apyakāryaśataṃ kṛtvā bhartavyā manurabravīt" iti nyāyena pitṛsaṃrakṣake putre pitrādyapekṣayā patiśabdaprayogābhāvāt gṛhādyarakṣake'pi svāmini patiśabdaprayogācca śeṣiṇi patiśabdo rūḍhaḥ | tathā, "dāsabhūtāḥ svataḥ sarve hyātmānaḥ paramātmanaḥ" tathā, "nantavyaḥ paramaḥ śeṣī śeṣā nantāra īritāḥ | nantṛnantavyabhāvo'yaṃ na prayojanapūrvakaḥ" iti dāsaśeṣaśeṣiśabdaprayogo bhagavacchāstreṣu dṛśyate | patyādiśabdābhāve'pi, "vrīhīn prokṣati" ityādau dvitīyāśrutyā prokṣaṇādevrīhyādiśeṣatvavat, "yasyātmā śarīram" ityādinā jagataḥ paramātmaśarīratvāvagamāt śarīrapārāthyarsya ca "saṅghātaparārthatvāt" ityādibhiḥ prasiddhatvācca jagadbrahmaṇoḥ śeṣaśeṣibhāvaḥ siddhaḥ |
ato yathokta evārthaḥ | mukhāntareṇāpi bhedasidiṃdha darśayati  jñājñāviti | utpattipralayābhāvapratipādanaṃ darśayati nityo nityānāmiti | ākārāntareṇāpi bhedamāha  bhokteti | bhagavato'spṛṣṭadoṣatvaṃ darśayati  tayoriti | bhedajñānasya mokṣahetutvamāha  pṛthagiti | muktau bhedamāha  ajāmiti | jīveśvarayoḥ svato bhedaṃ saviśeṣatvaṃ ca spaṣṭayitumāha  samāna iti | pṛthaktavajñānasya mokṣopāyatvaparasya vākyadvayasya madhye ajāmekāmityādivākyamupāttam, "samāne vṛkṣe", "ajāmekām" iti pradhānaprasaṅgopetatvasāmyāt | juṣṭamprīyamāṇam | smṛtāvapīti | aṣṭadhā bhinnā prakṛtirmametyanena kāraṇāvasthāyāmapi bhedasiddhaḥ | māmikāṃ prakṛtiṃ kalpakṣaye yāntītyatrāpi tathā | prakṛtiṃ svāmavaṣṭabhya visṛjāmītyatrāpi tatsiddhiḥ | mayā'dhyakṣeṇetya tu svabhāvāsaṅkaraḥ kāraṇāvasthāyāṃ bhedaśca sidhyataḥ | prakṛtimityatrānāditvakaṇaṭhoktiḥ | mametyatrāpi kāraṇāvasthāyāṃ bhedasiddhiḥ | udāhṛtasmṛtivacaneṣu vyākhyeyāṃśaṃ vyācaṣṭe  jagadyonīti | jagadyoniśabdena "triguṇaṃ tajjagadyoniḥ" iti vacanaṃ smāryate | kāryāvasthavyāvṛttyarthaṃ bhūtasūkṣmamityuktam | evaṃ cidadiśvarabhede sati kathamekatvāvadhāraṇamupapadyata iti śaṅkāyāṃ ghaṭakaśrutīravatārayati  evamiti | "ya pṛthivīmantare sañcaran" iti subālopaniṣadi śrūyate | maraṇamādivyāvṛttyarthaṃ mṛtyuśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe  atreti | līyata iti vacanāt | kramapratyabhijñānādityarthaḥ | "yasyāvyaktaṃ śarīraṃ yasyākṣaraṃ śarīraṃ yasya mṛtyuḥ śarīram" iti kramo hi "avyaktamakṣare līyate akṣaraṃ tamasi līyate"iti krameṇa saṅgacchate | tamasa ekībhāvamātraṃ śrutam, nalayaḥ; tamastvaprahāṇābhāvāt | kāryānupayuktatamaśśarīrake deve kāryopayuktasya tasyaikībhāvaḥ | mṛtyusaṃjñasya tamasaḥ śarīratvaśravaṇāt viśeṣaṇamūtatamasā tamasa ekībhāvo yuktaḥ | sarvātmatvavivaraṇāyāha  antaḥ praviṣṭa iti | anenāpi śarīrātmabhāvaḥ phalitaḥ | antaḥ praviśya niyāmyatvaṃ hi śarīratvam | antaḥpraveśaśāstibhyāṃ nṛpagaganavyāvṛttiriti | etadapi śarīralakṣaṇaṃ bhāṣyakārābhipretam | bhedaśrutighaṭakaśrutyavirodhenaikyavākyānāmarthamāha  evamiti | ghaṭakatayopāttaṃ sanmūlā iti | atrāpīti | chāndogyaprakaraṇe taittirīyaprakaraṇe cetyarthaḥ | hantāhamityādi chādogye | tatsṛṣṭvetyādi taittirīye | jīvenātmanetyasya vyākhyānārthamāha  aneneti | anupraveśaśravaṇābhāve'pi sāmānyenoktaṃ nāmarūpavyākaraṇamanupraveśapūrvakanāmarūpavyākaraṇe paryavasyati sāmānyaviśeṣānyāyādityāha  evambhūtameveti | yadvā sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyena kvacidanuktasyānyato grāhyatvāt kvacit jñāto'nupraveśaḥ kāryopayogitayā apekṣitatvādanyatrāpi svīkārya ityāha  evamiti | evambhūtaśabdo'nupraveśapūrvakatvaparaḥ | anena nāmarūpavyākaraṇaśrutyupādānena jīvānāmutpattipralayau nāmarūpavyākaraṇatadabhāvau; na tu svarūpaniṣpattivināśāvityuktaṃ bhavati | anena pūrvoktaśaṅkā ca parihṛtā; kālaviśeṣoktamaikyaṃ nāmarūpavyākaraṇābhāvamātram; na tu svarūpaikyamityavagamāt |
atha sarvaśrutīnāmasminnarthe mukhyatvaṃ darśayan prathamamekavijñānena sarvavijñānaṃ paramate'nupapannamiti prāguktaṃ svamata upapannamityāha  ata iti | kāryakāraṇoraikyapratipādanāt ekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñānāt sāmānādhikaraṇyācceti tridhā hyadvaitapratītiḥ | atra pūrvoktadyamasmaduktaprakāreṇopapannamiti ata ityādibhāṣyeṇoktaṃ bhavati | viśiṣṭaṃ kāraṇam, tadeva kāryamiti kāraṇāt kāryasyānanyatvam | ataḥ kāryakāraṇayoraikyaparāṇāṃ śrutīnāṃ tayorekadravyatvameva pratipādyam; na tu viśiṣṭatvaniṣedhaḥ, tasya vihitatvāt | evavijñānena sarvavijñānamapi evameva | yathā matpiṇḍena tatkāryajñāne'pi piṇḍagatarūpādiniṣedho na kṛtaḥ syāt, tadvat | upapannataramiti tarappratyayena mukhyatvaṃ sarvatrāpi vivakṣitam | evaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyasya mukhyatvamāha  ahamimā iti | upādānatvasvabhāvāsaṅkarau kathamupapate ityatrāha  ataḥ sthūleti | bhāvyavasthāviśeṣavataḥ prāgavasthāyāgo hyupādānatvam | ato'vasthāviśeṣau sthūlasūkṣmaśabdābhyāṃ darśitau | anena kālaviśeṣāvacchinnaikatvāvadhāraṇaṃ nāmarūpavibhāgābhāvābhiprāyamiti phalitam | upādātve'pi svabhāvāsaṅkaramāha  sūkṣmeti | dṛṣṭāntenemamarthamupapādayati yatheti | nanu śuklakṛṣṇāditantavaḥ kāraṇavasthāyāmapi bhinnāḥ | na ca teṣvanyatamaṃ prati anyatamasya kāraṇatvam | atastatra svabhāvāsaṅkaraḥ | atra tu viśvasya saṅghātopādānatve'pi kāraṇavasthāyāṃ paramātmaika eva svaśabdena śrūyate; na tu cetanācetanau | kiñca paramātmanaḥ prāgekatvaṃ tasmāditarayordvayorutpattyādikaṃ ca śrūyate | ato na sbhāvasaṅkara ityatrāha  tantūnāmiti | na hi tantuṣvanyonyaguṇapradhānabhāvo'stīti na tatrānyatamavāciśabdena samudāya ucyate | atra tu sarvaprakārasya bhagavataḥ savarśabdavācyatvamupapannamityanyatamavāciśabdenāpi viśiṣṭamevocyata iti viśiṣṭasyaiva kāraṇatvāt prāgapi bhedo'stīti svabhāvāsaṅkara upapanna ityarthaḥ | kenākāreṇa sādharmyamityatrāha  svabhāveti | rumāgatetarapadārthānāṃ lavaṇatvāpattivat brahmaṇo'nyathābhāvamāśaṅkayāha  evañceti | tarhyupādānatvamevānupapannamityatrāha  sthūlāvasthasyeti | ātmatayā'vasthānāt kathaṃ kāryatvamityatrāha  avastheti | avikāratvaśrutīnāṃ prakṛtigatasvarūpānyathābhāvarūpavikāro brahmaṇi nāstītyarthaḥ | kāryāvasthacidacinniyamanarūpāvasthāntarāpattirbrahmaṇaḥ kāryatvamiti kāryatvavādinīnāṃ śrutīnāmityarthaḥ | na hi kāraṇāvasthaniyamanaṃ kāryāvasthaniyamanaṃ bhavati | tattadavasthacidacinniyanarūpaviśeṣā eva brahmaṇo'dvārakāvasthāḥ | svarūpānyathābhāvajñānasaṅkocādirūpavikārāstu sadvārakāvasthā ityarthaḥ | yathā grāhakagrahaṇena saṃnidhisamāmnāteṣu vastuṣu paramāpūrvaśeṣatayā'vagateṣu yāgavrīhyāderadvārakaśeṣatvaṃ prokṣaṇādeḥ sadvārakaśeṣatvaṃ ca mukhyamevāvagamyate, tathā bahu syāmiti prāhakaprahaṇena sarvāvasthāsu paramātmīyatayā'vagatāsu svarūpānyathābhāvajñānasaṅkocādirūpasadvārakāvasthāyāḥ tattanniyamanarūpādvārakāvasthāyāśca paramātmīyatvaṃ mukhyameveti bhāvaḥ | nirguṇeti apahatapāpmetyādi cātra kiñcidvivṛtam | śrutireveti | matāntaroktanirvāheṣu śrutahāniraśrutakalpanaṃ cāsti; atra tu nirvāhaḥ śrauta eva, śrutānuguṇaśceti vaiṣamyamiti bhāvaḥ |
atha ārthaguṇaniṣedhapraratvena parābhimatānāṃ śrutīnāmarthamāha  jñānasvarūpamiti | sarvajñasyetyādipadāni maṅgalaguṇaviśeṣavidhāyivākyasmaraṇārthāni | "tadguṇasāratvāt" ityādisūtrasiddhamevātra nirvāhadvayamuktam | īśvarasya jñātṛtatvāt jñānaikanirūpaṇīyatvamuktam | jñāturhi jñānaṃ nirūpakam | tarapo mukhyatvamarthaḥ | jñānasvarūpatvajñānaguṇakatvaparāḥ śrutīrdarśayati  yaḥ sarvajña iti | jñānasvarūpatāmubhayathāpi jñānavyapadeśayogyatām | jñānaguṇakatvasya jñānasvarūpatvasya ca vihitatvādubhayamapyupapannamityarthaḥ | jñānasya jñānāśrayatvānupapatticodyaparihāraḥ pūrvameva kṛtaḥ |
bhedaniṣedhaśrutīnāmarthamāha  so'kāmayateti | vicitrasthiratrasarūpatayāvicitravastunānātvamityarthaḥ | yadvā sthiratrasarūpatayāsthiratrasātmakatvāt | abrahmātmaketi | abrahmabhūtamityarthaḥ | tathā sati kāryakāraṇabhedaniṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt | aikyaśrutīnāṃ prakāryaikyaparatvādaikyaśrutiviśeṣabhūtabhedaniṣedho'pi tadanurodhena prakāribhedaniṣedha eva bhavitumarhatītyarthaḥ | niṣedhasāmānyaṃ hi viśeṣavidhāne dṛṣṭe tadyvatiriktaviṣayaṃ dṛṣṭam, "na hiṃsyāt" ityādiṣu | viśeṣavidhānaṃ sāmānyaniṣedho bādhate cetvaidhahiṃsāyā adharmatvaprasaṅga ityabhiprāyeṇāha  na punariti | uktamarthamupakrameṇaivopapādayati yatra tvasyeti | yo'nyatrātmana iti | anyatretyavyayaṃ vināśaśabdaparyāyam | brahmaṇaḥ pṛthagbhūtaṃ tadavinābhāvarahitaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ | bhedaviśeṣaniṣedhadarśanāt sāmānyena bhedaniṣedho'pi tatraiva paryavasyati, "chāgo vā mantravarṇāt" iti nyāyāditi bhāvaḥ |
itaravyākhyātṛbhiḥ bhavadbhirapi nirvāhaprakārāḥ kṛtāḥ; tatra ko viśeṣa ityatrāha  evamiti | asmaduktanirvāhaḥ śrutibhirevoktaḥ, śrutyanuguṇaśca; tatkṛtanirvāhaḥ śrutiviruddhaḥ, aśrutaḥ, tarkābhāsamūlaścetyarthaḥ | apanyāyamūlasya sakalaśrutiviruddhasyeti sarvatrānveti | anyasyeti svābhāvikabhedābhedaṃ svaniṣṭhabhedaṃ cāha | imamarthaṃ vaidikadṛṣṭāntenopapādayati cidacidīśvarāṇāmiti | āgneyaḥ agnīṣomīyopāṃśuyājau aindrau dvau aindrāgnaśceti  ṣaḍyāgāḥ | utpattivākyaiḥ"yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati" ityevamādibhiḥ | utpattivākyamiti prathamapratipattijanakaṃ vākyam (ucyate? |) pṛthagutpannān pṛthak pratipādatān | samudāyānuvādivākyadvayena"ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ yajate", "ya evaṃ vidvānamāvāsyāṃ yajate" ityetābhyām | darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmiti | svargasādhanatvākāreṇaikīkṛtya tatkartavyatayā vidadhātītyarthaḥ | tathā atrārthapratipādanaṃ darśayati  tatheti | śarīribhūteti | kāraṇāvasthaḥ kāryāvasthaśca paramātmaika eveti vacanabhaṅgayā pṛthakpratipannaṃ vastutritayaṃ pratipādayatītyarthaḥ | āgneyādisamudāye anyatamavāciśabdaiḥ samudāyābhidhānaṃ na dṛṣṭam; atra tu paramātmavāciśabdena samudāyābhidhānaṃ kathamityatrā''ha cidacidvastviti | dṛṣṭāntamāha  yatheti | tatra anyonyaṃ prakāraprakāribhāvābhāvādanyatamavāciśabdena na samudāyābhidhānam; atra tu tathābhāvādupapannam | katham | ucyate; arthasāmarthyāt śabdasāmarthyācca | cidacitorapṛthaksiddhaprakāratvāt niṣkṛṣṭabrahmaṇaḥ kāraṇatvānupapattyā ca prakārivāciśabdena viśiṣṭopasthāpanasiddhiḥ | sadbrahmaśabdau viśiṣṭasya sattvabṛhattvayogādviśiṣṭopasthāpanasamarthau | ātmaśabdaśca vyāptirūpapravṛttinimittasya vyāpyasāpekṣatvādviśiṣṭopasthāpaka iti | yadvā "akṣarāt saṃbhavatai viśvam", "yaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvavit yasya jñānamayaṃ tapaḥ | tasmādetadbrahma nāmarūpamannaṃ ca jāyate", "ātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ" ityādiṣu paramātmamātravācibhiḥ śabdaiḥ kāraṇamucyate | teṣāṃ viśeṣaṇabhūtacidacidabhidhāne śaktirnāsti | lakṣaṇāyāṃ sa eva doṣaḥ | ataḥ sarvatra svarūpariṇāma eva svarasaprāpta ityatrāha cidaciditi | śrutyantarabalena svarūpavikārāsaṃbhavāt kāryopayuktamanuktamapi viśeṣaṇaṃ pṛṣadājyanayādatharsvabhāvena saṃnidhāpitamanusandheyamiti bhāvaḥ | tadeva lokaprayogeṇāpi draḍhayati  yatheti | ayamātmā sukhītyātmaviśeṣasya sukhitvavidhāne śarīrahitasyātmano vaiṣayikasukhāsaṃbhavāt tādṛśasukhopayuktamanuṣyādipiṇḍaviśiṣṭatvamarthataḥ sidhyati; tadvaditi bhāvaḥ |
nivṛttyanupapatiṃta vaktumanuvadati  yat punariti | dūṣayati  tadayuktamityādinā | prapañcasya jñānabādhyatvaṃ jñānasya caikyaviṣayatvamubhayamapi parābhimatam | tatra prathamaṃ jñānabādhyatvānupapattimāha  bandhasyeti | sarvapramāṇānuguṇaṃ pāramārthyamupapādayati  puṇyāpuṇyeti | pratītimātrasiddhasya hetuhetumadbhāvaniyamo'nupapannaḥ; paramārthasyaivārthakriyākāritvādutpattimattvācca | asatyasya hetutvāsaṃbhavamutpattyasaṃbhavaṃ ca prāgupapaditamupajīvyoktam | na hi pratītimātrasiddhamanyatra vidyamānaṃ vastvai kimapyutpādayati; nāpi svamidānīmutpādyate | kiñca aparamārthatya bhrāntijñānasāmagrīvyatiriktahetusāpekṣatvaṃ ca na dṛṣṭam | na cāṅkurādisāmagyrena bhramasāmagrī; giriśikharagatamṛtsalilabījasaṃbandhena apavarakagatasyāṅkurabhramaprasaṅgāt | na ca padāthrānāmarthakriyākāritvamutpattimattvaṃ ca mithyeti vācyam, jñānabādhyatvābhāvāt | kiñca mithyātve pāpakaraṇe'pi na prāyaścittāpekṣā, mithyeti buddhirevālamiti bhāvaḥ |
bhavatā'pi jñānanivartyatvamavidyāyā vaktavyam, tacca satyatve kathamupapadyata ityatrāha  evaṃrūpeti | paramārthasya jñānanivartyatvaṃ dṛṣṭadvārā nopapadyate; api tvadṛṣṭadvārā; yathā satyasarpadaṣṭaviṣasyopāsanaprītagaruḍaprasādānnivṛttiḥ; na tu mithyeti jñānāttathetyarthaḥ | prapañcasya jñānānivartyatvamuktam | aikyajñānasyopāyatvānupapattimāhabhavadabhimatasyeti | tattvajñānaṃ hi mokṣopāyaḥ | bhinnaviṣayasyābhedajñānasyātattvajñānarūpatvādviparītaphalatvamityarthaḥ | advaitasyātathyatve pramāṇamāha  mithyaitaditi | aikyasyātāttvikatvakaṇṭhoktirdarśitā | aikyasyāsatyatvaṃ yathā phalati, tathā bhedajñānasyaiva mokṣahetutvamāha  uttama iti | smṛtivacasoḥ saṅgatyarthaṃ śruteḥ paścādupādānam |
aikyājñānasya nivartakatve pramāṇavirodha uktaḥ | atha tarkavirodhamāha  apiceti | dāvānalaviṣanāśakaviṣadṛṣṭāntābhiprāyeṇa śaṅkate nivartakajñānamiti | nivartakajñānaṃ tadvināśaśca kiṃ brahmavyatiriktam, uta svarūpamiti vikalpamabhipretyāha  neti | brahmavyatiriktatvādghaṭāderiva vināśasya kālpanikatvam, yathā svapnapadārthasvarūpatadutpattisthitīnāṃ kālpanikatvānnāśaśca kālpanikaḥ, tatheti bhāvaḥ | vināśatatkalpanākalpakarūpāvidyāyā iti | vināśaḥ kalpyaḥ, tadviṣayabhramabuddhiḥ kalpanā, kalpako bhramāśrayādiḥ; evaṃrūpāvidyāyā ityarthaḥ | svarūpapakṣaṃ dūṣayati tathā satīti |
pūrvasmin pakṣe dūṣaṇaṃ prakārāntareṇāpyuktaṃ vedārthasaṅgrahe, "bhāvarūpasya nāśo hyuttarāvasthāprāptiḥ | sā cātrānupapannā; brahmavyatiriktasyāvasthāvato'nyasya sthityabhyupagame advaitahāniprasaṅgāt" iti | bhāvāntaraṃ hyabhāvaḥ | ghaṭasya prāgabhāvaḥ piṇḍatvādipūrvāvasthā, pradhvaṃsaḥ kapālatvādyuttarāvasthā, itaretarābhāvo'piaśvasya gotvābhāvo'śvatvam, gorapyaśvatvābhāvo gotvam | saṃsargābhāve kathaṃ bhāvarūpatvam | yadi mahīmātrameva, tarhi ghaṭasaṃsarge satyapi saṃsargabhāvaḥ syāt | yadyatiriktaḥ, tarhyabhāvo'ṅgīkṛta iti | ucyate | bhavatpakṣe abhāvāśrayasya yat vailakṣaṇyam, tadeva saṃsargābhāvaḥ | yadi mahīmātrameva abhāvāśrayaḥ, tarhi bhāvāśrayabhetale'pyabhāvāśrayatvaprasaṅgaḥ; tatrāpi mahīmātrasadbhāvāt | yadi kenacidviśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭaṃ bhūtalamabhāvāśrayaḥ, sa eva viśeṣaḥ saṃsargābhāva iti | kālaviśeṣaviśiṣṭatve sati deśaviśeṣatvameva sa ca viśeṣaḥ | tadānīmeva ghaṭasahitapradeśāntaravyāvṛttyarthaṃ deśaviśeṣatvamityuktam; tasyaiva deśasya kālāntare ghaṭahitasya vyāvṛttyarthaṃ kālaviśeṣaviśiṣṭatve satītyuktam | yathā''huḥ "saṃsargābhāvamevaṃ viduriha sudhiyo bhāvameva tvabhāvaṃ manvānāḥ, kumbhavadbhūtalata itarabhūbhāgabhedastvabhāvaḥ | yastattatkālabhedavyatikaritagṛhaprāṅgaṇādipradeśaḥ kumbhābhāvāśrayo'nyairagaṇi sa iha naḥ kvādhikasyopalambhaḥ |" iti | nāśasyāvasthāntaratvāt karmanāśaṃ vadatastavāpi codyaṃ tulyamiti cetna | karma hyasmatpakṣe bhagavatprītyaprītirūpam | tatra yaḥ saṃsāraphalānuguṇaḥ saṅkalpaḥ, tat vināśyaṃ karma; yastu mokṣānuguṇaḥ saṅkalpaḥ, sa eva pūrvasya nāśa ityupapannameva, "dhātuḥ prasādānmahimānamīśam" ityādibhiḥ |
atha nivartakajñānasya jñātranupapattimāha  apiceti | na hi svarūpabhūtajñānasya jñātrantarāpekṣā | atastadyvāvṛttyarthaṃ kṛtsnaniṣedhaviṣayajñānasyetyuktam | pramāṇajanyajñānaṃ hi sāśrayamevadṛṣṭam | jñātā kiṃ brahmavyatiriktaḥ, uta nātiriktaḥ iti vikalpābhiprāyeṇāha  cinmātreti | prathamaṃ dharmipraśnaḥ(?) ko'yamiti | brahmavyatiriktapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha  neti | karmakartṛtvavirodhāditi bhāvaḥ | nivartyatve sati hi karmakartṛvirodhaḥ | atastatparihārārthaṃ svarūpapakṣaṃ śaṅkate brahmeti | jñātṛtvadharmavikalpo'yam | kiṃ svarūpamiti | svarūpamsvābhāvikamityarthaḥ | pāścāttyatvena buddhisthatayā adhyastapakṣaṃ dūṣayati  adhyastaṃ cediti | nivartakajñānāviṣayatayā tiṣṭhatyeveti | jñātṛtvādhyāsasya tanmūlāvidyāntarasya ca nivṛttau nivartakāntarasāpekṣatvāt, nivartakāntarasya ca bhavadbhiranabhyupagamāt tadubhayaṃ tiṣṭhatyeveti niśśeṣāvidyānivṛttirna syādityarthaḥ | nivartakajñānāntarābhyupagame tasyāpi kasyacit kañcit prati siddhirūpatayā jñātrapekṣayā'navasthā syādityāha  nivartaketi | ādyaṃ śiro dūṣayati  brahmasvarūpasyeti | nirupādhikasyaiva brahmasvarūpasyābhyupagamyamānaṃ jñātṛtvaṃ svābhāvikamiti bhavatāmapi siddhāntaḥ syādityarthaḥ | brahmavyatiriktasya jñāturnivartakajñānasya ca brahmavyatiriktatvarūpopādhikoḍīkārabalena prapañcatanmūlāvidyānivartakajñānenaiva nivṛttirbhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkaya vyāghātena dūṣayati  nivartakajñānasvarūpamiti | jñāturapi nivartakajñānanivartyatve nivartakajñenārthaṃ śravaṇādau pravṛttiśca na syādityāha  adhyasto jñāteti | jñātṛnāśasya paramapuruṣārtharūpabrahmasvarūpatvāt nāpuruṣārthatetyāśaṅkayāha  tannāśasyeti | pūrvapakṣanirākaraṇamupasaṃharati  itīti |
evaṃ brahmavyatiriktakṛtsnamithyātvanirākaraṇena bandhasya satyatvasiddhestannivṛttiḥ karmasāpekṣopāsanātmakajñānedeveti karmavicārapūrvavṛttatvaṃ yuktamityāha  tasmāditi | tasmātsādhanacatuṣṭayasya brahmavicāraṃ prati pūrvavṛttatve vastusāmarthyaṃ nāma heturuktaḥ; tacca nirviśeṣabrahmādhyastaprapañcasya karmanirapekṣajñānanivartyatvam; taccānupapannamityupapādanena vastusāmarthyāsiddherityarthaḥ | svarūpānāditvavyāvṛttyarthaṃ pravāhaśabdaḥ | anirvacanīyavyāvṛttyarthaḥ karmaśabdaḥ | uktalakṣaṇajñānādevaupāsanātmakādeva | tadutpattirvarṇāśramocitakamarlabhyā'stu; tataḥ kimupāsanādisvarūpajñānaṃ prati prastutakarmavicārapūrvavṛttatvasyetyatrāha  tatreti | karmavicārādeva tasyālpāsthiraphalatvajñānaṃ phalitamiti bhāvaḥ | anabhisaṃhitaphaleti | "yajñena dānena" ityādikarmaviniyojakavākyārthajñānasya padārthajñānapūrvakatvāt padārthabhūtakarmasvarūpākhyaviśeṣyajñānāt ṛte upāsanadvārā anantasthiraphalatvarūpaṃ padārthajñānapūrvakatvāt padārthabhūtakarmasvarūpākhyaviśeṣyajñānāt ṛte upāsanadvārā anantasthiraphalatvarūpaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ ca na jñāyata iti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  kevaleti | kevalākāraḥātmayāthātmyabuddhisaṃskāraśūnyākāraḥ | hānārthamupādānārthaṃ ca hi kasyacijjñānam | tatra phaladvārā karma tyājyam; svarūpeṇopādeyam; ubhayārthaṃ jñānaṃ karmavicārāt ṛte na sidhyati | tasmāt karmavicāranivṛttau tajjñānaphalaṃ hānamupādānaṃ ca na bhavatītyarthaḥ | athātaśśabdārthaṃ nigamayati iti karmavicārānantaramiti | brahmavicāraḥ kartavya ityanena brahmajijñāsāśabdārthaḥ uktaḥ | vicārasya kartavyatāyāṃ nātīva vivādaḥ, śābdaḥ ārthaḥ ityetāvadeva hi vaiṣa myam | athātaśśabdārtha eva hyatīva vivādaḥ | ataḥ athāta ityetāvadupāttam ||
(jijñāsādhikaraṇaracanārambhaḥ)
evaṃ sūtrasyākṣarayojanā kṛtā | atha tātparyārtha ucyatetatretyādinā | akṣarayojanāyāṃ pareṇānyathokto'kṣarārthaśca nirastaḥ | tannirasanasamaya eva pareṇānyathoktastāparyārtho'pi nirastaḥ | pareṇa hi prapañcasya satyatvena jñānanivartyatvābhāvāt jñānāya brahmavicāro nārambhaṇīya iti pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā, prapañcasya mithyātvena jñānanivartyatvāt jñānāya sa ārambhaṇīya iti siddhāntitam | tacca pūrvaṃ nirastam | atha sūtrakārābhipretāṃ nirasanīyaśaṃkāmupanyasya tadabhipredaṃ tatparihāraṃ ca vaktumārabhate  tatretyādinā | karmavicārānantaraṃ tata eva hetorbrahmavicāraḥ kartavya ityuktvā prābhākaraiḥ, adhyayanasyācāryakādhikārakatvāt na dharmavicāraḥ karttavyaḥ iti pūvarpakṣaṃ kṛtvā, arthabodhādhikāratvāt kartavya iti siddhāntitam | bhāṭṭaistu adhyayanasya svargārthatvānna dharmavicāra iti pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā arthajñānārthatvāt sa kartavyaḥ iti siddhāntitam tacca vyāhataṃ bhavatpakṣe | tatra hi sūtrākṣarāṇi yojayitvā tātparyārtha uktaḥ; atrāpyakṣarārthamuktavā tātparyārtha ucyata ityanupapannam |
akṣarayojanāyāṃ brahmavicārārambhe viśiṣṭo heturuktaḥkarmaṇo'lpāsthiraphalatvanirṇayaviśiṣṭānantasthiraphalāpātapratītiḥ | anantasthiraphalāpādapratītirnāsti cet, alpāsthiraphala eva tṛptaḥ syāt | alpāsthiraphalatvanirṇayo nāsti cet, na nirvedaḥ syāditi viśiṣṭo hetuḥ | atrā''pātapratītiḥ saṃbhāvitaprāmāṇyā vivakṣitā, tādṛśī hi sā pravṛttihetuḥ | tatra brahmajñānasyānantasthiraphalāpātapratīteḥ prāmāṇyasaṃbhāvanā'nupapannā, siddhavastuni śabdasya bodhakatvaniścayābhāvāditi viśiṣṭahetau viśeṣyāṃśāsiddhimāśaṅkaya, siddhavastuni vyutpattisaṃbhavādanantasthiraphalāpātapratītirastīti parihriyate | (atra pūrvapakṣavādī prābhākaraḥ |) sūtrakāraibharviṣyaddarśanaveditvāt, kaiścidanuktatve'pisaṃbhāvyānānāṃ pratikūlapakṣāṇām āśaṅkaya nirasanīyatvāccaivaṃ pūrvapakṣīkaraṇaṃ yuktam | yadvā jaiminimataṃ hīdam, codanālakṣaṇo'rtha eva vedapratipādya iti | codanā ca kriyāyāṃ pravartakaṃ vacanam | tamāśaṅkaya siddhavastvapi vedapratipādyamiti sūtrakāraiḥ sādhayituṃ yujyate |
akṣarayojanāyāṃ brahmavicāraḥ kartavya ityuktatvāt, brahmavicārārambho na yukta iti pūrvapakṣasamāptāvuktatvāt, brahmavicārārambho yukta iti sthitamiti siddhāntasyopasaṃhṛtatvācca dīpe kaṇṭhoktau viṣayaḥ saṃśayaścehārthasiddhau | brahmavicāra ityuktatvāt brahmamīmāṃsā viṣaya iti siddham | ārambho na yuktaḥ, yuktaḥ iti coktatvāt saṃśayasiddhiḥ | brahmamīmāṃsā kimārambhaṇīyā, utānārambhaṇīyeti; tadarthaṃ cintyatekiṃ vedāntāḥ brahmaṇi pramāṇam, uta neti; tadarthaṃ parīkṣyateśabdasya siddhavastubodhanasāmarthyāvadhāraṇaṃ saṃbhavati, neti; vṛddhavyavahāre ca śabdasya siddhavastubodhakatvāvadhāraṇaṃ saṃbhavati, neti ca | na saṃbhavatīti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ | saṃbhavatīti siddhāntaḥ | yadā vyavahārādanyatra na vyutpattiḥ, vyavahāre ca śabdasya siddharūpārthabodhakatvāvadāraṇaṃ na saṃbhavatitadā śabdasya siddhavastubodhanasāmarthyābhāvāt vedāntānāmapi brahmaṇi pariniṣpannarūpe prāmāṇyābhāvaniścayavataḥ puruṣasya anantasthiraphalāpātapratīteḥ prāmāṇyasaṃbhāvanāyā asiddhevirśiṣṭahetvabhāvādanārambhaṇīyeti pūrvapakṣe phalaphalibhāvaḥ | rāddhānte tuyadā vyavahārādanyatra vyutpattirvyavahāre siddhavastuparatvāvadhāraṇaṃ ca saṃbhavati, tadā śabdasya siddharūpārthe sāmarthyāt vedāntānāmapi brahmaṇi pariniṣpannarūpe prāmāṇyāt prāmāṇyābhāvaniścayarahitapuruṣasya anantasthiraphalarūpabrahmaviṣayāpātapratītiprāmāṇyasaṃbhāvanāsiddheḥ viśiṣṭahetusiddhayā brahmamīmāṃsā ārambhaṇīyeti vicārāṇāṃ phalaphalibhāvaḥ |
pūrvapakṣamupakṣipati tatreti | pūrvaṃ mṛṣāvādyuktaṃ sūtratātparyaṃ vyudastam; tadyvāvṛtiṃta sūcayati | tatraśabdena | tatraprapañcasatyatve sthite satītyarthaḥ | pūrvapakṣamupapādayati  vṛddhavyavahārāditi | vṛddhaḥvyutpannaḥ, prayojyaḥ prayojanakaśca | tayorvyavahāraḥvācikaḥ kāyikaśca | vyavahārādanyatra śaktayavadhāraṇaṃ mā bhūt | tataḥ kimityatrāha  vyavahārasya ceti | kāryadhīpūrvakatvaphalamāha  kāyārtha eveti | tataḥ phalitamāha  kāryarūpa iti | vedasya śabdātmakatvāt śabdasya ca vyutpattyapekṣatvāditi bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha ata iti | ataḥvedārthasya kāryarūpatvādityarthaḥ | na pramāṇabhāvamanubhavitumarhanti | prāmāṇyasaṃbhāvanā ca nāsti; ayogyatvādityarthaḥ | prathamavyutpattirvṛddhavyavahārādanyatra na saṃbha vati | na hi ghaṭo'stītyukte pravṛttyabhāve sati tasya bodhakatvaṃ jñāyate | gāmānayetyādiśabdaprayogānantaraṃ prayojyapravṛtiṃta dṛṣṭvā, pravṛtteḥ kāryabuddhipūrvakatvaṃ jānan vyutpitsuḥ, ayaṃ śabdaḥ kāryarūpārthabodhaka iti niścinoti | tatra bahuṣu prayogeṣvanuvṛttaśabdasyānuvṛttārthena saṃbandhaṃ vyāvṛttaśabdasya vyāvṛttārthena saṃbandhaṃ gṛhītvā āvāpodvāpamukhena arthaviśeṣaiḥ śabdaviśeṣasaṃbandhaṃ niścinetīti prathamaṃ vyutpattiḥ kāryārtha eva | na hi prathamata eva, asya śabdasyāyamartha ityukte, asya śabdasyāyamartha ityetadvākyasthapadānāmarthapratītiḥ | evaṃ kāryārtha eva vyutpatiṃta kṛtavataḥ puruṣasya, asya śabdasya ayamartha iti paścācchikṣite'pi prathamaṃ kāryārthaparatayā vyutpannakatipayapadasamabhivyāhāradarśanāt prathamavyutpattyavirodhena tattacchabdārthasaṃbandhagrahaṇāt sarve śabdāḥ kāryārthaparā eveti gṛhyante | ataḥ, "ya eva laukikāḥ, ta eva vaidikāḥ" iti nyāyāt vedāntāḥ siddhavastuni na bodhakā bhavantītyarthaḥ | vedāntānāṃ saṃskṛtaśabdatvāt bhāṣāntareṇa prathamaṃ vyutpannasya puruṣasya saṃskṛte śabde asya śabdasyāyamartha iti vyutpādyamāne prathamameva siddhavastuni vyutpattiḥ kṛtā syāditi cennakāryārthaparatvena prathamavyutpannabhāṣāntaraśabdānāṃ paryāyatvena vyutpādyamānatvāt saṃskṛtaśabdā api kāryārthaparatvenaiva hi vyutpannāḥ syuḥ |
siddhavastuni vyutpatterbhāṭṭaruktamudāharaṇaṃ vyudasyati  na ceti | kālatrayavartināmiti pañcikāyāmuktam; tadatrābhipretam | deśakālayogyatādibhiḥ putrajanma jānātītyatrāha  sulagneti | sulagnasukhaprasavādīnā'nthāsiddhirnayavivekoktā | ādiśabdena pitrādyariṣṭābhāvo bhāvisamṛddhayādikaṃ ca vivakṣitam | vyutpattirnāma śabdasyārthaviśeṣaissaha saṃbandhagrahaṇam, na tvarthamātreṇeti evaṃ dūṣaṇamuktam | naiyāyikādibhiruktamudāharaṇaṃ vyudasyati  nāpīti | vyutpannetarapadasya padāntarārthaniścayodāharaṇamidamkaḥ kūjatīti praśnasya pikaḥ kūjatīti kenacidukte vyutpanna(kaḥ) kūjatiśabdena vyutpitsunā pikaśabdārtho jñāyate | vyutpannetarapadavibhaktayarthasya prakṛtyarthaniścayodāharaṇamidam  kāṣṭhaiḥ sthālyāmodanaṃ pacatītyukte vyutpannavibhaktipacatiśabdārthena vyutpitsunā kāṣṭhādiprakṛtyartho jñāyata iti | jñāteti | idānīṃ śrute asmin vākye pūrvaṃ kāryaparatayā vyutpannavākyasthakatipayapadadarśanāt ayamapi padasamudāyaḥ kāryābhidhāyīti jñāyata ityabhiprāyeṇa jñātakāryābhidhāyipadasamudāyasyetyuktam | tadaṃśaviśeṣaḥkāryāṃśaviśeṣaḥ | kārye hyanekakārakaviśiṣṭam | tasya kāryasya viśeṣaṇāṃśaniścayarūpatvātt tasyapadāntarārthaniścayasya prakṛtyarthaniścayasya cetyarthaḥ | yadvātadaṃśaviśeṣaḥkāryābhidhāyipadasamudāyaṃśaviśeṣaḥ | mṛṣāvādibhiruktamudāharaṇaṃ dūṣayati  na ceti | vācaspatinoktamarthamāśaṅkaya pariharati  kāryeti | tena khalvevaṃ siddhavastuni prāmāṇyamupāditamsavarśabdāmartho'nuyāyī vaktavyaḥ | kiṃ kāryarūpārthābhidhāyitvamunuyāyi, uta kāryānvitasvārthābhidhāyitvam, uta kārakānvitasvārthābhidhāyitvam? prathame kārakapadeṣu vyabhicāraḥ, teṣāṃ kāryābhidhāyitvābhāvāt | dvitīye liṅādiṣu vyabhicāraḥ; teṣāṃ kāryānvitasvārthābhidhāyitvābhāvāt | tṛtīye ca kārakapadeṣu vyabhicāraḥ; teṣāṃ kārakānvitasvārthābhidhāyitvābhāvāt | tasmādanyānvitasvārthābhidhāyitvaṃ padānāmanuyāyīti vaktavyamanvitābhidhāyitvavādinā | anyānvitatvaṃ siddhavastuno'pi syāditi kāryarūpārtha eva vyutpattiriti nirbandho'nupapanna iti | imāṃ śaṅkāmabhipretya pariharati  kāyarbuddhīti | kāryabuddhipravṛttivyāptibaleneti uttaratra sarvapadānāṃ kāryaparatvenetyanenānvayaḥ | śabdaprayogānantaraṃ pravṛttidarśanāt śabdasya pravartakārthāvabodhakatvāt kāyarbuddheḥ pravṛtteśca vyāptibalena pravartakasya ca kāryarūpatvāt sarvaiḥ padaiḥ kāryameva viśiṣṭaṃ pratipādyate | tasmāt nānyānvitasvārthamātre padaśaktiniścayaḥ, apitu viśiṣṭakāryāṃśaviśeṣe padaśaktiniścaya ityarthaḥ | nanu kāryameva pravartakaṃ cet, pravartakasya śabdārthatvāt sarvaśabdānāṃ kāryaparatvaṃ syāt | tanna; iṣṭasādhanatābuddheḥpravartakatvāditi bhāṭṭoktamarthamāśaṅkayāha  iṣṭasādhanateti | svaprayojanopāyaḥ pareṇa sādhyate cet, tatrāpi na pravṛttiriti vartamānāyā api iṣṭopāyatābudderapravartakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam | ataḥ kāryabuddhiḥpravṛttivyāpyetyarthaḥ | nanu kāryabuddhirapi pravṛtiṃta vyabhicarati, nirdhanasya dvijasya yāgakartavyatābuddhimattvepi pravṛttyabhāvāt | naivam; mayaivādya sādhayituṃ śakyamiti buddhirhi kāryabuddhiḥ | na tasyāḥ pravṛttivyabhicāraḥ, nirdhanasya hi naivaṃvidhā pratipattiḥ, kiṃtu yāgaḥ kadācitkartavyaḥ, arthādilābhādanuṣṭhāne sati phalaprāptirastīti | ato na doṣaḥ |
tataḥ kimityapekṣāyāmupapāditahetuśarīraṃ vadan śaṅkāntaraṃ ca pariharan pūrvapakṣaṃ nigamayati ata ityādinā | brahmavicārārambhe viśiṣṭo heturuktaḥ, tatra viśeṣyāṃśasyānantasthiraphalāpāta pratītirūpasyāsiddhiruktā | atra codyamāpāditam, mantrārthavādeṣu upāsanavidhiśeṣabhūteṣvanantasthiraphalāpātapratītisiddheḥ na viśeṣyāṃśāsiddhiriti viśiṣṭa eva heturiti | etadāśaṅkayāha  akṣayyaṃ ha vā iti | ayamarthaḥyadi mantrārthavādeṣvanantasthiraphalapratītyā brahmavicārārambhaḥ, tarhi pūrvabhāge'pi "akṣayyaṃ ha vai cāturmāsyayājinaḥ sukṛtaṃ bhavati" ityādibhiranantasthiraphalapratītyā alpāsthiraphalatvanirṇayarūpaviśeṣaṇāṃśāsiddherbrahmavicārārambho na yukta iti | viśiṣṭahetau viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoranyatarāṃśāsiddhayabhiprāyeṇa karmaphalālpāsthiratvabrahmajñānaphalānantasthiratvajñānahetuka ityuktam |
atrābhidhīyata iti | asmin pūrvapakṣe sūtrakāraiḥ parihāro'bhidhīyata ityarthaḥ nikhileti | anyathā vadatā bhavatāpi
vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇaiva śabdavyutpattiḥ kṛteti nikhilalokaśabdasya bhāvaḥ | prāmāṇikāḥpramāṇenārthaṃ svīkurvanta ityarthaḥ | kathaṃ saṃbandhāvadhāraṇamityatrāhaevaṃ kileti | mātāpitṛprabhṛtibhiriti | ayaṃ bhāvaḥyadā svayameva bālo vyutpattikṣamo bhavati, tadānīmapyenaṃ vṛddhairupādhyāyādibhirvyutpādayituṃ śraddadhānā mātāpitrādayo na hi svayaṃ vyutpattyakṣamadaśāyāmupekṣante | kintu akṣaraśikṣādyapayoginīḥ śikṣāḥ prathamata eva svabuddhipūrvakaṃ kurvantīti | ambātātaprabhṛtiḥ sapratiyogikaḥ śabdagaṇaḥ, śaśipaśuprabhṛtirapratiyogikaḥ śabdagaṇa iti vibhāgaḥ | asaṃbandhiśabdavyutpatteḥ pūrvamevāmbātātādiśabdavyutpattirdṛśyate | sā ca tvabhimataśabdārthasaṃbandhagrahaṇe tu nopapadyate | na hi kiñcitprati pitā anyasyāpi pitā bhavati | tasmādyutpitsormātāpitrādiṣu anyaistattacchabdaprayogāsaṃbhavāt prathamamambādiśabdārthavyutpattiḥ tvanmate na saṃbhavati | ato buddhipūrvikaiva prathamavyutpattiriti jñāpanārthaṃ koṭidvayaṃ śabdeṣu darśitam | yādṛcchikavṛddhavyavahāreṇānantaśabdavyutpattyanupapattiśca | sarvalokasaṃpratipannavyutpattiprakārapahnavaśca | enamavehi imañcāvadhārayeti | enambodhakaṃ śabdam, imambodhyarthañcāvehītyarthaḥ | bahuśa iti | yāvat aṅgulinirdeśaśabdaprayogasāhacayardarśanajanitavāsanābhūyastvodayena svayameva tattacchabdān prayoktum arthamātradarśanena śabdaṃ smarttuṃ śabdamātraśravaṇenārthaṃ smarttuṃ ca kṣamā bhavanti, tāvadityarthaḥ | śikṣitāḥtaistaiḥ śabdaiḥ teṣu teṣvartheṣūtpāditajñānāḥ | evaṃ tarhyaṅgulyā nirdiṣṭeṣvartheṣvamī śabdāḥ saṅketitāḥ iti manyeranniti cetyadvā liṅgavajjagyajanakabhāvādisaṃbandhāntarādbodhakā iti manyeranniti cettatrāha saṃbandhāntarādarśanātsaṅketayitṛpuruṣājñānācceti | ayamarthaḥyādṛcchikavyutpattāvapi tulyaṃ codyam | śabdaprayogānantaraṃ prayojyapravṛtiṃta dṛṣṭavato vyutpisoriyaṃ śaṅkā bhavati, etacchabdaprayogādanantaramasya pravṛttiḥ kiṃ janyajanakabhāvādisaṃbandhāt, uta saṅketāditi | tatra saṃbandhāntaraśaṅkā tu adarśanādeva na jāyata iti cetbuddhipūrvakavyutpattāvapyayaṃ parihāraḥ samānaḥ | saṅketabuddhayutpattiśca nopapadyate | kimete asmanpātāpitrādayaḥ saṅketayanti, uta pūrvameva kaścit saṅketitavān iti | na tāvatprathamapakṣaḥ; anekaiḥ puruṣaisteṣvevārtheṣvekarūpaśabdaprayogadarśanāt | nāpi dvitīyaḥ; anena pūrvaṃ saṅketitāḥ śabdā iti saṅketayituḥ puruṣasyājñānāditi parihārastavāpi vaktavyaḥ; so'smākamapi samānaḥ | sarvapramāṇānāṃ bodhakatve aviśiṣṭe'pi pratyakṣasya vaiṣamyaṃ sattayā jñānajanakatvam | anumānāgamau tu jñātatayā jñāpakau | tatrānumānaṃ janyajanakabhāvādisaṃbandhāntarajñānena bodhyaviṣayabodhajanakam; śabdastu bodhyabodhakabhāvarūpasambandhajñānādeva bodhyaṃ bodhayati | evaṃ saṃbandhāntaraśaṅkā saṅketitatvaśaṅkā ca nirastā | sambandhāntarābhāvātsaṅketayitṛpuruṣājñānācca bodhyabodhakabhāva eva sambandha iti na bālaijrñātuṃ śakyamiti cet tat tavāpi tulyam | kiñca śabdoccāraṇānantaraṃ prayojyavṛddhasya pravṛtiṃta dṛṣṭvā pravṛtteśca kāyarbuddhipūrvakatvamanumāya, yadanantaraṃ yadbhavati tat tasya kāraṇamiti nyāyāt śabdoccāraṇena kāryabuddhirasya jāteti kāyarrūpaḥ śabdārtha iti boddhuṃ bālairatīva na śakyate | aśakyatvaṃ dṛśyate ca; na hi bālā uktaprakāreṇa kāryārthaparatvaṃ śabdasya niścinvanti | ato balairduravagamatvacodyaṃ bhavatpakṣa evātīva prasajati | kālaparipākāt jñāyata iti cetayaṃ parihāro'smatpakṣe susaṅgata iti |
punaśceti | asya śabdasya ayamartha iti vyutpattiścetanvitābhidhānabhaṅgaprasaṅga iti cetna; prātisvikavyutpatteḥ samudāyajñānārthatvāt | na hi kāvyādiṣu vākyārthajñānopayogitvena saṃpādyamānaṃ padārthajñānaṃ vākyārthajñānavirodhi | na hyakṣaraśikṣā ca padārthajñānavirodhinī | evaṃ taistaiḥ padaiḥ parasparānvitasvārthābhidhānavyutpatteḥ pratipadamarthavyutpattirna virodhinī; api tu uyuktaiva | yathā bhavatpakṣe āvāpodvāparūpeṇaṃ pratipadārthavyutpattirvākyārthajñānopayogitvānna virodhinī, tadvat | bhavatpakṣe tu prātisvikavyutpattiḥ paścādbhāvinī, atra tu pūrvabhāvinīti viśeṣaḥ | vākyārthajñānopayogitvaṃ samānam | śabdenānvayaparyantābhidhānaṃ hyanvitābhidhānam | prātisvikavyutpattāvapi tatraiva vyutpattiḥ kriyata iti na virodhaḥ | abhihitānvayapakṣe arthānāṃ parasparānvayabodhanayogyatvaṃ śabdānāṃ svātharbodhanaśaktiḥ śabdairapi parasparānvayayogyatvena svārthābhidhānamiti trayamapi kalpanīyam; anvitābhidhānapakṣe tu śabdānāṃ svārthabodhanaśaktereva anvayaparyantatvābhyupagamāt kalpanālāghavamastīti sa evātra svīkṛtaḥ | anvitābhidhānabhaṅgaprasaṅgaśca parihṛtaḥ | asya śabdasya ayamartha ityatrāpyayamartha iti budhyasveti hyuktaṃ bhavati; tasmāt kāryārtha eva vyutpattiriti cetevaṃ tarhi yādṛcchikavyutpattāvapi siddhavastunyeva vyutpattiḥ syāt | prayojyavṛddhasya kāryabuddhirjāteti hi vyutpitsurjānāti | śabdabodhyatvaṃ kāryasyaiva; na buddheḥ | buddhirhi śabdajanyā;
