na tu śabdavācyeti cetatrāpi śabdabodhyatvaṃ tattatpadārthasyaiva; na buddheḥ | na hi ghaṭabuddhirghaṭaśabdavācyā; api tu tajjanyā; vācyastu ghaṭa eva iti tulyaḥ parihāraḥ ityabhipretya enamavehi imaṃ cāvadhārayetyabhiprāyeṇāṅgulyā nirdiśyetyuktam | tattadarthāvabodhivākyajātaṃ prayuñjata iti | yādṛcchikavyutpattau katipayaśabdānāṃ kāryārthaparatvena vyutpattidarśanāt vyutpādakāḥ puruṣā api kāryārtha eva vyutpatiṃta kṛtavanto gāmanayetyādivākyaṃ prayuñjata iti cetanekaśabdānāṃ siddhavastuparatvena, vyutpādakāḥ puruṣā api tathaiva vyutpatiṃta kṛtvā tattadarthavivakṣayā śabdān prayuñjate | vyutpattidarśanaṃ prayogadarśanamapi hyubhayamatrā(bhayatrā?)viśiṣṭamiti bhāvaḥ |
evaṃ buddhipūrvakavyutpattyā śabdānāṃ siddhavastuparatvamuktam | yādṛcchikavyutpattāvapi siddhārthe'pi vyutpattirastītyāha  prakārāntareṇāpīti | śabdanirapekṣaṃ tattadarthajñānaṃ ceṣṭādinā saṃbhavatīti darśayati mūkavaditi | paroktayādṛcchikavyutpattau vyutpitsuvyatirekeṇa puruṣadvayāpekṣā, gavādyapekṣā ca | asyāṃ tu vyutpitsuvyatirekeṇa puruṣatrayāpekṣeti vaiṣamyam |
kiñcaputraste jāta ityādivākyasya gāmānayetyādivākyasya ca vaiṣamyaṃ durupapādam | kalātrayavartiharṣahetubāhulyasaṃbhāvanayā hi putrajanmavākye vyutpatteraśakyatvamuktam | tanna; saṃnihitaṃ putrajanma dṛṣṭvā tajjñāpanāya pravṛtte puruṣe jñāte, paścācca jātakarmādau dṛṣṭe, tataḥ pūrvamanullasitamukhatvādasaṃbhāvitaputrajanmavijñānasya puruṣasyaitadvākyaśravaṇānantarabhāvino mukhavikāsasyātītāgāmiharṣahetvantaraśravaṇamūlatvaśaṅkānudayāt | na hi saṃnihitahetuparityāgenādṛṣṭahetuśaṅkā dhiyamadhirohati | sulagnasukhaprasavādihetvantaraśaṅkā syāditi cetnaivam; sulagnādimātrasya harṣahetutvāyogāt | na khalvanyadīyaputrajanmādyanubandhisulagnatvādīnāṃ harṣahetutvam | ataḥ svaputrajanmaviśeṣaṇībhūtānāṃ sulagnatvādīnāmeva haṣarhetutvam | ataḥ svaputrajanmani ajñāte sulagnatvādīnāṃ heṣarhetutvāyogādasya vākyasya svaputrajanmajñāpakatvamavaśyaṃ viditaṃ syāt | prāgeva putrajanmajñānasaṃbhavādasya vākyasya sulagnatvādiparatvaśaṅkā syāditi cetnaivam; tataḥ pūrvaṃ mukhavikāsaviraheṇa prāgeva putrajanmajñānaśaṅkānudayāt | ataḥ putrajanmanaḥ saṃnihitatvāt pūrvaṃ mukhavikāsābhāvācca prāthamikamukhavikāsahetorasya vākyasya putrajanmajñāpakatvaṃ vyutpisurmanyate | tatraivaṃ śaṅkā saṃbhavatikiṃ putrajanmādimātrajñāpakamidaṃ vākyam, uta sulagnatvādiviśiṣṭaputrajanmādijñāpakamiti | īdṛśaśaṅkāgrastatvaṃ gāmānayetyādivākyasyāpi tulyam; kimidaṃ vākyaṃ gavānayanamātrapratipādakam; uta purovartini piṇḍe ye śuklatvādiviśeṣā dṛśyante, tairviśiṣṭagavānayanapratipādakamiti śaṅkopapatteḥ | prayogabhedenāvāpodvāpamukhena śaṅkāpākaraṇamubhayatra tulyam | putrajanmavākyādapi gavānayanādivākyasya anekārthāntaraśaṅkāgrastatvaṃ sutarāṃ dṛśyata iti arthaviśeṣāvadhāramatīva kartumaśakyam; gāmanayeti śabdaprayogānantaraṃ vyāpārāntaravidhuraṃ gavi samānītāyāmapi, gāṃ saṃdarśaya, gāṃ puraḥ sthāpaya, gāṃ dehi, gāṃ krīṇīhītyādyanekārthaśaṅkāhetutvāt prayojyavṛddhapravṛtteḥ | kiñca gāmānayetyādiśabdaprayogānantaraṃ sāmanayanātpūrvameva utthānoparivāsaācchādanadaṇḍagrahaṇayādṛcchikajanasaṃbhāṣaṇagamanādyavāntaravyāpārāśca bahavo yasya puruṣasya ādyavyutpattāvupalabhyante, tasya teṣvanyatamārthavācakatvaśaṅkā gāmānayetyādivākyasya jāyate | paścādgavānayanamapi yādṛcchikaṃ kṛtaṃ syāt, na tu vākyapreritatvāditi ca śaṅkā saṃbhavati | ato nārthaviśeṣasaṃbandhāvadhāraṇasaṃbhava iti | bahubhiḥ prayogairarthaviśeṣaniścayo'nvayavyatirekābhyāmiti cetevameva putraste jāta ityādivākyasyārtaviśeṣaniścayaḥ sutarāṃ saṃbhavati |
evaṃ siddhavastuni śabdavyutpattyupapattyupapādanena vedāntānāṃ parabrahmaparatvamupapannamityāha  ato vedāntā iti | atha kāryārthaparatvamabhyupagamya brahmavicārasya kartavyatāmāha  kāryārthatve'pīti | kāryārthatvābhyupagame'pi stāvakatvasiddhihetutvena phalasādhanatvena ca prakāradvayena siddhavastuni tātparyamuttaratropapādayiṣyate | atra tu prakārāntareṇopapādyate | anantasthiraphalāpātapratīteḥ siṣādayiṣitatvāt phalatvena tātparyakathanamatrocitamiti phalatayā siddhiratrocyate | anekavākyopādānam upāsane tātparyātiśayajñāpanārtham, upasargaviśeṣasanpratyayayogāyoge'pyarthabhedo nāstīti jñāpānārthaṃ ca | upāsanaviṣayakāryādhikṛteti | upāsanāvacchinnakṛtisādhyāpūrvādikṛtasya | viṣiṣvan (virśiṣan) hi viṣaya ucyate | brahmasvarūpatadviśeṣaṇānāmiti | viśeṣaṇāniguṇāḥ vibhūtayaśca | vidhivākyoktasya phalasyārthavādektaviśeṣaṇe tātparyamastīti jñāpanārthaṃ duḥkhāsaṃbhinnadeśaviśeṣarūpasvargādivadityuktam | "yasminnoṣṇaṃ na śītaṃ nāratiḥ" iti śrutiḥ | svargākhyaphalaṃ vidhigatam; viśeṣaṇamanyatra | phalasya vidhivākyagatatvābhāve'pyanyaparārthavādoktaphale vidhyapekṣite tātparyamastīti darśayituṃ rātrisatrapratiṣṭhāvadityuktam | (rātrīrupeyāt) "pratitiṣṭhanti ha vā ete ya etā rātrīrupayanti" iti hi śrutiḥ | pratiṣṭhākāma upeyāditi vacanābhāve'pi arthavādoktaphale tātparyamaṅgīkṛtamityarthaḥ | vidheyopakārake virodhiphale'pi tātparyamastīti jñāpanātharmapagoraṇaśatayātanāsādhyasādhanabhāvavaccetyuktam | "tasmādbrāhmaṇāya nāpaguretayo'pagurute taṃ śatena yātayāt" iti hi śrutiḥ | anena mokṣopāyavirodhiphale'pi tātparyaṃ siddhamityabhiprāyaḥ | anuyāyihetuḥ kāryopayogitayaiva siddherityuktaḥ | upāsanaviṣayakāryopayogitvāt phalabhūtabrahmasvarūpe, tadviśeṣaṇaguṇādau, vidhivirodhini phale, saṃsāraheyatvādau ca vivakṣā kāryetyarthaḥ |
pravartakavākye'pi na tvadabhimatasiddhirityāha gāmiti | kāryārthe prādhānyena tvadabhimate kṛtyuddeśyalakṣaṇakāryārthe | kuta ityatrāha bhavadabhimateti | svedaśramādāvapi kṛtisādhyatvāt tadyvāvṛttyarthaṃ kriyākārye'pyuddeśyatvamaṅgīkāryam; tvaduktoddeśyatvasya durnirūpatayā tallakṣaṇakāryasya durnirūpatvādityarthaḥ | durnirūpatvaṃ kathamityatrāha  kṛtīti | kṛtibhāvabhāvi | kṛtiḥ āntaraprayatnaḥ; tatsadbhāvānantarabhāvi | kṛtisādhyatvaṃ bhāvārthādiṣvapyasatīti tadyvāvṛttyarthaṃ kṛtyuddeśyamityuktam | kṛtyuddeśyatvaṃ kṛtipradhānatvamityarthaḥ | kāryasya kṛtisādhyatvamiṣṭatvaṃ kṛtyuddeśyatvamiti trayamapi tanmate'bhyupagatam | iṣṭatvakṛtisādhayatve phalabhāvārthasādhāraṇe | kṛtipradhānatvaṃ hyākāradvayavilakṣaṇaṃ phalabhāvārthavyāvartakaṃ varṇyate | yathā ṭīkāyāmuktam, "kāryamarthaṃ pratipādayato vedasya prāmāṇyam" iti | atrārthaśabdena prādhānyaṃ vivakṣitam | yathā pañcikāyām, "kāyarm arthaṃ pradhānatayā pratipādayato vedasya prāmāṇyam; tatraiva prāmāṇyaśabdavyutpatteḥ vyutpattyāyattatvāt tasya" iti | prakaraṇaśālikāyām, "kṛtisādhyaṃ pradhānaṃ yat tat kāyarmabhidhīyate" iti | tatra tṛtīyākāratayā'bhimataṃ kṛtyuddeśyatvaṃ kṛtisādhyatveṣṭatvākārayorantarākāre paryavasyatītyabhiprāyeṇa dūṣayitumāha  kṛtyuddeśyatvaṃ ceti | pāṇinyuktaprakāreṇa karmatvaṃ vivṛṇoti kṛtikarmatvaṃ ceti | iṣṭatamatvaṃ ca kārye nāstītyāha  iṣṭatamaṃ ceti | kṛtikarmatvaṃ nāma pravartakatvamityatrāha  tatreti | tadapīṣṭasya svaprayatnasādhyatvamevetyarthaḥ | ādiśabdena duḥkhanivṛttirucyate | svaprayatnāt ṛte yadītyāderayaṃ bhāvaḥkṛtisādhyatvātirikikṛtikarmatvaṃ nāma iṣṭatamatveparyavasyatīti | prayatnecchuḥ cikīrṣuḥ | pravartate | āntaraprayatnamicchan sa tamutpādayatītyarthaḥ | iṣṭatamasyaiva rūpadvayamasti icchāviṣayatvaṃ prerakatvañceti | tatra prerakatvaṃ kṛtyuddeśyatvamityatrāha  icchāviṣayatyeti | kuta ityatrāha  tata eveti | puruṣānukūlatvaṃ kṛtyuddeśyatvamityatrāha  na ceti | sukhameva puruṣānukūlamiti na vācyam, sukhavyatiriktasyāpi anukūlatvadarśanādityatrāha  na ca duḥkhanivṛtteḥ puruṣānukūlatvamiti | na hi duḥkhanivṛttiḥ sukhaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | etadupapādayati puruṣānukūlamiti | tarhi duḥkhanivṛttericchāviṣayatvaṃ kathamityatrāha duḥkhasyeti | svata iṣṭatvamanukūlatvam; na tvaniṣṭāntarahetutayā iṣṭanivṛttirūpatayā vā'niṣṭatvam | ato duḥkhanivṛtteriṣṭatvaṃ duḥkhasya pratikūlatvādityarthaḥ | duḥkhanivṛtteranukūlatvābhāvamupapādayati anukūlapratikūleti | svarūpeṇāvasthitiḥsukhanivṛttirūpā duḥkhanivṛttirūpā ca | anukūlapratikūlānvayaviraharūpāyāṃ svarūpeṇāvasthitau duḥkhanivṛttyaṃśasya sāmānādhikaraṇyena vyapadeśaḥ | duḥkhanivṛtteriva sukhaṃ cetduḥkhanivṛttau sukhanivṛttirna syāt | tadā suṣuptāvapi sukhānvayaprasaṅgaḥ | anyataranivṛttiranyatarasaṃyogaścetsvāpe'pi sukhaduḥkhānvayaḥ prasajediti bhāvaḥ | apūrvasyānukūlatvāsaṃbhave dṛṣṭāntābhiprāyeṇa kriyādyupādānam | kriyāderityādiśabdena prayatno vivakṣitaḥ | sukhāsādhanatvādanukātvamityatrāha neti | kuta ityatrāha duḥkhātmakatvāditi | tasyakriyādeḥ | pratikūlarūpatayā bhāsamānaṃ vā tadviṣayajñānaṃ vā duḥkham; na tadyvatiriktamātmaguṇāntaramityabhipretya duḥkhātmakatvādityayaṃ heturuktaḥ | sukhārthatayeti | na hi daṇḍacakrādirghaṭo bhavatītyarthaḥ | asukhārthāt sukhārthasya kiṃ vaiṣamyamityatrāha  sukhārthatayā'pīti |
kṛtiśeṣitvaṃ kṛtyuddeśyatvamiti pakṣaṃ dūṣayati  na ceti | anirūpaṇātdurnirūpatvādityarthaḥ | poddeśapravṛttakṛtivyāptyarhatvaṃ śeṣatvamiti pakṣamanūdya dūṣayati  na ca paroddeśapravṛttetyādinā | na ca paroddeśapravṛttyarhatāyā iti | utpattiśca pravṛttimadvyāpāraḥ | ataḥ pravṛttyarhatvam utpattyarhatvam | paroddeśapravṛttyarhatāyāḥ śeṣatvarūpatayetyarthaḥ | uddeśyatvasyaiva nirūpyamāṇatvāditi | ayamarthaḥkṛtyuddeśyatvamkṛtiśeṣitvam; śeṣitvañca śeṣapratisambandhitvam; śeṣatvam paroddeśapravṛttyarhatvamityukte sati uddeśyatvaṃ nāma uddeśyatvamityuktaṃ bhavatītyāmāśrayaḥ; uddeśyatvanirūpaṇopayuktasya śeṣatvanirūpaṇasya uddeśyanirūpaṇasāpekṣatvāditi | kiṃ paroddeśapravṛttyayogavyavacchedo vivakṣitaḥ utānyayogavyavacchedaḥ iti vikalpe, prathame śirasi rājani ativyāptimāha pradhānasyāpīti | atroddeśyaśabdena prayojanabhāvābhisandhirvivakṣitaḥ; tatparihāramukhena dvitīyaṃ śiraḥ śaṅkate pradhānastviti | paroddeśena pravṛttyanyayogavyacchedo vivakṣitaḥ | sa tu pradhānasya nāsti, svoddeśenāpi tasya pravṛtteḥ | ato nātivyāptirityarthaḥ | pariharati neti | bhṛtyeṣvavyāptimāha mṛtyo'pi hīti | kāryapratisaṃbandhitvaṃ śeṣatvamiti pakṣaṃ dūṣayati  kāryasvarūpasyeti | kāryasvarūpe nirūpyamāṇe phalabhāvārthavilakṣaṇākāreṇa tannirūpaṇārthaṃ kāryatvaṃ kṛtyuddeśyatvamityuktam | uddeśyatvaṃ śeṣitvam; śeṣitvaṃ ca śeṣapratisambandhitvam; śaṣatvaṃ ca kāryapratisambandhitvam ityukte sati ātmāśrayaḥ syāt, kāryanirūpaṇopayuktaśeṣatvanirūpaṇasya kāryanirūpaṇasāpekṣatvādityarthaḥ |
bhāṣyakārābhimataṃ śeṣatvalakṣaṇaṃ svavīkṛtya kṛtyuddeśyatvasamarthanamapi duśśakam | tathāhi "paragatātiśayādhānecchayopādeyatvameva yasya svarūpam, śeṣaḥ; paraśca śeṣī" iti bhagavān bhāṣyakāro vedārthasaṅgrahe śeṣilakṣaṇabhāṣiṣṭa | "śeṣaḥ parārthatvāt" iti śeṣaśeṣibhāvalakṣaṇaparasya jaiminīyasūtrasya parairanyathāvyākhyātatvāt tadyvāvṛttyarthaṃ tasya sūtrasvārtho'nena lakṣaṇagranthena yathāvat pradarśyate | asyāthar ucyateanyasya prayojanameva yasya paramaprayojanaṃ sa śeṣaḥ, anyaḥ śeṣīti vākyārthaḥ | atra paraśabdo'nyaparyāyaḥ, paraatiśayaśabdayoḥ karmadhārayaśaṅkānivṛttyartho gataśabdaḥ | tena svagatātiśayādhāyake śeṣiṇyativyāptivyudāsaḥ | atiśayaśabdaḥ pratikūlatarākāraparaḥ | nikṛṣṭetarākāraparo vā | tena parāgatavināśādhāyakaśastrāgnikaṇkādīnāṃ vināśyaṃ prati śeṣatvavyudāsaḥ | na ca duḥkhahetuṣu yātanāśarīreṣvavyāptiḥ; teṣāmapi duḥkhajananadvārā pāpakṣayalakṣaṇātiśayahetutvāt | na cānutpanne apūrve vrīhyādibhiratiśayādhānāyogāt teṣvavyāptiḥ, sattālābhasyātiśayarūpatvāt; nikarṣātmakadharmetarākāro hyatiśayaḥ | nanu mānasaṃbandhārhaṃ vyavahārārhaṃ vā yat svarūpaṃ tadeva saditi bhavanmatam; sattājātyabhāvāt | tat kathaṃ svarūpamevākāra ityucyate | na; svarūpasyaiva sattārūpatve'pi tallābhasyā''kāratvopapatteḥ | sattālābho hyatiśaya ityuktam | sattālakṣaṇasvarūpasya ca lābho nāma prathamakṣaṇasaṃbandhaḥ | svarūpasyāvidyamānatve'pi dhīsthatayā parātiśayādhānavyavahāra upapannaḥ | icchayetipadena paragatātiśayasya icchāviṣayatayā prayojanatvamavagamyate | icchāpadasya ca nirupapadatvāt sākṣādevecchāviṣayatvamabhipretam | sākṣācchāviṣayaśca paramaprayojanam; avāntaraprayojanasya hi tadarthatayeṣṭatvamiti na sākṣādicchāviṣayatvam | ataḥ paramaprayojanajñāpakena icchayeti padena parārthatvādityarthaśabdo vyākhyāto bhavati | arthyata iti hyarthaḥ; iṣyata iti yāvat | nirupapadaścātharśabdaḥ svataḥparamaprayojanaparaḥ | anena svātiśayādhāyake bhṛtyādau lakṣaṇasyāvyāptiśaṅkā vyudāsaḥ | bhṛtyo hi svālaṅkārādikamapi svārmyātaśayāya bhavatīti hi (?) (sva) buddhayā svātiśayamādhatte | ato bhṛtyena svātiśayādhānasya parātiśayaḥ paramaprayojanamiti nāvyāptiḥ | upādeyatvamsvīkāryatvam; vyavahartavyatvamiti yāvat | icchāsvīkārau yathāyogyaṃ saṃbhavataḥ | śeṣaśeṣiṇorubhayoḥ, anyatarasmin vā saṃbhavataścet, icchāsvīkārau tadgatau staḥ | yathā rājabhṛtyarājatadbhavanādau | ubhayamacetanaṃ cet, ubhayavyatiriktacetanagatāvicchāsvīkārau; yathā prabhāprabhāvadyāgatadaṅgādike | upādeyatvamupādātumarhatvam | tenākiñcitkāradaśāyāmavyāptiparihāraḥ | evakāreṇa kadācitsvārthanirapekṣaparaprayojanasādhakeṣu prakṛṣṭakṛpāsnehānviteṣu ativyāptivyudāsaḥ | athavā kenacidākāreṇopahitasya śeṣatve sati tadanupahitasya śeṣatvavyāvṛttyartha evakāraḥ; anupahitasya prayojanāntarasādhakatvena parātiśayaikaśabdasya vyutpādanārthatvāt vyāvartyadharmāpekṣā | parātiśaya eva paramaprayojanaṃ yasya, sa paraṃ prati śeṣa iti lakṣaṇamuktaṃ bhavati |
yataḥ parātiśayasyaiva paramaprayājanasyā''dhāyakatvaṃ lakṣaṇam, ata eva paragatātiśayādhānāyogānyayogavyavacchedavikalpena rājanyabhṛtyayorativyāptyavyāptiprasañjanamasmatpakṣe nāvatarati; parātiśayamātrādhāyakatvasya lakṣaṇatvābhāvāt | na ca dvāraśeṣigatātiśayasya paramaśeṣigatātiśayaṃ prati prayojakatve satyapi tasya paramaprayojanatvābhāvāt dvāraśeṣiṇaṃ prati śeṣabhūtavastuni lakṣaṇasyāvyāptiḥ śaṅkanīyā; śeṣabhūtavastugatātiśayāpekṣayā śeṣigatātiśayasya pāramyamātrasya vivakṣitatayā paramaśeṣigatātiśayarūpaparamaprayojanatvasya vyudasanīyatvābhāvāt | tataśca dvāraśeṣigatātiśayasya śeṣabhūtavastugatātiśayāntarādhāyakatvena prayojanatvaṃ paramaśabdavyudasīnayam | nanu puruṣaśca karmārthatvāditi puruṣasya karmaśeṣatvaṃ karmamīmāṃsāyāṃ rāddhāntitam | puruṣaśca svargakāmaḥ iti tasya paragatātiśayaniṣpādanameva paramaprayojanaṃ na bhavatītyavyāptiriti cetna; tasya kartṛtvopahitaveṣeṇa śeṣatvādupahitasya karmaniṣpādanaikaprayojanatvācca karmaśeṣatopapatteḥ |
nanvetallakṣaṇamasaṃbhavahatam | na khalu cetayamānaḥ kaścit paragatātiśayaṃ svasya paramaprayojanaṃ matvā pravartate, kintu paraprayojanamapi svaprayojanārthaṃ matvā hi pravartate | ucyate | naivamasaṃbhavaḥ; acetaneṣu parātiśayaikaprayojanatvadarśanāt | yadyapi cetanaḥ svārasyena svaprayojanameva paramaprayojanaṃ manyatetathā'pi na lakṣaṇasya hāniḥ, janmakriyādyabhijñairmadhyasthaiḥ parātiśayaniṣpādanaikaprayojanatayā pratipattuṃ śakyatvāt | icchāsvīkārau yathāsambhavamiti hyuktam | tathā pratipattiyogyatvamaniṣṭamapyavarjanīyaṃ svayamapi bhṛtyo jānāti |
api ca parātiśayasya paramaprayojanatvāvagatiḥ svarasataścetanasyāpi saṃbhavati; prakṛṣṭakṛpāsnehānviteṣu taddaśarnāt | dayā hi svārthanirapekṣā paraduḥkhāsahiṣṇutā | atrānukūletarajanaḥ para iti vivakṣitaḥ | arthādikāmanayā paraduḥkhaṃ śiśamayiṣostadduḥkhānuvṛttiraniṣṭā syāditi tadvayudāsāya svārthānapekṣaśabdaḥ | yadyapi kṛpayā paraṃ rakṣataḥ śāstrasiddhamadṛṣṭam, tathāpyadṛṣṭābhisandhivirahitasyaiva paraduḥkhadarśanānantaramavaśāśrupātādimattvadarśanāt tadrakṣaṇadaśāyāmapyadṛṣṭābhisandhirāhityadarśanācca svārthānapekṣatā yuktā | paraduḥkhadarśanajanitatādātvikasvaduḥkhanivṛttirūpaphalāt tatpravṛttiriti na svārthānapekṣatvamiti cetīdṛśaṃ svārthatvaṃ śeṣasyāpyasti | taddhi svārthānapekṣatvaṃ na vihanti; kintu tadanukūlameva | paraduḥkhajñānarūpaduḥkhanivṛtiṃta parābhyudayajñānarūpaprītimattvaṃ ca vinā svārthānapekṣatvasya vivakṣitatvāt | tathā mitrādiṣu snehaprakarṣācca svārthānapekṣā pravṛttirbandhudraviṇayaśodharmahānikarī prāṇavyayakarī ca dṛśyate | saṃbandhaviśeṣānviteṣu prītiḥ snehaḥ, yasya vipākāḥ asthānabhayaśaṅkitvaṃ doṣānavabhāsaḥ doṣe'pi guṇabuddhirityādayaḥ | snigdhaśca janaḥ svasattānāmapekṣya putrādiduḥkhanivṛttyarthaṃ pravarttamāno dṛśyate | tacca tadgataduḥkhāsahatvakṛtam | yasya duḥkhātiśayadarśanaṃ svasattānapekṣatāmāpādayet, sa ca niratiśayaprītiviṣayaḥ; parānarthanimittāprītitāratamyasya tadviṣayaprītitāratamyanibandhanatvāt | yaśca niratiśayapriyaḥ, tadabhyudayo'pi niratiśayapriyaḥ | tatprītitāratamyasya tatsabandhiprītitāramyahetutvāt | tadabhyudayaśca paramaprayojanaṃ bhavati; svaprītihetubhūtasvagatārthāntarasādhanatvanairapekṣyeṇa svecchāviṣayatvāt | ataḥ kṛpayā snehena vā paraduḥkhāsahiṣṇutvadarśanāt paraprayojanasya paramaprayojanatvaṃ siddhamiti na śeṣalakṣaṇasyāsaṃbhavaḥ | na ca paramaprayojanarūpaparātiśayādhāyakatvasya mitrādiṣvapi saṃbhavāt lakṣaṇasyātivyāptiḥ śaṅkanīyā; teṣāṃ parātiśayaikaprayojanatvaniyamābhāvāt | taddhi teṣāmākāraviśeṣopahitarūpeṇa vā yāvajjīvaṃ vā puruṣaviśeṣaṃ prati na niyatam | puruṣabhedenāpyaniyatañca | bhṛtyeṣu tu tanniyatam; śeṣiviśeṣaniyamābhāve'pi yaṃ kañcitprati pārārthyaṃ bhṛtyāderyāvadātmabhāvīti | yadīdṛktavaṃ na dṛśyate, teṣāṃ na bhṛtyatvam | yadvā yadyapi garbhadāsādayaḥ sveṣāṃ parārthaikaprayojanatvamajānantaḥ śeṣiṇyatiśayādhānamapi svārthaṃ manyantetathāpi sthūlo'hamityātmano dehādyabhinnatvabuddhivat sā bhrāntiriti na lakṣaṇāvyāptiḥ, svārthatvabuddherātmasthūlatvadhiya iva pramāṇabādhitatvāt | na ca svārthatvabhrāntimātreṇa pārārthyahāniḥ | na hyātmanaḥ sthūlo'hamiti bhrāntyā dehavailakṣaṇyahāniḥ | evaṃ cicitorapi svātantryabuddheḥ śrutibādhitvānna lakṣaṇāvyāptiḥ | na khalu vrīhyādīnāṃ yāgīyatvājñāne'pi yāgaśeṣatvahāniḥ |
svātantrābhimānavataḥ paramaprayojanarūpaṃ paragatātiśayaṃ niyamenānādadhataḥ kathaṃ lakṣaṇavattvamiti cetna; etadabuddhayā tathātvānavagame'pi vastutaḥ paramātmalīlopakaraṇatayā paramātmani līlārasarūpātiśayasya niyamena siddheḥ | tattvajñairīśvaraparikaratvena niyamena jñāyamānatvaṃ cāsya kiñcitkāraḥ | tena etatparikaravattayā jñāyamānatvarūpātiśayaḥ parasya sidhyet | taduktaṃ nītividbhiḥ, "manāgupakārila sarvasyāstveva; tatparikaratvena jñāyamānatvāt" iti | śeṣabhūtavastvāhitalīlārasādyatiśayabhāktavaṃ na paramātmano'vāptasamastakāmatvavirodhi | icchāyāṃ satyāmabhimataviniyogānuguṇaparikarasaṃpattirhyavāptasamastamākatvam | yathā''ha bhagavān bhāṣyakāro vedāntasāre, "asyā''tmatṛptasyāvāptasamastakāmatvaṃ hi sadā'bhimatasakalabhogopakaraṇasadbhāvaḥ" iti | ato yathoktaśeṣalakṣaṇamupapannam |
evamasmaduktaṃ śeṣalakṣaṇamaṅgīkṛtya kṛtiṃ prati śeṣitvaṃ kṛtyuddeśyatvamiti parairvarktuṃ na śakyate; vikalpāsahatvāt | kiṃ tvayā dvāraśeṣitvaṃ kṛtyuddeśyatvamabhimatam, uta paranaśeṣitvam | prathame bhāvārthasyāpi kṛtiśeṣitvaṃ syāt; tasya kṛtisādhyatvāt | dvitīye svargasya kṛtiṃ prati śeṣitvaṃ syāt; kṛtisādhyāpūrvasyāpi svargasādhanatvāt | ataḥ kṛtiśeṣitvarūpaṃ kṛtyuddeśyatvaṃ phalabhāvārtha vilakṣaṇākāreṇa na sidhyati |
atha kṛtiprayojanatvaṃ kṛtyuddeśyatvamiti pakṣaṃ dūṣayati nāpīti | na hi kṛtirnāma cetayamānā kācit prayojanavatī | tasmāt kṛtiprayojanaṃ nāma kṛtimatpuruṣaprayojanamityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityapekṣāyāṃ tacceṣṭatve paryavasyatītyāha sa ceti | kṛtisādhyatākṛtipradhānatvarūpaṃ kāryaṃ durnirūpameveti | kṛtipradhānatvaśabdena svedādivyāvṛttiḥ | kṛtisādhyatāśabdena ātmavyāvṛttiḥ; tasya hi kṛtiśeṣitvamasti | viśiṣṭasya lakṣaṇatvāt tatra viśeṣye durnirūpe sati viśiṣṭamevāsiddhamityarthaḥ | evaṃ tṛtīyākārarūpaṃ prayojanatvaṃ dūṣitam |
atha svataiṣṭatvarūpaṃ prayojanatvaṃ tatprayuktakṛtisādhyatvaṃ ca dūṣayati niyogasyāpīti | iṣiḥicchā | atrecchāviṣayabhūtārthāntarasādhanatvaviraheṇeṣṭatvaṃ svataiṣṭatvaṃ vivakṣitam | tat sukhasya duḥkhanivṛtteśca samānam | svata iṣṭatvaṃ svata iṣṭatvaprayuktakṛtisādhyatvañca tayoreva | tasmāt svataiṣṭatvatatprayuktakṛtisādhyatve tatsādhanatayeṣṭasya niyogasya ca sidhyata ityarthaḥ | sādhanatayeṣṭatvamupapādayati ata eva hīti | sādhanatvena siddhayanaṅgākāre dhātvartha eva kāryaṃ syādityāha anyatheti | etadvivṛṇoti svargakāmeti | ata iti | svargakāmapadānvayātpūrvaṃ dhātvarthamātrasyaiva kāryatāpratipatteḥ, tadanvaye tatsādhanatayaiva pratipatteścetyarthaḥ | prathamamananyārthatayā pratipannasya kāryasyānanyāthartvanirvahaṇāyāpūrvameva paścāt svargasādhanatvaṃ bhavatīti | ayamarthaḥyathā svaprādhānyanirvahaṇāya anujīvināmabhimataṃ prabhuḥ pradadāti, tadvat apūrvamapi svayaṃ pradhānatayā pratipannaṃ svaprādhānyanirvahaṇāya svaṃ sādhayataḥ puruṣasya svargaṃ dadātīti | yathā pañcikāyām, "ātmasiddhayanukūlasya niyojyasya prasiddhaye | kurvat svargādikamapi pradhānaṃ kāryameva naḥ" iti | upahāsyamsamīpasthairapi hāsyam | ata ityuktamarthaṃ vivṛṇoti svargakāmeti | prādhānyena kāryapratipattiḥ kimekapadaśravaṇavelāyām, uta rsvagakāmapadānvitavelāyāmiti vikalpamabhipretya prathame kalpe dūṣaṇam, anyathā kriyaiva kāryaṃ syādityanenoktaṃ bhavati | tasminneva pakṣe abhyupagamena dūṣaṇāntarañcaekapadena kāryamananyārthe pratipannamastu; tathā'pyanvitābhidhānadaśāyāṃ pratipanna evārthaḥ samyagarthaḥ | ato nānanyārthatvamiti | dvitīyakalpe dūṣaṇamucyate svargakāmapadānviteti | svargakāmapadānvitaliṅādinā tatsādhanatayaivābhidhānāt prathamamananyārthatayā pratipannamiti na vaktuṃ yuktamityarthaḥ | vyutpattidaśāyāmapūrvasya sādhanatayā vyutpattiḥ; abhidhānadaśāyāṃ tu ananyārthaṃ sthāyi kāyarmityeva pratīyata iti śaṅkāyām, apūrvavyutpattimato'pi puruṣasya ekapadaśravaṇavelāyāmananyārthatvapratītyanupapattimāha sukheti | "na nirviśeṣaṃ sāmānyam" iti nyāyāt sādhyamiti sāmānyenābhidhīyamānamapi viśeṣaniṣṭhatayā pratīyate | sukhaṃ duḥkhanivṛttistatsādhanaṃ vā trīṇyeva kṛtisādhyāni | tasmādeṣu triṣvanyatamena sādhyena bhavitavyam | tatra sukhatvaduḥkhanivṛttitvāyogāt tatsādhanatayaiva sādhyamiti pratīyate | kṛtirhi triṣvanyatamameva gocarayati; tathā darśanāt | darśanānurodhena cābhyupagantavyam | kṛteḥ kriyātiriktagocaratvādarśanena hi kṛtyapūrvayorghaṭakatvena bhāvārtho niveśitaḥ | tasmāt triṣvanyatamatvābhāve, sādhyamiti pratītireva na syādityarthaḥ | kiñca anvitābhidhānavādinā svargakāmapadānvita eva liṅādiḥ kāryamabhidadhātīti vaktavyam | tadānīṃ tatsaṃnidhānabalena tatsādhanatayaiva pratītiḥ syāditi nānanyārthatayā pratipattiriti | sukhetyāderevaṃ vā'rthaḥsukhaduḥkhanivṛttyanyatvāt svata iṣṭatayā kṛtisādhyatvamayuktam | tatsādhanādanyatayā parasparayeṣṭatvena kṛtisādhyatvamapyayuktamiti |
pūrvaṃ tṛtīyākārarūpaṃ prayojanatvaṃ nirastam; atha svataiṣṭatvarūpaṃ prayojanatvañca sukhaduḥkhanivṛttyanyatvānnirastam; idānīṃ svataiṣṭatvasiddhaye ananyārthatvadraḍhimne ca sambhāvanīyaṃ sukharūpaprayojanatvaṃ dūṣayitumupakramate api ceti | kimidaṃ niyogasya prayojanatvamiti | kiṃkṣepe | śaṅkate sukhavaditi | anukūlatvaṃ sukhetarasyānupapannaṃ manyamānaḥ pṛcchati kimiti | abhipretaṃ vivṛṇoti sukhameva hīti | punaḥ śaṅkate sukhaviśeṣavaditi | niyogāparaparyāyam paryāyaśabdabāhulyasaṃbhavādaparaśabdaḥ | sukhāntaramiti | yathā bhaumasukhādvilakṣaṇaṃ svargādisukhaṃ saṃbhāvyate, tathā tato'pi vilakṣaṇaṃ sukhāntaramidamityarthaḥ | pramāṇābhāvaṃ vaktumāha kiṃ tatreti | candanādisukhaṃ hi svānubhavasiddham | ataḥ svānubhavaḥ laukikavākyaṃ vede ca kāmyavidhivākyaṃ nityanaimittikavākyam arthavādāśca yathākramaṃ niyogasya sukharūpatāṃ prati pramāṇāni na bhavantītyucyate svānubhavaścedityādinā | tasya duḥkhātmakakriyāviṣayatvāt tena sukhādisādhanatayaiva kṛtisādhyatāmātrapratipādanāditi | duḥkhātmakasya sukhādisādhanabhūtadhātvarthamātrasya kartavyatāpratipādanādityarthaḥ | niyataiḍikaphalasyetyādinā yogyānupalabdhirucyate | niyataihikaphalasya karmaṇaḥaprastutapratibandhasya karmaṇa ityarthaḥ | anena antyeṣṭisāpekṣaparamāpūrvavyāvṛttiḥ |
atha kṛtisādhyatvaṃ dūṣayati  ato vidhivākyeṣvapīti | kiṃ vyutpattisiddhatvāt dhātvarthātiriktārthaḥ svīkriyate, uta puruṣārthatāsiddhayartham, uta sukhasādhanatvalakṣaṇavyavahitapuruṣārthatvasiddhayarthamiti vikalpaṃ hṛdi nidhāya prathamadvitīyakalpayoruttaramāha ata iti | ayamarthaḥuktaprakāreṇa dhātvārthātirikte vyutpattyabhāvāt tathāvidhasya svataḥ puruṣārthatvābhāvācceti | kartṛvyāpāraḥprayatnaḥ | śabdaśāstrasvārasyamapyasmatpakṣe vidyata ityāha śabdānuśāsanasiddhameveti | sādhanatvasiddhyarthaṃ kriyātiriktārthasvīkāra ityatrāha dhātvarthasya ceti | "yaja devapūjādau" iti hi dhāturiti bhāvaḥ |
prakṛtabrahmavicārārambhahetuḥ siddha ityāha ata iti | siddhavastuni buddhipūvarkaṃ yadṛcchayā ca ādyavyutpattisaṃbhavāt, anyathā'pi vidhiśeṣatayā siddheścetyarthaḥ | atha viśeṣaṇāṃśāsidiṃdha pariharati cāturmāsyādityādinā | karmaṇāmāvṛttividhānācca kṣayiphalatvamavagatamiti siddhamityanusaṃdheyam | "tadyatheha karmacito lokaḥ kṣīyate" ityādivākyamabhipretyāha kṣayiphalatvopadeśāditi | akṣayaphalaśravaṇanirvāhamāha vāyuśceti | na hi cāturmāsyādivākyeṣu akṣayaphalaśravaṇamarthavādoktatvāt tyajyate; api tu kamarṇāmāvṛttividhānāt kṣayiphalatvopadeśācca | tasmāt kamarṇāṃ kṣayiphalatvanirṇayasiddhiḥ | ato hetau viśeṣaṇāṃśaḥ siddhaḥ |
adhikaraṇārthamupasaṃharati ata iti | asyādhikaraṇasya brahmamīmāṃsā viṣayaḥ; sā kim ārambhaṇīyā, uta neti saṃśayaḥ; siddhavastuni śabvavyutpattirnāstīti vicāraḥ; astīti niścayaḥ; ārambhaḥ prayojanam ityadhikaraṇāṅgapañcakam | yathā''huḥ, "viṣayaḥ saṃśayaścaiva vicāro nirṇayastathā | prayojanena sahitametat syādaṅgapañcakam" iti | parīkṣya lokān ityādivākyaṃ prathamasūtrasthanyāyasiddhānuvādapūrvakaṃ gurūpasadananiyamavidhiparam; gurumevābhigacchedityuktatvāt | rāgataḥ pravṛttau satyāṃ vidheyābhāvādasya sūtrasya vākyatvaṃ na ghaṭate; uddeśyopādeyavibhāgavaddhi vākyam; vidheyaṃ hyupādeyam iti na vācyam; ajñātajñāpakatvāt | prāgajñāta vākyajñāpyaṃ hyupādeyam | rāgato brahmavicāre pravṛttasyāpi siddhavastuni vyutpattirnāstīti vākyena anārambhaṇīyatvaṃ jñāyate | taṃ prati, siddhavastuni vyutpattisaṃbhavādārambhaṇīyatvajñāpanamajñātajñāpanamevetyuddeśyopādeyavibhāgavattvaṃ sūtrasya | atra hi rāgataḥ pravṛttimataḥ pūrvapakṣahetunā nivṛttau prasaktāyāmapratipannastattatparihāro vidhīyate ||
iti jijñāsādhikaraṇam ||
atha śāstrakāṇḍadvikādhyāyapādapeṭikādhikaraṇarūpasambandhibhedena saptavidhāsu saṅgatiṣu saṅgatyantarāṇāṃ spaṣṭatvādadhikaraṇasaṅgatimāha  kimpunariti | śāstrasaṅgatirhi vedārthavicārarūpatayā spaṣṭatarā, vedāntārthavicārarūpatvātkāṇḍasaṅgatiḥ, kāraṇaviṣayatvāddvikasaṅgatiḥ, kāraṇaviṣayavākyatarkarūpatvādadhyāyasaṅgatiḥ, ayogavyavacchedaviśrānteḥ pādasaṅgatiḥ, śāstrārambhārthatvātpeṭikāsaṅgatiḥ, ato'vāntarasaṅgatiḥ niṃpunarityādibhāṣyeṇo cyate | jijñāsyamvicāryam, sakaletarapuruṣārthatatsādhanaparityāgapūrvakaṃ prāpyatvenopāyatvena ca yat jijñāsyamuktamityarthaḥ | prāpyatayā prāpakatayā ca hi brahma āpātataḥ pratipannam, anena jijñāsyamiti padena praṇavavedaprādhānādyaupacārikārvācīnabrahmaśabdārthavyāvṛttiḥ, tacca vyāvatarkasya lakṣaṇasya vaktavyatayāpi hi sidhyati | brahmaśabdavācyaṃ svarūpeṇa guṇaiśca niratiśayahavṛtvayogi, "bṛhati bṛhayati" "bṛhatvādbṛṃhaṇatvācca brahmeti paripaṭhyate" iti śrutismṛtinirvacanāt | tatra "brāhmaṇo vai sarvā devatāḥ" nakirindratvaduttara" agnissarvā devatāḥ "eka eva rudraḥ" somaḥ pavate janitā matīnāṃ janitā divo janitā pṛthivyāḥ | janitāgnejarnitā sūryasya janitendrasya janitota viṣṇoḥ" "āpo vā idaṃ sarvam" ityādibhirbrāhmaṇāgnīndrādīnāmapi samābhyadhikarahitahatatvapratītterarthatattvaṃ vyākulam, atasteṣu tāpatrayāturajijñāsyaṃ tat brahma kiṃlakṣaṇakamityarthaḥ | sarveṣāṃ samābhyadhikarāhitye pratīte'pi tadvayāhatamanyaparavākyāvagataṃ cetyanādaraṇīyam, tattvapradhāneṣu sṛṣṭipralayaprakaraṇeṣu yadeva niratiśayabṛhaduktaṃ tadeva jijñāsyamityabhiprāyeṇāha "yato vā imānī" tyādiśrutiritīmamarthaṃ hṛdi nidhāya sūtrakāreṇa janamādisūtraṃ praṇītamityabhiprāyava toktaṃ kiṃ punastadvrahma yajjijñāsyamucyata iti | nahi kiṃ punarbrahmetyuktam |
sūtramupādatte janmādyasya yata iti | prathamapadaṃ vyācaṣṭe janmādīti sṛṣṭisthitipralayamiti |anyat padadvayaṃ vākyātharyojanāyāṃ vyākhyāsyate, prathamapadavyākhyānasya samāsātharnirṇayārthaṃ vākyānrasāpekṣatvena vākyārthayojanāyāmantarbhāvayitumaśakyatvāttasya pṛthagvyākhyānam | sṛṣṭisthitipralayamityatra sṛṣṭiśabda utpattiparaḥ "sṛṣṭisthityantakāleṣu" "sṛṣṭisthinyantakaraṇī, ityādiprayogāt | prayojyaprayojakavyāpāravāciśabdānāṃ vyatikareṇa prayogo brahmaṇa eva nimittopādānatvābhiprāyanibandhanaḥ | sṛṣṭisthitipralayamiti samāhārārthe dvandvaḥ | ekasmi nkārye anyonyasāpekṣatayā tulyaniṣpādakatvenānvaya itaretarayogaḥ | yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ svargaṃ prati, atra samuditāvivakṣā,ayameva samudāyavivakṣāyāṃ samāhāraḥ,tatkṛtamekavacanatvaṃ napuṃsakatvañca; ato'tra sṛṣṭisthitipralayamiti samāhāre dvandvaḥ kṛtaḥ, vākyārthaṃyojanāyāṃ sṛṣṭisthitipralayā iti itaretayogadvandvaḥ kṛtaḥ, ubhayorapi phalaikyāt | janmādītītyatra itikaraṇena tatraikavacane tātparyaṃ gamyate, tatra padārthayojanāyāṃ sṛṣṭisthitipralayamityekavacanānta padena sautrapadasyaikavacanamanusṛtam tatrāpyekavacanaṃ, sṛṣṭisthitipralayānāṃ samudāyo lakṣaṇam, na tvekaikamiti jñāpanārtham |
samudāyasya lakṣaṇatvaṃ śrutisvārasyādavasīyate "yato vā imāni bhūtāni jāyante | yena jātāni jīvanti | yatprayantyabhisaṃviśanti" ityatra hi na prativākyaṃ tadbahmetyuktam |anyathaikataralakṣaṇavaiyarthyaṃ ca syāt | na ca samaditaṃ lakṣaṇam, vyāvartyābhāvāt | na hi jagadutpattau nimitopādānabhūtaṃ stityādikāraṇatvavyavacchedyaṃ kimapi vastva stīti cet  satyam; vyavacchedyaṃ neṣyate | tathāpi śrutyanurodhātsūtrakāreṇaivamuktam | śrutiśca "tadvijijñāsasva" iti vidhitsitopāsanopayoginiratiśayavṛhattvavipatītāvṛhattvaśaṅkāvyavacchedārthaṃ samudāyamāha | śaṅkitavyavacchedenāpi hi saprayojanatvaṃ syāt; lakṣyākāraviparītaśaṅkānirākaraṇena vinā lakṣyākāraniścayāyogāt | na ca janmādiṣvekaikakāraṇatvaṃ lakṣyākāraviparītaśaṅkānirākaraṇakṣamam | tathā (dā?)hi  utpattikāraṇatve'bhihitepi sthityādikāraṇatvaṃ na cet, tadanuguṇajñānaśaktivirahāt sthitipralayakāraṇabhūtavastvantara sadbhāvācca janmamātrakāraṇasya niratiśayabṛhattvaṃ na syāt | mukterlayāntarbhāvāt mokṣapradatayopāsyasyaiva prāpyatvācca mokṣapradatvaprāpyatvānuguṇairguṇaiśca vṛhattvaṃ na sidhyati | ato janmakāraṇatvamātrasya samastavastuvyavacchedakṣamatve'pi janmādisamudāyakāraṇatvasyaiva niratiśayavṛhattvaraupayikatvāt sṛṣṭisthitipralayasamudāyakāraṇatvaṃ lakṣaṇamiti jñāpitam |
samudāyasya lakṣaṇatvamihāvivakṣitam | janmādīti bahuvrīṃheranyapadārthapradhānatvena janmano'ntarbhūtatvādityatrāha  tadguṇeti | bahuvrīhirdvividhaḥ, tadguṇasaṃvijñāno'tadguṇasaṃvijñānaśca iti | tatra prathamasyodāharaṇaṃ "sarvā dīni sarvanāmāni" lambakarṇamānaya ityādi | dvitīyasyodāharaṇaṃ citragumānayeti | tacchabdena viśeṣyam, guṇaśabdena viśeṣaṇaṃ ca vivakṣitam | samityekīkāre | viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyañca ekakāryānvitatvena saha jñāpayatītyarthaḥ | evamapi bahuvrīhernnānyapadārthapradhānatvabhaṅgaḥ, svapadavācyaviśiṣya samudāyasya tatsamudāyino vā anyapadārthatayā vivakṣitatvopapatteḥ | samāsasthapadavācyasyāpi viśiṣṭasamudāyāntargatatvākāreṇa hyanyapadārthatvaṃ yujyate, svapadamātrasya tenākāreṇa tadvācakatvābhāvāt |
asyeti vyākhyeyapadopodānam | acintyetyādinā tadvayācaṣṭe | asyeti padasya jagata ityetāvanmātre (arthe?) vaktavye kimartho vistara iti cet sūtrakāravivakṣitārthakathanārthaḥ | tadvivakṣā ca śrutivivakṣayā | śrutivi vakṣā kathaṃ jñāyata iti cetucyate | "yato vā imāni bhūtāni jāyante" ityatra bhūśabdena kāryavarge'bhihitepi imānīti padaṃ kāryavargasya dharmigrāhakapramāṇasiddhākāraviśeṣaparam | tatra jagata ābhāsatāparatvaṃ brahmaṇo jijñāsyatānapayogīti vaicitryaparamimānītipadam, īdṛśakāryaniṣpādanānuguṇaguṇotkarṣaṃ brahmeti jñāpanārtham | śrutivākyasthedaṃśabdena nirdiśataḥ sūtrakārasyāpīyameva vivakṣā | jagataḥ imānītiśrutau bahuvacane satyapi sautramekavacana kṛtsnasya bhuvanasyaikakāryatāviśeṣeṇaikakartṛkatvajñāpanārtham; bhūtaśabdasya devādicaturvidhabhūtamātraparatvavyāvarttanena bhuvanakriyāyogikṛtsnakāryasamudāyātmakajagadviṣayatvajñāpanārtthañca | ata eva hi bhāṣye jagata ityuktam | tatra kāryavargasya cidacidātmakatvat tattatpramāṇasiddhacidacidvaicitrīmacintyetyādipadadvayenā''ha |
nanu gṛhādhikaraṇe, "gṛhaṃ sammāṣṭa " ityatra uddeśyagataviśeṣaṇe vivakṣābhāvādekavacane tātparyābhāva uktaḥ | tena nyāyena prasiddhavannirdeśarūpatayā anuvādarūpasyedaṃśabdasyoddeśyaviśeṣaṇe tātparyābhāve (vena?)naivaṃ vyākhyātavyam || maivam; gṛhādhikaraṇe hyuddeśyaviśeṣaramātravivakṣā na niṣiddhā |apitvanuvādasya mūlabhūtaprāpakavākyoktārthaviruddhaviśeṣaṇe hi tātparyābhāva uktaḥ | utpattivākhyasiddhasya gṛhabahutvasya viruddhaṃ hyekatvam | anyathā "aṣṭavarṣaṃ brāhmaramupanayīta" ityatrāpyaṣṭavarṣatvādiviśeṣaṇe tātparyābhāvaprasaṅgāt | atra tu prāpakavākyeṣu jagadvaicitryameva spaṣṭam | yadvā  yatra prayuktasya śabdasyārthāvivakṣāyāmanvayānupapattyā'ranarthakyam, tatroddeśyaviśeṣaṇavivakṣā tatra tatrāṅgīkṛtā | tasmādevaṃ vyākhyātuṃ yuktam |
tatrācidaṃśavaicitryamāha  acintyetyādinā padena | jīvakartṛkatayā cintayitumaśakyatvamacintya tvam | ākāśavāyvādibhedena vividhatvam | pratyekaṃ tattadvayaṣṭibāhulyena vicitratvam | īdṛśaracanasyetyarthaḥ, atra racanā saṃsthānam | atha cidvaicitryamāha  niyateti | asmindeśe asminkāle idaṃ phalamanena bhoktavyamiti niya mo brahmādipipīlikāntānāmaviśeṣeṇa bhavati | brahmaṇo'pi hi svamānaparimitavarṣaśatādadhikaṃ jīvitum, aṇḍā ntare praveṣṭumaṇḍādhipatyādadhikaṃ phalaṃ bhoktuñcāśakyam | evaṃ cidacidvaicitrīkathanena kṣetrajñamātrasya kartṛtvānupapattiḥ sūcitā | tṛtīyaṃ padamupādatte yata iti || pūrvapadasya śrutivivakṣānusāreṇa vyākhyānaṃ kṛtam; atra tu tādṛśapadaśravaṇābhāve'pi kathamanekaviśeṣaṇoktiḥ? ucyate; "yato yena yat" iti prasiddhavannirddeśo hi prāpakavākyasāpekṣāḥ, tatra prāpakavākyeṣu jagatkāraṇatvajijñāsyatvopayogiyāddaśaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭo yo dharmiviśeṣa uktaḥ, tādṛśaviśeṣaviśiṣṭaḥ sa evātra śrutau yacchabdena vivakṣita iti sūtrakārābhiprāya iti kṛtvā tattadviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭataddharmiviśeṣaparatvaṃ sautrasya yataśśabdasyoktam | yata ityatra tasipratyayasya sārvavibhaktikatvādvibhakatyantaraśaṅkā syāt | tena jagajjanmādayo yatra bhavantīti deśakālādivadadhikaraṇatvemeva brahmalakṣaṇamityapi śaṅkituṃ śakyam | evaṃ tasilopyekadvibahuvacanasādhāraṇatvātkāraṇavākyeṣu sadvrahmādyanekaśabdairabhidhānācca kāraṇānekatvaśaṅkā syāditi tadubhayavyudāsārthaṃ yasmādityuktam | upāyatayopeyatayāpi jijñāsyatve kāraṇatve copayuktāni tattatprāpakavākyasiddhānyetacchutivivakṣitāni viśeṣaṇāni darśayati sarvetyādinā | tistrā mūrtayaḥ aṃśāḥ, brahma aśīti yādavaprakāśa pakṣaḥ | prādhanapuruṣayoḥ kāraṇatvaṃ keṣāñcinmatam | īdṛśanyūnādhikatattvavyavacchedārtham, "tamīśvarāṇāṃ paramaṃ maheś varam" "sa kāraṇaṃ karaṇādhipādhipaḥ" ityādiśrutyanusāreṇa sarveśvarādityuktam | kāraṇavākyaśeṣabhūtaśodhakavākyasiddhaṃ jijñāsyatvopayoginaṃ cidacidvayāvarttakākāramāha nikhilaheyapratyanīkasvarūpāditi | nikhilaśabdenācidgataheyāḥ ṣaḍbhāvavikārāḥ, cidgataheyāḥ kleśakarmavipākāśayāśca vivakṣitāḥ | heyārhatve sati tadviyuktatvaṃ vyudasyate pratyanīkaśabdena | pratyanīkaścet, jagadupādānatvaṃ nopapadyata ityatrāha svarūpāditi | advārakaheyasambandho vyudastaḥ, na tu sadvāraka ityarthaḥ | heyapratyanīkatve viśeṣaṇāṃśe'pi heyāsambhavaḥ, tatsambandhavirodhi tvāt svapratikūlotpādakatvāyogāccetyatrāha satyasaṅkalpāditi | svasaṅkalpānurūpaṃ heyasambandhaṃ saṃśriteṣu tadvi yogaṃ ca karttuṃ samarthaḥ | na ca heyaṃ savarmīśvarāpekṣayā heyam, tatsaṅkalpanivatrtyatvena tallīlārasāvahatvāditi bhāvaḥ | satyasaṅkalpatvaṃ heyapratyanīkatvopapādakaṃ kāraṇatvajijñāsyatvopayogi ca | heyapratyanīkāt satyasaṅkalpāditi padadvayena "apahatapāpme"tyādivākyaṃ smāritam | jijñāsyatvopayoginī dharmisvarūpasya kalyāṇatāmāha jñāneti ānandatvaṃ svānukūlatvam | ādiśabdena satyatvamānantyaṃ ca vivakṣitam | heyapratyanīkatvaṃ pūrvamuktam | jñānāna ndeti bhāvapradānanirdeśaḥ |"dvayekayordvivacanaikavacane" itivat | jñānatvānandatvasatyatvāni na prādeśikānīti anantaśabdārthaḥ | ādiśabdenānantyasya gṛhītatve'pi sarvavyāpitvasya kālānantyakathanaṃ nityatvasya sārvatrikatvakathanaṃ sarvavastusāmānādhikaraṇyārhatvasya ca nityatvakṛtsnapradeśavṛttitvakathanaṃ hyaviruddham | kalyāṇatvamanyeṣāmanubhavitṛṇāmapyanukūlatvam | jñānatvādayaḥ kalyāṇaguṇā yasya tasmādityarthaḥ | yathā prabhāśraye dīpe prabhāṃ vinā āśrayāṃśasyaiva caturaṅgulatvarūpa(spaśar?)vattvojjalatvaguṇāḥ tathā brahmaṇo'pi jñānatvānandatvasadaikarūpatvāni svarūpasya guṇāḥ | dharmiṇo dharmasya ca jñānatve vyaktibhedādavirodhaḥ; dharmadhammaṇoḥ sādhāraṇākāro jñātvānandatvādiḥ | yathā narasyaiva sato rājño narāḥ parikarā ityukte vyaktibhedādavirodhaḥ; naratvaṃ cobhayasādhāraṇākāraḥ tadvat | dharmabhūtajñānavattāmāha sarvajñāditi | sarvajñatvaṃ nimittatvopayogi | sarvaśaktitvamupādānatvopayogi | anena cidaciccharīrakatvamapyabhipretaṃ bhavati; anyathopādānatvāyogāt | kiñca sarvajñatvam upāsakāpekṣitatatpratibandhatannirasanaprakārajñanopayogi; sarvaśaktitvaṃ tadvirodhinirasanopayogi; paramakāruṇikatvaṃ ca jijñāsyatvakāraṇatvopayogi; pralayadaśāyāmasatkalpaṃ cetanajātaṃ nirīkṣya dayayā hi sṛṣṭiḥ | saṃśritasauṃlabhyaṃ ca dayayaiva; yathā "mātā pitā bhrātā nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛdgatirnārāyaṇaḥ" iti | īdṛśeśvara upāyabhūtaḥ, upeyamanyadityatrāha parasmāditi | atra mātā pitetyanusandheyam | devatāviśeṣanirṇayārthamāha puṃsa iti | kāraṇavākyeṣu "chāgo vā mantravarṇāt" iti sūtranyāyātsadvraṃhmātmādisāmānyaśabdānāṃ puruṣanārāyaṇādiviśeṣaparyavasāyitvātsavarśrutīnāṃ nārāyaṇa eva paryavasānabhūmariti "yato vā imāni bhūtāni" ityāditerhṛdayamiti sūtrakārasya bhāva iti bhāṣyakārābhiprāyaḥ | puṃsa ityanena kāraṇabhūtasya vastunastrapādvibhūtimattvamapi sūcitam; puruṣasūkte "tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi" iti śravaṇāt | sūtrāthar iti | akṣarāthastātparyārthaścetyarthaḥ |
nanu yadīśvaro lilakṣayiṣitaḥ, tarhi tadasādhāraṇasarvajñatvādipratipādakasatyajñānādivākyānādareṇa janmādikāraṇatvaṃ kimarthaṃ sūtritam | ucyate | guṇaiḥ svarūpasya lakṣyamāṇatve tadapekṣayā bahiṣṭhāyā vibhūterupāsyānantarbhāvaḥ pratīyeta | sargādiviṣayabhūtayā tu vibhūtyā svarūpe lakṣyamāṇe tanniyamanadhāraṇādyapekṣitatvādeva guṇānantarbhāvo na śakyaśaṅkaḥ | ato guṇānāmiva vibhūteśca jijñāsyāntarbhāvajñāpanārthaṃ janmādilakṣaṇaṃ sūtritam | vibhūteśca jijñāsyāntarbhāvaḥ upāsātraividhyatattunyāyābhyāṃ setsyati || nanvevamapi kṛtsnavibhūterjijñāsyānta rbhāvo na sidhyati, tripādvibhūterjanmādyaspṛṣṭatvāt || maivam; tasyāḥ janmādyaspṛṣṭatve'pi "yatprayantī"tipralayavākyasthayacchabdanirdiṣṭe muktaprāpye brahmaṇyantarbhāvasiddheḥ | tathāhi  prayantītyetadaviśeṣaṇā'tyantikalayarūpaṃ mokṣa mapi pratipādayatīti yacchabdena muktaprāpyatayāpi brahma nirdiṣṭaṃ bhavati | prāpyākāraviśiṣṭaṃ ca brahma pramāṇāntarasidvamihānūdyate | pramāṇāntarāṇi ca vibhūtidvayaviśiṣṭam brahma prāpyaṃ vadanti | prāpyākāsya copāsyatvaṃ tatkratunyāyasiddham | tadevaṃlakṣaṇāntarbhūtena layāṃśenopalakṣitāyāsitripādvibhūterapi jijñāsyāntarbhāvasiddhiḥ sūtritā bhavati |
nanu yata iti sūtrapadasthāyāḥ pañcamyā upādānārthatvāt brahmopādānamiti, nimittāntarasadbhāvāt "upādānantu bhagavānnimittaṃ tu maheśvaraḥ" ityuktavyomātītapakṣāvakāśaḥ prasajet || naivam; yata iti pañcamyā hetumātraviṣayatvāt | hetvarthatvaṃ ca jātisthitilaya sādhāraṇatvādavagamyate | na tu "jāni kartuḥ prakṛtiḥ"ityāpādāna saṃjñāvidhānavat sthitikartuḥ janisthatilayasthānasya ca apādānasaṃjñāvidhānaṃ dṛśyate | tasmādiyaṃ hetau pañcamī | tataśca nimittopādānayorubhayorapi hetutvāviśeṣāt yata iti padenobhayavidhakāraṇatvamapi koḍīkṛtaṃ bhavati | yato vā imānītyādivākye yata iti padasyobhayaviṣayatvāt sautrapadasyāpyubhayaviṣayatvopapatteḥ || nanu "yato vā imāni" iti vākye yato yena yaditi yacchabdasyāvṛttatvāt yata iti padasya janisthitilayasādhāraṇyaṃ nāstīti tatra yata iti pañcamī upādanamātraviṣayā; jāyanta ityanenaivānvayāt | pañcamyartho hi, "janikarttuḥ prakṛtiḥ"ityeva pratīyate | kiñca hetumātraviṣayāyā api sautrapadapañcamyāḥ śrutivākyasthapañcamyabhihitopādānarūpahetuviśeṣe paryavasānaṃ syāt; sūtra sya śrutyaikārthyopapatteḥ | ataḥ śrutisūtrayorubhayorapi pañcamyā upādānamātraviṣayatvāt brahmopādānam,na tu nimittamiti || naivam; śrutau yata iti padasya janisthitilayasādhāraṇatvābhāve'pi yacchabdasyānudāvarūpatvādanuvādasya ca prāpakavākyasāpekṣatayā tadviruddhātharparatvāsambhavāt prāpakavākyeṣu ca "ekamevādvitīyaṃ tadaikṣata bahu syāṃ tattejo'sṛjata" ityupādānabhūtasyaiva brahmaṇo nimittāntaraṃ niṣidhya,ahameva jagadrūpeṇa bahu syāmiti saṅkalpamukatvā yathā saṅkalpaṃ tatkartṛkasṛṣṭeśca pratipādanāt tadanuvādini lakṣaṇavākye yata iti padamubhayaviṣayam | śrutyanuvidhāyitvājjanmasthitilayasādhāraṇatvācca sautraṃ ca yata iti padamubhayaviṣayameveti nimittāntaravādo vedāviruddhatvādanādaraṇīya eveti || evaṃ tarhi prakṛtyadhikaraṇapaunarukatyaṃ syāditi cenna | tatra hi nimittopādānaikyasya śrutipratipādyatvaṃ sama rthyate | atra tu nimittopādānaikyasiddhavatkāreṇa ta(a)syobhayavidhakāraṇatvasya lakṣaṇatvānupapattiḥ parihṛyata iti vaiṣamyāt |
nanvīśvara eva brahma cet, satyajñānādi lakṣaṇatvena vaktavyam | na tu janmādi; īśvarasya sarvavidhakāraṇatvāyogāt | nimittakāraṇamupādānaṃ caikameva hi vedānteṣu matam | tasmādīśvavarādatiriktaṃ brahmābhyupagacchato bhedābhedavādino'nukūlamidaṃ janmādilakṣaṇakathanam || naivam; cidacidviśiṣṭatayā satyasaṅkalpatayā ceśvarasyaiva bahu syāmiti īkṣaṇakṣamatvena sarvavidhakāraṇatvopapatteḥ | sanmātrasya cinmātrasya ca satyasaṅkalpatvāyogādīśvarasya ca brahmāṃśatayā'dhyastatayā cābhimatasyāṃśāntarādhyastāntarasamānādhikaraṇaśabdavācyatvāyogācca bhedābhedapakṣe mṛṣāvādi pakṣe ca bahu syāmiti saṅkalpapūvarkakāraṇatvaṃ na ghaṭata iti etalakṣaṇaṃ pareṣāmevānupapannam | kiñca bubhutsitasya lakṣaṇaṃ vācyam | bubhutsitaṃ copāsyam | īśvara evopāsyaḥ prāpyaśca | upāsanaṃ ca viśiṣṭaviṣayam; upāsātraividhya sya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | prāptiśca viśiṣṭaviṣayā, yathopāsanabhāvitvāt tasyāḥ | janmādi copāsya lakṣaṇam, "tadvijijñāsasveti pratipādanāt | satyajñānādi tu viśeṣyāṃśasya lakṣaṇam; na tu viśiṣṭasya | ato viśiṣṭasyaivopāsyatvāt jijñāsyabrahmalakṣaṇaṃ janmādyeva | yata ityasyānuvādarūpatvāt vijijñāsasveti jijñāsyatvavaca nācca jijñāsyatvopayogiśodhakavākyārthaśca yacchabde garbhitaḥ | tasmāt yasmādityādiviśeṣaṇānyuktāni ||
atha janmādīnāṃ lakṣaṇatve tatra janmano'ntarbhāve, tatrāpi samaditasya lakṣaṇatve ca kiṃ te pramāṇamityākāṅkṣāyāṃ sūtrakārairviṣayatvenābhipretāṃ śruti darśayati bhṛguriti | śāstraṃ praṇāṅyāviṣayaḥ | "yatā vā imāni" ityādimātre udāharttavye'pi arthavādarūpatāttpayarliṅgajñāpanārthoṃ prakaraṇasya brahmakramatvenānanyaparatvajñāpanārthaṃ ca bhṛgurvāṃ ityādyudāhṛtam | agnīndrādivastuṣu sarvotkṛṣṭatayā āpātapratīteṣu sarveṣāṃ sarvotkṛṣṭatvasyānupapannatvena tattvasya durnniścayatayā niratiśayavṛhattvāśrayavyaktiviśeṣajijñāsayā hi, "adhīhi bhagavo brahma" iti praśnaḥ | tatra vyaktiviśeṣasya lakṣaṇamucyata, "yato vā imāni" iti | yato yena yaditi yadvṛttayogāt kāratvamanū dyate | tadvrahmeti kāraṇasya brahmatvaṃ vidhīyate | tena kāraṇatvasya brahmalakṣaṇatvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati | tadvijijñāsasveti na vicārasyopāsanasya vā vidhiḥ | vicārātmakajñānaṃ rāgaprāptvānna vidheyam | upāsanātmakasya tu jñānasya "brahmavidāpnoti" iti prākaraṇikavākyāntarasiddhatvāt upakrame "adhīhi bhagavo brahme"tipraśnasya tattvaparatvenopāyaviṣayatvābhāvācca nopāsanātmakajñānamiha vidheyam | ato vijijñāsasveti upadi'yamānārthe avadhānārthaṃ sandehanivṛttyarthaṃ voktam, yā gandhavatī tāṃ pṛthivī viddhī"itivat | ataḥ kāraṇatvasya brahmalakṣaṇatvamevāsya vākyasya vidheyam | yathā yatra sārasaḥ sa devadattakedāra ityukte sārasasambandhasya devadattakedāralakṣaṇatvamuktaṃ syāt, tadvat | devadattakedāro bubhutsito dhīsthaḥ sārasasambandhaśca dṛṣṭaḥ | tasya devadattakedāralakṣaṇatvaṃ hyajñātam | atastadeva vākyasya vidheyam | evaṃ niratiśayavṛhattvaṃ bahuṣvartheṣvāpātataḥ pratītam | kāraṇatvaṃ ca prāpakavākyāvagatam | tasya niratiśayabṛḍahadvastulakṣaṇatvamanavagatamiti tadatra vidheyam | lakṣaṇasya ca sajātīyavijātīyavyāvarttanasvabhāvatvādanyeṣāṃ niratiśayavṛhattvaśaṅkāvyudāsaḥ phalitaḥ | ato nārāyaṇādiviśeṣaśabdavācyavastuviśeṣasyaiva niratiśayavṛhattvasiddhiḥ | ata eva hi parasmātpuṃsa ityuktam |
prāpakavākyaireva kāraṇabhūtavastuviśeṣasya niratiśayavṛhattvaṃ jñāyata iti kimanena lakṣaṇavākyena? sati cet na; agnyādīnāmapi karmabhāgavākyaiḥ sarvotkṛṣṭatvāvagamāt teṣu bṛhattvaśaṅkāvyudāsāya kāraṇavākyānāmapi tadvadanyaparatvābhāvena tattvaparatvajñāpanaparatvādasya vākyasya | atha śrutireva lakṣaṇaṃ pratipādayati cet, kiṃ sūtreṇeti śaṅkāyām, sūtratātparyārthaṃ vivakṣuḥ saṃśayaṃ darśayituṃ śrutigatahetunaiva saṃśayotpatiṃta darśayati tatreti | tatratādṛśa ityarthaḥ | pūrvapakṣānuguṇena viśeṣaṇabahutvena siddhāntānuguṇenaikavācanāntabrahmaśabdaikyena ca viśiṣṭatvaṃ saṃśayahetutvenābhipretya tatretyuktam | saṃśayasvarūpaṃ darśayati kimasmāditi | brahmamīmāṃsā kimārambhaṇīyā, uta na vā iti prathamavicāraḥ | tadarthaṃ vedāntā brahmaṇi pramāṇam, uta neti dvitīyavicāraśca caturasūtrīsādhāraṇaḥ | siddhasvarūpaṃ brahma na śāstraṃ pratipādayatītyāśaṅkayāha ...tacchāstrapramāṇakatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sambhavatyeva iti samanvayādhikaraṇopakame | tasyādhikaraṇasya śāstrārambhahetubhūtaprāmāṇyasamarthanārthatvavasya bhāṣyakāraireva vakṣyamāṇatvāt | tathā cāhuḥ 
"vyutpattyabhāvaḥ pratipattidaussthyamanyena siddhatvamathāphalatvam |
etāni vai sūtratuṣṭamenā'nārambhamūlāni nirākṛtāni"
iti, atastadvicārayugalamatrārthasiddhamityabhipratyaitadadhikaraṇāsādhāraṇaṃ saṃśayaśarīraṃ darśitaṃ kimasmāditi | yato vā imānītyādivākyaṃ brahma lakṣaṇataḥ pratipādayituṃ śaknoti, uta neti saṃśayaḥ | tadarthaṃ saṃśathyatekiṃ sṛṣṭayādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇatvenopalakṣaṇatvena ca brahmalakṣaṇatvaṃ sambhavati neti; tadarthaṃ viśeṣaṇapakṣe kiṃ viśeṣaṇabhedena viśeṣyabhedo'sti, neti; tadarthaṃ kiṃ viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣaṇatvaṃ svāśraya(?)sarvadharmavyāvarttakatayā, uta virodhidharmavyāvarttakatayeti | upalakṣaṇapakṣe kimākārāntarapratipattirasti, uta nāstīti | sarvadharmavyāvarttakatayā viśeṣaṇatvam; ākarāntarapratipattiśca nāstītipūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ | virodhidharmavyāvarttakatayaiva viśeṣaṇatvam; ākārāntarapratipattiścāstīti rāddhāntaḥ | sarvadharmavyāvartakatayā viśeṣaṇatve viśeṣyabhedaprasaṅgena janmādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇatvāyogāt ākārāntarapratipattyabhāvena copalakṣaṇatvāyogāt ubhayathāpi lakṣaṇatvāsambhavāditaṃ vākyaṃ brahma lakṣaṇataḥ pratipādayituṃ na śaktotīti lakṣaṇadaussthena brahmaṇi śāstraprāmāṇyābhāvāttadvicāro'nārambhaṇīya iti pūrvapakṣe phalitam | virodhidharmavyāvarttakatayaiva viśeṣaṇatve viśeṣyabhedābhāvājjanmādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇatvopapatteḥ ākārāntarapratipatisadbhāvādupalakṣaṇatvopapatteśca ubhayathā'pi lakṣaṇatvasambhavādidaṃ vākyaṃ brahma lakṣaṇataḥ pratipādayituṃ śaktetīti lakṣaṇasauṣṭhavena brahmaṇi śāstraprāmāṇyopapatteḥ tadvicārasyārambhaṇīyatvaṃ siddhānte phalitam |
tatra pūrvapakṣamupapādayituṃ pratijānīte na śakyamiti | janmādīnāṃ brahmalakṣaṇatvaṃ kiṃ viśeṣaṇatayā? utopalakṣaṇatayā? iti vikalpamabhipretya prathamaṃ dūṣayati na tāvaditi | kathaṃ viśeṣaṇatvena na lakṣayantītyatrāha ane keti | anekatvaprasaktirvyāvarttakatvaṃ vā kathamityatrāha viśeṣaṇatvaṃ hīti | viśeṣyate'neneti nirvacanānusāreṇa bhedakaṃ veśeṣaṇaṃ bhedyaṃ viśeṣyamiti prasiddheḥ, khaṇḍo muṇḍaḥ pūrṇaśṛṅgaḥ, nīlaṃ śuklaṃ pītama, ajo gajo mahiṣa ityā diṣu tathā darśanācceti bhāvaḥ | siddhānticchāyayā codayati nanviti | pariharati naivamiti | upasaṃhāraḥparyava sānam | anyathāpramāṇāntareṇaikyapratītyabhāve satītyarthaḥ | tatrāpidevadattādāvapi | pakṣe vaiṣamyamāha atra tviti | pramāṇāntareṇaikyamanavagatamiti vadato'yaṃ bhāvaḥ  "ekamevādvitīyam" ityādibhirapi naikatvaniścayaḥ, tatrāpyekatvādiviśeṣaṇabhedena bahutvāpatteḥ | ekamityādipadānām; eko vrīhiḥ ityādivannirvāhasambhavācceti | nanu na kevalaṃ pramāṇāntareṇaivaikyapratītiḥ; śābdī ca vidyate | tasyāṃ satyāṃ dharmibahutvaṃ na syāt | atra caikavacanāntadharmivācipadaikyaṃ viśeṣyaikyajñāpakamiti śaṅkate brahmaśabdeti | tadvrahma tadvrahmeti muhurmuhuruktirvā, tāni brahmā ṇīti bahuvacanaṃ vā nāstīti bhāvaḥ | pariharati neti | tat kathamityatrāha ajñāteti | ekavacanāntadharmivācipa daikyaṃ viśeṣaṇabahutvādhīnaṃ viśeṣyabahutvaṃ na bādhate; khaṇḍo muṇḍaḥ pūrṇaśṛṅgo gaurityatra bahutvapratīteḥ | ekavacanāntadharmivācipadaikyaṃ svato viśeṣyaikyapratipādakam, khaṇḍādiṣu pratyakṣabādhāt bahutvapratītiriti cenna; apratyakṣe ṣvapi goṣu khaṇḍa ityādivākye prayukte bahutvapratīteḥ | tasmāt viśeṣaṇabahutvaṃ ceti, viśeṣyabhedāpādakamityabhiprāyeṇoktam ajñātayovyakteriti | ajñātagovyakteḥpratyakṣegaṇādṛśyamānagovyakterityarthaḥ | khaṇḍo muṇḍa ityādivākyaprayogāsambhavavyudāsāya jijñāsorityuktam | gosāmānyajñāne satyadṛṣṭagovyaktitvājjijñāsāsambhavāt prayogasambhavaḥ |
sṛṣṭisthitipralayāḥ kiṃ pratyekalakṣaṇāni, uta sambhūyeti vikalpamabhipretya pratyekapekṣa dūṣaṇamuktam; sambhūyetipakṣe dūṣaṇamāha ata eveti | ata evaviśeṣaṇabhedasya svato viśeṣyabhedāpādakatvādi tyarthaḥ |
upalakṣaṇapakṣaṃ dūṣayati nāpīti | kuta ityatrāha ākārāntareti | vyāpakanivṛttyā vyāpyanivṛttiriti bhāvaḥ | vyāpakatvabhevopapādayati upalakṣaṇānāmiti | upalakṣaṇenopalakṣyapratipattau upalakṣaṇamupalakṣyākāraḥ pūrvapratipannākāraścetyākāratrayamavarjanīyam; sampratipannasthaleṣu taddarśanāt | yathā sārasasambandha upalakṣaṇam; devadattasambandhitvamupalakṣyam; kedāratvaṃ pūrvapratipannākāraḥ | ato'tra tṛtīyākārapratipattyabhāvādupalakṣaṇatvamanupapannami tyarthaḥ || śāsvarāgre candra ityatra kathamākāratrayamiti cetucyate | kālaviśeṣe deśaviśeṣasambandhaḥ upalakṣyākāraḥ; śākhāgramupalakṣaṇam; śākhācandrayośca ṛjupaśodevarttitvaṃ sambandhaḥ | sa ca sambando vākyāvagataḥ | ādityādivyāvarttakaṃ candraśabdabodhyaṃ candrasaṃthānaṃ tṛtīyākāraḥ | kedāratvādyākāraḥ pratyakṣapratītaḥ; candratvaṃ tu pūrvānubhūtatvāt dhīstham | kutra candra iti bubhutsāyāmevam | kaścandra iti bubhutsāyāṃ śabdavācyatvamupalakṣyam; svārasikena vā śabdotyāpitabubhutsāmūlena vā pratyakṣeṇa pratīto vakratādiḥ pūrvapratipannākāraḥ, anena nirviśeṣavastuvāde tū upalakṣaṇatvamapi nopapadyate ityuktaṃ bhavati | tṛtīyākārapratipattirastīti codayati nanu ceti | dūṣayati neti | satyatvādayaḥ kiṃ viśeṣaṇatayā lakṣaṇabhūtāḥ, uta upalakṣaṇayā | pūrvasmin kalpe dūṣaṇamuktam | anyatra caākārāntarapratipattyapekṣāyām vākyāntareṇa cet,anavasthā | svena cet ātmāśraya iti | ataḥ yato vā imānītyādivākyena ākārāntarapratipattirvaktavyā | tataścānyonyāśraya iti bhāvaḥ | ata iti | viśeṣaṇatvopalakṣaṇatvāyogādityarthaḥ ||....
siddhāntamavatārayati evaṃ prāpte'bhidhīyata iti | evamsūtrakārābhipretepūrvapakṣe prāpta; tavābhipretastatparihāra ucyata ityarthaḥ | jñāpyabahirbhūto jñāpyapratītyupāya upalakṣaṇam | jñāpyāntarbhūto jñāpyapratītyupāyo viśeṣaṇam | na caikasya jñāpyajñapakatvavirodhaḥ; ghaṭāderindriyasaṃyogapratisambandhitvena jñānotpattihetutvasya viṣayatvasya ca daśar nāt | evaṃ śabdato dhīsthatayā svaviśiṣṭapratītau hetubhūtaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti ubhayathāpi lakṣaṇatvopapatiṃta vakṣyana, "ekānekasvarūpāya sthūlasūkṣmātmane namaḥ" itivaccaramoktamupalakṣaṇapakṣe buddhisthatayā prathamamupapādayituṃ pratijā nīte jagaditi | nanūpalakṣaṇapakṣe anupapattiruktetyatrāha na ceti | ākārāntaramākāraviśeṣaḥ; sa copalaṇopalakṣyākārātirikta ityapunaruktiḥ | pṛthak tṛtīyākāraṃ darśayitumākāradvayaṃ vivakṣan pūrvamupalakṣyākāramāha upalakṣyaṃ hīti | atharvaśirasi, "vṛhati vṛṃhayati tasmāducyate paraṃ brahma" iti | śrīmati vaiṣṇave purāṇe ca "vṛhattvādvṛhaṇatvācca brahmeti paripaṭhyate" ityādirnirvacanaprasiddhidyotako hi śabdaḥ | ākāratrayapṛthakatvadyotanārthāścaśabdāḥ tatra tatra jñeyāḥ | kathaṃ niratiśayabṛhattvabṛhaṇatvapratipattirityatrāha bṛhateriti | maninpratyayāntasya rūḍhisahakṛtasya bṛhatidhātostadarthatvādityarthaḥ | yadvā brahmaśabdena bṛhattvabṛṃhaṇatvāvagatiḥ kathamityatrāha bṛhateriti | bṛhattvasya svarūpato guṇataśca vivakṣitatvāt bṛṃhaṇatvarūpabṛhattvamapi dhātvarthāntargatamiti bhāvaḥ | upalakṣaṇākāramāha tadupalakṣaṇeti | nanu sārasasya kedāreṇeva janmādīnāṃ brahmaṇā saha sambandho vaktavyaḥ, kiñca brahmaṇa upādānatve bāhyamata iva nimittāntarādhiṣṭheyatāprasaṅgena satyasaṅkalpatvādiguṇānvayalakṣaṇabṛhaṇatvāsiddhiśca syādityetacchaṅkādvayaṃ pari haran tṛtīyākāropasthāpakaṃ vākyaṃ cāvatārayati yato yenetyādinā | kutra kathaṃ prasiddhirityatrāha prasiddhiśceti | tacca kathamityapekṣāyāṃ tatpratipādanaṃ padānāmanvayamukhena darśayati tadapīti | tatnimittopādānatvarūpakāraṇatvam |
upādānatvādhiṣṭhātrantaranivāraṇayorupapādanaṃ kṛtaṃ "tadaikṣata bahu syām" "asṛjata" iti | rāmakṛṣṇādirūpeṇa bahubhavanavyāvṛttyarthe jagadrūpeṇa bahubhavanamiti darśitam, "tattejo asṛjata" ityanena |atra phalitaṃ sambandhamāha  tasmāditi | yathā upalakṣaṇena sārasenādhikaraṇatvena sambandhitvaṃ kedārasya, yathā candradeśasya śāravāyāśca ṛjubhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ, tathā brahmaṇa upalakṣaṇabhūtajanmādibhirhetumadbhāvaḥ sambandha ityuktaṃ bhavati, yathā prasiddhi anuvādarūpa tayā vākyasya | nimitāntaraśaṅkā cārthātparihṛtā bhavati |
evaṃ tṛtīyākārasyākṣepakamupalakṣaṇasambandhātmakaṃ nimittopādānarūpakāraṇatvamuktam | atha tadākṣiptaṃ tṛtīyākāramāha jagaditi | yataśśabdasmāritakāraṇavākyeṣu hi sārvajñyādyavagamaḥ | ato jagannimittopādānatākṣiptetyuktam | guṇānāmaparicchinnatayā tadviśiṣṭasya brahmaśabdavācyatāyogyatvajñāpanārthamākārabṛhattvenetyuktam | "yaḥ sarvajña" ityādivākyāvagatasārvajñyādīnāmupalakṣaṇatvābhāvānnanyonyāśrayaḥ | viśeṣaṇabahutvaṃ tu na viśeṣyabhedāpādakamiti vakṣyata iti na virodhaḥ | upalakṣaṇapakṣānupapattiparihāramupasaṃharati iti ceti | iti ca ataśce tyarthaḥ |
upalakṣyaṃ hītyādibhāṣyasyaivaṃ vā yojanā anavadhikātiśayaśabde tātpayarm | upalakṣyamanavadhikātiśayabṛhattvaṃ bṛṃhaṇatvaṃ ca | niravadhikabṛhattvaṃ ca svarūpato guṇato vibhūtitaścānavadhikabṛhattvam | bṛhattvabṛṃhaṇatvavi śeṣaḥ upalakṣya ityuktaṃ bhavati | tataścopalakṣyākāraikadeśabhūtaṃ bṛhatvabṛṃhaṇatvamātraṃ pūrvapratipannākāro bhavatīti phalitam | loke tathā darśanāt | devadattakedāratvaṃ hyupalakṣyam | na ca devadattasambandhitvamātram, ghaṭapaṭādiṣvatiprasaṅgāt | tadekadeśabhūtakedāratvamātreṇa ca pūrvapratipattiḥ | tasmādupalakṣyamityabhiprāyeṇa hyanadhikātiśayabṛhadbṛhaṇañcetyuktam | bṛhattva bṛṃhaṇatvaviśeṣayopalakṣyatvāt bṛhattvabṛhaṇatvamātraṃ pūrvapatipannākāra ityatharsiddhamiti hi śabdena sūcitam | kathaṃ tatpratipattirityatrāha bṛhaterdhātoriti | bṛhattvamātraṃ pūrvapratipannākāra ityadhyāhṛtena vākyena tadarthatvāditi pañcamyā anvayaḥ | yadvā na cetyādinā pūrvavākyenānvayaḥ | upalakṣaṇākāramāha  tadupalakṣaṇeti | tṛtīyākāramanyamapi vivakṣaḥ tatpratipādakaṃ vākyamavatārayannupalakṣaṇasyopalakṣyeṇa sambandhaṃ vadan nimittāntaraśaṅkāṃ ca vyudasyati yato yenetyādinā | pūrvavadarthaḥ | vivakṣitamanyaṃ tṛtīyākāramāha jagaditi | idānīṃ caśabdaḥ tṛtīyākārāntarasamuccaye | yathā kedāratvaṃ sārasādhikaraṇatvadevadattasambandhitvopayayogi, tathā sarvajñatvādayo'pyanavadhikātiśayabṛhattvabṛṃhaṇatvajanmādikāraṇatvopayoginaḥ |
atha viśeṣaṇatayā lakṣaṇatvamupapādayati jagajjanmādīnāmiti | kathaṃ na doṣaḥ; apavādakapramāṇābhāve viśeṣaṇabhedasya viśeṣyabhedāvahatvaṃ doṣatvena hyuktamityatrāha lakṣaṇabhūtānyapīti | lakṣaṇabhūtānivyāvarttakabhūtānītyarthaḥ | yadvā lakṣaṇabhūtānāṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ sajātīyavijātīyavyāvartanasvabhāvatve'pītyarthaḥ | svavirodhivyā vṛttamniyatabhinnāśrayaviśeṣaṇāśrayādvyāvṛttam; na tvaviruddhaviśeṣaṇāśrayādvyāvṛttamityarthaḥ | ayaṃ granthaḥ pakṣa viṣayaḥ | bahutvāpavādakapramāṇābhāve sati viśeṣaṇatvameva virodhitvamityatrāha ajñāteti | ayaṃ tu sapakṣaviṣayaḥ | devadattaḥ śyāmo yuvetvādyudāharaṇamatrābhipretam | apratyakṣaviṣayepyekavacanāntadharmivācipadaikyādviśeṣyaikyaṃ pratīyata ityarthaḥ | atra viśeṣyaikyavyavasthāpakaṃ kimityapekṣāyāṃ sapakṣe viśeṣyaikyamupapādayati viśeṣaṇānāmiti | śabdasvārasyādviśeṣaṇānāmekāśrayānvayapratīteḥ aviruddhaviśeṣaṇānāmekāśrayavṛttitvopapatterityarthaḥ | aviruddhaviśeṣa ṇatvaṃ viśeṣyaikyavyavasthāpakamityuktam bhavati | yadvā ajñātasvarūpa ityapi granthaḥ pakṣaviṣayaḥ | pūrvasmin granthe viśeṣaṇānāṃ viruddhaviśeṣaṇāśrayāt svāśrayabhekatvamuktam | apratyakṣatve sati bhinnaviśeṣaṇatvameva bhedakatvamitya
trāha ajñāteti | tatrāpyaviruddhaviśeṣaṇabhedo na viśeṣyabhedaka ityarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha viśeṣaṇānāmiti | deva dattaḥ śyāmo yuvā lohitākṣaḥ ityādāvaviruddhaviśeṣaṇānāmekāśrayatvadarśanāt pakṣīkṛte'pyekasminneva viśeṣaṇanāmanvayopapatterityarthaḥ | aviruddhaviśeṣaṇānāṃ viśeṣyabhedānāpādakatvamuktam; vipakṣabhūtakhaṇḍādiṣu bahutvaniyāmakamāha khaṇḍatvādayastviti | tataḥ pakṣasya vaiṣamyamāha  atra tviti | kālabhedenetyasyāyamabhiprāyaḥviśeṣyabrahmabahutve'pi jagajjanmādīnāṃ yaugapadyavyāghātāt kālabhedenāvirodha āśrayaṇīyaḥ; viśeṣyaikye'pi tathaivāvirodha iti |
atrāyamartho'nusandheyaḥ, viśeṣaṇabahutvaṃ svata eva viśeṣyabhedāpādakam, khaṇḍo muṇḍa ityādiṣu darśa nāt | devadattaḥ śyāmo yuvetyādiṣu pratyakṣabādhādaikyapratītiḥ | tasmāt pratyakṣāgocare brahmaṇi viśeṣaṇabahutvāyattaṃ viśeṣyabahutvamavarjanīyamiti cetekavacananānta dharmivāci padaikyasya svatoviśeṣyaikyaparatvaṃ devadatta śyāmo yuvenyādiṣu dṛṣṭam | khaṇḍā muṇḍa ityādiṣu pratyakṣabādhāt bahutvapratītiḥ | ataḥ pralyakṣā'gocare brahmaṇi ekavacānanta dharmivāci padaikyātokyaṃ siddhameva || naivam | viśeṣaṇabhedāyataṃ viśeṣyabahṛtvaṃ ekavacanāntadharmivācipadaikyaṃ na bādhate, api tu pratkṣabheva bādhate, adṛśyamānagovyakteḥ puruṣasya khaṇḍo muṇḍa ityādivākyaprayoge satyekavacanāntadharmivācipadaikyepi bahutvapratīteriti hi pūrvapakṣasthitiḥ | tatrottaramucyateajñātetyādinā | ekavacanāntadharmivācipadaikyaṃ bahutvaṃ bādhata eva; adṛśyamāne'pi devadatte devadattaḥ śyāmo yuvetyādivākyaprayoge viśeṣaṇabahutve satyapi viśeṣyaikyapratīteḥ | evaṃ pratyakṣāpratyakṣavibhāga vidhuraṃ bahutvapratītiraikyapratītiśca bhavataḥ | atra tu bahutvaikatvayoḥ ko nirṇāyaka iti cet niyatabhinnāśrayadṛṣṭaviśeṣaṇabahutvaṃ viśeṣyaikyavirodhi, aniyatabhinnāśraya dṛṣṭaviśeṣaṇabahutvaṃ naikyavirodhīti ||
atha satyajñānādīnāṃ lakṣaṇatvopapatiṃta pūrvoktānyonyāśrayaṇaparihārañcāha yato vā iti | lakṣaṇavākyenānena kāraṇatvameva lakṣaṇatvenoktamiti ayasya kāraṇavākyatvam | ādiśabdena "sadevetyādīni" kāraṇatvaprāpakavākyāni gṛhyante | nanu lakṣaṇabhūtenaiva janmādikāraṇatvena brahmaṇaḥ sajātīyavidhātīyavyāvṛttiḥ siddhā; anyathā tasya lakṣaṇatvāyogāt | tat kathaṃ satyādivākyena sakaletaravyāvṛttābhidhānoktiḥ || ucyate | vyāvṛttirdvividhā | vyakatyantareṣvasambhāvitadharmayogarūpātattajjātīyāsādhāraṇadharmānanvayarūpā ca | tatra vilakṣaṇadharmayoge vyakatyantarebhyo'nyatvaṃ siddhayati; na tvatajjātīyatvam | tajjātīyatvavyañjakadharmānvayādhīnatajjātīyatvaśaṅkāyā anavagamāt | tadananvaye tu tajjātīyatāvyāvṛttiḥ siddhyati | yathā ghaṭasya saṃsthānaviśeṣeṇa svetarasamastavailakṣa ṇye siddhe'pi pṛthivītvavyavasthāpakagandhavattvayogāt pṛthivījātīyatvaṃ nāpaiti, tadayogādabādiṣu tajjātīyatvā pagamaḥ evaṃ jagatkāraṇatvarūpavilakṣaṇadharmānvaye satyapi brahmaṇo acijjātīyatvajīvajātīyatvaśaṅkāvatiṣṭhata iti tajjātīyatāvyāvṛttiḥ satyajñānādivākyena pratipādyata iti tasya sakaletaravyavṛttasvarūpabodhakatoktiryukteti |
kathaṃ vyāvṛttasvarūpābhidhānamityatrāha tatreti | kenāpi pariṇāmaviśeṣeṇa tattadavasthasya sattā sopādhikasattā, ato nirupādhikasattā nirvikāratvam | satyapadavyāvartyamāha  teneti | kathamityatrāha  nāmāntareti | nirupapadaṃ sanyapadāmasaṅkocāt svarūpato dharmataścaikarūpatvaṃ jñāpayatītyacittatsaṃsṛṣṭajīvavyāvṛttiḥ | jñānaśabdārtha māha jñānapadamiti | idānīma asmin viṣaya ityādyupapadarahahitaṃ jñānapadamasaṅakucitatvaṃ nityatvañca jñānasya darśayati | nityāsaṅkucitajñānatvamevākāro yasya tata nityāsaṅkucitajñānaikākāram | tena brahmaṇaḥ kadācit kkacidapi pradeśe jaḍatvavyāvṛttiḥ | nityāsaṅkucitajñānatvamadvārakaṃ dharmadvārakaṃ ca paramātmana ākāro bhavati | "ātmajyotiḥ sabhrāḍiti hovāca", "brahmaṇā vipaścitā", vijñātāramare kena vijānīyāt" ityādibhiḥ svarūpasya dharmasya ca jñānatvāvagamāt jñānaśabdāsaṅkocena sadvārakādvārakajñānākāratvasiddhiḥ |
nanvasya jñānaśabdasya kiṃ pravṛttinimittam? viṣayāvagāhijñānākhyadravyatvaṃ cet aparyavasānāt jñānadharmakatvamuktaṃ syāt; na tu jñānasvarūpatā | svapramāśatārūpaṃ jñānatvaṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ cetajñānasvarūpatvamuktaṃ syāt; na tu jñānadharmakatvam | tataśca "tadguṇasāratvāt iti sūtravirodhaśca | na ca gavādiśabdānāṃ paramātmaparatve gotvasaṃsthānapiṇḍajīvānāmiva dvāradvāribhāvāt jñānākhyadravyajñānatvaguṇayordvayorapi pravṛttinimittatvaṃ ghaṭate | na hi dharmabhūtajñānaṃ svarūpabhūtajñānagatajñānatvaguṇa samavaiti, yena dvāradvāribhāvaḥ syāt || dharmabhūtajñāne svarūpe cānu gataṃ jñānatvameva pravṛvittinimittaṃ cetgośabdena khaṇḍamuṇḍapiṇḍadvayavat jñānavyaktidvayamuktaṃ syāditi dvāradvāribhāvenānabhidhānāttayorjñānayorna dharmadharmibhāvapratītiḥ, jñānatvaguṇaviśeṣitajñānadravyaviśiṣṭatayā jñānatvaguṇaviśiṣṭatayā ca svarūpasyābhidhāne śabdasya yugapadvyāpārabhedaḥ prasajet | ato jñānapadena svarūpato dharmataśca jñānākāratvamātmano na siddhayet ||
ucyate, jñānaśabdasya svaprakāśatārūpaṃ jñānatvaṃ pravṛttinimittam | na ca tadguṇasāratvāditi sūtravirodhaḥ; dharmabhūtajñānadravyābhidhāne'pi jñānatvasya pravṛttinimittatvāt | svarūpasya ca jñānatvaṃ, "prakāśavaccāvaiyarthyāt" iti sūtritam | na ca sadvārakamadvārakañca svarūpasyābhidhāne'pi śabdasya yugapadvyāpārabhedaḥ; sākṣādvā paramparayā veti viśeṣamanapekṣya jñānatvamātrasya pravṛttinimivatve sati śabdaśaktayasaṅkocātsākṣātpraṇāṅyā ca jñānatvaviśiṣṭatāvagamena jñānadharmakatvajñānasvarūpatvasiddheḥ | na ca dvāradvāribhāvenānabhidhānāt khaṇḍamuṇḍavyaktayoriva dharmadharmibhāvāsiddhiḥ, "ātmajyotiḥ samrāṭ" "brahmaṇā vipaścitā" "atrāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayaṃ jyotirbhavati" "eṣa hi draṣṭā śrotā rasayitā ghrātā mantā boddhā karttā vijñānātmā puruṣaḥ" ityādibhiḥ paramātmano jīvasya ca jñānadharmakatvasya jñānasvarūpatvasya ca siddheḥ | jñānaśabdasya cāsaṅkocena jñānātmanorviśeṣaṇāṃśe viśeṣyāṃśe ca jñānatvavaiśiṣṭayabodhanasāmārthyācca | yathā saparikaro rājā dṛṣṭaḥ saparicchadaṃ gṛhaṃ krītam, savatsā gauḥ krītetyādau viśeṣaṇāṃśasya viśaṣyāṃśasya ca dṛṣṭatvakrītatvānvaya ekavyāpāreṇa śabdena bodhyate tadvat | na ca viśeṣāṃśe viśeṣyāṃśe vā draṣṭatva krītatvānvayaḥārthaḥ viśeṣaṇāṃśaviśeṣyāṃśayoranyatareṇa vinānyatarasya dṛṣṭatvakrītatvānvayapratītyunupapattyabhāvāt | na hi pravāhasya ghoṣaṃ prati vāsatvavat(ghoṣaprativāsatvavat?)viśeṣaṇāṃśena vinā viśeṣyāṃśasya dṛṣṭatvakrītatvādikamanupapannam | na ca darśanakrayādiyogyatālakṣaṇenātharsāmarthyena viśeṣaṇāṃśasya tadanvayapratītiḥ; maṇḍapakṣetragodohanādīnāṃ darśanakrayādiyogyānāmapi tadanvayāpratīteḥ | tadapratītiśca bubhutsāyāṃ satyāṃ sandehodayāt siddhā | na ca samabhivyāhārabalāt viśeṣaṇāṃśasya tadanvayasiddhiḥ, dhārmiko rājā dṛṣṭa ityatra dharmasya dṛṣṭatvāpratīteḥ | na hi dhamarścakṣurviṣayaḥ, yogyatve sati samabhivyāhārabalāt tadanvayasiddhiriti cettarhi viśeṣaṇāṃśe'pi tadanvayasya śābdatvamuktaṃ syāt | na hyākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatānvayena pratipannatvaṃ śābdatvaṃ nivārayati || nanu saparikaro rājā dṛṣṭa ityādiṣu viśeṣaṇāṃśasya viśeṣyāṃsya ca śabdenopasthāpanāt tatra viśeṣaṇāṃśepi vidhitsitākārānvaya upa pannaḥ; atra tu tadabhāvādubhayatra vidhitsitākārānvayānupapattiriti || naivam; brahmaśabdenaiva viśiṣṭavastūpasthāpa nāt | tathāhi tadvijijñāsasveti mumukṣorjijñāsyatayoktaṃ brahma tadaikṣatetyādīni vākyāni satyasaṅkalpatvādiviśiṣṭaṃ kāraṇaṃ vadanti | tacchodhanapravṛttasatyādivākyagatabrahmaśabdaḥ satyasaṅkalpatvādiviśiṣṭakāraṇaviśeṣayaḥ | bṛṃhaṇatvamapi hi brahmaśabdārthaḥ | tacca svasaṅkalpenācetanasya sthūlapariṇāmahetutvam, cetanānāṃ "sa cānantyāyākalpate" ityuktajñānabṛhattvahetutvañca || tataśca satyasaṅkalpatvādiviśiṣṭārthopasthāpakabrahmaśabdapratipannaviśiṣṭavastuviśeṣakatvāt, jñānapadamasaṅkucitaśaktitayā viśeṣyāṃśe viśeṣaṇāṃśe ca svapravṛttinimittabhūtajñānatvānvayaṃ pratipādayati | sapari karo rājā dṛṣṭa ityādiṣu padāntarasamabhivyāhṛtaśabdena viśiṣṭopasthāpanam, atra tu svopajīvyavākyāntarasthanirvacanasāpekṣabrahmaśabdeneti bhidā | viśiṣṭavastunyupasthāpite sati viśeṣaṇāṃśasya viśeṣyāṃśasya ca vidhitsitākārānvayitvaṃ tulyam | svopajīvyavākyāntarasāpekṣaśabdena viśiṣṭavastuni upasthāpite vidhitsitākārasyobhayānvayitvañca dṛṣṭam, yathā sānucaro rājā samāgataḥ, mayā ca rājā satkṛta iti; savatsā gauḥ sthitā, sā ca datteti | ataḥ paramātmano jñānaśabdena jñānadharmakatvajñānasvarūpatvābhidhānaṃ yuktam | ānandādiśabdeṣvapyeṣa eva nyāyaḥ svataḥ pravarttate | pramāṇāntaravirodha sati tu nivarttate | ato yathoktārtha upapannaḥ | ataḥ sākṣāt praṇāṅyā ca nityāsaṅkucitajñānaikākāratvaṃ darśayatā jñānapadena muktavyāvṛttisiddhimāha teneti | anantapadasyārthamāha ananteti | ihedam,nānyayatreti paricchettumaśakyatvaṃ deśāparicchedaḥ | idamidānīm, nānyadeti paricchedāyogyatvaṃ kālapari cchedaḥ; na tu deśakālābhāvau | evaṃ vastvaparicchedā'pi na vastvantarābhāvaḥ; kiṃtu idāmidaṃ na bhavatīti paricchedānarhatvameva; sarvavastusāmānādhikaraṇyārhatvaṃ vastvapariccheda iti yāvat | brahmavyatirikte bhāvarūpājñānatatkāryajāte'ṅgīkṛte sati vastvantarābhāvarūpo vastvaparicchedaḥ parasyānupapannaḥ | satyavastvantarābhāvaḥ sa iti cet tarhi svaniṣṭhavastvantarābhāvaḥ sa ityabhyupagamo varam; pramāṇāntarāvirodhāt | satyavastvantarābhāvo hi tattaddharmigrāhakapramāṇaviruddhaḥ | guṇato'pyānantyamāha saguṇatvāditi | guṇānāṃ deśakālaparicchedau vidyete na tūktalakṣaṇavastuparicchedābhāvaḥ, sa tu svarūpasyaiva | yadvā prakārāntareṇa vastuparicchedābhāvamāha saguṇatvāditi | idami yaditi vastu svabhāvataḥ paricchedābhāvo vastvaparicchedaḥ; yathā tulyakāratve (tulyakālatve) tulyaparimāṇatve'pi daśavarṇasvarṇāpekṣayā ṣaḍvarṇasvarṇaṃ tadapekṣayā kaladhautādi cāpakṛṣṭam | so'pakarṣo vastuparicchedaḥ | tattadapekṣayā gurutvojjavalatvapavitratvādibhirdaśavarṇasvarṇādikaṃ prakṛṣṭam | tasya prakaṣarsya niratiśayatvaṃ vastvaparicchedaḥ | īdṛśavastvaparicchedaḥ svarūpasya guṇānāṃ ca yujyate; teṣāmapi heyapratyanīkatvādisvabhāvotkarṣasya niravadhikatvāt samābhyadhikarāhityanidānabhūto guṇairniratiśayaprakarṣo vastupariccheda ityuktaṃ bhavati | sarvavasutasāmānādhikaraṇyārhatvaṃ cāsminnantargatam | taddhi sarvaśarīrakatvam | tacca niyamanadhāraṇaśeṣitvakāṣṭheti | anantapadavyavacchedyamāha teneti | sātiśayasvarūpatvaguṇā iti | svarūpamaṇutvāt sātiśayam | jñānavyatirikta aiśvaryādiguṇāśca jagadvyāpārānarhatayā sātiśayāḥ | jñānaṃ ca nityaṃ sarvagatamapi tathātvasya paramātmanityecchādhīnatvāt sātiśayam | aparādhīnatvarūpasyātiśayasya parasmin vidyāmānatvāt svābhāvikatve'pi guṇānāṃ sātāyatvamiti jñāpanārthaḥ sva śabdaḥ | evaṃ vyāvṛttikathanasya hetumāha viśeṣaṇānāmiti | anyonyāśrayasya parihṛtatvaṃ darśayati tata iti | tataḥevaṃ vyāvṛttisiddheḥ | avagatasvarūpamavagatāsādhāraṇākāram | janmādikāraṇatvaṃ hyasādhāraṇākāraḥ; tat lakṣaṇatvenāvagatamityarthaḥ | vastuviśeṣyasvarūpam | brahmeti vā pāṭhaḥ | kāraṇatayā lakṣitasya brahmaṇaḥ kāraṇatvāṅkitadoṣavyāvartakatvācchodhakavākyānāṃ lakṣaṇavākyapūvarkatvamanti,na tu tasya śodhakavākyapūrvakatvamiti nānyonyāśrayaṇamityarthaḥ | sūtrakāraiḥ satyajñānādīnāṃ lakṣaṇatvenānuktinidānaṃ ca anenaiva darśitaṃ bhavati | viśaṣyāṃśasya lakṣaṇaṃ satyajñānādi; na tu viśiṣṭasya | viśiṣṭasyaivopāsyatvātprāpyatvācca jijñāsyabrahmalakṣaṇaṃ janmādyeveti sūtrakārābhiprāyaḥ | jagatkāraṇaṃ brahma jijñāsyamityuktate kāraṇatvaśaṅkitadoṣavyāvarttakatayā taccheṣabhūtaḥ śodhakavākyārthaścāsmin sūtre sūtrakārābhipretaḥ | jijñāsyatvānuguṇasya kāraṇatvasyaiva lakṣaṇatayā vinākṣitatvāt | svarūpeṇa heyāspayasya jijñāsyatvānupapatyā jijñāsyatāyāḥ śodhakavākyārthasāpekṣatvāt | satyajñānādivākyaviṣayasūtrāntarābhāvāt "prājñavat" "prakāśavacca" "prakāśādivacca" iti sūtrāṇāṃ satyādivākyaṃ dṛṣṭāntatayopajīvya arthāntaropapādanaparatvācca satyajñānādivākyārthaścehābhipretaḥ ityabhiprāyeṇa bhāṣyakārairnisvilaheyapratyanīkasvarūpādityādi viśeṣaṇamuktam |
adhikaraṇārthamupasaṃharati | ata iti | ataḥjanmādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇatayā upalakṣaṇatayā ca lakṣaṇatvopa patteḥ | jijñāsyatvopayogiśodhakavākyāvagatākāraviśiṣṭameva kāraṇavastu "yato vā imāni" ityādikye arthalabdhamityabhiprāyeṇāha niravadyamiti | sarvajñatvādiguṇajātaṃ kāraṇatvākṣiptaṃ yata iti atrānūdyata ityabhiprāyeṇa taduktiḥ |
asya sūtradvayasya nirviśeṣavādipakṣāsaṅgatimāha ye tviti | ādyasūtrāsaṅgatimupapādayati niratiśa yeti | atharvaśirasi śrīviṣṇupurāṇe coktanirvacanamabhipretam | na, nirviśeṣaṃ brahmeti niruktamiti bhāvaḥ | dvitīyasūtrāsaṅgatiṃ vivṛṇoti tacceti | na hi, jagato'dhyāso yata iti lilakṣayiṣitamiti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ sūtrāsaṅgatikatha nena tadviṣayavākyāsaṅgatirapi phalitā | uttareṣāṃ sūtrāṇāṃ tattadviṣayavākyānāmapi nirviśeṣapakṣānanuguṇatvamāha evamiti | sūtragaṇeṣviti | naikaikaṃ sūtraṃ vākyaṃ vā viruddham; api tu tattadadhikaraṇaśarīraṃ tattadviṣayavākyajātaṃ ca viruddhamiti bhāvaḥ | tarkānanuguṇatvāmāha tarkaśceti | tarkaśabdo'numānaparaḥ; pramāṇanugrāhakatarkaparo vā | parābhimatayojanāyāmapi nirviśeṣavastvasiddhimāha jagajjanmādīti | sotprekṣāpakṣe'pīti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ "yathā somyaikena mutpiṇḍena sarvaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vijñātaṃ syāt", "tadātmānaṃ svayamakuruta", "kaṭakamukuṭakarṇikādibhedaiḥ", "ātmakṛteḥ", pariṇāmāt" iti śrutismṛtisūtreṣu pariṇāmavacanatadanuguṇadṛṣṭāntatadupapādanāni dṛśyante | na tu vivartānuguṇaṃ kimapi dṛśyate | na hi yathā somyaikena śuktiśakalena sarvaṃ rajatajātaṃ vijñātaṃ syāditi śrutiḥ, vivartāditi sūtraṃ vā dṛśyate | tasmājjagajjanmādibhramo yataḥ tadvrahmetyayamarthaḥ svayamārjitaḥ, na tu śrutisiddha iti | parotprekṣitapakṣe tarnnirviśeṣatvāsiddhimupapādayati bhramamūlamiti | tataḥ kimityatrāha sākṣitvaṃ hīti | tato'pi kimityatrāha prakāśatvaṃ tviti | prakāśatvamprakāśaśabdavācyatvam | vyavahārayogyatāpādanasvabhāveneti | vyavahārayogyatāpādanameva svabhāvaḥ, tena bhavati  svaparavyavahārayogyatāpādanarūpasvabhāva eva prakāśatvamityarthaḥ | tathā'bhyupagame saviśeṣaparatvamāha tatheti | anabhyupagame dūṣaṇamāha tadabhāva iti ||
athāvāntarasaṅgatimāha jagajjanmādīti | kathamayuktamityatrāha taddhīti | sāmānyena śabdapratipādyatve siddhe hi śabdaviśeṣarūpavedāntavedyatvasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | tacca kutaḥ? na hi pratyakṣeṇa tadīkṣyata ityatrāha anumāneteti |
nanu īśvarānuprānanirāsārthaṃ nedamadhikaraṇamārambhaṇīyam | sādhakabādhakapramāṇāntaragocarasya śāstreṇa pratipādanāyogāddhi tannirāsaḥ | na cāyamapekṣitaḥ | anumānena kartṛmātre siddhe'pi tadapratipannasya nimittopādānaikyasya gaganādisargasya ca pratipādanopapatteḥ || anumānaviruddhāṃśaṃ na śāstraṃ pratipāyadatīti tatpratipādanāyānumānanirāsa iti cetna; āgamavirodhasyaivānumānadūṣatayā'numānenāgamapratibandhāyogāditi || ucyate; śāstraṃ hi sādhakāntarasiddhaṃ bādhakāntarabādhitaṃ ca na pratipādayati | yathāhuḥ "asannikṛṣṭa vācā ca (hi) dvayamatra jihāsitam |
tādrūpyeṇa paricchittistadviparyayato'pi vā" || iti | tatra nimittatvopādānatve ca śāstreṇa pratīyete | tatra nimittamātrasyānumānasiddhatvāt taduktiranuvādaḥ syāt |anuvādasya pramāṇāntarasiddhisāpekṣatvānnimittānuvādo'numānasāpekṣa eva bhavati | anumānaṃ cāmūrttadravyetaraniṣṭhopādānavyatiriktakartṛkatvavyāptimūlamiti dharmigrāhakānumānavirodhena nimittopādā naikyaṃ gaganādyutpatiṃta ca śāstraṃ na pratipādayitumalam | evaṃ kāraṇavākyānām aṃśe prāptaviṣayatvāt aṃśāntare bādhitaviṣayatvācca nimittopādānaikyadikaṃ na sidhyediti tatsiddhaye nimittamātrānumānanirāsārthamidamadhikararamārambhaṇīyamiti ||
nanvanumānavādibhiravi īśvarasyāgamagamyatvamaṅgīkṛtam, āgamānugrāhakatayā ca anumānamucyata iti na tannirāso yukta iti cet parataḥ prāmāṇyavādibhirnaivaṃ vaktuṃ yuktaṃ | anumānasya śāstrānugrāhakatve śāstrameva prādhānyeneśvare pramāṇaṃ bhavati | anugrāhyaṃ hi pradhānam, īśvaraproktatayā ca tairvedaprāmāṇyamaṅgīkriyate |ata īśvare siddhe tatpraṇītatvādvedaprāmāṇyasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhāvīśvarasiddhirityanyonyāśraya iti cet  na | tatparigrahasya bhrāntimūlatvavyudāsārthaṃ nirddoṣatvajñānamūlatvaṃ vācyam; nirdoṣatvajñānaṃ ca guṇavadvaktṛktatvajñānādityanyonyāśrayaḥ syādeva || āptoktatvamanumānataḥ siddhamiti nānyonyāśraya iti cet tata evānumānādvedavaktṛtveneśvarasiddheḥ kiṃ vedeneti śāstravaiyarthyaparihārāya tannirāsaḥ kārya ityadhikararaṇārambho yuktaḥ |
śāstrayonitvāt || vyākhyātrantarābhimataṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣayojanāvyāvṛttyarthamāha śāstraṃ yasyeti | yoniśabdasyopādānaparatvavyāvṛttyarthaṃ kāraṇamātraparatvamāha kāraṇamiti | kathaṃ sarvakāraṇasya brahmaṇaḥ śāstraṃ kāraṇa miti śaṅkāyāmutpattikāraṇaparatvavyāvṛttyarthamāha pramāṇamiti | kāraṇavācino yoniśabdasya kathaṃ pramāṇavācitvamityatrāha brahmajñāneti | utpādaka iva jñāpake'pi hetuśabdaḥ prayujyate; tadvat hetvabhiprāyeṇa yoniśabdaprayoga saṃbhava iti bhāvaḥ | pramāṇantaravedyatvāt brahma na śāstravedyamiti pūrvapakṣe sati śāstravedyatvāditi siddhāntahetoḥ sādhyāviśiṣṭatvaṃ syāditi śaṅkāṃ pariharan pañcamyantasya hetuvācipadasya sādhyavācipadānvayaṃ ca darśayati atya nteti | brahmaṇaḥ svarūpeṇendriyasambandho nāsti; na ca talliṅgasya, nāpi liṅgaliṅgasya cetyabhiprāyeṇoktam atya nta atīndriyatveneti | ata eva hi pratyakṣādi pramāṇa aviṣayatayetyuktam | yadvā vyaktirūpeṇa dṛṣṭatvam, vyāptyāpayikaṃ dṛṣṭasajātīyatvaṃ ca nāstīti bhāvaḥ | indriyapratyakṣaśabdayoḥ karaṇatatphalabhūtajñānavivakṣayā bhinnārthatā | śāstraikapramāṇakatvāditi avbhakṣa itivadavadhāraṇagarbhaḥ śāstrayoniśabda iti bhāvaḥ | tataśca pramāṇāntarāviṣa yatvaṃ sidhyatīti pramāṇāntarāgocaratvena śabdena pratipādiyituṃ yogyatvāt brahma, "yato vā imānī"tyādivākya viśeṣo bodhayatītyuktaṃ bhavati | pūrvasmin sūtre yat sādhyam, tadevāsmin sūtre mukhabhedena sādhyata ityevakārābhi prāyaḥ | atrāpi "yato vā imānī"tyādivākyadvārā śāstraṃ viṣayaḥ | saṃśayo'pyarthasiddhaḥ | sādhāraṇavicāradvayamanusandheyam | "yato vā imānī"tyādivākyaṃ kiṃ brahmaṇi pramāṇam, uta neti saṃśayaḥ; tadarthaṃ kiṃ brahma mānāntaragocaraḥ, na veti; tadarthaṃ kiṃ sāmānyatodṛṣṭamanumānaṃ jīvavilakṣaṇamavagamayati, neti | yadā'vagamayati, tadā mānāntaragocaratvāt "yato vā imānī"tyādivākyaṃ na brahma pratipādayatīti vedāntānāṃ brahmaṇi prāmāṇyābhāvāt ttadvicārānārambhaḥ pūrvapakṣe phalitaḥ | rāddhānte tu sāmānyato dṛṣṭānumānasya jīvavilakṣaṇe pramāṇatvābhāvena brahmaṇo mānāntarāgocaratvāt "yato vā imānī"tvādivākyaṃ brahmaṇi pramāṇamiti sarvavedāntavākyānāṃ tatra prāmāṇyāt vicārasyārambhaṇīyatvaṃ phalitam ||
sūtrākṣarayojanāyāṃ saṅgraheṇoktamarthamasahamānaḥ pūrvapakṣī codayati nanviti | śāstrayonitvamśāstrapramāṇakatvam | pramāṇāntaravedyatve kathaṃ śāstrayonitvānupapattirityatrāha aprāpte tu śāstramarthavaditi | tu śabdo'vadhāraṇe | "syureva tu punarvai cetyavadhāraṇavācinaḥ" iti hi naidhaṇṭukāḥ | vaiṣamyai vā | abubhutsitagrāhitvenāyatnasādhyatvāt pratyakṣasya jñātā prayojanabodhakatvaṃ na dūṣaṇam ;śāstrasya tu bubhutsitagrāhitvena yatnasādhyatvāt jñātāprayojana bodhakatvaṃ dūṣaṇam | tathā sati vahyaupṇyavāyasadantasaṅkhayāvākyepviva śravaṇādipravattyanupapatteḥ ||
asmin pūrvapakṣe siddhāntyekadeśī mīsāṃsakaścodayati kiṃ tarhīti | īśvarānumānanirāsena siddhānti tvam; īśvaramātrānabhyupagamena ekadeśitvam | kiṃ tarhi? na kiñcidityarthaḥ | kathamityatrāha na tāvaditi | sarva syāpi pratyakṣasyāsāmarthyaṃ darśayituṃ tasya dvaividhyamāha taddhīti | prathamasyāpi dvaividhyamāha indriyasambhavamiti | antarasambhavaṃ ceti | āntaraśabdena mano vivakṣitam | prathame anupapattimāha bāhyendriyāṇīti | deśasannikarṣaṃ viśiṃṣatā vidyamānaśabdena kālasannikarṣaśca siddhaḥ | yogyaśabdena svabhāvasannikarṣa uktaḥ | anena dharmādharmādivyāvṛttiḥ, svaśabdena cakṣurādikaṃ prati śabdādivyāvṛttiḥ | yadvā svaviṣayaśabdenaivātīndriyasyendriyāntaraviṣayasya ca vyavacchenaḥ yogyaśabdena tu tattadindriyapratiniyatarūpādijātīye apyanudbhavādivaśādayogyasya vyavacchedaḥ | dvitīyaṃ prativakti nāpīti | manaśca na tadviṣayavodhajanakabhityarthaḥ | āntarasukhaduḥkhādi ityatra āntaraśabdaḥ ātmataddharmaparaḥ | tadgrāhitvādeva hi manasopyāntaratvam | sukhaduḥkhādītyāntaraśabdavivaraṇam | ādiśabdenecchādveṣāderātmanaśca parigrahaḥ | vyatiriktetyanena rūpādīnāṃ bahiṣṭmevepapāditam | yogajanyasyānupapāti darśayitu māha nāpi yogeti | yogipratyakṣaṃ kiṃ pūrvānubhutānadhikaviṣayaṃ pramāṇam, uta anubhūtādhikaviṣayamati vikalpamabhipretya anadhikaviṣayatve dūṣaṇamāha bhāvaneti | anadhikaviṣayatayā smṛtimātratvāt na pramāṇatvamiti pramāṇāvāntaraviśeṣatvaṃ dūrotsāritamityarthaḥ | anadhikaviṣayatvamupapādayati tadatiriktaviṣayatve kāraṇābhāvāditi | kāraṇamindriyasambandhaḥ | pramitikāraṇābhāvānna prāmāṇyamityarthaḥ | adhikaviṣayatve dūṣaṇamāha tathā satīti | indriyasambandābhāve'pyanubhūtādhikaviṣayatve tasya doṣabhūlakatvena bhrāntitaivetyarthaḥ | dvividhānumānāgocaratvamāha nāpītyādinā | niyatamvyāptam |
siddhānticchāyayā codayantaṃ vādinaṃ pūrvapakṣyekadeśī codayati nanu ceti | naiyāyikaikadeśibhiruktānumānavaktṛtvāt pūrvapakṣyekadeśitvam; sampradānambhoktā | prayojanamviniyogaḥ | ekakartṛkatvasidhdyarthamanumānāntaramāha acetaneti | upādānādyabhijñakartṛkatve dṛṣṭāntamāha sarvaṃ hīti | ekacetanādhīnatve ca dṛṣṭānta māha acetaneti | rugṇaparaśarīravyāvṛttyarthau arogasvaśabdau | kāryatve siddhe hyupādānādyabhijñakartṛkatvasiddhirityatrāha sāvayavatveneti | anenācetanāravdhatvahetoścāsiddhiśaṅkāparihāro'pi phalitaḥ | evaṃ pūvarpakṣyekadeśinoktamarthaṃ siddhāntyekadeśī dūṣayati ucyata ityādinā | buddhisthatvāt pāścātyamanumānaṃ dūṣayati kimidamiti | ekacetanādhīnatvaṃ nāma kiṃ tadāyattotpattisthititvam, uta tadāyattapravṛttitvamati vikalpya prathame'pi tadāyattotpattisthititvaṃ nāma kiṃ tadicchādhīnotpattisthitvamtvam, uta tadadṛṣṭādhīnotpattisthitvamiti kilpo'bhipretaḥ | teṣāṃ vikalpānāṃ kṣepārthaḥ kiṃ śabdaḥ | tatra tadicchādhīnotpattisthititvaṃ na dṛṣṭamiti sādhyavaikalyaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ prasiddha miti buddhayā(dhvā) dvitīyaṃ śiro dūṣayati dṛṣṭānto hīti | sādhyavikalatva vivṛṇoti na hīti | kuta itya trāha taccharīrasyeti | yadvā na tāvadityādigranthaḥtadicchādhīnotpattisthititvatadadṛṣṭādhīnotpattisthititvayoḥ
sādhāraṇaḥ | tatrecchādhīnatvapakṣe sādhyavaikalyaṃ sphuṭamiti tadadṛṣṭādhīnatvapakṣe sādhyavaikalyaṃ vivṛṇoti na hīti | utpatisthitī hi saha dūṣite | atha sthitaṃ pṛthagvikalpya dūṣayitumāha kiñceti | svāvayavasamavetatārūpasthityuktivaiśeṣikādimatānusāreṇa | na cetanamapekṣata iti | cetanāpekṣā hi svarūpato vā syāt, adṛṣṭadvāreṇa vā, icchādvāreṇa vā | tatra svarūpamātramakiñcitkaram; tatsadbhāve'pi vināśadarśanāt | adṛṣṭādhīnatve prāgevottaraṃ dattamiti icchādhīnatvapakṣo'nena dūṣitaḥ | cetanecchāṃ nāpekṣata ityarthaḥ | āvināśakālādaśithilatvalakṣaṇā sthitirapyanena dattottaretyabhiprāyeṇa tadanuktiḥ | athoktaprakāravikalpadūṣaṇena nirastamapi śiro'ntaraṃ dūṣaṇāntarasadbhāvādupādāya dūṣayati prāṇaneti | prāṇanalakṣaṇāpañcavṛttiprāṇasahitatvalakṣaṇā | nopalabhāmaha iti | kālātyayāpadeśa ityabhiprāyaḥ | tadāyattapravṛttitvamekacetanādhīnatvamiti pakṣaṃ śaṅkate tadāyatteti |acetanārabdhatvahetoranaikāntyamāha aneketi | anekacetanasādhyeṣuanekacetanapravatrtyeṣvityarthaḥ | cetanaikatvāvivakṣāyāṃ siddhasādhyatvamāha cetanamā treti | evamekacetanādhīnatvaṃ nirastam | kāryatvahetorlāghavatarkamukhena siddhasādhyatāmāha kiñceti | ubhayavādisiddhānāmiti lāghavasya heturuktaḥ | klṛptakalpya virodhe tu yuktaḥ "kalṛptaparigrahaḥ" iti hyāhuḥ | sambhavantyāṃ gatau hi lāghavatarkaḥ, gatyantarāsambhave tvadhikakalpanaṃ na doṣāyetyatrāha na ceti | kuta ityatrāha sarveṣāmiti | pūrva kāle cetanānāṃ sākṣātkārasāmarthyaṃ dṛśyamānanītyopapādayati yatheti | idānīmiti | evaṃ pūrvakāle'pīti bhāvaḥ | dharmādharmasākṣātkārābhāvāt kartṛtvāsambhavamāśaṅkayāha upakaraṇeti | yāgādiśaktirūpeti | yāgādijanyasvātmatiśayarūpetyarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha tatsākṣātkāreti | tarhi ghaṭādinirmāṇe mṛdādisākṣātkāraniyamaḥ kathamityatrāha śaktimaditi | śaktimacchabdena śaksimbandhi ucyate | janyajanakabhāvasya ca sambandhaviśeṣarūpa tvāt śaktirūpādṛṣṭajanakayāgādiṣu śaktimacchabdaprayogaḥ | śakterapi apekṣitatvasābhyāt tatsākṣātkāro'pe kṣitaḥ | anyathā anavagatavastuśaktayo'pi puruṣāstaistatkāryaṃ kuryurityatrāha śaktestviti | tu śabdaḥ śaktimata iva śakterapi jñātavyatve'pi viśeṣadyotanārthaḥ | śaktisākṣātkārānupayogamupapādayati na hīti | śaktisākṣātkārānapekṣatve'pi śaktijñānamātramapekṣitam; tacca daṇḍacakrādiṣvanvayavyatirekavaśāttsadhyati; yāgādau tu kathamityatrāha iha tviti | evaṃ siddhasādhanatvamuktam | atha kāryatvahetorupādhidvayena sāpedhikatvāmāha kiñceti | sādhanāvyāpakatvamāha mahīmahīdhareti | sādhyasamavyāptatvamāha ata iti | sopādhikatve sati sādṛyena hetorvyāpyatvāsiddhiḥ syādityupādherdūṣaṇatvam | adṛṣṭavajjīvakartṛkatvavyāvṛtyarthaṃ buddhimatkartṛpūrvakatvasādhana ityu ktam | atha kāryatvahetorviśeṣaviruddhatvamāha kiñceti | anīśvareṇakarmavaśyena, parigrahavatā upakaraṇavate tyarthaḥ | sarvānumānocchedamāśaṅkayāha na ceti | kathamityatrāha liṅginīti | pakṣe'pi tathā syādityatrāha iha tviti | tu śabdābhipretaṃ vaiṣamyamāha nivarttaketi | siddhāntyekadeśimatamupasaṃharati ata iti | sidhdyati cet, nāgamādṛte mānamityarthaḥ |
ataḥ siddhasādhanatvasopādhikatvaviruddhatvairdūṣitatvādityarthaḥ ||
atha sākṣātpūrvapakṣiṇaṃ prastauti atrāhuriti | kāryatvahetoḥ svarūpāsiddhimāśaṅkaya vyudasyati sāvayavatvāditi | sāvayatvādeveti | pūrvaṃ prastutādevetyarthaḥ | anena hetvantarasadbhāvo'pi sūcitaḥ | evaṃ kaṇṭhokatyā abhiprāyeṇa ca siddhān hetūn prayogato vivṛṇoti bhavantīti | vivādādhyāsitapadavivaraṇaṃ bhūbhūdharādipadam, ādiśabdopāttavyaktisaṅgāhakaṃ vivādādhyāsitapadam | yadvā pakṣīkṛteṣveva sampratipannāṃśavyavacchedāya vivādādhyāsitaśabdaḥ | santi hi ravātapūraṇaniṣpādyāḥ pṛthivyaṃśāḥ, sagarasutādiniṣpādyāḥ samudrāṃśāḥ, astrādiniṣpādyāḥ parvatādayaśca | pralaye'pi jaladheravasthānāt sarvābhāve'pi straṣṭuḥ śarīrāvasthānācca tayorakāryatvaśaṅkādyotanāya pratijñāvākyāvartanena jaladhitanuśabdopādānam | dvitīyatṛtīyaprayogayormadhya mahattvapadena paramāṇuvyāvṛttiḥ | kriyāvattvamūrtatvaśabdābhyāṃ gaganādivyāvṛttiḥ | avanimahīdharaśabdamadhye jaladhiśabdaniveśaḥ tadvat tayorapi kampasadbhāvajñāpanārthaḥ | prasiddho hyutpātādau bhūbhūdharakampaḥ | nanu tanupakṣīkāro na yuktaḥ, asmadādiśarīre siddhasādhanatvāt; īśvaraśarīre tvāśrayāsiddheḥ || naivam; tanorviśeṣataḥ pakṣīkāranirbandhābhāvāt | tadupādānaṃ tu svapakṣasampratipannasyeśvaraśarīrasyāpi kāryatājñāpanārtham | yadvā sāvayavatvādevetvāderayamāśayaḥ na sāvayavatvādutpattimattvaṃ prasādhya tataḥ sakartṛkatvaṃ sādhyata;,api tu sāvayavatvenaiva kṛtisādhyatvarūpakāryatvaṃ sādhyate;
