kṛtiśca na nirāśrayeti tadāśrayaḥ karttā sāmānyataḥ sidhyatīti || nanvevaṃ tarhi kāryatvāt sakartṛkatve sādhye hetoḥ sādhyāviśiṣṭatā syāt || na; kṛtisādhyatvaṃ hetuḥ, upādānādyabhijñakartṛkatvaṃ sādhyamiti vaiṣamyāt | ata eva hyuttaratra kriyata ityuktam, notpadyata iti | "kāyartvaṃ niścitya tadānīmeva karttustajjñānaśaktivaicitryamanuminotī"tyādi ca | evañca kṛtisādhyatvalakṣaṇe sādhye śarīrasyāpi vivādapadatvāt pakṣatopapattiḥ | atha sopādhikatvaṃ sāmānyena pratikṣipati sāvayaveṣviti | sāvayavatvamupalakṣaṇam, mahattve sati kriyāvattvaṃ mahattve sati mūrttatvaṃ ca sāvayavatvasāmānāśrayaṃ tatsamavyāptamiti tayorapyupādhiparihārasiddhiḥ | rūpāntaram ākārāntaram | upādhiṃ śaṅkate kāryatveti | pariharati neti | kāryatvenānumate sapakṣe | anyatrapakṣe | sapakṣe'pi ghaṭādau kāryatvānumeye jñānaśaktī, tadvat pakṣe'pi kāryyatvasya pratipannatvāt jñānaśaktī anumīyete iti nāśakyakriyatvam śakyajñānatvaṃ cetyarthaḥ | tathaiva darśayati tathā hīti | kiṃ tadakartturapi śakyakriyatvaṃ śakyopādānādijñānatvamupādhiḥ, uta tatkartuḥ śakyakriyatvaṃ śakyepādānādijñānatvam? prathame kalpe sapakṣānuyāyitvābhāvānnopādhitvam | dvitīye kalpe pakṣe'pi vidyamānātvānnopādhitvam | sarvasapakṣānuyāyī pakṣaṣva(tva?)vidyamāno hyupādhirityabhiprāyaḥ | kartustajjñānaśaktivaicitryamityanenābhipreto'yaṃ vikalpaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha ata iti | ataḥsāvayavatvādihetornirupādhikatvādityarthaḥ | evaṃ sāvayavatvātkṛtisādhyatva rūpe kāryatve sādhye śakyakriyatvādika upādhiḥ parihṛtaḥ | anenotpattimattvāt sakartṛkatve sādhye utpattimattvahetu rapi nirupādhiko bhavati | sāvayavātvādutpattimattve sādhye tūpādherdūrvādau vyabhicāraśca siddhaḥ | na hi dūrvādirutpadyamāno'smadādeḥ śakyakriyaḥ |
siddhasādhanatvanirāsātharmanumānāntarapradarśanārthaṃ cāha kiñceti | dharmādharmanimitte'pīti siddasādhanatvaśaṅkāsūcanam | anadhiṣṭhitayoḥ...anupapatteriti anvayavyāptisthemne vyatirekavyāptyuktiḥ | dṛṣṭāntamāha varddhakineti | vāsyāderyūpādyakaraṇasya cetanavyatiriktasahakāryantarābhāvaprayuktatvaśaṅkāvyāvṛttyarthaṃ deśakālādyanekaparikarasannidhāne'pītyuktam | dharmādharmau svasākṣātkāricetanādhiṣṭhitāveva kāryakarau acetanatvāt | vāsyādivadityanumānaśarīram, jīvaidharmādharmasākṣātkāratatpūrvakatadadhiṣṭhānāyogāt jīvavilakṣaṇasiddhiḥ | anadhiṣṭhitasya kāryakaratvāyogāt jīvaiḥ sākṣātkāratatpūrvakādhiṣṭhānāyogācca siddhasādhanaṃ ca parihṛtam | karturabhāve kāryānutpattiprasaṅgarūpasya vipakṣe bādhakatarkasya puruṣasukhādiprayogakādṛṣṭena kāryotpattyupapattiriti yā anyathāsiddhiḥ, sā'pyanenaiva parihṛtā bhavati | acetanasyā'pyanadhiṣṭhitasya bījādeṅkurotpādakatvadarśanāt vyabhicāra iti śaṅkāṃ pariharati bījāṅkureti | kāryatvahetoraṅkurādau vyabhicāraśaṅkāparihāraścāṅkuraśabdopādānena phalitaḥ | cetanānabhisaṃhitapulakādyutpādakaiḥ cetanānadhiṣṭhitaiḥ svayamacetanaiḥ sukhādibhiracetanatvahetorvyabhicāramāśaṅkaya pariharati tata eveti | ādiśabdena duḥkhādikaṃ cetanānadhiṣṭhitaṃ sukhādyutpādakaṃ manaḥprabhṛti ca vivakṣitam | etena svecchāmantareṇotpādya mānaiḥ sukhaduḥkhaviśeṣaistatkāryaiśca pulakāṅgakampādibhiḥ kāryatvahetorvyabhicāraśca parihṛto bhavati | lāghavanyāyena
hetoranyathāsiddheḥ siddhasādhanatvamāśaṅkaya pariharati na ceti | kuta ityākāṅkṣāyāmīdṛśaśabdābhipretaṃ hetuṃ vivṛṇoti teṣāmiti | ekendriyakalpanasya lāghave'pi ekendriyasya śabdādisakalaviṣayagrahaṇāśakterhyanekendriyakalpa nam | tasmāllāghavātharmaśaktasya kāryakaratvakalpanamayuktamiti bhāvaḥ | tadevopapādayati darśaneti | upapannameva hi kalpanīyam; na ca jīvānāṃ sūkṣmavyavahitādidarśanaśaktirdṛṣṭetyarthaḥ | śaktimatsākṣātkāra evāpekṣitaḥ; na tu śaktisākṣātkāra itīdamapi pratyuktaṃ bhavati sūkṣmavyavahitetyādinā | śaktimatāmapi paramāṇvādīnāṃ kṣetrajñena sākṣātkārāsiddheḥ | īśvare na tathā'nupapattirityāha na ceti | avāntarānumonaneśvarasidiṃdha nigamayati ata iti | vyāptibalāt kāryānuguṇajñānaśaktimān karttā sidhyatu; tasya kathaṃ kṣetrajñavailakṣaṇyam; jñānaṃ hi dehendriyādisāpekṣa miti śaṅkāyāṃ pakṣadharmatābalasiddamarthamāha samartheti | asvābhāvikatve karmānuguṇaparimitajñānaśaktimattvaṃ syā diti tadvayudāsārthaḥ svābhāvikasarvārthasākṣātkāraśabdaḥ |
atha kāryatvahetorviruddhatvaṃ vyudasyati yattvityādinā | kathamityatrāha sapakṣa iti | kiṃ sahadarśanamā trāt śarīrādiprāptiḥ, uta hetutvāt | nādyaḥ;atiprasaṅgāt | na dvitīyaḥ, hetutvāsiddherityabhiprāyaḥ | kāryasyāhetubhūtānāmiti vyāptyabhāvo'pyabhipretaḥ | nanu sarvasapakṣeṣu sahadṛṣṭatvāt kāyarhetutvaṃ ca kalpyam, tathā sati kathaṃ katipayāprāptiḥ katipayaprāptiścocyate ityatrāha etaduktamiti | viśeṣavirodhaṃ parihartumapekṣitāṃśavivekamāha kenaciditi | sapakṣe sahadṛṣṭatvādajñānāderapi hetutvaṃ kalpyatāmityatrāha svanirmāṇeti | akiñcitkarasyeti | ananyathāsiddānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ hi hetutvaniścayaḥ | tatra jñānaśaktinirvartyāt kiñcitkārādadhikaḥ kaścit tadanyājñānāsāmarthyanivartyaḥ kiñcitkāro dṛṣṭaścet, syādananyathāsiddhiḥ | na cādhikaḥ kiñcitkāro dṛṣṭaḥ; na ca kalpyaḥ; ajñānāsāmarthyahetuvyatireke kāryanivṛttyabhāvāt | svaviṣayasāmarthyopādānādijñānābhyāṃ vinā yathā kāryānudayaḥ, tathā'nyāsāmarthyājñānābhyāṃ vinā na kāryānudayo na dṛṣṭaḥ | ato na tasya hetutvaṃ kalpyam | na hi sati bhāvamātraṃ hetutvam, kiṃtu satyeva bhāva iti bhāvaḥ | akiñcitkaratvameva vikalpamukhenopapādayati kiñceti | sarveṣviti | na hi kuḍyādinirmāṇānuguṇajñānasāmarthyābhāvo ghaṭaniṣpattihetuḥ, tadanuguṇajñānasāmarthyavato'pi ghaṭādiniṣpādakatvadarśanādityarthaḥ | yattusapakṣe sahadṛṣṭatvena liṅgini, prāptaviparītaviśeṣāṇāṃ dharmigrāhakapramāṇapratihatānāṃ nivṛttiḥ, na tvitareṣāmitiḥ idamapi kāryatvasyāsādhakānāmityanena pratyuktam | sādhyānupayogitvenānyathāsi ddhānāṃ saha dṛṣṭānāmapi dharmāṇāṃ vyatirekābhāvena vyāptiśūnyatvādaprāpteḥ || sahadṛṣṭeṣvapi kāryānupayogināṃ prāptirna syāt; śarīraṃ hi kāryopayogīti śaṅkate kulālādīnāmiti | pariharati neti | kathamityatrāha saṅkalpeti | śaṅkate kathamiti | pariharati neti | ko heturityatrāha mana eveti | tat kimastītyatrāha taditi | kuta itya trāha kāryatveneti | īśvarasya manassambandhoktirnyāyaikadeśimatena | punaḥ śaṅkate mānasa iti | pariharati neti | anaikāntyātvyāptyabhāvāt | aśarīre'pi manassambandhasya vidyamānatvādvā'naikāntyam | manaso nityatve'pi cetanasya kāryakaratve śarīrasambandhasāpekṣatvamasti; manasi nitye satyapi muktātmanaḥ kāryakaratvābhāvāt | na hi muktatmano buddhisukhaduḥkhādikaṃ mano janayatīti codyamasti | atra mīmāṃsakaṃ prati pratibandyā parihāraṃ hṛdi nidhāya pakṣadharmatābalaṃ darśayannīśvarasidiṃdha nigamayati | ato vicitrāvayaveti | aśarīraḥ saṅkalpamātrasādhanapariniṣpannānantavistāravicitraracanaprapañca ityābhyāṃ padābhyāṃ pratibandyā parihārābhiprāyo jñātaḥ | vibhudravyasaṃyoginaḥ parispandavato ghaṭādeḥ sparśavattvaniyame'pi, vibhudravyasaṃyoginaḥ parispandavato'pi manaso na sparśavattvamaṅgīkriyate | ayaṃ prābhākaraṃ prati parihāraḥ | mahimaguṇaśālinastaijasasya rūpopalambhaniyame dṛṣṭe'pi cakṣuṣi rūpopalambho nāṅgīkṛtaḥ; kāryārambhakasya sāvayavatvavyāptiḥ paramāṇuṣu bhagnā; tasmādanekavirodhaparihārāyaikavyāptibhaṅgo nyāyyaḥ | ato manasaḥ kāryakaratve śarīrasambandhasāpekṣatvaṃ bhogasādhanamanastvaprayuktamityaṅgīkāryamiti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ sādhakāntarasiddhatvāt jagatkāraṇavastuni śāstrasyāprāmāṇyaṃ nigamayati ataḥ pramāṇeti |
nimittopādānaikyasya gaganādisṛṣṭeścānumānāviṣayatvena śāstrasyādhikaviṣayatvādbrahmāṇi prāmāṇyamā śaṅkaya tatra bādhakāntarabādhitatvāt śāstrāprāmāṇyamucyate kiñceti | nimittamātramanuvadataḥ śāstrasyānumānasāpekṣatvāttadviruddhanimittopādānaikyaṃ na śāstraṃ pratipādayati | pakṣīkṛteṣu kṣityādiṣu dravyeṣu sāvayavatvasyaiva kāryatvaprayojakatayā niravayavadravyasyākāryatvaṃ pūrvameva pratipannamiti paścāt śāstraṃ niravayavadravyotpatiṃta na pratipādayati | śrutiliṅgādiṣvapi paurvāparyaṃ hi prābalyadaurbalyaheturiti bhāvaḥ | pūrvapakṣaparisamāptāvitiśabdaḥ ||
siddhāntaṃ vaktumupakramate evaṃ prāpta iti | paramasādhyaṃ pratijānīte yathokteti | ākāṅkṣāpūrvakaṃ hetumāha kuta iti | śāstraikapramāṇakatvātśāstretaraprāmāṇāgocaratvādityarthaḥ | hetvasidiṃdha pariharttuṃ pūrvapakṣamanubhāṣate yaduktamiti | dūṣayati tadayuktamiti | pakṣadhamartābalāt kṣetrajñavailakṣaṇyaṃ vadatā kiṃ vipulakāryāṇāṃ kartṛkālaikyaniyamamantarbhāvya taducyate, uta vipulatvamātreṇa, utātīndriyopādānādidarśanavaśāt, athavā śarīrānapekṣasṛṣṭiva śāt iti vikalpamabhipretya prathamaṃ dūṣayati mahīti | ekadevaikena nirmitatvābhāvamupapādayati na caikasyetyādinā | ekaṃ kāryyatvaṃ ghaṭāderiva yugapadekakartṛkatvayogyamiti śaṅkādyotakamekamitipadam | kāryatvasyaikatvaṃ nāma ekasāmagrīpūrvakatvam; tatsidhdyarthamekasyetyuktam | na hyekā vyaktiranekasāmagrīsādhyā, ekakāryāvacchinnasya sarvasya hetorekasāmagrītvāt | ekatve'pyanekakartṛkagopurādivyavacchedārthamekadaivaikakartranvayayogyatvaṃ ghaṭaśabdena vivakṣitam | ekaghaṭasyaikaṃ kāryatvaṃ yādṛśaṃ dṛśyate tādṛśaṃ parimitaikāvayaviniṣṭhaṃ kāryatvamevaikadaivaikakartṛkatvasambhāvanāpādakam; tacca mahīmahīdharādīnāṃ na dṛśyata ityarthaḥ | syāditi sambhāvitatvamātramucyate | na hyekaghaṭasyāpyekakartṛkatvaniyamaḥ, anekairapyekaghaṭaniṣpādanasambhavāt | tataḥ kimityapekṣāyāṃ bahuṣu vipuleṣu ca kāryyeṣu tadviparyayamāha pṛthagbhūte ṣviti | pṛthagbhūteṣvityatra vipulatvamapi garbhitam | ekaghaṭasyeveti pūrvamukteḥ | bahuṣu vipuleṣu ca kāryeṣu kartṛkālaikyaniyamādarśanānmahyādayopyekadaiva ekena nirmitā ityatra pramāṇābhāvaḥ, pramāṇābhāvāttadayuktamityadhyāhāreṇa granthānvayaḥ | na ca kāryatvameva kartṛkālaikye pramāṇam; vikalpāsahatvāt | kiṃ kāryatvamātram, uta vipulakāryatvam,utāsambhāvitajīvakartukaṃ pakṣāsādhāraṇakāryatvam? prathame anaikakāntyam | dvitīye viruddhatvam; vipula kāryeṣu kāladairdhyakartṛvatvadarśanāt | yadvā'naikāntyameva | tṛtīye cāsādhāraṇānaikāntyamiti bhāvaḥ | kāryatvabalena karttari kalpanīye vipulatarasūkṣmatarapakṣarmatābalāt kṣetradbhavailakṣaṇyaṃ lāghavanyāyāt karturekatvaṃ ca sidhyatītyatrāha na ceti | vicitraśabdenāsmadādyaśakyatvārthamativipulatvamatisūkṣmatvaṃ ca vivakṣitam | kuta ityatrāha kṣetrajñānāmeveti | kṣetrajñātirikte kalpye sati hyanekakalpanādekakalpanasya nyāyyatvam | kṣetrajñānāmeva kartṛtvopapattyā tadatirikto na kalpayitavya ityarthaḥ | upacitapuṇyaviśeṣāṇāmiti sapakṣe śaktivaicitryopapādanārthamuktam | atiśayitādṛṣṭasambhāvanayeti pakṣaviṣayamuktam |"sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo jyotiṣṭomaḥ" ityādibhiḥ kṣityādistraṣṭṭatvānuguṇātiśayitādṛṣṭasambhāvanā kṣetrajñānāmeva yogena sūkṣmavyavahitādidarśanaṃ parābhyupetam | asmadādiṣu deveṣu ca jñānaśaktivaicitrī dṛśyate | na ca pakṣadharmatābalamanvayavyatirekasiddhān dharmān nivartayitumīṣṭa; tasyānvayavyatirekasiddhadharma prakarṣa apakarṣamātrahetutvāt | itarathā jñānacikīrṣayorapi hānaprasaṅgāt | tadatirikteti | dharmikalpanāto varaṃ dharmakalpane"ti nyāyādīśvarakalpanādadṛṣṭaviśeṣakalpanameva varamiti bhāvaḥ | acetanatvāt cetanādhiṣṭhitāveva dharmādharmau kāryakarau, vāsyādivadityanupapannam; īśvarajñānapravatnādau vyabhicāreṇānyatarānaikāntyāt | atha kṣetrajñasya sarge śarīrasāpekṣatvāt tasya sarvasaṃhāradaśāyāṃ śarīrabhāvāttadānīṃ śarīrānapekṣaḥ karttā jīvavilakṣaṇaḥ syādityatrāha na ceti | idānīṃ krameṇotpattivināśau dṛśyete tadā tūtpattivināśayaugapadyakalpanamityatrāha kāryatveneti | atra kāryatvaṃ; kṛtisādhyatvaṃ | tṛtīyā cetthambhāvārthā | virodhābhāvātvyāptivirodhābhāvādityarthaḥ | evaṃ paramatadūṣaṇopayuktārthaśikṣā kṛtā | atha phalitaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ darśayati ata iti | tadayuktamityārabhyoktārthānāṃ hetutvaparo'taś śabdaḥ | calanādiṣu tṛṇāderiva kriyāśrayatvamātralakṣaṇakartṛtvavyāvṛttyartho buddhimacchabdaḥ | kiṃ būddhimadekakartṛkatvaṃ sādhyam, uta sakartṛkatvamātram? prathame'pi kiṃ sāmānyato buddhimadekakartṛkatvamātraṃ sādhyam, uta sarvajñasarvaśakatyekakartṛkatvamiti vikalpamabhipretya prathame kalpe'naikāntyam, anekakartṛkarathagopurādiṣu kāryatvasya vidyamānatvāditi bhāvaḥ | sarvajñasarvaśaktikakartṛtvapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha pakṣasyeti | na hyagrimattvamiva sarvajñasarvaśaktikartṛkatvama nyatra dṛṣṭam | dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavikalatā; kāryeṣu ghaṭādiṣvadarśanāt | aprasiddhaviśeṣaṇatvasādhyavaikalye dve apyupapādayati sarveti | sarvanirmāṇacaturasyetyuktatvādidaṃ dūṣaṇadvayaṃ sarvajñasarvaśaktikartṛkatvapakṣasyeti jñāyate | pūrvasminneva pakṣe cet, aprasiddhaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ na ghaṭate | na hyekakartṛkatvamaprasiddham | sakartṛkatvamātrapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha buddhimaditi || siddhasādhanatvaṃ vedāntinā na vaktavyaṃ, kṣetrajñakartṛkatvānabhyupagamāditi cenna, kṣetramānāmapi dvārakartṛtvābhyupagamāt | samaṣṭitattveṣu na dvārakarteti cet na ca tatpakṣīkaraṇaṃ; laukikapramāṇāviṣayatvāt || āga mena siddhānāṃ teṣāmapi pakṣīkāra iti cet  tena karttā'pi siddha iti siddhasādhyateti |
mukhāntareṇa dūṣayituṃ hetuṃ vikalpayati sārvajñyeti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ kartṛmātravyāpyena kāryyatvamātreṇa na kartṛviśeṣasiddhiriti prāgevoktam | ataḥ pakṣaviśeṣādhīnena kāryatvaviśeṣeṇa kartṛviśeṣaḥ sādhyaḥ | kumbhādikāyarviśeṣeṇa hi kulālādikartṛviśeṣānumānaṃ; na tu kāryatvamātreṇa | ataḥ pakṣādhīnaḥ kāryatvaviśeṣo nirasyata iti | kiṃ yugapaditi | pakṣaprakarṣādhīnaṃ hetuvaiśiṣṭayaṃ dvedhā sambhavetparidṛśyamānamahyādivipulakāryāṇāṃ yugapadutpattyā vā, kramabhāvināṃ traikālyavartināṃ kāryāṇāmānantyena vā? tatra kīdṛśyena pakṣaprakarṣeṇa hetuviśeṣo vivakṣita ityarthaḥ | prathamaṃ dūṣayati yugapaditi | kṛtsnapralayāsiddheḥ bhūdharādīnāṃ yugapadutpattau pramāṇābhāvāt tannibandhanaṃ kartṛvailakṣaṇyasādhakahetuvailakṣaṇyamasiddhamityarthaḥ | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati krameṇeti | yadyapyekaikena kulālādinā janmasahasreṇāpyanantakāryaniṣpādanasambhavaḥ, tathā'pi tattajjanmasamānakālakuvindādikṛtānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ tatkartṛkatvābhāvāt sarvakāryāṇāmekakartṛkatvaṃ nāsti | atastraikālyavarttisamastavastuniṣṭhatvaviśeṣitaṃ kāryatvaṃ kartṛbhedenaiva vyāptamiti kartraikyasādhane viruddhamityarthaḥ | atrāpyekakartṛkatvasādhana iti | viśiṣṭakāryatvavyāpakatayā'bhimatasya ghaṭapaṭarathādidṛṣṭasya bhinnakarttṛkatvasya pratikṣepa ityarthaḥ | bhinnakartṛkatayā pratyakṣasiddheṣu pratyakṣavirodhaḥ | anyatradvīpāntaravarttī ghaṭaḥ etadvayatirikta kulāla kartṛkaḥ, etadvayāpārāgocarahetukatve sati ghaṭatvāt, saṃpratipannakūlāntarotpāditaghaṭa vat | dvīpāntaravarttighaṭahetūnāṃ daṇḍādīnāmetadvayāpārāgocaratvametasya tatra gamanābhāvanirṇayāt |ataḥ evamādibhiranumānairvirodhaḥ | śāstravirodhamupapādayati kumbhakāra iti | kumbhakāro jāyate rathakāro jāyata ityarthopādānam; na tu pāṭhakramaḥ | na hi kumbharathayorekakartṛkatve kumbhakārarathakārayorutpattiḥ pṛthagvaktavyā; ekasañjñātvena punaruktiprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ |
prakārāntareṇa viruddhatvamāha api ceti | sukhādeḥ sattvādiguṇakāryatvaṃ śāstradṛṣṭamiti tat śāstraprāmāṇyavādinā'ṅgīkāryamiti matvā'niṣṭamāpādayati; na tu parābhyupagamāt, sukhādiśabdena sukhaduḥkhamohā vivakṣitāḥ |
śarīrādīnāṃ sukhādyanvayaḥ sukhādihetutvā'vasthānvayaḥ, sattvādimūlatvamsattvādiguṇakadravyopādānatvamityarthaḥ | ke te sattvādayaḥ, kathaṃ ca teṣāṃ sukhādihetutvamityatrāha kāyarvaicitryeti | kāraṇagatā viśeṣāḥ | kāraṇaśabdo nimitopādānasādhāraṇaparaḥ | tataḥ kiṃ karturguṇavaśyatvasyetyatrāha teṣāṃ kāryāṇāmiti | puruṣeṇa kāryāṇāṃ tanmūlatvāpādanaṃ sattvādiyuktasvakīyāntaḥkaraṇavikāradvāreṇetyarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha puruṣasya ceti | kāryānupayohagino hi dharmāḥ na prāpnuvantīti pūrvapakṣiṇoktaṃm | sattvādīnāṃ tu kāyryopayogitvāt tadadhīnaḥ karmasambandho'varja nīya iti bhāvavānāha jñānaśaktivaditi | sukhaduḥkhamohādīnāṃ sattvarajastamohetukatvaṃ śāstrasiddham | sukhādihetubhūtaśarīrādyupādānasya, nibhittasya ca karttuḥ sattvādiguṇānvayaśca śāstrasiddhaḥ, "nirguṇasyāprameyasya śuddhasyāpyamalātmanaḥ | kathaṃ sargādikartṛtvaṃ brahmaṇo'bhyupagamyate " ityādibhirdṛśyate | ataḥ sattvādiguṇakaṃ śarīrādyupā dānaṃ dravyaṃ sattvādiguṇānvayavikṛtāntaḥkaraṇaḥ puruṣo'dhitiṣṭhati | guṇānvayaśca karmamūla iti kamarvaśyatvaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | hetvantareṇāpi karmasambandhamāha jñāneti | na jñānaśaktivaicitryāt vicitrasargaḥ; api tu icchāmātrā diti cettatrāha icchāyā iti | viṣayaviśeṣaviśeṣitāyāḥ | icchāyāḥ sargasthemādiviṣayatvam tatrāpi vicitrasargādiviṣayatvaṃ ca sattvādimūlatvena karmamūlabhityarthaḥ | evaṃ kartṛtvakṣetrajñatvayorvyāptidarśanāt na tadvilakṣaṇasiddhirityāha ata iti |
pratitarkānāha bhavanti ceti | tanubhuvanādīti | idaṃ pratyanumānaṃ pratitarko vā | anye pratitarkā eva | kāryatve kṣetrajñakartṛkatvaprasaṅgaḥ; kartṛtve sāpekṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ; kartṛtve saśarīratvaprasaṅgaḥ ityarthaḥ | aśarīratvahetorthabhicāramāśaṅkaya pariharati na ceti |anādeḥbījāṅkuravat pravāhānāderityarthaḥ | adhiṣṭhānaṃ dehena prathamasambandha ścet  sūkṣmasthūlaśarīrapravāhānāditayā parihṛtaḥ; yathā bālaśarīraviśiṣṭena yuvaśarīraparigrahaḥ, tadvadeva | adhi ṣṭhānaṃ preraṇaṃ cet svaparanirvāhakanyāyāt parihṛtaḥ | śarīravyatiriktapreraṇasya śarīrāpekṣā, na śarīrasyeti (hi) śarīratvaprayuktaṃ śarīrāntaranirapekṣapreraṇatvam | tathā jagataḥ īśvaraśarīratve na saśarīratvāt karmavaśyatvaprasaṅgaḥ | yathā dehaḥ svajñānotpattau karaṇaṃ karma ca bhavati, yathā ca ghaṭaḥ svaviṣaya jñānonpattau svasattayā hetuḥ paścāt tadviṣayāśca bhayatitathā svaviṣayapreraṇe'pi śarīramiti na karmakartṛvirodhaḥ | na cāṅkurādau śarīrasya yogyānupalabdhiḥ; piśācasiddhādiśarīravadadṛśyatvopapatteḥ; deśāntarasthena vā śarīreṇa saṅkalpadvārā viṣāderiva preraṇopapatteśca | pratitarkāntaramāha vimatīti | atra sūryaparivṛttisaṅkhayāviśeṣāvacchedāt pūrvatvena paratvena ca kālasya pakṣīkṛtatvāt nāśrayāsiddhiriti | (anumānaṃ) mukhāntareṇa dūṣayati api cetyādinā | dūṣaṇaṃ vaktuṃ vikalpayati kimiti | dhīsthaṃ caramaśiro dūṣayati na tāvaditi | aśarīrasya manasā kartṛtvaṃ syāditi prāguktaṃ dūṣayati mānasānīti | kuta ityatrāha manasa iti | apiśabdena svapakṣe nityatvānabhyupagamaḥ sūcitaḥ | saśarītvapakṣaṃ dūṣayati nāpīti |vikalpāsahatvaṃ vivarituṃ vikalpayati taditi | prathamaṃ dūṣayati na tāvaditi | jagataḥbhūbhūdharādeḥ | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati nā pīti | hetumāha tadvayatiriktasyeti | taccharīrahetoḥ śarīrāntarasyābhāvādatyarthaḥ | dūṣaṇaparihārāya paroktaṃ śaṅkate svayameveti | svayaṃśabda īśvaraparaḥ | pariharati neti | tadayogāthetutvāyogāt | punaḥ śaṅkate anyeneti |anavasthayā dūṣayati neti | prāmāṇikaparamparā na doṣa iti cetśarīritvaprayuktakarmavaśyatvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | karmavaśyatvaprasaṅgasya prāguktatvādihāpyanavasthādūṣaṇasya karmavaśyatvaprasaṅgaparyantatvamabhipretamityavagamyate | mukhāntareṇa vikalpya dūṣayati sa kimiti |aśarīrasya nirvyāpāratve nirvyāpārasya kāryākāraṇe ca dṛṣṭānto muktātmā | vyāpāraśca prayanno vivakṣitaḥ | icchāviśeṣasya hetutve hi guṇavaśyatāprasaṅgaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ | icchāmātrameva vyāpāra ityatrāha kāryaṃ jagaditi | mātraśabdena sattvādiguṇānvayatanmūlakarmasambandhavyāvṛttiḥ | nanu karmavaśyatvādikaṃ na karttuḥ prasañjanīyam, avyāpakatvāt | na hi tvatpakṣeṇa vā'smatpakṣeṇa vā vyāptiḥ, īśvare tvayā mayāpi tadanabhyupaga māt || naivam; āgamāt ṝte'pīśvaraḥ sidhyatīti vadantaṃ prati āgamamasantaṃ kṛtvā'smādādibhirucyamānatvāt | yadīśvarapratipādakāgamabalāt maduktavyāptibhaṅgeneśvarānumānaṃ sthāpyate, tadānīmanumānasyāgamānapekṣaprāmāṇyāsiddhirityaprāptagrāhitvamāgamasya sidhyet | yadvā alaukikapramāṇaikavedyatvābhāve sati kartṛtvasya karmavaśyatvādivyāpya tvāt | śāstrayogimukteśvarapratyakṣāṇyalokikaśadoktānīti |
anumānadūṣaṇamupasaṃharati ata iti | parasya brahmaṇa īśvarānatiriktatvajñāpanārthaḥ sarveśvaraśabdaḥ |anena "tamīśvarāṇāṃ paramaṃ maheśvaram" iti śrutiḥ smāritā bhavati | devatāviśeṣanirṇayārthaṃ "mahān prabhurvai puruṣaḥ sattvasyaiṣa pravartaka" iti śrutismāraṇārthaḥ puruṣottamaśabdaḥ | uktadoṣāstadānīmapi prāpnuyurityatrāha śāstrantviti | sarvavijātīyatvaṃ darśayati sārvajñyeti | sārvajñyasatyasaṅkalpatvādimiśraśabdo brahmaviśeṣaṇaṃ guṇaviśeṣaṇaṃ | vā; tadvatatirūpatvādanyeṣāṃ guṇānām | ekaimanavadhikātiśayā guṇā aparimitāḥ niḥsaṃkhyātā ityarthaḥ ||
|| iti śāstrayonitvādhikaraṇam ||
yathā mṛttikāyā ghaṭaniṣpādanaśaktatvepi, kulālasya ca nirmāṇaśaktau satyāmapi daṇḍacakraparikarāpekṣā'styevatathā śabdasya pariniṣpannabrahmapratipādanaśaktatve'pi, brahmaṇo'pi śabdena pratipattuṃ śakyatve'pi, bubhutsākhyaparikarāpekṣā pramityutpādane vidyate | yatnasādhyatvāt bubhutsā apekṣitā | sā cājñātatvapuruṣārthatvaprayuktā | tatrāvāntarapeṭikārūpeṇa prathamena sūtradvayena śabdadvārakamarthadvārakaṃ ca śaktimattvaṃ pratipāditam | atha sūtradvayāntaramavāntarapeṭikāntaraṃ bubhutsāhetunirūpaṇaparam | tatra prathamena tṛtīyasūtreṇājñātatvarūpo bubhutsāheturuktaḥ | atha prayojanatvarūpo bubhutsāheturucyate caturthena | arthe pratipanne hi prayojanāprayojanatvacintā | pratipattiśca lakṣaṇataḥ iti janmādisūtraṃ dvitīyamabhūt | janmādikaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cetmānāntarāt tatsiddhiḥ syāditi śaṅkāyāḥ saṅgatatvāt śāstrayonitvāditi sūtraṃ tṛtīyamabhūt | ajñātatve'pyaprayojane bubhutsānudayāt prayojanarūpatvamatra nirūpyata iti kramo'yameva | sū tattu samanvayāt tatrāvāntarasaṅgatimāha yadyapīti | ajñātatvannāma bubhutsāheturyadyapyastītyarthaḥ | prayo janaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhanivṛttiśca | śāstrasya tatparyavasāyitvaṃ tadupāyapravṛttibodhanadvārā | tacca na siddhaparatve'sti | tasya pravṛttinivṛttirūpatvābhāvāt | tasmātprayojanaparyavasāyitvābhāvena bubhutsākhyaparikarābhāvāt siddhe śāstraṃ na pramitiṃ janayatītyarthaḥ | evaṃ śaṅkāyāṃ sūtramudāharati tattu sayanvayāditi | ihāpi sādhāraṇavicāradvayamarthasiddham; brahmaṇaḥ śāstrapramāṇakatvaṃ saṃbhavati, neti dvitīyavicāraḥ; tadarthaṃ pravṛttinivṛvirūpaprayojanaśūnyānāṃ vedāntavākyānāṃ brahmaparatayā'nvayaḥ sambhavati, neti; tadarthaṃ kiṃ śabdasya prāmāṇyaṃ pravṛttinivṛttiparatayā, uta puruṣārthaparatayeti |śabdasya pravṛttinivṛttiparatayaiva prāmāṇye brahmaṇaḥ siddharūpasya śāstrapramāṇakatvābhāvāt tadvicārānārambhaḥ | śabdasya puruṣārthaparatayaiva prāmāṇye puruṣārthabhūtabrahmaṇaḥ śāstrapramāṇakatvāt tadvicārasyārambhaṇīyatvaṃ phalitam | evamarthasiddhau viṣayasaṃśayāvabhipretya sūtraṃ vyācikhyāsuḥ tatra vākyārthayojanāyāmeva padayojanāmantarbhāvayipyan pṛthagvyākhyeyam tuśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe prasakteti | sarveṣāṃ sūtrāṇāṃ tattacchaṅkāyāmavataraṇe'pi asmin sūtre tu śabdaḥ pradaśarnārthaḥ | taditi vyākhyeyaṃ padam; tad vyācaṣṭe śāstrapramāṇakatvaṃ brahmaṇa iti | saṃbhavatyevetyetat tuśabdaphalitam | hetupadasyākāṅkṣāṃ darśayati kuta iti | samanvayaśabdasyottaratra vistareṇa vyākhyāsyamānatvādidānī saṅkṣapeṇa vyācaṣṭe paramapuruṣārthata yeti | kasya kena kkīdṛśo'nvayaḥ ityapekṣayāmāha parameti | śāstreṇa paramapuruṣārthabhūtasya brahmaṇo'bhidheyatayā'nvayādityarthaḥ | śāstrasya dhīsthatvāt śāstreṇeti kaṇṭhoktayabhāvaḥ | brahma śāstrapramāṇakamiti pratijñāte sati pakṣaniṣṭhatayā hetorvaktumucitatvāt samanvayo brahmakartṛkatayā vyākhyātaḥ; na tu śāstrakartṛkatayā | kathaṃ tathāvidhānvayaḥ ityapekṣāyāmetadupapādayati evamiti | ivaśabda evārthaḥ; evamevetyarthaḥ |aupaniṣadaḥ padasamudāyaḥ paramapuruṣārthabhūte brahma ṇi pratipādakatvena samanvita eva hītyarthaḥ | padasamudāyaḥ vākyamityarthaḥ |aupaniṣadavākyabahutve'pi teṣāṃ vākyaikavākyabhāvenaikārthaparatayā ekarāśitvavyañjanāyaikavacanam | samanvita iti vākyakartṛkatvenoktiḥ phalitārthābhiprāyā; na tu sūtrayojanābhiprāyā | brahmaṇi samanvitānāmityuttaratrāpyevameva | pratipattikramānurodhena prathamaṃ lakṣaṇavākyamupādatte yato vā iti |atha prāpakaṃ kāraṇavākyamāha sadevetyādinā | sacchabdasya bṛhadabṛhatsādhāraṇatvāt viśeṣakavākyamupādatte brahma vā iti || yat kāraṇaṃ, tat brahmeti lakṣaṇavākyenokte, sataḥ kāraṇatve ca kathite, tasya sato brahmatvaṃ sidhyatīti na bṛhattvaniścayaḥ brahma vā iti vākyādhīna iti cenna; lakṣaṇavākyasya kāraṇānuvāditvena prāpakavākyopajīvitvādupajīvyeṣu prāpakavākyepveva viśeṣanirdhāraṇajñāpanārthaṃ hi brahma vā iti vākyamupāttam | sadvrahmaśabdayorīkṣaṇānvayaliṅgādacidvayāvṛttavastuparatve'pi tayoḥ śabdayoḥ sādhāraṇatayā śabdasāmarthyādacidvayāvṛttiniścayastatra nāstīti śabdaśakatyaiva viśeṣajñāpanārtham ātmā vā iti vākyopādānam | brahmaśabda sya sādhāraṇatvaṃ nāma bahuṣvartheṣu prayujyamānatvam; na tu pravṛttinimittasādhāraṇyam | pravṛttinimittabhūtasya niratiśayabṛhattvasya bhagadvayavyatiriktagāmitvasandehasahatvaṃ vā | na hi svārasikātmaśabdaikārthye pratipanne sati niratiśayabṛhattvasyācidgāmitvasandehaḥ | sādvadyāyāṃ "sa ātmā" iyātmaśabda upasaṃhārastha iti upakramasthenaivātmaśabdena viśeṣaniścayārtham, "ātmā vā" iti vākyamupāttam | "yato vā imāni"ityādiprakaraṇa eva, "ānandāddhyeva khalvi māni bhutāni jāyante" ityānandaśabdena kāraṇe nirdiṣṭe'pi, "yadeṣa ākāśa ānando na syāt" ityākāśaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāt ānandaśabdenācidvayāvṛttiniścayaḥ pratibaddha ityabhiprāyeṇācidvayāvṛtteḥ sukhena pratipattyartham ātmā vā iti vākyopādānam | sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyena vinā'pi prakaraṇādeva brahmaśabda ātmapara iti jñāpanārtham, etadadhikaraṇāpekṣitānāndarūpatāpratipādakaprakaraṇasthatayā tajjñāpanārthaṃ copādatte tasmādvā etasmādā tmana iti | "satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma" iti hi tatra prakṛtam | "anyo'ntarātmā ānandamayaḥ", "ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān" iti ca tatra vakṣyate | atra(tha) "chāgo vā mantravarṇāt" iti nyāyāt sāmānyaśabdānāṃ devatāviśeṣe paryavasānaṃ darśayati eko ha vā iti | "seyaṃ devataikṣata" "yo brahmaṇaṃ vidadhāti pūrvaṃ yo vai vedāṃśca prahiṇoti tasmai | taṃ ha devam" "sa īśo'sya jagato nityameva nānyo heturvidyata īśanāya" "īśāno bhūtabhavyasya" tamīśvarāṇāṃ paramaṃ maheśvaram" ityādiṣu śrutānāṃ devatādiśabdānāṃ pūrvapūrvāpekṣayā viśeṣaśabdānāmapi sākṣāt kāraṇavākyasthatvābhā vāt, teṣu ca, rūḍhimatāma'pi devatādiśabdānāṃ vyaktiviśeṣe rūḍhatvābhāvāt īśādiśabdānāṃ ca, "jagata īśo nānyo heturvidyate īśanāya" iti samabhivyāhṛtaṣaṣṭhayantapadanirdeśādibhiravayavārthavivakṣāyāḥ sphuṭataratvena nimagnarūḍhitaya | sādhāraṇatvācca, caramaviśeṣaśabdapradarśanena teṣāmapi tatparyavasānamarthasiddhaṃ syādityābhiprāyeṇa ca "seyaṃ devatā" ityādivākyāni anādṛtya eko ha vai nārāyaṇaḥ ityādivākyamudāhṛtam | hiraṇyagarbhādayaśśabdā ākāśaprāṇādiśabdavadayogyārthāḥ | śivādiśabdāśca bahvartheṣu prayogāt sādhāraṇa iti sadādiśabdavanna viśeṣopasthāpanakṣamā ityabhiprāyaḥ | "vacanāni tvapūrvatvāt", "vidhastu dhāraṇe'pūrvatvāt" iti nyāyena, "yadāgneyo'ṣṭhākapālaḥ" "upari hi devebhyo dhārayati" iti vākyavadidaṃ mahopaniṣadvākyamapi aprāptārthopasthāpakatvāt ākāśaprāṇādivākyavat ayogyārthopasthāpakatvābhāvāccānanyāpekṣaṃ svārthaṃ pratipādayati |
"na sanna cāsacchiva eva kevala" iti vākyavirodhādidaṃ vākyamayogyārthamiti cet na; "sadeva somye dagre" iti vākyavirodhena, "na sannacāsat" ityādivākyasyāyogyārthatvaprasaṅgāt || sādhāraṇasya sacchabdasya śivaparyavasānāvirodhāt nātrāyogyārthatvamiti cet tarhi śivaśabdasya ca bahuṣvartheṣu prayogāt sādhāraṇasya nārāyaṇaparyavasānāvirodhāt nātrāyogyārthatvam | brahmaśivādīnāṃ hi kāryatvamindrādīnāmiva bahvībhiḥ śrutibhiḥ pratipādyate yajuṣi, "ajasya nābhāvadhyekamarpitaṃ yasminnidaṃ viśvaṃbhuvanamadhiśritaṃ viśvakarmā hyajaniṣṭa devaḥ", sa prajāpatirekaḥ "puṣkaraparṇe samabhavat ", "tasmādvirāḍajāyata virājo'dhipuruṣaḥ", mahopaniṣadi, "tatra brahmā caturmukho'jāyata", subālopaniṣadi, "adbhayaḥpṛthivī | tadaṇḍamabhavat | tat samvatsaramātramuṣitvā dvidhā'karodadhastādbhūmimupariṣṭādākāśaṃ madhye puruṣo divyaḥ; sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ" ityārabhya, "so'gre bhūtānāṃ mṛtyumasṛjat | tasya brahma'bibhet | so brahmāṇameva viveśa" iti |atra paramapuruṣātmanaḥ puruṣebrahmā samutpanna iti śrutaḥ; puruṣaśabdadvayaśravaṇāt mṛtyubhayavattvaśravaṇācca | śvedāśvatare, "vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam", "mahān prabhurvai puruṣaḥ sattvasyaiṣa pravarttakaḥ" yo brahmāṇaṃ vidadhāti pūrvam iti ca hiraṇyagarbhotpattiravagamyate |
tathā mahopanipadi, "tryakṣaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ puruṣo'jāyata", subālopaniṣadi, "lālāṭāt krodhajo rudro'jāyata", bṛhadāraṇyake, "brahma vā idameka evāgra āsīt | tadekaṃ sanna vyabhavat | tacchreyorūpamatyasṛjata kṣatramyānyetāni devakṣatrāṇi indro varuṇaḥ sāmo rudraḥ parjanyo yamo mṛtyurīśāna" iti | tathā śatapathe "abhūdvā idaṃ pratiṣṭho" iyārabhya "bhūtānāṃ ca prajāpatiḥ saṃvatsarāyādīkṣiṣata | bhūtānāṃpatirgṛhapatirāsīduṣāḥ patnī" "ityādikamukatvā; "bhūtānāmpatiḥ saṃvatsara uṣasi reto'siñcat | saṃvatsare kumāro'jāyata | so'rodīt | taṃ prajāpatira vravīt | kumāta! kiṃ rodiṣi yat śramāt tapaso'dhi jāto'sīti | so'bravīt | anapahatapāpmā vā ahamasmi avi(nā)hitanāmā | nāma me dhehi pāpmanopahatyā iti | tamabravīt rudro'sīti | tadasya tannāmā'karot | agnistadrūpamabhavat" ityārambha śarvapaśupatiprabhṛti nāmakaraṇaṃ pṛthivīsalilādimūrtipradānaṃ coktam | rudravākyādevānapahatapāpmatvaṃ ca tasya śrutam | tatreva ca śatarudrīyabrāhmaṇe, "prajāpatervissṛtā devatā udakrāman | tameka eva devo na jahān mahāmanyureva so'sminnantarhito atiṣṭhat | so'rodīt | tasya yānyaśrūṇi prāskandan, tānyasmin manyau prātiṣṭhan | sa eṣa śataśīrṣā rudraḥ samabhavat" iti | atra prajāpateḥ kruddhasya krodhajāśrusambhavatvaṃ manyurūpasya rudrasyābhihitam | krodhasya cāśruhetutvaṃ prasiddham ,"tasya kruddhasya netrābhyāṃ prāpatannaśruvindavaḥ | dīptābhyāmiva dīpābhyāṃ sārciṣaḥ snehavindavaḥ" iti | tathā śailālibrāhmaṇe, "prajāpatirvai prajākāmaḥ sa tapo'tapyata" ityārabhya agnivāyvādityacandrāṇāmutpatiṃta teṣāṃ retaḥskandanaṃ cokatvā "sa prajāpatirhiraṇmayaṃ ca samamakarodiṣumātramūrdhva mevaṃ tiryañcam | tasmin retaḥ samasiñcat | tata udateṣṭhat sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt | tat sahasreṇa pratihitābhiḥ sa prajāpatti pitaramabhyāyacchat | tamabravīt kathamabhyāyacchasīti | nāma me kurvityabravīt | na vā idamavihitena nāmnā annamatsyāmi iti | śarvo vai tvamityabravīt | bhava eveti yadbhava" ityārambha bhavaśarvādināmakaraṇaṃ salilādimūrttipradānaṃ cokatvā, "sa eṣo'ṣṭanāmā'ṣṭadhā vihito mahādeva" iti nāmāṣṭakamūtrtyaṣṭakavatvaṃ prajāpatinā vihitamiti spaṣṭataramuktam | talavakāriṇāṃ karmārambhe "idaṃ karma kariṣyāmi tanme samṛdhyatāṃ tanma upapadyatāṃ virūpākṣāya dantāñjaye brahmaṇaḥ putrāya jyeṣṭhāya śreṣṭhāyamodhāya karmādhipataye namaḥ" iti | tathā chandogānāṃ ca karmārambhe, "tasmai virūpākṣāya datāñjaye tuddhāya viśvavedāya sahasrākṣāya brahmaṇaḥ putrāya namaḥ" iti ca tantradvayena rudrasya brahmaputratvamabhihitam | ghṛtasūkte ca "yo brahmā brahmaṇa ujjahāra prāṇeśvaraḥ kṛtivāsāḥ pinākī"iti brahmaṇa udbhūtatvaṃ rudrasyoktam | ujjāhāraudbhūvetyarthaḥ | ato hiraṇyagarmādīnāṃ kāryatvāvagamena tadvācaśabdānāmayogyārthatvāt nārāyaṇa eva sadādiśabdāḥ paryavasyanti ||
nanu "hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavarttatāgre" "na sanna cāsacchiva eva kevalaḥ" "eko ha vai nārāyaṇa āsīt", "brahmaviṣṇurudrendrāste sarve samprasūyante" iti | trayāṇāmapi devatānāṃ kāraṇatvakāyartvayoraviśeṣaṇa śravaṇāt, ayogyatvaśaṅkāyāḥ triṣvapi tulyatvāt janmanaḥ aicchikatvena ayogyatva parihārasya triṣyapi suvacatvāt, kāraṇaikatvāvadhāraṇasyānuroddhavyātvāt rūḍheraparityāgasya svataḥ prāptatvācca, trayāṇāmapyaikyāśrayaṇena paramakāraṇatvamabhyuganta vyam || naivam; trayāṇām aviśeṣeṇakāryatvaśravaṇābhāvādeva triṣvapyayogyatvaśaṅkāyāḥ tulyatvābhāvāt | tasya hi prakaraṇasyepakrame, "kaśca dhyeya" iti dhyeyavidhiparatvamavagatamiti kāryatvamanūdyate | anuvādaśca prāpakānurodhena syāt | lakṣmīpativiṣaya uttaranārāyaṇānuvāke bhagavadutpataravatārarūpā śrūyata iti yasmin vākye bhagavadavatārānu vādaḥ | brahmaśivayostu avavatāraśrutyabhāvādindravaruṇāditulyotpattiranūdyate iti nāviśeṣeṇa kāryatvaśravaṇam | kiñcotpatiścet karmādhīnadehasaṅgatirityutsargasiddham | tacca brahmaśivayoranapoditam nārāyaṇe tvavatāraśrutyā'po ditam | "prajāpatirdevānasṛjata te pāpmanā sanditā ajāyanta" iti prajāpatisṛṣṭadevānāṃ sāmānyena pāpmasambandhaḥ śrutaḥ; viśeṣato rudrasyānapahatapāpmatvaṃ śatapathe svavākyādeva darśitam | "eṣa sarvabhūtāntarātmā'pahatapāpmā  divyo deva eko nārāyaṇaḥ" "tasya yathā kapyāsaṃ puṇḍarīkamevamakṣiṇī | tasyoditi nāma | eṣa hi sarvebhyaḥ pāpmabhyaḥ uditaḥ", "apahatapāpmā vijaro vimṛtyuḥ", "sa uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ" iti puṇḍarīkākṣasyākarmakṛtavigrahavattvaṃ cektam |
evaṃ vaiṣamyasya sphuṭatvena utpattisāmyaśaṅkāyā dūravidhvastatayā yogyārthanārāyaṇādiśabdānāmiva ayogyārthabrahmaśivādiśabdānāṃ rūḍhiparityāgābhāvo'nupapannaḥ | yadi rudrasya paramakāraṇatvaṃ tadutpatteravatārarūpatvaṃ cāstikatamairbhavadbhirucyate, tarhi bhavatāmindre kaḥ pradveṣaḥ? "indro māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyate", "brahmaviṣṇurudrāste sarve samprasūyante" iti kāryatvakāraṇatve hi brahmaśivayorivendrasyāpi śrūyete | ata indrasya paramakāraṇatvaṃ tadutpatteḥ paramakāraṇabhūtendrāvatārarūpatvaṃ cāśritya indraśabdasya yogyārthatvaṃ kimiti nābhyupagamyate || "prajāpatirindramasṛjata" iti tasya sṛjyatvaśravaṇāt tvāṣṭravadharūpabrahmahatyā'bhibhūtatvaśravaṇāt tatprāyaścitādiśravaṇācceti cet indrasya janmavṛttāpakarṣayogaḥ kṛṣṇasya vasudevagṛhajanma kālayavananimittapalāyanavat līlā kiṃ na syāt || indrasya paramakāraṇavastvaikye sati uttaranārāyaṇapratipādyatvam, tasmin sati janmavṛttāpakarṣa(saṃ)yogasya līlātvam, tasmin sati indraśabdasya yogyārthatvam, tasmin sati indrasya paramakāraṇavastvaikyamiti cakrakāśrayaprasaṅgāt, ekasmi nneva vākye somavaruṇayamādivat sṛjyatvapratīteśca naivamiti cet tarhi rudrasya paramakāraṇavastvaikye sati uttaranārāyaṇapratipādyāntabhārvaḥ, tena janmakarmāpakarṣasya līlātvam, tena śivādiśabdānāṃ yogyārthatvaṃ tena paramakāraṇavastvaikyamiti cakrakaprasaṅgāt, somavaruṇādivat tasminneva vākye sṛjyatvasaṃhāryatvaśravaṇācca śivādiśabdānāmayogyārthatvaṃ duṣpariharam | bhagavajjanmano'vatārarūpatve tu na cakakaprasaṅga, "tasmādvirāḍajāyata" iti kāraṇatayoktasya paramapuruṣasya mahāpuruṣaśabdenottaranārāyaṇe pratyabhijñātasya lakṣmīpateḥ ajāyamānaḥ" ityādivākyenāvatārasya pratipāditatvāt |
kāryakāraṇaviṣayaśivādiśabdānāṃ bhinnārthatvāt nāyogyārthatvamiti cet kiṃ kāryaviṣayaśivādi śabdānāṃ prasiddharudraparatvam uta kāraṇaviṣayāṇām? prathame prasidvasdrasya ākāśādivat sṛjyatvāt tadvayatiriktaviṣaya śivādiśabdānāṃ yogyārtha nārāyaṇa padopasthāpita viśeṣaparatvaṃ avarjanīyam || kāraṇaviṣaya śivādi śabdāḥ prasiddharudraparāḥ, kāryaviṣayāstu tadatiriktaviṣayā iti cet kāraṇe(ṇaviṣaye?)ndraśabdaḥ prasiddhendraparaḥ, kāryaviṣayendraśabdastadatiriktapara iti kiṃ na syāt | vṛtrabadhādikarttari indraśabdavyutpatteriti cet tryakṣaśśūlapāṇyādiparyāyatvena śivādiśabdavyutpatteḥ, "tryakṣaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ puruṣo'jāyata", umāpatiḥ paśupatiḥ śrī(śiti)kaṇṭho brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ | uktavānidamapyagro jñānaṃ pāśupataṃ śiva" iti śūlapāṇyādiśabdānāṃ kāryaviṣayatayā prayo gācca | kāraṇaviṣayaśivādiśabdānāṃ prasiddharudraparatvamayuktam | kāraṇaviṣayāṇāṃ nārāyaṇādiśabdānāṃ prasiddhaviṣṇuparatvaṃ tu yuktam; avatīrṇasya kāraṇasya ca dharmyaikye pramāṇasya darśitatvādatharbhedābhāvāt | arthabhede sati hi kāryakāraṇaviṣayanārāyaṇādipareṣu kasya prasirddhāthatā, kasya tadatiriktaviṣayateti vicārasambhavaḥ | kāryakāraṇabhūtarudradharmyaikye tvindradharmyaikya iva cakrakāpattiravarjjanīyetyuktam |ataḥ kāryakāraṇaviṣayaśivādiśabdānāmarthabhedāṅgīkāreṇa kāraṇaviṣayaśivādiśabdāḥ prasiddhetarārthaviṣayā iti nārāyaṇabhevābhidadhati | nārāyaṇādiśabdānāṃ prasiddhārthasya yogyatayā arthabhedābhāvāt dharmyaikyasya pramāṇapratipannatvācca |ato mahopaniṣatpratipādite nārāyaṇa eva sadvrahmādiśabdāḥ paryavasyantīti bhāvaḥ |
atha kāraṇatayā nirdiṣṭasya brahmaṇaḥ śaṅkitadoṣavyāvartakaṃ śodhakavākyamāha satyamiti | uktaguṇavibhūtyādiviśiṣṭasya brahmaṇaḥ puruṣārthatvamāpanāyāha ānando brahmeti | ānandatvaṃ hyanukūlatvam |anukūlatvaṃ ca svata iṣṭatvam; tadapi iṣṭasādhanatvanivartyaprātikūlyātbhyāṃ vinā'pīṣṭatvam | tacca viṣayagatam | tadviṣayajñānasyāpyanukūlatvādānandatvam | bhagavato muktānāṃ niratiśayabhogyatvenānukūlatayā svarūpato dharmataścānandatvam | svaviṣayajñānasya svarūpasya ca svātmānaṃ pratyanukūlatvāccānandatvam | ityevamādiḥ | aupaniṣadaḥ padasamudāya iti pūrveṇānvayaḥ |
evamanviteṣu vākyeṣu prastutapuruṣārthatvopayogitvena ko'rthaḥ pratipannaḥ; sa ca kimāpātapratipannaḥ, uta tātpayarbhūmiḥ? na prathamaḥ; tasya tāttvikatvaniścayāyogāt | na dvitīyaḥ; pravṛttinivṛttyabhāvena tadayogāditi śaṅkāyāṃpravṛttinivṛttyanvayaḥ prāmāṇyavyāpakaḥ, atastadvayāpyaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ tadvirahe na sidhyatīti kimucyate | kiṃ vā pravṛttinivṛttyanvayaḥ prayojanavyāpakaḥ, prayojanañca prāmāṇyavyāpakamiti pravṛttinivṛttyanvayavirahe tadvayāpyaprayojanābhāvāt tadvayāpyaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ na sidhyatītyucyata iti vikalpamabhipretya pravṛttinivṛttyanvayasya prāmāṇyavyāpakatvaṃ nāstītyāha na ceti | vyutpattasiddheti prathamasūtrārthānuvādaḥ | siddhavastunopururṣārthatvānna śāstraṃ pratipāda yituṃ śaknoti | pratipanne'pi, na tatra tātparyam, siddhe vyutpattyabhāvāditi na vācyaṃ, siddhe vastuni vyutvattyupapādanāditi bhāvaḥ | pramāṇāntaragocaratvaprayuktānyaparatvāṅkāvyudāsāya udāhṛtakāraṇavākyapratipannamarthamāha akhi leti | śodhakavākyapratipannaṃ kāraṇavākyaiśca siddhamarthamāha aśeṣeti | śāṅkhayābhimataprakṛtipuruṣaparatvaṃ durvaca miti bhāvaḥ | puruṣātharparatvābhāvādanyaparatvavyudāsāyāha ānandasvarūpa iti | anyaparatvaṃ tātparyābhāvaḥ; brahmaṇi prāmāṇyābhāva ityarthaḥ | pravṛttinivṛttyanvayavirahe kathaṃ prāmāṇyamityatrāha svaviṣayeti | pramāṇāni hi svaviṣayāvabodhe paryavasyanti, na tu pravṛttinivṛttyorityarthaḥ | atha pravṛttinivṛttyanvayasya prayojanavyāpakatvamabhyu pagamya prayojanasya prāmāṇyavvāpakatvābhāvamāha na ca prayojaneti | tadupapādayati prayojanaṃ hīti | hi śabdā hetau | yadvā prayojanasya prāmāṇyavyāpakatvābhāvaprasiddhirhiśabdābhipretā; yathā tantraṭakāyām,"na hi loṣṭaṃ paśyatastaddarśanaṃ niṣprayojanamiti suvarṇadarśanatā kalpyeta" iti tadā hetutvamarthasiddham | prayojanavyāpakatvaṃ pravṛttinivṛttyanvayasyāstu; tena tannivṛttau prayojanameva nivartate; na tu prāmāṇyam prayojanasya prāmāṇyavyāpakatvābhāvādi tyarthaḥ | na cetyatra ca śabdo vyāpakadvayaniṣedhasamuccaye | yathā pravṛttinivṛttyanvayasya prāmāṇyavyāpakatvamayuktam, tathā prayojanasya ca prāmāṇyavyāpakatvamayuktamityarthaḥ | pratyakṣādiṣu prayojanasya prāmāṇyavyāpatvābhāve'pi śāstre prayojanasya prāmāṇyavyāpatvamastīti śaṅkāyāṃ prayojanavyāpyatvaṃ śāstraprāmāṇyasyāstu ,tathāpi prayojanasya pravṛttinittattyanvayavyāpyatvaṃ nāstītyāha na ca pravṛttīti | vākyasyetyadhyāhāraḥ | kuta ityatrāha puruṣārthānvayapratīte riti | idaṃ pakṣaviṣayam | pravṛttinivṛttirūpatvābhāve'pi puruṣārthabhūtasyaiva brahmaṇo'bhidheyatayā'nvayapratīterityarthaḥ | na cetyatra ca śabdo vyāpyatvaniṣedhadvayasamuccaye | yathā prāmāṇyasya pravṛttinivṛttyanvayavyāpyatvaṃ nāsti tathā prayojanasyāpi pravṛttinivṛtyanvayavyāpyatvaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ | prāmāṇyasya pravṛttinivṛttyanvayavyāpyatvābhāvaḥ svaviṣayāvabodhetyādinā siddhaḥ | sapakṣatvābhimate laukike'pi siddhaparavākye puruṣārthānvayaṃ darśayati tatheti | yathā pravṛtti paratvaṃ nivṛttiparatvaṃ vā na prayojanaparyavasāyitvam, kintu puruṣārthaparatvamevatathā pravṛttinivṛttiparatvaṃ siddhavastupara tvaṃ vā na prayojanaparyavasāyitvam, api tu sādhyena vā siddhena vā puruṣārthenānvitatvameva vākyasya prayojanaparyavasāyitvamityuktaṃ bhavati; puruṣārthānvayapratīterityuktatvāt | evaṃ sūtrākṣarayojanārthaṃ saṅkṣepeṇārtha uktaḥ ||
atha tātparyārthaṃ vaktuṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ vistareṇāvatārayati atrāheti | etāvatyadhikaraṇārtha ukte labdhasvadūṣya prasaṅgaḥ pūrvapakṣī āhetyarthaḥ | brahmaṇaḥ śāstrapratipādyatvābhāvaṃ pratijānīte na vedānteti | sautratacchabdena śāstrayonitvasya parāmṛṣṭatvāt pūvarpakṣiṇā tadabhāvo'pi pratijñāta iti hi jñāyate | pratijñāta(jñā)mupapādayati pravṛttinivṛttyanvayavirahiṇa iti | tadanvayābhāve pratipādanameva na pūryeteti bhāvaḥ | tathāca vāttirkam,
"yāvat khalu pramātṛṇāṃ pravartananivartane | śabdā na kurvate tāvanna nirakāṅkṣabodhanam" iti | śāstrasyeti | śāsanāddhi śāstram | śāsanaṃ ca pravartananivartanātmakam | tatra vārtikam,
"pravṛttirvā nivṛttirvā nityena kṛtakena vā | puṃsāṃ yenopadiśyeta tacchāstraṃ nūpapadyate ||" iti | pūrvoktaṃ pramāṇānāṃ svaveṣayāvabodhitvamāśaṅkaya tat pramāṇaviśeṣe vyavasthāpayan śāstrasya prayojanaparyavasānāvaśyambhāvamāha yadyapīti | tadupapādayati na hīti | na kevalamanupalabdhireva, anupapattirapyastītyāha na kiñciditi | kiñcitsvasaṃbandhi parasaṃbandhi vā, alpaṃ prabhūtaṃ vā | vākyaprayogāderyatnasādhyatvāt yatnasya ca prayojanena vinā'nupapannatvādityarthaḥ | vākyānāṃ prayojanaparyavasāyitvādeva hi punarukteḥ prayojanābhāvāt dūṣaṇatvam | niṣprayājanavākyaprayogaḥ tacchravaṇaṃ vā'nupapannaṃ syāt; tataḥ kiṃ prastutasya prayojanaparyavayasāyināṃ vākyānāṃ pravṛttinivṛttiparatvasya; siddhaparatve'pi hi prayojanaparyavasāyitvamupapadyata ityatrāha tacceti | pravṛttinivṛttiparatvena lokavadayoḥ prayogaṃ darśa yati arthārthītyādinā | pravṛttinivṛttiparatvābhāve'pi prayojanaparaṃ vākyaṃ dṛṣṭamiti śaṅkāyāṃ siddhaparatvenoktaṃ vākyaṃ dūṣayitumanuvadati yatpunariti | vikalpayati tatreti | prathamakoṭyanupapattyā dvitīyaśiro'bhyupagamaṃ śaṅkate sato 'pīti | dūṣayati tarhiti | tasmāditi pūrvapakṣopasaṃhāraḥ ||
jaranmāyāvādipakṣau dvau vidyete | tatraiko niṣprapañcīkaraṇapiyogavādaḥ, anyo dhyānaniyogavādaḥ | etanmatadvayam, dhyānaniyogavādimukhena śāṅkarādimataṃ ca dūṣitavantamadhikaraṇapūrvapakṣiṇaṃ prati siddhāntaṃ vakṣyan idānīṃ niṣprapañcīkaraṇaniyogavādaṃ prastauti atra kaścidāheti | taṃ pratijānīte vedānteti | kāryyaparasya vākya sya siddhavastuni pramāṇabhāvaḥ kathamityabhiprayannāha kathamiti | uttaramāha niṣprapañcamiti | kuryādityatretiśabdaḥ prakāraparaḥ | niṣprapañcīkaraṇavidhinā brahmaṇaḥ ko'nvaya satyapekṣāyāmanvayamāha brahmaṇa iti |viṣayatvenānvaya ityarthaḥ |
siddhasvarūpasya brahmaṇo vidhiviṣayatvānupapattiśaṅkāparihārārthaṃ prapañcapravilayadvāreṇetyuktam | atra siddhasya sādhyatvamākārabhedādaviruddhamiti garbhitam | iha tvitiśabdaḥ samāptau | kathamityasyottaratvena itthamiti vārthaḥ | vidhiṃ darśayitumākāṅkṣāmutthāpayati ko'sāviti | katipayanāśe'pyaśaktasya viśvaprapañcanāśanavidhiraśakya ityabhiprāyaḥ | vidhiḥvidhivākyam |āvidyikasya prapañcasya buddhinivṛttimātrarūpo vilayaḥ śakya ityabhiprāyeṇa vākyamupādatte na dṛṣṭeriti | dṛṣṭivyatiriktatvāviśeṣāt jñeyaniṣedho'pi phalitaḥ | ādiśabdopāttaiḥ śrutyantaraiḥ kaṇṭhoktaśca | ātyantikanivṛtterasiddhatvādvidheyatvaṃ ca yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | śūnyaśabdenātyantikanivṛttirvivakṣitā | mātraśabdena draṣṭṭadṛśyakalpakāvidyānivṛttiḥ | tata eva hyātyantikatvasiddhiḥ | siddhasya brahmaṇo vidheyatvaṃ kathamiti śaṅkāyāṃ prapañcapravilayadvāreṇeti pūrvaṃ vivakṣitamarthaṃ visteraṇāha svataḥ siddhasyāpīti | yadvā pūrvaṃ bhāvārthavyatiriktasya vidhiviṣayatvānupapattiḥ parihṛtā; iha tu svataḥsiddhasyetyādinā prapañcavilayadvāreṇa siddharūpasyāpi vidhiviṣayatvānupapattiḥ parihṛteti bhidā | bhāvārthāndanyatvaṃ svargāderapyasti; na tasya siddhatvam | sādhyaṃ hi tat ||
adhikaraṇapūrvapakṣī mīmāṃsakastaṃ dūṣayati tadayuktamiti | kathamityatrāha niyogeti | viśiṃṣan viṣaya iti vyutpattyā viṣayo yāgādiḥ | kṛtisādhyāpūrvapratipattivelāyāṃ kṛtyavacchedakatvena sa viṣayaḥ; sa eva kāryani ṣpattau karaṇam | vaktavyāḥ | na tvayā vaktuṃ śakyamiti bhāvaḥ | prathamaṃ niyojyaviśeṣaṇaṃ dūṣayitumāha tatreti | tatrateṣu vaktavyeṣu | niyojyaviśeṣaṇamanupādeyam |upādeyam vidheyam; tadvayatiriktamityarthaḥ | vikalpya dūṣa yituṃ viśeṣaṇadvaividhyamāha tacceti | tataḥ kimityatrāha atreti | atranipprapañcīkaraṇaniyoge | niyojyaviśeṣaṇasvarūpaṃ śaṅkate brahmasvarūpeti | nimittatāṃ dūṣayati tarhīti | ku ityatrāha jīvanādivaditi | "yāvajjīvamagni hotraṃ juhoti " ityatra jīvanasya siddhatvāt yathā nimittatvam, na tathetyarthaḥ | putrajanmādivat yadā sidhyet, tadā nimittaṃ bhaviṣyatītyatrāha nimittatve ceti || apavargottarakālamapi nānuṣṭhānaprasaṅgaḥ; yāvānnimittamanuṣṭhānaniyamābhāvāt | parikaraśūnyeṣu tanniyamābhāvo dṛṣṭaḥ | tasmāt karaṇakalebaraviraheṇa na tadānīmanuṣṭhānamiti cet hanta svadūṣaṇameva svayamāviṣkaroṣi | tathāhisaprapañcatayā'nubhavasya yathārthānubhavarūpatvābhāvādapavargottarabhāvyeva yāthārthyānubhavaḥ | tadānīṃ karaṇakalevarābhāve'pi viṣayānuṣṭhānaṃ śakyaṃ, na vā? aśakyatve vidheyatvameva na syāt | ataḥ śakyamiti vaktavyam | ato nimittasya nityatvāt naimittikasya nityaṃ śakyatvācca nityaṃ tadanuṣṭānaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | phalatayā viśeṣaṇatve dūṣaṇamāha nāpīti |
niyogaviṣayānupapatiṃta vaktumā kaśceti | śaṅkate brahmaiveti | dūṣayati neti | hetumāha tasyeti | abhavyarūpatvātasādhyatvāt | abhāvārthatvācca"bhāvārthāḥ karmaśabdāḥ" kriyārūpatvābhāvādityarthaḥ | sādhyatvaṃ phalasyāpyastīti tadvayāvarttakaṃ bhāvārthatvam | tadubhayābhāvāditi yāvat | niṣprapañcatākāreṇa sādhyatvaṃ śaṅkate niṣprapañcamiti | prativadati sādhyatve'pīti | phalatvameveti | viṣayatvaṃ cetphalavyatiriktatvaṃ syāt | phalavyatiriktatvābhāvādviṣayatvamayuktamiti tātparyam | hetvantaraṃ kaṇṭhokatyā darśayan viṣayatvaṃ dūṣayati abhāvārthatvānna vidhiviṣayatvamiti | viśiṣṭasya viṣayatvānupapattiruktā; atha viśeṣyāśasya viśeṣaṇāṃśasya ca viṣayatvānupapatiṃta vakṣyan vikalpayati sādhyatvaṃ ceti | yadvāviśiṣṭasya sādhyatvābhyupagamena viṣayatvaṃ dūṣitam; atha viśiṣṭasya sādhyatvaṃ dūṣayituṃ vikalpayati sādhyatvaṃ ceti | viśiṣṭasya sādhyatvānupapattirhi viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyasya ubhayasya ca sādhyatvānupapattyā syāt, tatra ubhayasyeti vikalpānuktiḥ śirodvayena tulyadūṣaṇatvāt | prathamaṃ dūṣayati na tāva diti | kuta ityatrāha siddhatvādanityatvaprasakteśceti | siddhatvānna sādhyatvam, sādhyatvāṅgīkāre tu bhāvarūpatve sati sādhyatvādanityatvaprasakte(kti?)ścetyarthaḥ | dvitīyaṃ śaṅkate atheti | dūṣayati na tarhīti | prapañcanivṛtteḥ sādhyatve brahmaṇaḥ sādhyatvābhāvānna vidhiviṣayatvamityarthaḥ| prapañcanivṛttervidhiviṣayatvamāśaṅkaya dūṣayati prapañcetyā dinā | tasyāḥ phalatvamupapādayati prapañcanivṛttireva hīti | prapañcanivṛttirmokṣo'stu, tataḥ kiṃ viṣayatvānupapatterityatrāha sa ceti | prapañcanivṛttermokṣarūpatvāt mokṣasya ca phalatvāt phalabhūtāyā na viṣayatvamityarthaḥ | dūṣaṇāntaramāha asya ceti | asyā iti vaktavye'pi phalatvavivakṣayā asyetyuktiḥ | phalatvaṃ viṣayatvaṃ cetyākāradvayābhyupa game prapañcanivṛttiḥ phalatvānniyogasādhyā, viṣayatvāt prapañcanivṛttyā niyogasiddhirityanyonyāśraya ityarthaḥ || niṣprapañcīkaraṇapakṣe mukhāntareṇa dūṣaṇamāha api ceti | yadvā niyogaviṣayadūṣaṇenānyonyāśrayeṇa niyogaśca dūṣito bhavati; mukhāntareṇāpi niyogaṃ dūṣayati api ceti | dūṣayituṃ vikalpayati kimiti | prathamaṃ dūṣayati mithyeti | sāphalyaṃ śaṅkate niyogastviti | dūṣayati taditi | svavākyātprapañcamithyātvabrahmanirviśeṣatvaparavākyādityarthaḥ | niyogasya niṣphalatvadūṣaṇokatyā niyojyaviśeṣaṇaṃ ca dūṣitaṃ bhavati; niyogasādhyaphalasyaiva phalatayā niyojyaviśeṣaṇatvāt, iha tadayogācca | dūṣaṇāntaramāha vākyārthajñānādevetyādinā | pūrvaṃ vikalpitaśirodvaye dvitīyaṃ śiro dūṣayitumāha prapañcasyeti | prapañcasya satyatve na niyoganivartyatve ityarthaḥ | kimityādinā vikalpya prathamaṃ dūṣayati yadītyādinā  dvitīyaṃ dūṣayituṃ tadabhyupagamaṃ śaṅkate atheti | dūṣayati tasyeti | tasyetyādinā naṣṭa ityantena prayoktṛdūṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtaṃ bhavati | prapañcanivṛttītyādinā prapañcasatyatve'pi phalābhāvoktimukhena niyogo dūṣitaḥ | karaṇamitikarttavyatāṃ ca dūṣayati kiñceti | itikarttavyatāyā abhāvaṃ vivaritumāha kathamiti | prativakti itthamiti | bhāvarūpatvapakṣe dvaividhyamāha bhāvarūpā ceti | karaṇaśarīraniṣpattiḥ avaghātavat prokṣaṇavacca dṛṣṭādṛṣṭāthartayā dvidheti cābhipretam | tataḥ kimityatrāha ubhayavidheti | ubhayavidhāniṣpādikā anugrāhikā ca | niṣpādakapakṣe prathamaṃ dṛṣṭārthatve dūṣaṇamāha na hīti | kṛtsnaprapañcanivṛttirūpakaraṇaśarīraniṣpādakābhāvarūpā dṛṣṭārthā na sambhavatītyarthaḥ | adṛṣṭārthā asti cet prapañcasatyatvaprasaṅgaḥ, aprāmāṇikatvaṃ ceti sphuṭamiti na kaṇṭhoktam | athānugrahaṃ dūṣayati nāpīti | tadasambhavamupapādayati anugrāhaketi | anugrāhako hi karaṇānantarabhāvī; kṛtsnaprapañcanivṛttirūpakaraṇānantaramanugrāhakastiṣṭhati cetkaraṇameva na siddhaṃ syāt | yadā karaṇasiddhiḥ, na tadānīmanugrāhako vidyata ityanugrāhakāsambhava ityarthaḥ | itikarttavyatāsadbhāvamukhena karaṇasidiṃdha śaṅkate brahmaṇa iti | dūṣayati tenaiveti | karaṇādiniṣpādyamkaraṇaniṣpādyo niyogaḥ, niyoganiṣpādyaṃ phalamiti ādiśabdārthaḥ | karaṇaṃ cet svakāryakaraṃ syāt | tada bhāvāt karaṇatvamayuktamityarthaḥ | athābhāvarūpetikartavyatāṃ dūṣayati abhāvarūpatva iti | abhāvādevaabhāvarūpetikarttavyatāyā aprāmāṇikatvādevetyarthaḥ | nivṛttirūpaśamādīnāṃ na abhāvarūpetikartavyatātvam teṣāṃ jñānaniṣpādakatvena prapañcanivṛttirūpakaraṇaniṣpādakatvāyogāditi bhāvaḥ | atra abhāvādevetyevakāreṇa pūrvamadṛṣṭātharbhāvarūpetikartavyatāyāḥ aprāmāṇikatvasyābhipretatvaṃ gamyate | dūṣaṇamupasaṃharati ata iti | vidhiḥniyogaḥ; niṣprapañcīkaraṇaviṣayo niyoga ityarthaḥ | ataḥ pravarttakavākyenaiva brahmasvarūpasiddhiriti vaktuṃ na śakyamiti phalitam ||
atha dhyānaniyogavādipakṣamupakṣipati anyo'pyāheti | brahmaṇi vedāntavākyānāṃ svātantreṇa prāmāṇyābhāvamaṅgīkṛtyāha yadyapīti | tarhi kathaṃ tatsiddhirityatrāha tathāpīti | vyāghātābhiprāyeṇāha kuta iti | hetu māha  dhyānavidhīti | dhyāvidhiḥ kaḥ? tasya sāmarthyaṃ kathamityatrāha evameva hīti | yathā vākyānāṃ dhyānaparatve 'pi pariniṣpannaṃ sidhyati, tathaivetyarthaḥ | dhyānavidhivākyānyāha ātmā vā iti | nididhyāsitavya ityupāsanamuktam; (?) draṣṭavya iti tasya darśanarūpatvam | vijijñāsitavya iti sāmānyaśabdaḥ | ātmetyaikyopāsanamuktam |
ātmānamiti svasya jagattādātmyopāsanam | sāmarthyaṃ darśayati atreti | dhyeyamākṣiptamastu; tat brahmeti kathaṃ jñāyata ityatrāha sa ca dhyeya iti | ākāṅkṣāyāṃ sannihitameva yogyaṃ cet, tat parityaktuṃ na yuktam; gāmānayetyā diṣu hi tathā dṛṣṭamiti bhāvaḥ | svarūpamātrapratipādakānāṃ kāraṇaśodhakavākyānāmapi vidhyapekṣitasamaparkatvenaiva prāmāṇyamityāha sa kiṃ rūpa iti | śodhitasvarūpasya dhyeyatvāt satyādivākyaṃ prathamamupāttam | tadanuguṇārthatayā sadeveti kāraṇavākyaṃ paścādudāhṛtam | dhyānaśarīrānupraviṣṭeti | "arthenaiva viśeṣo hi nirākāratayā dhiyām" iti bhāvaḥ | astyeveti | svavākyapratipannasvargādiphalaviṣayasya "yasminnoṣṇam " ityādivākyasyeva vidhiśeṣatayā prāmāṇyamiti bhāvaḥ | dhyeyabrahmasvarūpaṃ hi dhyānaśarīrānupraviṣṭam | prapañcamithyātvasya dhyānaśarīrānanupraveśāt kathaṃ bhedaniṣedhe tātparyamityatrāha ata iti | ataḥvidhiśeṣabhūtasya siddhārthe tātparyasadbhāvāt | advitīyaṃ brahma dhyeyam | bhedaniṣedhaśrutayaśca brahmaṇo'dvitīyatvaparāḥ; brahmaṇo'dvitīyatvameva bhedamithyātvam iti dhyānaśarīrānupraviṣṭe bheda niṣede tātparyamastītyarthaḥ | bhedagrāhipramāṇavirodhāt na śāstramadvitīyaṃ brahma pratipādayati, "ādityo yūpaḥ" ityādivaditi śaṅkāṃ pariharttuṃ pratyakṣādibhirviruddhapratītimabhyupagacchati pratyakṣādibhiriti | śaṅkāṃ pariharati bhedābhedayoriti | bhedapratīteranyathāsiddhatvādananyathāsiddhaśāstrāvagatamaikyaṃ tāttvikamityarthaḥ | tarhi viṣayaḥ karaṇaṃ prayoktā phalamityādi vaktavyam, niyoganivatrtyatve prapañcasatyatvaprasaṅgaḥ, nityaprāptatvāt brahmabhāvo na phalamityatrāha tatreti | dhyānaniyogeneti dhyānasya viṣayatvamuktam | niyogānmokṣaścat na jñānānmokṣa iti śaṅkāṃ vyudasyati tatsākṣātkāraphaleneti | niyogasyopāyatvam, jñānadvārakamityarthaḥ | nirastetyādinā avidyānivṛttiḥ phalamityuktam | tadeva phalatayā niyojyaviśeṣaṇam, upāsakaḥ prayoktā, śamādiḥ itikarttavyatetyādi asmākaṃ siddhamiti bhāvaḥ | vākyārthajñānamātrānmokṣavādinaṃ dūṣayati na ceti | pratyakṣavirodhamāha anupalabdhervividhabhedadarśanānuvṛtteśceti | śāstravirodhamāha tathā ca satīti ||
atha sākṣānmāyāvādinā svamataṃ paścādvivakṣatā prathamaṃ dhyānaniyogavādipakṣapratikṣepamāśaṅkate athocye teti | bandhasya jñānamātranivattyarthatvaṃ sopapattikamāha rajjureṣeti | nivatrtyamithyātvaṃ hyubhayasammatam |ata eva niyoganairapekṣyamāha neti | anyathā'niṣṭamāha niyogeti | mokṣānityatvasya tadaniṣṭatāmāha mokṣasyeti | niyā go viparītaphalapradaścetyāha kiñceti | dvāreṇetyantena prasañjanīyaprasañjakayorvyāptirdaśirtā | avarjanīyamityantena prasaṅgaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha tasmāditi | tasmātsaṃsāraphalatvaprasaṅgāt | vyāpakasya saṃsāraphalatvasya nivṛttyā vyāpyaṃ dharmasādhyatvañca nivṛttamityarthaḥ | mokṣasyāśarīrarūpatvaśrutyā ca niyogasādhyatvamāha tathā ceti | aśarīratvarūpe mokṣe dharmādharmaphalarūpapriyāpriyasambandhavirahaśravaṇāt mokṣasya dharmasādhyatvābhāvaḥ phalita ityāha ityaśarīratvarūpa iti | evaṃ niyogasādhyatva mokṣasya dharmādhamarphalasambandharāhityaśravaṇānupapattiriti śrutyarthāpattiruktā bhavati | yathā niyogaviśeṣasya pāpanivṛviḥ phalamucyate, tadvat niyogaviśeṣasya bandhanivṛttiphalatvaṃ saṃbhavatītya trāha na ceti | niyogaviśeṣaphalaviśeṣaśabdābhyāṃ prāyaścittapāpakṣapaṇe vivakṣite | ku ta ityatrāha aśarīratva syati | aśarīratvasya svarūpatve śrutimāha yathāhuriti | aprāṇa iti | prāṇamanassambandhābhāvādaśarīratvaṃ siddham | saśarīrasya hi prāṇamanassabandha iti bhāvaḥ | ataḥ aśarīratvasyātmasvarūpatvāvagamādityarthaḥ | na kevalaṃ karmaphalasambandhavirahādaśarīratvasya svābhāvikatvācca niyogasādhyatvābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ, api tu kaṇṭhoktaścetyāha tathā ca śrutiriti | anyatradharmātdharmādanyatradharmeṇa vinā |anena dharmasambandharāhityamuktam | saṃbandhaśca sādhyasādhanamāva iti bhāvaḥ | atra kṛtākṛtaśabdena kriyamāṇamucyate; bhūtabhavyaśabdābhyāṃ bhūtabhaviṣyatī |
mukhāntareṇa mokṣasya niyogasādhyatvaṃ dūṣayati api ceti | sādhyatvasya vaividhyaṃ vadastadasambhavamāha utpattīti | mokṣaśabdena kiṃ nivṛttāvidyaṃ svarūpaṃ vivakṣitam, utāvidyānivṛttiḥ iti vikalpe, svarūpasya vivakṣitatve caturvidhasādhyatvānupapattimāha na tāvadityādinā | nivṛtterutpādyatve'pyavināśitvaṃ pradhvaṃsābhāvarūpatvā diti vakṣyate | saṃskāro hītyādi |atra nityaśuddha śabdena paramārthadoṣānanvayo'bhipretaḥ | nityaśuddhasya nirviśe ṣasya vastuno doṣāpanayanaguṇādhānarūpasaṃskāraviṣayatvaṃ nityaśuddhatvānādheyātiśayatvābhyāṃ nāstītyuktam | atha kriyāviṣayatvābhāvāt saṃskāraviṣayatvābhāvaḥ ucyate nityetyādinā | nirvikāratvena kriyāviṣayatvābhāvaḥ katham? ittham,yadyatkriyāviṣayabhūtaṃ, taddhi savikāraṃ dṛṣṭam(miti?) || yadā darppaṇo hastatale nirghṛṣyate tadā darpaṇāśrayā kriyā; yadā darpaṇe pāṇirnirghṛṣyate tadā pāṇyāśrayā kriyeti svāśrayaparāśrayakriyayordarpaṇodāharaṇam | kriyāviṣayatvābhāve'pi saṃskāryatvaṃ dṛṣṭamityatrāha na ceti | tarhi kaḥ saṃskriyata ityatrāha kintviti | avidyāgṛhītaḥ vidyākalpitaḥ | tena atiśayādhānānuguṇavikāritvaṃ sūcitam | yadvā avidyāgṛhīta iti śudhdyaśudhdyādibhravattayā śuddhisāpekṣatvaṃ darśitam | ahaṅkartturapi dehādvilakṣaṇatvāt kathaṃ dehagatasnānādibhistasyātiśaya ityatrāha tatsaṅgata iti | tatsaṅgataḥdehasaṅgataḥ | ātmanaḥ phalabhoktṛtvāt sa eva saṃskārya ityatrāha tatphaleti | phalabhoktā ahamartha ścet sa evātmetyatrāha na cāhamiti | hetumāha taditi | yo yasya sākṣī, sa hi na tadbhavatīti bhāvaḥ | sākṣitve mānamāha tathā ceti | tayoranya ityāderayaramarthaḥahaṅkārajñaptyātmanorekaḥ phalabhoktā, anyo'naśnanniti | aha ṅkartaiva bhokteti spaṣṭaṃ darśayati ātmendriyeti | ātmāḥdehaḥ | dehādisambandhasya bhoktṛtvādātmano'śarīratvāprāṇatvāmanaskatvādiśravaṇāt anaśnannityabhoktṛtvaśravaṇācca bhoktuvirlakṣaṇa ātmetyabhiprāyaḥ | yadvā ātmaśabdaḥ saṃvidātmaparaḥ | tataśca tadyuktasya bhoktṛtvāt tasya bhoktṛtvaṃ nāstītyahaṅkārasyaiva bhoktṛtvamityabhiprāyaḥ | eko deva ityatra kevalaśabdena phalānvayarāhityaṃ vivakṣitamiti tasyātropayogaḥ | nirguṇaḥaguṇavaśyatvādabhokte tyarthaḥ | sākṣī ahaṅkāre vyāpriyamāṇe svayaṃ sākṣimātratayā'vasthānānna bhokteti bhāvaḥ | sa paryagāditi | śuklamavidyārahitam, vāsanārahitaṃ vā | śuddhamapāpaviddhamkarmaphalarahitaṃ karmarahitaṃ ca | payargāt | gatyarthā budhdyarthāḥ; amanyatetyarthaḥ | udāhṛtaśrutipratipannākāropetamātmasvarūpaṃ vadati avidyeti | ahaṅkarttuniṣkṛṣyata ityanvayaḥ | mukterasādhyatvaṃ nigamayati tasmāditi |
jñānavaiyarthyaṃ śaṅkate yadyevamiti | pariharati mokṣeti | pratibandhanivṛttereva sādhyatvaṃ śrutisiddhamāha tathā ceti | pratibandhanivṛtteḥ sādhyatvaṃ nigamayati tasmāditi | pratibandhanivṛtteḥ sādhyatvenānityatvaṃ syādityatrāha nivṛttiritvati | ayaṃ parihāro niyogasādhyatvapakṣe'pi tulya iti cetna; niyogasādhyatve prapañcasatyatvaṃ syādityabhipretamityuktatvāt | niyogasādhyatvapakṣe śrutisvārasyahānimāha brahmeti | śrutisvārasyameva vilambaṃ na sahata iti bhāvaḥ | kathaṃ niyogavyavadhānapratirodhaḥ; vidhiśeṣatayā hi brahmaṇaḥ siddhiḥ; tatsidhdyarthaṃ niyogaḥ svīkārya iti śaṅkāyāṃ niyogaśeṣatvaṃ vidikarmatvena dhyānakarmatvena cobhayathā'pi na sambhavatītyāha na ca vidīti | vedanaṃ jñānam; upāsanamjñānaviśeṣaḥ | atra vedanaśabdo niṣprapañcīkaraṇajñānaviśeṣe viśrāmyati; vivakṣāvaśāt |ato niṣprapañcīkaraṇaniyogavādasyāpi dūṣaṇaṃ phalitam | vidyupāsikarmatvābhāve śrutimāha anyaditi | viditāt jñeyāt; aviditātjñāturityarthaḥ | anyadeveti vidikarmatvaniṣedhaḥ | tadeveti dhyānakamartvaniṣedhaḥ | vidikarma
tvābhāve śāstravedyatvāsiddhayā śāstrasya nirviṣayatvamāśaṅkaya pariharati na ceti | "brahma veda", "brahmavit" ityādibhirbrahmaṇo vedyatvaṃ pratīyata ityatrāha na hīdantayeti | idantayāprameyatayā | api tviti | pratyagātmasvarūpaṃ nirviśeṣanaviṣayatayā pratipādayatītyarthaḥ | śāstrasya bhedanivṛttiparatvaṃ darśayati tathā ceti | jñānādeva bandhanivṛttiścet, śāstrapratyakṣavirodhaḥ syādityāśaṅkaya, śāstra virodhaṃ tāvat pariharati na ca jñānāditi | śravaṇādividhyānarthakyāmiti | śravaṇamananayorapi vidheyatvaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇoktamiti na virodhaḥ | kuta ityatrāha svabhāveti | svabhāvapravṛttaśabdenādipravṛttatvaṃ vivakṣitam | atha pratyakṣavirodhaṃ pariharati na ca jñānamātrāditi | kathamityatrāha bandhasyeti | kathaṃ sthityanupapattiḥ? bandho hyanuvarttata iti śaṅkā, yasya tu bandha ityādinā parihariṣyate | uktādeva hetoḥ śarīrapātānapekṣatvamāha ata eveti | dṛṣṭāntenopapādayati na hīti | dṛṣṭānte darśitamarthaṃ vyatirekamukhena dārṣṭāntike vivṛṇoti yadīti | pāramārthikatvaviparyayamāha sa tviti | vipratipannamapāramārthikam, brahmavyatiriktatvāt śuktirūpyavaditi bhāvaḥ | jñānottarakālasthitiranupapannā cet; kathaṃ bandhasyānuvṛttirityatrāha yasya tviti | yasya tvanivṛtiḥanivṛtta iti pratītiḥ, tasya jñānameva na jātam, tatkāryādarśanāditi | kāryābhāvā sya kāraṇābhāvamātravyāpyatvābhāve'pi sāmagrayabhāvavyāpyatvāt bhramanivṛtiṃta prati tattvajñānasya sāmagrītvāt tadabhāvena jñānābhāvaḥ kalpyata iti na pratyakṣavirodha ityarthaḥ | jñānotpattyanantaraṃ bandhanivṛtiṃta nigamayati tasmāditi | śarīrasthitirbhavatu vā mā veti | dagdhapaṭe paṭapratibhāsavat śarīrapratibhāso'nuvarteta vā, nivarteta vetyarthaḥ | mukta evāsāviti | bandhasya cchinnamūlatayā dagdhapaṭavadakāryakara iti bhāvaḥ | bandhanivṛtterniyoganairapekṣyasādhakahetubhiḥ rvidhiśeṣatayā na brahmaṇaḥ siddhirityāha ata iti | ataḥvākyārthajñānamātrasādhyatvāt | tarhi brahmaṇaḥ kathaṃ siddhirityatrāha api tviti | tatpareṇaiveti | bhedaniṣedhaparairvākyairnirviśeṣatayā siddhayatītyarthaḥ | yadvā siddharūpārthapareṇaivetyarthaḥ | sidhyatīti | brahmetyarthalabdham ||
etata dhdyānaniyogavādī dūṣayati tadayukamityādinā | kuta ityatrāha vākyārtheti | prapañcamithyātvavā dinā jñānādvandhanivṛttyanupapattiḥ kathamucyata ityatrāha yadyapīti | jñānanivartyatvopagame'pi vaiṣamyamāha tathāpīti | parokṣajñānasyāparokṣabhramābādhakatve dṛṣṭāntamāha rajvādāviti | ādiśabdena bhūdalanādi gṛhyate | sarppaviparītajñānamrajjujñānam | tena bhayānivṛttiścedāptopadeśānarthakyaṃ syādityataāha āptopadeśasyeti | anena prathamasūtre, "prabalapramāṇabādhitatvena bhayādikāryaṃ tu nivartata iti bhāṣyārtho jñāyate | āptopadeśasya bhayādikāryanivīttahetu tvaṃ vastuyāthātmyāparokṣyajñānanimittapravṛttidvārakamiti hi tasya bhāṣyasyārthaḥ | imamarthaṃ dṛṣṭānte darśayati tathā hīti | astvaparokṣajñānameva tādṛśabhramavirodhi; śabda evāparokṣajñānaṃ janayatītyāśaṅkayāha na ceti | hetumāha tasyeti | vyāptiṃ darśayati jñāneti | na ca anindriyatve'pyālokādaraparokṣajñānajanakatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti hetorvyābhi cāraḥ; indriyapradhānakajñānasāmagrayananupraviṣṭatvasya vivakṣitatvāt | etacca jñānasāmagrīṣvityanena sūcitam | jñānasāmagrīṣusaparikarāsu indriyaliṅgaśabdasadṛśānupapattyanupalabdhiṣvityarthaḥ | indriyāṇyeveti ālokādisahakṛtānīti śeṣaḥ | indrayameva yogino vyavahitādikaṃ jñāpayati, tathā vivakṣitapuruṣaviśeṣasya vākyamaparokṣajñānaṃ janayatītyāśaṅkaya pariharati na ceti | asyapuruṣasya | hetumāha nivṛtteti | anabhisaṃhitetyādipadadvayaṃ hṛti nidhāya viśeṣaṇadvayamāha nivṛttapratibandhe tatparepīti | svaviṣayaniyamātikamādarśanenatyatra viṣayaśabdaḥ sādhyaparaḥ | svāsādhyajñānātikramadarśanenetyarthaḥ | śabdasādhyaṃ jñānaṃ parokṣameva; śabdastu svasādhyaṃ parokṣajñānaṃ nātikrāmatīti yāvat | manasaḥ parokṣāparokṣajñānasādhāraṇahetutvāt śabdasya tu liṅgasyeva parokṣajñānamātrahetu
tvānna yogimanassāmyamiti bhāvaḥ |
nanu śabdenāpyaparokṣajñānaṃ jāyate, daśamastvamasīti vākyena daśamo'hamityaparokṣajñānotpattidarśanā diti || tanna; upadeśānantaraṃ śīghrabhāvipratyakṣasāmagrījanyena jñānena pūrvajñānasya bhedāgraheṇa pratyakṣatvāropāt | tadā hi upadeśātpūrvabhāvinavakaparisaṅkhayānajanitasaṃskāravaśenāvilambitā hyapekṣābuddhirjāyate | yathā ghaṭo'yamityukte ghaṭaṃ paśyato'parokṣapratītirindriyajanyā; na tu ghaṭo'yamiti vākyajanyā; vākyaṃ tvāparokṣyanimittacakṣurvyāpārahetuḥtathā daśamastvamasīti vākyaṃ daśamo'hamitibuddhi nimittasya pūrvavāsitāpekṣaṇīyavastupratisandhānasya hetuḥ; na tvaparokṣāvabhāsahetuḥ; tattatpratītisāmagrīvyavahitasya vākyasya tattatsāmagrītvābhāvāt | vimataṃ pratyakṣajñānaṃ na vākyajanyam, pratyakṣajñānatvāt anupadiṣṭavākyasya daśamo'hamiti pratyayavat | vimataṃ vākyaṃ na pratyakṣamānajana kam, vākyatvāt sampratipannavaditi | evaṃ sāmagrīśaighyreṇānyathāsidhyā parihāro vastuyāthātmyāparokṣyanimitapravṛttihetutveneti bhāṣyeṇābhipretaḥ | na ca vākyajanye'pi jñāne viśeṣyabhūtāhamarthapratyakṣatāmātreṇa viśiṣṭānupraviṣṭaviśeṣaṇāṃśasyāpi pratyakṣateti vācyam(?) | ahaṃsamānādhikṛtaśabdollikhitapratīteraparokṣatvaniyamaśca nāsti; sukhaduḥkhādyanumitapuṇyapāpasya puruṣasya puṇyakṛdahaṃ pāpakṛdahamityādipratīteḥ puṇyāpāpayorāparokṣyādarśanāt | dharmipratyakṣatāmātreṇa dharmapratyakṣatve laiṅgike parvato'gnimāniti jñāne agnerapi pratyakṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ | tadetadakhilaṃ svaviṣayaniyamātikramādarśanena tadayogādityatrābhipretam |
evaṃ śabdasyāparokṣajñāna hetutvaṃ dūṣitam | atha dhyānasya vākyārthajñānopāyatāmanyonyāśrayaṇena dūṣayati na cetyādinā |anyonyāśrayaṇaparihārāya, dhyānapūrvabhāvijñānamarthāntaraviṣayam, pāścātyajñānamarthāntaraviṣayamiti bhinnaviṣayatāśrayaṇamayuktamityatrāha na ca dhyāneti | kuta ityatrāha tathā satīti | kathamupāyatvahānirityatrāha na hyanyadhyānamiti | ekaviṣayatve'pi nivartakasya vākyārthajñānasya dhyānāpekṣā syāt;dhyānasya vākyārthajñānāpekṣā kathamityatrāha jñātārtheti | dhyānahetubhūtaṃ jñānaṃ hetvantarajanyam, na tu dhyānaṃ paścadbhāvivākyajanyajñānamūlamityevaṃ dhyānavākyārthajñānayoṃ sāmagrībhedenānyonyāśrayaṇaparihāramāśaṅkaya sāmagrībhedo na sambhavatītyāha dhyeyeti | hetvantarāsambhavātbrahmaṇaḥ pratyakṣādyagocaratvāditi bhāvaḥ | tatparihārāya vākyabhedamāśaṅkaya tathā vaktumayuktamityāha na ceti | vikalpya dūṣayati dhyānamūlamiti | ekaviṣayatve tadevetaretarāśrayatvamiti | vākyāntareṇa jñānetpattau tasya tattvamasivākyajanyamānatulyaviṣayatvāt tasyāpi jñānasya nididhyāsanāpekṣā syāt, dhyānasya ca vākyārthajñānāpekṣā syādityanyonyāśrayaṇamityarthaḥ | vākyayorbhinnaviṣayatve dūṣaṇamāha bhinneti | dhyānasya ca vākyārthajñānavirodhitvamevetyāha kiñcati | dhyātrādītyādiśabdena śamādirgṛhyate | dṛṣṭadvāreṇeti | adṛṣṭadvāreṇopayogastu atyatvabhīrubhiḥ parainirrasanīyadvaitavāsanāyāḥ satyatvaprasaṅgabhayāt parityakta iti dhyānaniyogavādino'bhiprāyaḥ |
vākyārthajñānamātrādavidyānivṛttinirāsena jīvanmuktinirāsaḥ sidhyatītyāha yata iti | dūrotsāritā | vākyādaparokṣajñānasambhave'pi vyāghātādinā jīvanmuktirutsāritā; vākyādāparokṣyāsambhavāt dūrotsāriteti bhāvaḥ || kā ceyamiti | kiṃ śabdaḥ kṣepe | vikalpābhiprāyeṇa praśnaparo vā | tatsvarūpaṃ śaṅkate saśarīsyeti | vyāhatimāha māteti | vyāhatimupapādayati yata iti | vyāhatiparihārārthaṃ tanmataṃ śaṅkate atheti | saśarīratvanivṛtti riti nirdeśena saśarīratvasya chinnamūlatā jīvanmuktivādinā abhipretā | dūṣayati neti | śarīrasya satyatvānabhyupagamāt tasya pradhvaṃsarūpā svarūpanivṛttiranabhimatā, ataḥ pratibhāsanivṛttirvā pratibhāsatāttvikatābhimānani vṛttirvā vivakṣitā syādityabhiprāyeṇa prathamaṃ kalpamanūdyā abhimatāsiddhayā dūṣayati mithyetīti | saśarīratvam saśarīratvapratibhāsaḥ | anantaragranthe pratibhāsanirdeśāt | kathaṃ saśarīrasya muktiriti | na saśarīrasya muktiruktā syādityarthaḥ | tadevopapādayati | ajīvato'pīti | mithyāpratibhāsaśabdena bhrāntijñānaṃ vivakṣitam | jīvadajīvamukatyorviśeṣābhāvānna śarīrasya muktiruktā syādityarthaḥ | dvitīyaṃ śiraḥ śaṅkate atheti | atra pūrva saśarīratvapratibhāse varttamāna ityādigranthābhipretārtho vivṛto bhavati | dūṣayati neti | kathamityatrāha brahmeti | āvidyākarmā dīti ādiśabdena vāsanā gṛhyate | tenaiva bādhitaḥbādhakajñānena bādhita ityarthaḥ | dvindrajñānādau hi bādhitānuvṛttidṛṣṭetyatrāha dvicandra(jñāna)ādāviti | na hi rajuyāthātmyajñānena śuktau rajatabhramo nivarttate iti bhāvaḥ | prathamasūtre bādhitānuvṛttinirākaraṇe doṣasya pāramārthikatvena jñānabādhyatvābhāvāt bhramānuvṛttiruktā; atra tu candraikatvajñānāviṣayatvena doṣasyābādhitatvāt dvi(candra)tvajñānānuvṛttirukteti bhidaḥ | jaranmāyāvādino'pi kṛtsnamithyātvasyābhyupagatatvāt evaṃ vaiṣamyamuktam || jīvanmukteḥ śrutivirodhamāha kiñceti | smṛtivirodhamāha saiṣeti | vedaśabdena trivargasādhanakarmāṇyucyante | tatphalamucyate imaṃ lokamamuṃ ceti | buddhevākyārthajñāne jāte sati | kṣemaprāpaṇammokṣaḥ | tacchāstrairvipratiṣiddhamśāstrairiti bahuvacanasyāyambhāvaḥ,vākyātharjñānottarabhāvyupāsanavidhiparaiḥ, "evaṃ vartayan yāvadāyuṣam" ityāprayāṇādinuvāttaparaiḥ, rmokṣasya śarīrapātamātrasāpekṣatvaparaiḥ, "tayordhvamāyannamṛtatvameti" iti nāḍīviśeṣanekramaṇaparaiḥ, arcirādimārgeṇa deśaviśeṣaprāptiparaiścānekaiḥ śāstrairvirodha iti | vipratiṣiddhamiti | viśeṣeṇa pratiṣiddham | na tulyabalaiḥ pratiruddham; apitu prabalaiḥ parāhatam | prābalyañca, bhūyasāṃ syāt balīyastvam (sadharmatvam)" iti nyāyāditi bhāvaḥ | pratyakṣavirodhamapi smṛtirevāha buddhe cediti | etena paraṃ vyākhyātam | etena śāstrapratyakṣa virodhena, auhulāmi matānusāreṇoktaṃ anyadapi vyākhyātam; sarvamapyapāstamityarthaḥ | yadvā yathedānī duḥkhopalabdhiḥ, tathā pretyāpītyarthaḥ | yadvāyathā duḥkhanivṛttirnopalabhyate tathā sukhanivṛttirapi netyarthaḥ | jīvanmuktinirāsārthamudāhṛtena vacanena vākyārthajñānamātrānmokṣaścārthānnirasta ityāha aneneti | jīvanmuktinirāsamupasaṃharati ata iti |
jīvanmuktinirāsena svamatasthairyasiddhimāha tasmāditi | vākyārthajñānamātrānmokṣavādinoktaḥcodyapari hāro mamāpi tulya ityāha na ca niyogeti | niyoganivartyatve prapañcasatyatvaṃ syādityāśaṅkayāha kiñceti | dhyānaniyogapakṣānupapattiparihārasya vivakṣitatvāt kiñcaśabdaprayogaḥ | niyogasya nivarttakatvaṃ jñānadvārakamiti na nivartyasatyatvamityarthaḥ | niyogasya jñānotpattau kiñcitkārabubhutsayā pṛcchati | kathamiti | na khalu jñāne dṛṣṭaḥ kiñcatkāro niyogena sambhavati; ataḥ sa vaktavya iti bhāvaḥ | pratibandyā pariharati | kathaṃ veti | vedanotpattihetutvamiti | icchādvārā vedanotpattihetutvamabhipretam | vividiṣantī"ti hyudāhariṣyate | parihāraṃ śaṅkate mana iti | tatsāmyamāha mamāpīti | punarāśaṅkate mama tviti | mano hi sādhāraṇakāraṇam | tasmin satyayi asādhāraṇakāraṇamapekṣitam; tanmamāsti; tvayā tu vaktavyamiti cedityarthaḥ | vaiśeṣikādyabhimatamānasapratyakṣa iva, prakṛṣṭādṛṣṭasahakṛtamanomātrakāraṇake "tat sarvaṃ dhamarvīryeṇa yathāvatsamprapaśyasi" ityādisiddhe yogipratyakṣa iva ca mana evāsādhāraṇakāraṇamiti pariharati dhyāneti | manomātrasya sādhāraṇakāraṇatve'pi nirmalatarasya manoviśeṣasyāsādhāraṇakāraṇatvaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | tajjñāpakaṃ praśnaṃ śaṅkate keneti | jñāpakasvārasyalakṣaṇaṃ svapakṣe vaiṣamyaṃ darśayituṃ pṛcchati bhavato veti | nididhyāsanena viṣayavimukhīkṛtamanaskasya śāstreṇa nivarttakajñānotpattau pramāṇa tayā parābhimatāni śrutivākyāni śaṅkate vividiṣantīti | "brahma veda brahmaiva bhavati"iti vedanaśabdena vākyārtha jñānaṃ vivakṣitamiti parābhiprāyaḥ | manaso jñānasādhanatve pramāṇaṃ darśayati mamāpīti | na cakṣuṣetyādivākyaṃ manasa
eva sādhanatve svarasam | brahma vedetyatra vedanaśabdasya vākyārthajñānaparatvaṃ tu na svarasataḥ pratīyate | na ca śrutyantaraikārthyena tatparatvāvagamaḥ, vākyārthajñānasyopāyatvakaṇṭhoktimacchatyantarābhāvādityabhipretam | mithyātvanibandhanāḥ sarve codyaparihārāḥ samānāḥ | parokṣajñānasyāpyaparokṣabhramanivartakatvaṃ śāstrapratyakṣavirodhau śrutisvārasyahāniśca bhavatāṃ pakṣe'dhikaṃ dūṣaṇamiti vaiṣamyajñāpanāya kathamityādinā pratibandīmukhena tattacchaṅkāparihāraḥ kṛtaḥ | iti śabdo nānantaravākyaśeṣaḥ; api tu prakaraṇaśeṣaḥ |
upāsyatvapratiṣedhaṃ śaṅkate nedamiti | pariharati naivamiti | tasya vākyasyaivaṃ nirvāho na yukta ityarthaḥ | upāsyatvaniṣedhaḥ pratīyata ityatrāha nātreti | kastarhyartha ityatrāha api tviti | kathaṃ vairūpyapratipādanāmityatrāha yadidamiti | "yadidamupāsate" ityatra idamaṃśe niṣedhasya tātparyamiti bhāvaḥ | "mano brahmetyupāsīta" ityādinā vihitapratīkopāsanopāsyāni hi paricchinnāni; nedaṃ brahma | kintvaparicchinnaṃ tadeva paraṃ brahmetyarthaḥ | anena "anyadeva tadviditāt" ityādikamapi jagadvairūpyaparamiti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | yat vācā anabhyuditamvaktumaśakyam, aparicchinnam | anyatheti svāvākyavirodha uktaḥ | dhyānavidhivaiyarthyamiti vākyāntaravirodha uktaḥ | svapakṣamupasaṃharati ata iti ||
athāyameva dhyānaniyogavādī bhāskaramataṃ dūṣayituṃ tadabhimataṃ bhedābhedāvirodhamanuvadati yadapītyādinā | prathamaṃ saṅkṣepeṇa dūṣayati tadayuktamiti | niyamena bhinnādhāratvalakṣaṇaḥ sahānavasthānalakṣaṇaśceti virodho dvidhā | ādiśabdena tṛṇadahanāderiva nāśyanāśakabhāvo vivakṣitaḥ | tadvat bhedābhedayorapi virodho'stītyāha na hīti || atha bhedābhedamataṃ vistareṇa prastauti athocyeteti | vakṣyamāṇaupayikamarthaṃ śikṣayati sarvaṃ hīti | śītoṣṇādi ṣvapi virodhaḥ pratītyadhīna iti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha sarvaṃ ceti | kathaṃ bhinnābhinnatvamityatrāha kāraṇātma neti | pūvoktadvividhavirodhopalambhasthalavairūpyaṃ vaktumāha chāyeti | tataḥ kimityatrāha kāryeti | avirodhenopalabdhimāha pratyuteti | upalabdhimabhinayena darśayati yatheti |advirūpavastvanupalabdhimāha na ceti | nāśyanāśakatvalakṣaṇastṛtīyo'pi virodho nāstītyāha na ca tṛṇāderiti | vastuvirodhaśabdena nāśyanāśakatvalakṣaṇaviro dho vivakṣitaḥ | tādṛśavirodhābhāvamupapādayati mṛtsuvarṇeti | jātigato'bhedo vyaktigataśca bheda iti kathamekasya bhedābhedāviti śaṅkāyāṃ jātivyakatyoḥ paramparabhedābhedamupapādayati na cābhinnasyeti | abhinnasyajāteḥ, bhinna syavyakterityarthaḥ | jāterabheda evākāraḥ, vyakterbheda evākāra iti kimīśvarājñayā svīkriyate? na hi pramāṇatarkānādareṇa haṭhāt kaścidarthaḥ svīkārya iti bhāvaḥ | pratītibalādabhyupagatiṃ śaṅkate pratītatvāditi | tathā svamatasyābhyupagantavyatāmāha pratītatvādeveti | tvaduktādevetyevakārābhiprāyaḥ | dvairūpyamapīti |aniṣṭamapīti apiśabdasyābhiprāyaḥ | pratītatvamevopapādayati na hīti | iyaṃ jātiḥ iyaṃ vyaktiriti vivakte hi,atrābhedaḥ atra ca bheda iti vaktuṃ yuktam, na tathā vivicyata ityarthaḥ | tarhi kathaṃ pratītirityatrāha api tviti | ekameva vastu jātyā tmanā vyakatyātmanā ca bhinnamabhinnañca pratīyata ityarthaḥ | mṛdayaṃ ghaṭa ityanena matvarthīyapratyayanirapekṣasāmānādhikaraṇyapratyayo bhedābhedasādhakayuktiruktā bhavati | anuvṛttivyāvṛttibhyāṃ vivekaṃ śaṅkate anuvṛttīti | pariharati naivamiti | viviktākārānupalabdhi vivṛṇoti nahi susūkṣmamapīti | viviktākāropalambhe sati hi asminnaśe'nuvṛttibuddhibodhyatvam asminnaṃśe vyāvṛttibuddhibodhyatvamiti jātuṃ śakyamityarthaḥ | ākārabhedaḥ aṃśabhedaḥ | tarhi kathamupalambha ityatrāha yathā sampratipanneti | viśeṣaḥ vyaktiḥ | yathā kāryaikatvaṃ vyakatyekatvañca sampratipannaṃ, tathā kāryakāraṇayośca jātivyakatyoścaikatvabuddhirjāyata ityarthaḥ | ekatvabuddhirityanena ekaśabdānuviddhapratyaya ukto bhavati | sahopalambhaniyamaḥ prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇe abhedena grahaṇaṃ(aśaṃbhedenāgrahaṇaṃ) ca arthāduktaṃ bhavati; na vivektuṃ śaknotītyukteḥ | evaṃ jātivyakatyoranyonyaṃ bhedābhedaḥ uktaḥ; atha piṇḍānāṃ parasparabhedābheda ucyate evameveti | deśakālavailakṣaṇyaṃ spaṣṭam | nīlatvakhaṇḍatvādirākāravailakṣaṇyam | atyantabhedaḥ abhedāsaho bheda ityarthaḥ |atra codyamāśaṅkate athocyeteti | dehātmanoḥ saddravyātmanaikatve'bhimate'pi deharūpeṇa ātmarūpeṇa vā tayoraikyasyāprāmāṇikatvāt tayorbhinnābhinnatvamaniṣṭamiti bhāvaḥ | pariharati tadidamiti | abādhitaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhedābhedasādhakam; abādhitaśca bhedābhedastattvam" ityajānatoktamityarthaḥ | tadupapādayati | tathā hīti | parihāraupayikamarthe śikṣayati abādhita iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha devādīti | jātivyakatyorapi tathā syādityatrāha khaṇḍa iti | evaṃ laukikārthānāṃ bhedābheda uktaḥ | tadu(mu?)pajīvya vaidikeṣvaṣyartheṣu jīvabrahmaṇaśerbhedābhedamāha ata eveti | ataḥbhedābhedayoraviruddhatvādityarthaḥ | brahmāṃśatvenetyatra "aṃśo nānāvyapadeśāt" iti sūtraṃ smāritam | acidvrahmaṇorbhedābhedaḥ svābhāvika iti bhāskarayādavayorubhayorapyabhimatam; "cidvrahmaṇostu bhedābhedau svābhāvi kau" iti yādavamatavyāvṛttyarthamāha tatreti | kathamiti | bhedābhedasadbhāve tatrābhedasyaiva svābhāvikatve ca kiṃ pramāṇamityarthaḥ | abhedasya svābhāvikatvena prādhānyāt prathamam anyathā ceti sūtrāṃśaviṣayavākyamāha tattvama sīti | dāśakitavetyādyaśaviṣayamāha brahmema iti | nānāvyapadeśādityaṃ śasya viṣayamāha nityo nityānāmiti | kriyāguṇairātmaguṇaiśceti kriyāguṇāḥsāṃrahetuguṇaḥ | ātmaguṇāḥmokṣahetuguṇāḥ; taissaṃyogaheturityarthaḥ |atra bhedasyaupādhikatvaṃ kathamavabhamyata ityatrāha tatreti | tatsvarūpāpattivyapadeśo bhedaniṣedhaścā bhedasyānaupādhikatvajñāpakāvityarthaḥ | muktau bhedaniṣedhādeva bhedasyaupādhikatvamapyarthasiddham | muktau bhedaṃ darśayaṃścodayati nanu ceti | sahaśabdo bhoktṛsāhityapara iti codayiturabhiprāyaḥ | bhogyasāhitya buddhayā pariharati naitaditi | bhedapratītiṃ parihari ṣyan muktau bhedasya śrutiviruddhatāṃ darśayati nānya iti | bhedapratītiṃ pariharati so aśnuta iti | sośnuta iti vākyenoktaṃbhavatītyanvayārthaḥ | brahmaṇā saha guṇānaśnuteguṇāṃśca brahma cānubhavatīti |kiṃ brahma pṛthagbhūto'śnute, utāpṛthagbhūta ityapekṣāyām tat vākyāntarāvagamyam |ato nātra bhedapratītiriti yāvat | etadupapādayati anya theti | aprādhānyaṃ bhokatrāntarāpekṣayā doṣaḥ; bhogyabhūtasvaguṇāpekṣayā tu na doṣa iti bhāvaḥ | parodāhṛtasūtrasya svābhimatamarthamāha jagaditi | brahmaṇo muktasya ca bhede sati jagadvayāpāravarjatvaprasaṅgānna bheda iti sūtrārtha ityarthaḥ | tadupapādayati anyatheti |abhesya svābhāvikatvaṃ nigamayati tasmāditi | muktau bhedaniṣedhādarthasiddhaṃ bhedasya aupādhikatvam evakāreṇābhipretam | upādhiḥ ka ityapekṣāyāmāha bhedastviti | aupādhikatvarūpavaiṣabhyaparaḥ tuśabdaḥ; śaṅkādyotako vā | brahmaṇo vibhutvaniravayavatvābhyāṃ jīvagata upādhirbrahmaṇyeveti tadasaṃsṛṣṭapradeśābhāvāt jīveśvara bhedo na sambhavatītyatrāha yadyapīti | anyonyāśrayamāśaṅkayāha na ceti | īśvarāṃśe karmakṛtabudhyādyupādhisambandhābhāvādupādhasaṃyogasya bhedapūrvakatvam | pravāhānāditayā pariharati upādheriti  kathamupādhitatsaṃyogamakarmaṇāṃ pravāhānāditvam, tena cānyonyāśrayaparihāraḥ katham iti śaṅkāyāṃ tadvivṛṇoti etaduktamiti | tadyuktātkarmeti | karmavaśyatvaṃ hi jīvatvam | upādhinā jīvatvaṃ jīvabhāvādupādhyantaramityanādirityarthaḥ | phalitamarthamāha ata iti | acidaṃśe vaiṣamyamāha upādhīnāṃ punariti | punaḥ tvarthaḥ | vaiṣamye hetudvayamāha upādhīnāmiti | bhinnābhinnatvapakṣamupasaṃharati ato jīvakarmeti ||
atha bhedābhedapakṣaṃ dhyānaniyogavādī dūṣayati atrocyata ityādinā | pūrvaṃ yadapi kaściduktamiti prakāntasya pakṣasyotthāpakaṃ saṅgatisthalaṃ darśayitumāha advitīyeti | tatsaṅgatisthalaṃ darśayati tatra yaduktamiti | bhedābhedaviṣayapratītiṃ dūṣayiṣyan pūrvaṃ tayorvirodhamupapādayituṃ tatsvarūpamāha kasmācciditi | vilakṣaṇatvamanyatvam | idamidaṃ na bhavati, idamidaṃ bhavatīti hi bhedābhedaviṣayapratītiḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha tayoriti | bhedābheda iti na kasyaciddharmasya saṃjñā | lokaprasidhyanuguṇo'rtho bhedābhedaśabdasya svīkṛtaścet bhāvābhāvayorvirodho'varjanīya ityarthaḥ | kiñca anena kkacidapi virodho nāstīti vaktuṃ na śakyam; trividhavirodhopalabdheḥ | yadi bhāvābhāvayorna virodhaḥ, tarhi bhinnābhinnatvaṃ bhavati, na bhavatīti svaparavacasorapi virodhābhāvaḥ syāt | paroktaṃ piṇḍadvayabhedābhedasyākārabhedādavirodhamanuvadati kāraṇātmaneti | vikalpya dūṣayati netyādinā | ekasmin ākāra iti | ākāraśabdaḥ padārthaparaḥ | pūrvasmin kalpa iti | tatra jātivyakatyoḥ kiṃ parasparaṃ bhedaḥ, utābhedaḥ, uta bhedābhedaḥ iti vikalpatrayamabhipretya prathamaṃ śiro dūṣayati vyaktigata iti | dvitīyamanuvadati jātiriti | dūṣayati tarhīti | virodhaṃstiṣṭhatyevetyarthaḥ | tṛtīyaṃ dūṣayati ekasmiṃśceti | jātiḥ vyaktirbhavati na bhavatīti bhāvābhāva virodhaḥ sthita evetyarthaḥ | kaṇṭhokta pūrvavikalpo dvitīyaṃ śiro dūṣayati dvitīye tu kalpe iti | atra tṛtīyasya jātivyaktivyatiriktasya vastuno'pratipannatvaṃ nāmaikaṃ dūṣaṇamadhikam | tadidaṃmapratipannañcetyanenābhipretam | pratipannatvābhyupagame'pi dūṣaṇamāha tṛtīyābhyupagame'pīti | na punariti | anyathā tritvābhāvādityarthaḥ | atra tṛtīye vastuni ākāradvrayena bhedābhedayornirvāhyatvenāvirodhitvaṃ śaṅkate ākāradvayeti | idamākāradvayaṃ svāśrayeṇa bhinnam, utābhinnam, uta bhinnābhinnam iti vikalpamabhipretya prathamaṃ śiro dūṣayati svasmāditi | svaśabdatrayamapyāśrayaparam | bhedābhedayorekāśrayatvena hi virodhaḥ | avirodhanirvāhakākāradvayaṃ hi na bhedābhedayorāśrayabhūtam | ato na tat avirodhanirvāhakam |agrigataṃ paiṅgalyamaujjavalyāñcākāradvayam agnau śītoṣṇatvarūpaviruddhadharmadvayasamāveśanirvāhakaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ | dvitīyaṃ śiro dūṣayati avilakṣaṇamiti | pūrvamākāradvaye sambhavati tasya viruddhadharmadvayanirvāhakatvāyoga uktaḥ; atra tvākāradvayameva nāstīti nitarāṃ viruddhadharmasamāveśāyoga ityabhiprāyeṇa kathantarāmityuktam | tṛtīyaṃ śiro dūṣayati ākāradvayatadvatoriti |ākāradvayasya tadāśrayasya ca bhinnābhinnatvanirvāhakamākāradvayāntaramapekṣitam; tasyāpi svāśrayeṇa bhinnābhinnatvamasti cet, tadavirodhanirvāhakākāradvayāntaramapekṣitamityanavasthā syādityarthaḥ | atha kiṃ dṛṣṭe'nupapannaṃ nāmeti śaṅkāyāṃ bhedābhedaviṣayapratītiṃ dūṣayati na ceti | hetumāha yata iti | tasyāṃ pratītau prakāraprakāriṇau vivicya darśayati tatreti |
anenedamapi parihṛtammatvarthīyapratyayanirapekṣasāmānādhikaraṇyam, sahopalambhaniyamaḥ; ekaśabdānuviddha pratyayaḥ, prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇejātivkatyorabhedapratītiśceti hetucatuṣṭayam | apṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ matvarthīyapratyayanirapekṣasāmānādhikaraṇyahetuḥ | apṛthaksiddhiśca prakāraprakāriṇoḥ sambandhaniyamādevopapannā |ataḥ prakāraprakāribhāvapratipannabhedaviruddhābhedakalpanāyā nāvakāśaḥ | sambandhaniyama eva sahopalambhaniyamahetuśca | eko'yaṃ gauriti pratyayo'pi eko daṇḍītivat viśeṣyaikyaviṣayaḥ; na tu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyaikyaviṣayaḥ | prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇe'pi prakāraprakāribhāvāt bhedenaiva pratītiḥ | kiñca sahatvamapi bhedasādham | dvayoreva hi sāhityam | sahopalambhaniyamaśca, samprati panne bhinne abhinna ca na dṛṣṭa ityasādhāraṇānaikāntikatvāt nobhayasādhakaḥ | bhinneṣu abhinneṣu cādṛṣṭasya bhedābhedasādhakatve'bhyupagamyamāne nityebhyo'nityebhyaśca vyāvṛttaṃ gandhavattvaṃ pṛthivyā nityatvānityatvasādhakaṃ syāt | kiñca sādhananiyamaḥ sādhyaniyamaheturiti sahatvaniyamo bhedaniyamahetureva | atra jātiḥ atra vyaktiriti pradeśabhedāgrahaṇaṃ jāteḥ piṇḍe vyāpyavṛttitvāt | tacca sahopalambhaniyamāntargatam | deśataḥ kālataścopalambhaniyamo hi sahopalambhaniyamaḥ | ato deśataḥ kālataśca sambandhaniyamakṛtaḥ sahopalambhaniyamaḥ | kiñca sahopalambhaniyamo'siddha|; idaṃ rajatamityatra śuktitvajātivyatirekeṇādhiṣṭhānabhūtavyaktipratīteḥ | ato naikyasādhakatvamiti ||
laukikavastuni bhedābhedayorviruddhatvamupajīvya vaidike'pi tatsadbhāvamāha ata eveti | bhedābhedayorvirodhenaikasmin vastuni tayoranupapannatvādityarthaḥ | bhedābhedanirāsamupajīvyābhedasyaiva tāttvikatāmāha tasmāditi | doṣasambandhamukhena codayati nanviti | aparamārthatayā pariharati naivamiti | paroktadoṣaḥ parasyaivetyāha bhavata stviti | tadupapādayati na hīti | aṅgulyāderiva chedo na sambhavatīti acchedyatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ, tasya hetuḥ niravayava tvam | bhitvāacchinnatve'pi pāṇipādādivat pratiniyatapradeśabhedenetyarthaḥ | pradeśabhedena chedanena vā brahmaṇi sambandhamupādhayā nārhanti, niravayavatvādacchedyatvāccetyarthaḥ | niravayavatve'pyacchedyatve'pi gaganavat upahitānupahitāṃśabhedena sadoṣatvanirdoṣatvopapatiṃta śaṅkate yadi manvīteti | upādhyavacchedājjīvabhāvaḥ jīvabhāvādupādhyavacchedaḥ; karma ṇā jīvabhāvaḥ tasmātkarmeti cānyonyāśrayaparihārāya anādirityuktam | dūṣayitumāha ayaṃ praṣṭavya iti | vikalpayati kimiti | śrutau aṇuśabdasya sūkṣmaparatvābhiprāyasambhavāt tṛtīyakalpodayaḥ | caturthapañcamau kalpau ābhyāṃ vikalpābhyāṃ vinā gatirnāstītyabhiprāyeṇa kṛtau; na tu parābhyupagatyā | brahmaśabdasya jīve'pyupacāravṛtteḥ caturthaḥ kalpaḥ | upādhibrahmaṇorbhinnābhinnatvābhyupagamāt pañcamaḥ | prathamaṃ śiro dūṣayati acchedyatvāditi | dūṣaṇāntaramāha ādimattvamiti | tadupapādayati ekasya sata iti | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati dvitīye tviti | dūṣaṇāntaramāha upādhā viti | ākarṣaṇena vinā tatparihārāsambhavāt tadāśaṅkayāha ākarṣaṇe ceti | anupapattyā tadanabhyupagamamāśaṅkaya pūrvoktadūṣaṇena vyudasyati niraśaṃsyeti | dūṣaṇāntaramāha acchinneti tatparihāramāśaṅkayāha pradeśabhedāditi | tṛtīyaṃ śiro dūṣayati tṛtīya tviti | anupahitabrahmasiddhiḥ syāditi | nirdoṣamaṅgalaguṇakatvaśrutīnāmanupahitabrahmaviṣa yatvaṃ hi parābhyupetam | jīveśvarabhedābhāvaprasaṅgo jīvānāṃ parasparabhedābhāvaprasaṅgaścetyarthaḥ | caturthapañcamau dūṣayati turīye tvityādinā | carama iti | aciddravyasyaiva cetanatvavacanāt tasya cetanabrahmatādātmyānupapattiścetyabhi prāyaḥ | bhedābhedadūṣaṇamupasaṃharan svamatasiddhimāha tasmāditi | dhyānavidhiśeṣatayā brahmaṇaḥ siddhimupasaṃharati ata iti ||
