dhyānaniyogavādipakṣaṃ mīmāṃsako dūṣayati tadapyayuktamiti | na kevalaṃ niṣprapañcīkaraṇavidhivāda evānupapannaḥ, idamapi matamanupapannamiti apiśabdasya bhāvaḥ | kuta ityatrāha dhyāneti | dhyānavidhiśeṣatve kathamarthasatya tve tātparyoyogaḥ; vidhiśeṣatvaṃ hitvā svātantreṇa vā brahmaṇi prāmāṇyaṃ syādityatrāha etaduktamiti | dūṣayituṃ vikalpayati brahmasvarūpeti | prathamaṃ śiro dūṣayati eketi | ekavākyatvammahāvākyaikatvam | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati bhinnati |anavabodhakatvaṃ duḥkhasādhyaśravaṇādau pravṛttyayogāt | ekavākyatvapakṣe vidhiśeṣatayā brahmaṇaḥ siddhimāśaṅkayāha na ca vācyamiti | kuta ityatrāha dhyānavidheriti | "nāma brahmetyupāsīta" ityādiṣu dṛṣṭividhiṣu viśeṣyasatyatve'pi viśeṣaṇāsatyatvena viśiṣṭāsatyatvamavarjanīyam; iha ca tathaivetyarthaḥ | sārthasaṅgrahaṃ pūrvapakṣamupasaṃharati ata iti || nanu prathamasūtre vidhiśeṣatayā brahmaṇi prāmāṇyasamarthanam etadadhikaraṇapūrvapakṣe vidhiśeṣatayā tatsiddhipratikṣepaśca kathaṃ ghaṭate || ittham; tatra tu phalatvena siddhiruktā, phalatayā sidhyataḥ pāramārthyābhāve svargāderapyasatya tva prasaṃgāt | tatpāramārthyaṃ sidhyatīti phalatayā tatsiddhisamatharnaṃ sādhīyaḥ | atra tu dhyānavidhikarmatvena tatsiddhirvyudastā; na tu phalatayā tatsiddhirityavirodhaḥ ||

yojayati parameti | paramapuruṣārthatvopapādakamanavadhiketi padam | puruṣeṇāthyartvaṃ hi puruṣārthatvam | ānāndarūpa tayā puruṣārthatvam; tasyānavadhikātiśayatvātparamapuruṣārthatvamiti bhāvaḥ | svayamananukūlasya sukhasādhanasyāpi puruṣārthatvamastīti tadvayāvṛttiścānavadhiketyādipadena siddhā | tacchabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe śāstrapramāṇakatvamiti | pūrvapakṣavyāvarttakatuśabdalabdhamarthamāha sidhyatyeveti | tattvamasyādisvarūpopadeśaparavākyārthajñānamātreṇāvidyānivṛtiṃta tanmu khena vākyasya prayojanaparyavasānañca vadato mṛṣāvādino dhyānavidhyānarthakyaṃ syāt; kathaṃ ca pravṛttinivṛttyoḥ puruṣārthatvavaikalyam; svarūpaparavākyasya puruṣārthaparyavasānaṃ kutra dṛṣṭam; tathā sati kathaṃ dhyānavidhisāphalyam ityākāṅkṣāyāmāha etaduktamiti | brahmaṇaḥ puruṣārthatādhikyamāha anādītyādinā | kamarbhiranubhavapratibandhāt kṣetrajñānāṃ tasya puruṣārthatvajñānābhāvaḥ, na tu tatra tadvaikalpādityabhiprāyeṇoktam anādikarmeti | devāsurādiparigaṇanaṃ teṣāṃ vyavasthitabhogyatvapradaśarnā rtham | yogyānupalabdhiśaṅkāvyudāsāya anubhavasambhava ityuktam | tadviṣayajñānānukūlatvaṃ hi tadanukūlatvena vinā na sambhavati | ato'navadhikātiśayānandajanananatvoktayā brahmaṇo'navadhikātiśayānukūlatvaṃ sidhyatītyānandatvamupapāditaṃ bhavati | svarūpetyādinā sarvaprakārabhogyatvamuktam | tena puruṣārthatvādhikyaṃ siddham | pravṛttītyādinā pravṛttinivṛttyoḥ puruṣārthatvavaikalpamuktam; iṣṭasukhalavasādhanatayopādeyatvāt duḥkhātmakatayā svato bhogyatvābhāvācca |
dhyānādividhyānarthakyaṃ pariharati evambhūtamiti | parokṣajñānasyāpi sukharūpatvāt svarūpaparāṇi vākyāni puruṣārthaparyavasāyīnyeva, tadāparokṣyākāṅkṣiṇastatsādhanajñāpakatvāt dhyānavidhāyīni vākyāni api na niṣphalātītyarthaḥ | imamartha dṛṣṭāntena darśayati yatheti | evaṃ parokṣajñānajanakasyaiva vākyasya puruṣārthaparyavasāyitve 'pi phalaviśeṣāpekṣayā dhyānapravṛttiryuktā, yathā "darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta", "jyotiṣṭobhena svargakāmo yajeta", "agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ" ityādiṣu darśapūrṇamāsādīnāmekaikasyasvargasādhanatve'pi phalaviśeṣāpe kṣayā karmāntarārambhaḥ ekasyaiva karmaṇa āvṛttiścopapadyate, yathā putrajanmaśravaṇasañjātaharṣasyāpi paścāt tanmusvāparokṣyasukhāśayā pravṛttirupapadyate tathātrāpītyābhiprāyaḥ | atra nidhirājakumāradṛṣṭāntadvayaṃ cidacidvibhāgāduktam, ubhayagataṃ bhogyatvaṃ brahmaṇyastīti jñāpanāya | "tadyathā hiraṇyanirdhi nihitamakṣetrajñā uparyupari sañcaranto na vindeyuḥ" iti śrutiḥ | nidhirastītivākyasya puruṣārthaparatvaṃ darśayati tṛptassanniti | "avijñātāḥkumārakāḥ", "bhagavato 'haṃ putraḥ prepyaḥ śiṣyaśca", "mātā pitā bhrātā", "bhūtānāṃ yo'vyayaḥ pitā", "eka indro (idrājā) jagato babhūva", "rājādhirājaḥ sarveṣām" ityādiśrutismṛtyanusāreṇa sarvavidhabhogyatvapradarśanāya rājakumāra iti bhagavati rājatvaṃ cetaneṣu putratvañcopavarṇitam | atra kuśalavasamādhirdraṣṭavyaḥ | bālakrīḍāsakta ityanena cetanānāṃ bāhyaviṣayaprāvaṇyaṃ sūcitam | narendrabhavanānniṣkrānta ityanena bhagavatsakāśabahiṣṭhatvaṃ darśitam, paramavyomālābhaśca mārgādbhraṣṭa ityanena karmajñānādyupāyānanvayaḥ khyāpitaḥ | dvijavaryeṇa varddhita ityanena bhagavajjñānaniṣpattiyogyatāsiddhihetubhūtādhyayanādiniṣpādakācāryasambandho'bhipretaḥ | ṣoḍaśavarṣaḥbhoktṛtvāvastho bhogyatāvasthaśceti bhāvaḥ | sarvakalyāṇaguṇākaraḥ"nirvāṇamaya evāyamātmā jñānamayo'malaḥ" ityādyuktairbhagavadabhimatairguṇaiḥ pūrṇatā sūcitā | pitā ta ityā dinā bhagavadguṇagaṇāḥ sūcitāḥ | gāmbhīryyādaya upāsakaṃ prati saulabhyopayuktā guṇāḥ; tadvattā sauśīlyam | śauryamśatrumadhye svagṛha iva praveśasāmarthyam | "śūraṃ bhīruṃ kaviṃ jaḍam" iti bhīrutvapratiyogi hi śauryam | vīyarmaśrāntiḥ | parākramaḥvikramaṇam | atrānuktamapi dhairyamanusandheyam, tacca śatrubhirgharṣaṇe tṛṇavanmanyamānatvam | didṛkṣuriti "sa mahātmā sudurllabhaḥ" iti bhagavadabhiprāyaḥ ssūcitaḥ | puravara ityanena brahmapurākhyaśarīrāntassthitirabhipretā; tripādvibhūtisambandho vā | abhiyuktatamaśabdena bhagavajjñānaprado gururvivakṣitaḥ | tasyaitaravailakṣaṇyaṃ kenacidityabhipretam | yadā adhyayanādikārayitā gurureva brahmopadeṣṭā sambhavati, tadāyamabhiyuktatamaśabdaḥ pūrvanirdiṣṭadvijavaryameyavābhidhate | tadasambhave brahmopadeṣṭṭṛpuruṣamātrābhiprāyaḥ | atra kenacidityanena pūrveṇaiva vā anyenaiva veti ca tā tparyaṃ grāhyam | ṛṇoti cedityanena bhagavajjñānasya durllabhatvamabhipretam | niratiśayaharṣasamanvito bhavatītyanena vākyasya puruṣārthaparatvaṃ darśitam | rājā ceti rājasthānīyo'pyupāsako vivakṣitaḥ | anena sarvavidhabhogyatvasya bhagavati puṣkalatvāt guṇavatputragatabhogyatvamapi tatra vidyata iti jñāpitam | na hi bhagavato jñānaṃ parokṣarūpam | avāptasamastapuruṣārtho bhavatītyanena ca vākyasya prayojanaparyavasāyitvaṃ darśitam | rājā cetyādigranthasyāpātapratipannārtho'pyaviruddhaḥ | dhyānavidheravaiyarthyaṃ dṛṣṭāntadvayenāpi siddhamiti jñāpayitumuktaṃ paścāttadupādāne ca prayatata iti, paścāttābubhau saṅgacchete ceti ca | atra pūrvabheva, "arthārthī rājakulaṃ gacchet" "mandāgnirnāmbu pibet"iti vākyonāharaṇāt iha nidhidṛṣṭāntopanyāsāccāyamapyartho'rthasiddhaḥ kiṃ kriyottīrṇakāryaparatayaiva vākyasya prayojanaparyavasāyitvam, uta kriyākāryaṃ vā taduttīrṇaṃ vā pravarttakamarthamabhidadhata eva tatparyāvasāyitvamiti matam? | na prathamaḥ, arthārthī rājānaṃ sevetetyādīnāṃ saprayojanatvāt | na dvitīyaḥ, nidhimadbhūbhāgalakṣaṇaratnaparīkṣaṇaparā ṇāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ prayojanaśālitvāt | na ca tatrāpi khananadhāraṇādividhiparatvaṃ vākyānāṃ kalpyam; atha pūrvapakṣiṇoktamanubhāṣate yatpunariti vedāntavākyānāṃ nārthasadbhāve prāmāṇyamastīti pratijñā, tadarthamarthasadbhāvābhāve'pi puruṣārthaparyavasānāditi heturvivakṣitaḥ | dūṣayati tadasaditi | kuta ityatrāha arthasadbhāvā bhāva iti | idaṃ vākyaṃ pakṣaviṣayam, pakṣadṛṣṭāntasādhāraṇaṃ vā | hetutvaṃ gabhirtam | arthasadbhāvābhāvaniścaye sati puruṣārthaparyavasānābhāvādityarthaḥ | arthāsadbhāve'pi puruṣārtho dṛśyata iti śaṅkāyāṃ tatrārthāsadbhāvaniścayābhāvamupādhi māha bālāturādīnāmiti | tadevopapādayati teṣāmeveti | tataḥ kimityapekṣāyāṃ sapakṣe darśitamarthaṃ pakṣe sphuṭīkaroti aupaniṣadeṣvapīti | bālāturādyupacchandanavākyeṣvivātrāpyarthasadbhāvabhrāntyā puruṣārthaparyavasānaṃ syāditi cet "payaḥ piba, kaṣāyaṃ piba, śikhā varddhiṣyate | pāṃsuṣu luṭhasi cet, na dantā udbhidyante" ityādīnāṃ pravṛttinivṛttiparavākyānābhiva "svagarkāmo yajeta", " na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayeta" ityādivākyānāmapyatharsadbhāvabhrāntyā puruṣārthaparyavasānaṃ kiṃ na syāt || apauruṣeyatvat vedavākyasya vipralipsāmūlavākyasyaiva bhrāmakatayā puruṣārthaparyavasānamayuktam; tathā sati śāstrasya nirūpakādhigantavyatvāt svaputraśiṣyādīnāmadhyāpanādau pravṛttirnopapadyata iti cet apauruṣeyatvamadhyāpanādipravṛttivaiyarthyaṃ ca vedāntavākyepvapi tulyam || karmavidhīnāṃ dehātiriktātmajñānasāpekṣatvāt vedāntavākyānāṃ karmavidhiśeṣatvena adhyāpanādipravṛttyupapattiriti cetna; asatyapi dehātmabhede tatsadbhāvabhrāntihetutvaśaṅkāyāṃ satyāṃ tanmukhena prarocanānupapattyā vidhiśeṣatayā'dhyāpanādyanupapatteḥ || tarkānugṛhītanirdoṣaśrutisiddhadehātmabhedastāttvika iti cettat puruṣārthabhūtasya paramātmanaḥ pratipādyatve'pi tulyam || dehātmabhedasādhakahetvantarasaṃvādāt na bhrāntihetutvaniścaya iti cettarhi tenaiva hetvantareṇa dahotmabhedasiddhiriti tajjñāpanāya vedāntavākyānāmanapekṣitatvādvidhiśeṣatayā tadadhyāpanādikaṃ nopapadyate; evaṃ nirūpakādhikāra(rya?)sya śāstrasyārthasadbhāvabhrāntyā puruṣārthaparyavasānānupapattau pravattarkavākyānāṃ pratibandītvamabhipretya aupaniṣadeṣvapītyādibhāṣyaṃ pravṛttam |
uktasya hetorviparyaye paryavasānaṃ darśayannadhikaraṇārthamupasaṃharati ata iti | kāraṇavākyānāmarthamāha nikhileti | nikhilaśabdaḥ parairnityatayā'bhimatānāmākāśādīnāmapi kāryatvajñāpanārthaḥ | ekaśabdo nimittaupādānaikyadyotakaḥ | yato vā imānītyādivākye śodhakavākyārthaśca gabhirta ityabhiprāyeṇāha nirasteti |atra nikhilaśabdena cidacidgatāḥ kleśakarmādayo janmādayaśca vivakṣitāḥ | kadāciddoṣasambandhārhatvavyāvarttakena gandhaśabdena sadā tatpratyanīkatvamuktaṃ bhavati | kāraṇatvāpaiyikān guṇānāha sārvajñyeti | etadadhikaraṇasiddhamarthamāha anavadhiketi | bodhayatīti |adhyāpanādyupapattaye puruṣārthaparyavasānasyāpekṣitvāt prekṣāvadadhikāyarsya śāstrasyārthasadbhāvābhāvaniścaye sati puruṣārthaparyavasānānupapattestadupapattyarthaṃ pravarttakavākyānāmiva arthasadbhāve prāmāṇyamaṅgīkāryamiti yathoktalakṣaṇaṃ brahma "yato vā imāni" ityādivākyaṃ pratipādayatītyarthaḥ ||
śāstrārambhasidhdyarthaiṣā catussūtrī mṛṣāvādināṃ pakṣe na saṅgacchate; tatpakṣe viṣayaprayojanānupapattyā śāstrasyānārambhaṇīyatvāt | tathā hi viṣayaḥ kiṃ brahma, uta bhedamithyātvam, uta javabrahmaṇoraikyam? ||
na prathamaḥ; brahmaṇo vedyatvānabhyupagamāt, vedyatve ghaṭāderivānanubhūtitvaprasaṅgasya svoktatvācca | vyāvahārikaṃ vedyatvāmastīti cetghaṭasyāpi vedyatvaṃ vyāvahārikamiti tadvadevānanubhūtitvaprasaṅgo durvāraḥ | vāstavavedyatvābhāvasya brahmaṇi sādhyatve ghaṭasya vyatirekadṛṣṭāntatvaṃ na ghaṭate; ghaṭasya vāstavavedyatvābhāvavirahābhāvāt | anubhūtiḥ paramārthato na vedyā; anubhūtitvāt; yat paramārthato vedyam, tat nānubhūtiḥ, yathā ghaṭaḥ ityukte vyatirekadṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyāvyāvṛtto hi syāt | na hi ghaṭaḥ paramārthato vedyaḥ | vedyatve'nanubhūtitvaprasaṅgamanādṛtya brahmaṇo vedyatvaṅgīkāre 'pi brahmaṇaḥ śāstraviṣayatvamayuktam; pratyakṣasya sanmātragrāhitvamabhyupagacchatastava mate śāstrānarthakyaprasaṅgāt | "aprāpte hi śāstramarthavat" |
na dvitīyaḥ; dṛśyatvādinā liṅgena bhedamithyātvamabhimanyamānasya tava śāstrānarthakyaprasaṅgāt | tattadarmigrāhakapratyakṣādipramāṇaviruddhasya prapañcamithyātvasya yūpādityaikyasyeva śāstreṇa prati pādanāyogāt śāstrasya nirviṣayatvaṃ syāt | aprāpte hi śāstramarthavat | sādhakasyeva bādhakasyāpyagocaratvaṃ hyaprāptatvam | jvālābhedānumānavaiṣamyaṃ ca trividhaṃ prāgeva prapañcitam | pramāṇāntaravirodhaśca tātparyaliṅgamiti tadviruddhe'rthe tātparyāsambhavaśca prāga voktaḥ |ato bhedamithyātvasya viṣayatvamayuktam |
tṛtīyaśca kalpo'nupapannaḥ; brahmaṇo'pi vedyatvaprasaṅgāt | na hi ghaṭapaṭayorekatvamucyate śāstreṇa | api tu jīvabrahmaṇorekatvam | tadānīṃ brahmaśabdena brahmaṇyanavabodhite kathaṃ tasya jīvasya caikyaṃ vaktuṃ śakyate? | na hi jīva
eka ityukte jīvabrahmaṇoraikyaṃ sidhyati; ghaṭa eka ityukte ghaṭapaṭaikyavat | yadi aikyopadeśavākyeṣu, "ayamātmā brahma" ityādiṣu brahmaṇaḥ śabdabodhyatvaṃ soḍhavyam, tarhi prādhānyena brahmaṇa eva śāstrapratipādyatvaṃ kimiti nābhyupagamyate? "sarve vedā yat padamāmananti" ityārabhya "tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam" ityādiśrutyasvārasyameva tadanabhyupagamaphalam |
kiñca upadiśyamānamaikyaṃ kiṃ brahmasvarūpānatiriktam, utāriktam? | atiriktatve svarūpavedyatvapakṣa eva syāt | tathā copadeśavaiyarthyādidoṣaprasaṅgaḥ | svarūpamātrasya pratipannatvāt | atiriktatve tat kiṃ paramārtha bhūtam, utāparamārthabhūtam? | prathame saviśeṣatvabhaṅgaḥ | dvitīye jvālaikyadehātmaikyāpāramārthye jvālābhedadehātmabhedapārabhārthyavajjīvabrahmabhedapāramārthyaṃ syāt |
kiñca jīvabrahmaṇoraikyaṃ nāma kimantaḥkaraṇasya saṃvidaścaikyam, uta saṃvidavacchinnāntaḥkaraṇasya saṃvidaśca, utāntaḥkaraṇāvacchinnasaṃvidaḥ kevalasaṃvidaśca? | na prathamaḥ; jaḍājaḍayoraikyānupapatteḥ | nāpi dvitīyatṛtīyau, viśiṣṭaikye'bhyupagamyamāne viśeṣaṇatvena viśeṣyatvena vā tadantarbhūtasyāntaḥkaraṇasyāpi saṃvidaikyaprasaṅgāt | tayośca ajaḍatvatvajaḍatvābhyāṃ satyatvavānṛtatvābhyāṃ caikyamayuktamityuktam | antaḥkaraṇopalakṣitajñaptyaikyaṃ viṣaya iti cettadupalakṣitajñapteḥ kenaikyamupadiśyate? kiṃ svātmanaiva? uta jñaptyantareṇa? | na prathamaḥ; upadeśavaiyyarthyāt | na hi kasyacidvastunaḥ svasmādabhinnatvamupadeṣṭavyam; svasmādbhedaprasaṅgābhāvāt | jñaptyantareṇa cetkiṃ paramārthato bhinnena na, utābhinnena? na prathamaḥ, anabhyugamāt anupapannatvācca | abhinnena cetbhedapratītirasti vā, na vā? na cet aikyopadeśavaiyarthyam |asti cetbhedamithyātvopadeśa evaikyopadeśaḥ syāt | bhedamithyātvasyānumānasiddhatvābhimānācchāstrasya nirviṣayatvaṃ syāt || bhedapāramārthye dṛśyatvānupapattirityāditarkānugṛhītaṃ śāstraṃ bhedamithyātve pramāṇamiti na śāstrasya nirviṣayatvamiti cetna; dharmaścethisātvaṃ na syāditi tarkānugṛhītena, "na hiṃsyāt" itiśāstreṇa vaidhapaśvālambhanasyādharmatvapratipādanānupapattivat śāstrasiddhabhedasya śāstreṇa mithyātvapratipādanānupapatteḥ saṃbandhibhedabhinnānāṃ saṃyogecchādīnāmiva jñaptīnāmapi parasparabhedasya pratyakṣādisiddhatvāt tadviruddhatvādayogyasya jñaptibhedamithyātvasyā śāstreṇa pratipādanānupapatteśca | "nāhaṃ svalvayamevaṃ sampratyātmānāṃ jānātyayamahamasmīti", yadā suptaḥ svapnaṃ na kathañcana paśyati", prāṇebhyo devā devebhyo lokāḥ"devāḥ indriyāṇi, lokāḥ ālokanāni, saṃvidaḥevamādiśāstrasiddhaḥ pratyakṣādisiddhaśca kālato viṣayata āśrayataśca jñaptīnāṃ parasparabhedaḥ || antaḥkaraṇavṛttibhedaviṣayā sā śrutiriti cenna; svāpnaśrutervṛttigocaratve sati saṃvidaikyam saṃvidaikye sati jñaptibhedaśrutervṛttigocaratvamityanyonyāśrayaṇaprasaṅgāt | jñātṛjñeyāvacchinnatayā pratīyamānasya jñānasyāntaḥkaraṇakriyātve tritayottīrṇajñānasya śaśaviṣāṇāyamānatvācca tadbhedamithyātvapratipādanaṃ śaśaviṣāṇabhedamithyātvapratipādanatulyamiti na śāstra sya saviṣayatvasiddhiḥ | sampratipannajñānānāmeva mitho bhedasya mithyātvaṃ śāstravirodhāt pratyakṣavirodhācca paśvālambhanādharmatvavat yūpādityaikyavacca na śāstraṃ pratipādayituṃ śaktoti |
ataḥ śāstrasya viṣayābhāvādanārambhaṇīyatvam |
tathā prayojanañca na ghaṭate, tathā hiprayojanaṃ dvividhaṃ śāstrasya upāyabhūtamavāntaraprayojanam, mokṣastu praramaprayojanam | tatredānīmupajāyamānaṃ vākyajanyajñānamanivarttakamityavigītam, vasiṣṭhaparāśarakṛṣṇadvaipāyanādīnāmapyanutpannaṃ jñānamanyeṣāmutpatsyata ityatyantāsambhāvitam | teṣāmutpannañcetbhedapratibhāso na syāt | sa nivartti ṣyata iti cettata eva tadabhinnānāmanyeṣāmapi nivattirṣyata iti na śāstramārambhaṇīyaṃ syāt | prapañcasya satyatvādeva
jñānanivartyatvābhāvādanivarttakaṃ jñānaṃ nāvāntaraphalamiti na tadarthaṃ śāstramārambhaṇīyam | paramaprayojanaṃ ca na sidhyati; jñātṛjñeyabhedasya satyasya nivṛtterasambhāvitatvāt |
kiñca śāstraśravaṇādhikāro jñaptimātrasya vā, jñāturvā | na prathamaḥ; jñaptimātrasya śrotṛtvāyogāt | na dvitīyaḥ; jñātuḥ svanāśasyāpuruṣārthatvena śravaṇādau pravṛttyanupapatteḥ | yatsambandhisukhaṃ duḥkhanivṛttiśca puruṣārthaḥ, sa khalvahamarthaḥ | ahaṃ nirduḥkhaḥ sukhī syāmiti hi pratītiḥ (pravṛttiḥ?) | tasya puruṣārthavato nāśaḥ kathaṃ puruṣārthaḥ? puruṣārthāntaraṃ vā kathamarthayitustasyābhāve puruṣārtho bhavet ||
athocyetabhavatpakṣe vaddhasya vā muktasya vā śāstrādhikāraḥ | prathame svanāśasyāpuruṣārthatvāt apravṛttiḥ | upādhiviśiṣṭasya baddhasya tadrūpanāśo hi svanāśaḥ | dvitīye tu muktasya śāstrānapekṣatvādanadhikāraḥ | aupādhikākāravināśo nāpuruṣārthaḥ, duḥkhavinirmuktasvābhāvikarūpāvasthānāditi cettarhi jñātṛtvasyaupādhikatvāt tanni vṛttau svarūpaṃ tiṣṭhatīti nāpuruṣārtha iti
naivam; saṃvidi vāstavajñātṛtvānabhyupagamāt | tadārope tvanyatra tatsiddheravaśyambhāvāt | anyasya ca jñāturjñaptidharmatvābhāvāt | yadi jñaptiḥ svarūpam, jñātā taddharmaḥtadānīmiyaṃ pratibandī syāt | ahaṃ sukhī duḥkhīti sukhaduḥkhavat ahaṃ jānāmīti jñānasyāhamarthadharmatāpratīterahamarthasya dharmitayā pratīteścāvigītatvāt sukhaduḥkhanivṛttyorāśrayasya tasya nāśo'puruṣārtha eva | dharmiṇi naṣṭe kasya duḥkhanivṛttiḥ pumarthassyāt | acetanaprakṛtibaddhatvamaupādhikaduḥkhāvahamiti, malino'hamiti pratyayavataḥ puruṣasya mālinyanivṛttivat tannivṛttirnnāpuruṣārthaḥ; atyantābhimatasya dharmisvarūpasya sthitatvāt aniṣṭabandhanivṛtteriṣṭatvācca |
nanu laukikapratītyā nirūpakapratītyā vā'hamarthasya svarūpatvam | prathame, sthūlo'haṃ kṛśo'hamiti lokadṛṣṭayā pratipannatvāt sthūlatvādiviśiṣṭadehanivṛttirapyapuruṣārthassyāt | dvitīye sthaulyādivat adhyasto'hamartho jñātā'pi na svarūpamiti na tannāśo apuruṣārthaḥ || naivam; mama hṛstaḥ, mama pādaḥ iti lokadṛṣṭayā'pyahamarthasya dehavyatirekapratīteḥ, ahamatharsyaivātmatve śrutismṛtisūtrāṇāṃ prāgeva darśitatayā nirūpakapratītāvapyahamarthasyaiva svarūpatāpratīteścehamarthanivṛtterdehanivṛttitulyatvābhāvenāpuruṣārthatvasya durnivāratvāt | ato viṣayaprayojanābhāvācchāstrasyānārambhaṇīyatvaṃ mṛṣāvādināṃ pakṣe sthitam |
paścādbhāvino nityānityavivekādeḥ pūrvavṛttatvāyogāt athaśabdārthaḥ parokto'nupapanna iti pūrvamevoktam | śāstrāntarajanyasya nityānityavivekasya vedāntaviruddhatvāt teṣveva mokṣopāyopadeśena nirākāṅkṣatvācca brahmavicārahetutvābhāvāt, nityānityaviṣayāpātapratītestu ubhayabhāgasādhāraṇatvādekāntato brahmavicārahetutvābhāvāt, itihāsapurāṇayoḥ saṃśayaviparyayagrastatayā tajjanyanityānityādipratīteḥ trivargajihāsājanakatvābhāvena brahmavi cāraṃ prati hetutvābhāvācca ataśśabdārtho'nupapannaḥ | yannityaṃ tadupādeyam, yadanityaṃ taddheyamiti viveko nityānityavastuviveka ityutprekṣaṇamapyapuktam; vedānteṣu nityapuruṣārthapratipādanāvagamāt tadārabhyaḥ, tadārambhāt teṣu nityapuruṣārthapratipādanāvagama ityanyonyāśrayaprasaṅgāt; śāstrāntareṣvapi nityapuruṣārthasambhavanayā brahmavicāraṃ prati ekāntato hetutvābhāvāt; śāstrāntareṣu tadabhāvasya vedānteṣu tatsadbhāvaniścayasya ca tarkapādādhīnatvena pūrvavadanyonyāśrayaprasaṅgāt; vedāntataditaraśāstreṣu nityapuruṣārthasadbhāvāsadadbhabhāvayorguruvacanādavagamyatve, brahmopāsanasyāpi guruvacanādavagamyatvena śārīrakamīmāṃsānairapekṣyeṇa tadanārambhaṇīyatvaprasaṅgācca | jīvabrahmaṇoraikyasya śāstraviṣayatvāṅgīkāre brahmajijñāsāpādañca na saṅgacchate | brahmaṇo jijñāsyatvaṃ hi śabdādavagamyate; na jīvabrahmaṇeraikyasya |
yathā dharmajijñāsāpadaṃ dharmamātrasya jijñāsyatāṃ vakti, na tu dharmādharmayoraikyasya jijñāsyatvamtadvadeva hi brahamajijñāsāpadam |
nirviśeṣasya vastuno lakṣaṇoktiśca na ghaṭate, viśeṣaṇatayā lakṣaṇatve saviśeṣatvaprasaṅgāt; upa līkṣaṇatayā lakṣaṇatve pūvarpratipannākārātiriktasyayopalakṣaṇajñāpyasyākārantarasya abhāvenopalakṣaṇavaiyarthyāt; tadabhyupagame saviśeṣatvaprasaṅgācca | svarūpamevopalakṣaṇajñāpyamiti cet tatsvarūpaṃ prāk pratipannam, na vā? pratipannaṃ cetupalakṣaṇavaiyarthyam | apratipannatve, svaprakāśakatā na syāt | upalakṣayitumaśakyatā ca; kedāratvākāreṇāvagatasya devadattasambandhitayā sārasena jñāpyatvaṃ hyupalakṣyatvam | prāganavagatā prapañcavyāvṛttirupalakṣyākāra iti cet, prapañcavyāvṛtteḥ svarūpātiriktatve saviśeṣatvaprasaṅgāt | anatiriktatve tatsvarūpaṃ prāgeva bhātabhityupalakṣaṇavaiyathyam | kiñca kathaṃ kāraṇatve lakṣaṇe sati prapañcavyāvṛttiḥ? || kāraṇatvaṃ nāma kāryajagadadhyāsādhiṣṭhānatvam | ato'dhyastādanṛtāt prapañcādadhiṣṭhānasya brahmaṇaḥ satyatayā vyāvṛttiriti cetna; ghaṭādyadhiṣṭhānasya mṛda iva brahmaṇo'pyanṛtatvena vyāvṛttiprasaṅgāt | ghaṭādikāraṇasyāpi mṛdādeḥ kāraṇāntare'dhyastatvādasatyatvam; kālatrayavatirkṛtsnakāryadhiṣṭhā nasya brahmaṇo'nyatrādhyastatvābhāvānnāsatyatvamiti cetna, "idamagra āsīt" itīdaṃśabdavācyaṃ kāyarmātraṃ prati ayadhiṣṭhānatvaśravaṇena brahmaṇo'pi kāraṇāntarādhyastatvāvirodhāt vījāṅkuranyāyena pravāhānāditvopapatteśca || kṛtsnakāryakāraṇasya brahmaṇaḥ kāraṇāntarapratiṣedhenākāryatvāt satyatvamiti prapañcavyāvṛttiriti cettarhyakāryatvamātreṇa jagadvayāvṛttisiddheḥ kāraṇatvoktivaiyarthyādakāryatvaśrutireva lakṣaṇavākyavenodāharttavyā syāt; na tu "yato vā imāni" ityādi śrutiḥ || akāryatvaśrutireva vivakṣiteti cettarhi, "sa kāraṇaṃ karaṇādhipādhipo na cāsya kaścijjanitā na cādhipaḥ" ityakāryatvaśruteḥ karaṇādhipādhipaśabdavācyeśvaraviṣayatvāllakṣyavastuno nirviśeṣatvaṃ na sidhyet | kiñca jagatkāraṇatvarūpalakṣaṇaviśeṣo lakṣyasya nirviśeṣatvavirodhī, sārvajñyādiguṇākṣepakatvāt tasya || ākṣiptamapi sārvajñyādikaṃ vastumātropalakṣaṇamiti cetna, sārvajñyena vastunyupalakṣite sati sarvaśaktitvādyupalakṣaṇāntaravaiyarthyāt | na hi śākhayācandra upalakṣite prāsādāgreṇa prayojanam | sāvajrñyena nirviśeṣavastūpalakṣaṇaṃ vyāhataṃ ca; svena saviśeṣasyāśrayasya nirviśeṣatva jñāpanāyogāt; sarvaśaktitvādiviśeṣāntararāhityajñāpanāsāmarthyācca | ato lakṣaṇasūtraṃ nivirśeṣapakṣaviruddham |
tṛtīyaṃ sūtramapi na ghaṭate; nirviśeṣavastuni tātparyaviṣaye sati kāraṇatvākṣiptasārvajñyādisamarthanaṃ kkopayujyate? prasaṅgādapi na tatsamarthanaṃ nyāyyam; nirviśeṣatvavirodhāt | kiñca ṛgvedādiśāstraṃ svaviṣayādadhikaviṣayajñānavadupādānakam vākyatvādityanumānamapyasaṅgatam | tathā hikimadhikaviṣayajñānavadupādānakatvaṃ sādhyam, uta tadvaktṛkatvam, uta taduccāritatvam | prathame dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyavikalaḥ, ākāśaguṇasya śabdasya kālidāsādyupādānakatvābhāvāt | na dvitīyaḥ, vedasya pauruṣeyatvaprasaṅgāt | na tṛtīyaḥ, anaikāntikatvāt | na hi vaidikamanyadvā vākyamuccāravatāṃ bālādīnāṃ tadviṣayādadhikaviṣayajñānamasti | śāstrapramāṇakatvaṃ sūtrārtha iti ca vyākhyā brahmaṇo'nubhāvyatvamanabhyupagacchatāṃ na ghaṭate |
caturthe ca sūtre brahmaṇaḥ prādhānyena śāstrayonisūtranirddiṣṭatvābhāvāt tacśabdasya brahmaparatvaṃ na svārasikam | vedāntavākyānāṃ bhramanivarttakavākyārthajñānajanakatayā prayojanaparyavasāyitvam vākyārthajñānamātreṇa bandhanivṛtteḥ śāstrapratyakṣavirodhadhvastatvādanupapannam | tadanyathāsiddhipratividhānaṃ ca pūrvameva kṛtam | kiñca kasya bhramanivṛttiḥ? kiṃ jñapteḥ, uta cetanasya | na tāvat jñapteḥ; tasyā acetanatvena bhramāśrayatvābhāvāt | cetano hi bhrāntyāśrayaḥ | jaḍa
tvaṃ bhramānāśrayatve prayojakamiti cettvayā jaḍatvenābhimate jñātari bhramānāśrayatvābhāvena sādhyasamavyāptya siddheḥ | cetanasya bhramanivṛttirapi bhavatpakṣe na puruṣārthaḥ syāt; jñāturapi nivartyakoṭiniviṣṭatvāt | taṃ prati svanāśasyāpuruṣārthatvācca | rājñaḥ śatrunivṛttiriva jñānarūpasyātmano jñātṛnivṛttiḥ puruṣārtha iti cetna; jñāturevātmatvāt | jñātṛdharmatayā'vagatasya jñānasyecchādveṣāderivātmatvābhāvāt | ātmatvābhyupagame'pi tasya puruṣārthārthayitṛtvābhāvena puruṣārthapratisambandhitvānupapattyā jñānaṃ prati jñātṛnivṛtteḥ puruṣārthatvāyogāt | puruṣeṇārthanīyasya hi puruṣārthanyavam | jñānasyātmatvapuruṣārthapratisambandhitvābhyupagame'pi, tadapekṣyajñātṛnivṛtteḥ puruṣārthatvamayuktam; jñānaṃ prati jñātuduḥkhataddhetuṣvanyatamatvābhāvāt | sukhadaḥkhabhoktāraṃ prati sukhataddhetūnāṃ duḥkhataddhetunivṛtterapi hi puruṣārthatvam | na hi jñātā jñapterduḥkharūpaḥ, na ca duḥkhajanayitā; jñānasya duḥkhānubhavitṛtvāyogāt | pravṛttinivṛttiparatvena prayojanaparyavasānaṃ tvayaivāpāstaṃ dhyānaniyogavādapratikṣepe | ato'nupapannaṃ śāstrasya tvaduktaṃ prayojanaparyavasāyitvam ||
yādavaprakāśīyāstu duḥkhatrayābhidhātajñānānantaraṃ tadupaśamopāye puruṣāpravṛttereva hetorbrahmaiva jijñāsyam, na tu pradhānādīniti prathamasūtrārthaṃ varṇayanti | astu brahmaṇo jijñāsyatvam; naitāvatā pradhānādīnāmajijñāsyatvam; teṣvanyatamasyaiva brahmaśabdārthatvāt, śāstreṇa hi brahmānūdya tajjñāna vidhīyate | ekena vākyenaikasyārthasya vidhānānuvādāyogāt anuvādaḥ pramāṇāntarasāpekṣaḥ | pramāṇāntaraiśca vādibhiḥ sambhāvitāstattvaprakāraviśeṣāḥ sarve parikalpitā iti tattvāntarotprekṣā na śakyā | atasteṣvanyatamasyaiva jñātavyatvavidhānāya śāstreṇānuvādaḥ kriyata iti śaṅkāparihārārthaṃ janmādisūtram | sanmātravapuṣo'nekaśaktiśālina ekasmādadvitīyāt brahmaṇaḥ kṛtsnasya cidacitpra pañcasya janmasthitirayaṃ pratipādyam | ata īdṛśaṃ tattvaṃ vādyantarairaparikalpitamiti na tatparikalpitārtheṣvanyatamasya brahmaśabdārthatvamiti sūtrārthamāhuḥ | evaṃ tarhi pramāṇāntarāsiddhatvācchāstreṇānuvādasambhava iti śaṅkāyāṃ śāstrayonitvādityucyate | vedānteṣveva kenāpi vākyena pratipāditasya vākyāntareṇānuvāda upapannaḥ; pramāṇāntarānāghrātacaravastupratipādanakṣamatvaṃ śabdamahimā iti sūtratātparyaṃ vadanti | tathāpi siddhe vyutpattyabhāvāt pravṛttinivṛttivirahe vākyasya prayojanābhāvācca brahmaṇaḥ śāstrapratipādyatvāyogaśaṅkāparihāraparaṃ samanvayasūtraṃ vyācakṣate |
tatra tāvatprathamasūtre duḥkhatrayābhighātajñānasya pūrvavṛttatvaṃ prāgeva pratikṣiptam, pratyakṣādinā tajjñāne viva kṣite tatparihārasyāyurvedādisiddhatvāt; svargāderapi tāpatrayāntarbhāvajñānasya ca sāṅkhayādiśāstrāntarādhīnatve mokṣopāyasyāpi tatraiva sulabhatayā vedāntanairapekṣyāt; vedena tajjñānasya karmavicārasāpekṣatayā tatpūrvavṛttatvāpātācceti | pradhānādīnāmajijñāsyatāparatvañca pūrvameva nirastam; śrutyaviruddhāṃśe sāṅkhayādiśāstrasya bhavadbhiraṅgīkṛtatvāt viru ddhāṃśe cāprāmāṇyasya virodhādhikaraṇanyāyasiddhatvāt tatprameyadausthyasya tarkapāde darśayiṣyamāṇatvāt vedāntavākyānāmatatparatvasya īkṣatyadhikaraṇādiṣu vakṣyamāṇatvācca sūtrasya kṛtakaratvaprasaṅgāditi |
janmādisūtrasya vādyantarāparikalpita prakāreṇaupaniṣadatattvavailakṣaṇyāt brahmaśabdasya tatparikalpitapradhānādyanyatamaviṣayatvanirāsaparatvaṃ cāyuktam; viśeṣaṇabhedāyattaviśeṣyabahutvaparihārābhāve sati advitīyavastunaḥ samastajagatkāraṇatvapratipādanānupapatteḥ | cidacitprapañcasyādvitīyakāraṇatayā hi vādyantarakalṛptatattvebhya aupaniṣadatattvavailakṣaṇyaṃ bhavadbhiruktam | vedāntavedyatattvasya tvaduktaprakāreṇa pradhānādivailakṣaṇyaṃ cekṣatyadhikaraṇādinyāyanairapekṣyeṇa na sidhyati | iha vakṣyamāṇavyatiriktanyāyāntarānukteḥ; vakṣyamāṇānupapattīnāṃ vakṣyamāṇanyāyairvinā parihārāyogācca | vakṣyamāṇopajīvane ca tata eva tattvavailakṣaṇyaṃ pradhānāderajijñāsyatvaṃ ca sidhyatīti kṛtakaratvaṃ syāt |
vākyāntareṇa pratipāditasya vākyāntareṇānuvādasambhavaparatvañca śāstrayonyadhikaraṇasyāyuktam, kṛtakaratvādeva | "agnihotraṃ juhoti" iti vākyāntareṇa vihitasya homasya "dadhnā juhoti" itivākyāntareṇānuvādaḥ pūrvakāṇḍe prasiddhaḥ | āgneyādipaṭkaṃ tadutpattivākyāvihitam, "ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsī yajate, "ya evaṃ vidvānamāvāsyāṃ yajate" iti vākyābhyāmanūdyata iti ca tatra tatra prasiddham | ato vākyabhedena vidhānānuvādasambhavo nātra vyutpādyaḥ |
samanvayasūtrasya ca pravṛttinivṛttiparatvābhāve'pi śāstrasya prayojanavattāpratipādanaparatvamiṣṭam | sidde vyutpattipratipādanaparatvaṃ tvayuktam, prathamasūtreṇaiva siddhārthavyutpatteḥ samarthitatvāt | tatra ca tatsamarthanābhāvena tvaduktārthaparatve tatsūtravaiyarthyasyopapāditatvācca siddhavastumātre śabdaśaktisamarthanābhāve sati siddhavastuvailakṣaṇaṇyatadvidhānānuvādatatprayojanādinirūpaṇasyānapekṣitatvena janmādisūtratrayotthānasya tatpūrvakatvāvaśyambhāvāt; vakṣyamāṇopajīvanenotthāne pratipattikramasāmañjasyābhāvāt; ādyasūtrasyāpekṣitavidheranapekṣitavidhānaparatvāyogācca | ato bhāṣyakāroktātharparatvameva catussūtryā upapannam ||
|| iti samanvayādhikaraṇam ||5
prathame sūtre uddeśaḥ kṛtaḥ | dvitīye lakṣaṇamuktam | tṛtīyacaturthābhyāṃ lakṣyasya brahmaṇaḥ parīkṣyatvasidhyarthaṃ lakṣaṇasvabhāvātsiddharūpalakṣyasvabhāvāccotthite jñātatvāprayojanatvaśaṅke parihṛte | atha lakṣyaṃ vastu kiṃ cidacidvilakṣaṇam? utāvilakṣaṇam? iti parīkṣyate | yadvā pūrvaṃ kāraṇatvamanūdya tasya lakṣaṇatvamuktam | lakṣaṇalakṣyasvabhāvanibandhanaṃ śaṅkādvayaṃ ca parihṛtam | atha lakṣaṇabhūtakāraṇatvaprāpakavākyāni nirūpyante | yadvā catussūtryā vedāntavākyānāṃ brahmaṇi prāmāṇyarūpaparīkṣyatāparikarasthāpanaṃ kṛtam | atha prameyaviśeṣaparīkṣā kriyata iti peṭikāsaṅgatiḥ |
nanu īkṣatyadhikaraṇamanārambhaṇīyam, samanvayādhikaraṇe puruṣārthabhūtasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ pratipādyatvaniścayena heyāspadasya pradhānasya prasaṅgābhāvāditi naivam; puruṣārthabhūtasya brahmaṇaḥ pratipādyatvaṃ na sambhavati, apuruṣārthabhūtasya pradhānādeḥ pratipādanāditi samanvayādhikaraṇoktārthasyāpekṣepeṇotthānāditi | iyamavāntarasaṅgatiḥ, ityetadabhiprāyeṇa peṭikābhedatatsaṅgatyavāntarasaṅgatīrāha  yato vā imānītyādīti  uddiṣṭasya brahmaṇo lakṣaṇamuktam | lakṣitasya parīkṣaṇaṃ varttiṣyata ityabhiprāyeṇa lakṣaṇavākyamupāttam kāraṇatvānuvādena tasya lakṣaṇatvavidhānāt kāraṇasya cidacidvailakṣaṇyanirṇayasya kāraṇatvapāpakavākyanirūpaṇasāpekṣatvādasminnadhikaraṇe kāraṇavākyāni nirūpyanta iti ca jñāpanārthaṃ lakṣaṇavākyopādānam | ādiśabdena kāraṇatvaprāpakavākyāni gṛhyante, ata eva hyanuvādapurovādasādhāraṇyena jagatkāraṇavādītyuktam | samanvayādhikaraṇārthākṣepahetukāvāntarasaṅgatyupayogīni sarvajñatvādiviśeṣaṇānijijñāsyamityuktamiti prāmāṇikatayā parīkṣyamityarthaḥ |tadanantaraṃ parīkṣā hi saṅgatetyabhiprāyeṇāha  idānīmiti | anena catussūtryānantaryaṃ brahmaṇaḥ puruṣārthatāpratipādanaparasamanvayādhikaraṇānantaryamapyuktam | ānumānikapradhānādītyanenānantaroktasamanvayākṣepeṇotthānādavāntarasaṅgatiriti sūcyate, pradhānādītyādiśabdena kṣetrajñamātraṃ cidviśeṣāḥ acidviśeṣāśca gṛhyante, īkṣaternāśabdamityādineti  pādaśeṣaṇādhyāyaśeṣeṇeti vārthaḥ |
viṣayamudāharati  idamiti  pratijñādṛṣṭāntopetaṃ saṅkalpapratipādakaṃ sāmānyaśabdavat kāraṇavākyaṃ viṣayaḥ | tatra sadvidyāvākyamevāsyādhikaraṇasya sākṣādviṣayaḥ, sadvidyādvāreṇedṛśakāraṇavākyānāṃ viṣayatvam, na tu sākṣādeva, viṣayavākyopādānasamaye vākayāntarāṇāmanupādānāt | dīpasārayośca teṣāmanupāttatvāt pratijñāvirodhasvāpyayoratratya yoreva sūtritatvāttadanugrāhakatvenopadiṣadantaragatisāmānyasya asyāmupaniṣadi vidyāntareṣu śrutatvasyāpi sūtritatvāt budhyavataraṇakrameṇa prathamamupādānatvocitācetanatvaśaṅkāyāḥ pratikṣepyatvāt sadbrahmātmādipadacihniteṣu vākyeṣu sāmānyaśabdacihnitavākyasya prathamanirūpaṇīyatvācca | sāmānyadvārā hi viśeṣo buddhimadhirohati | sāmānyaparigrahe prati kṣepe ca viśeṣaviṣaya saṃśayovakāśān | viśeṣe tu pratipakṣe hi sāmānyākāṅkṣā na svarasavāhinī, sandigdhe hi nyāyapravṛttiḥ, ataḥ saṃśayasadbhāvamāha  tatreti | kāraṇasyedaṃśabdavācyakāryasālakṣaṇyāvaśyambhāvekṣitṛtvābhyāṃ saṃśayaḥ | saṃśayaśarīraṃ darśayati  kimiti | sacchabdavācyamiti dharmivācipadasya sādhāraṇatayā saṃśayasahatvaṃ darśitam | jagatkāraṇamiti upādānatvāt kāryasālakṣaṇyaṃ dustyajam, nimittatvānmukhyekṣitṛtvaṃ ceti saṃśayahetusthirīkaraṇam | paroktamiti  vipratipattirapi saṃśayahetvoranugrāhiketi bhāvaḥ | pūrvapakṣabījasmāraṇaparasautrapadadyotanārthaṃmānumānikamiti padam | uktalakṣaṇamsarvajñatvādilakṣaṇam, ānumānikoktalakṣaṇapadābhyāṃ saṃśayahetudvayasūcanam | kiñca jagatkāraṇavādivedāntavākyāni kiṃ pradhānādipratipādanaparāṇi? uta tadvilakṣaṇabrahmaparāṇi? iti pādaśeṣasādhāraṇo vicāraḥ, atra tu tadarthaṃ sadvidyāvākyāni kiṃ pradhānapratipādanaparāṇi? utoktalakṣaṇabrahmaparāṇi? iti vicāraḥ, tadarthaṃ kimatrekṣaṇaṃ gauṇam? uta mukhyam? iti | tadarthaṃ kimanumānākāratā gauṇekṣaṇasāhacaryaṃ ca vidyate? neti, tadarthaṃ pratijñādṛṣṭāntau kiṃ hetorākṣepakau neti, tejaḥ prabhṛtiśabdāḥ kiṃ tejaḥprabhṛtimātravācinaḥ? uta paramātmaparā? iti ca | tadarthamātmaśabdastejaḥprabhṛtiśabdānām abrahmaparatvasyāvirodhi? uta virodhīti | tadarthamātmaśabdasvārasyabhaṅgahetavo'nuroddhavyāḥ? uta tadanugrāhakahetavaḥ? iti vicāraḥ | tatsvārasyabhaṅgahetavo'nuroddhavyā iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ | tadanugrāhakā evānuroddhavyā iti siddhāntaḥ | yadā svārasyabhaṅgahetoranuroddhavyatvenātmaśabdasya tejaḥprabhṛtiśabdānām abrahmaparatvāvirodhitayā tejaḥprabhṛtiśabdāstejaḥ prabhṛtimātravācinaḥ, pratijñādṛṣṭāntau ca yadā hetvākṣepakau tadā hetvākṣepo gauṇekṣaṇasāhacaryaṃ cāstīti prathamaśrutekṣaṇasya gauṇatvena sadvidyāvākyānāṃ pradhānaparatvāttadekārthatayā sarvāṇi kāraṇavākyāni pradhānaparāṇīti pūrvapakṣe phalaphalibhāvaḥ | yadā ātmaśabdasvārasyottambhakahetoḥ anuroddhavyatvenātmaśabdasya tejaḥprabhṛtiśabdānāmabrahmaparatvavirodhitvena tejaḥprabhṛtiśabdāḥ paramātmaparāḥ, pratijñādṛṣṭāntau ca yadā na hetvākṣepakau tadā'numānākāratvagauṇekṣaṇasāhacaryayorasidhdyā prāthabhikekṣaṇasyāgauṇatvāt sadvidyāvākyāni parabrahmaparāṇi, atastadaikārthyātsarvāṇi kāraṇavākyāni parabrahmaparāṇīti siddhānte phalapalibhāvaḥ | tatra pūrvapakṣaṃ vaktumanyattaraśiraso yuktimattvena nirddhāraṇākāṅkṣāṃ darśayati kiṃ prāptamiti | prāptamyuktam, yuktimadityarthaḥ | pūrvapakṣī svapakṣaṃ yuktimattvena pratijānīte pradhānamitīti | saṃśayakroḍīkṛte śirodvaye pradhānamiti śiro yuktimadityarthaḥ | yuktiviśeṣākāṅkṣāṃ darśayati  kuta iti | tadupapādayati sadeveti | kāraṇasya pradhānatvasiddhayaupayikāni tadvilakṣaṇapuruṣaviśeṣatvavirodhīni ca viśeṣaṇānyāha idaṃśabdetyādinā | idaṃśabdavācyasyeti  parāgarthe hīdaṃśabdasvārasyam, na tu pratyagrūpe cetana iti bhāvaḥ | jagataścidacidātmakatayā cetanasyāpīdaṃśabdavācyāntarbhāvavyudāsāyāha  cetanabhogyabhūtasyeti | cidaṃśasya kāyartvakāraṇatvāyogāt na tasya kāryāntarbhāva iti bhoktṛtayā'vasthānameva tasya, bhogyasyaiva tu kāryatvamiti bhāvaḥ | cetanasya jñeyataikasvabhāvajagadrūpatvamayuktamiti cābhiprāyaḥ | kāryasya bhogyatvaupayikaṃ kāraṇasya pradhānatvāpādakaṃ ca viśeṣaṇamāha  sattvarajastamomayasyeti | sattvādikāryasukhaduḥkhamohānvayahetutvadarśanājjagataḥ sattvādimayatvam, nirguṇaḥ kathaṃ guṇamayasya kāraṇamiti cābhiprāyaḥ | bhogyatvopapādanāyāha  viyadādīti | yadvā, idaṃśabdavācyadravyasya kāraṇatve kāryatvakāraṇatvayoḥ ko bheda ityatrāhaviyadādīti | ekatvāvasthaṃ kāraṇam bahutvāvasthaṃ kāryamiti bhidetyarthaḥ | ekarūpasya puruṣasya nānārūpakāryabhāvo'nupapannaśceti bhāvaḥ | kāraṇasya kāryasālakṣaṇyāvaśyambhāve hi cetanasya idaṃśabdavācyaṃ prati kāraṇatvānupapattiḥ, kāraṇāvasthā kāryopādanabhūtadravyāntaraniṣṭheti kathaṃ sālakṣaṇyāvaśyambhāva iti śaṅkāyāṃ kāryakāraṇayorekadravyatvamāha  kāraṇabhūtadravyasyeti | tataḥ kimityapekṣāyāṃ kāryakāraṇasālakṣaṇyaniyamaṃ phalitamāha  ata iti | tato'pi kimityāśaṅkāyāṃ kāryasya pradhānasālakṣaṇyamāha  sattvādimayañceti | pradhānasya kāryasārūpyamāha  guṇasāmyāvasthamiti | kārye guṇavaiṣamyadarśanātkāraṇamapi tathāvidhaṃ syāditi śaṅkāpakaraṇārthaṃ guṇasāmyāvasthamityuktam, na tu guṇamayamiti | viṣamāvasthasya sarvasya kāryatvadarśanāt kāraṇasyāpi tathātve kāraṇāntarāpekṣayā'navasthāprasaṅgācca pradhānasya guṇasāmyāvasthatvasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | anekaguṇasāmyāvasthasya pradhānasya kāraṇatve ekatvāvadhāraṇamanupapannam |
ekasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ kāraṇatve tūpapannamityatrāha  tadevopasaṃhṛteti | ekameveti nāmarūpavibhāgavyudāsaḥ, advitīyamiti guṇavaiṣamyavyudāsa ityabhiprāyeṇa upasaṃhṛtasakalaviśeṣamityuktam | sanmātramiti  sadeveti kādācitkāsattvavyudāsa iti bhāvaḥ | sanmātramitītyatretiśabdo hetau | pradhānakāraṇatvameva yuktayantareṇopapādayitumāha  tata eveti | idaṃ śabdavācyaṃ prati kāraṇasya triguṇātmakasya pradhānasya sacchabdavācyatvādeva hi kāryakāraṇayorananyatvasiddhiḥ, na hi vijātīyayorananyatvamitibhāvaḥ | ananyatvaṃ mābhūdityatrāha  tathā satīti | ananyatve sati hyekavijñānena sarvavijñānasiddhiḥ, taccidacidvilakṣaṇakāraṇatvapakṣe na sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ pratijñāsiddhirūpayuktiruktā bhavati | yadvā idamagre saditi sāmānādhikaraṇyāt "taddhaika āhuḥ" ityasatkāryavādapratikṣepāccānanyatvasiddhiḥ pūrvagranthe abhipretā | hetvantaraṃ cāhatathāsatīti | tathā satipradhānakāraṇatve satītyarthaḥ | kāryakāraṇayorananyatve pratijñāvākyatātparyāttatraikaśabdo'pi guṇasamudāyaikyādyukta iti bhāvaḥ | yuktayantaramāha  anyatheti | acetanamṛtpiṇḍalohamaṇyādidṛṣṭāntaścetanakāraṇasya dārṣṭāntikatve na saṅgacchata ityabhiprāyaḥ | yadvā sarūpamṛtpiṇḍaghaṭādikāryakāraṇadṛṣṭānto na virūpakāryakāraṇayordārṣṭāntikatve ghaṭata iti bhāvaḥ | kapilasmṛtyaikārthyaṃ hetutvenābhiprayannāha  jagatkāraṇeti | uktanyāyena śrutyavirodhātsmṛtinirāso na yukta iti bhāvaḥ | maharṣiṇetipadena "ṛṣiṃ prasūtaṃ kapilaṃ mahāntam" iti śrutiḥ smāritā | hetvantaramāha  pratijñeti | pratijñādṛṣṭāntayorhetvākṣepakatvābhiprāyeṇoktamanumānaveṣameveti | nanu na kāraṇaviṣayā pratijñā, api tvekavijñānena sarvavijñānaviṣayā; ato'numānaveṣatve'pi na pradhānakāraṇatvasiddhiriti na vācyam, ekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñāyāḥ sarvasyaikasya cānanyatvena nirvāhyatvādananyatvasya kāryakāraṇabhāvanibandhanatvācca pradhānakāraṇatvapratijñānasya phalitatvāt | atrāyaṃ prayogo'bhimato veditavyaḥ, jagatsvānanyopādānakam, kāryatvādghaṭavat | yadvā idaṃ jagat svakāraṇaikajñānena jñātaṃ bhavitumarhati, kāryatvāt ekamṛtpiṇḍādyārabdhaghaṭādivaditi | pūrvapakṣaṃ nigamayati
itīti  itirhetau | sukhaduḥkhamohonneyasattvarajastamomayasyedaṃśabdavācyasya kāraṇatvamekaḥ pūrvapakṣahetuḥ, kāryakāraṇānanyatvaphalabhūtamekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñānaṃ taduttambhakam anumānākārapratītiścānyo hetuḥ | asmin pūrvapakṣe siddhāntasthāpanāya sūtrasyāvatīrṇatvaṃ darśayati  ityevaṃ prāpta iti | ucyamānāḥ viṣayasaṃśayapūrvapakṣāḥ asyādhikaraṇasyeti jñāpanāya pūrvaṃ sūtropādānam | asya rāddhāntasūtratvajñāpanātharmakṣaravyākhyānārthaṃ cedānīṃ tadupādānamiti vaiṣamyam | śabdavedyatayā'bhimatasya kathamaśabdatvamiti śaṅkāyāmāha  yasminniti | abbhakṣo vāyubhakṣa itivadavadhāraṇagarbhitamitibhāvaḥ | śabdaikapramāṇakatvaṃ na cettatra kimanyat pramāṇamityatrāha  ānumānikamiti | tarhi pramāṇāntaraprāptaṃ śāstraṃ na pratipādayatīti cenna, sāmānyato dṛṣṭānumānena kāraṇamātre pratipanne'pi tadviśeṣāṇāmapratipannatayā tadviśiṣṭena rūpeṇa śāstrapratipādyatvāt | aprāpte hi śāstramarthavaditi mīmāṃsakānāṃ matam, natu sāṅkhayānāmiti pūrvapakṣiṇo'bhiprāyaḥ | tasyānupapannatāṃ ca jñāpayitum aśabdaśabdaprayogaḥ | ānumānikatvamindriyāṇāṃ paramāṇūnāmapyaviśiṣṭamiti tadvayudāsārthaṃ sautramekavacanamityabhiprāyeṇāha  pradhānamiti | pradhānaṃ hyekaṃ sadanekeṣāṃ kāraṇam, paramāṇavastvaneke santa ekaikasya kāryasya kāraṇam, indriyāṇi tu bahūni jñānakāraṇāni, na tvarthakāraṇānīti tadyvavacchedasiddhiḥ | netipadasya pradhānasvarūpapratikṣepārthatvaśaṅkāṃ vyudasyan vākyārthaṃ yojayati  na taditi | dhamirniṣedhaparatve'pi śāstrasya vākyanirūpaṇaparatvāddhetupadena dhātusvarūpopādānācca pratipādyatāveṣeṇa niṣedhyatvaṃ vivakṣitamitibhāvaḥ | vākyapratipādyatvābhāvaḥ pramāṇāntarapratipannatvabādhitatvābhyāṃ vākyasyānyapara tvādvā syāt, yogyānupalambhādyabhāvādapratipannākāravaiśiṣṭayasadbhāvācca bādhitatvapratipannatvāsambhavaḥ, anyaparatvaṃ tu pūrvapakṣayuktibhireva nirastam, ato heturna sambhavatītyabhiprāyeṇa hetvākāṅkṣāṃ darśayati  kuta iti | hetorasiddhimanyathāsiddhiñca vyudasituṃ vyācaṣṭe  sacchabdavācyeti | sacchabdavācyasambandhīti vyadhikaraṇāsiddhivyudāsaḥ | prakṛtaṃ sadeva hi "tadaikṣata" iti tacchabdena parāmṛśyate iti bhāvaḥ | vyāpāraviśeṣaśabdenābhidhāyiśabdena cānyathāsiddhivyudāsaḥ | na hi cetanācetanasādhāraṇaṃ kāryaunmukhyamātramīkṣatidhātvabhidheyam, api tu cetanarūpakartrasādhāraṇo vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ | na ca mukhye sambhavati upacāro yukta iti bhāvaḥ | "ikstipau dhātunirddeśe vaktavyau" iti prakriyayā īkṣatiśabdena dhātūpādānam, nārthopādānam tathā satīkṣiteriti hi vaktavyaṃ syāt anena ca śabdasya vivakṣitārthe svārasyaṃ sūcitamityabhiprāyeṇāha  dhātoriti | śravaṇādityajñānāsiddhiparihāraḥ, śrūyamāṇādīkṣateriti sūtravivakṣitam, tatphalitaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhayā niṣkṛṣya vyākhyātam, īkṣatiśabdenekṣaṇaṃ lakṣitamiti vedāntadīpe vyākhyātamarthasvārasyāya, atra tu śabdasvārasyena vyākhyātam | nanu "tatteja aikṣata" "tā āpa aikṣanta" iti vākyadvayagatamīkṣaṇamacitsambandhitayā pratīyate, "seyaṃ devataikṣata" ityatrāpi īkṣaṇamacidgatamucitam, devatāśabdasya "hantāhamimāstisro devatāḥ" ityāsannavākyasthadevatāśabdavirūpārthatvāyogāt | prathamekṣaṇaṃ ca seyamiti tacchabdaparāmṛṣṭasatsambandhitvādacidgatamevetyākāṅkṣāyāmāha  tadaikṣateti | caramavākayānurodhenopakramasvārasyabhaṅgo na yukta itīdantāvadīkṣaṇaṃ mukhyamiti bhāvaḥ | dhātvarthānāṃ kriyātvādacetanasya ca kriyāyogasambhavānnātrānupapattirityatrāha  īkṣaṇākriyeti | ayaṃ kriyāviśeṣo na sambhavatītyarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  ata iti | ataḥ acetanasyāsambhāvitatvenekṣaṇasya tvatpakṣaviruddhatvādityarthaḥ | īdṛśekṣaṇakṣama iti  anenācidyvāvṛttiruktā | īdṛśaśabdena cetanaviśeṣaśabdena cekṣaṇasvabhāvaphalitāccetanamātrādapi vyāvṛttiruktā, yaccetanamātre'pi na sambhavati tatkathamacetane sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | tadaikṣateti siddhaṃ guṇamāha  sarvajña iti | bahu syāmiti phalitamarthamāha  sarvaśaktiriti | cidacidyvāvarttakaliṅgabalasiddhaṃ saditi sāmānyanuteḥ paryavasānasthalaṃ darśayati  puruṣottama iti | seyaṃ devateti devatāśabdo'pi īkṣaṇaviśeṣasāmarthyācchāgapaśunyāyena cānugṛhītaḥ prakaraṇāntaroktadevatāviśeṣaviṣaya iti bhāvaḥ | sadvidyāvākyasyoktārthaparatvamanekaśrutyantarasvārasyenopapādayati  tathā ceti | nātra viṣayavākyatayā śrutyantaropādānam | sarveṣvevasarveṣvapi; anena prācuryamabhipretam | īkṣaṇasya gauṇatvāśrayaṇe anekaśrutisvārasyabhaṅgaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | pratīyata iti  pratītistāvadavigīteti bhāvaḥ | svapakṣasādhakamuktavā pūrvapakṣayukiṃta pariharttuṃ codyamupakṣipati  nanu ceti | kāryakāraṇayoḥ sālakṣaṇyantāvadaṅgīkāryam mṛttatkāryādiṣu darśanāt | tacca sālakṣaṇyaṃ brahmaṇastriguṇātmakatvādiyogena vā
jagatastadvidhuratvena vā nirvāhyam? ādye śabdāntareṇa pradhānāṅgīkāraḥ | dvitīye sukhaduḥkhamohānvayādyupalambhavirodha iti bhāvaḥ | pariharati  satyamiti | arddhāṅgīkāre satyaśabdaḥ | kāryānuguṇyamaṅgīkṛtam, na tu pradhānatvamiti | sarveti  pradhānasyaiva hi sarvakāryānanuguṇatvam, kāryānupraviṣṭacidapekṣayā tasya kāraṇatvaupayikākāravirahāditi bhāvaḥ| kāryānuguṇanimittopādānabhāvasidhdyarthaṃ sarvajñaḥ sarvaśaktiritipadadvayam, tadubhayaphalitamāha  satya saṅkalpa iti sarvaśaktitvāsaṅkocānna tasya saṅkalpapratibandhasambhāveneti bhāvaḥ | vikārādīnāṃ sadvārakatvasidhdyarthaṃ sūkṣmetyādipadam, uktākāravirahe kāraṇatvāyogāt | tadvattve śrutivākyāni darśayati  parāsyeti | cidacitoḥ śarīratvaṃ katham? śarīratve ca tadvataḥ karmavaśyatvādidoṣaḥ syādityatrāha  tadetaditi | na vilakṣaṇatvādityādisūtraireṣāṃ sūtrāṇāṃ paunaruktayamāśaṅkayāha  atra sṛṣṭīti | vastuvirodhaḥarthasāmarthyavirodhaḥ | atra vākyatarkeṇārthaniṣkarṣaḥ, tatra tvābhimānikavyāptyābhāsanibandhanabāhyatarkavimarśatannirāsamukhenārthaniṣkarṣa iti bhidetyarthaḥ | evaṃ sattvādiguṇamayasyedaṃśabdavācyasya kāraṇatvaṃ taduttambhakamekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñānaṃ ca parihṛtaṃ bhavati | atha paroktaṃ hetvantaramanuvadati yattūkatamiti | tasyānupapannatvamāha tadasaditi | kathamityatrāha  hetvanupādānāditi | vakturanumānavivakṣā'sti cet tatra pradhānāvayavo heturavaśyopādeyaḥ, tadabhāvānna tadvivakṣeti bhāvaḥ | pratijñādṛṣṭāntābhyāṃ hetvākṣepo'pyayukta ityāha yenāśrutamiti | ananyathāsiddhaṃ hyākṣepakam, sarvapramāṇasādhāraṇatvātpratijñā'nyathāsiddheti siddhaṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭāntasya hetvākṣepakatvāyoga ucyate, na kevalaṃ vyāptipradarśanāyaiva dṛṣṭāntopanyāsaḥ, api tvasambhavavyāvṛttipradarśanāyāpi sambhavatītyanyathāsiddhatvāt sa nākṣepaka ityarthaḥ | sarvātmanā tadasambhavamiti  ekavijñānena sarvavijñānaṃ dharmmaikyādekākārānvayādvā vastvantara vyatirekādvā sambhavati, ghaṭapaṭādiṣu tredhāpi tanna sambhavati, ghaṭapaṭādiṣu dharmaikyasyānvayenānyasmādvyatirekeṇa vā samānākārayogasya cābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | astu dṛṣṭāntasyānumānāṅgatve sambhavapradarśanārthatve ca sādhāraṇyam, tathā satyasmanmate'pi sambhavaḥ pākṣikaḥ syādityatrāha  īkṣatyādīti | ādiśabdena vakṣyamāṇahetavo vivakṣitāḥ | pratijñādṛṣṭāntayoḥ sādhāraṇyenānumānatvaṃ śaṅkitam, īkṣaṇādyasādhāraṇahetusadbhāvācchaṅkā'pi nirastetyabhiprāyeṇoktam anumānagandhābhāva iti |
uttarasūtramavatārayitumīkṣaṇasya gauṇatvaṃ śaṅkate  atha syāditi | cetanagatamcetanatvānugatam | iheti  prakaraṇamālocanīyamiti bhāvaḥ | pradhānagatamacetanatvānuguṇamityarthaḥ | prathamekṣaṇasya tejaḥprabhṛtikāryācidgatatvāyogāt pradhānaśabdaḥ | hetumāha tatteja iti | prāyadarśanāya vākyadvayamupāttam, agrayaprāyanyāyo'pi bādhakābhāve jīvatīti bhāvaḥ | seyaṃ devateti devatāśabdo'pyanenaiva nyāyena imāstisro devatā itivat acidviṣayatvaucityānna gauṇatvabādhaka iti bhāvaḥ | gauṇaprayogaṃ darśayati  bhavati ceti | īkṣaṇatulyayogakṣemaharṣādidharmāntarasaṅgrahāya cetanadharmaśabdaḥ | loke śāstre ca prayogadvayaṃ darśitam | gauṇatvaṃ nigamayannuktaśaṅkāparihārāya sūtrasyāvatīrṇatvamāha  ata iti | śaṅkāyā utsūtratvābhāvāt anubhāṣyetyuktam |
gauṇaścennatmaśabdāt | kena guṇayogena gauṇatvamiti śaṅkāṃ pariharan sūtraṃ yojayati  yaduktamiti | pulliṅgagauṇaśabdaviśeṣyaḥ prakṛta īkṣatirityabhiprāyeṇoktamīkṣaṇavyapadeśa iti, gauṇa īkṣatirnetyukte viśeṣyapratikṣepaśaṅkāvyudāsāya yattacchabdābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇaniṣedhaparatvena vyākhyātam | yadgauṇatvamuktaṃ tannetyarthaḥ | sargeti  gauṇo'rthaḥ sargaprāgavasthā, tatra niyatapūrvatvalakṣaṇaṃ kāryānurūpyaṃ guṇayoga ityarthaḥ | ātmaśabdāditisautreṇa padenāviśeṣeṇa "aitadātmyaṃ sa ātmā" iti vākyadvayagatātmaśabdo vivakṣita ityabhiprāyeṇa vākyadvayamupāttam | sacchabdapratipāditasyeti  aitadātmyamityatra etacchabdasya sa ātmetyatra sa itipadasya ca prakṛtaparāmaśirtvāditi bhāvaḥ | ātmaśabdo'pi mṛdātmako ghaṭaḥ ghaṭasya mṛdātmetivatsvarūpānatiriktārthaḥ syādityatrāha  etaduktamiti | cetanācetanaprapañcoddeśeneti  "idaṃ sarva"miti sarvaśabdāsaṅkocasya svataḥprāptatvāt "sanmūlāḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ" iti pūrvavākyaikārthyāt idaṃ sarvamasṛjata "sacca tyaccābhavat vijñānaṃ cāvijñānaṃ ca" iti śrutyantaraikārthyācca sarvaśabdaścidacidātmakajagadgocara iti bhāvaḥ | nācetane iti  na hi cetanasyācetanena svarūpaikyaṃ sambhavatītyarthaḥ | evaṃ gauṇekṣaṇasāhacaryamabhyupagamya dūṣaṇamuktam | atha tadeva nāstītyāha ata iti | ataḥcidacidātmakaprapañcasyātmatvādityarthaḥ | kimarthamīkṣaṇopadeśarahitasyānnasyopādānam? ucyate; īkṣaṇopadeśavirahanibandhanābrahmātmakatvaśaṅkānirākaraṇārtham, anyathā sarvasya kāyarsya brahmātmakatvānavagamādidaṃ saditi sāmānādhikaraṇyāyogyatvenaikavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñānaṃ na ghaṭate, atastadupādānena pratijñāsidhdyaupayikamanupraveśanutisiddhamannasya brahmātmakatvamihānuṣaṅgikaṃ darśitam | na hi kiñcidapyatadātmakamiti apiśabdābhiprāyaḥ, atadātmakatvena tvadabhimatānāmapīti vā, yadāśrayatayā prathamamīkṣaṇaṃ mukhyaṃ sa evetyevakārābhiprāyaḥ | tejaḥ prabhṛtayo'pīti  sacchabdavadityapiśabdasya bhāvaḥ | loke tejaḥprabhṛtimātraparatvena vyutpannā apīti vā | paramātmana eveti  viśeṣyatayā prādhānyena pratipādyaḥ paramātmaiva, tejaḥprabhṛtayastu dvāramātramiti bhāvaḥ | paramātmavācitvamupapādayati  tathāhīti | vastutvamtadrūpavastutvam | tejaso vastutvaṃ tejastvam, apāṃ vastutvamaptvam, pṛthivyā vastutvaṃ pṛthivītvam, devamanuṣyādīnāṃ vastutvaṃ devatvamanuṣyatvādikam, tattadavasthābhāktavamityarthaḥ | nāmabhāktavamnāmavācyatvam | nanu kathaṃ parasya nāmavyākartṛtvaśravaṇānnāmavācyatvasiddhiḥ? ucyate; "tannāmarūpābhyāṃ vyākriyate" iti samānavākye vyākṛtatvaśravaṇāt nāmno viśeṣitatvaṃ hi nāmavyākṛtatvam,nāma viśeṣitatvaṃ ca nāmavācyatvarūpamiti prasiddham, natu tadutpādakatvamātram | na hyākāśasya vā mātāpitrādervā devadattādināmaviśeṣitatvaprasiddhiḥ, ato nāmavyākṛtatvaṃ nāmavācyatvam, atastadaikārthyādihāpi nāmavācyatvaṃ vivakṣitam |
"vacasāṃ vācyamuttamam" iti cāyamartha ucyate, evaṃ tejaḥprabhṛtiśabdānāṃ paramātmavācitvopapādanaphalamāha iti tatteja aikṣateti | itiśabdo hetuparaḥ | mukhyatvaphalamāha  ata iti | apiśabdo gauṇatvaśaṅkāhetusamuccayaparaḥ, idaṃśabdavācyajagatkāraṇatvādinā gauṇatvaśaṅkā parihṛtā, gauṇekṣaṇasāhacaryācca gauṇatvaśaṅkā nirastetyarthaḥ | yadvā tvanmatasādhakādapi tvanmataṃ nirastamiti bhāvaḥ | dūrotsāriteti  gauṇasāhacarye satyapi savarśabdatatpratisambandhivācakātmaśabdasvārasyena "tadaikṣate"tyatra gauṇatvāśaṅkotsāritā, gauṇasāhacaryāsiddhayā dūrotsāritetyarthaḥ | gauṇekṣaṇasāhacarye satyapi ātmaśabdāt prathamekṣaṇamagauṇam, ātmaśabdādeva gauṇekṣaṇasāhacaryamasiddhaṃ cetyathardvayaṃ kathamekena vākyenocyata ityatrāha  iti sūtrābhiprāya iti | pratijñādṛṣṭāntayorhetvanākṣepakatvaṃ mukhyāmukhyārthānugrāhakeṣu mukhyānugrāhakasyānuroddhavyatvaṃ cāsminnadhikaraṇe vyutpādyamiti sūtradvaye spaṣṭam |
avāntarasādhyaviṣayatvaśaṅkāṃ vyudasyannuttarasūtramavatārayati  itaśceti | kāraṇatvaupayikekṣaṇadharmanirūpaṇena paramātmatvaṃ sataḥ samarthitam | atha "kāraṇantu dhyeyaḥ" iti kāraṇavastvasādhāraṇamokṣapradatvadharmeṇa paramātmatvaṃ sādhyata iti saṅgatiḥ |
tanniṣṭhasya mokṣopadeśāt || "tasya tāvat" iti śrutau tasyetipadasya vyākhyānaṃ sūtre tanniṣṭhasyetipadamiti darśayaṃstacchabdaniṣṭhāśabdayorarthaṃ vivṛṇvan sūtrārthamāha  mumukṣoriti | arvācīnaphalakadṛṣṭividhisambhavāccetane kṛtsnajagadupādānatayotkṛṣṭapradhānadṛṣṭividhirayamitiśaṅkā mumukṣoritipadena nirastā  tattvamasīti sadātmakatvānusandhānamupadiśyeti  sadātmakatvopadeśavākyagatastacchabdaḥ prakṛtasadviṣaya iti jñāpanaparassūtre tacchabda ityabhiprāyeṇa
sadātmakatvetyuktam | anusandhānaśabdena niṣṭhāśabdārtha uktaḥ, ihopadeśasyānusandhānārthatvaṃ kathamavagatam? ucyate, upakrame "yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavati amataṃ matamavijñātaṃ vijñātam" iti śravaṇamananasamanantarabhāvivijñānaśabda upāsanaparaḥ, "śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ" ityanenaikārthyāt, upasaṃhāre ca "taddhā'sya vijajñau" iti tattulyārthaṃ vijajñāvitipadamāvarttitam | madhye'pi "ācāryavān puruṣo veda" ityācāryavattāphalatvena pratipāditārthaviśeṣavedanavacanamācāryopadiṣṭārthasyānusandheyatve liṅgam | evamebhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ sadātmakatvopadeśasyopāsanārthatvāvagamaḥ | śarīrapātamātrāntarāya iti  antarāyaśabdena vilambo lakṣyate, śarīrapātāvadhi vilamba ityarthaḥ | "yāvanna vimokṣye" ityukte kathaṃ śarīrānmokṣasiddhiḥ? ucyate; mokṣa ityukte kasmānmokṣa iti bandhakaṃ kiñcidākāṅkṣitam, tacca kimityapekṣāyāmasyāmeva vidyāyām "atha yadā'sya vāṅmanasi sampadyate" ityādinā dehādutkramaṇaśravaṇāt anyatra ca "asmāccharīrāt samutthāya paraṃ jyotirupasampadya" dhūtvā śarīram "aśarīraṃ vā vasantaṃ na priyāpriye spṛśataḥ" iti śravaṇāt "tyaktavā dehaṃ punarjjanma naiti" ityādismaraṇācca śarīramityavagamyate | brahmasampattilakṣaṇa iti  "atha sampatsye" iti sampatteḥ "satā somya tadā sampanno bhavati" iti vākyāntarapratipannaṃ brahmaiva karmeti bhāvaḥ  mokṣa iti | sautrasya mokṣaśabdasya śarīrapātapūrvikā brahmasampattirevārthaḥ, na tu śarīrāpātamātramityabhiprāyaḥ | tataḥ kiṃ pradhānavailakṣaṇyasyetyapekṣāyāṃ mumukṣoritipadenābhipretaṃ vivṛṇoti  yadi ceti | kathamanupapattiḥ? tīrthakṣetrasevādivadacidupāsanasya mokṣopayogitvaṃ śāstrabalāt kiṃ na syāditi śaṅkāyāmāha  yathā kraturiti | upāsanānurūpaphalabhākktavaṃ śrutyarthaḥ, tataśca heyopāsanāddheyaprahāṇānupapattiḥ | acetanasampattiḥacitprāptiḥ, saṃsāritvam karmakṛtācitsambandho hi saṃsāraḥ | sampattiśabdasya prāptyarthatvaṃ tāpatrayābhihatihetubhūtāmacitsampattimityanantarabhāṣyeṇa vyaktam | acetanasampattirastu, tataḥ kimityatrāha  na ceti | atra "śāstraṃ hi vatsalataraṃ mātāpitṛsahasrataḥ" iti purāṇavacanaṃ smāritam | mātāpitṛsahasebhya iti  mātāpitarāvekasmin janmanyaihikapoṣaṇamātraparau, śāstraṃ tvanekeṣu janmasu aihikāmuṣmikasarvavidharakṣaṇaparamiti bhāvaḥ | tāpatrayeti  śāstrasya prayojanapayarvasānaṃ na syādityabhiprāyaḥ | evaṃ śrutisiddhanyāyavirodhaprayojanaparyavasānābhāvābhyāṃ mokṣopayogitvaṃ nirastam | asminnarthe paramatasaṃvādaṃ darśayati  pradhānakāraṇeti | pradhānaniṣṭhasyeti  "vyaktāvyaktajñavijñānāt" iti vadatā'pi sāṅkhayena pradhānasya vyādheriva parijñānamātraṃ vivakṣitam, na tūpāsanamiti bhāvaḥ |
nanu tattvamasīti na sadātmakatvānusandhānopadeśaḥ, kintu sthūlo'hamityādidehātmabhramānuvādaḥ,ataḥ sacchabdavācyācetanasya mumukṣuṇā jñātavyatvaṃ hānārthamiti śaṅkayā anantarasūtrasaṅgatimabhiprayannāha  itaśceti |
heyatvāvacanācca || na paraṃ pratyānukūlyābhāvamātram, kintu prātikūlyaṃ cāstītyāha  pratyuteti | sthūlo'hamityādyanusandhānasyeva na sadātmakatvānusandhānasya heyatvaṃ pratipādyate, api tūpādeyatvamevocyate; tacca pradhānaparatve'nupapannam, "anādimāyayā suptaḥ māyayā sanniruddhaḥ" "anīśayā śocati muhyamānaḥ" "jahātyenāṃ bhuktabhogāmajo'nyaḥ" ityādiṣu pradhānaprastāveṣu tasya heyatvenaiva pratipādanādityarthaḥ | evaṃ "tadaikṣate"tyādivākyaprabhṛti taduparitanavākyāvagatā hetava uktāḥ, teṣāṃ samāptau caśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ | yadvā upādeyatoktayanupādeyatānuktayoḥ sūtradvayapratipāditayoranvayavyatirekātmanā parasparasaṅgatayorekīkārārtha iha caśabdaḥ, ata eva hi pratyutetyādinā pūrvasūtrārthanigamanaṃ kṛtam |
athopakramavirodhe satyuttaravākyagatahetūnāṃ daurbalyāt pradhānameva pratipādyamiti śaṅkāṃ pariharati pratijñāvirodhāt || kasminnarthe virodha ityapekṣāṃ pūrayan vyācaṣṭe  pradhānakāraṇatva iti | tvanmatānuguṇatvena yaduktaṃ tadeva tvanmatapratikūlamiti sūtrakārahṛdayamiti bhāvaḥ | kathamityatrāha  vākyopakrame hīti | pratijñāvākye sarvaśabdābhāve'pi "kasminnu bhagavo vijñāte sarvamidaṃ vijñāṃ bhavati" "ātmani khalvare dṛṣṭe śrute mate vijñāte idaṃ sarvaṃ vijñāta"miti samānaprakaraṇavākyaikārthyāt sarvāḥ prajā iti vakṣyamāṇasvārasyācca sarvavijñānaṃ pratijñātamityuktam | na ca sarvaṃ mṛṇmayamitivatkāryabhūtasarvācidvijñānameva sarvavijñānamiti vācyam; "sanmūlāssomyemāḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ" iti sarvaśabdasamānādhikaraṇaprajāśabdasvārasyāvagatānāṃ cetanānāmapi sanmūlatayā jñātavyasarvakāryāntarbhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  tacceti | kāryakāraṇayorananyatveneti  na hi cidacitorananyatvamiti bhāvaḥ | nanvanyatve'pi ekavijñānāt sarvavijñānaṃ ghaṭate, pṛthivyādīnāṃ kāryatayā cidaṃśasyākāryatayā ca jñānasambhavādityatrāha  tatkāryabhūtacetanācetanaprapañcasyeti | mṛtpiṇḍatatkāryādidṛṣṭāntabalāt "sanmūlāḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ" iti vākye prajāśabdasvārasyācca cetanasyāpi kāryatayaiva jñātatvaṃ vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥ | jñātatayaivopapādanīyamiti  devadattajñānena grāmavijñānavannātra sarvavijñānamaupacārikam, aupacārikatve sarvavijñānasya lokadṛṣṭatvena kathaṃ nu bhagava iti praśnāyogāt ananyabhūtamṛttatkāryādidṛṣṭāntamukhena mukhyatayaiva sarvavijñānopapādanadarśanācceti bhāvaḥ | uktaviparyayeṇa pratijñāvirodhaṃ darśayati  tattviti |
ekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñānaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvanibandhanam, suṣuptau paramātmani cetanasya pralayaśca tannibandhana iti kāryakāraṇabhāvanibandhanatvasāmyāt saṅgataṃ suṣuptau layaṃ hetutvenāhetyabhiprayannāha  itaśceti | svāpyayāt || sacchabdasya jīvopasthāpakasvaśabdasamānaviṣayatvanibandhanāmarthāntaratvaśaṅkāṃ vyudasyati  tadeva sacchabdavācyamiti  jagatkāraṇavastuviṣaya evātrāpi sacchabda ityabhiprāyaḥ | yatrayadetyarthaḥ | nanu satā sampattiḥ prakṛtisaṃsargo'stu, svāpyayo'pi jīvasya svasvarūpe'vasthānamiti svasacchabdayorbhinnārthaḥ syāditi naitadvākyaṃ pradhānakāraṇatāvirodhīti | tadetatpariharan vyācaṣṭe suṣuptamiti | svamapīta itīdaṃ vivṛṇoti  svasmin pralīna iti | svamiti dvitīyā, sateti tṛtīyā ca phalatassati sampadyeti saptamyanuguṇārthe, vyapadeśabhedastu dhātusvabhāvabhedādityabhiprāyaḥ | apīteḥ prāptirūpatvāt dvitīyānirdeśaḥ, "brahmaiva san brahmāpyeti" "yatprayantyabhisaṃviśantī "ti hi śrutyantaram | sāhityasadbhāvāt tṛtīyānirdeśaḥ, sampanna iti karmaṇi niṣṭhā vā, tadānīṃ sampatteḥ prāptirūpatvātsataḥ kartṛtvavivakṣayā tṛtīyā, "prājñenātmanā sampariṣvaktaḥ" itivat, apyayasya sthānasāpekṣatvātsaptamīnirdeśaḥ | vyutpattivaśena pralayavācināṃ śabdānāṃ sthānāpekṣayā utkaṭatvāt saptamyanurodhena vyākhyātam; evaṃ sampattyapyayaśabdayoḥ pralayaparatayaikāthyarmuktam, svasacchabdayośca pralayasthānaparatayā aikārthyamuktam | ayamabhiprāyaḥ,"satā somya tadā sampannaḥ sati sampadyeti pratijñānigamanavākyamadhyagatasya svāpyayavākyānapekṣitārthāntaraparatve'nvayavaighaṭyaṃ sphuṭam | "athaitadapiyantyantataḥ brahmaiva san brahmā'pyeti" tadā sampadyate brahma" ityādiprayogaprācuryādapyayasampattiśabdasvārasyopasthāpitasya pralayasya sthānapratipādakatvāt svasacchabdayorekārthatvaparyavasāyitvaṃ tūcitam | "jīvenātmanā tattvamasīti" jīvātmaśabdayostvaṃ tacchabdayoriva ca svasacchabdayorapi jīvarūpeṇa svena rūpeṇa cāvasthitakāraṇavastuviṣayatayaikārthaparatvaṃ prakaraṇavaśādapyucitam | jīvādarthāntare sati tasya layānupapattiśaṅkāparihārārthaṃ svaśabdābhidheyasya tasya satparyantatāpratipādanasyāpekṣitatvācca tayorekārthatvaṃ yuktamiti | astu layasthānopasthāpakayoḥ svasacchabdayoraikārthyam, tattu svaśabdasya svīyaparatvena svasacchabdayorubhayorapi pradhānaparatve'pyupapadyata ityatrāha  pralayaśceti | kāryatārūpavisadṛśāvasthāprahāṇena kāraṇāntarbhāvo hi layaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  naceti | acetanamacittvādityarthaḥ | sthūlāvasthasya jīvasya sūkṣmāvasthe svakāraṇībhūte sattāyogini svātmani layopapatteḥ sacchabdasya tatparatvaṃ sambhavatīti śaṅkāṃ vyudasitumāha  tathā suṣuptamiti | sṛjyadehendriyānapekṣekṣaṇādiguṇakaparamakāraṇaviṣayatvāt tatsaṃvādiśrutyantarānuguṇyācca nātra sacchabdo'tisaṅkucitajñānasūkṣmāvasthajīvamātraviṣaya ityabhiprāyaḥ | nanu nityasya jīvasya layo'nupapannaḥ, kāryakāraṇayorananyatvāt, jīvavilakṣaṇasya parasya tatkāraṇatvāyogāttasminjīvasya layaścānupapannaḥ | naivam, sarvadā jīvaviśiṣṭasya paramātmano'vasthāviśeṣarūpakāryakāraṇabhāvopapatteḥ | tathā hi; "svamapīta" ityatra svaśabdastāvanna jīvamātraparaḥ, "satā somya tadā sampanno bhavati svamapīto bhavati" iti svaśabdasya sacchabdasamānaviṣayatvāt sacchabdasya cāsmin prakaraṇe paramātmaviṣayatvāt | nāpi niṣkṛṣṭabrahmaparaḥ nityanirvikārasya tasyopādānatvāyogenāpyayasthānatvāyogāt | kāryasya hi pralaya upādāna eva, ato jīvarūpeṇāvasthitaparamātmaparatvaṃ vaktavyam, tatrāpi na śuktau rajatasyeva layaḥ, tasyeva jīvasya svarūpanivṛttiprasaṅgāt | nāpi mahākāśe ghaṭākāśasyeva layaḥ, dehādyupādheravasthitatvāt | nāpi kṣititale ghaṭasyeva layaḥ, ghaṭatvasyeva jīvatvasya prahāṇe jīvanityatvaśrutivirodhādupādheravasthitatvena jīvatvaprahāṇāyogāt, āmokṣāvasthāyitayā'bhitamasya jīvabhāvasya svāpamātreṇa nivṛttau mokṣopāyavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt, akṛtābhyāgamādiprasaṅgāt, pratyabhijñāvirodhāt, "prājñenātmanā sampariṣvakto na bāhyaṃ kiñcana veda nāntara"miti tadānīmajñatvasarvajñatvābhyāṃ bhedavyapadeśācca jīvatve sthita eva svāpyayasya sarvairabhyupagantavyatvāt; ato bhedādeva svaśabdo jīvaviśiṣṭaparamātmaparaḥ, ata eva hyuktaṃ sāre, "ātmanameva jīvo'pīto bhavatītyarthaḥ | jīvasvarūpo hi para eva nāmarūpavyākaraṇaśrute"riti | tasya sampattirnāma bahirmukhajñānaprasaravirahitajīvarūpeṇāvasthānam, nirgamo nāma bahirmukhajñānaprasaraḥ | nanu kathaṃ dehaviśiṣṭasya sato jīvasya sthite dehe viśeṣyāṃśalayaḥ? naivam; viśeṣyāṃśe rāgadveṣādyanvayavat tatraiva pralayarūpāvasthānvayopapatteḥ | nanu tarhi svāpe jñānena dehadhāraṇābhāvātsvarūpeṇa dhāraṇasya mahāpralaye'pi tulyatvāt dehasya jīvaṃ pratyapṛthaksiddhirdehalakṣaṇaṃ ca na ghaṭate | na, jīvasya dehāparityāgāddehasya tatsaṅkalpena dhāraṇayogyatvāccāpṛthaksiddhidehalakṣaṇopapatteḥ, ato manuṣyādināmarūpābhimānarāgalobhādyanuguṇabahirmukhajñānaprasaravajjāgaritāvasthajīvaviśiṣṭaḥ paramātmā, devamanuṣyādināmarūparāgadveṣalobhamohādyaupādhikabāhyābhyantarākārābhimānakāluṣyavirahitajīvaśarīrakaḥ sannātmanyantarbhūta iti śrutyarthaḥ | apyayasya prāptirūpatvāt sāre ātmānamiti dvitīyānirdeśaḥ | apyayasya sthānasāpekṣatvāt svasmin pralīna ityuktaṃ bhāṣye | ekasya paramātmanaḥ sthānasthānibhāvavyapadeśaścāṃśabhedābhiprāyaḥ, ghaṭāderlayasthānasya ghaṭānupayuktasyāpi pṛthivyaṃśasya hi kāraṇajātīyatvāt kāraṇatvam, brahmaṇi tu
jīvaviśeṣaviśiṣṭataditarāṃśabhedena sthānasthānibhāvo dharmyaikyātkāraṇatvam, kāraṇāvasthānvayini dharmiṇyantarbhāvaḥ sarvatra samānaḥ, aupādhikākārābhimānānuguṇajñānavikāsavajjīvaviśiṣṭayā kāryāvasthā, atadabhimānajīvaviśiṣṭatā kāraṇāvasthā, tatra layasthānabhūtasya paramātmanaḥ kāraṇavasthāpekṣayā līyamānāṃśasya visadṛśāvasthā hi nāmarūpādyaupādhikākārābhimānānuguṇajñānaprasaravajjīvaviśiṣṭatā, tasmādaupādhikākārānabhimānajīvaviśiṣṭatārūpakāraṇāvasthāśraye svātmanyavasthānaṃ svāpyaya ityupapannam | ata eva jīvasya nityatvāvirodhaśca, jñānasaṅkocavikāsaviśeṣavyatirekeṇa jīvatvaprahāṇābhāvāt | āmokṣājjīvabhāvasya sthiratvaṃ hi parairapyabhyupeyam, atastadavirodhena svāpyayo varṇanīyaḥ, tadānīṃ "prājñenātmanā sampariṣvakta" iti bhedapratipādanāvirodhaścaivaṃ sati bhavati, evaṃvidha eva pralayo mahāpralayo'pītyabhyupagantavyam, jīvabahutvānāditvakarmavāsanāviśeṣasthityupagamena vaiṣamyanairghṛṇyādeḥ pariharttavyatvāt | na ca "na vijñāturvijñāterviparilopo vidyate" iti jñānanityatvaśrutivirodhaḥ, tasya saṅkocamātravatastucchatvābhāvāt | na ca prasaropalambhayorabhāvāt jñānadravyasya tucchatvaṃ śaṅkanīyam, na hyanullaṅghitaratnaprabhāyāḥ prasaropalambhābhāvānnāstitvam "yathā na kriyate jyotsnā malaprakṣālanānmaṇeḥ | doṣaprahāṇānna jñānamātmanaḥ kriyate tathā" iti hi smṛtiḥ | ātyantikapralaye'pi yathoktaprakāra upapadyate, tadānīṃ nāmarūpādyaupādhikākārābhimānarūpavisadṛśāprahāṇena kāraṇāvasthe paramātmanyavasthānāt aupādhikākārābhimānārhatvarūpakāryāvasthāvirahitajīvaviśiṣyatvaṃ hi parasya kāraṇāvasthatvam, vikṛtivirahitajīvaviśiṣṭatvamiti yāvat | tanmahāpralaye muktauca samānam | nanu "prājñenātmanā sampariṣvakto na bāhyaṃ kiñcana veda nāntaram" iti suṣuptau prājñatvājñatvarūpavaiṣamyāvagamāt mokṣe ceśvaratveśitavyatvādivaiṣamyasthityabhyupagamāt bhavadabhimatapralayaprakāro'nupapanna iti | naivam; kāraṇāvasthāmapekṣya visadṛśāvasthāyā vivakṣitatvāt, nāmarūpādyaupādhikākārābhimānavirahitajīvaviśiṣṭatā kāraṇāvasthā, tadapekṣayā visadṛśāvasthā ca tādṛgabhimānavajjīvaviśiṣṭatā | tatprahāṇasya cātra vidyamānatvāt suṣuptau laya upapannaḥ | mokṣe ceśitavyatvākāreṇa vaiṣamyaṃ nātyantikapralayavirodhi, īśitavyavatāyā avasthārūpatvābhāvāt, kādācitkadharmo hyavasthā, īśitavyatvādi tu nityam, "sa īśo'sya jagato nityameva nānyo heturvidyata īśanāya" "yasyātmā śarīram" "ya ātmānamantaro yamayati" ityādiśruteḥ | ato neśitavyatvādikamavastheti vaidharmyarūpasyāpi tasyāprahāṇaṃ na doṣaḥ, ato yathokta eva svāpyayaḥ | sautraṃ hetuṃ paramasādhyena saṅgamayati  tasmāditi | apyayasthānasya paramakāraṇatvāyāha paraṃ brahmeti | jīvavyāvṛttyarthaṃ sarvajñaśabdaḥ | "prājñenātmane"ti hi śrutiḥ | "tadaikṣate"tyetatsamvādinī | apyaye'pi jīvaniyantṛtvajñāpanārthamīśvarottīṇartattvavyudāsārthaṃ ca parameśvaraśabdaḥ | suṣuptapuruṣavailakṣaṇyaparo devatāviśeṣaparaśca puruṣottamaśabdaḥ | vyākhyānāntaravyāvṛttyarthamāha  tadāheti | sampattyasampattibhyāmiti "sati sampadya na viduḥ sati sampatsyāmahe" iti sata āgamya na viduḥ sata āgacchāmaha ityuktābhyāṃ sampattinirgamābhyāmityarthaḥ | yadvā paramātmani sampattyā anyatra asampattyā cetyarthaḥ | svāpyayaśabdenāsampattirapyabhipreteti vṛttikārasya bhāvaḥ | etatparabrahmakāraṇatvamityarthaḥ ||
pūrvasūtre "prājñenātmane"tyādeḥ suṣuptiviṣayasya śrutyantarasya prakṛtārthopapādakatayā buddhisthatvāt kāraṇasya paramātmatvamapi kāraṇaviṣayaiḥ śrutyantarairupapādyate gatisāmānyāt || pūrvaṃ "gauṇaścennātmaśabdā "dityuktatvādātmaśabdavatīḥ śrutīrudāharati  ātmā vā ityādinā tasya ha vā etasyetyatrāpi ātmaśabdaḥ śrūyate, ātmāvāre draṣṭavyaḥ ātmani khalvare daṣṭe, yonyantrātmanaḥ sarvaṃ veda iti ca pravṛttiśa tasya ha vā etasyetyatrātmanassarvaṃ veda" iti ca | gatiśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe  pravṛttiriti | bodhanavyāpāraparaḥ pravṛttiśabdaḥ, "bhinnapravṛttinimittānām" ityatrapravṛttiśabdavat | samānatvamarthadvārakamityāha  tatsamāneti | tataḥ kimityatrāha  teṣu ceti | tato'pi kimityatrāha  tasmāditi || na kevalamupaniṣadantareṣu, atraiva sarveśvarakāraṇatvaṃ sphuṭamityāha śrutatvācca || ātmatvena nāmarūpavyākartṛtvaṃ darśayati  anena jīveneti | sarvajñatvasarvaśaktitve "tadaikṣata bahu syām" ityādivākyena pūrvameva darśite, sanmūlā iti sūcite ca | ādhāratvaṃ darśayatisadāyatanā iti, yaccāsyeti ca | dhārakatvaṃ cātmatveneti darśayati  aitadātmyamiti | na hyatra kāraṇatayā kāryādhāratvamātraṃ vivakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ | yaccetyādikaṃ satyakāmatvapratipādanopayuktañca | apahatapāpmatvādiguṇān daśaryati  eṣa ātmeti | uktaguṇavaiśadyārthamanuktaguṇadarśanārthaṃ tadvata īśvaratvadevatāviśeṣatvasphuṭīkaraṇārthaṃ ca pūrvasūtrābhipretānyanudāhṛtāni śrutyantarāṇyudāharati  tathā ceti | na tvetatsūtraviṣayavākyatvena, asya sūtrasya chāndogyopaniṣanmātraviṣayatvaṃ dīpasārayorapi hyuktam "śrutameva hyasyāmevopaniṣadi" iti | nātra kramavivakṣā | liṅgamśarīram | nāśabdamityupakramasūtrānurodhena pradhānasyāpratipādyatvaṃ nigamayati  tasmāditi | tena phalitaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pratipādyatvaṃ nigamayati  ata iti | sarvajñatvādayassargādikāraṇatvopayogiguṇāḥ | śodhakavākyoktaguṇā nirastanikhiletyādinoktāḥ | anavadhiketyādinā puruṣārthatvañca darśitam, oghaśabdo'sti cet guṇānāmanyatrāparyavasāyitvaṃ darśayati, mahārṇavaśabdo guṇebhyo'pi tadāśrayasya mahatvaṃ darśayati | puruṣottamanārāyaṇaśabdau puruṣasūktanārāyaṇānuvākasiddhaviśeṣaparyavasāyitvaṃ kāraṇaśodhakavākyānāṃ daśaryantau cidacidvilakṣaṇatvaṃ taccharīrakatvaṃ ca darśayataḥ | nikhilajagadekakāraṇamiti  nikhilaśabdena gaganādikamapi kabalīkṛtam | ekaśabdena nimittopādānatve abhiprete |
eṣāṃ sūtrāṇāṃ brahmājñānavādino'nanuguṇatvaṃ pūrvamuktaṃ vistareṇāha  ata eveti | sūtrakāreṇeti  nyāyanibandhanakṛtetyabhiprāyaḥ | ābhirityarthapratyāyakatvaṃ vivakṣitam; nyāyānugṛhītābhirviśadārthābhiḥ śrutibhiriti bhāvaḥ | kiñca prāmāṇikasyāprāmāṇikatvābhimānādapasiddhāntatā siddhāntasyāpi bhrāntimūlatvādaprāmāṇikatā ca loke dṛṣṭeti tadubhayavyavacchedārthassūtrakāraśrutyornirdeśaḥ | nirasto veditavya iti  nirāsaḥ phalita ityarthaḥ | ata evetyuktaṃ vivṛṇoti  pāramārthiketi | īkṣaṇasyāpāramārthikatve sāṅkhyābhimataṃ pradhānameva brahma syāt, śuktitvāpāramārthye hi rajatameva paramārthaḥ syāditi sāṅkhayanirāso'nupapannaḥ syāditi pāramāthirkaśabdābhiprāyaḥ | sacchabdoktasvarūpasya saṃśayasahatvāttadatiriktena vyāvarttakena bhāvyamiti guṇaśabdasya bhāvaḥ | atassadādiśabdānāṃ sāṅkhayābhimatapradhānaparatvavyavacchedasiddhayarthamīkṣaṇādiguṇatatpāramārthikatvavivakṣāvadbhissūtraiḥ nirviśeṣanirāsaḥ phalita ityarthaḥ | "tadaikṣata" ityādivākyāni sākṣitvamātraparāṇi, na tu guṇaviśeṣaparāṇi | sākṣitvamātreṇāpi sūtrābhimatā pradhānavyāvṛttiḥ sidhyatītyatrāha  nirviśeṣeti | sacchabdopasthāpitavimatipadasvarūpātirekeṇa sākṣitvamapyapāramārthikaṃ tvanmata ityarthaḥ| jñātṛtvābhāve sākṣitvamapi na sidhyatīti prāgevoktamityapiśabdābhiprāyaḥ | apāramārthikatve kiṃ syādityatrāha  vedānteti | na hyāropitākārastattvāvedakapramāṇaviṣayaḥ, na cārvācīnaṃ brahma jijñāsyatayā pratijñātamiti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  tacceti | tato'pi kim? na hyasmābhiracetanamucyata ityatrāha  cetanatvaṃ nāma caitanyaguṇayoga iti | īkṣitṛtvaṃ hi na cidrūpatāmātramityabhiprāyaḥ | nirviśeṣanirāsasya phalitatvaṃ nigamayatiata iti | na hyatra cidrūpamātreṇa pradhānavyāvṛttiḥ sūtritā, api tvīkṣaṇaguṇayogena tadanabhyupagacchato vyāvartakābhāve vyāvṛttireva na syādityarthaḥ | pāramārthiketyādinā etadadhikaraṇavirodha uktaḥ | vedāntetyādinā pūrvādhikaraṇairvirodha uktaḥ | yadvā svarūpameva sākṣitvaṃ na dharmaḥ, ato nāpāramārthikamityatrāha  vedānteti | svarūpameva cettatpūrvasūtraiḥ siddhamiti pratipādyādhikyābhāvāt "īkṣate"rityādisūtra vaiyarthyamityabhiprāyaḥ | svarūpaviśeṣo'pratipanna iti cet kiṃ svarūpameva viśeṣaḥ? uta svarūpasya viśeṣaḥ? prathame prāguktadoṣaḥ | dvitīye saviśeṣatvam | pūrvasūtreṣu brahma kāraṇātmanā siddham, na tu cetanarūpeṇa; ataḥ "īkṣate"rityādisūtrāṇāmārambhaṇīyatvamiti śaṅkāyāṃ cetanarūpeṇapratipādyatvamabhyupagacchannāhatacceti | cetanatayā pradhānavyāvṛttiścaitanyaguṇavirahe na sidhyatīti vaktuṃ cetanatvaṃ śodhayati cetanatvaṃ nāmeti | guṇaśabdo dharmaparaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha ata iti | vyāvartakābhāvādravyāvṛttyasiddhirityarthaḥ | cetanaśabdasya svarūpamātraparatve adhikaraṇārambhavaiyarthyamarthasiddham, na pradhānatulyatvam, prakāśatvābhyupagamāt; yathā ātmadharmabhūtajñānasya jñānāntarāyoge'pyacidvyāvṛttistvanmate tadvadityatrāha  kiñceti | kathaṃ durupapādatvamityatrāha prakāśo hīti | vyavahārayogyatāvyavahārapratisambandhitā | tadubhayarūpatvābhāvāt svavyavahārahetutvaparavyavahārahetutvābhāvādityarthaḥ | atha tadubhayakṣamatvaṃ śaṅkate tadubhayeti | tatkṣamatvamabhyupagamya dūṣaṇamāha  tanneti | parasya agatitvaṃ darśayitumāha  atheti | pariharati  hanta tarhīti | tatkṣamatvameva nāstītyāha  śaktimattvaṃ ceti | kāryaviśeṣasya niṣpramāṇakatvesvaparavyavahārayogyatāpādanābhāve, nirūpakābhāve nirūpyābhāva ityarthaḥ | vastutve sambhavatyapi pradhānatulyatvamuktam | atha vastutvameva na sidhyatītyāha  kiñceti | vastutvamtucchavyāvṛttatvam | kuta ityatrāha  pratyakṣeti | pratyakṣāntarbhūtasyāpi svānubhavasya pṛthakpramāṇatvaṃ paramatābhyupagamenoktam | saviśeṣagocarāḥvastutaḥ saviśeṣabhūtārthagocarā ityarthaḥ | vastutvaṃ cidacitsādhāraṇam | tacca tucchavyāvṛttatvam, tanna sidhyatītyarthaḥ | parapakṣadūṣaṇānantaraṃ svapakṣaṃ nigamayati  tasmāditi | paraistvevaṃ sūtrayojanā kṛtā, pradhānaṃ na pratipādyam, aśabdaṃ hi tat, śabdena pratipādayitumaśakyaṃ hi tat, aśaktavañca īkṣatiśravaṇāditikya naiṣocitā pratijñāvākye dharmyupasthāpakaśabdasyādhyāhāryatvāt aśabdaṃ hi tadityukte'pi hetvantarasākāṅkṣatvācca | "nānumānamatacchabdāt" "ānumānikamapyekeṣem" ityādisūtreṣu ānumānikādiśabdavadaśabdaśabdasyāpyavayavārthamukhena dharmyupasthāpanakṣamatayā adhyāhāranirapekṣatvādavayavaśaktayaivānumānākārāvagamarūpapūrvapakṣabījasya sūtreṇaiva dyotamānatvasiddheśca bhāṣyakārābhimatā yojanā sādhīyasī "gauṇaścennātmaśabdāt" ityatrātmaśabdasya svarūpaparatvamāśritya jīvaṃ nirdiśya sacchabdavācyasya svarūpatvena vyapadeśādagauṇamīkṣaṇamityapyayuktam, tasyāmodhekṣaṇatvāyogāt sūtrāsvārasyācca | na hi gauṇaścenna jīvaśabdādityuktam svarūpapara ātmaśabdassāpekṣaḥ, jīvavācipadasamabhivyāhāreṇa vinā tasyācidravyāvarttanāsāmarthyāt | cetanaparastvātmaśabdaḥ "aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvam" iti cidacidātmakasamastaprapañcaṃ pratyātmatvaṃ darśayannacidyvāvarttane'tīva nirākāṅkṣaḥ, ataḥ sākāṅkṣahetunirdeśādapi nirākāṅkṣahetunirdeśo varamiti tasyāpi sūtrasya yathokta evārthaḥ | cidacidātmakasamastajagadantarātmavācina ātmaśabdasya "mamātmā bhadrasena" itivanmukhyārthānupapattyabhāvena gauṇatvaśaṅkānudayādātmaśabdo na gauṇa iti pratijñāvākyāntaranirapekṣatvācca tṛtīyaṃ sūtramapi paramasādhyahetuvācīti yuktam | sarvavedāntanāmaikakaṇṭhyaṃ darśayatā gatisāmānyasū treṇaiva śvetāśvataravākyasyāpi kroḍīkṛtatvāt śvetāśvataravākyasya "śrutatvāt" iti sūtraviṣayatvāśrayaṇamayuktam | yattūktaṃ yādavaprakāśīyaiḥ satā sampanna iti satprāptimātramuktam, na tvaikyam, sacchabdasya pradhānaparatve'pi sati sampattirghaṭate svāpyayaśca sarveṣāṃ jīvānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak svasminnapyayo bhavatviti śaṅkāparihārāya suṣuptau sarvajīvānāṃ gantavyasya vastuna ekatvam, tatra sati teṣāmaikyāpattiśca gatisāmānyasūtreṇocyate | viṣayaśca "yathā somya madhu madhukṛto nistiṣṭhanti nānātyayānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ rasān samavarāhamekatāṃ rasaṅgamayanti te yathā tatra na vivekaṃ labhante amuṣyāhaṃ vṛkṣasya raso'smi amuṣyāhaṃ vṛkṣasya raso'smīti evameva khalu somyemāḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ sati sampadya na viduḥ" iti vākyamiti | tadapyayuktam | tathā hi; dṛṣṭāntānugṛhītamekatāmavagamayat "sati sampadya" ityādi vākyaṃ kiṃ kāraṇatvamupajīvya sataḥ pradhānatvavyudāsakam? uta kāraṇatvamanupajīvya? prathame gatisāmānyasūtravaiyarthyaṃ syāt, svāpyayasya kāraṇatvāpattirūpatayā svāpyayasūtreṇaiva pradhānatvavyudāsasiddheḥ | dṛṣṭāntavaighaṭyañca, bahūnāṃ rasānāmekasmin kāraṇe layasya nidarśitatvābhāvāt | rasavatāmavayavānāṃ madhuratvarūpeṇa samānarasatvāpattireva hi tatra dṛśyate | dvitīye ca jīvānāṃ kīdṛśamekatvaṃ sataḥ pradhānatvavyudāsakam, na tāvajjīvatvaprahāṇena sataikatvam jīvatvaprahāṇasya bhavatānabhyupagamāt jīvanityatvaśrutivirodhāt "prājñenātmanā sampariṣvakto na bāhyaṃ kiñcana veda nāntaram" iti ajñasya jīvasya tadā prājñādhiṣṭhitatvaśravaṇavirodhāt punarapi vyavasthitakarmaphalabhogādyanupapatteśca | na ca sadrūpeṇaikatvam, tajjāgraddaśāyāmapyastīti tadānīmiva jīvānāṃ svāpe svasvarūpāvasthānapradhānasaṃsargayoravirodhādabhimatāsiddheḥ | na ca devatvamanuṣyatvarāgadveṣādibāhyābhyantaravikalpābhimānaviraheṇaikatvam, tasyāpi svasvarūpāvasthānapradhānasaṃsargayoravirodhitvena sampattyapyayādhikaraṇasya svasvarūpapradhāna vyatirekāsiddheḥ, ataḥ sūtravaiyarthyaśaṅkāparihārāsiddhayoranyatarāvaśyambhāvāt paroktārthaparatvaṃ sūtrasyāyuktam | yacca śrutatvāditi sūtrasya pratijñāvākyaprabhṛti "sa eṣo'ṇimā""aitadātmya"mityādivākyajātaṃ viṣayatayopāttam | tadapyayuktam, pratijñāvirodhāt" "nātmaśabdāt" ityādibhiḥ sautrapadairasya punaruktiprasaṅgāt, ataḥ sūtrāṇāṃ yathokta evārthaḥ |
athottarādhikaraṇasya pūrvādhikaraṇena saṅgatimāha  evaṃ jijñāsitasyeti | jagatkāraṇasya nirūpaṇīyatve catussūtryā siddhe pratyakṣādisiddhatayā prasidhdyatiśayādacetane prathamamataranti | buddhirīkṣaṇādibhistato vyāvartya cetanavastvabhimimuravīkṛtā | idānīmacetanāpekṣayā prasiddhimāndye'pi paramātmāpekṣayā prasiddhatare'hampratyayasiddhe pratyagātmanyavatarantī buddhirvyāvartyata ityarthaḥ |
ānandamayo'bhyāsāt || kāraṇaviṣayasya "tasmādvā etasmādātmanaḥ" iti vākyasyottaratra codyaparihāramukhena udāhariṣyamāṇatvāt prathamamātmaśabdavyākhyānopakramabhūtaṃ "sa vā eṣa puruṣaḥ" ityādikamupāttam, ata eva hi prabandhāntare "tasmādvā" ityādikamudāhṛtam | tatreti  śārīratvānandaprācuryābhyāṃ saṃśaya ityabhiprāyaḥ | sadvidyāyāṃ "jīvenātmane"tisamānādhikaraṇyamatra pūrvapakṣotthānabījamiti sūcanārthaṃ jīvaśabdābhilapanīyāditipadam | kiṃ kāraṇavādinaḥ sarve vedāntāḥ pariśuddhapratyagātmasvarūpaparāḥ, uta tadvilakṣaṇaparāḥ | iti prathamavicāraḥ | tadarthamānandamayaḥ kiṃ pariśuddhāvasthaḥ pratyagātmā; uta paramātmā? iti | tadarthamiha pratipannaḥ śārīrasambandhaḥ kiṃ jīvātmāsādhāraṇaḥ uta na? tadarthaṃ mayaṭ kiṃ svārthakatvavikārātharkatvayoranyataravān; uta prācuryārthaḥ tadarthaṃ kiṃ vikārādyarthānuguṇa hetavaḥ anuroddavyāḥ uta prācuryādyarthānuguṇahetavaḥ? vijñānamayaśabdaḥ kiṃ vijñānamātraparaḥ, uta jīvaparaḥ ?
tadarthaṃ tatra mayaṭ kiṃ svārthikaḥ? uta na? tadarthaṃ "vijñānaṃ yajñaṃ tanute" iti vijñānaśabdaḥ kiṃ jñānamātre varttate, uta jñānaguṇake pratyagātmani? iti | pūrve kalpāḥ pūrvapakṣāḥ, itare tu siddhāntāḥ | yadā vikārārthatvādyanuguṇahetoranuroddhavyatvena mayaṭ svārthiko vikārārtho vā bhavati, tadā niratiśayaprācuryāpratipatterānandamātrasya jīve sambhavātsvato jīvānuguṇatayā pratipannasya śarīrasambandhasya jīvāsādhāraṇatve virodhābhāvādānandamayo jīvaḥ, yadā ca ślokasthavijñānaśabdo vijñānamātraparaḥ tadā vijñānamayaśabdasyāpi svārthikamayaḍantatvena vijñānamātraparatvādvijñānaśabdasya buddhiparatvasambhavāt tadantara ānandamayaḥ pratyagātmeti pūrvapakṣe phalaphalibhāvaḥ | rāddhānte tu yadā prācuryārthānuguṇahetoranuroddhavyatvenānandamaya ityatra mayaṭ prācuryārthaḥ, tadānīmānandaprācuryasya niravadhikatayā'vagatasya śrutiviruddhāśrutopādhikalpanāyogena svato niratiśayasya jīvātmanyasambhavāttadvirodhena śarīrasambandhasya jīvāsādhāraṇakarmamūlatvābhāvācca nānandamayaḥ pratyagātmā, yadā ca ślokasthavijñānaśabdo vijñānaguṇake pratyagātmani vartate tadā vijñānamayaśabdasyāpi prācuryātharmayaḍantatayā pratyagātmavācitvācca tadantara ānandamayaḥ paramātmeti phalaphalibhāvaḥ | pūrvapakṣotthānamākṣipati  nanu ceti | sukhapratipattyarthamannamayādīnanukramyeti | anena jagatkāraṇaprakaraṇasyāvicchittirdyotitā | tadeva jagatkāraṇamiti vakṣyamāṇaparyālocanayā vibhūtiprakarṣādhīnātiśayitānandasyāśrayatvopapādakaṃ sakalajagatkāraṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityāha  jagatkāraṇañceti | jñānaśaktayupayogajñāpanāya jagatkāraṇamiti punarupādānam | pariharati  satyamiti cetanatvādāvabhyupagamaḥ, jīvādatireke vivādaḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇyanirddeśo'stu, tataḥ kiṃ jīvādavailakṣaṇyasyetyatrāha sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti | īkṣatiśravaṇājjīvavilakṣaṇatvamuktamityatrāha  īkṣeti | upapadyata evetyevakāraḥ asvārasyasūcakaḥ | sākṣitvameva īkṣitṛtvamiti bhāvaḥ | "bhedavyapadeśācca" iti bhedavyadeśaṃ siddhāntahetuṃ vadatā sūtrakāreṇa aikyavyapadeśasya pūrvapakṣahetutvaṃ vivakṣitamityavagamyate; evamutthānopapatteḥ sautrahetuvaśācca aikyavyapadeśaḥ pūrvapakṣahetutayopanyastaḥ | evaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇena jīvavyatirekāsiddheradhikaraṇāntaramārambhaṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu "brahmavidāpnoti para"mityatra brahma prāpya śrūyate, anantaraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kathyate, tatra satyatvamānantyañcāntarbhūtam |
jīvasya nityaprāptatvāt prāpyatvamanupapannam, jñātatvāllakṣaṇañca na vācyam; satyatvānantatvarūpalakṣaṇaviśeṣaśca naikarūpajñānasya paricchinnasya nopapadyate, ataḥ paramātmaiva pratipādyata iti śaṅkāṃ pariharan pūrvapakṣamāha  ato brahmaviditi | ataśśārīratvaśravaṇātsāmānādhikaraṇyabalenaikyasya pratipannatvāccācidviyuktasvarūpaprāpyatāparatvaṃ kalpyamityarthaḥ | lakṣaṇakathanaṃ tatpratipattyarthaṃ tadviśeṣoktiśca acidviyukte svarūpe sambhavatītyāha  acidviyukteti | na kevalaṃ śārīratvasāmānādhikaraṇyabalādacidviyuktasvarūpasya prāpyatvam, kintu kaṇṭhoktaṃ cetyāha  tadrūpeti | hiśabdaḥ śrutiprasiddhidyotakaḥ | yadvā svarūpasyaivaupādhikākāranivṛttimātraparamokṣaśabdasvārasyasūcakaḥ | śrutimeva darśayati  na ha vā iti | itiśravaṇāditi śeṣaḥ | prāpyatvānuguṇapuruṣārthatāṃ darśayan nigamayati  ata iti | nanu nātrācidviyuktajīvasvarūpamupadiśyate "sa vā eṣa puruṣo'nnarasamayaḥ" iti śarīrasambandhaśravaṇādaparicchinnānandatvaśravaṇāccetyatrāha  tathā hīti | śarīramupalakṣaṇamātram, na tu viśeṣaṇamiti tadviyogenāparicchinnānandatvādikamupadiśyata ityarthaḥ | tadantarabhūtāṃ ca buddhimiti  prāṇamayamanomayayormayaṭpratyayasya svārthikatvādvijñānamaya ityatrāpi mayaṭ svārthikaḥ, "vijñānaṃ yajñaṃ tanute" iti mayaḍantatvaṃ vinā vakṣyamāṇatvāt, "vijñānasāthiryastu" "budiṃdha tu sārathiṃ viddhi" iti buddhivijñānaśabdayorekārthatvena prayogācca, vijñāyate'neneti vyutpattyā vijñānaṃ buddhiriti bhāvaḥ | kimarthamannamayādinirdeśa ityatrāha  tatra tatra budhdyavataraṇeti | aparicchinnānandatvamapi pariśuddhātmasvarūpasya sambhavatītyarthasiddham | śārīratvaśravaṇāt jīvasāmānādhikaraṇyādvijñānamayaśabdasyāntaḥ karaṇaparatvātprāpyatvādeḥ pariśuddhasvarūpe'pyupapannatvāccharīrasyopalakṣaṇatvena tadviyuktasvarūpeṇa prāpyatvādisambhavānmayaṭpratyayasya svārthikatvena vikāraparatvābhāvācca pariśuddhapratyagātmasvarūpaviṣayamidaṃ vākyamiti pūrvapakṣasaṅgrahaḥ, tatra dvau hetū sādhakau, anye tu śaṅkitadūṣaṇānyathāsiddhirūpāḥ ||
evamānandamayaśabdasya pratyagātmaparatvavādinaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇaṃ sāṅkhayaṃ mṛṣāvādipakṣasthaścodayati  nanu ceti | tasya pucchamiti ṣaṣṭhayā'vayavisambandhapratītessambandhasya dviniṣṭhatayā pratiṣṭhātadvadbhāvena ca vyatirekāvagamādanyatvami tyarthaḥ | pariharati  naivamiti | "anvayaṃ puruṣavidhaḥ" iti śrutivākyasmaraṇārthaṃ puruṣavidhatvarūpitamityuktam | puruṣavidhatvena rūpitam | anatiriktatvamupapādayati  yatheti | prakaraṇe svasmādanatiriktaissvāvayavaiḥ pucchapratiṣṭhātvarūpaṇadarśanādatrāpi pucchapratiṣṭhātvena rūpitaṃ brahma ānandamayādanatiriktamityarthaḥ | ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśaḥ samudāyatadekadeśatvanibandhanatayopapanna iti bhāvaḥ | nanu "ānanda ātmā" ityānando'vayavitvena rūpitaḥ, na tvavayavatvena tatkathamucyate avayavatvena rūpitānāṃ pirayamodapramodānandānāmiti | naiṣa doṣaḥ, ātmaśabdasya svavācitvābhāvāt | kāyasya madhyabhāgo hyātmaśabdavācyaḥ "daśahastyā aṅgulayo daśapādyā dvāvū ḍigrī dvau bāhū pañcaviṃśa ātmā" ityādau tathā prayogadarśanāt | ata eva tasyānanda ātmeti ṣaṣṭhayā vyatirekanirdeśasvārasyaṃ sidhyati, tasmādānando madhyabhāgatvena rūpitaḥ | nanvevamapi pucchatayā nirdiṣṭaṃ brahmetyaṅgīkṛtaṃ syāt | tataḥ kim? tarhi kiṃ nirasanīyam? ānandamayasyābrahmatvam; atastannirāsamukhena pucchasya tadantarbhāvo abhidhīyate | hetvantaramāha  yadi ceti | nanu tasmādvā etasmādānandamayādanyo'ntara ātmā brahmetyantarātmatayaiva bhedo vaktavya iti na hyasti niyamaḥ, "pṛthagātmānaṃ preritāram" "patiṃ viśvasya" ityādivat vyāvarttakākārāntareṇāpyanyatvapratipādanasambhavādityāśaṅkayāha  etaduktamiti | prakaraṇasya tattadantaratayaivānyatvapratipādanaparatvāt tatprakaraṇasthena vākyena tādṛśena bhavitavyami tyarthaḥ | ātmaśabdasya śrutyaiva vyākhyānaṃ kṛtamiti kathamavagamyata iti śaṅkāyāṃ svoktasya svayameva vyākhyānaṃ prakaraṇasiddhamiti darśayitumātmaśabdanirdiṣṭasyaiva brahmatvopapādanopayogitayā ca "brahmavidāpnotī "tyādyuktam | tatra brahmaśabdavyākhyānaṃ satyajñānādivākyam ātmaśabdavyākhyānamānandamaye samāptamastu tataḥ kimānandamayasyaiva brahmatva iti śaṅkāyāṃ brahmaśabdena prakṛtasyaivātmaśabdena nirddiṣṭatvaṃ darśayati  tadeveti | "tasmādvā etasmāt" iti | tadettacchabdau prakṛtaparāmarśināvityabhiprāyaḥ | punaścodayati  nanu ceti | pūrvaṃ prādhānyenoktānāmannamayādīnāṃ ślokeṣu tattacchabdaireva nirddeśo dṛṣṭaḥ, evamatrāpyānandamayaḥ pradhānaścettadviṣayaśloke'pi tacchabdenaiva nirddeṣṭavyam | yadvā yadyānandamaye ātmaśabdavyākhyānaparisamāptiḥ tarhyātmaśabdena nirdeṣṭavyam, tathā ca na kṛtam, api tu brahmaśabdena nirdi ṣṭam | tasmādānandamayasya na prādhānyam ataḥ pucchabrahmaiva pradhānapratipādyamityarthaḥ | brahmaśabdasyānandamayaviṣayatve siddhe brahmaśabdena nirdeśo na doṣa iti śaṅkāmarthātpariharan yuktayantaramāha  na cānandamayasyeti | āśaṅkāśabdenodāhṛtaśrutivākyadvayasthaḥ cedartho vyākhyātaḥ | sarvalokaprasiddhasya durapahnavatvenāsadbhāva iva sadbhāve'pyāśaṅkāvādo na yukta ityarthaḥ | pariharati  naivamiti | brahmātmānandamayaśabdānāmaikārthye niścite ānandamayaśabdanirdeśasamo brahmaśabdanirdeśa iti sphuṭamitibuddhvā ānandamayaprādhānye yuktimāha  idaṃ pucchamiti | prakaraṇasthapūrvaślokānāṃ pucchamātrapratipādanaparatvābhāvādayamapi śloko na pucchamātrapratipādanapara ityarthaḥ | prasiddhānandasya sadbhāvāsadbhāvaśaṅkānupapatiṃta pariharati  ānandamayasyeti | pratibandīmabhipretyāha  pucchabrahmaṇo'pīti | "vijñānamānandaṃ brahma" "ānando brahma" ityādivākyena brahmaṇa ānandarūpatvasyoktatvāt ānandasya ca prasiddhatvāt na tasya sadbhāvāsadbhāvajñānāśaṅkā yukteti codite, tasyānandarūpasya brahmaṇo'viditvamaparicchinnānandatvādeva hi tvayopapādanīyam, tadatrāpi tulyamityarthaḥ | śaṅte  śiraḥ prabhṛtīti | pariharati  brahmaṇa iti | pucchatvamavayavaviśeṣatvam |
pratiṣṭhātvamādhāratvam | brahmaṇo'vayavitvamanupapannamiti cet, avayavatvamapyanupapannamityarthaḥ | avayatvaṃ rūpaṇamātramiti śaṅkate  atheti | pariharati  hanta tarhīti | asukhāditi  asukhavyāvṛttiviśeṣāḥ śiraḥprabhṛtitvena rūpitā ityarthaḥ | satyajñānādivākyena sakaletaravyāvṛttatve siddhe kimatra kriyata ityatrāha  evañceti | satyaśabdanirdiṣṭasya brahmaṇaḥ
