kasyacidvikāratvābhāvādānandamayaśabdavācyatvamapyayuktamityatrāha  tataśceti | tataḥuktānupapattīnāṃ parihṛtatvādupapattyantarasadbhāvāccetyarthaḥ | kiñca "so'kāmayata" itivākye sa iti pulliṅgatacchabdena kāraṇavastunirddeśācca ānandamayaḥ paraṃ brahma "tasmādvā etasmādātmanaḥ" ityātmaśabdanirdiṣṭātmābhiprāyo'yaṃ pulliṅganirddeśa iti cenna, vyavahitādavyavahitasya grāhyatvenānandamayasya grāhyatvāt "brahmapucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā" iti vākyātpaścātpaṭhitasya "tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā" itivākyasthasyātmaśabdasya vyavadhānābhāvāttadabhiprāyaḥ sa iti pulliṅganirdeśaḥ, ānandamayastvetadvākyāpekṣayā vyavahita iti na sa parāmṛśyata iti cenna; "tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā" iti vākyasthasyātmanaḥ sarvaparyāyasādhāraṇatvena etatparyāyasya pradhānapratipādyatvābhāvāt sarvanāmaśabdasya pradhānaparāmarśitvasvārasyācca sa ityānandamaya evocyate | "vijñānaṃ brahmeti vyajānāt" "ānando brahmeti vyajānāt" ityatra "vijñānamayamātmānamupasaṅkramya "ānandamayamātmānamupasaṅkramya" ityatra ca sthānapramāṇenānandānandamayaśabdayorekārthatvāvagamādānandaśabdasya parabrahmaviṣayatvaprasiddheścānandamayaḥ paraṃ brahma | na ca "ānando brahme"tyatrānandaśabdo'pyānandamayaśabdavat bāhyakośapara iti vācyam, "annaṃ brahma" "prāṇo brahma" ityādivijñānānantaramiva "ānando brahma" itivijñānānantaraṃ bhṛgorvaruṇopasattyabhāvāt | na hi "tadvijñāya punareva varuṇāṃ pitaramupasasāra" iti punaḥ śrūyate | etaduktaṃ bhavati "annaṃ brahmeti vyajānāt" ityatra kimannādyupalakṣitabrahmavedanamuktam; uta annamayādau brahmabudhdyavataraṇam? ādye annaṃ brahmeti jñānānantaraṃ varuṇopasattirna syāt, upalakṣaṇabhūtena tena brahmaṇaḥ pratipannatvāt | dvitīye hyānandaviṣayabrahmabuddheryathārthatvaṃ syāt, punarvaruṇopasattyabhāvāditi | kiñca "ānando brahme"tyatrānandaśabdasya brahmaparatvaṃ yuṣmābhireva vyākhyātam, uktaṃ hi śaṃbhā "yā tu bhārgavī vāruṇī vidyā ānando brahmeti vyajānāditi tasyāṃ mayaṭo'śravaṇāt priyaśirastvādyaśravaṇācca yuktamānandasya brahmatvam" iti | ataśca "ānando brahme"tyasya vākyasya paramātmaparatvāt sthānapramāṇena "ānandamayamātmāna"mityatra ānandamayaśabdo'pi paramātmaparaḥ | ānandamayasya śodhyatvañca tadanuguṇasaṃsāranirharaṇādirūpamiti cānusandheyam | pratyagātmasvarūpamevāparicchinnānandarūpañcet kathaṃ jīvānāṃ duḥkhitvasukhitvatāratamyañcopalabhyata iti śaṅkāṃ ca pariharan pūrvapakṣamupasaṃharati  tasmāditi | "tasya priyamiti sambandhavācinyā ṣaṣṭhayā vyatirekapratīterbrahmaviṣayasyoparitanaślokasya ānandamayaviṣayatvābhāvena pucchatayoktabrahmaṇa eva pradhānatvāvagamāt, priyamodādirūpeṇa lokaviditasyānandamayasya sadbhāvāsadbhāvajñānāśaṅkānupapatterniravayavasya paramātmano'vayavitvānupapatteravikārasya vikāritvānupapatteḥ "tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā" ityānandamayaviṣayavākyāvagatasyātmāntarasya paramātmatayā ānandamayasya paramātmatvānupapatteḥ "annamayaprāṇamayamanomayavijñānamayānandamayo me śudhdyantām" iti śrutasya śodhyatvasya nityaśuddhe paramātmanyanupatteśca nānandamayaḥ paramātmā, api tu pucchatayā nirdiṣṭameva brahma paramātmeti pucchabrahmavādahetusaṅgrahaḥ | prakaraṇasya svasmādanatiriktaiḥ svāvayavaiḥ śiraḥpakṣādirūpaṇaparatvāttadantaratayā ātmaśabdavyākhyānasyānandamaye paryavasitatvādannamayādiviṣayāṇāṃ prakaraṇasthaślokanāṃ pucchavadviṣayatvāt kāraṇatvapratipādake "so'kāmayata" ityanantaravākye sa iti pulliṅgāntena pradhānaprakṛtārthaparāmarśinā tacchabdenāvyavahitasyānandamayasyaiva vaktuṃ yuktatvāt, "ānando brahma" ityānandaśabdasya brahmaparatvābhyupagamāt "ānando brahmeti vyajānāt" "ānandamayamātmānamupasaṅgramya" ityānandānandamayaśabdayorekārthatvenānandamayaśabdasyāpi parabrahmaparatvāt ānandamayaśabdatulyārthānandaśabdavācyabrahmajñānānantaraṃ varuṇopasattyaśravaṇāt sūtrasvārasyātsvasmādanatiriktasvāvayavaireva śiraḥpakṣapucchādirūpaṇaparaprakaraṇānuguṇyena ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśasya samudāyasamudāyibhāvanibandhanatvopapatterānandamayātmabrahmaśabdānāmaikārthyena teṣvanyatamena tadviṣayaśloke nirdeśasya yuktatvādaparicchinnānandasyāprasiddhatvena "ānando brahme"tyuktatayā'bhyupetapucchabrahmaṇa iva sadbhāvāsadbhāvaśaṅkāsambhavādavayavatvavat avayavitvena rūpaṇasambhavādānandamaya ityatra mayaṭpratyayasya svārthikatvena prācuryārthatvena vā vikāraparatvābhāvena brahmaṇo nirvikāratvāvirodhāt "tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā" iti vākyasyānanyātmatvapratipādanaparatvāt "annamayaprāṇamayamanomayavijñānamayānandamayā me śudhdyantām" ityatra śodhanaṃ tattadvastvanuguṇaṃ kāryamiti pratyagātmatvapakṣe saṃsāranirharaṇena śodhyatvādatiriktatvapakṣe bhagavataḥ kāluṣyaśāntirūpaśodhyatvasya prapadanasādhyasyopapannatvāccānandamayānatiriktaṃ pucchabrahmetyānandamaya eva paramātmeti pucchabrahmavādanirākaraṇayuktisaṅgrahaḥ, atrādyaṃ hetuṣaṭkaṃ siddhāntasādhakam, itarahetugaṇaśśaṅkitavipakṣayuktiparihāraparaḥ |
asmin parvapakṣe prāpte siddhāntasūtramavatārayati  evaṃ prāpta iti | tatra pratijñāṃśaṃ sādhyasamarpakapadena pūrayan vyā caṣṭe ānandamaya iti | uttarādhikaraṇe "bhedavyapadeśāccānyaḥ, ityanyaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ, iha tadākarṣaṇalabdhārtha uktaḥ  paramātmeti | yadvā pūrvādhikaraṇa sūtrasyayoḥ na aśabdaṃ iti padayoḥ anuṣaṅgaḥ labdhārthamāha  paramātmeti | yasmin śabda eva pramāṇaṃ na bhavati sa hyaśabdaḥ, svayamprakāśapratyakṣānumānādibhiḥ sidhyato jīvasyāpi tadaśabdatvamupapadyate, yathā ātmasiddhau "evamātmā svataḥ sidhyannāgamenānumānataḥ | yogābhyāsabhuvā spaṣṭaṃ pratyakṣeṇa prakāśate" iti | yadvā etadadhikaraṇasūtrastha eva netara iti sādhyāṃśo'trāpi vivakṣita ityabhiprāyeṇoktaṃ paramātmeti | antarātmaparamparāsamāptidyotanāya atra paramātmaśabdena dharmi nirddeśaḥ | abhyāsādānandamayatvaṃ śrutau pratītam, ata ānandamayatvāpekṣayā heturnirdeśaśaṅkāvyudāsāya sādhyāṃśe hetvākāṅkṣāṃ darśayati  kuta iti | nanu bhedavyapadeśasya jīvādanyatve sphuṭataratayā nirapekṣahetutvāt svavākyasthatvācca sa eva prathamaṃ vaktavyaḥ, na tu vākyāntarastho'nugrāhakayuktayapekṣo'bhyāsaḥ, | naivam; svavākyasthādbhedavyapadeśādapi svapadaikadeśamayaḍvācyasya prācuryasyopapādanasāpekṣasyāpyāsannataratvāttadvivaraṇarūpasya niratiśayadaśāśiraskasyābhyāsasyaiva prathamaṃ hetutayā vaktuṃ yuktatvāt | kasyābhyāsādityākāṅkṣāṃ pūrayan hetupadaṃ vyācaṣṭe  saiṣānandasyeti | abhyāsaḥguṇanam, āvṛttiḥ | "yato vāco nivartante" ityasyārthamabhipretya niratiśayadaśāśiraska ityuktam | "sa eko brahmaṇa ānandaḥ, iti vākyasyārthamabhipretya abhyasyamāna ityuktam | śataguṇitottarakrameṇa guṇitatvādityarthaḥ | "sa eko brahmaṇa ānandaḥ" itivākyasya caturmukhānandaviṣayatvena "yato vāca" ityādivākyasyaiva brahmānandaviṣayatvāṅgīkāre'bhyāsāditi hetorvyadhikaraṇatā syāt | kiñca ayaṃ brahmaśabdaḥ paramātmavācakaḥ, brahmaśabdasya bhagavatyeva mukhyatvāt "brahmavidāpnoti" "asti brahmeti" ityādiṣu vākyeṣu parabrahmaparatayaiva brahmaśabdasya prayogakaraṇāt "yato vāco nivartante" iti pūrvottarayorvākyayorānandapratisambandhivāciṣṭhayantabrahmaśabdasya parabrahmaparatvadarśanāt "saiṣānandasya mīmāṃsā" iti prakṛtabrahmānandanigamanasyāpekṣitatvāt "sa yaścāyaṃ puruṣe" iti prakṛtaparāmarśinā'nantaravākyasthena kāraṇaparatacchabdena pūrvavākyasthasyāsya brahmaśabdasya parabrahmaparatvaniścayāt, anyathā caturmukhasya sarvāntarātmatvaparamakāraṇatvaprasaṅgāt, "tadapyeṣa śloko bhavati" iti bhagavadānandaviṣayaślokotthānasya bhagavadānandaprasaṅgāsāpekṣatvāt, nirupapadaprajāpatiśabdasya caturmukhe svarasatvāt, dakṣādiparatve ekavacanasvārasyābhāvāt "devānām" "devagandharvāṇām" indrasya "bṛhaspateḥ" iti bahuṣu vyaktiṣu bahuvacanasyaikaikavyaktiṣu ca ekavacanasya prakaraṇe prayujyamānatvācca | tathā "sa eka prajāpatiloka ānando yaśca śrotriyovṛjino'kāmahato'tha te ye śataṃ prajāpatiloka ānandāssa eko brahmaloka ānando yaśca śrotriyovṛjino'kāmahato'tha eṣa eva para ānanda eṣa brahmalokassamrāḍiti hovāca" iti bṛhadāraṇyakavākyaikārthyācca, "sa eko brahmaṇa ānandaḥ" iti vākyasya paramātmānandaparatvaṃ siddham na ca sa eka iti nirdeśāt brahmānandasya paricchinnatvam, ādhikyamātre vākyatātparyāt, yathā "kṣipteṣuriva sarpati" iti vākyaṃ sūryagatimāndyanivṛttiparam, na tviṣusāmyaparam sūryasya nimeṣamātre bahuyojanātilaṅghitvasya pramāṇasiddhatvāt, tathātrāpi pūrvāparavākyādibhiraparicchinnānandatvasiddheḥ "sa ekaḥ" iti vākyasya caturmukhānandādādhikye tātparyamityavagamyate | yadvā "romakūpeṣvanantāni brahmāṇḍāni bhramanti te" "aṇḍānāntu sahasrāṇāṃsahasrāṇyayutāni ca| īdṛśānāṃ tathā tatra koṭikoṭiśatāni ca "gaṅgāyāḥ sikatā dhārā yathā varṣati vāsare | śakyā gaṇayituṃ loke na vyatītāḥ pitāmahāḥ |" ityādibhiraṇḍānāṃ tatra tatra caturmukhānāṃ cāsaṅkhayeyatvāvagamānniyāmyānniyantuśśataguṇānandatve kathite caturmukhebhyo asaṅkhayātebhyaḥ śataguṇānandatayā'vagatasya bhagavato aparicchinnānandatvamarthasiddhamiti; ato yathokta evārthaḥ | abhyasyamāna iti  abhyāsaśabdaḥ karmārthaghañanta ityabhiprāyaḥ | yadvā bhāvārthatve'pyānandasyābhyastatvaṃ phalitamiti tathoktam | tacca hetorvaiyadhikaraṇyaśaṅkāvyudāsārtham | nanu guṇanamvarddhanam, prajāpatyānando hi śataguṇatvena vardhate, na tu brahmānandaḥ, satyam, tathāpi guṇitaḥ prajāpatyānanda eva brahmānanda ityupacāreṇoktiḥ, vrīhicatuṣṭayaṃ guñjetivat | guṇitatattadānandasadṛśastvekadeśatayā pratipādyamāno brahmānanda ityarthaḥ | yadvā muhurmuhuruktirabhyāsaḥ, tena tātparyaliṅgasattvaṃ sūcitam | astvānandasyāparicchinnatvam, tataḥ kimityatrāha  anantaduḥkheti | anena niratiśayānandaviruddhadharmayoga uktaḥ | parimiteti niratiśayānandābhāva uktaḥ | viruddhadharmopalambhādabhāvopalambhāccāsambhava ityarthaḥ | kathamasambhavaḥ? muktasyāparicchinnānandatvaṃ śrutamityatrāha  nikhilaheyeti | pratyanīkatvamatra nivarttakatvaṃ vivakṣitam muktasyāpi paramātmaprasādādeva hi heyanivṛttipūrvakaniratiśayānandaprāptiḥ, iha ca svata evāparicchinnānandatvamavagamyate, hetvaśravaṇāt niratiśayatvaśravaṇavirodhena hetukalpanāyogācca | na ca muktasya svato'paricchinnānandatvam "atha so'bhayaṃ gato bhavati" "eṣa hyevānandayāti" "rasaṃ hyevāyaṃ labdhvā''nandī bhavati" iti paramātmāyattatvaśruteḥ | na hyevaṃ paramātmānandasyānyādhīnatvaṃ śrutam "śrotriyasya cākāmahatasya" iti muktaḥ pṛthaṅinardiśyate | śrotriyaḥśrutavedāntaḥ | akāmahataḥupāsanānnivṛttasamastakleśaḥ "yaśca śrotriyovṛjino'kāmahataḥ" itiśrutyantaram | muktasya jagadyvāpārābhāvācca parasyaiva svato niratiśayānandayogaḥ | evaṃ niratiśayānandasya jīvātmanyayogyatārūpatarkānugṛhīta ānandamayaśabdaḥ paramātmaviṣaya ityuktaṃ bhavati | na kevalaṃ niratiśayānandatvarūpavastusāmarthyānugṛhītatvādvailakṣaṇyamavagatam, tat kaṇṭhoktaṃ cetyāha  yathāheti | nanu "bhedavyapadeśā"diti sūtrasya viṣayavākyaṃ hīdam | tatra vyākhyāsyamānasyāsya kathamihopādānamarthopapādanaṃ ca? ucyate; niratiśayānandasya jīvātmanyayogyatārūpastarko hyānandamayaśabdasya paramātmaviṣayatvavyavasthāpaka uktaḥ, asya tarkasya anena vākyena garbhitatvāttatsūcakatvenedaṃ vākyamatropanyastam, atra hi etasmāditipadena "vijñānaṃ yajñaṃ tanute | karmāṇi tanute'pi ca" iti pūrvavākyaprakṛtakarmavaśyatvādivaiśiṣṭayaṃ jīvasyābhipretam, dharmivācināpi mayaḍantena vijñānamayaśabdena sarvopādhivinirmuktaṃ svābhāvikarūpamasaṅkucitajñānamityavayavaśaktayā darśitam | anena vākyena svabhāvapariśuddhasyāpi jīvasya karmakṛtānantaduḥkhabhājanasya niratiśayānandāsambhavāt tataḥ paramātmano vilakṣaṇatvaṃ pratipāditamityatredamupāttam, asmin vākye vijñānamayaśabdasya buddhimātraparatvaṃ vyudasyati  vijñānamayo hīti | "yo'yaṃ vijñānamayaḥ prāṇeṣu hṛdyantarjyotiḥ puruṣaḥ" iti śrutiprasiddhidyotako hiśabdaḥ | śabdasvārasyānugrāhakapratyakṣaprasiddhidyotako vā, ahaṃ jānāmīti jñātṛtvaṃ hyātmanaḥ patīyate | jñaptivācino vijñānamayaśabdasya jñāyate'neneti vyutpattyā'ntaḥ karaṇaparatvamasvarasamityabhiprayannāha  na buddhimātramiti | mātracā abhipretaṃ pratyayavaiyarthyaṃ viśadayati  mayaṭpratyayeneti | prakaraṇavaśātsvārthikatvamāśaṅkayāha  prāṇamaye tviti | agatyā vikāraprācuryādyarthāntarāsambhavāt | pakṣe tadvaiṣamyamāha  iha tviti | tadvata iti  prāturyārthatvaṃ sambhavatītyarthaḥ | nātra mayaḍarthassambhavati, jñaptimātrasvarūpo hyātmā, jñātṛtvaṃ hi kālpanikam, muktāvasthāyāṃ tadapi nāstītyāha  baddha iti | prāṇamayādau svārthikatvamabhyupagamya parihāra uktaḥ | atha tadeva nāstītyāha  prāṇamayādāviti | vijñānamayaśabdasya tadviṣayaślokasthavijñānaśabdasamānārthatvāt mayaṭ svārthika ityabhiprāyeṇa pṛcchati  kathaṃ tarhīti | upapadyatena hi vijñānasya vijñānāntarāśrayatvaṃ sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | vijñānamayaśabdasya jñātari pravṛttau nimittaṃ darśayati  jñātureveti | evakāraśśaṅkitavirodhābhāvadyotakaḥ, apiśabdaḥ svarūpadharmayornimittasādhāraṇyaparaḥ | jñātṛśabdatulyārthatayā'pi nirvāhaṃ darśayati  jñānaiketi | tataḥ kimityatrāha  svarūpeti | svarūpanirūpaṇadharmaśabdāḥayutasiddhadharmavāciśabdāḥ | ākṛtinayaviṣayatayā sampratipannaṃ śabdaṃ nidarśayati  gavādīti | evaṃ sūtranyāyābhyāṃ dvidhā nirvāha uktaḥ | atha śābdamaryādayā dvidhā nirvāhamāha  kṛtyeti | prathame kartṛparatvaṃ kalpanīyam | dvitīye gaṇāntarbhāvaḥ kalpanīya ityubhayatrāśrayaṇaśabdaprayogaḥ | pratyakṣānuguṇyāt śrutyantarapratyabhijñānāt prathamaśrutatvātprakṛtisvārasyāt pratyayānarthakyānupapatteśca prabalavijñānamayaśabdānurodhena vijñānaśabdo nirvāhya iti bhāvaḥ | svavākyasthaṃ yuktayantaramāha  ata eveti | ata evavijñānaśabdasya cetanaparatvādevetyarthaḥ | yajñādikartṛtve śrute kathaṃ vijñānaśabdavācyasya cetanatvamityatrāha  buddhimātrasyeti | boddhureva hi kartṛtvaṃ pratyakṣaśrutibhissūtraiśca siddhamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu sarveṣāṃ svavyāpārakartṛtvamasti | satyam, nātra tāvanmātraṃ vivakṣitam, kintu cetanāsādhāraṇaḥ kartṛtvaviśeṣaḥ prayatnādhāratvalakṣaṇaḥ, yajñādikartṛtvamiti hyuktam |atra vijñānaśabdasvārasyamubhayorapyaviśiṣṭam, yajñādikartṛtvāsvārasyaṃ tu parasyādhikam | nanu "adyate'tti ca bhūtāni" ityannamaya iva prākaraṇikamaupacārikaṃ kartṛtvamupakaraṇatvāviśeṣāt buddherapi syādityatrāha  acetaneṣu hīti | bādhakābhāve sati upacāra eva doṣaḥ, sa ca prakaraṇānuvṛttaścet soḍhavyaḥ syāt, na ca tadanuvṛttiḥ, prāṇamaye manomaye ca tasya vicchinnatvādityabhiprāyaḥ | vijñānaśabdasya cetanaparatve prayogāntaraṃ darśayati  ata eva cetanamiti | ata eva vijñānaśabdasya cetanaparatvādevetyarthaḥ | cetanamacetanaṃ ceti  na hyantaḥkaraṇānantaḥkaraṇavibhāgo'tra kriyate, kintu cidacidvibhāga eveti bhāvaḥ | kuta ityatrāha  nilayanatveti | acidvikāraviśeṣasyāntaḥkaraṇasya "jīvabhūtāṃ mahāvāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat" iti prakāreṇa cetanadhāryasya viśvanilayanatvāyogāt pareṇa tasya satyatvānabhyupagamācceti bhāvaḥ | vijñānaśabdasya saṃvitparatvamapyayuktam, "anupraviśye"tyanenānupraveśaśravaṇāt na hi saṃvidrūpa ātmā ātmāntaravyāpyatayā'bhimataḥ parasya | vijñānaśabdasya cetanaparatve prayogāntaraṃ darśayati  tatheti | vijñānasyātmaśabdasthāne śrutatvādantaḥkaraṇaparatvamanupapannam | na cātmaśabdo'pyantaḥkaraṇaparaḥ, vijñānaśabdavattasyāpitatrāsvarasatvāt | yathā jñāyate'nenati vyutpattyā''śrayaṇaṃ vijñānaśabdasya kliṣṭam tadvaccetanavyatirikteṣvātmaśabdo'pi hyasvarasaḥ | antaḥkaraṇaparatve vijñānātmaśabdayordvayorapyasvārasyam, cetanaparatve tu vijñānaśabdamātrāsvārasyam, na tu dvayoriti viśeṣaḥ | atrātmaśabdasya paramātmatayā svābhimatasaṃvitparatvañca pareṇa durvacam, "ya ātmani tiṣṭhan" ityatrātmāntarasthitiśravaṇāt, ātmāntaravyāpyasya paramātmatvāsiddheḥ, sarvatra prayuktasya vijñānaśabdasya lyuṭpratyayāntatve viśeṣyānuguṇaliṅgatvādātmaviṣayasya tasya kathaṃ napuṃsakatvamityatrāha  vijñānamiti | upapāditamarthaṃ paramasādhyena ghaṭayati  tadevamiti | tatuktopapattibhiḥ | evamvijñānaśabdasya cetanaparatvasiddherityarthaḥ | ślokasthavijñānaśabdasya jñātṛparatvopapādanena vijñānamayaśabdasya jñātṛparatvamuktam | atha ślokasya jñātṛparatvābhāve'pi vijñānamayaśabdasya jñātṛparatvamāha  yadyapīti | mayaḍrahitavākye tadarthaḥ parityakta iti tadvatyapi vākye sa na tyājya ityarthaḥ | tarhi brāhmaṇasya ślokasya ca kathamaikārthyamityatrāha  yatheti | pūrvavākyoktārthaikadeśaviṣayatvāt ślokasya tadaikārthyam, yathā'nnamayaviṣayaślokasyetyarthaḥ | tanmaya iti śrutivākyagatamayaḍarthānuvādaḥ | tadvikāra iti tadyvākhyānam | uktārthajātasya utsūtratvaśaṅkāṃ pariharan vyākhyāsyamānasūtropayogitvañca darśayitumāha  etatsarvamiti | "tasmādvā etasmādvijñānamayāt" iti vākyaṃ jīvaparayorbhedapratipādakaṃ vadan sūtrakāro vijñānaśabdasya jñātṛparatvaṃ tadupapattiśca hṛdi nidadhadeva vadatītyarthaḥ | pūrvapakṣe jīvasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ śārīratvaśravaṇaṃ ca hetudvayamuktam, tatra sāmānādhikaraṇyasya bhedāvahatvamupapādayituṃ yaduktamityādinopadiśyata ityantenānūditaṃ pūrvapakṣahetuṃ dūṣayati  tadayuktamiti | prākaraṇikavākyaissamānādhikaraṇapadaprātipadikāṃśena ca viruddhadharmādhyāsapratipattyābhedasiddheḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭaheturiva paroktaheturna sādhyasādhaka iti dūṣaṇaṃ vaktuṃ tatpadopasthāpyaviśeṣasamarpakaiḥ prākaraṇikavākyaiḥ parābhimataikyaviruddhabhedasidiṃdha darśayati  jīvasyeti | pralayadaśāyāmupasaṃhṛtakaraṇakalebarasya karmavaśyasya saṅkalpamātreṇa | kathaṃ veti  prātipadikāvagataviśeṣaṇānvayaḥ kathamityarthaḥ | nirastetyādipadaistatpadaprātipadikāvagataviśeṣaṇānvayo darśitaḥ "tadaikṣata" "asṛjata" iti yathāsaṅkalpaṃ jagatsṛṣṭiśravaṇena prathamaśiraḥparigrahaṃ śaṅkate  heyapratyanīketi | heyamduḥkham | mithyāpratibhāsaḥbhrāntijñānam | svataśśuddhasya paṭasyaupādhikamālinyavat paramārthato nirmalasya sphaṭikasyādhyāsādaruṇimavacca brahmaṇo nirdoṣakalyāṇaguṇaikatānatvaṃ heyasambandhaśca svābhāvikaupādhikavibhāgena paramārthāparamārthavibhāgena vā aviruddham, ubhayorapi svābhāvikatvasatyatvābhyupagame hi virodha iti śaṅkābhipretā | dūṣayati vipratiṣiddhamiti | vipratiṣedhamupapādayati  avidyāśrayatvamiti | na kevalaṃ duḥkhameva heyam, api tu taddhetatpratibhāsāvapi heyāvityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha  tatsambandhitvamiti | avidyātatkāryaduḥkhatatpratibhāsarūpaheyānāmāśrayatvaṃ tatpratyanīkatvañca viruddhamityarthaḥ sambandhamithyātvādavirodhaṃ śaṅkate  tathāpīti | tathāpiavidyādīnāṃ heyatve'pi | tasya āśrayatvarūpasambandhasyetyarthaḥ | dūṣayati  mithyābhūtamapīti | āśrayatvaṃ mithyābhūtamapyapuruṣārtha ityarthaḥ | apuruṣārthatvamupapādayati  yannirasanāyeti | tataḥ kimityatrāha  nirasanīyeti | cennirasanīyatvābhāvācchāstrārambhavaiyarthyam, apurūṣārthatvamasti ceddheyapratyanīkatvavyāghāto duṣparihara iti | tadvirodhe'pi heyasambandhasya śrutibalādabhyupagantavyatvaṃ śaṅkate  kiṃ kurma iti | pariharati  śrutopapattaya iti | anupapannamtarkaparāhatam | viruddhampramāṇaviruddham | "apahatapāpmā" "viśoko vijaghatsaḥ" "eṣa hi sarvebhyaḥ pāpmabhya uditaḥ" "anaśnannanyaḥ" "anīśayā śocati muhyamānaḥ | juṣṭaṃ yadā paśyatyanyamīśam" "anārtāṃ devatāṃ prapadye" ityādiśrutivirodhaḥ | ekasmin heyapratyanīkatvaheyāspadatvādiviruddhadharmānvayānupapattistarkavirodhaḥ | śiro'ntaraṃ śaṅkate  atheti | dūṣayati  hantaivamiti | śāstrasya prayojanaparyavasāyitvābhāvādaprāmāṇyaṃ prasajedityartaḥ | parasya siddhāntabhūtamubhayaprahāṇaṃ śaṅkate  athaitaditi | pariharati  aho bhavatāmiti | arthaniṣkarṣopayuktapadadvayavākyaitatprakaraṇaprakaraṇāntaropaniṣadantarapramāṇāntaratarkasāmānādhikaraṇyanirūpaṇaṃ paryālocanam | prathamametatprakaraṇopakramavirodhaṃ darśayati  eketi | sarvasatyatve'pi kathaṃ setsyatītyatrāha  yathaiketi | paramārthaviṣayamithyāviṣayatve jñānayorvairūpyaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ  tadantargatañceti | pariṣadjñānena tadgataḥ puruṣā hi jñātā bhavanti, na tu tadbahiṣṭhā iti bhāvaḥ | jñānasya tadarngatatvaṃ tadviṣayāntargatatvam | yadvā tadarngatamsarvamiti śeṣaḥ | paramārthaviṣayaṃ tadantargatamityuktamarthaṃ vyatirekeṇopapādayati  na hi paramārtheti | na hi śuktirajatayorekadhīviṣayatvamityartaḥ | ekatvasarvatvāvasthābhede satyapi dharmaikyādekavijñānena sarvavijñānamupapadyate, jñātatvasarvatve hyekāśrayatvartinī, na hi jñātatvaviśiṣṭākāreṇa sarvatvam, sarvatvaviśiṣṭākāreṇa jñātatvaṃ vā, prāgevāyaṃ mayā jñāta ityapi hi dharmimātrasyaiva jñātatvam, na tvetadavasthāviśeṣaviśiṣṭasya, deśakālādibhedāt | na hi pūrvametatkālādiviśiṣṭatayā jñātatvam brahmaikameva satyamiti jñāte anyanmithyātvena jñātaṃ syāditi śaṅkate  athocyeteti | pariharati  na tarhīti | sarvaṃ mithyātvena jñātaṃ bhavatīti vā sarvaṃ nivṛttaṃ bhavatīti vā śrūyetetyarthaḥ | evañcārthe sati mithyātvenetipadasyādhyāhāraḥ, dharmyantaraviṣayatayā jñānaśabdayorvairūpyam, svarasataḥ prāptaṃ hi jñānaikarūpyam, tacca bhajyate, jñātaṃ bhavatīti jñātṛjñeyatadavacchinnajñānābhāvānnivṛttilakṣaṇā ceti doṣatrayamabhipretam, śrūyamāṇānvayaprakārasya paraviruddatāmāha  yeneti | evaṃ pratijñāvākyāsvārasyamuktam | atha dṛṣṭāntavākyānanuguṇatvamāha  kāraṇatayeti | aghaṭitatvamupapādayati  mṛtipaṇḍeti | na hi śuktijñānādrajatanivṛttitvamṛtpiṇḍajñānāt ghaṭādinivṛttinirdarśiteti bhāvaḥ | dṛṣṭāntāvirodhaṃ śaṅkate  tatrāpīti | prasiddhavadupanyāsānupapattyā dūṣayati  mṛdvikārasyeti | mṛdvikārāsatyatvamanumānādinā'vagatamityatrāha  na ceti | ananugṛhītamiti jvālaikyabuddhivadāpātapratītimātrajanakaṃ vivakṣitam | uparitanavākyāparyālocanāṃ darśayati  tatheti | sadāyatanatvaphalitaṃ svapravatrtyatvaṃ svenaiva jīvanañca | praśāsanena hi dhāraṇam; dhṛtyā ca tajjīyanam | niṣedhāya guṇānuvāda iti śaṅkāyāḥ vyudāsāyāha  śāstraiketi | na hi vidheranuvāditvamiti bhāvaḥ | śrutyantarāparyālocanāṃ darśayati  tatsambandhitayā prakaraṇāntareṣvapīti | apahatapāpmatvādirūpā nirastanikhiladoṣatetyarthaḥ | apūrvatālakṣaṇaṃ guṇeṣu tātparyaliṅgaṃ darśayituṃ sakaletarapramāṇaviṣayā ityuktam | tataḥ kimityākāṅkṣāṃ pūrayan padadvayaparyālocanābhāvaṃ darśayati  evamiti | evamananyagocarānantaviśeṣaviśiṣṭaprakṛtetyanena prākaraṇikavākyavirodho vivakṣitaḥ | prakṛtabrahmaparāmarśitacchabdasyetyanena yatra kvāpi prakṛtākāraviśiṣṭaparāmarśitayā tacchabdavyutpattivirodha uktaḥ | tvaṃpadasyāpi vastumātraparatve mukhyātharprahāṇamāha  tvaṃpadañceti | svābhimukhaścetanaḥ tvaṃśabdārthaḥ | ābhimukhyaṃ ca svavākyabodhyatvam, bodhyatvaṃ cājñasya saṃsāriṇaḥ svataḥ prāptamiti bhāvaḥ | tasādbodhanārhatopayogyākāraviśiṣṭaḥ tvamarthaḥ | ataḥ sa parityaktau bhavati | pramāṇatarkāparyālocanā pūrvoktetyāha  nirviśeṣeti | padadvayanimittaprahāṇe nirviśeṣatvasya buddhisthatvāttadanupapattirūpakartāparyālocanaṃ darśitam | sāmānādhikaraṇyabalānnivirśeṣavastvamabhagayupagama iti śaṅkāyāṃ padadvayalakṣaṇālakṣaṇaṃ dūṣaṇamāha  evañceti | evañca sati  nirviśeṣasvarūpopasthāpanaparatve mukhyārthasaṃbandhitayā vastumātrāvabodhane'bhyupagate lakṣaṇāsvīkāra ityarthaḥ ||
atha paramatamupanyasyati  athocyeti | samānādhikaraṇavṛttānāmityādi granthaḥ pakṣaviṣayasaṅgraharūpaḥ | viśeṣaṇāṃśe tātparyāsaṃbhavāditi | anyathā viśeṣaṇabahutvādekārthatvāsiddheriti bhāvaḥ | pūrvamapyuktādevetyevakārābhiprāyaḥ | prathamasūtre hi bahuśa uktaḥ | yadvā anyanairapekṣyapara evakāraḥ | na lakṣaṇaprasaṅga iti | vācyābahirbhūtapratipādanāditi bhāvaḥ | evaṃ pakṣaviṣaye saṅkṣepeṇoktamatharmupapādayati  yathetyādinā | tatra mahābhāṣyokte'pyudāharaṇe viśeṣaṇāṃśe tātparyāsambhavaṃ siddhaṃ kṛtvā udāhṛtaḥ | kathaṃ tatra viśeṣaṇāṃśāvivakṣetyatrāha  tadvivakṣāyāmiti | prasaktasyāniṣṭatāṃ darśayati  tattviti | yugapadabhidhāne udveśyopādeyavibhāgahāniprasaṅgāt padadvayaprakṛtyupasthāpitaviśiṣṭaikye samānavibhaktayā pratipādyamāne viśeṣyāṃśasyeva viśeṣaṇabhūtajātiguṇāṃśayorapyaikyaprasaṅgācca krameṇābhidhānapakṣo'bhyupagantavya iti hṛdi nidhāyāha  na hīti | kramapakṣe'pi pūvarpadapratipannākāraviśiṣṭasya padāntarapratipannākāraviśiṣṭavastutādātmyaṃ kiṃ samānavibhaktayā bodhyam? uta pūrvapadapratipanne viśiṣṭe viśeṣaṇāntarānvaya? iti vikalpamabhipretya prathame viśeṣaṇabhūtajātiguṇayorapyaikyaprasaṅgaṃ siddhaṃ buddhvā dvitīye śirasyonyasamavāyaprasa ṅgamāha  jātiguṇayoriti | tātparyabahiṣṭasyāpi viśeṣaṇasyopayogaṃ darśayan phalitamāha  ata iti | nīlotpalamityatra viśeṣaṇānvaye sphuṭepi tātparyābhāva uktaḥ, tatra viśeṣaṇānvayasyāsphuṭatvādviśeṣaṇānvaye spaṣṭatātparyābhāvamudāharaṇāntaraṃ darśayati  tatheti | viśiṣṭavācinaśśabdasya viśiṣṭaparityāgena viśiṣṭaikedeśatayā tatsambandhini viśeṣyasvarūpamātre vṛttirlakṣaṇaiva syādityatrāha  yadyapīti | pariharati  tathāpīti | vācye'rthena hi śaktiviṣayādviśiṣṭādbahirbhataṃ viśeṣyamiti bhāvaḥ | pradhānāṃśasyeti  tātparyaviṣayatayā dharmitayā ca pradhānasya viśeṣyāṃśasyāvarjanādapradhānaviśeṣaṇatyāge'pyaṅgulyādivikale puruṣaśabdasyeva na lakṣaṇeti bhāvaḥ | mukhyārthatve tulye'pi viśiṣṭapratipādanadaśāto vailakṣaṇyaṃ darśayati  api tviti | avivakṣāmātramiti  aśakye kvacidyvāpārābhāvāt vyāpāraviṣayāṃśe'pi na hyaśaktiriti bhāvaḥ | pūrvaṃ pakṣe lakṣaṇābhāva uktaḥ, idānīṃ sapakṣe viśādīkṛto bhavati | viśeṣaṇāvivakṣāyāmasvārasyaṃ syādityatrāha  sarvatreti | sāmānādhikaraṇyamutpatterīdṛśatvānnāsvārasyam,
vyutpattyananurodhe sati hyasvārasyam, ata aikārthyavyutpattivirodhiviśeṣaṇavivakṣāyāmevāsvārasyamiti bhāvaḥ | imaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ pratikṣipati  tadidamasāramiti | prathamaṃ caramoktatayā buddhisthaṃ vyutpattyantarāśrayaṇaṃ nirasyati  sarveṣveveti | sarveṣusamānādhikaraṇeṣu vyadhikaraṇeṣu ca vākyeṣvityarthaḥ | gāmānaya kāṃ badhānetyādivyadhikaraṇavākyeṣu, na hi prativākyaṃ padānāmarthabhedavyutpattikalpanam "kaptakalpyavirodhe tu yuktaḥ kaptaparigrahaḥ" iti nyāyena kaptavyutpattyaiva svārthabodhanasambhave vyutpattyantarakalpanānupapatteḥ, tathā samānādhikaraṇavākyeṣvapi na padānāṃ vyutpattyantaraṃ pravṛttinimittāviśiṣṭārthaviṣayaṃ kalpanīyamiti bhāvaḥ | vyutpattyantarābhāve'pi vākyānāṃ parasparavaiṣamyasambhavopapādanaparaṃ vyutpattisiddhārthasaṃsargaviśeṣamātramitipadam | vyutpattisiddhārthasaṃsargaviśeṣādvākyavaiṣamyam, na tu prakṛtyaṃśasya vyutpattyanavagatārthāntarakalpanādityabhiprāyaḥ | evaṃ sarvavākyasādhāraṇaṃ rūpamuktam, anena samānādhikaraṇavākyeṣu phalitamarthamāha  tatreti | tatrateṣu vākyeṣu | samānādhikaraṇapadānāṃ viśiṣṭaikārthapratītihetutvamudāharaṇena darśayati yatheti | pratyakṣaviṣayaṃ parokṣaviṣayañca udāharaṇadvayam, ata eva hyānīyate pratīyata ityuktam, kārakavibhatyantatvaṃ na sāmānādhikaraṇyavirodhītyabhiprāyeṇa nīlamutpalamānayetyuktam | nīlimādiviśiṣṭamevānīyata iti | samānādhikaraṇapadasamudāyo vastumātrapratyāyakaścet vastumātratvāviśeṣādanīlamapyānīyetetyabhiprāyaḥ | kiñca samānādhikaraṇapadānāṃ viśeṣaṇaparityāge ko hetuḥ | samānavibhaktayāvagatamaikyamiti cenna | prātipadikāvagataviśeṣaṇānvayabalāt samānavibhaktiraikyaṃ na pratipādayet | tadeva yuktam; vibhaktayarthādapi prātipadikārthaprādhānyāt, "aditiḥ pāśān" "grahaṃ saṃmāṣṭa" ityādiṣu hi vibhaktayartho'nādṛtaḥ | aikyaviṣayaprayogadarśanādaikyaviṣayamiti cet; viśeṣaṇānvaye'pi prayogadarśanādviśeṣaṇānvayamapi pratipādayati | śābdapratītirvastumātrasyaiva; viśeṣaṇānvayastu pratyakṣabalāt svīkriyate | pratyakṣāgocare tu yathāśabdaṃ na viśeṣaṇapratītiriti cenna | viśeṣaṇānvayaḥ śābdapratītiviṣayaḥ aivayaṃ tu pratyakṣabalādaṅgīkriyata iti kiṃ na syāt | pratyakṣāgocare'pi devadattaḥ śyāmo yuvetyādiprayogeṣvaikyadhīdarśanādaikyaṃ śabdapratītiviṣaya iti cet tatraiva parokṣaviṣayaprayoge viśeṣaṇānvayasyāpi pratīterviśeṣaṇānvayaḥ śābda eva; na pratyakṣasiddha iti | itthaṃ pratyakṣaparokṣavibhāgarahitaṃ samānādhikaraṇapadānāmanekaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaikārthabodhakatvaṃ dṛśyata iti caramaparvābhiprāyeṇodāharaṇadvayaṃ darśitam | tasmāt, "ya eva laukikāsta eva vaidikāḥ" iti lokavadādhikaraṇanyāyena vedāntavākyeṣvapi padadvayāvagataviśeṣaṇāparityāgenaivārthaḥ pratipattavya ityāha  evaṃ vedānteti | anyonyasamavāyaprasaṅgaṃ pariharati  na ceti | aruṇādhikaraṇe vistareṇa parihāro vakṣyata iti atra saṃkṣiptaḥ | na hi, yathā'nupapattiḥ syāt tathā vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥ | yugapadabhidhānaṃ hṛdi nidhāya sarvairviśeṣaṇaiḥ svarūpameva viśeṣyamityuktam |
sarvaviśeṣaṇaiḥ svarūpasya viśeṣyatve'nuguṇaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇamityāha  tathā hīti | na hi viśeṣaṇāntaraviśiṣṭākāre viśeṣaṇāntarānvapratipādanaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamityuktamityarthaḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇagranthaṃ vivṛṇoti  anvayena nivṛttyā veti | anvayarūpātharsya vyāvṛttirūpārthatvaṃ na kalpyam, yathāvyutpatti anvayamukhena vyāvṛttimukhena vā vastunaḥ padāntarapratipādyākārādākārāntarayuktatāpratipādanaṃ samānādhikaraṇapadasamudāyakāryamityarthaḥ | tatrodāharati  yatheti | anvayamukhenānekapravṛttinimittavaiśiṣṭayohāharaṇaṃ  śyāmo yuveti | vyatirekamukhenānekākārānvayodāharaṇam adīna ityādi | dīnatvam  abhāsvaramana skatvam | kṛpaṇatvamnirdhanatvam | atrāyamarthaḥ, krameṇābhidhāne vyadhikaraṇavākyeṣvapi karaṇakārakaviśiṣṭe'dhikaraṇakārānvayaḥ syāt, tadviśiṣṭe itarakārakānvayo vā prasatedityanyonyaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvacodyaṃ vyadhikaraṇavākye'pi samānam | tatra yaḥ parihārasya evātrāpi, tathāpi "padajātaṃ śrutaṃ sarvaṃ smāritānanvitārthakam | nyāyasampāditavyakti paścādvākyārthabodhakam" | ityuktaprakāreṇa smaraṇadaśāyāṃ sarvaiḥ padaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak svārthasmaraṇānna viśeṣaṇānāmanyonyasamavāyaprasaṅgaḥ, parāmarśadaśāyāṃ copapannaṃ bhavati yathā tathā parāmarśānnāyaṃ prasaṅgaḥ | paścādyugapatsarvaiḥ padairvākyārthabodhanānna mithassamavāyaprasaṅgaḥ, tasmātsamānādhikaraṇapadairyugapattattatpravṛttinimittaviśiṣṭaikaviśeṣyapratipādanena kramābhāvānnānyonyasamavāya iti | sarvairviśeṣaṇaiḥ svarūpameva viśeṣyamiti granthe ayamartho'bhipretaḥ, atra sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇagranthopādānena anyadapi codyaṃ parihṛtaṃ bhavati, yugapadabhidhāne viśiṣṭayoraikyaṃ samānavibhaktiḥ pratipādayatīti viśiṣṭaikyavat viśeṣaṇaikyamapi syāditi codyam | atra parihāraḥ, "ekasminnarthe vṛttissāmānādhikaraṇyam" iti samānavibhaktayā viśeṣyasyaivaikyapratipādanānna viśeṣaṇaikyamiti | nanu viśeṣaṇe viśeṣye cāviśeṣaṇe prātipadikenāvagate sati samānavibhaktirviśeṣyamātraikyaparā, na tu viśeṣaṇaikyapareti kiṃ niyāmakamiti cet; samānavibhaktiraikyabodhikā, na tu bhedabodhiketi kiṃ niyāmakam? vyutpattiriti cet sā'trāpi tulyā | kiñca padāntarāsamānādhikṛte ghaṭa itipade prayukte tatsthā vibhaktiḥ prātipadikāvagatānāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatatsambandhānāmaikyaṃ na pratipādayati viśeṣyamātraikyameva pratipādayatīti kiṃ niyāmakam? pratyakṣamūlā hi vyutpattiḥ, pratyakṣañca viśeṣyamātraikyaṃ darśayati, na tu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatatsambandhānāmaikyam, ataḥ pratyakṣamūlā vyutpattirniyāmiketi cet, saivā'trāpi niyāmiketi tulyamiti | evaṃ sarvatra vyutpattisiddho'rtha eva svīkāryaścenna kvacidapi vṛttyantarakalpanaṃ vyutpattyantarakalpanaṃ vā syādityatrāha  yatra tviti | viśeṣaṇadvayamiti tritvāderapyupalakṣaṇam, vyutpattisiddhārthasvīkāra eva sarvatra svataḥ prāptaḥ, tasya pramāṇavirodhādanvayāyogyatve sati vṛttyantarakalpanaṃ prāptam, tadasambhave vyutpattyantarakalpanam, gośabdasya kiraṇavācitve vṛttyantarābhāvāddhi śaktikalpanam, yadā vṛttyantarakalpanaṃ tadānīmapyanyatarapadasyāmukhyatvakalpanam, tāvataiva virodhasamanāt, na punassarveṣāṃ padānām, tātparyaniścāyakābhāvaprasaṅgāt | gaurvāhīka iti prayoge gaupadasyaiva hyamukhyatvam, na tu vāhīkapadasyāpi anyatarapadasya vṛttyantarakalpane'pi na nirviśeṣavastuparatvam, mukhyavṛttyupanītaviśeṣaṇānanvaye'pi vṛttyantaropanītaviśeṣaṇānvayādityabhiprāyaḥ | nīlotpalādivākyeṣu vṛttyantarakalpanahetureva nāstītyāha  nīleti | viśeṣaṇabhedena viśeṣyabhedaṃ śaṅkate  atha manuṣa iti | viśeṣaṇapratisambandhitvamviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭatā | ekaviśeṣaṇapratisambandhitvena nirūpyamāṇamiti bhāvapradhānanirdeśaḥ | nirūpyamāṇatvaṃ vivakṣitam | ekaviśeṣaṇapratisambandhitvaṃ viśeṣaṇāntarapratisambandhitvāt vilakṣaṇamityarthaḥ | yadvā ekaviśeṣaṇapratisambandhitvena nirūpyamāṇaṃ vastu viśeṣaṇāntarapratisambandhitvāddhetostasmādviśeṣaṇāntaraviśeṣyātpadārthādvilakṣaṇamityarthaḥ | viśeṣaṇapratisambandhitvabhedādviśeṣyasvarūpabhedaṃ nidarśayati  ghaṭapaṭayoriveti | yathā ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭatāyāḥ paṭatvaviśiṣṭatāyāśca bhedena tadviśiṣṭayorghaṭapaṭayorviśeṣyayorbhedaḥ tathā viśeṣaṇāntarānvayasyānyaviśeṣaṇānvayasya ca bhedena tadviśeṣyayośca bhedaḥ samānavibhaktinirdeśe satyapyavarjanīya iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na viśiṣṭaikyapratipādanakṣamamityarthaḥ | na viśiṣṭapratipādanaparatvamiti  viśeṣaṇānvayapratīteravarjanīyatve'pi na tatra tātparyamiti bhāvaḥ | viśeṣaṇatyāge tatpratisambandhiviśeṣyopasthāpanāyogāttadaikyamapi duṣpratipādamityatrāha  api tviti | tātparyāviṣayasyāpi viśeṣaṇasya parāmarśadaśāpratītimātreṇa tadviśeṣyapratītisiddhestadaikyapratipādanaṃ sambhavatītyarthaḥ | pariharati  syādetaditi | yatrāyogyatvamabhyupagataṃ tatrāpi viśeṣaṇa tvameva hyayogyatve prayojakam, ato nīlatvādiviśeṣaṇamapi viruddhaṃ syādityatrāha  ayogyatā ceti | pramāṇāntarasiddheti  na punarviśeṣaṇatvaprayuktamayogyatvamiti bhāvaḥ | pramāṇāntaramapi ghaṭatvapaṭatvayorbhinnādhikaraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ virodhamavagamayati, nīlatvopalatvayorapi sa virodhastulyaḥ, ṣaṭpade kumude ca pṛthakdarśanādityatrāha  nīlamutpalamityādiṣviti | na kevalaṃ bhinnāśrayatvamātraṃ virodhaḥ, api tu tanniyamaḥ, na ca nīlatvotpalatvayostādṛśavirodhaḥ, kvacitsahapratītatvāditi bhāvaḥ | daṇḍitveti  daṇḍādikaṃ yutasiddham, rūpādikamayutasiddham, evaṃ kāṇḍadvayavākyavirodhamutsargāpavādanyāyena parihṛtya pūrvapakṣiṇotthāpitaṃ kalpasūtrādi vākyavirodhamiti tainaiva nyāyena pariharatitredheti| idamatra virodhābhāsopapādanaṃ "karmacodanā brāhmaṇāni" ityupakramya " brāhmaṇaśeṣo'rthavādo nindā praśaṃsā parakṛtiḥ purākalpaśca" iti caturṇāmapyarthavādānāṃ brāhmaṇaśeṣatmāha bhagavānāpastambaḥ|evamanyadapi draṣṭavyam| tathā ca kathamarthavādānāṃ vidhiśeṣatvamantareṇa brahmaṇi prāmāṇyamucyate? atrottaramāha dattottaramiti| ayamarthaḥ  arthavādānāṃ vidhiśeṣatvavacanaṃ sāmānyam| atra punarbrahmaviṣayārthavādānāṃ svātantreṇa prāmāṇyakathanaṃ tasyaivāpavādaḥ| atastenaivotsargāpavādanyāyena virodhapraśamanāt smṛtivirodhakathanamanupālabhya eva| tamevotsargāpavādanyāyamajānānasya śiṣyasya viśeṣataḥ prakaṭayatisāmānyeti| imamevārthaṃ tadvākyasthenaiva dṛṣṭāntenopapādayati tata iti| tasminneva hyāpastambavākye mantravidhyoḥ parasparamanyatvaṃ hyupari kathyate " tato 'nye mantrāḥ" iti| "tataḥ" vidhyarthavādābhyāṃ "anye mantrāḥ" iti| etattu sāmānyameva mantrāṇāmapi vidhāyakatvasvīkārāt|mantro hi vidhatta iti hyāhustāntrikāḥ| tena mantrāṇāṃ vidhyanyatvavacanam utsargaḥ, vidhāyakatvavacanamapavāda iti bhavadbhiḥ parigṛhyate|tadvadatrāpi brāhmaṇaśeṣatvavacanamutsargaḥ svātantryeṇa pratipadakatvavacanamapavāda iti parigṛhya parituṣyatu bhavān||
bahuṣu prāmāṇyahetuṣu vidyāmāneṣu dūṣaṇamupaniṣadvākyānāṃ virīśvaramīmāṃsakānāṃ sāhasameva tadvyahāranibandhanamiti pratipādayan sarvanigamamārgāpalāpapratibandīmāracayati āmnātairiti|vede "kārīryā vṛṣṭikāmo yajeta " iti dṛṣṭaphavākyānusāreṇa " svargakāmo yajeta" ityadṛṣṭaphalavākyānāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ parikalpyate| aviguṇasaphalairiti karmakartṛsādhanavaiguṇyādeva kvacitkārīryādiṣu phalāsiddhirityarthaḥ| śākunacyotiṣādyairiti yathāhi aviguṇasaphalairvedoktaiḥ kārīryādibhiḥ phalasiddhiḥ tathaivāviguṇasaphalaiḥ kunajyotiṣādyairvedoktairapi phalasiddhirvarṇyata eva| tena vede prāmāṇyaṃ dṛṣṭaphaleṣu kvacitpratīyate| tathā śiṣṭānāmadṛṣṭārthapravṛttyā 'pi vedaprāmāṇyaṃ sarvatra niścīyata ityāha pāratrikyeti| atinipuṇeti mahānubhāvānāṃ paralokahetubhūtayā pravṛttyāpi vedaprāmāṇyaṃ niścīyata ityarthaḥ| anena mahājanaparigraho'bhidhīyate|
āgamāśvāsasiddhau evaṃ bahubhirhetubhirvedaprāmāṇye niścite sati| aprāmāṇyakāraṇābhāvamāha śabda iti| śabde tasmācca bodhe satītyanutpattilakṣaṇāprāmāṇayanirāsaḥ| paraviṣayeīśvaraviṣaye| doṣabādhavyapeta iti kāraṇadoṣabādhakapratyayau nirasyete| anādinidhanāvicchinnasaṃpradāyatvāt kāraṇadoṣābhāvācca alaukikārthaviṣayatvād bādhakapratyayābhāvācca prāmāṇye sata asati cāprāmāṇyakāraṇe punarasau vedaḥ parasmin brahmaṇi mānameva| evaṃ ca kāraṇamantareṇa vedāntavākyānāmaprāmāṇyakathane tenaiva nyāyena karmabhāge'pyaprāmāṇyaṃ kathanīyamiti vedamārgāpalāpa eva syādityarthaḥ||
evaṃ caturṇāmadhikaraṇānāmarthān vibhāgenābhidhāya sāmānyārthānuvādapūrvakamatratyayorjanmādyadhikaraṇasamanvayādhikaraṇayoruttarattaravakṣyamāṇābhyāṃ kāraṇatvādhikaraṇobhayaliṅdhikaraṇābhyāṃ paunaruktyamāśaṅkyottararatra tattadadhikaraṇārthaprasādhanam, atra punarvakṣyamāṇārthopajīvanena tattadarthābhidhānamiti na paunaruktyamityāha śāstretyādinā| viśeṣadvayamevam brahmādiśabdānāṃ śrīnivāsaparyavasānaṃ dvitīyādhikaraṇoktam| vedāntavedyasya brahmaṇo niratiśayānandarūpatvaṃ caturthādhikaraṇoktam| tatra pūrvaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ kāraṇatvādhikaraṇamupajīvati| uttaramubhayaliṅgādhikaraṇamiti suśobhanametat||
atra śārīrakaśāstrārambhahetubhūtacatussūtryātmakaprathamapeṭikārthaṃ sāmānyato viśeṣataśca darśayitvā tadanantaraṃ śāstrārambharūpadvitīyapeṭikārthābhidhānena tayoḥsa saṃgatimapyāha ātmanyevamiti| atra khalu caturadhukaraṇyāmātmā jñātavya ityarthaikyam, akṛta itimata ityādikarmacatuṣṭayamadhikaraṇārthavibhāgaḥ; brahmaviśeṣapratipādakatvāt sarveṣāmadhikaraṇānām| atha dvitīyapeṭikāpūrvapakṣānuvādamukhena saṃgatirapi darśayan peṭikāpravṛttiprakāramapi viśadaṃ darśayati īdṛktvamiti| pūrvapoṭikāproktamarthajātaṃ yathārhaṃ prakṛtipuruṣayoreva syāditi parakathanaṃ na tāvanumānādyayogyau duḥkhāspṛṣṭau cetyuttarābhyāṃ dvābhyāmadhikaraṇābhyāṃ krameṇa dodhavītītyarthaḥ| athavā īdṛktvamityārabhya itiśabdaparyantaṃ pūrvapakṣavākyameva| prakṛtipuruṣayoreva jagatkāraṇatvādikaṃ pramāṇāsiddhaṃ tayoranumānādyayogyatvaṃ duḥkhāspṛṣṭatvaṃ ca nāstīti pūrvādhikaraṇākṣepe uttaraṃ yogyābhiruktibhirdodhavītīti| atha samanantarapeṭikayā pādaśeṣeṇa vā| pūrvaṃ hi śāstrayonyadhikaraṇa samanvayādhikaraṇābhyāṃ vedāntavedyasyārthasyānumānādyayogyatvaṃ duḥkhāsaṃspṛṣṭatvaṃ coktam, ubhayamapi prakṛtipuruṣayoranyatarasya vedāntavedyatvāṅgīkāre na saṃbhavatīti pūrvoktāvāntarapeṭikāsaṃgatirapyatrocyate| akṛta iti prathamādhikaraṇe "nāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtena" iti viṣayavākyoktamakṛtatvaṃ pradhānārtha iti darśayati| evaṃ dvitīyādhikaraṇādiṣvapi viśvahetutvādikaṃ pradhānārthaṃ ityanukrameṇa mantavyam| tatra hi vedāntavākyānāṃ brahmaṇyayodavyavacchedapare prathamapāde prakṛtyādyanyayogavyavacchedakathanamayogavyavacchedaśeṣatvena napunaḥ prādhānyeneti samādhānāt īkṣatyadhikaraṇādīnāmasaṃgatiranāśaṅkanīyā| ayaṃ kila peṭikāvibhāgaḥ  prathamapāde śāstrārambhārthā caturadhikaraṇī tāvadekā| tatra dvayoravāntarapeṭikātvam| puṃnarīkṣatyādhikaraṇa ānandamayādhikaraṇayo rekapeṭikātvamucyate| ataḥ paraṃ pañcānāmapyadhikaraṇānāṃ prakṛtipuruṣaviśeṣatvātekapeṭikātvaṃ pratipadyate| athavā īkṣatyadhikaraṇādīni trīṇyekā peṭikā sadātmapuruṣarūpasāmānyaśrutyā samutthitasya pūrvapakṣiṇa īkṣatyādi viśeṣaliṅgena pratikṣepasya tulyatvāt| śrutiliṅgayorhi sāmānyaśrutyapekṣayā viśeṣaliṅgaṃ prabalamiti tāntrikāḥ| tataḥ paramākāśaprāṇajyotirādiviśeṣaśrutyā samutthitasya pūrvapakṣiṇo nyāyānukūlayaugikaśrutyarthāṅgīkāreṇākāśaprāṇādhikaraṇābhyāṃ tāvannirākaraṇaṃ kriyate| ākāśaprāṇaśabdayostu yaugikārthāvevāṅgīkriyete| natu rūḍhiryogamapaharati| klṛpto yogaḥ kalpyāṃrūḍhiṃ bādhata itinyāyena bādhyate| tenākāśaprāṇādhikaraṇayoḥ siddhamavāntarapeṭikātvam| jyotiradhikaraṇendraprāṇādhikaraṇayostu rūḍhibhaṅgaṃ vihāya tattadrūḍhārthaviśiṣṭaparamātmaparatvamucyata iti tayorapi peṭikāntaratvaṃ siddham| atra catuḥsūtryāṃ samyagarthāvabodhanāya prameyasaṃgrahapariśramaśālibhirbhavitavyam| avalokanīyā ca niyatamācāryakṛtā śatadūṣaṇī||
pūrvaṃ paramātmano vedāntavedyatvamuktam| idānīṃ prakṛtyādīnāṃ tadeva vedāntavedyatvaṃ na saṃbhavatītyucyate|tatrāpi sāṃkhyādiśāstroktaprakṛtipuruṣayoḥ prakṛterviśvākāreṇa pariṇatāyāḥ sarvalokaprasiddhatvāt tadapekṣayā puruṣasya sūkṣyatvāt saiva prathamaṃ nirākriyata iti saṃgatiḥ| athavā pūrvādhikaraṇe vedāntavedyasya vastunaḥ puruṣārtharūpatvamuktam, tanna ghaṭate apuruṣārtharūpāyāḥ prakṛtereva kāraṇatvāditi| evaṃ vā sarveṣāmapi vedāntavākyānāṃ prakṛtipuruṣottīrṇabrahmaparatvamuktaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇe, sarvavedāntasārabhūtā sadvidyā tāvat prakṛtimevācaṣṭe|kimanyairvākyābhāsairiti|evaṃ saṃbhāvitaṃ saṃgatyantaramapi vācyam| viṣayastu parameva brahma, purvaṃ śāstrārambha iti tato vibhāgaḥ| saṃśayaḥ punaḥ kiṃ prakṛtivilakṣaṇaṃ brahma sadvidyāvedyam, uta prakṛtiriti| saṃśayotthānakāraṇaṃ tu saditisāmānyaśrutiḥ| sarvabhāvavācakasya sacchabdasya prakṛtipuruṣeśvarasādhāraṇatvāt|
tadarthavicārastu sacchabdaḥ kiṃ paramātmaparaḥ, uta prakṛtiparaḥ| prakṛtiparatve "tadaikṣata" ityaktamīkṣaṇaṃ na ghaṭate, uta ghaṭata iti| tadarthaṃ punarvicāryateidañcekṣaṇaṃ mukhyamuta gauṇamiti| punaśca vicāryateatra gauṇekṣaṇasāhacaryaṃ nāsti utāstyeveti| tatrāpi vicāryate "tatteja aikṣata" ityādikaṃ tejaḥ prabhṛtīkṣaṇaṃ mukhymutāmukhymiti| ato'pi vicāryatekiṃ mukhyatvānurūpā hetavo 'nuroddhavyāḥ, utāmukhyatvānurūpā hetvo'pītyādi| phalaphalibhāstu amukhyatvānurupāṇāṃ bahūnāmapi yuktīnāmatra vidyamānatvāt "tatteja aikṣata" ityatrekṣeṇasya gauṇatvāt gauṇekṣā sāhacāryasya cātra vidyamānatvena sadīkṣaṇasyāpi gauṇatvāt atroktamīkṣaṇaṃ prakṛtiparatve'pi saṃghaṭata iti sāṃkhyādyuktaṃ pradhānamevātra sacchabdaḥ pratipādayatīti pūrvapakṣe| siddhānte phalaphalībhāvastu vaiparītyena| uktamarthamanukrameṇācaṣṭegauṇekṣāsāhacaryāditi| bahubhavanaprekṣaṇaṃ naiva mukhyamitiitthaṃ kila pūrvapakṣī manyate īkṣaṇaguṇayogāt prakṛtikāraṇatvaṃ nirākriyate brahmavādibhiḥ, taccekṣaṇaṃ gauṇam, kūlaṃ pipatiṣati, vṛṣṭiprītakṣatrāḥ śālaya ityādivat cetanadharmasyācetane'pi yojayituṃ śakyatvāt, atra gauṇatve nidānaṃ "tatteja aikṣata" ityādigauṇekṣaṇamāha caryameva| kiṃ ca mṛttatkāryadṛṣṭāntādevedānāṃ pariṇāmādityādisāṃkhyoktaṃ pradhānānumānameva pratibhātītyāha dṛṣṭāntādyairiti| naca śrutipratibhāvanāmātrameva, yuktiyuktamapīdamityāhatādṛśāditi| acetanarūpakāryasyācetanādeva janmayuktam| nanu savikāre pradhāne kathaṃ sacchabdaḥ syādityāśaṅkyāhasaditi|
mahadādīnāṃ vikārāṇāṃ kvācitkatvena sacchabdavācyatvaṃ mā bhūt, avikṛtirūpāyāḥ prakṛternityasiddhatvena sacchabdavācyatvaṃ bhavediti pūrvapakṣe rāddhāntamāha ayuktamiti| śrutyācetanāsādhāraṇātmaśabdādiśrutyā| prakṛtyādīnāṃ nirodhāt| na kevalaṃ śrutyā, apitu tvadabhimata prakṛtikāraṇatva tiraskārakekṣaṇādiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇairapyayamevārtha iti niścīyata ityāha tvadabhimateti||
atra sāṃkhyoktānumānikaprakriyāpratyabhijñānamāśaṅkya nirākarotijñāta iti|atraivaṃ kila pūrvapakṣī manyate ekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñā tāvat dṛśyate "yenāśrutaṃ śrutam" ityādinā|na kevalaṃ pratijñāmātraṃ, dṛṣṭāno'pyastītyāhamṛttaditi|ādiśavdāt śrutyukto nakhanikṛntanādirgṛhyate|evamanumānapradhānabhutayoḥ pratijñādṛṣṭāntayorupapādanenedaṃvākyaṃsāṃkhyoktānumānāmuvādakamevasyādityāhatyeneti|nirākarotivṛtheti|tatra hetumāhahetvanukteriti|anumānāvayaveṣvatyantapradhānabhūtahetvanukteḥ| santi sārūpyādayo hetavaḥ sāṃkhyānāmiti cet tanna; teṣāmuttaratra sāṃkhyādhikaraṇe nirākaraṇādityāha sārūpyāderiti| nanu tatracātra ca nirākaraṇe paunaruktyamityāśaṅkyāha atreti|uttaratra pradhānakāraṇatvaniścāyakahetavo niśśeṣamunmūlayiṣyate| atra pradhānakāraṇatvānumānasaṃbhāvanāmātraṃ nirākriyata iti na paunaruktyāvakāśaḥ||
evaṃ pratipakṣaprakriyāṃ nirasya svapakṣānukūlān viṣayavākyārthān hetūn saṃgṛhṇāti ādeśeti| "uta tamādeśamaprākṣyaḥ" ityupakrame tāvadādeśaśabdena sacchabdavācyaṃ brahma nirdiśyate| ādeśaśabdo 'pyādeṣṭāramevāha| ādeṣṭṛtvaṃ punarniyantṛtvameva| naca tat pradhānapakṣe saṃbhavati tasyācetanatvāt| ātmaśabdo'pyatra śrūyate "sa ātmā" satu cetanasyaivāsādharaṇaḥ| tatra suṣuptiprasaṅge "svamapīto bhavati" iti suṣuptisthānaṃ paramātmā svaśabdena nirdiśyate| antaryāmitvāt paramātmaiva svaśabdena nirdeśārhaḥ| na punaḥ pradhānam| tasya suṣuptaṃ pratyanantaryāmitvāt|
anitaraśaraṇaiḥananyathaāsiddhairityarthaḥ| ete hi śabdāḥ paramātmaviṣayatve mukhyāḥ ,pradhānaviṣayatve punarjaghanyavṛttaya ityarthaḥ| hetvantaramapyāhatvamiti|tacchabdavācyena saha tvaṃśabdasya jīvasyaikyamatra vyapadiśyate| yadi tacchabdaḥ pradhānaparaḥ, tadānīmatatvopadeśa evāyaṃ syāt; cetanācetanayoraikyopadeśasya dehātmopadeśavat bhrāntihetutvāt| atra sādhakāntaramāhajīveneti| svena  svātmakenetyarthaḥ| "anena jīvenātmanānupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi " ityuttamapuruṣasiddhāhaṅkārapūrvakamahamarthavyatiriktācidgaṇasya praveśāt,atra jīvaśarīrakaḥ paramātmā jīvadvārā jīvavyatiriktamacetanajātaṃ praviśatītyarthaḥ| tena praveṣṭavyasyācidvastunaḥ sāhaṅkaraṇamahaṅkārasahitaṃ praveṣṭṛtvaṃ na yoyujyata ityuktaṃ bhavati| kiṃ ca "yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavati" ityekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñā dṛśyate| sā punarīśvarakāraṇatva eva ghaṭate napunaḥ pradhānakāraṇatve,pradhānasya cetanaṃ pratyakāraṇatvādityāhaeketi|hetvantaramapyāhasarveti|"aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvam"iti
hi śruyate,pradhānasya kraṇatve kathaṃ tattādātmyaṃ sarvaśabdāntargasya jīvasya vaktuṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ|na kevalaṃ chāndogyaśrapatyaiva brahmakāraṇatvaṃ pratīyate,apitu śrutyantareṇāpi|chāndogye'pi na kekalaṃ sadvidyāvākyena,kiṃ tu daharavdyābhumavidyāderepi|atra ādiśabdena upabṛṃhaṇasmṛtipurāṇādikaṃ gṛhyate|atra viśvaviditi namittatvopayuktaṃ sārvajñyaṃ gṛhyate|viśvamurtirityupādānatvopayuktaṃ sarvaśarīratvaṃ gṛhyata iti vibhāgaḥ|atra pupakṣasiddhāntopanyāsapraṃkiyāvibhāgaḥ śrīmatibhāṣye nyāyasudarśanādau ca draṣṭavyaḥ|atra copakramopasaṃhāramahāvākyopapattiḥ śrutyantaravidyāntarādiprākāśanaparānāṃ sutrāṇāmanukramo'pi tatraivānusandheyaḥ||
pūrvottarādhikaraṇayossaṃgatidvayoktipūrvakamuttarādhikaraṇārthaṃ saṃgraheṇopadarśayatimukhyeti| yadi sato mukhyamīkṣaṇamiṣṭam, tarhi cetanatvāt mukhyekṣaṇārho jīva eva jagatkāraṇamastviti pūrvapakṣotthānādekā saṃgatiḥ|anyā ca sadvidyāvākye tattvamasīti tribhiḥ padairjīvabrahmaṇoraikyameva navakṛtvaḥ pradarśitam, tathā ca jīva eva jagatkāraṇaṃ brahāstviti pūrvapakṣotthānamiti| ityūhādujjihānaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇaṃ nirākartuṃ pūrvaprastuto viśvakartā jīvasyāpyantarātamā nirupadhikamahānandavān atrādhikaraṇe sthāpyate| tadarthavicārastu "brahmavidāpnoti param" ityasminvākye yaḥ punarānandamaya ucyate sa kiṃ jīva uta paramātmā| punarvicāryate atra mayaḍ vikārārthaḥ prācuryārtho vā| tadarthaṃ vicāryate upakramagatānnamayaśabdasthamayaṭo vikārārthatvānusāreṇa atrāpi mayaṭo vikārārthatvameva yuktam, uta prācuryārthatvam| punaśca vicāryate upakramāvagatasya madhye prāṇamayamanomayādibhirvicchedo'sti navetyādi| phalaphalibhāvastu tatrāvicchedādupakramāvagatavikārārthatvasyaivātrāpi grahītuṃ yogyatvenānandamayaśabdasthamayaṭo vikārārthatvādānandamayo jīva iti pūrvapakṣe| vyatyayena rāddhānte phalaphalibhāvaḥ||
atra kaścidāha "ātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ" ityādinā sṛṣṭerevābhidhānāt pūrvaṃ "sa vā eṣa puruṣo'nnarasamayaḥ" ityatra vikāre mayaḍ dṛśyata iti carame'pi "anyo 'ntara ātmā''nandamayaḥ" ityatrāpi evamastu mayaṭo vikārārthatvamevāstu pūrvoktasya mayaṭo vikārārthapratyabhijñānāditi, tadidamāhadṛṣṭa iti| tannirākarotiayuktamiti| tatra hetumāha madhya iti| prāṇamayādiṣu vikārārthatvabhaṅgadṛṣṭerityarthaḥ| phalitamāha pracuramiti| vikārārthatve ko doṣa ityāśaṅkyāha anyasyeti| ānandamayādatiriktasya vastuno bādhena vikārārthatvasya bādhitatvādityarthaḥ| nanvatrānanda prācuryābhidhāne duḥkhālpatvameva syāt yathā brāhmaṇapracuro deśa ityukte śūdrālpatvaṃ pratīyata iti, tatpratikṣipatiānandeti| atrānandaprācurī manuṣyānandamārabhya caturmukhānandaparyantatayā prakṛtaparasukhālpatvalabdhāvadhitvāt ānandamayaniṣñaduḥkhālpatvaṃ nāpekṣate, api tu caturmukhādiniṣṭhānandaprācuryanivṛttimeva| yathā "annamayo yajñaḥ" ityādi| nanvānandaprācurī duḥkhālpatvenāpi nirvaktuṃ śakyata ityāśaṅkya netyāhapareti| paraduritabhit saṃśritānāṃ duritaṃ bhinatti "ānandamayaḥ" iti hi śrūyate| "atha so'bhayaṃ gato bhavati" "etaṃ ha vāva na tapati" " na karmaṇā lipyate pāpakena " ityādikaṃ vākyajātaṃ śataśohyadhīmahi| tasmādatra duḥkhālpatvaśaṅkā na saṃghaṭata iti| kiṃ ca "bhīṣāsmādvātaḥ pavate" "tasya havā etasya praśāsane gārgi" "praśāsitāraṃ sarveṣām" ityādibhiḥ praśāsitṛtvena pratipannasyānandamayasya pāpālpatvavirodha ityāha śāsituriti||
nanvasmatpakṣe bhavadbhirānandamayatvalakṣaṇaṃ liṅgaṃ viruddhamiti hyuktam| asmākameka evāyaṃ virodhaḥ, bhavatāṃ bahavo virodhāḥ| ānandamaye'pi "tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā yaḥ pūrvasya "ityātmāntara kathanaṃ virudhyate| śārīratvakathanamapi śarīrasya karmaphalatvānna yujyate| na ca ghaṭate śodhyatvavādaḥ parasminbrahmaṇi aśuddhiprasaṅgābhāvāt| śrūyate hyānandamaye'pi "annamayaprāṇamanomayamanomayavijñānamayānandamayā me śudhyantām"iti śodhyatvavādaḥ|kiṃ ca tasminnevānandamaye phalanirdeśadaśāyāmupasaṃkramitavyatvamucyatetadapi viruddham|paramātmani nityameva vartamānasya jīvasya kathamapūrvamupasaṃkramaṇamiti|evaṃ caturo'pi virodhānanudya caturbhirapi pādairaṇukrameṇa samādhatteātmeti|iyaṃ kila samādhānaprakriyā "tasaiva....ātmā"ityuktirānandamaye"svayaṃ dāsāstasvinaḥ"itivadātmāntaranivṛtyartheti ko virodhaḥ?śārīratvakathanamapi bhagavataḥ sarvaśarīrakatvādānandamaya eva viśeṣeṇopapadyate|śodhyatvamapi"viśuddhameva rājahṛdayam"ityādivadānandamayasya prasādyatvameva| na punaḥ pūrvaśumaddhasya kaścit śuddhiviśeṣaḥ|loke'pi rājahṛdayaṃ viśuddhamityādau nigrahanivṛttirevocyate;anuguṇasyaivārthasya tatratatra svīkāryatvāt |ākāṅakkṣāsannidhānavadyogyatvasyāpi vākyārthanirṇayāṅgatvāt|atropasaṃkramaṇameva hi śiṣyate,tadap saṃghaṭate;prāptireva hyupasaṃkramaṇamucyate|prāptiśca pūrvamananubhūtasya brahmaṇaḥ paścādanubhavasaṃbhavaḥ| etadevābhidhīyate " so'śnute sarvān kāmān saha " iti| athavā deśaviśeṣaprāptireva hyasmābhirvaktuṃ śakyata iti| tadeva hyucyate "vaikuṇṭhe tu pare loke " iti| ato'smatpakṣe na virodhāvakāśaḥ| atra padārthatvaṃ svayameva bhāvyam||
atra pucchabrahmavādī pratyavatiṣṭhate nirdeha iti| ānandamayasyaiva brahmatve tasya niraṃśatvāt " tasya priyameva śiraḥ" ityādinā śiraḥpakṣādibhedena pañcaprakārāvayavaklṛptirna ghaṭate| tasmāt pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā " ityuktaṃ sarvabhūtādhiṣṭhānatayā viśvapratiṣṭhārūpaṃ pucchameva paraṃ brahma, ānandamayasya brahmatve śiraḥpakṣādi klṛptīnāmayogyatvāditi| imaṃ pakṣaṃ pritabandyā dūṣayitumupakramate soḍheti|deśakālaparicchedarahitatayā bhavadbhiraṅgīkṛtasya saccidānandarūpasya brahmaṇaḥ pucchatvakathanaṃ kathaṃ yujyate| śrutiprāmāṇyasiddhyarthamasmābhiḥ pucchatvakalpanaṃ soḍhavyamiti cet hanta tarhyasmābhirapi ānandamaye niraṃśe priyamodāditattadvibhāgavivakṣayā śiraḥ pakṣādikalpanaṃ soḍhavyamiti saṃtoṣṭavyamāyuṣmatetyāha kathamiti| itaratśiraḥpakṣādikamityarthaḥ| tarhyatyantaviruddhametat, yadānandamayasya brahmaṇa eva svapratiṣṭhārūpatvamiti| tacca na vidyate| svasyaiva svapratiṣṭhānatvavacanamanitarādhāratākhyāpanāya " sa bhagavaḥ kasminpratiṣṭhitaḥ sve mahimni " iti śrutyantaraprakāreṇa sarvapratiṣṭhārūpasya brahmaṇaḥ pratiṣṭhāntaranivṛttireva hyatrocyata iti ko virodhaḥ| atra pucchabrahmavādināṃ bahūnyapi dūṣaṇāni bhāṣya eva vyaktamuktānīti ślokārthameva pradarśya viramāmaḥ||
īkṣatyadhikaraṇaviṣayavākye " tasya tāvadeva ciram " iti śarīrapātaparyanto duḥkhasaṃbandha ucyate| tena "tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā "iti śarīrasaṃbandhī puruṣo jīva eva syādityāśaṅkya parihṛtamāndamayādhikaraṇe karmādhīnakaraṇakalebaraparigrahasyaiva saṃsārātmakatvam, napunaḥ svābhāvikasyaiva viśvaśarīrasyeti| ataḥ paramantarādityādhikaraṇaṃ pravartate asminnadhikaraṇe na kevalamantaryāmitvāvasthānamātreṇa śarīrātmabhāva ucyate, apitu pāṇipādākṣikeśādivibhāgavaccharīrasaṃbandhī puruṣaḥ, tādṛśaśarīrasaṃbandhitvaṃ jīvasyaiva saṃbhavatīti pūrvapakṣotthānena saṃgatiḥ| pūrvaṃ jīvasāmānyasya nirāsaḥ, idānīṃ jīvaviśeṣasya nirāsa iti ca saṃgatiḥ| tadidamāha bhūyiṣṭheti|
pūrvoktāḥ khalu manuṣyānārabhya prajāpatiparyantā bhūyiṣṭhānantapuṇyopacayabalasamudbuddhaiśvaryāḥ kecitpuruṣāḥ, teṣveva kaścidīśvaraḥ pravāharūpeṇa vartata iti kalpyamiti ca pūrvādhikaraṇasaṃgatyantaramucyate| ayamarthaḥ  pāpottarāḥ puṇyapāpayostulyavṛttayaśca mā bhūvan, api tu puṇyottarāḥ kecidīśvaratvena prakalpyeranniti| atrottaram tanneti| tatra hetūnpramāṇānusāreṇa saṃgṛhṇāti  akarmeti| akarmādhīnadivyaśarīravān| janiḥ janma| mahimā māhātmyam | sarvapuṃsāṃ svābhāvikaniyantā| nityaśrīḥ nityameva lakṣmīsaṃbandhavān| evaṃbhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ, bradhnabimbe  sūryamaṇḍale, śruta iti, " sa ya eṣo'ntarhṛdaya ākāśaḥ " ityanuvākaśrutaḥ paramapuruṣaḥ eka eva "eṣo'ntarāditye " ityantarādityavidyāyāṃ śrūyata iti na jīvaviśeṣaśaṅkāvakāśaḥ| "eṣa sarvebhyaḥ pāpmabhyaḥ uditaḥ udeti havai sarvebhyaḥ pāpmabhyo ya evaṃ veda " ityatraiva hi śrūyate| " samastāḥ śaktayaścaitā nṛpa yatra pratiṣṭhitāḥ " ityādikamatra bhāvyam| "na sā karmanimittajā " iti hi tatrocyate| aitihāsikamapi "vyaktameṣa mahāyogī " ityādikaṃ suprasiddhameva| atroktaṃ śāsitṛtvaṃ hi " antaḥ praviṣṭaṛ śāstā janānāṃ sarvātmā " " praśaāsitāraṃ sarveṣām" ityādi bahupramāṇasiddhatvāt sarvaviṣayamevānusandhātavyam| ayamatrasaṃgrahaḥ  sūryamaṇḍalāntarvartino bhagavadvigrahasyākarmādhīnatvādaprākṛtatvādāśritānugrahārthatvācca vigrahasaṃbandhamātreṇa jīvaviśeṣatvāśaṅkāvacanaṃ paramapuruṣavidveṣiṇāṃ pāpiṣṭhānāṃ pralāpaḥ| atra tadarthavicāro'pi kiṃdidālikhyate| āditamaṇḍalāntarvartī puruṣaḥ kiṃ jīvaviśeṣaḥ uta paramātmeti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate  kiṃ pāṇipādādivibhāgavacchaśarīrādisaṃbandho jīvatvaṃ prasādhayati na veti| tadarthaṃ punarvicāryate  kimayaṃ śarīrasaṃbandhaḥ karmādhīnaḥ, utākarmādhīna iti| punarapi vicāryate  sarvapāpmoditatvādivacanaṃ kiṃ karmādhīnatvaṃ nivārayati uta neti| tadarthamapi punarvicāryate  tatra pāpmaśabdaḥ kiṃ pāpamātraparaḥ, uta puṇyapāpātmakakarmamātrapara iti| phalaphalibhāvastu pāpmaśabdasya pāpamātraparatvena sarvapāpmoditatvādivacanasya karmādhīnatvanivārakatvābhāvāt śarīrasaṃbandhasya karmādhīnatayā niyamena jīvakarmādhīnatvādityamaṇlāntarvartī puruṣo jīva iti| rāddhānte phalaphalibhāvo'ntevāsibhiḥ svayamevohyaḥ||
atra cedakaḥ prāha  antarādityavidyāyāṃ " sarvebhyaḥ pāpmabhyaḥ uditaḥ " iti bhagavataḥ sarvapāparahitatvamucyate, viśeṣaniṣedhe śeṣābhyanujñānamiti tāntrikāṇāṃ prakriyā, tathā cādityamaṇḍalāntarvartini puruṣe pāpaniṣedhāt puṇyābhyanujñānamastīti| tadidamāha sarvebhya ityādinā| tannirākaroti maivamiti| atra hetūnāha āmnāta ityādinā| "na tasyeśe kaścana " ityādibhirbahubhiḥ pramāṇairbhagavato'nanyaśāsyatvaṃ pratīyate, anyaśāsyo hi rājakiṃkaraḥ śāsanātisaṅghanāt pratyavāyamupeyāt, tadanupālanādanukūlaṃ phalam| īśvarasyānanyaśāsyatvād duritavat paraśāsanānuvartanarūpaṃ sukṛtamapi na saṃbhavatītyayameko hetuḥ| hetvantaramāha svavaśeti| "phalamata upapatteḥ" iti nyāyena pareṣāmiṣṭamaniṣṭaṃ vā phalaṃ bhagavāneva dadātītyucyate tasya kathaṃ sukṛtasaṃbandhaḥ saṃbhavatīti| kiṃ ca " sa na sādhunā karmaṇā bhūyānno evāsādhunā kanīyān " iti hyarthāt sukṛtasaṃbandhaḥ pratikṣipyate, tacca viruddhaṃ tava| tarhi pāpmaśabdaḥ puṇye kathaṃ prayujyate? ityatrāha  syāditi| puṇye'pi pāpalakṣaṇayogādiha pāpmaśabdaḥ prayujyate| asti hi puṇye'pi pāpalakṣaṇayogaḥ, aniṣṭaphalasaṃbandhitvāt | loke hi kasyacidiṣṭaṃ phalamanyasyāniṣṭaṃ bhavati|tathā ca svargādikamiṣṭaṃ phalamadhyātmavidāmaniṣṭamityadhikāriviśeṣāpekṣayā pāpameva kāmyaṃ karma| atra śrautaprayogarūpaṃ prabalavyavasthāpakamāha na sukṛtamityādineti| atra hi sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtamubhayamapi nirdiśya dvayorapi pāpmaśabdena nirdeśaḥ spaṣṭameva kriyate| tasmāt duritavat sukṛtasyāpi pāpmaśabdavācyatvāt sarvapāpmoditavacanaṃ sukṛmanivṛttimapyāheti siddham||
atra punaścodayati parasya brahmaṇo vigraho'stīti bhavadbhiruktam, sa vigrahaḥ kiṃ pārakṛtaḥ, utāprākṛtaḥ, aprākṛtatvepi kiṃ bhagavatsvarūpameva uta tattvāntaram| pūrvatrāsmaduktaṃ saṃsāritvamevāpadyata iti ghaṭṭakuṭīnyāyaḥ, dvitīye pakṣe svarūpapariṇāmaprasaṅgaḥ, tṛtīyo'pi pakṣo na ghaṭate, prakṛtipuruṣeśvarakālavyatiriktatattvāntarābhāvāt, ataḥ kathaṃ taditi| etannirākaroti prakhyātamiti| prakhyātam  "pādo'syaviśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi " " vaikuṇṭhe tu pare loke " " tamasaḥ paramo dhātā " " svasattābhāsakaṃ sattvam " ityādibhiḥ | śuddhasattvam  rajastamorahitasattvāśrayabhūtam| divyaṃ kimapi dravyaṃ tat| anaghatvaṃ saṃsārapravartanopakāraṇatvābhāvāducyate| tasyāvyaktato'nyatvaṃ " tripādsyāmṛtaṃ divi" iti vyaktamevābhidhīyate| anena bhagavato rūpaṃ prākṛtaṃ svarūpaṃ ca na bhavati apitu aprākṛtaṃ dravyāntaramityāha  tadrūpamiti| " tadviśvarūpavairūpyaṃ rūpamanyaddharermahat" iti bhagavān parāśaraḥ prāha| vairupyaṃ virūpamityarthaḥ| tena vipratipannaṃ rūpaṃ prākṛtaṃ rūpatvāt tadanityaṃ sāvayavatvādityādayaḥ pareṣāṃ hetavo nirastāḥ| tādṛgvidharūpasiddhau dharmigrāhakapramāṇavirodhaḥ| aprākṛtānityatvādiviśeṣaṇayogenaiva pramāṇasiddhatvāt| asiddhau cāśrayāsiddheriti svakīyāṃ prakriyāṃ svayameva smaratu haitukaḥ| nanvastu bhagavatastādṛśaṃ rūpam, anantagaruḍādīnāṃ kā gatiriti cet bhagavāneva gatiḥ| " tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam" " āste viṣṇuracintyātmā bhaktairbhāgavataiḥ saha " ityādipramāṇaśatavyāhatatvāt śaṅkāpiśācikāyāḥ| astu vaikuṇṭhavāsinastādṛśaṃ rūpam, athāpi tasya nityatvādau niścāyakaṃ kimityāśaṅkya śrutipurāṇādītyabhiprāyeṇāha nityamiti| "sadā paśyanti" " nityaṃ nityākṛtidharam " " nityasiddhe tadākāre tatparatve ca pauṣkara " " śrīvatsavakṣā nityaśrīḥ " ityādipramāṇasahasramanusandheyam| astu sarvaṃ guṇajātaṃ vaikuṇṭhavāsino bhagavataḥ, rāmakṛṣṇādayastu prākṛtāḥ karmavaśena sukhaduḥkhādibhājaśca, kathaṃ teṣāmārādhanenāsmākamāpavargikī siddhirityāśaṅkya parāśarapārāśaryādimatānusāreṇa aprākṛtatvādikaṃ guṇajātamāha ajahadityādinā granthaśeṣeṇa| " samastaśakti" ityādi parāśaravacanam| "na bhūtasaṅghasaṃsthāno deho'sya paramātmanaḥ " iti pārāśaryavacanamapyanusandheyam| " vyaktameṣa mahāyogī paramātmā sanātana " iti valmīkasaṃbhavo'pyāha| tenāvatāreṣu śokamohādyanukaraṇaṃ naṭānāṃ nāṭakeṣviva parihāsarūpameveti mantavyam| paravyūhādivibhāgaḥ pañcarātrādiṣu spaṣṭamevānusandheyaḥ||
uktamevārthaṃ pūrvapakṣānuvādapūrvakaṃ pratibandyā sthirīkurvan duḥkhitvādi naṭanaphalamapi pradarśayati  dehatvāditi | ihaivaṃ pratibandī  yadi śāstraikavedyārthe bādhaḥ kvacidiṣyate  tarhi agnīṣomīyahiṃsādāvapi bādhaḥ syāditi| atra śrutisiddhatvānna bādha iti pratibandīmocane bandīmocanamapi tathaiva syāditi| bhagavadvigrahāderapi śrutisiddhatvāt duḥkhamiśratvādivacanamāsuropaplavārthamityuktam| āsurāḥ  kaṃsādayaḥ| kṛṣṇādīnāṃ bālyādinaṭanaṃ paramārtha eveti matvā punaḥ punaḥ prātikūlye pravarteran tatpravṛttyaiva vidhvaṃseranniti| "vināśāya ca duṣkṛtām" ityuktaduṣkṛdvināśaphalaṃ bālyādinaṭanamityarthaḥ||
atroktānāmadhikaraṇānāmarthaikyādekapeṭikātvamadhyāyaparisamāptiparyantamāgāmināmadhikaraṇānāmarthaviśeṣābhāvānnairarthakyamāśaṅkyamānasya pūrvapakṣavādinaḥ prakārabhedena prayojanavattvamupapādayan sarvādhikaraṇasādhāraṇaṃ bhagavadguṇaviśeṣānusandhānarūpaṃ pradhānaṃ prayojanaṃ prakaṭamevācaṣṭe  itthamiti| vidyātrayeṇa sadvidyādyadhikaraṇatrayoktena sthāvarajaṅgamātmakacetanācetanātmakasya sarvakāraṇasya bhagavataḥ pradhānājjīvavargāccādityāderapyādhikyaṃ yadyapi syāt | tathāpi " aspaṣṭataramaspaṣṭaṃ spaṣṭaṃ chāyānusārī ca " ityuktakrameṇotthānadvārabhedāt krameṇotthitān mṛdūpakramakrūraniṣṭhān prativādino 'sminnadhyāye nirundhan san śiṣṭairadhikaraṇairbhagavadguṇānapi viśeṣataḥ prakāśayatītiśabdārthaḥ| ayamatrabhāvaḥ  yathā yuddheṣu padātyaśvagajarathānāṃ pūrvapūrvadurbalānāṃ durbalabhaṅge prabalayodhanam, evamaspaṣṭatarajīvaliṅgānāṃ pūrvapūrvabhaṅge punaruttarottaraparigraheṇa pūrvapakṣaḥ pravartate| tatpravṛttikuṇṭhanamantareṇa jātamapi tattvajñānaṃ na pratitiṣṭhatīti| tenādhyāyaśeṣo'pyārambhaṇīya eva| kiṃ ca sarveṣvapyadhikaraṇeṣu tattadadhikaraṇapratiniyatā bhagavadguṇā viśeṣataḥ prakāśante, teṣāṃ guṇānāṃ kārtsnyenānusandhānamadhyāyaśeṣaprayojanamityāsmāko mārgaḥ| nirviśeṣāvādināṃ tu ekenaivādhikaraṇena nirviśeṣaṃ pratipannamiti pratipādyaguṇaviśeṣābhāvāduttareṣāmadhikaraṇānāṃ naiṣphalyameveti hṛdayam||
evaṃ pūrvapeṭikayā sahādhyāyaśeṣasya saṃgatimuktvā pādaśeṣasya saṃgatiṃ vaktuṃ pūrvottarapeṭikayoḥ svarūpamapi viśeṣataḥ prakāśayati śabdairiti| " athāto brahmajijñāsā " iti śārīrakaśāstrādyapeṭikāyāṃ brahma jijñāsyamityuktam| tat brahmasadātmāpuruṣarūpasādhāraṇaśabdapratipannaṃ brahma kiṃ prakṛtiḥ kiṃ vā jīvaḥ athavā upacitapuṇyaviśeṣaḥ kaścijjīvaviśeṣaḥ, pāpmaśabdasya sādhāraṇatvena puṇyāpuṇyarūpapāpmoditatve'pi kiṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ, anyo vā kaściccaturmukhavirūpākṣādirityāśaṅkya puṇḍarīkākṣa eveti nirdhāritaṃ pūrvapeṭikāyām| tatretaravyāvartakaliṅgānyāha saṃkalpeti| saṃkalpāt pradhānavyāvṛttiḥ| ānandābhyāsājjīvasāmānyaṃ vyāvartyate| aprākṛtarūpaviśeṣādupacitapuṇyaviśeṣo jīvo'pi | tatrāpi puṇḍarīkākṣatvaśravaṇāt caturmukhādirapīti hārdo bhāvaḥ|
atadananuguṇaiḥ  ananyathāsiddhairityarthaḥ| atra pūrvapakṣī pratyavatiṣṭhate pūrvādhikaraṇatraye liṅgaireva sāmānyaśrutibādhena pradhānādivyāvṛttirbhavadbhirabhihitā| liṅgād viśeṣaśrutirbalīyasī| sā hi rūḍhiśaktyā vartate| tenākāśaprāṇajyotirindriyādiviśeṣaśrutyā liṅgāni bādhitvā prasiddhākāśādikameva jijñāsyabrahmatvena svīkāryamiti| tena pādaśeṣātmakapeṭikāsaṃgatyamuktaṃ bhavati| tadetadāha bhūteti| ākāśo dvividhaḥ  " yadeva ākāśa ānando na syāt " ityadhyātmavitasammataekaḥ, pāmaraparīkṣakāviśeṣeṇa sarvalokaprasiddho bhūtākāśo'paraḥ| tena prasiddhyatiśayānusāreṇa bhūtākāśaevātra grāhyaḥ| evaṃ prāṇādāvapi draṣṭavyam| evamākāśādīnāṃ viśeṣaśrutyā pūrvādhikaraṇatrayoktaṃ liṅgaṃ bādhitvā pūrvapakṣyabhiprāyeṇa nirasya siddhāntī punarākāśādiviśeṣasamudāyāsaṃbhava pratipādanena tadeva brahmapratipādakaṃ liṅgaṃ pradhānādivyāvartakaṃ bhunakti rakṣatītyarthaḥ| " bhujo'navane " iti rakṣaṇavyatiriktārthavivakṣāyāmātmanepadavidhānāt| ayamāśayaḥ  rūḍhiryogamapaharatīti siddhameva, athāpi pramāṇapariklṛpto yogo rūḍhimeva bādhata iti nyāyavidāṃ nirṇayaḥ| atra ca " sarvāṇi ha vā imāni" iti prasiddhavannirdeśo dṛśyate| havā iti prasiddhaipratipādakāvyayadarśanāt| prasiddhiśca kāraṇavākyeṣu |
teṣu ca chāgapaśunyāyādinā nārāyaṇaparatvaṃ siddhameva| ato nārāyaṇapratyabhijñāpakaprasiddhavannirdeśayuktānanyathāsiddhavākyastha sarvakāraṇatvaliṅgapariklṛpto yoga ākāśaśabdasya rūḍhiṃ bādhata iti yuktameva| śeṣaṃ bhāṣye||
ataḥ paramuttareṣāṃ caturṇāmadhikaraṇānāṃ yugadvayena bhedamanyonyasaṃgatamapyāha ākāśeti| ākāśaprāṇaśabdāvanitaragatikau prasiddhākāśaprāṇapratipādanānārhau parasminbrahmaṇi rūḍhiṃ hitvā yogaśaktyaiva pratipādanīyau| tena dvayoradhikaraṇayorekapeṭikātvasiddhiḥ| tathottarādhikaraṇayorūḍhibhaṅgamantareṇa rūḍhārthaviśiṣṭabrahmaparatvādekapeṭikātvaṃ siddham| tatra jyotiśśabdasya tāvadrūḍhārthaviśiṣṭaparatvaṃ darśayati  jyotiriti| "na tatra sūryo bhāti " "nacodeti nāstameti " " yadādityagataṃ tejaḥ " ityādikaṃ hi pramāṇajātamupalabhyate| evamindriyādiśabdo'pi indrādiviśiṣṭaparamātmaparatayā rūḍhyabhaṅgena viśeṣaṇamātrārthavasānamāśritya netavyaḥ| tathācārthabhedāt peṭikādvayasiddhiriti nigamayati ityevamiti| ekatra yaugikaśaktiranyatra viśeṣaṇamātrāparyavasitā rūḍhiśaktiriti śabdapravṛttikramaḥ||
pūrvaṃ " ya eṣo'ntarāditye hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣaḥ " ityādityāntarvartinaḥ kasyacit puruṣasya viśeṣaliṅgāt vedāntavedyatvamuktam| idānīṃ tadabhāvādākāśasya viśeṣaśrutyā vedāntavedyatvamāśaṅkya parihriyata iti saṃgatiḥ|
prasiddhākāśabrahmaṇorākāśaśabdayogasādhāraṇyaṃ saṃśayabījamityādi svayameva bhāvyam| tadarthavicārastu " sarvāṇi havā imāni bhūtāni " ityādicchāndogyavākyasthākāśaśabdaḥ kiṃ prasiddhākāśapara uta paramātmapara iti; tadarthaṃ vicāryate  kimayamākāśaśabdo rūḍhiśaktyā vartate uta neti, tadarthamapi vicāryate kiṃ rūḍhiryogamapaharatītinyāyāpavādakaṃ nyāyāntaraṃ na vidyate, uta vidyata iti| punaśca vicāryate  prasiddhavannirdeyuktamatratyakāraṇatvādikaṃ cetanamātraviṣayamuta cetanācetanāviṣayamityādi|| phalaphalibhāvastapa " imāni bhūtāni" iti prasiddhārthaviṣayakāraṇatvānuvādasyācetanamātraviṣayatvena yogaśaktikalpakanyāyāntarābhāvāt ākāśaśabdo rūḍhyaiva vartata ityayaṃ śabdaḥ prasiddhākāśaparaḥ| siddhānte'pi svayameva vācyaḥ| atra pūrvapakṣavādī manyate  chāndogye hyākāśaśabdaḥ sarvotpattivilayakāraṇavācakatayā dṛśyate, sa cākāśastaittirīye'nanyotpādyatayā kathyate " ātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ " iti, tasyānanyotpādyatvaṃ sarvakāraṇatvena nityatvādeva yujyate iti| tadidamāha  atretyādinā| tannirākaroti  maivamiti| tatra hetumāha siddheti|" havai" iti prasiddhavannirdeśayuktasyāsya vākyasya siddhānuvādaviṣayatvāt pūrvaprasiddhiravaśyāpekṣaṇīyā| prasiddhiśca kāraṇavākyeṣu, tāni ca nārāyaṇaviṣayāṇīti prāgevoktam| tasmādākāśaśabdo na prasiddhākāśapara ityarthaḥ| kiṃ ca " ākāśaḥ parāyaṇam" iti ākāśasya paramaprāpyatvamatraiva śrūyate| nahyacetanaṃ kiṃcit paramaprāpyamityātmavido vadanti| tadidamāha atheti| tasminnākāśe paramaprāpyatvaṃ na saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ | dūṣaṇāntaramāha taditi| " tadaikṣata, tatteja aikṣata, tā āpa aikṣanta " ityādiṣu tattakartā vipaścittvenaiva hi śrutaḥ| tathācākāśasya vividhadarśanaṃ na saṃbhavati| athavā tatkartetiākāśakarteti| brahmavallyāṃ vipaścitā brahmaṇeti jagatkāraṇaṃ vastu vipaścittvenaiva hi śrūyate| vividhaṃ paśyaccittvaṃ hi vipaścittvamiti vyācakhyuḥ| tenātmaśabdaḥ paramātmavācakaḥ| yattūktamātmana ākāśa iti svātmana ākāśotpattirabhidhīyata iti, tatra mukhyārthasvīkāre bādhaḥ, amukhyārthasvīkāre sa eva doṣaḥ| tasmādātmanaḥ paramātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūta ityayamevārtha ityabhiprāyeṇāha vihateti||
atraivaṃ pūrvapakṣavādī manyate prasiddhākāśe jagadutpatterapratyakṣatvāt ākāśaśabde rūḍhibhaṅgo nyāyyaḥ, iha tu prāṇe sarveṣāmapi puruṣāṇāṃ prāṇāyattapravṛttikatvasyopalambhādasmākamanukūlaliṅgaṃ yat tadeva yuṣmākaṃ prātikūlaliṅgam, tenānukūlaliṅgasaghrīcī prāṇarūḍhiśaktirabhañjanīyeti| tadidamāha prāṇāyattamiti| tannirākaroti  tanneti | tatra hetumāha prāṇasyeti| " sarvāṇi havai " iti cetanācetanavibhāgābhāvena kṛtsnasyāpi prapañcasya prāṇāyattapravṛttikatvamucyate| acetaneṣveva keṣucicchilākāṣṭhādiṣu prāṇāyatīti vyutpattimāśritya prāṇaśabdavācyatayā svīkārya ityarthaḥ| pūrvādhikaraṇoktaṃ hetumatrāpi yojayati  pūrvavaditi| ubhayatrāpi havā iti śabdasya vidyamānatvādityarthaḥ| atra bhagavati prāṇaśabdasya śrautaṃ prayogaṃ sadṛṣṭāntamāha ākāśeti| yathā paramātmaviṣayasyākāśaśabdasya śrutau tatratatropalabhyamānatvādākāśaśabdaḥ paramātmaviṣayaḥ, evaṃ nikhilaprāṇiprāṇanokterdṛṣṭatvāt prāṇaśabdo'pi paramātmaviṣaya ityuktaṃ bhavati| tadarthavicāraphalaphalibhāvau pūrvādhikaraṇavat svayameva kalpanīyau| saṃgatiḥ punātideśikī||
pūrvoktādhikaraṇadvayasādhyaprasākayuktīnāmuktādhikaraṇadvayaviṣayavākyorabhāvenojjihānasya pūrvapakṣiṇo nirākaraṇaṃ prakārāntareṇātra kriyata iti pūrvottarapeṭikāvaiṣamyaṃ prakāśayati śiṣyānugraheṇa noktimiti| yat siddhāntānukūlaṃ liṅgaṃ tat pūrvapakṣaviruddhaṃ yat punaḥ pūrvapakṣānukūlaliṅgaṃ tadeva siddhāntāviruddhamiti virodhāvirodhaprakriyā| atrākāśādiviśeṣaśabdena pūrvayoradhikaraṇayoḥ |svasādhyopasthāpakasiddhāntānurūpapūrvapakṣayuktidārḍhyāt siddhāntanirṇayaḥ kṛtaḥ| atra tāvat pūrvapakṣavādī manyate yathā pūrvayoradhikaraṇayoḥ sarvakāraṇatvādikaṃ liṅgaṃ viśeṣokiṃta vyāharanti tathottarayoradhikaraṇayoḥ kimapi liṅgaṃ viśeṣokiṃta na vyāhanti| api tu pūrvapakṣoktaprasiddhajyotirindriyoranukūlaṃ kaukṣeyajyotiraikyādikaṃ liṅgamapyastīti darśayati bhavatīti| tadeva siddhāntabhūtaparabrahmatvapratikūlam| nakevalaṃ liṅgenaiva vadāmaḥ, kiṃtu pradhānabhūtayā śrutyāpīti darśayati  śabda iti| ananyaniṣṭhaḥ viśeṣaśabda ityarthaḥ| evaṃ caturbhirhetubhiḥ paramātmā na jyotirādyuktivedya iti pūrvapakṣiṇo viśeṣābhiprāyasaṃgrahaḥ| evaṃ tarhi jyotirādiṣu sākṣātkāraṇatvakathanābhāve kathaṃ jyotirādikāraṇatvaśaṅkāvakāśa ityāśaṅkya sākṣātkāraṇatvakathanābhāve'pi kāraṇatvākṣepakayatkiñcidābhāsaniratiśayagīptyādiliṅgena jyotirādikāraṇatvaṃ śaṅkitumapi kathaṃcicchakyamityāha viśveti| evamākṣipantamanantarādhikaraṇābhyāṃ nirākaroti  rundha iti| taduciteti  bhagavata ididyutyanurūpacetanācetanavaiśiṣṭyapradarśanena nirundha iti śabdārthaḥ||
atrākāśādiṣu triṣvadhikaraṇeṣu " ākāśādvāyuḥ " ityādiśrutyuktakrameṇa pūrvapakṣotthānaṃ samādhānaṃ ceti saṃgatiḥ| prasiddhajyotiḥ paramātmanostatratatra jyotiśśabdaprayogasādhāraṇyaṃ saṃśayakāraṇam| tadarthavicārastu " atha yadataḥ parodivaḥ " ityādivākye jyotiśśabdaḥ prasiddhajyotirvācakaḥ, uta paramātmavācakaḥ| tadarthaṃ vicāryate  svavākye paramātmāsādhāraṇaliṅgābhāve'pyupakramasthaṃ paramātmāsādhāraṇaṃ liṅgaṃ jyotiśśabdasya paramātmavācakatvaṃ na pratipādayati, uta pratipādayatīti| tadarthamapi vicāryate  upakrame'pi paramātmāsādhāraṇaṃ liṅgaṃ nāsti utāstīti| tataśca vicāryate|  " gāyatrīvā idaṃ sarvam " ityupakramasthagāyatrīśabdaḥ paramātmaparatvaṃ bādhate na veti| punaśca vicāryate  etadvākyastho bhūtādipādavyapadeśo gāyatrīmātraparatvaṃ na vyāvartayati, uta vyāvartayatīti|
phalaphalibhāvaḥ svayamevonneyaḥ| atra pūrvapakṣī manyate  ākāśaprāṇādhikaraṇayoriva jyotiradhikaraṇaviṣayavākye jyotiśśabdasya paramapuruṣavācakatvasthāpakaṃ sarvakāraṇatvādikaṃ prasiddhajyotirviruddhaliṅgaṃ nopalabhyate| upalabhyate cānukūlaliṅgaṃ kaukṣeyajyotiṣaikyam| tadidamāha kaukṣeyeti| tathā ca tadeva jagatkāraṇam| na kevalamanayā vidyayā pratīyate apitu vaiśvānaravidyāyāmapi tadeva jagatkāraṇatvena pratītamityāha tarayeti|phalitamā ata iti| nirākaroti  maivamiti| hetumāha puṃsūkteti| upakrame hi " pādo'sya sarvā bhūtāni " iti vākyena puruṣasūktasthaṃ " pādosya viśvā bhūtāni " ityādivākyaṃ pratyabhijñāpyate| puruṣasūkte hi nārāyaṇaparatvaṃ suprasiddhameva| tacca kāraṇatvaṃ nārāyaṇe " hrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyau " iti lakṣmīpatitvaliṅgasāmarthyāt, " bhagavānitiśabdaḥ" iti parāśaravākyācca| tarhi vākyaśeṣasthakaukṣeyajyotiraikyasya kā gatiriti cet tasya nyāyavirodhena bādha eva gatiḥ| upakramopasaṃhārayorupakramo balīyāniti hi nyāyavidaḥ| atrāśvapratigraheṣṭinyāya evodāharaṇam| nanu sarvokrame " gāyatrī vā idaṃ sarvam " iti gāyatrīparatvapradarśanādupakramavākyaṃ gāyatrīmeva pratipādayati na punaḥ paramapuruṣamityāśaṅkya tasyāpyanyathāsiddhimāha gāyatrīti| gāyatryuktiścatuṣpāttva sāmyādeva na punaḥ gāyatrīsvarūpatvāt| itthamavagame ko heturityāśaṅkya niyāmakaṃ hetumāha api ceti| asminkhalu vākye gāyatrīśabdavācyasya parasya brahmaṇaḥ sādṛśyena bhūtapṛthvīśarīrahṛdayāni nirdiśyante| gāyatrīśabdasya paramātmaparatve niyāmakaṃ paramātmano viśvātmakatvaṃ na kevalamakṣarasaṃghātarūpāyāṃ gāyatryām, ata upakramavākyānusāreṇaivopasaṃhārasya varṇayituṃ śakyatvāt jyotiśśabdavācyaṃ parameva brahmeti nirṇayaḥ| prayujyate ca " taṃ devā jyotiṣāṃ jyotiḥ " ityādiṣu parasminneva brahmaṇi jyotiśabdaḥ sthalāntareṣvapi||
śrīmadbhāṣyagranthe mandapratibodhārthaṃ pūrvottaravākyayoḥ parasparaṃ vyāhatimāśaṅkya pariharati utthānamityādinā itthamityantena| etadadhikaraṇārambhe jyotirādāvadhikaraṇayuge kāraṇavyāpta liṅgādutthānamiti bhāṣyakārairevābhāṣya punarapi pūrvapakṣopanyāsasamaye prasiddhavannirdeśe'pyākāśaprāṇādivat svavākyopāttaparamātmaliṅgaviśeṣādarśanādityuktam, ataḥ kathamavirodha iti| atra nirākaraṇahetumāha viśveti| ayaṃ kila bhāṣyakārābhiprāyaḥ  evaṃ kila manyate pūrvapakṣī "" viśvataḥpṛṣṭeṣu sarvataḥ pṛṣṭheṣvanuttameṣūttameṣu " ityādikaṃ kāraṇatvākṣepakamavabhāsātmakaṃ liṅgamasti|
athāpyubhayaliṅtvādiviśiṣṭaparamapuruṣapratiṣṭhāpakaṃ jagatkāraṇatvādikaṃ svavākye liṅgaṃ nāstīti| ato na virodhaityāha vyāhatiriti| ayamarthaḥ  siddhāntopanyāsabhāṣye yadyapi " atha yadataḥ paradivo jyotiḥ" ityetasminvākye paramapuruṣāsādhāraṇaṃ liṅgamastīti bhāṣyakārahṛdayam| anuttameṣūttameṣu lokeṣu dyotata iti viśeṣaṇadvayopādānamaprākṛtadivyalokavāsino jyotiṣa eva saṃghaṭate| na punaraṇḍāntarvartino vā jyotirmātrasyeti bhāvaḥ||
atra saṃgatirbhāṣyakārairevoktā " niratiśaya " ityādinā| ādityādiparajyotiśśabde niraste paro jyotiṣāmadhipatitvena parakalpita indro'pi jagatkāraṇatvenāśaṅkya nirasyata iti| athavā upakramaprābalyādupasaṃhāroktārthanirāsaḥ pūrvādhikaraṇa uktaḥ, tarhi tenaiva nyāyena pratardanavidyāyāmapi upakramaprābalyādupasaṃhāravākyapratipannaparamapuruṣapirakalpanaṃ bādhyamiti pūrvapakṣotthānena saṃgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu pratardanavidyāyāṃ kiṃ prasiddha evendraḥ pratipādyate utendraśarīrakaḥ paramātmā| evaṃ prāṇe'pi vācyam| tadarthaṃ vicāryate  pūrvādhikaraṇoktopakramādhikaraṇanyāyenātrāpyarthopavarṇanaṃ nyāyyam, athavā neti| upakramādhikaraṇanyāyebādhakamupakramamahāvākyavirodhe mahāvākyamevānusaraṇīyamiti nyāyanantaraṃ na vidyate, athavā vidyata iti| punarvicāryate asminvākye sarvatra parabrahmatvaniścāyakaṃ hetujātaṃ nānugamyate, utānugamyata iti| atra pūrvapakṣī manyate pūrvamupakramānusāreṇaivopasaṃhāravarṇanaṃ nyāyyamiti bhavadbhiruktam, pratardanavidyāyāmupakrame pūrvamindraśabdaḥ prayujyate, sa tu viśeṣaśrutiḥ, tenopakramasthaśrutyānuguṇyamastyeva, kiṃ ca " tvameva me varaṃ vṛṇīṣva yaṃ tvaṃ manuṣyāya hitatamaṃ manyase" iti hitatamopāstikarmatvaṃ tathaivocyate, tacca parabrahmatvaliṅgam, tenopakramasthaśrutiliṅgābhyāmindra eva paramapuruṣaḥ, kiṃ ca tvadabhimatanārāyaṇaviruddhaṃ prasiddhendrasādhāraṇaṃ tvāṣṭravadhādikaṃ copalabhyate, tacca paramapuruṣaviruddhameva| phalitamāha taditi| tasmāt | asau  śakrādipada vācya indra eva, jagatkartā| paraharati neti| ayamāśayaḥ  upakramasthahitatamopāstikarmatvaṃ prasiddhendrasya na ghaṭate, evaṃ hitatamopāstitarapavargārthopāsanam, prasiddhendrastu devagaṇāntargataḥ svargādiparimitadeśavāsī kaścitkīṭakalpaḥ, sa kathaṃ hitatamopāstikarma bhavet, tenārthavirodhāt śabdārthāsaṃkocasiddhyarthaṃ cendraśabdena paramapuruṣa evābhidhīyate, " idi paramaiśvaryaṃ " iti hi vyutpādayanti, nipuṇanirūpaṇe pitāmaho'pyudumbarakīṭaḥ, kimuta meghanādādijitaḥ prasiddhendra iti tvameva bhāvaya| tarhi māmupāssveti svopāsanaṃ vidadhātīndraḥ, tvāṣṭravadhādikaṃ cāsminneva prakaraṇe prakhyāpyate paramapuruṣaviruddhaṃ prasiddhendrānukūlaṃ liṅgam, tatkathamiti cedatra samādhimāha brahmetyādinā| svātmanā cetyantena| ayamabhiprāyaḥ  tredhā hyupāsyaṃ brahma acidviśiṣṭopāsanaṃ cidviśiṣṭopāsanaṃ kevalaṃ paramātmopāsanamiti| tena prasiddhendrādikamapi brahmaviśeṣaṇatvenopāsyatayā'bhidhīyate | tena viśeṣaṇabhūtaprasiddhendrādipratipattyarthaṃ tvāṣṭravadhādikamapi liṅgaṃ sārthakameva na punarviruddham| ayamatra nirṇayaḥ hitatamopāstikarmatvādibhiḥ paramapuruṣasyaiva pratardanavidyāyāmindraśabdapradhānavācyatvaṃ siddhameva| tvāṣṭravadhādinā liṅgena tadviśeṣaṇatvena prasiddhendro'pi parigṛhyate | evaṃ prākaraṇikena liṅgeviśeṣeṇa prasiddhaprāṇo'pi svīkriyatāṃ, natu svarūpeṇa| svarūpeṇa paramātmanopāsanaṃ suprasiddhameva | tenopāsātraividhyasiddhyarthaṃ prasiddhendrādyasādhāraṇalibhgaṃ pratardanavidyāyāmuktamiti na virodhaḥ| ata indrādiviśiṣṭaḥ paramātmeva pratardanavidyāyāmupāsya itīndrādirūḍhiśaktyā viśeṣaṇaparityāgena viśeṣyaparyancābhidhānamiti siddham| kathaṃ tarhi upakramavirodhe vākyārthanirṇaya ityāśaṅkyāha prāṇendrāti | ubhayamiha prakāṣyate upakramopasaṃhārayo upakramopasaṃhārayopurakramo balīyān, upakramamahāvanakyayorvirodhe mahāvākyameva balīya iti| idaṃ punarvirodhe satyameva| atra punarvirodha eva nāstīti bhāṣyakārahṛdayam| mahāvākyagatopakramasyāpīndraviśiṣṭa paramātmaviṣayatvenādhyātmavidbhipanusandhānāditi||
atrādhikaraṇārambhānupapattimāśaṅkya samādhatte  yaditi| ayamarthaḥ  jyotiṣīndre ca yalliṅgaṃ kāraṇaikasthitamiti kathitaṃ bhavatā jyotiṣi tāvat " atha yadataḥ" ityādyuktamuttameṣu lokeṣu niratiśayadīptiyuktatvam, yaccendre tvamityādyabhipretaṃ " māmupāssva " iti sākṣānmuktyarthaṃ mumukṣūpāsyatvam, tadubhayamapi prakhyātānyaikaniṣṭhaṃ kāraṇatvena prakhyātanārāyaṇamaikaniṣṭhaṃ prathamamitam ākāśādhikaraṇatvavayāptaṃ liṅgadvayam, tatkathamucyate| yathā sarvajagatkāraṇatvaṃ paramapuruṣaviṣayatayā prathamamitam, tadvat, tena samavyāptam liṅgadvayamapi tathaiva pramitamevetyarthaḥ| phalitamāha ata iti| niratiśayadīptiyuktatvaliṅgasya mumukṣūpāsyatvasya ca paramapuruṣaniṣṭhatayā pūrvameva pramitatvāt kāraṇatvavyāptaliṅgena pūrvapakṣotthānamiti na ghaṭate| itthaṃ liṅgadvayasya paramapuruṣasthitatvaparāmarśe dūṣaṇamuktam tadabhāve'pi dūṣaṇamāha aprāpta iti| liṅgadvayasya sarvakāraṇasthitatvaparāmarśābhāve liṅgadvayānvitaṃ yatkiṃcijjotirastu yaḥ kaścidindro'stu na caitāvatā pūrvoktamekaniṣṭhaṃ kāraṇatvaṃ paramakāraṇatvaṃ bhraśyati kimarthamadhikaraṇāmbha ityāśaṅkyārdhāṅgīkāreṇa pariharati satyamiti| yadyapyadhikaraṇaprayojanaṃ nāsti, athāpi kiṃcitprayojanamasti, yadyapi liṅgadvayaṃ paramapuruṣaikaniṣṭham, athāpi sa eva paramapuruṣa upendratvamāsthāya vartate, ataḥ so'pyupāsya eva, tasya śrutiḥ purāṇādirivopendrotpatiṃta vāvadītīti kaścit bālabuddhi rbhrāmyati, tacchaṅkānirākaraṇamārambha ityarthaḥ| upendrasya paramapuruṣatvaṃ śrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇeṣu prasiddham, teṣvevendrasya puruṣottamakiṅgaratvamapi tatraiva prasiddhamiti bhāvaḥ||
evamuktayoradhikaraṇayorvirodhābhāsaṃ śamayitvā pūrvapakṣiṇā parigṛhīte'rthe saṃmatāsaṃmatavibhāgaṃ darśayan virodhiliṅgatvena kathitasya kaukṣeyajyotiṣaikyasya mukhyaprāṇādiliṅgasya copāsanārthatvena prayojanamapi darśayati jyotiriti| jyotirādiśabdānāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭhaparamavastuvācitvaṃ saṃmatam| viśeṣaṇamātravācitvasaṃmatam| kaukṣoyajyotiṣaikyamupāsanārtham| tathā mukhyaprāṇaliṅgampyupāsyaviśeṣaṇaprakāśanārthamiti ślokārthasaṃkṣepaḥ| spaṣṭamevāvaśiṣṭham||
atra śiṣyāmugrahārthaṃ ākāśajyotirādyadhikaraṇoktārthavaiśadyāyetaravāciśabdānāṃ brahmaṇi prayoge viṣayabhedena niyamaṃ darśayati  kāryamiti| yat kāryamiti dṛḍhamitamadhigatamākāśādikaṃ yadapi karmavaśyamiti dṛḍhamitaṃ prājāpatyādikaṃ tayo rnirūḍhaiḥ prasiddhaiḥ śabdaiḥ brahmaṇi nirdiṣṭhe sati kvacit ātmāvasthiteṣvākāśādiśabdeṣu gatyantarābhāvādrūḍhirbādhyā| agatihatā  rūḍhitvena nirvāhāsaṃbhavastviha agatiḥ tayā nivāryate rūḍhiḥ| tena yoga evāśrīyata ityarthaḥ| kvacidanyatra prakārāntareṇa nirvāhamāha taditi| jyotiṣi liṅgaṃ kaukṣeyajyotiṣaikyam, indre tvāṣṭravadhādikaṃ tadubhayamananyathāsiddhaṃ vyāptamityarthaḥ|| tattaliṅgānanyathāsiddherjñānabalāt tadviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭhaviṣayatvaṃ syāt| atrodāharaṇacatuṣṭayamāha jyotiriti| jyotirviśiṣṭe brahmaṇi jyotiśabdaḥ| indraviśiṣṭhe punarindraśabdaḥ| evamahaṃ brahmāsmītyatrāhaṃśabdaḥ svātmaviśiṣṭaṃ paramātmānamāha| atra aindrānayenetyetadavaśiṣyate, tadapyācakṣmahe " aindryā gārhapatyam" ityatrendraśabdasya gārhapatye rūḍhiśaktyabhāvāt gauṇīvṛttirvyutpattirvā samāśrayaṇīyā| ubhayamapyāhuḥ 
"indratvamagnau gauṇaṃ syāt yajñasambandhakāritam| indatyarthānusārādvā svakārye so'pi hīśvaraḥ|| " iti|
tenākāśaprāṇaśabdayorasmābhiḥ parasmin brahmaṇi vyutpattirevāśrīyata iti susaṃgatametat| ayamarthaḥ
vyupattyā paramātmānaṃ tattaduktiḥ prakāśayet| talliṅgānanyathāsiddhau tadviśiṣṭāvalambinī|| iti||
pūrvaṃ tadguṇādgṛṇātītyāgāmināmadhikaraṇānāṃ pratyekamekaikabhagavadguṇaprakāśane tātparyamiti pratipāditam| adhunā punaratītānāṃ saptānāmadhikaraṇānāṃ saptasu bhagavadguṇeṣu tātparyamanukramā ityādaujetṛvītahavyavijevṛtayā balapauruṣādiśayayukta ityānuśāsanikādi dācaṣṭe  svecchāta ityādinā| śubheti śubhaguṇavibhavarūpānantanissīmaharṣa ityarthaḥ| anupadhiketi deśakālavastupiracchedarāhityenetyarthaḥ| saprāṇeti saprāṇānāmaprāṇānāṃ prāṇaheturityarthaḥ| tatra prabhuritikathanaṃ sarvādhikaraṇokta vaibhavaprakāśanārtham||
prathamādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ
atītānāṃ pādābhyāmaspaṣṭatarāspaṣṭajīvādiliṅgakāni vākyāni nirūpitāni uttarābhyāṃ punaḥ pādābhyāṃ spaṣṭaspaṣṭatarajīvādiliṅgakāni vākyāni krameṇa nirūpyante| ata eva dvitīya tṛtīyapādayoḥ parasparasaṃgatirapi siddhā| adhikaraṇasaṃgatistu pūrvapādānte dyupṛthivyādisaṃbandhinaḥ paramātmatvamuktam, tadevākṣipya samādhīyate| kiṃcādṛśyatvādyadhikaraṇa eva trailokyaśarīratvena paramātmatvaṃ prasādhitam, tatprasaṅgāt vaiśvānarādhikaraṇe'pi jīvatvamāśaṅkya nirākṛtam| atra punaḥ prāsaṅgikaparisamāptau pūrvādhikaraṇoktārthaśeṣābhidhānena punardyubhvādivākyameva samādhīyate| iha tṛtīyapāde niveśastu nirasanīyajīvādiliṅgānāṃ spaṣṭatvāt| asminkhalu pāde saptaivādhikaraṇāni sākṣātsaṃgatāni|madhye devatādhikaraṇādīni trīṇyarthāntaratvāt na saṃgatānītyāśaṅkya pariharatispaṣṭairiti| spaṣṭairjīvādiliṅgairyutamasmin tṛtīye pāde brahniṣṭhaṃ vacaḥ prasādhyate madhye triṣvadhikaraṇeṣu vidyādhikāroktiḥ kimarthā? tanna prasaṅgādukteḥ "hṛdyapekṣayā tu manuṣyādhikāratvāt" ityadhikāraprasaṅgāt tadukteḥ samucitatvāt| kiṃ ca devatādhikaraṇādyuktau ardhalokāyatikānāṃ nirīśvaramīmāṃsakānāṃ nirasanaṃ paramapuruṣasya caturmukhādipipīlikāntasakalajagatkāraṇatvarūpaprastutārthaprasādhanopayuktameva| devatānāmabhāve tadapekṣayā kāraṇatvāpādānāyogāt| tadapekṣayāpi bhagavata ārādhyatvena brahmotakarṣaśca sidhyet| tāsāṃ devatānāṃ kāraṇaikyabhramo'pi galatyeva||
ataḥ saptānāmadhikaraṇānāṃ sākṣāt saṃgatiḥ, prasaṅgādanyeṣām, tadidamanūdya sākṣātsaṃgateṣu saptasu ṣaṣṭhadaśamayoḥ parasparasaṃgatiṃ cāha nyāyā iti| saptaiva nyāyāḥ sākṣātparaviṣayatayā saṃghaṭante'trapāde| kiṃcāsmin pāde sarvādhāraḥ sa evātmā " kasminpratiṣṭhitaḥ sve mahimni" ityuktakrameṇa bhagavataḥ svamahinilayatvopapādanamananyādhāratvaṃ ca pādasya tātparyaviṣayaḥ| uktaṃ hi pūrvameva sraṣṭā dehī svaniṣṭhaḥ iti "svayaṃ dāsāstapasvinaḥ" itivat| etasya tātparyasya prasiddhyarthaṃ bhagavataḥ sarvapraśāsitṛtvādikaṃ tattadadhikaraṇārthajātaṃ kathitaṃ mitharasyūtaṃ parasparasaṃśliṣṭamālocanīyam| tarhi tribhiradhikaraṇaiḥ ṣaṣṭhadaśamayorvyavadhāne kathaṃ sambandha ityāśaṅkya ṣaṣṭhādhikaraṇapramitaṃ bhagavataḥ sarveśatvaṃ daśamādhikaraṇena tasyaiva mokṣapradatvapratiṣṭhāpanena saṃrakṣaṇīyamiti parasparasaṃbandhaḥ sidhyatyeva||
sūtre dyubhvādītipadadvayopādānamūrdhvalokopalakṣaṇārthamiti mantavyam| atrādhikaraṇārambhamākṣipya samādhatte siddhamityādinā| prāgeva adṛśyatvādhikaraṇa eva| muṇḍopaniṣadiparaṃ brahma svavyavasthāpakaistattaddharmabhedaiḥ siddhabhedameva| bhedokteśca sākṣājjīvaparayorbhedakathanācca| tathā ca sati kimarthamimāmupaniṣadaṃ piṣṭapeṣaṃ pinaṣṭi viśiṣya punaḥ punaḥ pinaṣṭītyarthaḥ| ardhāṅgīkāreṇa samādhatte satyamityādinā| astu pūrvameva vicāritaṃ muṇḍopaniṣadvākyam, athāpi vicāryate tat kimarthamityatrāhakṣetrajñeti| nāḍyādhāratvādibhirasādhāraṇairjīvadharmairupanatā śaṅkāyāḥ punarudayābhāvenonmūlyate śabdapūrvaiḥ śrutyādibhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ| ayamarthaḥ muṇḍopaniṣadvākyayorubhayatrāpi paramapuruṣaguṇapratyabhijñānāt prakaraṇabhedaśaṅkaiva nāsti| nāḍīsambandhādayaścābhāsahetavaḥ| tata ucitaiḥ samādhānarahetubhirbhāṣyakārābhipretaireva samādheyā iti| tadarthavicārastu  kiṃ dyupṛthivyādyāyatanaṃ jīva uta paramātmeti| tadarthaṃ punarvicāryate "yasmindyau" ityādivākyajātaṃ kimadṛśyatvādiguṇakaprakaraṇāt bhinnamutābhinnamiti| tadarthaṃ punaḥ prāṇādisaṃbandhaḥ kimupakāryopakārakatvanibandhana utādhārādheyabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| tadarthaṃ punaḥ prāṇādisaṃbandhaḥ kimupakāryopakārakatvanibandhana utādhāradheyabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| tadarthaṃ dyupṛthivyādyāyatanatvāmṛtasetutvādidharmāḥ kiṃ karmaphalānubhaviturjīvasya saṃbhavanti uta neti||
