atra pūrvapakṣasiddhāntau saṃgṛhṇāti yasminnotamityādinā| "yasmin dyauḥ pṛthivī ca" ityādivākyeṣvanyakaraṇaissaha mano yasminnotaṃ yasminnairantaryeṇa saṃbaddham| yaśca nānā jāyatenāḍyādhāraśca yaśca dehe'ntaścaratīti kathayate, sa cakṣurādinā karaṇī karaṇavān karmabhoktaiveti cet, uktamarthaṃ pratikṣipatineti| tatra hetūnāhaviśveti| viśvādhārātmabhāvenāsmin prakaraṇe paramapuruṣasya kathanāt "amṛtasyaiṣa setuḥ" iti mokṣapradatvapratipādanāt muktaprāpyatvapratipādanāt pūrvoktabrahmaprakaraṇavicchedābhāvāt "anaśnannanyo abhicākaśīti" iti karmaphalabhoktṛtvābhāvena niratiśayadīptiyogāt cakārādanyasmādapi brahmāsādhāraṇaguṇayogāt tvaduktaṃ na ghaṭata ityanvayaḥ||
atha pūrvapakṣayuktīnāmanyathāsidiṃdha vaktumārabhate vyāpta iti| sarvavyāpte bhagavati indriyādikamotaṃ cet kimiha tataḥ kiṃ nopapadyata ityarthaḥ| bhagavato janma nopapadyata iti cetaccopapadyate aicchatvājjanmana ityāhajanmeti| "ajāyamāno bahudhā vijāyate" iti hi śrūyate|
nāḍīcakrahārdarūpeṇa tiṣṭhan hṛdayāntarvartitvena vartamānaḥ| sarvāsāmapi nāḍīnāṃ hṛdayāntarvartiparamapuruṣa sambandhitvāt| śrūyate hi "śataṃ caikā hṛdayasya nāḍyaḥ" iti| tarhi sarvavyāpinaḥ kathamantaśtaraṇamiti cettadapyanūdya samādhatte niṣkampeti| dvirūpaṃ khalvantaryāmitvaṃ bhagavataḥ, vigrahaparigraheṇaikam, sarvavyāptena svarūpeṇāparam| vigraheṇa dehāntaścaraṇaṃ tāvanmukhyata eva svarūpeṇāntaścaraṇaṃ tu "yaḥ pṛthivīmantare sañcaran " ityādinā subālopaniṣadāmnātasarvāntaryāmitvarūpacaraṇavadatrāpi saṃghaṭata eva| antaryāmitvenādhiṣṭhānamātrasyaiva caraṇaśabdavāctvādityarthaḥ||
paramātmaprakaraṇavicchedāt muṇḍopaniṣadi āpādacūḍhaṃ paramātmaparatvameva prasādhitam| tarhi cchāndogye bhūmavidyāyāṃ jīvaprakaraṇāvicchedāt jīva eva pratipādyata iti pūrvapakṣotthānena pramāṇadvārā saṃgatiḥ| arthadvārāpi saṃgatirabhidhīyate pūrvatra " otaṃ manaḥ saha prāṇaiḥ" iti prāṇasambandhī puruṣa uktaḥ, atrāpi prāṇasambandhitvena prāṇaśabdavācyo jīvaevocyata iti| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ bhūmaśabdanirdiṣṭaḥ pratyagātmā uta paramātmeti| kiṃ bhūmaśabdanimittavaipulyena pratgātmānirdiśyate uta paramātmeti| kiṃ prāṇaśabdanirdiṣṭapratgātmani praśnaprativacanābhyāṃ bhūmāpi samāpto neti| kiṃ ca " sa vā eṣa evaṃpaśyannevaṃ manvāna evaṃvijānannativādī bhavati" ityativāditvaṃ prāṇātivādina uktvā " eṣa tu vā ativadati yaḥ satyenātivadati" iti prāṇātivādinaḥ satyavajanamaṅaagatayā vidadhāti uta satyaśabdena paramātmānaṃ nirdiśya tadativādinaḥ prāṇātivādino'pyativāditvaṃ vadatīti| kimasminvākye " eṣa tu vā ativadati" ityatra prāṇātivādinaḥ pratyabhijñāsti neti| kiṃ tuśabdaḥ pratyabhijñānavirothe neti| atra pūrvapakṣasiddhāntau saṃgṛhṇāti ātmeti| iha khalu bhūmavidyāyāṃ sanatkumāro gururnāradaḥ śiṣyaḥ| sa ca sarvamapi vidyāsthānaṃ parijñātavān tathāpi ca bhagavajjñānaśūnyo'hamiti "so'haṃ bhagavato mantravidevāsmi nātmavit" iti ātmajñānābhilāṣādanuparata śoko nāradaḥ| asmai nāradāya pravṛttaṃ sanatkumāravacanaṃ prāṇe paryavasyati| tadeva pratipādayati prāṇa iti| sa ca prāṇākhyo jīva eva tasminneva prakaraṇe tasya hiṃsanārhatvena kathanāt| kiṃ ca atrālpapratyarthitvenābhidhīyamāno bhūmaśabdavācyo'rtho niravadhikasukhāśrayo jīva eva syādityāśaṅkya pratikṣipati neti| tadeva vivṛṇotiprāṇākhyāditi| tatra hi prāṇabdena jīvamuktyā prāṇavedinaścetarasukhātiśayitasukharūpajīvavedino'tivāditvamuktvā tasyāpi jīvasyālpatvena paramātmasukhavedina evāntato'tivāditvaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyate| tena prāṇākhyādadhikaṃ satyaśabda vācyaṃ paraṃ brahmaivāsminprakaraṇe pradhānapratipādyamucyata iti ||
pūrvapakṣābhiprāyaṃ vistareṇoktvā svābhiprāyamapi tathaiva kathayati nāmeti| nāmopakramya āśānte dikparyante vedye praśnaprativacanayoranuvṛttatvāduttarottaramatiśayitaphalavattvenādhikokteśca dṛṣṭatvāt prāṇe tādṛgabhidhānasya viśrāntidarśanācca prastutātmopadeśaḥ prāṇāvadhiḥ syāt| tataḥ prāṇasyopari satyaśabdavācyatayā ātmopadeśo nāsti| uktamarthaṃ pratikṣipatimaivamiti| iha asminprakaraṇe| nāmādivat prāṇo'pi parasmādātmano jāta uktaḥ| jātasya tasya kathaṃ paramātmatvam| nanvatrātmaśabdaḥ svātmaparaḥ, tena svasmājjāta iti prakaraṇāvirodhaḥ syādityāśaṅkya pratikṣipati  neti| tatra hetumāha vighaṭanāditi| kāryakāraṇabhāvapratipādikāyāḥ svārasikyā vibhaktervighaṭanāt | kāryakāraṇabhāvo'pi bhedagarbha eva| svātmana utpattikathanaṃ kliṣṭameveti bhāvaḥ||
śiṣyapratibodhanārthaṃ pūrvapakṣābhiprāyaṃ vivicya taducitamuttaramapyāha prāṇadraṣṭeti| atra hi prāṇadraṣṭā ativāditvenoktaḥ, tadanūdya satyavādo'ṅgatvena vidhīyate, tasmāt sarvāhamartho jīvaḥ khalvadṛṣṭadvārā sakalatattvotpādakaḥ prāṇa eveti cet tadetatpratikṣipati neti| pratikṣepahetuṃ vivṛṇoti eṣa iti| "eṣa tu vā agnihotrī yaḥ satyaṃ vadati" ityatrāpi tuśabdaśiraska eṣaśabdola dṛśyate athāpi tatrādhikāryantaraṃ na kalpyate tadvadatrāpi syādityāśaṅkyāha tadvaditi| tatra hyagnihotradvayaṃ na pramitam, iha tu pramitameva| pūrvaṃ prāṇātivādinamuktvā punaśca "eṣa tu vā ativadati yaḥ satyenātivadati" iti dvivāramativāditvamucyate naivamagnihotravākye dvivāramagnihotritvamucyate| tena pūrvāgrihotriṇamuddiśya satyavadanamaṅgatayā vidhīyata iti yuktam| atra punastuśabdasahitaitacchabdenātivādyantaraṃ pratīyata iti viśeṣaḥ| anyathā punaratrāpi "eṣa tu vā ativadati yaḥ satyenātivadati" ityadhikāryantaraṃ na śrūyeta| kiṃ ca yadi jīve viśrāntiḥ syādvākyasya tadānīmetatprakaraṇoktānāṃ paramātmāsādhāraṇadharmāṇāmanupapattiḥ syāt| tena svamahimanilaye paramātmanyeva sarvadharmopapattiḥ syādityayamapi hetuḥ paramātmasādhane bhavati||
atra bhūmavidyāyāṃ nāmādyāśāparyantavastūnāṃ svarūpapratipattyarthaṃ tatsaṃgrahaślokamāha nāmeti| ādau nāma tasyopari vāk tadanu manaḥ atha saṃkalpanāmā tataścittaṃ tato'pyanantaraṃ dhyānaṃ tato vijñānaṃ tato balaṃ tasmādannaṃ tasmāttoyaṃ tasmādapi tejaḥ tataḥ punarākāśastato manmathaḥ tata āśā tataḥ prāṇaśabdavācyo jīvaḥ sarveṣāmupari satyaśabdavācyaḥ paramātmā sarvaniyantā'yameveti gamyata iti||
pūrvādhikaraṇe svamahimapratiṣṭhitatvamuktam| tattu paramapuruṣavyatirikte'pi śrūyata iti pūrvapakṣotthānena saṃgatiḥ| athavā " yenākṣaraṃ puruṣaṃ veda satyam" iti satyākṣaraśabdābhyāṃ nirdiśya parasya brahmaṇaḥ satyaśabdavācyatvaṃ pūrvatra pratiṣṭhāpitam, atrākṣaraśabdavācyatvaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyata iti vā saṃgatiḥ|
evaṃvā pūrvaṃ jīvanirāsaḥ, iha tu jīvapradhānayordvayorapi nirāsa iti| tadarthavicārastu "etadvai tadakṣaraṃ gārgi brāhmaṇā abhivadanti" iti vākye punarakṣaraśabdanirdiṣṭaṃ pradhānaṃ vā jīvo vā paramapuruṣo veti| tadarthaṃ cintyate"kasminnu khalvākāśa otaśca protaśca" ityatra pratīyamānamākāśādhāratvaṃ kiṃ pradhānasya kiṃ vā jīvasya uta paramātmana eveti| kimatrākāśaśabdanirdiṣṭo bhūtākāśa uta avyākṛtākāśa iti| atra pūrvapakṣasiddhāntāvanukrameṇācaṣṭe prakhyāteti|"kasminnu khalvākāśa otaśca protaśca" ityādau prasiddhākāśapūrvasvakāryavahanādakṣaraśabdavācyaṃ pradhānamevetyekaḥ pakṣaḥ| tasyāpi pradhānasya kāraṇākāśatvena ākāśata iti vyutpattyā avadhāritasyāpyādhāratvenābhidhīyamānamakṣaraṃ dhṛtanikhilajagat samaṣṭi jīvatattvameva syāt prakṛterjīvādhiṣṭhānatvāt| pakṣadvayamapi vyudasyatimaivamiti| tatra hetumāhadraṣṭṛtveti|cetanācetanayorasaṃbhāvitaiḥ sarvadraṣṭṛtvādibhirdharmairbhagavadasādhāraṇaiḥ "sā ca prasāśanāt" ityukta prakāreṇa svaśāsanāyattadhāraṇācca| kiṃca asminprakaraṇe draṣṭrantarasya vyudasanaṃ dṛśyate| tattu paramātmanapakṣa eva saṃbhavati, na punarjīvapakṣe draṣṭurjīvādanyasya sarvadraṣṭuḥ paramātmano vidyamānatvāt| tena draṣṭranyaranirākaraṇamīśvarāntaranirākaraṇameva| tadidamāha draṣṭkantarasyeti| viśvādhāratayā niyantṛtvena viśvadraṣṭuḥ paramapuruṣasādanyasya draṣṭurvyudasanaṃ paramapuruṣādhikatayā paramapuruṣaniyantṛtvena avasthitatatsadṛśeśvarāntaranirāsa ityarthaḥ||
sūtre "saḥ" iti pulliṅganirdeśaḥ paramapuruṣavivakṣayā| pūrvatra khalu "adṛṣṭo draṣṭā" iti paramātmano'nyairadṛṣṭatvamuktam, tarhīkṣatikarmatvenābhidhīyamānaḥ paramapuruṣo ma syādeveti pūrvapakṣotthānena saṃgatiḥ| athavā pūrvatrākāśaśabdasyārthavirodhādarthāntaraparatvaṃ pratyapādi, tadvadevāntarikṣaśabdasyāpi mukhāntareṇa nirvāhaḥ saṃbhavediti śaṅkayā saṃgatiriti cāhuḥ| yadvā ākāśaśabdasyāmbarāntaparatvāt brahmalokaśabdasyāpyanyathānirvāho'stīti saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu " yaḥ punaretaṃ trimātreṇomityenenaivākṣareṇa paramapuruṣamabhidhyāyīta" iti nirdiṣṭaḥ caturmukha uta paramātmeti| kiṃ "puruṣamīkṣate" ityatrekṣatikarmatvaṃ caturmukhasya uta paramātmana iti| kiṃ jīvadhanaśabdena caturmukhasyāpi grahaṇamasti neti| kimatra brahmalokaśabdaścaturmukhasthānavacana uta paramavyomavacana iti| īkṣatikarmaviṣayatayogāhṛte śloke "yattatkavayā vedayante" iti vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ pratbhijñāyate neti| atra pūrvapakṣamuktvā krameṇa pratyācaṣṭe  lakṣībhūta iti| asmin prakaraṇe yathopāsanaṃ phalamiti nyāyena ya eva dhyānaviṣayassa eva prāpya iti dvayorapi vādinoḥ sammato dhyāyaterīkṣateśca viṣayībhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ| sa tu mukhyo jīva eka eva kṣetrajñaḥ| sa evāṇḍādhipatiḥ| "parātparaṃ puriśayaṃ puruṣamīkṣate" iti saiva īkṣatikarmatvena vyapadeśaḥ| asya parātparatvaṃ prakṛtyādibhyaḥ parasmājjīvātparatvena| itthamanaṅgīkāreṇa doṣamāhanocediti| pariharatiayuktamiti| praṇavopāsye tasmin parasmin vastuni śāntāmṛtatvādiparamātmaguṇopavarṇanasya tadanuvādasya cāyogāt| tena paramātmāsādhāraṇa guṇānvayādetatprakaraṇapratipādyaḥ paramapuruṣa evetyarthaḥ||
atra codayatinanviti| pūrvamekadvimātrapraṇavopāsanaphalatayā nirdiṣṭabhūmyantarikṣagaṇanānirdiṣṭo brahmalokaḥ trimātrapraṇavopāsanaphalatayā nirdiśyamānaḥ pūrvoktapratayāsattyā caturmukhaloka eva syāt| na syādityāha maivamiti|tatra hetumāhapāponmukteneti| asminprakaraṇe sarvapāpavinirmuktasya prāpyatayā śrūyamāṇo brahmaloko na kṣayiṣṇucaturmukhasthānaṃ bhavitumarhati| kiṃ ca "sa tejasi sūrye sampannaḥ" iti sūryasampattipūrvakaṃ prāpyatayā śrūyamāṇo brahmalokaḥ "saṃvatsarādādityam" ityarcirādimārgapratyabhijñānānmuktaprāpyo vaikuṇṭha eva syāditi| asminnapi prakaraṇe "yattatkavayo vedayante" iti sūriddasyatvamucyate| tadidamāhasūryasampattipūrvamiti| nanvantarikṣalokapratyāsattyā caturmukhaloka eva syāditi cenna ;madhye svargādīnāṃ bahūnāṃ lokānāṃ vyavadhānena pratyāsatterabhāvāt| tāvadvvadhānaṃ soḍhavyamiti cet samaḥ samādhiḥ| atra caturmukhalokavyavadhānāmapi tadāhasoḍhavya ityādinā| kiṃcopakrame "paramapuruṣamabhidhyāyīta" itidhyānaviṣayasyaivekṣatikarmatvaṃ vācyam| anyathā tatkratunyāyavirodhaḥ syādityādidūṣaṇamūhyam | tasmādīkṣatikarmatvena vyapadiśyamānaḥ paramātmaiveti siddham||
pūvādhikaraṇe "parātparaṃ puriśayaṃ puruṣam" ityuktasya puriśayapuruṣasya paramātmatvaṃ sādhitam, atra puriśayasyākāśaśabdavācyasya paramātmatvaṃ nirasyata iti saṃgatiḥ| pūrvaṃ brahmalokaśabdasya paramātmasthānaparatvamuktam| tadvadihāpi brahmalokaśabdabrahmapuraśabdayoḥ sthānaparatvaṃ syāditi śaṅkayā saṃgatiḥ| yadvā pūrvatrāntarikṣaśabdasya prasiddhāntarikṣaparatvaṃ vyāvartitam, tadvat daharākāśasya prasiddhākāśadharmiparatvaṃ pratipādyata iti saṃgatiḥ parasminnanveṣṭavyāntarapratītyanupapatteḥ pakṣadvaye'pyupamānopameyābhāvānupapatteśca saṃśayaḥ| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ daharākāśo bhūtākāśa uta jīvo'tha paramātmeti| tadarthamanveṣṭavyāntaranirdeśaḥ kiṃ daharākāśasya paramātmatvavirodhī uta neti| "tasminyadantaḥ"iti nirdeśaḥ kiṃ guṇajātaviṣaya utārthāntaraparaḥ| "eṣa ātmā" iti vākyoktamapahatapāpmatvādikaṃ kiṃ prajāpativākyoktajīvadharmaḥ uta na| jīvadharmatve'pahatapāpmatvādiśrutisvārasyamasti uta neti| phalaphalibhāvastu yadā "tasminyadantaḥ"iti nirdeśo'rthāntaraparaḥ, tadā'nveṣṭavyaśabdasya guṇaviṣayatvābhāvena daharākāśasya bhūtākāśatvaṃ syāt| yadā "eṣa ātmā" iti vākyoktaguṇāṣṭakasya prajāpativākyoktajīvadharmatve svārasyamasti, tadānīṃ "eṣa ātmā" iti vākyasya jīvaviṣayatayā daharākāśo jīvaḥ syāditi pūrvapakṣe phalaphalibhāvaḥ| yadā tasminyadantaḥ" iti guṇajātaviṣayoktistadā'nveṣṭavyaśabdasya guṇajātaviṣayatvād daharākāśo bhūtākāśādatiriktaḥsyāt, yadā "eṣa ātmā" iti vākyasya prajāpativākyoktadharmaviṣayatve svārasyaṃ nāsti tadā svaraso guṇāṣṭakaviśiṣṭaparamātmapratipādakatayā sa daharākāśaḥ paramātmā syāditi rāddhānte phalaphalibhāvaḥ|
viṣayavākyaśodhapūrvakaṃ pūrvapakṣasiddhāntau saṃgṛhṇāti dahraṃ hṛtpuṇṭarīka iti| ayamarthaḥ  " daharo'sminnantarākāśaḥ" iti taittarīye ca gaganākāśaśabdoḥ paryāyatvenākāśa evoktaḥ, sa cākāśo bhūtākāśa eva syāt, ākāśaśabdasya brahmaṇi ca prasiddhiprakarṣāditi | tadāha prasiddhermahimata iti|
tadetatpratikṣipatineti| tatra hetumāha pratyanīkairiti| "eṣa ātmā'pahapāpmā" ityādivākyagatairnirupādhikātmatvāpahatapāpmatāvasatyasaṃkalpatvādibhiḥ paramātmāsādharaṇairdharmairatrākāśaśabdanārdiṣṭasya viśeṣyamāṇatvāt | kiṃca dvividhā hi prasiddhirvaidikī laukikī ceti| tatra vaidikī prasiddhirvedavidāṃ vyavahāreṣu balavatī tenātrākāśaśabdanirdiṣṭaḥ paramātmaiva| kiṃca nirupādhikāpahatapāpmatvādiliṅgasanāthāyāḥ "yadeṣa ākāśa ānando na syāt" ityādiśrutyantarasiddhāyā ākāśaśabdaprasiddherbhagavati balīyastvācca| tadidamāhaśrautī ceti| nakevalaṃ śrautaprasiddhi:, liṅgānyapi vidyanta ityāhaliṅgavargairiti||
punarapi bhūtākāśatvanirāsakān viṣayavākyān hetūn saṃhṇātibāhyākāśa ityādipūrvārdhena| tasyāyamarthaḥ"yāvānvāyamākāśastāvāneṣo'ntarhṛdaya ākāśaḥ " ityupamānopameya bhāvastu daharākāśasya bhūtākāśatve nopapadyate upamānopameyabhāvasya bhedagarbhatvāt | hṛdayāvacchedanibandhana upamānopameyabhāva iti cet tathā sati hṛdayāvacchinnasya "ubhe asmindyāvāpṛthivī" ityādipratipāditasarvāśrayatvānupapatteḥ| kiṃca "etatsatyaṃ brahmapurumeṣa ātmā" ityādinirdiṣṭasatyātmabrahmaśabdavācyatvaṃ bhūtākāśe na saṃbhavatīti| tadidamāhasatyeti| nanu "tasminyadantastadanveṣṭavyam" ityākāśāntarvartyanveṣṭavyāntaranirdeśād daharākāśo na paramātmeti cet tatrāha kāmādhāraśceti| atra yaḥ kāmādhāraḥ samagaṇi gaṇita uktaḥ, nityaḥ sa eva daharākāśavācāpyuktaḥ, atastasyaiva eṣa ātmetyanuvadanaṃ tadguṇāśca cintyakāmā iti yojanā| ayaṃ bhāvaḥkiṃ tadatra vidyate yadanveṣṭavyamiti praśnapūrvakaṃ "tasminkāmāḥ samāhitāḥ" iti daharākāśaśabdanirdiṣṭasya paramātmanastadantarvartino guṇāṣṭakasya ca prathamamupāsanaṃ vidhīyate| ata eva phalavākye "atha ya ihātmānamanuvidya vrajantyetāṃśca satyānkāmān" ityubhayorapyupāsyatvaṃ nirdiśyata iti daharākāśaḥ paramātmā| tadantarvatyanveṣṭavyaṃ cāpahatapāpmatvādiguṇajātaṃ kāmaśabdenocyata iti| kāmyanta iti kāmāḥ kalyāṇaguṇāḥ||
chāndogye daharākāśaḥ paramātmetyabhidhīyate, vājasaneyināṃ tu śākhāyāṃ "ya eṣo'nthṛdaya ākāśastasmiñthete sarvasya vaśī sarvasyeśānaḥ" ityākāśe śayāna eva paramātmatvenābhidhīyate, prasiddhākāsa eva tadvācakena śabdenocyatace, tatkathamubhayonvayaḥ| atra samādhimāhasarveśeti| vājināṃ tu śākhāyāṃ sarveśvarasyādhāratayā hṛdayavyomābhidhīyate tena tatra vyomaśabdābhidheyaṃliṅgaviśeṣāt prasiddhākāśa evetyaṅgīkurmahe| chāndogye ākāśaśabdaḥ sarvakāmādhāratvakathanālliṅgāt paramapuruṣaparaeva| nanu cchāndogye brahmalokaśabdaḥ prayujyate natu brahmaiva loko brahmaloka iti samāsaḥ, brahmaṇo loko brahmaloka iti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣasamāsāśrayaṇasya nyāyyatvāditi cenna "etayā niṣādasthapatiṃ yācayet" ityatra karmadhārayasamāsasyaivāśrayaṇāt tena nyāyānusāreṇa brahmaiva loko brahmaloka ityasmābhirvyākhyātamiti na kaściddoṣaḥ| tadidamāhachāndogyeti| nirṇāyakanyāyābhāve hyarthāntaramāśaṅkyate| asya ca brahmaṇaḥ sarvādhāratvena lokaśabdavācyatvaṃ ca yujyate|imamevārthamāpastambo'pi vadatīti darśayatiāpastamba iti| "sa vai vaibhājanaṃ puraṃsa ca bhūtaṃ sa bhavyam "iti sarvātmabhūtaṃ brahmaiva sarveṣāṃ puratvena pratipādayati|sa vaibhājanamsarveṣāṃ padārthāṃnāṃ pratyekavibhajanena sthātuṃ yogyaṃ sthānam| "puḥ prāṇinaḥ sarva eva guhāśayasya " ityapyāha|sarve prāṇino guhāśayasya paramātmanaḥ puramityarthaḥ|tena prāṇinaḥ paramātmānaḥ puramāvāsasthānam| tadapitathāpi|tadapibrahmāpi|teṣāṃ puraṃsarvādhāratvena sarveṣāmasminvāsāt|tena "sarvatrāsau samastaṃ ca vasatyatreti vai yataḥ " iti vāsudevaśabdārtho'nusmṛto bhavati|
itthaṃ daharākaśasya prasiddhakāśatvamāśaṅkya nirākṛtam|idānīṃ jīvatvamāśaṅkya nirākriyatejīva iti|tarhi guṇādhāratvānupapattyā prasiddhakāśatve nivṛtte'pyapahatapātvādiguṇopapatteḥ "eṣa ātmā " iti jīvasyaiva parāmarśanāt "tatrāpi dahraṃ gaganaṃ viśokaḥ " iti alpapramāṇatvakathanācca jīva eva daharākāśaḥ syādityāśaṅkya pratikṣipatiasaditi|atra hetumāhaanupadhikāditi|svābhāvikādityarthaḥ|paramātmano hi svābhāvikaṃ satyasaṃkalpatvādikam|jīvasya tu tatprasādalabhyam| "paraṃ jyotirūpasampadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate " iti vacanāt|kiṃca prapañcādhāratvaṃ paramapuruṣasyātra kathyatetenāpi para eva pratipādyaḥ| nanu daharatvamuktaṃ tasya tatkathamityāśaṅkya pariharatiaupādhikīti| nātra paramātmanaḥ sbhāvikaṃ daharatvamucyate apitu hṛdayāvacchedanibandhanaṃ taducyata ityarthaḥ| nanu prajāpativākye jīvasyāpyapahatapāpmatvādiguṇāṣṭakamabhidhīyate tenāpahatapāpmatvādīnāṃ bhagavadasādhāraṇyaṃ kathaṃ sidhyatītyāśaṅkyāhaprājāpatya iti| ayamarthaḥdaharavākyaprakaraṇasamāmnātaṃ prajāpativākyaṃ daharavākyaśeṣameva tatra pratipādyo'pi jīvaḥ paramapuruṣaprasādalabhyatatsāmyadaśayā'pahatapāpmatvādigatuṇaudhaparikarmitaḥ syāt| tathā ca na kaściddoṣaḥ||
tarhi prajāpativākyaṃ daharavākyadbhinnameva syāt, tatpratipādyo'paki jīvaḥ svatantra eva syāt kimarthaṃ nirākāṅkṣayordvayorapi vākyoḥ parasparasaṃbandho bhavadbhirupapādyata ityāśaṅkya pariharatidahrākāśa iti| nāsmābhiratrākāṅkṣā parikalpyate apitu vākyasyābhāvyādeva| atra hi pūrvasminvākye pratipannasya bhagavato mokṣapradatvaṃ pratipādayituṃ jīvakathanam| saṃprasādo jīvaḥ| bhagavatsaṃbandhajñānarasikatvena prasannasvabhāvatvāt| utaratra prajāpativākye'pi pratipādyasya jīvasya prāpyaviśeṣanirdhāraṇārthaṃ tasminvākye paramātmaparipaṭhanam| tadvamāṅakṣāsattiyogyatvairubhayorapaki vākyayoranvitatve sati na vākyabhedaḥ parikalpyaḥ| tathā ca na pūrvottaravākyayonyabādhaḥ śaṅkyaḥ | naca nairapekṣyaṃ parikalpyam; saṃbhavatvekavākyatve vākyabhedastu neṣyata iti nyāyenaikavākyatve saṃbhavati vākyabhedāṅgīkārasyānyāyyatvāt| ato dvayorapi vākyayoḥ sāmarasyameva sūtrakāraḥ proheti darśayatitaditi||
pūrva daharavidyāyāmalpatvena śrutaḥ paramaruṣa iti "alpaśruteriti cettaduktam" iti sūtra pratyapādi, tadalpapimāṇayuktatvaṃ jīvasyaivānyatra śrūyata iti pūrvapakṣotthānena saṃgatiriti bhāṣya evoktam| tadarthavicārastu "aṅguṣṭhamātra puruṣaḥ" ityaṅguṣṭhapramitaḥ pratyagātmā uta paramātmeti| tadarthavicārastu kimīśānatvaṃ dehendriyādyapekṣam, uta sarvāpekṣamiti| tadarthavicārastukimupakramagatapramitatvamīśānanvaliṅgasvārasyavirodhi na vetiḥ| tadartha vicāryatekiṃ tatpramitatvaṃ jīve samañjasamuta ubhayatrāsamañjasamiti| atra viṣayavākyāni bhāṣyadīpayovryaktaṃ draṣṭavyāni| tatra pūrvapakṣamuktavāpratikṣipatiprāṇaśaiti| "prāṇādhipassañcarati svakarmabhiḥ| aṅguṣṭhamātro ravitulyarūpaḥ" iti śrutiratrābhisandhīyate| karmabhiḥ svairasañcaran prāṇena eva kvacit śrutāvaṅacguṣṭhamātraḥ kathitaḥ| anyatra vākye punaḥ "aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ niścakarma yamo balāt" iti ddaṣṭam tasmādetatpramāṇapramitamaṅāguṣṭhamātraṃ jāvamupaniṣadāheti pūrvapakṣaparikalpanam| tadayuktaṃ svavākyasthitena "īśāno bhūtabhavyasya" ityukteneśānatvādinā liṅgena nirastatvāt| kathaṃ tarhīṣaśānasyāṅguṣṭhapramitatvamityāśaṅkyāhanareti| upāsakahṛdayaparicchdāpekṣayā tadaṅguṣṭhapramitatvamucyate napunaḥ svābhāvikam|| atrādhikaraṇamadhye manuṣyādhikāratvaprasaṅgādadhikaraṇatrayakathanaṃ tenātra tṛtīyādhyāyaprasādhyādhikāra cintanādadhyāyasaṅkaraprasaṅga ityatrāhanahītyādinā| itthaṃ kila kaścinmanyate pūrvatrāṅguṣṭhapramitatvaṃ paramapuruṣasyoktaṃ tacca hṛdayāpekṣayetyuktaṃ nahi sarveṣāṃ jantūnāṃ hṛdayāṅguṣṭhapramitatvam; aṅguṣṭhābhāvāt tenākhilajantvāśrayaṃhṛdayamaṅguṣaṣṭhapramitamiti vaktuṃ na śakyata iti| satyametat, sarvāśrayaṃ hṛdayamaṅguṣṭhapramitamiti nocyate apitūpāsakahṛdayam| tena sarvavyāpte parasmin brahmaṇyaṅguṣṭha pramitatvakathanaṃ kvacinmanuṣyādhikārāpekṣayeti mantavyam| tenādhikāraprasaṅgenāsminnadhikaraṇe sūtracatuṣṭayātmake dvayordvayoḥ sūtrayormadhye tribhiradhikaraṇairadhikāraviśeṣaścintyate|na punaratratṛtīyādhyāyasthairadhikaraṇaiḥ sthāpanīyā'dhikriyā avagantumiṣṭā tena nādhyāyasaṅgaraprasaṅgaḥ|tadidamāha tātīryairiti|itikartavyatā nāma aṅgakalāpaḥ||
pūrvasminnadhikaraṇe "hṛdyapekṣayā tu manuṣyādikāratvāt" iti brahmopāsanasya manuṣyādhikāratvamuktatam| tarhi devādīnāṃ brahmavidyāyāmadhikāro na syādityāśaṅkayā saṃgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ brahmavidyāyāṃ devādīnāmadhikāro'sti neti| kiṃ tadvigrahapratipādakānāṃ mantrārthāvādānāṃ tatparatvaṃ saṃbhavati neti| kiṃ teṣāṃ vigrahavattvaṃ saṃbhavati neti| kiṃ tadvigrahapratipādakānāṃ mantrārthavādānāṃ tatparatvaṃ saṃbhavati neti| kiṃ mantrārthavādānāmanuṣṭheyārthaprakāśanastutiparatvābhyāṃ pratīyamānavigraharaparatvāvikṣā śakyābhidhānā neti| kiṃ vigrahavattvamanuṣṭheyārthaprakāśanastutyupayogi neti| atra devatādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣamuktvā pratikṣipatiśabdātmeti| caturthyantaḥśabda eva devatā athavā laukikāgnyādirartha eva yadvā arthopaśliṣṭaśabdo devatā athastasyā brahmopāsanaṃ na saṃbhavatīti|anārṣamavaidikamityarthaḥ| devatāyā abhāve sati devatāyāḥ phalapradatvameva na syāt| tathā ca "sa evaṃ prītaḥ prīṇāti" iti śrutāyā devatāyāḥ prīteḥ pariharaṇaṃ paritāgaḥ syāt| aśrutasya apūrvasya kalpyasya vācyasya vā matabhedena parikalpanaṃ bhavet| taccāyuktameva śrutahānāśrutakalpanayoratyantajaghanyatvāt| nanvevaṃ sati śāstrayonyadhikaraṇe nirastamīśvarānumānaṃ tatkathamatra devatāṅgīkāraḥ? īśvarasyāpi devatāntarbhāvādityāśaṅkya pariharativiśvasraṣṭeti| tatreśvarasyānumānikatvaṃ nirasyate'smābhiḥ na punarāgamikatvam, tena prāk śāstrayonyadhikaraṇe nirbādhaisyātparyaśālibhiḥ śāstra sthāpitaḥ paramapuruṣastenāpi sarvaśaktinā'palapitumaśakyaḥ | tenāgamikeśvaravādināmasmākaṃ na ko'pi doṣa iti||
arthitvasāmarthyoḥ sadbhāvāt devatānāmuktamevādhikāraṃ viśeṣeṇa sthāpayatisāmarthyamiti| arthī samarthā vidvān śāstreṇāparyudasta iti cāturvidhyenādhikāra ucyate| athavā'rthitvaṃ sāmarthyaṃ ceti dvidhevādhikāraḥ| sāmarthyaṃ punasridhā janmasāmarthyaṃ karmasāmarthyaṃ buddhisāmarthyaṃ ceti, tadetatasarvamapi devatānāmastītyucyateucitatanubhṛtāmiti| śarīrasaṃbandhasya pramāṇapratipannatvāt buddhisāmarthyaṃ karmasāmarthyaṃ cāstyeva| dṛśyate hi kvatijjanmāntarāvismaraṇād buddhisāmarthyam, kvacidupadeśācca| śrūyate hīndrādīnāṃ brahmavidyopadeśaḥ| janmasāmarthyaṃ sattvotpattiśarīraparigrahādeva| arthitvaṃ tu tāpatrayābhihatatvādeva sampadyata iti tāsāmapi devatānāṃ bhagavadupāsanavargāghikāro bhavatyeva| atra nirīśvaramīmāṃsakāḥ pratyavatiṣṭhante dehādīnāmanupalabdhaṃ tadeva hi prakhyāpyate vedeneti tāntrikamaryādā| tathā ca pramāṇāntarāpratipannārthapratyāyakamantrārthavādapramitaṃ sakalamapi devatāvigrahādikaṃ kāraṇadoṣabādhakapratyayābhāve sati tathyamityaṅgīkaraṇīyam, ye punastanmithyetyudghoṣayanti nirīśvaramīmāṃsakāḥ te tu svoktameva vedasya svataḥprāmāṇyaṃ vismaranti| svata eva prāmāṇyaṃ, parataḥ punaraprāmāṇyamiti hi mīmāṃsakānāṃ maryādā| paraṃ punaḥ kāraṇadoṣādikaṃ tatra nāstītyarthaḥ||
atra kaścidāhaarthavādādeḥ stutiparatvamucyate tāntrikaiḥ, arthapārāmārthye stutitvaṃ bādhyata iti| imāmāśaṅkāṃ pariharatidvedhā vṛttiriti| guṇena guṇinaḥ sambandhābhidhānaṃ hi stotram| tad dvividhaṃ mukhyamaupacārikaṃ ceti| mukhyaṃ tāvadyathārtham"apahatapāpmā virajaḥ" ityādikam| aupacārikaṃ tu rājādiviṣayaṃ tvamindraścandra ityādikam| tatrāpi tattadindracandrādiguṇasambandhakathanaṃ paramārthaviṣayameva, tadetatsarvamatra pūrvordhenoktam| tathāhi| stutau dvedhāvṛttiḥ svaguṇamukhī kācit paraguṇamukhīcānyā| tatra prāktanī tāvadarthyā arthādanapetā| paścimāyāmapi stutau mukhyadharmaikadeśo nipuṇadhībhiranumantavyaḥ| nanu bālopacchandanārthamanṛtamapi kathyate taccauṣadhādistutirūpaṃ, tanmithyaiva ataḥ stutimithyātvaṃ dṛṣṭamevetyāśaṅkyāharucyarthāyāmiti| ayamarthaḥ yatra rucyarthamapyanṛtamucyate tatrāpi śrotā na mugdhaścet anṛtakathanataḥ prarocanā naiva sidhyati| mugdhaścet paramārthaviṣayatvapratipattyaiva tadvākyaṃ tasmai rocate| ato'rthapāramārthyaṃ stutyupayuktameva| nanu bhūtārthe kā stutiḥ syāt iti munibhiruktam, kavibhirapi "bhūtārthavyāhṛtiḥ sā hi na stutiḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ" iti, tataḥ stuteḥ pāramārthyaṃ nāstītyucyate;tanna aupacārikanivṛttyarthatvāttadvākyasya| napunaḥ sarvathā pāramārthyaṃ niṣidhyate stutīnām| parameṣṭhinastutitvaupacārikastutirna bhavati, api tu tāttvikītyarthaḥ||
atra "vigraho havirādānam" ityādinā vigrahādipañcakanirāsena devatānāmadhikāro brahmavidyāyāṃ nāstīti pralāpaṃ pratyācaṣṭenāneti| nānādehaparigrahasamarthā devādaya iti śrutipurāṇādiṣu prasiddhameva tena tādṛśaśaktiyuktānāṃ devatānāṃ yugapatkarmasannidhiḥ kathamiva na saṃyoyujyate| nanu savigrahāṇāṃ devatānāṃ tadvyāpārāṇāṃ ca pratipādane tāsāmanityatvāt śrutīnāṃ nityatvāt nityānityasaṃyogadoṣaḥ prasajyetetyāśaṅkya pariharatitattaditi|tatra hetumāhapravāhāditi|
anityeṣvapi devatāvigraheṣu tattadvṛttānteṣu tādṛgvidheṣu anityasaṃyogadoṣo nāsti śrutīnām, indrādipravāhādiviṣayatvāt| tarhi śrutīnāṃ nityatvamucyate bhavadbhiḥ tannopapadyate kāṭhakaṃ viśvāmitrasya sūktamityādiṣu, sakartṛkatvaṃ pratīyate| netyāhakāṇḍādāviti| śrutiṣu keṣāṃcit kartṛtvavādaḥ pravacanādeva| napunaḥ sākṣātkartṛtvena | tatkathamiticettatra hetumāhavedeti| vedanityatvasya pramāṇapratipannatvādityarthaḥ| astu madhye vedapravartakatvameva vyāsaviśvāmitrādīnām| ādikalpe bhagavāneva vedaṃ vividhaṃ karotīti "tasya ha vā etasya mahato bhūtasya niśvasitametat " ityādibhiḥ śratibhiḥ pratipannamityāśaṅkya pariharatiīśa iti|"dhātā yathāpūrvamakalpayat" iti bhagavato'pi pūrvakalpakrameṇa pravartakatvamabhidhīyate|yadyapi vedo bhagavacchāsanam,tathāpi bhagavato nityamekarūpeṇa vākyena praśāsitṛtvānnityatvaṃ nāpabhraśyatīti bhagavacchāsanamatvavādaḥ|atra varṇasarge'pīti varṇeṣvanityamaṅgīkriyate tena varṇanityātvavādibhyo nirīśvaramīmāṃsakebhyo bhedaḥ siddhyati||
atra nyāyavādināṃ pakṣamanūdya nirākaroti vedānāvamiti|"pratimanvantaraṃ caiṣā śruturanyā vidhīyate" ityuktatvād vedānāvamīśvarabuddhyā kramaniyamahatisteṣu kalpeṣvanyathā bhavatīti yadīṣṭā yajñādiṣu prayujmānānāṃ mantrāṇāmapi tathaivānyathākaraṇaṃ syāt| astvanyathākaraṇamityāśaṅkya pratikṣipatineti| tatra hetumāhavrīhīti| ayamarthaḥ loke kāryakāraṇabhāvo niyata eva dṛśyate yathā kapālena ghaṭastantunā paṭa iti| nahi kalpabhedena tantubhyo ghaṭo jāyate paṭo vā kapālebhya iti parikalpeṣu nyāyavādibhiḥ| evaṃ vaidike'pyudāharaṇe "vrīhibhiryajeta, somena yajeta" ityādau sarveṣvapi kalpeṣu tattatkāryahetubhūtānāṃ mantrāṇāmanyathākaraṇaṃ na saṃghaṭata eva| tathā ca vedanityatvasiddhiḥ| tarhyastu mantrāṇāṃ kramaniyama āvaśyakatvāt, māstu vidhyarthavādayoriti cet tatrottaramāhaitthamiti| ayamarthaḥ mantrāṇāmiva vidhyarthavādayo'pi teṣuteṣu jñāneṣu kāraṇatvamastyeva tatra yathātvaṃ niyamamantareṇa na kāraṇatvam| evaṃ kramaniyamamantareṇa na kāraṇamiti bhavataiva vicārya santoṣṭavyam, tathāca kāryakāraṇayoranyathākaraṇaśaṅkāyā nāvakāśaḥ| atra yatheśvaraśikṣitakrama iti prāgalbhayād yadi vadasi athāpi kramaniyamaḥ kadācid bhavatā'ṅgīkṛta eva| tathā ca nityamevāyamaṅgīkāryaḥ kramaniyama iti śreyānevāyaṃ pakṣa ityabhiprāyeṇāhapākṣika iti| tarhi nyāyamārgaḥ kiṃ bhedavādinā bhavatā parityajyate? parityajyata evetyāhapakṣa iti| ayamākṣapādaḥ pakṣo'smākaṃ vedāntināṃ bāhyāsiddhāntakoṭiṃ prāpnotu kā no hānirityarthaḥ||
yadi devatānāṃ vigrahāgikamasti tarhi kimarthamasmābhirnopalabhyata ityāśaṅkyānupalabdhikāraṇānāṃ bahutvamācaṣṭe saukṣmyāditi| "atidūrāt sāmīpyāt" iti sāṅkhyagranthe hi vidyamānāmapyanupalabdhikāraṇāni paripaṭhitāni|
saukṣmyātparamāṇvādīnāmanupalabdhiḥ| tulyābhighārāt tailasiktasya tailabindoḥ| sahakṛdapagamāt sahakāryabhāvādandhakāravartino ghaṭādeḥ| chādakāt paṭāvāritānāṃ padārthānām| ānyaparyāt vyāsaktahṛdayasyāgrataḥ sthitānāṃ padārthānām| atyāsattyā svanayanagatasya| atidūrāt deśāntaragatasya| balavadabhibhavāt madhyandinolkāprakāśasya anudbhavāt cākṣuṣakiraṇasaṃghātarūpādeḥ| akṣopaghātāt rugṇanayanasya puro'vasthitasya vastuno'nupalabdhiriti sarvatrānvayaḥ| etebhyassarvebhyo hetubhyaḥ purato vartamānānyapi nopalabhyate| tadvadagnīndrādidevatāgaṇo'pyantardhaānaśaktyā nopalabhyate| kiṃ ca śāstreṣu janmanā tapasā yogena mantrauṣadhīdibhiśca māhātmyāt siddhiviśeṣāḥ prakhyātāḥ| janmataḥ piśācādīnām, tapaso maharṣīṇām, yogato yogināmantardhiśaktirastyeva| mantrauṣadhibhyastacca prasiddhameva| tena devādīnāmantardhiśakteranupalabhya iti suṣṭhūktam||
pūrvasminnadhikaraṇe devatāsāmānyasya bhagavadupāsanādhikāraścintitaḥ, idānīṃ punardevatāviśeṣasyopāsanāviśeṣādhikāro nirūpyata iti saṃgatiḥ| yadvā pūrvatrādhikārasaṃbhava uktaḥ adhunā madhvādividyāyāmetadasaṃbhavena pūrvapakṣotthānamiti saṃgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu madhvādividyāsu yā devatopāsyā tāsu kiṃ tasyā adhikāro'sti uta neti| kiṃ tasyāstadvidyopasaṃhārasāmarthyamasti uta neti| kiṃ madhuvidyāyāṃ vasvādidevatāmātramupāsyamuta tadavasthaṃ brahmeti| kiṃ vasutvamātraṃ vidyā phalamuta brahmaprāptiparyantaṃ vasutvamiti| atra saṃgatyabhidhānagatarbhaṃ pūrvapakṣaprakāramanūdya tatra pūrvapakṣeṇa virodhadvayamāśaṅkya pariharatisyādevamiti| manuṣyeṣviva devatāsāmānye paramapuruṣapāsanasāmānyamevaṃ bhavatyeva tathāpi madhvādiṣu keṣucidupāsaneṣu yāsāṃ devatānāmupāsyatvaṃ na syāt| tathā ca yāsāṃ devatānāṃ prāpyatādiniveśastāsāmeva devatānāṃ prāptṛtvaṃ viruddhameva| tathacopāsyopāsakayoḥ karmakartṛvirodhena madhvādiṣudīnāmadhikāro na syāt| śabdārthastuvasvādibhujyamānasyādityasyārādhyabhāvāt viśeṣaṇatayā niviṣṭasya vasvāderārādhakabhāvo viruddha eva| tathā ca vasuprāptipūrvakaparamātmaprāpteḥ phalatvāt syādeva pūrvameva vidyamānavasvādīnāṃ vasupadasyāprāpyatvāttatrāpi virodha eva| tena tatrādhikāra eva nasyāditi| uktamimaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ nirākarotimainamiti| tatropāsanavirodhaṃ tāvatpariharatisarvāntarātmeti|na kevalaṃ svātmepāsyaḥ api tu svaviśiṣṭaḥ paramātmā tena paramātmapradhānasyātmano nopāsanānadhikāraḥ| naca phalaprāptāvapi virodha ityāhakāmāditi| vasutvena vartamānasya vartamānameva vasupadaṃ phalañcet tadā ha virodhaḥ syāt| atra hi kalpāntare manvantare'pi vasupadaprāptiḥphalatvena prāpyate| tathā ca ko virodha iti||
manuṣyavyatiriktānāṃ devatānāṃ vasvādidevatāviśeṣāṇāṃ cārthitvasāmarthyayossaṃbhavādadhikāro'stītyuktam, tarhyarthitvasāmarthyayoḥ manuṣyaviśeṣāṇāṃ śūdrādīnāmapyadhikāraḥ syādityāśaṅkyā saṃgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ brahmavidyāyāṃ śūdrasyādhikāro'sti neti| kiṃ tasya tadupaṃsahārasāmarthyamasti neti| kiṃ brahmaviṣayamanovṛttirūpā brahmavidyā 'nadhītavedasyāpi saṃbhavati neti| kiṃ vedādeva brahmāvagatiḥ, utetihāsapurāṇādināpi saṃbhavatīti| kimitihāsapurāṇādināpi saṃbhavatīti| kimitihāsapurāṇayorvedopabṛṃhaṇaṃ kurvatoreva brahmāvagatihetutvamuta svātantryeṇeti| kiṃ jānaśruteḥ pautrāyaṇasya śūdretyāmantrya vidyopadeśa itihāsapurāṇayornirapekṣabrahmāvabodhakatvamupodbalayati neti| kimatra śūdraśabdo vṛṣalajātipara uta śugasyeti vigṛhya "śucerdaśca" iti rakpratyayayogavṛttyā śokavatparaḥ| yadyapi pūrvakāṇḍe bhagavatā jaimininā śūdrāṇāmagnividyayorabhāvāt karmādhikāro nāstītyuktam| athāpi "māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ| striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste'pi yānti parāṃ gatim||"
iti bhagavadvacanādadhikāraśaṅkayā pūrvapakṣamāhajaiminyukteti| "māṃ hi" iti śūdrāṇāmadhikāritvaṃ bhagavataiva smaryate tasmādadhikāro 'sti iti| athāpi jñānābhāve kathamupāsanaṃ saṃyoyujyata ityāśaṅkayāha śrotṛtvāditi| ayamarthaḥvedādhyayanapūrvakaṃ bhagavajjñānaṃ mā bhūcchūdrādeḥ| athāpi bhāratādiśravapūrvakamastyeva bhāratādeḥ śrotṛtvātśrotuṃ yogyatvādityarthaḥ| astu jñānaṃ bhāratādiśravaṇāt tathāpi karmabhirapakvakaṣāyasya kathaṃ bhagavataḥ satyavacanādupāsanaṃ jāyata iti punarapyāśaṅkya nirākarotisvajanīti| yathā brāhmaṇādayaḥ svādhikārānurūpairyajñādibhiḥ karmabhirvidyāvirodhipāpanibarhaṇaṃ kurvate, evaṃ śūdro'pi svādhikārānuguṇaiḥ śuśrūṣādibhirbrahmopāsanavirodhipāpanibarhaṇaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ| itthaṃ pūrvapakṣamanūdya nirākaroti ayuktamiti| tatra hetuṃ darśayatiprāpta iti| brahmopadeśe prāpte sati "saṃskāraparāmarśāttadabhāvābhilāpācca" ityādibhiḥ sūtrairupanayanasadbhāvāvaśyaṃbhāvaḥ sūtrakāraireva pradarśitaḥ| atastraivarṇikānāmeva brahmavidyāyāmadhikāro na śūdrādīnāmityarthaḥ||
śūdrādīnāṃ bhāratādiśravaṇaṃ kimarthamanumatamityāśaṅkyāhaśūdrāṇāmityādinā| pāpaśāntyarthaṃ napunaḥ śrautajñānārthaṃ śāstrāt pratipannārthaviśadīkaraṇākaraṇārthamityarthaḥ| tadeva vivṛṇoti vedārtheti|vedārthāpātabuddhiḥ śūdrasya yadi syāt tadānīṃ śūdra itihāsapurāṇairupabṛṃhyeta viśadajñānavān parikalpyetetyarthaḥ| naca śūdrasyāpātabuddhirevāsti| tasya brāhmaṇyābhāvādupanayābhāvaḥ, tadabhāvādvedādhyayanābhāvaḥ| tasmādāpātapratītireva nāsti| sā punarāpātapratītiryadanadhikaraṇā yacchūdrānādhārā sa śūdra itihāsapurāṇairnopabṛṃhyeta tattvajñānavattayā nopahṛṃhyetetyarthaḥ| tasmāditihāsapurāṇaśravaṇaṃ śūdrasya pāpakṣayārthameva| napunastattvajñānābhivṛddhiyarthamiti| yadvā vedārthāpātabuddhirityāderayamarthaḥ vedo hi dvividhaḥ adhīto'nadhītasceti| adhīto brāhmaṇādeḥ| anadhītastu śūdrasya ,adhīto veda āpātapratītiṃ janayati anadhītastu na janayati| tathā ca vedārthāpātabuddhiryadanādhikaraṇā yasmādanadhītādvedānna jāyate| so'nadhīto vedastairitihāsapurāṇādyairnopabṛṃhyeta | āpātupratipannārthaviśadīkaraṇaṃ hyupabṛṃhaṇam| śūdraviṣayetvāpātapratītijanakatvābhāvāt vedasyopabṛṃhaṇīyatvaṃ na yujyata iti| kiṃca bhagavāneva sākṣāt dvisapta catirdaśa vidyāsthānāni mayā manīṣiṇāṃ pāvanatvenopadiṣṭhāni śūdrasya na spraṣṭavyānīti mahābhārate pāṇḍavāyovapādiśat "ādāveva mayoktāni pāvanāni manīṣiṇām|
tasmānnaitāni śūdrādyaiḥ spaṣṭavyāni yudhiṣṭhim||"iti|
kathaṃ tarhyaitihāsikāni paurāṇikāni ca bhagavatstātrāṇi śūdraiḥ paṭhyante?ittham| kevalasaṃkīrtanatvena teṣāṃ pāṭho na punarvedopabṛṃhaṇatveneti vibhāgaḥ| tasmādityādievaṃ vedārthajñānopāyābhāvāt vikaladhiyāmalpajñānānāṃ śūdrāṇāmupāsādhikāro nehi bhavedityarthaḥ||
nani śūdrādīnāmapi parabhajanaṃ "brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ "ityādinā "māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya" ityādinā coktaṃ tatkathamupapadyata ityāśaṅkyāhagītamiti | tadanuṣṭhānaṃ svajātyanurūpadharmānuṣṭhānena mālākaraṇadīpāropaṇapradakṣiṇanamaskāropalepanādimātreṇeti na virodhaḥ| nanu tarhīśūdrāṇāmupāsanādhikāro nāstīti bhavadbhirucyate tathā ca sati dharmavyādhādīnāṃ brahmavidyānuṣṭhānaśravaṇaṃ na yoyujyata ityāśaṅkyāhadharmeti|dharmavyādhastulādharo vidura ityevamādayastu mahānubhāvāḥ pūrvajanmābhyāsasaṃsiddhāḥ na punaretasminneva janmani vedābhyāsādijanitajñānanavanta iti tatrāpi na virodhaḥ| astvetatsamādhānam, asamādheyametat ddaśyate yajjānaśruterbrahmavidyopa deśārtha śūdretyāmantraṇamityāśaṅkya tadapyanyathāsiddhanityāhavekteti| jānuśrutimabhimukhayannocāryo raikvaḥ śūdreti vaktā jānaśruteḥ śākameva vyanakti napunaḥ śūdrajātitvam| śūdraśabde rūḍhiṃ parityajya yogaḥ kimarthamaṅgīkriyate tathā ca rathakānyāyavirodhaḥ rūḍhiparityāgo'nyāyya iti rathakāranyāyaityāśaṅkyāhakṣattṛpraiṣādīti| kṣattā rājājñākartā tasya praiṣaḥ preṣaṇam|ayamarthaḥraikvaparijñānārthaṃ kṣattṛpreṣaṇenānyairapi "uttaratra caitramathena liṅāgāt" ityādibhiḥ sūtrasthairliṅgairjānaśruteḥ kṣatriyatvaṃ sphuṭataraviditameva| tataśca "śucerdaśca" iti vyutpattyā "śocanācchūdraḥ" iti niruktena ca śūdraśabdo jānaśrutau prayujyate napunaḥ śūdrajātitveneti nirṇaya iti||
pūrvaṃ daharādhikaraṇe daharākāśasya hadayaparimitatvenālpatvamuktam| tatprasaṅgenāntarādhikaraṇe paramātmana evāṅguṣṭhapramitatvamuktam| tatraiva ca manuṣyādhikāratvaprasaṅgādadhikaraṇatrayaṃ madhye niveśitam| tadanantaraṃ pūrvādhikaraṇaśeṣo'pi samāpitaḥ| adhunā pūrvaśrutadaharavidyāyāṃ vedanasthānatvena tadanantarādhītasya "ākāśo ha vai nāma" ityādiprakaraṇasya jīvaparatvamāśaṅkya nirākriyata iti saṃgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu chāndogye "ākāśo ha vai nāmarūpayernirvahitā" ityatrākāśaśabdanirdiṣṭaḥ kiṃ muktātmā uta paramātmeti| kiṃ "dhūtvā śarīramakṛtaṃ kṛtātmā" itimuktasyānantaraprakṛtatvamākāśa śabdasya muktaparatāvagamayati neti| kiṃ muktasyāpi nāmarūpanirvoḍhṛtvaṃ saṃbhavati neti| kimatra nāmarūpanirvoḍhṛtvaṃ nāmarūpabhajanena uta nāmarūpakaratṛtayeti| kiṃ"te yadantarā" iti nirdeśaḥ kartṛtayā nirvoḍhṛtvamupapādayati neti| "ākāśo ha vai nāmarūpayornirvahitā"ityatra śrūyamāṇa ākāśo "dhūtvā śarīramakṛtaṃ kṛtātmā" iti pūrvatrapratipannajīva eva sarvatrāpi prakṛtagrahaṇasya nyāyyatvāt| asau jīvo bandhakāle nāmarūpe gṛhṇāti| tadanu ca brahmabhāve nāmarūpe vijahāti| ataḥ pūrvavākyokto jīva evottaravākyastho bhedena pratipadyate| sa eva mukta evākāśa iti pūrvapakṣamanūdya nirākaroti dhūtvetyādinā 'nyāyyamityantena| tadeva vivṛṇoti purokta iti| ayamarthaḥ dvau khalu dhūtvā "dhūtvā śarīram" ityatra puroktau| abhisaṃbhavitā kaścideko jīvaḥ, abhisaṃbhāvyastu paramapuruṣa eva|
"brahmalokamabhisaṃbhavāni" iti brahmalokaśabdena tasyaivopādānāt| brahmalokaśabdasya niṣādasthapatinyāyena sāmānādhikaraṇyena paramapuruṣaniṣṭhatvāt sa evābhisaṃbhāvyatayā pūrvoktaḥ paramapuruṣa evāyamuttaravākye punarākāśaśabdenocyate| tenākāśaśabdasya prakṛtiparāmarśitvaṃ susthameva| pradhānatayā prakṛtasya paramapuruśasyopādānāt| nanu "brahmalokamabhisaṃbhavāni" ityatra jīva eva muktāvastho brahmalokaśabdenocyata napunaḥ kādācitkaṃ kriyāviśeṣasādhyaṃ muktarūpam| tena pūrvāvasthāprahāṇenottarāvasthāgrahaṇameva jīvasya brahmatvamucitamityasaṃgatametat| kiṃca bhavatā jīvasya pūrvamamuktatvamanīśatvamabrahmatvam, muktāvasthāyāṃ tasyaiva sarvajñatvamīśatvaṃ brahmatvamityucyate, tatchativiruddhameva| śrutiṣu yugapadeva "jñājñau dvāvajāvīśanīśau" iti jīvabrahmaṇo rvibhaktatvenābhidhānāt| ato nityasiddhabṛhattvabṛṃhaṇatvaguṇayogī paramapuruṣa evākāśaśabdenocyata iti siddham||
uktānāṃ daśānāmadhikaraṇānāṃ pradhaānārthabhūtān bhagavadguṇān parisañcaṣṭe viśvātmeti| sarvāntaryāmyanantaiśvaryaviśiṣṭo niyamanena sarvakāryādhāro muktairupabhogyasvabhāvaḥ parimicaparimāṇarūpadahrasvādhārasarvaloko hṛdayaparimitāvasthayā sarvayantā devādīnīmupāsyo vasumukhairdevaiḥ svāntaryāmitvena sevyaḥ śūdrādīnāmupāsanārho nāmarūpaikakartā prabhurnārāyaṇa iha tṛtīye pāde bubudhe bodhita ityarthaḥ||
||śubham||
evaṃ tribhiḥ pādairaspaṣṭatarātmaspaṣṭarūpajīvādiliṅgāni vākyāni jīvaparatvenāśaṅkya paramātmaparatayā nirṇītāni atha spaṣṭatarajīvādiliṅgakāni vākyāni caturthapāde paramātmaparatayā nirṇīyanta iti pādasaṃgatiḥ| tānyeva tattacchāyānusārīṇītyabhidhīyante| pūrvatrākāśaśabdasya tatpūrvavākyokta jīvaparatvamāśaṅkya tadvākyapratipannabrahmalokaparatvaṃ sūcitam,tadvadihāpyavyaktaśabdasya sāṃkhyoktapradhānaparatvamāśaṅkya rūpakavinyāsapratipādakavākyāntaroktaśarīraparatvaṃ siddhāntinā sthāpyata ityadhikaraṇa saṃgatiḥ| yadvā pūrvasminnadhikaraṇe jīvasya pratipādyatvaṃ nirākṛtya paramātmanaḥ pratipādyatvamuktam, iha punaḥ pradhānasya pratipādyatvaṃ nirākṛtya paramātmanaḥ pratipādyatvamucyata iti saṃgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kaṭhavallīṣu "indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthāḥ" ityatrāvyaktaśabdenābrahmātmakaṃ pradhānamabhidhīyate neti| kimasminmantre tantrasiddhaprakriyāpratyabhijñānamasti neti| kimatra paratvaṃ vaśīkāryatayā uta tāntrikakāraṇabhedeneti| atra tṛtīyacaturthapādayaḥ saṃgatikathanapūrvakaṃ caturthapādasthānāmaṣṭānāmadhikaraṇānāṃ peṭikādvayarūpatvamapyāhanirṇītamiti| tṛtītapāde paraviṣayatayā spaṣṭajīvādiliṅgaṃ vākyajātaṃ nirṇītam| caturthapāde tu tattatsāṅkhyoktacchāyānusārivākyajātaṃ parameva puruṣaṃ pratipādayatīti pādayoḥ saṃgatiḥ| tatrāvāntarapeṭikāvibhāgamāhaṣaḍbhirityādinā| ṣaḍbhiradhikaraṇaiḥ sākhyoktārthaśaṅkāṃ pratikṣipati dvābhyāmadhikaraṇābhyāṃ yogasiddhāntoktamarthaṃ pratikṣipatīti vibhāgaḥ| tathā ca ghaṭṭau peṭike| jāghaṭṭaḥ parasparaṃ saṃghaṭate ityarthaḥ| kecitpunarācāryā aṣṭamaṃ punaradhikaraṇamuktārtha nigamanamityāhuḥ| adhyāyaparisamāptirūpatvādasyādhikaraṇasyeti||
tatra caturthapādasthānamaṣṭānāmadhikaraṇānāmavāntarārthabhedenāpi bhedamāhadvābhyāmiti| dvābhyāmadhikaraṇābhyāṃ sapilābhimataṃ pradhānaṃ pratikṣepyam| anantaramekenādhikaraṇena kapilābhimatatattvasaṃkhyā pratikṣipyate| turyeṇa caturthenādhikaraṇena avyākṛtaśabdasyāpi prakṛtidvāravṛttyā vibhuḥ paramapuruṣaeva avadhiriti sthāpyate| tathā ca pratipādyata ityarthaḥ| anantaramadhikaraṇayuge śuddhāśuddhau baddhamuktau jīvau vāraṇīyau paratattvaṃ na bhavata iti pratipādanīyāvityarthaḥ|avaśiṣṭamadhikaraṇadvayaṃ yogatantroktanimittamātreśvaranirasanakṛditi caturthapādādhikaraṇārthavibhāgaḥ||
atra kaṭhavallyāṃ "indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthāḥ" ityādivākyamindriyopakramamavyaktaparyantaṃ jaḍapadārthaṃ atha anantaraṃ puruṣaṃ tattvakāṣṭhārūpaṃ vibhajya paramatakathitāṃ prakriyāmeva brūta iti pūrvapakṣamanūdya pratikṣipati pūrvārdhena akṣādīti| ayuktatvameva vivṛṇotitatreti|ayamarthaḥ  atra khalūttarottaṃra kāraṇaparamparā nocyate apitu vaśīkāryaparamparāmuktvā pūrvasmādvaśīkāryāduttarasya vaśīkāryatve paratvaṃ mukhyatvamucyata iti| ayamatra padānvayaḥ  tatprakaraṇasthānavākyapratipādita vaśīkārya pradhānakramābhidhānāditi| kiṃcāsminprakaraṇe "so'dhvanaḥ pāramāpnoti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam" iti muktaprāpyasthānādhipatirviṣṇureva "puruṣānnaparaṃ kiṃcitsā kāṣṭā sā parā gatiḥ" iti pratyabhijñāpyate, sa tu na jīvaḥ, tenedaṃ prakaraṇaṃ sarvamapi paramapuruṣaparamevetyāha śāntātmeti||
atra sāṅkhyoktapratyabhijñābhāvaṃ bahvarthavirodhapratipādanena kathayitvā vākyasya paramapuruṣaparatvameva nigamayati na hyarthāḥ iti| atra "indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthāḥ" ityuktam, na khalu sāṅkyasiddhāntaprakriyāyāmindriyāṇāmarthāḥ prakṛtiriti kathyante| atha mano hetureṣāṃ na ceṣṭam athaiṣāmarthānāmindriyānāṃ mano heturiti sāṅkyānāṃ na ceṣṭaṃ sarveṣāmapīndriyāṇāmāhaṅkārikatvāt|
tatra "manasastu parā buddhiḥ"ityucyate,sāṅkyasiddhānte buddhireva mahān tena mahān jāyata ityuktaṃ bhavati tadapi na ghaṭate|tarhyatra mahānpara iti na ghaṭate  ucyate, jīva eva bhoktā tasya ca mahāniti viśeṣaṇaṃ yujyata ityāhamahatīti| nanu "mahataḥ paramavyaktam" iti mahataḥ kāraṇatvenāvyaktābhidhānam, "avyaktātpuruṣaḥ paraḥ" iti sāṅkhyoktapuruṣābhidhānāt sāṅkhyoktameva pratyabhijñāpyata ityatrāhapāriśeṣyāditi| ayamarthaḥ pūrvatra "ātmānaṃ rathinaṃ viddhi śarīraṃ rathameva ca" ityādinā mantreṇātmaśarīrādīnāṃ rathirathatvādirūpaṇaṃ kṛtam, teṣu rūpiteṣvartheṣu kasmātkasya vaśīkāryatvātiśaya itiśaṅkāyāṃ "indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthāḥ" ityādinā kasmāccitkasyacit vaśīkāryatvātiśaya ucyate, atra pūrvamantroktārthāḥ sarve'pyuttaramantre nirdiṣṭāḥ śarīramekameva na nirdiṣṭaṃ pāriśeṣyāttadeva śarūramanenāvyaktaśabdenocyata iti| ato'tra kapilaprakriyāpratbhijñā nāstītyāha taditi||
nanu pāriśeṣyasthānapramāṇābhyāmavyaktakāryabhūtaśarīramātravācako'vyaktaśabdaiti pūrvādhikaraṇe samarthitaṃ tena tadvadeva "ajāmekām" ityādivākyāmubhayābhyupagatāvyaktasyaiva vācakaṃ syādityutthānena saṃgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu śvetāśvatarīyājāmekāmiti mantreṇābrahmātmakaprakṛtirabhidhīyate neti| kiṃ mantre yaugiko'jāśabdo'brahmātmakaprakṛtiparaḥ, uta brahmātmakaprakṛtipara iti| kiṃ "bahvīḥ prajāḥ sṛjamānām" iti vākyāvayavatvamajāśabdasya svātantryeṇa sṛṣṭiparatāmavagamayati neti| kiṃ taittirīyājāmekāmityajāśabdasya jyotirupakkamāvākyāvayavatvaṃ svātantryeṇa sṛṣṭiparatvāvagamakatvavirodhi neti| kiṃca ajātvaṃ jyotirupakramātvaṃ ca virudhyete neti| atra pūrvapakṣābhiprāyamāhasvātantryeṇeti| "ajāmekām" ityatra "janayantīm" iti bahuprajājanane svātantryeṇa kartṛtvamucyate pradhānasya| "sṛjamānām" iti tu śvetāśvataravākye'pi tacca kartṛtvameva| "ajo hyeko juṣamāṇo'nuśete" iti baddhasya juṣamāṇasya prītiyuktasya tasyāmevājāyāmanuśayanamucyate| "jahātyenām" ityādinā muktasya tatparityāgo'pyucyate| śrutāpi punariyamuktistāntrikī kapilantrasiddhetyāśaṅkya pratikṣipatineti | tatra hetumāhaajātvamātrābhidhānāditi| ayamarthaḥatra hjetyajātvamātramabhihitam| na punarabrahmātmikājetyuktam| tena sāṅkyoktābrahmātmikāyā ajāyā abhidhānāsiddhirityarthaḥ| hetvantaramāhaasvātantryaprasiddheriti| prasiddhaṃ khalvacetanāyā mūlaprakṛterasvātantryaṃ sarvalokeṣu| tarhi "janayantīṣu" "sṛjamānām" iti sṛṣṭi kartṛtvakathanaṃ kathamityāśahkyāhasṛjatiriti | loke hi sraṣṭṭatvaṃ dviprakāraṃ prayojakakartṛtvaṃ prayojyakartṛtvaṃ ceti| tena mūlaprakṛteḥ śrūyamāṇaṃ prayojyakartṛtvaṃ pramāṇasiddhāṃ paramātmapreryatāṃ noparundhyādityarthaḥ pūrvādhikaraṇe sāṅkyoktābrahmātmakāvyaktapratipādakājāmekāmityādiśrutyā samutthitasya pūrvapakṣiṇaḥ pratikṣepaḥ kṛtaḥ| adhunā sāṅkyoktatattavasaṅkhyāpratipādakaśrutimavalambya samutthitasyāpi tasya pratikṣepaḥ kriyata iti saṃgatiḥ| tadarthavicārascu"yasminpañca pañcanāḥ" itimantraḥ kiṃ kāpilatantrasiddhatattavapratipādanaparo neti| kiṃ pañcapañcajanaśabdena pañcaviṃśatitattvapratītirasti neti| kiṃ pañcapañcajanaśabdena pañcaviṃśatitattvapratītirasti neti| kiṃ pañcapañcajanaśabdena pañcapañcakānyucyante uta pañca padārthā iti| kiṃ pañcajanā iti samāsaḥ samāhāraviṣayaḥ uta " diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām " iti saṃjñāviṣaya iti| kiṃ samāhārasamāsapakṣe avāntarasaṅkhyānvayanimittamasti na veti| kimākāśasya pṛthaṅnirdeśaḥ avāntarasaṃkhyānvayavirodhi neti| atra pūrvapakṣī manyate " yasminpañca pañcajanāḥ " iti vākye yasminniti saptamyā nirdiṣṭaḥ sāṅkhyoktaprakṛteḥ paraḥ puruṣagaṇaḥ| " pañca pañcajanāḥ " ityuktāni tu pañcaviṃśatitattvānyeva| tathā ca pañca saṅkhyayā gaṇitāḥ pañca padārthāḥ pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyākā ioti suprasiddhametat| tamimaṃ pūrvapakṣamanuvadati yasminnityādinā'stvityantena| ananyaniṣṭhaḥ paramātmaniṣṭhatvarahita ityarthaḥ| uktaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ pratikṣipati maivamiti| tatra hetudvayamāha ākāśasyeti|
sāṅkhyapakṣe hi pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyākānyeva tattvāni vidyante| napunaḥ saptaviṃśatisaṅkhyākāni| atra punarākāśasya paṛthagabhidhānaṃ vidyate| yasminniti saptamyantena puruṣo'pi paṛthaṅ nirdiśyate| tenaitābhyāmubhābhyāṃ sāṅkhyoktapañcaviṃśatitattvapratyabhijñā na vidyata ityarthaḥ| tarhi bhavatpakṣe yasminniti ka ucyata ityāśaṅkyāha ṣaḍviṃśa iti| ṣaḍviṃśaḥ paramapuruṣaḥ | " taṃ ṣaḍviṃśakamityāhuḥ" iti śrutiprasiddheḥ| sa tu sarvādhāratvād yasminniti dhachārakatnenānūdyate| tatra hetumāha brāhmatādyairiti| prakaraṇapratipannairbrahmatvāmṛtatvādyairliṅgaiḥ paramātmeti niścīyata ityarthaḥ||
atra pūrvapakṣavādī manyateayaṃ alu samāhārasamāsaḥ| tathā ca pañcapūlyādivat, pañcajanā iticchāndasaprakriyayā pulliṃṅganirdeśena samāhāre'bhihite samāhārāṇāṃ pañcasaṃkhyayā viśeṣaṇe pañcaviṃśadatitattvasiddhiriti| tamimaṃ pakṣaṃ pratikṣipan " diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyāṃ" iti sūtroktaprakriyayā saptasaptarṣaya itivat pañca pañcajanā iti saṃjñopādhirityāha saṃjñopādhiriti| tarhi saṃjñopādhikatayā pratipādyaṃ pañcakaṃ kimtiyāśaṅkyāha prāṇādyamiti| " prāṇasya prāṇam " ityādivākyoktaṃ manaḥparyantaṃ pañcakaṃ śrutāveva spaṣṭamuktaṃ jñānendriyātmakam| nanu kvacidannasyānnamiti kāṇvapāṭhe na ddaśyate tatkathaṃ pañcakatvasiddhirityāśaṅkyāha jyotiriti| " jyotiṣaikeṣāmasatyanne " iti sūtrakāreṇaiva pañcakatvamupapāditamityarthaḥ| tatra kathaṃ nyūnavāda ityatrāha nyūnavāda iti| ekatra nyūnavādo'pyanyatraddaṣṭenādhikyena pūraṇīya ityārthaḥ| jñānendriyāṇi ṣaṭśaṃkhyākāni kathamiha pañcatvasiddhirityāśaṅkyāha ghrāṇamiti| tatrānnaśabdo ghrāṇaṃ rasanaṃ cobhayamapi sahaivāha tena pañcakatvasiddhiḥ| tarhi tvagindriyasya kutra kathanamityāśaṅkya pariharati prāṇeti| atrahi prāṇaśabdastvagindriyasya prāṇenāpyāyitatvāt lakṣaṇayā tvagindriyamevācaṣṭa iti sarvānumatameveti| tadidaṃ bhāṣya eva suvyaktam||
evaṃ tribhiradhikaraṇaiḥ sāṅkyoktacchāyānusārivākyānāṃ paramātmaparatvameva prasādhya taireva sāṃkhyairabrahmātmakapradhānaparatayā parigṛhītamavyākṛtādiśabdasāmarthyapi paramapuruṣaparatvenaiva susaṃgatamityācakṣāṇa īkṣatyādyadhikaraṇoktamarthatattvaṃ siṃhāvalokananyāyena parāmṛśan samyaṅnyāyakalāpoktaṃ sthāpayatīti saṃgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastukiṃ jagatkāraṇavādivedāntapratipādyamavyaktaṃ sāṃkhyoktapradhānamuta brahmeti| kiṃ "asadvā idamagra āsīt" ityasacchabdo'vyākṛtanāmarupāvasthabrahmaparaḥ, utāvyākṛtāpara iti| kiṃ "tadapāyeṣa śloko bhavati" iti sākṣitvena nirdeśaḥ "asadvā idamagra āsīt" ityatrāsacchabdasya prakṛtabrahmaparatāmavagamayati neti| kiṃ "taddhede tarhyavyākṛtamāsīt" ityatrāvyākṛtaśabdenāvyākṛtaśarīraṃ brahmābhidhīyate utāvyaktamiti| kiṃ "sa eṣa iha praviṣṭa ānakhāgrebhyaḥ paśyatyacakṣuḥ" iti praśāsiturviduṣo'vyākṛtaśarīrabrahmatāmavagamayati neti| atra pūrvapakṣayuktimanuvadativiśveti| śrutiṣu sadasadavyākṛtoktirviśvopādānaṃ vaktiti paroktāvyākṛta evānveti| tarhyātmādiśabdānāṃ lokavedaprasiddhyā prakṛtivācitvasya dṛḍhapramitatvādanye punarātmādiśabdāstadānuguṇyenaiva kathaṃcinnetavyā ityarthaḥ| imāmāśaṅkāṃ pratikṣipati neti| tameva pratikṣepaṃ vivṛṇoti yatreti| yasminvākye'sadavyākṛtādi dṛṣṭaṃ tatra tasminneva vākye vahusyāmiti prakaraṇasamuditaṃ sarvajñatādyaṃ paramapuruṣaliṅgam| api tu upakramopasaṃhārādiṣaḍvidhatātparyaliṅgopetatvāt susthirameva pratipannam| tasmāt "ātmā vā idameka evāgra āsīt""eko havai nārāyaṇa āsīt" ityādivākyasthātmanārāyaṇādiśabdāḥ kāraṇa vākyasthāḥ prakṛteḥ kāraṇatvamāśritya abādhyā ityarthaḥ||
nanvavyākṛtādiśabdasya prakṛtivācakatvābhāve kathamiva paramātmavācakatvamityāśaṅkya tadvācakatvaprakāramāha vistareṇaāsīditi| atra khalu "asadvā idamagra āsīt" ityādinā vākyena pariddaśyamānasya prapañcasya layāvasthatāmātramuktam| napunaścinmātrapūpatvamasadrūpatvamatyantābhāvarūpatvamatyantāsadrūpatvaṃ vā|tarhi "naiveha kiṃcanāgra āsīt" iti vākyaṃ kathamupapadyata ityāśaṅkyāhanaiveti| vilayo hi nāma vedāntasiddhānte avasthāntaraprāptireva napunardravyasvarūpanāśaḥ| tatkathamityatrāhaśūnyatāderniṣedhāditi| dravyasvarūpavināśo vilaya iti hi vaiśeṣikādīnāṃ pralāpaḥ| sa tu pratyakṣādipramāṇikairniṣiddha eva| tarhi kathamavyākṛtatvamityatrāhasarvasyeti|
sarvasyāpyarthasya kāraṇāvasthāyāmavyākṛtatvaṃ nāmarūpavibhāgābhāvādavocyate| itthaṃ sāmānyataścintitamavyākṛtaśabdārthaṃ brahmaṇyapi yojayatitāddaśeti| tattasmātkāraṇāt| avyākṛtatvādyavasthāviśiṣṭatattaddravyasamūhāntarātmā paramapuruṣa eva sadasadavyākṛtaśabdavācya iti vedāntaniṣṇātairnirṇīyate| ato'vyākṛtaśabdasya bhagavatparatve'rtho nāstīti na bhramitavyamiti||
pūrvasminnadhikaraṇe khalu anaikāntikādavyākṛtādisamākhyāmātrāt prakṛtiparatvamāśaṅkyānanyathāsiddhaprakaraṇādiprābalyena paramapuruṣaparatvamuktamavyākṛtādiśabdasya, tarhi karmatvādyananyathāsiddhaliṅgabalāt samākṛṣyamāṇaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ purūṣa eva paratattvamastviti śaṅkyā saṃgatiḥ| saṃgatyantaramapi rāddhāntenocyatepūrvamavyākṛtaśabdasya prakṛtiparatvaṃ nirasya paramātmaparatvaṃ nirṇītam, adhunā punaḥ karmaśabdasya puṇyapāparūpakarmaparatvaṃ nirasya kāryarūpajagadvācitvamucyata iti| tadarthavicārastukiṃ jagatkāraṇavādivedāntapratipādyaḥ prakṛtayadhiṣṭhātā puruṣaḥ uta paramātmeti| kiṃ "eteṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ kartā" iti kartṛtayā nirdiśyamānaḥ puruśo jīva paramātmeti| kiṃ "yasya vaitatakarma" iti karmaśabdaḥ puṇyāpuṇyakarmavācī uta jagatvācīti| kiṃ prakaraṇādyasaṃkucitavṛttipratyakṣapramitajagatparaitacchabdasāmānādhikaraṇyena karmaśabdas jagatvācitvaṃ yuktamiti| kiṃ "tau ha suptaṃ puruṣamājagmatuḥ" ityādijīvamukhyaprāṇaliṅge puṇyāpuṇyavācitāmupodbalayato neti| kimetallibhge jīvapare uta paramātmapare| kiṃ "kvaiṣa etadvālāke puruṣo'śayiṣṭa athāsminprāṇa evaikadhā bhavati" iti praśnaprativacanābhyāṃ jīvātiriktabrahmapratipādanapare uta neti| asminnadhikaraṇe pūrvapakṣaṃ āracayati yasyeti| yo vai bālāke paridṛśyamānānāmeteṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ kartā yasya paradṛśyamānasvaputrādi sakalapuruṣakāraṇapuṇyapāpātmakaṃ karma sa vai veditavyaḥ sa jijñāsitavyaḥ ityukteḥ tatphalabhūtakarmakartā jīva eva veditavyo na paramapuruṣa ityuktaṃ bhavatīti pūrvapakṣaḥ| śabdārthastu svakarmapariṇateḥ putrādīnāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ kartā sa eva pitṛtvenāvasthitaḥ puruṣa eva vedya iti| tadetannirākaroti upakrāntīti| upapādayati bālākīti| atra khalu bālākerajñātameva tattvamupadiśayatyajātaśatruḥ| napunarjñātaṃ jñātasya jñāpane nairarthakyāt| tadidamāha tajjñātoktirnirartheti| etaduktaṃ bhavati "yo vai bālāka eteṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ kartā" ityetacchabdanirdiṣṭāḥ sarvapuruṣā bālākiparijñātā eva| atasteṣāṃ jñāpane prayojanaṃ nāsti| ato jīvātiriktaḥ paramapuruṣa eva svasṛṣṭikarmabhūtaviśvajagatkartā sa vai veditavya ityucyate tadidamāha jagatīti| kriyata iti karmeti vyutpattyā jagata īśvarāpekṣayā karmatvavacanaṃ mukhyameveti||
asminprakaraṇe kimarthaṃ jīvākhyānaṃ prāṇākhyānaṃ cetyāśaṅkya jīvaprāṇayoḥ paramātmaśarīratvena tadviśiṣṭatayā bhagavata upāsanārmityāhaevamityādinā upāsetyantena| evaṃ jīvātirikte paramātmani prakaraṇapratipanne sati asminprakaraṇe yajjīvamukhyaprāṇakathanaṃ teneha kṣatirvirodho na bhavati| kuta ityatrāha tatheti| tathā sati tadviśiṣṭatvena kathane sati, tadviśiṣṭasyāpyupāsā saṃbhavediti śabdārthaḥ| ayaṃ sārvatrika ityāha prāṇasyeti| vājasaneyake hi antaryāmibrāhmaṇe prāṇasya prāṇabhājo jīvasyāpyadhikaraṇatayā taccharīritvenocyate paramapuruṣaḥ| tathā ca sati tenaiva nyāyena brahmajñaptyai tadanyaprakathanamiti tadviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaparamātmopāsanārthaṃ tatratatra viśeṣaṇarūpadravyakathanamiti| asmākaṃ sthāpanā sarvabhūmau vartata ityarthaḥ||
"pūrvasminnadhikaraṇe liṅgatvenābhimatasya karmaśahabdavācyatvasyānaikāntikatvenāliṅgatvamuktam" atra pūrvapakṣī puruṣanirṇaye'sādhāraṇatayā'bhimataṃ liṅgamāha katham? "ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ" ityārabhya "vijñānaghana evaitebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tānyevānuvinaśyati na pretya saṃjñāsti" iti sarvaṃ taṃ parādādyonyatrātmanaḥ sarvaṃ veda" "yatra hi dvaitamiva bhavati" "vijñātāramare kena vijānīyāt" iti pañcaviṃśājjīvādadhikaṃ niṣidhya tena ca liṅgamātravyapadeśāditi| tatrāha "vākyānvayāt" iti, iti śrīviṣṇucittāryaiḥ saṃgatimālāyāṃ vyaktamupāpādi saṃgatiḥ| tenātra pūrvaṃ sāṃkhyoktaprakriyāśaṅkāmukhena tribhiradhikaraṇaairekā peṭikā pravṛttā| adhunā punaḥ kāraṇatvādibhistribhiḥ avyākṛtādikarmatvādiliṅgābhyāṃ
saha jīvabrahmaṇoraikyopadeśādatyantābhedāt prakṛtyadhiṣṭhāturjīvatvamāśaṅkya nirākriyata itipeṭikāntaramityapyāgurācāryāḥ|
tadarthavicārastujagatkāraṇavādivedāntapratipādyaṃ puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ pradhānamuta paramātmeti|bṛhadāraṇyake kiṃ maitreyībrāhmaṇe "na vā are patyuḥ kāmāya patiḥ priyo bhavati" ityupakramya "ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ" ityātmā pañcaviṃśaḥ puruṣa uta paramātmeti| kimupakrame patijāyāputrādipriyasaṃbandha ātmaśabdasya puruṣaparatāmavagamayati neti| kiṃ vākyāvayavānāṃ sarveṣāṃ paramātmanyevānvayasāmarthyamuta puruṣa iti| atra pūrvapakṣamupanyasyatipatyārdānāmiti| "na vā are patyuḥ kāmāya patiḥ priyo bhavati" ityādinopakrame patyādīnāṃ priyatvaṃ śrutiranuvadati hyātmanaḥ kāmasiddhyai svābhīṣṭasiddha ityarthaḥ| tena svābhīṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ putrādīnāṃ priyatvopapādanena asāvātmā puṇyapāpotpannaphalabhugjīva eveti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ| taṃ nirākarotiprakramādīti| idamupakramādiviruddhamiti| tarhyasminvākye maduktaṃ na bhavati cet kiṃ punarucyata ityāśaṅkyāhatattaditi| tattatputrādinimittabhogapradātuḥ paramapuruṣasyaiva saṃkalpātteṣāṃ putrādināṃ priyatvaṃ bhagavatsaṃkalpāyattamityarthaḥ| asya piturayaṃ putraḥ priyo bhavatviti bhagavatā saṃkalpite sati tathaiva tatpriyatvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ|atrātmaśabdena bhagavānevoṃcyate napunaḥ pitrādirūpo jīvaḥ| kiṃ ca sarveṣvapi vedānteṣuṃ bagavān puruṣottama eva mokṣārthaṃ draṣṭavyatayā śruyate tena sa evātmā "ātmā vāre draṣṭavyaḥ" ityatrātmaśabdena pratyabhijñāpyate| gatisāmānyasya pūrvamevoktatvāditi||
atra prayujyamānānāmātmaśabdānāṃ paramātmaparatvaṃ vyitpattyetyekaḥ pakṣaḥ| tṛtīyastu jīvavācakātśabdo jāvadvārā paramātmānameva vadatīti| tamimaṃ pakṣatrayavibhāgamāhavyutpattayetyādinā pūrvārdhena| atra jāvavācakānāṃ paramātmaparatve ṛṣitrayābhimatapakṣān pūrvoktānanukrameṇa śiṣyānugrahārthaṃ viśadayatyuttarārdhenavyaktyaikyādityādinā| jīvabrahmaṇoḥ svarūpaikyāt jīvaśabdena paramātmābhidhānamityāśmarathyaḥ| auḍulomistu nirupadhikadaśādvaitato muktadaśāyāṃ jīvaśabdena paramātmābhidhānamityāha| kāśakṛtsnaḥ punastatsthatvāt jīvasya paramātmaśarīratvena paramātmanastanniṣṭatvādityāha| atra kāśakṛtsnīyameva rāddhāntatvenocayata iti||
auḍulomīyaṃ pakṣaṃ nirākṛtya kāśakṛtsnīyameva pakṣaṃ svapakṣayatibhedeti|
bhedakāvidyopādhivyapāye sati jīvo'yaṃ brahmatāṃ prāpnayāditi auḍulomimatamayuktam| kutastatrāhanityaṃ tadbhedaddaṣṭeriti | "nityo nityānām" ityādiśrutyā jīvaparayorbhedasya nityatvena sākṣādeva darśanāt| atra hetvantaramapyāhaatipatiteti| atītasarvabandhe jīve "nirañjanaḥ paramaṃ sāṃmyamupaiti" "mama sādharmyamāgatāḥ" iti sāmyasādharmyayoḥ śrutatvāt tayośca bhedagarbhatvādityarthaḥ| tarhi mṛttatkāryaddaṣṭāntaḥ śrutāvucyate sa kathaṃ jīvaparayoratyantabhede bhavadbhirabhidhīyamāne ghaṭata ityāśaṅkyāhamṛttaditi| nahi ddaṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayoḥ sarvathā vācyam, api tu pramāṇānuguṇameva,anyathā śrutiśatavirodhaḥ syādityāhaśrutiśatavihata iti| "kṣaraṃ pradhānamamṛtākṣaraṃ haraḥ kṣarātmānāvīśate deva ekaḥ "iti śrutyaiva sākṣāccidacidīśvarāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ vibhajya nirṇīyata ityarthaḥ| uktamarthaṃ kāśakṛtsnīyamatena nigamayatiteneti| jīvaśabdamīśvare'pṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇavācināṃ śabdānāṃ viśeṣyābidhānasāmarthyāditi kāśakṛtsno nipavahaditi yat eṣa eva śrīvedavyāsasiddhānta iti| itarat dvitayaṃ nirasanīyameveti||
pūrvatra "avasthiteriti kāśakṛtsnaḥ" iti bhagavato niyāmakatvenāvasthānāt jīvasāmānādhikaraṇyamityakte kaścidāhayathā rājā rāṣṭramityatra rāṣṭraniyāmakatvena rājā'vatṣṭite sāmānādhikaraṇyamihopacārikamasti athāpi nopādānatvam, tadvadatrāpi nimittameva syānnopādānamityāśaṅkayotthānāt saṃgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastukiṃ brahma jagato nimittakāraṇamutopādānakāraṇamapīti| kiṃ jagatkāraṇavādivedāntavākyaṃ brahmaṇa upādānakāratvamapi pratipādayati, uta nimittakāraṇatvamātramiti| kimanyatra nimittopādānayorbhedaniyamo nimittamātratvaṃ brahmaṇo vyavasthāpayati neti| kiṃ nimittakāraṇatvamātrapratipādakatve satyekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñāddaṣṭāntayorupayoruparodho'sti neti| atra pūrvapakṣoktaprakāramanūdya dūṣayitumupakramatemṛtpiṇḍāderiti| loke hyupādānānmṛtpiḍādernimittabhūtaḥ kulālādiḥ pṛthagevopalabhyate tadvadeva jagatāmādikartā nopādānaṃ kuta ityāśaṅkya hetumāhavikārairvirahata itivikārarahitatvādityarthaḥ| uktamarthaṃ pratiṣedhatineti| tadeva vivṛṇotidvāreti yathā bālo yuvā jāta ityatra dvārabhūtadehe vikārāt nātmani jīve vikāraḥ,evamatrāpi jagatupādānabhūtabhagavadviśeṣaṇe vikārād bhagavati na vikāra ityarthaḥ| nanu mṛttatkāryaddaṣṭānto ddaśyate ddaṣṭāntabhūte mṛdādau tu svarūpaeva vikāraḥ tadvadatrāpi svarūpaeva vikāraḥ syādityāśaṅkya netyāhamṛditi| nahi ddaṣṭāntadārṣāntikayoḥ sarvathā sādharmyamapekṣitam, api tu yathāyogyameva sādharmya svīkriyate| atra tu bhagavati svarīpavikārasyāsaṃbhavādacetanavaiśiṣṭyenaivāvasthāntaraprāptirupalabhyate| tadadamāha deheti| prabhṛtipadena "yathā sataḥ puruṣātkeśalomāni" ityādinidarśanagrahaṇam| vyāpṛterdarśitatvāt  bhagavadvyāpārasya darśitatvāt| nahyūrṇanābherdeha evāvasthāprāptiḥ,nāpi kevalātmani, api tu dehaviśiṣṭātmanīti lokopalambhaḥ, evaṃ prakṛtiviśiṣṭaparamātmanyevāvasthāntaraprāptiriti samañjasametat||
ekasyaiva padārthasya nimittatvamupādānatvaṃ ca parasparaviruddhamiti pare pralapanti| tairuktamarthaṃ tacadaṅgīkṛtaprakriyādṛṣṭāntenopapādayitumupakramate svajñānādyavamiti| nyāyavādino bhagavadupādānatvapratikṣepakāḥ svaprakriyāvirodhādeva bhraśyanti| te khalu samavāyikāraṇamasamavāyikāraṇaṃ nimittakāraṇamiti tridhā kāraṇaṃ kalpyanti| athāpi yadeva nimittakāraṇaṃ tadeva samavāyikāraṇamiti bruvate| tadyathā svajñānādyaṃ svajanyameva svakīyaṃ hi jñānacikīrṣāprayatnādikaṃ śāstrābhyāsīdibhiḥ svayameva karoti jīvaḥ| tena tatra kartṛtvānnimittakāraṇaṃ bhavati| tathāpi ca svayameva samavāyikāraṇaṃ bhavati svajñānādaḥ kāryaṃ yatra samavaiti tat, samavāyikāraṇamiti samavāyikāraṇalakṣaṇasya sphutamupalambhāt| kiṃceśvaro'pi sarvavyāptasya svasya sarvairapi paramāṇvādibhiḥ saṃyogaṃ svayameva sṛjati sarvakāryahetutvāt tathāca tatra kartṛtvena nimittakāraṇaṃ bhavati| samavāyikāraṇatvamapi taṃ prati tasya dṛśyate paramāṇvādisaṃyogasyeśvaraniṣṭhatvāt| tena yathā kartṛtvaṃ samavāyikāraṇaṃ ca yuṣmatsiddhānte bhavatīśvaraniṣṭhameva tathā'smatsiddhānte nimittatvamupādānatvaṃ caikavastuniṣṭhamiti ko virodhaḥ| atrāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ samavāyasyāprāmāṇikatvāt pratyayotpattivādasyātyantajaghanyatvācca kevalamavasthantarāpattimātrameva vayaṃ svīkurmaha iti| sṛjatītyādi  svasyānyasaṃyogamīśvaraḥ sṛjatīti śabdānvayaḥ| tatreśvarasyopādānatvaṃ vivṛṇoti saṃyogavaiti| tat tasmātkāraṇāt| īśvaro mūrtaiḥ saha svasya saṃyoge prapakṛtirapi upādānamapi kriyāto nimittaṃ svavyāpārānnimittaṃ syādityarthaḥ| tadapi mūrtamīśvarasaṃyoge samavāyikāraṇaṃ bhavati| svaniṣṭhakarmadvārā svayaṃ nimittakāraṇaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| atra codayati ekasyeśvarasya kathaṃ bahusyāmiti bahubhavanaṃ syāditi| taccodanāṃ pariharati ekasyeti| yathā saubharireka eva pañcāśaccharīraparigrahaṃ saṅkalpya tena rūpeṇa jāta iti pramāṇasiddhaṃ tathā bhagavānapi nānāviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaveṣeṇa svasaṃkalpādeva jāyata iti ko virodhaḥ| kācidabhedaśrutiraparā ca bhedaśrutiḥ, bhedābhedau parasparaviruddhāvevetyāśaṅkyāsmatsiddhānte virodhagandho'pi nāstītyāha bhedābhedeti| svarūpabhedādbhedaśrutirupapadyate, viśiṣṭaikyādabhedaśrutiriti nirvāhe vayameva vijayāmaha iti||
uktanimittatvāviruddhāpādānatvopapādakayuktijātaṃ saṃgraheṇa pradarśayati  kāryaikye iti| tatra tāvat pratijñāvākyamekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratipādakaṃ bhagavata upādānatvamantareṇa na saṃghaṭate| kāraṇasya kāryeṇa sahaikye pratijñā ghaṭata ityarthaḥ| tadanuguṇa iti  kāryakāraṇoraikyapratijñānuguṇa eva mṛttkāryādidṛṣṭāntavarga udāhāri| itthamupādānatvamuktam|nimittatvamapyamāhasraṣṭuriti| sraṣṭurīśvarasya syāmiti śrutirabhidhyānaṃ vakti nimittatvaṃ vaktītyarthaḥ| anyā tu śrutirnimittatvaṃ siddhaṃ kṛtvā upādānatvaṃ sahakāritvaṃ ca sākṣāt svayamevāha "kiṃ svidvanam" ityādinā| vanatāṃ vṛkṣatādiṃ ca vaktītivaktītyasyāvṛttyānavayaḥ| "kiṃ svidvanam" ityupādānapraśnaḥ| "ka u sa vṛkṣa āsīt" ityupakaraṇapraśnaḥ| "yataḥ" upādānāt "dyāvāpṛthivī bhagavānniṣṭatakṣuḥ" sasrajeti vacanavyatyayaśchāndasaḥ| athavāmanīṣiṇo vanaṃ manasā buddhyā niṣṭatakṣurniścitavanta ityarthaḥ| upādānabhūtād bhagavata eva sarvotpattiriti manasā niraṇaiṣurityarthaḥ| athavā manīṣiṇa ityasyottaratrāpyanvaye saṃbodhanāntatvamiti| "yadadhyatiṣṭhat" ityādibhuvānāntaryāmitvena dhārayannīśvaro yadupakaraṇamadhyatiṣṭhaditi śrutyanvayaḥ| "brahma vanam" ityādibrahmavanamupādānam| "brahma sa vṛkṣaḥ" itibrahmaivopakaraṇamityarthaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavatisūkṣmacidacidviśiṣṭamupādānaṃ viśvasyopakaraṇabhūtakālādiviśiṣṭaḥ sa evopakaraṇamiti| "manīṣiṇo manasā pṛcchatedutat" hemanīṣiṇaḥ manasāṣa'vadhānena sahaitacchaṇutetyarthaḥ| "manīṣiṇo manasā vibravīmi vaḥ" ityatra vaḥ śrṛṇvatāṃ bhavatāmanugrahapūrvakāvadhānaviśeṣeṇa bravīmīti| "yadadhyatiṣṭhat" iti yadupakaraṇaṃ bhagavānadhyatiṣṭhiditi pūrvamevoktam| tena sarvādhiṣṭhātṛtvāt bhagavato nimittatvasiddhiḥ| kiṃca "tadātmānaṃ svayamakuruta" iti tasyaiva bhagavataḥ svayameva svātmano'vasthāntarakaraṇādupādānatvaṃ nimittatvaṃ ca ddaśyate| tadbhūtayonitvamuktamiti "yadbhūtayoniṃ paripaśyanti dhīrāḥ" iti tasyaiva bhūtayovitvaṃ sākṣādevocyate| ataḥ kratṛtvaṃ prakṛtitvaṃ cobhayamapi pramāṇasiddhaṃ bhavatīti nigamayatitasmāditi| sarvatattvāntarātmetihetugarbhaviśeṣaṇam|sarvāntaryāmitvāt sarvaṃ saṃghaṭata ityarthaḥ|
atra kaścidāhayatsamavāyikāraṇaṃ yaccāsamavāyikāraṇaṃ tadubhayavyatiriktakāraṇaṃ nimittakāraṇamiti hi nyāyvādibhirlakṣaṇamabhāṇi| tena yadupādānaṃ tannimittaṃ na bhavati yacca nimittaṃ tadupādānaṃ na bhavatīti niyamasya siddhyatvāt nimittopādānaikyavādo na saṃghaṭata iti lakṣaṇavirodhamāśaṅkya pariharatinopādānamiti| kimapyupādānaṃ nimittaṃ na bhavati| upādānavyatiriktaṃ kāraṇaṃ nimittamiti hi nimittakāraṇavidaḥ| evaṃ yannimittatvenasiddhaṃ tadupādānatāṃ na bhajatīti śabdānvayaḥ| uktamarthaṃ pratikṣipatiayuktamiti| ayuktatvameva lokavedaprasiddhyopapādayatiiṣṭādityādinā| loke hi tulāsāṃ pramāṇaprameyavyavahāranyāyenaikasyaiva padārthasya sarvalakṣaṇayoge sati ākārabhedānnānātvavyavahārayogitvaṃ sidhyatīti niyame siddhe sati svakapolakalpitanyāyenopādānavyatiriktaṃ nimittaṃ nimittavyatiriktamupādānamiti parasparavirodhapraṇayanakusṛtiḥ kuyuktirbālacintāvipāka ityarthaḥ| kiṃca yuṣyatsaṃketasiddhanimittaśabdavācyatvābhāve'pyapādānakāraṇasyaiva kartṛtvaṃ suprasiddhameva| tadevamīśvarasyopādānatvaṃ kartṛtvaṃ cāviruddhamiti na saṃkaṭaṃ kiñcit|
nanu svakāraṇe kāryasya "pṛthivyastu praliyate" ityādinā layo vināśa uktaḥ, "puruṣaścāpyubhāvetau līyete paramātmani" iti prakṛtipuruṣayorapi layo bhagavatā parāśareṇa pratipāditaḥ, tena tayoḥ pralayakāle vinaṣṭatvāt kathaṃ sūkṣmacidacidviśiṣṭapupuṣādviśvasṛṣṭirbhavadbhipabhidhīyata itiyāśaṅkya ādosṛṣṭyādikāle|
ekasyaekasyaiva sata īśvarasya| bahusyāmiti bahubhavanam"bahusyām" ityuktarītyā bahubhavanaṃ tu| saubharinyāyasiddhamyathā saubhariḥ eka eva pañcāśaccharīraparigrahaṃ saṅkalpya tena rūpeṇa jāta iti pramāṇasiddhaṃ tathā bhagavānapi nānāviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭhaveṣeṇa svasaṅkalpādeva jāyata iti nidarśananyāyasiddhamityarthaḥ| ihaasmin siddhānte| bhedābhedaśrutīnāmavihatiśca viśiṣṭaikyayogāt syāt "dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā" "kṣaraṃ pradhānamamṛtākṣaraṃ haraḥ kṣarātmānavīśate deva ekaḥ" "nityo nityānāṃ cetanaścetanānām" ityādyā bhedavādinyaḥ śrutayaḥ|"neha nānāsti kiñcana" ityādyā abhedaśrutayaḥ|dvividhānāmapi śrutīnāṃ parasparāvirodhaśca svarupabhedaparatvāt bhedaśrutīnāṃ abhedaśrutīnāṃ cetanācetanaviśiṣṭaprakāryaikiyaparatvayogācca saṃsidhyatītyarthaḥ||
uktanimittatvāviruddhāpādānatvopapādakayuktijātaṃ saṃgraheṇa pradarśayati kāryaikye iti| tatra tāvat pratijñāvākyamekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratipādakaṃ bhagavata upādānatvamantareṇa na saṃghaṭate| kāraṇasya kāryeṇa sahaikye pratijñā ghaṭata ityarthaḥ| tadanuguṇa iti  kāryakāraṇayoraikya pratijñānuguṇa eva mṛttatkāryādidṛṣṭāntavarga udāhāri | itthamupādānatvamuktam| nimittatvamapyāha sraṣṭuriti| sraṣṭurīśvarasyasyāmiti śrutirabhidhyānaṃ vakti nimittatvaṃ vaktītyarthaḥ| anyā tu śrutirnimittatvam siddhaṃ kṛtvā upādānatvaṃ sahakāritvaṃ ca sākṣāt svayamevāha "kiṃ svadvanam" ityādinā| vanatāṃ vṛkṣatādiṃ ca vaktīti vaktītyasyāvṛttyānvayaḥ|"kiṃ svadvanam" ityupādāvapraśnaḥ|"ka u sa vṛkṣa āsīt" ityupakaraṇapraśnaḥ| "yataḥ" upādānāt " dyāvāpṛthivī bhagavānniṣṭatakṣuḥ" sasarjeti vacanavyatyaschāndasaḥ| athavā manīṣiṇo vanaṃ manasā buddhyā niṣṭatakṣurniścitanvata ityarthaḥ|upādānabhūtād bhagavata eva sarvotpattiritimanasā niraṇaiṣurityarthaḥ|athavā manīṣiṇā atyasyottaratrāpyanvaye saṃbodhanāntatvamiti "yadadhya tiṣṭhat" ityādibhuvanāntaryāmitvena dhārayannīśvaro yadupakaraṇamadhyatiṣṭhaditi śrutyanvayaḥ| "brahma vanam" ityādibrahma vanamupādānam| "brahma sa vṛkṣaḥ" itibrahmaivopakaraṇamityarthaḥ|etaduktaṃ bhavatisukṣmacidacidviśiṣṭamupādānaṃ viśvasyopakaraṇabhūtakālādiviśiṣṭa sa evopakaraṇamiti| "manīṣiṇo manasā pṛcchatedutat " hemanīṣiṇaḥ manasā'vadhānena sahaitacchaṇutetyarthaḥ|"manīṣiṇo manasā vibravīmi vaḥ" ityatra vaḥ śrṛṇvatāṃ bhavatāmanugrahapūrvakāvadhānaviśeṣeṇa bravīmīti|"yaddhyatiṣṭhat" iti yadupakaraṇaṃ bhagavānadhyatiṣṭhaditi pīrvamevoktam|tena sarvādhiṣṭhātṛtvāt bhagavato nimittatvasiddhiḥ| kiṃca "tadātmānaṃ svayamakuruta" iti tasyova bhagavataḥ svayameva svātmano'vasthāntarakaṇādupādānatvaṃ nimitatvaṃ ca dṛśyate|tadbhutayonitvamuktamiti"yadbhutayoniṃ paripaśyanti dhīrāḥ" iti tasyaiva bhūtayonitvaṃ sāśrādevocyate|taḥ kardṛtvaṃ prakṛtitvaṃ cobhayamiti pramāṇasiddhaṃ bhavatītinigamayatitasmāditi|sarvātvāntarātmetihetugarbhaviśeṣaṇam sarvāntaryāmitvāt sarvaṃ saṃghaṭata ityarthaḥ||
atra kaścidāhayatsamavāyikāraṇaṃ yaccāsamavāyikāraṇaṃ tadubhavyatiriktakāraṇaṃ nimittakāraṇamiti hi nyāyavādibhirlakṣaṇamabhāṇi|tena yadupādānaṃ tannimittaṃ na bhavati yacca nimittaṃ tadupādānaṃ na bhavatīti niyamasya siddhyatvāt nimittopādānaikyavādo na saṃghaṭata iti lakṣaṇavirodhamāśaṅkya pariharatinopādānamiti|kimapyupādānaṃ nimittaṃ na bhavati|upādānavyatiriktaṃ kāraṇaṃ nimittamiti hi nimittakāraṇavidaḥ|evaṃ yannimittatvenasiddhaṃ tadupādānatāṃ na bhajatīti śabdānvayaḥ|uktamarthaṃ pratipakṣipatiayuktamiti|ayuktatvameva lokavedaprasiddhyopapādayatiiṣṭādityādinā|loke hi tulāyāṃ pramāṇaprameyavyavahāranyāyenaikasyaiva padārthasya sarvalakṣaṇayoge sati ākārabhedānnānātvavyavahārayogitvaṃ sidhyatīti niyame siddhe sati svakapolakalpitanyāyenopādānavyatiriktaṃ nimittaṃ nimittavyatiriktamupādānamiti parasparavirodhapraṇayanakusṛtiḥ kuyuktirbālacintāvipāka ityarthaḥ|kiṃca yuṣmatsaṃketasiddhanimittaśabdavācyatvābhāve'pyupādānakāraṇasyaiva kartṛtvaṃ suprasiddhameva|tadevamīśvarasyopādānaṃ kartṛtvaṃ cāviruddhamiti na saṃkaṭaṃ kiñcit||
nanu svakāraṇe kāryasya "pṛthivyapsu pralīyate" ityādinā layo vināśa iktaḥ, "puruṣaścāpyubhāvetau līyete paramātmani"iti prakṛtipuruṣayoripi layo bhagavatā parāśareṇa pratipāditaḥ, tena tayoḥ pralayakāle viniṣṭatvāt kathaṃ sūkṣmacijacidviśiṣṭapuruṣādviśvasṛṣṭirbhavadbhirabhidhīyata ityāśaṅkya kāryabhūtapṛthivyādilayāt śrutisiddhaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ darśayatiuktvetyādinā|ayamarthaḥatra dvividho hi layo vivakṣitaḥ|ekastāvat svāvasthāprāptiḥ|itarastu svāvasthāprahāṇamantareṇa vastvantaravibhāganarhasaṃsargaviśeṣaprāptiḥ| yathā prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ prakṛtirūpaṃ ca nityasiddhamabādhitatvādaparityajya viśeṣyabhūtena bhagavatā vibhāgānarha saṃsargaviśeṣaprāptiḥ| tadeva tamaḥ para ekībhavatīti viśiṣṭaikyarūpatayābhidhīyate| pūrvaṃ tu "pṛthivyapsu pralīyate" ityādinā sākṣāllayaśabda eva prayujyate| ataḥ "ubhāvetau līyete" iti purāṇasthalaśabda ekībhāvamātrameva kathayatīti vibhāgaḥ| saṃsargaviśeṣe'pi layaśabdaḥ prayujyate  yathā vṛkṣeṣu pakṣiṇo līyanta iti sākṣāllayaśabda eva prayujyate| tadidaṃ sarvamasminpadye yathāpāṭhamanusaṃdheyam| anvayastu "pṛthivyapsu pralīyate" ityādau tattvāntarāṇāṃ vilayamuktvā tamasaḥ punarbhagavatyekatāmātramevoktaṃ tama ekībhavatīti| tena tayoḥ prakṛtipuruṣayorna vināśaḥ| kiṃ ca "prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva viddhyānādī ubhāvapi| acetanā parārthā ca nityā satatavikriyā||"
ityādiṣu vedaparavedināṃ parāśarādīnāṃ vākyeṣu ca prakṛtipuruṣayoranāditvaṃ proktam| tasmādapi tayorna sākṣādvilayaḥ| purāṇoktaṃ layavacanaṃ sadṛṣṭāntamanyathayati syāditi| ayastoyanītyeti āyudharūpeṇa pariṇate'yasi parigṛhītaṃ toyaṃ toyarūpeṇaivāvatiṣṭhate| anyathā snehānuvṛttyādyayogāt| tadvat prakṛtipuruṣāvapi bhagavatyavibhāgārhasaṃsargaviśeṣamātreṇaikībhāva vyavahāraviṣayabhūtau viśeṣeṇa jagatsṛṣṭyādāvupakurutaḥ| uktamarthaṃ sahetukaṃ nigamayati teneti|
sopabṛṃhaṇanipuṇanirūpitaśrutisiddhatvena bhoktṛbhogyaprabhṛti sahitād bhagavato viśvasṛṣṭiḥ samīcī| atra prabhṛtiśabdena kālasaṃbandho vivakṣitaḥ| tena sūkṣmacidacidviśiṣṭasyopādānatvasiddhiḥ kālavaiśiṣṭyenopakaraṇatvasiddhirityarthaḥ||
śāstrārambhe janmādisūtroktaṃ bhagavato jagannimittopādānatvaṃ prakṛtyadhikaraṇae nigamitam, ataḥ paramuktāvaśiṣṭānāṃ śrutivākyānāmānantyādaśeṣeṇa vaktumaśakyatvena tenaiva prakāreṇa nirvāhassvayamevohanīya iti saṃgatiḥ| atra caturṇāṃ pādānāṃ prathamādhyāyoktānāmarthavibhāgena saṃgatimāhurviṣṇucittāryāḥ "itthaṃ prathamādhyāyaprathamapādena pramāṇalakṣaṇābhyāṃ paramakāraṇatayā sarvavedāntābhimataparamapuruṣasthāpanam| dvitīyatṛtīyābhyāṃ vibhūtestasya ca saṃbandhaprakārau| caturthapādena pratipakṣanirāsa iti| itthaṃ sarvaśrutinirvāha ukta ityāha eteneti" iti|tadarthavicārastu anudāhṛtāḥ kāraṇādivākyaviśeṣāḥ kimuktalakṣaṇacidacidvalakṣaṇabrahmadvātā uta neti| tadarthaṃ te kimuktanyāyānāmaviṣayā uta viṣayāḥ||kimuktanyāyānāma viṣayā uta viṣayāḥ|tadarthaṃ viṣayatvaṃ saṃbhavati na veti|asminnatideśādhikaraṇe pūrvaṃ niścitakāraṇavākyaprakriyayā'niśacitānāmapi kāraṇavākyānāṃ nirvāha ityuktam |
tāni kānivākyānītyāśaṅkāyāṃ kānicidvākyānyudāhṛtya tacchāyayā sarvāṇayapi vākyāni nirvahaṇīyānīti vaktuṃ prārabhateagra iti| "hiraṇyagarbhassamavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka asīt" iti hiraṇyagarbhapāramyapratipādakarīpamekaṃ vākyaṃ tāvadābhāti| tathā "nasannacāsacchiva eva kevalaḥ" ityaparamapi vākyaṃ rudrapāramyapratipādakamiva ddaśyate|tatra hi "yadā tamastanna divā na rātriḥ" iti pralayakāle rudrasyaivāvasthānaṃ kathyata ityāpātataḥ pratiyate|tadidamāhagrasteti| etadvākyadvitayamupāttam, etāddaśāni vākyāni bahūni vidyante, tadvākyāprabhavaṃ nārāyaṇādadhikaṃ tattnamastīti śaṅkaviśeṣaṃ stambhayituṃ prāguktāneva nyāyaviśeṣānanyatrātidiśati sūtrakāraḥ, tatkimartha? śiṣyaśikṣārthamiti cāhaetāddagiti| ayamarthaḥekatra śikṣitasya nyāyasyetaratrāpi yojyat vādayamaryassvayameva sidhyati tathāpi śiṣyānugraheṇa bhagavān sūtrakāro vācāpyacaṣṭa iti||149||
atra śāstre śrīpatireva sarveśvara iti bhavadbhirabhidhīyate va ca śrīpakatireva brahma, brahmaviṣṇurudā iti trimūrtyantamatvena sa śrutyaivābhidhīyate, loko'pi trimūrtivyavahāraḥ suprasiddha eva tatra brahmahuddhrau ca karmavaśyāviti tatsahapaṭhito viṣṇurapi karmavaśyaca eva tathā ca ghaṭukuṭāyāṃ prabhātaṃ bhagavato nārāyaṇasyetaravailakṣaṇyaṃ pratipādayituṃ pravṛttasyaiva bhavataḥ punarapi tatsālakṣaṇyamevāpannamiti| imāmāśaṅkāṃ pūrvārdhenāśaṅkateviśveśa iti| duḥkhyadvidhiśivatulayā karmavaśyatayā duḥkhyadbrahmarudrasādharmyāt|
uktamarthaṃ pratikṣipatimaivamiti| tadeva vivṛṇotimatsyāditi| matsyādibhāveṣu ca bhagavato nijavibhūtināṃ matsyādīnāṃ sajātīyatvenānukaraṇanāṭyameva dṛśyate|
evaṃ nijavibhūtibhūtayorbrahmarudrayoḥ nāṭyamātrametat| kuta ityatrāha  brahmeśasraṣṭarīti| "
"eko havai nārāyaṇa āsīt" ityupakramya "tatra brahmā caturmukho'jāyata tatastasya dhyānāntasthasya lalāṭātsvedo'patat svedādbudbudamabhavat budbudāt tryakṣaśśūlapāṇiḥ puruṣo'jāyata" iti brahmarudrayoḥ sraṣṭṛtvena sampratipanne niravadhikabṛhattvalakṣaṇapauruṣe parasminbrahmaṇi vibhūtyanukāranāṭyametadityarthaḥ||
atra caturthapādasthānāmaṣṭānāmadhikaraṇānāṃ pūrvapakṣotthānaprakriyāṃ tatpratikṣepaṃ ca śiṣyāṇāṃ sukhagrahaṇārthaṃ saṃgṛhṇāti  sāṃkhyokteti| ānumānikādhikaraṇe sāṃkhyoktaprakriyām, camasādhikaraṇe taduktābrahmatmakapradhānasṛṣṭiprakriyām, saṃkhyopasaṃgrahādhikaraṇe taduktāṃ tattvasaṃkhyāpariklṛptim, kāraṇatvādhikaraṇe sāṃkhyoktāvyākṛtaikyaṃ kāraṇasya, jagatvācitvādhikaraṇe karmaśabdasya puṇyapāparūpasvakarmavācitvam, vākyānvayādhikaraṇe patiputrādirūpakarmaphalāvadyayogitvam, prakṛtyadhikaraṇe nimittopādānayorbhedam, sarvavyākhyānādhikaraṇe brahmarudrādīnāṃ kāraṇatvañca pūrvapakṣīkṛtya tannirākaraṇaṃ sūtrakāraścakāra|
atra granthe pañcamyopādānaṃ pūrvapakṣotthānahetuviśeṣāṇāṃ vibhajya pradarśanārtham| kṣiptamityādi  etebhyo hetubhyaḥ pūrvapakṣikalpitebhyaḥ pratikṣiptaṃ pūrvapādatrayoktamarthaṃ caturthapāde śrutihṛdayasamuddhāṭanāt śrutyarthānāṃ viśadaprakāśanāt sūtrakāro rakṣitavān||
evaṃ prathamādhyāyārthe niścalatayā nirūpite sati dvitīyādhyāyamāripsuḥ pūrvottarādhyāyayoḥ saṃgatimanuvadati  jijñāsyatveneti| siddhe iti śāstropodghātacatussūtryarthaḥ prathamapādārthaśca tantreṇaivopādīyate| sthiracaracidaciddehinīti dvitīyapādārthaḥ| brahmatattva iti tṛtīyapādārthaḥ, brahma śabdena bhagavatassarvādhāratvaprakāśanāt| śrutyādyairityādinā caturthapādārtho'pi taissaha saṃgṛhītaḥ| śrutiliṅgavākyādibhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ kāraṇāmnāyavācāṃ kāraṇatvapratipādakāmnāyavācāṃ svārasikī vṛttiriyaṃ sūktetyanvayaḥ| atha vakṣyamāṇaṃ dvitīyādhyāyārthamāha bādhamiti| tatra hi kāraṇadvārakabāhyavirodhaparihāraparaṃ pūrvaṃ pādadvayaṃ tatrāpyekaṃ bādhaparihāraṃ anyat pratirodhaparihāraparamiti vibhāgaḥ| uttaraṃ pādadvayaṃ kāryadvārakāntaravirodhaparihāraparam| āntaravirodhastu śrutivākyānāmanyonyavirodhaḥ|atra ca kāryāvalambivirodha eva parihriyata iti kāraṇāvalambivirodhaparihāraparatvena pūrvapādadvikādvibhāgo'pi sidhyatītyuktaṃ bhavati| śabdārthastu bādhaṃ pratirodhaṃ ca bāhyamūlāntaramūlaṃ ca bahudhā varṇayanto musalyā musalaprahartāraḥ, athavā musalena vadhyatvāt musalyāḥ, niṣkālyeran nirasyerannityarthaḥ| tatkimarthamityāśaṅkyāha  niṣadupaniṣadāmiti| niṣadāmupaniṣadāṃ ca niścalatvaprasiddhyartham| niṣaccātra pāñcapātroktārthaprakāśikā mūlaśrutiriti vikhyātasamākhyā bhāgavatairabhidhīyamānā kācit| upaniṣat punaḥ sarveṣvapi vedeṣu sāratayā'smābhirabhidhīyamānā suprasiddheti na vaktavyamatra kiñcit||
atropodghātamārabhya prathamādhyāyapratipādyaṃ sakalamarthajātaṃ nirviśeṣabrahmavādināṃ na ghaṭata ityadhyāyānte parapakṣapratikṣepamāracayati  ādāviti ślokena| ādau bahuvihatihatā jijñāsyatā'stāmityarthaḥ| atrāpi "athāto brahmajijñāsā" ityādyaṃ sūtraṃ prāvartiṣṭa| asminsūtre brahmaṇo jijñāsyatvamucyate| tacca jijñāsyatvamadvaitavādibhipyupakṣipyate| yadi jijñāsyaṃ brahma tadā dṛśyatvānmitthātvamiti prakriyayā nithyātvaprasaṅgāt| yadi na jijñāsyaṃ brahmatadā sakalamapi śāstraṃ parityaktaṃ syādityakāmenāpi svīkartavyam| tata ubhayatasspāśā rajjurityadvaitavādināmapahāsyataiva avaśiṣyate| tadidamāha bahuvihatihateti| kākākṣinyāyenātrāpyanuṣajyate| "janmādyasya yataḥ" iti lakṣaṇavākyamadvaitavādināmapi saṃmatam| lakṣaṇaṃ nāmāsādhāraṇo dharmaḥ| nirdharmakabrahmaṇi lakṣaṇakathanamadvaitavādināṃ na jāghaṭīti| nanu lakṣaṇaṃ dviprakāraṃ taṭasthalakṣaṇaṃ svarūpalakṣaṇaṃ ceti, svarupalakṣaṇaṃ "satyaṃ jñānam" ityādivākyapratipādyaṃ satyatvajñānatvānantatvādi, tatpunaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena pratipādyate, taṭasthalakṣaṇaṃ ca jagadatkāraṇatvādi, tatpunarvaiyadhikaraṇyenocyate "yato vā imāni" ityādivākyena pratipādanāt tathā ca brahmaṇaḥ svarūpalakṣaṇaṃ mā bhūt, taṭasthalakṣaṇamastu svarūpasaṃbandhābhāvāt, yathā śākhāgre candra ityukte śākhāgraṃ candreṇa na saṃbandhyate, tena jagatkāraṇatvādikaṃ brahmalakṣaṇaṃ satyabrahmaṇā na saṃsṛjyate, ato nirviśeṣameva brahmāvatiṣṭhata iti na kaścidasmākaṃ doṣa iti| atrottaramyadi svarūpalakṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇi na syāt tarhi satyajñānādivākyaṃ brahmaṇi pratipādakameva na bhavatīti mahānprahāraḥ| vyāvṛttimukhena pratipādakamiti cet vyāvṛtteravācyatvāllakṣaṇaiva doṣaḥ| vākyatātparyānurodhena lakṣaṇāpi svīkāryeti cedastu lakṣaṇīyaṃ kimiti svayamevaviśeṣato darśaya, vyāvṛttiriti yadi vadasi tarhi vikalpayāmaḥ vyāvṛttiḥ svarūpaṃ tadadhikaṃ vā kiṃcit| svarūpaṃ cet ekenaiva padena svarūpaṃ lakṣitamiti padāntaranairarthakya prasaṅgaḥ| atiriktaṃ cet bhedavādaprasaṅgaḥ| nānālakṣaṇābhidhānañca nirarthakaṃ tattallakṣaṇairapi lakṣyaviśeṣākārābhāvāt bhāve vā bhedaprasaṅgādityeṣā dik| tṛtīye'pi sūtre śāstrayonityakathanamapi vimṛśāmaḥ| mṛṣyāma iti śabdenāmarṣaṇīyatvameva dyotyate| tenāpi bahuvihatihatamityatrāpyanuṣajyate| "tattu samanvayāt" iti samanvayavyavahāro'pyapaṣṭhureva syāt| samanvayo nāma sarveṣāṃ kāraṇavākyānāṃ brahmaṇi tātparyeṇa samanvayaḥ| sa ca brahmaṇi bhavadbhirabhidhātuṃ na śakyate| vācyavācakabhāvādikhaṇḍanasya svapakṣasthāpanādaurbalyena khaṇḍanamāśrayadbhirbhavadbhirevābhidhānāt| astu mukhyavṛttikhaṇḍanam, aupacārikī vṛtiṃta brahmaṇyāśrayāma iti cet tadapi hāsyameva| mukhyābhāve kathamaupacārikī vṛttirucyate| mukhyārthasaṃbandhinyarthāntare vṛttirlakṣaṇā mukhyārthaguṇayoginyarthāntare vṛttirgauṇīti sarvalokalakṣaṇapraṇayanavirodhāt| kiṃ ca gauṇī vṛttirapi vṛttireva, vṛttirnāma śabdasyārthabodhanam| tathāca gauṇyā'pi vṛttyā brahmaṇo bodhyatvamastyeva| tathāca bodhyatvānmithyātvamiti svavacanaṃ paripālayatu bhavān| tarhi tātparyavṛttirastviti cet sāpi hi vṛttireva tathāca sarpo vā vṛściko vā bhavatu bādhakatvaṃ dvayorapi sādhāraṇamityalamatra vistareṇa| sarvamapaydvaitavādibhiruktamapārthaṃ soḍhāsmaḥ, idamekaṃ na soḍhāsmaḥ| "īkṣaternāśabdam" ityārabhya "etena sarve vyākhyātā vyākhyātāḥ" ityantaissūtrairekasya sūtrasyaiko'rtho bhedena pratipādyo'sti vā na vā  yadyasti tadā
bhedavādaprasaṅgaḥ| yadi nāsti tadā nairarthakyameva sūtrāṇāmiti| santyarthāḥ, te tu vyāvahārikā iti cet yadi vedāntasūtrārthā vyāvahārikāḥ, tarhi pāramārthikaṃ kimiti vada| na kiṃciditi cet kimarthaṃ śārīrakaśāstramārabhyate| śārīrakaśāstrasyāpāramārthikaviṣayatve ca paroktānāmarthānāṃ apāramārthikatvāt punarapi śāstrārambhanairarthakyam atisuṣṭhuktaṃ bhavatā| ayamiha śabdānvayaḥsphuṭārthaissaviṣayavacanairetaissūtrairnirviśeṣaikyapakṣe sūtrārthatayā pradhānapratipādyairīkṣaṇādiguṇairbrahmadharmabhūtaiḥ prakṛtipuruṣato brahmaṇo bhedavādaḥ kathaṃ bhavatāṃ syāt| prakṛtyadhikaraṇapratipādyabrahmaṇaḥ prakṛtipuruṣābhyāṃ bhedo mithyā cet adhikaraṇanairarthakyam, tattvañcet bhedavādaprasaṅgaḥ| vyāvahārikatvakusṛtiḥ pūrvameva nirasteti na tatra prayatāmaha iti||
prathamādhyāye caturṣu pādeṣu aspaṣṭatarajīvādiliṅgakāni pūrvapakṣiṇā caturdhā purasākṛtāni| tatpratipakṣavākyāni siddhāntinā|
<3>
dvitīyādhyāye prathamapādaḥ
prathamādhyāye caturṣu pādeṣu aspaṣṭajīvādiliṅgakāni vākyāni pūrvapakṣiṇā caturdhā puraskṛtāni| tatpratipakṣavākyāni siddhāntinā| tatra pūrvapakṣayuktīnāṃ paulastyaparakaranyāyena pratipādaṃ kṣayaḥ| prakṣīṇānāñcāpunarudayāduttarottarapādopāttānāmupapattīnāṃ vākyānāṃ ca nissahāyatvena daurbalyāt krameṇa saṅkṣayo jātaḥ| siddhāntayuktīnāṃ punaḥ sugrīvasainikavat pratipādaṃ pratihatapratipakṣāṇāmakṣatatvenaivāvasthānāt uttarottarapratipādyānāṃ śrutismṛtiyuktyādīnāṃ sasahāyatvenottarottaraṃ prābalyāt siddhāntaprakriyā niṣkaṇṭakamevābhivartata iti sarvatomukhī vijayasiddhiriti pūrvādhyāyena sāṅkhyādipakṣe niraste punaḥ prativādino naṣṭe dyūte balbajaṃ kuryāditinyāyena prakramopamātraparatantrā yuktibhirvirodhaṃ vaktumārabhanta iti dvitīyādhyāyasaṃṅagatiḥ| prathamādhyāyaparisamāptau sāṅkhyayogapakṣayoranukrameṇa niratatvāt sākhyavādī tāvadvedāntavirodhamācaṣṭe, tataḥ punaryogavādī, ityadhikaraṇasaṅgatiḥ ekapeṭikātvañca| atra pūrvottarādhyāyasaṃgatiṃ sadṛṣṭāntamāha tattādṛk tattādṛgvidhatarkatantrakrame nipuṇānāṃ mahābuddhīnāṃ santoṣasiddhiḥ prathamādhyāyoktena prakāreṇa yadyapi labhyā, tathāpi mṛdudhiyāṃ bālabuddhīnāṃ haitukai hetuvādibhirāskandamākramaṇamāśaṅkamānaḥ kathitameva brahmaṇaḥ kāraṇatvaṃ sthūṇānikhananyāyena sthirayati sūtrakāraḥ| kāryatvañca yasyākāśāderyādṛk tacca tādṛśameva sthitayatīti punaranvayaḥ| ayamarthaḥ brahaṇaḥ kāraṇatvamākāśādeḥ kāryatvañca saprakāraṃ bāliśabuddhīnāṃ pratibhaṭavādibhiranākramaṇāya sthūṇānikhananyāyena sūtrakāraḥ sthirayatīti prathamādhyāyoktārthasthāpanameva dvitīyādhyāyakṛtyamityuktaṃ bhavati| tathā ca na paunaruktyaśaṅkāvakāśa iti||
