pūrvaṃ prathamadvitīyayoradhyāyayossaṃgatiruktā adhunā punardvitīyādhyāye pūrvapādadvandvasyottarapādadvayasya ca parasparasaṅgatirabhidhīyate| taccheṣabhūtañcārthatattvamanyadapi tatraiva prakāśyate pādadvandamityādinā| śabdārthastu dvitīyādhyāye prathamapādadvandvaṃ parasminkāraṇabhūte brahmaṇi vedabāhyoktāṃ bādhapratirodhātmikāṃ pīḍāṃ krameṇa pariharati| pādāntarayugaṃ punarviyatpādaḥ prāṇapādaśca kāryadvāreṇa samutthitaṃ va virodhamāntaraprakṣobhaśāntyai pariharati| tena bādhapratirodhābhyāṃ saha paramātmavijñānasyānutpattilakṣaṇamaprāmāṇyamapi parihṛtaṃ bhavati| āntarakṣobho nāma vedāntavākyānāmanyonyavirodhaḥ| itthaṃ pādadvayasya pūrvasyottareṇa pāddvayena saṅgatiruktā| prakārāntareṇāpyarthabhedaṃ saṅgatiñcāhahetutveti| pūrveṇa pādadvandveneśvarasya kāraṇatvāyogabhaṅgaḥ kṛtaḥ| dvitīyena tu pādadvandvena tasyaiva hetutvasya sārvatrikatvāyogabhaṅgaḥ kriyata iti| ayamarthaḥ nyāyavādina evaṃ manyante  īśvarasya hetutmastu nāma, athāpyākāśādernityatvāt tatprati tasya hetutvaṃ nāsti| ata īśvarasya hetutvaṃ na sārvatrikamiti| tadapi vidhūyate viyadādipādeneti| phalatīti sākṣādartho'yaṃ na bhavati phalitārtha ityarthaḥ| ākāśādeḥ kāryatvopapādane sati īśvarāpekṣā tasya kāryatvaṃ svayameva phalitaṃ bhavatīti| nanu prakṛtipuruṣayornityatvaṃ śrūyate kathamīśvarahetutvasya sārvatrikatvāyogakṣepa ityāśaṅkyāha sa ceti| yassarvatrikatvāyogakṣepaḥ sa tu śrutisiddhanityaṃ vihāya bhavet| yatra nityatvaśrutistadvyatirekeṇānyatra sarvatreśvarasya kāraṇatvamityarthaḥ| īśvarasvātantryaṃ nityānityasādhāraṇaṃ niyatapūrvabhāvitvalakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇatvamanityamātre vyavitaṣṭata iti bhāvaḥ||
pūrvamadhyāyasaṅgatiruktā adhunā punaḥ prathamalakṣaṇacaturthapādena dvitīyalakṣaṇaprathamāpādasya saṅratirabhidhīyate  tantreti| upaniṣadāṃ tantracchāyānidāne pūrvasminpāde svayamanyaparatve niṣiddhe tantrebhyastāsāmupaniṣadāṃ durbalatvāt tadanusaraṇaṃ tantrānusaraṇameva nyāyyamiti para ujjihīte| ayamarthaḥ sarvavyākhyānādhikaraṇe "vyākhyātāḥ" ityupaniṣadāṃ vyākhyānamuktam| vyākhyānañcopabṛṃhaṇameva| taccopabṛṃhaṇaṃ śruteḥ samṛtyā katrvyam| manvādismṛtistu karmapratipādanaparatvāt karmabhāgopabṛṃhaṇam|
tathācānādeśikatvādupaniṣacattapasvinī nyāyopabṛṃhaṇe sāṃkhyasmṛtimevāśrayate| tena samāśrayaṇīyasāṃkhyāsmṛtyapekṣayā durbalatvāt tadanurodheneyamuniṣanneyetyadhikaraṇotthānena saṅgatirapyatra parisphurati| itthaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā vaiyākulīmāpāditāṃ samādhatte pādāntareṇa sūtrakāra ityāha itthamiti| tattadityādi  tattatsāṃkhyādismṛtinyāyābhyāṃ kalitamatikamaṃ hiṃsanaṃ tattatapratikṣepārhaiḥ pratyastrairvārayitvā cālitaṃ pūrvapādoktamarthaṃ dṛḍhīkaroti||
dvitāyādhyāyapādārambhasya nairarthakyaṃ pariharati nirṇītamityādinā|karmakāṇḍe hi virodhādhikaraṇādau smṛtinyāyavirodhe śrutīnāṃ niścalatvaṃ nirṇītam| vedānto'pi śrutireva| tatsiddhaye pūrvasiddhārthasiddhaye, punariyaṃ carceti dvitīyādhyāyādyapādo viphala eva syāt | netyāha maivamiti| tadeva vivṛṇoti gambhīreti| upaniṣadāṃ gambhīratvopapadānāt tatparicchedyasyārthasya durbodhatvaśaṅkāyāṃ kapilādyāptatamavākyaistadupaskārarūpatarkaiśca tattvārthapirajñānānusaraṇaṃ prāptamiti paśyataḥ kasyacinmandamateratra bhaṅgaḥ kriyata iti na paunaruktyaśaṅkāvakāśa iti||
samṛtivirodhapirahāraḥ kutra nyāyavirodhaparihāraśca kutretyāśaṅkya dvābhyāmadhikaraṇābhyāṃ smṛtivirodhaparihāro bhavati, aṣṭabhiḥ punaradhikaraṇairnyāyavirodhaparihāra iti vibhajya darśayati dvābhyāmityādinā| ubhābhyāmapi parihārābhyāṃ phalitamarthamāha teneti| upādānatvaṃ nimittatvañca bhagavataḥ sudṛḍhameva sthāpitaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| tadvadvayaṃ ceti kkvacidupādānatvaṃ kvacicpunarupādānatvaṃ nimittatvañcobhayamapi prakāśayatītyarthaḥ| tattadvādiparikalpitānāṃ parasparaviruddhānāmarthatattvānāmekapratikṣepe tadanyeṣāmarthānāṃ tulāgranamanonnamananyāyena sadbhāvāsadbhāvaśaṅkāvarge pravṛtte parīkṣāyāṃ sāmyena nihitamatisūtakāraḥ pakṣapātaṃ ruṇaddhi sāmyameva sthāpayatītyuttarārdhasya yojanā||
atra saṃgatiḥ pūrvamevoktā| tadarthavicārastu  uktaṃ brahmaṇo jagatkāraṇatvaṃ cālayituṃ śakyate na veti| kiṃ vedāntavākyāni brahmakāraṇatvamāpādayati neti| kimanavakāśasāṅkhyasmṛtyanusāre virodho vedāntavākyānāṃ pradhānaparatvamāpādayati neti| kiṃ sāṅkhyasmṛtayā vedopabṛṃhaṇamuta manvādismṛtyeti| kiṃ sāṅkhyasmṛtirbhrāntimūlā na veti| atrāvaśyameva vedāntānāṃ kapilasmṛtyanusāre kāraṇamanukrameṇāha  smarteti| "ṛṣiṃ prasūtaṃ kapilam" iti śvetāśvataraśrutyaivāsau kapilaṛṣirvijñātārthatattvatvena śrūyate| ṛṣitvaṃ hi jñānavṛddhatvam, abhedya'yaṃ heturitu| aparo'rapyasti rāmāyaṇādavayaṃ kapilo vāsudevāṃśa iti prakhyātaḥ| nahi vāsudevasya bhrāntissambhavati| apicāyaṃ praṇidhinipuṇadhīḥ yogābhyāsātiśayanipuṇadhīriti śrutipurāṇādiṣu sarvatrāpi śrūyate|ayamāśayaḥ manuyājñavalkyādayaḥ kevalakarmiṇaḥ, ayaṃtu jñānaikaniṣṭhaḥ tenaitadvākyenaiva vedāntopabṛṃhaṇaṃ kriyata iti| evamatiśayayuktatvādasmākamapratyakṣārthe śrutiśirasi taduktyaiva niṣkarṣaṇaṃ syādityāha tasmāditi| maivamityāha na syāditi|tatra hetucatuṣṭayamāha ekārtheti| manvādivākyānāmekārthatvena parasparavirodhābhāvāt "yadvai kiñcana manuravadattadbheṣajam" iti sāṃsārikasakalarogabheṣajatvena śrutatvāt kapilavadasthānakrodhādidoṣānupahataparamaśāntapraṇītatvāt bahuśrutatvācca tadvākyānusaraṇameva nyāyyam| tena tadvākyaireva tattvajñānasiddheḥ kapilavākyānusaraṇamanyāyyamityarthaḥ||
atrādhikāśaṅkoktyā bhāṣya eva saṅgatissuvyaktā "yogasmṛtāvapīśvarābhyupagamānmokṣasādhanatayā vedāntavihitayogasya cābhidhānādvakturhiraṇyagarbhasya sarvavedāntapravartanādhikṛtatvācca tatsmṛtyā vedāntopabṛṃhaṇaṃ nyāyyamiti" iti| tadarthavicārastu brahmakāraṇatvavādastathaivāvatiṣṭhate neti| kiṃ vedāntavākyāni brahmakāraṇatvaparāṇi utānyaparāṇīti| kimīśvarādhiṣṭhitaṃ pradhānaṃ tatkāraṇamuta brahmeti| kimanavakāśayogasmṛtyā vedopabṛṃhaṇamuta parāśarādismṛtyeti| kiṃ yogasmṛtirbhrāntimūlā neti| kiṃ tatpraṇeturhiraṇyagarbhasyāpi bhrāntissaṃbhavati neti|
atra sarvatrāpi phalaphalibhāvassvayamevonneyaḥ|tadarthavicāraparamparāprāptānāmuttottareṣāmarthānāṃ viparyaye pūrvapūrvaviparyayapradarśanarūpatvād dvayorapi pakṣayoḥ phalaphalibhāvasya| tena pūrvapakṣe siddhānte caphalaphalibhāvassvayamevonneya iti na viśeṣataḥ pradarśayāmaḥ| viṣayasaṃśayotthānakāraṇapūrvapakṣasiddhāntanyāyanirṇayatattatphalānāṃ vaktuṃprāptānāmapi bhāṣyadīpayoreva suvyaktatvādviśeṣato na vaktavyamiti saṃgatitadarthavicārāveva sarvato vistṛṇīmahi| atra pūrvapakṣasiddhantanyāyau vibhajya darśayati vedāniti| pūrvasminkāle bhagavato vedānalabhata vidhāteti śrūyate "yo brahmaṇāṃ vidadhāti pūrvaṃ yo vai vedāṃśca prahiṇoti tasmai " iti| nāyameko hetuḥ  sarveṣvapi vidyāsthāneṣu pravartakatvena niyukta iti dvitīyaḥ| etasya ca sarveṣvapi lokeṣu vāgīśatvaprasiddhiḥ punastṛtīyaḥ |tasmāt  hetutrayāt| hiraṇyagarbhoktivyāghātādvedāntasya calanameva bhavati| uktamimaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ pratikṣipati  maivamiti| tatra hetumāha tasyāpīti| hiraṇyagarbhasyāpi madhukaiṭabhanimittavedāpahārapramukha vipaddarśanāt kṣetribhāvāt triguṇātmakaprakṛkiśarīratvād bhrāntyādissaṃbhaviṣyatītyagatikaviṣaye tadvacanasya vedavrodha nāstīti kathaṃcidapi parihartumasakyatvāt kapilavākyavadapramāṇameveti nirvahāmaḥ|vedavirodhasya nirvoḍhumasakyatve tadvākyamapramāṇamityeva pratipadyāmahabhāvaḥ||
atra saṃgatirbhāṣyakārairevokta "punarapi smṛtivirodhavādi tarkamavalambamānaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhete" ita|
imamevārthaṃ śrīviṣṇucittāryāḥ prāhuḥ "kapilahiraṇyagarbhādyupadeśaṃ parityajya taduktaistarkairvedārthamanyathākartuṃ pratyavatiṣṭhate" iti| tadarthavicārastu uktaṃ brahmaṇo jagatkāraṇatvaṃ saṃbhavati neti| kiṃ cetanādbrahmaṇo'cetanajagadutpattisaṃbhavati neti| kiṃ sajātīyātkāraṇāt sajātīyaṃ kāryamutpadyate uta vijātīyam| kiṃ kāryakāraṇayossālakṣaṇyānumānamanaikāntikaṃ na veti| tatra kāryakāraṇayossālakṣaṇye niyāmakatvenoktaṃ sāṅkyāvacanaviṣayamarthaṃ upakṣipati viśvamiti| itthaṃ kilāhussāṅkhyāḥ  sukhaḥdukhamohātmakatvāt traiguṇyātmakaṃ viśvaṃ triguṇādevodetuṃ bhavitumarhati| nāsamāt traiguṇyarahitatvena asamāt paramātmana udetuṃ bhavituṃ nārhatīti| pūrvapakṣamupanyasya pratikṣipati  ityayuktamiti| atra vikalpayati sarvākāreṇa sāmyaṃ kāryakāraṇayorbhavatocyate kiṃ vā kenāpyākāreṇa| tatrāpi kiṃ kāryakāraṇayorbhāvavaniyāmakākāreṇa kiṃ vā yenakenāpyākāreṇeti vikalpavibhāgaḥ| tatra prathamavikalpaṃ dūṣayatisarveti| kāryakāraṇayossarvākāreṇa sāmyaṃ na bhavati tayoḥ kāryatvena kāraṇatvena ca vibhaktākāreṇa ddaṣṭatvāt| yena kenāpyākāreṇeti tṛtīyaṃ pakṣaṃ prāgeva pratikṣipatiiṣṭamiti| "parvate paramāṇau ca padārthatvaṃ vyavasthitam" iti cāhuḥ| yenakenāpyākāreṇa sāmyaṃ prasādhanīyameva na bhavati| tasmāt kāryakāraṇabhāvaniyāmakākāreṇa sāmyamiti dvitīyaḥ pakṣo'vaśiṣyate| sa ca netyāhabhagneti| hetuvyavasthocitaguṇasamatā kāryakāraṇabhāvavyavasthāpakagomayatvādiguṇasāmyaṃ kāryakāraṇabhūtayorvṛścikagomayayornāstyeva| gomaye gomayatvasattvādvṛścike tadabhāvāccetyarthaḥ|guṇasamatā bhagnetyanvayaḥ| tena sūkṣmacidaciccharīro bhagavān sthūlacidacidviśiṣṭarūpeṇāvatiṣṭhata iti sugamametat| tasmāt sarvasyāpi codyasyopamarda eva| sūkṣmasya tasyaiva dravyasya sthūlarūpeṇāvasthānamātrasyaiva kāryakāraṇabhāvarūpatvenāsmābhirabhidhānāt| nahyasmābhirīśvara eva svarūpeṇa prakṛtipuruṣātmanā pariṇamata ityucyata iti||
atra pāśvasthaḥ kaścinmṛduprajño manyate "tatteja aikṣata" "tā āpa aikṣanta" iti kārye vastuni caitanyopalambhāccaitanyaṃ kārye ddaśyate kāraṇe punarvastuni "tadaikṣata bahu syām" iti caitanyopalambhaḥ siddha eva tena kāryakāraṇayoḥ sālakṣaṇyamiti| tadidamāhaīkṣeti| ayamarthaḥsati kāraṇe bahusyāmiti paripaṭhitā tāddagīkṣā tejaso'pāñca "tatteja aikṣata" "tā āpa aikṣanta" iti ddaṣṭā| tena kāryabhūtasya jagataḥ kāraṇabhūtātmā saha sālakṣaṇyaṃ caitanyayogena ,syāditi mṛduprajñapārśvasthasya codye sati tatra samyaguttaramidaṃ yaktaṃ tejaḥprabhṛtimūrteḥ parasya puruṣasyekṣaṇamidamitīmaṃ bhāvamapalapya pūrvapakṣī bhāvāntareṇa parijahāra | "tatteja aikṣata" "tā āpa aikṣanta" ityādikamabhimānivyapadeśa iti| ayaṃ punarvyapadeśastejaḥprabhṛtitattattattvābhimānidevatāviśeṣavyavahāraṇamiti sāmānyena prāha| napunaḥ paramātmavyapadeśo vā tattaddevatāmātraparo veti vibhajya prāha| tena pūrvapakṣivyavahāratvānnāsmākaṃ doṣa iti||

svarūpaprakṛtipuruṣakālātmikāḥ śaktayaḥ kāraṇāvasthāyāmapi santi| ato na doṣa ityarthaḥ| atra tattaducitasahakāriśaktyupādāne bahūndṛṣṭāntamāha kṣīretyādinā| kṣīramātañjanena dadhi karoti| ātañjanaṃ tu śīghraṃ dadhibhāvārthaṃ rasaviśeṣārthaṃ ca| ayaskāntaḥ sannidhimātreṇāyodravyamākarṣati| lūtā lālāsahitā tantuṃ tanoti| devā ṛṣayaśca svābhāvikaprabhāvasahitā vicitrāṇi tattatkāryāṇi kurvanti| evamanyānyapyadāharaṇāni draṣṭavyāni| tāndṛṣṭāntān vīkṣya bhavatā santoṣṭavyam| ayathāyathokiṃta parityajya sukhenāvasthātavyamityarthaḥ| sarvalokaprasiddhaṃ paravādibhirapyanatilaṅghanīyaṃ dṛṣṭāntamāha saṅkalpāditi| jīvo hi kulālādissaṅkalpamātreṇa śarīraṃ nudati svaśarīrādhiṣṭhitadaṇḍādinā cakrādikam, yatra yadapekṣitaṃ tatra tatkāryaṃ kartumityarthaḥ| evamīśvaro'pītyāha viśvarūpa iti| viśvaśarīratvādīśvaro'pi saṅkalpamātreṇa sarvaṃ praṇayatītyarthaḥ||
astu vā kālarūpabāhyasahakārisahitaṃ jagatkāraṇaṃ brahma tathāpi svayamapi sarvacidacicchaktiyuktaṃ niravayavaṃ paramātmasvarūpaṃ kathamiva "bahu syām" iti saṅkalpyānekakāryatayāvatiṣṭhata ityāśaṅkyā saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu  prāguktameva jagatkāraṇatvaṃ sambhavati neti| kiṃ brahmaṇo jagatkāraṇatve niravayavatvaśrutirbādhyate na veti| pūrvaṃ sahakāryabhāvena kāraṇatvasāmānyacodyaṃ parihṛtyedānīmupādānatvarūpakāraṇatvaviśeṣe codyaviśeṣamācakṣāṇasya parihāraḥ kriyata itīmamarthamāha kṛtsnamiti| ayamatra vikalpaḥ  kāraṇabhūtaṃ brahma kṛtsnamapyekakāryātmanā pariṇamatyutaikadeśena| yadi kṛtsnaṃ tarhi brahmaṇa ekakāryātmanā pariṇatasyāvaśeṣābhāvāt kāryāntarātmanā pariṇāma eva na syāt| yadyekadeśena pariṇāmaḥ niṣkalatvaśrutīnāṃ niravayayatvaśrutīnāṃ nityameva vyākopaḥ syājiti|idaṃ tu dūṣaṇaṃ na kevalaṃ brahmasvarūpakāraṇatve, apitu cetanācetanaviśiṣṭakāraṇatve'pi tulyamityāhaidamiti| tasminbrahmaṇītyarthaḥ|evaṃ dūṣaṇamuktvā pūrvapakṣe tatphalamāha brahmeti| evaṃ brahmaṇa upādānatvaṃ na ghaṭata ityanvayaḥ| itthamāśaṅkyāṃ pirahariṣyan pūrvapakṣaṃ nirākaroti  neti| māyāviśiṣṭaṃ brahma kāraṇamiti māyāvādinaḥ, upādhiviśiṣṭamiti bhāskarīyāḥ, śaktiviśiṣṭamiti yādavaprakāśīyāḥ, tena teṣvapi pakṣeṣu dūṣaṇaṃ samānamityāha svapakṣeṣviti| evaṃ pratibandīmuktvā teṣāmabhimataḥ pratibandhīparihāro'pi tulya ityāha  tanmānāditi| ayaṃ kila teṣāṃ pratibandīparihāraḥ  māyopādhaiśaktiviśiṣṭabrahmapratipādakapramāṇabalāttādṛśaṃ brahmāsmābhiḥ svīkriyata iti| evaṃ pramāṇābhāsabalāt tvatpakṣalasvīkāre sākṣātpramāṇaiḥ śrutiśataiḥ pratipannamasmātpakṣaparigṛhītaṃ cetanācetanaviśiṣṭaṃ brahma sarvalokānukūlaṃ svīkuruṣveti pakṣānantarāṇi pratyakṣapramāṇaviruddhatvāt svīkartumayogyāni, asmatpakṣastu lokavedāviruddhatvāt svīkartuṃ yogya iti bhāvaḥ||
evaṃ nyāyavādino'pi śarīrātmabhāvapratikṣepakāḥ parihartavyāḥ, ākāśāvayaviparimāṇusambandhādīnāṃ teṣāmapi pakṣe sambandhaviṣaye kṛtsnaikadeśavikalpānupapatterapi bhāvāt|svapakṣoktaṃ dūṣaṇamekadeśena parihṛtya vistareṇa parihariṣyan mādhyāmikoktakṛtsnaikadeśavikalpaprakriyaiṃ dāvadanuvadatisaṃyogeti|paramāṇudvayādisaṃyogād dvyaṇukādisṛṣṭiriti vaiśiṣikādīnāṃ prakriyā|tatra ca jagatkarteśvaraḥ svayaṃ vibhureva paramāṇubhissaṃyujya tānadhitiṣṭatīti tānadhitiṣṭatīti ca te prāhuḥ|tatra mādhyamikaḥ pratyamatiṣṭateparamāṇudvayaṃ kārtsnyena vānyonyaṃ syujyate, utaikadeśena|kātsrnyenatparamāṇvoranyonyaṃ svarūpe nimajjanādadhikaparimāṇadvayaṇukādikāryaṃ nārabhyeta|ekadeśena cet sāṃśatvaprasaṅgaḥ|evamaṇuḥ paramāṇurvibhuśceśvaraḥ kātsrnyena saṃyujyate cet tarhi tayostulyaparimāṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ|tadhācāṇuḥ paramāṇurīśvadvibhuḥ syāt|vibharīśvaraḥ paramāṇuvadaṇureva syāt ekadeśena saṃyoge dvayorapīśvaraparamāṇvossāvayavatvaprasaṅgadena niravayavadravyadbhāva eva lolupyeta|tathā ca niravayavabhāvāt sāvayavakathanamapi sāhasameva syāt|niravayavarūpaparamāṇvabhāve tadavayavāśritatvena sataiṃ dvyaṇukādīnāmapi tyaktavyatvāditi| itthaṃ mādhyamikena svapakṣaduṣaṇāyoktarthaṃ kaṇabhakṣādipakṣaniṣṭo yadi vedāntinaṃ prati tadā svayamapi mādhyamika nimajjet|ayamatra śabjānvayaḥsaṃyogākhyaṃ kāryaṃ vibhutadirayoḥ syāt īśvaraparamāṇvorvā syāt, aṇūnāṃ mitho vā paramāṇūnāmanyonyaṃ ca syāt tatrāpi kātsrnyena vā syādaṃśena vā syāditi vikalprakārāḥ| tadvihatamevetyasmānvedāntavādinaḥ prati vadan parapakṣavādī svayaṃ mādhyamikavacchūnyavāde nimajjet| astu paramāṇukāraṇavādino vaiśeṣikāderidaṃ dūṣaṇam, tena sāṅkhyasya kiṃ dūṣaṇamityāśaṅkyāha sāṅkhyo'pīti| itthaṃ kila sāṅkhyānāṃ prakriyā prakatirviśvaṃ sṛjati| sā ca vibhvī| sā punassattvarajastamasāṃ saṅghātātmiketi| tathā ca kāryaṃ kurvatī svātmabhūtaissattvarajastamobhiḥ parasparaṃ saṃyujya karoti vā kimaikaikaśyena| yadi saṃyujya tadā kātsrnyena vā sattavarajastamāsaṃ saṃyoga utaikadeśena| yadi kātsrnyena tarhyekameva kāryaṃ prati sarveṣāṃ sattvarajastamasāṃ viniyuktatvāt kāryāntarārambhaṃ pratyavaśeṣo na syāt| yadyekadeśena sambandhaḥ tadā teṣāṃ sattvarajastamasāṃ sāṃśatvaprasaṅgaḥ| tathā ca vibhutvakalpanākyāghātaḥ| yadyaikaikaśyena kāraṇam tadā kāryasya triguṇātmakatvaṃ na syāt kiñcitsattvena sṛjyata itaradrajasā tamasā cānyaditi evamādidūṣaṇakalopopahatā sāṅkhyoktaprakriyeti| kathaṃ nyūnasṛṣṭistataḥ syāditi asyāyamarthaḥ| vibhvīṃ prakṛtimaṅgīkurvataḥ sāṅkhyasya kathaṃ nyūnasṛṣṭiḥ syāt| uktaprakāreṇa duṣṭatvāditi| evaṃ sāṅkhyādipakṣapratikṣepaprakriyayā māyopādhiśaktyupahitabrahmapakṣeṣvapi dūṣaṇamūhyam| astu tulyatvamasmatpakṣāṇāṃ tvatpakṣasya ca, athāpi tvatpakṣasya parigrahe ko viśeṣa ityāśaṅkyāha nigamanigaditeti| ayamatra viśeṣaḥ " kṣaraṃ pradhānamamṛtākṣaraṃ haraḥ kṣarātmānāvīśate deva ekaḥ " ityasmatpakṣasya śrutiśatanigati tatvāttaddūṣaṇapralopo dharmigrāhakapramāṇabādhitaḥ, asmatpakṣastu śrutyānukūlyādavatiṣṭhata eveti| tadidamāha akṣatā paddhatirnaiti||
atra saṅgativiśeṣapratyāyakaṃ bhāṣyaṃ " yadyapūśvaraḥ prāksṛṣṭereka eva san sakaletaravilakṣaṇatvena sarvārthaśaktiyuktaḥ svayameva vicitraṃ jagatsraṣṭuṃ śaknoti tathāpīśvarakāraṇatvaṃ na saṃbhavati prayojanatvādvicitrasṛṣṭeḥ, īśvarasya ca prayojanābhāvāt "iti| tadarthavicārastu  kimuktaṃ jagatkarāṇatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ samabhavati neti| kimavāptasamastakāmasyāpi līlayā jagatkāraṇatvaṃ sambhavati neti| kimavāptasamastakāmasyāpi līlā prayojanaṃ neti| atra vikalpya dūṣayati  ātmārthaṃmityādinā| kimīśvarasya viśvasraṣṭṛtā ātmārthamuta parārtham| ātmārthaṃ tāvanna saṃbhavati avāptasamastakāmatvāt| tadidamāha satatāvāptakāmasyeti| parārthatvapakṣe kṛpayā viśvasṛṣṭiriti vaktavyam, tadapi na vaktaṃ śakyata ityāha kāruṇyāditi|yadi kāruṇyād viśvaṃ sṛjati tarhi sukharūpameva viśvaṃ sṛjenna punardukharūpam| nanu duḥkharūpamapi sṛjati tadapi kāruṇyādeva yathā duḥkharūpāṃ cikitsāṃ kurvan cikitsako rakṣaka ityabhidhīyate evaṃ duḥkharūpāṃ viśvasṛṣṭiṃ kurvannīśvaro'pi cikitsakadrakṣaka eva syādityāśaṅkya pariharati  na ceti|ayamatra bhāvaḥcikitsakastvalpaśaktikatvāt duḥkharūpāṃ cikitsakanayādduḥkhasṛṣṭiriti| tat tasmātkāraṇāt svātmatṛptaḥ sarvajñaḥ īśvaro jagatsṛṣṭiheturna bhavatītyandhānāmeva codyam|tadevopapādayatilīleti| "lokavattu lālākaivalyam" iti spaṣṭameva sūtrakāraireva codyaparihāra uktaḥ| yathā sārvabhaumo rājā pūrvameva paripūrṇo'pi dyūtakrīḍāṃ karoti| atra "paśyantīṣu śrutiṣu" itiyādikamācāryapadyameva pāṭhyam| nanu pūrvamavidyamānasya sancoṣaviśeṣasya prāpāptamarthaṃ dyūtakrīḍā tena kathamīśvarasyāvāptasamastakāmatvamityāśaṅkyāhaabhimateti|yat yadeṣṭaṃ, tadā tasya siddhiravāptasamastakāmatā na punarāgāmināṃ puruṣārthānāṃ prāgeva siddhatvam, tathā ceśvarasyāpi bahusyāmityādisahkalpād yasminkāle yadiṣyate jagatsṛṣṭyādikaṃ mokṣapradānādikaṃ tasminkāle tasyasiddhirevāvāptasamastakāmatvam, ato'vāptasamastakāmatvaṃ līlāyogaśca viruddhamiti bhrāntipralapitametat||
atra kaściccodayativiśvaṃ duḥkhaikatānaṃ viṣamamapi sṛjata īśvarasyāsamañjasavṛtiḥ syāditi| tadidamāhaviśvamiti| atra viṣayatavamekasya sukhitvamaparasya duḥkhitvamityādikam| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥviśvaṃ duḥkhaikatānaṃ viṣayapi sadā nirmimāṇasyeśvarasya līlā asamañjakramataḥ sañjāyeta asamañajo nāma kaścidayathākarmakārī suprasiddhaḥ purāṇeṣu, tasya vṛttāntakramāt saṃjāyeta| tata īśavarasya nirdayatvādidoṣo bhavete | imamarthaṃ pratikṣipatimaivamiti| tameva pratikṣepaprakāraṃ vivṛṇoti bījīṅkureti | ayamarthaḥanādirayaṃ karmāvidyādicakrapravāhaḥ pratipuruṣaṃ pravartate| sa ca vicitraḥ| tasya ca pravāhasya teṣuteṣu kāleṣu vipāko bhavati| vipākaśca phalapradānābhimukhyam| tacca bahuprakāram| imañcārthaṃ sarvepi saiddhāntikā na pratikṣipati hi| anyathā sarveṣāmapi vādināṃ siddhāntaprakriyayā tattatkarmacāritvaniyamāyogaprasaṅgāt| teneśvaraḥ prācīnakarmānurūpaṃ sarvaṃ sṛjatīti sāmānyametadīśvarakartṛtvam| athāpi tattatkarmānurūpaṃ vaiṣamyamapi na hīyataiti| karuṇāsāmyayoraprahāṇāditiayamarthaḥ| īśaavareṇa viśvakāryakaraṇasya ca tatra ca prācīnakarmānurūpavaiṣamyasya cāparityāgāditi| īśvaro hyanādisvasaṅkalpasiddhe puṇyapāpādiniyamaṃ tattatkāle tadvipākaṃ ca nānyathayati| asminnarthe kiṃ pramāṇamiti cet śrutismṛtyādireva| anyathā pitṛhantuḥ svargaḥ syāt dharmaśīlastu nārakī syāditi| kathaṃ tarhi pāpaśīlānāṃ caidyādīnāmapavargaprāptiriti dattottarametat prācīnakarmakramāditi| atra lokasiddhanyāyānusāreṇa
"krīḍātaḥsṛjato viśvaṃ vihanyeta kṛtārthatā|
sukhaikatānaṃ canayejjagat karuṇayā sṛjan||"
ityanumānabalambyeśvaro na sṛjatīti kaumārilacodeyamapi dattottaram||
addaṣṭamarthaṃ kalpayatāṃ vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ ddaṣṭānusāreṇa kalpanasya nyāyyatvāt mādhyamikādyuktaddaṣṭānusārābhāvalakṣaṇadoṣoddhāṭanarūpakṛtsnaikadeśavikalpādyupahatiḥ syāt, asmākaṃ punarapūrvārthapratipādakāgamāvalambenārthatattvamupapādayatāṃ ddaṣṭānusāranaiyatyābhāvāt sarvamenārthatattvaṃ samañjasamevopapādayituṃ śakyata iti sarvasāmānyānyāyamāhaddaṣṭeti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥddaṣṭānyāyena ddaṣṭaprakāreṇa viśvaprajanakaḥ cit īśvaraḥ, sa punarīśvaro'numānena kalpyate|viśvaprajanako'citparamāṇuḥ, sa punastryaṇukaparamāṇvanumānena kalpyate| tathācobhayatrāpyanumānādeva pariklṛptiḥ| tasyāṃ yatkārya tadalpajñakartṛkamiti tathā tayā vaiyākulī syāt|yadyalpajñakartṛkatvaṃ kāryatvabalātpakṣe' vartate tadānīmiśvarāsiddhiḥ, yadi tu sarvajñakartṛtvaṃ tadā viśeṣavirodha iti vaiyākulī bhavet|evaṃ saṃyogasyāpi sāvayavatvaprasaṅga iti ca prasaṅgo bhāvyaḥ|evamānumānikajatkāraṇavādipakṣe doṣamuktvā sivapakṣe doṣāmuktvā svapakṣe doṣābhāvamāhaatyanteti|atyantādṛṣṭaṃ cidaciccharīrakeśvarakāraṇatvamarthaṃ bhaṇituṃ pravṛttāt śāstrāt sarvakartuśarīśvarasya siddhau bādha pratirodhāyogyatattvajñānaparatantrā sarvadharmopapattirastyeva sarveṣāmapi nimittatvopādānatvasarvajñatvaniravayavatvādidharmāṇāmupapattirastyeva|ata āgamikeśvarabādhanaṃ naraśiraḥ pavitratvādyanumānavadanādaraṇīyameveti na bādha iti|
uktānāṃ daśānāmadhikaraṇānāṃ pūrvapakṣotthānanaprakriyāṃ viśeṣato vibhajya darśayan sāmānyatastannirākaraṇamapi darśayatisaṃkhyāsmṛtyeti|sāṅkhyasmṛtivirodhāt smṛtyadhikaraṇe, caturmakhasmṛtivirodhadyogādhikaraṇe, kāryakāraṇayorvairupyānnavilakṣaṇatvādhikaraṇe,śiṣṭāparigrahādhikaraṇe punarasmin kāraṇe brahmaṇyekārthānekatantranyāyavihatatvāt, bhoktrāpatyadhikaraṇe dehasya bhogāvinābhāvāt, ārambhaṇādhikaraṇe kāryopādānayorbhedakathanāt,itaravyapadeśādhikaraṇe svātmahitakaraṇavirodhāt, upasaṃhāradarśanādhikaraṇe sahakāryabhāvāt, kṛtsnaprasaktyadhikaraṇe kṛtsnaikadeśavikalpabādhāt, naprayojanavattvādhikaraṇe punarīśvaravyāpāranairarthakyādapyutthitaṃ vipratipadyamānaṃ purvapakṣavādinaṃ pratyavidhyat nirākarodityarthaḥ||
evaṃ kāṇḍadvayavākyavirodhamutsargāpavādanyāyena parihṛtya pūrvapakṣiṇotthāpitaṃ kalpasūtrādi vākyavirodhamiti tainaiva nyāyena pariharatitredheti| idamatra virodhābhāsopapādanaṃ "karmacodanā brāhmaṇāni" ityupakramya " brāhmaṇaśeṣo'rthavādo nindā praśaṃsā parakṛtiḥ purākalpaśca" iti caturṇāmapyarthavādānāṃ brāhmaṇaśeṣatmāha bhagavānāpastambaḥ|evamanyadapi draṣṭavyam| tathā ca kathamarthavādānāṃ vidhiśeṣatvamantareṇa brahmaṇi prāmāṇyamucyate? atrottaramāha dattottaramiti| ayamarthaḥ  arthavādānāṃ vidhiśeṣatvavacanaṃ sāmānyam| atra punarbrahmaviṣayārthavādānāṃ svātantreṇa prāmāṇyakathanaṃ tasyaivāpavādaḥ| atastenaivotsargāpavādanyāyena virodhapraśamanāt smṛtivirodhakathanamanupālabhya eva| tamevotsargāpavādanyāyamajānānasya śiṣyasya viśeṣataḥ prakaṭayatisāmānyeti| imamevārthaṃ tadvākyasthenaiva dṛṣṭāntenopapādayati tata iti| tasminneva hyāpastambavākye mantravidhyoḥ parasparamanyatvaṃ hyupari kathyate " tato 'nye mantrāḥ" iti| "tataḥ" vidhyarthavādābhyāṃ "anye mantrāḥ" iti| etattu sāmānyameva mantrāṇāmapi vidhāyakatvasvīkārāt|mantro hi vidhatta iti hyāhustāntrikāḥ| tena mantrāṇāṃ vidhyanyatvavacanam utsargaḥ, vidhāyakatvavacanamapavāda iti bhavadbhiḥ parigṛhyate|tadvadatrāpi brāhmaṇaśeṣatvavacanamutsargaḥ svātantryeṇa
pratipadakatvavacanamapavāda iti parigṛhya parituṣyatu bhavān||
bahuṣu prāmāṇyahetuṣu vidyāmāneṣu dūṣaṇamupaniṣadvākyānāṃ virīśvaramīmāṃsakānāṃ sāhasameva tadvyahāranibandhanamiti pratipādayan sarvanigamamārgāpalāpapratibandīmāracayati āmnātairiti|vede "kārīryā vṛṣṭikāmo yajeta " iti dṛṣṭaphavākyānusāreṇa " svargakāmo yajeta" ityadṛṣṭaphalavākyānāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ parikalpyate| aviguṇasaphalairiti karmakartṛsādhanavaiguṇyādeva kvacitkārīryādiṣu phalāsiddhirityarthaḥ| śākunacyotiṣādyairiti yathāhi aviguṇasaphalairvedoktaiḥ kārīryādibhiḥ phalasiddhiḥ tathaivāviguṇasaphalaiḥ kunajyotiṣādyairvedoktairapi phalasiddhirvarṇyata eva| tena vede prāmāṇyaṃ dṛṣṭaphaleṣu kvacitpratīyate| tathā śiṣṭānāmadṛṣṭārthapravṛttyā 'pi vedaprāmāṇyaṃ sarvatra niścīyata ityāha pāratrikyeti| atinipuṇeti mahānubhāvānāṃ paralokahetubhūtayā pravṛttyāpi vedaprāmāṇyaṃ niścīyata ityarthaḥ| anena mahājanaparigraho'bhidhīyate|
āgamāśvāsasiddhau evaṃ bahubhirhetubhirvedaprāmāṇye niścite sati| aprāmāṇyakāraṇābhāvamāha śabda iti| śabde tasmācca bodhe satītyanutpattilakṣaṇāprāmāṇayanirāsaḥ| paraviṣayeīśvaraviṣaye| doṣabādhavyapeta iti kāraṇadoṣabādhakapratyayau nirasyete| anādinidhanāvicchinnasaṃpradāyatvāt kāraṇadoṣābhāvācca alaukikārthaviṣayatvād bādhakapratyayābhāvācca prāmāṇye sata asati cāprāmāṇyakāraṇe punarasau vedaḥ parasmin brahmaṇi mānameva| evaṃ ca kāraṇamantareṇa vedāntavākyānāmaprāmāṇyakathane tenaiva nyāyena karmabhāge'pyaprāmāṇyaṃ kathanīyamiti vedamārgāpalāpa eva syādityarthaḥ||
evaṃ caturṇāmadhikaraṇānāmarthān vibhāgenābhidhāya sāmānyārthānuvādapūrvakamatratyayorjanmādyadhikaraṇasamanvayādhikaraṇayoruttarattaravakṣyamāṇābhyāṃ kāraṇatvādhikaraṇobhayaliṅdhikaraṇābhyāṃ paunaruktyamāśaṅkyottararatra tattadadhikaraṇārthaprasādhanam, atra punarvakṣyamāṇārthopajīvanena tattadarthābhidhānamiti na paunaruktyamityāha śāstretyādinā| viśeṣadvayamevam brahmādiśabdānāṃ śrīnivāsaparyavasānaṃ dvitīyādhikaraṇoktam| vedāntavedyasya brahmaṇo niratiśayānandarūpatvaṃ caturthādhikaraṇoktam| tatra pūrvaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ kāraṇatvādhikaraṇamupajīvati| uttaramubhayaliṅgādhikaraṇamiti suśobhanametat||
atra śārīrakaśāstrārambhahetubhūtacatussūtryātmakaprathamapeṭikārthaṃ sāmānyato viśeṣataśca darśayitvā tadanantaraṃ śāstrārambharūpadvitīyapeṭikārthābhidhānena tayoḥsa saṃgatimapyāha ātmanyevamiti| atra khalu caturadhukaraṇyāmātmā jñātavya ityarthaikyam, akṛta itimata ityādikarmacatuṣṭayamadhikaraṇārthavibhāgaḥ; brahmaviśeṣapratipādakatvāt sarveṣāmadhikaraṇānām| atha dvitīyapeṭikāpūrvapakṣānuvādamukhena saṃgatirapi darśayan peṭikāpravṛttiprakāramapi viśadaṃ darśayati īdṛktvamiti| pūrvapoṭikāproktamarthajātaṃ yathārhaṃ prakṛtipuruṣayoreva syāditi parakathanaṃ na tāvanumānādyayogyau duḥkhāspṛṣṭau cetyuttarābhyāṃ dvābhyāmadhikaraṇābhyāṃ krameṇa dodhavītītyarthaḥ| athavā īdṛktvamityārabhya itiśabdaparyantaṃ pūrvapakṣavākyameva| prakṛtipuruṣayoreva jagatkāraṇatvādikaṃ pramāṇāsiddhaṃ tayoranumānādyayogyatvaṃ duḥkhāspṛṣṭatvaṃ ca nāstīti pūrvādhikaraṇākṣepe uttaraṃ yogyābhiruktibhirdodhavītīti| atha samanantarapeṭikayā pādaśeṣeṇa vā| pūrvaṃ hi śāstrayonyadhikaraṇa samanvayādhikaraṇābhyāṃ vedāntavedyasyārthasyānumānādyayogyatvaṃ duḥkhāsaṃspṛṣṭatvaṃ coktam, ubhayamapi prakṛtipuruṣayoranyatarasya vedāntavedyatvāṅgīkāre na saṃbhavatīti pūrvoktāvāntarapeṭikāsaṃgatirapyatrocyate| akṛta iti prathamādhikaraṇe "nāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtena" iti viṣayavākyoktamakṛtatvaṃ pradhānārtha iti darśayati| evaṃ dvitīyādhikaraṇādiṣvapi viśvahetutvādikaṃ pradhānārthaṃ ityanukrameṇa mantavyam| tatra hi vedāntavākyānāṃ brahmaṇyayodavyavacchedapare prathamapāde prakṛtyādyanyayogavyavacchedakathanamayogavyavacchedaśeṣatvena napunaḥ prādhānyeneti samādhānāt īkṣatyadhikaraṇādīnāmasaṃgatiranāśaṅkanīyā| ayaṃ kila peṭikāvibhāgaḥ  prathamapāde śāstrārambhārthā caturadhikaraṇī tāvadekā| tatra dvayoravāntarapeṭikātvam| puṃnarīkṣatyādhikaraṇa ānandamayādhikaraṇayo rekapeṭikātvamucyate| ataḥ paraṃ pañcānāmapyadhikaraṇānāṃ prakṛtipuruṣaviśeṣatvātekapeṭikātvaṃ pratipadyate| athavā īkṣatyadhikaraṇādīni trīṇyekā peṭikā sadātmapuruṣarūpasāmānyaśrutyā samutthitasya pūrvapakṣiṇa īkṣatyādi viśeṣaliṅgena pratikṣepasya tulyatvāt| śrutiliṅgayorhi sāmānyaśrutyapekṣayā viśeṣaliṅgaṃ prabalamiti tāntrikāḥ| tataḥ paramākāśaprāṇajyotirādiviśeṣaśrutyā samutthitasya pūrvapakṣiṇo nyāyānukūlayaugikaśrutyarthāṅgīkāreṇākāśaprāṇādhikaraṇābhyāṃ tāvannirākaraṇaṃ kriyate| ākāśaprāṇaśabdayostu yaugikārthāvevāṅgīkriyete| natu rūḍhiryogamapaharati| klṛpto yogaḥ kalpyāṃrūḍhiṃ bādhata itinyāyena bādhyate| tenākāśaprāṇādhikaraṇayoḥ siddhamavāntarapeṭikātvam| jyotiradhikaraṇendraprāṇādhikaraṇayostu rūḍhibhaṅgaṃ vihāya tattadrūḍhārthaviśiṣṭaparamātmaparatvamucyata iti tayorapi peṭikāntaratvaṃ siddham| atra catuḥsūtryāṃ samyagarthāvabodhanāya prameyasaṃgrahapariśramaśālibhirbhavitavyam| avalokanīyā ca niyatamācāryakṛtā śatadūṣaṇī||
pūrvaṃ paramātmano vedāntavedyatvamuktam| idānīṃ prakṛtyādīnāṃ tadeva vedāntavedyatvaṃ na saṃbhavatītyucyate|tatrāpi sāṃkhyādiśāstroktaprakṛtipuruṣayoḥ prakṛterviśvākāreṇa pariṇatāyāḥ sarvalokaprasiddhatvāt tadapekṣayā puruṣasya sūkṣyatvāt saiva prathamaṃ nirākriyata iti saṃgatiḥ| athavā pūrvādhikaraṇe vedāntavedyasya vastunaḥ puruṣārtharūpatvamuktam, tanna ghaṭate apuruṣārtharūpāyāḥ prakṛtereva kāraṇatvāditi| evaṃ vā sarveṣāmapi vedāntavākyānāṃ prakṛtipuruṣottīrṇabrahmaparatvamuktaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇe, sarvavedāntasārabhūtā sadvidyā tāvat prakṛtimevācaṣṭe|kimanyairvākyābhāsairiti|evaṃ saṃbhāvitaṃ saṃgatyantaramapi vācyam| viṣayastu parameva brahma, purvaṃ śāstrārambha iti tato vibhāgaḥ| saṃśayaḥ punaḥ kiṃ prakṛtivilakṣaṇaṃ brahma sadvidyāvedyam, uta prakṛtiriti| saṃśayotthānakāraṇaṃ tu saditisāmānyaśrutiḥ| sarvabhāvavācakasya sacchabdasya prakṛtipuruṣeśvarasādhāraṇatvāt|
tadarthavicārastu sacchabdaḥ kiṃ paramātmaparaḥ, uta prakṛtiparaḥ| prakṛtiparatve "tadaikṣata" ityaktamīkṣaṇaṃ na ghaṭate, uta ghaṭata iti| tadarthaṃ punarvicāryateidañcekṣaṇaṃ mukhyamuta gauṇamiti| punaśca vicāryateatra gauṇekṣaṇasāhacaryaṃ nāsti utāstyeveti| tatrāpi vicāryate "tatteja aikṣata" ityādikaṃ tejaḥ prabhṛtīkṣaṇaṃ mukhymutāmukhymiti| ato'pi vicāryatekiṃ mukhyatvānurūpā hetavo 'nuroddhavyāḥ, utāmukhyatvānurūpā hetvo'pītyādi| phalaphalibhāstu amukhyatvānurupāṇāṃ bahūnāmapi yuktīnāmatra vidyamānatvāt "tatteja aikṣata" ityatrekṣeṇasya gauṇatvāt gauṇekṣā sāhacāryasya cātra vidyamānatvena sadīkṣaṇasyāpi gauṇatvāt atroktamīkṣaṇaṃ prakṛtiparatve'pi saṃghaṭata iti sāṃkhyādyuktaṃ pradhānamevātra sacchabdaḥ pratipādayatīti pūrvapakṣe| siddhānte phalaphalībhāvastu vaiparītyena| uktamarthamanukrameṇācaṣṭegauṇekṣāsāhacaryāditi| bahubhavanaprekṣaṇaṃ naiva mukhyamitiitthaṃ kila pūrvapakṣī manyate īkṣaṇaguṇayogāt prakṛtikāraṇatvaṃ nirākriyate brahmavādibhiḥ, taccekṣaṇaṃ gauṇam, kūlaṃ pipatiṣati, vṛṣṭiprītakṣatrāḥ śālaya ityādivat cetanadharmasyācetane'pi yojayituṃ śakyatvāt, atra gauṇatve nidānaṃ "tatteja aikṣata" ityādigauṇekṣaṇamāha caryameva| kiṃ ca mṛttatkāryadṛṣṭāntādevedānāṃ pariṇāmādityādisāṃkhyoktaṃ pradhānānumānameva pratibhātītyāha dṛṣṭāntādyairiti| naca śrutipratibhāvanāmātrameva, yuktiyuktamapīdamityāhatādṛśāditi| acetanarūpakāryasyācetanādeva janmayuktam| nanu savikāre pradhāne kathaṃ sacchabdaḥ syādityāśaṅkyāhasaditi|
mahadādīnāṃ vikārāṇāṃ kvācitkatvena sacchabdavācyatvaṃ mā bhūt, avikṛtirūpāyāḥ prakṛternityasiddhatvena sacchabdavācyatvaṃ bhavediti pūrvapakṣe rāddhāntamāha ayuktamiti| śrutyācetanāsādhāraṇātmaśabdādiśrutyā| prakṛtyādīnāṃ nirodhāt| na kevalaṃ śrutyā, apitu tvadabhimata prakṛtikāraṇatva tiraskārakekṣaṇādiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇairapyayamevārtha iti niścīyata ityāha tvadabhimateti||
atra sāṃkhyoktānumānikaprakriyāpratyabhijñānamāśaṅkya nirākarotijñāta iti|atraivaṃ kila pūrvapakṣī manyate ekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñā tāvat dṛśyate "yenāśrutaṃ śrutam" ityādinā|na kevalaṃ pratijñāmātraṃ, dṛṣṭāno'pyastītyāhamṛttaditi|ādiśavdāt śrutyukto nakhanikṛntanādirgṛhyate|evamanumānapradhānabhutayoḥ pratijñādṛṣṭāntayorupapādanenedaṃvākyaṃsāṃkhyoktānumānāmuvādakamevasyādityāhatyeneti|nirākarotivṛtheti|tatra hetumāhahetvanukteriti|anumānāvayaveṣvatyantapradhānabhūtahetvanukteḥ| santi sārūpyādayo hetavaḥ sāṃkhyānāmiti cet tanna; teṣāmuttaratra sāṃkhyādhikaraṇe nirākaraṇādityāha sārūpyāderiti| nanu tatracātra ca nirākaraṇe paunaruktyamityāśaṅkyāha atreti|uttaratra pradhānakāraṇatvaniścāyakahetavo niśśeṣamunmūlayiṣyate| atra pradhānakāraṇatvānumānasaṃbhāvanāmātraṃ nirākriyata iti na paunaruktyāvakāśaḥ||
evaṃ pratipakṣaprakriyāṃ nirasya svapakṣānukūlān viṣayavākyārthān hetūn saṃgṛhṇāti ādeśeti| "uta tamādeśamaprākṣyaḥ" ityupakrame tāvadādeśaśabdena sacchabdavācyaṃ brahma nirdiśyate| ādeśaśabdo 'pyādeṣṭāramevāha| ādeṣṭṛtvaṃ punarniyantṛtvameva| naca tat pradhānapakṣe saṃbhavati tasyācetanatvāt| ātmaśabdo'pyatra śrūyate "sa ātmā" satu cetanasyaivāsādharaṇaḥ| tatra suṣuptiprasaṅge "svamapīto bhavati" iti suṣuptisthānaṃ paramātmā svaśabdena nirdiśyate| antaryāmitvāt paramātmaiva svaśabdena nirdeśārhaḥ| na punaḥ pradhānam| tasya suṣuptaṃ pratyanantaryāmitvāt|
anitaraśaraṇaiḥananyathaāsiddhairityarthaḥ| ete hi śabdāḥ paramātmaviṣayatve mukhyāḥ ,pradhānaviṣayatve punarjaghanyavṛttaya ityarthaḥ| hetvantaramapyāhatvamiti|tacchabdavācyena saha tvaṃśabdasya jīvasyaikyamatra vyapadiśyate| yadi tacchabdaḥ pradhānaparaḥ, tadānīmatatvopadeśa evāyaṃ syāt; cetanācetanayoraikyopadeśasya dehātmopadeśavat bhrāntihetutvāt| atra sādhakāntaramāhajīveneti| svena  svātmakenetyarthaḥ| "anena jīvenātmanānupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi " ityuttamapuruṣasiddhāhaṅkārapūrvakamahamarthavyatiriktācidgaṇasya praveśāt,atra jīvaśarīrakaḥ paramātmā jīvadvārā jīvavyatiriktamacetanajātaṃ praviśatītyarthaḥ| tena praveṣṭavyasyācidvastunaḥ sāhaṅkaraṇamahaṅkārasahitaṃ praveṣṭṛtvaṃ na yoyujyata ityuktaṃ bhavati| kiṃ ca "yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavati" ityekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñā dṛśyate| sā punarīśvarakāraṇatva eva ghaṭate napunaḥ pradhānakāraṇatve,pradhānasya cetanaṃ pratyakāraṇatvādityāhaeketi|hetvantaramapyāhasarveti|"aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvam"iti
hi śruyate,pradhānasya kraṇatve kathaṃ tattādātmyaṃ sarvaśabdāntargasya jīvasya vaktuṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ|na kevalaṃ chāndogyaśrapatyaiva brahmakāraṇatvaṃ pratīyate,apitu śrutyantareṇāpi|chāndogye'pi na kekalaṃ sadvidyāvākyena,kiṃ tu daharavdyābhumavidyāderepi|atra ādiśabdena upabṛṃhaṇasmṛtipurāṇādikaṃ gṛhyate|atra viśvaviditi namittatvopayuktaṃ sārvajñyaṃ gṛhyate|viśvamurtirityupādānatvopayuktaṃ sarvaśarīratvaṃ gṛhyata iti vibhāgaḥ|atra pupakṣasiddhāntopanyāsapraṃkiyāvibhāgaḥ śrīmatibhāṣye nyāyasudarśanādau ca draṣṭavyaḥ|atra copakramopasaṃhāramahāvākyopapattiḥ śrutyantaravidyāntarādiprākāśanaparānāṃ sutrāṇāmanukramo'pi tatraivānusandheyaḥ||
pūrvottarādhikaraṇayossaṃgatidvayoktipūrvakamuttarādhikaraṇārthaṃ saṃgraheṇopadarśayatimukhyeti| yadi sato mukhyamīkṣaṇamiṣṭam, tarhi cetanatvāt mukhyekṣaṇārho jīva eva jagatkāraṇamastviti pūrvapakṣotthānādekā saṃgatiḥ|anyā ca sadvidyāvākye tattvamasīti tribhiḥ padairjīvabrahmaṇoraikyameva navakṛtvaḥ pradarśitam, tathā ca jīva eva jagatkāraṇaṃ brahāstviti pūrvapakṣotthānamiti| ityūhādujjihānaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇaṃ nirākartuṃ pūrvaprastuto viśvakartā jīvasyāpyantarātamā nirupadhikamahānandavān atrādhikaraṇe sthāpyate| tadarthavicārastu "brahmavidāpnoti param" ityasminvākye yaḥ punarānandamaya ucyate sa kiṃ jīva uta paramātmā| punarvicāryate atra mayaḍ vikārārthaḥ prācuryārtho vā| tadarthaṃ vicāryate upakramagatānnamayaśabdasthamayaṭo vikārārthatvānusāreṇa atrāpi mayaṭo vikārārthatvameva yuktam, uta prācuryārthatvam| punaśca vicāryate upakramāvagatasya madhye prāṇamayamanomayādibhirvicchedo'sti navetyādi| phalaphalibhāvastu tatrāvicchedādupakramāvagatavikārārthatvasyaivātrāpi grahītuṃ yogyatvenānandamayaśabdasthamayaṭo vikārārthatvādānandamayo jīva iti pūrvapakṣe| vyatyayena rāddhānte phalaphalibhāvaḥ||
atra kaścidāha "ātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ" ityādinā sṛṣṭerevābhidhānāt pūrvaṃ "sa vā eṣa puruṣo'nnarasamayaḥ" ityatra vikāre mayaḍ dṛśyata iti carame'pi "anyo 'ntara ātmā''nandamayaḥ" ityatrāpi evamastu mayaṭo vikārārthatvamevāstu pūrvoktasya mayaṭo vikārārthapratyabhijñānāditi, tadidamāhadṛṣṭa iti| tannirākarotiayuktamiti| tatra hetumāha madhya iti| prāṇamayādiṣu vikārārthatvabhaṅgadṛṣṭerityarthaḥ| phalitamāha pracuramiti| vikārārthatve ko doṣa ityāśaṅkyāha anyasyeti| ānandamayādatiriktasya vastuno bādhena vikārārthatvasya bādhitatvādityarthaḥ| nanvatrānanda prācuryābhidhāne duḥkhālpatvameva syāt yathā brāhmaṇapracuro deśa ityukte śūdrālpatvaṃ pratīyata iti, tatpratikṣipatiānandeti| atrānandaprācurī manuṣyānandamārabhya caturmukhānandaparyantatayā prakṛtaparasukhālpatvalabdhāvadhitvāt ānandamayaniṣñaduḥkhālpatvaṃ nāpekṣate, api tu caturmukhādiniṣṭhānandaprācuryanivṛttimeva| yathā "annamayo yajñaḥ" ityādi| nanvānandaprācurī duḥkhālpatvenāpi nirvaktuṃ śakyata ityāśaṅkya netyāhapareti| paraduritabhit saṃśritānāṃ duritaṃ bhinatti "ānandamayaḥ" iti hi śrūyate| "atha so'bhayaṃ gato bhavati" "etaṃ ha vāva na tapati" " na karmaṇā lipyate pāpakena " ityādikaṃ vākyajātaṃ śataśohyadhīmahi| tasmādatra duḥkhālpatvaśaṅkā na saṃghaṭata iti| kiṃ ca "bhīṣāsmādvātaḥ pavate" "tasya havā etasya praśāsane gārgi" "praśāsitāraṃ sarveṣām" ityādibhiḥ praśāsitṛtvena pratipannasyānandamayasya pāpālpatvavirodha ityāha śāsituriti||
nanvasmatpakṣe bhavadbhirānandamayatvalakṣaṇaṃ liṅgaṃ viruddhamiti hyuktam| asmākameka evāyaṃ virodhaḥ, bhavatāṃ bahavo virodhāḥ| ānandamaye'pi "tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā yaḥ pūrvasya "ityātmāntara kathanaṃ virudhyate| śārīratvakathanamapi śarīrasya karmaphalatvānna yujyate| na ca ghaṭate śodhyatvavādaḥ parasminbrahmaṇi aśuddhiprasaṅgābhāvāt| śrūyate hyānandamaye'pi "annamayaprāṇamanomayamanomayavijñānamayānandamayā me śudhyantām"iti śodhyatvavādaḥ|kiṃ ca tasminnevānandamaye phalanirdeśadaśāyāmupasaṃkramitavyatvamucyatetadapi viruddham|paramātmani nityameva vartamānasya jīvasya kathamapūrvamupasaṃkramaṇamiti|evaṃ caturo'pi virodhānanudya caturbhirapi pādairaṇukrameṇa samādhatteātmeti|iyaṃ kila samādhānaprakriyā "tasaiva....ātmā"ityuktirānandamaye"svayaṃ dāsāstasvinaḥ"itivadātmāntaranivṛtyartheti ko virodhaḥ?śārīratvakathanamapi bhagavataḥ sarvaśarīrakatvādānandamaya eva viśeṣeṇopapadyate|śodhyatvamapi"viśuddhameva rājahṛdayam"ityādivadānandamayasya prasādyatvameva| na punaḥ pūrvaśumaddhasya kaścit śuddhiviśeṣaḥ|loke'pi rājahṛdayaṃ viśuddhamityādau nigrahanivṛttirevocyate;anuguṇasyaivārthasya tatratatra svīkāryatvāt |ākāṅakkṣāsannidhānavadyogyatvasyāpi vākyārthanirṇayāṅgatvāt|atropasaṃkramaṇameva hi śiṣyate,tadap saṃghaṭate;prāptireva hyupasaṃkramaṇamucyate|prāptiśca pūrvamananubhūtasya brahmaṇaḥ paścādanubhavasaṃbhavaḥ| etadevābhidhīyate " so'śnute sarvān kāmān saha " iti| athavā deśaviśeṣaprāptireva hyasmābhirvaktuṃ śakyata iti| tadeva hyucyate "vaikuṇṭhe tu pare loke " iti| ato'smatpakṣe na virodhāvakāśaḥ| atra padārthatvaṃ svayameva bhāvyam||
atra pucchabrahmavādī pratyavatiṣṭhate nirdeha iti| ānandamayasyaiva brahmatve tasya niraṃśatvāt " tasya priyameva śiraḥ" ityādinā śiraḥpakṣādibhedena pañcaprakārāvayavaklṛptirna ghaṭate| tasmāt pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā " ityuktaṃ sarvabhūtādhiṣṭhānatayā viśvapratiṣṭhārūpaṃ pucchameva paraṃ brahma, ānandamayasya brahmatve śiraḥpakṣādi klṛptīnāmayogyatvāditi| imaṃ pakṣaṃ pritabandyā dūṣayitumupakramate soḍheti|deśakālaparicchedarahitatayā bhavadbhiraṅgīkṛtasya saccidānandarūpasya brahmaṇaḥ pucchatvakathanaṃ kathaṃ yujyate| śrutiprāmāṇyasiddhyarthamasmābhiḥ pucchatvakalpanaṃ soḍhavyamiti cet hanta tarhyasmābhirapi ānandamaye niraṃśe priyamodāditattadvibhāgavivakṣayā śiraḥ pakṣādikalpanaṃ soḍhavyamiti saṃtoṣṭavyamāyuṣmatetyāha kathamiti| itaratśiraḥpakṣādikamityarthaḥ| tarhyatyantaviruddhametat, yadānandamayasya brahmaṇa eva svapratiṣṭhārūpatvamiti| tacca na vidyate| svasyaiva svapratiṣṭhānatvavacanamanitarādhāratākhyāpanāya " sa bhagavaḥ kasminpratiṣṭhitaḥ sve mahimni " iti śrutyantaraprakāreṇa sarvapratiṣṭhārūpasya brahmaṇaḥ pratiṣṭhāntaranivṛttireva hyatrocyata iti ko virodhaḥ| atra pucchabrahmavādināṃ bahūnyapi dūṣaṇāni bhāṣya eva vyaktamuktānīti ślokārthameva pradarśya viramāmaḥ||
īkṣatyadhikaraṇaviṣayavākye " tasya tāvadeva ciram " iti śarīrapātaparyanto duḥkhasaṃbandha ucyate| tena "tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā "iti śarīrasaṃbandhī puruṣo jīva eva syādityāśaṅkya parihṛtamāndamayādhikaraṇe karmādhīnakaraṇakalebaraparigrahasyaiva saṃsārātmakatvam, napunaḥ svābhāvikasyaiva viśvaśarīrasyeti| ataḥ paramantarādityādhikaraṇaṃ pravartate asminnadhikaraṇe na kevalamantaryāmitvāvasthānamātreṇa śarīrātmabhāva ucyate, apitu pāṇipādākṣikeśādivibhāgavaccharīrasaṃbandhī puruṣaḥ, tādṛśaśarīrasaṃbandhitvaṃ jīvasyaiva saṃbhavatīti pūrvapakṣotthānena saṃgatiḥ| pūrvaṃ jīvasāmānyasya nirāsaḥ, idānīṃ jīvaviśeṣasya nirāsa iti ca saṃgatiḥ| tadidamāha bhūyiṣṭheti|
pūrvoktāḥ khalu manuṣyānārabhya prajāpatiparyantā bhūyiṣṭhānantapuṇyopacayabalasamudbuddhaiśvaryāḥ kecitpuruṣāḥ, teṣveva kaścidīśvaraḥ pravāharūpeṇa vartata iti kalpyamiti ca pūrvādhikaraṇasaṃgatyantaramucyate| ayamarthaḥ  pāpottarāḥ puṇyapāpayostulyavṛttayaśca mā bhūvan, api tu puṇyottarāḥ kecidīśvaratvena prakalpyeranniti| atrottaram tanneti| tatra hetūnpramāṇānusāreṇa saṃgṛhṇāti  akarmeti| akarmādhīnadivyaśarīravān| janiḥ janma| mahimā māhātmyam | sarvapuṃsāṃ svābhāvikaniyantā| nityaśrīḥ nityameva lakṣmīsaṃbandhavān| evaṃbhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ, bradhnabimbe  sūryamaṇḍale, śruta iti, " sa ya eṣo'ntarhṛdaya ākāśaḥ " ityanuvākaśrutaḥ paramapuruṣaḥ eka eva "eṣo'ntarāditye " ityantarādityavidyāyāṃ śrūyata iti na jīvaviśeṣaśaṅkāvakāśaḥ| "eṣa sarvebhyaḥ pāpmabhyaḥ uditaḥ udeti havai sarvebhyaḥ pāpmabhyo ya evaṃ veda " ityatraiva hi śrūyate| " samastāḥ śaktayaścaitā nṛpa yatra pratiṣṭhitāḥ " ityādikamatra bhāvyam| "na sā karmanimittajā " iti hi tatrocyate| aitihāsikamapi "vyaktameṣa mahāyogī " ityādikaṃ suprasiddhameva| atroktaṃ śāsitṛtvaṃ hi " antaḥ praviṣṭaṛ śāstā janānāṃ sarvātmā " " praśaāsitāraṃ sarveṣām" ityādi bahupramāṇasiddhatvāt sarvaviṣayamevānusandhātavyam| ayamatrasaṃgrahaḥ  sūryamaṇḍalāntarvartino bhagavadvigrahasyākarmādhīnatvādaprākṛtatvādāśritānugrahārthatvācca vigrahasaṃbandhamātreṇa jīvaviśeṣatvāśaṅkāvacanaṃ paramapuruṣavidveṣiṇāṃ pāpiṣṭhānāṃ pralāpaḥ| atra tadarthavicāro'pi kiṃdidālikhyate| āditamaṇḍalāntarvartī puruṣaḥ kiṃ jīvaviśeṣaḥ uta paramātmeti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate  kiṃ pāṇipādādivibhāgavacchaśarīrādisaṃbandho jīvatvaṃ prasādhayati na veti| tadarthaṃ punarvicāryate  kimayaṃ śarīrasaṃbandhaḥ karmādhīnaḥ, utākarmādhīna iti| punarapi vicāryate  sarvapāpmoditatvādivacanaṃ kiṃ karmādhīnatvaṃ nivārayati uta neti| tadarthamapi punarvicāryate  tatra pāpmaśabdaḥ kiṃ pāpamātraparaḥ, uta puṇyapāpātmakakarmamātrapara iti| phalaphalibhāvastu pāpmaśabdasya pāpamātraparatvena sarvapāpmoditatvādivacanasya karmādhīnatvanivārakatvābhāvāt śarīrasaṃbandhasya karmādhīnatayā niyamena jīvakarmādhīnatvādityamaṇlāntarvartī puruṣo jīva iti| rāddhānte phalaphalibhāvo'ntevāsibhiḥ svayamevohyaḥ||
atra cedakaḥ prāha  antarādityavidyāyāṃ " sarvebhyaḥ pāpmabhyaḥ uditaḥ " iti bhagavataḥ sarvapāparahitatvamucyate, viśeṣaniṣedhe śeṣābhyanujñānamiti tāntrikāṇāṃ prakriyā, tathā cādityamaṇḍalāntarvartini puruṣe pāpaniṣedhāt puṇyābhyanujñānamastīti| tadidamāha sarvebhya ityādinā| tannirākaroti maivamiti| atra hetūnāha āmnāta ityādinā| "na tasyeśe kaścana " ityādibhirbahubhiḥ pramāṇairbhagavato'nanyaśāsyatvaṃ pratīyate, anyaśāsyo hi rājakiṃkaraḥ śāsanātisaṅghanāt pratyavāyamupeyāt, tadanupālanādanukūlaṃ phalam| īśvarasyānanyaśāsyatvād duritavat paraśāsanānuvartanarūpaṃ sukṛtamapi na saṃbhavatītyayameko hetuḥ| hetvantaramāha svavaśeti| "phalamata upapatteḥ" iti nyāyena pareṣāmiṣṭamaniṣṭaṃ vā phalaṃ bhagavāneva dadātītyucyate tasya kathaṃ sukṛtasaṃbandhaḥ saṃbhavatīti| kiṃ ca " sa na sādhunā karmaṇā bhūyānno evāsādhunā kanīyān " iti hyarthāt sukṛtasaṃbandhaḥ pratikṣipyate, tacca viruddhaṃ tava| tarhi pāpmaśabdaḥ puṇye kathaṃ prayujyate? ityatrāha  syāditi| puṇye'pi pāpalakṣaṇayogādiha pāpmaśabdaḥ prayujyate| asti hi puṇye'pi pāpalakṣaṇayogaḥ, aniṣṭaphalasaṃbandhitvāt | loke hi kasyacidiṣṭaṃ phalamanyasyāniṣṭaṃ bhavati|tathā ca svargādikamiṣṭaṃ phalamadhyātmavidāmaniṣṭamityadhikāriviśeṣāpekṣayā pāpameva kāmyaṃ karma| atra śrautaprayogarūpaṃ prabalavyavasthāpakamāha na sukṛtamityādineti| atra hi sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtamubhayamapi nirdiśya dvayorapi pāpmaśabdena nirdeśaḥ spaṣṭameva kriyate| tasmāt duritavat sukṛtasyāpi pāpmaśabdavācyatvāt sarvapāpmoditavacanaṃ sukṛmanivṛttimapyāheti siddham||
atra punaścodayati parasya brahmaṇo vigraho'stīti bhavadbhiruktam, sa vigrahaḥ kiṃ pārakṛtaḥ, utāprākṛtaḥ, aprākṛtatvepi kiṃ bhagavatsvarūpameva uta tattvāntaram| pūrvatrāsmaduktaṃ saṃsāritvamevāpadyata iti ghaṭṭakuṭīnyāyaḥ, dvitīye pakṣe svarūpapariṇāmaprasaṅgaḥ, tṛtīyo'pi pakṣo na ghaṭate, prakṛtipuruṣeśvarakālavyatiriktatattvāntarābhāvāt, ataḥ kathaṃ taditi| etannirākaroti prakhyātamiti| prakhyātam  "pādo'syaviśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi "
" vaikuṇṭhe tu pare loke " " tamasaḥ paramo dhātā " " svasattābhāsakaṃ sattvam " ityādibhiḥ | śuddhasattvam  rajastamorahitasattvāśrayabhūtam| divyaṃ kimapi dravyaṃ tat| anaghatvaṃ saṃsārapravartanopakāraṇatvābhāvāducyate| tasyāvyaktato'nyatvaṃ " tripādsyāmṛtaṃ divi" iti vyaktamevābhidhīyate| anena bhagavato rūpaṃ prākṛtaṃ svarūpaṃ ca na bhavati apitu aprākṛtaṃ dravyāntaramityāha  tadrūpamiti| " tadviśvarūpavairūpyaṃ rūpamanyaddharermahat" iti bhagavān parāśaraḥ prāha| vairupyaṃ virūpamityarthaḥ| tena vipratipannaṃ rūpaṃ prākṛtaṃ rūpatvāt tadanityaṃ sāvayavatvādityādayaḥ pareṣāṃ hetavo nirastāḥ| tādṛgvidharūpasiddhau dharmigrāhakapramāṇavirodhaḥ| aprākṛtānityatvādiviśeṣaṇayogenaiva pramāṇasiddhatvāt| asiddhau cāśrayāsiddheriti svakīyāṃ prakriyāṃ svayameva smaratu haitukaḥ| nanvastu bhagavatastādṛśaṃ rūpam, anantagaruḍādīnāṃ kā gatiriti cet bhagavāneva gatiḥ| " tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam" " āste viṣṇuracintyātmā bhaktairbhāgavataiḥ saha " ityādipramāṇaśatavyāhatatvāt śaṅkāpiśācikāyāḥ| astu vaikuṇṭhavāsinastādṛśaṃ rūpam, athāpi tasya nityatvādau niścāyakaṃ kimityāśaṅkya śrutipurāṇādītyabhiprāyeṇāha nityamiti| "sadā paśyanti" " nityaṃ nityākṛtidharam " " nityasiddhe tadākāre tatparatve ca pauṣkara " " śrīvatsavakṣā nityaśrīḥ " ityādipramāṇasahasramanusandheyam| astu sarvaṃ guṇajātaṃ vaikuṇṭhavāsino bhagavataḥ, rāmakṛṣṇādayastu prākṛtāḥ karmavaśena sukhaduḥkhādibhājaśca, kathaṃ teṣāmārādhanenāsmākamāpavargikī siddhirityāśaṅkya parāśarapārāśaryādimatānusāreṇa aprākṛtatvādikaṃ guṇajātamāha ajahadityādinā granthaśeṣeṇa| " samastaśakti" ityādi parāśaravacanam| "na bhūtasaṅghasaṃsthāno deho'sya paramātmanaḥ " iti pārāśaryavacanamapyanusandheyam| " vyaktameṣa mahāyogī paramātmā sanātana " iti valmīkasaṃbhavo'pyāha| tenāvatāreṣu śokamohādyanukaraṇaṃ naṭānāṃ nāṭakeṣviva parihāsarūpameveti mantavyam| paravyūhādivibhāgaḥ pañcarātrādiṣu spaṣṭamevānusandheyaḥ||
uktamevārthaṃ pūrvapakṣānuvādapūrvakaṃ pratibandyā sthirīkurvan duḥkhitvādi naṭanaphalamapi pradarśayati  dehatvāditi | ihaivaṃ pratibandī  yadi śāstraikavedyārthe bādhaḥ kvacidiṣyate  tarhi agnīṣomīyahiṃsādāvapi bādhaḥ syāditi| atra śrutisiddhatvānna bādha iti pratibandīmocane bandīmocanamapi tathaiva syāditi| bhagavadvigrahāderapi śrutisiddhatvāt duḥkhamiśratvādivacanamāsuropaplavārthamityuktam| āsurāḥ  kaṃsādayaḥ| kṛṣṇādīnāṃ bālyādinaṭanaṃ paramārtha eveti matvā punaḥ punaḥ prātikūlye pravarteran tatpravṛttyaiva vidhvaṃseranniti| "vināśāya ca duṣkṛtām" ityuktaduṣkṛdvināśaphalaṃ bālyādinaṭanamityarthaḥ||
atroktānāmadhikaraṇānāmarthaikyādekapeṭikātvamadhyāyaparisamāptiparyantamāgāmināmadhikaraṇānāmarthaviśeṣābhāvānnairarthakyamāśaṅkyamānasya pūrvapakṣavādinaḥ prakārabhedena prayojanavattvamupapādayan sarvādhikaraṇasādhāraṇaṃ bhagavadguṇaviśeṣānusandhānarūpaṃ pradhānaṃ prayojanaṃ prakaṭamevācaṣṭe  itthamiti| vidyātrayeṇa sadvidyādyadhikaraṇatrayoktena sthāvarajaṅgamātmakacetanācetanātmakasya sarvakāraṇasya bhagavataḥ pradhānājjīvavargāccādityāderapyādhikyaṃ yadyapi syāt | tathāpi " aspaṣṭataramaspaṣṭaṃ spaṣṭaṃ chāyānusārī ca " ityuktakrameṇotthānadvārabhedāt krameṇotthitān mṛdūpakramakrūraniṣṭhān prativādino 'sminnadhyāye nirundhan san śiṣṭairadhikaraṇairbhagavadguṇānapi viśeṣataḥ prakāśayatītiśabdārthaḥ| ayamatrabhāvaḥ  yathā yuddheṣu padātyaśvagajarathānāṃ pūrvapūrvadurbalānāṃ durbalabhaṅge prabalayodhanam, evamaspaṣṭatarajīvaliṅgānāṃ pūrvapūrvabhaṅge punaruttarottaraparigraheṇa pūrvapakṣaḥ pravartate| tatpravṛttikuṇṭhanamantareṇa jātamapi tattvajñānaṃ na pratitiṣṭhatīti| tenādhyāyaśeṣo'pyārambhaṇīya eva| kiṃ ca sarveṣvapyadhikaraṇeṣu tattadadhikaraṇapratiniyatā bhagavadguṇā viśeṣataḥ prakāśante, teṣāṃ guṇānāṃ kārtsnyenānusandhānamadhyāyaśeṣaprayojanamityāsmāko mārgaḥ| nirviśeṣāvādināṃ tu ekenaivādhikaraṇena nirviśeṣaṃ pratipannamiti pratipādyaguṇaviśeṣābhāvāduttareṣāmadhikaraṇānāṃ naiṣphalyameveti hṛdayam||
evaṃ pūrvapeṭikayā sahādhyāyaśeṣasya saṃgatimuktvā pādaśeṣasya saṃgatiṃ vaktuṃ pūrvottarapeṭikayoḥ svarūpamapi viśeṣataḥ prakāśayati śabdairiti| " athāto brahmajijñāsā " iti śārīrakaśāstrādyapeṭikāyāṃ brahma jijñāsyamityuktam| tat brahmasadātmāpuruṣarūpasādhāraṇaśabdapratipannaṃ brahma kiṃ prakṛtiḥ kiṃ vā jīvaḥ athavā upacitapuṇyaviśeṣaḥ kaścijjīvaviśeṣaḥ, pāpmaśabdasya sādhāraṇatvena puṇyāpuṇyarūpapāpmoditatve'pi kiṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ, anyo vā kaściccaturmukhavirūpākṣādirityāśaṅkya puṇḍarīkākṣa eveti nirdhāritaṃ pūrvapeṭikāyām| tatretaravyāvartakaliṅgānyāha saṃkalpeti| saṃkalpāt pradhānavyāvṛttiḥ| ānandābhyāsājjīvasāmānyaṃ vyāvartyate| aprākṛtarūpaviśeṣādupacitapuṇyaviśeṣo jīvo'pi | tatrāpi puṇḍarīkākṣatvaśravaṇāt caturmukhādirapīti hārdo bhāvaḥ|
atadananuguṇaiḥ  ananyathāsiddhairityarthaḥ| atra pūrvapakṣī pratyavatiṣṭhate pūrvādhikaraṇatraye liṅgaireva sāmānyaśrutibādhena pradhānādivyāvṛttirbhavadbhirabhihitā| liṅgād viśeṣaśrutirbalīyasī| sā hi rūḍhiśaktyā vartate| tenākāśaprāṇajyotirindriyādiviśeṣaśrutyā liṅgāni bādhitvā prasiddhākāśādikameva jijñāsyabrahmatvena svīkāryamiti| tena pādaśeṣātmakapeṭikāsaṃgatyamuktaṃ bhavati| tadetadāha bhūteti| ākāśo dvividhaḥ  " yadeva ākāśa ānando na syāt " ityadhyātmavitasammataekaḥ, pāmaraparīkṣakāviśeṣeṇa sarvalokaprasiddho bhūtākāśo'paraḥ| tena prasiddhyatiśayānusāreṇa bhūtākāśaevātra grāhyaḥ| evaṃ prāṇādāvapi draṣṭavyam| evamākāśādīnāṃ viśeṣaśrutyā pūrvādhikaraṇatrayoktaṃ liṅgaṃ bādhitvā pūrvapakṣyabhiprāyeṇa nirasya siddhāntī punarākāśādiviśeṣasamudāyāsaṃbhava pratipādanena tadeva brahmapratipādakaṃ liṅgaṃ pradhānādivyāvartakaṃ bhunakti rakṣatītyarthaḥ| " bhujo'navane " iti rakṣaṇavyatiriktārthavivakṣāyāmātmanepadavidhānāt| ayamāśayaḥ  rūḍhiryogamapaharatīti siddhameva, athāpi pramāṇapariklṛpto yogo rūḍhimeva bādhata iti nyāyavidāṃ nirṇayaḥ| atra ca " sarvāṇi ha vā imāni" iti prasiddhavannirdeśo dṛśyate| havā iti prasiddhaipratipādakāvyayadarśanāt| prasiddhiśca kāraṇavākyeṣu |
teṣu ca chāgapaśunyāyādinā nārāyaṇaparatvaṃ siddhameva| ato nārāyaṇapratyabhijñāpakaprasiddhavannirdeśayuktānanyathāsiddhavākyastha sarvakāraṇatvaliṅgapariklṛpto yoga ākāśaśabdasya rūḍhiṃ bādhata iti yuktameva| śeṣaṃ bhāṣye||
ataḥ paramuttareṣāṃ caturṇāmadhikaraṇānāṃ yugadvayena bhedamanyonyasaṃgatamapyāha ākāśeti| ākāśaprāṇaśabdāvanitaragatikau prasiddhākāśaprāṇapratipādanānārhau parasminbrahmaṇi rūḍhiṃ hitvā yogaśaktyaiva pratipādanīyau| tena dvayoradhikaraṇayorekapeṭikātvasiddhiḥ| tathottarādhikaraṇayorūḍhibhaṅgamantareṇa rūḍhārthaviśiṣṭabrahmaparatvādekapeṭikātvaṃ siddham| tatra jyotiśśabdasya tāvadrūḍhārthaviśiṣṭaparatvaṃ darśayati  jyotiriti| "na tatra sūryo bhāti " "nacodeti nāstameti " " yadādityagataṃ tejaḥ " ityādikaṃ hi pramāṇajātamupalabhyate| evamindriyādiśabdo'pi indrādiviśiṣṭaparamātmaparatayā rūḍhyabhaṅgena viśeṣaṇamātrārthavasānamāśritya netavyaḥ| tathācārthabhedāt peṭikādvayasiddhiriti nigamayati ityevamiti| ekatra yaugikaśaktiranyatra viśeṣaṇamātrāparyavasitā rūḍhiśaktiriti śabdapravṛttikramaḥ||
pūrvaṃ " ya eṣo'ntarāditye hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣaḥ " ityādityāntarvartinaḥ kasyacit puruṣasya viśeṣaliṅgāt vedāntavedyatvamuktam| idānīṃ tadabhāvādākāśasya viśeṣaśrutyā vedāntavedyatvamāśaṅkya parihriyata iti saṃgatiḥ|
prasiddhākāśabrahmaṇorākāśaśabdayogasādhāraṇyaṃ saṃśayabījamityādi svayameva bhāvyam| tadarthavicārastu " sarvāṇi havā imāni bhūtāni " ityādicchāndogyavākyasthākāśaśabdaḥ kiṃ prasiddhākāśapara uta paramātmapara iti; tadarthaṃ vicāryate  kimayamākāśaśabdo rūḍhiśaktyā vartate uta neti, tadarthamapi vicāryate kiṃ rūḍhiryogamapaharatītinyāyāpavādakaṃ nyāyāntaraṃ na vidyate, uta vidyata iti| punaśca vicāryate  prasiddhavannirdeyuktamatratyakāraṇatvādikaṃ cetanamātraviṣayamuta cetanācetanāviṣayamityādi|| phalaphalibhāvastapa " imāni bhūtāni" iti prasiddhārthaviṣayakāraṇatvānuvādasyācetanamātraviṣayatvena yogaśaktikalpakanyāyāntarābhāvāt ākāśaśabdo rūḍhyaiva vartata ityayaṃ śabdaḥ prasiddhākāśaparaḥ| siddhānte'pi svayameva vācyaḥ| atra pūrvapakṣavādī manyate  chāndogye hyākāśaśabdaḥ sarvotpattivilayakāraṇavācakatayā dṛśyate, sa cākāśastaittirīye'nanyotpādyatayā kathyate " ātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ " iti, tasyānanyotpādyatvaṃ sarvakāraṇatvena nityatvādeva yujyate iti| tadidamāha  atretyādinā| tannirākaroti  maivamiti| tatra hetumāha siddheti|" havai" iti prasiddhavannirdeśayuktasyāsya vākyasya siddhānuvādaviṣayatvāt pūrvaprasiddhiravaśyāpekṣaṇīyā| prasiddhiśca kāraṇavākyeṣu, tāni ca nārāyaṇaviṣayāṇīti prāgevoktam| tasmādākāśaśabdo na prasiddhākāśapara ityarthaḥ| kiṃ ca " ākāśaḥ parāyaṇam" iti ākāśasya paramaprāpyatvamatraiva śrūyate| nahyacetanaṃ kiṃcit paramaprāpyamityātmavido vadanti| tadidamāha atheti| tasminnākāśe paramaprāpyatvaṃ na saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ | dūṣaṇāntaramāha taditi| " tadaikṣata, tatteja aikṣata, tā āpa aikṣanta " ityādiṣu tattakartā vipaścittvenaiva hi śrutaḥ| tathācākāśasya vividhadarśanaṃ na saṃbhavati| athavā tatkartetiākāśakarteti| brahmavallyāṃ vipaścitā brahmaṇeti jagatkāraṇaṃ vastu vipaścittvenaiva hi śrūyate| vividhaṃ paśyaccittvaṃ hi vipaścittvamiti vyācakhyuḥ| tenātmaśabdaḥ paramātmavācakaḥ| yattūktamātmana ākāśa iti svātmana ākāśotpattirabhidhīyata iti, tatra mukhyārthasvīkāre bādhaḥ, amukhyārthasvīkāre sa eva doṣaḥ| tasmādātmanaḥ paramātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūta ityayamevārtha ityabhiprāyeṇāha vihateti||
atraivaṃ pūrvapakṣavādī manyate prasiddhākāśe jagadutpatterapratyakṣatvāt ākāśaśabde rūḍhibhaṅgo nyāyyaḥ, iha tu prāṇe sarveṣāmapi puruṣāṇāṃ prāṇāyattapravṛttikatvasyopalambhādasmākamanukūlaliṅgaṃ yat tadeva yuṣmākaṃ prātikūlaliṅgam, tenānukūlaliṅgasaghrīcī prāṇarūḍhiśaktirabhañjanīyeti| tadidamāha prāṇāyattamiti| tannirākaroti  tanneti | tatra hetumāha prāṇasyeti| " sarvāṇi havai " iti cetanācetanavibhāgābhāvena kṛtsnasyāpi prapañcasya prāṇāyattapravṛttikatvamucyate| acetaneṣveva keṣucicchilākāṣṭhādiṣu prāṇāyatīti vyutpattimāśritya prāṇaśabdavācyatayā svīkārya ityarthaḥ| pūrvādhikaraṇoktaṃ hetumatrāpi yojayati  pūrvavaditi| ubhayatrāpi havā iti śabdasya vidyamānatvādityarthaḥ| atra bhagavati prāṇaśabdasya śrautaṃ prayogaṃ sadṛṣṭāntamāha ākāśeti| yathā paramātmaviṣayasyākāśaśabdasya śrutau tatratatropalabhyamānatvādākāśaśabdaḥ paramātmaviṣayaḥ, evaṃ nikhilaprāṇiprāṇanokterdṛṣṭatvāt prāṇaśabdo'pi paramātmaviṣaya ityuktaṃ bhavati| tadarthavicāraphalaphalibhāvau pūrvādhikaraṇavat svayameva kalpanīyau| saṃgatiḥ punātideśikī||
pūrvoktādhikaraṇadvayasādhyaprasākayuktīnāmuktādhikaraṇadvayaviṣayavākyorabhāvenojjihānasya pūrvapakṣiṇo nirākaraṇaṃ prakārāntareṇātra kriyata iti pūrvottarapeṭikāvaiṣamyaṃ prakāśayati śiṣyānugraheṇa noktimiti| yat siddhāntānukūlaṃ liṅgaṃ tat pūrvapakṣaviruddhaṃ yat punaḥ pūrvapakṣānukūlaliṅgaṃ tadeva siddhāntāviruddhamiti virodhāvirodhaprakriyā| atrākāśādiviśeṣaśabdena pūrvayoradhikaraṇayoḥ |svasādhyopasthāpakasiddhāntānurūpapūrvapakṣayuktidārḍhyāt siddhāntanirṇayaḥ kṛtaḥ| atra tāvat pūrvapakṣavādī manyate yathā pūrvayoradhikaraṇayoḥ sarvakāraṇatvādikaṃ liṅgaṃ viśeṣokiṃta vyāharanti tathottarayoradhikaraṇayoḥ kimapi liṅgaṃ viśeṣokiṃta na vyāhanti| api tu pūrvapakṣoktaprasiddhajyotirindriyoranukūlaṃ kaukṣeyajyotiraikyādikaṃ liṅgamapyastīti darśayati bhavatīti| tadeva siddhāntabhūtaparabrahmatvapratikūlam| nakevalaṃ liṅgenaiva vadāmaḥ, kiṃtu pradhānabhūtayā śrutyāpīti darśayati  śabda iti| ananyaniṣṭhaḥ viśeṣaśabda ityarthaḥ| evaṃ caturbhirhetubhiḥ paramātmā na jyotirādyuktivedya iti pūrvapakṣiṇo viśeṣābhiprāyasaṃgrahaḥ| evaṃ tarhi jyotirādiṣu sākṣātkāraṇatvakathanābhāve kathaṃ jyotirādikāraṇatvaśaṅkāvakāśa ityāśaṅkya sākṣātkāraṇatvakathanābhāve'pi kāraṇatvākṣepakayatkiñcidābhāsaniratiśayagīptyādiliṅgena jyotirādikāraṇatvaṃ śaṅkitumapi kathaṃcicchakyamityāha viśveti| evamākṣipantamanantarādhikaraṇābhyāṃ nirākaroti  rundha iti| taduciteti  bhagavata ididyutyanurūpacetanācetanavaiśiṣṭyapradarśanena nirundha iti śabdārthaḥ||
atrākāśādiṣu triṣvadhikaraṇeṣu " ākāśādvāyuḥ " ityādiśrutyuktakrameṇa pūrvapakṣotthānaṃ samādhānaṃ ceti saṃgatiḥ| prasiddhajyotiḥ paramātmanostatratatra jyotiśśabdaprayogasādhāraṇyaṃ saṃśayakāraṇam| tadarthavicārastu " atha yadataḥ parodivaḥ " ityādivākye jyotiśśabdaḥ prasiddhajyotirvācakaḥ, uta paramātmavācakaḥ| tadarthaṃ vicāryate  svavākye paramātmāsādhāraṇaliṅgābhāve'pyupakramasthaṃ paramātmāsādhāraṇaṃ liṅgaṃ jyotiśśabdasya paramātmavācakatvaṃ na pratipādayati, uta pratipādayatīti| tadarthamapi vicāryate  upakrame'pi paramātmāsādhāraṇaṃ liṅgaṃ nāsti utāstīti| tataśca vicāryate|  " gāyatrīvā idaṃ sarvam " ityupakramasthagāyatrīśabdaḥ paramātmaparatvaṃ bādhate na veti| punaśca vicāryate  etadvākyastho bhūtādipādavyapadeśo gāyatrīmātraparatvaṃ na vyāvartayati, uta vyāvartayatīti|
phalaphalibhāvaḥ svayamevonneyaḥ| atra pūrvapakṣī manyate  ākāśaprāṇādhikaraṇayoriva jyotiradhikaraṇaviṣayavākye jyotiśśabdasya paramapuruṣavācakatvasthāpakaṃ sarvakāraṇatvādikaṃ prasiddhajyotirviruddhaliṅgaṃ nopalabhyate| upalabhyate cānukūlaliṅgaṃ kaukṣeyajyotiṣaikyam| tadidamāha kaukṣeyeti| tathā ca tadeva jagatkāraṇam| na kevalamanayā vidyayā pratīyate apitu vaiśvānaravidyāyāmapi tadeva jagatkāraṇatvena pratītamityāha tarayeti|phalitamā ata iti| nirākaroti  maivamiti| hetumāha puṃsūkteti| upakrame hi " pādo'sya sarvā bhūtāni " iti vākyena puruṣasūktasthaṃ " pādosya viśvā bhūtāni " ityādivākyaṃ pratyabhijñāpyate| puruṣasūkte hi nārāyaṇaparatvaṃ suprasiddhameva| tacca kāraṇatvaṃ nārāyaṇe " hrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyau " iti lakṣmīpatitvaliṅgasāmarthyāt, " bhagavānitiśabdaḥ" iti parāśaravākyācca| tarhi vākyaśeṣasthakaukṣeyajyotiraikyasya kā gatiriti cet tasya nyāyavirodhena bādha eva gatiḥ| upakramopasaṃhārayorupakramo balīyāniti hi nyāyavidaḥ| atrāśvapratigraheṣṭinyāya evodāharaṇam| nanu sarvokrame " gāyatrī vā idaṃ sarvam " iti gāyatrīparatvapradarśanādupakramavākyaṃ gāyatrīmeva pratipādayati na punaḥ paramapuruṣamityāśaṅkya tasyāpyanyathāsiddhimāha gāyatrīti| gāyatryuktiścatuṣpāttva sāmyādeva na punaḥ gāyatrīsvarūpatvāt| itthamavagame ko heturityāśaṅkya niyāmakaṃ hetumāha api ceti| asminkhalu vākye gāyatrīśabdavācyasya parasya brahmaṇaḥ sādṛśyena bhūtapṛthvīśarīrahṛdayāni nirdiśyante| gāyatrīśabdasya paramātmaparatve niyāmakaṃ paramātmano viśvātmakatvaṃ na kevalamakṣarasaṃghātarūpāyāṃ gāyatryām, ata upakramavākyānusāreṇaivopasaṃhārasya varṇayituṃ śakyatvāt jyotiśśabdavācyaṃ parameva brahmeti nirṇayaḥ| prayujyate ca " taṃ devā jyotiṣāṃ jyotiḥ " ityādiṣu parasminneva brahmaṇi jyotiśabdaḥ sthalāntareṣvapi||
śrīmadbhāṣyagranthe mandapratibodhārthaṃ pūrvottaravākyayoḥ parasparaṃ vyāhatimāśaṅkya pariharati utthānamityādinā itthamityantena| etadadhikaraṇārambhe jyotirādāvadhikaraṇayuge kāraṇavyāpta liṅgādutthānamiti bhāṣyakārairevābhāṣya punarapi pūrvapakṣopanyāsasamaye prasiddhavannirdeśe'pyākāśaprāṇādivat svavākyopāttaparamātmaliṅgaviśeṣādarśanādityuktam, ataḥ kathamavirodha iti| atra nirākaraṇahetumāha viśveti| ayaṃ kila bhāṣyakārābhiprāyaḥ  evaṃ kila manyate pūrvapakṣī "" viśvataḥpṛṣṭeṣu sarvataḥ pṛṣṭheṣvanuttameṣūttameṣu " ityādikaṃ kāraṇatvākṣepakamavabhāsātmakaṃ liṅgamasti|
athāpyubhayaliṅtvādiviśiṣṭaparamapuruṣapratiṣṭhāpakaṃ jagatkāraṇatvādikaṃ svavākye liṅgaṃ nāstīti| ato na virodhaityāha vyāhatiriti| ayamarthaḥ  siddhāntopanyāsabhāṣye yadyapi " atha yadataḥ paradivo jyotiḥ" ityetasminvākye paramapuruṣāsādhāraṇaṃ liṅgamastīti bhāṣyakārahṛdayam| anuttameṣūttameṣu lokeṣu dyotata iti viśeṣaṇadvayopādānamaprākṛtadivyalokavāsino jyotiṣa eva saṃghaṭate| na punaraṇḍāntarvartino vā jyotirmātrasyeti bhāvaḥ||
atra saṃgatirbhāṣyakārairevoktā " niratiśaya " ityādinā| ādityādiparajyotiśśabde niraste paro jyotiṣāmadhipatitvena parakalpita indro'pi jagatkāraṇatvenāśaṅkya nirasyata iti| athavā upakramaprābalyādupasaṃhāroktārthanirāsaḥ pūrvādhikaraṇa uktaḥ, tarhi tenaiva nyāyena pratardanavidyāyāmapi upakramaprābalyādupasaṃhāravākyapratipannaparamapuruṣapirakalpanaṃ bādhyamiti pūrvapakṣotthānena saṃgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu pratardanavidyāyāṃ kiṃ prasiddha evendraḥ pratipādyate utendraśarīrakaḥ paramātmā| evaṃ prāṇe'pi vācyam| tadarthaṃ vicāryate  pūrvādhikaraṇoktopakramādhikaraṇanyāyenātrāpyarthopavarṇanaṃ nyāyyam, athavā neti| upakramādhikaraṇanyāyebādhakamupakramamahāvākyavirodhe mahāvākyamevānusaraṇīyamiti nyāyanantaraṃ na vidyate, athavā vidyata iti| punarvicāryate asminvākye sarvatra parabrahmatvaniścāyakaṃ hetujātaṃ nānugamyate, utānugamyata iti| atra pūrvapakṣī manyate pūrvamupakramānusāreṇaivopasaṃhāravarṇanaṃ nyāyyamiti bhavadbhiruktam, pratardanavidyāyāmupakrame pūrvamindraśabdaḥ prayujyate, sa tu viśeṣaśrutiḥ, tenopakramasthaśrutyānuguṇyamastyeva, kiṃ ca " tvameva me varaṃ vṛṇīṣva yaṃ tvaṃ manuṣyāya hitatamaṃ manyase" iti hitatamopāstikarmatvaṃ tathaivocyate, tacca parabrahmatvaliṅgam, tenopakramasthaśrutiliṅgābhyāmindra eva paramapuruṣaḥ, kiṃ ca tvadabhimatanārāyaṇaviruddhaṃ prasiddhendrasādhāraṇaṃ tvāṣṭravadhādikaṃ copalabhyate, tacca paramapuruṣaviruddhameva| phalitamāha taditi| tasmāt | asau  śakrādipada vācya indra eva, jagatkartā| paraharati neti| ayamāśayaḥ  upakramasthahitatamopāstikarmatvaṃ prasiddhendrasya na ghaṭate, evaṃ hitatamopāstitarapavargārthopāsanam, prasiddhendrastu devagaṇāntargataḥ svargādiparimitadeśavāsī kaścitkīṭakalpaḥ, sa kathaṃ hitatamopāstikarma bhavet, tenārthavirodhāt śabdārthāsaṃkocasiddhyarthaṃ cendraśabdena paramapuruṣa evābhidhīyate, " idi paramaiśvaryaṃ " iti hi vyutpādayanti, nipuṇanirūpaṇe pitāmaho'pyudumbarakīṭaḥ, kimuta meghanādādijitaḥ prasiddhendra iti tvameva bhāvaya| tarhi māmupāssveti svopāsanaṃ vidadhātīndraḥ, tvāṣṭravadhādikaṃ cāsminneva prakaraṇe prakhyāpyate paramapuruṣaviruddhaṃ prasiddhendrānukūlaṃ liṅgam, tatkathamiti cedatra samādhimāha brahmetyādinā| svātmanā cetyantena| ayamabhiprāyaḥ  tredhā hyupāsyaṃ brahma acidviśiṣṭopāsanaṃ cidviśiṣṭopāsanaṃ kevalaṃ paramātmopāsanamiti| tena prasiddhendrādikamapi brahmaviśeṣaṇatvenopāsyatayā'bhidhīyate | tena viśeṣaṇabhūtaprasiddhendrādipratipattyarthaṃ tvāṣṭravadhādikamapi liṅgaṃ sārthakameva na punarviruddham| ayamatra nirṇayaḥ hitatamopāstikarmatvādibhiḥ paramapuruṣasyaiva pratardanavidyāyāmindraśabdapradhānavācyatvaṃ siddhameva| tvāṣṭravadhādinā liṅgena tadviśeṣaṇatvena prasiddhendro'pi parigṛhyate | evaṃ prākaraṇikena liṅgeviśeṣeṇa prasiddhaprāṇo'pi svīkriyatāṃ, natu svarūpeṇa| svarūpeṇa paramātmanopāsanaṃ suprasiddhameva | tenopāsātraividhyasiddhyarthaṃ prasiddhendrādyasādhāraṇalibhgaṃ pratardanavidyāyāmuktamiti na virodhaḥ| ata indrādiviśiṣṭaḥ paramātmeva pratardanavidyāyāmupāsya itīndrādirūḍhiśaktyā viśeṣaṇaparityāgena viśeṣyaparyancābhidhānamiti siddham| kathaṃ tarhi upakramavirodhe vākyārthanirṇaya ityāśaṅkyāha prāṇendrāti | ubhayamiha prakāṣyate upakramopasaṃhārayo upakramopasaṃhārayopurakramo balīyān, upakramamahāvanakyayorvirodhe mahāvākyameva balīya iti| idaṃ punarvirodhe satyameva| atra punarvirodha eva nāstīti bhāṣyakārahṛdayam| mahāvākyagatopakramasyāpīndraviśiṣṭaparamātmaviṣayatvenādhyātmavidbhipanusandhānāditi||
atrādhikaraṇārambhānupapattimāśaṅkya samādhatte  yaditi| ayamarthaḥ  jyotiṣīndre ca yalliṅgaṃ kāraṇaikasthitamiti kathitaṃ bhavatā jyotiṣi tāvat " atha yadataḥ" ityādyuktamuttameṣu lokeṣu niratiśayadīptiyuktatvam, yaccendre tvamityādyabhipretaṃ " māmupāssva " iti sākṣānmuktyarthaṃ mumukṣūpāsyatvam, tadubhayamapi prakhyātānyaikaniṣṭhaṃ kāraṇatvena prakhyātanārāyaṇamaikaniṣṭhaṃ prathamamitam ākāśādhikaraṇatvavayāptaṃ liṅgadvayam, tatkathamucyate| yathā sarvajagatkāraṇatvaṃ paramapuruṣaviṣayatayā prathamamitam, tadvat, tena samavyāptam liṅgadvayamapi tathaiva pramitamevetyarthaḥ| phalitamāha ata iti| niratiśayadīptiyuktatvaliṅgasya mumukṣūpāsyatvasya ca paramapuruṣaniṣṭhatayā pūrvameva pramitatvāt kāraṇatvavyāptaliṅgena pūrvapakṣotthānamiti na ghaṭate| itthaṃ liṅgadvayasya paramapuruṣasthitatvaparāmarśe dūṣaṇamuktam tadabhāve'pi dūṣaṇamāha aprāpta iti| liṅgadvayasya sarvakāraṇasthitatvaparāmarśābhāve liṅgadvayānvitaṃ yatkiṃcijjotirastu yaḥ kaścidindro'stu na caitāvatā pūrvoktamekaniṣṭhaṃ kāraṇatvaṃ paramakāraṇatvaṃ bhraśyati kimarthamadhikaraṇāmbha ityāśaṅkyārdhāṅgīkāreṇa pariharati satyamiti| yadyapyadhikaraṇaprayojanaṃ nāsti, athāpi kiṃcitprayojanamasti, yadyapi liṅgadvayaṃ paramapuruṣaikaniṣṭham, athāpi sa eva paramapuruṣa upendratvamāsthāya vartate, ataḥ so'pyupāsya eva, tasya śrutiḥ purāṇādirivopendrotpatiṃta vāvadītīti kaścit bālabuddhi rbhrāmyati, tacchaṅkānirākaraṇamārambha ityarthaḥ| upendrasya paramapuruṣatvaṃ śrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇeṣu prasiddham, teṣvevendrasya puruṣottamakiṅgaratvamapi tatraiva prasiddhamiti bhāvaḥ||
evamuktayoradhikaraṇayorvirodhābhāsaṃ śamayitvā pūrvapakṣiṇā parigṛhīte'rthe saṃmatāsaṃmatavibhāgaṃ darśayan virodhiliṅgatvena kathitasya kaukṣeyajyotiṣaikyasya mukhyaprāṇādiliṅgasya copāsanārthatvena prayojanamapi darśayati jyotiriti| jyotirādiśabdānāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭhaparamavastuvācitvaṃ saṃmatam| viśeṣaṇamātravācitvasaṃmatam| kaukṣoyajyotiṣaikyamupāsanārtham| tathā mukhyaprāṇaliṅgampyupāsyaviśeṣaṇaprakāśanārthamiti ślokārthasaṃkṣepaḥ| spaṣṭamevāvaśiṣṭham||
atra śiṣyāmugrahārthaṃ ākāśajyotirādyadhikaraṇoktārthavaiśadyāyetaravāciśabdānāṃ brahmaṇi prayoge viṣayabhedena niyamaṃ darśayati  kāryamiti| yat kāryamiti dṛḍhamitamadhigatamākāśādikaṃ yadapi karmavaśyamiti dṛḍhamitaṃ prājāpatyādikaṃ tayo rnirūḍhaiḥ prasiddhaiḥ śabdaiḥ brahmaṇi nirdiṣṭhe sati kvacit ātmāvasthiteṣvākāśādiśabdeṣu gatyantarābhāvādrūḍhirbādhyā| agatihatā  rūḍhitvena nirvāhāsaṃbhavastviha agatiḥ tayā nivāryate rūḍhiḥ| tena yoga evāśrīyata ityarthaḥ| kvacidanyatra prakārāntareṇa nirvāhamāha taditi| jyotiṣi liṅgaṃ kaukṣeyajyotiṣaikyam, indre tvāṣṭravadhādikaṃ tadubhayamananyathāsiddhaṃ vyāptamityarthaḥ|| tattaliṅgānanyathāsiddherjñānabalāt tadviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭhaviṣayatvaṃ syāt| atrodāharaṇacatuṣṭayamāha jyotiriti| jyotirviśiṣṭe brahmaṇi jyotiśabdaḥ| indraviśiṣṭhe punarindraśabdaḥ| evamahaṃ brahmāsmītyatrāhaṃśabdaḥ svātmaviśiṣṭaṃ paramātmānamāha| atra aindrānayenetyetadavaśiṣyate, tadapyācakṣmahe " aindryā gārhapatyam" ityatrendraśabdasya gārhapatye rūḍhiśaktyabhāvāt gauṇīvṛttirvyutpattirvā samāśrayaṇīyā| ubhayamapyāhuḥ " indratvamagnau gauṇaṃ syāt yajñasambandhakāritam| indatyarthānusārādvā svakārye so'pi hīśvaraḥ|| " iti|
tenākāśaprāṇaśabdayorasmābhiḥ parasmin brahmaṇi vyutpattirevāśrīyata iti susaṃgatametat| ayamarthaḥ vyupattyā paramātmānaṃ tattaduktiḥ prakāśayet| talliṅgānanyathāsiddhau tadviśiṣṭāvalambinī|| iti||
pūrvaṃ tadguṇādgṛṇātītyāgāmināmadhikaraṇānāṃ pratyekamekaikabhagavadguṇaprakāśane tātparyamiti pratipāditam| adhunā punaratītānāṃ saptānāmadhikaraṇānāṃ saptasu bhagavadguṇeṣu tātparyamanukramā ityādaujetṛvītahavyavijevṛtayā balapauruṣādiśayayukta ityānuśāsanikādi dācaṣṭe  svecchāta ityādinā| śubheti śubhaguṇavibhavarūpānantanissīmaharṣa ityarthaḥ| anupadhiketi deśakālavastupiracchedarāhityenetyarthaḥ| saprāṇeti saprāṇānāmaprāṇānāṃ prāṇaheturityarthaḥ| tatra prabhuritikathanaṃ sarvādhikaraṇokta vaibhavaprakāśanārtham||
dvitīyādhyāyasya tṛtīyapādaḥ
atra pūrvottarapādasaṅgatirbhāṣya eva suvyaktamucyate "sāṅkhyādivedabāhyatantrāṇāṃ nyāyābhāsamūlatayā vipratiṣedhāccasāmañjasyamuktam| idānīṃ svapakṣasya vipratiṣedhādidoṣagandhābhāvākhyāpanāya brahmakāryatayābhimatacidacidātmakaprapañcasya kāryaprakāro viśodhyate" iti| atra pūrvapādadvayasyottarapādadvayena saṅgatirassmābhiḥ pūrvamevoktā kāraṇadvārakabāhyavirodhaparihāra parau dvau pādau, aparau punaḥ kāryadvārakāntaravirodhaparihāraparāviti| ataḥ paraṃ kāryaviṣayavirodhaparihāraparayoḥ pādayoḥ paravādyuktaprakriyāṃ vibhāgenānūdya tatpratikṣeparūpasvapakṣamante nigamayati sarvamiti| atra catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ pratikṣepyāḥ| dravyañcādravyaṃca sarvaṃ nityamiti sāṅkhyāḥ prativadanti| sarvaṃ kṣaṇikamiti vaibhāṣikāḥ| sarvaṃ nityānityamiti jinaparipaṭhitāṃ saptabhaṅgīṃ paṭhantaḥ prāhuḥ| dravyamānā nityaṃ paryāyātmanā'nityamiti vadanto'pi viparyasya pravadanti| nityamevānityamiti kvacit kvacitpunaranityamapi nityamiti prāhuḥ| vaiśeṣikāḥ khalu nityameva caitanyamanityamiti vadanti tathā nityameveśvaravigrahādikaṃ pramāṇasiddhaṃ na sahante evamanityamapi nityayanti| yathā'nityayaorghaṭataddharmayossambandhaṃ samavāyātmakamanityamapi nityameva bruvate| evaṃ parapakṣānanūdya śrutya valambanenotthitāṃstān śrutibhireva nirundhan viyatprāṇapādau yunaktītyanvayaḥ||
adhikaraṇasaṅgatistu  śrīpāñcarātrādhikaraṇe jīvotvādau jīvābhimānisaṅkarṣaṇādiparatvādaupacārika ityuktam, tarhi tenaiva nyāyena viyadutpattivādo'pyaupacārika eva syāditi śaṅkyotthānamiti| tadarthavicārastu  kiṃ viyadutpadyate neti| kiṃ "ātmana ākāśassaṃbhūtaḥ" ityākāśasyotpatiṃta pratipādayati neti| kimatra sambhūtiśabdo mukhyotpattipara uta gauṇa iti| kimanyatra niravayavasyānutpattidarśanaṃ niravayavasyāsya śabdaikamadhigamyasyotpattiyogyatāmavagamayati neti| atra pūrvottarādhikaraṇayossaṅgatipradarśanapūrvakaṃ pūrvapakṣavādyabhimatamanūdya pratikṣipati  pūrvatreti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥ pūrvasminnadhikaraṇe jīvotpattivākyaṃ puruṣanityatvapratipādakavākyena bādhitamiti prasādhitam| evamākāśotpattiviṣaye'pi vākye nityatvānityatvapratipādakavacasorvirodhe tathaiva sthitiriti nityatvavākyenānityatvabādha iti kaścidvadati| evaṃ pūrvapakṣayuktau siddhāntyabhimatamāha  siddhāntīti| ayamarthaḥ  ākāśotpattiranekaśrutipratipannā| na tāsyāmanyathāsiddhirasti| ananyathāsiddhabahuśrutipratipanne'rthe jāgrati eko'mukhyo yuktyābhāsaḥ paravādikalpito jīvitumeva nārhatīti bhavaduktaṃ parityajāmaḥ| "vāyuścāntarikṣañcaitadamṛtam" iti śrutyaivākāśasyāmṛtatvamuktam, tatparityāge jīvāmṛtatvokterapi parityāgaprasaṅga ityāśaṅkya bhāṣyakāroktavaiṣamyaṃ darśayati  vāyvityādinā| idaṃ kilātra vaiṣamyam  anekāḥ śrutayo hyākāśasya janimutpatiṃta vidadhati| ekā śrutismṛtatvamanuvadati| ato hetorhi bhagnā| sā ca vāyusahapāṭhādatyantamavasīdati| vāyorhyanityatvaṃ sarvalokasampratipannam| iha punarjīvanityatvameva sarvavedasampratipannam|utpattivādastu kvacitka eva| sa cānthāsiddhaḥ| tenānyathāsiddhabahuśrutyānuguṇyenātmanityatvaṃ yuktam| vaiparītyādayuktamākāśanityamiti vaiṣamyasiddhiriti||
atrākāśanityatvapratipādane pūrvapakṣiparikalpitānuktānsubahūn hetūnanūdya śiṣyapratibodhanārthaṃ vyaktameva nirākaroti  tejaḥprāthamyetyādinā| ayamatra pūrvapakṣyabhipreto hetusamudāyaḥ  sadvidyāyāṃ hi "tattejo'sṛjata" iti prathamamākāśasṛṣṭimanuktvā tejassṛṣṭirevocyate| tenākāśasya sṛṣṭyavacanamākāśa nityatvaparamityeko hetuḥ| "vāyuścāntarikṣañcaitadamṛtam" ityavyavadhānenāmṛtatvavacanādityamaraḥ| anaṃśakadravyabhāvāditi tṛtīyaḥ| ato vyomanyutpattivāgupahitaviṣayaiva syād ghaṭākāśādiviṣayaiva ityādirātmotpattivādo dehaparigrahaviṣaya ityanyathākriyate tadvadihāpīti pratibandī| anūditametatpratikṣipati  neti| yattu prathamaṃ tejassṛṣṭyabhidhānadṛṣṭerityuktaṃ tanna| prāthamyasyāśrutatvāt| nahyatra prathamaṃ
tejassṛta iti prathamaśabdaśrūyate| mābhūtprāthamyaśravaṇam, athāpi prathamapaṭhanamātreṇa tat kalpyata ityāśaṅkya pratikṣipati prathamapaṭhanata iti| anyena bādhāt  bahusmṛtītihāsapurāṇanyāyopabṛṃhitena "ātmana ākāśassambhūtaḥ" ityādinā vākyena bādhādityarthaḥ| kalpanaṃ hi laiṅgikam| "tasmādvā etasmādātmanaḥ" iti pañcamīnirdeśāt sākṣādevākāśasya kāryatvaṃ śrutyaiva pratīyata ityarthaḥ| saṃbhūtaśabdo'pi jananavācī| amṛtapadamavaśiṣyate  tacca cirakālavartitvamātrapratipādakāmartyādipadavanna nityatvamupapādayati| atra vinigamane kāraṇamāha anekavākyaikakaṇṭhyāditi| "dvaidhe bahūnāṃ vacanam" iti hi nyāyavido nirṇayanti||
vaiśeṣikāḥ khalu "ākāśo notpadyate niravayavadravyatvāt" ityanumānaṃ prayuñjate tadasat vyarthaviśeṣaṇatvāt sarvasyāpi hi dravyasya nityatvenaiva prāmāṇikatvāt dravyatvamātraṃ tu tvatpakṣeṇānaikāntikam|nanu ghaṭādyutpattistarhi kathamucyate? satkāryavādādeveti brūmaḥ| na punarghaṭādidravyasyotpattiḥ sadeva hi mṛtpiṇḍādikaṃ pṛthubudhnodarākārādirūpaṃ prāpya ghaṭādikamityucyate| tacca yuktiyuktameva| asamavāyikāraṇāvasthāpannadravyaviśeṣamantareṇa kāryāvasthāyāmapi dravyāntarasyānupalambhāt| ayaṃ ca pakṣaḥ śrutibhirapyanumataḥ| tena niravayavadravyatvāditi vyarthaviśeṣaṇameva| tena teṣuteṣu dravyeṣu nāmāntarabhajanārhāvasthayā sṛṣṭivādava iti suśobhanametat| tadidamāha yukta ityādinā| yuktaḥ yuktiyukta ityarthaḥ| śrutibhiranumata iti "sadeva somyedamagra āsīt" iti hyucyate| "yathā somyaikena" iti dṛṣṭāntaścāsminneva pakṣe … jīve tadguṇayogaḥ, tathā tatkāryayodādividhure'pīśvarādau saṃyogādiḥ, nityānāmeva paramāṇūnāṃ parasparasaṃyogaḥ, pārthivaparamāṇuṣu pākajaguṇotpattiḥ, ityādi svayameva bhāvyam| ayamatra viśeṣaḥ  upādānasvarūpe nāmāntarabhajanārhāvasthāntarāpattau kāryatvaṃ vadanti| anyathā 'vasthāntaraprāptirūpamiti| evamupapāditamarthaṃ vaiśadyāya nigamayati  tasmāditi| śrutiṣvākāśādyutpattiruktā vāyuvahnijalapṛthivyutpattitulyatvānnabādhyetyarthaḥ| ayamarthaḥ  niravayavatvādutpattinirākaraṇe siddhasādhanam, nāmāntarabhajanārhāvasthotpattinirākaraṇe lokavedayuktyupalambhavirodha iti||
atra saṅgarbhāṣya eva suvyaktamuktā  "brahmavyatiriktasya kṛtsnasya brahmakāryatvamuktam| idānīṃ vyavahitakāryāṇāṃ kiṃ kevalāttattadanantarakāraṇabhūtādvastuna utpattirāhosvittattadrūpādbrahmaṇa iti cintyate" iti| tadarthavicārastu  mahadahaṅkārādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ tattvānāṃ kiṃ kevalātpūrvatattvamātrādutpattiḥ uta tattadrūpādbrahmaṇa iti| kiṃ "ākāśādvāyuḥ" ityādiśrutiṣvākāśādiśabdā ākāśādimātraparā uta tattadavasthabrahmaparā iti| kiṃ "teja aikṣata" ityādiṣvabhidhyānaliṅgaṃ tejaḥ prabhṛtiśabdānāṃ tattadavasthabrahmaparatāmavagamayati neti| kiṃ tejaḥ prabhṛtiśabdānāṃ tattadavasathabrahmaparatve lakṣaṇā syānneti| kiṃ tejaḥ prabhṛtiśabdānāmaparyavasānavṛttyā brahmābhidhāne vyutpattivirodhādidoṣo bhavati neti| atra pūrvapakṣamanūdya nirākaroti  kūṭasthāditi|"etasmājjāyate prāṇaḥ" ityādagiśruterdvayī hi gatissambhāvyate| etasmādbrahmaṇaḥ prakṛtyādikrameṇa pṛthivīparyantaṃ viśvasṛṣṭirityekā, aparā tu prakṛtyādipūrvapūrvatattvaśarīrād brahmaṇaeva pṛthivīparyantaṃ kṛtsnasya viśvasya sṛṣciriti| atra pūrvapakṣavādī manyate  putrapautrādinītyā kūṭasthādbrahmaṇa eva paramparayā viśvasṛṣṭiḥ "etasmātprāṇaḥ" ityasminvākye kalpayitvā| asminvākye "khaṃ vāyurjyotirāpaḥ pṛthivī viśvasya dhāriṇī" iti pāṭhakramātkrama e pratipādyata iti pratīyate| "ākāśādvāyuḥ" iti śrautakramasyātrāpi dṛṣṭatvena śrutyantarasaṃvādāt tatsahapāṭhasāmarthyāt "etasmājjāyate prāṇo manassarvendriyāṇi ca" ityatrāpi pratīmānaḥ pāṭhakramo vivakṣyate api na brahmaṇassākṣādviśvasṛṣṭiriti| nanu "etasmājjāyate prāṇaḥ" "tasmādetadbrahma nāmarūpamannañca jāyate" "tattejo'sṛjata" ityādikaṃ tvatpakṣena ghaṭata ityāśaṅkya pūrvapakṣī pariharati  etasmāditi| ayamarthaḥ  "etasmāt" ityādibhiśśabdairhetutvamātramucyate| tattu hetutvaṃ vyavahitāvyavahitapakṣayossādhāraṇamityasmatpakṣe'pi sugamameveti| nirākaroti ihetyādirūho'tra moha  iti| ayamarthaḥ  vyavahitāvyavahitayoravyavahite sampratyaya iti hi nyāyavidāṃ nirṇayaḥ| tena brahmaṇa evāvyavahitakāraṇatve sambhavati vyavahitakalpanā nalaghīyasī| kiṃñca "etasmājjāyate " ityatraitasmāditi padasyānuṣaṅgeṇa vākyārthayojanāyāṃ saṃbhāvitāyāṃ "etasmājjāyate prāṇaḥ prāṇānmano manasa indriyāṇīndriyebhyaḥ kham" ityādikayāvacanavyaktyā pūrvapūrvānuṣaṅgavipariṇāmābhyāmarthopavarṇanamanyāyyameva| apica etasmādbrahmaṇa ityatra brahmaṇa eva kāraṇabhūtātmaprāṇasya sākṣādutpattirucyate manaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ paramparayotpattiriti vairūpyam| avairūpye sambhavati vairūpyeṇa nirvāho'pi jaghanya eva| kiñca "pṛthivyapsu pralīyate" ityādinā subālopaniṣādādau bahusmṛtītihāsapurāṇādiṣu prāṇānmanassṛṣṭirmanasa indriyasṛṣṭirindriyebhya ākāśasṛṣṭirityasti| atrāpyanthāsiddhimāśaṅkya pariharati  prāṇetyādinā 'tiprasaṅgādityantena| ayamarthaḥ  ayaṃ khalu bhavato'bhiprāyaḥ "khaṃ vāyuḥ" ityatra śrutyantarasiddhakrama eva pratīyate; tatsahapāṭhaliṅgāt
"manassarvendriyāṇi" ityatrāpi pāṭhakrama evānusartavyaḥ, tena subālopaniṣadādiprasiddhaṃ kramāntarameva bādhyata iti, tadidamasāram sampratipannabahuvākyānusāreṇāsampratipannaikavākyārthopavarṇanaṃ hi nyāyyam| na punarvaiparītyena parikalpanam| nyāyaviruddhārthaparikalpane sarvaśātravyāpakopāt| tenātra kramo na vivakṣyate| apitu pūrvapūrvatattvāviśiṣṭādbrahmaṇa eva viśvotpattiriti| imamarthaṃ śrutirevopabṛṃhayatīti hetvantaramapyāha  īkṣeti| " tadaikṣata" " tatteja aikṣata" "tā āpa aikṣanta" ityādiṣu kāraṇabhūte brahmaṇīkṣaṇamevānusyūtaṃ dṛśyate| tacca tattattatvaviśiṣṭādbrahmaṇa eva viśvocatpattau yujyata itīkṣatyadhikaraṇādau sarvatrāpi śāstre samarthitam| uktamarthaṃ nigamayati  prathamamiti| yathā prakṛtiśarīraṃ brahma mahattattvaṃ sṛjati, tathā mahaccharīraṃ brahmāhaṅkāraṃ sṛjati, ityādikrameṇa pṛthivīparyantaṃ yojanīyamiti||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye "viyadādeḥ" ityādinoktā| ayamāśayaḥ  viyadadhikaraṇe tāvatparavādibhirnityatvena parigṛhītānāṃ viyadādīnāmutpattiḥ sthāpitā| samanantarādhikaraṇe punaḥ
dvitīyādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ
atra prayojanādhikyābhāvena pādāntarārambhamākṣipya samādhatte  akṣādīti| ayamiha śabdārthaḥ ātmana utpattyabhāvāsamarthanaṃ jñātṛtvasamarthanamityādikaṃ phalaviśeṣavattvāt kartavyameva| acidviśeṣarūpasyendriyāderutpattikathamatyantābhāsaprayojanameva| yatkiñcidadhikāśaṅkāparihārārthamadhikaraṇamārabhyate cet tadapi spaṣṭamiha na dṛśyate| tadidamāha  mandamiti| nanvasyādhikaphalamindriyasaṃkhyādi parijñānamityāśaṅkyāha tatsaṃkhyāderiti| nahi kākadantasakhyāparijñāne kiñcitprayojanamasti| tadvadindriyāṇyapyekādaśa vā ṣaḍvetyādiviśeṣaparijñāne na kimapi phalamupalabhāmahe| āśaṅkitamarthaṃ pratikṣipati  neti| pratikṣepārthaṃ prakaṭayati eteṣviti| prakṛte'pi prapañcasya brahmakāryatvaṃ hi pratijñātam| tat keṣāṃcidbrahmakāryatvasamarthanābhāve śrutivipratipattyā kasyacit mandasya vipratipattirapratipattirvā syāt| śiṣyānugrahārthaiva hi sūtrakārasya pravṛttiḥ| tasmāt prāṇaādikāryapariśodhanārthaṃ pādārambhassārthaka eva| tatra syāt prāṇakāryatvapratipādakasya prathamādhikaraṇasya "saṃjñāmūrtiklṛptistu trivṛtkurvata upadeśāt" iti caramādhikaraṇasya ca sākṣājiha saṅgatiḥ madhyamānāṃ prāsaṅgikī saṅgatiriti vibhāgaḥ||
atra pāde punaradhikaraṇasaṅkhyāmadhikaraṇārthabhedaṃ tattadadhikaraṇaprayojanañca vibhajya darśayati  aṣṭāviti| aṣṭāvadhikaraṇānyatra pāde proktāni| tatra prathamādhikaraṇe viyannītirindriyāṇāmuktā|
yathā viyatpāde prathamaṃ viyata utpattiruktā, evaṃ prāṇapāda indriyāṇāmutpattirucyate| yadyapi cakṣurādīnīmutpattiḥ kāṇādairākṣapādairapyucyate athāpi manasa utpattirnocyate tena pratikṣepyaviśeṣalābhādadhikaraṇārambhassaprayojana eva| caramādhikaraṇaprayojanamāha tejo'banneti|yathā tejo'bannādiśarīrakaḥ paramātmā samaṣṭisṛṣṭāvuttarottarakāryaṃ karotīti samarthitam evaṃ vyaṣṭisṛṣṭāvapi caturmukhādiśarīrakaḥ paramātmā tattatkāryaṃ karotīti samarthanāt saprayojanameva caramādhikaraṇamitibhāvaḥ| tarhi madhye saṃkhyāpariṇāmādikaṃ kimarthaṃ cintyate kāryakāraṇabhāvapratipādanānupayogagādityāśaṅkyāha saṃkhyeti| indriyasaṃkhyāparimāṇādicintane'pi tattadvidyāviśeṣeṣu tattatsaṅkhyāparimāṇādiyuktendriyadiviśiṣṭaparamātmopāsane nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇetinyāyena saprayojanatvāt sarvamapi pāde cintanaṃ saphalameva| prakārāntareṇāpi sāphalyamāha prāṇādibhya iti| "dehendriyamanaḥ prāṇādhībhyo'nyo'nyasādhanaḥ" ityādinā yāmunacāryadibhirdehādibhyaḥ paratvena jīvātmā nirdiśyate| tatra prayojanavāneva parimāṇasaṅkhyādiviśeṣavicāra iti saphala eṣa sarvo'pi pādaḥ||
atra pādasaṅgatirbhāṣye "brahmavyatiriktasya viyadādeḥ kṛtsnasya kāryatvenotpattāvuktāyāṃ jīvasya kāryatve'pi svarūpānyathābhāvalakṣaṇotpattirapoditā| ttaprasaṅgena jīvassvarūpaṃ śodhitam| samprati jīvopakaraṇānāmindriyāṇāṃ prāṇasya cotpattyādiprakāro viśodhyate " iti|tadarthavicārastu kimindriyāṇi jīvavannotpadyante, uta viyadādivadutpadyanta iti | kiṃ etasmātjāyate prāṇo manassarvendriyāṇi ca iti vākyaṃ teṣāmutpatiṃta pratipādayati neti| kiṃ prāṇaśabda indriya uta paramātmapara iti|kiṃ "prāṇā vāva ṛṣayaḥ" ityatra ṛṣiśabdaḥ prāṇaśabdasya paramātmaparatāmalagamayati neti|atra pūrvapakṣamanudya nirākaroti agra ityādinā|asadvā idamagra āsīt|tadāhuḥ kiṃ tadāsīditi|ṛṣayo vāva te agre'sadāsīt tadāhuḥ ke te ṛṣaya iti prāṇāvāva ṛṣayaḥ " iti jagadutpatte vācyamiti vaktuṃ śakyate|ṛṣaya iti prāṇā iti ca bahuvacanavirodhāt tena nityendriyasiddhiriti pūrvapakṣānuvādaḥ|nurākarotimaivamiti| śrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇeṣu śataśaḥ pradeśeṣviindriyāṇāṃ sṛṣṭivacanadāḍhyāt pratisaṃhārakāle tatsadbhāvavacanaṃ na ghaṭata eva|tarhi bahuvacanavirodha ityuktamavaśiṣyate, tadapi na "aditi pāśān" itivahrahutvasyaupacārikatvāt|pāśādhikaraṇe hi pāśabahutvaṃ pāśaikatvasya pramāṇasiddhatvāt pāśāvayavabahutvaparamiti niraṇaiṣurnyāyabṛddhāḥ|tena
cetanācetanaviśiṣṭabrahmāṃbhutaviśeṣaṇabahutvāt bahuvacanamapi yujyata eva|tadidamāhabahuvacanamiti|nanu pramāṇatvamindriyeṣu prasiddham, ṛṣitvamapi jñāpakatvāt kathañcidupapadyate na paramātmanītyāṣaṅkyāhaprāṇarṣitve iti|sarvaprāṇiprāṇanahetutvāt prāṇatvaṃ tāvadupapadyata eva|paramātmani tāvadṛṣitvamapi jñānavṛddhatvātsutarāmupapadyate|tadidamāhataditi| niruktiścettulyā, rūḍhiścetsāpi ca tathā|asmābhirapi brahmaṇyeva rūḍhiriti vaktuṃ śakyatvāditi|yadvā prayogaprācuryamādiśabdena vivakṣyata iti||
