evamindriyāṇāṃ kāryatvamuktam|teṣāṃ saṃkhyāpi cintyata iti saṅgatiḥ|tadarthavicārastu kimindriyāṇi sapta utaikādaśeti|kiṃ "sapta ime sokā yeṣu caranti" iti saptānāṃ gatiśravaṇamindriyāṇāṃ saptasaṅkhyākatvamavagamayati neti|kiṃ jīvena saha gatyabhāve|ḍapi puruṣopakārakatvāt prāṇādhīnadehavṛttitvācca hastādīnyapīndriyāṇi neti|kiṃ "daśeme puruṣo prāṇā ātmaikādeśaḥ" iti prāṇaśabdena nirdiṣṭānāmekādasaṃkhyākatvaṃ vāgādīnāmindriyatvamavagamayati neti|atra pūrvapakṣī prāhasaptaprāṇā iti|sapta prāṇāścarantīti śruto saptatvamuditaṃ praṇānām|te ca viśiṣyābhihitā yoge yogapratipādake " yadā pañcāvatiṣṭhante jñānāni manasā saha|buddhiśca na viceṣṭeta tāmāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim" iti vākya ityarthaḥ|paramāṃ gatimitihi mokṣārthagamanarūpatvādyoga|tasmādevamupapādanāt saptaivendriyāṇi| etat pratikṣipatiasaditi|atra hetumāhaadhiketi|vākyāntareṣvindriyāṇāmadhikasaṅkhyākatvavacanāt saptatva vacanamanyaparameva|taccoktaṃ bhāṣye " nyunavyapadeśāstu tatratatra vivakṣitagamanādikāryaviśeṣaprayuktāḥ " iti|natu svarūpata indriyāṇāṃ saptatvaṃ, apitu saptalokasañcaraṇopādhinā saptatvamucyate|tacca sañcaraṇamekādaśānāmapyulakṣaṇaṃ pramāṇabalāt|yadā "pañca" iti na saṅkhyāparaṃ paragatipratipādane, tarhīndriyalakṣaṇasampannatve hi ekādaśendriyāṇāmindriyatvaṃ tatkathaṃ lakṣaṇamityāśaṅkyāhalakṣmeti| ayamarthaḥsātvikāhaṅkāradravyavikṛtitvaṃ hindriyalakṣaṇam|tadekādaśānāmapyaviśiṣṭameva|tarhi pañcendriyāntarāṇi sāmānyenoktā manasā saheti manasaḥ pṛthagabhidhānaṃ kimarthamityatra prayojanaviśeṣamāhabhedeneti|kimendriyebhyo jñānendriyebhyaśca pradhāne manasi bhedenoktistatprādhānyapradarśanena phalavatītyarthaḥ||
atra pāde pakṣaviśeṣāṇāṃ vaividhyenāṅgīkāraprakāraviśeṣānuktvā teṣāṃ nirākaraṇamapyarthād ṅāṣya eva siddhamityāhadeheti|kecidāhuḥekamevendriya dehavyāpti tadeva dehāṅgabhūtakaracaraṇādisthānaviśeṣanivāsānnānātvenābhidhīyate nānākāryaśca karotīti|kecitpunaḥ śrutipatavimukhāḥ kāṇādākṣapādādayaḥ kṣudratarkaiḥ karmendriyāṇi tatyajuḥjñānendriyamevāsti na kararamendriyamiti|apare punaḥ purāṇādiśravaṇamātreṇa buddhyahaṅkāracittaissaha caturdaśendriyāṇi kṣetrajñasya puruṣsyāhuḥ|tādṛśāścenye kecana cittaṃ muktvā trayodaśa karaṇāniti nijagaduḥ|iti tānarthato bhāṣyakāro nirācakāra|ekādaśetyupapādanāt nyunadhikasaṃṅkhyānirāso'trārthasiddha ityarthaḥ||
indriyāṇāṃ saṃṅkhyoktā, idāniṃ svarūpaparimaṇaṃ cintyata iti saṅgatiḥ|tadarthavicārastu kimindriyāṇi sarvagatāni, utānuparamāṇānīti|kiṃ "ta ete sarva eva samāssarve'nantāḥ " ityānantyavacanaṃ sarvagatatvamavagamayati neti|kimānantyaśravaṇaṃ " atha yo haitānantānupāste " ityupāsanaphasavyāpārabāhulyaparamastu sarvagatatvaparamiti|tiṃ " prāṇamanutkrāmantaṃ sarve prāṇā anutkrāmanti" ityutkrāntiśravaṇaṃ parimitatve sati apratyakṣatvamaṇutvamavagamayati neti|atra pūrvapakṣamupanyasyatisarveṣviti| sarva ete samā anantā iti sarveṣāmindriyāṇāmānantyapāṭhāt parimikiṃniyamānuktitaśca esyendriyasyedaṃ parimāṇamiti viśṣaparimitiniyamānuktitaśca indriyāṇāṃ vyāptisiddheti cediti|etatpratikṣipatineti| tatrahetutramayāprayaditi|prayatāṃ sarveṣāṃ tanubhya utkrāntestadā deśāntaragamāt punarāgamoccetyarthaḥ|nanvindriyāṇāmaṇutve durakatārthapratītiḥ kathaṃ syādityāśaṅkyāhavṛttyeti| vṛttirāpyāyanārthairbhūtaiḥ ityanyatroktam|vṛttiḥ prasaraṇam, taddhi āpyāyakairbhūtairjāyate|ayamarthaḥ
yadyapīndriyāṇāmaṇutvam, tena svarūpavibhūtvābhāve'pyāpyāyanārthairbhūtairbrahmāṇḍodaravartikṛtsnavastugrahanārūpaṃ vibhūtvaṃ saṅghaṭata iti|yathā cakṣuṣo gālakāntasthitatve'pi tatprakāśāt sarvatodikkaprasarādaṇḍodaravartivastugrahaṇaṃ kāṇādānām|tarhindriyopāsanavidhipare vākye indriyāṇāmanantatoktiḥ kathamtyāśaṅkyāhasvakāryairiti|indriyakāryairityarthaḥ|parimitānyapi hindriyāṇi pratibandhakābhāve'saṃkhyātānviṣayān gṛhṇantīti pradīpaprakāśādivad dṛṣṭameva|nanu sarvendriyakandabhūte hṛdaya eva tattattanuṣvindriyāṇāmavasthāne kathaṃ pṛthutvamityāśaṅkyāhakandeti|vikāridravaytvāt sarvatodikkaprasarātpṛthutvaṃ yujyata ityarthaḥ||
pūrveṇaiva tulyanyāyatayā siddhaṃ śreṣṭhasyāpi prāṇasyotpādyatvamupajīvya tattatsvarūpaviśeṣacintā kriyate|tadarthavicārastukiṃ śreṣṭhaprāṇo vāyumātratatvaṃ tatkriyā vā, atha kañcana viśeṣamāpanno vāyuriti| atra pūrvoktanītyā prāṇasyāpi śreṣṭasya parajanitvatvaṃ sthāpitameva|tasya svarūpamevādhunā vicāryate|kiṃ dehāntarvāyumātraṃ kiṃ vā tatkriyāmātrāmiti|etadanuvadatiprāma iti|ubhayamapi netyāhaneti|tatra hetumāhapṛthagiti|"etasmamājjāyate prāṇo manassarvendriyāṇi ca" iti prāṇasya "khaṃ vāyurjyotiḥ" ityuktavāyunā saha pṛthakapatpattivādāt dravyavarge paṭhanācca dravyatvameva sanucetam|itthaṃ vāyutvaṃ vāyukriyātvañca nirastam|tarhi tattvāntaratvaṃ syādityāśaṅkya pariharitaneti|tattvāntaratvābhāve hetumāhatejastva ityādinā|yathā vāyutvāvasthāparityāgena tejastvāvasthāparityogena prāṇatvāvasthāprāptirasti cet tattvāntaratvaṃ syāt na caivamasti tasmādvāyuviśeṣa eva prāṇa iti||
"śreṣṭhaśca" ityatra śreṣṭhaprāṇasyāpi brahmakāryatvaṃ tulyanyāyasiddhaṃ pratipādikam|tasya ca " na vāyuktiye pathagupadeśāt " ityatra svarūpaviśeṣo varṇitaḥ|adhunā punaraṇutvamupavarṇyate| tadarthavicārastukiṃ prāṇassarvagato'thavā'ṇuriti|kiṃ " sama ebhistribhirlokaiḥ " ityānantyavyapadeśā vibhutvamavagamayati neti|kiṃ " prāṇamanutkrāmantaṃ sarve prāṇā anutkrāmanti " iti prāṇasya gatiśravaṇamānantyaśravaṇasya prāṇāyattāsthititvena stutyarthatvena gauṇatvavagamayati neti|atra " sama eṅistribhirlokaiḥ " iti trailokyasāmya vacanāt sa jagadvyāpako bhavatviti pūrvapakṣamāhauktaityādinā| tatpritipakṣapatiayuktamiti|tatra hetumāhajīveti|jīvasya indriyāṇāñca dehādutkrāntiśśrūyate tathā prāṇasyāpi tena vibhutvaṃ na ghaṭate; utkrāntigatyāgatīnāṃ bādhādityarthaḥ|" sama ebhistribhirlokaiḥ " icyādiḥ sarvasāmyaśrutiriha kathamtyāśaṅkya stutyarthatvena nirvaharatistutyartheti|stutāvapi hetumāhakaraṇeti| ayamarthaḥkaraṇakṣetradhṛtyādihetau prāṇe dehaviṣaye buhapakārakatvamasti|saca vṛttibhedairdaśadhā vibhaktaḥ prāṇaḥ|dṛśyate hi prāṇāpānavyānodānasamānarūpena pañcavidho vāyuḥ|tadhā nāgakūrmakṛkaradevadattadhanañjayabhedenāpi pañca vāyavo hyāyurvedādipraliddhā yogatantre vistṛtāśca tacopakārakatvabhedād bhinnāḥ|tena stutiviṣayatvaṃ yujyata iti|
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye " saśreṣṭhānāṃ prāṇānāṃ brahmaṇa utpattiriyattāparimāṇañcoktam|teṣāṃ prāṇānāmagnyādidevatādhiṣṭhitatvañca pūrvameva " abhimānivyapapadeśasitu viśeṣānugatibhyām " ityanena sūtreṇa prasaṅgādupapāditam|jīvasya ca svabhogasādhanānāmeṣāmadhiṣṭātṛtvaṃ lokasiddham| "evamevaivaṣa etānprāṇāngṛhītvā sve śarīre yathākāmaṃ parivartate " ityādiśrutisiddhañca|tadidaṃ jīvasyāgnyāditevatānāñca prāṇaviṣyamadhiṣṭhānaṃ kiṃ svāyattamuta paramātmāyattamiti viśaye iti| tadarthavicārastujyotirādīnāmagnyādīnāṃ jīvasyacendriyādhiṣṭhānāṃ kiṃ paramātmāyattamuta svāyattamiti|kiṃ teṣāṃ tatratatra nairapekṣyapratītissamīcīnā, uta bhrāntimūleti|kiṃ nairapekṣyapratītau bādhakaṃ pramāṇamasti naveti|tatra pūrvapakṣamālapatibhoktṝṇāmiti|tattaccharīre bhokṝṇāṃ jīvāṇāṃ cakṣurādyadhiṣṭhātṛṇāṃmagnyādidevatānāmapi dehendriyādyadhiṣṭhānaṃ neśvarādhīnam| tatsvātantraya pradānāditi|  ayamarthaḥ īśvaraḥ khalu sāmānyena sarveṣāmapi cetanānāṃ jñānacikīrṣāprayatnādipradānena svatantryamāpādayati| teneśvareṇa dattasvātantryā jīvaḥ karaṇakalebāvarādyadhiṣṭāne svayameva pravartanta iti yuktam| tannirākaroti  neti| tadeva vivṛṇoti  tanubhṛta iti| ayamarthaḥ  sarve tanubhṛto jīvā īśvarasya śarīrameva| śarīrañca niyatādhiṣṭheyaṃ niyatavidheyaṃ niyataśeṣañceti niraṇaiṣuḥ| tena niyataparatantrā eva jīvāḥ| "tatsṛṣṭvā|tadevānuprāviśat " "tena vinā tṛṇāgramapi na casati" ityādipramāṇaśatapratipannatvāt| tena rājasāmānyanītiḥ kvacidapīśvaraparatantre na syādeva| sāmāntāḥ khalūcchvāsacintitanimiṣitādikāryeṣu svatantratā api rājājñāmapayanuvartante| nacaivamīśvaraparatantreṣu svātantryagandho'pyasti| tatra dṛṣṭāntamāhaprāṇānyāyaditi| nahi jāgarāvasthāyāmeva prāṇiti, apitu suṣuptyavasthāyāmapi| nahi suṣupta ucchvāsādau svatantrabuddhyā pravartate, apitvīśvaraprerita eveti hi bhavatāmapi siddhāntaḥ| tarhi kāryavargeṣu kartuḥ prabhutvamasti jīvasya karaṇapreraṇādiṣu svātantryābhāve kathaṃ tatprabhutvamityāśaṅkya pariharati prabhutvamiti jīvānāṃ svaśakyaviṣaye prabhutvamapi paramātmaparatantrameva prayojyakartṛtvāt| īśvarasyaiva prayojakakartṛtvāt| samudralaṅghanādāvaśakyakārye kartṛtvaprasaṅgo'pi nāstīti vaktuṃ svaśakyata ityuktam||
pūrvaṃ "tamutkrāmantaṃ prāṇo'nūtkrāmati prāṇānutkrāmantaṃ sarve prāṇā anūtkrāmanti" iti jīvotkramaṇe pradhānaprāṇasahitānāṃ sarveṣāmapi prāṇānāmutkramamityuktam| tatrendriyaśabdavācyatvaṃ kiṃ
sarveṣāmapi prāṇānāmuta pradhānaprāṇavyatiriktanāmiti vyavahāraviśeṣaniyamārthaṃ punarārābhyata iti saṃṅagatiḥ|
tadarthavicārastu kiṃ sarve prāṇā indriyāṇi, uta mukhyaprāṇavyatiriktā iti| kiṃ śrotrādiṣu mukhyaprāṇe ca prāṇaśabda ekanimittena vartata uta nimittabhedeneti| atra pūrvapakṣī manyate  prāṇo'pi hṛṣīkamindriyaṃ
syāditi| bhṛśamiti|jīvopakārakatvamevahīndriyāṇāṃ svabhāvaḥ, tattu prāṇe utkrāntyādikaṃ nirvahati lokadṛṣṭametat| tena prāṇa eva pradhānendriyamiti| uktaṃ pratiṣedhati  neti|tatra hetumāha pṛthagiti| "etasmājjāyate prāṇo manassarvendriyāṇi ca" iti, "prāṇāmanūtkrāmantaṃ sarve prāṇā anūtkrāmanti"iti ca prāṇa iti pṛthagabhidhānena tasyendriyebhyo bhedāt| tarhi "manassarvendriyāṇi" iti manaso'pi pṛthagabhidhānanindriyatvaṃ syādityāśaṅkye samādhatte kaṇṭhoktāditi| " manaṣṣaṣṭhānīndriyāṇi " iti manasaḥ kaṇṭhoktādindriyatvāt śrutahānirmā bhūditīndriyatvaṃ ghaṭata eva| tarhīndriyāṇīti sāmānyenoktatvāt manasa indriyatvavacane paunaruktyamiti punarāśaṅkya pariharati gobalīvardanītiriti| vaiṣamyāntaramapyāha na prāṇa iti| indriyalakṣaṇaṃ hi sāttvikāhaṅkāravikṛtitvam, tanmanasi vidyate tena lakṣaṇābhāvānna prāṇasyendriyatvam| athāpi prāṇaśabdavācyatvamātreṇendriyatvaṃ syāditimandāśaṅkāmutthāpya pariharati śabdeti| na hyakṣaśabda vācyatāmātreṇa vibhītakādīnāmindriyatvamasti nāpīndriyādīnāṃ vṛkṣaviśeṣatvamityarthaḥ||
atra peṭikāsaṅgatirbhāṣye " bhūtendriyādīnāṃ samaṣṭisṛṣṭirjīvānāṃ kartṛtvañca parasmādbrahmaṇa ityuktaṃ purastāt| ( purastāditi tṛtīyapāda ityarthaḥ) jīvānāṃ svendriyādhiṣṭhānañca paramātmāyattamiti cānantaraṃ sthirīkaraṇāya smāritam| (anantaramasminpāda ityarthaḥ) yā tviyaṃ nāmarūpanyākaraṇātmikā prapañcavyaṣṭisṛṣṭi sākiṃ samaṣṭijīvarūpasya hiraṇyagarbhasyaiva karm, uta tejaḥ prabhṛtiśarīrakasya parasyābādi sṛṣṭivat hiraṇyagarbhaśarīrakasya parasya brahmaṇa itīdānīṃ cintyate| " iti|
ayamarthaḥ atra tṛtīyapādādārabhya itaḥ pūrvamekā peṭikā|tatra bhūtendriyasamaṣṭisṛṣṭinirūpaṇam, atha vyaṣṭisṛṣṭinirūpaṇamiti peṭikāsaṃṅgatiḥ| vyaṣṭiścopakaraṇatvāt tatsṛṣṭinirūpaṇamiti pādasaṅgatiḥ| pūrvādhikaraṇe "khaṃ vāyurjoyatiḥ" ityādau paramātmakartṛtvamuktam,adhunāpunarvyaṣṭisṛṣṭirjīvātmakartṛkatayā pratibhātīti śaṅkotthānenāvāntarasaṃṅagatiḥ| idañcābhipretaṃ jīvopakaraṇānāṃ prāṇānāmutpattyādikaṃ nirupitam| tairjīvasya saṃyogakaraṇaṃ hi vyaṣṭisṛṣṭeḥ paramātmakartṛkatvamuktam, adhunāpunarvyaṣṭisṛṣṭirjīvātmakartṛkatayā pratibhātīti śaṅkotthānenāvāntarasaṅgatiḥ| idañcābhipretaṃ jīvopakaraṇānāṃ prāṇānāmutpattyādikaṃ nirupitam| tairjīvasya saṃyogakaraṇaṃ hi vyaṣṭisṛṣṭiriti ca saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ brahmaṇassākṣātsarvakāraṇatvaṃ śrutamupapadyate uta neti| tadartha vyaṣṭināmarūpavyākaraṇaṃ kiṃ hiraṇyagarbhamātrakartṛkamuta tadavasthabrahmakartṛkamiti| tadartha "anena jīvena" iti jīvasāmānyasya kartṛtvaśrutiḥ kiṃ jīvasamaṣṭyāśrayakevalahiraṇyagarbhakartṛkatvamavagamayati, uta jīvamātraviśiṣṭaparamātmakartṛkatvamiti| tadartha kiṃ kevalahiraṇyagarbhakartṛkatve trivṛtkaraṇanāmarūpavyākaraṇayoḥ śrūyamāṇayorekakartṛtvaṃ ghaṭitaṃ neti| tadartha kiṃ trivṛtkaraṇe hiraṇyakarbhasya kartṛtvaṃ saṃbhavati neti| tadartha kiṃ trivṛtkaraṇaṃ hiraṇyagarbhopattisthānabhūtāṇḍasṛṣṭeruttarakālikaṃ vā pūrvakālikaṃ veti| tadartha kiṃ "nāmarūpe vyākarot| tāsāṃ trivṛtaṃ trivṛtamaikaikāmakarot" iti pāṭhakramo'ṇḍāntarvartitrivṛtkaraṇapradarśanamannādīnāṃ trivṛtkaraṇa śrutiśca trivṛtkaraṇasyāṇḍasṛṣṭyuttarakālikatāvamagamayati neti| kimete trayo hetavaḥ prabalā uta durbalā iti| teṣāṃ prābalye trivṛtkaraṇasyāṇḍasṛṣṭyuttarakālikatāvagamakatayā tasya haraṇyakarbhakartṛkatvasambhavena trivṛtkaraṇanāmarūpavyākaraṇayoḥ kartraikyaśrutyupapatteḥ "anena jīvena" iti nirdeśasya hiraṇyagarbhamātrakartṛkatvajñāpakatayā vyaṣṭināmarūpavyākaraṇaṃ hiraṇyagarbhamātrakartṛkamiti parabrahmaṇassākṣātsarvakāraṇatvaṃ na syāt| pāṭhakramādīnāṃ durbalatve trivṛtkaraṇasyāṇḍasṛṣṭyuttarakālikatvāsiddhestatra hiraṇyagarbhasya kartṛtvāsambhavena trivṛtkāraṇanāmarūpavyākaraṇayoḥ kartraikyāyogāttadupapattyarthaḥ "anena jīvena" iti nirdiśasya jīvasamaṣṭiśarīrakaparamātmakartṛkatvāvagamakatayā vyaṣṭināmarūpavyākaraṇaṃ hiraṇyagarbhaśarīraparamātmakartṛkamiti parabrahmaṇassākṣātsarvakāraṇatvamupapannamiti sidhyati| atra pūrvapakṣavādī manyatemanvārdyaimaharṣibhissarasijavasatireva nāmarūpavyākaraṇa kartṛtvena kathyate smaryate ca "nāmarūpañca bhūtānām" iti| na ca smṛtimātram, śrutirapi "anena jīvena" iti| ataścāreṇānupraviśya parabalaṃ saṅkalayānīti preṣyakṛtyakramo'treti śaṅkatemanvādyairiti| uktamapratipakṣipatitanneti| tadeva vivṛṇotieka iti| eka eva hi praveṣṭā "anena jīvenātmanānupraviśya" iti, trivṛtamakṛta "tāsāṃ trivṛtaṃ travṛtamekaikāmakarot|" iti, "nāmarūpe vyākarot" iti cādhītaḥ| tena trayāṇāmekakartṛkatvaṃ siddham| tarhi kathaṃ caturmukhakartṛke paramātmanaḥ kartṛtvamityāśaṅkyāhatattaditi| yathā "tatteja aikṣata" "tadapo'sṛjata" ityādau tejaḥprabhṛtiviśiṣṭasya paramātmanaḥ kartṛtvam| evaṃ caturmukhādiviśiṣṭasya paramātmana eva samaṣṭisṛṣṭāvapi kāraṇatvamityarthaḥ||
atra parapakṣoktaprakriyāṃ svapakṣeṇa bhaṅktvā " anena jīvena " iti vākyārthaṃ viśiṣya śiṣyaśikṣāyai viśadayan nigamayati yā jīvene ti| " anena jīvenātmanā " iti śrutirna jīvabrahmaṇoraikyamācaṣṭe| prāgeva pūrvameva| eka enāntarātmā, sarvaṃ tasya vapuriti śrutismṛtisūtropabṛṃhaṇādibhirnityasiddhabhedopapādanāt| evaṃ paroktamarthaṃ nirasya paramātmana eva nāmarūpavyākaraṇavadanupraveśe'pi kartṛtvaṃ jīvaviśiṣṭaveṣeṇeti nigamayati teneti| evamupapādanāttadviśiṣṭo jīvaviśiṣṭa eva nāmarūpavyākaraṇavadanupraveśe'pi kartā| svakaraṇakatayā jīvaśarīrakayā| " karaṇaṃ sādhakatamakṣetragātrendriyeṣvapi " iti karaṇaśabdasya gātravācitvāt| athavā svasyaiva sādhakatamatayā| īśvaro hi vivakṣitaḥ kārakāṇi bhavantīti
nyāyena sādhakatamatayā karaṇatayāpi vyapadeṣṭuṃ śakyate| svatantrayā kartṛtvena vyavahārassuprasiddha eva| jīvasyaiva praveśakartṛtvapakṣe pradhānabhūtaṃ doṣamāha jīva iti| jīvasya praveśakartṛtva katvāśrutirnaghaṭate, jīvasya praveśakartṛtvādīśvarasya nāmarūpavyākartṛtvāditi||
nanvaṇaḍamadyasthitimatyagnyādau rūpabhedaisrivṛtvamuktam, " yadagne rohitaṃ rūpam" ityādinā| " annamaśitaṃ tredhā vidhīyate " ityādāvidameva trivṛtkaraṇaṃ viśadamuktamiti caturmukhasyaiva trivṛtkaraṇakartṛtvamiti kaścinmandaḥ prāha agnyādāvityādinā | tatpratikṣipati maivamiti| tadeva vivṛṇoti brahmāṇḍeti| " nānāvīryāḥ " iti śloke trivṛtkṛtānāmeva bhūtānāṃ sṛṣṭisāmarthyamityuktam, aṇḍasraṣṭeḥ pūrvaṃ trivṛtkaraṇābhāve kathaṃ brahmāṇḍasṛṣṭirbhavatu| yattu " annamaśitaṃ tredhā vidhīyate " iti tena tredhā pariṇatimātramucyate napunasrivṛtkaraṇam| trivṛtkaraṇaṃ hi nāma trayāṇāmekīkaraṇaṃ napunarvibhāgaḥ| iyaṃ tridhoktā pariṇatiḥ| itarat bhūteṣu bhūtāntarasannikarṣasya dṛṣṭiḥ pradarśanamityarthaḥ||
atra pāde'dhikaraṇāṣṭakārthānvibhajya vyācaṣṭe akṣaṇāmityādinā| indriyāṇāṃ janma teṣāmekādaśatvaṃ saṃkhyā parimāṇañcāṇutvaṃ mukhyaprāṇasya svarūpaṃ tasyaiva mukyaprāṇasyāṇutvaṃ devatānāṃ jīvānāñca mukhyāmukyaprāṇādhiṣṭhāne pāratantrayaṃ tatra mukhyaprāṇasyānindriyatvaṃ bahuvidhacidacidvayaṣṭināma rūpavyākaraṇaṃ svanābhiprabhavacaturmukhaśarīrakādādyāt samaṣṭisṛṣṭo tejo'bannādiśarīrakatvena tattatkāryasṛṣṭihetoḥ pañcīkaraṇahetubhūtāt paramapuruṣāt parabrahmabhūtādeva bhavatītyete'rthā viśadamuciro prāṇapāda iti||
pūrvapādābhyāmeva parapakṣapratikṣepaḥ kṛtaḥ uttarayoranayoḥ pādayoḥ kimavaśiṣṭaṃ pratikṣepyamityanuyuñjānasya kasyacidatyantabālakasyātrāpi pratikṣepyapakṣān krameṇa prāha nityatvamityādinā| viyadadhikaraṇe tāvat vyomni nityatvaṃ vātādiparamāṇuṣu nityatvaṃ puruṣe jñānarūpatvābhāvena pāṣāṇavat muḍhatvaṃ śrotrādāvākāśatvādikaṃ manasi vibhutvaṃ nityatatvāntaratvaṃ prākṛtavastunyatirekeṇa nityatattvānantararūpatvaṃ mukhyāmukhyaprāṇeṣvātmādibhāvaṃ svargibṛnde devatāsamūhe svaniyāmyaniyamane svātantrayeṇa kartṛtvaṃ tadvajjīvānāmapi svakaraṇādhiṣṭhānasvātantrayaṃ nirmuktayantrakrameṇa nirjarāṇāmadhipe'pi pitāmahe svātantryeṇa nāmarūpavyākaraṇakartṛtvamapi vadatāṃ vādināmetasminpādayugme bhaṅgaḥ ityarthaḥ||
avirodhādhyāyasya mṛṣāvādipakṣāviruddhatvamevetyāha tarkairityādinā| ayamatra vikalpaḥ kiṃ vyāvahārikasatyaistarkairavirodhaḥ kathyate kiṃ pāramārthikasatyairiti| nādyaḥ avirodhasthāpakānāṃ tarkāṇāṃ vyāvahārikasatyatve paramārthato vyāhatissthāpitaiva syāt| nāparaḥ vastuvṛttyāsamyagbhistarkairyadyavirodhaṃ vadasi tadā svābhimānoparodhaḥ| cinmātravyatiriktārthasya pāramārthyopapādane'pasiddhāntaḥ| tadidamāha samyagmiriti| evaṃ dūṣaṇamuktvā phalitamāha teneti| avirodhādhyoyo'yaṃ boddhabandhormṛṣāvādino hi viruddha eva| kathaṃ tarhi " tarkāpratiṣṭhānāt " iti sūtrakāreṇa nirastaistarkairbhavatāṃ parapakṣapratikṣepa ityāśaṅkyāha sotrīti| dvayaṃ khalu tarkajātaṃ śrutiviruddhamaviruddhañceti tena tarkāpratiṣṭhānavacanaṃ " ārṣa dharmopadeśañca " ityuktaprakāreṇa vedaviruddhatarkaviṣayatayā yojyam| na punarvedeti kartavyatārūpatarkaviṣayamiti kṛtamanena kṛpaṇajananirāsaprayāsena||
evaṃ siddhaviṣayanirūpaṇaparapūrvadvikacintā kṛtā| atha sādhyaviṣayanirūpaṇaparottaradvikacintāyāmutpattikrameṇa caturthādhyāyanirūpaṇīyasādhyāṃśātpūrvaṃ sādhanacintā tṛtīye kriyata iti dvikasaṅgatiḥ, adhyāyasaṅgatiśceee etatsarvaṃ "atikrānta" ityādinā savistaraṃ bhāṣyaevoktamiti tatraiva draṣṭavyam| tṛtiyādhyāyapādadvandasaṃgatirapi tatraiva bhāṣye suvyaktamuktā| "upāsanārambhābhyarhitopāyaśca prāpyastuvyatiriktavaitṛṣṇā ceti| tatsiddhayarthaṃ jīvasya lokāntareṣu sañcarato jāgratassvapatassuṣuptasya mūrcchataśca doṣāḥ, parasya brahmaṇastadrahitatākalyāṇaguṇākaratvañca prathamadvitīyayoḥ pādayoḥ pratipādhyate" iti| adhikaraṇasaṅgatiruttaratra bhaviṣyati| atra kaściccodayatisādhyetimuktissādhyā? na vā? nacet sādhanādhyāyaklṛptirviphasā prasajati| sādhyā cet sā muktirnaśvarī syāt|
tataśca kathaṃ punarāvṛttiśūnyo'pavargassyāditi| tadetatpratikṣapatimaivamiti| pratikṣepaprakāraṃ darśayatibrāhmeti|
parabhajanavatā puruṣeṇa prāgasiddhaiva sādhyā| tarhyanubhūtessādhyatvādanityatvaṃ syādityāśaṅkya paramataprakriyayaiva
anityatvaṃ pariharati dhīsaṅkoceti| jñānasaṅkocapraṇāśa eva brahmānubhūtiḥ| pradhvaṃsasya ca kṛtakatve'pi praṇāśo nāstīti paravādino'pi vadanti| tena brahmānubhūtiḥ praṇāśarūpatvāduttarāvadhirahitetyarthaḥ| ayamarthaḥasmatpakṣe'pi bhāvāntarābhāvāṅgīkārādbhāvaevābhāvo'pi syāt| "na ca punarāvartate" iti pramāṇabalātnityatvasiddhiśca| dhiyo vikāsassvābhāvika eva vedāntasiddhānte| upādhivaśātsaṅaakoco jātaḥ| tasminsaṅkoce nivṛtte svābhāviko vikāsaevāvatiṣṭhata iti hi "sacānantyāya kalpate" iti śrutyaiva sākṣāducyata iti||
atra tṛtīye'dhyāye pūrvottarapādadvandvayorarthavibhāgaṃ caturṇāmapi pādānāmarthabhedaśca darśayati pādābhyāmiti| vairāgyapādobhayaliṅgapādābhyāṃ bhavināṃ jīvānāṃ brahmavidyādhikāraṃ janayati paścāt ubhābhyāṃ pādābhyāṃ teṣāmevajīvānāmaṅgāssahitāṃ tāmeva brahmavidyāṃ pradarśayatītyarthaḥ| caturṇāmapi pādānāmarthabhedānanukrameṇa darśayati aiśvrayādāviti| aiśvaryādau viraktirvairāgyapāde, ubhayaliṅgapāde tu niravadhivibhave paramapuruṣe niratiśayābhilāṣotpattiḥ, guṇopasaṃhārapāde tu vidyābhedāvalambhaḥ vidyāṅgapāde punarvidyopakaraṇasaṃpattiriti vibhāgaḥ||
atra kaścidacūcudat vedāntaśravaṇavelāyāṃ viraktaevāditaḥ pravartate tena prāgeva vairāgyasya siddhatvāt punastṛtīyādyapāde vairāgyasampādanaṃ na kartavyamiti| taditamāha saṃsāreti| asmin śārīrakaśāstre saṃsārodvigracetā jīva evādhikaroti| ataśśāstrārambhaeva vairāgyaṃ siddham| punaratra vairāgyapādaḥ kimarthamārabhyata iti| ardhāṅgīkāreṇottaramāha satyamiti| diṃvavidhaṃ hi vairāgyaṃ śāstraśravaṇaupayikaṃ tāvadekam, upāsanānuṣṭhānaupayikañcānyadvairāgyam| tadatra nirupyata iti na pādārambhanaiṣphalyam| tadetadviśadayati prāpyeti|
"ete vai nirayāstāta sthānasya paramātmanaḥ" iti paramātmasthānāpekṣayā svargādīnāṃ nirayatulyatānusandhānamupāsanārambhopayuktaṃ tadasminneva pāde sidhyatīti saphalo'yaṃ vairāgyapādārambhaḥ| tadidamāha muttayupāyaprārambhe'myarhitaṃ syāditi| tadeva viśatayati tvarata iti| spaṣṭadṛṣṭasvabodhaḥ paramapuruṣassarvaśeṣī ahaṃ punassūrivannityameva tadanubhavayogyaḥ athāpi karmavaśāt saṃsārāmīti spaṣṭadṛṣṭasvajñānavān pūrvaṃ vyādhatvenāvasthitarājakumāravat svasvarūpasya samyagavalokanena punarasaṅkucita brahmānubhavāya tvarata ityarthaḥ||
pūrvādhikaraṇe "saṃjñāmūrtiklṛptistu trivṛtkurvata upadeśāt " ityatra mūrtiprasaṅgaḥ kṛtaḥ| adhunā punarekāṃ mūrtiṃ parityajya deśāntare mūt ryantaraprāptau kiṃ pūrvamūrtisaṃgatabhūtasūkṣmaiḥ pariṣvakto yāti neti vicāryate| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ dehāntaraṃ gacchan jīvo bhūtasūkṣmairdehabījaissampariṣvakto raṃhati utāsampariṣivakta iti| " vettha yathā pañcamyāmāhutāvāpaḥ puruṣavacaso bhavanti " iti tu pañcamyāmāhutāvāpaḥ puruṣa vacaso bhavanti iti praśnapratinacane kiṃ sampariṣvaktasya raṃhaṇaṃ gamayato neti| kiṃ śraddhādiśabdairavasthāviśeṣāpannānyabādidravyāṇyucyante, uta tatpariṣvakto jīva iti| kiṃ kevaleṣṭāpūrtakāriṇāṃ pitṛyāṇena nivartane " eṣa somo rājā " iti somaśabdasya somadehajīvaparatvaṃ " tasyā āhutessomo rājā saṃbhavati" iti somaśabtasya somadehajīvaparatāmavagamayati neti|
atra pūrvapakṣamāha dehādhyamiti| pūrvadehānniṣkrāntasya puruṣasya deśāntaraprāptau tatratatraiva dehendriyādikaṃ karmānurupamapūrvaṃ sidhyatyeva yathā tatra bhogyamupalabhyate| tasmātpūrvadehāt gṛhītaiḥ prāṇādhyairbhūtasūkṣmaiśca sampariṣvakta eva yātīti kalpanāgauravaṃ syāt| nanu jīvasya gamanaṃ bhūtasambandhamantareṇa kathaṃ ghaṭata ityāśaṅkyāhajīvasyeti|
parimitamānatvaṃ hi gamane kāraṇam| tenāṇorjīvasya gamanamaṇutvādeva saṅghaṭate| dravyāntarasaṃyuktasyeti kalpane gauravameva doṣaḥ| īśvara eva " ūrdhvaṃ prāṇamunnayatyapānaṃ pratyagasyāpi" iti prāṇanītyā jīvasyāpi gatiṃjanayatīti|
uktaṃ pakṣaṃ pratikṣipati maivamiti| tadeva vivṛṇoti khacchandeti| yadhyatheśvaraḥ karotīti śrutipramitaṃ tattathaiveti prāmāṇikairabhyupagantavyam| napunarīśvarakṛtye śrutisiddhe gauravādi doṣa udāhāryaḥ | ānumānikyāṃ hi kalpanāyāṃ gauravadoṣamudāharanti nyāyavādinaḥ| śrutipramitaniyatau svacchandakṛtye gauravābhidhānasyāyuktatvādityabhedhyo'yaṃ hetunirdeśaḥ||
nanu pañcāgnividhyāṃ bhūtasūkṣmaiḥ pariṣvakto jīvo yātīti bhavadbhirucyate, tatra ko'yaṃ bhūtapañcakavācakaśśabdaḥ śraddhāśabdaeva jalavācaka upalakṣaṇanyāyena bhūtapañcakaṃ vadatīti cet; śraddhāśabdasyaiva kathaṃ jalavācakatvamityāśaṅkyobhayīmapi śaṅkāṃ pariharatyanukrameṇa nānājātīyetyādinā| ayamarthaḥ loke'pi jano nānādravyasaṅghātarūpe vastūni bahudravyanāmnaiva vyavaharatīti drṛṣṭameva ghṛtapracuramauṣadhaṃ ghṛtameveti| śraddhāśabdo jalavācakatvājjalasaṃsṛṣṭāni bhūtāntarāṇyacapi vadatīti| nanvanyabhūtavācakaśśabdaḥ kathamanyasyāpi bhūtasya vācaka ityāśaṅkya dehe jalasya bhūyastvājjalavācakaśśabdo bhūtāntarāṇyapi vadatīti yuktamevetyāha prācuryāditi|
śraddhāśabdoktanyāyo'yaṃ " pañcamyāmāhutāvāpaḥ puruṣavacaso bhavanti " ityapchabde'pi samāna ityāha evamiti| tarhi ekabhūtena sṛṣṭiḥ kiṃ na syādityāśaṅkyāha vyaṣṭimiti| pañcīkṛtaireva hi bhūtairdehādiṣu sarvatrāpi sṛṣṭirdṛśyate| tatra tāratamyamapi dṛśyate| vātapittaśleṣmācivaiṣamyaṃ tattadbhūtavaiṣamya prācuryādeva hi deheṣu jāyate|
taditamāha tāratamyamiti| śraddhāśabdaḥ kathaṃ salilavācīti dvitīyaṃ codhyamavaśiṣyate tatrottaram  śraddhāśabdasviti| tatra hetumāha nigama iti| "śraddhā vā āpaḥ" iti nigame śraddhāsamākhyāvatvenāpāmukteḥ||
atra kāni pañcāgnitvena parikalpyante kāni vā hotavyāni ke ca te hotāra ityāśaṅkya sarvametadvicya darśayati  dhyauriti| dhyauḥ parjanyaḥ pṛthivi puruṣo yoṣiditi pañcāgnayaḥ| parikarasahitānityagnikalpanopakaraṇasāhityamucyate| śraddhāsomavarṣānnaretāṃsi hotavyāni| śraddhākhyaṃ bhūtasūkṣmaṃ kramapariṇāmena somavarṣānnaretorūpaṃ bhavatītyanvayaḥ| sajīvamiti jīvasahitaṃ bhūtasūkṣmamityarthaḥ| bhūtasūkṣmaviśiṣṭo jīvo hotavya iti bhāvārthaḥ| jīvasyaiva prādhānyāt| tanutaramarutaḥ pitṛdehadhārakamaruto juhvatītyarthaḥ||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye "kevaleṣṭāpūtadattakāriṇāṃ dhūmādinā pitṛyāṇena pathā gamanaṃ karmaphalāvasāne punarāvartanañcāmnātaṃ " yāvatsampātamutvāthaitamevādhvānaṃ punarnivartante" iti| tatra pratyavarohan jīvaḥ kimanuśayavān pratyavarohati uta neti saṃśayyate iti| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ yāvatsampātamuṣitvā athaitamevādhvānaṃ punarnivartante iti āmnāto nivartamānassānuśayo nivartate uta niranuśaya iti| kiṃ "yāvatsampātam" iti vākyaṃ sampātaśabdasya phaladānapravṛttakarmaparatvābhāvena sarvakarmaparatvāt niranuśayasya nivartanamavagamayati neti| kimatra sampātaśabdaḥ karmamātrapara uta phalapradānapravṛttakarmapara iti| kiṃ " tadhya iha ramaṇīyacaraṇā abhyāśo ha yat te ramaṇīyāṃ yonimāpadhyeran" iti vākyaṃ sampātaśabdasya phalapradānapravṛttakarmaparatāmavagamayati neti| kiṃ "ramaṇīyacaraṇāḥ" iti caraṇaśabda ācārapara uta karmapara iti| atra pūrvapakṣī manyate iṣṭāpūrtādīti| śrautasmārtaṃ karma yadhyadiha karoti tatkṛtsnamapi svargādau sthalāntare bhuktvā tadante punarihāyāti| ato niranuśāya evāyāti| anuśayo nāma phaladayaparyantamātmanyanuśeta iti karmavarga ucyate| tena sarvaṃ karma bhuktvā svayamevāyātīti pūrvapakṣiṇo'bhiprāyaḥ| tatpratikṣipatiityasaditi| atra hetumāhadṛṣṭabādhāditi| sarveṣāmapi karmaṇāṃ paratraivopabhogādanantaramāgamane karmānurūpaṃ keciccaṇḍālayonimāpadhyante kecidbrāhmaṇayonimiti dṛṣṭaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ bādhyeta|kiñca "prāpyāntaṃ karmaṇastasya" ityatra kātsnrye karmaṇo'ntaṃ prāpyeti na śrūyate| tenopabhujyamānasya karmaṇo'ntaṃ prāpya karmāntareṇa sahāgacchatīti kāryānurūpaṃ spaṣṭametat| yuktyantaramāpyāha sukṛteti|
ramaṇīyacaraṇā ramaṇīyāṃ yonimāpadhyeran kapūyacaraṇāḥ kapūyāṃ yonimāpadhyeranniti sukṛtaduṣkṛtaphalatvena jātibhedādhyayanāt| uktamarthaṃ nigamayati tasmāditi| prārabdhaśeṣaistaditarasahitairiti ayamarthaḥ karmavibhākaśāstreṣvekasyaiva karmaṇassvargādiphalaṃ tadante punaraihikaphalamapi bhoktavyatvenābhidhīyate| tena prārabdhaphalamapi karma bhuktvā tadavaśeṣeṇābhuktaphalena karmāntareṇa ca yuktaḥ punarāvartata iti sarvapramāṇāvirodhena netavyamiti| svargapāntha iti "gatāgataṃ kāmakāmā labhante " iti pramāṇamupadarśayati|
atra " yathetamanevañca " iti sūtrakhaṇḍe gamanāgamanayorvaiṣamyasyābhidhānāt tadeva vaiṣamyaṃ darśayatidhūmamiti|dhūmaṃ rāntiṃ timirakaluṣitaṃ pakṣaṃ dakṣiṇāvṛttimāsān paścātpitṛlokaṃ gamanaṃ candramapi mṛtaḥ karmī prāpnoti|
pratyāvṛttau tu candrādgamanaṃ gaganādvāyuṃ tato dhūmaṃ tasmādabbhraṃ abbhrānmegham, atrābbhrameghaśabdau cārthabhedādapunaruktau, apo bibhartītyabbhraśabdena kathyate megha eva| " miha secane " iti secamāvasthāviśiṣṭaveṣeṇa sa eva megha itpucyate|
vrīhyādīn pitṛbhakṣaṇīyavrīhyādīnityarthaḥ| retassigiti janaka ucyate| atha jananīṃ yātītyanvayaḥ| yātanācakravartīti yātanācakre vartate ityarthaḥ| athavā saṃsāravatrmani sarvatra iti cakravartī||
atra pūrvapakṣavādī manyate pūrvakṛtakarmaśeṣeṇāvaruhya jātyādikaṃ prāpnotīti bhavatoktaṃ tannopapadhyate kapūyacaraṇāḥ kapūyāṃ yolimityādinā vākyena caraṇasyaivopādānāt tasya ca kevalācāramātratvāditi| tadidamāha ācāreti| āgatasya jātibhogādikaṃ kevalācāramātrasādhyaṃ syāt caraṇavacanāt| nanu ācāra eva karma karmevācāra ityāśaṅkya vibhāgamāha karmeti| śrūyate hi " yānyanavadhyāni karmāṇi tāni sevitavyāni " yānyasmākaṃ sucaritāni" iti| tadidaṃ pratikṣipati na saditi| tatra hetumāha gatyabhāvāditi| ācārasya śabdasya karmavācakatve'pi karmācārayordvayorapi tasminvākye dṛṣṭatvād gatyabhāvena śabdasāphalyārthaṃ tathākathanam|
tadevopapādayatimukhyamiti| vṛtyāpravṛtyā karmaṇyapi mukhyaṃ caraṇavacanaṃ naikadeśe ācāramātre nirodhyam| puṇyaṃ karmācarati, pāpaṃ karmācarati, iti hi prayogaprasiddhirupalabhyate| evaṃ jātyādiḥ karmabhedaprabhava iti karmavipāka
śāstraistatratatra "caṇḍālaḥ pretya jāyate" śucināṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo'bhijāyate" iti pramite sati ācārasādhyamacintyameva na cintyamityarthaḥ| drṛḍhatarapramāṇapramitatvāt| drṛśyate hyācārasādhyatayā " sandhyāhīno'śucirnityamanarhassarvakarmasu " ityādāvuttarakarmādhikārādikam||
atra prasaṅgādācārasyāvaśyakartavyatvamāha  prāpteti | itthaṃ kila kaścinmanute karmānuṣṭānādeva svargādisiddhiḥ, kimanenācāreṇeti| tatrottaraṃ prāptetyādi| prāptānāṃ sandhyāvandanādīnāmṛtivṛttau ṛṣayaḥ pratipadaṃ pratyavāyānāhuḥ| uttarakarmānadhikārādīndoṣānityarthaḥ| tadanusaraṇataḥ ācārānusārāt| prācīnapāpapraṇāśañcāhuḥ| " yadahvā pāpakārṣam " ityādibhiśśrūyate| "śucinā karma kartavyam" ityādinā punarācārānusārāt puṇyakarmārhatāñcāhuḥ| evametairhetubhiḥ satkarmamātrāt tridiva iti dhiyaivācārasya parityāgo nārha ityāha nāta iti| atra pramāṇaṃ darśayati " ācārahīnaṃ na punanti " ityādikam nāhīti|ācāraprīhīṇe puruṣe śvadṛtijalasamo vedavargaśśodhako na bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye "kevaleṣṭāpūrtadattakāriṇaścandramasaṃ gatvā sānuśayā eva nivartanta ityuktam| idānīmani niṣṭādikāriṇo'pi candramasaṃ gacchanti neti saṃśayyate " iti| tadarthavicārastu kimaniṣṭādikāriṇo'pi yamayātanāmanubhūya candramasaṃ gatvā nivartanta uta neti| kiṃ " ye vai keca " iti vākyamaniṣṭādikāriṇāmapi candrama saḥ prāptimavagamayati neti| kimatra sarvaśabdaḥ pretamātraviṣayaḥ utaṣṭādikāripretaviṣaya iti| kiṃ pitṛyāṇagamanamaniṣṭādikāriṇāmeveti| kiṃ "ya ime grāma iṣṭāpūrta "ityupakramaḥ pitṛyāṇasyeṣṭādikārimātraviṣatvamavagamayati neti|
" vettha yathā kenāsau loko na sampūryate" ityasya prativacane " athaitayoḥ pathoḥ " ityupakramasya " jāyasya mriyasvetye tat tṛtīyaṃ sthānaṃ tenāsau loko na sampūryate " ityetasya svarlokārohābhāvaḥ, tṛtīyasthānasya pañcamāhutimantareṇa puruṣatvaniṣpattimavagamayati neti| atra pūrvapakṣamāracayati sarveṣāmiti| sarvaṣāṃ dehāpāte sati niyamavatī candramasaḥ prāptiruktā, tasmātpāpottarāṇāmadhikapāpopahatānāmapi nirayugatipuraskāriṇī candraprāptiriti| uttaṃ pratikṣipatineti| pratikṣepameva vivṛṇoti loka iti| ayamarthaḥ " candramasameva te sarve gacchanti " iti sarvasabdāsaṅkocārthaprevahyaniṣṭādikāriṇāmapi candramasaḥ prāptirbhavatocyate| " tenāsau loko na sampūryate " iti vacanabalātsaṅkoco na doṣa iti| uktamarthaṃ nigamayati ta iti| aniṣṭādikāriṇaste yamaśāsanena tadhyātanānte candramasa prāpyaiva kutsitāṃyoniṃ pratipadhyanta iti||
nanu pañcamāhutyapekṣayā janmavatāṃ janma kathyate kathaṃ tarhi pāpottarāṇāṃ pañcamāhutimantareṇa janma bhavatītyāśaṅkyāha janmeti| jarāyujaprabhṛtīnāṃ janma tāvat pramāṇapratipannameva| athāpi pañcamāhutyāpekṣā vaktuṃ na śakyata eva pitṛśarīrānmātṛśarīrapraveśādarśanāt| kathaṃ tarhi pañcamāhutyapekṣāvacanamityāśaṅkyāha bhūyiṣṭairiti|ayamarthaḥ pañcamāhutyapekṣāvacanaṃ sāmānyam| tattu yatrāpavādo nāsti tatraivāvakāśaṃ labhate nānyatra| bhūyiṣṭādṛṣṭajanmāno draupadīdhṛṣṭadhyumnādayaḥ pañcamāhutiṃ nāpekṣante| evaṃ jarāyujādayo'pi bhūyiṣṭapāpajanyatvāt| tadvadeva pañcamāhutyapekṣāvat dhūmādimārgo'pyavadanavānityarthaḥ| asminnarthe sukṛtaviśeṣādatiśayitādbrahmalokaprāptiparyantaṃ svatassiddhadivyadehādiparigraheṇa prayātāḥ katikati śrūyante| ta eva pañcamāhutyanapekṣadehaparigrahe dṛṣṭāntatayāpādeyā ityarthaḥ||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye iṣṭādikāriṇo bhūtasūkṣmapariṣvaktāssānuśayāścandramaso'varohantityuktam| avarohaprakāraśca
"athetamevādhvānaṃ punarnivartante yathetamākāśamākāśādvāyuṃ vāyurbhūtvā dhūmo bhavati dhūmo bhūtvābbhraṃ bhavatyabbhraṃ bhūtvā megho bhavati megho bhūtvā pravarṣati " itivacanāt| yathetamanevañcetyuktam| tatrāsyākāśādipratipattau devamanuṣyādibhāvavadākāśādibhāva uta tatsādṛśyāpattimātram" iti| tadarthavicārastu " yathaitamākāśam " ityākāśādibhāvo devamanuṣyādibhāvavadākāśādidehāpattiruta tatsādṛśyāpattimātramiti| atra kaścinmanyate pañcasvāhutiṣu prathamacaramayorāhut yordehavatvaṃ nirvivādameva " tasyā āhutessomo rājā sambhavati " "pañcamyāmāhutāvāpaḥ puruṣavacaso bhavanti " iti dehavatvasya prakaṭameva kathanāt| tathā ākāśavāyuprabhṛtiṣvapi janmaiva syāt puruṣasya, somo rājā bhavatīti prathamaśrutasya bhavaterdhātoranvayāditi| tadetadāha āhutyoriti| tannirākaroti āsāramiti| tadeva prakaṭayati retassigiti| yathā pitṛśarīrapraveśe kevalaṃ saṃsargamātram, evamākāśādibhāve'pi saṃsargaviśeṣāt pṛthagabhidhānānarhatāmātramevākāśādivādinā śabdenābhidheyamityarthaḥ| uktārthe hetumāha dhyubhvoriti| madhye śarīraparigrahe śarīrasya puṇyaphalabhogārthatvāt puṇyaphalamapi śrūyate| naca kaścidupabhogo dṛśyate ityarthaḥ||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye " ākāśaprāptiprabhṛti yāvadvrīhyādiprāpti kiṃ tatratatra nāticiraṃ tiṣṭati utāniyama iti viśaye iti| tadarthavicārastu kimākāśaprāptiprabhṛti vrīhyādiprapteḥ prāgākāśādiṣu ciraṃ tiṣṭhatyutācireṇa niṣkrāmatīti| vrīhyādiprāptau " ato vai khalu durniṣprapataram " iti durniṣprapataratvābhidhānamanyatrāciraniṣkramaṇamavagamayati neti| atra pūrvapakṣamāha vyomādīti| atra jīvasya vyomādisthityavasthā ciramaciramiti vyaktameva viśeṣanirdeśābhāvānmātṛśarīre śuklāvasthānyāyenāniyatireva syāt| śuklāvasthā hi paripūrṇagarbhaparyantamavasthāne ciraṃ madhye pāte punaciramiti dṛṣṭameva| nirākaroti neti| tatra hetumāhasvārasikyā iti| " ato vai khalu durniṣprapataram " iti svārasikyāḥ vākyapravṛttevidhyamānatvādityarthaḥ| tadeva svārasikatvamāhavrīhyādibhya iti|
vrīhyādibhyo hi durniṣprapataramiti viśeṣavacanamitarebhyaḥ suprapataratvamācaṣṭe| tena pūrvaṃ vākyaśaktyaiva śīghraṃ tattadṛśāyāstyajanamiti parijñāyate| viṣayaviśeṣe durniṣprapataratvābhidhānamitaratra durniṣprapataratvaṃ niṣedhatītyarthaḥ||
bhāṣya eva saṅgatirvyaktā " avarohanto jīvā vrīhyādibhāvena jāyanta iti śrūyate megho bhūtvā pravarṣati " ta iha vrīhiyavā oṣadhivanaspatayastilabhāṣā jāyante " iti| te kimanyairbhāktṛbhirvrīhyādiśarīrairadhiṣṭhitān vrīhyādīnāśliṣyanti, uta te bhoktāro vrīhyādiśarīrā jāyanta iti viśaye jāyanta iti vacanāddevo jāyate manuṣyo jāyata itivadvrīhyādiśarīrā eveti prāpte ucyate " iti| tadarthavicārastu avarohato jīvānprati " ta iha vrīhiyavā oṣadhivanaspatayastilabhāṣā jāyante " iti śrutiḥ kimanyabhoktṛśarīrabhūtavrīhyādiśarīrā jāyanta iti gamayati neti| jāyanta iti vacanaṃ kiṃ devojāyate manuṣyo jāyata itivadutpattiparamuta sambandhamātraparamiti|jāyanta iti śravaṇasya "kapūcaraṇāḥ " ityādivat karmasambandhābhāvassaṃśleṣamātraparatāmavagamayati neti| atra pūrvapakṣī manyate janmeti| vrīhyādibhāvena jāyanta iti hyatra janmaiva śrūyate| ata idaṃ janmadevatvamartyatvavatsyāt| nanu sthāvarāṇāṃ nairātmyameva| tena kathaṃ sthāvarabhāvena jīvasya janmeti kaścidāha|tadidaṃ vedāntabahiṣṭhasya vacanamityāha nairātmyamiti| imaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ nirākaroti neti| tadeva vivṛṇoti puṇyasyeti|
pañcāgnividhyāyāṃ hīṣṭāpūrtādikarmakāriṇāṃ puṇyaphalamabhidhīyate| evaṃ prādhānyena puṇyaphalamabhidhānaprasaṅge "śarīrajaiḥ karmadoṣairyāti sthāvaratāṃ naraḥ " iti sthāvarajanmaprāptirūpaṃ pāpaphalamabhidhīyata iti na yuktametat| tarhi "jāyante" iti sākṣājjananaṃ kathamabhidhīyata ityāśaṅkyānyādhiṣṭhite pitṛśarīre yathā janivacanaṃ tathānyādhiṣṭhate vrīhyādiśarīre'pi janivacanamavarohato jīvasya aupacārikamiti na kaścidvirodhaḥ||
atra kaściccodayati"ddaṣṭavadānuśravikassa hyaviśuddhikṣayātiśayayuktaḥ " iti sāṅkhyāhiṃsāyogādaṃśenāviśuddhatvaṃ yajñādīnāṃ vadanti| tena puṇyāṃśaphalaṃ svargādi pāpāṃśaphalaṃ tu vrīhyādibhāvaḥ, ataḥ puṇyaphalaprasaṅge'pi pāpaphalābhidhānaṃ yuktameveti| tadetadanuvadatihiṃseti| paśvālambhādirūpahiṃsāyogādaśuddhaṃ śrutivihitamapīṣṭādikaṃ taditi nyāyyam| ataḥ sukṛtī vrīhyādibhāvaprabhṛtiṣu pāpāṃśaṃ bhuṅkta iti| anūditamarthaṃ pratikṣipati ayuktamiti| tatra hetumāhaukteti| mantrairarthavādaiśca paśuhitamityeva khalveṣā hiṃsoktā| "na vā u etanmriyase " ityādirmantraḥ| atharvavādo'pi " hiraṇyaśarīra ūrdhvaṃ svargaṃ lokameti " iti| nanu śrutirapi yogyamevārthaṃ brūyāt|
duḥkhajananarūpasya saṃjñapanasya kathaṃ paśuhitatvamityāśaṅkya ddaṣṭāntenopapādayati taccikitsāvaditi| loke hi adhikasukhaprāptihetubhūtamalpaduḥkhātmakaṃ śastralavanakṣārāgnikarmādikaṃ hitamityevābhidhīyate tadvadityarthaḥ| nanu tarhi bandhuvadho'pi hitassyādityāśaṅkya hitāhitavibhāgaśśāstraikasamadhigamya ityabhiprāyeṇāhabrūta iti| " yadvai kiñca manuravadattadbheṣajam " ityuktavacanaprāmāṇyaśālī bhagavānmanuryajñe vadhasya vadhatvameva nāstītyāha| hiṃsātvaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ| aśāstrīyamārgeṇa prāṇaviyojane hiṃsātvaṃ prasajyate| yathā rājñāṃ yuddhe śastruvadho na hiṃsā| yathā vā coravadhaḥ| tasyaiva sarvatra viṣayabhedena hi puṇyāpuṇyavyavasthā| ātmahananamapi kvacitpuṇyakoṭimāṭīkate " brāhmaṇārthe gavārthe vā samyakprāṇānparityajet "| tena na yajñādiṣu hiṃsā na ca tatphalānubhavaḥ, nāpi vidhispṛṣṭo doṣaḥ, nāpi hiṃsakatvaṃ vaidikānāmiti ramaṇīyametat| nanu jñānaprasaṅgeṣvitihāsapurāṇeṣu kvacit kvacit karmanindā ddaśyate tatkathamityāśaṅkyāhastautīti| nahi nindā nindhyaṃ nindituṃ pravartate apitu ninditāditarat praśaṃsitumiti nyāyena tatratatra vivakṣitajñānādipraśaṃsārthaiva karmanindā| nacātyantamavaśyakartavyakarmanindā adhyātmaśāstreṣu phalasaṅgakatṛtvādinindāyāmeva tatra tātparyāt| tātparye hi śabdaḥ pramāṇamiti hi tāntrikāḥ| anyathā "karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśyet " ityādikaṃ sakalamapi gītāśāstraṃ lolupyeteti||
atra kaścidāha kimanena kathañcitsamādhānena| sāṅkhyāḥ khalu tattvavidagraṇyāḥ saṃjñapanaṃ doṣamāhuḥ|anyathā kathaṃ purāṇādibhiḥ piṣṭapaśūpādānādiprasaṅga ucyata iti| itthaṃ khalu sāṅkhyānāmabhiprāyaḥ "na hiṃsyāt " iti niṣedho rāgaprāptahiṃsāviṣayaḥ| "ālabheta " iti vaidhahiṃsā vidhiprāptā| vidhiniṣedhayorvirodhe vihitavyatiriktaviṣayo niṣedha iti viṣayabhadena vidhiniṣedhavyavasthā kartavyeti mīmāṃsakā vadanti| tanna yujyate virodhe satyeva hi viṣayabhedena vyavasthā kāryā| sa evātra na vidhyate| saṃjñāpanavidhirhi paśvālambhanena kratusādguṇyamāha| " na hiṃsyāt " iti niṣedho hiṃsāyāḥ pāpahetutvam| ekameva karma vidhiniṣedhābhyāmubhayamapi sukhaduḥkhātmakaṃ kāryaṃ karotīti ko virodhaḥ| tena saviṣānnabhakṣaṇanyāyena hitāhitarūpaṃ yajñādikamiti| tadanuvadati karturiti| sāṃkhyabhaktā iti parihāsavacanam| ukte'pi yukte mārge punaḥ punaḥ paricodakaḥ kevalaṃ bhaktyaiva sāṅkhyasiddhāntaprakriyāṃ pralapatītyarthaḥ ayamatra nirṇayaḥahitatvaprasaṅgameva nivārayituṃ sayuktike mantre cārthavāde ca jāgrati mahājanaparigrahādālambhanavidhivacanaprāmāṇye ca tiṣṭati kathaṃ sāṃkhyaḥ pāpasaṅkaraṃ pravadediti| tadidamāhanirdhūta iti| kathaṃ tarhi purāṇe tihāsādiṣu piṣṭapaśvādikalpanaṃ kathyata ityāśaṅkya tadapi kālaviṣeśaniyatadharmaviśeṣatvānna virūdhyata ityāha piṣṭeti| yathā ghaṭikāvyavasthādiviśeṣāddharmavyavasthā dhārmikaireva parigṛhyate, evamihāpīti na kaścidvirodhaḥ||
punarapi sāṃkhyapakṣe doṣāntaraṃ samuccinoti kiñceti| tadupapādayati utsargeti| ayamarthaḥ yadhyapi " svargakāmo yajeta " ityādiṣu kāmyavidhiṣu svargarāgāttatsādhanakratūpakārakahiṃsāyāṃ puruṣaḥ pravartata iti tatra hiṃsāṃśasya pāparūpatvāt tatphalaṃ vrīhyādisthāvarabhāvenānubhūyata ityucyate| tathāpyatra utsargāpavādanyāyaṃ jahatastava "śaradi paśumālabheta " ityādi nityahiṃsā kathaṃ sidhyet| tatra hiṃsā nityaprāptā na rāgajanyā| nanu tatrāpi rāgo'sti sarvavarṇināmapi svadharmānuṣṭhāne'parimitasukhaprāptivacanāditi cet na nityakāmyalopaprasaṅgāt|
tadidamāha kīddaśī nityahiṃseti| nityahiṃsaiva na sidhyedityarthaḥ| nanu piṣṭādināpi nityatvasiddhervirodho nāstīticet tatrāha tava hīti| sarvatrotsargāpavādanyāyaṃ jahatastavetyarthaḥ| śrutipurāṇādiṣu pañcamahāyajñaprastāve " pañcasūnā gṛhasthasya vartante'harahastathā"| khaṇḍanī peṣaṇī ityādinā peṣaṇāderapi hiṃsātvakathanāt tava vihiteṣu niṣedhāviṣayaḥ kiṃcidapi nāstyeva|evamastviti cenna mantrārthavādavirodhasya pūrvamevoktatvāt| nanu " vivāhakāle ṛtusamprayoge " ityādinā " anākrośyamākrośyānṛtaṃ voktvā trirātramakṣāralavamabhojanam " iti cānṛtakathanaṃ vidhāya tatprāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate tatra kathamiti cet satyaṃ tatrāgatyā tadāśrayaṇamityāha yatrāsatyādivaidhamiti| itaravaditi anṛtakathanavidhānavat prāyaścittavidhānamapi syādityarthaḥ| athavā tatra vihite doṣasadbhāvena prāyaścittaṃ na vidhīyate| kiṃtu jāteṣṭivannaimittikameva kiñcittadvidhīyata iti na vidhineṣedhayorekaviṣayatvamityāha athavā kevalaṃ tannimittamiti| tat anṛtakathanaṃ putrajananavannimittamātramityarthaḥ||
etasya pādasya sāṃkhyamāyāvādinoḥ pakṣanirākaraṇe viśeṣeṇopakārakatvaṃ darśayati āśliṣṭamiti| evaṃ kila sāṃkhyāḥ prāhuḥ kecinmāyāvādinaśca| bādhakairdehādibhiraśliṣṭaṃ nabho musalairiva kṣetriṇaṃ prāhuḥ| nahyākāśo musalaprāhārairbādyate evaṃ bādhakairdaihādibhissāṃkhyamṛṣāvādhyuktamātmatatvamapi na bādhyate'saṅgatatvāditi| itthaṃ phalabhoktṛtvaṃ nāstītyuktvā kartṛtvamapi nāstītyāha karmākartāramiti| atrāpyāhurityanuṣajyate| tarhi jīvasya kartṛtvābhāve kutra phalamityāśaṅkyāhaphalamityādi| jīvopādhibhūtāhaṅkāraniṣṭhamityarthaḥ| tarhi sāṃsārikaphalamastvahaṅkārādeḥ, mokṣaḥ kasyetyāśaṅkya mokṣo'pi prakṛterityāhaavyaktasyeti| " saṃsarati badhyate mucyate ca nānāśrayā prakṛtiḥ, iti hi māṅkhyaprakriyā| "tasmānna badhyate nāpi mucyate nāpisaṃsarati kaścit " iti jīvasyānādimuktatvamevāhuḥ|" puruṣastu sadā puṣkarapalāśavannarlepaḥ" iti sāṅkhyānāmākhyānam| atra sarvatrāhutiryan vayaḥ | idaṃ sāṅkhyamṛṣāvādinorabhimataṃ jīvasyaiva saṃsārasambandhapratipādanāt sūtrakāro nirācakāretyāha teṣāmiti ayaṃ vairāgyapādaḥ sāṅkhyamṛṣāvādinormataṃ bahirakṛta nirācakāretyarthaḥ| atrāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ sāṅkhyānāṃ prakṛtissatyā prakṛtisambandhaprayuktāḥ sukhaduḥkhādayo doṣā mithyetipakṣaḥ| mṛṣāvādināṃ punarmāyāpi mithyā tatsambandhaprayuktasaṃsāro'pi mithyeti pakṣaḥ| pakṣadvayamapi saṃsārasambandhapāramārthyapratipādanena nirākṛtamityarthaḥ||
atroktānāṃ ṣaṇṇāmadhikaraṇānāmarthabhedān vibhajya darśayati pāda iti| asminpāde ṣaḍarthāḥ pratipādhyāḥ|
tānevārthānanukrameṇāha vapuriti| vapurdehaṃ vijahajjīvo bhūtasūkṣmaissaheyādityeko'rthaḥ| aparastu bhuktasvargassānuśaya eva yathetamanevañcāvarohediti| tṛtīyaḥ punarnirayapathajuṣāṃ narakamārgeṇa gacchatāṃ candrāvāptirna syāditi|
caturtho'pyākāśādisāddaśyameva na punastadrūpeṇa janmeti| ākāśāderavarohaśśīghraeveti pañcamaḥ| ṣaṣṭho'pi paraśarīre vrīhyādau ciraṃ yogamātramiti| yogastusaṃsargamātramityarthaḥ||
iti tṛtīyādhyāye prathamapādaḥ samāptaḥ
atra vairāgyarapādānantaramubhayaliṅgapādārambhamākṣipya samdhatte brahmaiveti| pūrvamubhābhyāmadhyāyābhyāṃ sarvairapi svaiḥ svabhāvairanvitaṃ brahma pratyapādi| ayañca sādhanādhyāyaḥ| asminnadhyāye samanvayāvirodhādhyāyapratipādhyasya brahmaṇaḥ punarākṛṣya cintā kimartheti codakābhiprāyaḥ| codhyaṃ nirākaroti maivamiti| ayamatrābhiprāyaḥ satyamayaṃ sādhanādhyāyaḥ| athāpi brahmacintā viśeṣataḥ kartavyaiva| sādhanaṃ hi dvividham sādhyopāyassiddhopāyaśca| siddhopāya īśvaraḥ| sādhyopāyassadvidhyādibhedavatī tadbhiktireva| vidhyābhedaśca rūpabhedāt| rūpañca vidhyāyāḥ prādhānyena vedhyaṃ brahmaiva| tasya ca bhedastadguṇabhedāt| evañca sādhanādhyāyapratipādhyasādhanarūpabhaktiviṣayatvena svayañca siddhopāyatayā
sādhanatvena sādhanādhyāye brahmacintā viśeṣeṇa saṅgacchata iti| tatra brahmacintanasya vidhyopakārakatvaṃ tāvadāha vidhyā iti| taddhi tadrūpabhedāditi tad brahmaviśadīkaraṇaṃ tadrūpabhedāt tadguṇabhedāt tenobhayaliṅgatvādiviśeṣaṇopetaṃ brahmātra cintanīyamityarthaḥ| asya siddhopāyatvapratipādanārthaṃ brahmacintanaṃ saphalamityāhasiddheti| dvaṃkhalu viśeṣataḥ pratipādhyam brahmaṇassiddhopayatvaṃ siddhaprāpyatvañca| etadubhayapratipādanaṃ prāpye brahmaṇi tṛṣṇāviśeṣasiddhayartham| tṛṣṇāviśeṣābhāve khalupāyādhikāra eva puruṣasya na syāt| svargakāmo hi yāgādiṣvadhikurute evaṃ parabrahmaprāptikāmo hi brahmopāsaneṣvadhikuryāt| tathā cobhayaliṅgapāda upāsanānuṣṭhāne viśeṣeṇopakarotīti śarīrakaśāstrasāro'yaṃ pāda iti na nairarthakyaprasaṅgaḥ| tṛṣṇāprathimna iti tṛṣaṇābhivṛddhayarthamityucyate|abhivardhate hyatra tṛṣṇā " sa svenaiva phalapradaḥ " ityuktaprakāreṇa svaprāpakatvena svayameva brahmaṇi parijñāte iti bhāvaḥ||
kiṃñca akhilaheyapratyanīkakalyāṇaikatānatāpratipādanaparo'yamubhayaliṅgapādo mṛṣāvādiprabhṛtīnāṃ pareṣāṃ pratikṣepe viśeṣeṇopakarotīti saphalaevetyāha  nairguṇyamiti| brahmaṇo nairguṇyaṃ cet guṇopasaṃhārapādādhikaraṇeṣūbhayaliṅgapādapratipāditakalyāṇaguṇabhedairbrahmavidhyāvibhāgo vitathassyāt| nanu kalpitaireva guṇairbrahmāvidhyāvibhāgassyāditi parapakṣamanuvadati so'sviti| tat pratikṣipati śrutimatavihatiriti| anādinidhanāvicchannasampradāyatayā pratipannasya śrutyarthasya kalpitatve kimakalpitaṃ syāt? tathā ca guṇānāṃ kalpitatvaṃ vadan vedāntabahirbhūta ityarthaḥ|
nanu vedānte'pi "mano brahmetyupāsīta " ityevamādiṣu "garuḍamātmānaṃ jānīyāt " ityādivad ddaṣṭividhirddaśyate tadvadatrāpi syādityāśaṅkya nirākaroti nātreti| ekatrāgatyā ddaṣṭividhiparigrahe sarvatrāpi tathaiva syāditi na vaktuṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ| anyatrānyaguṇāropeṇānusandhāne hi ddaṣṭividhiḥ| brahmaṇastu satyatvajñānatvādikaṃ svarūpaguṇatvavādabādhyamityarthaḥ| evaṃ kalyāṇaguṇaikatānatvapratipādakapramāṇavirodhāt mṛṣāvādino doṣamuktvā nirdoṣatvapratipādakapramāṇavirodhādapi mṛṣāvādipakṣasya duṣṭatvamāhanirdoṣatvamiti|brahmanirdoṣatvañca nityameveti pramāṇānusāreṇa yadi vadasi tathā brahmavyatiriktasya saṃsarato jīvasyābhāvād brahmaṇo nityanirdoṣatvācca mudhā nirarthaka eva saṃsārarūpadoṣaśāntyartho vedāntaśravaṇādiprayāsa iti nairarthakyameva śāstrārambhasya| tarhi nirdoṣatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kalpyamiti vadāma iti parasyābhiprāyamāśaṅkya pratikṣipati kalpyamiti| nirdoṣatvaṃ kalpyaṃ cet duṣṭataiva brahmaṇaḥ prakṛtisyāditi punaśśāstrārambhavaiyarthyamiti pareṣāṃ pratikṣepāyobhayaliṅgapādassaphala eva||
itthaṃ nirviśeṣatvasya mithyātve doṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā punassatyatvaṃ vadato bambhramyamāṇasya mṛṣāvādino bahūnapi doṣānāhakiñceti| brahmaṇo nirviśeṣatvapāramārthye brahmajijñāsā kartavyeti ādau cintyatvavādo na syāt, tathāpramāṇagocaratvamapi tathaiva svasiddhāntasārabhūtaṃ svayamprakāśatvamānandarūpatvaṃ viśvādhyāsādhiṣṭhānatvaṃ "bahusyām" iti svasya bahubhavanasaṅkalpaḥ| etāddaśaṃ sarvamapi guṇajātaṃ nirviśeṣe brahmaṇi kathaṃ syāt? na kathaṃcit syādityarthaḥ| ete guṇā yadi paramārthāstadā saguṇavādaprasaṅgaḥ| aparamārthāścet svayamprakāśatvānandatvayorapyaparamārthatve svasiddhāntasya mūlocchedaḥ| bauddhādibhyo vaiṣamyañca kiṃ syāt? ayamarthavirodha uktaḥ|śrutivirodhamapyāha
sarveti| śrutipramāṇavirodhamuktvā svavacanavirodhamapyāha svavacaneti| pratyakṣādikṛtsnapramāṇaviruddhavāditvādikaṃ mṛṣāvādinassuprasiddhameva " durghaṭatvamavidhyāyā bhūṣaṇaṃ natu dūṣaṇam " iti| tad bhūṣaṇaṃ ced brahmaivāvidhyā, niradhiṣṭhāna eva bhramaḥ, niṣprakāśameva brahmetyādikamapyatyantadurghaṭaṃ śreṣṭhameva bhūṣaṇaṃ syāditi mādhyamikavijayatūryameva joghuṣyeta|māyāvaiyātyetyādi māyādhāṣrṭyāt kaṣṭāṃ daśāmāpannānāmaṣṭapādakalpanāṃ mṛṣāvādināmiha guṇopasaṃhārapādapratipādhyaṃ sakalamapi saguṇopāsanaṃ samūlonmūlanamarhatīti sarvaśāstravyākopaḥ||
asminnubhayaliṅgapāde yadi brahma cintyamucyate tarhi jīvasya svapnādhyavasthākathanaṃ kathaṃ saṅghaṭetetyāśaṅkyasvapanādiddaṣṭirapi bhagavatsaṅkalpādeva sidhyatīti tatpradarśanasyāpi bhagavanmāhātmyapradarśaparatvādasminpāde saṅgatiryujyata iti pariharatityaktamiti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥdoṣaistyaktaṃ guṇāḍhyaṃ brahma yadi punariha cintyeta tarhi jīvasya svapnādhyavasthamananamatha vairāgyapādānantaramasminpāde kathaṃ saṃghaṭeteti śaṅkā| tāmimāmāṃ nirākaroti neti| tadeva vivṛṇoti svapneti| svapnārthasyāpi bhagavāneva sraṣṭati tatsraṣṭṛbhāvaprabhṛtibahuvidhabrahmamāhātmyasiddhayai tathā asya jantossvamuktāvatyanta paravaśatājñaptaye caitajjīvasya svapnādhyavasthāmananamatra kriyate|
ayamarthaḥ na jīvassvaprādhānyenātrocyate, api tu paramātmano jagratsvapnasuṣuptyādisarvāvasthākatṛtvapratipādanārtham iti paramātmaivāsminpāde sarvatra prādhānyenocyata iti||
atra kecidāhuḥ  " asminnubhayaliṅgapāde pūrvārdhaṃ jīvaparaṃ vairāgyapādaśeṣabhūtam, uttarārdhaṃ paramātmaparamiti|
etadanuvadati  pādasyeti| paścārdhamatrāsminpāde sākṣādanughaṭitamupāstyartha tattadbhagavadguṇokteriti|
idamekadeśimataṃ nātīva hṛdhyamiti nirākaroti etaditi| tatra hetumāha śabaliteti| saṅkīrṇakathane cāturīvaiparītyāditi| tarhi pādapūrvārdhe jīvadoṣagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamityāśaṅkya brahmaguṇābhivyaktyarthamiti pariharati brahmeti|saṃsarato jīvasya kathane hi saṃsāramocakasya paramātmano māhātmyaṃ sidhyatītyarthaḥ|śabdārthastu  jīvadoṣagraha iha tu mukhamupāya ityartha iti||
atra codayati " svapnasṛṣṭiḥ paramārthabhūteti bhavadbhirucyate tatkathaṃ saṅghaṭate? atītānāgatayorapi svapne darśanāt| asambhāvitatārthadarśanaṃ hi jāgare mithyā kiṃ punassvapne| atassvapnasṛṣṭirnaparamārthabhūtā " iti| tadidamāhasvapna iti| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ svapne'rthāssṛṣṭāssantu| athāpi bahuvidhā bhrāntiratra svapne dustyajā pradhavastānāṃ pitrādīnāmidānīntanavadanubhavāt svapnalabdhānāṃ suvarṇādīnāmasthirāṇāmapi sthāyitādibhramācca, ataḥ svapnasya apāramārthyaṃ tava vaktavyamiti| tadidamardhāhgīkāreṇa nirākaroti satyamiti| tatra aṅgīkṛtamanaṅgīkṛñca vibhajya darśayati śrutyādīti| śrutyādisiddhe'rthe śrutahānāyogāt sarvakarturbhagavatastatkālamātra tattatpuruṣamātrānubhāvyastusṛṣṭimaṅgīkṛtyātyantavyāhateṣvartheṣu bādhādeva jāgaravad bhrāntimaṅgīkṛtya sarvaṃ nirvahantaśśrutisiddhamarthaṃ na kṣipāma iti||
tarhi svayamekatra vartamānasya svapne deśāntaragamanaṃ pāramārthikaṃ kathaṃ syādityāśaṅkya nānāśarīraparigrahavato yogina iva viśvakarturbhagavatassaṅkalyaprabhāvāt sarvaṃ saṅghaṭata ityāha  kaściditi| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ kaścidhyogī yogaprabhāvāt svaparagṛhayossvairasañcāranyāyena pūrvadehānniṣkrānto viśati paravapurdehāntaraṃ prāpnoti| tenaiva tatra sañcārādikamapi karoti|pūrvaṃ śarīramapi bhūyassamāgatya prāpnotīti| tathā svapne pūrvaśarīraṃ parityajya bhagavatā sṛṣṭaṃ śarīrāntaraṃ svapnadraṣṭā prapnoti svapnānte pūrvaśarīraṃ pūnaḥ prapnotīti kecitpratipedire|
tadidamāha  itthamiti| pakṣāntaramapyāha śvāsavṛttyeti| ayaṃ khalvanyeṣāmabhiprāyaḥ  yadi svapne śayitaḥ puruṣaḥ pūrvaśarīraṃ parityajya śarīrāntaraṃ parigṛhṇāti, tadā pūrvasmin śarīre śvāsavṛttirna syāt| atastasminneva śarīre jīvo'vatiṣṭhate| bhagavatā sṛṣṭeṣu tu svāpneṣu śarīrāntareṣu " pradīpavadāveśaḥ " iti vakṣyamāṇānyāyena dharmabhūtajñānavyāptyā saubharinyāyasya siddhatvāt dharmabhūtajñānavyāptyaiva śarīrāntaraparigraha iti niraṇaiṣuriti||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye " evaṃ karmānurupagamanāgamanajanmādiyogena jāgrato jīvasya duḥkhitvaṃ khyāpitam| idānīmasya svapnavasthā parīkṣyate " iti| tadarthavicārastu  " na tatra rathā na rathayogā na panthāno bhavanti " ityārabhya svapnasṛṣṭirāmnāyate, sā kiṃ pāramārthikī, uta māyāmātramiti| kiṃ "sṛjate sa hi kartā " iti nirdeśaḥ pāramārthikatāmavagamayati neti| kimayaṃ nirdeśassṛṣṭikartuḥ kartṛtvaparaḥ, uta svapnajñānavatkartṛtvapara iti| kiṃ prajāpativākyāvagatasatyasaṅkalpatvasya jīvasya svapne saṅkalpamātrāt sṛṣṭissambhavati neti| ya eṣu supteṣu jāgarti kāmaṃkāmaṃ puruṣo nirmimāṇaḥ " iti jīvasya svapne saṅkalpamātrāt sraṣṭṛtvamavagamayati neti| kimidaṃ vākyaṃ jīvaparamuta paramātmaparamiti|asmin khalvadhikaraṇe svapnasṛṣṭirjīvakāryamuta paramātmakāryamiti cintyate|
atra pūrvapakṣavādī manyate uktamiti|uktaṃ hi daharavākyaśeṣabhūte prajāpativākye prajānāṃ patyā satyasaṅkalpatādhyaṃ daharavad daharākāśavajjīvasyāpi|bhavinīti saptamī| jīve ityarthaḥ| tena svasaṅkalpāt sṛṣṭissvapne jīvasyaiva samucitā| kiñcātraputrādīnāṃ sṛjyatvamucyate|putrādisambandho jīvasyaiva saṅghaṭate rathādīnāṃ jīvānukūlavastūpalakṣaṇatvāt| tena putrādikatṛtvena prakṛto jīvassvābhīṣṭaṃ svāpnamarthaḥ sṛjedityarthaḥ| imamarthaṃ pratikṣipati maivamiti|tatra hetumāha muktāviti| tāddagguṇokteḥ jīvasyāpahatapāpmatvadiguṇāṣṭakāvirbhāvasyokteḥ svapnāvasthāyāmandhaprayo jīvaḥ kathamapahatapāpmatvādiguṇāṣṭakaṃ prāpnuyādityarthaḥ| hetvantaramapyāha anabhimateti|
yadi jīvassvayameva svārthaṃ svapne sṛjati tadānīṃ niyatamevānukūlaṃ sṛjet| suptaḥ khalu kadācitpratikūlānapi svapne paśyati| tanna yujyate satyasaṅkalpatve jīvasya svapratikūlaṃ svayameva kathaṃ sṛjediti| tṛtīyamapi hetvantaramāha  svāpnānāṃ sūcakatvāditi| śuklāni sarvāṇi śubhāvahānītyevaṃ svapne'pīśvarasaṅkalpena svayamāgatāni śubhāśubhasūcakānīti pratipattavyamityarthaḥ| tasmādīśvarasraṣṭṛtvameva svapnaprapañcasya| tadidamāha nikhilajagaditi||
atra " kāmaṅkāmaṃ puruṣo nirmimāṇaḥ " iti viṣayavākye kiṃ ṇamulyapratyayenābhidhānam? kiṃ vā kāmaṃkāmamiti karmabhūtaviṣayaviśeṣābhidhānam? ityāśaṅkya bhagavatassatyasaṅkalpasya sraṣṭṛtvābhidhānārthaṃ ṇamuleva samucita ityāha  kāmaṃkāmamiti| jīvasyāsatyasaṅkalpasya kartṛtvāyogāt| tathā ca satīśvara evānudhyate|
ayaṃca paramātmā supteṣu puruṣeṣu jāgarti| tena tasyāścaryarupakāryakaraṇe kartṛtvaṃ yujyata ityarthaḥ| tasya jāgaraṇañca śratisiddhamityāha viśadamiti| " prājñenātmanā sampariṣvaktaḥ " iti hi śrūyate| nanu jāgivat svapnasyāpi paramārthasṛṣṭirūpatve kathaṃ tattatkālāvasāyitvam? kathaṃvā tattadekaikapuruṣamātrānubhāvyatvaṃ? ityāśaṅkyaniraṅkuśasvatantreśvarasaṅkalpaviśeṣādityabhiprāyeṇa pariharatitattaditi| na kevalaṃ svapna eva tattatkālāvasānakāryasṛṣṭiḥ, apitu jāgare'pi meghodayādīnāṃ tāddaktvenopalambho ddaśyate| nanu tathapyekapuruṣānubhāvyatvaṃ na ddaśyata iti cet tadapīśvarasaṅkalpāditi mantavyam| ddaśyante hi mantrauṣadhasiddhāñjanādiprabhāvat tattatpuruṣamātrānubhāvyā viṣayaviśeṣāḥ| aparyaviyājyaḥ khalvīśvarasṛjyatve hetvantaramapyāha tattatkarmānurūpaṃ phalavitaraṇamiti| svapnadarśanaṃ hi sukhaduḥkhātmakatvātkarmaphalaṃ karma ceśvarasaṅkalpaviśeṣa itīśvarāyattatvameva svāpnasyārthajātasya|
pāpī hi pāpānurūpaṃ svapnaṃ paśyati dharmottarastu tadanurūpamiti mahānayaṃ mārgassarvairapyanatilaṅghanīyaeva| etadapyuktamāptairiti  ayamabhiprāyaḥ|kasyacitkvāpi kāle śubhapraptiritasya punaraśubhaprāptiriti nimittasāmudrikatattadgrahasañcārādinā vidvadbhirabhidhīyate, pratibandhādinā yadi tanna syāt tatsvapne'pi na prāpyata iti tairevābhidhīyate, ato'pi karmaphalatvaṃ siddhaṃ svāpnasya sukhaduḥkhāderiti||
atra " māyāmātrantu kātsn ryena " iti sūtre māyāśabdaprayogamātramavalambya śrutimukhasugatā vedavādacchadmabauddhā mṛṣāvādino viśvamithyātvamāhuḥ| tanmataṃ dūṣayati  māyeti| tat prapañcamithyātvaṃ taiśśāsrārambhe kathitamiti punaratrābhidhāne paunaruktyamasaṅgatatvañca| teneśvaravicitrasṛṣṭissvapnaprapañca ityetadevātrocyate napunarviśvamithyātvam| māyāśabdamātravalambanenaiva hi mṛṣāvādināmidamabhidhānam, tadapi teṣāmanālambanamityāha  māyāśabda iti| na hi loke māyāśabdo mithyāvacana ityābhidhānikāḥ paṭhanti|
" māyā tu vayanaṃ jñānam " iti hi naighaṇṭukā jñānaviśeṣa eva māyāśabdaṃ prayuñjate| "indro māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyate" ityādāvīśvarassaṅkalpaviśeṣairnānārūpo'nubhūyata iti hyucyate| āha ca parāśaraḥ " anekaśaktirūpāṇi tatkaroti janeśvara|
devatiryaṅmanuṣyākhyāceṣṭāvanti svalīlayā||
jagatāmupakārāya na sā karmanimittajā|| iti|
līleti svasaṅkalpa evocyate| sa ca saṅkalpo jñānañca māyā, ato na māyāśabdo mithyāvācī, apitvāścaryasṛṣṭivācī, yadvā tatsṛṣṭihetubhūtaśaktiviśeṣavācī, athavā tattatsṛṣṭinidānanimittabhūtasaṅkalpaviśeṣavācī| ddaśyante hi prayogāḥ " devamāyeva nirmitā " iti| mithyātve hi kalpiteti vyapadiśyeta| anyadapi|
" tenamāyāsahasraṃ tat śambarasyāśugāminā|
bālasya rakṣatā dehamaikaikaśyena sūditam|| iti|
atra hi sūditamiti nāśyatvamevocyate| nāśo hi paramārthasataḥ pradhvaṃsaḥ| anyathā bādhyatvamevocyeta| bādho hi pratipannopādhau niṣedhyatvamiti bhṛṣāvādino vadanti| "māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ vidhyāt" iti māyāśabdasya mithyārthatvavyāvṛttyarthaṃ hi prakṛtiṃ vidhyādityucyate| ata eva " māyāmṛgo hṛtaḥ " ityatra mārīcasya pradhvaṃsa eva varṇyate| meghanādamāyādiṣvapi mantraviśeṣasādhyaparamārthasarpāṇāmeva māyeti vyavahāraḥ| kathamanyathā garuḍaprabhāvaviśeṣairnirākaraṇāyatvaṃ yujyate? kiñca sarvalokaprasiddho'yaṃ vyavahāraḥ| sāmabhedadānadaṇḍamāyendrajālopekṣā iti sāptopāyā nītiśāstreṣu nirdiśyante| tatra māyendrajālayorvaiṣamyamucyate|
mantrādiśaktiviśeṣāt paramārthasarpādisṛṣṭirmāyā| tasmādeva mantrādiśaktiviśeṣādaparamārthagajaturagarathapādātādipradarśanena parakaṭakabhañjanamindrajālaphalamiti| evamanyatrāpyudāharaṇāni draṣṭavyāni| athāpi purāṇeṣu pāmaraprayogeṣu ca mithyāviṣaye'pi māyāśabdaḥ prayujyata ityāśaṅkyottaramāha upacaratviti| na hyaupacārikaḥ prayogaśśabdasya śaktiviśeṣaṃ niyamayatītyarthaḥ| tadidamāha  kiṃ tata iti| prayogaprācuryamitihāsapurāṇādiṣvapi prācuryeṇa satyabhūtaevāsurarākṣasāstrādāveva ddaṣyata ityāha  satya iti| " meghodayassāgarasaṃnivṛttiḥ " ityupakramya " viṣṇorvicitrāḥ prabhavanti māyāḥ " iti purāṇeṣvapi paṭhyate| tarhi kṛtsnasyapi kāryasya māyāśabdavācyatve kiṃ niyāmakamityāśaṅkyāhaucitaniyamana iti| ayamarthaḥ āścaryarūpakāryaviśeṣo māyetyucyate indrajāle māyāśabdabhidhānamāścaryarūpatvāviseṣādaupacārikamiti māyendrajālayorvibhāgaḥ| " devī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyāduratyayā " iti vacanaṃ triguṇasyaiva vicitraprapcasṛṣṭihetomāryāśabvācyatvaṃ vyaktameva sthāpayati||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye " idānīṃ suṣuptisthānaṃ parīkṣyate " iti| pūrvaṃ svapno nirūpitaḥ, idānīṃ suṣuptisthānamityarthaḥ| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ nāḍīpurītahbrahmāṇi jīvasya vikalpena suṣuptisthānāni? uta samuccayeneti| kimeṣāṃ prasādakhaṭvāparyaṅkavat kāryabhedo'sti neti| " sata āgacchāmahe" iti brahmaṇaḥ prabodhaśravaṇaṃ brahmaṇaḥ paryaṅkasthānīyatāmavagamayat kiṃ kāryabhedamavagamayati neti| atra pūrvapakṣīmanyatesthānaṃ jantorityādi|
jantossuṣuptau śrutiraniyamato nāḍyaḥ purītat brahmeti ca sthānaṃ vakti vadati| tasmāt trayāṇāmapi sthānānāṃ mitho nairapakṣyāt nāḍyo vā purītadvā brahmaveti vikalpa iti pūrvapakṣaḥ| uktamarthaṃ pratikṣipatitanneti| pratikṣipameva yuktyā vivṛṇotiprāsādeti| ayamarthaḥ samuccaye kāryabhedābhāve hi vikalpo nyāyyaḥ| atra punaḥ kāryabhedena samuccayena yojitānāṃ prāsādakhaṭvāparyaṅkanyāyena nāḍīpurītadbrāhmaṇaṃ vikalpo na nyāyya eva|sa ca vikalpo'ṣṭadoṣaduṣṭa eva| tadevāhapakṣepakṣa iti| " vrīhibhiryajeta " " yavairyajeta " iti vikalpenānaṣṭhīyamānayo vrīhiyavayoḥ prathamaṃ vrīhyanuṣṭhāne yavaśāstraviṣayau dvau doṣau sto yavaśāstre pramāṇyatyāgo'prāmāṇyasvīkāraśceti|
samanantaraṃ kadācidyavaśāstrānuṣṭhāne vrīhiśāstre pramāṇyatyāgo'prāmāṇyasvīkāraśceti dvau doṣau staḥ| tasminneva yavānuṣṭhānasamaye yavaśāstre tyaktaprāmāṇyasvīkārassvīkṛtāprāmāṇyaparityāgaśceti dvau doṣau bhavataḥ| punaḥ parivṛtyavrīhiśāstrānuṣṭhānarūpe tṛtīye prayoge vrīhiśāstre tyaktaprāmāṇyasvīkāraḥ svīkṛtāprāmāṇyaparityāgaśceti dvau doṣausta iti prayogatrayādaṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvaṃ dvayorapi śāstrayoścatvāraścatvāro doṣā iti prathamānuṣṭhānavelāyāṃ dvau doṣau, dvitīyānuṣṭānavelāyaṃ catvārastṛtīyānuṣṭhānavelāyāṃ punardvau doṣāviti buddhyā vibhajya dhīmadbhirbhāvanīyam|
prakārāntareṇāpyaṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvamāhurvikalpaviṣayamācāryaḥ vrīhyanuṣṭhāne yavaśāstre pratipattyanuṣṭhānāpūrvaphalabādha iti catvāro doṣāḥ| evaṃ yavānuṣṭhāne vrīhiśāstre pratipattyanuṣṭhānāpūrvaphalabādha iti catvāro doṣā ityaṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvam|
tenāyamarthaḥgatyabhāve vikalpassvīkāryaḥ sambhavantyāṃ gatau samuccaya iti| atra tu prāsādakhaṭvāparyaṅkanyāyena samuccayasya sambhavād vikalpo na svīkāryaḥ| kramaghaṭitacaturdoṣayukta iti  prayogatrayasuddhamaṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvamanuvadati| tena prayogadvāyāditi bālakānāṃ pratibhāso duṣpratibhāsa ityarthaḥ||
saṅgatirbhāṣeye " kiṃ suṣupta eva prabodhasamaya uttiṣṭhatyutānya iti saṃśaye " iti| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ suṣuptādanyaḥ prabodhasamaye uttiṣṭhati, uta sa eveti| kiṃ suṣuptau sakalopādhivinirmoko'styuta neti| kiṃ karmānusmṛtiśabdavidhayassakalopādhivinirmokābhāvaṃ gamayanti neti| nanu suṣuptirnāma muktiprāyaiva muktiḥ kila jahadarasukhagaṇā duḥkhasaṅghātavirahitā brahmaṇyapītireva pralaya eva śrutyaivakhyāpyate tena tadanu suṣuptyanantaramudbudhyamānastanubhṛdanya eveti pūrvapakṣānuvādaḥ kriyate muktiriti|imaṃ pakṣaṃ pratikṣipatimaivamiti| muktessvāpasya viśeṣaṃ darśayatikarmānuvṛtterityādinā|pūrvakarmānuvṛtteḥ karmaphalasya sukhaduḥkhāderdarśanāt karmānuvṛttirityādibhāṣyopāttaḥ| vidhirapi suṣuptasyaiva muktatve mokṣārthavidhayaḥ kathaṃ saṅghaṭeran? ayatnalabhyasya kiṃ yatneneti| svapadanuvadanāditi"nāhaṃ khalvayamevam " ityādinā " nāhamātra bhogyaṃ paśyāmi" "vināśamevapito bhavati " iti suṣuptasyānuvadanācca| prācīna eva vinaṣṭaprāyaḥ puruṣaḥ prabuddho bhavatīti mantavyam||
atra suṣuptasyaiva prabodhasamaye punarutthānamiti kimarthaṃ sthāpyate viśeṣaprayojanābhāvadityāśaṅkyātyantopayuktaṃ prayojanaviśeṣamāha jīvānāditvamityādinā padyena| jīvānāmanāditvasiddhyarthamidaṃ sūtraṃ cet tatroktameva " na karmāvibhāgāditi cennānāditvāt"|ityādinā| mokṣe ddaṣadanukaraṇakṣepaṇaṃ mūḍhatvakṣepaṇamanena sūtreṇa kriyate cet tadapyuttaratra kariṣyate| sthāyitvopapādanena jīvānāṃ svargādhyarthapravṛttiḥ kriyate cet sāpi śrutinayaviditākṛtsnasyāpi mīmāṃsāśāstrasya sthāyitvamantareṇānupapattessvargādhyarthapravṛttirapi śrutyā tadanugrāhakanyāyena ca pūrvamevaviditā| ātmasthairyopapādanena kṣaṇabhaṅgabhaṅgaścet so'pi saugatādhikaraṇādiṣu siddhaḥ| jīvasya suṣuptāvīśvavaraikatvanirākaraṇārthamidamadhikaraṇaṃ cet tasya kalpānte'pyekatvamapi nāmarūpādiprahāṇamātrānna punassvarūpaikyādititatratatroktam| tena sāpyuktirniyamitaviṣayā| ato bhūyaścintā suṣupteḥ na kartavyeti kasyacid bālaprāyasya codhyamanūditaṃ pariharati pralayasamadaśāsajjihāsādisiddhyā iti| naiyāyikadurdurūḍhāḥ kecit pāṣāṇaprāyemeva mokṣaṃ vadanti| tarhi " nāhamatra bhogyaṃ paśyāmi " "vināśamevāpīto bhavati " iti ninditā suṣuptirapi muktissyāt, neyaṃ muktiriti manīṣibhiḥ prarthyate| evaṃ pāṣāṇavanmuktiriti vairāgyapāde tanmuktinindayā tajjihāsāviśeṣo'pi sidhyati tadarthamayaṃ prasaṅga iti na nairarthakyamityarthaḥ||
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptirūpāvasthāviśeṣān pariśodhyānantaraṃ mūrcchārūpā suṣuptitulyāvasthā vicāryata iti saṅgatiḥ|
jāgratsvapnayoḥ prajñāyuktatvāt suṣuptimūrcchayoḥ prajñāviloparūpatvāt tayormithassaṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ mūrcchā jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyādīnāmanyatamāvasthā, utāvasthāntaramiti| kiṃ lakṣaṇato bhedo vyavasthāpayituṃ śakyate neti| kiṃ sūkṣmaprāṇasambandho mūrccheti lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati neti| atra pūrvapakṣī prāha jāgratsvapnasuṣuptimaraṇabhedena catvāro hyavasthāviśeṣā loke prasiddhāḥ| tatra jāgratsvapnau bāhyajñānavirahitau na bhavataḥ suṣuptiśca śvāsapūrṇatvānna mūrcchā maraṇameva praśamitakaraṇaprāṇavargatvāditi| tadidamanuvadatijāgraditi| tatpratikṣipatineti| mūrcchāmaraṇayorbhede kāraṇabhedameva tāvat prāmāṇyatimṛtyāderiti| abhighātādimātrānmūrcchā śiraśchedādermaraṇamiti mūrcchāmaraṇakāraṇayorbhedādityeko hetuḥ| hetvantaramāpyāhasthitīti| mūcchate paryantasthitāḥ sthito vā mṛto veti viśerate| sa ca saṃśayo mūrcchāmaraṇayorvaiṣamyamāvedayati| tṛtīyamapi hetumāhautthiteriti| mūcchateṣveva kaścinmantrauṣadhādivibhāvāt punaruttiṣṭhate| mṛtastu gacchatyameva evamutthānasyāniyatatvādityarthaḥ| tarhi mūrcchetiko'yamavasthāviśeṣa ityāśaṅkyāha martumiti| martuṃ prakramya vidhinā madhye vimatīti maraṇasyārthasampattirūpāvasthāviśeṣo mūrcchetiparikalpanīyamiti| ardhamaraṇaṃ mūrcchetyarthaḥ||
atrāṣṭānāmapyadhikaraṇānāmanyonyārthabhedopapādanāt peṭikābhedamuttarapeṭikāyāmavāntarapeṭikābhedañcāha jantūnāmiti| evaṃ caturbhiradhikaraṇairjantūnāṃ jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyādyavasthāsu yadvaiśasaṃ taddarśitam| ataḥ paraṃtu sarvasthānayoge'pi svayamanaghaśubhaguṇaṃ brahma saṃśodhyata iti peṭikāvibhāgaḥ| uttarapeṭikāyāmapi pūrvabhāgasyottarabhāgasya cārthabhedena vaiṣamyamāha saṃsargetyādinā| ubhābhyāmadhikaraṇābhyāṃ doṣavatsasargamūlāṃstattādāmyābhidhānamūlāṃśca doṣān pariharati| athottarādhikaraṇadvayārthamāha hīnatveti| sarvasmātparatvābhāve niratiśayaudāryābhāvecopāsyatvāsambhavāt sarvasmātparatvahāniṃ niratiśayaudāryarahitatvaṃ cottarābhyāmadhikaraṇābhyāṃ nirākarotīti mitho vibhāgaḥ||
pūrvādhikaraṇe saṃsarantaṃ maraṇāvasthādhīnaṃ jīvaṃ vairāgyātiśayasiddhayarthamuktvā prāpyatṛṣṇāviśeṣasiddhyarthaṃ bhagavata ubhayaliṅgatvamucyata iti saṅgatiḥ| tadidaṃ vyaktameva darśayatinairguṇyamiti| atra mṛṣāvādināṃ pakṣanūdya viśeṣatastatpratikṣepapārthamevedamadhikaraṇaṃ pravṛttam| te khalvevamāhuḥ" nirguṇaṃ nirañjanam " iti brahmaṇo nairguṇyameva prāmāṇikam| tarhi " satyakāmasatyasaṅkalpaḥ " ityādi guṇavacanasya kā gatiratyāśaṅkyāha guṇavacanamiti|
avidyāparikalpitadharmārthavādamātrameva guṇavacanaṃ pralobhanārthamityarthaḥ| tarhi guṇābhāve kiṃ brahmaṇo doṣavattavameva svābhāvikamiti bhavatocyata ityāśaṅkyāha nairdoṣyamiti| ayamarthaḥ brahmaṇi nairguṇyaṃ nairdoṣyaṃ cobhayamapi svābhāvikamiti| tadidamāha vastuvattyeti| tarhi śrutipurāṇādisiddhaṃ brahmaguṇavigrahādikaṃ saṃsārasambandhaśca sarvalokaprasiddhaḥ kiṃ bhavedityāśaṅkyāhataditaraditi| uktametadekadeśamātramasmābhiḥ| itthamevaṃ jīveśvaraiśvaryāpaharaṇapravṛttakuhanāvādamomuhyamānān nirākartuṃ " na sthānatopi " ityadhikaraṇamārabhyate| anekaśrṛṅgambahuprakāramityarthaḥ||
" doṣadarśanāt " ityādinā bhāṣye saṅgatirvyaktā| pradarśitā cāsmābhiḥ pūrvameva| tadartha vicārastu suṣuptyut krāntyādisthāneṣu sthitasya jīvasya ye bhavantyapuruṣārthāḥ, te tadantaryāmiṇastaccharīrasyāpi prasajyante neti| kiṃ jīvasyāpuruśārthasambandhaśśarīrasambandhanibandhanaḥ, uta karmasambandhanibandhana iti| kiṃ saśarīrasyāpi brahmaṇa ubhayaliṅgatvaṃ śrutipratipannaṃ karmasambandhasyaivāpuruṣārthatvahetutāmavagamayati neti| kiṃ śrutipratipannamubhayaliṅgaṃ tāttvikam? utātāttvikam? iti| kiṃ " athāta ādeśo netineti " iti prakṛtaḥ sarvaviśeṣaniṣedhaḥ? uta prakṛtaitāvattvaniṣedhaḥ? iti| kiṃ sarvaviśeṣaniṣedhe vākyopakramopasaṃhārasāmañjasyam? uta prakṛtaitāvattvaniṣedhe? iti| atra pūrvapakṣābhiprāyaṃ viśeṣataḥ pradarśya siddhāntābhiprāyeṇa nirākaraṇamapi darśayatiheyamiti| itthaṃ kila pūrvapakṣī masyate pūyaśoṇitādmajjanaṃ hi yathā rājakiṅkarasya heyaṃ tathā rājño'pi heyameva anyathā tasya heyatvameva na syāt| tathā ceśvarasyāpi jīvavat dehāvasthānaṃ duḥkhakāraṇameva syāt| nanu jīvaḥ karmaparatantro dehe vartate, īśvaraḥ svecchayaiva, ato na doṣa ityāśaṅkyapariharati  svecchayeti| svecchayāpi pūyaśoṇitādimajjanaṃ duḥkhakāraṇameva ddaśyate| apayarnuyojyatvād vastusvabhāvānāmiti| uktamarthaṃ pratikṣipati neti| tatra hetumāha nirupadheriti| ayamarthaḥ loke hi tyājyopādeyabhāva upādhibhedenānyathākriyate| yathā prātaranukūlamauṣṇyaṃ madhyāhne pratikūlameva| śaityaṃ ca madhyāhne'nukūlaṃ prātaḥ pratikūlameva,evaṃ puruṣabhedenāpi ddaśyate| paśūnāmanukūlaṃ tṛṇādikaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ pratikūlam| evamavasthābhedenāpi kṣudhitasyānukūlamannaṃ mṛṣṭameva bhuktavataḥ pratikūlameva| tadidamuktaṃ bhagavatā parāśareṇa
" tadeva prītaye bhūtvā punarduḥkhāya jāyate|
tadeva kopāya yataḥ prasādāya ca jāyate||
tasmād duḥkātmakaṃ nāsti naca kiñcit sukhātmakam|| " iti|
pratipattṛbhedenāpi sukhaduḥkhavibhāgo ddaśyate| ekasminneva bālake tava putro'yamityukte sukham, śatruputra ityukte duḥkham| evaṃ tattadupādhibhedāt sukhaduḥkhavipariṇāmassarvalokasākṣikaḥ suprasiddhaḥ evaṃ puṇyapāpātmakarmopādhivaśajjīvānāṃ sukhaduḥkhavibhāgo nāpahnotuṃ śakyate| yathā loke vātapittaśleṣmavatāmanukūlapratikūlātmakavastuvaiṣamyamāyurvedādiṣu paṭhyate tathaivopalamyate ca| tasmānneśvarasya śarīreṣvavasthānāt karmasambandhakathanaṃ tatprayuktasukhaduḥkhasambandhakathanaṃ vā yoyujyate| nanvīśvarasyāpi śarīrasambandhādeva karmasambandho'pi syādityāśaṅkya pariharati nityeti| atrāyaṃ vikalpaḥ kimīśvaraśabdena sarvasvāmī viśvajaganniyantocyate kiṃ vā rājādimātram| uttaratra cet siddhasādhanameva rājādīnāmapi sukhaduḥkhānubhavasya vibhāvyamānatvāt| pūrvatra neśvaratvameva sidhyati sukhaduḥkhādikamanubhavati, īśvaraśceti vyāghātāt| karmaphalaṃ hi sukhaduḥkhānubhavaḥ| karma ceśvarājñāparipālanadullaṅghanajanito guṇaviśeṣa eva| athavā'dhyātmaśāstramaryādayā śāsiturīśvarasya nigrahānugrahasaṅkalpaḥ| teneśvarasya kathaṃ sukhaduḥkhānubhavaprasaṅgaḥ? yadi vadasi mohādīśvarasyāpi kaścana praśāstā astīti tathā " na tatsamaścābhyadhikaśca ddaśyate " ityādiśrutireva bhavataḥ kapolatāḍanaṃ karotu| tāḍito'pi yadi pralapasi bahiṣkurvantu bhavantaṃ brahmavādinaḥ| tasmādīśvarasyājñāpakeśvarāntarābhānna śāstravaśyatvam| śāstravaśyatvā bhāvānna karmānubandhaḥ| karmasambandhābhāvācca na śarīrasambandhaprayuktasukhaduḥkhānubhavaprasaṅga iti mānāmānavivekakovidānāṃ mahānubhāvānāṃ mārgaḥ| ayamarthaḥ śrutyaiva vyaktameva vibhajya darśita ityāha śrutyaiveti|
" dvā suparṇā " iti hi śrutirekasmindehe vartamānayorjīvaparamātmanorekasya karmaphalopabhogamitarasya karmaphalabhogābhāvenaniratiśayadīptiyogañcāha| " dvā suparṇā " ityatra jīvaparamātmānāveva vibhajyoktāviti prāgeva prasādhitam|
paiṅgiśrutivirodhābhāvo'pi tatraiva viśadaṃ prakāśita ityuparamyate'smābhiḥ||
atra kaściduktamarthatattvamāndhyādatigarvāccājānan punaścodayati| " tathahi kaṇabhakṣādipakṣe īśvarasya dharmādharmayoḥ prerakatvena śarīrāntaravasthā'pi śarīritvābhāvānna brāhmaṇādiśabdavācyatvam| tena " brāhmaṇo yajeta "
" kṣatriyo yajeta " ityādivākyeṣu vidhigocaratvaprasaṅga eva nāsti| yuṣmākaṃ siddhānte punarbrahmakṣatrādiśabdānāṃ prādhānyeneśvaravācakatvādīśvara eva vidhigocaratāmaśnute| kuryānnakuryāditi niyāmyatvādīśvaratvameva bhajyate " iti|
tadidamanuvadati brahmakṣatrādīti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥ brahmakṣatrādideheṣvaṇu rjīva iva vibhurīśvaro'pyātmabhāvena śarīraprerakatvena tiṣṭhan tattacchabdābhilapyo bhavadanumatyā brāhmaṇādiśabdavācya eva bhavati| tena sa īśvaro brāhmaṇatvādyupādhiviśiṣṭastattadvidhivaśyaḥ kathaṃ na bhavati ?īśvaratvānna bhavatīti cet nahi sākṣāt śrutipratipanne'rthe nāstikatvamaṅgīkartavyam| tasmād vidhiniṣedhaśāstragocarasyeśvarasya sarvadoṣākaratvamiti| tamimamandhapralāpaṃ
nirākarotimaivamiti| tadeva vivṛṇotina jñāpyata ityādinā| ayamatra vikalpaḥ kimajñātajñāpanamapravṛttapravartanaṃ vā vidhiriti bhavatocyate? na tāvadajñātajñāpanamīśvarasya sambhavatīti tadāhana jñāpyate'sāviti| tatra hetumāha
aviditavirahāditi| sarvajñatvādityarthaḥ| na hi divākasya dīpena kaścidupakāraḥ kriyate| apravṛttapravartanamapi na sambhavati| uktārthasya draḍhimne lokaddaṣṭyā vyatirekaddaṣṭāntamāha kiñcijjña iti| loke hi rājñā bhṛtyādayaḥ kiñcijjñatvāt kartavyeṣu bodhyante paratantratvāt preryante ceti sarvalokaddaṣṭaṃ nāpahnotavyam| tasmāt sarvajña īśvaro bodhyaḥ preryaśca syāditi vacanaṃ na buddhimatāṃ vādaḥ apitu buddhihīnānāmityupahasanti santaḥ| yat śrutipratipannatvād brāhmaṇādiśabdavācyasyeśvarasyāpi praśāsyatvamiti, tadapi hāsyamśrutirhi yogyamevārthaṃ vadati| na tvatyantāyogyaṃ śrutyantaravirūddhañceti svayameva bhāvayatu bhavānapīti||
asminnubhayaliṅgādhikaraṇe hyakhilaheyapratyanīkatvaṃ kalyāṇaikatānatvañcobhayaliṅgatvenocyate| etacca tribhirnyāyairnirūpitairupapādyam| " na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni " " agnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabheta " ityatrotsargāpavādanyāyo vihitavyatiriktaviṣayatvānniṣedhaśāstrasyeti| " prajāpatirvaruṇāyāśvamanayat " ityādāvupakramādhikaraṇanyāyaḥ, upasaṃhāradupakramo balīyān upakramasyāsañjātaviroditvādupasaṃhārasya sañjātavirodhitvāditi| "yadyudgātāpacchadyeta " ityādāvaniyatapaurvāparyavirodhe punarapacchedādhikaraṇanyāyaḥ| " pūrvābādhena notpattirattarasya hi siddhayati " iti pūrvaṃ bādhitavaivottarasyotpatteḥ| atra mṛṣāvādinaḥ prāhuḥsaguṇavākyāni tāvat pravartante tāni tu pūrvāṇyeva vidhirūpārthapratipādakatvāt| nirguṇavākyāni tu parāṇi niṣedharūpārthapratipādakatvāt| loke hi vidhipūrvako niṣedha iti suprasiddhametat| tena vidhāyakasya pratyakṣapramāṇasya ca pūrvabhāvitvād bādhyatvam| niṣedhakānāṃ " nirguṇaṃ nirañjanam " "neha nānāsti kiñcana " ityādīnāṃ vākyānāṃ paratvādi bādhakatvam| evamanumānasyāpi|
tathā karmaśāstrāṇāmapi| yāni tu vākyāni vedānte'pi saguṇopāsanaparāṇi tānyapi karmaśāstratulyatvāditthameva bādhyāni| yāni punaḥ saguṇabrahmasvarūpaparāṇīti kānicidvākyāni saguṇavādibhirabhidhīyante tānyapi vidhiviṣayatvāt pūrvabhāvitvād bādhyāni| nirguṇavākyāni tu niṣedhaviṣayatvāccaramabhāvitvena bādhakatvācca pramāṇatvenāvatiṣṭhante| yathā apacchedādhikaraṇe udgātṛpratihartrapacchetayoravakrameṇa jātayornimittayoḥ parasparaviruddhaprāyaścittadvayaprasaṅge pūrvāpacchedanimittaprāyaścittaṃ bādhitvottarāpacchetanimittaprāyaścittamevānuṣṭhīyati| tenātrāpi vidhivākyaviṣayaguṇaṃ bādhitvā nirguṇavākyaviṣayabhūtanairguṇyameva prāmāṇikairaṅgīkartavyamiti| tadidamitaranyāyadvayanirūpaṇena pratikṣipati utsargeṇeti| " na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni " ityutsargaḥ| " agnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabheta " ityapavādaḥ| tatra apavātenotsarga eva kṣomyate na punarutsargeṇāpavāda iti tāntrikaprakriyā| tena " nirguṇaṃ nirañjanam " ityutsargaḥ|
"satyakāmassatyasaṅkalpaḥ " ityapavādaḥ| ekasya sāmānyaviṣayatvāditarasya ca viśeṣaviṣayatvāt| tena saguṇavākyenaiva nirguṇavākyaṃ heyaguṇaviṣayatayā saṅkocanīyamivi nītividāṃ nirṇayaḥ| tadidamāhatasmāditi|
" nirguṇaṃ nirañjanam " iti brāhme guṇādau niṣedhaḥ "satyakāmassatyasaṅkalpaḥ " ityādividhiviṣayamatikramyatiṣṭhet| evamutsargāpavādanyāyena saguṇanirguṇavākyayorviṣayabhedena virodhaśāntimuktvā virodhe śānte sasi apacchedādhikāraṇanyāyāpekṣaiva nāstītyāhanahi samaviṣayeti| tulyaviṣayatve satyeva hyapacchedādhikaraṇanyāyaḥ pravartate| apacchedayoḥ apacchedatvena tulyatvāt| atra punarnyāyāntarasiddhena viṣayabhedena virodha upaśāntaḥ| tena tadupaśamanaheturapacchedādhikaraṇanyāyo nairarthakyādanapekṣaṇīya eva | viṣadaṣṭasya maṇimantrādiṣvanyatamena viṣadoṣaparihāre kimitareṇa pratividhānābhāsena? atrāpacchecadādhikaraṇanyāyaprasaṅgasyābhāsatvameva pradarśayatiddaṣṭa iti| ayamarthaḥ aniyatapaurvāparyaviṣaye hyapacchedādhikaraṇanyāyaprasaṅgaḥ, yathā kadācidudgatā pūrvamapacchidyate kadācit pratihartā, tena tatrottaraprābalyam| iha tu niyatapaurvāparyameva vidhiḥ pūrvo niṣedhaḥ para iti| upakramādhikaraṇe hi dātṛṃpratigrahītroḥ kasyāśvapratigraheṣṭiriti cintāyāmupakramavākyānusāreṇa dāturityeva nirṇītam| tenātrāpi pūrvaprābalyāt saguṇavākyānāmeva prābalyam, na punarnirguṇavākyānāmiti nirṇetavyam| atra vaktavyaśeṣamaśeṣamapi tattvamuktākalāpavyākhyāne tattvaṭīkādau ca draṣṭavyam| bhāṣye ca prathamasūtra eva " uttaraprābalyakathanaṃ mādhyamikavijayapralaṅgenāpahasitam " iti| tadevātra vistareṇānusandheyamavahitakaraṇairantevāsibhiḥ|
kiñcapajīvyavirodhamālapanti nyāyavidaḥ| yathāhuḥ " pūrvātparabalīyatvaṃ tatra nāma pratīyate|
anyo'nyanirapekṣāṇāṃ yatra janma dhiyāṃ bhavet|| " iti|
tena svarūpe svaprāmāṇye ca bhedapratītisāpekṣāṇāṃ bhedaniṣedhaśāstrāṇāṃ prābalyakathanamaśrutamīmāṃsānāṃ śrutivismṛtamīmāṃsānāṃ vā kathanam| nahīdaṃ pūrvamidaṃ paramiti bhedapratītimantareṇāpacchedādhikaraṇe'pi prābalyadaurbalyanirṇayaḥ| na ca tatpratītimantareṇa prāmāṇyanirṇaya ityuparamyate||
" tarhi śrutimevāśrayāmaḥ| sāhi prapañcamithyātvameva sarvatra vadati| tat tattvameva| nakhalu mātā viṣaṃ dadāti|
tena " asadevedamagna āsīt " ityādiśrutisiddhatvāt prapañcamithyātmeva tattvam " iti kecit pralayanti| tadetat śrutiparyālocanayaiva pratikṣipatisattvaṃ kāryasyeti| ayamarthaḥ "kathamasatassajjāyeta " iti vākyaṃ hi kāryasya sattvamaṅgīkṛtya kāraṇāsattvameva pratikṣipati| tena kāryamapi sat kāraṇamapi sadityuktaṃ bhavati| tena "taddhaika āhuḥ " ityekaśabdaprayogāt asattvasya parapakṣatvameva pratīyate| śabdānvayastu kathamasatassadbhavodityadhītiḥ kāryakāraṇayordvayorapi sattvamavagamayatīti| nanu mā bhūdidaṃ vākyaṃ " yathā somya" iti vākyamasmākamavalambanaṃ syādityāśaṅkya pariharati dravyānyatvamiti| tadapi vākyaṃ kārayakāraṇayordravyānyatvamātrameva pratikṣipati| napunaḥ prapañcamithyātvaṃ pratipādayatītyarthaḥ| tarhi neha nānāsti kiñcana " iti vacacacanamasmākamavalambanamiti ca bhavadbhirna vaktavyamityāha antarbhāvāditi| viśiṣṭe bhagavati viśeṣaṇānāṃ antarbhāvāt " neha nānā " iti vākyamapyabrahmātmakanānātvameva pratikṣipati| tarhi sākṣāt "neti neti"iti prapañcaniṣedhakaṃ vākyamasmākaṃ kuladhanamiti cet tadapi svapnalabdhasuvarṇamityāha nirdiṣṭeti| pūrvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kānicid viśeṣaṇānyuktvā nirdiṣṭeyattvameva brahmaṇa iti mandasya śaṅkāṃ neti netītivādo vyapanayati| iti na, iti na, iti prāguktaprakāraviśeṣamātraṃ niṣidhyate, napunarvakṣyamāṇaṃ guṇajātamapi| ata eva sūtrakāraḥ prāha " prakṛtaitāvattvaṃ hi pratiṣedhati tatobravīti ca bhūyaḥ " iti| evaṃ sarvāsāmapi śrutīnāṃ viṣayabhedena prāmāṇyasiddhassaguṇabrāhmavādināmeva vedāntārthanirṇayasādguṇyamiti nirguṇavādo nirguṇānāmeva svecchālāpaḥ||
"nanu santvetāni samādhānāni, athāpyasādheyamidamekaṃ ddaśyate| sarvatrāvasthitasya bhagavato " jalādhāreṣvivāṃśumān " iti ddaṣṭānta upādīyate| tanmithyātvameva pratipādayati " iti kaścinamanute, tasyāpyuttaramāhatattaddūsviti| tātparye hi śabdaḥ pramāṇam| nātra jīvānāṃ mithyātvaṃ vivakṣyate pramāṇaviruddhatvāt|
apitu brahmaṇassarvatrāvasthitasyāpi viśeṣamabhūtatattadvastugata vṛddhihnāsabhāktvameva kevalaṃ niṣidhyate| yathā taraṅgeṣu pratīyamānasya candrabimbasya taraṅgatavṛddhihnāsādibhāktvaṃ na paramārthato vidyate| evaṃ sarvāntaryāmitvenāvasthitasya parasya brahmaṇastattadvastuprayuktabhedoṣasambandho nāstīti| ayamatra vidyamānasyāpi brahmaṇaḥ prabhāvaviśeṣādaupādhikadoṣaprasaṅgābhāva iti ddaṣṭāntapradarśanamātrametaditi| ayamatrānvayaḥtattadvastupradeśe sakalaguṇatayā paripūrṇaṃ ddaśyaḥ paramātmā vṛddhihāsādibhedavidhura iti hi " jalādhāreṣvivāṃśumān " ityucyate|
tātparyānuguṇamevārthasyopavarṇanīyatvāt kimarthamiyaṃ kliṣṭakalpanā? asaṃsargārthamevātra nidarśanamucyata ityāśaṅkate asparśodāhṛtiścediti| sarvairaspṛṣṭamevātra brahmocyata ityarthaḥ| tatrottaramāha na hīti| na hyeka eva ddaṣṭānto maharṣibhirucyate| kvacid " jalādhāreṣvivāṃśumān " iti, itaratra " ākāśamekaṃ hi yathā ghaṭādiṣu pṛthagbhavet " iti kvacidavidyamānaṃ pratibimbamudāhniyate'paratra vidyamānamevākāśam| tenobhayaddaṣṭāntasāmāñjasyārthamucita evārtha udāhartavyaḥ| na punastadgatadoṣairaspṛṣṭatvameva| anyathaikopādāne itarapracyavanādubhayamapi na sidhyet|
evaṃ vistareṇārthatattvamupapādyobhayaliṅgatvaṃ nigamayatitasmāditi| dviliṅgamakhilaheyapratyanīkakalyāṇaikatānatvādubhayaguṇayuktam| dvividhavibhavamubhayavibhūtiviśiṣṭam| "puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam " ityādipramāṇaprasiddhavibhūtidvayaviśiṣṭamityarthaḥ| vivṛtaṃ hi bhagavatā parāśareṇa " samastakalyāṇaguṇātmako'sau ityādinā| vedāntapakṣa iti kathanaṃ mṛṣāvādipakṣasya bauddhapakṣanikṣepārtham||
saṅgatirbhāṣye " tasyācidvastuno brahmarūpatvaprakāra idānīṃ cintyate brahmaṇo nirdoṣatvasiddhayartham " iti|
ayamarthaḥ pūrvādhikaraṇe brahmaṇo nirdoṣatvaṃ pratijñātam| tasya nirdoṣatvasya pratiṣṭhāpanārthamacidvastuno brahmarūpatvamahikuṇḍalanyāyenota prabhāprabhāvannyāyena, athavā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāveneti cintyata iti pūrvādhikaraṇena saṅgatiriti| tadarthavicārastu kimacidvastuno brahmarūpatvamahikuṇaḍalanyāyena? uta prabhāprabhāvadrūpeṇa? uta viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabānenāṃśāṃśitvena iti| kiṃ " sa vā eṣa mahānaja ātmājaro 'maraḥ " ityādyaciddharmapratiṣedho viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena brahmarūpatvaṃ prapañcasyāvagamayati neti| atra pūrvapakṣamāhaviśvasraṣṭuriti| viśvasraṣṭuḥ paramapuruṣasya svāṃśato'cidvargaprajanane svaduḥkhakāraṇatvaṃ nāstyeva| acito duḥkhābhāvāt| aṃśataścācittvaklṛptau mṛttatkāryādikañca bahūdāhṛtaṃ ddaṣṭāntajātaṃ supratijñaṃ svarasameva bhavati| ato brahmaivāvyākṛtādisṛṣṭiṃ vihāravaśād vikriyāmapi karoti| tato vikārarūpāpyacitsṛṣṭaryujyata evetyarthaḥ| tadidaṃ pratikṣipatineti| tadeva vivṛṇotisvāṃśa iti| ayamarthaḥ dvividho hyanarthaḥ| duḥkhaprajananamityekaḥ| niratiśayasukhānubhavayogye vastunimauḍhyāpādanamityaparaḥ| acidvastunaścidvilakṣaṇatvena duḥkhajananābhāve'pi niratiśayajñānānandātmani vastunyaṃśe acidrūpatayā mauḍhyāpādanamapi svānarthāpādanameva| tasmādacidrūpasvāṃśasṛṣṭirna ghaṭata eva||
uktapakṣeṇa saha pakṣāntarāṇyapyanūdya nirākarotikaściditi| pūrvaṃ brahma svayameva svasminnacittvamāpādayatītyāśaṅkya dūṣitam| adhunā pūrvoktadoṣaparihārārthaṃ kecidanādisiddho nitya eva kaścidācidaṃśo vividhavikṛtimān vartata ityāhuḥ| tatrāpi virodhastadavasthaḥ sarvajñasya brahmaṇo nityameva tāddaśamauḍhyasaṃvalitarūpakalpanasyātyantadaussthyāt| pakṣāntaramanuvadati phenādīti| sanmātre brahmaṇi sāgarephenataraṅgabuhbudanyāyena cidacidīśvarātmakaṃ tattvatrayaṃ vikṛtivaśājjāyata ityanye prāhuḥ| tadapi tāddaśameva ;
nirvikāre vikārakalpanāt svānarthakaraṇadoṣasya tādavasthyācca| katicitpunaścandracandrikānyāyena jagahbrahmaṇoraikajātyameva bruvate| tad jagahbrahmaṇoraikyapratipādakavedāntavākyānāmananukūlatvādanādaraṇīyameva|
vastutvamātreṇa sājātyañcet sarvalokaprasiddhatvānna vedāntavedyam| ātmatayā sājātyaṃcet acidvastuni nāstyeva|
īśvaratvena sājātyañcet tattvatrayapariklṛptiparāhatam| " bhoktā bhogyaṃ preritāram " iti śrutiviruddhañca| ato viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvenaikātmyamiti vedāntatattvavedināṃ nirṇayaḥ| tena sarve vādinaḥ sarvavedāntavākyasvāsyavirodhādatravitrāsanīyā iti śabdānvayaḥ||
bhāṣya eva pūrvādhikaraṇanigamanavākyānvitenottarādhikaraṇopakramavākyena saṅgatirucyate " brahmaṇo nirdoṣatvena kalyāṇaguṇākaratvena cobhayaliṅgatvamapi siddham| idānīmasmāt parasmājjagannimittopādānarūpaparamakāraṇāt parabrahmaṇaḥ paramapi tattvamastīti kaiściddhetvābhāsairāśaṅkya nirākriyate " iti| tadarthavicārastu yadidamubhayaliṅgaṃ brahma kimasmātparamapi kiñcit tattvamasti? uta neti| kimasyaiva paratve setūnmānasambandhabhedavyapadeśānāmupapattirasti? na veti| atra sūtrakāreṇopāttān pūrvapakṣahetūnanukrameṇānūdya sautrakrameṇa parihāramapi darśayatisetumiti| " etaṃ setuṃ tīrtvā "iti tartavyatvavacanāt "catuṣpād brahma ṣoḍaśaphalam " iti brahmaṇaḥ parimitatvavacanāt prāpyasambandhitokteḥ "amṛtasyaiṣa setuḥ " iti prāpyasyānyasyāmṛtasya prāpakatayā tatsambandhitvenābhidhānāt, anyādhikyaśruterapi " parātparaṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam "
