"parātparaṃ yanmahato mahāntam " iti sarvasmāt parasyānyasya śruteśca| ativahananayāt ativāhikanyāyenāyaṃ paramapuruṣo viśvakāraṇabhūtaḥ prāpaka eva syānna punaḥ prāpyaḥ| prāpyañcānyadeva kiñcid bhavediti vyomātītavādinaḥ| tadidaṃ pratikṣipati  asaditi| yajjagatkāraṇaṃ tadevadhyeyam " kāraṇaṃ tu dhyeyaḥ " iti niyamāt| yacca dhyeyaṃ tadeva prāpyam " brahmavidāpnoti param " "brahmaveda brahmaiva bhavati " iti prāpyaprāpakayorekatvanirṇayāt| ato yo'mṛtasya setustadevāmṛtamiti trayyantavādināṃ nirṇayaḥ| asmin brahmaṇisetutvādyuktiḥ kathamiti cedatrottaram setutveti| bahupramāṇairaviruddhāṃ vṛttimaṅgīkarotu| īśvarasyaiva tāvatprāpyatvaṃ prāpakatvañca sakalavedāntasiddhatvādaṅgīkaraṇīyameva| tena setutvādyuktīnāṃ yogyārthakalpanayārthopavarṇanaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ| anyathā loke mukhyāmukhyaprayogavibhāgo na syāt| amukhyaprayogāṇāṃ parityājyatvañca syāt| upa kramopasaṃhāpāditātparyaliṅgapariśodhanena viduṣāṃ tatratatra vākyārthopavarṇanamapi na syāditi sarvaśāstrasaṅkṣobhaḥ||
atra pūrvaṃ setutvādivacanaṃ yāgyārthakalpanayā yojyamityuktam| tāneva yogyānarthānanukrameṇa darśayatisetutvamiti| setutvaṃ setutulyād vidharaṇaniyāmātdhārakatvaniyamādityarthaḥ| bhagavāneva hi sarvadhārakaḥ| arthāntaramapyāhabandhanāditi sa eva bhagavālasaṅkareṇa sarvamapi tattvajātaṃ sambadhnāti|parimitivacanasyāpi gatimāhavyāpte'pīti| vyāpte'pyasminparasmin brahmaṇi parimitivacanaṃ sārthakamiti daharākāśādiprasaṅgeṣu tatratatra sūtritameva| " catuṣpād brahma " iti vacanaṃ tu "pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni " itivat tattacchatibhiranugaṇameva kalpanīyamanantabhūmno'pi brahmaṇaḥ| " amṛtasyaiṣa setuḥ " ityamṛtarūpasya brahmaṇa iti vā brahmaprāptirūpamokṣasyāmṛtasyeti vā yojanīyam||
atra nārāyaṇasya paratvamaṅgīkṛtya tasmādapyanyasya paratvamucyata iti pūrvapakṣiṇā varṇyate| tatra ddaṣṭānto'pyuktaḥ| yathā "akṣarāt parataḥ paraḥ " ityatra parato'kṣarādanyaḥ para iti para ucyata iti| evamukteddaṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayovaṣaimyamāhaanyasyeti| ayamarthaḥ ddaṣṭānte hi prathamāntaparaśabdanirdiṣṭasya parasyādhikyavāde pañcamyantaparaśabdanirdiṣṭamavadhitayā ddaṣṭam| tasya ca paraśabdavācyatvaṃ tatkāryarūpamahadādyapekṣayeti vacanānnirṇītama| tatra svakāryāpekṣayā parasmādakṣarāt paro jīvo vā paramātmā veti vaktuṃ śakyate| iha punaḥ
" na hyetasmāditi netyanyat paramasti " iti paramātmāpekṣayā paraḥ pratikṣipyate| tasmādanyaḥ paro na kalpanīya eva|
nanu " tato yaduttarataram " ityatra tacchabdena prakṛtaṃ paramapuruṣaṃ nirdiśya tato'pyuttarataraṃ tattvāntaraṃ nirdiśyate| ataḥ paramapuruṣāduttaraṃ tattvamastīti kecidūcuḥ| tat pariharati evantvāditi| tatra tata ityevantvāditi heturanūdyate|
pūrvaṃ bahubhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ paramapuruṣa eva paratattvamityupapāditattvādityarthaḥ| tena "yaduttarataram " ityādikaṃ paramapuruṣamevāha napunastattvāntaram| tata iti śabdasyārthāntaramapyāhayadi veti| tataḥ paramapuruṣavyāpyatvena pūrvoktāt prapañcāt uttarataraṃ yadarūpamanāmayamityanvayaḥ| atrāpi paramapuruṣa eva paratvenocyate| yadi paramapuruṣāduttarataraṃ vastvastītyabhidhīyate tadā prakaraṇopakrame puruṣasūktapratyabhijñānena paramapuruṣāduttarasya
pratikṣepādupakramopasaṃhārayorupakramabalīyastvasyanyāyyatvādupakramānuguṇyenopasaṃhāravākyamasmaduktaprakriyayaiva yojanīyamiti bhāvaḥ| iyamatraśabdayojanāanyasyeśvarasya " akṣarātparataḥ paraḥ " ityādhikyavāde paraṃ prakṛtyādikaṃ avadhitayā yatra ddaṣṭaṃ tatra tasminnevodāharaṇe tadavadhiravyākṛtādistadapekṣayā avadhirasyāt| svayañca "akṣarāt parataḥ paraḥ" iti svakāryavargāt paratvenāpi nirdiśyate| atra tu " na hyetasmāditi netyanyatparamasti " iti "iti na " ityupadiṣṭādanyatparaṃ nāstīti parāntararāhityenopadiṣṭe viṣaye tatparoktestasmātparasyānyasyokterayukteḥ| tena paratvakalpanaṃ paramapuruṣa eva paryavasyati| " tato yaduttarataram " ityatra tu pañcamyantasya tacchabdasya hetuparatvamityeko nirvāhaḥ| avadhiparatve'pi pūrvoktāt paramapuruṣavyāpyāt prakṛtatvena tacchabdena nirdeṣṭuṃ yogyādityaparo nirvāha iti||
atra pūrvottarādhikaraṇayossaṅgatimāha ārādhya iti| yatra hi paratvamaudāryañca sa eva hi sevya iti lokaprasiddham| paratve satyapi kadaryasyāsevyatvāt| tathaudārye satyapi nirdhanasyāsevyatvāt| tenottarapādapratipādyopāsyatvasiddhayarthaṃ bhagavataḥ paratvamuktaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇe| iha punaḥ phalapradatvakathanāt audāryamucyata iti pūrvottarādhikaraṇasaṅgatiḥ| tadidaṃ paratvaṃ bhagavatastrikāṇḍyāṃ sarvatroktamanūdya tadanvitamaudāryamadhunā prakhyāpyate| anvayārthastu"sarve vedā yatraikaṃ bhavanti " " sarve hotāro yatraikaṃ bhavanti"|
"varṇāśramācāravatā " ityādibhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ prathamakāṇḍe viṣṇureva sarvakarmasamārādhyatā nirṇītaḥ| madhyamakāṇḍepi "agniravamo devatānāṃ viṣṇuḥ paramaḥ" iti sa eva sarvadevatāntaryāmitvena tadadhyakṣatayā pratipāditaḥ| asminnapi brahmakāṇḍe punaretāvatā daśabhirapi pādairbhāṣito bhavabhayacakitaprāptyupāstyekalakṣyamiti prāgevāsminpāde viśadataramupapāditam| athobhayaliṅgapādānte vidyāpratipādanārambhe tattacchāstrārthayogyaṃ nityanaimittikakāmyarūpāṇāṃ pravṛttiniṣṭhadharmāṇāṃ karmayogajñānayogabhaktiyogādirūpāṇāṃ nivṛttiniṣṭhadharmāṇāñcānuguṇaṃ phalaṃ diśatīti vidyārambhasiddhyarthaṃ viśadamupapādyate| nahi prayojanamantareṇa prāṇināṃ pravṛttissambhavati| naca prayojanaṃ pradātāramantareṇa| na ca pradātṛtvaṃ paratvaudāryābhyāṃ vinā| nāpi caitau guṇau puruṣottamādubhayavibhūtiviśiṣṭasvātmapradānamahāvadānyād bhagavato nārāyaṇādanyatra sambhavata iti bhāvaḥ||
saṅgatiruktā| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ sāpūrvātkarmopāsanāt svargāpavargaphalotpattiḥ uta karmopāsanaprītādra vāyvādyavasthāt kevalācca parasmād brahmaṇa iti| kiṃ "sa evainaṃ bhūtiṃ gamayati " "yamevaiṣa vṛṇute tena labhyaḥ "
ityadivākyaśeṣo vāyvādyavasthasya kevalasya ca phalapradātṛtvagamayati neti| kimayaṃ vākyaśeṣo yathapratīyamānārthaḥ, utānyapara iti| atra pūrvapakṣavādī manyatekṛṣyāderiti| lokekṛṣyādermardanāderapi phalamastītyavivādametat|
anyathā pravṛttyayogāt| tacca phalaṃ ddaṣṭadvāreṇaiva jāyate na punaraddaṣṭadvārā kalpanāgauravaprasaṅgāt| avyavahitaphalotpattau ddaṣṭamapi dvāraṃ nāpekṣate| dharmāṇāṃ punaḥ sādhanatvaṃ śrutyavagatatvādaparityājyameva| na ca "ādityo yūpaḥ " ityādivat śrutiratra bādhavatī| tena bādhadoṣojjñitābhiśśrutibhiravagatatvādasyeva dharmāṇāṃ sādhanatvam| itthaṃ dharmāṇāṃ sākṣāt sādhanatve śrūyamāṇe'pīśvara prasādāt phalamiti vacanamīśvarapraśaṃsārthameveti kalpayituṃ yuktam| āśaṅkitamarthaṃ pratikṣipati neti| tatra hetumāhaśrauteti| atrāyaṃ vibhāgaḥkarmaiva kālāntarabhāviphalaṃ dadātītyeka pakṣaḥ| karmavyatiriktamapūrvābhidhānamityaparaḥ| karmarūpārādhanaprīto devatāviśeṣa iti tṛtīyaḥ| prathamapakṣe karmaṇaścitapradhvastatvāt phalahetutvameva na sambhavati| dvitīye tu pakṣe śrutahānāśrutakalpanābhyāṃ dvau doṣau staḥ| śrūyate hi " sa enaṃ prītaḥ prīṇāti " ityādinā devatāyāeva phalapradatvam| tena tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ śraudatvādarthavirodhābhāvācca svīkartavya iti devatāyā eva phalapradatvaṃ siddham| idaṃ tu sāmānyaṃ " ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca" iti sarvakarmasamārādhyatvaṃ sarvakarmaphalapradatvaṃ cocyate| apradānaśīlasya hi prabhutvaṃ gaganakusumakūrmaromanaraviṣaṇādiṣvanyatamāyate| tena prabhutvamiti phalapradatvamevocyata iti bhāṣyakārā niraṇaiṣuḥ| tasyaiva vākye vaktuṃ yogyatvādkāṅkṣitatvācceti||
atra phalapdatvakathane tatratatra pūrvoktārthaviśeṣeṇa paunaruktyamāśaṅkya pratikṣipati yadyapīti| pūrvaṃ hi devatādhikaraṇe " prītiḥ phalapradānañca devatānāṃ na vidyate " iti vadatāṃ pratikṣepāt phalapradatvamuktameva| samanantaraṃ tu "kṛtaprayatnāpekṣastu vihitapratiṣiddhāvaiyarthyādibhyaḥ " ityasminnapi sūtre pūrvakarmānurūpaṃ puṇyapāpayorīśvaraḥ pravartayatīti karmaphalamīśvarādhīnamityuktam| tat kimarthaṃ phalapradatvamatrāpyucyate? tadetadaṅgīkṛtyaiva pratikṣipati tathāpīti| " sākṣī cetā " "avākyanādaraḥ " ityādau tatratatravedāntavākye sākṣitvānādaratvavacanāt tacchravaṇamātreṇa bibhyataupāsakasyopāsanapravṛttirevotsīdet|teneśvarasyopekṣakatvādiśaṅkātaṅkapaṅkilabuddherupāsakasya bhayanivāraṇārthaṃ paramodārasya bhagavataśśriyaḥ patyuḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇaikatānacittasyaudāryameva pradhānaguṇamasminnadhikaraṇe pratiṣṭhāpayati sūtrakāra iti sāphalyānna paunaruktyagandhāvakāśaḥ|| īśvarasya phalapradānaprakāraṃ rājatatputranyāyena lokaddaṣṭaprakriyayā pratiṣṭhāpayatisamrāja iti| loke hi keṣāñcit putrāṇāṃ kaścidapi pitā samrāḍeva bhavati sa ca sānukampaḥ kartavyākartavyayorucitamapyarthaṃ jānāti sarveṣu ca putreṣu sāmyameva bhajate vadānyaśca bhavati| sarvaṣvapi putreṣu audāryamapi sādhāraṇamevetyarthaḥ| evambhūtāt pituḥ putrā niyatarucibhidāyantritāssvasvecchānurūpyeṇa svābhīṣṭaṃ taṃtamarthaṃ vindanti labhante| evaṃ paramapuruṣādapyetadguṇajātopetāt putrakalpāssarve tatsevakāḥ puruṣāḥ svābhīṣṭamarthaṃ labhanta itiśeṣaḥ| tatra prāpyaprāpakatadvirodhitadupaśamanādikaṃ sakalamapi pitāputranyāyeneśvare'pi syāditi viśadaṃ prakāśayati tatreti|
svataḥ prāpyaṃ gṛhakṣetrādikaṃ dāyarūpaṃ yat yataḥ pitrājñollaṅghanādihetostasya vihatirbhavati| tatpraśāntiśca yasmātpunarāgatya tatpādapraṇāmādeḥ| yacca deyaṃ dhanābharaṇapaṭṭavastracchatracāmarādikam| aviśeṣādaparādhakṣamāpaṇābhāve damanamapi śikṣaṇamapi yathālokaṃ tatsarvamatrāpi syāt| rājabhṛtyasya tu rājājñollaṅghane pādacchedādimanam, tatputrasya tu jīvikāsaṅkocādikam| evamabhāgavatānāṃ pāpaphalaṃ śāstroktaṃ narakaprāyaṇādikam| bhāgavatānāṃ tu buddhapūrvakāparādha prasaṅge " na khalu bhāgavatā yamaviṣayaṃ gacchanti| ihaivaiṣāṃ kecidupaplavā bhavanti" iti kāṇatvakhañjatvādikameva damanam| tena " laghurdaṇḍaḥ prapannasya rājaputrāparādhavat " ityuktaprakāreṇa prapannānāmaparādhānanurūpadaṇḍanamatyalpameva syāditi sakalaphalaprade bhagavati paramakāruṇike viśvāsena brahmavidyānuṣṭhānaṃ sahasaiva kartavyamitīdamadhikaraṇamupāsanārambhameva sandhukṣayati||
pādārtheṣu pradhānārthaviśeṣān prakaṭayan bhagavatpāramyabuddhimuddīpayatiśuddhānanda iti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥ tat evamupapādanāt śuddhānandasvarūpe parasminbrahmaṇi śubhaguṇajaladhau satyanityasvadehe paramārthanityavigrahavati devībhūṣāyudhaparijanaparicchadādibhiratiśayini| kanadbhogalīlāvibhūtāviti vibhūtidvayaviśiṣṭatvamāha| kanaditi dedīpyamānatvamucyate| "atha yadataḥ paro divo jyotirdīpyate " iti hi śrutiḥ| śeṣitvetiādheyatvavidheyatvaśeṣatvairviśvasya śarīratvam, ādhāratvādibhirīśvarasya śarīratvamiti vedāntārthatattvanirṇayasāraḥ| sambandhasya stāsnutvaṃ nityasiddhatvam| svargāpavargaprasavitarīti "phalamata upapatteḥ " ityadhitakaraṇārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ prāha| evambhūte harau nirnimeṣā ddaṣṭirasmākaṃ śrutirevābādhitapramāṇamityarthaḥ| tena śrutisiddheṣveteṣvartheṣu vivādo na vaidikaiḥ kartavya ityarthaḥ | tena kakṣānumānatulyairanumānābhāsairīśvaraguṇavigrahavibhūtyādikaṃ nirākurvatāṃ sarveṣāmeva pūrvavādināṃ śrutireva paripanthinīti niraśiraḥpavitratvānumānamapi te namaskurvantu| puraskurvantu ca " brāhmaṇena surā peyā " ityādikamapi vacanam|
athavā manuṣyatvādibhissvabrāhmaṇyamapi tiraskurvantviti hāsyamevāvaśiṣyate||
uttaratra vidyābhedeṣu guṇabhedakathanārthametatpāde pratyadhikaraṇamuktānarthabhedān pratyekamupādāya prakaṭayati pāda iti| svapnasambandhyarthasraṣṭā suṣuptyādhṛtissuṣuptyādhārassuptagoptā suptasya vināśābhāvena saṃrakṣakaḥ| mugdhohbrodhātikartā mūcchatasyohbodhaṃ kadācit karoti| kadācinmaraṇamityādi śabdārthaḥ| anaghaśubhaguṇa ityubhayaliṅgatvamucyate| acidbhiraṃśī svadehairityahikuṇḍalādhachikaraṇārtha ucyate| atha parādhikaraṇārthaḥ pāramyasyaikasīmeti| eka eva parastasmāt paro nāstītyarthaḥ| sakalaphalada iti phalādhikaraṇārthaḥ| evamucyate bhagavān kimarthamityāśaṅkyāha bhaktibhūmna iti| vakṣyamāṇabrahṇavidyārūpabhaktyabhivṛddhyarthamityarthaḥ| nanu vyāvahārikaṃ guṇajātametāddaśamastviti vayamapi brūma iti mṛṣāvādinaḥ pravadānta tatrottaramāha satye hīti| evamukte guṇādau satye satyeva hyanantarapāde parabhajanādau rūpabhedādikaṃ vaktuṃ śakyate| ayamarthaḥ tattvameva vedāntaśāstramupapādayati| tatpratipādyamarthajātamatattvaṃ cet kiṃ tattvam? na kimapīti cet mādhyamikasaṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ| viśeṣaṇamātattvaṃ viśeṣyamātraṃ tattvamiti cet kaḥ prāha? śrutiriticed vācyatvavedyatvādibhiḥ punarapi mithyābhūtaṃ brahma syāt| svayamprakāśaṃ taditi cet ki tat svayamprakāśatvam ? avadyatve sati aparokṣavyavahārānuguṇatvamiti ced vyavahārānuguṇatvādeva punarapi mithyātvamunmajjet| svayamprakāśatvamṛṣātvānna doṣaiti cet svayamprakāśatvasya mithyātve paraprakāśatvameva tathyamiti punarapi ddaśyatvānmithyātvaṃ samarthayase brahmaṇa ityasambaddhavādinā bhavatā vivādamapi kartumapatrapāmahe|| evaṃ pūrvoktairdaśabhiḥ pādairmokṣopāyopayuktaṃ tattvajñānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpitam| uttaratra ṣaḍbhiḥ pādai parabrahmaprāptirūpaphalasaṃvalitaṃ taddhetubhūtamupāsanaṃ viśadameva prakāśyata iti pūrvottarayoranvayamāhatattvajñāneti|
mokṣyamāṇasya puruṣasya tattvajñānānuviddhaṃ hitatamamupāsanamuttaratra vaktuṃ tattve viṣaye tarkajvarajanitamahāsannipātapralāpān paravādān nirdhūyādhunā tattvabodhe niṣpanne sati tattvajñānasya sañjātatvāt|
" dagdhākhilādhikāratvāt brahmajñānāgninā muniḥ|
vartamānaśśrutermūndha naiva syādvedakiṅkaraḥ|| "
iti vedakiṅkaratvamapalapadbhayo mṛṣāvādibhyaḥ " sa khalvevaṃ vartayan yāvadāyuṣaṃ brahmalokamabhisampadyate "
iti śrutisiddhaṃ yāvajjīvānuvartyaṃ muraripubhajanaṃ muktisiddhaye vaktītyanvayaḥ| itthaṃ kila mṛṣāvādīmanyate ya eva hyahaṅkārādiyuktaḥ saeva vedakiṅkaraḥ; kartṛtvabhoktṛtvayoranātmadharmatvāt| kāmyakartṛtvaṃ tāvat saṃsārahetutvānnirastameva jñāninaḥ| brahmopāsanakartṛtvamapi tathaiva nirastaṃ tasyāpi sāṃsārikadharmāntarbhāvāt| brahma tu na jñeyaṃ nopāsyaṃ na prāpyamapi| naca vedairayamartho jñāpyate| nityasvayamprakāśatvāt svayamprakāśatvamapi na nirucyate| tadanirvacane kathaṃ brahmasiddhiriticet mā bhūt brahmasiddhiḥ| ata eva hyadhyātmavidaḥ pravadanti " avacanenaiva provāca " iti| evamasambaddhavādino mithyāvādinassadvidyāmapi svasamayasārabhūtatayā parigṛhītāṃ parityajanti kimuta daharavidyādikān vidyābhedān vividhaguṇapariṣkārayuktān| atastatpratikṣepārabhyata iti|| atra tṛtīyādhyāye caturṇāmapi pādānāmarthabhedaṃ dvikadacvayasyāpyarthabhedānmithobhedaṃ paurvāparyaniyamañca darśayati bhīmābhya iti| atra pūrvapādadvaye'dhikārasampattiheturadhikāraśca saṃsāraviraktisaṃvalito bhagavati tṛṣṇāyogaḥ ubhāvetāvubhābhyāṃ pādābhyāmabhidhīyate iti viśadaṃ prakāśyate| tatra bhīmābhya ityādinā vairāgyapādārthamāha tṛṣṇāmityādinobhayaliṅgapādārtham| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ yāvatākṛṣṇāmṛtābdhau tṛṣṇāṃ paraṇayati tāvaduktamiti uttarapādadvayārthamāha  itthamiti| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ ubhābhyāṃ pādābhyāṃ labdhādhikāro yatra sāṅge sādhane pravartate tat sāṅgaṃ sādhanaṃ parasmin pādadvandve bahubhidābarbaraṃ nirbravītibahubhedena viṣamitaṃ vikalpitaṃ nirbravīti
sūtrakāraḥ| ayamarthaḥbrahmavidyāviśeṣāḥ khalu " nānāśabdādi " iti sapramāṇakaṃ bhinnatayopadiṣṭāḥ| "vikalpo'viśiṣṭaphalatvāt " ityekaphalasādhanatvena ta eva vikalpitāḥ| evamubhayākārayuktasādhanajātamudiśyata iti | ayamatrānukramaḥ vairāgyapūrvaṃ hi prāpyatṛṣṇā jāyate prāpyaviṣayaprepsāyaṃ jātāyāmupāyādhikāraḥ upāyepravṛttasyādhikāriṇaḥ purastādupāye nirṇīte upariṣṭāt karaṇasthānīyasarvabrahmavidyāṅgakarmopāditsā jāyata iti vidyāṅgapādasya paścādbhāva iti||
nanu pādārthābhidhāne bhagavatā bhāṣyakāreṇa " idānīṃ brahmopāsanānāṃ guṇopasaṃhāravikalpa nirṇayāya vidyābhedābhedacintā prastūyate " ityuktam, atra ko'yaṃ pādārthaḥ? kiṃ bhedacintā utābhetacintā athavā kvacidbhedacintā kvacidabhedacintā yadvā bhedābhetacinteti| nādyaḥ; sārvatrikatvābhāvāt| ata eva na dvitīyaḥ|
na ca tṛtīyaḥ; anuvṛttārthāsiddheḥ| na caturthaḥ; bhedābhedātmakasya cintanīyasya vyāhatatvena tadviṣayacintāyā ayogāt| cintāśabdena saṃśayātmakaṃ vicāramabhidhāya pakṣadvayābhidhāne'pi etasminpāde guṇopasaṃhārānupasaṃhāracintā hīyeta| saiva hi cintā pāde'smin pradhānā; guṇopasaṃhārapāda iti samākhyāyogāt| tadidaṃ sarvamabhipretyāha ekasminniti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥ ekasmin pāde eka evārthassvīkāryo nipuṇanayakṛtā puruṣeṇa| dvayostarkaṇaṃ vicāro na syāt| bhedābheda ityeko'rtho nāstyeva, śabdaprayogamātreṇa śaśaviṣāṇādivadastitve'pi tasyaiva cintanamasmin pāde syāt na punaranyasya guṇopasehārānupasaṃhārādeścintanam| tadidamāha anyahānaprasaṅgāditi| uktamarthaṃ saṅkalayya nigamayatitasmāditi| evaṃ vikalpaduṣṭatvādasmin pāde prakīrṇā nayavitatirnyāyavistaraḥ praśithila iti prekṣitagranthacodye vidyābhedābhedacintā kriyata iti ddaṣṭabhāṣyagranthasya kasyacit puruṣasya codye sati vedyāvacchinnavidyāniyamakṛdayaṃ pāda ityaidamarthyaṃtātparyaṃsamarthyam|
ayamarthaḥ nātra bhedo nāpyabhedaḥ pradhānatayā cintyate, bhedābhedau guṇopasaṃhārānupasaṃhārārthāveva| tena guṇopasaṃhārapādaprasiddhirapi yujyate| tarhyupasaṃhāro'nupasaṃhāro vā pādārtha iti punaścodyamunmajjatīti cet yathāyogyamupasaṃhārānupasaṃhārānyataranirṇayaḥ pādārtha ityaikārthyasiddhiḥ| vedyāvacchinnavidyāniyamakṛdayamiti vedyaṃ bhinnaṃ cet vidyā ca bhinnā, abhinnaṃ cet sā cābhinnā, tena vedyānurūpaṃ vidyāniyamanamiti pādarthaikyasiddhiḥ| atra vedyabhedastu guṇabhedāt napunarbrahmabhedāt| tena guṇopasaṃhārapādaprasiddhissutarāṃ saṅghaṭata iti||
pūrvasmin śloke vedyāvacchinnavidyāniyamakṛdayamiti pādasyaikārthyaṃ samarthitam| atra kaścidāha astvaikārthyam, athāpi vidyaikyapratipādake'sminpāde abheda evaikaḥ pādārthaḥ| na punarvidyā bhedaḥ, tarhi " vidyābhedābhedacincā " iti kathaṃ bhāṣyakārairucyate? iti cet astvapavādapradarśanam| vidyaikyameva pādārthaḥ|
aikyāsambhave kvacidbhedo'pi syādityapavāda eva pradarśyate napunarbhedaḥ pādārthabhūta iti| imāmāśaṅkāmanuvadati ākhyāvantamiti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥguṇānāmupasaṃhārato guṇopasaṃhārapāda ityākhyāvantametaṃ pādaṃ nijagaduḥ|
tat tasmātkāraṇādākhyāsāmarthyāt vidyaikyapratipādatake'sminpāde bhedacintā tvapavādatvenaiva prasaktā na punaḥ pādārthatayā| imamāśaṅkā parihartumeva bhāṣyakārairuktaṃ " vidyābhedābhedacintā " iti| tadāha itthamiti| kaḥ
punassarvānuvṛttaḥ pādārtha iti cettatrāha viṣaya iti||
atra kaściccodayatiguṇabhedāt vidyābheda iti bhavadbhiriktam| tarhi phalabhedo'pi syāt| "yathākraturasmin loke puruṣo bhavati tathetaḥ pretya bhavati " iti hi śrūyate "taṃ yathāyathopāsate tathaiva bhavati " iti ca| tena yadguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ bhagavantamupāste tadguṇaviśiṣṭameva prāpnotīti śrutyarthaḥ| viśeṣavidhauśeṣaniṣedhasya nyāyyatvāt upāsyaguṇavyatiriktaguṇaviśiṣṭabhagavatprāptirarthānniṣidhyata iti paripūrnabrahmānubhavo mokṣa iti vādamātrameva syāt|
tadidamanuvadatinissīmeti| nissīmānandaparvotkarṣahetubhūtanirupadhikānantasampadguṇaudhe paramātmani vedyākārabhedaprayuktabhedavadvidyābhedairvibhajya praṇidhiryadi syāt, tarhi prāptirapi brahmaṇi aṃśata ekadeśena syāt|
yāvānupāsanaviṣaya ākārastāvāneva prāpyākārassyāt| tathā ca na paripūrṇabrahmānubhavaḥ phalamityāpatet| etaccodyamapākarotimaivamiti| apākaraṇameva vivṛṇotitaireveti| ayamarthaḥ "yathākraturasmiṃlloke puruṣo bhavati "
ityatropāsyākārasyānyūnabhāveva prāptirucyate| "tathaiva bhavati " iti kṛtsnasyāpyupāsyākārasya prāptyabhidhānāt|
nyūnatve punarupāsyākārasya kṛtsnatvameva bhajyeta| adhikākārasambandhastvatra na vidhīyate nāpi niṣidhyate| viśeṣavidhau śeṣaniṣedhanyāyāt niṣidhyata iti cet ayamapi bhrāntimūla evopanyāsaḥ| vidhāyakapramāṇāntarābhāve hi ārtho niṣedhaḥ parigṛhyeta| atra tu vidhāyakamasti " nirañjanaḥ paramaṃ sāmyamupaiti " iti śrutyaiva paramasāmyābhidhānāt| idañca paramasāmyaṃ bhogamātra eveti sūtrakāraireva sthāpayiṣyate " bhogamātrasāmyaliṅgācca " iti| tena nahi vacanavirodhe nyāyaḥ prabhavatīti nyāyenādhikaniṣedho durnyāyavedināmeva nirṇayaḥ| tarhīśvarasāmyāṅgīkāre jīvasyāpīśvaratvaṃ prasajya iti cenna; sūtrakāraireva mātraśabdaṃ prayuñjānairnirastatvāt|
śabdārthastutairevadharmairupāsyaireva bhagavadguṇaistaditarasahitai ranupāsyairguṇairapi sahitaiḥ pūrṇaṃ brahmaiva pūrṇakāmasya muktasya prāpyamiti nānyadatra phalamasti| svargādisādhaneṣu tūpāsyamanyat phalamanyaditi prasiddhametat| tenātra tatkratunyāyenopāsyānupāsyakalaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ tadeva brahma prāpyamiti tatkratunyāyassidhyati| tena na kvacidapi vidyāsu phalavaiṣamyaprasaṅgaḥ||
atra pādasaṅgatirbhāṣye " uktaṃ brahmopāsisiṣopajananāya vaktavyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ phaladāyitāparyantam| idāniṃ brahmopāsanānāṃ guṇopasaṃhāravikalpanirṇayāya vidyābhedābhedacintā prastūyate " iti| adhikaraṇāvatāramapyāha "prathamaṃ tāvat " ityādinā| "phalamata upapatteḥ " ityatra upāsyasya brahmaṇassarvaphalapradāne prādhānyamuktam, adhunā punarmūrdhādipādaparyantapariklṛptyā savigrahabrahmopāsanarūpāyā vaiśvānaravidyāyāḥ paravidyāntarāt prādhānyena saiva prathamaṃ vicāryate| ata eva bhagavatā parāśareṇa brahmavidyāprasaṅgesavigrahameva brahma prathamaṃ cintanīyaṃ śubhāśrayatvāt, brahmasvarūpaṃ tu na yogayujā cintyam, ārūḍhayogenaiva cintyamityuktam| asyāñca vidyāyāṃ pūrvakāṇḍaśākhāntarādhikaraṇoktasakalanyāyasamuccayasya vidyamāntavāt etadvicārapūrvakameva vidyāntaravicāraucityādeṣaiva vidyā pūrvaṃ vicāryata itiyabhiprāyaḥ| etadeva " prathamaṃ tāvat " iti dvābhyāmapi padābhyāṃ dyotyate| tadarthavicārastu nānāśākhāsvadhītāyā vaiśvānarādikāyā vidyāyāḥ kiṃ pratiśākhaṃ bhedaḥ, utaikyamiti| kiṃ śākhāntare pratyabhijñāsti neti| kiṃ " teṣāmevaitāṃ brahmavidyāṃ vadeta śirovrataṃ vidhivadyaistu cīrṇam " iti śirovratavatāmātharvaṇikānāṃ vidyopadeśaniyamobhedopapādakatayā pratyabhijñānirodhī neti| kiṃ śirovrataṃ vidyāṅgam, utādhyayanāṅgamiti| atra karmakāṇḍaśākhāntarādhikaraṇoktābhedacakanyāyairabhedamuktvā punarbhedakanyāyairākṣipya bhedakānāṃ teṣāmanyārthatvapradarśanenābhedameva punaḥ pratiṣṭhāpayāmāsa sūtrakāra ityāhabheda ityādinā| ayamarthaḥ karmakāṇḍe hi saṃyogarūpacodanākhyāviśeṣāt karmaṇāmaikyamuktama| saṃyogo nāma phalasaṃyogaḥ| rūpañca dravyadevate|
dravyadevate hi karmaṇo rūpamiti tāntrikāḥ| codanā liṅloṭtavyapratyayādiśiraskaḥ kriyāvāciśabdaḥ| ākhyā jyotiṣṭomādināmadheyam| teṣāmaviśeṣāt karmaikyamiti " saṃyogarūpacodanākhyāviśeṣāt " iti sūtrārthaḥ| bhedakapramāṇāni tu śabdāntarādīni| aparyāyaśabdaśśabdāntaraṃ yajati juhoti dadātītyādi| abhyāsastu " samidho yajati " "tanūnapātaṃ yajati " ityādirūpaḥ punaḥ punaḥ pāṭhaḥ| saṅkhyā "tisra āhutīrjuhoti " ityādiṣu ddaṣṭā tritvādiḥ| guṇastu " tapte payasi dadhyānayati sā vaiśvadevyāmikṣā vājibhyo vājinam " ityādiṣu śruto vājinādiḥ| "upasadbhiścaritvā māsamagnihotraṃ juhoti " ityādiṣu prakaraṇāntaramupalabhyate| nāmadheyamapi bhedakaṃ ddaśyati "athaiṣa jyotirathaiṣa viśvajyotirathaiṣa sarvajyodiḥ " ityādau| tena pūrvakāṇḍoktanyākalāpairbhedakairabedakaiścedamadhikaraṇaṃ vyāracitam| tatra śabdānvayastukarmakāṇḍe dvitīyādhyāye śabdāntarādyairbhaido vidhiṣu niyamitaḥ pratipāditaḥ| samudayaniyatāt samuccitāt saṃyogādyaikyataḥ saṃyogarūpacodanākhyāviśeṣāt anyaḥ karmaṇāmabhedo'pi sthāpitaḥ| karmabrahmakāṇḍayoraikaśāstryāt nyāpravṛtterapi tulyatvāt vidyāmapi karmanītireva nītiḥ| itthaṃ sāmānyenārthatattvamabhidhāya etasyādhikaraṇasya
siddhāntārambhapūrvakatvāt prathamaṃ siddhāntamabhidhāya pūrvapakṣābhiprāyeṇākṣipya punastameva siddhāntaṃ sthāpayāmapi sūtrakāra iti darśayati ādāviti| śabdānvayastu tenaiva karmakāṇḍenaiva codanādarebhedādādāvuditamuktaṃ śākhāntaranayaṃ
śrutyaivākṣipya śrutyantargatāt bhedakapramāṇādākṣipya taṃ pūrvoktamevārthaṃ pratisamādhita sthāpayāmāsa| tatra hetumāha bhedakānyārthatoktayeti| bhedakasya pramāṇasya arthāntare tātparyādityarthaḥ||
pūrvaṃ sāṅkhyasya nityamukiṃta vadataḥ kathitaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ mṛṣāvādino'pyaviśiṣṭamityukvā svapakṣemokṣaṃ svarūpato viśadameva darśayatimokṣeti| atrāyaṃ vikalpaḥ nityamuktatvavādi mṛṣāvādi kimāgāmimokṣa eva nāstīti brūte kiṃvā bhrāntisiddho mokṣa iti| ubhayathāpi na yujyate | tathā hi  mokṣo yadi na syāt tadā saparikarāmidaṃ cintyamānaṃ sādhanaṃ mudhā syāt | āgāmino mokṣarūpa phalasyābhāvāt|
tarhi muktirbhrāntisiddheti pakṣaṃ parigṛhnima iticet tatrāpi vikalpaḥ kimādhunikabhrānsiddho mokṣaḥ, uta mokṣadaśāyāmutpannāya bhrāntayā siddhaḥ| na tāvadādyaḥ  adhunā samsārabhrānte vidyamānatvena mokṣabhrānteranudayāt| nāpi paraḥ  tathā sati muktidaśāyāmāropitamokṣaviṣayabhrāntyanuvṛtteryāvadātmasvarūpaṃ bhrāntireva syāt| kiñca śretrajñasya nityamuktatvaṃ kathayitustava sādhanādhyāyo'phala eva syāt, nityamuktatvena sādhanādhyābhāvāt| bhrāntyupaśamanārthaṃ sādhanādhyāya iti cet tarhi nivartyasadbhāvānna nityavuktatvasiddhiḥ| nivartyabhāve tu tadevanaiṣphalyamanuvarteta|tarhisakalasāṃsārikaduḥkhanivṛttirbrahmajñānakāryeti cet kāryasyānityattannāśe saṃsāronmajjanaprasaṅga ityāśaṅkayāhapradhvaṃseti| nyāyavidāṃ pakṣe
pradhvaṃsarūpāṇī miktiḥ| pradhvaṃsasya kārytavepi nityatvamiti hi teṣāṃ pakṣaḥ| ato nānityatvaprasaṅgaḥ| tarhi yuṣmatpakṣe bhāvarūpatvamastīti cetastyeva | teṣāmabhāva evāsmakaṃ bhāvaḥ| yathā abhāvarūpatvānmukteḥ kāryatvepi nityatvāmiti nyāyavādinaḥ vadanti evaṃ bhāvāntarābhāvāvādināmasmākamapi na ca punarāvartate iti nyāyānugṛhītaśrutisāmarthyādapahatapāpmatvādiguṇāṣṭakāvirbhāvarūpamukterbhāvarūpatve'pi nityatvasiddhiriti kṛtaṃ vistareṇa||
uktaṃ bhāvāntarābhāvapakṣaṃ lokadṛṣṭaprakriyayā purānāṇusāreṇa ca sthāpayan mokṣasya nityatvaṃ pakṣadvayeṇa darśayati| santatyātmeti|mahi ghaṭatvaṃ ghaṭataḥ kapālikā iti parāśarādivacana balāduttarāvasthāntara mātrasya santanyamānasyaiva vināśatvena ca loke upalambhāt dhīśaṅgocaprāṇāśa eva vikaśanam|
atathābhūtaṃ nityasiddhasvarūpamatra punarāgamātsyāt| āgamastu na ca punarāvartate ityādikaḥ|
apunarāvṛttirnāma vikasitajñānasya punassaṅkocābhāvaḥ|yathā na kriyate jyotsnā mala prakṣīlanānmaṇeḥ iti śainakavacanamapyatraiva saṃvadate| atra pakṣāntaramapyāha manyata iti| vikasanaṃsvarūpato nityamityakaḥ atra vairāgyarapādānantaramubhayaliṅgapādārambhamākṣipya samdhatte brahmaiveti| pūrvamubhābhyāmadhyāyābhyāṃ sarvairapi svaiḥ svabhāvairanvitaṃ brahma pratyapādi| ayañca sādhanādhyāyaḥ| asminnadhyāye samanvayāvirodhādhyāyapratipādhyasya brahmaṇaḥ
punarākṛṣya cintā kimartheti codakābhiprāyaḥ| codhyaṃ nirākaroti maivamiti| ayamatrābhiprāyaḥ satyamayaṃ sādhanādhyāyaḥ| athāpi brahmacintā viśeṣataḥ kartavyaiva| sādhanaṃ hi dvividham sādhyopāyassiddhopāyaśca| siddhopāya īśvaraḥ| sādhyopāyassadvidhyādibhedavatī tadbhiktireva| vidhyābhedaśca rūpabhedāt| rūpañca vidhyāyāḥ prādhānyena vedhyaṃ brahmaiva| tasya ca bhedastadguṇabhedāt| evañca sādhanādhyāyapratipādhyasādhanarūpabhaktiviṣayatvena svayañca siddhopāyatayā sādhanatvena sādhanādhyāye brahmacintā viśeṣeṇa saṅgacchata iti| tatra brahmacintanasya vidhyopakārakatvaṃ tāvadāha vidhyā iti| taddhi tadrūpabhedāditi tad brahmaviśadīkaraṇaṃ tadrūpabhedāt tadguṇabhedāt tenobhayaliṅgatvādi viśeṣaṇopetaṃ brahmātra cintanīyamityarthaḥ| asya siddhopāyatvapratipādanārthaṃ brahmacintanaṃ saphalamityāhasiddheti|dvaṃkhalu viśeṣataḥ pratipādhyam brahmaṇassiddhopayatvaṃ siddhaprāpyatvañca| etadubhayapratipādanaṃ prāpye brahmaṇi tṛṣṇāviśeṣa
siddhayartham| tṛṣṇāviśeṣābhāve khalupāyādhikāra eva puruṣasya na syāt| svargakāmo hi yāgādiṣvadhikurute evaṃ parabrahmaprāptikāmo hi brahmopāsaneṣvadhikuryāt| tathā cobhayaliṅgapāda upāsanānuṣṭhāne viśeṣeṇopakarotīti śarīrakaśāstrasāro'yaṃ pāda iti na nairarthakyaprasaṅgaḥ| tṛṣṇāprathimna iti tṛṣaṇābhivṛddhayarthamityucyate|abhivardhate hyatra tṛṣṇā " sa svenaiva phalapradaḥ " ityuktaprakāreṇa svaprāpakatvena svayameva brahmaṇi parijñāte iti bhāvaḥ||
kiṃñca akhilaheyapratyanīkakalyāṇaikatānatāpratipādanaparo'yamubhayaliṅgapādo mṛṣāvādiprabhṛtīnāṃ pareṣāṃ pratikṣepe viśeṣeṇopakarotīti saphalaevetyāha  nairguṇyamiti| brahmaṇo nairguṇyaṃ cet guṇopasaṃhārapādādhikaraṇeṣūbhayaliṅgapādapratipāditakalyāṇaguṇabhedairbrahmavidhyāvibhāgo vitathassyāt| nanu kalpitaireva guṇairbrahmāvidhyāvibhāgassyāditi parapakṣamanuvadati so'sviti| tat pratikṣipati śrutimatavihatiriti| anādinidhanāvicchannasampradāyatayā
pratipannasya śrutyarthasya kalpitatve kimakalpitaṃ syāt? tathā ca guṇānāṃ kalpitatvaṃ vadan vedāntabahirbhūta ityarthaḥ|
nanu vedānte'pi "mano brahmetyupāsīta " ityevamādiṣu "garuḍamātmānaṃ jānīyāt " ityādivad ddaṣṭividhirddaśyate tadvadatrāpi syādityāśaṅkya nirākaroti nātreti| ekatrāgatyā ddaṣṭividhiparigrahe sarvatrāpi tathaiva syāditi na vaktuṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ| anyatrānyaguṇāropeṇānusandhāne hi ddaṣṭividhiḥ| brahmaṇastu satyatvajñānatvādikaṃ svarūpaguṇatvavādabādhyamityarthaḥ| evaṃ kalyāṇaguṇaikatānatvapratipādakapramāṇavirodhāt mṛṣāvādino doṣamuktvā nirdoṣatvapratipādakapramāṇavirodhādapi mṛṣāvādipakṣasya duṣṭatvamāhanirdoṣatvamiti|brahmanirdoṣatvañca nityameveti pramāṇānusāreṇa yadi vadasi tathā brahmavyatiriktasya saṃsarato jīvasyābhāvād brahmaṇo nityanirdoṣatvācca mudhā nirarthaka eva saṃsārarūpadoṣaśāntyartho vedāntaśravaṇādiprayāsa iti nairarthakyameva śāstrārambhasya| tarhi nirdoṣatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kalpyamiti vadāma iti parasyābhiprāyamāśaṅkya pratikṣipati kalpyamiti| nirdoṣatvaṃ kalpyaṃ cet duṣṭataiva brahmaṇaḥ prakṛtisyāditi punaśśāstrārambhavaiyarthyamiti pareṣāṃ pratikṣepāyobhayaliṅgapādassaphala eva||
itthaṃ nirviśeṣatvasya mithyātve doṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā punassatyatvaṃ vadato bambhramyamāṇasya mṛṣāvādino bahūnapi doṣānāhakiñceti| brahmaṇo nirviśeṣatvapāramārthye brahmajijñāsā kartavyeti ādau cintyatvavādo na syāt, tathā
pramāṇagocaratvamapi tathaiva svasiddhāntasārabhūtaṃ svayamprakāśatvamānandarūpatvaṃ viśvādhyāsādhiṣṭhānatvaṃ " bahusyām "
iti svasya bahubhavanasaṅkalpaḥ| etāddaśaṃ sarvamapi guṇajātaṃ nirviśeṣe brahmaṇi kathaṃ syāt? na kathaṃcit syādityarthaḥ| ete guṇā yadi paramārthāstadā saguṇavādaprasaṅgaḥ| aparamārthāścet svayamprakāśatvānandatvayorapyaparamārthatve svasiddhāntasya mūlocchedaḥ| bauddhādibhyo vaiṣamyañca kiṃ syāt? ayamarthavirodha uktaḥ|śrutivirodhamapyāha
sarveti| śrutipramāṇavirodhamuktvā svavacanavirodhamapyāha svavacaneti| pratyakṣādikṛtsnapramāṇaviruddhavāditvādikaṃ
mṛṣāvādinassuprasiddhameva " durghaṭatvamavidhyāyā bhūṣaṇaṃ natu dūṣaṇam " iti| tad bhūṣaṇaṃ ced brahmaivāvidhyā, niradhiṣṭhāna eva bhramaḥ, niṣprakāśameva brahmetyādikamapyatyantadurghaṭaṃ śreṣṭhameva bhūṣaṇaṃ syāditi mādhyamikavijayatūryameva
joghuṣyeta|māyāvaiyātyetyādi māyādhāṣrṭyāt kaṣṭāṃ daśāmāpannānāmaṣṭapādakalpanāṃ mṛṣāvādināmiha guṇopasaṃhārapādapratipādhyaṃ sakalamapi saguṇopāsanaṃ samūlonmūlanamarhatīti sarvaśāstravyākopaḥ||
asminnubhayaliṅgapāde yadi brahma cintyamucyate tarhi jīvasya svapnādhyavasthākathanaṃ kathaṃ saṅghaṭetetyāśaṅkyasvapanādiddaṣṭirapi bhagavatsaṅkalpādeva sidhyatīti tatpradarśanasyāpi bhagavanmāhātmyapradarśaparatvādasminpāde saṅgatiryujyata iti pariharatityaktamiti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥdoṣaistyaktaṃ guṇāḍhyaṃ brahma yadi punariha cintyeta tarhi
jīvasya svapnādhyavasthamananamatha vairāgyapādānantaramasminpāde kathaṃ saṃghaṭeteti śaṅkā| tāmimāmāṃ nirākaroti
neti| tadeva vivṛṇoti svapneti| svapnārthasyāpi bhagavāneva sraṣṭati tatsraṣṭṛbhāvaprabhṛtibahuvidhabrahmamāhātmyasi
ddhayai tathā asya jantossvamuktāvatyanta paravaśatājñaptaye caitajjīvasya svapnādhyavasthāmananamatra kriyate|
ayamarthaḥ na jīvassvaprādhānyenātrocyate, api tu paramātmano jagratsvapnasuṣuptyādisarvāvasthākatṛtvapratipādanārtham
iti paramātmaivāsminpāde sarvatra prādhānyenocyata iti||
atra kecidāhuḥ  " asminnubhayaliṅgapāde pūrvārdhaṃ jīvaparaṃ vairāgyapādaśeṣabhūtam, uttarārdhaṃ paramātmaparamiti|
etadanuvadati  pādasyeti| paścārdhamatrāsminpāde sākṣādanughaṭitamupāstyartha tattadbhagavadguṇokteriti|
idamekadeśimataṃ nātīva hṛdhyamiti nirākaroti etaditi| tatra hetumāha śabaliteti| saṅkīrṇakathane
cāturīvaiparītyāditi| tarhi pādapūrvārdhe jīvadoṣagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamityāśaṅkya brahmaguṇābhivyaktyarthamiti pariharati
brahmeti|saṃsarato jīvasya kathane hi saṃsāramocakasya paramātmano māhātmyaṃ sidhyatītyarthaḥ|śabdārthastu  jīvadoṣagraha iha tu mukhamupāya ityartha iti||

aṅgīkṛtamanaṅgīkṛñca vibhajya darśayati śrutyādīti| śrutyādisiddhe'rthe śrutahānāyogāt sarvakarturbhagavatastatkālamātra tattatpuruṣamātrānubhāvyastusṛṣṭimaṅgīkṛtyātyantavyāhateṣvartheṣu bādhādeva jāgaravad bhrāntimaṅgīkṛtya sarvaṃ
nirvahantaśśrutisiddhamarthaṃ na kṣipāma iti||
tarhi svayamekatra vartamānasya svapne deśāntaragamanaṃ pāramārthikaṃ kathaṃ syādityāśaṅkya nānāśarīraparigrahavato
yogina iva viśvakarturbhagavatassaṅkalyaprabhāvāt sarvaṃ saṅghaṭata ityāha  kaściditi| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ
kaścidhyogī yogaprabhāvāt svaparagṛhayossvairasañcāranyāyena pūrvadehānniṣkrānto viśati paravapurdehāntaraṃ prāpnoti| tenaiva tatra sañcārādikamapi karoti|pūrvaṃ śarīramapi bhūyassamāgatya prāpnotīti| tathā svapne pūrvaśarīraṃ
parityajya bhagavatā sṛṣṭaṃ śarīrāntaraṃ svapnadraṣṭā prapnoti svapnānte pūrvaśarīraṃ pūnaḥ prapnotīti kecitpratipedire|
tadidamāha  itthamiti| pakṣāntaramapyāha śvāsavṛttyeti| ayaṃ khalvanyeṣāmabhiprāyaḥ  yadi svapne śayitaḥ puruṣaḥ pūrvaśarīraṃ parityajya śarīrāntaraṃ parigṛhṇāti, tadā pūrvasmin śarīre śvāsavṛttirna syāt| atastasminneva
śarīre jīvo'vatiṣṭhate| bhagavatā sṛṣṭeṣu tu svāpneṣu śarīrāntareṣu " pradīpavadāveśaḥ " iti vakṣyamāṇānyāyena
dharmabhūtajñānavyāptyā saubharinyāyasya siddhatvāt dharmabhūtajñānavyāptyaiva śarīrāntaraparigraha iti niraṇaiṣuriti||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye " evaṃ karmānurupagamanāgamanajanmādiyogena jāgrato jīvasya duḥkhitvaṃ khyāpitam| idānīmasya svapnavasthā parīkṣyate " iti| tadarthavicārastu  " na tatra rathā na rathayogā na panthāno bhavanti "
ityārabhya svapnasṛṣṭirāmnāyate, sā kiṃ pāramārthikī, uta māyāmātramiti| kiṃ "sṛjate sa hi kartā " iti nirdeśaḥ
pāramārthikatāmavagamayati neti| kimayaṃ nirdeśassṛṣṭikartuḥ kartṛtvaparaḥ, uta svapnajñānavatkartṛtvapara iti| kiṃ
prajāpativākyāvagatasatyasaṅkalpatvasya jīvasya svapne saṅkalpamātrāt sṛṣṭissambhavati neti| ya eṣu supteṣu
jāgarti kāmaṃkāmaṃ puruṣo nirmimāṇaḥ " iti jīvasya svapne saṅkalpamātrāt sraṣṭṛtvamavagamayati neti| kimidaṃ
vākyaṃ jīvaparamuta paramātmaparamiti|asmin khalvadhikaraṇe svapnasṛṣṭirjīvakāryamuta paramātmakāryamiti cintyate|
atra pūrvapakṣavādī manyate uktamiti|uktaṃ hi daharavākyaśeṣabhūte prajāpativākye prajānāṃ patyā satyasaṅkalpatādhyaṃ daharavad daharākāśavajjīvasyāpi|bhavinīti saptamī| jīve ityarthaḥ| tena svasaṅkalpāt sṛṣṭissvapne
jīvasyaiva samucitā| kiñcātraputrādīnāṃ sṛjyatvamucyate|putrādisambandho jīvasyaiva saṅghaṭate rathādīnāṃ jīvānukūlavastūpalakṣaṇatvāt| tena putrādikatṛtvena prakṛto jīvassvābhīṣṭaṃ svāpnamarthaḥ sṛjedityarthaḥ| imamarthaṃ pratikṣipatimaivamiti|tatra hetumāha muktāviti| tāddagguṇokteḥ jīvasyāpahatapāpmatvadiguṇāṣṭakāvirbhāvasyokteḥ svapnāvasthāyāmandhaprayo jīvaḥ kathamapahatapāpmatvādiguṇāṣṭakaṃ prāpnuyādityarthaḥ| hetvantaramapyāha anabhimateti|
yadi jīvassvayameva svārthaṃ svapne sṛjati tadānīṃ niyatamevānukūlaṃ sṛjet| suptaḥ khalu kadācitpratikūlānapi
svapne paśyati| tanna yujyate satyasaṅkalpatve jīvasya svapratikūlaṃ svayameva kathaṃ sṛjediti| tṛtīyamapi hetvantaramāha  svāpnānāṃ sūcakatvāditi| śuklāni sarvāṇi śubhāvahānītyevaṃ svapne'pīśvarasaṅkalpena svayamāgatāni śubhāśubhasūcakānīti pratipattavyamityarthaḥ| tasmādīśvarasraṣṭṛtvameva svapnaprapañcasya| tadidamāha 
nikhilajagaditi||
atra " kāmaṅkāmaṃ puruṣo nirmimāṇaḥ " iti viṣayavākye kiṃ ṇamulyapratyayenābhidhānam? kiṃ vā kāmaṃkāmamiti karmabhūtaviṣayaviśeṣābhidhānam? ityāśaṅkya bhagavatassatyasaṅkalpasya sraṣṭṛtvābhidhānārthaṃ ṇamuleva
samucita ityāha  kāmaṃkāmamiti| jīvasyāsatyasaṅkalpasya kartṛtvāyogāt| tathā ca satīśvara evānudhyate|
ayaṃca paramātmā supteṣu puruṣeṣu jāgarti| tena tasyāścaryarupakāryakaraṇe kartṛtvaṃ yujyata ityarthaḥ| tasya jāgaraṇañca śratisiddhamityāha viśadamiti| " prājñenātmanā sampariṣvaktaḥ " iti hi śrūyate| nanu jāgivat svapnasyāpi paramārthasṛṣṭirūpatve kathaṃ tattatkālāvasāyitvam? kathaṃvā tattadekaikapuruṣamātrānubhāvyatvaṃ? ityāśaṅkyaniraṅkuśasvatantreśvarasaṅkalpaviśeṣādityabhiprāyeṇa pariharatitattaditi| na kevalaṃ svapna eva tattatkālāvasāna
kāryasṛṣṭiḥ, apitu jāgare'pi meghodayādīnāṃ tāddaktvenopalambho ddaśyate| nanu tathapyekapuruṣānubhāvyatvaṃ na ddaśyata
iti cet tadapīśvarasaṅkalpāditi mantavyam| ddaśyante hi mantrauṣadhasiddhāñjanādiprabhāvat tattatpuruṣamātrānubhāvyāviṣayaviśeṣāḥ| aparyaviyājyaḥ khalvīśvarasṛjyatve hetvantaramapyāha tattatkarmānurūpaṃ phalavitaraṇamiti| svapnadarśanaṃ hi sukhaduḥkhātmakatvātkarmaphalaṃ karma ceśvarasaṅkalpaviśeṣa itīśvarāyattatvameva svāpnasyārthajātasya|
pāpī hi pāpānurūpaṃ svapnaṃ paśyati dharmottarastu tadanurūpamiti mahānayaṃ mārgassarvairapyanatilaṅghanīyaeva| etadapyuktamāptairiti  ayamabhiprāyaḥ|kasyacitkvāpi kāle śubhapraptiritasya punaraśubhaprāptiriti nimittasāmudrikatattadgrahasañcārādinā vidvadbhirabhidhīyate, pratibandhādinā yadi tanna syāt tatsvapne'pi na prāpyata
iti tairevābhidhīyate, ato'pi karmaphalatvaṃ siddhaṃ svāpnasya sukhaduḥkhāderiti||
atra " māyāmātrantu kātsn ryena " iti sūtre māyāśabdaprayogamātramavalambya śrutimukhasugatā vedavādacchadmabauddhā mṛṣāvādino viśvamithyātvamāhuḥ| tanmataṃ dūṣayati  māyeti| tat prapañcamithyātvaṃ taiśśāsrārambhe kathitamiti punaratrābhidhāne paunaruktyamasaṅgatatvañca| teneśvaravicitrasṛṣṭissvapnaprapañca ityetadevātrocyate napunarviśvamithyātvam| māyāśabdamātravalambanenaiva hi mṛṣāvādināmidamabhidhānam, tadapi teṣāmanālambanamityāha  māyāśabda iti| na hi loke māyāśabdo mithyāvacana ityābhidhānikāḥ paṭhanti|
" māyā tu vayanaṃ jñānam " iti hi naighaṇṭukā jñānaviśeṣa eva māyāśabdaṃ prayuñjate| "indro māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyate"
ityādāvīśvarassaṅkalpaviśeṣairnānārūpo'nubhūyata iti hyucyate| āha ca parāśaraḥ
" anekaśaktirūpāṇi tatkaroti janeśvara|
devatiryaṅmanuṣyākhyāceṣṭāvanti svalīlayā||
jagatāmupakārāya na sā karmanimittajā|| iti|
līleti svasaṅkalpa evocyate| sa ca saṅkalpo jñānañca māyā, ato na māyāśabdo mithyāvācī, apitvāścaryasṛṣṭivācī, yadvā tatsṛṣṭihetubhūtaśaktiviśeṣavācī, athavā tattatsṛṣṭinidānanimittabhūtasaṅkalpaviśeṣavācī| ddaśyante hi prayogāḥ " devamāyeva nirmitā " iti| mithyātve hi kalpiteti vyapadiśyeta| anyadapi|
" tenamāyāsahasraṃ tat śambarasyāśugāminā|
bālasya rakṣatā dehamaikaikaśyena sūditam|| iti|
atra hi sūditamiti nāśyatvamevocyate| nāśo hi paramārthasataḥ pradhvaṃsaḥ| anyathā bādhyatvamevocyeta| bādho hi
pratipannopādhau niṣedhyatvamiti bhṛṣāvādino vadanti| "māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ vidhyāt" iti māyāśabdasya mithyārthatvavyāvṛttyarthaṃ hi prakṛtiṃ vidhyādityucyate| ata eva " māyāmṛgo hṛtaḥ " ityatra mārīcasya pradhvaṃsa eva varṇyate| meghanādamāyādiṣvapi mantraviśeṣasādhyaparamārthasarpāṇāmeva māyeti vyavahāraḥ| kathamanyathā garuḍaprabhāvaviśeṣairnirākaraṇāyatvaṃ yujyate? kiñca sarvalokaprasiddho'yaṃ vyavahāraḥ| sāmabhedadānadaṇḍamāyendrajālopekṣā iti sāptopāyā nītiśāstreṣu nirdiśyante| tatra māyendrajālayorvaiṣamyamucyate|
mantrādiśaktiviśeṣāt paramārthasarpādisṛṣṭirmāyā| tasmādeva mantrādiśaktiviśeṣādaparamārthagajaturagarathapādātādipradarśanena parakaṭakabhañjanamindrajālaphalamiti| evamanyatrāpyudāharaṇāni draṣṭavyāni| athāpi purāṇeṣu pāmaraprayogeṣu
ca mithyāviṣaye'pi māyāśabdaḥ prayujyata ityāśaṅkyottaramāha upacaratviti| na hyaupacārikaḥ prayogaśśabdasya
śaktiviśeṣaṃ niyamayatītyarthaḥ| tadidamāha  kiṃ tata iti| prayogaprācuryamitihāsapurāṇādiṣvapi prācuryeṇa
satyabhūtaevāsurarākṣasāstrādāveva ddaṣyata ityāha  satya iti| " meghodayassāgarasaṃnivṛttiḥ " ityupakramya
" viṣṇorvicitrāḥ prabhavanti māyāḥ " iti purāṇeṣvapi paṭhyate| tarhi kṛtsnasyapi kāryasya māyāśabdavācyatve kiṃ
niyāmakamityāśaṅkyāhaucitaniyamana iti| ayamarthaḥ āścaryarūpakāryaviśeṣo māyetyucyate indrajāle
māyāśabdabhidhānamāścaryarūpatvāviseṣādaupacārikamiti māyendrajālayorvibhāgaḥ| " devī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā
duratyayā " iti vacanaṃ triguṇasyaiva vicitraprapcasṛṣṭihetomāryāśabvācyatvaṃ vyaktameva sthāpayati||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye " idānīṃ suṣuptisthānaṃ parīkṣyate " iti| pūrvaṃ svapno nirūpitaḥ, idānīṃ suṣuptisthānamityarthaḥ| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ nāḍīpurītahbrahmāṇi jīvasya vikalpena suṣuptisthānāni? uta
samuccayeneti| kimeṣāṃ prasādakhaṭvāparyaṅkavat kāryabhedo'sti neti| " sata āgacchāmahe" iti brahmaṇaḥ prabodhaśravaṇaṃ
brahmaṇaḥ paryaṅkasthānīyatāmavagamayat kiṃ kāryabhedamavagamayati neti| atra pūrvapakṣīmanyatesthānaṃ jantorityādi|
jantossuṣuptau śrutiraniyamato nāḍyaḥ purītat brahmeti ca sthānaṃ vakti vadati| tasmāt trayāṇāmapi sthānānāṃ
mitho nairapakṣyāt nāḍyo vā purītadvā brahmaveti vikalpa iti pūrvapakṣaḥ| uktamarthaṃ pratikṣipatitanneti| pratikṣipameva yuktyā vivṛṇotiprāsādeti| ayamarthaḥ samuccaye kāryabhedābhāve hi vikalpo nyāyyaḥ| atra punaḥ
kāryabhedena samuccayena yojitānāṃ prāsādakhaṭvāparyaṅkanyāyena nāḍīpurītadbrāhmaṇaṃ vikalpo na nyāyya eva|sa ca
vikalpo'ṣṭadoṣaduṣṭa eva| tadevāhapakṣepakṣa iti| " vrīhibhiryajeta " " yavairyajeta " iti vikalpenānaṣṭhīyamānayo
vrīhiyavayoḥ prathamaṃ vrīhyanuṣṭhāne yavaśāstraviṣayau dvau doṣau sto yavaśāstre pramāṇyatyāgo'prāmāṇyasvīkāraśceti|
samanantaraṃ kadācidyavaśāstrānuṣṭhāne vrīhiśāstre pramāṇyatyāgo'prāmāṇyasvīkāraśceti dvau doṣau staḥ| tasminneva
yavānuṣṭhānasamaye yavaśāstre tyaktaprāmāṇyasvīkārassvīkṛtāprāmāṇyaparityāgaśceti dvau doṣau bhavataḥ| punaḥ parivṛtya
vrīhiśāstrānuṣṭhānarūpe tṛtīye prayoge vrīhiśāstre tyaktaprāmāṇyasvīkāraḥ svīkṛtāprāmāṇyaparityāgaśceti dvau doṣau
sta iti prayogatrayādaṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvaṃ dvayorapi śāstrayoścatvāraścatvāro doṣā iti prathamānuṣṭhānavelāyāṃ dvau doṣau,
dvitīyānuṣṭānavelāyaṃ catvārastṛtīyānuṣṭhānavelāyāṃ punardvau doṣāviti buddhyā vibhajya dhīmadbhirbhāvanīyam|
prakārāntareṇāpyaṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvamāhurvikalpaviṣayamācāryaḥ vrīhyanuṣṭhāne yavaśāstre pratipattyanuṣṭhānāpūrvaphalabādha iti
catvāro doṣāḥ| evaṃ yavānuṣṭhāne vrīhiśāstre pratipattyanuṣṭhānāpūrvaphalabādha iti catvāro doṣā ityaṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvam|
tenāyamarthaḥgatyabhāve vikalpassvīkāryaḥ sambhavantyāṃ gatau samuccaya iti| atra tu prāsādakhaṭvāparyaṅkanyāyena samuccayasya sambhavād vikalpo na svīkāryaḥ| kramaghaṭitacaturdoṣayukta iti  prayogatrayasuddhamaṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvamanu
vadati| tena prayogadvāyāditi bālakānāṃ pratibhāso duṣpratibhāsa ityarthaḥ||
saṅgatirbhāṣeye " kiṃ suṣupta eva prabodhasamaya uttiṣṭhatyutānya iti saṃśaye " iti| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ
suṣuptādanyaḥ prabodhasamaye uttiṣṭhati, uta sa eveti| kiṃ suṣuptau sakalopādhivinirmoko'styuta neti| kiṃ karmānusmṛtiśabdavidhayassakalopādhivinirmokābhāvaṃ gamayanti neti| nanu suṣuptirnāma muktiprāyaiva muktiḥ kila
jahadarasukhagaṇā duḥkhasaṅghātavirahitā brahmaṇyapītireva pralaya eva śrutyaivakhyāpyate tena tadanu suṣuptyanantaramudbudhyamānastanubhṛdanya eveti pūrvapakṣānuvādaḥ kriyate muktiriti|imaṃ pakṣaṃ pratikṣipatimaivamiti| muktessvāpasya viśeṣaṃ darśayatikarmānuvṛtterityādinā|pūrvakarmānuvṛtteḥ karmaphalasya sukhaduḥkhāderdarśanāt karmānuvṛttirddaśyate| anyatve kathamiva smaraṇaṃ sambhavati? śabdo'pi " ta iha vyāghro vā" ityādibhāṣyopāttaḥ| vidhirapi
suṣuptasyaiva muktatve mokṣārthavidhayaḥ kathaṃ saṅghaṭeran? ayatnalabhyasya kiṃ yatneneti| svapadanuvadanāditi"nāhaṃ

eva vinaṣṭaprāyaḥ puruṣaḥ prabuddho bhavatīti mantavyam||
atra suṣuptasyaiva prabodhasamaye punarutthānamiti kimarthaṃ sthāpyate viśeṣaprayojanābhāvadityāśaṅkyātyantopayuktaṃ
prayojanaviśeṣamāha jīvānāditvamityādinā padyena| jīvānāmanāditvasiddhyarthamidaṃ sūtraṃ cet tatroktameva
" na karmāvibhāgāditi cennānāditvāt"|ityādinā| mokṣe ddaṣadanukaraṇakṣepaṇaṃ mūḍhatvakṣepaṇamanena sūtreṇa kriyate cet
tadapyuttaratra kariṣyate| sthāyitvopapādanena jīvānāṃ svargādhyarthapravṛttiḥ kriyate cet sāpi śrutinayaviditākṛtsnasyāpi mīmāṃsāśāstrasya sthāyitvamantareṇānupapattessvargādhyarthapravṛttirapi śrutyā tadanugrāhakanyāyena ca pūrvameva
viditā| ātmasthairyopapādanena kṣaṇabhaṅgabhaṅgaścet so'pi saugatādhikaraṇādiṣu siddhaḥ| jīvasya suṣuptāvīśvavaraikatvanirākaraṇārthamidamadhikaraṇaṃ cet tasya kalpānte'pyekatvamapi nāmarūpādiprahāṇamātrānna punassvarūpaikyāditi
tatratatroktam| tena sāpyuktirniyamitaviṣayā| ato bhūyaścintā suṣupteḥ na kartavyeti kasyacid bālaprāyasya
codhyamanūditaṃ pariharati pralayasamadaśāsajjihāsādisiddhyā iti| naiyāyikadurdurūḍhāḥ kecit pāṣāṇaprāyemeva
mokṣaṃ vadanti| tarhi " nāhamatra bhogyaṃ paśyāmi " "vināśamevāpīto bhavati " iti ninditā suṣuptirapi muktissyāt,
neyaṃ muktiriti manīṣibhiḥ prarthyate| evaṃ pāṣāṇavanmuktiriti vairāgyapāde tanmuktinindayā tajjihāsāviśeṣo'pi
sidhyati tadarthamayaṃ prasaṅga iti na nairarthakyamityarthaḥ||
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptirūpāvasthāviśeṣān pariśodhyānantaraṃ mūrcchārūpā suṣuptitulyāvasthā vicāryata iti saṅgatiḥ|
jāgratsvapnayoḥ prajñāyuktatvāt suṣuptimūrcchayoḥ prajñāviloparūpatvāt tayormithassaṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ
mūrcchā jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyādīnāmanyatamāvasthā, utāvasthāntaramiti| kiṃ lakṣaṇato bhedo vyavasthāpayituṃ śakyate neti| kiṃ sūkṣmaprāṇasambandho mūrccheti lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati neti| atra pūrvapakṣī prāha jāgratsvapnasuṣuptimaraṇabhedena catvāro
hyavasthāviśeṣā loke prasiddhāḥ| tatra jāgratsvapnau bāhyajñānavirahitau na bhavataḥ suṣuptiśca śvāsapūrṇatvānna
mūrcchā maraṇameva praśamitakaraṇaprāṇavargatvāditi| tadidamanuvadatijāgraditi| tatpratikṣipatineti| mūrcchāmaraṇayorbhede kāraṇabhedameva tāvat prāmāṇyatimṛtyāderiti| abhighātādimātrānmūrcchā śiraśchedādermaraṇamiti

viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvenaikātmyamiti vedāntatattvavedināṃ nirṇayaḥ| tena sarve vādinaḥ sarvavedāntavākyasvāsyavirodhādatravitrāsanīyā iti śabdānvayaḥ||
bhāṣya eva pūrvādhikaraṇanigamanavākyānvitenottarādhikaraṇopakramavākyena saṅgatirucyate " brahmaṇo nirdoṣatvena

parabrahmaṇaḥ paramapi tattvamastīti kaiściddhetvābhāsairāśaṅkya nirākriyate " iti| tadarthavicārastu yadidamubhayaliṅgaṃ brahma kimasmātparamapi kiñcit tattvamasti? uta neti| kimasyaiva paratve setūnmānasambandhabhedavyapadeśānāmupapattirasti? na veti| atra sūtrakāreṇopāttān pūrvapakṣahetūnanukrameṇānūdya
sautrakrameṇa parihāramapi darśayatisetumiti| " etaṃ setuṃ tīrtvā "iti tartavyatvavacanāt "catuṣpād brahma ṣoḍaśaphalam " iti brahmaṇaḥ parimitatvavacanāt prāpyasambandhitokteḥ "amṛtasyaiṣa setuḥ " iti prāpyasyānyasyāmṛtasya prāpakatayā tatsambandhitvenābhidhānāt, anyādhikyaśruterapi " parātparaṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam "
"parātparaṃ yanmahato mahāntam " iti sarvasmāt parasyānyasya śruteśca| ativahananayāt ativāhikanyāyenāyaṃ paramapuruṣo viśvakāraṇabhūtaḥ prāpaka eva syānna punaḥ prāpyaḥ| prāpyañcānyadeva kiñcid bhavediti vyomātītavādinaḥ| tadidaṃ pratikṣipati  asaditi| yajjagatkāraṇaṃ tadevadhyeyam " kāraṇaṃ tu dhyeyaḥ " iti niyamāt| yacca dhyeyaṃ tadeva prāpyam " brahmavidāpnoti param " "brahmaveda brahmaiva bhavati " iti prāpyaprāpakayorekatvanirṇayāt| ato yo'mṛtasya setustadevāmṛtamiti trayyantavādināṃ nirṇayaḥ| asmin brahmaṇi
setutvādyuktiḥ kathamiti cedatrottaram setutveti| bahupramāṇairaviruddhāṃ vṛttimaṅgīkarotu| īśvarasyaiva tāvatprāpyatvaṃ
prāpakatvañca sakalavedāntasiddhatvādaṅgīkaraṇīyameva| tena setutvādyuktīnāṃ yogyārthakalpanayārthopavarṇanaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ| anyathā loke mukhyāmukhyaprayogavibhāgo na syāt| amukhyaprayogāṇāṃ parityājyatvañca syāt| upa kramopasaṃhāpāditātparyaliṅgapariśodhanena viduṣāṃ tatratatra vākyārthopavarṇanamapi na syāditi sarvaśāstrasaṅkṣobhaḥ||
atra pūrvaṃ setutvādivacanaṃ yāgyārthakalpanayā yojyamityuktam| tāneva yogyānarthānanukrameṇa darśayatisetutvamiti| setutvaṃ setutulyād vidharaṇaniyāmātdhārakatvaniyamādityarthaḥ| bhagavāneva hi sarvadhārakaḥ| arthāntaramapyāhabandhanāditi sa eva bhagavālasaṅkareṇa sarvamapi tattvajātaṃ sambadhnāti|parimitivacanasyāpi gatimāhavyāpte'pīti| vyāpte'pyasminparasmin brahmaṇi parimitivacanaṃ sārthakamiti daharākāśādiprasaṅgeṣu tatratatra sūtritameva| " catuṣpād brahma " iti vacanaṃ tu "pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni " itivat tattacchatibhiranugaṇameva kalpanīyamanantabhūmno'pi brahmaṇaḥ| " amṛtasyaiṣa setuḥ " ityamṛtarūpasya
brahmaṇa iti vā brahmaprāptirūpamokṣasyāmṛtasyeti vā yojanīyam||
atra nārāyaṇasya paratvamaṅgīkṛtya tasmādapyanyasya paratvamucyata iti pūrvapakṣiṇā varṇyate| tatra ddaṣṭānto'pyuktaḥ| yathā "akṣarāt parataḥ paraḥ " ityatra parato'kṣarādanyaḥ para iti para ucyata iti| evamukte
ddaṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayovaṣaimyamāhaanyasyeti| ayamarthaḥ ddaṣṭānte hi prathamāntaparaśabdanirdiṣṭasya parasyādhikyavāde
pañcamyantaparaśabdanirdiṣṭamavadhitayā ddaṣṭam| tasya ca paraśabdavācyatvaṃ tatkāryarūpamahadādyapekṣayeti vacanānnirṇītama| tatra svakāryāpekṣayā parasmādakṣarāt paro jīvo vā paramātmā veti vaktuṃ śakyate| iha punaḥ
" na hyetasmāditi netyanyat paramasti " iti paramātmāpekṣayā paraḥ pratikṣipyate| tasmādanyaḥ paro na kalpanīya eva|
nanu " tato yaduttarataram " ityatra tacchabdena prakṛtaṃ paramapuruṣaṃ nirdiśya tato'pyuttarataraṃ tattvāntaraṃ nirdiśyate| ataḥ
paramapuruṣāduttaraṃ tattvamastīti kecidūcuḥ| tat pariharati evantvāditi| tatra tata ityevantvāditi heturanūdyate|
pūrvaṃ bahubhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ paramapuruṣa eva paratattvamityupapāditattvādityarthaḥ| tena "yaduttarataram " ityādikaṃ paramapuruṣamevāha napunastattvāntaram| tata iti śabdasyārthāntaramapyāhayadi veti| tataḥ paramapuruṣavyāpyatvena pūrvoktāt prapañcāt uttarataraṃ yadarūpamanāmayamityanvayaḥ| atrāpi paramapuruṣa eva paratvenocyate| yadi paramapuruṣāduttarataraṃ vastvastītyabhidhīyate tadā prakaraṇopakrame puruṣasūktapratyabhijñānena paramapuruṣāduttarasya
pratikṣepādupakramopasaṃhārayorupakramabalīyastvasyanyāyyatvādupakramānuguṇyenopasaṃhāravākyamasmaduktaprakriyayaiva yojanīyamiti bhāvaḥ| iyamatraśabdayojanāanyasyeśvarasya " akṣarātparataḥ paraḥ " ityādhikyavāde paraṃ prakṛtyādikaṃ avadhitayā yatra ddaṣṭaṃ tatra tasminnevodāharaṇe tadavadhiravyākṛtādistadapekṣayā avadhirasyāt| svayañca "akṣarāt parataḥ paraḥ" iti svakāryavargāt paratvenāpi nirdiśyate| atra tu " na hyetasmāditi netyanyatparamasti " iti "iti na " ityupadiṣṭādanyatparaṃ nāstīti parāntararāhityenopadiṣṭe viṣaye tatparoktestasmātparasyānyasyokterayukteḥ| tena paratvakalpanaṃ paramapuruṣa eva paryavasyati| " tato yaduttarataram " ityatra tu pañcamyantasya tacchabdasya hetuparatvamityeko nirvāhaḥ| avadhiparatve'pi pūrvoktāt paramapuruṣavyāpyāt
prakṛtatvena tacchabdena nirdeṣṭuṃ yogyādityaparo nirvāha iti||
atra pūrvottarādhikaraṇayossaṅgatimāha ārādhya iti| yatra hi paratvamaudāryañca sa eva hi sevya iti lokaprasiddham| paratve satyapi kadaryasyāsevyatvāt| tathaudārye satyapi nirdhanasyāsevyatvāt| tenottarapādapratipādyopāsyatvasiddhayarthaṃ bhagavataḥ
paratvamuktaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇe| iha punaḥ phalapradatvakathanāt audāryamucyata iti pūrvottarādhikaraṇasaṅgatiḥ| tadidaṃ paratvaṃ bhagavatastrikāṇḍyāṃ sarvatroktamanūdya tadanvitamaudāryamadhunā prakhyāpyate| anvayārthastu"sarve vedā yatraikaṃ bhavanti " " sarve hotāro yatraikaṃ bhavanti"|
"varṇāśramācāravatā " ityādibhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ prathamakāṇḍe viṣṇureva sarvakarmasamārādhyatā nirṇītaḥ| madhyamakāṇḍepi
"agniravamo devatānāṃ viṣṇuḥ paramaḥ" iti sa eva sarvadevatāntaryāmitvena tadadhyakṣatayā pratipāditaḥ| asminnapi
brahmakāṇḍe punaretāvatā daśabhirapi pādairbhāṣito bhavabhayacakitaprāptyupāstyekalakṣyamiti prāgevāsminpāde

pravṛttiniṣṭhadharmāṇāṃ karmayogajñānayogabhaktiyogādirūpāṇāṃ nivṛttiniṣṭhadharmāṇāñcānuguṇaṃ phalaṃ diśatīti vidyārambha
siddhyarthaṃ viśadamupapādyate| nahi prayojanamantareṇa prāṇināṃ pravṛttissambhavati| naca prayojanaṃ pradātāramantareṇa| na ca
pradātṛtvaṃ paratvaudāryābhyāṃ vinā| nāpi caitau guṇau puruṣottamādubhayavibhūtiviśiṣṭasvātmapradānamahāvadānyād bhagavato
nārāyaṇādanyatra sambhavata iti bhāvaḥ||
saṅgatiruktā| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ sāpūrvātkarmopāsanāt svargāpavargaphalotpattiḥ uta karmopāsanaprītādra vāyvādyavasthāt kevalācca parasmād brahmaṇa iti| kiṃ "sa evainaṃ bhūtiṃ gamayati " "yamevaiṣa vṛṇute tena labhyaḥ "
ityadivākyaśeṣo vāyvādyavasthasya kevalasya ca phalapradātṛtvagamayati neti| kimayaṃ vākyaśeṣo yathapratīyamānārthaḥ,
utānyapara iti| atra pūrvapakṣavādī manyatekṛṣyāderiti| lokekṛṣyādermardanāderapi phalamastītyavivādametat|
anyathā pravṛttyayogāt| tacca phalaṃ ddaṣṭadvāreṇaiva jāyate na punaraddaṣṭadvārā kalpanāgauravaprasaṅgāt| avyavahitaphalotpattau ddaṣṭamapi dvāraṃ nāpekṣate| dharmāṇāṃ punaḥ sādhanatvaṃ śrutyavagatatvādaparityājyameva| na ca "ādityo yūpaḥ " ityādivat śrutiratra bādhavatī| tena bādhadoṣojjñitābhiśśrutibhiravagatatvādasyeva dharmāṇāṃ sādhanatvam| itthaṃ dharmāṇāṃ sākṣāt sādhanatve śrūyamāṇe'pīśvara prasādāt phalamiti vacanamīśvarapraśaṃsārthameveti
kalpayituṃ yuktam| āśaṅkitamarthaṃ pratikṣipati neti| tatra hetumāhaśrauteti| atrāyaṃ vibhāgaḥkarmaiva kālāntarabhāviphalaṃ dadātītyeka pakṣaḥ| karmavyatiriktamapūrvābhidhānamityaparaḥ| karmarūpārādhanaprīto devatāviśeṣa iti
tṛtīyaḥ| prathamapakṣe karmaṇaścitapradhvastatvāt phalahetutvameva na sambhavati| dvitīye tu pakṣe śrutahānāśrutakalpanābhyāṃ
dvau doṣau staḥ| śrūyate hi " sa enaṃ prītaḥ prīṇāti " ityādinā devatāyāeva phalapradatvam| tena tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ śraudatvādarthavirodhābhāvācca svīkartavya iti devatāyā eva phalapradatvaṃ siddham| idaṃ tu sāmānyaṃ " ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca" iti sarvakarmasamārādhyatvaṃ sarvakarmaphalapradatvaṃ cocyate| apradānaśīlasya hi prabhutvaṃ
gaganakusumakūrmaromanaraviṣaṇādiṣvanyatamāyate| tena prabhutvamiti phalapradatvamevocyata iti bhāṣyakārā niraṇaiṣuḥ| tasyaiva vākye vaktuṃ yogyatvādkāṅkṣitatvācceti||
atra phalapdatvakathane tatratatra pūrvoktārthaviśeṣeṇa paunaruktyamāśaṅkya pratikṣipati yadyapīti| pūrvaṃ hi devatādhikaraṇe " prītiḥ phalapradānañca devatānāṃ na vidyate " iti vadatāṃ pratikṣepāt phalapradatvamuktameva| samanantaraṃ tu "kṛtaprayatnāpekṣastu vihitapratiṣiddhāvaiyarthyādibhyaḥ " ityasminnapi sūtre pūrvakarmānurūpaṃ puṇyapāpayorīśvaraḥ pravartayatīti karmaphalamīśvarādhīnamityuktam| tat kimarthaṃ phalapradatvamatrāpyucyate? tadetadaṅgīkṛtyaiva pratikṣipati
tathāpīti| " sākṣī cetā " "avākyanādaraḥ " ityādau tatratatravedāntavākye sākṣitvānādaratvavacanāt tacchravaṇamātreṇa bibhyataupāsakasyopāsanapravṛttirevotsīdet|teneśvarasyopekṣakatvādiśaṅkātaṅkapaṅkilabuddherupāsa
kasya bhayanivāraṇārthaṃ paramodārasya bhagavataśśriyaḥ patyuḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇaikatānacittasyaudāryameva pradhānaguṇamasminnadhikaraṇe pratiṣṭhāpayati sūtrakāra iti sāphalyānna paunaruktyagandhāvakāśaḥ||
īśvarasya phalapradānaprakāraṃ rājatatputranyāyena lokaddaṣṭaprakriyayā pratiṣṭhāpayatisamrāja iti| loke hi keṣāñcit putrāṇāṃ kaścidapi pitā samrāḍeva bhavati sa ca sānukampaḥ kartavyākartavyayorucitamapyarthaṃ jānāti sarveṣu ca putreṣu sāmyameva bhajate vadānyaśca bhavati| sarvaṣvapi putreṣu audāryamapi sādhāraṇamevetyarthaḥ| evambhūtāt
pituḥ putrā niyatarucibhidāyantritāssvasvecchānurūpyeṇa svābhīṣṭaṃ taṃtamarthaṃ vindanti labhante| evaṃ paramapuruṣādapyetadguṇajātopetāt putrakalpāssarve tatsevakāḥ puruṣāḥ svābhīṣṭamarthaṃ labhanta itiśeṣaḥ| tatra
prāpyaprāpakatadvirodhitadupaśamanādikaṃ sakalamapi pitāputranyāyeneśvare'pi syāditi viśadaṃ prakāśayati tatreti|
svataḥ prāpyaṃ gṛhakṣetrādikaṃ dāyarūpaṃ yat yataḥ pitrājñollaṅghanādihetostasya vihatirbhavati| tatpraśāntiśca yasmātpunarāgatya tatpādapraṇāmādeḥ| yacca deyaṃ dhanābharaṇapaṭṭavastracchatracāmarādikam| aviśeṣādaparādhakṣamāpaṇābhāve damanamapi śikṣaṇamapi yathālokaṃ tatsarvamatrāpi syāt| rājabhṛtyasya tu rājājñollaṅghane pādacchedādimanam, tatputrasya tu jīvikāsaṅkocādikam| evamabhāgavatānāṃ pāpaphalaṃ śāstroktaṃ
narakaprāyaṇādikam| bhāgavatānāṃ tu buddhapūrvakāparādha prasaṅge " na khalu bhāgavatā yamaviṣayaṃ gacchanti| ihaivaiṣāṃ
kecidupaplavā bhavanti" iti kāṇatvakhañjatvādikameva damanam| tena " laghurdaṇḍaḥ prapannasya rājaputrāparādhavat "
ityuktaprakāreṇa prapannānāmaparādhānanurūpadaṇḍanamatyalpameva syāditi sakalaphalaprade bhagavati paramakāruṇike viśvāsena brahmavidyānuṣṭhānaṃ sahasaiva kartavyamitīdamadhikaraṇamupāsanārambhameva sandhukṣayati||
