vedāntaśāstramupapādayati| tatpratipādyamarthajātamatattvaṃ cet kiṃ tattvam? na kimapīti cet mādhyamikasaṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ| viśeṣaṇamātattvaṃ viśeṣyamātraṃ tattvamiti cet kaḥ prāha? śrutiriticed vācyatvavedyatvādibhiḥ punarapi mithyābhūtaṃ brahma syāt| svayamprakāśaṃ taditi cet ki tat svayamprakāśatvam ?
avadyatve sati aparokṣavyavahārānuguṇatvamiti ced vyavahārānuguṇatvādeva punarapi mithyātvamunmajjet|
svayamprakāśatvamṛṣātvānna doṣaiti cet svayamprakāśatvasya mithyātve paraprakāśatvameva tathyamiti punarapi ddaśyatvānmithyātvaṃ samarthayase brahmaṇa ityasambaddhavādinā bhavatā vivādamapi kartumapatrapāmahe||
iti tṛtīyādhyāye dvitīya pādaḥ
evaṃ pūrvoktairdaśabhiḥ pādairmokṣopāyopayuktaṃ tattvajñānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpitam| uttaratra ṣaḍbhiḥ pādai parabrahmaprāptirūpaphalasaṃvalitaṃ taddhetubhūtamupāsanaṃ viśadameva prakāśyata iti pūrvottarayoranvayamāhatattvajñāneti|
mokṣyamāṇasya puruṣasya tattvajñānānuviddhaṃ hitatamamupāsanamuttaratra vaktuṃ tattve viṣaye tarkajvarajanitamahāsannipātapralāpān paravādān nirdhūyādhunā tattvabodhe niṣpanne sati tattvajñānasya sañjātatvāt|
" dagdhākhilādhikāratvāt brahmajñānāgninā muniḥ|
vartamānaśśrutermūndha naiva syādvedakiṅkaraḥ|| "
iti vedakiṅkaratvamapalapadbhayo mṛṣāvādibhyaḥ " sa khalvevaṃ vartayan yāvadāyuṣaṃ brahmalokamabhisampadyate "
iti śrutisiddhaṃ yāvajjīvānuvartyaṃ muraripubhajanaṃ muktisiddhaye vaktītyanvayaḥ| itthaṃ kila mṛṣāvādīmanyate ya eva
hyahaṅkārādiyuktaḥ saeva vedakiṅkaraḥ; kartṛtvabhoktṛtvayoranātmadharmatvāt| kāmyakartṛtvaṃ tāvat saṃsārahetutvānnirastameva jñāninaḥ| brahmopāsanakartṛtvamapi tathaiva nirastaṃ tasyāpi sāṃsārikadharmāntarbhāvāt| brahma tu
na jñeyaṃ nopāsyaṃ na prāpyamapi| naca vedairayamartho jñāpyate| nityasvayamprakāśatvāt svayamprakāśatvamapi na nirucyate|
tadanirvacane kathaṃ brahmasiddhiriticet mā bhūt brahmasiddhiḥ| ata eva hyadhyātmavidaḥ pravadanti " avacanenaiva provāca "
iti| evamasambaddhavādino mithyāvādinassadvidyāmapi svasamayasārabhūtatayā parigṛhītāṃ parityajanti kimuta
daharavidyādikān vidyābhedān vividhaguṇapariṣkārayuktān| atastatpratikṣepārabhyata iti||
atra tṛtīyādhyāye caturṇāmapi pādānāmarthabhedaṃ dvikadacvayasyāpyarthabhedānmithobhedaṃ paurvāparyaniyamañca darśayati
bhīmābhya iti| atra pūrvapādadvaye'dhikārasampattiheturadhikāraśca saṃsāraviraktisaṃvalito bhagavati tṛṣṇāyogaḥ
ubhāvetāvubhābhyāṃ pādābhyāmabhidhīyate iti viśadaṃ prakāśyate| tatra bhīmābhya ityādinā vairāgyapādārthamāha tṛṣṇāmityādinobhayaliṅgapādārtham| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ yāvatākṛṣṇāmṛtābdhau tṛṣṇāṃ paraṇayati tāvaduktamiti
uttarapādadvayārthamāha  itthamiti| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ ubhābhyāṃ pādābhyāṃ labdhādhikāro yatra sāṅge sādhane
pravartate tat sāṅgaṃ sādhanaṃ parasmin pādadvandve bahubhidābarbaraṃ nirbravītibahubhedena viṣamitaṃ vikalpitaṃ nirbravīti
sūtrakāraḥ| ayamarthaḥbrahmavidyāviśeṣāḥ khalu " nānāśabdādi " iti sapramāṇakaṃ bhinnatayopadiṣṭāḥ| "vikalpo'viśiṣṭaphalatvāt " ityekaphalasādhanatvena ta eva vikalpitāḥ| evamubhayākārayuktasādhanajātamudiśyata iti | ayamatrānukramaḥ vairāgyapūrvaṃ hi prāpyatṛṣṇā jāyate prāpyaviṣayaprepsāyaṃ jātāyāmupāyādhikāraḥ upāyepravṛttasyādhikāriṇaḥ purastādupāye nirṇīte upariṣṭāt karaṇasthānīyasarvabrahmavidyāṅgakarmopāditsā jāyata iti vidyāṅgapādasya paścādbhāva iti||
nanu pādārthābhidhāne bhagavatā bhāṣyakāreṇa " idānīṃ brahmopāsanānāṃ guṇopasaṃhāravikalpa nirṇayāya vidyābhedābhedacintā prastūyate " ityuktam, atra ko'yaṃ pādārthaḥ? kiṃ bhedacintā utābhetacintā athavā kvacidbhedacintā kvacidabhedacintā yadvā bhedābhetacinteti| nādyaḥ; sārvatrikatvābhāvāt| ata eva na dvitīyaḥ|
na ca tṛtīyaḥ; anuvṛttārthāsiddheḥ| na caturthaḥ; bhedābhedātmakasya cintanīyasya vyāhatatvena tadviṣayacintāyā ayogāt| cintāśabdena saṃśayātmakaṃ vicāramabhidhāya pakṣadvayābhidhāne'pi etasminpāde guṇopasaṃhārānupasaṃhāracintā
hīyeta| saiva hi cintā pāde'smin pradhānā; guṇopasaṃhārapāda iti samākhyāyogāt| tadidaṃ sarvamabhipretyāha ekasminniti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥ ekasmin pāde eka evārthassvīkāryo nipuṇanayakṛtā puruṣeṇa| dvayostarkaṇaṃ
vicāro na syāt| bhedābheda ityeko'rtho nāstyeva, śabdaprayogamātreṇa śaśaviṣāṇādivadastitve'pi tasyaiva cintanamasmin pāde syāt na punaranyasya guṇopasehārānupasaṃhārādeścintanam| tadidamāha anyahānaprasaṅgāditi| uktamarthaṃ saṅkalayya nigamayatitasmāditi| evaṃ vikalpaduṣṭatvādasmin pāde prakīrṇā nayavitatirnyāyavistaraḥ praśithila iti prekṣitagranthacodye vidyābhedābhedacintā kriyata iti ddaṣṭabhāṣyagranthasya kasyacit puruṣasya codye sati vedyāvacchinnavidyāniyamakṛdayaṃ pāda ityaidamarthyaṃtātparyaṃsamarthyam|
ayamarthaḥ nātra bhedo nāpyabhedaḥ pradhānatayā cintyate, bhedābhedau guṇopasaṃhārānupasaṃhārārthāveva| tena
guṇopasaṃhārapādaprasiddhirapi yujyate| tarhyupasaṃhāro'nupasaṃhāro vā pādārtha iti punaścodyamunmajjatīti cet
yathāyogyamupasaṃhārānupasaṃhārānyataranirṇayaḥ pādārtha ityaikārthyasiddhiḥ| vedyāvacchinnavidyāniyamakṛdayamiti vedyaṃ bhinnaṃ
cet vidyā ca bhinnā, abhinnaṃ cet sā cābhinnā, tena vedyānurūpaṃ vidyāniyamanamiti pādarthaikyasiddhiḥ| atra vedyabhedastu guṇabhedāt napunarbrahmabhedāt| tena guṇopasaṃhārapādaprasiddhissutarāṃ saṅghaṭata iti||
pūrvasmin śloke vedyāvacchinnavidyāniyamakṛdayamiti pādasyaikārthyaṃ samarthitam| atra kaścidāha astvaikārthyam, athāpi vidyaikyapratipādake'sminpāde abheda evaikaḥ pādārthaḥ| na punarvidyā bhedaḥ, tarhi " vidyābhedābhedacincā " iti kathaṃ bhāṣyakārairucyate? iti cet astvapavādapradarśanam| vidyaikyameva pādārthaḥ|
aikyāsambhave kvacidbhedo'pi syādityapavāda eva pradarśyate napunarbhedaḥ pādārthabhūta iti| imāmāśaṅkāmanuvadati
ākhyāvantamiti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥguṇānāmupasaṃhārato guṇopasaṃhārapāda ityākhyāvantametaṃ pādaṃ nijagaduḥ|
tat tasmātkāraṇādākhyāsāmarthyāt vidyaikyapratipādatake'sminpāde bhedacintā tvapavādatvenaiva prasaktā na punaḥ
pādārthatayā| imamāśaṅkā parihartumeva bhāṣyakārairuktaṃ " vidyābhedābhedacintā " iti| tadāha itthamiti| kaḥ
punassarvānuvṛttaḥ pādārtha iti cettatrāha viṣaya iti||
atra kaściccodayatiguṇabhedāt vidyābheda iti bhavadbhiriktam| tarhi phalabhedo'pi syāt| "yathākraturasmin
loke puruṣo bhavati tathetaḥ pretya bhavati " iti hi śrūyate "taṃ yathāyathopāsate tathaiva bhavati " iti ca| tena yadguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ bhagavantamupāste tadguṇaviśiṣṭameva prāpnotīti śrutyarthaḥ| viśeṣavidhauśeṣaniṣedhasya nyāyyatvāt upāsyaguṇavyatiriktaguṇaviśiṣṭabhagavatprāptirarthānniṣidhyata iti paripūrnabrahmānubhavo mokṣa iti vādamātrameva syāt|
tadidamanuvadatinissīmeti| nissīmānandaparvotkarṣahetubhūtanirupadhikānantasampadguṇaudhe paramātmani vedyākārabhedaprayuktabhedavadvidyābhedairvibhajya praṇidhiryadi syāt, tarhi prāptirapi brahmaṇi aṃśata ekadeśena syāt|
yāvānupāsanaviṣaya ākārastāvāneva prāpyākārassyāt| tathā ca na paripūrṇabrahmānubhavaḥ phalamityāpatet| etaccodyamapākarotimaivamiti| apākaraṇameva vivṛṇotitaireveti| ayamarthaḥ "yathākraturasmiṃlloke puruṣo bhavati "
ityatropāsyākārasyānyūnabhāveva prāptirucyate| "tathaiva bhavati " iti kṛtsnasyāpyupāsyākārasya prāptyabhidhānāt|
nyūnatve punarupāsyākārasya kṛtsnatvameva bhajyeta| adhikākārasambandhastvatra na vidhīyate nāpi niṣidhyate| viśeṣavidhau śeṣaniṣedhanyāyāt niṣidhyata iti cet ayamapi bhrāntimūla evopanyāsaḥ| vidhāyakapramāṇāntarābhāve hi
ārtho niṣedhaḥ parigṛhyeta| atra tu vidhāyakamasti " nirañjanaḥ paramaṃ sāmyamupaiti " iti śrutyaiva paramasāmyābhidhānāt| idañca paramasāmyaṃ bhogamātra eveti sūtrakāraireva sthāpayiṣyate " bhogamātrasāmyaliṅgācca " iti| tena nahi vacanavirodhe nyāyaḥ prabhavatīti nyāyenādhikaniṣedho durnyāyavedināmeva nirṇayaḥ| tarhīśvarasāmyāṅgīkāre jīvasyāpīśvaratvaṃ prasajya iti cenna; sūtrakāraireva mātraśabdaṃ prayuñjānairnirastatvāt|
śabdārthastutairevadharmairupāsyaireva bhagavadguṇaistaditarasahitai ranupāsyairguṇairapi sahitaiḥ pūrṇaṃ brahmaiva pūrṇakāmasya
muktasya prāpyamiti nānyadatra phalamasti| svargādisādhaneṣu tūpāsyamanyat phalamanyaditi prasiddhametat| tenātra
tatkratunyāyenopāsyānupāsyakalaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ tadeva brahma prāpyamiti tatkratunyāyassidhyati| tena na kvacidapi vidyāsu phalavaiṣamyaprasaṅgaḥ||
atra pādasaṅgatirbhāṣye " uktaṃ brahmopāsisiṣopajananāya vaktavyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ phaladāyitāparyantam| idāniṃ brahmopāsanānāṃ guṇopasaṃhāravikalpanirṇayāya vidyābhedābhedacintā prastūyate " iti| adhikaraṇāvatāramapyāha "prathamaṃ tāvat " ityādinā| "phalamata upapatteḥ " ityatra upāsyasya brahmaṇassarvaphalapradāne prādhānyamuktam, adhunā punarmūrdhādipādaparyantapariklṛptyā savigrahabrahmopāsanarūpāyā vaiśvānaravidyāyāḥ paravidyāntarāt prādhānyena saiva prathamaṃ
vicāryate| ata eva bhagavatā parāśareṇa brahmavidyāprasaṅgesavigrahameva brahma prathamaṃ cintanīyaṃ śubhāśrayatvāt, brahmasvarūpaṃ tu na yogayujā cintyam, ārūḍhayogenaiva cintyamityuktam| asyāñca vidyāyāṃ pūrvakāṇḍaśākhāntarādhikaraṇoktasakalanyāyasamuccayasya vidyamāntavāt etadvicārapūrvakameva vidyāntaravicāraucityādeṣaiva vidyā pūrvaṃ vicāryata itiyabhiprāyaḥ| etadeva " prathamaṃ tāvat " iti dvābhyāmapi padābhyāṃ
dyotyate| tadarthavicārastu nānāśākhāsvadhītāyā vaiśvānarādikāyā vidyāyāḥ kiṃ pratiśākhaṃ bhedaḥ, utaikyamiti| kiṃ
śākhāntare pratyabhijñāsti neti| kiṃ " teṣāmevaitāṃ brahmavidyāṃ vadeta śirovrataṃ vidhivadyaistu cīrṇam " iti śirovratavatāmātharvaṇikānāṃ vidyopadeśaniyamobhedopapādakatayā pratyabhijñānirodhī neti| kiṃ śirovrataṃ vidyāṅgam,
utādhyayanāṅgamiti| atra karmakāṇḍaśākhāntarādhikaraṇoktābhedacakanyāyairabhedamuktvā punarbhedakanyāyairākṣipya bhedakānāṃ teṣāmanyārthatvapradarśanenābhedameva punaḥ pratiṣṭhāpayāmāsa sūtrakāra ityāhabheda ityādinā| ayamarthaḥ karmakāṇḍe hi saṃyogarūpacodanākhyāviśeṣāt karmaṇāmaikyamuktama| saṃyogo nāma phalasaṃyogaḥ| rūpañca dravyadevate|
dravyadevate hi karmaṇo rūpamiti tāntrikāḥ| codanā liṅloṭtavyapratyayādiśiraskaḥ kriyāvāciśabdaḥ| ākhyā jyotiṣṭomādināmadheyam| teṣāmaviśeṣāt karmaikyamiti " saṃyogarūpacodanākhyāviśeṣāt " iti sūtrārthaḥ| bhedakapramāṇāni tu śabdāntarādīni| aparyāyaśabdaśśabdāntaraṃ yajati juhoti dadātītyādi| abhyāsastu " samidho
yajati " "tanūnapātaṃ yajati " ityādirūpaḥ punaḥ punaḥ pāṭhaḥ| saṅkhyā "tisra āhutīrjuhoti " ityādiṣu ddaṣṭā tritvādiḥ| guṇastu " tapte payasi dadhyānayati sā vaiśvadevyāmikṣā vājibhyo vājinam " ityādiṣu śruto vājinādiḥ| "upasadbhiścaritvā māsamagnihotraṃ juhoti " ityādiṣu prakaraṇāntaramupalabhyate| nāmadheyamapi bhedakaṃ
ddaśyati "athaiṣa jyotirathaiṣa viśvajyotirathaiṣa sarvajyodiḥ " ityādau| tena pūrvakāṇḍoktanyākalāpairbhedakairabedakaiścedamadhikaraṇaṃ vyāracitam| tatra śabdānvayastukarmakāṇḍe dvitīyādhyāye śabdāntarādyairbhaido vidhiṣu niyamitaḥ pratipāditaḥ| samudayaniyatāt samuccitāt saṃyogādyaikyataḥ saṃyogarūpacodanākhyāviśeṣāt anyaḥ karmaṇāmabhedo'pi sthāpitaḥ| karmabrahmakāṇḍayoraikaśāstryāt nyāpravṛtterapi tulyatvāt vidyāmapi karmanītireva nītiḥ| itthaṃ sāmānyenārthatattvamabhidhāya etasyādhikaraṇasya
siddhāntārambhapūrvakatvāt prathamaṃ siddhāntamabhidhāya pūrvapakṣābhiprāyeṇākṣipya punastameva siddhāntaṃ sthāpayāmapi sūtrakāra
iti darśayati ādāviti| śabdānvayastu tenaiva karmakāṇḍenaiva codanādarebhedādādāvuditamuktaṃ śākhāntaranayaṃ
śrutyaivākṣipya śrutyantargatāt bhedakapramāṇādākṣipya taṃ pūrvoktamevārthaṃ pratisamādhita sthāpayāmāsa| tatra hetumāha
bhedakānyārthatoktayeti| bhedakasya pramāṇasya arthāntare tātparyādityarthaḥ||
atroktārthāpavādarūpaṃ vidyābhedatumanūdya tatparihāramapi bhāṣyoktameva viśadaṃ prakāśayati śakhāsviti| ayamarthaḥ aviśeṣapunaśśravaṇāt prakaraṇāntarācca vidyābheda evātra samucitaḥ| "samidho yajati " "tanūnapātaṃ yajati" ityādau yajati yajatītyaviśeṣapunaśśravaṇāt "upasadbhiścaritvā māsamagnihotraṃ juhoti" ityatra
prakaraṇāntarācca karmabhedo ddaṣṭaḥ| evamatrāpi tābhyāmeva hetubhyāṃ vidyābhedo 'ṅgīkārya eva| ayamatrānvayaḥ
brahmavidyāvādinīṣu śākhāsu tatratatra prakriyā anyā ddaṣṭā atra ca aviśeṣamapi punaśśravaṇaṃ ddaṣṭaṃ tato vidyābhedassyāditi| tadetat pratikṣipatineti| tadubhayaṃ aviśeṣapunaśśravaṇaṃ prakaraṇāntarañca adhyetṛbhedādyuktameva| ayamarthaḥ itthaṃ kila mīmāṃsakānāṃ maryādā| aviśeṣapunaśśravaṇaṃ prakaraṇāntarañca vidheyabhedāvahameva yadyadhyetṛbhedo na syāt| pratipattṛbhede sati aviśeṣapunaśśravaṇaṃ prakaraṇāntarañca na bhedakameva|
tenātra pratipattṛbhedasya vidyāmānatvāt na vidyābhedaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu " teṣāmevaitā brahmavidyāṃ vadeta śirovrataṃ vidhivadyaistu cīrṇam " iti śirovratavatāmeva brahmavidyopadeśaniyamāt vidyābhedo'stviti mayoktaṃ tatra ko'yaṃ parihāra iti pūrvapakṣiṇo'bhiprāyamāśaṅkya tatrāpi parihāramāha ayukteti| kathamayuktatvamityatrāha svādhyāya
iti| atra brahmavidyāpadaṃ svādhyāyavācakameva na punarvidyāvācakaṃ " naitadacīrṇavrato'dhīyīta " iti vedavratena
vedādhyayanasyānvayokterityarthaḥ||
atra kaściccodayati rūpaikyāt vidyaikye siddhe sati kimitaradupasaṃhāryam? tadeva rūpaikyamiti cenna itaretarāśrayādiprasaṅgāt rūpaikyāt vidyaikyaṃ vidyaikyāti rūpaikyamiti| athavā cakrakameva rūpaikyāt vidyaikyaṃ
vidyaikyāt vedyākārarūpaguṇopasaṃhāro guṇopasaṃhārāt rūpaikyamiti| tarhi vaidyākārādanyo guṇa upasaṃhārya iti cet
sa cānyo viruddho vā ki vā aviruddhaḥ| virūddhaścet tarhi viruddhadharmayorekatropasaṃhārāṅgīkāre sati loke sarvatra bheda eva na syāt| uṣṇatvaśītatvayorekatropasaṃhārasambhave ko'nyo bhedakaḥ? tena karmaṇāṃ vidyānāṃ vā
tattadasādhāraṇabhedakadharmopasaṃhāre yāgādānahomādīnāṃ sadvidyādaharavidyābhūmavidyādīnāṃ bhedaeva na syāt| nanu vikalpenopasaṃhārassyāt kadācit svadharmānvayaḥ anyadā tadviruddhānyadharmānvaya iti, tadapi na; vikalpayoyāṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvāt| kiñca vikalpa evātra na sambhavati svadharmasya śrutyaivopadiṣṭatvāt anyasya viruddhadharmasya śrutyā anupadiṣṭatvāt| tulyayorhi vikalpo na punaratulyayoḥ| tenopasaṃhāryo dharmaḥ ko'yamiti|
tasmāt bhedābhedacintā guṇopasaṃhārānurasaṃhārārtheti vyarthābhidhānamiti| tadetadanuvadati rūpaikyāditi| śabdānvayastu
rūpaikyādaikyasiddhau kimitaradupasaṃhāryam? anyo guṇaścet vidyāntarādivyavasthito guṇaścet
karmaṇāṃ vidyānāṃ vā kvacidapi rūpabhedavyavasthito bhedo na syāt| vikalpyaṃ tadiha kimiti| atra kimiti pratikṣepe| vikalpyaṃ tadrūpamiha na bhavatyeva vidyāntarāsādhāraṇatvāt| tena evamupapādanena bhedābhedacintā na guṇopasaṃhārārthā bhavatīti niṣphaleti| atrottaramneti| upasaṃhāryānupasaṃhāryavibhāgaṃ vyaktameva darśayativedyākāreti| vedyākāraikyaṃ vidyaikyaṃ diśati| tattu vedyākāraikyamanupasaṃhāryameva prāgeva siddhatvāt| tena
na cakrakam, nāpyanyonyāśrayaḥ| tathā ca vidyāyā aikye siddhe tadadhikaṃ vidyāyā aikyāpādakākārādadhikamanyadeva
kiñcidaṅgamākṛṣyate taccāpi tattacchākhāsu sarvatra śrutaṃ cet anupasaṃhāryameva śrutatvāt| kvacideva śrutaṃ cet tadānīṃ vidyaikyāt śākhāntare'pyupasaṃhartavyamiti nyāyamārgaḥ| iyaṃ kila maryādā kiṃ bhavataiva paraklṛptetyāśaṅkaya
karmakāṇḍavidāmapīyameva maryādeti mvoktamarthaṃ sarvavidvajjanasammatyā draḍhayatikarmaṇyapīti| asmaduktānaṅgīkāre sarvaśāstravyākopassyādityarthaḥ| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ karmaṇyapi karmakāṇḍe'pi evameva evamprakāreṇaivopasaṃhāraviṣayo guṇo bhedakaguṇātirikta eva svīkṛtaḥ| atra hi yāgadānahomādīnāṃ bhinnānāṃ karmaṇāṃ
tattadasādhāraṇadharmādbhedakādatiriktaḥ kaścit dharmassaṃyogarūpacodanākhyāviśeṣāt karmaikye siddhe tasmādevaikyāt sarvatropasaṃhriyata iti| ayamarthaḥ karmasu parasparaviruddho dharmo nopasaṃhāryaḥ, rūpādyaikyādaikye siddhe'pi aikyāpādakaṃ rūpamapi nopasaṃhāryam, tadvyatiriktamapi rūpamekatraiva pratipannaṃ cet itaratropasaṃhāryam| taccobhayatrāpi
pratipannaṃcet anupasaṃhāryameveti tāntrigoṣṭhīniṣṭhānāṃ nirṇayaḥ||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye " evaṃ codanādyaviśeṣāt vidyaikatvam, ekatve ca guṇopasaṃhāraḥ kartavya ityuktam| ataḥ paraṃ
kāścana vidyā adhikṛtya pratyabhijñāhetubhūtacodanādyaviśeṣo'sti neti nirūpya nirṇīyate " iti| tadarthavicārastu
astyudgīthavidyā vājināṃ chanedogānāñca, kimubhayatra vidyaikatvamuta vidyābheda iti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kimubhayatra
vidyāpratyabhijñānamasti neti| kimubhayatrodgīthasyaivopāsanakarmatvamuta cchandogānāmudgīthāvayavapraṇavasyeti| kimubhayatrodgīthaśabdaḥ udgīthaparaḥ uta cchandogānāmudgīthāvayavabhūtapraṇavaparā iti| kiṃ " omityetadakṣaramudgīthamupāsīta " iti praṇavaparodgīthaśabdasyopakramasthatvaṃ " udgīthamupāsāñcakrire " ityudgīthaśabdasya praṇavaparatāmavagamayati neti| pūrvaṃ vaiśvānaravidyāṃ saṃyogarūpacodanākhyāviśeṣāt vidyaikyamuktam, evaṃ tarhi vidyāntareṣvapi tenaivāviśeṣeṇa vidyaikyaṃ grāhyam| tatrodāharaṇatvena tāvadudgīthavidyocyate| tadidamāha prāgvaditi| vaiśvānaravidyāvat śākhābhede'pyupaśamitabhid syādekaivodgīthavidyā| itthamāśaṅkya tadtannirākaroti tadasaditi| tatra hetumāha ubhayatheti| rūpabhedo hi sarveṣvapi bhedakeṣu pradhānaḥ, saca rūpabhedo'tra naikavidhyenopalabhyate, apitūbhayathā| tena bhedakapramāṇabhūyastvāt bheda evāṅgīkāryaḥ| uktameva bhedakapramāṇadvaividhyaṃ darśayati gāteti| kvacidudgīthavidyāyāmudgātā dhyeyatayocyate, aparatratu geyam, ayameko
rūpabhedaḥ| rūpabedāntaramapyāha geya iti| kvacit sakalageyānudhyānam, anyatrāsakalageyānudhyānamiti vibhāgaḥ|
evaṃ rūpavaiṣamyasiddhau saṃyogarūpacodanākhyāsu rūpavyatiriktānāṃ saṃyogādīnāmabhedo'pi vidyāyā abhedaṃ na gamayatyeva| tadeva vivṛṇoti bhideti| iyaṃ khalu mīmāṃsakānāṃ maryādā saṃyogarūpacodanākhyānāmekabhede'pi karmabhedassidhyedeva| tadvadatrāpi pradhānabhūtasyaikasyāpi rūpasya bhede siddhe vidyābhedo'ṅgīkartavya eva| atra punaḥ pradhānasya rūpasya bheda ubhayathā dṛṣyate| tena sutarāmapi vidyābhedassiddha iti bhāvaḥ||
pūrvamudgīthavidyayorbhedasiddhyarthaṃ vedyākārabhidā pratijñātā tāmeva vedyākārabhidāṃ viśadamupapādayati chandogeti| chāndogyavākye dāvadudgīthaśabdastadavayavabhūtapraṇavapara eva| tatra hetumāha prakramādiprasiddheriti|
chāndogyavākyopakrame udgīthaśabdasya praṇavaparatvenābhidhānāt, vājasaneyake tu niyāmakaprakaraṇādyabhāvāt udgīthaśabdaḥ kṛtsnodgīthābhidhāyī| tena kvacidudgīthābhidhāyī anyatrodgīthāvayavabhūtapraṇavābhidhāyīti rūpabhedassidhyati| udgītho nāma sāmāvayavo bhaktiviśeṣaḥ, tadavayavaḥ praṇava iti tayorbhedaḥ prasiddhaḥ| evaṃ tarhi
vājināmudgītāśabda upakramastha aupacārikassyāt udgātaryudgīthaśabdaprayogāt tenopacāra eva doṣa iti cet
nātropacāradoṣa ityāha taditi| ayamarthaḥ udkātā nāma udgīthasya kartā, tatkartrā sādhanīye kārye tasyāpyudgīthasya nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇetinyāyena sādhanatvamastyeva, tena "udgīthenātyayāma " ityudgīthasyaiva sādhanatvopadeśe sati nopacāraprasaṅga
iti śabdārthaḥ| dviṣadupaśamane śatruparājaye| tatphalatvoktyabādhāt udgīthaphalatvokterabādhāditi||
guṇopasaṃhārapāde brahmavidyaiva sañcintanīyā, adhyātmaśāstratvāt tathā saiva sarvatra sañcintyate ca, athāpi kimatra svayamabrahmavidyā śatruparājayādikṣudraphalāntarārthā codgīthavidyā sañcintya ityāśaṅkya dvedhā samādhānamāha
yadyapīti| tatraikadeśibhiruktaḥ parihārastāvaducyate yadyapi iyamabrahmavidyaiva kṣudraphalārthā ca tenātra na grāhyā ca
mokṣaśāstre, tathāpi saṃyogarūpacodanākhyāviśeṣāditinyāyena sañcintanīyatvāviśeṣādatra sañcintyata ityekadeśināmayaṃ pakṣaḥ| apareṣāṃ tu iyaṃ vidyā kāmyapi brahmavidyānuṣṭhānopayuktasya tadvirodhinirākaraṇasya sādhanatvenopadiṣṭatvāt upayogaviśeṣasya vidyamānatvena brahmavidyāntargatatvāt tatra viśeṣatassañcintanīyeti| śatravo hi vidyānuṣṭhānapratipakṣā vādādayaḥ tatpravartakāśca puruṣā iti| teṣāṃ paribhavaśca vidyāsādguṇyamevāpādayatītyudgīthādividyācintanamatraiva viśeṣeṇa saṅgacchata iti||
atraivodgīthavidyāyāścintanīyatve prakārāntareṇāpi hetudvayamāhaajñāteti| idaṃ kila hetudvaṃ udgīthādyupāsanāni brahmaddaṣṭirūpāṇi tāni ca draṣṭanyabrahmaparijñānābhāve kartumeva na śakyante| tenodgīthādyupāsanacintanasyātraiva saṅgatiḥ| ata eva pūrvaṃ draṣṭavyabrahmaviṣayavaiśvānaravidyādikamasmin pāde prathamameva cintitam| idānīṃ brahmaddaṣṭirūpodgīthādividyā cintyata iti| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ ajñātabrahmasvarīpayāthātmyaḥ kathamiva kutracidudgīthādiṣu brahmaddaṣṭiṃ vimṛśet| tasmāt brahmajñānamantareṇa udgīthādiddaṣṭividhīnāmaśakyacintanatvāt āgatya atraiva brahmakāṇḍa eva cintanīyatā syāt punaḥ karmakāṇḍe
īddaśasaṅgatyabhāvāt| ayameko heturudgīthādyupāsanacintanānāmatraiva kartavyatva uktaḥ| hetvantaramapyupayogaviśeṣarūpaṃ darśayati ādadhyuriti| " yadeva vidyayā karoti, tadeva vīrvattaram " iti vidyāṅgakarmaṇāṃ vīryavattaratvāpādakatvenodgīthavidyā viśeṣaṇātraiva kartavyā, vīryavattaratvaṃ nāma vidyāṅgakarmaṇāmapratibaddhaphalatvam| pratibandhakābhāve hi vidyāṅgakarmāṇi brahmavidyāṃ sahasaiva sādhayituṃ śaknuvanti|
tena brahmavidyotpattipratibandhakanirākaraṇārthatvāt svayaṃ brahmaddaṣṭirūpatvācca ubhayatāpyudgīthādividyānāmatraiva cintanaṃ
samucitamityarthaḥ| ayamatra nirṇayaḥ vidyāṅgakarmaṇāṃ svaphalavitaraṇe vīryavattvātirekamudgīthādi vidyāḥ khalvādadhyuḥ| tasmāt brahmadhyānārthakarmaṇāmatiśayajananenodgīthādyupāsanacintanaṃ prastutāpekṣitameveti||
pūrvasminnadhikaraṇe rūpabhedādvidyābheda ityuktam, tataḥ pūrvaṃ vaiśvānarādhikaraṇe rūpaikyādvidyaikyamiti, adhunā pūrvādhikaraṇavat rūpabhedādvidyābhedamāśaṅkya tatpratikṣepeṇa vaiśvānarādhikaraṇavat rūpaikyāt vidyaikyameva punaḥ pratiṣṭhāpyata iti saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu chandogānāṃ kauṣītakīnāñca praṇavidyā āmnātā, kimubhayatra vidyaikyamuta bheda iti| kimubhayatra vasiṣṭhatvādiguṇakamupāsanamuta kauṣītakīnāṃ tadvidhuramiti| kiṃ kauṣītakīnāṃ
praṇavidyāmapi vasiṣṭhatvādiprāptirasti neti| kiṃ kauṣītakīnāṃ "yadahaṃ vasiṣṭhāsmi tvaṃ tadvasiṣṭho'si" ityanuvādābhāve'pyupakrame prāṇāyattasthitikāryakaratvābhidhānāt vāgādīnāṃ tathārūpavasiṣṭhatvādiprāptiḥ prāṇavidyāyāṃ
gamyate neti| tatra pūrvapakṣamāha chāndogamayavājasaneyakakauṣītaki brāhmaṇeṣu jyaiṣṭhyaśraiṣṭhyādīnyadhītāni prāṇe,
kauṣītakividyāyāmasya sarvasyāpi guṇajātasya sāmye'pi kevalaṃ vāgādivasiṣṭhatvādikam, madvasiṣṭhatvādikaṃ tvadvasiṣṭhatvādhīnamiti vāgādibhiḥ prāṇamuddiśya nānūditam| tatretthaṃrūpabhedādbahvīṣu śākhāsu pratipannā prāṇavidyā
bhidyatāmiti| imaṃ pūrvapakṣamanuvadatijyaiṣṭhyeti| tatpratikṣipatimaivamiti| vāgādīnāṃ tattajjyaiṣṭhyaśraiṣṭhyavāsiṣṭhyādiguṇānāṃ prāṇaparavaśatāvarṇanasyāviśeṣāt vāgādyaiḥ prāṇe svasvadharmopacaraṇamātraṃ
na kṛtam, tāvatā na rūpabhedaḥ| vāgādīnāṃ vasiṣṭhatvādeḥ prāṇādhīnatvopapādanādeva vāgādivasiṣṭhatvaṃ prāṇavasiṣṭhatvamityarthāduktaṃ bhavatīti na pṛthagvaktavyamavaśiṣyate| tena na rūpabhedādvidyābhedāvakāśa iti| tadtatsarvaṃ
bhāṣya eva suvyuktaṃ vivṛtamiti nācāryairvivaraṇīyamavaśiṣṭaṃ kiñcidastītyuparamyate||
pūrvaṃ tribhiradhikaraṇairvidyānāṃ bhedābhedacintā kṛtā, tatra ca vaiśvānaravidyāyāṃ " vāyuḥ prāṇaḥ " iti vāyuḥ paramapuruṣaprāṇatvena dhyeyatayā parikalpitaḥ| udgīthavidyāyāṃ punarudgīthādiṣu prāṇaddaṣṭirūpatvena prāṇaprasaṅgaḥ kṛtaḥ| itaḥ pūrvasminnadhikaraṇe sākṣāt prāṇa eva nirūpitaḥ| ato'pi ca pūrveṣāmadhikaraṇānāṃ parasparasāṅgatyam|
jyaiṣṭhyādiguṇopapādanāntarbhāvena vasiṣṭhatvādīnāmapyanusandheyatvamuktam| tatprasaṅgāt brahmaṇassarvavidyāvedyatvāt
tatsvarūpanirūpakadharmāṇāmānandādīnāṃ tatsvarūpanirūpaṇāntarbhāvenānusandheyatvamucyateiti saṅgatiḥ| bhāṣyeca saṅgatisspaṣṭā ddaśyate " atra brahmasvarūpaguṇānāṃ sarvāsu paravidyāsūpasaṃhāro'sti neti vicāryate " iti| tadarthavicārastu kimānandādayo guṇāssarvāsu vidyāsūpasaṃhāryāḥ, uta yatra śrūyante tatraiveti| kimānandādīnāmaiśvaryādivat guṇyapṛthaktvamātrameva, uta brahmasvarūpavat svarūpapratītyanubandhitvamastīti| pūrvapakṣābhiprāyeṇa saṅgatiṃ pradarśayan pūrvapakṣaṃ tāvadāhanānāśabdeti| ayamarthaḥ pūrvaṃ guṇabhedādvidyābheda iti bhavataivoktam, tena tatra tatra śrutānāmanyeṣāṃ guṇānāṃ vyavasthitissiddhā, tadvadeva satyatvādīnāmapi dharmāṇāṃ brahmasvarūpavyatiriktānāṃ vidyābhedena vyavasthitiriti pūrvapakṣiṇo'bhiprāyaḥ| uttaratra sūtrakāro " nānā śabdādibhedāt " iti guṇabhedād bhidurāṃ brahmavidyāṃ vakṣyati| tena svaprakaraṇapaṭhitāt rūpādanyat vidyāntarasya rūpam anyatra vidyāntare na yojyam| ubhayatrāpi paṭhitaṃ cet ubhayatrāpi yojyamastu nāma| iyameva
hi nītividāṃ maryādā| tasmāt evaṃ nyāyamaryādānirṇītatvāt satyatvapūrvā guṇāapi satyatvajñānatvānantatvānandatvāmalatvānyapi taditaraguṇavat vyavasthāpanīyassyuriti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ| tadidamapākaroti maivamiti| apākaraṇaprakārameva vivṛṇoti brahmeti| ayamarthaḥ loke hi vastūnāṃ guṇā dvividhāḥ, tatra svarūpanirūpakāḥ kecit, nirūpitasvarūpaviśeṣakāścāpare, yat svarūpanirūpakaṃ tat vastusvarūpaprasaṅge sarvatrānveti
yathā ghaṭaprasaṅge ghaṭatvam| nirūpitasvarūpaviśeṣakaṃ tu raktatvakṛṣṇatvādikaṃ tatratatra vyavatiṣṭhate| evaṃ svarūpanirūpakatvādānandādīni sarvatrānuvartante| pare punaḥ priyaśirastvādayastatratatra vyavatiṣṭhanta iti sarvavidyāsādhāraṇyamevānandādīnām| brahmasvarūpeti  brahmasvarūpāvargatiryasmādbhavati tat svarūpavat sarvāsu vidyāsvapekṣaṇīyamiti| ayamanvārohaḥ| svarūpanirūpakadharmatvāt svarūpapratipattyarthameveti tattvam||
prasaktaṃ satyatvādikaṃ svarūpeṇa vibhajya darśayati satyatvamiti| satyatvaṃ viśvahetau parasminbrahmaṇi bahuvidhacidacidvikriyājālahānerbhavati jñānatvaṃ jñātṛbhāvāt bhavati| jñānabdaḥ kartaryapi prayujyate "kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam " iti kartaryapi lyuṭprayogasambhavāt| "nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ " iti kartaryeva lyuprayogamāśritya nirvoḍhuṃ śakyatvāt| "tadguṇasāratvāttu tadvyapadeśaḥ " iti jñānaguṇasāre jñānaśabdasya prayoktumapi śakyatvāt|
svarūpasya svaprakāśatvena svaprakāśasvarūpavācino jñānaśabdasya tatraiva samanvayācca| nanvatra kartṛtvena bhāvatvena pratyabhedenāpi bahudhānirvāhe sati arthabhedāt svarabhedasyādityāśaṅkya tatrāpyuttaramāha  svarabahulatayeti| svarasya vaikalpikatvādityarthaḥ| yatra svarānupapattirna vidyate tatra tathaiva svīkāryam| yatra punassvarabhedo'ṅgīkāryaḥ, tatra " bahulaṃ chandasi " iti svarādīnāṃ bahulatvena na saṅkaṭaṃ kiñcit| anyathā kathaṃ " uṇādayo bahulam " ityādivyapadeśo bhagavataḥ pāṇinerapi| trividhaparicchedābhāvarūpaṃ brahmaṇo'nantatvaṃ vaktuṃ paricchedaprakāramāha tridviyakābhiriti| triparicchinnā ghaṭādayaḥ deśataḥ kālato vastutaśca paricchinnatvāt| dviparicchinnaḥ paramāṇuḥ aṇutvādanantaryāmitvācca| ekaparicchinnaḥ punaḥ kālaḥ vibhutve nityatve ca sati kevalamanantaryāmitvena vastuparicchinnatvāt| brahmaṇa ānantyamapyāha tasyeti| tisṛbhiḥ paricchittibhirayogāt parabrahmaṇa ānantyamiti|
sadā nirmalānandadhāmna iti vacanamānandasya brahmaguṇeṣu prādhānyaprakyāpanārtham||
nanu janmādisūtra eva brahmaṇo lakṣaṇamuktam| tacca lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣaṇatvādeva samānāsamānajātīyavyāvartakam, atastenaiva lakṣaṇenālam, kimarthamidaṃ svarūpalakṣaṇamiti satyatvādikamucyata ityāśaṅkya prayojanaviśeṣābhidhānena pariharati uktamiti| nanvici codyaṃ dyotayati| tenaiva svarūpāvagātiḥ syāt| satyatvādikamatra nirarthakameva|
satyādiśabdena tadeva brahmocyate cet paunaruktyam| anyaccet tarhi brahma na syāt| nahi brahmadvitayamasti| lakṣaṇāntaraṃ cet kṛtakaratvādeva nairarthakyam| prayojanaviśeṣo'sti cet tatta kimiti viśadaṃ prakāśayeti parābhiprāyaḥ| pariharati neti| tadeva vivṛṇoti hetoriti| īśvarasya jagatkāraṇatve pratipanne kāraṇatvāśaṅkitadoṣaparihārārthaṃ satyatvādikamabhidhīyata iti bhāṣyakāraireva prāgevoktam| acitsaṃsṛṣṭajīvamuktanityānāmanukrameṇa vyavacchedāt| tena sarvavilakṣaṇatvena pratipannabrahmasvarūpapariśodhanārthaṃ satyādivākyamapīti na nairarthakyaprasaṅgaḥ| kiñcāsmatpakṣe brahmaṇi nānāguṇopādānamupāsanārtham, athavā phaladaśāyāmanusandānārthamiti sarvasāphalyasiddhiḥ||
nanu brahmadhyānārthaṃ satyatvādyanusandheyamityuktaṃ bhavatā, tarhi brahmānudhyānaṃ priyaśirastvādyanusandhānenāpi sidhyatītyāśaṅkya vaiṣamyaṃ darśayati nanviti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥ brahmānudhyānaṃ "tasya priyameva śiraḥ " ityādibhirapi sidhyatīti|
priyaśirastvādīnāmapi brahmaṇi niyamenānusandhānaṃ syādityāśaṅkya tatrārdhāṅgīkāramāha bāḍhamiti| ayamarthaḥ tvadukte kiñcidaṅgīkriyate kiñcicca na, priyādīnāṃ paramānandarūpabrahmāntarbhāvādaṅgīkāraḥ pakṣādīnāṃ parakalpanāmātratvādanaṅgīkāraśca| tena priyādīnāmapi brahmasvarūpāvagatihetutvāt te priyadayo guṇāḥ sarvānuvṛttāḥ| priyādyaistadavagatiḥ priyamodapramodādibhirbrahmasvarūpāvagatirityarthaḥ| tarhi pucchatvādikamapi " brahmapucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā " ityādibhiradhītamanusandheyaṃ syādityāśaṅkyāsambhavānnetyāha pucchādyaṃśa iti| asambhavamevāha niraṃśe brahmaṇi pucchādyaṃśe na bhavatītyanvayaḥ| tarhi brahmaṇi pucchatvaddaṣṭissyāt, ddaṣṭividhau hyavidyamānasya darśanaṃ bhūṣaṇameva syādityāśaṅkya pariharati na ceti| apakṛṣṭe hyutkṛṣṭaddaṣṭividhānaṃ ddaṣṭividhiḥ| yathā "mano brahmetyupāsīta " ityādau| iha punarbrahmaṇi pucchatvādiddaṣṭiścet viparītameva syāt| utkṛṣṭabrahmaṇi apakṛṣṭapucchatvādiddaṣṭividerayogāt| tarhi " tasya priyameva śiraḥ" ityādeḥ kathamiha parikalpanamityāśaṅkāyāṃ tatparikalpane nirvāhamāha tasmāditi| evaṃ priyaśirastvādīnāṃ buddhyohārtatvopapādanāt uttaratrābhidhīyamānacityāgnirūpakramavadiha parasmin brahmaṇi śiraḥprabhṛtiparikalpanaṃ samucitameva||
atrānandādiśabdānāmarthabhedaṃ pakṣabhedenoktvā bhāṣyakārābhimataprakāreṇa svīyamarthaṃ nigamayati ānandatveti|
kecidatra sautramānandaśabdaṃ svarūpasya ānandarūpatvapradhāne varṇayanti| apare punaḥ dharmānandābhidānamāhuḥ| tadguṇasāratvāditi nyāyenānanditvamevānandaśabdaḥ prāheti| tathā tṛtīyaṃ pakṣamāha tadubhayavacanamiti| ānanditvamānandatvañcobhayamapi ānandaśabdaḥ kathayatīti| atra pakṣadvamapi vikalpenaikakoṭitvenopāttam| ayamarthaḥ ānandatvamevocyata ityeke| apare ānanditvameva yadvobhayamapītyāhuḥ| yadvā kecicchabdāvṛttyā pakṣatrayamapi trayāiṇāṃ pakṣaiti pṛthakpṛthak pakṣatvena vācyam| atrānandaśabdoktamaryādāṃ jñānaśabde'pyatidiśati jñānoktāviti|
jñānatvaṃ jñānitvaṃ tadubhayaṃ vā jñānaśabdenocyata iti| evaṃ pakṣabhedānuktvā bhāṣyakārābhipretaṃ pakṣaṃ vaiśadyāya darśayatitaditarasamateti| ayamarthaḥ  brahmasvarūpapratipattivelāyāṃ brahmavyatiriktārthasāmyaśaṅkā yāvatā viśeṣaṇena na syāt tāvaddharmānuvṛttistāvadviśeṣaṇāni bahubhajanapade sarvabrahmavidyāvedye parasmin brahmaṇi anusandheyānītyatra sthāpyate| tāni ca satyatvajñānatvānantatvānandatvāmalatvānyanukrameṇopayuktatayā bhāṣya eva sthāpitānīti tatraiva vistareṇa draṣṭavyam||
pūrvaprastutāvaśiṣṭatayā saṅgatirbhāṣye| tadarthavicārastu chāndogyavājasaneyakavākyayoḥ prāṇavāsoddaṣṭiparatvamācamanīyāsvapsu pratīyate neti| atra pūrvapakṣamāha ācāmediti| bhāṣye vākyārthasya vistṛtatvāt śabdānvayamātrapradarśanamatra kriyate| atrācāmediti vidhiśravaṇāt vidheśca " aprāpte śāstramarthavat " iti nyāyenāpūrvārthe tātparyāt smṛtyācāraprāptācamanavyatiriktamācamanāntaraṃ vidhīyata iti| tamimaṃ pakṣaṃ pratikṣipatimaivamiti| pratikṣepaprakāramāha  smṛtyādīti| bhojanāṅgasyācamanasya samṛtyādisiddhatvāt prāṇavāsastvānusandhānapūrvamevātra vidhīyate| tenāpūrvārthaviśeṣavidhānādasminpakṣe na vidhibhaṅgaḥ| tarhyapūrvācamanavidhānābhāve pūrvasya tasyācamanasya siddhatvāt ācāmediti kathaṃ vidhiśravaṇamityāśaṅkyāha bhujjīteti| yathā "snātvā bhujjīta " ityatra prāpte bhojane vidhiśśrūyate, athāpi vidhiraprāptasnānavidhānapara eva, evamatrāpyācāmediti pūrvaprāptācamane vidhiśśrūyatāṃ nāma, athāpyaprāptaprāṇavāsastvānusandhāna eva vidhirbhavet| ato na śabdānvayavirodhaḥ| anyatra sthitasya vidhiśravaṇasya upakramopasaṃhārāditātparyaliṅgaparāmarśenānyatrānvayena nirvāhastāntrikāṇāṃ sammata eveti tathaivātra syāt| prāptadhātvarthaniṣṭha iti pūrvaprāptācamanamucyate| śravaṇaṃ tatrāstu tathāpi tātparyamanyatretyarthaḥ| atrāpyupakramopasaṃhārādiparamarśena vākyasya prāṇavāsastvānusandhānavidhānaparatvaṃ bhāṣya eva vivṛtamiti vistarabhayāduparamyate| nanu prāṇavidyā pūrvamapyuktā kimarthamidānīmapyucyata iti bāliśacodye parihāramāha prāgiti| pūrvaṃ prāṇavidyāyāṃ bhedābhedādicintā kṛtā, idānīṃ prāṇavidyāyāmācamanīyānāmapāṃ prāṇavāsastvānusandhānarūpamaṅgaṃ cintyata ityadhikaraṇabhedopapattiḥ||
evamukte'pyadhikaraṇārthe śiṣyāṇāṃ vaiśadyāya uktānanuktāṃśca hetuviśeṣān saṃgṛhya kathayati ādāviti| upakramopasaṃhārayorvāsaḥparidhānamityeko hetuḥ| aparamapi hetumāha manyatiriti| "manyante " iti manyatiśabdaprayoge ddaṣṭividhyartha eva| nanu prāṇavāsastvamastu, anena kiṃ prayojanamityāśaṅkya prayojanamāha ārādhyapriyārtheti| ayamarthaḥ vihitāyāḥ kriyāyā yogyameva prayojanaṃ kalpyam, yathā vihitāyā ācamanakriyāyāḥ prayojanamārādhyaprītiḥ, evaṃ prāṇavāsastvānusandhānasyāpi prayojanamārādhyaprītireva| sā ca manyatirārādhyapriyārthetyanvayaḥ| nanu
prāṇavāsastvānusandhānavacanaṃ stotrameva kiṃ na syādityāśaṅkya pratikṣipati stutiriti| gatyabhāve hi stutirabhinandyā, atrāpūrvārthavidhānena gatisambhave sati stutirna kalpyetyarthaḥ| atra ca
"adbhiḥ paritadhati " iti paridhānarūpāpūrvārthasya viśeṣataḥ pratipādanāt prāṇavāsastvānusandhānavidhiryukta eva| kiñca prāṇo'trārādhanīyatvena pratipādyate ārādhanīyasya ca devatāviśeṣasyādbhiḥ paridhānavacanamārādhanāṅgatvāt yujyata eva| yathā loke vasrapradānaṃ devatārādhanāṅgaṃ tadvadihāpīti bhāvyam||
atra pūrvādhikaraṇaṃ prāṇavidyāśeṣatvena prasaṅgasaṅgatyoktam, tatpūrvādhikaraṇe punassvarūpenirūpakadharmaṇāṃ svarūpapratītyantarbhāvenopasaṃhāryatvamuktam| adhunā punassatyasaṅkalpatvāntarbhūtānāṃ vaśitvādiguṇānāmupasaṃhāra ucyata iti saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu vājasaneyake'gnirahasye bṛhadāraṇyake ca śāṇḍilyavidyā āmnātā, kimatra vidyā
bhidyate neti| kimubhayatra rūpabhedo'sti neti| kimagnirahasye vaśitvādiprāptirasti neti| kiṃ manomayatvasatyasaṅkalpatvāmnānameva guṇipratyabhijñāyā vaśitvādiprāptiṃ gamayati neti| atra pūrvapakṣī manyate "samidho yajati " ityādivat aviśeṣapunaśśravaṇāt vidyābhedo'varjanīyaḥ| nacādhyetṛbhedādaviśeṣapunaśśravaṇamiti na tena bheda iti vācyam; śākhaikye sati adhyetṛbhedāsambhavāt| ekasyāṃ śākhāyāmadhyetṛbhedo na sambhavatīti sādhāraṇo'yaṃ nyāyaḥ| ato'tra vidyābhedassyāditi| nacātra guṇavidhiḥ kaścit ddaśyate yena vidyaikyamāśrīyeta| yadi guṇābhidhānamatra syāt, tadā khalu pūrvasyāmeva vidyāyāṃ guṇavidhānārthaṃ punaśśravaṇamiti vaktuṃ śakyate| tasmāt vidyābedaḥ svīkartavya iti| tadidamāhaśākhaikya iti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥśākhaikye siddhe sati adhyetṛbhedo'stīti vaktuṃ na śakyate| atra kaścidapi guṇo na vidheyaḥ, tena guṇavidhānārthaṃ punarabhidhānamiti na vācyam| tasmāduktāviśeṣaśravaṇamiha vidyāṃ kathaṃ na bhindyāditi| uktaṃ pakṣaṃ pratikṣipatimaivamiti| pratikṣepaprakāramāhayadyapīti| atra guṇavidhirnāstīti bhavatoktaṃ tattathaiva, vidheyasya guṇāntarasyātrādarśanāt| tathāpi pūrvoktasyaivātrānūktirvyaktyai vivicyābhidhānenoktārthābhivyaktyai saukaryataśca śiṣyāṇāṃ saukaryārthaśca| tatra ddaṣṭāntamāha  vyasaneti| loke hi samāsenoktamarthaṃ vigrahavākyena vyāsenāpi vadanti tadvadatrāpi satyasaṅkalpatvaśabdenoktameva tadantargataṃ vaśitvādikaṃ vaśitvādiśabdenāpi vivriyate tena vivaraṇārthameva punaranuvāda iti na kaściddoṣa iti||
atra kaściccodayati nanu vājasaneyakavākye sthaladvayapaṭhitā śāṇḍilyavidyā bhāṣyakārairupāttā na punaśchāndogyavājasaneyakayoḥ paṭhitā śāṇḍilyavidyā bhinnā abhinnā veti vicāritā, tat kimarthamityāśaṅkya ekatra nirṇītasya nyāyasyetaratrāpi svayameva yojyatvāt svayameva śiṣyā vidāṅkurvantviti bhāṣyakārābhiprāya iti pariharati chandogairiti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥ chandogestathā vājibhiśca sphuṭamevānupaṭhitā śāṇḍilyavidyā bhāti ihodāharaṇe bhedābhedāvamarśo bhāṣyakāraiḥ kimiti na sandarśita iti| imamāśaṅkāṃ pariharati tadbrūma iti| tadeva vivṛṇoti yatra yatreti| vājasaneyake vā chāndogye vā yatrayatra vaśitvādyadhikapaṭhanaṃ ddaśyate tatratatrādhikānāṃ guṇānāṃ satyasaṅkalpatvādiguṇāntarbhāvādiyuktau satyāmadhikamanadhikaṃ veti sādhāraṇokteryuktatvādityarthaḥ| ekatra nirṇītanyāyasiddhārthasya punarabhidhānāpekṣābhāvādityarthaḥ||
punaruktasyārthasyātyantavaiśadyārthaṃ vājasaneyakoktasthānadvandvaśāṇḍilyavidyāyāḥ prakārabhedaṃ darśayan atra vidyaikyasiddhyatha rūpabhedābhāvamapyāha sthānadvandva iti| vājasaneyake hyagnirahasye vaśitvādivirahitā satyasahkalpatvādyuktimatī śāṇḍilyavidyā sammāmnātā| bṛhadāraṇyake vaśitvādyavirahitā saivāmnāt| tenātra vedyabhedena rūpabhedāt śāṇḍilyavidyāyā bhiduratā kalpanīyeti cet| tadidaṃ pratikṣipati neti| tadeva vivṛṇoti
āraṇyeti| bṛhadāraṇyakoktaṃ vaśitvādikamagnirahasyoktasatyasaṅkalpatāyā bhinnaṃ cet tadā rūpabhedāt vidyābheda
iti vaktuṃ śakyate, nacaitadbhinnaṃ satyasaṅkalpatvavivaraṇarūpatvāt vaśitvādeḥ, tena rūpabhedābhāvāt na vidyābhedaḥ|
tadevopapādayatiseti| sā satyasaṅkalpatā agneḥ rahasye adhītā| satyasaṅkalpatāyā vivaraṇarūpatvāt vaśitvādikamapi tatraivādhītameva bhavati| tena rūpabhedābhāvāt na vidyābheda ityāha adhikavirahata iti||
pūrvaṃ śāṇḍilyavidyāyāṃ rūpabhedābhāvāt vidyaikyamuktam, tarhi bṛhadāraṇyakoktādityamaṇḍalākṣyantarvartipuruṣaviṣayavidyāyāmapi
rūpabhedābhāvāt vidyaikyamityāśaṅkya sthānabhedādrūpabhedo'stītyabhidhīyata itīha saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu ādityākṣyantarvartinorāmnāte kimete nāmanī yathāśrutamekaikavyavasthite, utobhayatrāpyavyavasthayopasaṃhārye iti| kimatra vidyaikyamuta neti| kiṃ vyāhṛtiśarīrasyopāsyatvamubhayatra vidyaikyaṃ gamayati neti| kimupāsyaguṇaikyamātramabhedahetuḥ, uta sthānaikyamapīti|
sthānaṃ kimupāsyāntargatamuta neti| atrākṣyādityāntarvartinoḥ puruṣayorupāsane rūpaikyādvidyaikyamāśaṅkya ubhayatrāpi sthānabhedena rūpabhedāt vidyābheta iti darśiyati akṣīti| śabdārthastu akṣyādityopalakṣye bhagavati bhajanaṃ saṃyogarūpacodanādyaikyādekameva syāt| tena dvayorapi nāmnorūbhayasthānasthe parasmin brahmaṇi aniyatireva syāditi| tamimaṃ pakṣaṃ pratikṣipatineti| tatra hetumāha sthānata iti| sthānabhedena rūpabhedasya vidyāmānatvāt| tameva rūpabhedamupapādayati sthānamiti| sthānaṃ hi bhagavatastatsthānāvasthitatvapratipattyai hyupadiśyate| atra
pratibandīmāha na cediti| yadi sthānaṃ nairarthakyenopadiśyate tarhi tat rūpamapi tāddagvidhameva syādityarthaḥ| uktamarthaṃ sahetuktaṃ nigamayati tasmāditi| anayornāmnorvyavasthayaivopasaṃhāra ityarthaḥ||
pūrvādhikaraṇe nāmnossthānabhedāt vyavasthā kṛtā iha punaranārabhyādhītasya sambhṛtyādikasyāpi tenaiva sthānabhedena vyavasthocyata iti saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu rāṇāyanīyānāṃ khileṣu "brahmajyeṣṭhā vīryā sambhṛtāni " ityādivākyāni śrūyante tatra sambhṛtidyuvyāptyādikaṃ kathyate|tatkiṃ sarvavidyāsūpasaṃhāryamuta kāsucidevati| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kimanārabhyādhītānāṃ sarvāsu viniyogaḥ, uta kāsucideveti| kiṃ sāmarthyaṃ sarvāsu vidyāsu viniyuṅkte uta kāsucideva viniyuṅkta iti| atra pūrvapakṣamāha sambhṛtyādiriti| " brahma jyeṣṭhā " ityādivākyoktaḥ sambhṛtyādirguṇaughaḥ prakaraṇapaṭhanābhāvāt sarvāsvapi vidyāsvanvīyeteti| siddhāntamāha neti| tatra hetumāha kvaciditi| ayamarthaḥ na sarvatrānveti, apitu kvacideva, agatikāt liṅgāt kvacideveti sthāpitatvāt| liṅgasyāgatikatvamananyathāsiddhatvam| tadeva hi prābalyahetuḥ| anyathāsiddhānāṃ hetūnāṃ durbalatvāt| ananyathāsiddhatvameva viśadaṃ prakāśayati alpeti| ayamarthaḥ " brahma jyeṣṭhā " mantre " brahmāgre jyeṣṭhaṃ divamātatāna " iti brahmaṇo viśvavyāpitvamuktam| tacca viśvavyāpitvamalpasthānāsu vidyāsu na ghaṭate, apitu vyāptyā brahmopāsaneṣveva ghaṭate| tenaitanmantrasthaviśvavyāptyādeḥ svocitasthānavṛtteravaśyambhāvādekasmin mantre dyuvyāptyā saha paṭhitā itare sambhṛtyādidharmāstatsamasthāninaḥ dyuvyāptiryatra vartate tatraiva saha vartanta iti tatsamasthānina iti||
dyuvyāptisannidhisamāmnātasya sambhṛtyādestatsamānasthānānupraveśāt ekavidyānvaya uktaḥ, idānīṃ brahmavidyāsannidhisamāmnātapuruṣavidyāyā brahmavidyāśeṣatvamucyata itisaṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu taittirīyake "tasyaivaṃ

atra kaścit puruṣavidyāprasaṅga eva na kartavyaḥ prasphuṭapūrvapakṣahetvabhāvādityāśaṅkate tāmāśaṅkāṃ pratikṣeptumanuvadatisphuṭa iti| dvayorapi puruṣavidyayoḥ rūpādibhede spaṣṭe sati nāmasāmyādimātrāt haṭhenaiva samupanataḥ puruṣavidyāpūrvapakṣaḥ atyantamṛdutvādavācya iti etadadhikaraṇaṃ viphalameveti| imamāśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti neti| nirākaraṇe kāraṇamāhaanyeti| atra khalu dve vidye " brahmaṇe tvā mahasa omityātmānaṃ yuñjīta " iti pūrvaṃ vihitā nyāsavidyā anyā| iyaṃ tu " tasyaivaṃ viduṣaḥ " ityāmnātā puruṣavidyā taccheṣabhūtā anyā tena nyāsavidyāprādhānyakathanārthaṃ taccheṣabhūtā puruṣavidyā punaratra viśodhyate| chāndogyasthā puruṣavidyā punarāyuḥprāptyarthatvena vighānāt na brahmavidyāṅgabhūtā tvanayā puruṣavidyayā tādātmyaṃ bhajata iti na puruṣavidyayoraikyaprasaṅga iti vaktavyamaśeṣaṃ nyāsaviṃśatyādiṣu prabandhāntareṣu vyaktamuktamiti neha pratanyate||
atra puruṣavidyāviṣayapakṣadvayaṃ tattadekadeśiproktamanūdya ubhayathāpi bhāṣyakāraparikalpitādhikaraṇacintā saṅghaṭata iti sandarśayati yadyaivamiti| ayamatra keṣāñcit pakṣaḥ idda yajñaddaṣṭirna kalpyate apitu pūrvoktanyāsavidyāniṣṭhasya māhātmyapradarśanārthaṃ sakalamapi karmajātaṃ tasya śarīra eva vartata iti yajñaklṛptyā

puruṣavidyāyorbhedo'pi pratipādyata ityaikyāsiddhiḥ| tena kvacitpakṣe puruṣavidyayorabhāvādaikyāsiddhiḥ pakṣāntare tu tayorūpadibhedādaikyāsiddhirityaikyanirākaraṇārthamidamadhikaraṇaṃ saṅgacchate| tadidaṃ sarvamabhipretyāha tiṣṭhatviti| dvayorapi pakṣayorbhāṣyakārakalpitādhikaraṇaprakārasya sughaṭataiva vartate| tarhi ko'yaṃ paramārtha ityāśaṅkya yathāsampradāyamabhidhīyatām, asāmpradāyikapakṣo na saṃgrāhya iti sāmānyataḥ prāha sampradāya iti| yuktiyuktatvāt prāktana eva parigrāhya ityarthaḥ||
brahmavidyāsannidhisamāmnānāt brahmavidyāṅgatvaṃ puruṣavidyāyā uktam, idānīṃ punarbrahmavidyāsannidhisamāmnātānāṃ " śanno mitraḥ " ityādimantrāṇāṃ brahmavidyāṅgatvaṃ syāditi śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kimupaniṣadārambheṣvadhītāḥ "śukraṃ pravidhya " " śanno mitraḥ " ityādayo mantrāḥ pravargyādīni ca karmāṇi vidyāṅgamuta neti| kimeṣāṃ śrutiliṅgavākyaiḥ karmasveva viniyogaḥ, uta brahmavidyāyāṃ prakaraṇādviniyogaḥ| kimeṣāṃ prakaraṇapāṭho'ṅgatvāya uta divākīrtyāraṇyānuvākyatāyai| atra pūrvapakṣamāha yujyeranniti| "śannaḥ " ityādimantrā brahmavidyāparisarapaṭhitatvāt teṣāṃ vidyāśeṣatvāviśeṣācca sarvavidyāsvapi śeṣatvena yujyeranniti| tadetatpratikṣipati neti| tatra hetumāha taduditeti| ayamarthaḥ liṅgāt tattatkarmaśeṣatvaṃ pratīyate, sannidherbrahmavidyāśeṣatvam, tatra liṅgasannidhyorliṅgasyātyantabalīyastvaṃ sarveṣāmapi sammatam| tatra " śanno mitraḥ " ityādimantrasya " namo brahmaṇe " ityādinā liṅgenādhyayanaśeṣatvasya spaṣṭaddaṣṭatvādatyantakanīyasā sannidhinā kalpanīyaṃ brahmavidyāśeṣatve "śukraṃ pravīdhya " ityādimantrasyāpi brahmavidyāsannidhisamāmnātasya brahmavidyāśeṣatvaṃ syāt| tatta viruddhameva " śukraṃ pravidhya hṛdayaṃ pravidhya " iti parapīḍāprārtanātmakasya karmaṇo brahmavidyāvirodhitvena tadaṅgatvakalpanāyogāt, liṅgato durbalatvācca sannidhisamāmnānasya| tena na brahmavidyāśeṣatvamiti kathaṃ sarvavidyāṅgatvakalpanaṃ yoyujyeta||
atra brahmavidyāsannidhisamāmnātānāṃ "śukraṃ pravīdhya " ityādīnāṃ brahmavidyānaṅgatvamuktam| tathā sannidhisamāmnātahānopāyanacintā anantaraṃ prāpteti saṅgatiḥ| athavā "śukraṃ pravīdhya " ityādimantrāṇāṃ liṅgāt tattatkarmaśeṣatvamuktam, iha punarūpāyanasya prahāṇaviṣayatvarūpārthasāmarthyaliṅgāt ubhayoranyonyānvayaniyamevobhayorubhayatrānusandheyatvamucyata iti saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu " aśva iva romāṇi vidhūya pāpaṃ candra iva rohormukhāt " "tathā vidvānpuṇyapāpe vidhūya " iti kvacit sukṛtaduṣkṛtayorhānicintanamāmnātam, "suhṛdassādhukṛtyāṃ dviṣantaḥ pāpakṛtyām " ityupāyanacintanaṃ kvacidāmnātam, kvacidubhacintanam " tatsukṛtaduṣkṛte dhūnute tasya priyā jñātayassukṛtamupayanti apriyā duṣkṛtam " iti, tatra kiṃ
hānicintanopāyanacintanobhayacintanāni samuccīyeran uta vikalperanniti| kimupāyanaṃ hāniśeṣatayā vidyāṅgamuta svatantratayeti| kumupāyanavākyaṃ śākhāntarādhītamapi hānivākyaśeṣabhūtaṃ uta svatantram| kiṃ kauṣītakīnāmubhayāmnānamupāyanavākyasya hānivākyaśeṣatāvirodhi neti| atra viṣayaṃ viśodhya udgranthameva pūrvapakṣaṃ nirākurvan saiddhāntikamarthaṃ samyageva pramāṇanyāyābhyāmupapādayati śākhe dve iti| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ dve śākhe muktibhājaḥ puruṣasya puṇyapāpaprahāṇaṃ kvacit kathayataḥ| anyā punaḥ śākhā priyataditarayordārasaṃkrāntikāle puṇyapāpapraveśaṃ brūte| priyapriyayoḥ puṇyapāpasaṅkrāntimācaṣṭaityarthaḥ| kvacit śākhāyāṃ hānañcopāyanañca samuccitya kathitamiti anyatra
pṛthagāmnātayostayossamparka eva nyāyānugṛhītapramāṇaviṣayatvena sidhyati| asannihitānāṃ śākhāntaraśthānāṃ vākyānāmanyonyānvayasiddhiḥ kathaṃ syādityāśaṅkya sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyameva prāguktamiha pratyabhijñāpayati vākyamiti||
pūrvaṃ hānopānayorvaikalpikatvaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇoktaṃ pramāṇatarkābhyāṃ parihṛtam, tarhi mā bhūt tayorvailpikatvam, tathāpi taccintane vaikalpikatvaṃ syādityāśaṅkya tadapi netyāha itthamiti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥ itthaṃ brahmajñānaṃ karmatyajanaṃ karmaprahāṇaṃ priyāpriyayossaṅkrānātisampṛktamastu nāma| cintāyāṃ punarvyavasthā vikalpa eva bhavatu| kuta

nanvatra priyāpriyayossukṛtaduṣkṛtasaṅkrāntirupadiṣṭā seyaṃ viruddhaiva, nahyanyena kṛtaṃ karmānyatra saṅkrāmati, nahyanyakarmaphalamanyatrotpadyate, akṛtābhyāgamakṛtavipraṇāśaprasaṅgāt, tena virūddhametadbhavaduktamityāśaṅkate kartreti| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ yaḥ karoti karma tenaiva kartrā tatphalaṃ bhogyamiti karmakāṇḍe sthāpitam| ddaśyate hi "śāstraphalaṃ prayoktari " iti| tasmāt brahmajñakarma śātrau mitre vā saṅkrāmatīti na ghaṭate| tadidaṃ pratikṣipati ayuktamiti| vidyāmāhātmya iti ayamarthaḥ na hyasmābhirbrahmavinniṣṭhapuṇyapāpayoḥ priyāpriyayossaṅkrāntirucyate, nāpi priyāpriyaphalayossuhṛdi duhṛdi vā jananam, api tu svakarmaphalameva suhṛdāṃ duhṛdāmapyucyate| yo hi brahmavidviṣaye prīṇāti yaśca tasmai druhyati tayorūbhayorapi svācaritasya sukṛtasya duṣkṛtasya ca niṣphalatvoyāgāt svakīyakarmaphalamevocyate| tarhi svakarmaphalabhoge karmaphalasaṃkrāntivacanaṃ kathaṃ syāt? tadidamavahitamanāśśrṛṇu, anyakarmaṇo'nyatra saṃkrānterayogāt anyakakarmaphalasyānyatra jananāyogācca na karmasaṃkrāntyatideśo nāpi phalajananātideśaḥ, api tu tattatkarmaphalaparimāṇamovocyate| paramakāruṇikena bhagavatā yāvatpuṇyaphalamadhyātmavitsu na dattaṃ tāvatpuṇyaphalamadhyātmavidanikūlaṣu svakṛtānukūlyaphalatayā dīyate yāvatpāpaphalamadhyātmavitsu na dattaṃ tāvatpāpaphalamadhyātmavitpratikūleṣu svakṛtaprātikūlyaphalatayā dīyata iti| tenādhyātmavidanukūlapratikūlayordīyamānaphalaparimāṇapradarśanamātramatrocyate na punaranyakarmaṇāmanyatra saṃkrāntiriti sarvaṃ samāhitam||
saṅgatirbhāṣye " sukṛtaduṣkṛtayorhānamupāyanañca sarvasu vidyāsu cintanīyamityuktam| taddhānaṃ kiṃ dehaviyogakāle dehādutkrāntasyādhvani ca, uta dehaviyogakāla eveti viśaye " iti| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ sukṛtaduṣkṛtahānaṃ dehaviyogakāle 'dhvani ca, uta dehaviyogakāla eveti| kimubhayatra hāniśravaṇaṃ uta dehaviyogakāla eveti| kiṃ " sa etaṃ devayānaṃ panthānamāpadyagnilokaṃ gacchati" ityupakramya " sa āgacchati virajāṃ nadīṃ tāṃ manasātyeti tatsukṛtaduṣkṛte dhīnute " iticaramaśrutasya " tatsukṛtaduṣkṛta dhūnute " iti vākyāvayavasya " sa ete devayānam " ityetasmāt prāganvayaḥ, uta yathāpāṭhamanvaya iti| kiṃ " aśarīraṃ vāva santaṃ na priyāpriye spṛśataḥ" ityaśarīrasya sukhaduḥkhānanubhavaśravaṇānurodhena prāganvayavarṇanaṃ nyāyyam, uta devayānagamanaśravaṇānurodhena sūkṣmaśarīrasthityarthaṃ yathāpāṭhamanvayavarṇanaṃ nyāyyamiti| atravarṇanaṃ nyāyyamiti| atra pūrvapakṣī manyate tāṇḍino hi dehaviyogakāle sukṛtaduṣkṛtavidhūnanamadhīyate " aśva iva romāṇi vidhūya " ityādinā| kauṣītakinastu " sa āgacchati virajāṃ nadīṃ tāṃ manasātyeti tat sukṛtaduṣkṛte dhūnute" iti virajātaraṇānantaraṃ sukṛtaduṣkṛtavidhūnanaṃ taccintanamapi brahmavidā kartavyaṃ tathaivāṃśenāstviti| tadidamāhakarmoddhūtiriti| śabdānvayastu kvacidupaniṣadi karmavidhūnanaṃ mumukṣo dehaviyogakāle śrūyate anyasyāmupaniṣadi mārge, tena dvayamapi pramāṇam| śakalaśo dvidhaivamastu keṣāñcit karmaṇāṃ dehaviyogakāle'pareṣāṃ mārga iti cintanamapi śakalaśo'stviti| tadidaṃ pratikṣipati mābhūditi| tadeva vivṛṇoti na hīti| yadi mārge kimapi phalamuktaṃ syāt tadā tatphalārthaṃ karmāvaśeṣo'stīti vaktuṃ śakyeta mārgānubhāvyaphalābhāvāt saphalaṃ karma sarvamapi sāmparāye naśyatītyarthaḥ| nanu yadi sarvaṃ karma dehāvasāne naśyet, tarhi arcirādimārgeṇa gamanameva na syāt tathāca nirarthaka evādhyātmavidāṃ prayāsa
ityāśaṅkya pariharati atheti| muktyai gatyarthadehānuvṛtiṃta brahmavidyaiva kuryāt| tarhi dvayoḥ pramāṇayostulyabalatvāt kathaṃ dehāvasāna eveti niyama ityāśaṅkya pāṭhakramādarthakramasya balīyastvena dehāvasāne karmakṣayasyārthakramaprāptatvāt pāṭhakramaprāptaṃ mārge karmakṣayaṃ bādhitvā artho varṇyata iti na kaścidvirodhaḥ||
syādetat niśśeṣaṃ karma viduṣo yadīhaiva naśyet tadā "tasya tāvadeva ciram " iti vākyaṃ sthūladehāntamātre viśrāmyet| tathā ca tadānīmevāsau muktassyāt| evañca sati arcirādigamanasya prayojanavattvaṃ na syāt| nacārcirādigamanaṃ nāstīti vaktuṃ śakyam; " paraṃ jyotirupasampadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate "ityarcirādimārgaṇa gatvā paramapuruṣaprāptyanantarameva mokṣasyāmnātatvāt| tat kathaṃ sthūladehāvasāne niśśeṣakarmavilopa iti kasyacit śaṅkā| tadidamanuvadati niśśeṣamiti| uktaśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti ayuktamiti| ayuktatvamevopapādayati syāditi| ayamarthaḥ sukhaduḥkhādiphalaprāptihetuḥ karmakalopo dehāvasāne yadyapi viśrāntaḥ, tathāpi paraṃ jyotirupasampadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpattiparyantaṃ jñānasaṅkocamātrahetusūkṣmakarmaśeṣo'nuvartate| kathametaditi cet " paraṃ jyotirūpasampadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate " iti śrutisāmarthyāt| nahi svābhāvikajñānavataḥ puruṣasyākāraṇaka eva tāvantaṃ kālaṃ jñānasaṅkoca iti vaktuṃ śakyate| na ca tasya bhagavannigrahaśeṣamantareṇa kāraṇāntaramastīti| tena bhagavantaṃ prāptasyaivāsaṅkucitabrahmānubhavarūpamoṅasiddhessākṣādeva śrutatvādanukrameṇaiva bhagavannigrahanivṛttiriti siddham||
pūrvādhikaraṇe sthūladehāvasāna evārcirādimārgopakrame sthūlasarvakarmakṣayaḥ, sūkṣmasaṃskāraśeṣeṇa paraṃ jyotirupasampannasyaiva svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpattirityupakṣiptam| tatra prastuto'yamarcirādimārgo yasyāṃ vidyāyāmadhītastadvidyāniṣṭhasyaiva syāt kiṃ vā sarvavidyāniṣṭhasyeti cintyata iti saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kimarcirādigatiḥ pañcāgnividyāniṣṭhānāmeva uta sarvavidyāniṣṭhānāmiti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ pañcāgnividyāyāṃ "ya evametadvidurye cāmī araṇye śraddhāṃ satyamupāsate te'rciṣamabhisambhavanti " "tadya itthaṃ viduryeceme 'raṇye śraddhā tapa ityupāsate te'rciṣamabhisambhavanti " itītarānapi coddiśyārcirādigatividhiśśrūyate uta pañcāgnividyāniṣṭhānevoddiśyeti| kiṃ śraddhāsatyatapaśśabdairupāsyabrahmopasthāpanamukhenātropāsanāntarapratipattirasti neti| kimupakosalavidyāyāṃ " ācāryastu te gatiṃ vaktā " iti gatyanuvāda upāsanāntarapratipattimupohbalayati neti| tatra śaṅkāpūrvakaṃ pūrvapakṣamupanyasya siddhāntamapi prakaṭayati panthā iti| bhāṣyoktaṃ saṃśayasvarūpaṃ prathamaṃ darśayati| idaṃ hi bhāṣyavākyaṃ " upakosalādiṣu yeṣūpāsaneṣvarcirādigatiśśrūyate kiṃ tanniṣṭhānāmeva tayā brahmaprāptiḥ
uta sarveṣāṃ brahmopāsananiṣṭhānām " iti| atra prārabhyetyādinā pūrvapakṣaṃ darśayati| ayamarthaḥ upakosalādividyāviśeṣaṃ prārabhya yatrayatrārcirādhāmnānaṃ tatratatraiva syādarcirādigatiḥ tadanusārāt taccintanamapi tathā nānyatreti| tadidaṃ pratikṣipati neti| tadeva vivṛṇotisarvāsāmiti| ayamarthaḥ pañcāgnividyāyāṃ " tadya itthaṃ viduḥ " iti pañcāgnividyāniṣṭhānanūdya " ye ceme 'raṇye " iti vidyāntaraniṣṭhāṃścānūdyārcirādimārgo vidhīyate,tena sarvāsāmapi vidyānāmarcirādimārgaḥ phalatayā sādhāraṇa eva tena brahmavidyāniṣṭhānāṃ phalacintanasyāvaśyambhāvitvāt arcirādimārgacintanamapi tadvadeva mārgavadeva sādhāraṇaṃ syāditi| nahi phalānusandhānamantareṇopāyaniṣṭhānāmupāsanaṃ sambhavati| ata eva " brahmalokamabhisambhavāni " iti cintanamavaśyakartavyatvena pratipāditamiti pūrvamapapyuktamasmābhiḥ||
gaticintanāderavaśyakartavyatvaṃ bhagavadvākyaparāmarśenāpyupapādayati heyopādeyeti| ayamarthaḥ heyamārgo dhūmādimārgaḥ| upādeyamārgaḥ punararcirādimārgaḥ| ubhayamapi mārgamupadiśan muktidātā bhagavān " naite sṛti pārtha jānan yogī muhyati kaścana " iti gaticintanasyāvaśyakartavyatvamagāyat| tasmādasmāddaśādhyayanāviśadārthaviśadīkarturbhagavato vākyāvamarśāt brahmaprāptyupayuktakṛtsnārthapraṇihitavihitam| praṇihitaṃ praṇidhānaṃ bhāve niṣṭhā| ayamatra nirṇayaḥ na kevalamatra
mārgacintāvidhānamucyate api tu brahmaprāptyupayuktaṃ yadyadatra prāmāṇikamupalabhyate tatsarvamapi cintanīyaṃ dehāvasānasarvakarmakṣayāpriyāpriyasaṃkrāntyarcirādimārgavirajātaraṇādikaṃ sarvamapi phalatvādupāyadaśāyāṃ
cintanīyamiti||
atra sūtrakārairhānopāyanābhidhānasya pādāsaṅgatimāśaṅkya pariharati hānāderiti| ayamatra pūrvapakṣiṇo bhāvaḥ hānopāyanādicintanaṃ vidyāṅgameva, aṅgaṃ ca nirūpaṇīyamuttaratra vidyāṅgapāde, ayañca pādo vidyāsvarūpopateśaparaḥ, tasmādatra kathaṃ saṅgatiriti| hānāderarcirāderapi sūtrakāraiścintanaṃ kimarthamihābhihitam? vidyāṅgatvasiddhyai cet tadā anantare vidyāṅgapāde bhavatu nātreti| imāmāśaṅkāṃ pratikṣipati maivamiti| atraiva gaticintanādisūtrasya sthānapātitvamastyeva| kutaityatrāha vidyāṅgatāyāmiti| gaticintanādervidyāṅgatve satyapi bhajanamiva sādhanabhūtamupāsanamiva upāsanāṅgabhūtamidañca gaticintanādikamapi karmādibhyo vibhaktaṃ iti kathayitumiha tatsūtraṇaṃ sthānapātītyanvayaḥ| ayamatra bhāvaḥ vidyāṅgāni kānicit jñānarūpāṇi, kānicit kriyārūpāṇi, jñānarūpāṇāṃ gaticintanādīnāṃ pradhānabhūtavidyātulyatvapradarśanārthamiha taccintanam, itareṣāṃ karmarūpāṇāṃ prācuryeṇa vidyāṅgapāde cintanamiti vibhāgaḥ| tena gaticintanādessthāna evābhidhānamiti nāsthānapātitvaśaṅkāvakāśaḥ||
pūrvamaricirādigatessarvavidyāsādhāraṇyena śrutatvāt taccintanasyāpi nyāyaprāptaṃ sarvavidyāsādhāraṇyaṃ pratipāditam, adhunā punarakṣaradhiyāṃ sarvavidyāsādhāraṇyaṃ na veti cintyata iti saṅgatiḥ| pūrvādhikaraṇe prakaraṇaṃ pūrvapakṣahetuḥ, atrāpi tatheti vā saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu bṛhadāraṇyake gārgibrāhmaṇe " etadvai tadakṣaraṃ gārgi brāhmaṇā abhivadantyasthūlamanaṇvahrasvam " ityādyasthūlatvādikaṃ tatraivopasaṃhāryamuta sarvāsu vidyāsviti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ niṣedharūpāṇāmasthūlatvādīnāmeva brahmāsādhāraṇākāratayā brahmasvarūpanirūpakatvamuta kevalajñānānandādīnāmita| kimasthūlatvādikaṃ vinā śaṅkitakṛtsnadoṣavyāvṛttipratītirasti neti| at pūrvapakṣī manyate  nanu gārgibrāhmaṇādiṣu kvacidevākṣaratvādikamāmnātam, yasyāṃ tu vidyāyāṃ yāvadguṇajātamāmnātaṃ tāvadeva tatropasaṃhāryaṃ tatprakaraṇapaṭhatatvāt; anyathā sarvaṃ sarvatropasaṃhāryamiti sadvidyādīnāṃ guṇasaṅkarassyāt, brahmasvarūpapratipattistvānandādibhireveti prāgevoktam, tena kimanenājāgalastanāyamānena brahmasvarūpapratipattāvakṣaratvādinā guṇeneti| tadidamanuvadati yasyāmiti| anyatrānupasaṃhāryatvamāha nānyasyāmiti| tatra hetumāha mānahāneriti| sarvasyāpi guṇasya sarvatropasaṃhāpassyādityarthaḥ| evaṃ pūrvapakṣamanūdya dūṣayati neti| pūrvapakṣapratikṣepaprakāraṃ viśadameva darśayati hetutveti| ayamatrābhiprāyaḥ na kevalaṃ brahmaguṇamātramatrocyate, api tu kāraṇatvāśaṅkitadoṣaparihāreṇa svarūpapratipattiheturguṇaviśeṣaḥ| sa punaramalatvam, tena sahitāssatyatvādayo'pi| tathāhi satyatvaṃ savikāramacidvastu vyāvartayati| jñānatvaṃ viluptabuddhikaṃ tatsaṃsṛṣṭaṃ jīvam| anantatvaṃ pūrvāvadhimantaṃ muktam| ānandatvamapi paravādiparikalpitaṃ nirānandamīśvaram| tenāmalatvena nityo vyāvartyate| yadyapyanantapadenaivāṇusvarūpo nityo'pi vyāvartyate tathāpi dharmabhūtajñānato dekālābhyāmānantyasya tasmin vidyāmānatvāt kathañcidānantyaṃ vaktuṃ śakyate| amalatvaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ vyāvartakameva| nityo'pi paratantracetanatvāt saṃsāre svarūpayogyatāvān kevalaṃ bhagavadapacārarūpasahakāriyogyatābhāvāt nityamevāsaṃsārī vartate| īśvarastu svatantracetanatvāt saṃsāre svarūpayogyatārahitaḥ| tenedamevāmalatvamīśvarasyāsādhāraṇameva| kiñcetarasaṃsaraṇanivartakatvamīśvarasyāsādhāraṇam, taccāmalatvameva| teva svayaṃ malarahitatvāt itaramalapratibhaṭatvācca īśvara evāmala ityucyate| tarhyamalatvamevāstu kiṃ satyatvādibhiriti codyamavaśiṣyate taccātra nāstītyāhahetutveti| dvedhā hi lakṣaṇamabhidhīyate ekenaiva viśeṣaṇena kṛtsnālakṣyavyāvṛttirtayekaḥ pakṣaḥ, aparastu nānāviśeṣaṇairbuddhyavataraṇakrameṇālakṣyavyāvṛttyā lakṣyasvarūpanirūpaṇaṃ kriyate tadidamiti bhāṣyakārābhiprāyaḥ| ayamatra śabdārthaḥ kāraṇatvena vastvantaraniṣṭhadoṣā āśaṅkyante| teṣāṃ vyapanayanaṃ satyajñānānantānandāmalapadaiḥ kriyate| tena kramāddoṣavyapāyapratipattiḥ| pratipattisaukaryārthamanukramādarthaviśeṣapratipattau ddaṣṭāntamāhaānandeti| ānandamayādhikaraṇe'nnamayaprāṇamayamonomayavijñānamayānandamayā uttarottaraṃ kramādevādhikatvena pratipadyante| evamatrāpyanukrameṇa sarvādhikatvena bhagavān pratipādyate| tena prathamata evamalatvena bhagavatassarvādhikatva pratipattau kimebhissatyatvādibhirviśeṣaṇairiti codyaṃ parihṛtameveti| asya sārvatrikatvāt etasyānukramabodhananyāyasya
sarvalokaprasiddhatvādityarthaḥ||
atra kaściccodayati satyatvādyairguṇaissvarūpāvagatirabhihitā sarvāvidyānuvṛttatayā| tena bhūyo'pi tattulyadharmeṣvakṣaratvādiṣvidamadhikaraṇaṃ vṛthaiva syāditi| tadidamanuvadatisatyatvādyairiti| anuditamarthaṃ nirākaroti neti| nikātakaṇaprakārameva vivṛṇoti kaiściditi| " labdharūpe kvacit kiñcit tāddaganyanniṣidhyate " iti nyāyena vastusvarūpapratipattau viśeṣaṇāntaraissiddhāyāṃ paścādeva vyāvṛttipratipattaḥ, tathā ca vastumbarūpapratipattornopakarotītyanadhyakṣitanyāyaḥ kaścinmanyate tatprakṣaṇasyātroparodhārthamidamadhikaraṇaṃ saphalamevetyarthaḥ| ayamatra bhāvaḥ  loke karmavyatiriktatve sati jātimātrāśrayo guṇa ityādau vyāvṛttipratipattirapi guṇādisvarūpaviśeṣapratipattāvupayujyate| tadvadatrāpi brahmasvarūpapratipattau vyāvṛtteḥ pratipattirupayajyate| tarhi " labdharūpe kvacitkiñcittāddaganyanniṣidhyate " ityasya ko'rthaḥ? kenāpi prakāreṇa siddhe vastuni itaravyavṛttirūpaṃ prakārāntaramapi pratīyata iti na kaściddoṣaḥ| ayamarthaḥ vidhiniṣedhayoḥ pūrvaṃ vidhirūpeṇa kenāpi prakāreṇa pratipanne vastuni paścāt niṣedhapravṛttiḥ na punaratyantāpratipanne iti||
atra kaścidāha vyāvartyānāmanantatvāt vyāvṛttirapyanantā| tasyāḥ punarānantye tadvyāvartakamapyanantameva vācyam| tathā ca kartumeva na śakyate | na hyaśakyaṃ sāgarataraṇaṃ kaiścidupadiśyate| aśakyavidhāne vākyasyānanuṣṭhānalakṣaṇāprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāditi| tadidamanuvadati vyāvartyeti| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ vyavartyānantyāt vyāvartanamapyanantaṃ syāt tena taccintā vyāvṛtticintā kiñcijjñasādhyapatayā nopadiśyeta|
tatrāśakyopadeśe ddaṣṭāntamāha jaladhitaraṇavaditi| tadidaṃ pratikṣipatimaivamiti| pratikṣepaprakārameva darśayati tattaditi| dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvādisāmānyadharmopādāne nānantānāmapi vyaktīnāṃ yathā loke nirāsaḥ evamatrāpi pratikṣepyāṇāṃ dharmāṇāṃ sāmānyadharmopādānena nirāsassyāt| athavā ekenaiva viśeṣaṇena sarvadharmavyāvṛttissetsyatītyāhaanavamamiti| " anavamaṃ brahma " ityekena viśeṣaṇenāpareṣāṃ pratikṣepyāṇāmavamānāṃ saṃgṛhītirgṛhyatāṃ saṃgraheṇopādānaṃ svīkriyatāmityarthaḥ||
heyapratyanīkatvaṃ brahmaṇo'sādhāraṇaṃ cet aśanāyādyatītatvaviśiṣṭaṃ brahma syāt, prāṇitṛtvādiviśiṣṭastu jīvassyāditi śaṅkyā saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu " yat sākṣādaparokṣādbrahma ya ātmā sarvāntarastaṃ me vyācakṣva " " yadeva sākṣādaparokṣādbrahma ya ātmā sarvāntarastaṃ me vyācakṣva " iti praśnaḥ uṣastakaholayoḥ| prativacanamapi " yaḥ prāṇena prāṇiti sa ta ātmā sarvāntaraḥ " ityekatra " yo'śanāyāpipāse śokaṃ moham " ityādyanayatra| kimubhayatra vidyaikyamuta vidyābheda iti| kiṃ pūrvatra jīva upāsyaḥ paratra paraḥ, utobhayatra para eveti| kiṃ tatra " yaḥ prāṇena prāṇiti sa ta ātmā sarvāntaraḥ " ityādipratipekṣayā ca aupādhike, uta nirūpādhike iti| kiṃ " na ddaṣṭerdraṣṭāraṃ paśyaḥ, na matermantāraṃ manvīthāḥ" iti punaḥ praśnaprativacanaparyālocanayā " yaḥ ātmano'ntaraḥ"
" ko hyevānyāt " iti pratipanne brahmaṇo nirūpādhikasarvāntaratvaprāṇanakartṛtve pratīyete neti| kiṃ "na ddaṣṭerdraṣṭāram "
iti ddaṣṭerjñānahetunā draṣṭāraṃ brahma na manvīthā iti vākyārthaḥ, ahosvit ddaṣṭeranubhūterdraṣṭāraṃ na manvīthā iti vā|
atra bhāṣye dvau pakṣāvabhihitau| ekatra pakṣe kvacijjīvaparatvamāśaṅkya sarvatra paramātmaparatvanirṇayaḥ| anyatra ubhayatra paramātmaparatve satyapi pūrvatra guṇabhedāṅgīkāreṇa rūpāntaraviśiṣṭabrahmaparatvam, utaratra paramātmāsādhāraṇāśanāyādyatītatvādiguṇānubandhādrūpāntaraviśiṣṭaparamātmaparatvamityāśaṅkyobhayatrāpi rūpābhedādekarūpaparamātmaparatvamiti nirṇīyata iti| atra dvayorapi pakṣaparakalpanayoḥ kāraṇaṃ vaiṣamyañca darśayati sūtreti| pūrvasyāṃ kalpanāyāṃ sūtrasvārasyalābhaḥ kāraṇaṃ " bhūtagrāmavat " iti jīvasya darśanāt| uttarasyāṃ tu śrutisvārasyalābho hetuḥ dvayorapi praśnayoḥ " sākṣādaparokṣādbrahma " iti brahmasvarūpapraśnadarśanāt | ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ sūtrasvārasyalābhāt prathamamasubhṛtaḥ jīvasya pūrvapakṣe niveśaḥ| siddhānte tu brahmaṇo niveśaḥ| ayaṃ tokaśaṅkāpanuttyai bāliśaśaṅkāpanodanāyetyarthaḥ| atha tokaśaṅkāpanuttyai uttarāmapi kalpanāmamanuvadatisākṣāditi| " yatsākṣādaparokṣādbrahma " iti brahmaśabdānuviddhaṃ praśnadvayavākyaṃ parāmṛśatāṃ viduṣāṃ anyaśaṅkaiva na syāditi vicārya pūrvatrāparitoṣāt athānantaraṃ bhāṣye paramātmaviṣayatayā pūrvapakṣo'pi
parikalpita iti||
atra svābhimatāmuttarapakṣakalpanāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ sukhapratipattyarthaṃ pūrvapakṣasiddhāntavibhāgena viśadaṃ prakāśayati yatsākṣāditi|
ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ " yatsākṣāt " ityamuṣmin vākye " yadeva sākṣāt " ityetasmiṃśca vākye paraṃ brahmaiva vedyamastu athāpi prativacanabhedo rūpaṃ bhinattyameva rūpabhedāt vidyābhedaśca sidhyati| na kevalaṃ rūpabhedāt, praṣṭṛbhedādapi vidyābhedassidhyatītyāha vidyābhiditi| praṣṭṛbhedo'pi vidyāṃ bhinattītyarthaḥ| kvaciduṣastaḥ praṣṭā, aparatra kaholaḥ| yadīti pūrvapakṣānuvādaṃ dyotayati| tadidaṃ pratikṣipati neti| tatra hetumāhaanūdyeti| " yadeva sākṣādaparokṣādbrahma iti sāvadhāraṇamanūdyoṣasteva śrutasya pūrvasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ punaranuyogādityarthaḥ| tarhi paścāduktamaśanāyadyatītatvaṃ vidyāṃ bhinattītyāśaṅkya tadapi na bhanattītyāha paścādukta iti| ayamarthaḥ paścāduktaṃ hyaśanāyā dyatītatvaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇoktāmalatvāntargatameva| taccāmalatvaṃ sarvavidyāsādhāraṇatvāt na vidyāṃ bhinattīti| athavā dvayorapi praṣṭrossādhāraṇatvāt sabrahmacaryeṇa sannihitayossādhāraṇatvādityarthaḥ| evaṃ vidyaikye siddhe viśadapratipattyarthaḥ praṣṭṛbhedo na vidyāṃ bhinattīti bhāvaḥ||
nanu bhāṣye sadvidyāddaṣṭāntena sādhāraṇyamupapāditam, tatra praṣṭraikyamaṅkīkurmahe tena sarveṣāmapyuttarāṇāṃ sādhāraṇyamastu nāma iha tu praṣṭṛbhedāt kathamuttarasādhachāraṇyamityajānānasya kasyaciccodakasyoktamevārthaṃ viśadaṃ prakāśayati sadvidyāyāmiti| ayamatra bhāvaḥ astu nāma sadvidyāyāṃ praṣṭraikyam, astu cātra praṣṭṛbhedaḥ,athāpyuttarasādhāraṇyamaṅgokartavyameva, loke hyekamevācāryamuddiśya dvayoḥ śiṣyayorāgatayorekārthaṃ pṛṣṭavatorupadeśavelāyāmekaikābhimukhyenoktamarthadvayaṃ dvayorapi pratipannamupādeyamanusandheyañca bhavati| evamatrāpyubhayatrāpyuktamuttaramubhayorapi sādhāraṇameva| kiṃ kāraṇamatreti cet tayossabrahmacaryameva| ubhau khalu sahaivāgatya pṛṣṭavantau ubhayamapyuttaraṃ labdhavantāviti lokaddaṣṭānukūlametat| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ upakramopasaṃhārādi parāmarśena vidhikatve pratipanne sati sadvidyāyāṃ yathā prativacanabhedaḥ praśnabhedānusārāt parāmeva devatāṃ viśeṣyaṃ prakaṭayati, tenaiva nyāyena uṣastaḥ kaholaśrutamapi kaholaścoṣastaśrutamapi saṅkalayya pratipaday dhyāyetāṃ sarvāntarameva brahma| nanūktassadvidyāyāmekaḥ praṣṭeti viśeṣaḥ tena tatra vidyaikyamastu evaṃ tarhyatrāpi viśeṣo'sti yat punassabrahmacaryamityāha phalavaditi| yathā loke śrṛṇvatāṃ bahūnāṃ sabrahmacāriṇāṃ śāstraśravaṇavelāyāṃ pratyekacodyapraśamanārthaḥ pṛthagupadeśassarvasādhāraṇaḥ,tathoṣastaḥ kaholaśrutaṃ saṅkalayya sa ca kahola uṣastaśrutaṃ saṅkalayya dvāvapi sarvāntaraṃ brahma dhyāyetāmityuktaṃ bhavati||
prāṇitṛtvādīnāmaśanāyādyatītvānāñcaikadharminiṣṭhatvāt vidyaikyaṃ pratipāditam, atratvapatapāpmatvādiguṇāṣṭakasya ca vaśitvādeśca dharmibhedāśaṅkayā pūrvapakṣotthānamiti saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu " atha yadidamasmin " iti daharavidyāyāṃ chāndogye apahatapāpmatvādiviśiṣṭamupāsyaṃ brahma, vājasaneyake vaśitvādiviśiṣṭamutobhayatrāpahatapāpmatvādiviśiṣṭamiti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ vājasaneyake hṛdayāyatanatvasatyasaṅkalpatvāvāntaraviśeṣavaśitvādimukhena satyasaṅkalpatvasahacārāpahatapāpmatvādīnāṃ pratipattirasti neti| atra cchāndogyavājasaneyakavākyayorvidyābhedābhedacintā bhāṣye vyaktamuktā, na punastāṇḍināṃ vākyamupāttam, athāpi tadvāvākyasyāpi nyāyasiddhaṃ brahmaviṣayatvamanūdya bhāṣyoktāmapi prakriyāṃ chāndogyavājasaneyakoyorekavidyātvaprakaṭanīṃ niśśeṣaśaṅkānirākaraṇena prakaṭayati ākāśamiti| ayamatra vākyārthaḥ ākāśaṃ tāṇḍino dhyeyamadhīyate vājinastvākāśaśayitaṃ puruṣam| tena tāṇḍivākye vājasaneyakavākye ca vidyā bhidyeteti kasyaciccodyam| tat pratikṣipati neti| tatra hetumāha dvividha iti| dvividho'pi nirdeśo brahmanirdeśa iti nirṇīto yataḥ, atastāṇḍivājasaneyavākyayornavidyābheda iti siddham| ataḥ paraṃ tu bhāṣyānukrameṇa cchāndogyavājasaneyakavākyayorbhedacintā santanyate sarvādhāratvapūrvairbhagavadasādhāraṇairguṇaissāmagākāśaśabdaḥ "daharo'sminnantara ākāśaḥ " iti cchāndogyasthākāśaśabdaḥ paramātmaviṣayaḥ| vājasaneyake tu " ya eṣo'ntarhṛdaya ākāśastasmiṃñchete sarvasya vaśī sarvasyeśānaḥ " iti vaśitvādiguṇopetasya bhagavata ākāśe śayānatvavacanāt ākāśaśabdaḥ paramātmādhārabhūtasuṣiravācakaḥ| atra dvayorapi vidyayo rūpabhedamāśaṅkya pariharati rūpaṃ tu
nānyaditi| chāndogye vājasaneyake cobhayatrāpyapahatāpāpmatvādiguṇaviśiṣṭaḥ paramapuruṣa evānusandheyatayocyata iti rūpabhedo nāstīti na vidyābheda iti bhāṣye eva vistṛtam||
atra cchāndogyavājasanekavākyayoravirodhopapādanaprakāramuktvā tenaiva prakāreṇa tāṇḍivājasaneyakavākyoyoravirodhaṃ siddhaṃ kṛtvā taittirīyakoktadaharavākyamapyanenaiva prakāreṇopapādyamityācaṣṭe
chandogānāmiti|ayamarthaḥchāndogānāmupāsyaṃ brahma apahatapāpmedyuktaguṇāṣṭakajuṣṭaṃ prathitameva|tacca brahma anyeṣāṃ vājasaneyināṃ vākye vaśitvādiguṇa ghacatamiti rūpabhedo'stu|ato vidyābhedo'stviti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ|imaṃ nirākarotimaivamiti|nirākarokaraṇaprakāramāhayattaditi|yattadviśitvādi guṇajātaṃ tat satyasaṅkalpatāyā bheda eva|vaśitvaṃ hi svavaśe vartamānatvaṃ athavā itarān svavaśe vartayatīti nirucyate|tat satyayaṅkalpatvameva prakārāntareṇocyate|tadidamāhatadiha bhideti|ityaikārthyanirūḍham chāndogyavājasaneyakavākyakavākyayoraikārthyaṃ nirūḍhamityarthaḥ| evaṃ tāṇḍivājasaneyakavākyadvayaṃ nirṇītam| evaṃ taittirīyakasthamapi daharavākyaṃ tadvadeva chāndogyavājasaneyakavākyavat vicāraṇīyamityarthaḥ||
nanu daharādhigahaṇe prāgeva daharavākyaṃ nirūpitam, tat kimatra prastūyata ityāśaṅkya prayojanaviśeṣāt na paunarūktyamiti pariharati nanviti| daharākāśaḥ paramātmāsādhadāraṇagumādyaiḥ paramapuruṣaeveti daharādhikaraṇe prāgevoktam, ataḥ paramātmavyatiriktārthaśaṅkā nāsti, tasmādidamādhikaraṇaṃ nojjihīta iti kaścidācaṣṭe| tatpratikṣipati neti| paunaruktyābhāvamupapādayati vyomātītamiti| ayamarthaḥ vyomātītavādinirākaraṇārthaṃ pūrvaṃ daharādhikaraṇaṃ pravṛttam, daharākāśaḥ paramapuruṣaḥ upādānaṃ tata upari kiñcit nimittaṃ vastvastīti vadanto vyomātītavādinaḥ pūrvaṃ pratikṣiptāḥ, tena tatpratikṣepapradhāne daharādhikaraṇaṃ, idaṃ punaradhikaraṇaṃ vidyābhedābhedacintāpradhānam, ataḥ prayojanabhedānnapaunaruktyam| pūrvaṃ pratikṣiptā api vyomātītavādino'tra prasaṅgāt chinnamūlatvaṃ gamitā iti||
pūrvatra satyakāmatvasatyasaṅkalpatvādīnāṃ guṇānāmupasaṃhāryatvamuktam, evamudgīthādyupāsanānāmapi niyamenopasaṃhāryatvaṃ syāditi śaṅkotthānena saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu " omityetadakṣaramudgīthamupāsīta " ityādikarmāṅgāśritodgīthādyupāsanādīni kiṃ kratuṣu niyamenopādeyāni utāniyamena iti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kimetāni kratvaṅgodgīthādimukhena kratvaṅgāni? uta godohanādivat puruṣārthabhūtāni? iti | kiṃ " tenobhau kuruto yaścaitadevaṃ veda yaśca na veda " ityaniyamadarśanaṃ godohanādivat puruṣārthatāmavagamayati neti| " yadeva vidyayā karoti śraddhayopaniṣadā tadeva vīryavattaraṃ bhavati " iti apāpaślokaśravaṇādivat kiṃ phalārthavādaḥ, uta phalavidhiriti| atra " yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati " iti parṇamayyadhikaraṇoktanyāyena udgīthādau kriyāṅge bhajanaṃ karmāṅgaṃ bhavet| parṇamayyadhikaraṇe'pyavyabhicaritakratusambandhijuhvādimukhena parṇatādikaṃ kratvaṅmityeva hi niraṇāyi| tatra yathā apāpaślokaśravaṇādikaṃ phalaṃ stutireva, evaṃ " yadeva vidyayā karoti " ityārabhya " tadeva viryavattaram " iti phaloktirarthavāda eva syāt| ubhayatrāpi " yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati " " yadeva vidyayā karoti "
iti vartamānanirdeśasyāviśiṣṭatvāt| tadidamāhaudgīthādāviti| uktamimaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ pratikṣipati godohaneti| nanu godohanādau pradhānaphalāt phalāntarasya paśordarśanādadhikṛtādhikāratvamaṅgīkṛtam, idamevāśrityavidhānamityucyate iha tu khatamityāśaṅkyātrāpi phalāntaradarśanamastīti parihāra ucyate svargādīnāmiti| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ kratuṣu svargādīnāmeva phalatvam, kratvaṅgāśrayodgīthādyupāsaneṣvatra vīryātirekaḥ pūrvoktaphalādadhikameva phalam | tatra vīryavattaratvaṃ nāma karmāntarairapratibaddhaphalakatvam| loke hi karmaphalaṃ prabalakarmāntaraphalaiḥ pratibadhyate| udgīthādyupāsanaṃ tu prācīnakarmāntarapratibandhavāramasāmarthyaṃ karotītyudgīthādyupāsanasya vīryavattaratvaṃ phalamityarthaḥ| ddaśyate hi loke svabhāvataḥ kāraṇaṃ svakāryakaraṇamātanute, pratibandhakamāgatya tacchakiṃta nirundhe, uttambhakaṃ punarmaṇimantrādikaṃ tāmeva karaṇaśaktimuttambhayati| tenāyamarthaḥ udgīthādyupāsanasahitaṃ cet karma sahasaiva svakāryaṃ kuryāt, nacet sahasaiva na kuryāditi| tenodgīthādikaṃ karmāṅgaṃ pradhānaphalenaiva phalavattvāt| upāsanaṃ tu na karmāṅgam; pradhānaphalātiriktaviryavattaratvarūpaphalāntaravattvāt| parṇatādikaṃ tu pṛthakphalaśūnyatvāt
avyabhicaritakratusamabandhijuhvādimukhena kratvaṅgameva| nanu " yasya parṇamayī " " yadeva vidyayā " iti vākyayostulyatayā phalaśravaṇe kathamiha vaiṣamyamabhidhīyate? ittham | idamavadhānenākarṇayethāḥ| viṣamarūpatvādvākyaśravaṇasya, kvacidvidyayeti tṛtīyā śrutirākarṇyate| sā ca tṛtīyā phalasādhanatvameva sākṣādupadiśati| parṇatāvākye tu na tṛtīyānirdeśaḥ| tena tatra na phalasambandhaḥ| tasmādarthavādamātrameva| tadidaṃ viśadameva darśayati parṇatvādāviti| yadi karaṇatvaṃ na vadati kiṃ tarhi tatrāhetyata āha karma cāhānupāstāviti| anupāstau upāsanavyatirikte karmaprayoge aṅgabhūtajuhvādeḥ parigraharūpaṃ karmaiva
vākyaṃ vadatītyarthaḥ| co'vadhāraṇe karmaiva vadatīti||
atra kaściccodayati udgīthe prāṇaddaṣṭau kratuphalādanyadeva phalaṃ vīryavattaratvādikaṃ parāmṛśasyaiva pūrvaṃ " anyathātvaṃ śabdāt " ityasminnadhikaraṇe vidyābhedābhedacintā kṛtā| tena punaḥ phalāntarārthatayā pūrvapakṣotthānaṃ vihatameveti| tadetadanuvadati udgītha iti| tadetat pratikṣipati maivamiti| tadeva vivṛṇoti atratya iti| ayamarthaḥ udgīthaviṣaye dvāvarthāvupapadyau| atra punaḥ phalāntarārthatayā karmānaṅgatvanirṇayaḥ| tatra tvanāgatāvekṣaṇanyāyena etadadhikaraṇanirṇītamarthamupajīvya vidyābhedābhedacintā| tato na paunaruktyam| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ atratye'naṅgabhāve sthiranihitadhiyaḥ śroturadhikāriṇastatra vidyaikyaśaṅkā sā ca parihṛtetyoko'yaṃ samādhiḥ| samādhānāntaramapyāha tyaktveti| asyāṅgānaṅgabhāvau parityajya vidyādvayaṃ pṛthagapṛthagiti pūrvatra cintā, tatra vidyādvayasya pṛthaktve nirṇīte vidyāyāḥ pṛthakphalatvenāśrayikarmatvamatra kevalaṃ samarthyate||
pūrvadhikaraṇaṃ prasaṅgādāyatam, adhunā tatpūrvadaharavidyāviṣayanirūpaṇamatra kriyata iti saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu " tadya ihātmānamanuvidya vrajantyetāṃśca satyān kāmān " iti apahatapāpmatvādīnāmapi bhedenopāsanaṃ vihitam, tatra guṇacintane guṇaviśiṣṭatayā daharasyātmanaścintanamāvartanīyaṃ neti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ daharamātracintane guṇavaddaharacintanamapi kṛtaṃ neti| atra kaścidāha " ya ihātmānamanuvidya vrajantyetāṃśca satyān kāmān " iti pṛthaganudyānavacanabalāt dharmyupāsanāt vibhaktā dharmopāstiḥ| tadarthaṃ guṇiparigaṇanaṃ dharmopāsanārthaṃ dharmyupādānaṃ tantrato'stu ekavāramevāstu| ayamarthaḥ dharmyupāsanārthaṃ dharmyupādāne kṛte tadupajīvanādeva dharmopāsanārthaṃ punardharmyupādānaṃ na kartavyam, pūrvopāttadharmyupādānenaivottaropāsane'pi dharmisiddheriti| tadetat sarvamanuvadati kāmāniti| tadidaṃ nirākaroti ayuktamiti| ayuktatvamovopapādayati tattaditi| apahatapāpmatvādiguṇagaṇaviśiṣṭopāsane tattadguṇavaiśiṣṭyabhedāt pratividhi tattadguṇaviśiṣṭabrahmopāsanavidhāne sarvatrāpi guṇinobrahmaṇaścintanāvṛttirarthyā arthādanapetā| tena pūrvaṃ "anuvidya " iti vihitaguṇyanusandhāne etāṃśca satyānkāmānanuvidya vrajantīti tattadguṇaviśiṣṭabrahmānusandhāne guṇyanusandhānaṃ pratyekameva kartavyamityarthaḥ| asminnarthe pūrvakāṇḍoktanyāyaṃ ddaṣṭāntatayā sūtrakāroktaṃ darśayati rājatvādyairiti| ayamarthaḥ " indrāya rājñe puroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet " ityādau tattadviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭendre pradānākhyaṃ karmāvṛttam | evamapahatapāpmatvādinānāviśeṣaṇaviśṣṭe parasmin brahmaṇi sthite tasyaiva parasya brahmaṇaḥ paunaḥ punyenāvṛttirarthavatīti||
atra kaścidāhaatra khalu dvividhamupāsanamuktam, nirguṇasvarūpopāsanamekam, guṇaviśiṣṭabrahmopāsanamaparam, iha ca yathopāsanaṃ phalamiti nyāyena nirguṇasvarūpopāsanāt nirguṇabrahmaprāptiḥ, tadidamucyate " paraṃ jyotirupasampadya svena rūpeṇābhaniṣpadyate " iti, saguṇopāsanāt punassaguṇabrahmaprāptiḥ, tadapyatrocyate " jakṣat krīḍan ramamāṇaḥ " ityādinā, tena kramamuktimatropakalpayāmaḥ, tatassaguṇopabāsanāt saguṇaṃ prāpya nirguṇopāsanāt nirgumapi prāpnotīti| tadidaṃ sarvamanuvadati tattadbhogeti| tat pratikṣipati asaditi| ayamarthaḥ atrobhayavidhopāsanaṃ bhavatā kiṃ pramāṇamanusṛtya kalpyate uta na| nādyaḥ upāsanasya sarvasyāpi saguṇaviṣayatvāt| na dvitīyaḥ atiprasaṅgāt| asatyā eva guṇā iti cenna " ta ime satyāḥ kāmāḥ " iti tatsatyatvasyaivātyādareṇa pratipādanāt| " paraṃ jyotirupasampadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate " ityetasmādanantarameva " jakṣatkrīḍan ramamāṇaḥ " iti saguṇaphalatya pratipādanācca| pūrvameva nirguṇavākyasya heyaguṇaniṣedhaviṣayatvena vyavasthāpanāditi| tena nirguṇameva nāsti
kutastasyopāsanaṃ kutastarāṃ nirguṇabrahmaprāptiḥ kutastamāñcopāsanaphasavaividhyena vākyārthabhedapariklṛptiriti| uktamevārthaṃ vaiśadyāya punarūpapādayati śāstro'sminniti| asmin śāstre khalu " athāto brahmajijñāsā " ityārabhya " anāvṛttiśśabdādanāvṛttiśśabdāt " iti sūtraparyantaṃ nirguṇabrahmopāsanaprasaṅga eva nāsti| iṣṭamevaitadbhavatāṃ upāsyatvena mithyātvaprasaṅgāt| phalañca nirguṇopāsane parikalpayituṃ na śakyate|
tatphalaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ cedanādisiddhatnādaphalameva| tasmāt saguṇādevopāsanāt phalasiddhiḥ| tacca phalaṃ saguṇātmakameveti siddham| mā bhūt śāstre nirguṇabrahmopāsanam, mā bhūdapi tatphalam, athāpyasmatsaṃpradāyapāramparyāt parikalpitamiticet tatrottaramāha nocchāstramiti| tiṣṭhantvetāni dūṣaṇāni, idamekaṃ brahmāstram| ayaṃ khalu pādo guṇopasaṃhārapāda ita nāmataḥ prasiddhaḥ| asminpāde guṇaviṣedhavacanaṃ bhavatāmumimattapralapitamevetyāhaguṇaniyamanata iti||
etasminnadhikaraṇe pūrvapakṣotthānamākṣipya samādhātumupakramate pratyekamityādinā| " apahatāpāpmā" ityādinā pratyekānusandhānam| " vrajantyetāṃśca satyān kāmān " ityādinā melanānusandhānam| yadvā tadvā bhavatu| ubhayathānusandhāne'pi guṇinamantareṇa guṇānusandhānābhāvāt brahmānusandhānaṃ svayameva sidhyati| atra guṇyananusandhānaṃ kathamivāśaṅkyate āśaṅkābhāve kathamivasamādhīyataiti codakābhiprāyaḥ| tadidaṃ pratikṣipatineti| pratikṣepaprakāramāha guṇānāmiti| guṇānāṃ buddhyārohe yadavadhi cacaguṇino rūpaṃ satyatvajñānatvānantatvādirūpaṃ arthyaṃ arthādanapetaṃ tadaviyuktamityarthaḥ| tatka svayameva sidhyatyeva| tato'nyat yat tat vidyaikāntaṃ sthānādirūpam| tadāvṛttīti tasya sthānāderāvṛttisahitasya brahṇa āvṛtticintāpravṛtteriti śabdārthaḥ| ayamarthaḥ sarvavidyāsādhāraṇasāmānyaguṇātiriktatattadvidyāviśeṣaviyatasthānādiviśeṣaṇasahitasyaiva brahmaṇa āvṛttiriti||
atra bhāṣye saṅgatiruktā " kiṃ pūrvaprakṛtavidyayā ekavidyātvena tadupāsyaviśeṣanirdhāraṇamanena kriyate " iti pūrvapakṣotthānakramābhidhānāt| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ sarvāsu paravidyāsu nārāyaṇa evopāsyaḥ, uta daharavidyāyāmeva nīrāyaṇa upāsya iti| tadartha vicāryate kiṃ nārāyaṇānuvāke sarvavidyopāsyaviśeṣanirdhāraṇaṃ kriyate uta daharavidyopāsyaviśeṣanirdhāraṇamiti| kimatra " padmakopratīkāśaṃ hṛdayañcāpyadhomukhakam " ityādinā pratīyamānadaharavidyopāsyadaharoddeśena nārāyaṇatvaṃ vidhīyate, uta sarvavidyāsu akṣaraśivaśambhuparabrahmaparajyotiḥparatatattvamādiśabhdanirdiṣṭamupāsyaṃ vastviha taireva śabdairanūdya nārāyaṇatvaṃ vidhīyata iti| kiṃ " padmakopratīkāśam " ityādihṛdayāyatanatvaśravaṇānurodhena daharoddena vidhānaṃ nyāyyam, uta vidheyanārāyaṇatvānurodhena liṅgabhūyastvena sarvopāsyoddeśena nārāyaṇatvavidhānaṃ nyāyyamiti| atra saṅgatigarbhaṃ pūrvapakṣopanyāsamāha prakrānteti| " aṇoraṇīyān " ityasminnanuvāke dahravidyā prakrāntā| " sahasraśīrṣam " ityanuvākaḥ pūrvaprakṛtadaharavidyāvedyanirdhāraṇārthaṃ iti pūrvapakṣotthānam| taddūṣayati maivamiti| pūrvapakṣapratikṣepaprakāraṃ prakaṭayati tattaditi| śrutiliṅgavākyādiṣu pramāṇeṣu uttarottaradaurbalyasya nyāyasiddhatvāt prakaraṇādvākyaṃ balīyaḥ| " nārāyaṇa paraṃ brahma " iti padāntarasamabhivyāhāro vākyam| tacca vākyaṃ " tattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ, nārāyaṇa paro jyotiḥ " ityādirūpaṃ sarvavidyāvedyopasthāpanaṃ karoti| bhavatā punaḥ prakaraṇādeva daharavidyāmātraśeṣatvamabhidhīyate| tena durbalapramāṇasiddhaṃ daharavidyāmātraśeṣatvaṃ parityajya prabalapramāṇasiddhaṃ sarvavidyāśeṣatmeva saṃgrāhyamiti| taddamāha adhikabalaṃ prakriyāto hi vākyamiti||
nanu na kevalaṃ prakaraṇamātramasmābhiravasambyate, api tu daharavidyāśeṣatvopapādakaliṅgamapyasminvākye ddaśyate tena tadvirodhe si vākyālliṅgasya prābalyāt daharavidyāśeṣatvamevāṅgīkāryamityāśaṅkya pariharati vākyairiti| ayamarthaḥ yadyekameva vākyaṃ tadā liṅgalya prābalyaṃ vaktuṃ śakyetāpi| atratu bahūni vākyāni vidyante, atasteṣāmeva prābalyam| naca tāni liṅgena virudhyante| sarvavidyāśeṣatvameva hi vākyairupapādyate| atropalakṣaṇanyāyena katipayopādānamiti sarvavidyāśeṣatvasiddho daharavidyāpi sarvavidyāntargateti tadvidyāśeṣatvamapi vākyānāmabhimatameva| tenopaśāntavirodhaṃ svavākye daharavidyāśeṣatvaliṅgamavirodhenāvatiṣṭhate| prakaraṇamapi daharavidyāśeṣatvopapādakaṃ taccheṣatvalābhena kṛtārthatvāt sarvavidyāśeṣatvapratipādakavākyaiḥ prabalairna virudhyate| kiñca " sahasrīrṣaṃ devam " "
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣāḥ " iti puruṣanārāyaṇapratyabhijñārūpaliṅgamupakramasthatvādatyantaprabalameva dṛśyate| tena lihgādupasehārasthāt na daharavidyāmātraśeṣatvasiddhiḥ| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ vākyaissarvārthatāyāmupapāditāyāṃ daharabhajanamapyatrabhāgīti asminnarthe bhāgavaditi sārthaḥ kṛtārthatāvān asminvākye daharavidyāśeṣatvopapādakaliṅgānvitobhāgaḥ, tasmādeva kṛtārthatvāt liṅgasya virodha eva nāsti| svābhimatārtalābhena virodhābhāvāt liṅgamudāsīnamevāvatiṣṭhate| evaṃ kṛtārthatnenodasīnaṃ liṅgaṃ bahubhistatparairvākyairyoddhuṃ nālameva| evañca sati prakaraṇamapi svayamalasaṃ svabhāvato durbalatvāt dahara vidyāśeṣatvasyāpi lābhena kṛtārthatvācca| tena naikasyāsya liṅgasyopakaroti| nahi bahuṣu viruddheṣu balavatsu vidyāmāneṣu svayaṃ kṛtārthatvādalasasya liṅgasya svayamapi svabhachāvato durbalaṃ kṛtārthatvādalacasaṃ ca prakaraṇamupakaroti| kiñcopakramopasaṃhārādiṣaḍvidhatātparyaliṅgaparāmarśena vākyārthe nirṇīte pratipannamarthāntaraṃ tyājyamevetihi nyāyamārgaḥ| atra punassarvavidyopajīvyatvāt nārāyaṇasyaiva paramaprāpyatvapratipādanamiti sphuṭapratipannamasaṃkucitamarthaṃ parityajya daharavidyāmātraśeṣatvaṃ nopapādanīyamiti sarvavidyāśeṣatvameva vākyasyeti siddham| ayamarthaḥ idaṃ tu vākyaṃ na
kevalaśeṣatvopapādakam| samanvayādhikaraṇe vidhiśeṣatvamantareṇāpi vākyaprāmāṇyasyopapādanāt| athāpi sarvavidyopakārakameva, paratattvaparijñānamantareṇa taddhyānasya kartumaśakyatvāt| tena pramāṇabalāt sarvopajīvyatvasiddhiriti tatparityāgaklṛptirvitathaiva||
uktaṃ nārāyaṇasyaiva pāramyaṃ nānāvidhaparapakṣapratikṣepapūrvakaṃ sampratipannapramāṇaviśeṣapratipādanādupapādayati ātmaikyamiti| sarve'pyātmāna ekameveti bhāskarayādavaprakāśaśaṅkaramatānusāriṇo vadanti| sarvāsāṃ devatānāmaikyāmiti praśithilaparipaṭhitakatipayanigamāḥ pāmaraprāyāḥ| trimūrtyuttīrṇaṃ kimapi tattvamastīti vyomātītavādinaḥ| kevalapurāṇapaṭhanamātrasaṃtuṣṭā viṣeśajñānavidhurā brahmaviṣṇurudrāṇāṃ tulyatvamiti pratipedire| tādṛśā evānye punastrayāṇāmaikyamiti| apare punarayathāyathameva yathābhimānaṃ kalpayanto bhāskarādiṣvanyatamameva sarvasmātparaṃ varṇayanti| anipuṇā evaite| vedavirodhāt smṛtivirodhāt sattvottarapurāṇavirodhācca eteṣāṃ phaṇitīstattvavido nādriyante| tarhi kiṃ pramāṇaṃ bhavatāmityāśaṅkya pramāṇopādānapūrvakaṃ paratattvanirṇayamupapādayati trayyantairiti| ekakaṇṭhairiti sarvaśrutyavirodhamāha| tadanuguṇeti sopabṛṃhaṇatvamāha| śrīmāniti " hrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyau " ityuttaranārāyaṇoktaniyamakaliṅgaṃ darśayati| nārāyaṇa iti asyaiva nārāyaṇānuvākopādānam| patiriti " patiṃ viśvasya " ityādinānāvidhaśrutipratipannaśeṣaśeṣibhāvavyaktīkaraṇam| sa eva hi praṇavārthaḥ| praṇava eva hi sakalavedasāraḥ " sarve vedā yatpadamāmananti " ityārabhya " tatte padaṃ saṃgraheṇa bravībhyomityetat " iti nigamanāt| naḥ patiriti bahuvacanopādānāt " nityo nityānām " iti śrutusiddhajīvanānātvamupapādyate| akhilatanuriti antaryāmibrāhmaṇādisiddhamadhyātmaśāstrasārabhūtaṃ sarvaśarīratvamucyate| muktido muktabhogya iti tṛtīyacaturthādhyāyapratipādyārthatattvamabhidhīyate| mokṣapradatvaṃ tṛtīye muktaprāpyatvaṃ caturthe iti tayorarthavibhāgaḥ||
prakaraṇādbalīyasā vākyena nārāyaṇānuvākasya sarvavidyāsādhāraṇyamuktam| ihatu prakaraṇasya bādhakābhāvāt manaścitādayaḥ kriyāmayakratvanupraveśina iti śaṅkyā saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu vājasaneyake " manaścito vākcitaḥ prāṇacitaścakṣuścitaśśrotracitaḥ karmacito'gnicitaḥ " iti manaścitādayo'gnaya āmnāyante, te kiṃ kriyamayakratvanvayena kriyārūpāḥ uta vidyāmayakratvanyena vidyārūpā iti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate  kimiṣṭakacitāgnisannidhānāt tad dvārā sannihite kratau kriyāmaye viniyogo'sti teṣāmuta neti| kiṃ " vidyayā haivaita evaṃvidaścitā bhavanti" dānhaitānevaṃvide sarvadā sarvāṇi bhūtāni vicanvanti iti śrutiliṅgavākyairvidyārūpakratau viniyogo'vagamyate neti| kiṃ " manaseṣu grahā agṛhyanta manasāstuvanta
manasāśaṃsan" iti stotraśastrādyanubandhānvayāt "teṣāmekaika eva tāvānyāvānasau pūrvaḥ " ityatideśāt phalasambandhasambhavāt vidyāvidhiḥ kalpyaḥ, uta vidhipratyayāśravaṇāt vedanāśravaṇācca na kalpya iti| asminnadhikaraṇe sūtrakāroktasyārthajātasya bhāṣyakāraireva suvyaktaṃ vivṛtatvāt pūrvapakṣatsiddhāntasvarūpopapādanamātreṇa svayamapi kiñcidāṣṭe| tena bhāṣya evāntevāsibhirāpādacūḍamatyantādareṇādhikaraṇārthaścintanīyaḥ| atra hi manaścitādyagnayaḥ
