pūrvamiṣṭakacitāgnyanvayena pūrvaprasaktakriyāmayakratvanupraveśena kriyārūpāḥ, kiṃ vā parikalpitavidyāmayakratvanupraveśena vidyārūpā iti cintā| atra pūrvapakṣābhiprāyamanuvadati aṅgamiti| pūrvaprasakteṣṭakacitasamupasthapitasya kratoreva manaścitādirapyaṅgaṃ syāt| ayamarthaḥ pūrvamapi kriyāmayakraturnaśrutaḥ athāpyavyabhicaritakratusambandhīṣṭakacitāgniśravaṇābalāt parikalpyata eva| tasyaivātra prakaraṇāt sannihitasyaiva kratormanaścitādirapi vikalpādaṅgamastu| tadidamāha budvīti| manaścitprabhṛtiḥ svayaṃ buddhayātmāpi aṅgisākāṅkṣatvāt pūrvaprasaktasya prakaraṇopasthāpitasya kriyāmayakratorevāṅgaṃ syādityarthaḥ| nanu svayaṃ jñānātmakaṃ kriyāmayakratoḥ kathamaṅgamaṃ syādityāśaṅkya tatra dṛṣṭāntamāha yatheti yathā dvādaśāhe mānasagrahasya kriyāmayakratvaṅgatvaṃ tathātrāpi svarūpato vidyārūpāṇāmapi manaścitādīnāṃ kriyāmayakratvaṅgatvaṃ syādityarthaḥ| tatra hetvantaramapyastītyāha tadvīryasyeti| iṣṭakacitādīnāṃ vīryaṃ manaścitādiṣvatiśyate| teneṣṭakacitādīnāṃ yathā kriyāmayakratūpakārasāmarthyam, evaṃ manaścitādīnāmapi tatsāmārthyānvayasya vidyāmānatvāt kriyāmayakratvanupraveśena ityarthaḥ| tadidaṃ nirākaroti na saditi| tadetadupapādayati udita iti| ayamarthaḥ svavākye vidyāmayakratvabhāve hi pūrvavākyaparikalpitakriyāmayakratvanupraveśe manaścitādīnāṃ sāpekṣatvaṃ
syāt| svavākya eva śrūyamāṇānubandhādiparikalpito vidyāmayakraturasti| tena svavākyasthaṃ vidyāmayakratu hitvā pūrvavākyaparikalpitena kriyāmayakratunā manaścitādayassambadhyanta iti na kalpanīyamiti| śrutyādyairiti svavākye vidyāmayakraturastīti śrutirovopapādayatītyarthaḥ| tarhi kriyāmayakratvanupraviṣṭānāmiṣṭakacitānāṃ sāmarthyātideśādatrāpi manaścitādīnāṃ kriyāmayakratvanupraveśo hyavaśyamaṅgīkartavya iti mayaivoktaṃ tatra kumuttaraṃ dattamityāśahkyāha upakṛtīti| ayamarthaḥ atideśo hi sāmyādbhavati, teneṣṭakacitādīnāṃ svāṅgibhūtakriyāmayakratvanupraveśena yatsāmarthyamasti, tatsāmarthyaṃ manaścitādīnāṃ svāṅgibhūtavidyāmayakratvanupraveśenaivāstīti nātideśavirodhaḥ||
nanvatra bhavatā kalpyavidyāmayakratvanupraveśo manaścitādīnāmucyate tato varaṃ pūrvasiddhakriyāmayakratvanupraveśa iti codakasya kasyacinmandasyottaramāha kalpya iti| atra vidyāmayakratureva na kalpyate pūrvaṃ kriyāmayakraturapi kalpya eva tena pūrvakalpitakriyāmayakratumākṛṣya tena manaścitādīnāmanavayādvāramatraiva parikalpitavidyāmayakratvanvaya ityarthaḥ| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ kriyātmā kraturapi kalpya eva tacca kalpanaṃ prāgupāttatadaṅgaśaktyaiva kriyate| atra kalpyasya vidyāmayakratorvaiṣamyamāhavākyasthairiti| vākyasthairevānubandhairiha samapanato vidyāmayakraturbhāti prakāśate| tena paravākyasthānubandhaparikalpitakriyāmayakratośśreyānevāsau svavākyasthānubandhaparikalpito vidyāmayakraturiti tadanvaya eva manaścitādīnāmityarthaḥ| asminnarthe nyāyanugrahaṃ viśadaṃ darśayati dūrastheti| dūrasthairākṛṣṭasya ca yogāt svavacanapaṭhitairākṛṣṭasya ca yogo saghīyāneva| laghupakṣāśrayaṇaṃ hi nyāyaprāptam| tarhi vidyāmayakratoratra vidhipratyayo nāsti sākṣādvedanaśabdaśca nāstītyāśaṅkya vidhiśravaṇābhāve'pi vidhikalpanaṃ karmakāṇḍa eva sammatamityāha aprāpte'rtha iti| vidyārūpakratvanupraveśe pramāṇataḥpratipanne vedanaśabdābhāvo'pi na doṣāyetiśeṣaḥ| śeṣamaśeṣamapi bhāṣya eva viśadaṃ draṣṭavyam||
atra pūrvādhikaraṇaṃ prasaṅgādāyātam, tatpūrvādhikaraṇena saṅgatirbhāṣyakārairovāktā "" sarvāsu paravidyāsūpāsyopāsanasvarūpavadupacāsakasvarūpasyāpi jñātavyatvamuktam, " trayāṇāmeva caivamupanyāsaḥ praśnaśca " iti| vakṣyati cāsya pratyagātmanaḥ paramātmātmakatvenānusandhānaṃ " ātmeti tūpagacchanti grāhayanti ca " iti| kimayaṃ pratyāgātmā jñātā kartā bhoktehāmutra sañcāra7mo'nusandheyaḥ, uta prajāpativākyoditāpabatapāpmatvādisvarūpaḥ "" iti | ayamatra bhāvaḥ liṅgabhūyastvādhikaraṇe sarvavidyopāsyasya nārāyaṇasyanirūpaṇaṃ kṛtam, adhunā sarvāsvapi vidyāsūpāsakasyaca upāsyaviśeṣaṇabhūtatayā svayamapyanusandheyasya jīvasya svarūpaṃ nirūpyata iti| tadarthavicārastu " ahaṃ brahmāsmi " iti paramātmaśarīratayā pratyagātmānusandheyaḥ, sa kiṃ jñātṛtvakartṛtvabhoktṛtvādyākāro'nusandheyaḥ, uta prajāpativākyoktāpahatapāptatvādyākāreṇānusandheya iti | tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ " yathākraturasmiṃlloke " iti yathopāsanaṃ prāptiritivacanaṃ paramātmamātraviṣayam, uta pratyagātmaviṣayamapīti| kiṃ " taṃ yathāyathopāsate tathaiva bhavati " iti tacchabdanirdeśo yathopāsanaṃ prāptiritivacanasya paramātmaparatāmavagamayati neti| kimatra tacchabdo
jīvaśarīraparamātmaparaḥ, uta paramātmamātrapara iti| atra pūrvapakṣamāracayati tatkālākāriṇa iti| " tvaṃ vā ahamasmi bhagavo devate " ityādibhirahaṃgraheṇa bhagavadupāsanamuktam, ahamiti buddhistu tatkālākārayukta evātmani vartate| tenāhamiti paramātmabhajane kañcukabhūtasya jīvasya dhīstatkālākāreṇa yuktasya jīvasya syāt| tena kartṛtvabhoktṛtvādiyuktayuktajīvātmasvarūpamevopāsanadaśāyāmanisandheyamiti| tadidamāha āsatteriti| sannihitatvādupāsanadaśāyāmityarthaḥ| tatra dṛṣṭāntamāha māmupāssvetyuditavaditi| yathā pratardanavidyāyāmindreṇa māmupāsvetyukte tādātvikasahasrākṣatvādiyukta evopāsyaḥ, na punarāgāmimuktākārayuktaḥ, tadvadatrāpīti| tadidaṃ nirākaroti neti| tatra hetumāha anyatheti| prakārāntareṇa sannikarṣasya vidyamāntavādityarthaḥ| tadeva prakārāntaramupapādayati śuddha iti| dve hi rūpe jīvasya śuddhamaśuddhañca| yat śuddhaṃ tadevopādeyam| yadevopādeyaṃ tadevopāsanadaśāyāmanisandheyam; yathopāsanaṃ phalasyaiva śrutibhirāmānātatvāt| tena śuddhameva rūpaṃ buddhisannihitamityupapādayituṃ śuddhasyaiva rūpasya phalatvaṃ tāvadāha śuddhohyātmātraca sādhya iti| astu śuddhasya phalatvam, athāpi kathaṃ tasya buddhisannihitatvamityatrāba phalamitiriti| " jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta " ityādau svargaphalānusandhānena hi svargārthapravṛttiḥ evamatrāpi phalabhūtaśuddhasvarūpānisandhānasāhityenaivopāsanapravṛttiriti buddhisannihitatvasiddhiśśuddhasyaiva rūpasya| atra tatkratunyāyo'pyamumevārthaṃ viśadamupapādayatītyāha buddhayāsanna iti| buddhayāsanne'ntaraṅge sati śuddhasvarūpe
tatkratunyāyasiddhiḥ pramāṇena niyamitā bhavati| ataśśuddhameva svarūpamanisandheyamityarthaḥ||
nanu karturyathāvasthitātmasvarūpamanusandhyamityukte karmakāṇḍe karmakarturapi tādṛśameva rūpamanisandheyaṃ syāt, evañca tatraiva jīvasvarūpayātātmye nirūpite nirarthaka eva vedāntaśāstre jīvasvarūpanirūpaṇavistarassyādityāśaṅkāparihārārthaṃ laukikavaidikādyanuṣṭhānakartṛbhūtajīvasvarūpānusandhānavibhāgaṃ viśadameva darśayati karturiti| trividho hi kartā, laukikaṃ śayanāsanabhojanakṛṣyādikaṃ karma kaścit karoti, parastu yāgadānahomādikaṃ vaidikaṃ karma| tṛtīyaḥ punaḥ parabrahmopāsane paramapuruṣārthaprāptihetubhūtam| triṣvapyadhikāriṣu kartṛtvānusandhānamastyeva| tatra prathamamāha dṛṣṭeti| dṛṣṭabhogārthayatne bhoktā kaścidastītyetāvanmātrameva gaṇayitumucitam| sa punardeho vā dehātirikto veti viśeṣaniścayo nāstu anupayogāt| dṛśyante hi cadehātiriktātmasthāryaparijñānavidhurāṇāmapi pāmarāṇāṃ svābhimataprāptihetavaḥ pravṛttayaśśataśassahasraśo'pi| atha dvitīyaṃ prakaṭayati svargādīti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥsvargādyarthe karmaṇi svādhikarānuviddhā brāhmaṇatvādisvādhikārānuviddhā kālāntarasambandhiphalasambandhānuvi dehāntarānugatirātmano gaṇayitumucitā| naitāvatā vedāntavaidyārthasiddhiḥ| tṛtīyamapi pakṣamāha muktyatha iti| muktyarthe punarupāsane prāptyavasthā praṇidhikathanataḥ upāsanadaśāyāṃ cintanīyatvakathaneva tatkratunyāyavācā yat cintyaṃ tadeva prāpyamityartho gamita iti jñāpita iti atiprasaṅgādiśaṅkā nāstyeva| ayamatra bhāvaḥ vedānta eva hi tatkratunyāyo viśeṣataḥ khyāpitaḥ, na punaḥ karmakāṇḍe, tenopāsanadaśāyāṃ prāptyavasthānusandhānaṃ niyamena kartavyam| karmakāṇḍe tu kālāntarabāvisvargādiphalabhoktṛtvānurūpasthairyānusandhānamātraṃ karmārambhe kartavyamiti||
atra kaściccodayati vidyābhedeṣu vedyākārāṇāṃ viṣamatvāt yāvaduktameva cintyam, anyathā parasparasaṅkaraprasaṅgāt| prāpacyaṃ punarubhayavibhūtiviśiṣṭam, tena baddharūpasyāpi sarvāntargatatatvena brahmaviśeṣatvāt prāpyatvamastyeva| tat kathaṃ tasya rūpasyāprāpyatvāt cintanīyatvaṃ nāstīti niṣedhaḥ kriyate| tasmāt sannihitasya baddharūpasya cintāstviti| tadidamāha vidyeti| śabdārthastu sadvidyādaharavidyādividyāviśeṣu vedyākārāṇāṃ bhinnatvāt yāvaduktameva cintyam| tatra brahmaviśeṣaṇatayā "ahaṃ manurabhavaṃ sūryaśca " ityahaṅgrahopāsanāt jīvasyāpi cintanīyatvamasti, prāpyaṃ tu brahma sarvaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭam, sarvaśabdārthe baddhasyāpi jīvasyāntargatatvāt baddharūpamapi brahmaviśeṣaṇatvādanusandheyamastu sannihitaparityāgāyogāt iti| tadetaddūṣayati neti| pratikṣepameva vivṛṇotikaluṣita iti| ayamarthaḥ ahaṃśabdārtho hi mukhya evāhaṅgrahopāsane brahmaviśeṣaṇatayānusandheyaḥ| tattu viśuddhameva rūpam| tenāhaṃśabdaśrutivirodhāt kaluṣitaṃ rūpaṃ nānusandheyamamukhyatvāt| kiñca
prajāpativākye hi brahmavidyāśeṣatayānusandheyaṃ jīvātmasvarūpamabhidhīyate| tattu viśuddhameva guṇāṣṭakaviśiṣṭamabhihitam| tasmāt viśauddhānusandhānameva jīvasyācapi vedānte ṣūpāsanadaśāyāṃ vihitamiti nāśuddharūpacintanaprasaṅgaḥ| ata eva bhagavatā parāśareṇa yogidhyeyārthanirṇaye " hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān " ityupakramya " aśuddhachāste samastāstu devādyāḥ karmayonayaḥ " ityaśuddhānāmacintanīyatvamuktamiti| tadidamāha prājāpatyāditi||
pūrvasminnadhikaraṇe yatra yatra brahmaṇa upāsyatvaṃ tatratatra sarvatrāpi śuddhasya jīvasyopātyatvamuktam, adhunā punaryatrayatra śākhāsūdgīthānupraveśaltatratatra sarvatrāpyudgīthādyupāsanānupraveśo'sti neti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu " omityetadakṣaramudgīthamupāsīta " iti kratvaṅgāśrayodgītādyupāsanāni pratiśākaṃ vyavatiṣṭeranniti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ " udgīthamupāsīta " ityudgītaśabda udgīthamātre vartate, utasvarabhedabhinnodgīthe iti| kiṃ śākhāviśeṣasya svapabhedayogāt svarabhedabhinnodgīthavyaktereva sannidhiḥ, uta śeṣibhūtakratossarvaśākhāsvekatvamukhena sarvodgīthavyaktīnāṃ sannidhiriti| pūrvamudgīthopāsanayorbhedacintā kṛtā, samanantaraṃ tasyaivodgīthopāsanasyāśrayikarmatvena karmaphalāt pṛthakphalatvena pūruśārthatvaṃ prasaṅgāccintitam, adhunā punarekatrāmnātasyodgīthopāsanasya sarvatrāmnātodgīthamātraśeṣatvaṃ pratipādyata ityarthavibhāgāt na paunaruktyam| atra pūrvapakṣamāha udgīthāderiti| asau bhajanavidhissvasānnidhyagīte udgīthaviśeṣa eva syāditi| tamimaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ pratikṣipati maivamiti| pratikṣepa prakāraṃ darśayati sarvāṅgīti| sannidhivaśādeva hi tatraivopāsanasyānvaya iti bhavatocyate sannidhissarveṣāmapyudgīthānāṃ samāna eva sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyena sarvāṅgibhūtakratossannidhāne siddhe sarveṣāmapyudgīthānāmatraiva sānnidhyasiddheriti| nanu sāmānyaṃ vyaktiviśeṣamantareṇānuṣṭhānayogyaṃ na bhavati| tenodgīthamiti sāmānyenoktaṃ tatratyodgīthaviśeṣarūpavyaktimapekṣate, tataśca tasminnevodgīthaviśeṣe upāsanānvaya) syāt; na syāt, yathā "vrīhīrbhiyajeta " ityukte vrīhimātreṇa yāgo'nuṣṭhīyate, evamatrāpyudgīthamātrānvayenopāsanamanuṣṭhīyatāṃ nāma| śabdārthastu
sāmānyaṃ vyaktyapekṣānuṣṭhānamapi niyāmakapramāṇābhāve "vrīhīrbhiyajeta " ityatra vrīhitāvat yaṃ kañcana vyaktiviśeṣamupādāyāvatiṣṭhate| tarhi " paśunā yajeta " ityatracchāga eva paryavasānaṃ kathaṃ syāt? itthaṃ syāt| tatra hi viśeṣaparyavasānasākāṅkṣatya paśuśabdasya viśeṣopasthāpacchāga śabdo mantravarṇe śrūyate| iha tu tādṛśaśabdaviśeṣo nāsti| tasmādudgīthamātraviṣayamupāsanaṃ na punassannihitodgīthaviṣayamiti siddhamityāha śabdaśceti| udgīthasāmānyaṃ vadati natu bhidāṃ napunarūdgīthaviśeṣamiti||
pūrvādhikaraṇe udgīthādikaṃ prastutam,tatra sāmāvayavodgīthādessamastasya vyastasya copāsanaṃ śrutisiddhamiti pūrvamevoktam, evaṃ vaiśvānaravidyāyāṃ kiṃ samastasyopāsanaṃ kāryaṃm uta vyastasya utobhayasyeti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ vaiśvānaravidyāyāṃ pṛthivyādyavayavasya vaiśvānarasya vyastasyaivopāsyatv, uta vyastasya samastasya ca, athavā samastasyaiveti| kiṃ " uddālako havai bhagavantaḥ " ityādivākye upāsanavidhirvyastasyaiva uta vyastasya samastasya ca, athavā samastasyaiveti| kiṃ pratyavayavaṃ vaiśvānaravyapadeśāt phalasambandhaśravaṇāccavayaveṣūpāsanavidhinānātve " yastvetamevaṃ prādeśamātramabhivimānam " iti samudāyānuvādāḥ, uta "attyannaṃ paśyati priyaṃ bhavati" iti vyastopāsane phalaśravaṇāt " yastvetamevaṃ prādeśamātramabhivimānamātmānaṃ vaiśvānaramuste sarveṣu lokeṣu sarveṣu bhūteṣu sarveśvātmastvannamatti " iti samaste phalaśravaṇācca ubhayatra vidhirnyāyyaḥ, uta ekavākyatānurodhena "yastvetam " ityatra samastasyaivopāsanavidhiḥ, avayavopāsanaṃ tu avayutyānuvāda iti| atra kaścidāha vaiśvānaravidyāyāṃ vyastopāsane phalanirdeśāt vyasta eva cintanīyaḥ| samastopāsane phalanirdeśastu arthavāda eva| athavā vyastopāsanavat samastopāsane'pi phalanirdeśāt vyastaścintanīyaḥ,samastaścāpi tathā cintanīya evet|tamimaṃ pakṣamanuvadativyasta iti|tadetat pratikṣipatimaivamiti|tatropapattimāhavyasteṣviti| atra hi vyastopāsaneṣu doṣo'bhidhīyate, tena vyastopāsaneṣu phalavacanamarthavādamātramiti kalpanīyam| uktamevārthaṃ
vaiśvānareṣṭivākya dṛṣṭāntena draḍhayati dṛṣṭamiti| yathā " vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvāpet " ityasmin vākye dvādaśakapāla nirvāpasyaiva vidheyatvam," pūta eva " ityādinā tasyaiva phalanirdeṣa ucyate| aṣṭākapālādīnāṃ na vidhiḥ tatra phalanirdeśaścāvayutyānuvādamātramiti tāntrikagoṣṭhānāṃ nirṇayaḥ| tadvadatrāpi samastasyaivopāsanaṃ vidhīyate na punarvyastasya| tatra phalanirdeśe'pyavayutyānuvādena stutimātrameveti||
atra samastopasanamiva vyastopāsanamapi vihitameva pratīyate phalanirdeśaścobhayatrāsti, itthaṃ bhūmavidyāyāmapi pūrvamalpopāsanamuktvā paścāduttarottaramadhikopāsanamucyate tatra pūrveṣāmupāsanānāmalpālpaphalamaṅgīkṛtam, avayutyānuvādatvamapi na kalpitam, kathamidaṃ vaiṣamyamucyata iti kenāpyanuyukte vaiṣamyadvayaṃ darśayan samādhātumupakramate sāmastyasyeti| itthamatra śabdānvayaḥ mahāvākyatātparyavṛttayā samastānusandhānasyāsmin vākye yoge samanvaye draḍhimavati sati vyasteṣūpāsaneṣu vaiśvānaroṣṭyādivat aṃśānuvādena stutiniyatanyāyāt phalanirdeśāsyānyaparyaṃ stutiparatvameva bhavati| bhūmavidyāyāṃ tu pūrvasmāduttarasyādhikaphalasādhanatvena vaktuṃ yujyate ananvitatvāt| api tu alpaphalādadhikaphalyādhikyena bhūmatvaṃ vācyam| tenāvidhitvena pūrveṣāmapi phalasambandho vācya iti vaiṣamyasiddhiḥ| atra hetvantaramapyāha nāpyevamiti| vaiśvānaravidyāyāṃ vyastopāsane pratyavāyaśśrutaḥ| bhūmavidyāyāṃ tu pūrvapūrvopāsane pratyavāyo na śrutaḥ| tenedamapi kiñcidvaiṣamyam| tasmāt viṣamasya dṛṣṭāntasyodāharaṇaṃ nārthasiddhayai ubhayatraikarūpatva rūpārthasiddhayai na bhavatyeva||
pūrvasminnadhikaraṇe vidyāviseṣaviṣayacintā kṛtā, idānīṃ sarvavidyāviṣayacintā kriyata iti saṅgatiḥ| athavā vaiśvānaravidyāyāṃ samastopāsanasyaivopapannatvena vyastopāsanānāmabhāvāt vidyānānātvaṃ nirākṛtam, adhunā sadvidyādaharavidyopakosalanidyādiṣu nānātvaṃ bhedakapramāṇānurodhādupapādyata iti saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu vedāntavidheyānāṃ sarvāsāṃ vidyānāṃ kimaikyameva uta bheda iti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ pratyāyāvṛttirūpavididhātvarthopāsanasya sarvatra brahmakarmatayā rūpābhedāt apunarāvṛttirūpaphalābhedāccaikyasāmāśrayaṇaṃ nyāyyam, utopāsayabrahmaṇa ekatve'pi apahatapāpmatvādiguṇāviśiṣṭasyopāsyatayopāsanasyāpi bhedasambhavāt tādṛśopāsanapratipādane nirapekṣatvāt vākyānāṃ bhedasamāśrayaṇaṃ nyāyyamiti| atra pūrvapakṣī vidyaikyaṃ sayuktikamupapādayati sarvāsviti| atra prathamādhikaraṇe saṃyogarūpacodanākhyaviśeṣāt vidyaikyamuktam, tadatrāpi samānam| sarvāsvapi vidyāsu brahmaiva vedyamiti rūpamaviśiṣṭam|
saṃyogo'pyaviśiṣṭa ityāha phalamapīti| tathā ākhyāpyaviśiṣṭā brahmavidyeti| astu tritayamidamaviśiṣṭam tathāpi codanā bhidyate kvacit " vidyāt " iti, kvacicca "upāsīta "iti, kvacicca " nididhyāsitavyaḥ " iti, kvacicca " nicāyya taṃ mṛtyumukhātpramucyate " iti darśanaparyāyeṇa dhātunā mṛtyutaraṇopāya ucyate| bhagavadgītādiṣu bhaktiśabdenaiva kriyāsamabhihāreṇāpavargasādhanaṃ vidhīyate| ataḥ kathaṃ codanābeda sati vidyaikyaśaṅkā? maivam| bhāṣya eva bhagavatā bhāṣyakāreṇaiva sarveṣāmevaiṣāṃ vidhīnāṃ chāgapaśunyāyenaikārthyamupapāditam| tenaikārthyaṃ siddham| aparyāyaprāyāṇāmeva hi śabdānāṃ prayoge codanābhedamāhustāntrikāḥ| yathā yajati dadāti juhotīti| atra punarekatraiva viśrānterna codanābhedaḥ| tadidaṃ darśayati dhyānādīti| vidhirapyaviśiṣṭa evetyarthaḥ| tasmāt vidyaikyameveti| tadetannirākaroti tanneti| atrākhyādibhedarūpaṃ hetucatuṣṭayāmāhaākhyetyādinā| ākhyābhedastāvat sadvidyādaharavidyābhūmavidyetyādiḥ| naca sāmānyanāmamātraikyaṃ viśeṣanāmaprayuktaṃ vidyābhedaṃ nivārayati yathā " athaiṣa jyotirathaiṣa viśvajyotirathaiṣa savrjyotiḥ " iti viśeṣanāmaprayuktaṃ bhedaṃ sarvasādāraṇayāgādiśabdamātraṃ na nivārayati| tadvadatrāpi brahmavidyeti samānyanāmamātraṃ vidyābhedaṃ na nivārayituṃ śaknoti| rūpabhedaśca sarvāsvapi vidyāsu sphuṭamovopalabhyate| brahmeti rūpasāmānyaṃ tu tattadvidyāsu pratiniyataguṇaviśeṣaprayuktarūpabhedasya na paripanthitāmaśnute viśeṣaṇabhedādviśiṣṭabhedasyāparihāryatvāt| itthaṃ hi karmakāṇḍe'pyanuṣṭhānaniyamaḥ| itthaṃ rūpabhedamākhyābhedañcopapādya codanābhedamapyupapādayati tadupahiteti| tattadvidyāsādhāraṇaguṇaviśeṣitavedanavidyau " arthenaiva viśeṣo hi nirākāratayā dhiyām " iti nyāyena tenatenārthenaiva tattadvidyābhedasiddhescodanānāmaparyāyatvameveti bhāṣyakāraireva suvyaktamupapāditam| atra saṃyogabhedo'pyastītyāha miśramiti| madhunidyāyāṃ vasupadaprāptiporvakaparamātmaprāpteḥ phalatvāt kvacit miśraṃ phalam, vidyāntareṣu
kevalaparamātmaprāpteḥ phalatvādamiśramevaphalamiti saṃyogabhedo'pyasti| itthaṃ brahmavidyāsūktanyāyena vedāntabhāgoktāsu kāmyavidyāsvapi bhedo nirūpya ityāha kāmyeti||
atra khalu " nānā śabdādibhedāt " iti vidyābhedaṃ vadan sūtrakāraśśabdabhedameva puraskaroti, śabdabhedo nāma codanābhedaḥ, codanābhedo'pi yajatidadātijuhotītyaparyāyeṇa śabdena bhāvārthavidhiḥ| atra punarbhāṣyakāraireva vedanopāsanādiśabdānāṃ paryāyatvamupapāditam| tena śabdasāmye sati kathaṃ " nānā śabdādibhedāt " iti sūtrakāroṇocyata iti kaścidākṣipati nānāśabdeti| vidyāt, upāsīta, dhyāyīta, iti dhātubhachedāditi parābhiprāyamāśaṅkayottaramāha nahīti| dhātevo hi svarūpabhedamātreṇa śabdabhedatvamaśnuvate, astividyatebhavatītyādīnāmapi śabdabhedatvaprasaṅgāt| tenāparyāyaśabdaprayoga eva śabdabhedo vācyaḥ| vidyādityādīnāṃ paryāyatvaṃ prāgeva samarthitamiti| satyamityardhāṅgīkāreṇa pariharati| yadyapi śabdāntarādhikaraṇoktamukhyaśabdabhedo nāsti, athāpi rūpabhedaprayuktaśśabdabhedaupacaryate| tat kimarthamityatrāha rūpabhedadraḍhimna iti| ayamarthaḥ rūpabheda evātra sākṣādbhedakaḥ| sa tu rūpabhedo dhātvarthaviśeṣakatvena dhātvarthamapi bhanattīti bhinnārthavācakatvena śabdabhedo'pi sidhyatītyaupacīrikī śabdabhedoktiḥ| atropacāroktau prayojanamāhajñānamiti| mṛṣāvādinaḥ khalvavidheyameva jñānaṃ mokṣasādhanamityāhuḥ tannirāsena jñānasya vidheyatvasiddhyarthaṃ vidyāviṣayacodanābhedo'stītyucyate| ayamabhisandhiḥ yadi vedanadhyānopāsanādiśabdānāṃ tattatprakaraṇasthānāṃ paryāyatvam, yadi vā chāgapaśunyāyena viśeṣaparyavasānam, yadi vā bhāṣyakāroktakrameṇa bhinneṣu prakaraṇeṣu vedyabhedanibandhanavedanabhedapratipādakatvenāparyāyatvam, sarvathāpi vidheyameva jñānam| vidheyādeva jñānādapavargasiddhiritīmamarthaṃ pratipādayituṃ codanābhedakathanamiti||
evaṃ bhāṣyakāroktaprakāreṇa śabdabhedamuktvā bhāṣkārābhiprāyastaṃ mukhyameva śabdabhedaṃ upapādayati yadveti| ayamarthaḥ nānāśabdādibhedāditi sūtrakāraśśabdabhedameva tāvat prāha| sa ca śabdabhedo'paryāyaśabdakathanam| tacca brahmavidyāyāssākṣādevāsti| bhaktiprapattyormokṣopāyatayā vihitayorvidhibhedadarśanāt| " anityamasukaṃ lokamimaṃ prāpya bhajasva mām " iti bhaktividhirdṛśyate " māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja " iti prapattividhiḥ| prapattireva hi śaraṇāgatiḥ|
" ananyasādhye " ityasmin prapattilakṣaṇavākye " prapattiśśaraṇāgatiḥ " iti paryāyatvenopadeśāt| tena sākṣādeva bhaktiprapattyorvidhibheda upalabhyata iti mukhyaevāyaṃ śabdabhedo bhāṣyakārabhāvasthaḥ| yajatidadātijuhotītyādiśabdabhedavadasyāpi śabdabhedasya sākṣādeva śabdabhedalakṣaṇopetatvāt| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ yadveti pakṣāntaropanyāsamāha| śabdādibhedāditi vadatā sūtrakāreṇa samyageva nyāsopāse vibhakte| tatra dṛṣṭāntamāha yajanahavanavaditi| tatra vibhāgahetuṃ darśayati śabdabhedāditi| abhāktāditi mukyatvāha| tena pūrvoktaprakārāt prakārāntarasiddhiḥ| evaṃ codanābhedamuktvā tadvedavākhyābedo
rūpabhedassaṃyogabedo'pyastītyāha ākhyeti| bhaktau hi casadvidyādaharavidyetyādirākhyā, prapattau punarnikṣeponyāsaśśaraṇāgatirityādiḥ| bhaktirope cacacacadahacaravidyāde apahatapāpmatvādikaṃ rūpam| iha punarūpāyāntarasthānāpattirbhagavato rūpam, tadeva nirapekṣopāyatvamityadhyātmavidbhirabhidhīyate| bhaktiyoganiṣṭhānāṃ hi sadvidyādaharavidyādisāpekṣaḥ paramapuruṣaḥ phalaṃ dadāti| iha punarupāyāntarasthāne svayamevāvasthitastadeva muktirūpaṃ phalaṃ dadāti| itamevocyate " sarvadharmān parityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja " iti| asyārthasya vistaro nyāsaviṃśatyādiṣvācāryaprabandheṣvanusandheyaḥ| itarasama iti yathā sadvidyādīnāmākhyābhedādrūpabhedāt saṃyogabhedādbheda upapadyate tathaiva prapatterapi bheda ityarthaḥ| yadyapi sarvāsāṃ brahmavidyānāṃ pradhānaphalaṃ mokṣaḥ tathāpyanusandhānavelāyāṃ tattadrūpaviśiṣṭabhagavadanubhavarūpaphalavaiṣamyamastīti bhāvaḥ| adhikārabhedādapi rūpabhedamāha kiñca bhinno'dhikāraśśīghraprāptyādibhiriti| bhaktiyoganiṣṭhasya prāpabdhakarmāvasāne hi mokṣaḥ| prapattiniṣṭhasya tu prārabdhamapi karma prapattireva kṣapayituṃ śaknoti " upāyabhaktiḥ prārabdhanyatiriktādhanāśinī| sādhyabhaktistu sā hantrī prārabdhasyāpi bhūyasī|| " iti vacanādeva prapatteśśīghraphalapradatvaśravaṇāt| śabdārthastu  upāyarūpā bhaktiḥ prārabdhaṃ cana hanyāt api tu tadvyatiriktameva hanyāt | sādhyabhaktiḥ prapatti) prārabdhamapi hanyāt| ata eva bhakteḥ prapattirbhūyasī phalādhikyāt| atra ādiśabdena "bhaktyādau śaktyabhāvaḥ " ityācāryagranthoktāḥ pañcadaśāpyadhikāraviśeṣā ucyante| śaktirjñānaṃ janma vilambakṣamatvamityetāni samastāni bhaktyadhikāraḥ| tatraikaikavarahe dvikadvikavirahe trikatrikavirahe sarvavirahe ca
sampadyante prapadanādhikārā iti pañcadaśatvasiddhiḥ| nanu brahmavidyānāṃ brahmaprāptireva phalam, taccaikamevetyāśaṅkamānasya bālabuddheranyatra phalabhedaṃ dṛṣṭāntatayā darśayati jaguriti| madhuvidyāyāṃ hi vasupadaprāptirūpvaparamātmaprāptiḥ phalam| daharavidyādau tu paramātmaprāptimeva phalatayā nirdiśati| atassaṃyogabhedādapi nyasopāsanayossiddhaeva bhedaḥ||
atra bhāṣya eva saṅgatirvyaktamucyate " brahmaprāptiphalanāṃ sadvidyādaharavidyādīnāṃ nānātvamuktam| idānīmāsāṃ vidyānāmekasmin puruṣe prayojanavattvena samuccayo'pi sambhavati uta prayojanābhāvāt vikalpa eveti viśaye " iti| tadarthavicārastu kimekasman puruṣe prayojanasamabhavāt sarvāsāṃ samuccayaḥ uka vikalpaḥ| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ sarvāsu vidyāsu phalarūpā brahmaprāptirekarūpā uta svargādiprāptivat vilakṣaṇeti| atra pūrvapakṣī manyate loke hi jyotiṣṭomāgnihotraprabhṛtayassvargādyarthaṃ vihitā ekenaivādhikāriṇā phalādhikyārthaṃ samuccayenaivānuṣṭhīyante, tattadanuṣṭhānādhikyena phalañcādhikamupalabhyate, evamatrāpi brahmavidyāḥ parabrahmaprāpratyarthaṃ samuccayenānuṣṭhīyantām, phalamapi deśakālādhikyena tāratamyena labhyatāmiti| tadidamāha jyotiṣṭometi| nacaikasyaivādhikāriṇa ekamupāsanamiti niyamo'stītyāha na ceti| " na caikaṃ prati śiṣyate " iti nyāyena sarvo'pi bhajanavidhissarvānpratyeva vidhīyate| tena samuccayassambhavatyeveti| nanvekasyopāsanasya cirakālānuṣṭheyatvāt upāsanāntarasya kālo nāstītyāśaṅkya pariharatikartumiti| jyotiṣṭomāgnihotrādivat atrāpyanukrameṇānuṣṭhātuṃ śakyata ityanuṣṭhānakālābhāvāt na samuccaya iti na bhramitavyamityarthaḥ| tamimaṃ pakṣaṃ pratikṣipati neti| tatra hetumāhamitha iti| ayamarthaḥ " sa khalvevaṃ vartayan yāvadāyuṣam " iti brahmavidyāyā āśarīrapātamanuṣṭheyatvaṃ śrūyate| tacca sarvāsāmapi brahmavidyānāṃ samānameva| tenaikayaiva brahmavidyayā kṛtsnasyāpi kālasyāvarūddhatvāt brahmavidyāntarānuṣṭhānakālābhāvāt samuccayo na bhavatyeva| itthamupapāditamarthaṃ nigamayati sampūrṇeti| atraikameva phalaṃ dṛśyate yā sampūrṇabrahmalabdhiḥ, tatsiddhayai pṛthagevānuṣṭheyānyupāsanāni, tāni ca pṛthageva vidhīyante| tatra hetumāha prāyaṇānte samādhāviti| ayamarthaḥ ekaikassadvidyādaharavidyādissamādhiḥ prāyaṇānto vidhīyate| tena vidheyānāṃ sāmastyenānuṣṭhānavirodhāt pratyekānuṣṭhānalābhāya pṛthageva sādhanatvamiti vikalpa eva svīkāryaḥ||
nanu bhavatā brahmavidyānāṃ phalaikyāt vikalpa eveti pratijñānam, nahi pratijñāmātreṇārthasiddhiḥ, phalaikyameva hi nāṅgīkurmahe kāraṇabhede kāryabhedasyāvasyasambhavāt, kāraṇāni tu brahmopasanāni bhinnānyeva rūpādibhedāt, tena phalabhedo'pyavaśyāśrayaṇīyaḥ, tasmāt bhinnaphalatve kathaṃ vikalpa itīmaṃ pūrvapakṣamanuvadati rūpādīnāmiti| śabdānvayastu rūpādīnāṃ viśeṣaiḥ parabhajanaṃ naikarūpaṃ vibhaktam| naikarūpamiti naganaikādiśabdavannasamāsaḥ| kāraṇabhedamupapādya phalabhedamāpyāha sāmagrībhedata iti| sammataṃ nyāyata iti  kāraṇabhedātkāryabhedo lokasammata eveti| taditaṃ pratikṣipati na syāditi| tatra hetumāha sarvāsviti| " bhogamātrasāmyaliṅgācca " iti " nirañjanaḥ paramaṃ sāmyamupaiti " itiśrutipratipannaṃ bhogasāmyameva phalatoyacyate
tena phalaikyasiddhiḥ| nanu sālokyādīnāṃ caturṇāmapi phalatvenābhidhānāt kathaṃ phalaikyamityāśaṅkyāha prāpyaikyamiti| " sāyujyamanye sa tu mokṣa uktaḥ " ityanena brahmaṇassāyujyameva mokṣa iti nirṇītam| solokyādīni tu tadantargatatayā phalatvenānūdyanta iti bhāvaḥ| anena bhinnānāmupāyānāṃ bhinnameva phalamiti śaṅkāpi nirastā| lokato vedaścopāyabhede'pi phalaikyadarśanāt| loke hi bahubhirmārgairekameva grāmaṃ prāpnuvanti vede'pi yāgadānahomādibhirbahubhirapi karmabhistatra tatra vihitairekameva phalaṃ prāpnuvanti karmaṭhāḥ| tathā adhyātmavido'pi stutinamaskārakīrtanādibhiḥ paramapuruśaṣamārādhya svābhimataṃ phalaṃ prāpnuvantīti bhāratādiprasiddham| evaṃ nānāvidyāniṣṭhāḥ svādhikārānurūpatattadvidyānuṣṭhānena paramapuruṣaṃ prāpnuvantīti śrutusiddhatvāt susaṅgatametat||
pūrvādhikaraṇe tāsutāsu brahmavidyāsu phalatāratamyamāśaṅkya tannivārya phalaprasaṅgāt pūrvāktodgīthavidyāyāeva phalamatra bahubhirhetubhirākṣipya samādhīyata iti saṅgatiḥ| athavā bhāṣya eva " yathā kāmam " iti padena saṅgatiruktā| yathākāmaṃ vikalpasamuccayo veti hi pūrvatroktam| tathodgīthādividyāyathākāmamupādeyā naveti
śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kratvaṅgāśrayāṇyudgītādyupāsanāni kratuṣu niyamenopādeyāni uta godohanādivadaniyameneti| kiṃ kratvaṅgodgīthadimukhena parṇatādivat kratvarthāni uta godohanādivat kratvaṅgāśritatayā " yadeva vidyayā karoti " iti phalaśravaṇāt puruṣārthabhūtāni| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ godohanādīnāṃ puruśārthatvaṃ svavākye phalasambandhaśravaṇāt uta kratuphalāt pṛthakphalasaṃbandhaśravaṇāditi| atra saṅgatyabhidhānapūrvakaṃ pūrvapakṣamuktvā pūrvapakṣyabhiprāyasthān hetunukrameṇa samādhātumukramate tattaditi| pūrvādhikaraṇe tāsutāsu brahmavidyāsu phalatāratamyaṃ vārayitvā samānaphalasādhanatvamuktam| phalasādhalaprasaṅgādanenādhikaraṇena
" tannirdhāraṇāniyamaḥ " ityatra prāgevoktamudgīthavidyāphalaṃ bahubhirhetubhiḥ punarākṣipya tattaddhetunirāsena dṛḍhīkaroti| anenodgīthaviṣayayoranayoḥ paunaruktyaṃ parihṛtam; pūrpavoktakṣepasamādhānatayā etasyādhikaraṇasyodhikaprayojanalābhāditi| evaṃ kila pūrvapakṣī manyate pūrvaṃ hi godohananyāyenodgīthavidyāyāḥ puruṣārthatvamuktam, tannopapadyate godohanavākye svavākya eva phalanirdeṣo dṛśyate " godohanena paśukāmasya praṇayet " iti| udgīthavidyāvākye tu na phalanirdeśaḥ, kevalaṃ " udgīthamupāsīta " ityupāsanasyodgīthaviṣayatvameva pratīyate| " yadeva vidyayā karoti " iti vākyāntara eva phalanirdeśo dṛśyate| idaṃ tāvadekaṃ vaiṣamyam| vaiṣamyāntaramapi godohanavākya eva " paśu kāmasya praṇayet" iti vidhiśruturasti, " yadeva vidyayā karoti " iti vākye karotīti vartamānanirdeśa eva, natu vidhiśrutiḥ| tena " yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati na sa pāpaṃ ślokaṃ śrṛṇoti " iti vartamānanirdeśopetaparṇamayatvavākyavat na puruṣārthasādhakatvasiddhiḥ| vīryavattaratvarūpaphalanirdeśo'pyapāpaślokaśravaṇarūpaphalanirdeśavadarthavāda eva| tenāvyabhicaritakratusambandhijuhūmukhena parṇamayatvaṃ yathā kratvaṅgam, evamudgīthopāsanamapyavyabhicaritakratusambandhyudgīthamukhena kratvamaṅgamiti| idamapi vaiṣamyaṃ godohanavākyādasya vākyasya| tṛtīyamapi vaiṣamya sautrameva dṛśyate| "udgīthamupāsīta " iti dvitīyāśrutyā sākṣādevodgīthāṅgabhūtamupāsanaṃ vidhīyate| udgīthaśca karmāṅgam| tena taddvāreṇopāsanamapi karmāṅgam; "godohanasya paśukāmasya praṇayet " itivat vidhivākye'dhikārāntaraśravaṇāt udgūthāṅgabhāva eva hi vidheya iti gamyata iti| samāhārāditi hetavantaramapi dṛśyate " hotṛṣadanāddhaivāpi durudgīthamanusamāharati " ityupāsanasya niyameva samāhāro'bhidhīyate| tathā hi  vadanahīnamudgīthaṃ durudgītham| tasya hotṛṣadanādanusamāhābhidhāne sati udgīthoposanasya niyame kartavyatvamuktaṃ bhavati| avaśyakartavyasya hyapacāre samādhānaṃ vaktavyam| tenopāsanasyāvaśyakartavyatvāt karmāṅgatvameva| atra guṇasādhāraṇyaśrutirapi karmāṅgatvaṃ heturasti| tadapyuktaṃ bhāṣya eva "" upāsanaguṇasya upāsanāśrayasya praṇavasya sopāsansaya "teneyaṃ trayīvidyāvartate omityāśrāvayatyomiti śaṃsatyomityudgāyati " iti sādhāraṇyaśruteścopāsanasamāhāro gamyate " iti| evamākṣepahetūnanukramāt nirokaroti mā bhūditi| svavākye phalamuktaṃ mā bhūdeva| athāpiha parṇamayatvādinītirna syāt pūruṣārthatvapratipādakasya sphuṭatarasya hetoratra vidyamānatvāt| asti parṇamayīvākye vartamānanirdeśaḥ asti ca "yadeva vidyayā karoti " iti vākye vartamānanirdeśaḥ| tāvatā sāmyena udgīthopāsanasya na parṇatādivadapuruśārthatvasiddhiḥ| " yadeva vidyayā karoti, tadeva vīryavattaram " iti tṛtīyānirdeśena phalasādhanatvasya
sphuṭatarābhidhānāt udgīthopāsanasya puruṣārthatvameva| parṇatāyāstu phalasādhanatvapratipādakavibhaktiviśeṣābhāvāt kratvaṅgatvameveti vibhāgaḥ| tadidamāha spaṣṭeti| atra "yadeva vidyayā karoti " iti vākye vidyā phalakaraṇatayā spaṣṭaiva dṛśyate| ataḥ parṇamayīvākyādvaiṣamyamiti||
pūrvaṃ " udgīthamupāsīta " iti dvitīyāśrutyodgīthāṅgatvamupāsanasyetyuktam, tat pariharati tādarthyamiti| atra karmaśrutiḥ tādarthyamaṅgatvaṃ nāvagamayati| tatra hetumāha āśrayālambamātrāditi atra karmaśrutiḥ puruṣārthasyaivopāsanasyāśrayamevodgīthamavalambate na tato'ṅgatvaṃ vadatītyarthaḥ| vidyāhānau durudgīthatvāt pratividhānamuktamiti karmāṅgatve heturbhavatoktaḥ, so'pi heturanyathāsiddha ityāha vidyāhānāviti| vidyāhānau durudgīthatvamuktvā yat pratividhivacanaṃ tadapi tatphalārthiprasaṅge yuktameva| ayamarthaḥ yastvadhikāri karmāṅgabhūtodgīthe vīryavattartavādikaṃ vidyāphalaṃ kāmayitvā vidyāmārabhya vidyaṃ yathāvat na karoti tasyādhikāriṇa eva hotṛṣadanādanusamāharo'bhidhīyate, na punaḥ karmāṅgabhūtodgīthakartussarvasyāpyadhikāriṇaḥ, ato na
karmāṅgatvasiddhirudgīthopāsanasya| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ upāsanaphalabhūtavīryavattaratvādyarthiprasaṅge vidyāhānau hotṛṣadanāt samāhāravacanaṃ yuktameva| " teneyaṃ trayī vidyāvartata iti tacchabdenopāsanasahitaṃ praṇavaṃ nirdiśya trayyāmanugamanavacanādupāsanasya praṇavāṅgatvamiti yaduktaṃ tadapi nāstītyāha tāra iti| sopāsane tāre stavanamastu nāma anugamāt triṣvapi vedeṣvanuvṛttatvāt| tathāpyupāsanasya nāṅgatvam| upāsanasya vīryavattaratvādiphalasādhanatvena puruṣārthatve'pi tasya stotratvena yojayituṃ śakyatvādityarthaḥ| nanu pūrvamevodgīthavidyāprasaṅge sarvamidamadhunoktamarthajātaṃ vaktavyameva, kimarthamiha sthānaṃ hitvocyata ityāśaṅkyāha prāgvaktanyasyeti| ayamatra bhāvaḥ brahmavidyāṅgapratipādanamuttarapāde kariṣyate tatprasaṅgārthaṃ pādānte'ṅgāṅgitvacintanamadhunā kṛtamiti nāsthānapātitvadoṣaḥ||
uktānāmadhikaraṇānāṃ pradhānārthabhedān vibhajyodgṛṇāti vidyaikyeti| prathamādhikaraṇe vidyaikyam| ataḥ param udgīthavidyādvitayavibhajanam| itthamanukramāt prāṇavidyaikabhāvaḥ| sarvāsu vidyāsvānandatādessvarūpanirūpakadharmasya svarūpavadanugatatvam| prāṇavāsastatvadarśanam| śāṇḍilyavidyaikyam| ahaśśabdasya ahaṃśabdasya ca vibhajyāvasthānam| sambhṛtyādiguṇasya sthānaniyamaḥ| puruṣavidyābhedaḥ| " śannaḥ " ityādimantrāṇāmadhyayanaśeṣatvam||
hānopāyanayoraranyonyayogaḥ tayorhānopāyanayoḥ prāptakālaḥ, tathā arcirādessarvavidyāsādhāraṇatvam, sarvatra vidyāsu asthūlatādiguṇasaṃgatiḥ, anekaśiṣyaśrutānāmanyonyavyatiharaṇam| daharavidyānāmaikyam| udgīthamāśritya dṛṣṭau upāsane guṇaphalavidhiḥ| apahatapāpmatvādiguṇopāsaneṣu sarvatra guṇina āvṛttiḥ| sarvaparavidyāvedyo nārāyaṇa iti nirṇayaḥ||
manaścitprabhṛtayo vidyārūpā vidyāmayakratvanupraveśinaḥ| kṣetrī tu śuddha evānucintanīyaḥ| kriyāṅgabūtasarvodgīthādiṣu upāsanavidhiḥ| vaiśvānaravidyāyāṃ sāmastyenaiva bhajanam| atha vidyānānātvam| mokṣārthānāṃ vidyānāṃ vikalpaḥ| udgūthopāsanasya pūrnamuktasyāpi sadṛḍhameva yuktibhiraniyatirūce||
iti tṛtīyādhyāyatṛtīyapādaḥ sampūrṇam||
guṇopasaṃhārapāde mokṣasādhanabhūtabrahmavidyānirūpaṇaṃ kṛtam, atha brahmavidyāṅgabhūtakarmanirūpaṇaṃ kriyata iti saṅgatiḥ| nanu pūrvasminkāṇḍe karmāṇi nirūpitāni svargasvārājyadisāṃsārikaphalasādhanānīti teṣāṃ kathaṃ brahmavidyāṅgatvam kathaṃ vā tatpratipādanena vidyāṅgapādasya vedānte samanvaya ityāśaṅkya pariharati karmeti| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ karma prāgeva cintayitvā karmajijñāsānantarameva brahmaṇo jijñāsyatvamuktam " athāto brahmajijñāsā " iti| asminpāde karmaṇāṃ vidyāṅgatoktirvitathā paunaruktyāt| kiñca karmaṇāṃ virodhiphalasādhanatvena viruddhatvācca| tadidamāha anekadhātyājyatokteriti| " na karmaṇā na prajayā " " plavā hyete adṛḍhā yajñarūpāḥ " iti tyājyatvameva karmaṇāmucyate| itthamāśaṅkitamarthaṃ pratikṣipati maivamiti| pratikṣepaprakāraṃ dvedhā vibhajya darśayati karmaiveti| karmāṇi khalu phalāntare yāni viniyuktāni tānyeva viniyogabhedena vidyāṅgatvena viniyujyante| atasteṣāmaṅgatvasiddhiḥ| tathā svargādiṣvaviniyuktānyapi paramapuruṣacaraṇayugaladhyānārcanapraṇāmādīni bahūni karmāṇi śrutismṛtihāsapurāṇasattvottarāgamasadācārapramāṇakāni vidyante teṣāṃ vidyāṅgatvaprakārapariśodhanaṃ kriyata iti pādārambhasya sārthakatvasiddhiḥ| atrāpyayamanvayaḥ karmaiva yajñādikaṃ karmaiva phalasaṅgakartṛtvatyāgādi guṇasamanvitaṃ bhagavadgītādipramāṇakaviniyogapṛthaktvena bhinnaṃ kāmyakarmaṇo vibhaktaṃ vidyāniṣpattiheturbhavatīti tannivṛttidharma iti nāmāntareṇa kathyamānaṃ sukṛtameva syāt| tathā vidyāniṣpattihetutayetihāsapurāṇādiprasiddhaṃ namaskārādikamapi nivṛttidharma iti tadubhayaprakāraviśeṣopapādanena vidyāṅgapādanyāyakalāpaḥ pratāyata iti susaṃgatametat||
atra keṣāṃ parityāgaḥ kāryaḥ keṣāṃ vā parigraha ityajānānasya śiṣyasya tyājyopādeyaprakāraviśeṣopapādanena vibhāgamāha tyāga iti| kāmyakriyāṇāṃ parityāgaḥ kartavya eva brahmavidyāniṣṭhasya| kvāpyanarhakriyāṇāṃ pāparūpāṇāmityarthaḥ| niṣiddhakāmyayossvarūpeṇa parityāgamuktvā nityanaimittikayorapi phalasaṅgakartṛtvatyāgamāha svaikādhīnatvabuddheriti| ayaṃ kartṛtvatyāgaḥ īśvaranirapekṣakartṛtvabuddhessvātmani parityāgāt| kalatyāgamapyāha anupādhiketi| paramātmaśeṣabhūtasvārthabuddhirna viruddhā, svatantrasvārthabuddhirviruddhetyanupadhikaśabdena viśeṣayati| rājabhṛtyādiparipoṣaṇaṃ rājārtham, na svārtham, evamadhyātmavidāṃ tattvajñānādisampādanamapu na svārtham,apitu svaśeṣibhūtaparamātmātiśayārthameveti bhāvaḥ| pativratālaṅkāro hi patyartho natu svārtha iti hi tattvavidāmālāpaḥ| tena " patiṃ viśvasyātmeśvaram " ityuktaparamātmaśeṣatvenaiva svātiśayamapi kurvate tattvavidaḥ| atra gītaiti bhagavadgītāpratipādyatvamucyate| evaṃ tyājyatvamuktvā viduṣāmupādeyamapi vibhajya darśayati atreti| ahiṃsāsatyāsteyādīnāṃ niyamarūpāṇaṃ pāpakṣayahetūnāṃ sarvajātisādhāraṇānāṃ tathā varṇāśramādipratiniyatimatāmupāstyaṅgabhāvamatrāsminpāde brūte||
atra pādasaṅgatirbhāṣye " guṇopasaṃhārānupasaṃhāraphalā vidyaikatvanānātvacintā kṛtā| idānīṃ vidyātaḥ puruṣārtha uta vidyāṅgakātkarmaṇa iti cintyate " iti| anena pūrvapāde vidyācintā, asminpāde vidyāṅgacinteti vibhāgaḥ pradarśitaḥ| atra prathamādhikaraṇe karmaṇāmaṅgatvasiddhayarthaṃ vidyāyā aṅgitvaṃ prasādhyata iti prathamādhikaraṇasyāsminpāde prāthamyasiddhiḥ| kiñca guṇopasaṃhārāntimādhikaraṇe udgīthavidyāyāḥ pṛthakphalatvena puruṣārthasādhakatvamuktam, adhunā brahmavidyāyāḥ phalavattvena puruṣārthasādhakatvaṃ sādhyata iti ca saṅgatiradhikaraṇasya| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ vidyātaḥ puruṣārtha uta vidyāṅgakāt karmaṇa iti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ vidyā kratukartubhūtātmasaṃskāramukhena kratvarthabhūtā āhosvidapunarāvṛttisādhanatayā puruṣārtheti| kiṃ " brahmavidāpnoti param " " tamevaṃ viditvātimṛtyumeti " ityādivedāntāḥ phalavidhaya uta phalārthavādāḥ| kiṃ paravidyāsu karmatayā pratīyamāna ātmā jīvātmā, uta tadatiriktaḥ paramātmeti| kiṃ " yakṣyamāṇo havai bhagavanto'hamasmi " ityācāradarśanādiliṅgānugṛhītaṃ
tattvamasyādisāmānādhikaraṇyamupāsyasya jīvātmatvamavagamayati neti| kimidaṃ liṅgamanaikāntikaṃ neti| atra pūrvapakṣamanuvadati karteti| yaḥ karmaṇāṃ kartā jīvaḥ, tasmādadhikaṃ brahma nāstyeva| tasmānmakādau yajñādau upaniṣadastadbuddhayaivopayuktāḥ jīvasvarūpaparijñānenaivopakurvanti| ityajñamīmāṃsakoktāviti pūrvapakṣamanūdya siddhāntamāha jīvānyeti| jīvavyattiriktabrahmacintātmakabhajanavidhau karmaṇāmaṅgabhāvaṃ prāha| nanu jīvaparatve sapramāṇe kathaṃ brahmaparatvamupaniṣadāmityatrāha kṣiptānyaliṅga iti| pratikṣiptajīvaliṅga ityarthaḥ| yāni jīvaliṅgāni pratibhānti tāni
pratibhāsamātrasiddhatvānna tattvānītyarthaḥ| kīdṛśānāṃ karmaṇāṃ brahmavidyāmaṅgabhāva ityāśaṅkyāha sattvasaṃvardhakānāmiti| kena prakāreṇetyatrāha kaluṣaśamanata iti| ayamatrānvayaḥ sattvasaṃvardhakānāṃ phalasaṅgakartutvādividhirāṇāṃ kaluṣaśamanato'ntaḥkaraṇanairmalyāpādanadvāreṇa sattvasaṃvardhanena brahmavidyāyāmaṅgatvaṃ bhavati vimalakarmānuṣṭānena nirmalīkṛtamanasāṃ brahmavidyayaivāpavargaprāptiriti vidyāyāḥ puruṣārthatvameveti||
acatra kaściccodayati evamekādaśabhiḥ pādaiḥ paraṃ brahmaiva paratattvamiti prasādhitaṃ kathamasminnadhikaraṇe jīvasyaivopaniṣatpratipādyatvaśaṅketi| tadidamāha pādairiti| ayamatrānvayaḥ atraikādaśabhiḥ pādaiḥ paraṃ brahmaiva vedyatayā nirūḍhaṃ prasiddham| bhūyaḥ kathaṃ gaganalipisamaiḥ ākāśākṣarasannibhaiḥ kṣudraliṅgairābhāsaheturbrahmavidyā kṣobhyata iti| tatrārdhāṅgīkāreṇottaramāha satyamiti| uktārthasya satyatvenāṅgīkārāḥ, athāpi bālabuddhīnāṃ vikaṭavidvadkṣobhitānāṃ saṅkṣobhaṇapraśamanena saṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ vaktavyaśeṣo'stītyardhāśenānaṅgīkāraḥ| ayamarthaḥ dhṛrtoktīnāṃ tāvanniśśeṣanirākaraṇaṃ kartavyameva, kiñca vādarāyaṇaśiṣyatallajasya jaiminerbrahmanirākaraṇamatyantāniṣṭamityuktaṃ bhavati||
atra vidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatve pūrvapakṣyabhipretāni liṅgānyanukrameṇānūdya nirākaroti kurvannevetyādinā| ayamarthaḥ " kurvanneveha karmāṇi jijīviṣcchataṃ samāḥ " iti karmaṇaḥ prādhānyaṃ vadati tena brahmavidyā karmāṅgamiti tāvadekaṃ codyamanyathāsiddham| tadvākyaṃ brahmavidaḥ karma kartavyamevetyāha napunarvidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatvaṃ tatsādhakaviśeṣaliṅgābhāvāt tenedaṃ vākyaṃ brahmavidi niyatācāratoktireva| hetvantaramapyanūdya nirākaroti anvārambha iti| " taṃ vidyākarmaṇi samanvārabhete " iti vidyākarmaṇo rbrahmavidi niyatānvayavacanāt brahmavidyā karmāṅgamiti| tadapi na tatra vidyākarmaṇossāhityamevocyate, napunarvidyāyā aṅgatvam, nāpi ca karmaṇo'ṅtvam, sāhitye sati yathāpramāṇaṃ vidyā vā karma vā aṅgitvamaśnuvīta, atra punaḥ " yajña dānena" "karmaṇaiva hi saṃsiddhim " " iyāja so'pi subahūn " iti pramāṇakoṭisahasrānusāreṇa karmaiva vidyāṅgam, na punarvidyā karmāṅgamiti| dhīkriyābyāṃ sahaivānvārambho jñānakarmaṇoraṅgatāṃ vā aṅgitāṃ vā na niyamayediti śabdānvayaḥ| paravādyabimataṃ tṛtīyamapi hetuṃ nirākaroti vidyāpūrvamiti| " yo vā etadakṣaraṃ gārgyaviditvā " iti vidyārahitaṃ karma nirākṛtya " yo viditvā " iti vidyāpūrva karmānūdya " sa brāhmaṇaḥ " iti brāhmaṇatvaprāptirūpaphalopadeśāt vidyā karmāṅgamiti| etacca vākyaṃ brahmavidyāṅgakarma brahmajñānapūrvakameva kartavyamiti vadati, na punarbrahmavidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatvaṃ vadatītī tatratatroktam| tadeva vivṛṇoti na hyetaditi|" yadeva etadakṣaraṃ gārgi viditvā " ityatrānuṣṭhānopayuktaṃ vedāntajanyaṃ jñānamevocyate tenaitadvākyaṃ na brahmopāsanarūpāṃ vidyāmanuvadatītyarthaḥ| ato na brahmavidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatvam| athavā " ācāryakulādvedamadhītya " iti vidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatvamāśaṅkya tasyāpi vedādyayanamātraparatvaṃ na punarbrahmavidyāparatvamucyate nahyetaditi| mā bhūdetairhetubhirbrahmavidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatvam, athāpyudgīthavidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatvavidhānādastu vidyākarmāṅgamityāśaṅkya tadapi prāgeva pratikṣiptamityāhanaceti| evaṃ parābhipretahetusamudāyanirāsāt karmaiva vidyāṅgamityarthaḥ||
vidyā karmāṅgamiti vadataḥ pūrvapakṣiṇo bhāvaṃ vikalpya dūṣayati svādhyāyeti| kiṃ vedādhyayanameva vidyeti bhavatābhidhīyate kiṃ vā adyayanajanitamakṣararāśigrahaṇam athavā tajjanyaṃ śārīrakamīmāṃsāśravaṇam athavā tadupabṛṃhitavedāntavākyārthaparijñānaṃ uta mananasantānamukhena tajjanyaṃ brahmopāsanam iti vikalpaḥ|
tatra prathamapakṣasya dūṣaṇaṃ darśayati svādhyāyeti| " svādyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ "
ityadhyayanamakṣararāśigrahaṇaprātyarthameva vidhīyate| nottarāṅgam uttarakarmānuṣṭhānārthaṃ na vidhīyate| atra karmakāṇḍānumataṃ dṛṣṭāntamāha ādhānavaditi| ādhānāṃ hyagnisiddhaye vidhīyate, napunaruttarakarmānuṣṭhānārtham| akṣararāśigrahaṇamiti dvitīyapakṣe'pi tasya śravaṇaśeṣatvena suprasiddhatvāt tatrāpi vaktavyam nāvaśiṣyate| vedāntavākyaparijñānamiti caturthaḥ pakṣaḥ pariśiṣyate, tatrottaramāha vidyāṅgamiti| vedāntavākyārthaparijñānaṃ brahmopāsanāṅgameva bhavatu, ekaviṣayatvāt sāpekṣatvācca| na punaḥ karmāṅgam parasparāpekṣābhāvāt| nanu vākyajanyaṃ jñānameva brahmavidyā, brahmajñānād brahmavidyāprāptirityasaṅgatamātmāśrayādityāśaṅkya pariharati yadadhiketi| vākyajanyajñānādupāsanātmakaṃ jñānamadhikameva| vākyajanyajñānaṃ hi parokṣaṃ sakṛcca mananaheturbhavati| upāsanātmakaṃ tvaharaharabhyāsādheyātiśayamāprāyaṇādanuvartamānamaparokṣajñānaśiraskaṃ sākṣād brahmaprāptyarthañca kathaṃ karmānuṣṭhānaṃ setsyati tena brahmajñānaṃ karmaṇo'pyaṅgaṃ syāt; netyāha nityātmajñānamātramiti| pravṛttidharmaniṣṇātaiḥ kriyamāṇeṣu karmasu|
dehātiriktanityātmajñānameva hyapekṣyate|| tacca karmakāṇḍa eva siddham| brahmakāṇḍasādhyaṃ tu brahmajñānaṃ pravṛttidharmaniṣṭhānāṃ viruddhameva tatparityāgahetutvāt| tena pañcamaḥ pakṣaḥ pariśiṣyate so'pi na vītarāgamātranuṣṭheyasya parabrahmopāsanasya svargādi prāpakakarmāṅgatvaprasaṅgābhāvāt| tena na vidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatvasiddhiḥ| athāpi parabrahmavidyā kāmya karmāṅgamiti mohād yadi vadasi tadunmattapralapitameva| yadi brahmavidyā kāmyakarmāṅgam, kathaṃ tarhi brahmavidyāniṣṭhasya kāmyakarmaparityāgassarvatrāpyadhyātmavitsu śrūyate? vidyāṃ prati aṅgitvenānuṣṭheyasya karmaṇastyāge pradhānalopaḥ; atyāge punastyājyatāpratipādakapramāṇavirodha iti| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ sā parabrahmavidyāpi yadyeṣāṃ pūrvakāṇḍapratipādyakāmyakarmaṇāmaṅgaṃ tadā savidye brahmavidyāniṣṇāte'dhikāriṇi kāmyakarmatyāgaḥ kathaṃ syāditi||
vidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatve dūṣaṇamāha nāṅgamiti| ayamarthaḥ kiṃ vidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatvaṃ śrutiliṅgādiṣvanyatamena pramāṇena? yadi vā mānamantareṇa? uttaratra sarvaṃ sarvāṅgaṃ syāt| pūrvatrāpi śrutyānaitadasti | vidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatvapratipādakaśruteradarśanāt| na ca liṅgena, tasyāpyadarśanāt| nāpi vākyasthānasamākhyābhiḥ, tāsāmpyanupalambhāt| prakaraṇamekavaśiṣyate tadapi nāstītyāha na hīti| karmādhikṛtadhikāriṇamadhikṛtya yadi brahmavidyā vīdhīyate tadā tasyāḥ karmaśeṣatvamaṅgīkāryam, na ca tad vidyate tataḥ karmāṅgatvaṃ kathamiva vidyāyāḥ| nanu brahmavidyāniṣṭhānāmeva tapastīrthatanādividhānād vidyāyāstattaddharmaśeṣatvamityāśaṅkya sā ca viparotakalpanetyāha syāditi | tattatkarmaṇāṃ vidyā aṅgaṃ syāditi na vaktavyam kalpanāyā viparītatvāt| tapastīrthādiniṣṭhānāṃ vyāsaparāśarādīnāṃ vidyaiva pradhānaṃ karma guṇa iti sarve'pi nirvahanti| tathā ca śrūyate " yajñena dānena tapasā nāśakena brāhmaṇā vividiṣanti"
"kriyāvāneṣa brahmavidāṃ variṣṭhaḥ " " karmaṇaiva hi saṃsiddhimāsthitā janakādayaḥ " "kaṣāye karmabhiḥ pakve tato jñānaṃ pravartate " iti sahasraśo'pi vacanajātam, tasmātkarmaiva vidyāṅgamiti viduṣāṃ nirṇayaḥ| yadi ca vidyā yajñādikarmāṅgam, tadordhvaretasāṃyajñādikarmābhāvāt vidyā viśyedeva| aṅgyabhāve sati kimanenāhgena niṣphalena saphalatve vā kathamaṅgatvaṃ parikalpyate| tarhi ūrdhvaretasāmāśramameva parityajāmaḥ, tadāśramaniṣṭhānāṃ vidyāmapyavidyāparikalpitāmāmanāma ityāśaṅkyottaramāha jābālairiti| jābāvarūpdhvaretovidhiḥ paṭhyate| tathānyairapi śrutītihāsapurāṇapāṭhakairūrdhvaretasāmāśramastatratatrānūdyate| atasso'pyāśramassvīkartavyaḥ| teṣāṃ brahmavidyā ca yathāpramāṇamaṅgīkartavyā| yajñādikarmābhāvād vidyāyāḥ karmaśeṣatvamapi parihartavyamiti| nanu sarvamapyetadanuvādamātram, na punarvidhiḥ| tenordhvaretasāmāśramasya pramāṇamūlatvaṃ nāstītyāśahkya pariharati tasmātprāptiriti| ayamarthaḥ paridṛśyamānasya pramāṇajātasyānupavādatve purovādamantareṇānupapatteḥ purovādaśśrutārthāpatyā parikalpyata iti tasyāpyāśramasya prāṇāmikatvasiddhiḥ| anyathāpi eṣāmanuvādatvābhāve'pi aprāptaviṣatvādetadeva pramāṇam| ayamatra śabdārthaḥ eteṣāmanuvādatve prāptiḥ purovādoktiḥ parigrāhyā eteṣāmaprāptaviṣayatve svayamevaitāni vākyāni pramāṇānīti|
nanu bādhakaprāmāṇābhāve hi prāptiḥ parikalpyā, vidyate hi bādhakapramāṇam "virahā vā eṣa devānāṃ yognimudvāsayate " iti, tenordhvaretasāmāśramo nāstītyāśaṅkya parihāramāha tanniṣedha iti| sarāgasyaivāgniparityāganiṣedhaḥ| vītarāgasya tu brahmacaryādyāśramaparityāgena caramāśramaparigrahasya sarveṣvapi smṛtītihāsapurāṇeṣu suprasiddhatvāt| śrutiṣu ca jābālādipaṭhitāsu nirbādhameva dṛṣṭatvāditi||
pūrvaṃ hi brahmasaṃsthasya stutyarthamanūditatvaṃ pūrvapakṣīkṛtyāśramadvayasya vidhireva pratyapādi| eva madhunā punasstutuprasaṅgāt rasatamatvapratipādavākyāni stutiparāṇi athavā neti śaṅkyā pūrvapakṣotthānamiti asyādhikaraṇasya prāsaṅgikī saṅgatiḥ| nanu pūrvamevāyamudgīthaprasaṅgaḥ kṛtaḥ kimarthaṃ punarucyate ityāśaṅkya bhāṣyakārairevodgīthaviṣayādhikaraṇayoḥ prayojanabhedena vaiṣamyamuktam " atra pratipāditamupāsanaparatvamaṅāgīkṛtyopāsanasya puruṣārthatvena kratuṣūpādānāniyama uktaḥ " iti| ayamarthaḥ atropāsanapatve tātparyaṃ pūrvatra kratuṣūpādānāniyame tātparyamiti| tadarthavicārastu sa eṣa rasānāṃ rasatamaḥ paramaḥ parārdhyo'ṣṭamo ya udgīthaḥ ityevañjātīyakāni vākyāni kiṃ sāmāvayavabhūtodgīthādistutimātraparāṇi utodgīthādiṣu rasatamatvadṛṣṭividhiparāṇīti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ padānāmeṣāmarthavādatvasamāśrayaṇaṃ nyāyyam uta vidhiparatvam| atrāpūrvatvaṃ kiṃ vidhitvamavagamayati neti| atra pūrvapakṣamāha juhvādīti| iyameva juhussvargo loke āhvanīyaḥ iti juhvādistotravad rasatamādyuktirapi yajñāṅgabhūtodgīthādistutitvameva bhajatu | pūrvapakṣaṃ nirākaroti maivamiti| nirākaraṇameva vivṛṇoti
tattaditi| yadyudgīthādividhānaprakaraṇa evedaṃ vākyaṃ syāt tadānīṃ vihitārthapraśaṃsārūpārthavādatvaṃ bhajeta| tena tatprakāraṇarahitatvenārthavādatvaṃ na bhajeta| kiñcaitadvākyasamīpa eva tattaddṛṣṭorvidhānañca dṛśyate, naivaṃ juhvādivākye anārabhyādhītatvāt| tasmādananyārthaśiṣṭe'nyasyāṅgatayā vidhānarahite " yadeva vidyā karoti, tadeva vīryavattaram " iti phalavatyudgīthopāsane kalpyamāno vidhireva yujyate na punararthavādatvam| parṇamayatvādikaṃ tvanyārthaśiṣṭaṃ phalasādhanatvapratipādakavibhaktyabhāvācca phalaśūnyaṃ tasmātatra na vidhiriti prāgevoktamiti bhāvaḥ||
uktameva vidhiparatvaṃ viśadapratipattyarthaṃ yuktibhiḥ pratiṣṭhāpayati kiñceti| ayamarthaḥ vidhiparatvaṃ nāstīti vadatā kimatrānuvādatvamevocyate uta vidheyastutiparatvaṃ ubhayamapi nāsti prāpterabhāvāt| pūrvameva rasatamatvādiviśiṣṭavidhāne satyeva hyatrānuvādatvaṃ kalpayituṃ śakyeta| tathaiva stutimātratvamapi kalpayituṃ śakyeta atra tu prāpterabhāvādubhayamapi kalpayituṃ na śakyate| nādhīropyastutirvā anyatrādhiropyasya rasatamatvādesstutiśca na bhavatīti| nanu tatra tatrobhayaparikalpanamapi dṛśyate tatkimatra nāśrīyata ityāśaṅkyāha yukteti| " vidhinā tvekavākyatvāt stutyarthena vidhīnāṃ syuḥ " iti nyāyānusāreṇa vidhyekavākyatve pratipanne satyevāgatyā gatiriyaṃ yuktā| sā gatiratra rasatamatvādi dṛṣṭividhāyakavākye nāsti āsaktihāneḥ vidhyāsaktihāneḥ vidhyekavākyatvaprasaṅgābhāvādityarthaḥ| nanvatra vidhyāsaktyabhāve'pi yatra vidhirastyanyatra tatredaṃ vākyamutkṛṣya stutiparatvena neyamiti cet tadapi netyāha agatikaviṣaye tatprasahya prasahyamiti| utkarṣakalpanaṃ hi gatiśūnyaviṣaya eva balādaṅgīkaraṇīyam atra punarasti gatiḥ apūrvārthaviṣayasya rasatamatvādidṛṣṭividhānasyopapādanādityarthaḥ| kiñca bahūnāṃ vidhīnāṃ madhya eva rasatamatvādidṛṣṭipratipādanaparamidaṃ vākyaṃ paṭhyate tena samabhivyāhārasāmarthyādasya vākyasya vidhiparatvameva nyāyyamityāha madhya iti||
atra pūrvapakṣyabhipretāmābhāsayuktimanūdya pratikṣipati vidyārthatva iti| " sa eṣa rasānāṃ rasatamaḥ " ityādivākyasya vidyārthatvameva napunasstutitvamiti hi bhavatoktam| tanna yujyate vidyarthatve'pi stutiparatvaṃ yuktameva avidyāmānasyaiva rasatamatvāderdṛṣṭayarthamatrābhidhānāt| atasstutiparamevedaṃ vākyamavidyamānarthakathanāditi pūrvapakṣiṇo'bhiprāyaḥra| tadidamayuktamityāha ayuktamiti| tatra hetumāha dṛṣṭyuddeśe'ticārāditi| dṛṣṭividhiṣu vyabhicārādatyarthaḥ| garuḍamātmānaṃ jānīyādityādiṣu
dṛṣṭividhiṣvasataḥ kīrtanamastyeva athāpi vidhiparatvamaṅgīkriyate tena yadasataḥ kīrtanaṃ tadvidhiparaṃ na bhavatītiniyamābhāvād vyabhicaritamevedamiti| nanvasataḥ kīrtanāditi yuktervyabhicāre'pi sandeha eva syāt vyabhicāre hi vivakṣitārthāsādhakatvena sandehāmevāvahati tena rasatamatvādivākyaṃ vidhirvā stutirivā īvatviti sandeha eva syāditi pūrvapakṣivākyaṃ bālabhāṣitamevetyāha atha cati| bālabhāṣitatvaṃ prakaṭayati nitya iti| atrāyaṃ vikalpaḥ kiṃ nityameva saṃśayassyāditi bhavatocyate kiṃ vā yāvanniyāmakaviśeṣādarśanamiti| pūrvatra vedāprāmāṇyameva syādityāha nitya iti| niyāmakadarśane'pi nityasya saṃśayasya sulabhatvāt| astu saṃśayaḥ, sa ca saṃśayaḥ| viśeṣadarṣanādityuktivārya iti dvitīyapakṣe'pi doṣamāha yuktīti| itthambhāve bubhutsye pramāṇavākyasyetthambhāvo nyāyaparyālocanameva " itikartavyatābhāgaṃ mīmāṃsā pūrayiṣyati " itivacanāt, atra vākyānugrāhakanyāye nirūpayitumabhilaṣite sati vaca iha phalavat " " yadeva vidyayā " iti phalavattvena pratipannaṃ rasatamatvādivaco rasatamatvādidṛṣṭividhyarthameva bhavati na punasstutimātram| ayamarthaḥ nyāyānugṛhītavākyaparyālocanākṣamāṇāṃ nottarameva deyam| tatparyālocanakṣamāṇāṃ tu rasatamatvādivākyaṃ rasatamatvādidṛṣṭividhānārthameveti siddhaṃ bhavati| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ vidyarthatve'pi avidyamānārthakīrtanāt stutireva yuktetyayuktam| asataḥ kīrtanāditi hotorgaruḍamātmānaṃ jānīyādityādidṛṣṭividho stutimātratvavyabhicārāt| tarhi stutirvā vidhirveti saṃśayassyāditi bālabhāṣitaṃ vaidikārthe nityasaṃśayāṅgīkāre vedāprāmāṇyameva syāt| viśeṣadarśanāt saṃśayanivṛttyaṅgīkāre tvatrāpi viśeṣadarśanamasti| vidhitvaniyāmakayuktīnāṃ vahvīnāṃ vākyārthanirṇayetikartavyātarūpāṇāmatra vidyāmānatvāditi| tena vidhitvameva na punasstutimātratvamityarthaḥ||
atrāpi prāsaṅgiko saṅgatiḥ| pūrvasminnadhikaraṇe hi rasatamatvādivākyānāṃ stutyarthatvaṃ pūrvapakṣīkṛtyopāsanaparatvaṃ sthāpitam| evaṃ pratardanādyākhyānāni kiṃ stutyarthatvena neyāni uta pāriplavārthatve neti śaṅkayotthānāt| tadarthavicārastu " pratardano havai daivodāsirindrasya priyaṃ dhāmopajagāma " " śvetaketu rhāruṇeya āsa "
ityādyākhyānāni vedāntavākyasthāni kiṃ pāriplavaproyagārtāni uta vidyāvidhānārthānīti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ pāriplave sarvākhyānānāṃ viniyoga uta manvādyākhyānānāmeveti| kiṃ " ākhyānāni śaṃsanti " iti pāripravākhyānaśabdaḥ sarvākhyānaparaḥ uta manvādyākhyānapara iti| kiṃ " manurvaivasvato rājā " iti tatraivākāyānaviśeṣasyāmnānamākhyānaśabdasya viśeṣaparatāmavagamayati neti| atra sarveṣāmapyākhyānānāṃ " ākhyānāni śaṃsanti " iti vidhibalāt pāriplavārthatvamiti pūrvapakṣamāśaṅkate vidyāsviti| sarvāsvapi vidyāsvākhyānabhedāḥ " pratardano havai " ityādaya ākhyānaviśeṣāḥ " ākhyānāni śaṃsanti " iti vidhimahimnā parigṛhītāḥ pāriplavārthāssantveveti| tadidaṃ pratikṣipati na syuriti| tatra hetumāha vidyāvidhānairiti| tattadākhyānaprakaraṇapaṭhitaistattadvidyāvidhānaisteṣāṃ sarveṣāmākyānānāmekavākyatvadṛṣṭeḥ pāriplavārthatvaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ| nahyatra " udgīthamupāsīta " ityudgīthasāmānyasyopāsanasambandhapratipādakadiṃvatīyaśrutivat sarvākhāyānānāṃ pāriplavasambandhapratipādikā kācit śrutirasti| kevalaṃ prakaraṇameva vidyate| tatpunaḥ prakaraṇaṃ prakṛtatamākhyānaṃ pāriplavārthatvena niyamayati| tarhi pāriplavārthamākhyānaśaṃsanavidhānasya ko viṣaya ityāśahkyāha manvādīti| tatra kathitaṃ manvādyākhyānamātrameva pāriplavārthaṃ bhavatviti na nairarthakyena vidhibhaṅgaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu prakaraṇānmanvādyākhyānamastvaṅgam, athāpyākhyānāntarāṇyapi pāriplavāṅgaṃ bhavatvityāśaṅkya pariharati teneti| ayamarthaḥ pāriplavasya svaprakaraṇapaṭhitena manvādyākhyānena nairākāṅkṣāt pratardanādyākhyānānāñca svavākyapaṭhitatattadbrahmavidyāsamanvayena nairākāṅkṣayācca sarveṣāmākyānānāṃ pāriplave samanvayaklṛptirniṣpramāṇiketi| śabdārthastu uktenānena hetunā ākāṅkṣānivṛttau manvādyākhyānādhikapratardanādyākhyānānāṃ pāriplavārthatvaklṛptirna syāditi||
atra vyākhyātayoradhikaraṇayoḥ prāsaṅgikatve bhāṣya eva vyaktamuktaṃ " stutiprasaṅgādavāntara saṅgativiśeṣeṇārthadvayaṃ cintitam " iti| etasya punaradhikaraṇasya prathamādhikaraṇena saṅgatirapi bhāṣyopāttā " vidyāvanta ūrdhvaretasa āśramiṇassantītyuktam " ūrdhvaretassu ca śabde hi " ityādibhissūtraiḥ| idānīmūrdhvaretaso yajñādyabhāvāt tadaṅgikā vidyā na sambhavatītyāsaṅkyāha " iti| tadarthavicarastu kiṃ parivrājakānāṃ brahmavidyāyāmadhikāro'sti neti| kiṃ " vividiṣanti " ityādinā yajñādyaṅgikaiva vidyā utāśramaprayuktadharmāṅgikoti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ " brahmasaṃsthomṛtatvameti " "ye ceme'raṇye śraddhā tapa ityupāsate" " etameva pravrājino lokamicchantaḥ pravrajanti " ityovamādīni vākyānyūrdhvaretaso vidyāsambandhaṃ pratipādayantyāśramaprayuktadharmāṅgikā vidyetyavagamayanti neti| kiṃ karmaṇo vidyotpādakatvaṃ sambhavati neti| atra pūrvapakṣaśaṅkāmanuvadati yajñāderiti| " yajñena dānena tapasā nāśakena iti yajñāderbrahmavidyāṅgatvenopadeśād yajñādyanadhikṛteṣu ūrdhvaretassu aṅginaḥ upāsanasyādhikāro nasyāt| aṅgavaikalyo'ṅginassādguṇyābhāvena phalasādhanatvabhaṅgāditi| imaṃ pakṣaṃ pratikṣipati neti| karatatra hetumāhabahuvidheti| ayamarthaḥ bahuvidhānāṃ satyavacanādīnāṃ sāmāndharmāṇāṃ svāśramamātraviyatānāṃ viśeṣadharmāṇāñcāṅgatvokteḥ| kiñca caturṇāmāśramāṇāṃ vidyāyogastatpratipādako vidhiśca śrūyate śrutyaiva pratipādyata ityarthaḥ|na kevalaṃ śrutiḥ, smṛtirapyastītyāha smaryate ceti| caturṇāmāśramāṇāṃ dharmavidhānaṃ hi prāyeṇa smṛtīnāṃ pravṛttiprayojanam| tena caturṇāmapyāśramāṇāṃ svocitakarmānuṣṭhānena brahmavidyāyāmadhikāro'sti| nanu tarhi mokṣāśrama iti sannyāsāśramasya viśeṣataḥ prasiddhiḥ kathamupapadyata ityāśaṅkya pariharati prāyeṇeti| ayamarthaḥ putrapautrādibahūpaplavopaplutānāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ tāvad brahmavidyāyāmaikāgryaṃ bhajyate| keṣāṃcittu bhāgadheyavaśāt sidhyatyaikāgrayam| evaṃ brahmacā rivānaprasthānāmapi casannyāsivadatyantaikāgrayābhāvāt bhajyeta vā navā brahmavidyādhikāraḥ| sannyāsinastu parityaktaparigrahatvena prāyeṇa brahmavidyādhikāraḥ paripūrṇassampatsyata iti tasminnaiva mokṣāśramatvaprasiddhiryojyate||
pūrvamūrdhvaretassvagnīndhanādyanapekṣoktā, adhunā punaḥ gṛhastheṣu yajñādikarmāpekṣocyata iti saṅgatessphuṭatvāt bhāṣye tadanuktiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ gṛhasthasya yajñādikarmavato brahmavidyāyāmadhikāra uta tadrahitasyeti| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ yajñādikarma vidyāṅgaṃ neti| kiṃ " yajñena " iti śrutirvidyāṅgatayā yajñādikarma viniyuṅkte neti| kiṃ karmaṇo vidyotpādakatvaṃ sambhavati neti| atra pūrvapakṣamāracayati tyakta iti| ūrdhvaretassu yajñādidharme parityakte'pi parabhajanavidherdṛṣṭatvād gṛhasthe'pi vidyā yajñādikarmānapekṣā bhavediti| tadidamapākaroti anālocitoktiriti| apākaraṇaprakāraṃ darśayati yajñeneti| asya gṛhasthasya| yajñenetyādikābhiśśrutibhiḥ sā vidyā tatprasādhyā yajñādiprasādhyaiva avagatā| nanu yajñenetyādibhiḥ
" vividiṣanti " iti vividiṣāsādhanatvamevocyate yajñādīnām, napunarvidyāsādhanatvam, tatkathamucyate karmaṇāṃ vedanasādhanatvamityatrottaramāha jijñāseti| yathā aśvena jigamiṣatītyatra jigamiṣāṃ prati pradhānabhūtagamanasādhanatvamevāśvasya tathā jijñāsāṃ prati pradhānabhūtajñānasādhanatvameva yajñādīnāmiti nyāyasiddho'yamarthaḥ| tena jijñāsārthatvavāde nivartya evetyarthaḥ| ayamatra bhāvaḥ " dhātoḥ karmaṇassamānakartṛkādicchāyāṃ vā " iti sūtre dhātvarthaprādhānyenaivocchāyāṃ san vidhīyate, tena sanpratyaya eva dhātvarthaprādhānyaṃ svayameva vadatīti yajñādibhirvedanasyaiva sādhyatvāṅgīkāre na sanprayogavirodha iti| evamasinā jighāṃsatīti dṛṣṭāntāntaramudāhartavyam| śloke tāvat padā jigamiṣatīti pādadṛṣṭānta uktaḥ||
nanu pādena jigamiṣatītyāde gatyabhāvāt sanprayogasya dhātvarthamātraparatvam, gatyabhāvaścopalambhavirodhāt nahi pāde jigamiṣāsādhanam api tu gamanasādhanameva ato'rthavirodhāt dṛṣṭānte prayogavaiparītyaṃ bhavatu nāma yajñādibhirvividiṣantītyādau tādṛśo na kaścidarthavirodho'stīti
pūrvapakṣyabhiprāyamāśaṅkya nirākaroti nanvityādinā asadityantena| pūrvapakṣiṇoktasya dṛṣṭānte gatyabhāvasya pakṣe'pi sāmyaṃ pradarśayati gatyabhāva iti sāmyameva prakaṭayati iccheti| tathā hi brahmajijñāsāṃ prāptumicchoḥ karmānuṣṭhānaṃ bhavatocyate| tanna viṣayavailakṣaṇyajñānamantareṇa karmabhiricchāyā asādhyatvāt| viṣayavailakṣaṇyajñānārthaṃ karmeti cet tarhi jñānārthameva karmetyuktaṃ syāt| tathācāpasiddhāntaḥ, svavacanavirodhaśca| karmaṇo jijñāsāhetutvasya svoktasyaivopaghātāt| athavā karmānuṣṭhānādicchā, icchayā karmānuṣṭhānamiti vaighaṭyam| vaighaṭyameva vivṛṇoti jijñāsāmiti| jijñāsāṃ prāptumicchoḥ karmānuṣṭhātuḥ puruṣasya pūrvameva jñānamiṣṭaṃ na na bhavati iṣṭameva bhavatītyarthaḥ| ato jñānecchaiva jijñāsā sā pūrvameva siddhā| tāṃ prāptukāmaḥ karmānuṣṭhāya tāṃ punaḥ prāpnotītyasaṅgatametat| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ jijñāsāṃ prāptumicchoḥ puruṣasya jñānaṃ puraiveṣṭaṃ na na bhavati, jñānārthameva hi jijñāsā prārthyate, jñānārthamityukte jñānasyābhilaṣitatvaṃ prāgeva siddham| jñānābhilāṣa eva hi jijñāsā | sā pūrvameva siddhā||
nanu pūrvameva jijñāsāyāṃ satyāṃ karmānuṣṭhānam, karmānuṣṭāne sati jijñāsetyanyonyāśrayaṇādikamuktam, tanna sambhavati viṣayaviśeṣeṇa jñānabhedāt tathāhi pūrvaṃ sāmānyato jñānam, tenecchā, icchātaḥ karmānuṣṭhānam, karmānuṣṭhānāt punaricchāviśeṣaḥ, tasmāduttarottaramicchājñānānuvṛttiriti na kaściddoṣa iti pūrvapakṣyabhiprāyamanūdya pariharati nanviti| ayamatra śabdārthaḥ icchānuvṛtiṃta prati karma vihitaṃ yojyam| na punaḥ pūrvecchāṃ prati| tataḥ kimityāha siddhāntī| ayamabhiprāyaḥ yāvajjīvamicchānuvṛtiṃta prati karmānuṣṭhānaṃ prayojyaṃ cet tarhi vividiṣārthasya karmaṇo nityānuvṛttatvādinuṣṭheyasya svarūpapratipattyarthaṃ karmavicārasyaiva pūrvavṛttitvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavatīti svasiddhāntavirodhaḥ| kiṃcottarottaramicchāsiddhayarthaṃ pūrvameva dhīviśeṣaprajananamuditaṃ tāvatā na vāritaṃ syādityāha necchārthamiti| ayamarthaḥ icchātaḥ pūrvameva brahmajñānaviśeṣasadbhāvo'ṅgīkārya iti tasya jñānasya sadbhāvaḥ karmaṇeti karmavicārasya pūrvavṛttatvasiddhiḥ| astu vā ayaṃ vidhirvividiṣārthaḥ, vedanārthamapi karmavidhirastītyāha jñānārthamiti| astu vividiṣārthamapi karmānuṣṭānam, athāpi " kriyāvāneṣa brahmavidāṃ viriṣṭhaḥ " " kaṣāye karmabhiḥ pakve tato jñānaṃ pravartate " " karmaṇaiva hi saṃsiddhimāsthitā janakādayaḥ " " iyāja sopi subahūn " ityādibhirjñānārthamapi karma nāpalapituṃ śakyate| tato'pi karmavicārapūrvavṛttatvaṃ siddhaṃ śāstrasya| tarhi " vividiṣanti" ityasya sanprayogasya kā gatirityāsaṅkya " nididyāsitavyaḥ " iti nyāyamatidiśati nidyānanyāyata iti| ayamarthaḥ yathā " nididyāsitavyaḥ " iti dhyāne sanprayogo vidheyasya dhyānasyeṣṭatāmāha, na punaricchāyā vidheyatvam tadvadatrāpi " vividiṣanti " itīcchāyā na vidheyatvam icchāviṣayatvena jñānasya prāpyatvamucyata iti susaṅgatametat||

atra saṅgatirbhāṣye " yajñādikarmāṅgikā brahmavidyetyuktam| tāni ca yajñādīni karmāṇyamumukṣuṇā kevalāśramiṇāpyanuṣṭheyāni uta neti cintāyām " iti| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ vidyāṅgabhūtānyāśramakarmāṇi kevalāśramiṇāpyanuṣṭheyāni uta neti| kimeṣāṃ vidyāṅgatve kevalāśramāṅgatvaṃ sambhavati neti| kiṃ kevalāśramāṅgatve nityānityasaṃyogavirodhaḥ prasajyate neti| atra pūrvapakṣamanuvadati varṇāderiti| "yajñena " ityādivākyena varṇādeḥ karmaṇo brahmavidyāṅgabhāvo'bhidadhe| tasmāt abrahmaniṣṭhe brahmavidyā'bhāvena brahmavidyāṅgakarmānanusaraṇātsvairitvamevāstu| atrottaram maivamiti| tatra hetumāha nityatvasyeti| itthaṃ kila tāntrikamaryādā  yāni karmāṇyekatra viniyujyante tānyanyatrāpi vidhinā viniyuktāni ced viniyogapṛthaktvādevobhayatrānvayasiddhiriti| viniyuktyanyabhāvānusārāt

atra bhāṣye saṅgatiruktā, " caturṇāmāśramiṇāṃ brahmavidyāyāmadhikāro'sti, vidyāsahakāriṇa āśramadharmā iti coktam| ye punarāśramānantarā vartante vidhirādayasteṣāṃ brahmavidyāyāmadhikāro'stinaveti viśaye " iti| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ vidhirādīnāṃ brahmavidyāyāmadhikāro'sti neti| kiṃ teṣāṃ sāṅgabrahmavidyopasaṃhārasāmarthyamasti neti| kimāśramasādhāraṇadharmāṅgikāpi vidyā sambhavati neti| "tapasā

atra bhāṣya eva pūrvapakṣotthānakrameṇa saṅgatirdarśitā "naiṣṭhikakhānasaparivrājakāśramebhyaḥ pracyutānāmapi brahmavidyāyāmadhikāro'sti neti cintāyāṃ vidhurādivadāśramaikāntairdānādibhirvidyānugrahasambhavādastyadhikāra iti prāpya ucyate iti| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ naiṣṭhikādyāśramabhraṣṭānāṃ brahmavidyādhikāro'sti neti| kimeṣāṃ sāṅgavidyopasaṃhārasāmarthyamasti neti| kimeṣāṃ prāyaścittāt śuddhimattvaṃ sambhavati neti| kiṃ " yo brahmacārī sriyamupeyāt " iti vihitaṃ prāyaścittaṃ sarvabrahmacāriviṣayamuta naiṣṭhikabhinnabrahmacāri viṣayamiti| kiṃ " prāyaścittaṃ na paśyāmi " iti vacanaṃ prāyaścittavacanasya naiṣṭhikanyatiriktabrahmacāriviṣayatāmavagamayati neti| atra pūrvapakṣamāha ārūḍha iti| naiṣṭhikāditrayamārūḍhaḥ samanantaraṃ tatparāvartanātpatito yastasminnapi brahmavidyā bhavatyeva| taddaśārhaissvadharmaissahakṛtā sahakṛtatvādityarthaḥ| pūrvapakṣaṃ nirākaroti maivamiti| nirākaraṇahetumupapādayati yadyapītyādinā| yadyapi naiṣṭhikasya bhraṣṭatva mupapātakāntargatam, na punarmahāpātakam| loke ca mahāpātakaparyantasakalapāpakṣayahetubhūtaṃ harikīrtanastutinamaskārādikamitihāsapurāṇādiprasiddham| athāpi naiṣṭhikādibhraṣṭo brahmavidyāyāṃ nādhikāroti " prāyaścittaṃ na paśyāmi" iti sākṣādeva prāyaścittaniṣedhavacanasya sphuṭataramupalabhyamānatvāt| nahi vacanavirodhe nyāyaḥ prabhavati| tenedamupapātakaṃ vā mahāpātakaṃ vā yatkiñcideva bhavatu| athāpi na brahmavidyāyāmadhikāraḥ| tadidamāha tadapīti| tatra hetumāha tādṛṅniṣedhāditi| anadhikāritvapratipādakaniṣedhavacanasāmarthyādityarthaḥ| yadyapi harikīrtanādikaṃ śodhakamasti tadapi tasya samābhāṣaṇādyarhatāmevāpādayati napunarbrahmavidyādhikāramiti bhāvaḥ||

"śrotavyo mantavyaḥ" iti vākyena śravaṇaṃ mananañca rāgataḥprāptatvādanudyate, tathāpi śravaṇamananābhyāṃ vinā vidyāniṣpattyayogāt tadubhayamapi tadaṅgameva| "evaṃ tasmād brāhmaṇaḥ pāṇḍityaṃ nirvidya " tasmād brāhmaṇaḥ pāṇḍityaṃ nirvidya tiṣṭhāset " ityatra viduṣā bālyamupādeyatayā śrutam| bālasya bhāvaḥ karma kāmacārādikaṃ sarvaṃ viduṣopādeyam, uta ḍambhādirahitatvameveti viśaye " iti saṅgatirbhāṣye vyaktā| tadarthavicārastu bālyopādāne kiṃ kācārādikamapyupādeyam uta māhātmyānāviṣkaraṇameva kiṃ bālyaśabdāssarvabālakarmaparaḥ ita māhātyamyānāviṣkaraṇarūpabālasvabhāvaviśeṣaparaḥ| " nāvirataḥ" ityādiśrutiḥ kiṃ bālyāśabdasyānāviṣkāraparatāmavagamayati
neti| atra pūrvapakṣī manyate " bālyena tiṣṭhāset " iti viduṣaḥ śrutau śiṣṭaṃ bālyaṃ bālakṛtyaṃ kāmacāravādabhakṣatvamevāstu na punarbālasyābhāvaḥ| na hyanyasya bhāvo'nyena bhartuṃ suśakaḥ vyavasthitatvāt bālyādīnāṃ dharmāṇām| tena svairitaiva bālyamityastu| tadidamanuvadati śiṣṭamiti| anūditamarthaṃ pratikṣipati neti| pratikṣepaprakāraṃ prakaṭayati duścāritrāditi| "nāvirato duścaritāt " iti vacastvaduktamamumarthaṃ sannirundhe| athavā svairiṇamamumadhikāriṇaṃ sannirundhe| tarhi bālyasya ko nirṇaya ityāśaṅkyaṃ bālyaśabdārthaṃ nirṇayena kathayati ata iti| adhyātmavidāṃ svamāhātmyagopanaṃ hi munibhirvidhīyate tena vihite svamāhātmyagopane bālyaśabdasya tātparyaṃ syāt| ata eva sadācāraniṣṭhasyāpi bharatasya " satāṃ mārgamadūṣayan " iti sanmārgadūṣaṇena prakyātasyodbhrāntavannaṭanamucyate| evamatrāpi bālavat svamāhātmyagopanamevocyate| idañca svamāhātmyagopanaṃ lokasaṃmānādivyāvṛttyartham| saṃmānādikañca tyājyamevādhyātmavidām

itthamaṅgacintā kṛtā, idānimaṅginiṣpattisamayacintā kriyata iti saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kimaihikaphalasādhanamupāsanaṃ svasādhanapuṇyakarmānantaramevotpadyate utānantaraṃ kālāntare vetyaniyamaḥ| kiṃ tadutpatteḥ pratibandhassambhavati neti| itthamiha pūrvapakṣī manyate bhogārthopāsanānāmaihikaphalānāmupāsanānāṃ svajanakasukṛtaissvotpādakasukṛtaistatkṣaṇādevodbhavassyāyāt| nanu svargādivad vidyāntarotpattiḥ karmaphalatvāt kālāntare syādityāśaṅkya svargādīnāṃ dehāntarānubhāvyatvenāsmindehe notpattiḥ syāt, sambhavatyevāsmindehe hṛdayaśuddhayādimukhena vidyāyā utpattiḥ| tenātra snānaprāyatyanītireva syāt| yathā snātasya puruṣasya prāyatyaṃ prayatatvaṃ tadānīmeva bhavati napunardehāntare tathā svakarmabhirvidyāprāptistadānīmeva niyamena syāditi| tadidamanuvadati bhogārtheti| anuditamarthaṃ pratikṣipati neti| utpattiḥ kadācit tadānīmeva syāt kadācit kānāntara ityaniyama eva| nanu saguṇaviracite kathaṃ kālāntare phalasiddhissyāt tatrāpyāha tadarhairiti| saguṇaviracite'pi karmaṇyatyantaprabalaiḥ karmabhistatpratibandhāhaiḥ kadācit vighnassyādeva||
pūrvamaihikaphalānāṃ vidyānāṃ niṣpattikālāniyama uktaḥ, evaṃ brahmaprāptihetūnāmapi vidyānāmaniyama evātidiśyata ityādideśikī saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ muktiphalamupāsanaṃ svasādhanakarmānantaramutpadyate utānantaraṃ kālāntare vetyaniyamaḥ| kiṃ paravidyāsādhanāt karmaṇaḥ prabalaṃkarmāntaraṃ sambhavati neti| atra pūrvapakṣī viśeṣābhidhānena pratyavatiṣṭhate astviti| abrahmavidāṃ
vidyāniṣpattikarmasu prayavāyo'stu nāma; abrahmavitkarmaṇāṃ durbalatvāt| phalasaṅgakartṛtvatyāgayuktaṃ nivṛtyāhvayaṃ karma prabalatamamiti proktam| tata idaṃ karma sarvataḥprabalatvāt svavirodhivargaṃ sarvamapi nirākṛtya sapadyeva brahmavidyāṃ vidadhyāt kuryāt| tadidaṃ pratikṣipati maivamiti| ayamatra bhāvaḥ

iti nyāyena saṃsārasāgare vartamānānāṃ mātsyanyāyenattarottaraṃ karmaṇāmādhikyamupalabhyate| tathā ca brahmavitkarmaṇāmapi tato'pyadhikaṃ karmāntaramasti yo'yaṃ brahmavidapacāraḥ, tairbrahmavidapacārādibhirmahattaraiḥ| pāpairbrahmavidyotpādakasyāpi nivṛttyākhyadharmasya nirākaraṇasambhavāt tādṛgvidhamahattaraduritābhāve nivṛttidharmo brahmavidyāṃ sadya eva janayati| tatsadbhāve kālāntare janayatīti brahmavidyānāmapyaniyataiva niṣpattiriti siddham| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ tasmānnivṛttidharmādapi balīyān parabrahmabhaktāparādho yadi bhavati tadā tacchāntau tatprasūtistādṛgvidhāparādhaśāntau brahmavidyāprasūtiḥ sa yadi na tādṛgvidhāparādhābhāve jhaṭiti brahmavidyālābhassyāditi||

asminpāde pratipāditānāṃ pañcadaśānāmadhikaraṇānāṃ pradhānārthānparigaṇayati vidyetyādinā ślokadvayena| prathamādhikaraṇe vidyā karmāṅgiketi pratītirādhīyate| dvitīye tu rasatamatvadidhīraprāptatvāccoditaiva| tṛtīye punarvidyāprakaraṇapaṭhitānāmākhyānānāṃ vidyāviśeṣatvameva| evamuttaratrāpyadhikaraṇeṣu tattadāśramaniyatādeva dharmādūrdhvaretassvapi sāṅgā vidyā| gṛhasthe punassā vidyā yajñadānādyapekṣā| gṛhastho'pi śāntyādyarha eva syāt| anāpadi viduṣo'pyannaśuddhayaiva yogasiddhissyāt||
ekameva karma vidyārthamāśramārthañca| vidhuramaviyutaṃ vidyayā saṃyutamāhurityarthaḥ| athavā vidhuramapi yutamitipāṭhaḥ| vidhuramapi vidyayā sambaddhamityarthaḥ| cyutaṃ na naiṣṭhikyādyāśramabhraṣṭaṃ vidyayā yutaṃ nāhurityanvayaḥ| kratvaṅge rasatamatvādidarśanamṛtvikkāryam| atha munitā maunam| coditādhyānasiddhayai  vihitabrahmopāsanasiddhyarthamityarthaḥ| dhyānasiddhayai coditeti vā padacchedaḥ| bālyaṃ svasāmarthyādigopanam| balavadabhihatairbalavatpratibandhakapratibaddhaiḥ karmabhirnānyavidyā abrahmavidyā na bhavatītyarthaḥ| tadvanmuktayarthavidyā brahmavidyāpi brahmavidapacārādiprabalapratibandhakapratibaddhaissvotpādakakarmabhirnotyapadyata ityasminpāde sūtrakāraḥ prāhetyanvayaḥ||
