atra kaścicududat "sāṃsārikasakaladuḥkhanivṛttirhi mokṣa ityadhyātmavidbharavidhīyate sa ca mokṣaḥ karmāṅgikayā vidhayā sidhyatīti ca, tadetadayuktameva kiṃ vidyamānasakaladuḥkhanivṛttirutātītasakaladuḥkhanivṛttirathavā bhīviduḥkhanivṛttimokṣa ityucyate? tritayamapi na sambhavati|vartamānasya kṣaṇikatvādeva svata eva nivṛttiriti na kāraṇāpekṣā|tathā dvitīyoṣapi pakṣo'sambaddha evātītānāṃ duḥkhānāṃ prāgeva nirastatvena tannirasahetubhūtopāsanapravṛtyapekṣābhāvāt|bhāviduḥkhabhāvāt tannirāsopāyabhūtopāsanorpājanamanarthaka" iti|tadidamanudya nirācaṣṭeyudduḥkhamiti|ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ yadduḥkhamiha vartate tat kṣaṇikatvānna svayatnoparodhyam|atītadukhanivṛttiścet sāpi prageva niṣpanneti tadarthamapi yatno na kartavyaḥ|tena bhāviduḥkhamavaśiṣyate tacca na supariharam|tacca na parihartuṃśakyate|kuta ityatrāhahetau samagra iti|anādikālasiddheṣu bahuṣu pāpeṣu vidyamāna kathaṃ bhāvi tadduḥkhaṃ supariharaṃ bhaviṣyatīti|kiṃñca bhāvītipadaṃ duḥkhasyottarakālasambandhamevāha|tasya nirāsaḥ kartumeva na śakyate|tathātve sarvaṃ sarvatra sarvadā mithyaiva syāt|tena sarvaduḥkhātyantoparodharbahmopāsanavidhiriti vyarthamevedaṃ vacanamiti| tadetatpratikṣipatiardharamyamiti|ayamarthaḥvartamānaduḥkhoparodha ityāsmābhirnocyate, nacātītaduḥkhoparodha ityucyate,nāpi bhāviduḥkhasya pradhvaṃsotpādanamiti kathyate|apitu kāraṇasadbhāve bhāvitvena prasaktasya duḥkhasya sāmagrīnirādhaḥ kriyate, bhāviduḥkhe kāraṇatvenāvasthitānāṃ karmaṇāṃ vināśaḥ kriyata iti|śakyate hi vidyamānāni duḥkhakāraṇāni vināśayituṃ duritāpanodanaprāyaścittarūpeṇa brahmopāsanena|na sarvalokaviditamidaṃ kudṛṣṭiparikalpitena durvivādena nivārayituṃ śakyate|loke hi vātapittaśleṣmādikāraṇaprakopena prastutaṃ maraṇādiduḥkhaṃ vaidyopadeśasiddhauṣadhaprayogeṇa kāraṇapratibandharūpena nivāryate|tadvatrāpi pūrvakṛtānāṃ duritānāṃ brahmajñānena vidhvaṃsāt tenaiva brahmajñānenottareṣāṃ duritānāmanārambhāt sāmagryuparodhena saṃsārānuvṛttirnirudhyata
iti sarvaṃ samāhitam|tadidaṃ darśayatiprāyaścittyeti|kṛtānāṃ prāyāścittyāpara paramapi duritānāmakaraṇād duḥkhasāmagrīnirādhena duḥkhotpattirna bhaviṣyati kāraṇābhāvātkāryābhāva ityāhālagopālaṃ likhitapaṭhito'yamarthaḥ||
bhāvyanarthaparihārāya pravṛttirloke bahudholabhyata ityatrāpyāśaṅkitabhāvyanarthakāraṇanirākaraṇāya brahmopāsane pravṛttiryojyuta iti darśayatirājadviṣṭādīti|rājaśāsanātilaṅghanaṃ sarpādyaniṣṭahetuṃ pariharasi sa ca parihāro bhāviduḥkhoparodhāyaiva|chatrapūrvaṃ bibharṣi bhāvivarṣāplāvanādinirākaraṇāyaiva hi cchatrādikaṃ bibharṣi|tadvadatrāpi kṛtsnapāpaprāyaścittarūpabhagavadupāsanābhāve sāṃsārikaṃ sakalamapi duḥkhaṃ bhaviṣyati|tatkaraṇe punassāmagrīvicchedāduttarakāle prasaktaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti brahmanopāsena pravṛtiṃta bhajasva|kiñca kimanenānyaklikena dṛṣṭāntena|adhunā bhavān bāvyanarthaparihārāyaiva prayateta|tathāhi yadyahaṃ tūṣṇīmeva syāṃtadā mama parājaya eva bhaviṣyatītyutprekṣārūḍhabhāvyāpajayaśamanāya svoktessāphalyamicchaṃstvaṃ bālatiryakparyantaṃ bhayacakitagatiṃ paśyaṃśca joṣamitthaṃ juṣasva joṣamāsvetyarthaḥ| bālāstiryañco'pi bhayacakitā eva gacchanti| bhayañca bhāvyanarthāśaṅkyā| tasyaivānarthasya pariharaṇāya palāyante ca| tenābālagopālaṃ prasiddhārthe na vivaditavyamiti||
itthaṃ karmāṅgakabrahmavidyayā kṛtsnaduḥkhanivṛttipūrvakabrahmaprāptirityuktam| atra kaściccodayati "kāryakāraṇabhāvasyaiva durnirūpatvānna sādhanatvaṃ vidyāyāḥ, nāpi vidyopakārakatvaṃ karmaṇaḥ, nāpi ca karmānugṛrītabrahmopāsanasādhyatvamapavargasya, sarvasyāpi vikalpāsahatvāt| kiṃ kāraṇād bhinnamabhinnaṃ vā kāryam? bhinnañcet tasya tatkāryatvaṃ na syāt| nahi ghaṭasya paṭaḥ kāryam| abhinnañcettathāpi na kāryam nahi ghaṭasya ghaṭa eva kāryam| bhinnābhinnatvamavācyameva vyāghātāt| tathā kurvat kāraṇamutākurvat?
ubhayathāpi kāraṇaṃ na bhavatyeva| yadāhuḥ
" kurvatkāryamakurvadvā yatkiñcitkāraṇaṃ bhavet|
kurvaccedanavasthānamakurvattvavyavasthitiḥ|| "
iti| evaṃ kiṃ prāpya kāryaṃ karoti kāraṇam, utāprāpya ubhayathā'pi kāraṇatvaṃ na sambhavati| prāptyaprāptisamotthānena dūṣaṇamapi vācyam| kiñca kāraṇaśabdārtha eva nirūpayituṃ na śakyate| niyapūrvabhāvikāraṇamiti nirūcyate cet, kiṃ sarvāpekṣayā niyatapūrvabhāvi tanna; atiprasaṅgāt| kāryāpekṣayā cet tacca na kāryaśabdārthasyaiva durnirūpatvāt| niyapaścādbhāvikāryamiti cet tacca sarvāpekṣayā cedatiprasaṅgaḥ, svakāraṇāpekṣayā cet parasparāśrayadoṣaḥ kāryakāraṇayoranyonyanirūpakatvāt| evamanekavidhadoṣadūṣitvāt kāryakāraṇabhāva eva na saṅgacchate| kutastena brahmopāsanasyāpavargaṃ prati kāraṇatvena vidhiḥ kāraṇaviśeṣatvāt karaṇasya iti itthaṃ durnirūpatvāt kāryakāraṇabhāve kaṇṭhagatajīve karaṇatvābhidhāyināmupāsanavidhīnāṃ maraṇameva śaraṇam iti| evaṃ vadantaṃ parapakṣavādinaṃ pratikṣipati sādhyaṃ veti| kāryaṃ vā kāraṇaṃ vā svavyāghātopahatadurmārgairdurnirūpamiti vadanto bhavantastasminvāde kimpravṛttāḥ? ayamarthaḥ ādhinikī bhavadīyavādapravṛttirnirarthikā sārthikā vā nirarthikā cet pravṛttireva na ghaṭate| nahi prayojanamunuddiṣya mando'pi pravartate| sārthikā cem sa prava kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ| etasyā eva vādapravṛtteḥ kāraṇatvāt paravādiparājayasya tatphalasya kāryatvāt| tarhi paravādiparājayaḥ siddha iti vijayāmaha iti cedidaṃ svapnalabdhasuvarṇena kaṭakanirmāṇamityāha svavihitavipathairiti| sādhyaṃ vā sādhanaṃ vā durnirūpamiti bhavānpralapatyeva| naitāvatā paravādiparājayasiddhissvavyāghātopahatatvādetasya vākyasya| tena kāryakāraṇabhāvāṅgīkāre na paravādiparājayaḥ| tadanaṅgīkāre paravādiparājayahetvabhāvānna paravādiparājayaḥ| tena pralāpa evāyaṃ bhavatparikalpito durmārga ityarthaḥ| tadvāde kiṃ pravṛttā ityanenāsmābhiruditaṃ svyāghātajātamidamuktaṃ bhavati| evaṃ vādapravṛttimevoparudhya lokapravṛttimapyuparuṇaddhi kimiti ceti| vādapravṛttyabhāve paribhūyeta bhavān, lokapravṛttyabhāve bhavatassvajīvanabhojanādyabhāvena
atra pūrvottarādhyāyayorekārdhena saṅgatimuktvā dvitīyenārdheṃna caturthāghyāye pūrvāttarapādadvakeyoḥ paurvāparyamāha ityutpattikrameṇa ti|"svargakāmo yajeta "ityatra sādhyavamarśapūrvakasādhanāvamarśasya dṛṣṭatvāt saḥ ayamavamarśakramaḥ punarbrahmavidyāyā utpattikramānusāreṇa pūrvacintanam, brahmaprāpteḥ punaḥ paścāccintanamityutpattikramaḥ| evaṃ prakāreṇotpattikrameṇamukyupāssahita iti tṛtīyādhyāyārthaḥ|
atha caturthādhyārthamāha tatsādhyamiti| upāyasādhyaṃ brahmaprāptirupaṃ phalaṃ sūtrakāraḥ parvabhedaivyanakti|
uttapūrvādhāślaṣavināśotkramaṇārcirādigamana brahmaprāptirūpaphalaparvabhedairvyanaktītyarthaḥ| evaṃ pādārthabhedamuktvā
pādārthamapi vibhajya darśayati| tatra tāvatsthūladehādanutkrāntasya yatphalaṃ tatpādadvayena vadatītyāha  sthūla iti| sthūladehādutkrāntasya yatphalaṃ taduttarapādadvayena vadatīti darśayati niṣkrāntasye ti| ayamarthaḥaśaleṣavināśādikamutkramaṇañca sthūladehe vartamānasyaiva bhavati arcirādimārgemaṇa gamanaṃ parabrahmaprāptiśca sthūladehādutkrāntasyeti vibhāga iti||
atra phalādhyāye vidyāyāḥ punarabhidhānamasaṅgatidoṣopahatamityāśaṅkya prayojanaviśeṣābhidhānena saṃgatiṃ darśayati sūkteti | ayamatrākṣepaḥ  prāgeva brahmavidyā sūktā| kimarthaṃ punarimāṃ brahmavidyāmatrāsthāne vakti
sūtrakāraḥ| nanubrahmavidyāyāṃ vaktavyāvaśeṣo'stītyāśaṅkya tadapi sūtrakāraḥ pūrvameva tṛtīyādhyāye brūtāṃ svasthānatvāt| athāpyatrābhidhāne kodoṣaityāśaṅkyāha nahīti |ayamarthaḥ phalātnādacyate ced brahmavidyā na phalam| aphalatve'pyatrocyate cedasaṅgatatvātpratipattivairasyameva jāyeteti| tadidaṃ pratikṣipatineti|
tatpratikṣepaprakāramāhamukteritiṣa| atra catvāro'rthā viśeṣato vyañjanīyāḥ| te ca phalāntargatā eva| tadabhidhānārthaṃ
tatprasambandhitayā brahmavidyātrāpyabhidhīyate| mukteranyairasiddhirityeko'rthaḥ| "nānyaḥ panthā ayanāya vidyate" itimokṣasyānyairasiddhiḥ prasiddhā| prakṛtatadavinābhāva ityaparo'rthaḥ | prakṛtasya brahmopāsanasya tadavinābhāvo mokṣāvinābhāvaḥ "teha nākaṃ mahimānassacante"ityucyate| āsannasiddhi rityanyaḥ| tamevaṃ vidvānamṛta iha bhavati
bhagavajjñānānantaramavisalambena muktāvasthātulyānasthāprāptiśśrūyate| muktāvasthāsamaśca sthirabhajanarasa itītaraḥ|
bhagavadipāsanasya mokṣānasthātilyarasarīpatvaṃ svargādisādhāneṣu sādhanaṃ duḥkhātmakaṃ phalaṃ duḥkhāvyāmiśraṃ ekadeśasukhātmakaṃ brahmopāsena phalatulyasukhātmakameva svarūpam| etānarthān prakāśayituṃ sādhanasyāpi brahmopāsanasyaphalādhyāya upakrame nirdeśe iti| vyaṅktumatrānubandhāt itiphalatulyatvena phalakoṭiniveśamupapādayitumatra brahmavidyānibamdha ityarthaḥ|| 
atrādhikaraṇasaṃgatirbhāṣye tṛtīye'dhyāye sādhanaissaha vidyā cintitā ityupakramya vedāntavākyeṣu
brahmaprāptitayā vihitaṃ vedanaṃ kiṃ sakṛtkṛtameva śāstrārthaḥ utāsakṛdāvṛttamiti saṃśayaḥ" ityabhidhānāt|
tadarthavicārastu kiṃ vedāntavihitaṃ vedanaṃ sakṛtkṛtaṃ śāstrarārthaḥ, utāsakṛdāvṛttamiti| kiṃ brahmavidāpnoti param ityādibhirvedamātraṃ vidhīyate uta nididhyāsanam| kimatra vidiśabdo jñānamātraparaḥ
utopāsanaparaḥ | upakramopasaṃhārābhyāṃ vākyāntarāccopāsanaparatvaṃ vidiśabdasyāvagamyateneti| atra tṛtīyādhyāyacaramādhikaraṇenāsyādhikaraṇasya saṃgati vadanpratipādyaviśeṣārthanapyāha śuddhairiti | phalasaṅgakartṛtvādidoṣaragutārutikṛṣṭadharmaiśśamādibhiśca sadanapacaraṇe brahmavidapacārābhāve brahmavidyābhavitrīti pūrvā dhikaraṇe uktam| etasmin adhikaraṇe brahmavidyāsvarūpaṃ vimṛśati|pūrvamapi brahmavidyāsvarūpaṃ tatratatra nirūpitam| tena paunaruktyaṃ kiṃ na syāditi āśaṅkyapūrvaṃ nirūpitākāraviśeṣasya brahmavidyāyāṃ vidyamānatvāt tadākāraviśeṣapapādanenāpaunarūktayamupapādayatipratyakṣamityādīnā| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ kiṃ mokṣopāyābhūtaṃ brahmopāsanaṃ pratyakṣarūpaṃ smṛtirūpaṃ vā sakṛtkṛtaśaśāstrārtha iti nyāyena sakṛdvā dhruvānusmṛtiriti pramāṇānusāreṇāsakṛdveti pūrvaṃ noktam| naitāvadeva sa khalvevaṃvartayanyāvadāyuṣam ityādyuktaṃ yāvajjīvānuvṛtyādikacca pūrvaṃ noktamiti na paunaruktyagandhaprasaṅga iti||
atra sakṛtvena pūrva pakṣaṃ kṛtvā bhāṣyādāvuktāmasakṛktvopapādanaprakriyāṃ smārayan siddhāntaṃ pradarśayatijñānamiti| atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ brahmavidāpnoti param brahma veda brahmaiva ityādau kevalaṃ brahmavedanameva mokṣopāya ityuktam| tasya vedanasyaikatvaṃ vāanekatvaṃ veti saṃkhyā noktā āvṛttatvaṃ vā anāvṛttatvaṃ vā noktamityarthaḥ | kiñca sakṛktve saukaryameva syāt laghupakṣāṅgīkāre hi nyāyānusārasyādityarthaḥ | tathā sakṛtkṛtaḥ śāstrārthaḥ iti nyāyena vidhīnāṃ caritārthtavaṃ ca syāt|
nanu dhruvānusmṛtiriti brahmopāsanasya dhruvatvamucyata ityāśaṅkya tadapyanthāsiddhamāhasamyaktvāditi |
atra pratikṣipati asāra miti| asāratvameva nyāyato darśayati samānyeti | sāmānya vyavahārasyasākāṅkṣasya viśeṣopasthāpakapramāṇāntare sati cchāgapaśunyāyena viśeṣe eva viśrāntisiddhiḥ | etasyārthasya vedanadhyānopāsanadhruvānusmṛtidarśanaśabdānāṃ bhaktiviśrāntipratipādake bhāṣyopakramagranthe vistareṇoktatvadatra saṅgaheṇāmumarthaṃ prācīkaśat||
ve danasya dhyānatve nyāyāntaramapi puraskṛtya tasyaiva vedanasya sevārūpatvenopāsanatvamapyupapādayan bhāṣyatāvuktaṃ vidyupāsyorvyatikareṇopakramopasaṃhāramapi darśayitvā bhaktimeva mokṣopāyatayā nigamayan dhruvānusmṛteranyatra bhaktiśabdaprayogaḥ aupacārika iti cāha kiñceti | ayamatra śabdānyaḥ āgneyyāgnīdhramupatiṣṭate ityatra āgneyīśabdaḥ prakṛtāgneyīmevopādatte| evaṃ brahma veda brahmaiva
ityādau vedanaśabdassamānaprakaṇopāktaṃ dhyānameva darśayati| nanūpāsanaṃ mokṣopāya ityadhyātmavidbhirucyate tatkathaṃ dhyānaṃ mokṣopāya ityāśaṅkyopāsanaśabdasya dhyāna eva paryavasānaṃ darśayatidhyāna iti| dhyāna
evopāsanoktiḥ parabhajanarūpatvena sevātmakatvaṃ guṇaviśeṣamāhetyarthaḥ| dhyānamiti cintanamātram| tatra corasarpādiviṣayamapi dhyānameva| atastadvayāvṛttyarthamanukūlaviṣayānusandhānamatropāsanaśabdena pratipādyata iti bhāvaḥ| vidyupāsyoraikārthye " atha yonyāṃ devatāmupāste anyo'sāvanyo'hamasmīti na sa veda akṛtsnaḥ hyeṣa ātmetyevopāsīta" iti vyatikaritatayā śrūyamāṇaḥ prayoga eva pramāṇam|
nanu "śravaṇaṃ kīrtanam" ityādau navavidhā bhaktirucyate upāsanañca tanmadhye'bhidhīyate tatkathaṃ dhruvānusmṛtireva
bhaktirūpatvamityāśaṅkya bhakte pūrvoktabhāvinorapi bhaktiśabdaprayoga aupacārika iti nigamayati kārya iti|kvacitkārye kāraṇavadupacāraḥ kvacicca kāraṇe kāryavadupacāra iti na saṅkaṭaṃ kiñcit|
bhaktibhadatvavādaḥ bhaktiviśeṣatvavāda ityarthaḥ||
nanu "bhaktyā tvananyā śakyaḥ"iti bhaktireva parabrahmaprāptirūpamokṣasādhanatayā smaryate sā tu yamaivaiṣa
vṛṇate tena labhyaḥ ityādiśrutyā bādyate tena śrutismṛtyorvirodhānnārthaviśeṣapratipattirityāśaṅkāṃ vārayan śrutismṛtyoranyonyānūkūlyameva darśayati yogo dyutakteṣviti|iyamatraśabdānvayaprakriyāyogodyukteṣvadhikāriṣu
yaḥ syād bhagavadvāraṇaviṣayabhūtaḥ tenaiva labhyaḥ paramātmā| tasya ca paramātmanā varaṇīyatavaṃ paramātmapriyatvādeva| tadapi
priyatvaṃ tanniṣṭātbhaktirūpāt guṇādeva| evañca sati bhaktireva sākṣācchayate|
tanniṣṭhā hi guṇatveṇābhihiteyaṃ bhaktiḥ kvacidatiśayite prītyātmikā dhīriti|ata eva bhaktipratipādaka
smṛtyabādhasyāt| śrutismṛtyoḥ parasparasaṃvādāt| smṛtirhi bhaktirityāha | śrutirapi tāmeva bhakiṃta bhagavadviṣayaprītirūpāṃ "yamevaiṣa vṛṇute tena labhyaḥ"iti phalato darśayati sma| tarhi bhaktitarityucyate bhavatā dhruvānusmṛtiriti śrutirāha tatra kathmavirodha ityāśaṅkyeyameva bhaktitastailadhārāvacchinnatvād dhruvānusmṛti rityucyata iti darśayati pro kteti| anuvahanāt anusyūtatvādityarthaḥ||
nanu bhavatā nidatyāsitavyaḥ iti dhyānasyaikasyaiva mokṣopāyatyāvidheyastvamucyate vidhiśravaṇaṃ tu
draṣṭavyaśśrotavyaḥ mantavyaḥ nidityāsitavyaḥ iti catuṣvartheṣu dṛśayate tatkathamityāśaṅkya viṣayabhedena
vidhitvānuvādatvavibhāgaṃ darśayatirāgāditi| ayamarthaḥ śravaṇamananayoḥ tāvatprāpta viṣayatvād rāgādeva pravṛtti| aprāptatvānnididhyāsanamekameva vidheyam| nanu kathaṃ draṣṭavya iti śabde jāgrati dhyānamekaṃ vidheya mityāśaṅkyaṃ pariharatitatreti|draṣṭavyaitiśabdasyaiva dhyānasya guṇabhutaṃ darśanasamānākāratvameva
darśayati| napunardhyānādanyasya darśanaśabdavācyasyasya kasyacinmokṣopāyatvaṃ darśayatītyarthaḥ|ayamatra bhāvaḥkvacit dhruvāspṛtiḥ| smṛtilambhe sarvagranthīnāṃ vipramokṣaḥ iti dhruvānusmṛtergatanthivimokṣopāyatvamuktam|
aparatra bhidyate hṛdayagranthiśchidyate sarvasaṃśayāḥ| kṣīyante cāsya karmāṇitasmindṛṣṭe parāvare||
iti darśanasya granthivimokṣopāyatvamuktam| nātrasmaraṇadarśanayornirapekṣamokṣopāyatayā pṛthageva vihitayoḥsamuccayassaṃbhavati| nairapekṣyaśravaṇādeva| nāpi vikalpaḥgurulaghvorvikalpānupapatte|
tena smaraṇasya darśanasya paryavāsānaṃ kṛtvā dvayorapyekatveṇa granthivimokṣopāyatvaṃ vaktavyam|atra
darśayati darśanamiti darśanasamānādhikaraṇa ucyate| tattu smṛtivaiśadyaṃ punassākṣāddarśanatvaṃm| smṛtitvadarśanatvayorviruddajātitvenaikatraiva sāmānyayogāt| evaṃ nirṇīte śāstrārthe draṣṭavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ ityātrāpi nidityāsanasya vaiśadyātiśayāddarśanatvamupacaryate| apakṛṣaṭe hyutkṛṣṭaśabde
aupacārikaḥ| yathā rājabhṛtye rājaśabdaḥ| evamatrāpya sākṣātkārarūpe śvayaṃ smṛtyātmaṇi nidhityāsane
darśanaśabdena sākṣātkāratvamupacaryate| ekatra nirṇītasya śāstrārthasyetaratrāpi grāhyatvāt| atra vedanasya
draṣṭavyapadānusāreṇa śabdajanyapratyakṣaviṣayatvaṃ daśamastvamasītyādinadi vadanti tānanūdya dūṣayati śabdottha miti | vyāghātātiprapañca itiatra svavyāghātassarvalokaviroghaḥ pramāṇalakṣaṇavibhāghavirodhaḥ ityādiśabdena gṛhyate| pratyakṣaṃ śabdajanyamiti vacanameva virudhyate|
evamanyadapi draṣṭavyam| tarhi daśamatvamasītyatra pratyakṣotpattiḥ katham tatra na pratyakṣotpattiḥ| api tu yavākyātparokṣajñāne sañjāte svayameva parāmarśātmakaṃ pratyakṣasāmagrīyutthāpaneva bhavati tatastvātmaṇi daśamatvaviṣayaṃ mānasaṃ pratyakṣaṃ jāyata iti na parasparaṃ pramāṇasaṅkaraprasaṅka iti| tamimarthaṃ darśayati
amiṣāmiti| nipaṇairantevāsibhissūkṣmaṃ vicāraṇīya ityāha nipuṇaiti | atra nipuṇatvaṃ pramāṇavibhāgadarśanakuśalatvam||
nanu bhavatpakṣe darśanasamānākāramātrakathanād draṣṭavyaitiśabda aupacārikassyāditi parapakṣiṇokte
tadaṅgīkṛtya tvatpakṣe'pyaupacārika eveti pratibandhā pariharati  dhyāna iti| ayamarthaḥ dhyāne
vaiśadhyamātrād ddaṣṭiśabdapravṛttirupacaraṇa vatītīmamarthamaṅgīkurmahe| tattūpacaraṇaṃ bhavatpakṣe'pi tulyamityāha
tulya miti| tadeva vivṛṇoti abhilapatī ti| ddaṣṭiśabdo hi cākṣuṣīmeva dhiyaṃ brūte| brahmaṇi tu na
cākṣuṣī ddaṣṭiḥ, apitu mānasī| tasyāmaupacārikaddaṣṭau ddaṣṭiśabdo na mukhya iti tavāpi tulyamityarthaḥ|
tulyatvameva saddaṣṭāntaṃ darśayati ghrāte ti|yathā ghrātā spraṣṭetyādiśabdo brahmaviṣaye tattadindriyajanyā
ghrāṇādikāryavidhure na prayoktuṃ śakyate evaṃ cakṣurjanyajñānaviṣayabhūtabrahmajñānavati draṣṭṛśabdo'pi mukhyatayā
prayoktumeva na śakyate tathā ca draṣṭavyaitipadasya gauṇatvaṃ tavāpi samānam| tarhi yatrobhayossamo doṣa
iti nyāyena dvayoḥ pakṣayostulyatve yuṣmatpakṣa eva parigrāhyo na punarasmatpakṣa iti vinigamanāyāṃ ko hetuḥ
ityāśaṅkya viṣeśamāha taditi| tayosvatpakṣāsmatpakṣayostulyabhāve sati| athavā taditi hetunirdeśaḥ|
tasmāt evamupapādanādityarthaḥ| bahunayagaṇavāna smatpakṣo bahunyāyopetaḥ| yuṣmatpakṣastvapanyāyamūla ityarthaḥ|
tu śabdo viśeṣameva darśayati||
nanvatra vedanāt dhyānaṃ dhyānād dhruvānusmṛtiḥ dhruvānusmṛterdarśanaṃ darśanād bhaktiriti dvāradvāri bhāva
evāstvityāśaṅkyaikatra viśrāntau sambhavantyāṃ tatparikalpanaṃ gauravātanyāyyamityāha nadvāreti| ayamatra
śabdānvayaḥ viśeṣe viśramaścenna dvāradvāriklṛptiḥ kathamapi ghaṭate| tarhi vedanādīnāṃ bhaktiparyantānāṃ
vikalpassyādityāśaṅkya tadapi netyāha  samānyātme ti| nahi sāmānyaviśeṣayorvikalpaḥ parigṛhyate
nyāya vidbhiḥ| yathā paśucchāgayoḥ| apitvekasyānyatra paryavasnameva svīkriyate| kiñca garuladhvorvikalpa
eva na saṃbhavatītyāha laghvi ti| nahi snānaprokṣamayorekasminnadhikāriṇi vikalpassvīkriyate nyāyavidbhiḥ| tarhi śaktāśaktabhedena tatra vikalpavadatrāpi vikalpaḥ kalpyatāmiti cettadapi na; vikalpe
tāvadaṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvaṃ doṣaḥ| adhunā punarvyavasthitavilpatvaparigrahe'dhikārivyavasthāparikalpanamadhikadoṣaḥ|
sarveṣvapi vākyeṣu mumukṣutvamevādhikāriviśeṣaṇatvena śrūyate| napunarekaikaṃ viśeṣaṇamanyadanyadaivākarṇyata
ityarthaḥ| nacātra śaktāśaktābhedena vikalpaḥ aśravaṇāt| aśrutamapi kalpyata iti cet kalpanaiva doṣaḥ|
tadidamāha karturaikya iti| bhinnādhikāritve nirṇīte vyavasthitavikalpatvaṃ yujyetāpi| napunaratra bhinnādhikāritvaṃ nirṇītamityarthaḥ| tarhi dhruvānusmṛtau darśanatvamupacartamiti bhavatoktam, darśane dhruvānusmṛtitva
mupacaritamiti viparītaṃ kiṃ na syādityāśaṅkyāha arthaikya iti| upacāro hyanyatrātiśayitārthābhidhānena guṇīkaraṇam| tattu dhyāne tadadhikārthābhidhāne yujyate siṃho devadatta
ityādivat, tena smaraṇe sākṣātkāratvavacanamupacārassyāt| sākṣātkāre smaraṇatvābhidhānaṃ tvapacāra eva
syāt| rājani bhṛtyatvakathanavat| tena dhyānena sākṣātkāratvamupacaryata ityayameva nyāyyo mārgaḥ|
ayamatra śabdānvaya arthaikye sati darśanoktyā spāṣṭyasiddhyai smṛtirūpacaritā yujyate|
smṛtyuktyā darśanasyopacaraṇaṃ tu asat anyāyyam| nanu draṣṭavya iti phalameva brahmasākṣātkāra ucyate na
punarupāya ityāśaṅkyamāha anyaditi | sa punaḥ pareṣāmeva siddhāntaḥ, asmākaṃ tu draṣṭavyaḥ iti vidhiśravaṇāt vidheyamevopasānaṃ darśana samānākāratvonocoyata iti siddhānta ityarthaḥ||
evaṃ bhūtasya bhagavadanusmaraṇayogasya prāyaścittānyaśeṣāṇi iti pramāṇoktasya dvayī hi gatiradhyātmavidbhirabhidhīyate| tattatprāyaścittarūpakṛcchrāśaktau tattsthāne vikalpenāvatiṣṭate so'yaṃ yoga
ityekā gatiḥ| aparā punassarveṣāmapi prāyascittānāṃ sādguṇyāpādakatvena bhagavadanusandhānaṃ tebhyassarvebhyaḥ
prāyaścittebhyaḥ paramutkṛṣṭamiti| atra punaranādikālapravṛttasya kṛtsyāpi pāpasya sarvaprāyaścittatvenedamekamevābhidhīyate| tadidamāhakṛcchrādāviti| tattatpāpaprāyaścittatayā vihite kṛcchrādau śaktihīnau dṛḍhaparitapano dṛḍhānutāpayuktassaṃyamārhaśca yogānuṣṭānarhaśca svayaṃ sarvaprāyaśacittasthānīyaṃ keśavānusmṛtiṃ kuriyāditi "prāyaśacittānyaśeṣāṇi"iti ślokasyaikau'rthaḥ|
atra paratvamekasyaiva sarveṣvapi prāyascitteṣu vikalpenāvāsthitatvam| yathārhaṃ tadvikalpaḥ yāni yāni bahuni prāyaścittāni dṛśyante teṣāmekasyasthāne yāvatkeśavānusmaraṇaṃ phalapradhānasamarthaṃ tāvat tatra tatra
kartavyamiti|arthāntaraṃ punarāha sāmānyāditi| sāmānyāt sarveṣvapi doṣeṣu prasakteṣu tattannemiktikānāṃ sarveṣāmapi keśavānusmaraṇaṃ pradhānasahakāritvenopakurute| asminpakṣe paratvamekasya
sarvopakārakatvaṃ sarvasmādapyutkṛṣṭatvañca| evaṃ "prāyaścittāni "iti ślokasyārthadvayamuktvā sūtrakārābhipretaṃ sarvapradhānabhūtamarthāntaramāha  mukte riti| keśavānusmaraṇaṃ na kevalamekaikasya prayaścittasya sthāne'vatiṣṭhate, nāpi sarvaṣāmapi prayaścittānāṃ sahakāritvenāpi kevalaṃ vāvatiṣṭhate, apitu svayamekamevānādisiddhānāmanantānāṃ duṣkṛtānāṃ prayaścittatvenāvatiṣṭhata iti sūtrakārābhiprāyaḥ|
mukterapyatra mūlaṃ na kevalamaniṣṭanivṛtteḥ, aniṣṭanivṛttipūrvakeṣṭapraptirūpa mukterapū dameva mūlamityarthaḥ||
atra śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prapannā ye iti śloke śaraṇāgatameva sarvaprāyaścittatvena paramapadaprāptihetutvena ca
vidhānādupāsanātmakasya yogasya kathaṃ sarvaprāyaścittatvamityāśaṅkya śaktāśaktarūpādhikāribhedena dvayorapi
sarvaprāyascittatvaṃ draḍhayati nanvevamiti| ayamarthaḥ  ye mukundaṃ śaraṇamupagatā dhyānayogairvarjitāste'pi mṛtyamatikramya yaminaiva yogina iva paraṃdhāma yantīti śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ
prapannā ye dhyānayogavivarjitāḥ| tepimṛtyumatikramya yānti tadvaiṣṇavaṃ padam| ityucyate tatkathaṃ dhyānayogasya upāyatvamiti| atrārdhāṅgīkāreṇottaramāha satyamiti| astu śaraṇāgatermokṣopāyatvaṃ tathāpiyogasyāpi
mokṣopāyatvamatraivocyate te'pi mṛtyumati kramya ityapiśabdasāmarthyāt| nahi ta eva mṛtyumatikrāmyeti
sāvadhāraṇamucyate| apitu te'pītyapiśabdānvayena| tataśca śaraṇāgatāśca vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yānti tathā yoganiṣṭāśceti vākyābhiprāyassyāt| tasmādidameva vākyaṃ yoganiṣṭānāṃ prathamaṃ vaiṣṇanapadagamanamuktvā
tadvat śaraṇāgatānāmapi vaiṣṇavapadagamaṇaṃ vaktīti na yoganiśṭhānāmapavargaphalaprāptiṃ pratikṣipatīti na kaścidapi virodhaḥ | niyataviṣayayorityāti  śaktasyārgurvanuṣṭānamaśaktasya laghvanuṣṭhānamiti gaurave
lādhave'pi śaktāśaktaviṣayatā niyataviṣayayossatoḥ praṇidhisahadaśāyogibhiryogavidbhidhyānaśāstraṃ prāptārtham arvadityarthaḥ| śaktaireva gurutaradhyānaśāstramanuṣṭeyamityuktam||
varṇāśramadharmāṇāṃ yathāntaḥkaraṇanairmalyanirvṛttidvāreṇopāsanahetutvam, tathāṅgaprapatterapi tenaiva dvāreṇopāsana hetutvamastīti sapramāṇakamāha  dharma iti| śabdānvayastu varṇādiyogyo dharmo hṛdayakāluṣyaśamanena
sattvābhivṛddhyā yathā bhaktyu pakāri tadvatprapattirapyagatikasamaye ṣvananyasādhyatvasamayeṣvantarāyāpahantrī
bhavati| ayaṃ kila prapattessvabhāvaḥ sānukrośe kṛpāyukte śakte purūṣe śaraṇavaraṇatassasarvasādhayaṃ sarvamapyabhīṣṭaṃ susudhāyati| tataśca mokṣasādhanabhūtopāsanāśaktau prapaktitatsthāne sthitvā mokṣameva sādhayati|upāsanāṅgabhūtakarmayogādyaśaktau tu karmayogādisthāne sthitvopāsanameva sādhayati| tadidamubhayamapi śruterabhipretamityabhiprāyena vadati mokṣākāṅkṣī ti| mumukṣurvai śaraṇamahaṃ prapadye
iti kvacinmatre śrūyate| idamaṅgaprapattiviṣayatayā vā svatantaraprapattiviṣayatayo vā yathābhimataṃ yojayituṃ
śakyamityarthaḥ||
pūrvaṃ parabrahmopāsanamasakṛtāvṛttaṃ kartavyamityuktam| idaṃ punaridānīṃ cintyate  kimupāsyaṃ brahma upāsituranyatvenopāsyamupāsyamutopāsiturātmatveneti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ| ayameva vicārastadarthavicāropakramaḥ kimātnatvenopāsane pṛthagātmānam iti vihitapṛthaktvāvisandhanavirodhaḥ prasajyate neti| tatra pūrvapakṣamāhajīvāditi| sādhanāntaissādhaparyavasānairlakṣaṇairadhyāyairjīvādatyantabhinnassa ca vibhurityabhidate sa paramapuruṣaḥ| tasmādasminnaṇurupajīvabuddhistattvataḥ kartubheva na śakyata ityarthaḥ|
nanu garūḍamātmānaṃ jānīyāditi nyāyena svātmani paramātmadṛṣṭissyāśaṅkya tadapi netyāhamukyartheti
ayamarthaḥkṣudraphalaprāptau hi dṛṣṭividhīnāmupayogaḥ atra tu muktyarthopāsane muṣitatamasi sarvājñānanivṛttiyukte viparītajñānarūpānyatrāndṛṣṭirna syāditi| tena svābhipretaṃ nigamayatitatvajña iti|
tatvajñe yathārthajñānavati vītarāge phalāntaraprāptirāghavidhure so'hamasamītyupāstirna syādeva| tadidaṃ pratikṣipatitanneti| ayamarthaḥyadi svātmaparamātmanossvarūpaikeyamatropadiśyate tadā bhrāntitvānna muktihetuḥ yadi ca svātmaniparamātmadṛṣṭirupadiṣyate, tadodgīthopasanādivat dṛṣṭividhitvādapavargasādhanaṃ
na syāt| nedamubhayamapyatropadiśyate api tu svāntaryāmitvebhagavatanusandhānaṃ tacca paramārthaviṣayatnācitve mukhyavṛttirna syādityāśaṅkya pratikṣipati mukyapravṛtteriti | ayamarthaḥyathā dehavācī devamanuṣyādiśabdaḥ
dehādhiṣṭātari jīvepi makhya eva pravartate, evaṃ jīvavācyahaṃśabdaḥ jīvāntaryāmiṇi paramātmaṇi mukhayatayā
pravartata iti|yadi brāhmaṇakṣatriyādiśabdaḥ jīve'pi na mukhyessyāt tadā brāhmaṇatvakṣatriyatavādyupahitādhikāriviśeṣopādānena pravṛttānāṃ vidhīnāmamuktānāṃ syāt tathā cārthavādamantrayorapi tattadaupādhikākāpaviśiṣṭapuruṣaviṣayatayā pravṛttayoramukyatvaṃ syāditi sarvavedavākye mukhyatvaparityāga iti sāhasametat||
atrāhaṅgrahopāsanasya prayojanābhāvaṃ vadataḥ kasyacit tatprayojanaviśeṣaṃ darśayati vasvindrāderiti|
ayamatra codakasyābhiprāyaḥkimatrāhaṅgrahopāsanābhidhāne viśeṣaprayojanam?acidviśiṣṭasvātmaviśiṣṭaparamātmopāsānañcet tad vasvindrāderupāsti prasaṅge prāgevoktam|
śuddhaśca svātmākvaciccintyaḥ prakṛtisaṃsargarahitaśśuddho'pyātmā kvaciccintanīya eva|iha tu śuddhena
svenayukto vibhuḥ paramātmā cintya eva| tādṛśā śudghenetyarthaḥ| tadidaṃjīnaparayorbhedacintanamevaaham
tvam, iti tayorbhedena vyapadeśāt| jīvaśabhede ca vyaktirabhivyaktirvyadhikaraṇapadaiścintane syat na
punassamānādhikaraṇapadaiścintane|tathācāhaṅgrahopāsane kiṃ phalam? iti | atroktam tathāpīti| yadyapi tvaduktaṃ yuktameva tathā'pi brahma paratantra svarūpapramitessudṛḍhatā ahaṅgrahopāsanādeva bhavati
tadarthamahaṅgrahoktissaphalaiveti||
parapakṣeṣvahaṅgūhopāsanasya nyāyaviruddhatvamuktvā svapakṣe punarnyāyopetatvaṃ darśayatiaikyostāviti|
tatra tāvanmṛṣāvādipakṣe dūṣaṇamāha nirveśeṣa iti| nirviśeṣa vastuni "tvaṃ vā ahamasmi bhagavo devataṃ ahaṃ vai tvamasi"iti tvamahaṃśabdārthabhāvena tvamahamitisamānādhikaraṇabuddhiḥ kathaṃ syāt| tarhi
bhadābhedameva bhaskaramatānusāreṇa vadāma iti cet so'pi na mukhya eva karakamaṇika yorbheda evākāśe tvabheda eva ekatra bhadaścābhadāśca nāstīti bhedābhadābhivalāpo na mukhya eva| tarhi sāmyamevāhaṃśabdenābhidīyata ityapara āha tatpakṣa'pyahaṃvyavahāro na mukhya evetyāha  muttulya iti|
tvaṃ vā ahamasmi bhagavaḥ devate ahaṃ vai tvamasi ityatra tulyatvaṃ śabdārtha iti vadatāmupacāra eva parigṛhītassyāt sa tu na yukta eva | evaṃ parapakṣaṃ dūṣayitvā savapakṣameva somapaktikaṃ nigamayatitasmāditi| sarvāntarātacmanī ti sāmānādhikaraṇyabījamucyate | śarīrātmabhāva eva hi sāmānādhikaraṇyanidānam|yathā dehini dehavīcī manuṣyādiśabdassāmānādhikaraṇyena prayujyate evamantaryāmiṇi jīvaśabdassāmanādhikaraṇyena prapujyata iti sarvaṃ sughaṭitameveti||
atra tvaṃ vā ahasmi bhagavo devate ityasnvākye dvaitaprasaṅgaeva nāsti dvaitasya srūpasūnyatvāt kevalamadvaitameva pratipādyata iti vadantaṃ mṛṣāvādinaṃ pratikṣipati advaitami ti| ayamatra vikalpaḥ
advaitaśabdena dvaitavirodhaḥ vā dvaitānyo vā dvaitabhāvo vā abhidhīyate athavā na kiñcidabhidhīyate tatra triṣvapi vikalpeṣu pratiyogyabhāvena trayaṇāmapyarthānāmasiddhiḥ pratiyogisadbhāve tasyāpi siddhiḥ na kiñciditi pakṣe nirarthakameva vacanaṃ syāt tenādvaitamitivadatastavāvaśyameva dvaitamaṅgīkartavyam||ayamatra śabdārthaḥ dvaitahānāvadvaitamiti vacanaṃ na suvacaṃ dvaitapratidvandvikatvāt| evamadvaitahānau dvaitamapi na suvacamiti prasaṅgadāha dvaitañcādvaitagarbha miti| advaitābhāve dvaitamapi na syāt|ekayorivā hi dvitvaṃ vartate tayorekatavameva hyadvaitamiti bhāvaḥ|tadeva vivṛṇotidvityamiti|dvitvāśrayabhūtamekaikaṃ vastu svasvarūpādabhinnam| tena tatrādvaitasiddhirityarthaḥ| apara āha dvaita mābhūt advaitaṃ ca mābhūt dvaitādvaitamevāṅgīkāromiti, tadapi netyāṅa dvaitādvaitamiti| kiṃ dvaitādvaitaśabdena dvaitādvaitayossamāhāra ucyate atavānyo yaḥ kaścidarthābhāsaḥ tatra tatsamāhāravacane dvaitalakṣaṇamadvaitalakṣaṇañcāṅgīkṛtya vaktavyam|tathā ca tadubhayaniyamānujjhānāt tadvacane dvaitañca sidhyatyadvaitañca sidyati| tadujjhane
susthamevobhayamapi |yasya kasyacidaretaibhāsasyoktau śṛṇavatāṃ na kācitkṣatiḥ| tarhi dvaitādikaṃ sarvaṃ sādhayatāṃ bhavatāṃ kiṃ tatvamaṅkīkṛtaṃ syadityāśaṅkya pramāṇānanusāriṇāṃ tu sarvamapyatatvamiti nigamayati sarvamati||
