api tu tadapi brahmopāsanaṃ kutrāpi śrutau prāyaṇāntaṃ vihitaṃ " prāyaṇāntamoṅgāramabhidhyāyīta " iti||
" evaṃ vidyāsvarūpaṃ viśedhya vidyāphalaṃ cintayitumārabhate"iti bhāṣyam|iyaṃ tu peṭikāsaṅagatiḥ|ayamāśa
yaḥbrahmavidyāsvarupasya niratisāyanandarūpatvena phalapakṣanipekṣepārhatvāt tatsvalarūpaśodhanamapi phalādhaye
saṅgatamiti|tadarthavicārastukimaśleṣavināśaśāstrayorabhuktakarmāparikṣayaśāstrasya ca virodha eva
utāvarodhassambhavatīti|kimaśleṣavināśaśāstraṃ mokṣasādhanabhutavidyābhidhāyivākyaśeṣagataṃ vidyāstutivādaparatvena netuṃ śakyate neti|atra pūrvapakṣoktipūrvakaṃ siddhāntamātaṣaṭe nābhukta miti|"nābhuktaṃ
kṣīyate karma kalapakoṭiśatairapi "iti phalabhogāt vinā karma na supariharamiti munīndrai rgītam|
tena pāpāleṣaśruti stadvināśaśrutiśca tata eva hetorbrāhmavidāṃ vaibhavokiṃtassayāt| uktaṃ pakṣaṃ dūṣayatimaivamiti|tadevopapādayati nābhuktamiti nābhuktamitiyādikamakṛtāprayaścittatvāt karmaṇā phaliṣyantītyāśaṅkya pariharati prāyaciktakrameṇeti| ayamarthaḥdvividhaṃ khalu prāyaściktaṃ pratipādikaṃ
sarvaprāyaścittañceti| viśeṣatastattannimiktaparijñāne pratipādikaṃ prāyaściktaṃ kartavyam|sāmānyataḥ parijñāne
tu sarvaprāyaścittameva prāmāṇarvihitaṃ karatavyam| kṛṣṇānusmaraṇaṃ param |iti kṛtsnaprāyaścittasthānīyatayā kṛṣṇānusmaraṇameva pramāṇairvihitam| tatra śucirbhavati saṃsmṛtyā ityādikaṃ sahasmapyaitihāsasikaṃ paurāṇikamāgamikaṃ smārtañca vacanajātaṃ pāṭhyām | nahi bahūnāṃ sannipāte nābhaktamityekaṃ vākyaṃ sorapabṛṇaśrutiviruddhaṃ svayamatiṣṭate| na khalu mārjāro bhavati mātaṅgaśatasya parispardhīti||
parabrahmopāsanasya sarvapāpaprāyaścittātmakatvamuktaṃ lakṣaṇato'pi pradarśayan pāpalepaviṣayamapi pariśodhayati niṣkṛtīti | asya brahmopāsanasya prāyaścittātmakatvamutapannaduritasamunmūlātmakatvā upapannameva| idameva hi pārayaścittasya lakṣaṇamitayarthaḥ| nanvastu brahmopāsanaṃ prāyaścittaṃ, athāpi
svarghādi puruṣārtha sāghanānuṣṭānavadasaṅkucitabrahmānubhavarūpajñānavikāsārthaṃ sādhanāntaramanuṣṭeyaṃ
syādityāśaṅkyapratikṣipati nātreti| tadeva sthāpayati pratihativigama iti|ayaṃ bhāvaḥsvargādyanubhavo
hi karmarūpopādhiprayaktatvādasvābhāvikaḥ| tena sādhanānuṣṭānamapekṣate| brahmaprāptistu sarveṣāmapyātmanāṃ svābhāvikī| athāpi keṣāñcitanādipāpapravāhavaśādanādipratibandhavati| pratibandhābhāve svayamevāvirbhavati|
ata evocyate yathā na krayate jyotsnā malaprakṣālanānmaṇeḥ| doṣaphāṇānna jñānamātmanaḥ kriyate tathā|
evañca svargādibhyaḥ vaiṣamyaṃ parabrahmaprāpteḥ, na hi prāmāṇaprātipannetyarthaḥ na viśvaśanīyam kiñcidasti|
yaktyābhāsastu pramāṇaviruddhatvāt vādenādaranīyaḥ| atra hiśabdaḥ prasidiṃdha darśayati| yathā dīpāderāvāraka
ghaṭādyapagamane prakāśavikāsasvata eva, evamātmaneti pratibandhakābhāve dharmabhatajñīnavikīsa ityarthaḥ|atra
kaściccodayatiyadi brahmavidāṃ pāpātestarhi teṣāmutpathapravṛttireva syāditi, atrāhapāpatepa iti|pramādikapāpālepa eva brahmavidāmasmābhirucyate na punarbuddhipūrvakapāpālepaḥ| tat kimarthamityatrāha ājñānuvṛtyā iti | śrutismṛti mamaivājñā ityadhyātmavidāmapi bhagavatājñarūpa śrutismṛtyanuliṅganasya bhagavataivoktatvādityarthaḥ| evamanaṅgikāre nāviroto duścaritāt iti vacansyagatirnasyāt| yogināñca niyameva svādhikaranānuṣṭānurūpapravṛtteca gatirna syāt| cakārasamuccayārthaḥ| bhrāntatvaṃ nāṭayanbharato'pi
satāṃ mārgamadūṣayan iti sanmārgavartitvena hyucyate||
atrāśleṣavināśaśabdayorarthaviśeṣaṃ dareśayitvā brahmavidyāyāmttarādhaṃ prayāpi prāyascittatvamākṣipya samādhate aśleṣa iti| atra karmaśakteranudayo'śleṣaḥ udaye tannavṛttirvināśaḥ iha karmaśaktirapi praṇetussarvaneturbhagavatastattatkarmocitaphalakṛnnigraṅaveva tena na siddhāntavirodhaḥ| tadidamāha śakti rityādinā | atra kenaciduktānāṃ śaṅkāṃ nivārayati prayāścittamiti| abuddhipūrvakasyottarāghasāyopāyānuṣṭhānadaśāyamutpattireva nāsti anutpannasya pāpasya kathamitaṃ brahmavidyā prāyaścittamici codakābhiprāyaḥ| imāṃ pratikṣipati naivānuyojya miti| ananuyojyatvameva darśayatinadharma iti| brahmavidyāniṣṭasya tasyābuddhipūrvottarādhe pāpameva na syaditi brahmavidyāyāssarvapāpaprāyaścittatvaṃ vadatāṃ hṛdaya mityarthaḥ||
evamabaddhipūrvoktarādhamuktvā buddhipūrvottarādhasyādhyātmavitsu keṣucidanutpattimaparetpannasya prāyaścittamanyeṣu keṣucidaprāyaścitte'pyāśūpabhogamupapādayan sarvāthāpi bhāgavatasya sāparādasyapi kramaśo
mukiṃta darśayatidhīpūrva miti| sarvadā sāvadāno brahmavit buddhipūrvamuktarādhaṃ na sṛjatyeva|madhyamastu brahmavit jātaṃ pāpaṃ prāyaśaacittena kṣipatītyāha jāta miti|aparo'pi brahmavit na khalu bhāgavatā yamaviṣayaṃ gacchati| ihaivaiṣāṃ kecidupaplavā bhavanti kāṇā bhavanti khañjā bhavanti ityādiśrutyaktaprākāreṇa pratipadaprāyaścittākāraṇe laghudaṇjamupabhuñjīta| idaṃ tadu vṛtrāsuraprabhṛtiṣu dṛṣṭameva | vṛtraḥ khalu bhāgavataḥ, athāpi kenāpyapacāreṇāsuraṃ dehaṃ prāptastatrāpi jātisvabhāvāddevaprakṛtīnāṃ
aparādhaṃ kurvannaparādhānurūpopabhogamapyante perāpya bhagavantameva dhyāya nnabhimataphalaṃ prāptavāniti porāṇikī prasiddhiḥ| nanvathāpyaparādhaśatamanutiṣṭataścedirādasyākṛtaprāyaścittasya kathamiva brahmaprāpti rabhūdityāśaṅkya tatrāpi prāconasukṛtavaśaidante kṛṣmāvatārakāvye
sukṛtena purākṛtena cadyaḥ pratipannaprakṛtirvilīnavairaḥ|
kṣaṇamadbhutakṛṣṇarūpadarśīṃ śithilākṛṣṭaśilīmukhā'vatasthe||
iti| tadidamāha niyativibhavata iti| astu siddhaḥ, athāpyadyaiva vā kālāntare vā siddhirityāśaṅkya prācīnakarmānurūpabhagavsaṃkalpānuvidhānenāniyamena phalasidiṃdhakila bhagavānbādarāyaṇo manyata ityāha  adyaiveti||
pūrvaṃ pāpasyāśleṣavināśāvuktau adhunā sukṛtasyāpyaśleṣavināśāvucyete ityātideśikā saṅgatiḥ|tadarthavicārastuuttarapurvasukṛtayoraśleṣavināśau kiṃ sambhavato neti|kiṃ"pāpaṃ karma na śliṣyate" "sarve pāpmānaḥ pradūyante"iti vākyadvayaṃ sukṛtaduṣakṛtāślaṣavināśaparamuta duṣkṛtamātrāśleṣavināśaparam|kimatra pāpakarmaśabdo niṣiddhapara uta vidyāvirodhaphalakarmaparaḥ|"sarve pāpmānaḥ"iti vākyaṃ kiṃ pāpmaśabdasya vidyāvirodhiphalakarmaparatāmavagamayati neti|atra pūrva pakṣamāha dharmasye ti| parabhajanānugraheṇā nukapalasya dharmasyāślanaivopapannau| anupapattau hetumāha tasye ti|nahi sarvalokaviditasya dharmasya pāpatvamupapadyate|
tadā puṇyapāpavyavasthānupapattiprasaṅgāt|kiñca śrutirapyāha adhyātmavit puṇyaphalaṃ sakalamapyanubhūya paścādapavargaṃ prāpsyatīti| tadidamāha bhāgai riti|tadetat pratiśripati neti| tatra hetumāha yata iti|
asyā dhyātmavidaḥ kāmyamapi pāpa meva|nanu kāmyasya sukṛtasya pāpatvavacanaṃ sāhameva nahi karmācarato'pi
karmaṭhān pāpina iti vadanti prājñāḥ tena kāmyasya karmaṇaḥ pāpatvamatisāhasamevetyāśaṅkyaṃ pariharati tasminni ti|loke hi sarvatra yasmin yallakṣaṇaṃ dṛśyate tadeva tacchabdena vyavahriyate|gavādiṣabdā ghaṭādiśabdāśca tattallakṣaṇānurodhena vyavahriyante vidvadbhiḥ|atrāpi kāmyeṣu karmasvadhikāribhedena kālabhedenāvasthābhedena pāpameva puṇyaṃ puṇyameva pāpamitiniyamasya sarvalokaprasiddhatvāt kāmyaṃ karmādhyātmavidāṃ pāpameva| upavarga eva khalvadhyātmavidāmabhimataḥ|
tadvirodhi hi svargādyupabhogaḥ| ata eva svargādirnarakatayocyate nārayaṇaparāṇāṃ| ete vai nirasyāstāta sthāsya paramātmanaḥ, arthakāmaparā yūyaṃ nārāyaṇaparā vayam itayādinā vacanānyatra prāmāṇam| na kevalaṃ lakṣaṇādeva kāmyakarmāṇāṃ pāpatvamasmābhirucyate na sakṛtaṃ na duṣkṛtaṃ sarve pāpmāno'to nivartante ityādiśrutirapi kāmyakarmaṇaḥ pāpatvaṃ kaṇṭhoktyā prakaṭayati darśayati na sakṛta miti||
atra pāpavat puṇayasyāpi virodhiphalasādhantavena nirasnīyatvād rājabhṛtyanirodhakasauvarṇāyasanigaladvayanyāyena puruṣārthaprāptidaśāyāṃ sarvasyāpi bhañjanīyatvātvamevetyāha
paṇayamiti| dvavidhaṃ hi puṇyaṃ vidyānukūlaṃ kevalopabhogārthañceti| tatra vidyānukūlaṃ karma vidyāprādhānena caritārthaṃ bhavati| vidyāyāmanupayuktaṃ yatkarma kāmyaṃ tat duritavat vāraṇīyamityāha tasyā miti| duritaṃ
hi duḥkhahetuḥ kadācidvairāgyaheturapi bhavati|kāmyaṃ karma sukhahetutvāt tadāśābhivṛddhimukhena saṃsārabhivṛddhimeva karotīti pāpadapi kāmyaṃ karma viśeṣeṇa parityājyamiti bhāvaḥ| puṇyapāpayoḥ pariharaṇīyatvaṃ lokadṛṣṭānyāyenopa pādayati kārāgāreti |idaṃ tu pāmarāṇāmapi pratītyartham||
atrādhyātmavidāmalepaviṣayaṃ sukṛtaṃ na sambhavatītyākṣipya prakārabhedana sambhavatītyupapādayati kāmya miti| ayamatrākṣepakasya bhāvaḥ adhyātmavid viraktatvāt kāmyaṃ karma necchet| ata eva tanna karoti| tasmādakṛtena karamaṇā tāvadalepo na vācyaḥ| nanu virokto'pi vāsanāvaśāt kadācit kāmyaṃ
karma kuryādityāśaṅkya yadi kuryāt tatkarma phalaṃ prayacchedeva, tena phalena vinaṣṭatvāt
tenāpi karmāṇā alepo na vācya ityāha yadi kile ti|tarhyabuddhipūrvakaṃ kāmyamasti tenālepa ucyata
ityāśaṅkyatadapi nirākaroti nidhīpūrva miti|kāmyaṃ ced buddhipūrvakameva kāmanāyā buddhiviśeṣajanyatvāt, tenābuddhipūrvakatve kāmyatvaṃ na syadityarthaḥ| tarhi jñātānyajñātāni ca sukṛtāni santi tatrājñātasukṛtairevālepa ucyata ityāśaṅkya tadapi
pariharatina ceti| ajñātadharmo hi kāmyaṃ phalaṃ na diśati phaloddeśenānuṣṭānābhāvāt| tarhi vidyārthaidharmai revālepa ucyata iti cet tadapi netyāha
vidyārthairiti|vidyāniṣpatyā luptatvāt vidyārthāni karmaṇi vidyāniṣpatyaiva dattyaiva dattaphalānyeva|ata itaratkarma nāsti, kenālepaḥ kathyata ityāha ata iti| atrottaramāhaneti| ayamarthaḥ vidyārthamanuṣṭitāni karmāṇi vidyāphalamadattvādhikānyavatiṣṭante vītarāgatve'pi vāsanāvaśaādanyārthatayā mohato'nuṣṭitāni sāntarāyatvāda dattaphalāni karmāṇayapi kānicidavatiṣṭante adhyātmavidi snāhādbandhubhiranuṣṭitāni sukṛtāni bahūnyavatiṣṭante tāni sukṛtānyapi tasya duṣkṛtānyeva tasmādanutāpavatastasyādhyātmavidastailena ucyata ityalepavacanasyāvakāśo'stīti||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye "brahmavidyotpatteḥ pūrvottarabhāvinossukṛtaduṣkṛtayoraśleṣavināśāvuktau| tataḥ pūrvabhāvinossukṛtaduṣkṛtayoḥ kimaviśeṣeṇa vināśaḥ utānārabdhakāryayoreveti viśaye "iti| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ pūrve sukṛtaduṣkṛte aviśeṣeṇa naśyata utānārabdaphale| kiṃ "sarvaṃ pāpmānaḥ "iti sarvaśabdasyānurodho nyāyya uta " tasya tāvat " vilambaśrutyanurodhaḥ| kiṃ kulālacakrabhramaṇavat karmavināśe'pi saṃskāreṇa śarīradhāraṇamupapadyate neti|
kimīśvaraprītyaprītivyatirekeṇa saṃskārakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇamasti neti| atra pūrvapakṣamanuvadati naśya tviti| anārabdhakāryava dārabdhakārya mapi duritaṃ naśyatyeva| tatra viśeṣābhāvāditi hetumāha nahī ti| anārabdhakāryameva naśyati ārabdhakāryaṃ tu na naśyatīti viśeṣo na hyadhīta ityarthaḥ| kathamanadhīta ityāśaṅkya sādhāraṇyenādhyayanamāha sarva iti|
pāpmānassarva iti hi sādhāraṇyenoktatvādubhayamapi naśyatīti vaktavyamiti| tamimaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ pratikṣipati neti| tatra hetumāha upālambhādī ti| pratyakṣabādhādanumānabādhādāgamabādhāccetyarthaḥ| upalabhyate hi brahmavidāmapi sukhaduḥkhānuvṛttiḥ| anyathā tadanukūlapravṛttinivṛtyādikaṃ na syādityanumānabādhaḥ| āgamabādho'pi "tasya tāvadeva ciram ""sa khalvevaṃ vartayan "ityādivacanabādhaḥ| āgamabādhameva viśeṣataḥ prakaṭayati sadvidye ti| asmaraṃścāgamajñā iti parāśarapārāśaryādayaḥ "svakarmaṇā tamabhyacya sidiṃdha vindati mānavaḥ"iti vacanasahasrairbrahmavidāmapi bhagavadārādhanarūpeṇa vidyāṅgakarmaṇāmavaśyakartavyatā masmaran | tarhi "tamevaṃ vidvānamṛta iha bhavati "iti jīvanmuktivacanaṃ kathaṃ syādityāśaṅkyāha jīvanmuktī ti| ihāmṛtatvavacanamamṛtaprāyatvādaupacārikamityarthaḥ| tarhi mṛṣāvādino jīvanmuktimevātyādareṇa pratiṣṭhāpayanti, tatkathamiti vadatastu śiṣyasya kasyacit gatānugatikasyottaramāha mohitā iti| śrutivākyasyābhiprāyamajānānā mandā jīvanmuktivādaṃ mauḍhyādeva pralapantītyarthaḥ||
atra kaściccodayati "nanu prārabdhakāryayoḥ puṇyapāpayorbhogena vināśa iti bhavadbhirucyate, tannopapadyate kṛtaprāyaścittānāṃ bhogābhāvāt "iti| tadidamāha rogādī ti| loke hi prārabdānāmapi pāpānāṃ bhogamantareṇa vināśo ddaśyate "janmāntarakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vyadhirūpeṇa bādhate| tacchāntirauṣadherdānairjapahomārcanādibhiḥ||"iti| kiṃca "janma karma ca me divyamevaṃ yo vetti tattvataḥ| tyaktvā dehaṃ punarjanma naiti māmeti so'rjuna|| "ityavatārarahasyavedināṃ prārabdhaśeṣanubhānenāpavargaprāptirucyate tat kathaṃ prārabdhasyopabhoga iti| tadapyāha pratyetu riti| svāvatārādi pretyeturi tyanvayaḥ| tasmādārabdhakārye karmaṇi phalaniyativaco durghaṭaṃ bhātī ti śabdānvayaḥ| tatrottaramāhamaivamiti| tadeva vivṛṇoti prāyaścittojjhitānāmiti| akṛtaprāyaścittānāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalāvaśyambhāvassūtrakārābhripretonapunaḥ kṛtaprāyaścittānāmapu,tena na kaścidapi virodha iti bhāvaḥ|
atra bhāṣye ""itarasyāpyevamasaṃśveṣaḥ"iti vidyābalāt sukatasyāpyasaṃśleṣa uktaḥ|agnihotrādināṃ nityanaimittikānāṃ svāśramadharmāṇāmapi sukṛtatvasāmānyena tatphalasyāśleṣādacchito'nanuṣṭhāne""iti śaṅkyā saṅgatipuktā|tadarthavicārastukimagnihotrādyāśramadharmo viduṣaḥ kāryāśleṣādananuṣaṭheya utānuṣṭheyaḥ|kimaśleṣavacanaṃ sarvasukṛtaviṣayamuta vigyāṅgāśramadharmavyatiriktasukṛtaviṣayaṃ|kiṃvidvatsambandhyāśramadharmasyāpi phalaṃ vidyāvyatiriktamuta vidyaiveti|atra pūrvapakṣamāracarayati śleṣa iti| yadyaśleṣasdā paravi dyāgnihotrādi puṇyaniṣṭhā niṣphalāsyāt|ataḥkāraṇā ddharmo'pyadharmakrameṇaiva parityājyaḥ syāditi|tadidaṃ dūṣayati ayukta miti|tatra hetumāha na syāditi|yadyagnihotrādirbandhāya syāt tadā hyayuktaḥ, sa tu bandhāya na syāt api tu mokṣasyopakuruta ityāha vidyāṅkura miti| brahmavidyāṅkura mantaḥ karaṇaśuddhi mupacinute hyagnihotrādidharma iti|upakārake pratikabalatvabūddhirbhavataḥ pāpanūleteyarthaḥ||
atra paunaruktyamāśaṅkya piraharati sarve ti|"sarvāpekṣā" ityasminsūtre karmaṇābhaṅgabhāvaṃ parabhajane hyakathayat adhunāpi "aginihotrādi"ityanena tadevābhidhiyate tenobhayo rekaṃ nirarthakamiti|tadetadduṣayati ne ti|atrobhayoḥ prayojanaviśeṣābhidhānena paunaruktyaṃ pariharati vidyāyā iti|tatra hi vidyāyā nairapekṣyā bhidhānena sāpekṣatvamuktam| tadaparikaratā vidyāyā niraṅgatvābhidhānaṃ sāmānyena prāgaprāstā |adhunā punassukṛtāśleṣaprasaṅge sukṛtatvāviśeṣādagnihotrādināṃ parityājyatvamāśaṅkya tadeva punaḥ pratiṣidhyata iti na paunaruktyaprasaṅgaḥ| nītivaiṣamyasiddheritirathaḥ ||
"ārabdhakārye puṇyapāpe kiṃ vidyāyoniśarīrāvasāne,uta taccharīrāvasāne śarīrāntarāvasāne veteyaniyamaḥ"iti cintanāt bhāṣye saṅgatirvyaktā|tadartharūrāvasāne śarīrāntarāvasāne vetyaniyamaḥ prābdhakarmaphalabhogāvasānatvamavagamayati|atra pūrvapakṣaṃ sopapattikamabhidhāya tadanyathāsiddhyāpratikṣipati nirdiṣṭe ti|itthaṃ kila pūrvapakṣī manyate"eṣa samprasādo'smāccharīrātsamutthāyaparañjyotirūpasampadya "ityasminevākye khalvasmāccharīrādityucyate tena vidyārambhaśarīrāvasāna eva brahmaprāptiḥ|tena "yāvanna vimokṣye"ityāvākyaṃ prābdhakāryaṃ karma kathaya tyeva athāpi viduṣastvaccharīrāntameva tatkarma bhavati tasmāt tasyāpi vākyasya na virodha iti|tadidaṃ dūṣayati maiva miti|tatra hetumāha prārabdhe ti|"yāvannā vimokṣye"ityādivākyaṃ prārabbhakāryaṃ karma kathaya tveva athāpi vidūṣastaccharīrāntameva tatkarma bhavati tasmet tasyāpi vekyasya na virodha iti|tadidaṃ dūṣayati maiva miti|tatra hetimāha prābdhate ti|"yāvanna vimokṣye"ityādivākyāt prārabdhā nāṃ karmāṇāṃ vaicitryānna taccharīrāvasāne mokṣaḥ|asmāccharīrāditi vacanaṃ buddhisthacaramaśīrīrāvasānaparamiti mantavyam|
nanvasimāccharīrāditi śrutisivārasyaṃ vihāya tatravā anyatravetyasvarasārthaḥ kimarithaṃ kalpyata ityāśaṅkyāha bhūya iti|ayam "ādityāditimatayaścāṅgaupapatteḥ"ityasya caturthādhikaraṇasyārthaḥ|
praṇidhirapi sāsano bhavet upāsanamāsanahitameva kāryamiti|ayam"āsīnassambhavāt"ityādeḥ paścamādhikaraṇasyārthaḥ|praṇidhiḥ pratyahañca bhavettadetadupāsanaṃ pratyahaṃ prāyanāntaṃ kāryimiti|ayam "āprāyaṇāttatrāpi hi dṛṣṭam "ityādeṣṣaṣṭhādhiparaṇasyārthaḥ| pāpe puṇye ca nāśādika mvidyāyāḥ pūrvamuttarañcānuṣṭhite puṇye ca nāśo'śleṣaśca|idamarthadvayaṃ kramāt "tadadhigama uttara pūrvāghayoḥ" ityādessaptamādhikaraṇasya "itarasyāpyevam"ityāderaṣṭamādhkaraṇasya cāvagantavyam| atha tu taduparitane "anārabdhakārye eva tu "ityādike navamādhikaraṇe tu|
tayoḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ| ārabdhakārye phalapradānapravṛtte karmaṇi viṣaye| bhogyatā phalānubhavenaiva nāśyatā| svārhavṛtteḥ kakāryatva mkaraṇasyārthaḥ| ārabdhaśāntau mokṣasya tattatpuruṣabhedādhinatāratamyayuktaprārabdhakarmanivṛttau mokṣalābha iti ca|ayaṃ "bhogena tvitare "
ityāderekādaśādhikaraṇasyārthaḥ| iti evaṃ krameṇoktamarthajātam| iha asmiṃścaturthādhyāye prathapāde|
kathita mpratipāditam|sūtrakārairiti śeṣaḥ||
caturthasyaadhyāyasya dvitīya pādaḥ
pūrvoktādhyāyadvayārthānuvādapūrvakaṃ caturthādhyāyadvatīyapādārambhe saṅgatimāha nityatve ti| prathamādhyāye paratatvapiratipādanaṃ kṛtam| nityatvajñatvapūrvairjīvatattva mapi dvitīyā dhyāye nipuṇamabhihitam|tṛtīyādhyāye vairāgyapāde jagadaṭavimahājāṅghikasya jīvasya duḥkhamapi proktam |
śiṣṭe ca śāsrāṃśe pūrva pravṛte vidyārambha mupakramya vidyā vasāna paryantaṃ madhye yadvaktavyaṃ tadapi coktam | ataḥ paraṃ prārabdhāvasāne sthūlaśarīraṃ jahato jīvasya gatyapakrānti prakāra māhe tyutkrā ntipādamavatārayati prārabdhasye ti
nanu jāgratsvapnasuṣuptimūrchāprasaṅgena vairāgyapāda eva maraṇamapi cintanīyam, kimarthamatra maraṇamasthāne cintyata ityāśaṅkyedamapi sthānacintanamityupapādayati varṇya ityādinā| ayamatraśabdānvayaḥyadyapi vairāgyapāda
eveddaṅmaraṇarūpa stanukaraṇakṣobho 'pi vācyaḥ| tathāpi brahmajñasyāpi prāpta kāle maraṇaṃ bhavatīti jñaptaye phalādhyāye' nubandhaḥ | kaścinmanute bālabuddhiḥbrahmajñasya mahānubhāvatvānmaraṇameva nāstīti, tatpratīti nivārayitu matrānubandha iti | kiñcātra sambandhe kāraṇāntaramastītyāha tasye ti | brahmajña syotktrāntau mūrdhanyanāḍyā gamana viśeṣaṃ kathayituṃ sarva sādhāraṇo tkramaṇamokṣavirodho bhavati | ityabhpetam iti bhavadbhiritaḥpūrvamaṅgīkṛtaṃ hi | paravidi paramātmopāsake | tairyadyaśleṣāṃ bhavet agnihotrādibhissākaṃ phalānubhavayogyatābhāvarūpo'sambandho yadi bhavet | parastāt puṇyaniṣṭā viphalā uttarakāle'gnihotrādidharmānuṣṭānaṃ viphalameva | tasmāt uktopapādavān | dharmo'pi
agnihotrādidharmo'pi | ardhamakramataḥ adharmatulyatayā| iha brahmavidi viṣaye| parityājya eva ananuṣṭheya eva| ityayukta m  iti|śaṅkanamayuktam| bandhāya na syāt agnihotrādidharmo bandhaheturna bhavet| agnihotrādidharmo vidyāṅkuramupacinute hi agnihotrādivarṇāśramadharmo vidyāyā aṅkūrasthānīyāmantaḥ karaṇaśuddhimabhirdhayati hi|vidyāniṣpattyarthameva teṣāmanuṣṭhānam,vidyāniṣpattirūpaṃ phalaṃ
na bandhakam,apitu sākṣānmokṣaheturiti na pūrvoktānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ|
atra paunaruktyamāśaṅkya pariharati sarve ti|"sarvāpekṣā "ityasminsūtre karmaṇāmaṅgabhāvaṃ parajane hyakathayat adhunāpi "agnihotrādi "ityanena tadevābhidhīte tenobhayo rekaṃ nirarthakamiti|tarthataddaṣayatineti| atrobhayoḥ prayojanaviśeṣābhidhānena paunarūktayaṃ pariharati vidyāyā iti | tatra hi vidyā nairapekṣyā bhidhānena sāpekṣatvamuktam | tadaparikaratā vidyāyā niraṅgatvābhidhānaṃ sāmānyena prāgapāstā | adhunā punaskṛtāśleṣaprasaṅge sukṛtatvāviśeṣādagnihotrādīnāṃ parityājyatvamāśaṅkya tadeva punaḥ pratiṣidhyata iti na paunarūttayaprasaṅgaḥ | nītivaiṣamyasiddheḥ nyāyapravṛttiprakāravai,myasiddherityarthaḥ||
ārabdhakārye puṇyapāpe kiṃ vidyāyoniśarīrāsāne,uta taccharīrāvasāne śarīrāntarāvasāne vetyaniyamaḥ" iti cintanāt bhāṣye saṅgatirvyaktā | tadarthavicārastuuktaiva prathamacintā | tadarthamapi vircāyate
kiṃ"tasya tāvat "iti vākyaṃ vidyāyoniśarīrāvasānatvamavagamayati uta taccharīramatantrīkṛtya prārabdhakarmaphalabhogāvasānatvamavagamayatīti | atra pūrvapakṣaṃ sopapattikamabhidhāya tadanyathāsiddhyā pratikṣiti nirdiṣṭe ti | itthaṃ kila pūrvapakṣī manyate"eṣa samprasādo'smāccharīrātsamutthāyaparañjyotirūpasampadya"ityasminvākye khalvasmāccharīrādityucyate tena vidyārambhaśarīrāvasāna eva brahma prāptiḥ |tena "yāvanna vimokṣye"ityādivākyaṃ prārabdhakāryaṃ karma kathaya tyeva athāpi viduṣastaccharīrāntameva tatkarma bhavati tasmāt tasyāpi vākyasya na virodha iti |
tadidaṃ dūṣayati maiva miti |tatra hetumāha prārabdheti |"yāvanna vimokṣye"ityādivākyāt prārabdhā nāṃ karmaṇāṃ vaicitryānna taccharīrāvasāne mokṣaḥ|asmāccharīrāditi vacanaṃ buddhisichacaramaśarīrāvasānaparamiti mantavyam| nanvasmāccharīrāditi śrutisvārasyaṃ vihāya tatravā anyatravetyasvarasārthaḥ kimarthaṃ kalpyata ityāśaṅkyāha bhūya iti|brahmavidyāniṣṭhanāmeva maharṣīṇāmanukramādanekajanmasambandhavajanasya mahābhāratādiṣu maharṣibhiḥ pratipāditatvāt|vidurohi dharmadevatā|evaṃ purvameva brahmavidyāniṣṭhānāṃ caramaśarīraparyantaṃ prābdhakarmānubhūya tadavasāne mokṣaḥ|
nanvatrāsmāccharīrāditi padasya sāphalyaṃ samyabeva bhavatā nauktamityāśaṅkya tasya padasyātyantasāphalyamastīti samādhātumārabhate natvi ti|śarīre viśeṣaṇatayā prayukta masmāditi padaṃ vitatha mityāśaṅkā|idamavitathamityāha natvi ti|śarīraviśeṣaṇasyāsmāditi padasya tādātvikaduranasthāprakāśanaparatvena sāphalya mastyeva|anantagaruḍaviṣvaksenādivadanabhagavadanubhavayogyasya kārāgāranivāsa iva kaśmale punarasmindehe nivāsaḥ|tamimarthaṃ bhagavāneva sākṣātprāheti darśayati tyājyatve ti| "anityamasukhaṃ lokamimaṃ "iti hyucyate bhagavataiva|dehasya tyājyatvaṃ nakevalaṃ bhagavatā gītam,maharṣayo'pyāhurityāha bhūtāvāsa miti| "asthisthūṇaṃ snāyubandhaṃ māṃsaśoṇitalepanam|carmāvanaddhaṃ durgandhi pūrṇaṃ mūtrapuriṣayoḥ||jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṃ rogāyatanamāturam|rajasvalamanityañca bhūtāvāsamimaṃ tyajet"| iti bhagavatā manunoktam||
atra kaścidanuyuṅktenanvetannopapadyate bhagavati sarvasamatvena vartamāne paramakāruṇike sati kathametasyādhunāmuktiritasya śvo vā paraśvo veti tathā ca sati sarveṣāmekadaiva muktissyāt athavā kādacidapi na muktissyādti|tadidamāha sarve iti| sarve'pi jīvāssamānāḥ,vividha mapi karmanādi tvena tulyam| karmaṇastulyatve'pi bhagavato vaiṣanyādido ṣo'stīti vaktumapi na śakyate|
yadi vaiṣamyanairghṛṇyādinivāraka śāstrabhaṅga ssyāt|ato muktau kasyacitpūrvaṃ kasyacidupariṣṭhāditi vaiṣamyaṃ na syādeveti|aya manuyogo' tyanta malpasāra eva|evātantaṃ kālamanekavidhanyāyaśravaṇapariktrimacetasastu bhavataḥ ko'yamanuyoga ityapahāsenāha alpasāra iti|alpasāratvameva prakaṭayati citra iti| karmapravāhe vicitre sati phalakālavibhāgassarvairapi tāntrikairāśrīyate|kaścidadhunā caturmukhapadaṃ prāpnoti,purvameva kaścit,kaścitpunaścirakālānantaraṃ prāpsyatīti so'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ kena kāraneṇa|evaṃ svarganarakādiprāptāvapyanuyojyam|ananuyojyaiveyamanādikarmapravāhavaicitrī pramāṇapratipanneti cet tarhi kālabhedena
mumukṣutvasiddhāvapi tadevānanuyojyattatvena prayojyamiti mukībhavantu bhavanta iti||
caturthādyapādādhikaraṇānāṃ prādhānārthabhedān parigaṇayati āvartye ti| asakṛtadāvartyābrahmavidye tyādyādhikaraṇārthaḥ aha mityanusandhānaṃ kartavyamityanantarādhikaraṇe nirṇītam|tṛtīye punaḥ praṃtīkopāsane nāhamitibuddhiḥ kartavyetyabhihītam|catūrthe karmāṅge ṣvādityādimatiḥ kartavyeti|pañcame tvāsanasahitasya praṇadhiḥ|
ṣaṣṭhe pratyaha manusandhānam|saptamāṣṭamayoḥ punaruttarapurvapuṇyāpāpayoraśleṣavināśau|navame tu tayoḥ papaṇyapāpayorārahdhakārye eva bhogyatām|daśame varṇāśramadharmayoravaśyānuṣṭheyatvam|caramādhikaraṇe prārabdhakarmāvasāne mokṣa iti kathita midarthacātam||
pūrvoktādhyāyadvayārthānuvādapūrvakaṃ caturthādhyāyadvitīyapādārambhe saṅgatimāha nityatve ti|prathamādhyāye paratatvapratipādanaṃ kṛtam| nitiyatvajñatvapabarvaijīvatamapi dvitīyādhyāye nipuṇamabhīhitam| tṛtīyādhyāye vairāgyapāde jagadaṭavīmahājāṅghikasya jīvasya duḥkhamapi proktam|śiṣṭe ca śāstramaṃśe pūrvaṃ pravṛtte vidyārambādya upakramya vidyāvāsanaparyantaṃ madhye yadvaktavyaṃ tadapi coktam| ataḥ paraṃ prārabdhāvasāne sthūlaśarīraṃ jahato jīvasya gatyupakpāvātiprakāramāhetyutkrāntipādamavatārayanti prārabdhasyasyeti||
nanu jāgratsvapnasuṣuptimūrchāprasaṅgena vairāgyapāda eva maraṇamapi cintanīyaṃ kimarthamatra maraṇamasthāne cintyata ityāśaṅkyedamapi sthānacintanamitiyupapādayati varṇye ityādīnā| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥyadyapi
vairāgyapāda evedṛṅmaraṇarūpastanukaraṇagaṇakṣobhopi vācyaḥ|tathāpi brahmajñasyāpi prāpta kāle maraṇaṃ bhavatīti jñaptaye phalādhyāye'nubandhaḥ| kaścinmanute bālabuddhiḥ brahmasya mahānubhāvatvānmaraṇameva nāstīti, tatpratītiṃ nivārayitumatrānubandha iti| kiñcātra sambandhe kāraṇāntaramastītyāha tasyeti| brahmajñasiyotkrāntau mūrdhanyanāḍyā gamanāviśeṣaṃ kathayituṃ sarvasādhāraṇotkramaṇa kathanam| nanu phalapāde duḥkhātmakaṃ maraṇaṃ vaktavyameva na bhavatītyāśaṅkyamānasya brahmavidāṃ tasya maraṇasya sukhātmakatvamevetyāhamadhya iti| vidyāphalānāmuttarapūrvādhāśaleṣavināśarcirādigamanabrahmaprāptīnāṃ madhye maraṇamapi vadan sūtrakāro brahmavinmaraṇasya phalakoṭiniveśāt sukhātmakameva tasyāhetyarthaḥ||
asminpāde "manasi karaṇagrāmaṃ prāṇe manaḥ puruṣe ca taṃ jhaṭiti ghaṭayanbhūteṣvenaṃ pare ca tamātmani| svavidaviduṣoritthaṃ sādhāraṇe saraṇeremukhe nayati parato nāḍībhedaiyathocitamīśvaraḥ||" iti niyatotkramaṇaṃ bhavadbhirevānyatroktam,kimanena niyamena taccintanena vā?yathākathañcidutkrāntasyāpi brahmavidyāmāhātmyānnaḍīviśeṣapkaprāptirarcirādimārgeṇagamaṇañca syādityāśaṅkya tannetyāhavṛttiriti|
ayamarthaḥ  vāgādivṛttiriti pūrvapakṣiṇoktaṃ, vāgādiritisiddhāntinā, tathā kramāntareṇa sampattiriti pūrvapakṣiṇoktam|"manasi karaṇagrāmam " atyaktaprakāreṇa niyameṇaiva sampattiriti siddhāntinā| kimanena prakāraviśeṣaniyamanena yenakenāpi prakāreṇotkrāntissyāt|nanūtkrāntiviśeṣacintanena phalaviśeṣasiddhassyāditi siddhāntyabhiprāyamāśaṅkya tadapi netyāhanahīti|tamimaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ pratikṣipatineti| pratikṣepamevopapādayati sampattīti | śrutireva hyasmākamarthatattve prāmāṇam|anusandheyaviśeṣa ca tadeva
tathā prāmāṇam| āmnātaśca niyamenānukramaḥ| naca tasya nairarthakyaṃ vaktuṃ yujyate|tena śrutipratipannasya nairarthakyaparihārārthaṃ yathā śrutameva sarvaṃ grāhyam|tathaiva taccintanīyamiti gaticincanādikaṃ kartavyamiti
"naite sṛtī pārtha jānan"iti bhagavataivoktam| tadgaticintanakathanamutkrānticintanasyāpyupalakṣaṇaṃ gatyupakramatvādutkrānteḥ| īdṛkkramaniyatiyutaṃ sampattyāmnānamapārthamiti vaktuṃ na yujyate ityanvayaḥ|
uktamarthaṃ nigamayatitasmāditi| taccintanam utkrānticintanam| vidyāyā upakuruta iti yarthāhaṃ yathāprāmāṇañca sthāpyata iti||
eva mutkramaṇādivacanasya mṛṣāvādipravṛttinirākaraṇaṃ viśeṣaprayojanamiti darśayatijīvamiti| jivo natyamukta iti sāṅkhyāmṛṣāvādinaśca prāhuḥ| tatra mṛṣāvādino jīvanmuktimapi cāhuḥ| tattvajñāne sampanne jīvata eva muktiriti| anayorardvayorapi pakṣayornirākaraṇorthaṃ tattajjalpasaṅghātopajāpapratalitanigamagrāmasya
saṅkṣobhaśāntyai ca prārabdhakārya karma viduṣica phalavat prāyaṇamutkramaṇañca dvayovidabrahmavidorapi tulyamitiyuktvā
brahmagatyai brahmaprāptyai brahmanāḍīpraveśaprabhṛti brahmavidassamadhikamiti sūtrakāraḥ vakṣyati ityanvayaḥ||
yogino bhāvicintā kartavyā cet putrādiṣu niyamanādikamapi bhāvitvāccintanīyamityāśaṅkya sarvaṃ bhāvi na cintyam, yāvanmātraṃ cintyatvena bhagavadgītāṣūktaṃ tāvadeva cintyamityāhaāyuriti| ayamarthaḥ bahubhiraniṣṭai rnimittaviśeṣairātmana āyussīmāṃ maraṇaṃ prekṣye yogī yat karma taducitaṃ madhye kuryāt yacca putraprabhṛtiṣu bhāvi kṛtyākṛtyaniyamanaṃ kuryat tanna tarkyam nahi taccintanīyam|iti tasyātranuktireva| nahi yoginaḥ bhāvi sarvaṃ kāryaṃ dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭaṃ vā cintanīyamiti pramāṇamasti| kiṃ tarhi cintanīyamityāśaṅkya cintyaviśeṣamāha gītādiṣviti| bhagavadgītādiṣvantyakāle kartavyatayā yat cintanamagaṇi tadapi pūrvasiddha yogaprakāre taccatprāpyānurūpe niyata meva bhavatī ti yathāpūrvadhīratra bhāvyā upakrāntayogasyāvicchedenānusandhānamatra bhāvyamityarthaḥ| antyakāle cintyaṃ sarvaṃ bhagavadghītādiṣeveva vistareṇa draṣṭavyam||
sthūlaśarīrasthitisamaye yadvidyāphalaṃ taduktam adhunā tadvinaśayadavasthāyāṃ gatyupakrame yataphalaṃ taccintyata iti pādasaṅgatiḥ| atrotkrāntyupakramakathanātprathamādhikaraṇasaṅgatiśca bhavati| tadarthavicārastu kimiyaṃ sampattirvāgvṛttiviṣayā uta vāksvarūpaviṣayeti prathamo vicāraḥ| tadarthaṃ vicāryate kiṃ vākśabdasya mukhyārthaparigraha upapanno neti| kimiyaṃ sampattirlayarūpā uta vyāpāranivṛttipūrvakasaṃyogarūpeti| indriyāntarasampattivacanaṃ kiṃ layaparatve'pyupapadyate uta saṃyogaparatva iti| atra pūrvapakṣyabhiprāyamanuvadati karmepi| ayamarthaḥ karmendriyavargo jñānendriyavargaśca manaindriye vilayaṃ na yāti| tatra hetumāha atatsambhavatvāditi| nahīndriyāṇi manasassambhavanti yena vilayo manasi vaktuṃ śakyate| tarhi kasya sampattirucyata ityāśaṅkyendriyavṛttereva, tasyā mano'dhīnatvānmanasi vilayo vaktuṃ śakyata iti vadati tadvṛtteriti| tena sampattiśabdo vāgvṛtteruparatimevāheti mantavyam| etatpratikṣipati ityetaditi| atra hetumāha tadubhayeti| vāgvṛttivilaye vāgindriya vilayeca codyaṃ samānam, parihāre'pi samāna eva| tathā ca yatrobhayossamo doṣa iti nyāyaviṣaya ityarthaḥ| yathā vāco manaḥ prakṛtitvābhāvāt sampattirvaktuṃ na śakyate, tathā vāgvṛtterapi manaḥprakṛtitvābhāvāt sampattivacanaṃ na ghaṭate yathā kathaṃcit samādhānamubhayatrāpi samānam| tarhi pakṣadvaye'pi guṇadoṣasāmye kimekaḥ pakṣaḥ parigṛhyate kathaṃ vā tasminpakṣe sampattiśabdasyasyaucityamityāśaṅkyāhasamttiriti|sampattiśabdo dhātūpasargābhyāṃ sambandhamevāha|sambandhasya vagīndharsya manaindriyena sambhavatyeva| asminpakṣe viśeṣahetumāha karaṇeti|vākśabdo vāgindriyasya mukhya eva tadvṛttau taddharmatvādaupacārikaḥ|tena vākśabdamukyatvasiddhyarthamasmatpakṣa eva saṃgrāhya iti bhāvaḥ||
"vāṅmanasi sampadyate manaḥ prāṇe "iti śrutyanukrameṇa cintanāt saṅgatirviśadā| tadarthavicārastu kimatra manaso laya ucyata uta saṃyogaḥ| kimatra "prāṇaḥ "ityapāṃ nirdeśa uta prāṇasyaiva| "āpomayaḥ "iti vākye kiṃ prakṛtivikṛtibhāvaparamutāpyāyanaparam| atra pūrvapakṣī manyate annasyeti| "āpomayaḥ prāṇaḥ "iti vākye'prāṇayoḥ prakṛtivikṛtibhāvasambhavāt prāṇaprakṛtibhūte jale manaso layostu jalaṃ tasya prakṛtiḥ, annañca manasaḥ prakṛtiḥ ;"annamayaṃ hi somya manaḥ "iti vacanāt tasmānmanaso "manaḥ prāṇe"iti prāṇaprakṛtau jale laya ucyata iti| tamimaṃ pakṣaṃ pratikṣipati maivamiti| tatra hetumāha tattaditi|
"annamayaṃ hi somya manaḥ "iti na manaso'nnaprakṛtitvamucyate kintvannāpyāyitatvam| tena prakṛtivikṛtibhāvaprasaṅgābhāvāt sampattiśabdena na pralayābhidhānam| tadidamāhatattaditi| tarhi kimucyata ityāśaṅkyāhaprāgvaditi| pūrvaṃ "vāṅmanasi sampadyate "iti saptamyā saṃśleṣamātramuktaṃ tadvadatrāpi| tatkathamityatrāha tata iha hīti| pūrvaṃ yathā "vāṅmanasi "iti saptamyā saṃśleṣanirdeśastathā iha hi manaḥ prāṇa iti saptamyā saṃśleṣa eva nirdiśyate upakramabhaṅgasyānyāyyatvāditi||
" manaḥ prāṇe prāṇastejasi ityanukramavacanāt śrutikramānusāreṇa saṅgatissphuṭā| tadarthavīcārastu kiṃ prāṇastejasi
sampadyate uta jīve| kiṃ "prāṇastejasi "iti vākyaṃ jīvasampattipūrvakatejassampattiparamuta
kevalatejaḥsampattiparam| jīvasampattipūrvakatejassampattiparatve
"prāṇastejasi "iti vākyasvārasyaṃ kiṃ hīyate neti| atraivaṃ pūrvapakṣī manyate ekādaśākṣasahitasya prāṇasya tejasi saṃśleṣasya sākṣācchatatvāt madhye nātmani sampattiriti| tadidamāha prāṇa iti| saikādaśākṣaḥ prāṇastadanu tejasyeva niviśate| tatra hetumāha itthaṃ śrutatvāditi| yathaiva śrūyate tathaiva svīkartavyamiti hi nītividāṃ maryādā| madhye punarātmaprāptiklṛptau śrutahānaṃ syādityāha madhya iti| atrottaram neti| tatra hetumāha ātmayogasya cokta riti| yadi tejasyeva yogaśśrūyeta tadā bhavaduktā prakriyā svīkriyeta madhye punarātmayogo'pi "evamevemamātmānamantakāle sarve prāṇā abhisamāyanti "iti śrutyaiva sākṣādabhidhīyate| tena dvayorapi kāryayośśravaṇasya śrutatvenāviśeśādavirodhena nirvāhaḥ kartavya iti|
kathamavirodha ityatrāha prāṇasye ti| svāptajīve svasambaddhajīve nijatanoruddhṛtairbhūtasūkṣmaissaha milati sati prāṇasya tejaḥ prāptiśca gaṅgānipatitayamunāsāgaraprāpti nyāyena paramparayā syāt napunargaṅgāsāgaraprāptinyāyena sākṣātprāptiḥ| ayamarthaḥ sarvendriyasahitaḥ prāṇo jīvaṃ prāpya jīvena saha tejasi sampadyata iti pramāṇadvayovirodhāya saṃgrāhyamiti||
"prāṇastejasi " iti prāṇasya tejasi sampattiruktā sā sampattiḥ kiṃ tejomātre uta sarveṣvapi bhūteṣviti cintyata iti saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ bhūtāntarasaṃsṛṣṭatejassaṃyoga uta tejomātrasaṃyoga iti|kiṃ tejaśśabdastejomātrapara uta saṃsṛṣṭapara iti | kiṃ pṛthivī maya āpomaya ityādivākyaṃ yugapadanekabhūtasaṃsargaṃ darśayati neti | kiṃ trivṛtkṛraṇaśrutiḥ pañcīkaraṇasmṛtiśca saṃhatānāmeva kāryasāmarthyaṃ darśayato neti|atra pūrvapakṣī "tejasi sampadyate"iti pratyekaṃ tejasa evopādānāt tejasyeva sampattirastvityāha tejasīti| yuktaśśritatanubhṛt ana iti prāṇa ucyate upasargāṇāṃ dhātulīnārthadyotakatvāt| āśritajīvaḥ prāṇaḥ tejasyeva sambaddho'stvityarthaḥ| atra hetumāha tejasī ti|
chatrinyāyena tejovyatiriktānāmapyupādānaṃ syāditeyāśaṅkya netyāha chatrinyāya
iti| tatra hyacchatriṇāmapi gamanasya pratyakṣopalambhāllakṣaṇayā sarveṣāmapuyapādānām| atra punastejovyatiriktasadbhāve
pramāṇābhāvāt kathaṃ tannyāya iti| imaṃ pakṣaṃ pratikṣipati neti| tatra hetumāha tathānya treti| "pṛthivīmaya āpomayastejāmayaḥ"iti jīvasya saṃcaratassarvabhūtamayatvaśruterityarthaḥ| atra "tāsāṃ trivṛtaṃ trivṛtamekaikāṃ karavāṇi "iti trivṛtkaraṇaśrutimapi pramāṇayati viśvārambhāye ti| sūtrakāro'pūmamarthaṃ prāheti darśayati prācuryā diti| "tryāṃtmakatvāttu bhūyastvāt "iti sūtreṇetyarthaḥ| tenaikasya bhūtasya kāryakaratvābhāvād bhūtāntarasaṃsṛṣṭe tejasi prāṇasyasampadyata ityavagantavyamiti| atra pañcīkaraṇopādānāṃ pañcīkṛtapañcabhūtānāmapyupalakṣaṇam| loke hi dehādyārambho na pañcīkṛtapañcabhūtamātreṇa apitu pañcīkṛtapañcabhūtopādāneneti sphuṭataramupalabhyate||
iyamutkrāntiḥ kiṃ vidvadaviduṣossamānā utāviduṣa eveti cintyata iti saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastu "tayordhvamāyan "iti śrutiḥ kiṃ viduṣa utkrāntimavagamayati neti| kimeṣā śrutirihāmṛtatvaśrutyutkrāntiniṣedhaśrutibhyāṃ vyāvahante netiḥ|amṛtatvaṃ kimuttarapūrvāghāśleṣavinīśarūpamuta sarvabandhamokṣarūpam|niṣidhyamānācotkrāntiśśarīrapādānā, utātmāpādānā|atra pūrvapakṣamāracayati atre ti| "tamevaṃ vidvā namṛta iha bhavati " ityāgamāt brahmaniṣṭha ihāmṛto bhavatīti tasya notkrāntiryuktā| tadetatpratikṣipati asa diti|asatve hetumāha saguṇe ti| ayamarthaḥ mokṣasya dvaividye sati hi gatyādivākyamanyārthakamiti vaktuṃ śakyate | napunadvaividyam| saguṇabrahmavyatikte brahamaṇitatprāptau ca pramā
ṇābhāvāt| tena muktiścetsaguṇaiva| nirguṇā muktiriti nirguṇānāmeva pravādaḥ| "so'śnute sarvānkāmānsaha"
iti prāpyatayā niridiśyate| nirguṇaṃ tu na śrūyate nānusandhīyate nāpi prāpyata iti nirguṇamuktipariklūptiraprāmāṇikatvādapahāsyetyabhidhīyate| tadidamāha suguṇeti | upapāditamarthaṃ nigamayati tsamā diti| ihāmṛto bhavatītyanena tādṛśī tadṛśoktā sākṣānmuktisadṛśī kācinmuktidaśoktā|
uttarapūrvādhāśleṣavināśarupāvakasthoktetythaḥ||
atra kaściccodayati niśśeṣamapi sthūladehāvasāne galitameva tasmādbhogābhāvād bhūtasūkṣmapariṣvaṅgeṇa
gamanamanarthakameva|nanu dehābhāve kathaṃ gamanaṃ syāditi na codinīyam aṇusvarūpasya jīvasya dehābhāve'pi gamanaṃ yujyata evetyāha aṇutayāniścitasye ti|aṇorjīvasya svabhāvataḥ kriyāvattvāt sūkṣmadehānuvṛttimantareṇāpi gatissambhavatyeva| tarhi mārge candrasaṃvādaśśrūyate tatkathaṃ śarīravidhurasyetyāśaṅkya tatrāpyanthāsiddhimāha mārga iti|ayaṃ bhāvaḥcandralokaparyantaṃ svarūpeṇa gatvā tatra kañciddehamapūrvaṃ parigṛhya candreṇa saṃvadeta iti evamanuyoge tatrottaratvena kṛtsnāvidyānivṛttiḥ parañjyotirupasampadya samanantaramutpadyata ityādi vācyam |ayamarthaḥdehādutkrāntasya parañjyotirupasampannasya paścādeva kṛtsnāvidyānivṛttiḥ|tena gamanamapekṣitam|tacca gamanaṃ mārgaviśeṣeṇa madhye saṃvādādikaṃ kṛtveti śratyaiva spaṣṭamabhidhānādvigrahavata eveti spaṣṭamavalokyate|na ca madhye vigrahaṃ parigṛhya saṃvādān karotīti vācyamtatratatrāpūrvavigrahaparikalpānāyāṃ kalpanāgauravamāpadyeta|ataḥ pūrvaśarīrāvayavaissānuhandhaireva vigrahān deśāviśeṣaprāptiparyantaṃ gacchatīti vaktumeva yaktam|tasmād bhūtasūkṣmaiḥ paviṣvakta eva gacchati, bhūtasūkṣmapariṣvaṅgasyaiva dehatvāt tenaiva dehenārcirādimārgagamanam,antarā vyavahāraḥ, tattadarcirādidevatāviṣayagamanam,tairativahanamityādikaṃ sarvaṃ saśarīrasyaiva yujyate|na punaratra parispandamātraṃ gamanamityuṃcyate apitu kriyāviśeṣaḥ|mārgaviśeṣeṇa saśarīrasyaiva deśaviśeṣaprāpterabhidhānāt||
atra kiṃ sūkṣmaśarīramityucyata iti śiṣyānuyoge sāṅkhyoktapakriyāmanūdya tasyāḥ pramāṇamūltvābhāvāt svābhimatamarthaṃ tataḥ prakaṭayati kalpādā viti|iyaṃ kila sāṅkhyaprakriyā kalpādau bhūtasūkṣmaprabhṛtibhirutaṃ śarīraṃ kalpānta vi nāśyam| tacca pratyekaṃ prāṇibheda niyatam, aniyatasthūladehānuyāni| sthūlāni śarīrāṇi devatiryaṅmanuṣyādīnāṃ karmānurūpamaniyatāni|sūkṣmaśarīraṃ tu kalpādimārabhya kalāpāvasānaparyantaṃ sarveṣvapi śthūlaśarīreṣvekamevāvatiṣṭhate anuvartate tadidamanuyāyītyucyate|tacca liṅgaśarīramiti cocyate|tatsvarūpaṃ dṛṣṭāntena darśayati bhasrike ti| bhasrikāntarnihatakṛtrimaputrikāvadavatiṣṭhata iti hi sāṅkhyaiḥ pragatīm| ayaṃ tu sāṅkhyapakṣaḥ pramāṇaviśeṣādarśanāt parikalpanāmātre parigṛhītaḥ |sarvapramāṇānukūlaṃ svābhimataṃ prakārānramāha sukṣmāṃśa iti|uttaradehaparigrahārthaṃ pūrvadehānniṣkrāntaḥ pañcabhūtasukṣmāṃśasamudāyaviśeṣa eva sūkṣmaśarītamityucyaca iti||
atra jīvanmuktivādī punarutkramaṇavārtāmasahamānaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate tattvajñānenāti| tattvamasāyādivākyadanyatattvājñānena pūrvameva saṃsāro galatyeva na punarutkramaṇena saṃsāro galati tena tattvavidāmutkrāntivacanamanarthakameveti| tadidamasāramityāha
asāra miti|asāratvamevopapādayati māte ti| jīvata iti saṃsārabandhaḥ ubhayasyāpyekadaikaniṣṭhaṃtvavacanaṃ mama mātā vandhyeti vacanavadasambaddhameva|vyāhitamevāniṣṭaprasaṅgapūrvakaṃ darśayati mukta ścediti|jīvanmukta iti bhavatā kathyamāno muktaścettattvabodhamātreṇa tadā tatparaṃ naiṣa daḥkhyeta tata uttarasminkāle sa puruṣo na daḥkhyeta|dṛśyate hi jīvanmuktatvena bhavatā vyavahriyamāṇānāṃ bhāvatkānāṃ dehānubandhikṣutpipāsākrodhādimūlaṃ daḥkham|tarhi tadā teṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ mithyeti vadāma iti cet tanna pūrvameva teṣāṃ duḥkhasya mithyātvāt|tena pūrvottarakālayorna vaiṣamyamityarthaḥ|tadidamāha kathye ti|sarvadāpi duḥkhaṃ mithyeti hi bhavatāṃ siddhāntaḥ|mithyābhūtaṃ tadeva duḥkhaṃ saṃsāra iti ca bhavatocyate|tena saṃsārato na muktiriti||
nanu yadutkrāntisāmyamuktaṃ tannāsti vidvadaviduṣorutkrāntirviśeṣasyaiva bhagavatābhidhānāt "yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalebaram " tasmātkathamutkrāntissamānetyucyate|tadidamāha yaṃ ya miti| ayamanvayaḥ yaṃ yaṃ bhāvaṃ smaranto dehina idaṃ vapurjahati taṃ taṃ bhāvaṃ yāntī ti viṣamasva bhāvaivotkrāntirucyate tasmādutkrāntisāmyaṃ na ghaṭate| tadidaṃ pratikṣipati tanne ti|tatra hetumāha tanmātrasāmyā diti|ayamarthaḥkarmānurūpamatkrāntiviśeṣo'stu nāma athāpi dehādutkrāntimityetāvanmātraṃ tulyamityuktamasmābhiriti|tarhyantimapratyaye vaiṣamyamaṅgīkṛtaṃ bhavatā tatkathamityāśaṅkaya pratibandhyā pariharati vidye ti|sadvidyādaharavidyādau vedyākārabhedādbhedau'sti| athāpi brahmavidyeti sāmānyād lidyaikyamapyasti|evamatrāpyutkramaṇamekameva|athāpi tattadbhāvanāviśeṣād bhedo'stīti na
kaścidvirodhaḥ|uktamarthaṃ lokadṛṣṭaprakriyā sthāpayati kiñci diti|ekadeśa sādharmyavāde sarvathā sāmya siddhirna ca niyatimatī na siddhyatītyarthaḥ|sādharmyavaidharmyayoḥ pramāṇānusāreṇa lokavedayoḥ praliddhatvāditi| sādharmyavaidharmyoḥ pramāṇānusāreṇa lokavedayoḥ prasiddhatvāditi| ayamāśayaḥvājasaneke"na tasya prāṇā utkramanti "ityadhyātmavidi praṇotkramaṇaniṣedhādutkramaṇamavidvaviṣayamiti yaduktaṃ tattatraiva sthalāntare "
na tasmātprāṇā utkrāmanti" iti jīvātpraṇotkrāntiniṣedhena dattottaramiti bhaṣya eva sukhyktamupapāditam| tasmādasmābhirnātra vaktavyaṃ kiñcidavaśiṣyate | antevāsibhiradhikaraṇacintanameva niyameva kartavyam| tena prāṇasahito vādvānapi mūrdhanyanāḍyotkramyārcirādinā mārgena
gacchatītyayameva śārīrakaśāstranirṇayaḥ||
atrāvāntarasaṅgatirbhaṣye muvyaktā "sakaraṇagrāmaḥ saparāṇaḥ karaṇādhyakṣaḥ pratyagātmā utkrāntivelāyāṃ tejaḥprabhṛtibhabatasūkṣmeṣu sampadyata ityuktam| saiṣā sampattirviduṣā na vidyata ityāśahaṅkya parihṛtam| tāni punarjīvaparipariṣvaktāni bhatasūkṣmāṇi kiṃ yāthākarma yathāvidyañca svakāryāya gacchanti uta paramātmani sampadyata iti viśaye" iti| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ tejaśśabdanirdiṣṭāni bhūtāni yathā karma
yathāvidyañca gacchanti uta paramātmani saṃpadyante| kimatra paradevatāśabdo gantavyasthānavasthaparamātmaparaḥ utātadavasthaparamātmaparaḥ iti| kimatra sampattau prayojanaṃ saṃbhāvati neti | nanu pūrvaṃ jīvotkrānti muktvā tadanantaraṃ bhūtotkrāntimuktvā paścādviduṣa utkrāntiniṣedhaparihāraḥ kimiti nocyata ityatrāha jīveti|
ayamarthaḥsāmānyena jīvotkrānti muktavā jīvaviśeṣabhūtaviduṣāmukrāntirnāstītyāśaṅkya teṣāmapyutkrāntirastīti kathane saṅgatyaucityātiśayo'sti| jīvotkrāntisamanantaraṃ bhūtotkrāntimuktavā paścādviduṣa utkrāntiniṣedhaparihārakathane saṅgatiḥ kathañcideva syāt | tasmā tkāraṇā dayaṃ vidvadavidvat sādhāraṇo'pi hārdayogastata upari sthāpyate viduṣa utkrāntisthāpanādupari sthāpyata iti| sādhāraṇo'pī ti"vāṅmanasi sampadyate" ityādivad hārdayogo'pi vidvadavidvatsādhāraṇo'pīti saṅgati viśeṣeṇa viduṣa utkrāntisthāpanānantaraṃ kathyata itīmamarthaṃ prakāśayitumapiśabdaḥ| tarhi hārdayoge tulye nāḍyo'pi tulyāḥ syarityāśaṅkya netyāha atulyā iti| atulyatve kāraṇamāha prāpye ti| hārdayogasya tulyatve kāraṇamāha saraṇimukhataye ti| ayamarthaḥhārdayogassaraṇimukhaṃ tadvidvadavidvattulyameva|tataḥ upari saraṇayo nāḍyastā vibhaktāḥ| yathaikena dvāreṇa niṣkrāntānāṃ bahunāṃ mārgabhedena nānādeśagamanam, evamekasmād hārdasthānānnānāḍīmārgeṇa svakarmānurūpaṃ tattannānādeśagamanaṃ jāyata iti||
atra hārdaprāptau prayojanābhāvād yathākarma yathāvidyaṃ gamanamevāstu kimanayā nirarthikayā hārdaprāptayetyāśaṅkya tatprāptau prayojanaviśeṣamāha prāptu miti| amamanvayaḥ bhogāpavargau prāptu prāptasūkṣmasvadehe tanubhṛti jīve prayati sati śriyahṛdayasuṣau śritahṛdayākāśāyāṃ parasyāṃ devatāyāṃ sa mpatyā kiṃ phalaṃ syāt atassampattireva nāsti| ātaḥ etasmātkāraṇāt| tejaḥ parasyāṃ devatāyāmiti vacanaṃ ciraghaṭite sarvadāsaṃghaṭite paramātmani siddhānuvāda eva| napunarapūrvaṃ saṃghaṭanaṃ kiñcidatrāsti niṣphalatvāditi| tadidaṃ pratipakṣati maiva miti| pratikṣepamevopapādayati mānānusārā diti| pramāṇasiddhe'rthe hi pramāṇanusārāt prayojanameva parikalpm| napunarāpātataḥ prayojanādarśanāt pramāṇasiddho'rthaḥ parityājya iti nītividāṃ maryādā| kimatra tarhi prayojanamityāśaṅkyāha parama iti| paramātmani saṃkra maśśrāntiśāntyai dehādutkrāntimaye jāyate śrāntiḥ tacchrāntiśāntiḥ paramātmani saṃkramādutpadyate tenotkrāntijanitaśrāntiśāntyarthaṃ hārde viśrasya svābhimataphalaprāptyarthaṃ tattanmārgeṇa gacchatītyarthaḥ||
""seyaṃ paramātmani sampattiḥ kiṃ prākṛtalayavatkāraṇāpattirūpā| uta "vāṅmanasi"ityādivadavibhāga rūpeti cintāyām""ici bhāṣye saṅgatiḥ|tadarthavicārastu kimiyaṃ sampattilayarupā, utavibhāgarūpā|
kiṃ "tejaḥ parasyām "itivacanasya kāraṇāpattiparatvaṃ nyāyyamutāvibhāgamātraparatvamiti| itthaṃ kila pūrvapakṣī manyate  atra devatāyāṃ sampattirabhiṃdhīyamānā laya eva bhava tvati | tadidamāha sampattiriti| atra hetumāha
sāhīti| tasyā devatāyāssarvakāraṇatvāllaya evana vaktuṃ yujyata ityarthaḥ|
tarhi devatāyāṃ sraṣṭaṃ kṣamā, taddattena gacchatvityarthaḥ| tadidamayuktamityāhaasaditi| tadevopapādayati anuṣadata iti | atra hi " vāṅmanasi sampadyate"iti prathamopāttassampadyata iti śabdassarvatrānuṣajyate|
anuṣaktasyaipabapyaṃ prasajyate | avaipūpyeṇa nirvāhe sambhavati vairūpyaṃ punaranyāyyameva | kiñca vināśonāma bhūtasūkṣmairviśleṣa eva syāt| sa ca na ghaṭate bhūtasūkṣmairviśleṣa taduktaraṃ gamanādivyāpārānvayāyogāt| nanu sarvaśaktiḥ paradevataiva vinaṣṭaśarīrasya tasya śarīrāntaramārabhetetyaśaṅkya kalyapanāgauravadoṣassyādityarthaḥ
kiñcārcirādimārgeṇa gacchato brahmavido gamanaṃ bhūtasūkṣmapariṣvaṅgamantarena na maṃbhavatyeva| dhūmādimārgeṇa
gacchato jīvasya gamanaṃ bhūtasūkṣmapariṣvaṅgeṇa pañcāgnividyādiṣu spaṣṭamevoktam| tadvatrāpi bhūtasūkṣmapariṣvaṅgeṇaiva bhavati
napunassvarūpeṇa | ata evāṇutvātsvarūpeṇa gamanamityādikamapāstaṃ bahupramāṇaviruddhatvāt||
"evaṃ gatyupakramāvadhi vidvadaviduṣossamānākāra utkrāntiprakāra uktaḥ| idānīṃ viduṣo viśeṣa ucyate"iti bhāṣye saṅgatiruktā| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ viduṣo mūrdhanyamāḍyaiva gamananiyamassambhavati neti| kiṃ " tayordhvamāyan"iti yādṛcchikagamanānuvādaḥ, uta nāḍīviśeṣeṇa gamananiyamavidhiḥ|kiṃ nāḍyo durvevecā uta suvevecā iti | atra pūrvapakṣamanuvadati nāḍījāla iti | atisīkṣme nāḍījāle muktināḍī dehādutkrāntena gacchatā puruṣeṇa vivektuṃ suśakā na bhavati| tena "tayordhvamāyan"ityādivākyaṃ kādācitkasambhāvitārthaviṣayam, napunarniyatārthaviṣayamiti| tadidamāha tasmāva diti| mūrdhanyanāḍīgatirmucyamānasya puṃsaḥ kadāci daniyamano bhavati| kadācimūrdhanyanāḍyāpi mucyamānasya puṃso gamanaṃ syādityarthaḥ| tena tayordhvaṃ ganturamṛtatāṃ pravadat "tayordhvamāyaman" ityādi vākyaṃ sambhavā devāstu| tamimaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ dūṣayati maiva miti| tatra hetumāha vidye ti| brahma
vidyāsamprīta sya prasannasya hārda sya prabhayā svārhanāḍī parijñānaṃ jāyate| tena svakīyāṃ nāḍī pravisya svābhilaṣitapuruṣārthāya gacchatītiyarthaḥ||
bhagavatprasādalabdaparijñānasya bhagavatpreraṇenaiva mūrdhanyānāḍyā brahmalokaparyantamiṣuvatsahasaiva gamanamāha svādhīna iti| svatantro hārdasaṃjño bhagavān svamavikalayā sampadā sākaṃ sampade ti sarvaiśvaryapradāyinī sahadharmacāriṇī lakṣmīrabhidhīyate "lakṣmyā saha hṛṣīkeśaḥ" iti hi vadanti| athavā bhagavadaiśvaryameva vābhidhīyate| eka śabdaḥ prādhānyavācī| hṛtpadmamadhye sthitvā sthagitanijatanuḥ abhaktānāmaprakāśitanijatanuḥ| asthāgitanijatanu riti vābhaktānāṃ prakāśitanijatanuḥ "atidūramabhaktānāṃ bhaktānāṃ purataḥ sthitam"iti hi vadanti| saptalokīgṛhastha iti vacanaṃ sarveṣāṃ pitṛtvena saṃrakṣakatvaṃ pradarśayati| ayaṃ khalu nāḍīcakre bahvīṣu nāḍīṣu vidyamānāsvapi nikhiladhṛtikarīṃ nikhilasantoṣakarīṃ nāmimūrdhāntarūpāṃ suṣumnāṃ nāḍī bhittvā anāvṛtamukhīṃ kṛtvā tanmadhyarandhraprahitaṃ jīvaṃ dhānuṣkaprayukta bhiṣumivotkṣipya mumukṣuṃ paramapadaparyantaṃ netetyarthaḥ||
viduṣo hṛdayācchakādhikayā mūrdhanyanāḍyā nirgatasyādityaraśmīnanusṛtya gamanaṃ cintyata iti saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastukiṃ raśmyanusāreṇa kamananiyamo viduṣassambhavati neti| kiṃ "raśmibhirūrdhvamākramate"iti vākyaṃ pākṣikagamanānuvādakam, uta niyamavidhiparam| kiṃ niśi mṛtasya raśmyanusāreṇa kamanaṃ sambhavati neti| kiṃ niśi raśmyanusambhavanti neti| atra pūrvapakṣamanuvadati etai riti| "etaireva raśmibhipūrdhvamākramate"ityasmi nvākye yogino dinakarakiraṇālambanena yadu rdhvayānamuktaṃ taṃddinamṛtiniyata miti| tatra hetumāha niśyayuktye ti| niśāyāṃ sūryakiraṇasyāsambhavenāyuktatvādityarthaḥ| tadetatpratikṣipati ne ti| tadevopapādayati ahnī ti| ahni yathā chāyāyāmauṣṇyaliṅgāddinakarakiraṇasadbhāvaḥ, evaṃ niśyapyauṣṇyādevaliṅgāddinakarakiraṇa
sadbhāvo'styeva| nanu kimarthaṃ sphuṭaṃ nopalabhyata ityāśaṅkyāha ladhutarā iti| tatrāpyahnicchāyeva ddaṣṭāntaḥ| nanu varṣādirātrau tāpo nāsti kathaṃ tatra dinakarakiraṇasadbhāvaḥ tatrāha himadinanyāyata iti| hemantakāle divase'pi tāpo nāsti kimetāvatā sūryakiraṇasadbhāvo na syādityarthaḥ||
niśi mṛtasya sūryakiraṇasadbhāvo'stu nāma athāpyātmavidāṃ niśi maraṇasya śāsreṇaiva pratiṣidaddhatvātteṣāṃ niśi maraṇameva na sambhavatīti śaṅkyā saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastukiṃ niśi mṛtasya viduṣo brahmaprāptissambhavati neti|
kiṃ niśi maraṇasyādhogatihetutvaṃ niśi mṛtasya brahmaprāptyabhāvaṃ jñāpayati neti| niśimaraṇanindāvacanaṃ kiṃ vidvadavidvatsādhāraṇamutāvidvadviṣayamiti| atra pūrvapakṣamāha sarveṣā miti| viduṣāmavidṣāñca sarveṣāṃ rajanimaraṇamapraśastamiti ahnyeva yogi mriyeta eṣa yogi yadirātrau preyāt mriyeta tanmaraṇaṃ caramamaraṇa meva na bhave diti| tamimaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ pratikṣipati
ayukta miti| pratikṣepameva vivṛṇoti karme ti| ayamarthaḥprārabdhakarmāvasāne mokṣa iti hi nirṇīyam, tacca prārabdhāvasānamaniyatasamayameva niśi vā divā vā jāyate| asminnarthe "tasya tāvadeva ciram"iti śrutireva pramāṇamityāha tāva diti| ayamarthaḥkarmāvasānaparyantameva mokṣavilamba uktaḥ| tacca karmāvasānaṃ brahmavit prāpnotīti||
caramaśarīrābhivyañjakapramāṇapūrvakaṃ caramaśarīramuktavā tatrāpi dinarajanideśakālanimittādiniyamābhāvaṃ dehavyogasya
darśayan śavyakarmānuṣṭhāne'pyadhyātmavidāmarcirādimārgeṇa gatvāparamapuruṣa
prāptimapyāvedayati yatre ti| yatra jātakajñaiḥ puruṣairyasmin śarīre kasyacidadhikāriṇo' pavargaḥ pratiniyatatayā gaṇyate tadantyaṃ śarīraṃ syāt | athāpi tāvanmātreṇa śarīrāntarama nāstīti nirṇetuṃ na śakyate madhye pāpaviśeṣasambhavena janmāntarasyāpi sambhavādityāha na tvi ti| atra dinarajanibhidāvaddeśādibhedo nāstīti darśayati na hī tyādinā| hi śabdena divarajanibhidābhāvasya pūrvoktasya ddaṣṭāntatvenopādānamidamiti darśayati| deśabhedādī tiasmindeśe maraṇamanena nimittena maraṇamityādi ca nāsti yathā dinarajanibhidā nāsti tadvadityarthaḥ| evaṃśavasambandhikarmānuṣṭhāna
niyamo'pyadhyātmavidāmapavargaprāptāvanapekṣita ityāha śavya miti| "yadu cāsmin śavyaṃ kurvanti yadu ca na te'rciṣamevābhisambhavanti"ityādikaṃ vākyaṃ śrūyate| evaṃ vibhāvyam evamadhyātmavidviṣayāsādhāraṇa
vākyamanusandheyamityarthaḥ| nanu yadyadhyātmavidaśśavyaṃ karma niyamanākartavyaṃ tarhi tanmaraṇe kadācit putrāśśiṣyāśca tanmaraṇānubandhi karmajātaṃ na kuryuḥ tathā ca alepakasiddhāntaprasaṅgaḥna prasaṅgaḥ| tatputrāṇāmeva vaidikānāṃ taduddeśena kṛstnakarmakalāpasyānuṣṭheyatvāt| tadananuṣṭhānaṃ teṣāṃ vihitānuṣṭhānaparityāgena pratyavāyassyādityavaśyakartavyameva putrādīnāṃ pitrādyuddeśena sarvamapi karmajātam ato nālepakamataprasaṅgaḥ| yathā rāmakṛṣṇādiviṣaye kuśalavādyanuṣṭhataṃ karma svakuśalārthameva evaṃ muktaviṣaye putrādyanuṣṭhitaṃ karma svābhivṛddhiheturiti niravadyam||
viduṣo maraṇe divārajanivibhāgo nāstītyuktaṃ yena hetunā tenaiva hetunā dakṣiṇāyanottarāyaṇavibhāgo'pi nāstītyucyata ityātideśikā saṅgatiḥ| tadarthavicārastukiṃ dakṣiṇāyanamṛtasya viduṣo brahmaprāptissambhavati neti| kiṃ "atha yo dakṣiṇo pramīyate" iti dakṣiṇāyanamṛsya candraprāptivacanaṃ brahmaprāptyabhāvaṃ gamayati neti| candraṃ prāptānāmāvṛttivacanaṃ kiṃ vidvadavidvatsādhāraṇamutāvidvadviṣayamiti| kiṃ bhīṣmādīnāṃ kālapratīkṣāyāṃ kālavidhānasmaraṇasahakṛtasāmānyaśrutyanurodhena sādhāraṇatvasamāśrayaṇaṃ nyāyyam uta "brahmaṇo mahimānam"iti vākyaśeṣānurodhenāvidvadviṣayatvasamāśrayaṇaṃ nyāyyamiti| atra candraṃ prāptasya punarāvṛtireva niyatā bhavatīti pūrvapakṣamanuvadati deha miti| yogīśvarī'pi dakṣiṇāvṛttikāle dehaṃ tyajati yadi tadā indossāyujyaṃ vindut indusāyujyānantara miha punarbhavati | kuta ityatrāha tacchateriti| candraṃ prāptānāṃ punarāvṛttiśruteḥ| tathā tatsmṛteśca "athaitamevādhvānaṃ punarnivartante"iti punarāvṛttiśrutiḥ| "tatra cāndramasaṃ jyotiryogī prāpya nivartante"iti smṛtiḥ| tadidaṃ nirākaroti
maiva miti| tadevopapādayati pūrvoktanīti riti| prārabdhakarmāvasāne sarvathā mokṣo niyata eva| candraṃ vā prāpnotu sūryaṃ veti sādhāraṇīyaṃ nītiḥ|tarhi candraṃ kimarthaṃ prāpnoti brahmaviditi cet sūryaṃ vā kimarthaṃ prāpnoti|viśrāntā iti cettattulyamityāha viśrāntyā iti|tarhi mumukṣo rbhīṣmasya kimartha muttarāyaṇaprekṣaṇamityāśaṅkyānyathāsiddhyā pariharati jaga diti| ayamarthaḥbhīṣmo hi dharmapravartakatvena viśvopakārakaḥ|tena sukṛtināmuttarāyaṇe maraṇasya prāśastyaṃ darśayitumuttarāyaṇaṃ prekṣitavān|yathā hi bhagavānlokasaṅgrahārthaṃ sarvaṃ karmācarati tadvadbhīṣmasyāpyuttarāyaṇapratīkṣaṇaṃ lokasaṃgrahārthamiti na virodhaḥ||
atra prakārāntareṇa parihāramāha kiñci ti| ayamarthaḥloke hyekapuruṣapratiniyatadharmadarśanena sarveṣāmapi sa evācāra iti vaktuṃ na śakyate yathā pāṇamaḍānāṃ pañcānāmapyekā patnī kānīnaḥ karṇaḥ kānīno vyāsaḥ, tena tatratatra niyamo dharmastatraiva vartate| evaṃ bhīṣmasyottarāyaṇaprekṣaṇamastīti sarveṣāṃ brahmavidāmiyameva nītiriti kalpayituṃ na śakyate| ayamātra śabdānvayaḥ jāhnavīsambhavasya prārabdhakarmapratinyataṃ yena karmaviśeṣeṇa yuddhaṃ yuddhamaraṇamuttarāyaṇakālapratīkṣaṇamityādi svecchaivamāsīt| etanna sarveṣāṃ brahmavidāṃ sādhāraṇam| sa ca bhīṣmo vasurabhavat na punassākṣādvimukta ityāhasa ceti| tena mumukṣoḥ kālaviśeṣapratīkṣetyasyārthasya nāyaṃ ddaṣṭāntaḥ| uktamarthaṃ nigamayati tasmā diti|narāṇāṃ rātrirniśā, pitṝṇāṃ rātriḥ kṛṣṇapakṣaḥ devānāṃ rātrirdakṣiṇāyanam eteṣvapi kāleṣu yogi dehaṃ tyaktavā mukti vindeta |tarhi purāṇādiṣūttarāyaṇasya prāśastvaṃ dakṣiṇāyanasya ca nindā kathaṃ kriyata ityāśaṅkyāha syātā miti| tathitaraviṣaye adhyātmavidvayatiriktaviṣaye ityarthaḥ| kiñca bhagavadgītāyāmaharādiśabdena rātryādiśabdena coktau mārgāveva na punaḥ kālaviśeṣau tena brahmavidāmaharādiniyamo nāstītyarthaḥ||
uktānāmadhikaraṇānāṃ pradhānārthānsaṅkalayya darśayati sambhadyete ti|vāgādika manyadakṣaṃ manasi sampadyete tyādyādhikaraṇārthaḥ| evamuttareṣvapyadhikaraṇeṣvarthān krameṇācaṣṭevāgādīndriya saṃyutaṃ tadapi manaḥ prāṇe sampadyeta| sa ca prāṇavāyuḥ taissameto'dhyakṣe jīve| sa ca jīva stadakhilavān pūrvoktasarvasaṃyuktas sūkṣme bhūtavarge | utkrānti sseyaṃ brahmavidabrahmavido ssamānā | anantaraṃ yutissaṃyogaḥ| pare brahmaṇi sampattiḥ| sā ca paramātmani saṃyogamātram| brahmanāḍyā nirgamanam| ghṛṇibhi ssūryaśmibhirgamanam| anantaraṃ niśāyāṃ devarātrau dakṣiṇāyane'pi mokṣo nirgacchedityarthaḥ||
caturthasyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ||
atha vakṣyamāṇapādārthaṃ saṅkalayya darśayati nirgatye ti| ayamarthaḥ brahmarandhrānnirgatya nāḍīnibaddhaṃ tapanakaramathālambya pratyudyaddevabṛndaiḥ "sarve'smai devā balimāvahanti"iti pramāṇānusāreṇa prahitabaliḥ prahitopahāro yogi yena mārgeṇa gacchati| maukundo mukundaprāpako'sau mārgo muninā pārāśaryeṇa pañcabhirnyāyabhedai radhikaraṇai ssthāpyate | kiṃ kurvan mohākūpārapāraṃ puraṃ paramapadaṃ no'bhigamayan | muktighaṇṭāpathaḥ arcirādimārga ityarthaḥ||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye "viduṣa utkrāntasya nāḍīviśeṣaṇa hādārnugrahād gatyupakrama uktaḥ| tasya gacchato mārga idānīṃ nirṇīyate" iti| tadarthavicārastu kiṃ vidvānarcirādimārgeṇaiva gacchati, uta tena vā mārgāntareṇa vetyaniyamaḥ|kiṃ sarvavidyāsveko mārga āmnāyate, uta nānāmārga iti | kiṃ kramāntarapadārthāntarāmnānāt nānāmārgasamāśrayaṇaṃ nyāyyamutādityādipratyapijñānena mārgaikatvāśrayaṇaṃ nyāyyamiti|atra pūrvapakṣamāha śākhābhede ṣviti| chāndogye vādasaneyake kauṣītakibrāhmaṇe ca tatratatra śākhābhedeṣūpaniṣado bhinnamiva brahmavidāṃ gatimadhīyate| tatra bhinnaprakārārthaṃ bhāṣya eva suvyaktamuktam|tena mumukṣorbrahmavidyāvaiṣamyanyāyena gaticintanamapi viṣamameva| tenārcirādeva vyavasthā niyamenaikarūrapyaṃ nāstīti| tadidaṃ pratikṣipati naita diti| sarvatra taistairagnivāyvādityacandravidyutprabhṛtibhistadeva devayānāmiti pratyabhijñānena siddhe sati nyūnādhikatvaprabhṛti nyūnatvamadhikatvaṃ vyatyayena kathanamapi nikhilaṃ nyāya viruddhaṃ bhāvyaṃ bhāvanīyam||
evamarcirādimārgeṇa brahmavidāṃ gamanamiti bhagavatprāptau gamananiyamo bhavatoktaḥ paramapadaṃ gacchatāṃ nānāprakāreṇa gamanaṃ ddaśyate pramāṇavākyeṣu tatkathamityāśaṅkya pramāṇasiddhārthaprahāṇāyogāt tatra tatrocitameva prakāravaiṣamyaṃ pratibhāvadbhiścintanīyamityāha caidyādīnā miti| ayamatra bhāvaḥsāmānyanyāyo'yaṃ brahmanāḍyotkramya brahmavidāmarcirādimārgeṇa gamanamiti brahmavidviśeṣāṇāṃ tulyapramāṇasiddhaṃ gamanavaiṣamyamapi nāpahnotavyam, naitāvatā
brahmavidāmarcirādimārgeṇa gamanamiti sāmānyo'yaṃ mahāmārgo'pahnotavya iti| caidyasya tadānīmeva vāsudevapadaprāptiḥ| ayodhyāsthiracarajanuṣāṃ bhagavatā rāmabhadreṇa saha yāvadbrahmalokagamanam|puṇḍarīkādīnāṃ tattatsaṃvādoktaprakāreṇa puruṣaviśeṣāṇāmapavargaprāptiḥ|bhīṣmādīnāṃ vasvādipadaprāptipūrvakaparamapadaprāptiḥ|upāstikrameṇa bhagava dvibhavyūhalokasthitānāṃ svābhimatakāle phalaprāptiḥ| dhātṝṇāṃ caturmakhādīnāṃ svasmāllokātparamapadaprāptiḥ|evamanyatrāpi vidvadbhiñcintanīyamiti|evaṃ sāmānyagamanorapadeśamātreṇa yathocitaviśeṣagamanaṃ nāpahnotavyamityaktaṃ bhavati||
bhinnadeśāmnātasyārcirādimārgasyaikatve sthite tatra kramacintane prāpte saṃvatsarādityayormadhye śrutyā prāptayorvāyudevalokayorbhedamaṅgīkṛtyānyamena kramo'kartavyaḥ uta pramāṇabalādekatvamevāṅgīkṛtyaikī bhūtayorekasthānāpannatvamiti cintyata iti saṅgatiḥ|tadarthavicārastusaṃvatsarādityayormadhyormadhyaprāptau vāyudevalokāvaniyatakrameṇa niveśayitavyāvuta neti|kiṃ vāyudevalokaśabdāvarthāntaraparāvuta neti|kiṃ devalokaśabdasya devāvāsaparatvaṃ nyāyyamuta vāyordevagṛhatvaśravaṇānurodhena vāyuparatvaṃ prāptau naca tayorekatvaṃ vaktuṃ śakyate loke rūḍhibhedasya ddaṣṭatvāt tenaikasminsthāne tulyapramāṇasiddhatvādvikalpa eva syāt| "yo'yaṃ pavata e, devānāṃ gṛhāḥ" iti vāyordevagṛhatvaṃ śrutiprasiddham|kathaṃ devalokatvamityāśaṅkyāha dhārakatvā diti|svargaloko vāyunaiva dhṛta iti purāṇādiṣu prasiddhametat|evamupapāditamarthaṃ nyāyato nigamayati ata iti vikalpo hyaṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvātkaṣṭa evetīmamarthaṃ darśayituṃ nirvikalpa miti viśeṣaṇaṃ proktam|ayamarthaḥvāyadevalokayoraikyaṃ vikalpaprayuktadoṣaparihārārthamaṅgīkartavyamiti||
atrāpi kramaviśeṣacintaiva kriyata iti saṅgatiḥ|tadarthavicārastukiṃ varuṇādayo yathāpāṭhaṃ niveśayitavyāḥ kiṃ vidyuto'dhīti|kiṃ varuṇasya vidyutsambandhānurodha upapanno neti|atra pūrvapakṣīkathayati kauṣītakivākyevaruṇaścendraśca prajāpatirapyātivāhikatvenopadiśyante|tecopadeśāvaiyarthyāya kvacinniveśāyitavyāḥ|teṣāṃ sarvatrāpi śrutyā niveśo bādhyate|athāpi pāṭhakramānurodhena śrutiṃ bādhitvāpi vāyorupari varuṇo niveśayitavyaḥ|tathā ca satyanekaśrutibādhād varamekatraiva śrutibādha itinyāyanusāreṇa tenaivopadeśāvaiyarthyahetunendraprajāpatī variṇānantaraṃ niveśayitavyāviti tayośca tatra pāṭhakramo vidyate|tadidamāha kauṣītakī ti|evamatra śabdānvayaḥ kauṣītakyāgamoktā varuṇaśatamakhaprajānāthāḥ śrutiṃ bādhatvāpi kvacinniveśayitavyāḥ|tatra hetumāha vipha leti|kvacinniveśābhāve teṣāṃ śrutirviphalā syāt evaṃ kvacinniveśyatve siddhe pāṭhakramamanusṛtya vāyulokātparaṃ niveśayitavyāḥ iti|tadetaddūṣayati ayukta miti|tarhi kutra niveśyatvaṃ teṣāmityāśaṅkyāha saṃbandhā diti|arthā dvaruṇo vidyuto 'dhiniveśyaḥ| indraprajāpatī tu pāṭhādeva varuṇātparau bhavato varuṇānantarabhāvinau bhavata ityarthaḥ||
atrāmānavasyāvyavahitabrahmaprāpakatvaṃ mā bhūt indraprajāpatidvāreṇa bhavatvityāśaṅkya vākyasvārasyānurodhenendraprajāpatibhyāṃ sahakāritvenāvasthitābhyāṃ sahakṛtasyāmānavasyaiva brahmaprāpakatvaṃ samucitamiti sthāpayati yattvasye ti|śabdārthastu asyāmānavasya śrutaṃ yad brahma prāpakatvaṃ tadindraprajāpatibhyāṃ sadvāratve'pi yadyapyabādhaṃ bhavati tathāpi tairamānavendraprajāpatibhissahitaireva brahmaprāptikaraṇe śrutaucityabhūmā sti|"sa enān brahma gamayati" ityamānavakartṛkatvena śrutabrahmaprāpti pratipattyaucityabhūmāsti|ayamarthaḥamānava eva prādhānyena brahma gamayati indraprajāpatī tu mānasasya tatkathamityāśaṅkyāmānava eva mānasaśabdenābhidhīyate tato nāmabhedamātramiti vadati yaścokta iti| śabdānvayastu taṭita upari brahmalokāptiheturyaśca mānasākhya uktastasmā nmānasā nnetā amānavo nānyaḥ |tatra hetumāha vidu riti|amānavo vidyutsambandhī puruṣaviśeṣaḥ mānaso'pi tathā tasmād vidyutsambandhinā puruṣaṇaikenaivātivahanamāhuḥ||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye "kimārcirādayo mārgacihnabhūtā uta bhogabhūmayaḥ, athavā viduṣāṃ brahmaprepsatāmativoḍhāra iti iti|tadarthavicārastukiṃ arcirādayo mārgacihnabhūtā iti cintāyāṃ punarapi cintyatekiṃ
laukikakopadeśaprakramānurodho nyāyyaḥ uta "eta eva lokā yadahorātrāṇyardhamāsā māsā ṛtavassaṃvatsarāḥ"iti vākyānurodho nyāyyaḥ, uta gamayitṛtvaliṅgānurodha ucita iti|tatrobhayaprakāreṇa pūrvapakṣamupanyasya tayoḥ prakārayoḥ pramāṇaviruddhatvādātivāhikatvapakṣameva pratiṣṭhāpayati bhogasthānānī ti| ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ amūni jvalanadinamukhāni bhogasthānā nyeva syuḥ atha vā mārga cihnāni syuḥ| kuta ityatrāha lokoktī ti|lokoktiprakāro bhāṣya eva suvyaktamuktaḥ|tadidaṃ pratipakṣatineti| tatra hetumāha asambhavā diti|nahi kālavāciśabde mārgacihnavācitvaṃ bhogabhūmivācitvaṃ vā sambhavati|tarhi tvatpakṣe kiṃ niyāmakamityatrāha spaṣṭe iti|"tatpuruṣo'mānavassa enānbrahma gamayati"vaidyutātpuruṣo mānasa etya brahmalokangamayati"iti kvaci damānavasya netṛtvapuṃstve spaṣṭe iti tadvadanyairapyatinahanameva kāryam |asminnarthe nyāyānusārameva darśayati sandigdha iti| sandigdha tu vākyaśeṣād gatiriti hi nītividaḥ prāhuḥ|nanu tarhyagnyādiśabdānāmātivāhikapuruṣaviśeṣavācitvaṃ kathamityāśaṅkya teṣābhimāni devatāviśeṣavācitvāt puruṣavācitvaṃ suprasiddhamityāha agnyādī ti|atrāpi jagu rityanuṣajyate| loka'pyagnyādiśabdānāṃ dikpālavācitvamabhidhānakośakārairapi paṭhyate||
uktamarcirādimārgamitarasmāt puṇyapāpamārgadvayāt vailakṣaṇyena darśayitvā ahaḥpakṣamāsādiśabdānāṃ devatāviśeṣaparatvameva draḍhayati yā miti| dharmasūnu rhi yāṃ narakamārgaṃ śrutvā duḥkhena nipapāta| tāmasautāsaugha stāmasapuruṣasamūhaḥ svaya mabhipatet pratipadyeta| traivargikāṇāṃ trivargameva puruṣārthatvena svīkṛtya kāmyaṃ karmācaratāṃ vargaḥ punardhūmādimārga ghaṭīyantracakre vighūrṇet |kāmyakarmānuṣṭhātā ghaṭīyantraghaṭavadūrdhvamukhamutkramya karmaphalānubhavānte tadvadeva nipatet| eṣā puna rapunarāvartināṃ vartanī śruti bhiḥ saṃvibhaktaiva pratipādyate|nanvatrātivāhiprasaktau ahaḥpakṣamāsādiśabdā na ghaṭante puruṣaviśeṣavācakatvābhāvādityāśaṅkya katipayapadeṣu puruṣaviśeṣavācakatve nirṇīte sati tannayāyena sarvatra puruṣaviśeṣavācakatvameva svīkāryamityāha tatre ti||
atra candraprāptistredhocyate kiṃ tadekamuta bhinnāmiti viśaye tisṛṇāmapi candraprāptīnāṃ tatratatroktānāṃ vaiṣamyaṃ darśayitvā sarvatrāpi sandehaviṣaye sūkṣmabuddhibhirantevāsibhissvayameva vaiṣamyaṃ draṣṭavyamityāha pūrva miti|dhū mādimārge candrasāyujyaprāptirūpā kāciccindraprāptirucyate sā cānyā|iyaṃ tu dakṣiṇāyanamṛtānāmuttarāyaṇamṛtānāṃ vā sarveṣāmapi brahmavidāmaviśeṣeṇātivāhikānāmaṣṭāmasya candrasya prāptirabhidhīyate|idamapi tābhyāṃ cindraprāptibhyāmanyā kācidapavargagāmināṃ sarveṣāmaviśeṣeṇa pañcāgnividyāyāmabhihitā|tadidamāha anyātreti |evaṃ śiṣyānugraheṇāvyaktārthaṃ viśadīkṛtya vaktavyānāmīddaśānāmarthānāṃ bahutvāt sūkṣmabūddhibhirantevāsibhissvayamevāśeṣaviśeṣapratipattiḥ kāryeti nigamayati praṇihite ti||
atra pūrvaprasaktānāmātivāhikānāṃ sāṃsārikāgnyādidevatārūpatvam, athavā paramapuruṣājñānupārakā prākṛtadevatārūpatvaṃ vetyāśaṅkamānasya kasyacicchiṣyasya pakṣadvayamapi pratipattṛbhedena vibhajya darśayitvottarasyaiva pakṣasya pramāṇakatvaṃ nigamayati bhūlokeśe ti|"pṛthivyantarikṣaṃ dyauḥ" ityatra "agnirvāmurādityaḥ"ityagnyādīnāṃ trāṇāmanukrameṇa devatātvanirdeśād bhūlokeśaḥ prasiddhāgniḥ| evamantarikṣadivorvāyvādityau|etānātivāhikānkaticana puruṣāḥ prasiddhā gnipūrvān bhavinassā riṇo devatāviśeṣānmanyante|tatra hetumāha darśayati śabdaikya iti|agniśabdādīnāmaikye sati saṃsāriṇo'gnyādayaḥ kecit asaṃsāriṇo'gnyādayo'pare ityarthabhedaklṛptirgurvī|śabdasyānuvṛttārthanameva nyāyyamiti bhāvaḥ| tadabhimantrāṇāṃ saṃsārikāgnyādidevatābhimantrantarāṇāmaprākṛtāgnyādidevatānāṃ praklṛptirgurvī ti teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ|anye punarācāryā nyāyānusāreṇa prakārāntaramāhuḥ|tatprākāmeva darśayati anya iti|ayamarthaḥamānavo hi vaikuṇṭhavāsinaṃ bhagavantameva prāpayati|tasmādamānavo'prāpayati| tasmādamānavo'prākṛtaḥ|tatsahabhāvena prāpakau tāvindraprajāpaticāprākṛtau|evañca satyanteṣāmātivāhikānāṃ prākṛtatvakalpanaṃ vairūpyādatyantasāhasameva|tasmātte sarve'pyātivāhikā divyapuruṣā eveti nirdhārayāmaḥ| anvayastu anye nyāyanirūpaṇabuddhayaḥ punarācāryā amānavasya vaikuṇṭhavāsiparamapuruṣaprāpakatva ddaṣṭyā nityeṣvanyatamatvānnityatvaṃ siddhameva
taddhadaciṃrādikānanyānnityavaikuṇṭhabhṛtyānnijagaduḥ|tena ta eva mukhyā arcirādayaḥ|prasiddhāgnyādayastu tannāmadhāriṇastadājñānuvartina iti marvaṃ ramaṇīyam||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye "arcirādinaiva gacchanti vidvān|arcirādiramānavāntaśca gaṇaādivāhiko vidvāṃsaṃ brahma gamayatītyaktam|idamidānīṃ cintyate|kimayamarcirādiko gaṇaḥ kāryaṃ hiraṇyagarbhamupāsīnānnayati uta paraṃ brahmopāsīnāneva, atha paraṃ brahmopāsīnān pratyagātmānaṃ brahmamakatayopāsīnāṃśceti viśaye"iti|pūrvaṃ tribhiradhikaraṇairarcirāderekatvena guṇopasaṃhāra uktaḥ adhunā dvāmyāmadhikaraṇābhyāṃ tasya svarūpaṃ nirupyata iti peṭikābhedaḥ|tatra pūrvaparcirādināmātivāhikatvamuktam idānīṃ teṣāmātivāhikatvaṃ kiṃviṣayamiti viśeṣacintā kriyata iti dvayorekapeṭikātvasiddhiḥ|tadarthavicirastukimarcirādirātivāhiko gaṇaḥ kāryaṃ hiraṇyagarbhamupāsīnāneva nayati, uta paraṃ brahmopāsīnāneva atha paraṃ brahmopāsīnān pratyagātmānaṃ brahmātmakatayopāsīnāṃsceti|kiṃ parabrahmaṇi prāpye gatibrahmalokaśabdāvupapadyete neti|brahmopāsīnānāmeva gamayatṛtve "tadya itthaṃ vidurye ceme'raṇye"
ityādivākyasāmañcasyamasti nti|atra pūrvapakṣamācaṣṭe vaidyātrasthāne ti|bādariḥ khalvatra pūrvapakṣavādī sa tvevaṃ manute|ātivāhikāḥ khalvete vaidyātrasthānanetāra iti bādarissamakathayat | tāddaśānāma vidhātṛsthānayogyānāma|tatra hetumāha gatyaucitya miti| brahmalokaprāptau puruṣārthe gatyaucitya masti|paramātmaprāptau gamanaucityaṃ nāstītyāha na khalvi ti| ayamarthaḥsarvavyāpakasya bhagavata upāsakānā matraiva kiṃ phalaṃ na labhyam |bhagavatsvarūpaprāptireva hi phalam, sā punaratraiva labhyate kimanena gamanopadeśena nirarthakena|nanu caturmukhabrahmaprāptau vivakṣitāyāṃ "sa enān brahma gamayati"iti napuṃsakaliṅgāntabrahmaśabdo nopapadyate tadā brahmāṇaṃ gamayatīti vaktavyatvādityatrāha sāmīpyā diti|"yo brahmāṇam"iti parabrahmasambhavasya parabrahmasāmīpyānnapuṃsika liṅgāntena brahmānāmnā so'pyabhidhīyata iti na virodhaḥ|atra "mānasa etya brahmalokān gamayati"iti brahmalokāniti bahutvaṃ pāśādhikaraṇanyāyena netavyam|lokaśabdopādīnañca niṣādasthapatinyāyena brahmaiva loko brahmaloka iti neyamiti nānupapattigandhaḥ|nacātra muktyupadeśānupapattiriti mantavyamityāha teneti |ayamarthaḥpūrvaṃ sarasijavasatiṃ prāpya tena sahaiva muktitarante syāditi|etatmarvaṃ bhāṣya eva suvyaktamanūditamiti nāsmābhiḥ prapañcyate|tadetannirākaroti etanneti |tatra hetumāha nāne ti|"tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam"iti śrutipaṭhitaparasthāna gamanasya nānāśruti siddhatvācchratibādho na nyāyya iti|śeṣaṃ bhāṣye||
bādarimatapratikṣepakasya jaimineḥ pakṣamanūdya śiṣyāṇāṃ viśadapratipattyarthaṃ vaktavyaśeṣamapi tatrācaṣṭe mārga iti| asāvarcirādimrrgaḥ paramaṃ dhāma "tadvaṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam"iti śrutisiddhaṃ vaikuṇṭhākhyaṃ paraṃ dhāma gamayati |athavā vaikuṇṭhavāsinam "atha yadataḥ paro divo jyotirdīpyate" iti divyalokavāsinaṃ niratiśayadīptiyogena dhāmaśabdavācyaṃ paramapuruṣameva gamayati| tatra hetumāha gatyādī ti|divyasthāsya tatsthānavāsinaḥ paramapuruṣasya ca gamanena prāpyatvasambhavāt|na kevalaṃ yogyatvenāyamarthaḥ sidhyati, apitu napuṃsaliṅgāntasya brahmaśabdasya mukhyatvācceti darśayati brahmokte riti|bhagavāñjaiminiḥ paraṃ brahmaprāpnuvatāmevaiṣā gatiriti niraṇaiṣīt|uktamarthamaṅgīkṛtyaiva tatra kañcidviśeṣaṃ vaktuṃ satya (yuktaḥ?)śabdaṃ prayuktavānācāryaḥ|tadevāha vaktavya miti|pratijñātameva vaktavyaṃ prakaṭayati nayatī ti|ayamarthaḥdvividhāḥ khalu brahmaniṣṭhāḥ|svātmaśarīrakaparamātmopāsakāḥ kecit|paramātmaśarīrabhūtasvātmaniṣṭhāḥ pare|dvividhānapi tānva paravido mukhabhedena brahmaniṣṭhāna rcirādimārgo gamayatīti jaiminerabhipreto'rthaḥ|nanu tarhi viṣamopāsakayordvayossampūrṇabrahmaniṣṭhatvaṃ kathamityāśaṅkyāha amī ce ti|viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavaiparītyopadeśamātramevātra kriyate|ubhayatrāpi brahmaṇaḥpradhānaṃ jīvasya tadviśeṣaṇatva mapyekarūpamevetyaikārthyasiddhiḥ|yathā "rāmānujaṃ lakṣmaṇapūrvajañca"ityādiṣūpadeśavaiparītye'pyarthatattvameka rūpameva|tadidaṃ sarvamabhipretyoktaṃ sūkrakāraiḥ "apratikālambanānnayatīti bādarāṇaḥ" iti||
pratikopasakā iti keṣāṃ vacanamapratīkopāsakā iti ca keṣāmityāśaṅkya tadvibhāgaṃ darśayitvā tatrāpratīkopāsakānāmevārcirādimārgeṇa muktiniyamaṃ darśayati dhyāyeyu riti| prakṛtiśabalitāñjīvān kevalānvā tāneva jīvān dvayorapi pakṣayo rbrahmaddaṣṭyā tāneva jīvān ye dhyāyeyuḥ |tathā jaḍanivahamapi svena rūpeṇa vā yadvā

ye tu śiṣṭāsrayo bhaktāḥ phalakāmā hi te matāḥ|sarve cyavanadharmāṇaḥ pratibuddhastu mokṣabhāk||" iti nityatvānityatvaniyāmakaṃ vacanama|paramapadatveṃ yuktivirodhamapyupapādayāmaḥ|parikalpitaḥ kevalo nāma jīvopāsakaḥ paramapurūṣaṃ prāpyāpi tadanubhavaṃ muktavā divākīrtyavadavasthitaḥ kiṃ sarvakarmavinirmuktaḥ, uta karmāvaśeṣavān| sarvakarmavinirmuktaśacet brahmānubhavavucchedo na syāt|svābhāvikatvādasaṅkucitabrahmānubhavasya tadvicchedasyacaupādhikatvācca|sarvakarmavinirmuktasyāpi brahmānubhavavicchede tasyaiva svābhāvikatvamaṅgīkāryam|tathā ca siddhāntavirodhaḥ|karma mā bhūtkāraṇam, anyadeva kimapi brahmānanubhavakāraṇaṃ syāditi cet
tat kiṃ viśeṣato vada|bhagavannigraha iti cet sa tu nigrahassahetuko vā nirhetuko vā nirhetukaścet nirhetukānugrahaṃ siddhāntamuktvā nirhetukaṃ nigrahaṃ vadan bhavānapahāsya eva|sahetukaśced heturvācyaḥ|karma ced dattottarametat|bhagavadicchaiva cet paramakāruṇiko bhagavān sarvakarmavinirmukte tasminnigrahaṃ vāñchatīti bhavadīyaiva vāñchā|tarhi jīvastu svecchayā bhagavantaṃ muktvā vartata iti vadāma iti cet taccāyuktam|sarvakarmavinirmukto jīvo "raso vai saḥ|rasaṃ hyevāyaṃ labdhvānandī bhavati" iti niratiśayānandarūpaṃ paramātmānaṃ muktaṃvā khadyotakalpaṃ svātmānamanubhavatītya sambhavaduktikamevaitat|anādivāsanāvaśādetatsambhavatīti cet saiva durvātmā pāpamiti syādayaṃ saṃsārīti na paramapadapraveśaprasaṅga ityuparamyate|evaṃ satyampradāyo'pi nirūpyaḥ|atra kecidācakṣate "jīvopāsakānāmarcirādigatirasti|bhāṣyakāraireva brahmopāsakavyatirekeṇa jīvopāsakamuktvā dvayorapyarcirādigamanamastīti bhāṣya eva vyaktamabhidhānāt|tenāsāvarcirādimārgeṇa gatvā bhagavantaṃ prāpya yathopāsanaṃ phalamiti nyāyāt tyaktvaiva bhagavadanubhavaṃ paramapade kvāpi koṇe sthitvā svapayodharapāyidhenuvadātmānamevopabhuṅkte|na punaḥparamapuruṣopabhogaṃ niyamena pratipadyate" iti|tena "patiṃ viśvasya"ityuktaparamapuruṣabhogābhāvāt patiparityaktayoṣitsādharmyamapyasyācakṣate tadasāramsūtravirodhād bhāṣyavacanavirodhāt pramāṇavirodhāt yuktivirodhāt sampradāyavirodhācca|tathā hi pañcāgnividyāyāṃ "śrutopaniṣatkagatyabhidhānācca" iti sūtreṇārcirādigatyupadeśāt pañcāgnividyāyāḥ kevalajīvavidyātvanirākaraṇena brahmavidyātvaṃ prasādhitam|ayamarthaḥarcirādimārgasya brahmavidyaikāntatvāt seyaṃ pañcāgnividyā brahmavidyeti|tena jīvapidyāyāṃ nārcirādimārgeṇa
paramapadagamanagandhaḥ|tadadhikaraṇa bhāṣyavirodho'pi tatraiva draṣṭavyaḥ|ata eva prajāpativākye brahmaprāptirūpaphalanirdeśo brahmavidyaphalenopasaṃhāra iti bhāṣyakārāḥ prāhuḥ|atrāpyātivāhikaprasaṅge bhāṣyakārairevabrahmavidāmevārcirādigamanamini suvyaktamabhidhīyate|atra "kevalaṃ vā cidvastu" iti sandhiviśeṣādakārapraśleṣāpraśleṣābhyāṃ cidacitordvayorapi grahaṇam|ayamatra bhāvaḥsvaśarīrakaparamātmopāsanaṃ paramātmaśarīrabhūtasvātmopāsanamityubhaya mapyarthādekameva|tena paramātmaśarīrabhūtasvātmopāsakasyāpi brahmopāsakatvādarcirādigamanopadeśo na virudhyate|kevalacinmātropāsakastu pratīkopāsakatvāt prāgeva nirastaḥ|pratīka ekadeśaḥ cidaciccharīrake brahmaṇi cidacitorekadeśatvāt|ato jīvopāsako'pi pratīkopāsakaḥ|evametasminnadhikaraṇe tvetasyārthasya bhāṣyakāraireva dvisrirabhidhānāt kevalajīvopāsakasya pratīkopāsakatvena nirastatvāt paramātmaśarīrabhūta svātmopāsakasyāpratīkopāsakatvena brahmavittvādarcirādimārgeṇa brahmaprāptirabhihitetyalaṃ vistareṇa|
atra sarvaṃ mithyeti vādināṃ mṛṣāvādināmapi śrutipratipannāssarve'rthāḥ pramāṇānusāreṇa svīkartavyā eva| athāpi vyāvahārikamidamathavā saguṇabrahmaviṣayamityādikutsitālāpaḥ kevalaṃ kriyate|vyāvahārikatvaṃ vikalpāsahatvād dhvastameva|saguṇameva brahma na nirguṇaṃ tasyāprāmāṇikatvāt|ato viṣayavibhāgakathanamapi vyāvahārikatvakathanavadapāstameva|nyāyanirūpakāṇāmitameva tattvam|athāpyasmābhirabhidhīyamānamarthajātaṃ parairapi kenāpi prakāreṇaṅgīkriyata iti mavasiddhānatasyānatilaṅghanīyatvamāha pratyāpattī ti| pratyāpattiprakāraḥ anādikālaṃ saṃsarato jīvasyāvijñātasukṛtādiyogāt mokṣamārge pravṛttiḥ|| karmayogā dītikarmajñānabhaktiniṣṭhā evaṃ sadvidyāmadhuvidyānyāsavidyetyādividyāviśeṣeṣvadhikāraniyamaḥ|bhagavadbhaktyaiva mokṣavidhātakaduritopaśāntiḥ| antyāvasthāvyavasthā kecitprārabdhadehāvasāne mucyante aparetu karmānusārāt taddehāddehāntare| pṛthagayanagatau dhūmādimārge'rcirādimārge vā candrasūryādideśaviśeṣe viśramāptiḥ keṣāñcit sākṣānmuktiḥ sadvidyādaharavidyāniṣṭhānām, kramāt madhuvidyāniṣṭhānam|etāddaśaṃ sarvamapyaupaniṣadavākyaprasiddhaṃ bhedātmakaṃ kāryajātaṃ nirviśeṣavādibhirapi tattadarthapratipādakaśrutinirvāhārthama praṇodyameva|kevalaṃ vyāvahārikatvādyuddhoṣaṇamevāvaśiṣyata iti||
itthamarcirādimārgeṇotkrāntaḥ kramād bhagavato vāsudevasya divyasiṃhāsanopāntamadhigacchatītyāha panthāna miti| tamimaṃ devayānā bhidhānāṃ pandhānaṃ paścime dehapāte prāptastamo'ntān pṛthivyupakramāṃ  stattvastomā namikrāmati|virajābhidhānāṃ divyāmāpagāñca tarati |tadanantaraṃ divyaṃ dehādi labdhvā janilayarahita mutpattivināśarahitaṃ viṣṇostatpadaṃ yāti "akṛtaṃ kṛtātmā brahmalokabhisambhavāmi" iti śruteḥ|ayaṃ tu brahmaṃsavādadhanyaḥ paryaṅkārohaṇāntāṃ bahumatiñca bhajati ||
atra pañcaśaktimayaṃ divyadeśādikamanaṅgīkurvāṇaḥ kaścidāha saṅghāta iti|bhavantaḥ khalu pañcaśaktimayaṃ
divyadeśamācakṣate|atra śaktiśabdena divyāni pañcabhūtānyabhidhīyate|tāni divyāni bhūtāni saṅghātātmakānyasaṅghātātmakāni vā|saṅghātātmakatve nityatvameva nāsti|kṛtsnasyāpi saṅghātātmano vastuno vināśitvenopalambhāt|evamanityatve sati nitya pṛthivyādibhāvo na syādityāha ne ti| ayamarthaḥnityāni pṛthivyādibhūtāni vaikuṇṭhasthānīti bhavanto vadanti teṣāṃ paramāṇurūpatve pṛthivyādirūpeṇa vibhajya darśanaṃ na syāt saṅghātātmakatve nityatvaṃ na syāditi|kiñca bhagavataḥ paryaṅkādikamapyastīti bhavatāṃ siddhāntaḥ tacca niṣprayojanamityāha paryaṅkādyai riti|atra hetumāha pūrṇanissīmaśakte riti|rājīdīnāṃ paryaṅkādiparikalpanaṃ dehajāḍyādihetubhūtāyāsādiparihārārthaṃ śayanāsanaśeṣatayā hi ddaśyate paripū rṇanissīmaśakterbhagavataḥ ki manena paryaṅkādiparikalpanena|api ca kṛtsnadeśavyāptimato bhagavataḥ prāptayarthamūrdhvaṃ gatirapi viphaletyādikān haitukānāṃ haituprayoktṝṇāṃ kṣodiṣṭhakṣībajalpān kṣudratamamattajalpānśrutirevo paśamayot |śrutipratipanne'rthe nirmūlāśaṅkā nirmatīnāṃ durmatīnāṃ vā jāyata iti śrutiprāmāṇyavedibhiranādaraṇīyameva|śruterīddaśasāmarthyaṃ kuta ityāśaṅkya pariharati adbhuteti|apūrvārthābhidhāyitvaṃ śruterbhūṣaṇaṃ tatrāpyadbhutārthābhidhāyitvamatyantabhūṣaṇam adbhutatvaṃ hyatyantaddaṣṭavisajātīyatvaṃ tena bādhakābhāve yathāśrutamarthatattvaṃ nirṇetavyaṃ nītimadbhiḥ paravādyuktāni tu bādhakānumānānyāgamaviruddhatvāt svayamevāpramāṇatāmaśnuvata ityarthaḥ|loke hi dvīpāntarādyagatānāṃ
laukikārthapratipādakānyapi vākyānyapūrveṣvartheṣu pramāṇabhūtānyova parigṛhyante|evañca sati vaidikāni vākyāni adbhutārthapratipādakāni kimarthaṃ tathātvena na parigṛhyante|kāraṇadoṣasyānāśaṅkanīyatvād bādhakapramāṇasya cāddaṣṭatvāt|nirmūlamevāprāmāṇyaśaṅkāyāṃ sarvopaplavaprasaṅgāditi||
nanu ddaṣṭavirodhe'pyevaṃ virodhābhāvakathane na kutrāpi virodhaḥ syādityāśaṅkya virodhasadbhāvodāharaṇa māha bhāva iti|yasminnadāharaṇo bhāvaścābhāvaśca deśakālādyupādhibhedenopadeśānna viruddhau
