asminpāde pratyadhikaraṇe pratipādyānāmarthānmanukramaṃ darśayati ekatva miti|prathamādikaraṇārthamāha brahmavidyāpariṣadyadhīyamānasya supatha ssatpathasyaikatvamiti|anantaraṃ vāyulokaśabdābhihito vāyurdevalokaśrutyābhidhīyate|tṛtīyādhikaraṇe vidyuta upari varuṇendraprajāpatīnāmanvayaḥ|caturthe tvadhikaraṇe 'mānavāntāḥparapadagamane netāra ityabhidhīyate|pañcamasyārthamāhabrahmavidāmevāyamadhveti| pādārthaṃ saṅkalyyābaturyeti|caturthasyā dhyāyasya tṛtīye pāde sṛti rarcirādisaraṇiḥ pañcabhi radhikaraṇai ritthamukteti||
caturthadhyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ
atra caturthādhyāye gatānāṃ pādānāmarthabhedaṃ vibhajyānūdya caturthasya pādasyārthaviśeṣaṃ tadantargatayostri katvena vibhaktayoḥ peṭikayorarthaviśeṣañca darśayati ukta miti|tatra tripādyarthabhedastāvatpradarśyate pādai riti|evamprakāreṇā ghānāṃ karmaṇāṃ sthūlavapuṣa ssūkṣma vapuṣaśca hānaṃ kramādupapāditamiti|caturthasya pādasyārthaṃ vibhajya darśayati nirdhūte ti| upādhi rdehasambandhastaddharmasambandhaśca sa tu virajātaraṇāvasthāyāṃ nirdhūtaḥ |evaṃ nirdhūtopādhi samūhasya viratiśayā nandamantyena pādena vakti |atra peṭikāvibhāgaṃ darśayati tribhi riti| tribhiradhikaraṇaissva svarūpā virbhāvaścintyaḥ |punasribhiradhikaraṇaissvacchandakaiṅkaryabhogo' bhidhīyate| ityeva mprakāre dve peṭike bhavataḥ|svarūpāvirbhāvakaiṅkaryabhogarūpametad dvitayaṃ svato bhavati na karmādhīnam|tarhi kāraṇābhāve kāryaṃ kathaṃ syādityāśaṅkya sarvakāraṇaṃ paramātmānamevātra puraskaroti nāthanidhna miti|ayamarthaḥniśśeṣakṛtsnapratibandhanirāse sati bhagavāneva jīvasya guṇāṣṭakāvirbhāvādikaṃ svayameva karotīti na kācidanupapattiḥ||
atra pādasaṅgatiradhikaraṇasaṅgatiśca bhāṣye vibhajya darśitā "paraṃ brahmopāsīnānāmātmānañca prakṛtiviyuktaṃ brahmātmakamupāsīnānāmarcirādinā mārgeṇapunarāvṛttilakṣaṇā gatiruktā|idānīṃ muktānāmaiśvarya prakāraṃ cintayitumārabhate" iti pādasaṅgatiḥ|"kim asmāccharīrātsamutthāya parañjyotiruṃpasampannasya devādirūpavat sādhyena rūpeṇa sambandho'nena vākyena pratipādyate uta svābhāvikasya svarūpasyāvirbhāvaḥ" ityadhikaraṇasaṅagatiḥ|tadarthavicārastukiṃ "asmāccharīrāt"ityādivākye muktasya sādhyena rūpeṇa sambandhaḥ pratipādyate uta svābhāvikasvarūpāvirbhāvaḥ|kiṃ svābhāvikasvarūpāvirbhāvaparatve mokṣaśāsrasya puruṣārthābodhitvaṃ sambhavati neti|kiṃ svarūpasya svato'paricchannānandatvaṃ sambhavati neti|kimānandasvarūpasya tirodhānaṃ sambhavati neti|kimāvirbhāvaparatve niṣpattivyapadeśavaiyarthyamasti neti|atrāpūrvarūpaprāptiḥ phalamiti vadan pūrvapakṣī svābhāvikasvarūpāvirbhāvapakṣe dūṣaṇāni darśayati aśrānte ti| ātmasvarūpaṃ nitya svaraprakāśa meva tasya pūrvame vāvirbhāvasiddhā vapūrva kimapi phalaṃ na syāt nityāvirbhūtasyāvirbhāvāntarāpekṣābhāvāt|kiñca yadi svarūpāvirbhāvamātrānnityasiddha eva mokṣassyāt tarhi suṣuptasyāpi muktissyāt tasyāpi svasvarūpāvirbhāvasya vidyamānatvāt|tadidaṃ darśayati suṣuptāviśeṣā diti|evaṃ parapakṣaṃ pratikṣipya svābhipretaṃ prakāraṃ darśayati tasmā diti|ayamarthaḥyathā nityamukta īśvaro rāmakṛṣṇādivigrahaṃ parigṛhṇāti evaṃ mukto'pi vilakṣaṇaṃ rūpaṃ parigṛhṇātīti vācyamiti|tatra hetumāha rūpaśabdā diti| rūpaśabdo hi dehavācitvādimamevārthaṃ darśayatītyarthaḥ etatpratikṣipati naiva miti|asminpratikṣepe hetumāha svene ti|ayamarthaḥkevalaṃ rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyata iti nocyate api tu svena rūpeṇeti|svaśabdo hyatra viśeṣaṇatvena prayujyate|sa śabdo yathā na niṣphalaḥ syāt tathaivārtho vācya iti|kathamaphalatvamityā śaṅkyāha rūpe ti|apūrvarūpaprāptau rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyataityetāvadeva vācyam|tena svaśabdasāmarthyāt svābhāvikarūpāvirbhāva ucyata ityarthaḥ|svābhāvikasyāvirbhāve hi svaśabdasāphalyamiti bhāvaḥ||
atra mṛṣāvādināṃ svasvarūpāvirbhāvavacimaghaṭitamiti darśayat svapakṣe tasya sughaṭitatvameva sthāpayati nitye ti|ayamatra bhāvaḥmṛṣāvādinaḥ kiṃ nityātmasthitimevābhinirṣpātta vadanti kiṃvā apūrvākāraprāptim uttaratra bhedavādaprasaṅgaḥ ataḥ pūrva eva kalpo'vaśiṣyate|so'pi na saṅghaṭate nityasvātmasvarūpasthiti riyamabhiniṣpattiriti vadanta stanmātraṃ vidyāphalaṃ na bhavatīti na viduḥ |tanmātrasyānādisiddhatvād vidyāphalasya phalatvenāgāmitvāt|na hyāgāminaḥ pūrvasiddhasya ca tādātmyaṃ vaktuṃ śakyate vyādhātāditi| tadidamāha nityāsiddha miti|nanu yadyasmatpakṣe'bhiniṣpattirvaktuṃ na śakyate tarhi tvatpakṣe kathaṃ vaktuṃ śakyata ityāha siddha miti|loke svarūpata ssiddha mapi sādhya bhūtaviśeṣaṇā nuvedhāt sādhyabhāvamāṭīkate|yathā sparśaviśeṣādaśuddhassnānādisādhyena śuddhasvarūpeṇa svayaṃ sādhyata ityucyate evaṃ karmabhiraśuddho jīvaḥ karmasambandhavinirmuktarūpeṇa sādhyata iti vacane ko virodhaḥ|tadidamāha sādhyānuvedhā diti| siddha mapi vastu sādhyānuvedhā tsādyamutyucyate|tathā ca prokṣaṇādinā vrīhyādikaṃ śuddhabhāvena sādhyate|phalasya svarūpamevātra darśayati se ti strīliṅganirdeśo'bhiniṣpattivivakṣayā|itthamabhiṃniṣpattiśabdasyākārāntaraprāptimarthamuktvā pratītiprāptimapyarthatayācaṣṭe yadve ti|vadanti hi loke tattadarthapratipādakāḥ ayamarthaḥ evaṃ niṣpadyata iti nirṇīyata iti|tathā cātrāpi svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyata iti svābhivikākāreṇa jñāyata ityuktaṃ bhavati|tena muktiśabdasyāsmatpakṣe sārthakatvāt " muktaḥ pratijñānāt " ityādi sutramapi sārthakameveti nigamayatitaditi| ayamarthaḥasmatsiddhānte jīvasya saguṇatvāttadguṇe saṅkocavikāsasadbhāvādatrāpūrvākāsasyāgantukatvācca muktiśabdapraṃyogassughaṭita eva|yuṣmatpakṣe nirguṇasyātmano nityasvayamprakāśatvādapūrvākāraprāptyabhāvena pūrvamamuktaḥ paścānmukta iti vacanamavayanameva syāt|avidyānivṛttirapūrvā vidyata iti cet sā kiṃ brahmasvarūpamuta tadatiriktā tadatiriktatve'pi paramārtharūpā aparamārtharūpā vā svarūpañcettadavasthameva dūṣaṇam|atiriktatve'pyapāramārthye tasyāḥ pradhvaṃsābhāvarūpatvenānantyāt|tasyā api nivṛttyaṅgīkāre nivṛttipāramparyādanavasthā|tathā cāroritatannivṛttipāmparyāṅgīkārāt tadavastha eva nityasaṃsāraprasaṅgaḥ| paramārthapakṣe tu dvaitāpattiriti prāgevoktam||
nanu jīvasya svarūpāvirbhāvo mokṣaścet tatsavarūpaṃ saṃsāradaśāyāmapyāvirbhūtaṃ mokṣadaśāyāṃ ko viśeṣaḥ?tatrottaramāha svākārā diti|loke hyekameva vastu purastātkiñcidanukūlatayamātam uttarottaraṃ paśyataḥ
paścādānukūlyādhikyenāvalokyate evaṃ jāvatmasvarūpaṃ nityabhātamapi prathamamekadeśānukūlyena pratīyate muktidaśāyāṃ tvatyantānukūlyena|ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ nityabhātāt svākārāt adhikasukhatayā tadānīṃ mokṣadaśāyāṃ jīvo bhātī ti|na cābhiniṣpattiśabdasvārasyaṃ nāstīti mantavyamityāha siddhe ti|prayoga eva hi śabdārthanirṇaye pramāṇam abhiniṣpattiśabdasyāvirbhāvamātre'pi prayogaprācuryamastīti prāgevoktam| nanvabhiniṣpattiśabdo hyāganatukameva kañcidarthaṃ vakti ko'yamāgantuko'rtha ityāśaṅkyāha saṅkoci ti| saṅkocātyantahāniḥ vikāsa ityarthaḥ|pūrvaṃ svarūpopādhikatvamuktam idānīmabhiniṣpattiśabdena saṅkocātyantāhānerabhidhānā nniṣpratyūha svarūpopādhikaṃ rūpaṃ svenetiśabdaḥ pravaktītyarthaḥ||
atra kaściccodayati "vedāntavidināmātmāvirbhāvo mokṣa iti sarvasammatam|tathā ca yathā cinmātrabrahmasvarūpāvirbhāvasya puruṣārthatvaṃ vadatāṃ puruṣārthābhāvo'viśiṣṭaḥ, yadyapi jīvātiriktaḥ paramātmā draṣṭavyatayā bhavadbhiraṅagīkiyate so'pi yogadaśāyāṃ ddaṣṭa eva tathā ca mokṣadaśāyāṃ viśeṣato draṣṭavyābhāvāt puruṣārthābhāva iti samānametat" iti|tadetatpratikṣipati prāya iti| ayamarthaḥ jīvasvarūpasāmānyamahamiti sarvalokaviditam|tathāpi sa jīvo vibhūrvā aṇurvā bhagavaccheṣabhūto vā anyaśeṣo vā svatantro vā paratantro vā jñānarūpo vā jaḍarūpo vā jñānaguṇako vā nirguṇo vā ānandādmako vā ānandasvarūpo vā sa ca kṣaṇikasantānamātrauta sthiraḥ sthiratve'pyāmokṣasthāyī athavā anudayāstamayassa ca kalpito vā akalpito vā bhinno vā abhinno vā bhinnābhinno vā iti bahudhā bambhramyamāṇairvādibhiranyathānyathā abhidhānādanavadhāritasvarūpa eva|tathā ca tatsvarūpaṃ bhagavaccheṣatvādinā muktidaśāyāmeva viśeṣato'valokyate|āstāmidaṃ jīvasvarūpaṃ nedamovāsmākaṃ muktidaśāyāṃ prakāśyam api tu tadantaryāmī puruṣottamaḥ|tadidamāha svadohinī ti|"yasyātmā śarīram" "antaḥpraviṣṭaśśāstacā janānām"iti nigamaśatanigadatena sarvaśarīratvenāvagantavyaḥ|tatsvarūpamapi śravaṇadaśāyāṃ yāvadavagamyate na tāvadeva mananadaśāyām|yacca mananadaśāyāmapyavagamyate na tāvanmātrameva nididhyāsanadaśāyām|yaducyate "tatrāpi dahnaṃ gaganaṃ viśokastasminyadantastadupākitavyam" iti atrāpyapahatapāpmatvādiguṇāṣṭakāvirbhāve satyapi samādhyavasthāvalambanīyaṃ sakalamapi sokhyaṃ vaikuṇṭhavisino devībhūṣaṇāyudhaparijanaparicchadādisakala viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya sarvataḥ paribṛḍhasya "pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi" iti vibhūtidvayādhipatyena nirṇītasya bhagavato'nubhavasindhau pṛṣatalavāyate|ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ svasmin svātmini anaghaguṇanidhau svadohini paramātmani tadvibhūtidvaye vā nityavibhūtau līlāvibhūtau vā yat samādhau yogadaśāyāṃ ddaṣṭaṃ tanmuktānubhūteḥ pṛṣṭavadeva bhavatīti |tenobhayavibhūtiviśiṣṭaparabrahmānubhūterūttara kālebhāvitvena puruṣārthatvaṃ yujyata iti bhāvaḥ|nanu pūrvaṃ duḥkhatvena ddaṣṭameva paścādapi ddaśyate kathaṃ tasya puruṣārthatvamityāśaṅkyāha kṛtsna miti|bhagavadvibhūtyantargataṃ vastu svabhāvataḥ pratikūlameva kiñcinnāsti api tu pittopahatasya kṣīramiva karmānubandhādetāvantaṃ kālaṃ pratikūlatayā bhātā seyaṃ vibhūtiḥ nityavibhūtestu bhānameva nābhūt parañjyotirupasampannasya tu sā ceyañca vibhūtidvayaṃ bhagavaccheṣatvānusamdhānāvirbhābena niratiśayasukhātmakatayā bhāti|tatra ddaṣṭāntamāha śarkare ti| vibhūtidvaya matra sudhāsindhuḥ śarkaraudhaḥ punarapahatapāpmatvādiguṇāṣṭakaviśiṣṭo bhagavān|athavā bhagavāneva sudhāsindhuḥ apahatapāpmatvādiguṇāṣṭaka pūrvakāprākṛtadevībhūṣaṇāyudhaparicchadadeśaviśeṣādayaśśarkarāsthānīyāḥ|tathā ca sakalaviśeṣaṇasampannasya śrīnivāsasya bhagavato vaikuṇṭhavāsino'nantagaruḍaviṣvaksenādibhirantaraṅgaparikarairanavaratasevyamānasya nityasevāhevākināmasmākaṃ puruṣārthābhāvamanuvadannatyantāprasiddhadeśavāsitvādaśeṣānupalambhena kūpodarakūrma ityapahasantyācāryāḥ|tasmādati ghṛṇārhaḥ kṛpāyogyaḥ|anarthapravaṇajanāḥ khalvātmavidbhiranugrāhyāḥ smaryate hi "ātmadruhamamaryādaṃ mūḍhamujjhitasatpatham|sutarāmanukampeta narakārciṣmadindhanam||" iti||
anādisiddhasya svābhāvikasvarūpasyopādhivaśādanyathābhāve siddhe paścādupādhyapagame siddhe punaḥ pūrvākāraprāptissyāt sacākāra uttarasminkāle nityamevānuvartata ityasminnarthe lokaddaṣṭāntamāha malli ti|mallikā hi madhye kiṃśukādisuṣirapraveśarūpopādhivaśāt śuddhaprasūna janakasvabhāvaṃ muktvā raktaprasūnaṃ janayati punaśca rañjakopādhimukte samaye sañjāte śuddha meva prasūnaṃ janayati
evamanantagaruḍaviṣvaksenādivajjīvo'pi śuddhasvabhāvassvayamanādikarmavaśāt sbhāvikarūpatirodhānaṃ prāpnoti upādhivinirmokṣe paścājjñānavikāsamupalabhate|tadidamāha tadva diti| nāthānukampā sū ritulyaṃ phalaṃ janayatī tyanvayaḥ|atrāyaṃ viśeṣaḥjīvānāṃ nityameva sūrivadbhagavadanubhavayogyatve satyapi anādipratibandhādananubhavaḥ pratibandhanivṛttau sūritulyānubhavasiddhiḥ|mallīpuṣpādau pūrvamapi śuddhirmadhye tvaupādhikākārāviśeṣaprāptiḥ paścātsvābhāvikasvarūpasambandha iti|atra sākṣādddaṣṭānto "yathā na kriyate jyotsnā"ityādyukto maṇireva|maṇeḥ khalūtpattisiddha eva prakāśaḥ|sa tu prakāśaḥ kasyacinmaṇerutpattimārabhya malatirohito bhavati|kasyacittavadita ārabhya malasambandha eva nāsti tattulyā nityāḥ|saṃsāriṇastvādita ārabhya malasambandhavanmaṇiprāyāḥ|teṣāṃtu śāṇollekhanena maṇeriva bhagavadupāsanātmaka śāṇollekhanāt svābhāvikaprakāśāvirbhāvo bhavati|uktamarthaṃ nigamayati tasmā diti| pratihativirahāt svābhāvikarūpāvi rbhāvasya tasya ca punaḥ pratibandhābhāvāt nityamevāvasthānasya loke ddaṣṭatvāt tāddaśadhīvikāsasyāgantu katve satyapi prāptasiddheḥ pratīcaḥ prāptaphalasya pratyagātmanaḥ pratyāpannasvadāyakrama iha kathitaḥ | ayamarthaḥkasyacitputrasya pitṛdhanaṃ svabhāvataḥ prāptaṃ tadanyena balavatā kutsitena kenāpyuparudhyate paścāduparodhanivṛttau svabhāvaprāptaṃ svadhanaṃ putraḥ prāpnoti evaṃ bhagavadanubhavasya sarvātmanāṃ svabhāvataḥ prāptatvāt tatpratibandhakakarmanivṛttau pratibandhakāntaraprasaṅgābhāvānnityamevāsāvanuvartata iti niṣkaṇṭako'yaṃ nītimārgaḥ|kṛtakatvenānityatvānumānaṃ tu "naca punarāvartate" iti pramāṇabādhitatvānnaraśiraḥpavitratvādyunumāna saubhrātramevalabhate||
atra kecidāhuḥ "jīvātmamātraprāptiriti kācinmaktirastīti, sā punarmuktireva na bhavatīti darśayituṃ tatpakṣamanuvadati arvāñca miti| kadici davicārakāḥ svātmamātrānubhūtiṃ muktiviśeṣamagaṇayan | atrottaramāhatatreti|atra brahmānubhūtivicchedassvābhāvikaḥ karmamūlo veti vikalpyobhayatrāpi dūṣaṇamabhidheyam|kiṃ dūṣaṇamityuyoge pūrvamasmābhiruktāndoṣānihācaṣṭe santī ti|tarhi kaivalyaṃ muktiriti kathayantyaitihāsikāḥ paurāṇikāśca na kevalaṃ ta eva bhavatpakṣānusāriṇo'pi kecidūcurityāśaṅkya sarvo'yaṃ vyavahāra aupacārika ityāha tata iti|astu kaivalyaṃ muktiraupacārikī athāpi sālokyasāmīpyasārūpyarūpeṇa mokṣaviśeṣā bhāvatkairevābhidhīyante tat kathamityāśaṅkyāha sālokyeti | tatrāpyaupacāriko muktiśabdaityarthaḥ|asti cātra pramāṇam"lokeṣu viṣṇornivasanti kecit samīpamṛcchanti ca kecidanye|anyetu rūpaṃ saddaśaṃ bhajante sāyujyamanye sa tu mokṣa uktaḥ||"iti|ayamarthaḥna kevalaṃ sālokyādikaṃ mokṣaḥ,tatra tu mokṣaśabda aupacārikaḥ|yastu sāyujyaṃ prāptaḥ, tasya tu sālokyāditrayamapi sāyujyāntargatatvena muktiśabdavācyatāmupalabhate|ataḥ prāptāprāptavivekena sāyujyameva mokṣaśabdārthaḥ|anyāni tu sāyujyasambandhādeva muktiśabdavācyatāmupalabhantām|kā no hāniḥ sāyujyaṃ tu "so'śnute sarvānkāmānsaha" iti śrutyaiva niruktam|"bhogamātrasāmyaliṅgācca"iti sūtrakāro'pi bhāgyasāmyameva sāyujyamityāha|yastu mokṣadaśāyāṃ sāṣṭateti kaścidviśeṣo'bhidhīyate so'pyācāryairevānyatra vivicya darśitaḥ" sāyujyamubhayoratra bhoktavayasyāviśiṣṭatā | sāṣṭatā tatra bhogasya tāratamyavihīnatā ||" iti|loke hi bhogyasyaikye'pi bhoktṛtṛṣṇāvaiṣamyamasti tadapyatra nāstītīmamarthaṃ darśayituṃ sāyujyāntargatameva sāṣṭatvamanukathayanti santaḥ|mṛṣāvādināṃ tu sāyujyaprasaṅga eva nāsti|upasargasya tāvatsahaśabdaparyāyatveva tanmatavirodhassuprasiddha eva|yujiryoga iti dhātorapi bhedagarbhatvamavivādameva sarveṣāmeva bādinām|sayujo bhāvassāyujyamiti pratyayo'pi sapratyayaṃ bhedamevācaṣṭe|tasmātsāyujyaṃ muktitarmṛṣāvādināmityavayutpannānāmevālāpaḥ|tarhi sāyujyamityaikyamabhidhīyata iti rūḍhiśaktimabhidadhmaha iti cet tadapi na rūḍhiśaktipratipādakapramāṇābhāvāt, pratyuta "dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā" "ādityasya sāyujyam"iti vaidikaprayogeṣu bhedapūrvakamevābhidhānāt|loke caikyameva sāyujyamiti pāmarā api na pravadanti kiṃ punaḥ kavayaḥ|yadi vadanti bhavāddaśāḥ, te punaravayo vā kapayo veti||
saṅgatirbhāṣye"kimayaṃ parañjyotirupasampannassarvabandhavinirmuktaḥ pratyagātmā svātmānaṃ paramātmanaḥ pṛthagbhūtamanubhavati uta tatprakāratayā tadavibhaktamiti viśaye" iti|tadarthavicarastumuktaḥ kiṃmātmānaṃ paramātmānaḥ
pṛthagbhūtamanubhavati uta tatprakāratayā tadavibhaktam|kiṃ sāhityasāmyasādharmyavacanānya vibhāgenānubhave virudhyante neti|kiṃ pṛthagbhūtasyaiva sāhityādikamupapannaṃ neti|atra pūrvapakṣī muktadaśāyāṃ bhedenaivānusandhāne hetuviśeṣānācaṣṭe jīveśā viti|ayamarthaḥ"dvā suparṇā" iti śrutireva jīvaparayorbheda mācaṣṭe|hetvantaramapyāha
śrutiri ti|saiva śrutiḥ "so'śnute sarvān kāmānsaha" iti muktabhogaṃ sahaśabdapūrvakamevāha |sahaśabdo hi bheda eva saṃghaṭate|putreṇa sahāgataḥ piteti prayuñjate na punaḥ pitrāsahāgataḥ piteti nāpi putreṇa sahāgataḥ putra iti|tṛtīyamapi hetumāha sāmya iti|sāmyaṃ tāvad bhedaparam|tadatra paramasāmyamatyantabhedaparam|kenāpi viśeṣaṇena sāmye sāmyamiti vaktuṃ yujyate|bahubhirapi viśeṣaṇaissāmye hi paramaṃ sāmyaṃ sidhyati|tena tadapi bhedaparam|idañca smṛtisiddhaṃ "mama sādharmyamāgatāḥ" iti bhagavataiva sāmyaparyāyasya sādharmyaśabdasya prayogadarśanāt|tena jīvaḥ paramātmanaḥ pṛthaktvena pratibhāsetetyāhasa iti|tadetatpratikṣipati maiva miti|tatra hetumāha tattva miti|muktidaśāyāṃ tattvameva pratibhāti nātattvam|atattvantu svatantrabhedo'brahmātmakabheda ityarthaḥ|tenānayornirdoṣo bhedo bhātu| jīvaparayossvarūpabheda ityarthaḥ|tarhi kīddagvidho bhedo niṣidhyata ityāśaṅkyāha siddha iti|dvidhā khalu bhedaḥ pratīyate brahmātmakabhedo'brahmātmakabhedaśceti|tatra pūrvo bhedaḥ "dvā suparṇā sayujā" "nityo nityānām" "bhoktā bhogyam" ityādiśrutiprasiddhatvādadhyātmavidāmaṅgīkārapadameva|abrahmātmakabhedastu "antaḥ praviṣṭāśśāstā janānāṃ sarvātmā" "sarvagatvādanantasya sa evāhamavasthitaḥ"ityādipramāṇasiddhabrahmātmabhāvānusandhānavirodhādanādartavya eva|tenāvinābhāvenānusandhānaṃ śarīrātmabhāvenānu sandhānamadhyātmavidāmājānasiddhamityarthaḥ|ayamatrānvayaḥ dehātmabhāve siddhe satitasya jīvasya svaniṣṭhatvaddaṣṭirna hi ghaṭate paramātmapāratantryānavalokanaṃ na saṅghaṭata ityarthaḥ||
atra pūrvarakṣī manyate"avibhāgena bhagavadanusandhānaṃ muktidaśāyāmiti bhavadbhirucyate|tacchativiruddha meva|satyajñānādimantre phaladaśāyāṃ bhedasyaiva sākṣādabhidhīyamānatvāt|tathā hi "so'śnutesarvānkāmānsaha" iti phalanirdeśaḥ|atra bhoktṛsāhityaṃ vā bhogyasāhityaṃ vā sahaśabdenocyata iti vivecanīyam|bhoktṛsāhityañcet "sahayukte'pradhāne" iti brahmaṇā saheti sahaśabdasambandhād bhoktāraṃ jīvaṃ prati brahmaṇassyādaprādhānyam|taccāyuktaṃ sarvasvāmino brahmaṇassvaśeṣabhūtaṃ jīvaṃ pratyaprādhānyāyogāt"|iti| tadidamāha mantrokta miti|bhoktṛsāhityavacanasyetthamanucitatvād bhogyasāhityameva vaktuṃ yogyamityāha tasmā diti|atraucitye hetvantaramāha brāhmaṇe ti|"brahmavidāpnoti param" iti vidhi brāhmaṇam |tasya vyākhyānaṃ "satyaṃ jñānam" iti mantraḥ|tatra brahmaviditiśabdasya pūrvaṃ vyākhyānamakāri|paramāpnotītyaṃśasya "so'śnute sarvānkāmān saha brahmaṇā vipaścitā" iti vyākaraṇaṃ kriyate|tena bhogyasāhityameva vaktumucitāmityarthaḥ|brahmaṇā saha so'śnuta iti bhoktṛsāhitye vacanavyaktiḥ|brahmaṇā saha sarvānkāmānaśnuta iti bhogyasāhitye vacanavyaktiḥ|nahi bhṛtyānprati svāmino'prādhānyamasti naca tadvaktavyaṃ lokavirodhāt| astu vātra bhoktṛsāhityaṃ vā vivakṣitam ubhayathāpi brahmatattvā jjīvaḥ pṛthageva pratīyate tathācāvibhāgenānu sandhānaṃ na yujyata iti śaṅkate dvedhāpī ti|tadidaṃ pratikṣipati vārta miti|ayamarthaḥatra jīvaparayossvarūpabhedo na pratikṣipyate, siddha eva svarūpabhedaḥ, api tu svātantryeṇāvasthānaṃ parihriyate, sūtropapādyam tasūtrakārābhipretamityarthaḥ, tātparye hi śabdaḥ pramāṇam, tenāpātārthaṃ muktvā tātparyameva paryālocanīyaṃ vicāradhaureyairiti||
"nirañjanaḥ paramaṃ sāmyamupaiti" iti vākyasyārthaṃ śrutitātparyaparyālocanena nigamayati pāramya miti|iha "paramaṃ sāmyam" ityanena sarvathā sāmyamiti nocyate tena pramāṇānusāreṇa yāvadabādhitaṃ sāmyaṃ tāvadaṅgīkāryamityarthaḥ|asminnarthe lokaddaṣṭāntamāha grāvṇa iti| grāvṇo hemnaśca samadharaṇadhṛtau tulyatulādhṛtau tulyatvokti ssyāt| naitāvatā varṇasāmyamapi syāt|api tu niṣkatadardhādibhāvena sāmyam|tadva datrā pi jīvaparamātmanorbhogasāmyameva napunassvāmitvādikamapi samaṃ tasya pramāṇena vyavasthitavṛttitvāt|tarhi "brahma veda brahmaiva bhavati "iti sādhāraṇasāmānādhikaraṇyanirdeśo dṛśyate sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tāvadaikyaparam evakārastu bhedaṃniṣedhati tena jīvabrahmaṇossvarūpaikyaṃ syāditrottaram eva miti|ayamanvayaḥśarīrātmabhāvapratipādakabahuvidhā mnāyabhūmnā jīvasya
bhagava ddehabhāve sthitavati nirṇīte sati brahmaiva bhavatīti sāvadhāraṇo'yaṃ nirdeśassāmyameva draḍhayati|yathā "yathartuṣvṛtuliṅgāni nānārūpāṇi paryaye|ddaśyante tānitānyeva tathā bhāvā yugādiṣu ||" ityatra "tāni tānyeva" iti sāvadhāraṇasāmānādhikaraṇyaśabdaḥ kevalaṃ tajjātīyatvamevācaṣṭe napunastattvameva pūrvottarartūtpannānāṃ tadātadotpannatvena bhinnatvāt evaṃ "brahma veda brahmaiva bhavati" iti brahmatulyaprakāratvamevācaṣṭe napunassvarūpaikyaṃ brahma tu nityanirmalam tadabhidhyānādadhunaiva nirmalībhavati brahmavedī kathaṃ tayoḥ svarūpaikyamiti vaktuṃ śakyate tena brahmaprakāratvena "brahmaiva bhavati" iti sāmānādhikaraṇyenocyata ityarthaḥ|evaṃ nyāyopapāditamarthaṃ pramāṇaṇenopapādayati tādda giti|"yathodakaṃ śuddhe śuddhamāsiktaṃ tāddageva bhavati evaṃ munervijānata ātmā bhavati gautama" iti jīvasya brahmaṇi tāddaktvamapyucyate|napunastattvam|tena yatrayatra tattvamucyate tatrasarvatrāpi tāddaktvamevocyata iti bhāvyamityarthaḥ||
"pratyagātmanaḥ parañjayotirūpasampadya nivṛttarodhānasya svarūpāvirbhāva evetyuktam| tatra yena svarūpeṇāyamāvirbhāvati tatsvarūpaṃ śrutivaividhyād vicāryate " iti saṅgatirbhāṣye| tadarthavicārastukiṃ guṇāṣṭakaviśiṣṭamevāsya svarūpamuta vijñānamātrameva utobhayaṃ svarūpam| kiṃ guṇāṣṭakavaiśiṣṭyajñānamātrasvarūpaviṣayaśrutyoḥ prābalyadorbalyavibhāgo yajyate neti| tayoḥ kiṃ virodhassambhavati neti|atra jaiminyauḍulomyabhimataṃ pakṣadvayaṃ pratyekamupadiśya cayorubhayorapi pakṣayossamuccayaṃ svābhīṣṭaṃ pratipādayitu mārabhate jñānasya iti|ayaṃ kila jaiminerabhiprāyaḥ"ātmano jñānasvarūpamātratvopadeśe tasya svaviṣayagrahaṇāyogyatvāt niṣphalatvameva tena guṇairbrahmasāmyamiṣṭamiti|auḍulomeḥ punarayaṃ bhāvaḥ "svarūpātiriktairabhihitairguṇaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam?tena cinmātrasvarūpaprakāśa evāstu"iti|evaṃ pūrvapakṣadvayamupanyasya dvayo'rapi pakṣayorubhayavidhaśrutyapāttatvenāvaviruddhatvādubhayasamuccayātmakaṃ sveṣṭasvarūpā virbhavanamaghaṭayat|ubhayavidhaśrutyupāttādvirodhāt siddhatattvaprakāśā dityanvayaḥ|ayamatra bhāvaḥyadi jaiminimatamaṅgīkṛtya jñānaguṇakatvādimātramevābhadadhmahe tadā jñānasvarūpatvādipratipādakaśrutivirodhaḥ|yadi ca tacchatyanusāreṇa jñānaguṇakatvādikaṃ hitvā jñānasvarūpatvamātrameva pratipadyāmahe tadā jñānaguṇakatvādi pratipādakaśrutivirodhaḥ|ubhayatrāpyupalambhavirodhaśca syāt|tena sarvavirodhaparihārārthaṃ jñānasvarūpatvaṃ jñānaguṇakatvañca samuccayenāṅgīkṛtya muktidaśāyāmubhayarūpeṇāvirbhavanaṃ pratipadyāmaha iti na ko'pi virodha iti||
atra pūrvasya caitasyacādhikaraṇasyārthavirodhamāśaṅkya virodhagandho'pi nāstīti vyācaṣṭe paryāyā viti| ayamatra pūrvapakṣiṇo bhāvaḥ"muktiḥ kaivalyanirvāṇa" ityādiṣu mokṣakaivalyaśabdau paryāyatvena paṭhitau tatra kaivalyaśabdo vastvantarābhāvameva pradarśayati tatkathaṃ brahmavyatiriktasya jīvasyāvibhāgena darśanaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇoktaṃ sambhavati asmiścādhikaraṇe'pahatapāpmatvādiguṇāṣṭakavaiśiṣṭyena jīve guṇaguṇabhāvena bhedanirdeśaḥ kathaṃ saṅghaṭate|tena kaivalyasyetarābhāvarūpasya
dharmidharmānvayaḥ kathaṃ syāt viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyānvayaḥ kathaṃ syāt|uktaṃ codyaṃ pratikṣipati maiva miti|atra kaivalyaśabdārthasadbhāvaṃ vibhajya darśayati brahme ti|pūrvasminnadhikaraṇe brahmasvarūpavyatiriktasya svaniṣṭhatvaṃ nāstītyuktam|tadeva tasya kaivalyam|asminnadhikaraṇe na kiñcid dravyaṃ guṇarahitamastītyucyate atrāpi tadeva kaivalyaṃ nirguṇatvarāhityopadeśāt|tenobhayasminnadhikaraṇaṃ vivakṣitārthapratipādanamastīti nirādaṅka mevetyāha adhikaraṇayugava miti||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye ""muktaḥ paraṃ brahmopasampadya jñānasvarūpo'pahatapāpmatvādisatyasaṅkalpatvaryanta guṇaka āvirbhavatītyuktam|tamadhikṛtya tasya satyasaṅkalpatvaprayuktā vyavahārāśśruyante "sa tatra paryeti jakṣatkrīḍan ramamāṇassrībhirvā yānairvā jñātibhirvā"" iti|"tadartha vicārastukimasya jñātyādiprāptiḥ prayatnāntarasāpekṣā uta saṅkalpamātramūlā|kimasya satyasaṅkalpatvaṃ rājādīnāmiva bhavati uta paramapuruṣasyeva|kiṃ saṅkalpā devetyavadhāraṇaṃ rājāditulyatāṃ nivartayituṃ prabhavati neti| kimīśvarasaṅkalpavanmuktātmasaṅkalpasyāmodhatvaṃ sambhavati neti|kimasya jakṣaṇādayo vyāpārāḥ puṇyapāparūpatayā bandhakā bhavatanti neti|atra muktasya sopakaraṇasyaiva tattatkāryakaratvaṃ syāt tathācopakaraṇāpekṣāyāṃ tasya saṃsāritvameva syādityāśaṅkyapariharati dhātrāde rityādinā|ayamatrānvayaḥ satyasaṅkalpavṛtterdhātrāderapyupakaraṇā pekṣā vidyate| evaṃ muktasyāpi kāryakaraṇeṣūṇakaraṇagaṇāpekṣā syāt| tathā cāsāvamuktādaviśiṣṭassyāditi|tamimamāśaṅkitamarthaṃ vikalpāsahatvena
dūṣayati vitatha miti|atrāyaṃ vikalpaḥ kiṃ dravyādyapekṣāmātrameva bhavatā sāpekṣatvamucyate kiṃ vā puṇyapāpāpekṣā na tāvadādyaḥ siddhasādhanatvādityāha iṣṭe ti|nāpyuttara ityāhata sukṛte ti|puṇyapāpavinirmukto hi muktaḥ, tasya puṇyapāpāpekṣāṇamastīti vaktumeva na śakyate|yathā nyāyavidāṃ mate cetanakartṛtve karmāpekṣāsti napunarīśvarakartṛtve evamatrāpi muktānāṃ kartṛtve karmāpekṣāstīti viruddhameva|īśvarasya tvīśvaratvadeva karmāpekṣā nāstīticeti muktasyāpi muktatvādeva sā na syāt dvayorapyakarmavaśyatvena pramāṇasiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ|nanu kartṛtvānmuktasyecchāvidhātaḥ kadācitsyāt;na syāt kena karmaṇā vidhātasambhavaḥ|tarhīśvarecchayā vidhātassyādityāśaṅkyāha deve ti|muktaḥ khalu "imām̐llokān kāmānnī kāmarūpyanusañcaran" iti bhagavadanuvartakatvenaiva śrūyate|atastasya bhagavadvāñchayecchāvidhātasśaṅkitumapi na śakyataityarthaḥ||
muktasya sarvavastusākṣātkāre sakalakāryakaraṇe ceśvarameva ddaṣṭāntayitvā durbalabuddhon pratyāyayati viśvasye ti|ayamatrānvayaḥ etasya viśvasya janmasthitilayaracanā viśvakartu rīśvarasya yathā syāt eva micchāsantānabhedānnityamuktakriyāṇā mapi niyatissyāt |nanvicchāsantānasya kāryatvenocchedassyād yathā pradīpārcissantānasya, tathā ca "jakṣatkrīḍan ramamāṇaḥ" ityādyukto muktikriyāsantānopyucchidyetetyā śaṅkya pariharati tasye ti|icchāsantānasyānucchedo hi "naca punarāvartate" ityādiśrutisiddhatvādapalapitu meva na śakayate|anyathā pūrvāvadhimata uttarāvadhyavaśyambhāvakathane tadvadevottarāvadhimataḥ karmasantānasya pūrvāvadhirapi syāt|tathā ca saṃsārasyānāditvameva na sidhyati|pramāṇasiddhatvāt tatparityuktaṃ vaktumeva na śakyata iti samassamādhiḥ|nanu muktabuddheḥ pārokṣyamāparokṣyaṃ vā pārokṣye bandha eva syāt āparokṣyamapi na ghaṭate indriyajanyajñānasya hyāparokṣyam muktasya tu śarīrendriyādikaṃ na vidyate vidyate cet tanmūlabhūtaṃ karmāpi syāt tathāca punassaṃsāra eva syāt tathā ca muktajñānasyāparokṣyamapi na sambhavatītyatrāha tadbuddhe rityādi|yathā khalvīśvarabuddherīparokṣyaṃ tadvajjīvabuddherapyā parokṣyaṃ prāptam|tadetāvantaṃ kālaṃ karmaṇā saṅkucitam|adhunā pratibandhakaṃ nivṛtte svābhāvikaṃ syāditi|
atra satyasaṅkalpatve satyapi prabalapratighātakasadbhāve loke pratihatirddaśyate, evaṃ mukte'pi prabalapratighātakasadbhāvāt pratihatissyādityāśaṅkya pratighātakatvaṃ puṇyapāpayoreva, tayostasminnabhāvāt pratihatiśaṅkaiva na syāt|asti kiñcit vyāpāratāratambhaṃ muktānām|tadastu nāma tāvatā na bhogasāmyaṃ bādhyate|sarveṣāmapi muktānāṃ pratibandhakābhāvenāsaṅkucitajñānatvāditi darśayati pratyūhārhā iti|śabdānvayastu satyasaṅkalpa tve satyapi prādeśika sukṛtinaḥ kālaviśeṣasukṛtino'pi pratyūhārhāḥ | anyadupakrāntamanyadāpatitamitinyāyena anyābhiprāyeṇa pravṛttānāmanyadeva jāyata iti darśayita martyārambhe ti| martyaḥ putrādiḥ|putrādyarambhaspṛhayā karmānuṣṭhāne karmakartṛsādhanavaiguṇyādinā śatrūṇāmevārambha darśanādityarthaḥ|athavā martyasyārambhaspṛhādau tadvirodhivividhaprāṇisṛṣṭyādiddaṣṭeri tyanvayaḥ| anyacintāyāmanyārambhe niyāmakamūlābhāvād vyāpāranairarthakyameva syādityāśaṅkya niyāmakameva darśayati teneti| amīṣāṃ saṃsāriṇāṃ jīvānāṃ pravṛttānāṃ sāphalyaṃ vaiphalyaṃ viparītaphalañca prācīnapuṇyapāpābhyāmeva bhavati| muktasya tu puṇyapāpe na staḥ|tasya cikīrṣā niyatameva saphalameva śrutirapi kathayati|īśvarasti tadicchāmevānucchinna pravṛttimātanotītyāha muktasye ti|nanu muktasyecchāvidhātābhāve'pi vyāpāratāratamya mastyeva tena bhogatāratamyāmapi syādityāśaṅkya pariharati tāratamya miti|nahi vyāpārātāratamyamevāpavarge doṣaḥ yadi bhogatāratamyamasti tadā hi doṣassyāt nahi naṭavṛttirnaṭasyaiva santoṣamātanoti, api tu taddarśināmanyeṣāmapi evaṃ sarveṣāmapi muktānāṃ bhagavadanusañcaraṇādivyāpārassā dhāraṇyena santoṣakāraṇamiti bhāgasāmyaṃ sidhyatyeva|rājakuleṣu vartamānāḥ khalu pratyekaṃ svādhikārānurūpeṇa vyāpāreṇa rājānaṃ sevante santoṣastu sarveṣāṃ sādhāraṇa iti karatalāmalakametat||
atra kaściccodayatisūtra iti|"saṅkalpādeva tacchateḥ|ata eva cānanyādhipatiḥ" iti sūtradvaye mukto'nanyādhipatiḥ kathitaḥ| tena tasya śeṣī na syāt|kiñca "sa svarāḍbhavati" iti śrutyaiva muktaḥ
svatantratve noktaḥ | ataḥ pūrvapratiṣṭhāpitānāṃ paramapuruṣaśeṣitvapāratantryādīnāṃ sarveṣāmapyarthānāṃ vihati ssyāt|atrottaram maiva miti|pratikṣepaprakāramāha nāthe ti|asminnadhikaraṇe bhagavadvyatiriktān prati pāpakṛta śśeṣabhāvo jīvasya pratikṣipyate tathaiva tatpārantryamapi|"patiṃ viśvasyātmeśvaram" ici yaḥ paṭhitau viśvasya patiḥ tasya bādhya meva na bhavati|ato muktasya bhagavaccheṣatvapāratantryayorna ko'pi virodha iti|
atra bhāṣye saṅgatiḥ"kiṃ muktasya dehendriyāṇi na santi uta santi athavā yathāsaṅkalpaṃ santi na santi ceti viśaye" iti|tadarthavicārastukiṃ muktasyetyādiḥ prathamavicāraḥ|tadarthaṃ vicāryate"
sa ekadhā bhavati" ityādiśrutiraśarīratvaśrutiṃ saṅkocayituṃ śaknoti neti|kiṃ "sa ekadhā bhavati" ityādivākyaṃ muktasya saśarīratvaṃ pratipādayituṃ prabhavatyuta na|pratipādane'pi kiṃ saśarīratvamātraṃ pratipādayatyutaitaccharīratvamavagamayatīti|tadarthamekadhābhavanatridhābhavādikaṃ muktasya śarīreṇa vinā sambhavatyuta na|atra bādarijaiminimatābhyāṃ pūrvapakṣamanuvadati mukta iti|"aśariraṃ vāva santaṃ na priyāpriye spṛśataḥ"iti kvaci dvākye mukto'śarīratvena proktaḥ | atha tasyaiva muktasya "sa ekadhā bhavati tridhā bhavati" ityādivākye bahudhāsambhavaśca śrūyate|kvacitpunaśśarīrendriyasādhyaṃ gānakrīḍādi ca "etatsāma gāyan" ityādivākye pratipādyate|tatta dvākyānuguṇamārṣaṃ matadvandvaṃ nirasyan bādarimatamaśarīratvaniyamaṃ jaiminimataṃ saśarīratvaniyamañca nirasyan sūtrakāraḥ sva mataṃ yathāvaddarśayatītyaha svacchandasye ti|yatheṣṭaṃ saśarīratvamaśarīratva ñcobhaya mapi tulyam|ayamabhiprāyaḥasaṅkucitabrahmānubhavaharūpepuruṣārthaṃ na śarīrapekṣā, sarvadeśasarvakārasarvāvasthocitabhagavatkaiṅkarye punaḥ "imāṃllokān" "jakṣatkrīḍan ramamāṇaḥ" ityādikaśrutyukte śarīrāpekṣeti|nanu saśarīratvamapyaṅgīkṛtañcet "na ha vai saśarīrasya sataḥ" ityuktapriyā priyayuktatvamapi syāditi punarāvartate saṃsāra ityāśaṅkyāhasyāditi|ayamarthaḥyadi saśarīratvamātraṃ saṃsāraḥ, tarhīśvarasyāpi saṃsārassyāt|api tu karmādhīnaśarīratvaṃ saṃsāraḥ|īśvaravanmuktasyāpi svacchandasya saṅkalpamātrādhīnaśarīratve'pi saṃsāragandhānavakāśa iti ramaṇīyametat||
nanu bādaripakṣo'pi svābhimata eva tathā jaiminipakṣo'pi evañca sati sūtrakāreṇa tatpakṣapratikṣepeṇa svapakṣatayā ko'yaṃ pakṣassthāpita iti codanāyāṃ śiṣyapratibodhanārthaṃ svapakṣaṃ punarapi viśiṣya darśayati mokṣa iti|ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ mokṣe puṇyādyabhāvāt tadupadhikavapurvarjitatvaṃ bādariṇā kathitaṃ na dūṣyam, tadvad duḥkhārhadeha rahite tasminmukte jaimininoktaśśubhaśarīrasattvapakṣo'pi na bādhanīya eva, itthaṃ satyatra muninā bādarāyaṇena kīddaśī muktasya sthitis sūtritā syāditi|atrottaramāha maiva miti|svābhipretamāviṣkaroti svacchande ti|svacchandadeho'stīti vacanād dehasambandho niyamena nāstīti vadan bādarirnirastaḥ|tena bhagavatsaṅakalpamūlasvasaṅkalpādeva yathāyogaṃ śarīrī cāśarīraśca bhavati mukta iti siddhāntaḥ||
atra kaściccodayati nāne ti|jīvastāvadaṇuriti prasiddham|atra puna radhigatabrahmasāmyasya tasya yukapat nānādeho bhavatītyucyate yadyevaṃ tarhi teṣāṃ dehānāṃ deśabhedenoppannānāṃ vyāptaparabrahmasvarūpānvaya eva samucitaḥ, na punaraṇurūpajīvasvarūpānvayaḥ|tena jīvāṇutvādo muktidaśāyāṃ bhajyeta|yadi tadā vibhutvaṃ jīvasya tarhi jīveśvaravibhāgo na syāt| aṇuravagatimāñjīvaīśo'nya iti bhavatāṃ siddhāntaḥ|tadetaddūṣayati naita diti|atra hetumāha dhītavyāptisiddhe riti| svarūpavyāptyabhāve'pi jīvasya muktitadaśāyāṃ dharmabhūtajñānavyāptisiddherityarthaḥ|ayamarthaḥ "pradīpavadāveśaḥ"iti vadatā sūtrakāreṇa vyaktamukta ityāha bhavati ce ti|jīvasyāṇutve'pi "sa cānantyāyakalpate" "sa ekadhā bhavati" ityādi jagadāveśavāk dharmabhūtajñānavyāptinibandhanetyarthaḥ|nanu jīvasya muktidaśāyāṃ "paramaṃ sāmyamupaiti" iti vacanād vibhutvamevāṅgākṛtyānekaśarīraparigrahaḥ kiṃ na syādityāśaṅakyāha saubharyādā vityādi|ayamarthaḥ śaubharyādau tāvad vibhutvamantareṇa dharmabhūtajñānavyāptyaiva nānāśarīraparigrahaḥ klṛptaḥ eva|evañca muktasya vibhutvaṃ parikalpya nānāśarīraparigrahavarṇanād varaṃ klṛptenaiva saubharyādinyāyena jñānavyāptyā nānāśarīraparigrahavarṇanameva klṛptakalpyavirodhe tu klṛptaparigraha eva nyāyya iti hi nītividāṃ nirṇayaḥ| paramasāmyaṃ tu bhāgamātrata eveti sūtrakāraireva niraṇāyi "bhogamātrasāmyaliṅgācca" iti, na punassvarūpasāmyam|tena vyavasthitameva jīveśvaralakṣaṇakathanamiti||
aṇorjīvasya punaranekaśarīraparigrahānupapattimabhīdhāya samādhatte dehānā miti|ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ śarīrāṇāṃ yaugapadye sati kathama ṇurjīvo muktassvayamanekeṣu śarīreṣu dhāraka ssyāt|atra dhāraka tvakathanaṃ niyāmakatvāderapyupalakṣaṇam| caitanyadvārataśce ditidharmabhūtajñānadvāreṇa dehadhāraṇamāśaṅkya muktajñānasya sakalārthavyāptimattvena sarvadhārakatvamapi muktasya syāt tathā ca jīveśvaravibhāgāsiddhirityāha sakalamapī ti|atrottaram maiva miti|nahi vyāptimātreṇa sarvadhārakatvaṃ syāt|tathā satikālasyāpi vyāptatvena sarvadhārakatvaprasaṅgāt|apitu śaktiviśeṣādeva dhārakatvam|nahi muktasyānekadhārakatvānukūlā śaktirasti|apitu niyamitaviṣayā muktasya śaktiḥ  "jagadvyāpāravarjam" iti sūtrakāreṇa tacchakteḥ kvācitkatvena niyamanāt|yatrāpi muktabuddheśśaktirasti tatrāpi sarvaśakte rīśvara syecchayaiva sā niyamyata ityāha icchayā sarvaśakte riti|kathaṃ tarhi saubharyāderamuktasyānekadehaparigrahaśaktirityāśaṅkyāha prāgi ti| tāddagyogaśaktyā īśvaradattayogaśaktyetyarthaḥ|na kevalaṃ yogaśaktyā anādisiddhakarmaparipāko' pyatra kāraṇamityāha karmabandha iti|karmānugṛhītajñānapaharipākāt tāddaśī śaktiryogasiddhirityucyata ityarthaḥ||
atra kaściccodayati bandhadaśāyāṃ saṅkucitasya jñānasya muktidaśāyāṃ vikāso bhavadbhirucyate, sa tu saṅkoco vikāsaśca jīvasvarūpasyaiva karmabhirāveṣṭanam, karmanirmiktasya tasyaiva vikāso'pi syāt, kimanena dharma bhūtajñāne saṅkocavikāsaparikalpanena pramāṇaviruddhena" iti | tadidamāha śakti riti|nanu niravayavatvājjīvasya kathaṃ vikāsa ityāśṅkya dharmabhūtajñānasyāpi tanniravayavatvaṃ samānamityāha puṃsa iti|yathā puruṣasyā naṃśāpi buddhiravasthā bhedena smṛtyanubhūtyādinānā vikṛti matī evaṃ jīvo'pi baddhadaśāyāmaṇuḥ muktadaśāyāṃ tu vibhuśca syāt|ayaṃ parimāṇabhedo muktabaddhavyavasthayā niraṃśe bhavadīyadharmabhūtajñāne'pyastīti bhavatāpi vaktavyamityarthaḥ|tadetannigamayati tadaya miti|tadidaṃ pratikṣipati na syā diti|pratikṣipahetumāha jainādibhaṅga iti|jaināḥ khalu dehaparimāṇo jīvastadātadā pariṇamata iti vadanti|tattu jīvasya vikarābhāvājjainādhikaraṇe pratikṣiptam|ayamatrānvayaḥ jainādibhaṅge parihṛtavikṛte rjīvasyai karūpyānapāyā diti ākārāntaprāptivirahasyānapāyāditi|ayamarthaḥātmano nirvikāratvaṃ pramāṇapratipannam baddhadaśāyāmaṇostasyaiva muktadaśāyāmānantyañca tenaiva pramāṇena pratipannam| dvayora'pi pramāṇayoravirodho vācyaḥ|sa cāviradhassvarūpavikārābhāvād dharmabhūtajñāne śrutipratipannānantyasvīkarācca viṣayabhedena sidhyati|jñānasya tu sākṣānnirvikāratvavacanaṃ nāsti|pratyuta savikāratvavaṭanānyeva śrūyante|jñānasaṅkocavikāsapratipādakaśrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇavacanānāmānantyāt| ātmani tirodhānavacanaṃ tu jñānadvārā yathā ghanapaṭalena tirohito dharmaraśmiriti||
atra punaścodayati jīvasye ti|vṛkṣeṣu sarvāsvapi śākhāsu vyāptyā vartamāno jīvaḥ kāścana śākhā jahāti kāsu cicchākhāsu vartate, yatra hānaṃ tatra śuṣkībhavati vṛśraḥ yatra punarahānaṃ tatrottarottaraṃ śākhāvṛddhirapi ddaśyate tena jīvasvarūpasya prahāṇaprahāṇayordarśanāt svarūpapariṇāmo'stīti mantavyam| tadidaṃ nigamayati tasmā diti|evamupapādanāt|āvaraṇābhāve jīve "sa cānantyāya kalpate" ityadhīta mānantyaṃ na dharmabhūtajñānadvarākam api tvadvāraka meva|netyāha maiva miti|tadevopapādayati śākhā sviti|jīvasya śākhāsu prahāṇaṃ nāma na svarūpaprahāṇam, apitu tāsu tāsu bhogāśraya tvopapādaka puṇyapāpaviratireva tato na jīvasya svarūpavikāraḥ|asminnarthe ddaṣṭāntamapyāha kṣetrādinyayata iti|yathā kṣetraṃ parigṛhmāti jahātītyatra kṣetre na svarūpavyāptirjīvasya parigrahaḥ, nāpi svarūpeṇa tadvimocanaṃ hānam, api tu jīvabhogasādhanatvopapādakadharmādharmaparigrahaḥ kṣetrasyāpi parigrahaḥ, tatprahāṇañca kṣetraprahāmamiti| abhimativirahā ditiupādhinimittābhimānaviśeṣavirahādityarthaḥ|ayamarthaḥ"vāsāṃsi jīrṇāni yathā vihāya" ityādiṣu dehasya hānaṃ parigrahaṇañcābhidhīyamānaṃ karmādhīnābhimānaviśeṣamātram, napunassvarūpaprāptirnāpi svarūpaviyogaḥ tena jīvasvarūpavikāraśaṅkā nāṅkurati||
muktāvasthāyāṃ bhedābhedavādināṃ svavacanavirodhāt pramāṇavirodhācca te jainamatavad vyāhataṃ pakṣaṃ parityajya vyāghātadośavidhuraṃ sanmārgameva bhajantvityāha eka iti|ayamarthaḥasmatpakṣe vyāghātapramāṇa virodhaśaṅkābhāvāt sa eva satpathaḥ apare tvasatpathā iti|śabdānvayastueko naiko bhinnaścābhinnaśca parasmātpṛthagapṛthagapi mukto jīvaḥ svasvarūpeṇa tathā paramātmaṇaḥ pṛthaktvāpṛthaktvasvarūpeṇa svābhīṣṭāśeṣabhoktā svayaṃ bhavatīti pṛthakakṣīpavad bālonmattavad ye bhramanti|te svoktibādhaṃ ekaścānekaścaparasmātpṛthagiti svavacanavirodhaṃ "pṛthagātmānaṃ preritārañca" ityādi śrutiśatavihatiṃ tattaduktayānyaparyaṃ bhedābhedapratipādakaśrutīnāmanyaparatvaṃ jīvānāmanyonyaikyapratipādanaṃ sājātyāt, jīvabrahmaṇoranyonyaikyapratipādanaṃ tu jñānānandādirūpeṇa sājātyāt śarīrātmabhāvapratipādanena brahmātmakatvābhiprāyāccacidbrahmamoraikyapratipādanaṃ viśiṣṭaikyādityāditātparyamālocya jaināvaṣṭambhena ddapyanmatikalahaṃ muktavā sanmārgameva saṃśravantvi ti|ayamarthaḥ ye bhedābhedavādinaḥ karmamīmāṃsakāḥ, ye ca tanmatānusāriṇo bhedābhedamāśrayante brahmamīmāṃsakāḥ|ubhaye'pi jainagāndhimīmāṃsakāḥ|ato jainamatānusāraṃ vihāya te sanmārgameva samāśrayantviti "bhoktā bhogyaṃ preritāram" iti tattvatrayasya
svarūpabhedāṅgīkāreṇa "sarvaṃ proktaṃ trividhaṃ brahmametat" iti viśiṣṭaikyānusandhānameva sanmārgaḥ, tameva mārgaṃ parigṛhṇantviti||
atra ponaruktyamāśaṅkya pariharati sarva miti|"sa yadi pitṛlokakāmo bhavati saṅkalpādevāsya pitarassamuttiṣṭhanti" iti śrutyaktam|tadeva "saṅkalpādeva tacchateḥ" iti sūtrakāreṇāpyupapāditaṃ pūrvameva|tadevādhunāpi svecchāto dehayogādyaniyatiriti punaḥ kathyate|tenāyaṃ piṣṭapeṣassyā diti codakābhiprāyaḥ|atra piṣṭapeṣaṇanyāyo netyāha tanne ti|tadevopapādayati anyonye ti|ayamarthaḥyadi pūrvoktamevātrāpyuktaṃ syāt tadā hi piṣṭapeṣanyāyaḥ|pūrvaṃ hi "saṅkalpādeva tacchateḥ" ityatra prayatnanirapekṣaṃ svasaṅkalpādeva dehendriyādikaṃ bhavatītyetāvanmātramuktam|atra punaḥ karmādhīnaderābhāve kaścidāha| karmānadhīnadehasadbhāvamaparastvāha|asmābhistu saśarīratvāśarīratvaśrutyorviṣayaniyamo'bhidhīyata ityayamadhiko'rthaḥ|arthāntaramapyadhikamāha kāmata iti|saṅkalpādevānekaderasvīkāre kadācitsvaparikalpitadehaparigrahaḥ kadācicca paramapuruṣaparikalpitadehaparigraha iti deraparigrahā niyatikathane sūtrakārābhisandhe rvidyamānatvādadhikārthopadeśo'stīti na paunarūktyaprasaṅgaḥ| atrā niyatikathanavacanaṃ samanantaroktaniyatikathanasyāpyupalakṣaṇam||
atra saṅgatirbhāṣye "kiṃ muktasyaiśvaryaṃ jagatsṛṣṭyādiparamapuruṣāsādhāraṇaṃ sarveśvaratvamapyuta tadrahitaṃ kevalaparamapuruṣānubhavaviṣayamiti saṃśayaḥ" iti|tadarvicārastukiṃ muktasyaiśvaryaṃ jagadvyāpāraviṣayamuta neti| kiṃ jaganniyamanasya muktaiśvaryāntarbhāve "yato vā imāni" ityādibraṃhmalakṣaṇavākyaṃ virudhyate neti|kiṃ muktasya sṛṣṭiprakaraṇāsannidhānena jagadvyāpārasya brahmalakṣaṇatvāśrayaṇaṃ nyāyyamuta muktasya vikāralokānusañcaraṇa śravaṇena jaganniyamanasya brahmalakṣaṇatvāśrayaṇamanyāyyamiti|kiṃ muktasya vikāralokānusañcaraṇaṃ niyamanārthamuta kevalabhogārthamiti|atra pūrvapakṣī "paramaṃ sāmyamupaiti" iti śrutyāpātapratītyanusāreṇa paramapuruṣavajjagadvyāpāro'pi muktasyāstviti śaṅkate yadya pī ti|ayamarthaḥpūrvameva muktaśśarīralakṣaṇairādheyatvādibhiḥ paramātmanaśśarīramiti yadyapyuktaḥ|tathāpi vyāpārāṃśe śrutaṃ paramaṃ sāmyamakṣobhaṇīyam |tataḥ "saṅkalpādeva tacchateḥ" iti sūtroktamukta saṅkalpādeva sarvotthānaṃ syāditi jagadvyāpārasyāpi bhavediti pūrvapakṣiṇaḥ pratyavasthānaṃ śāsrānte nikṛntati nudati| kṛtimaditarayorassthā payanbhogasāmya miti kṛtimān jagatkartā itaro jīvastayorbhogasāmyameva saṃbhavati napunarjagadvyāpārasāmyam, tatsāmye jīveśvaralakṣaṇavibhāgavilopaprasaṅgāditi||
atra pūrvapakṣī jagadvyāpārasāmyābhāve virodhamāśaṅkate
sāyujya miti|ayamatra śabdārthānugamaḥ nirguṇaiḥ khalu śabdārthānugamād bhogasāmya meva sāyujya miti samagaṇi| taccāsmābhiḥ prāgeva vivṛtam|tatra hetumāha śabdaśaktyādyabādhā diti|darśitā cāsmābhiśśabdaśaktiḥ|atra nipuṇairityabhidhānamaikyaṃ sāyujyamityabhidadhatāmadvaitināṃ nirāsārtham|astu sāyujyaśabdārthaḥ kiṃ tataḥ prastutasyetyāśaṅkyāha tacce ti|yadi vyāpārasāmyaṃ tadaiva hi sāyujyamapi syāt|bhojanasāmye hi bhogasāmyamapi sambhavati| uktamarthaṃ vyatirekato'pi draḍhayati asatī ti|tadevopapādayati svakriye ti|īśvarasya hi svakriyāsvāda eva sarvadā bhavatīti jīvasya jagadvyāpārābhāve svakriyāsvādābhā vāt kathamiva sarvasāmyasiddhiḥ|uktamarthaṃ sopapattikaṃ nigamayati tasmā diti|taditaṃ pratikṣipati maiva miti|tadevopapādayati tallakṣaṇa miti| ayamarthaḥyasya tu yallakṣaṇaṃ tat tasyaiva syāt napunaranyasya tena lakṣaṇabhūto jagadvyāpāra īśvarasya tada nyasyacānugamato 'nuvṛttyā kathaṃ syāt |lakṣyālakṣyayoranuvartamānaṃ na hi lakṣyasya lakṣaṇamiti lakṣamavido vadanti||
nanu vyāpārābhāve kathaṃ bhogasāmyaṃ syādityatra lokaddaṣṭaprakriyā tadabhāve'pi bhogasāmyamupapādayati kathyanta iti|ayamatra śabdānvayaḥsṛ ṣṭivākye kvacidapi muktā jagatkāraṇatvena na kathyante |tarhi "imāṃllokānkāmānnī" ityādi kāmacāra vacanaṃ kathaṃ syādityāṅkya so'pi bhavatu nāma tathāpi na jagadārambhakatva siddhirityāha prādhī ta iti|atra vyāpārasāmyābhāve kathaṃ bhogasāmyamityetāvadavaśiṣyate tadapi netyāha sarve ti|bhogyasāmyādeva hi bhogasāmyam, na puvarvyāpārasāmyāt|loke hi naṭanartanādiṣu vyāpāreṣu sabhāpatibhāvukanaṭādīnāmanubhārvyārthasāmyena bhogasāmyaṃ ddaśyata eva|na kevalaṃ naṭasyaiva bhogaḥ|yathā rājānaṃ sevamānānāṃ rājāntaraṅgapuruṣāṇāmānando rājñā samāna eva|kevalaṃ svāmyaṃ svātantryañca rājñi vartate napunarānande viśeṣaḥ|iyaṃ tu lokaddaṣṭaprakriyā|na kevalamiyameva, śrutirapi "sa eko brahmaṇa ānandaḥ śrotriyasya
cākāmahatasya" iti vadantī jīveśvarayośśeṣaśeṣibhāvādinā svarūpavaiṣamye vyāpāravaiṣamye ca satyapi bhogasāmyamevopapādayati|tathā ca ddaṣṭāddaṣṭapramāṇapratipannaṃ bhogasāmyaṃ samaddaṣṭīnāṃ viśiṣṭānāmiṣṭamiti na ko'pi virodhaḥ||
atra kecidvadanti "manuṣyānandamārabhya caturmukhānandaparyantamuttarottaramānandādiśayamuktvā "śrotrayasya cākāmahatasya" iti niṣkāmaśrotriyasyāpyanukramāt sa evānando'titiśyate|tena paramapadasthānāmapi niṣkāmaśrotriyāṇāṃ manuṣyānandāditulyānandavattvamaṅgīkāryam" iti|taditamanuvadati niṣkāme ti| evamanūditaṃ dūṣayati tatta ditutterottarasaṃsāribhogātpūrvapūrvoktabhogasya śatāṃśena nyūnatvātkaṣṭatva mityarthaḥ|nahi paramapadaṃ gatasya prasiddhendrādibhogādatvayantāvaratvakathanamāstikānāṃ goṣṭhīṣu samasti|na paramapuruṣaḥ paramaikāntinaḥ paramapadaṃ gatasyāpi bhagavadānandānantyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi|tadidameva prakārāntaraṃ yadvyatirekamukhenānantyaṃ kathayāmīti "yato vācaḥ" iti vākyena vyatirekamukhena kathitavatī|atra sukhapratipattyarthaṃ yāmunācāryābhipretaṃ sphuṭābhihitañca ddaṣṭāntadvayamāha yaṣṭ yeti|ākāśo hi yaṣṭyā na mīyate tadvatparabrahmānando'pyalpī yasā manasā na mīyata ityeko ddaṣṭāntaḥ|aparastu "ko majjatoraṇukulācalayorviśeṣaḥ" iti sphuṭamevokta ityāha tacceti ||
atra jagadvyāpāravarjamityuktasyārthasya viśadapratipattyarthaṃ muktasya jagadupādānatvābhāvena jagadvyāpāravarjanam|vyāpārābhāve'pi bhogasāmyaṃ prāguktameva prakaṭamupapādayati viśva miti|ayamanvayaḥ viśvaṃ muktasya tāvaddeha eva na bhavati| muktāpṛthaksiddhyabhāva sya sphuṭameva viśvasminnupa lambhāt tenā sāvupādāna miti kathayituṃ nocitaḥ |tasya sarvaśaktitvā bhāvāt|nanu muktasyecchāvighātābhāvo bhavadbhireva mahatā prayāsenopapāditaḥ, adhunā punaḥ prāyeṇecchāvighāta evocyate upādānādibhāvāsambhavāditi tatkathamityāśaṅkyāha nātmeti |ayamarthaḥmukto hi tattvavedī tena śakyameva
cikīrṣennāśakyam ato'śakyaviṣaye necchāvighāto muktasya|yattu śakyaṃ taccikīrṣedeva tatra tasyecchāvighāto nāstītyāha taditaraviṣaya iti|ayamabhiprāyaḥbhagavānkhalu muktasyābhipreteṣu kaiṅrkyādiṣu kartavyeṣu yathābhimataṃ pitṛlokādikaraṇeṣu ca necchāṃ vihanti tena muktasyecchāvighātābhāvaḥ|na hyākāśanigaraṇamapyabhilaṣati muktaḥ anabhijñatvaprasaṅgāt|aśakyābhilāṣādanyat kimanabhijñatvam|nanu tarhi vyāpārasaṅkoce muktasya rasasaṅkoco'pi syādityāśaṅkya pūrvameva bahuvāramuktamuttarameva bāraprāyasya codakasya punarapyanugrahādanuvadati vyāpāra iti|nahi rājāsthānamātasthuṣāmadhikārabhede'pyānandavaiṣamyamastīti bahuśo'pyuktamasmābhiriti||
uktamarthamantevāsināmatyantavaiśadyāya sārvabhaumaprasāda ddaṣṭāntena draḍhayatitattaditi| yathādhikāramucita sevāviśeṣe sati sthirapariṇamitassārvabhaumaprasāda ssevakānāṃ sāmyaṃ sūte |tatrāpyanu citābhyarthanānivāraṇāya tadeva sāmyaṃ viśeṣayati svaya miti|nahi bhṛtyassvayaṃ svāmicihnamapi cchatracāmarādikaṃ siṃhāsanādhirohaṇamabhivāñchati| eva meva dayāluṃ devaṃ śaraṇamupagatai radhyātmavidbhirlabhyate| ananyalabhyā "bhaktyā tvananyayā" ityuktairevādhikāribhirlabhyā nāparairadhikāribhiḥ|"naca punarāvartate" ityādi śrutyaiva nirdhūtāvṛttiśaṅkā nirupadhikarasā deśakālādyupādhirahitaniratiśayarasavatī sakhyavasthā śrīpatitvaśeṣaśāyitvādyasādhāraṇabhagadguṇarāhityena savyavasthā| avasthā sarvadeśasarvakālasarvāvasthocitata sarvavidhakaiṅkaryalābhāvasthetyarthaḥ||
etasminpāde'dhikaraṇaṣaṭkamarthabhedāduktam, apare punassaptamamapyadhikaraṇamekaraṇamekasūtramityāhuḥ "anāvṛttiśśabdādanāvṛttiśśabdāt" iti|tat prāyeṇa bhāṣyakārānabhimatam|adhikaraṇaprayojanañca na bhavatītyāha atrāhu riti|ayamatra śabdānvayaḥ atrānāvṛ ttipratipādakamantyaṃ sūtraṃ pṛthagadhikaraṇaṃ kecidāhuḥ |tatra heturapi vadanti āñjasyalābhā diti sūtrasvārasyalābhādityarthaḥ|pūrvādhikaraṇe samāpte punaḥ punarāvṛttiśaṅkyādhikaraṇāntaramārabhyata iti sūtrasvārasyamastīti bhāvaḥ|atrānugrāhakaṃ hetvantaramastītyāha  astī ti|ayamatra bhāvaḥ"imaṃ mānavamāvartaṃ nāvartante" ityasminvākye ddaśyate hīmamiti padaṃ, tenāvṛttirasti etallokaprāptimātra nāstīti dyotyate tenāvṛttiśaṅkayādhikaraṇotthānamiti pṛthagadhikaraṇārabhya iti|atrottaramāha bhāṣyādo tanna ddaṣṭa miti|tarhi "anāvṛttiśśabdāt" iti sūtrasya pṛthagadhikaraṇatvābhāve pūrvādhikaraṇaśeṣatvaṃ vācyam, taccheṣatvaṃ na ddaśyata ityāśaṅkyāha bhavatī ti|kathaṃ pūrvaśeṣatva miti punarāśaṅkyāha syādi ti|ayamatra bhāvaḥsatyasaṅkalpasya jīvasya punarāvṛttau satyāṃ pūrvādhikaraṇe pūrvapakṣiṇoktaṃ paramaśāmyaptāśaṅkituṃ śakyate paramapuruṣo'pi kaścitsatyasaṅkalpo' smilloke vartate ayamapi kaścitsatyasaṅkalpa iti tayorjagadvyāpāreṇātyantasāmyamiti, etacchaṅkānivārāṇārthaṃ muktasyānagamanameva niṣidhyate|kevalaṃ vaikuṇṭhe bhagavantaṃ sevityaiva vartata iti pūrvādhikaraṇaśeṣatvasiddhireva tasya sūtrasyeti|atrāyaṃ nirṇayaḥ"imaṃ mānavamāvartaṃ nāvartante" ityatremamitiśabdaḥ kṛtsnasya mānavāvartasyopalakṣaṇārthaḥ|sarvakarmavinirmuktasya muktasya kvacidapi karmādhīnapunarāvṛttiprasaṅgābhāvāt "imān lokān" ityatra svacchandakaiṅkaryarūpānugamanāṅgatayoktaṃ svacchandapunarāvartanamapi sarvatra samānam "imān lokān" ityasminneva loke
punarāvṛttiśravaṇāditi|| nanu "akṣayyaṃ havai cāturmāsyājinassukṛtaṃ bhavati" ityarthavādacanavat "naca punarāvartate" ityādikamapi cirakālāvasthāyitvamātreṇa caritārthaṃ syādityāśaṅkya sarvakarmavinirmuktasya punarāvṛttiprasaṅgābhāvānnitya mevana karmakṛtāṃ punarāvṛtiṃta niṣedhatīti darśayati sargādī ti|ayamatrānvayaḥsṛṣṭisthiti saṃhārāvarta līlārasasahacarite daṇḍarāsa prāye saṃsāriparivartane niyuktaṃ jīvaṃ ddaṣṭvā tuṣṭabuddhirbhagavāṃstasya paritoṣikapradānamiva saṃsārimocanopalambhasaukhyaṃ pradāya sāyujya dhanyaṃ tameva bhunakti paripālayatītyarthaḥ| sarveṣāmeva karmaṇāmatyantopaśānteḥ "naca punarāvartate"iti vākyenaiva bhagavānna punarāvartayatyenaṃ muktamityāmnāte sati "akṣayyaṃ havai cāturmāsya" ityādyuktākṣayyaphalakathanādiprayuktaśaṅkyā upaśāntissyāt|ayamarthaḥkṛtsnakarmavinirmokābhāve hi "naca punarāvartate" iti vākyasya yathākathañcidanyathākaraṇaṃ syāt kṛtsnakarmavinirmoke pratipanne sati apunarāvṛttivacanaṃ yathāśrutyaiva sādhīyānayaṃ mārga iti||
atroktādhikaraṇaṣaṭkārthaviśeṣān vibhajyānukathayati svāvirbhāva iti| apavarge svasvarūpāvirbhāvaḥ prathamādhikaraṇārthaḥ|evaṃ pañcabhiradhikaraṇaiḥ pañcārthāḥ pratipādyante| nirupadhi katayā niyata svaśarīriparyantaddaṣṭirdvitīye|tṛtīyaṃ ca cidrūpasyaiva jīvasya śruti śikharapratitaissvaguṇais saha darśanam| caturthe punas saṅkalpādeva svābhīṣṭa siddhiḥ |pañcame tu svaśarīrareṣvaniyamena parigrahaḥ|ṣaṣṭhe punaḥ parabrahmasāmyaprāptau jagatkāramatvamokṣapradatvaśrīpatitvādibrahma lakṣaṇa varjanamiti caturthādhyāyacaturthapādādhi karaṇaṣaṭkārthasārā iti||
atra caturthādhyāyārthasya kārtsnyena mṛṣāvādināṃ saṅghaṭanamena nāstītyāha dhyānādi miti|
dhyānaṃ bhagavaddhyānam| ādiśabdena tadaṅkabhūtaṃ karmaśamadamādikam|tatprabhāvamuttarapūrvāghayoraśleṣavināśarūpam| utkrāntipādoktaṃ karaṇabhṛto jīvasya dehakārākuṭīrā nnirgamanam| brahmanāḍyā gatiṃ supathā rcirādimārgeṇa gatim| svaprakāśañca parañjyotirūpasampadya svenarūpeṇābhiniṣpittim|svasaṅkalpādeva svābhīṣṭa sṛṣṭim | paramamapi parabrahmaṇā bhogamātre sāmyam|
etāddaśaṃ sarvamapyatroktamarthajāta mantimādhyāyasāra bhūtaṃ māyāmatasthaḥ kathamiva ghaṭayet na kathamapi ghaṭayedityarthaḥ|etasya sarvasyāpyarthasya saguṇabrahmasambandhitvena nirguṇabrahmasambandhābhāvāt tasya ca nirguṇasya brahmaṇaḥ kvacidapi phalādhyāye nirdeśābhāvaccetyarthaḥ|| pūrvaṃ mṛṣāvādino'ntimādhyāyārthavirodhamuktavā tasya trikāṇḍyāṃ kvacidapi mīmāṃsāyāṃ nyāyānukūlyaṃ nāstītyāha mānāmāne ti|karmakāṇḍe tāvanmānabhedāṅgaprayuktikramakartrādipratipādanaparipāṭīmupalabhāmahe| tena bhedapara eva prathamakāṇḍaḥ|tathā madhyame'pi kāṇḍe " nānā vā davatā " ityādisūtrakalāpena devatābhedādiḥ pratipādyate|so'pi mṛṣāvādināṃ viruddha eva|asminnāpi brahmakāṇḍe guṇaguṇibhedādidūṣūkāṇāṃ saugatādīnāṃ tattadarthopapādanena nirākaraṇameva sarvato dariddaśyate|tenaitairhetubhissaugatādimatānusāreṇa pravartamānasya mṛṣāvā dasya trikāṇḍyāṃ mīmāṃsāyāṃ na kvāpya vakāśaḥ ||
evaṃ nissandehameva nikhilamapyarthamuktvā kvacitsandeho'vaśiṣyate cet so'pi kālakramopaśāmyati atra na sarvadopaśāntaścet sa tu muktadaśāyāmupaśāmyatu naitātmā spaṣṭameva pratipannasyārthasya ko'pi virodhaḥ eṣā khalu maryādi na kevalamadhyātmaśāsraprasaṅgaḥ eva anuṣṭhāneṣvapi kalpasūtraprasiddheṣvanusartavyeti darśayati trayyante ti| trayyanta stāvadu danvān | tadantassṛtiriyañca karṇadhāra prāyai rdeśikai rabhidhīyate| deśikopadoṣṭā gatiḥ pāraṃ gamayatīti suprasiddhaṃ loke|evaṃ tattvajñānadeśikairuṣadiṣṭeyaṃ sṛtiḥ padavī jñānapāraṃ gamayatī ti yāvat|yadatrāparijñātaṃ tanmuktāveva draṣṭavyam|nahi sarvamapi loke pramāṇaparyālocanamācaranto'pi jānanti|katikati sandehapadaṃ krāntadarśināmapi|itthamadhyātmaviṣaye maryādā anuṣṭhāne'pyeṣaiva rītiriti darśayati kartavya iti| kalpakārai rapi kartavyeṣvartheṣu sasaṃśayameva kecidarthāḥ prakhyāpyante naca tāvatā kalpoditaṃ vimucyate|evaṃ tattvārthapratipādane'pi nissaṃśayapratipannamarthaṃ parigṛhya santoṣṭavyamātmavidbhiḥ|avaśiṣṭaṃ tu kālenāvabhāsyate|anavagatamapi parañjyotirupasampadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpattidaśāyāṃ viśadamevāvalokayiṣyate|athāpi svopayuktāṃśabodha ssarvatrāpi na vitatha eveti||
itthaṃ caturadhyāyīnirṇītārthaṃ caturbhiḥ pādairviśodhyopavarṇayati śrutyante ti|samanvayāvirodhasādhana phalāni khalu caturadhyāyyarthatvenopavarṇyante|tadekaikamevoktvā nigamayati|prathamādhyāye śrutivākyānukūlatarka nirūpaṇamakāri|tasya ca tarkasya gauravanirūpaṇe sarve'pi śailāstūlā yante|dvitīyetvadhyāye parapakṣanirākaraṇaṃ kriyate|tadetadāha tatsiddheti |prathamādhyāyasiddhabrahmaparijñānādityaprakāśe tamasstomakalpaḥ prativādināṃ jalpaḥ |tena parapakṣapratikṣepapradhānaṃ dvitīyalakṣaṇamityuktaṃ bhavati| tṛtīyādhyā yārthamapi vibhajya darśayati mokṣopāye ti| mokṣopāyā ssadvidyādayasteṣā maikarājye taditaravidhayo vidyāṅgakarmavidhayaśśamadamādividhayaśca kiṅkaratvaṃ bhajante śeṣabhāvaṃ bhajanta ityarthaḥ|tena tṛtīyādhyā yārtho'nukrānta|caturthādhyāyārthamapyāha mukte ti| muktānandāmṛta rūpamahārṇava pṛṣatakaṇaspardhine'ntye purūṣārthāssvagarkasvārājyādisukhāni paramapuruṣānubhavasukhamahārṇavapṛṣatabhāvaṃ bhajanta ityarthaḥ|tena puruṣārthāntaraparityāgenāpunarāvṛttilakṣaṇo mokṣa evādhyātmavidāmādartavya ityuktaṃ bhavati|| caturadhyāyyarthamitthaṃ yathāvadadhigatavato'dhikāriṇaḥ krameṇomānamapavargaparyantaṃ phalaṃ darśayati pārāvarya miti| prathamamavitathairāgamaistattvavarge pārāvaryaṃ vivicya saṃsāre vairāgyapādoktakrameṇa tīvrabhītiḥ ubhayaliṅgapādoktakrameṇa paramapuruṣacaraṇāravinda samadhigame tīvra meva niṣpannarā go bhavati puruṣaḥ|anenobhayaliṅgapādaparyantaṃ daśabhiḥ pādairupavarṇito'rthaṃ uktaḥ|ataḥ paraṃ pādaṣaṭkārthaṃ saṅkalayya darśayati kañci diti|sadvidyādiṣu saparikaraṃ kañcidvidyāviśeṣamadhiṣṭhāya śāntāntarāya ssan brahmavidyāniṣṭho brahma sampadya vaikuṇṭhavaimānikeṣu svayamapyanyatabhāvaṃ pratipadya nirupadhika meva paravāsudevapādāravindaparicārako bhavati|tasya viśeṣaṇadvayamāha anāvṛtti riti "naca punarāvartate" iti śrutiviṣayaḥ| itthaṃ śrutārthaḥ "yenākṣaraṃ puruṣaṃ veda satyaṃ provāca tāṃ tattavato brahmavidyām" ityācāryamukhādadhītasarvārtha ityarthaḥ||
svoktasya granthasyāpavargādhirohaṇahetutvena gauravaṃ darśa yannadhikaraṇasārāvalī tyabhihitanāmadheyā seyaṃ kṛtirbhavatāṃ paramapa darathārohasūtaṃ santaṃ santoṣaṃ suvīte ti śiṣyāṇāmāśīrūpamidaṃ padyamāracayati sāsā viti|suprasiddheyamityarthaḥ| sāsūyatattatkumatimatasamunmūlanī asūyāsahitatattatkumatimatasamunmūlnī|
mūlanītiśreṇīniśśreṇikalpā jagatkāraṇaviṣayanyāyanīthīniśśreṇisaddaśī| triyugapatharathārohasūtaṃ paramapuruṣaprāptimārgarathārohaṇe sūtaṃ sārathim| santa iti viduṣāṃ sambodhanam| santāpavargapraśamanapaṭunā tattvabodhena santaṃ santoṣaṃ tāpatrayapraśamanapaṭunā tattvajñānena sahajena saha vartamānaṃ santoṣaṃ suvīta brahmasūtrādhikaraṇacaraṇādhyāyasāravali ritisūtrādhikaraṇapādādhyānāṃ
caturṇāmapi sārasaṅgrahaṇaparampa retyarthaḥ sārasaṅgrahaṇaparamparetyarthaḥ|anenāpūrvagranthanirmāṇasya prayojanamadhyātmatattvamadhijigamiṣatāmantevāsināṃ santoṣa ityuktaṃ bhavati||
atha pūrvoktānāmadhikaraṇānāmasaṅkareṇa pratipattyarthaṃ ,saṅkhyāviśeṣaṃ nirdiśyāsmaduktamarthaṃ padavākyapramāṇavidaḥ katicid vidanti sarvatrāpi pratikṣepameva kurvāṇaiḥ kṣībaiḥ kimanyai rityunmattaprakṛtīnadhikṣipya tānanāddatya bhagavatprasādameva puraskṛtya na ca teṣu durvinīteṣu parihāsamapi kurmaha iti vaidagdhyameva svātmanaḥ prakaṭayati ṣaṭpañcāśa diti| ṣaṭpañcāśacchatañce tyadhikaraṇasaṅkhyānirdeśaḥ|itthame tairadhikaraṇagaṇairvyaktasīmā vibhāge'smin brahmakāṇḍe punarasmābhiruktaṃ katicidve davicakṣaṇā jānanti sarvatrāpi pratikṣepameva kṛtvā tāvatā parituṣṭairnaṣṭabuddhibhiḥ kimanyaiḥ kṛpaṇaiḥ vayaṃ punarviśvametat triguṇaguṇanikāyantritasvāntanighnaṃ paśyantaḥ  sattvarajastamasāmāmreḍanaṃ guṇanikā tayā yantritaṃ svāntaṃ duṣṭapuruṣacetastannighnaṃ tadadhīnaṃ paśyantaḥ loke hi durvinītāḥ paradoṣarśanaikāntacitā iti paśyantaḥ| nāthe śrīraṅganāthe no'smākaṃ nirmitaprabandhaguṇagorava sākṣibhūte sati tāddaśānāṃ duṣṭānāṃ parihāsavacanalīlāmapi na kurmahe |ayamarthaḥ"tvayi prasanne" iti nyāyena kevalaṃ bhagavatprasādameva puruṣārthayāmaḥ|itare puruṣāssvaguṇārūpyeṇānyathā paśyantu mā vā kimetadbruddhyanusāreṇa niṣphaleneti||
nanu śrīraṅgarājādivyājñālabjaṃ vedāntācāryanāmadheyamanvarthayāmītyādāveva bhavadbhiruktam|asminprabandhe śārīrakaśarīramātreṇa bhavadbhiḥ prakāśitaṃ parapakṣapratikṣepabhūyastvaṃ na ddaśyate nāpi ca svapakṣābhimatatattvaprakārapari kalpanam ācāryapīṭhikāmadhyārūḍhaistadapi vaktavyaṃ tatkathamityāśaṅkya tatrottaramāha viśva miti|ayamarthaḥ vedāntaviṣayāṇi nibandhanānyasmābhirabhihitāni śataśo vidyante tatra nibandhanadvitayamanyonyadattahastamaśeṣārthopapādakam ādyastāvat tattvamuktākalāpaḥ ayañcādhi karaṇasāravalī tyanvarthanāmako nibandhanaviśeṣaḥ idaṃ dvitayamapi parasparopakārakatvena bhāvyam etaddvitayaparijñānavatāmavagantavyaśeṣī nāsti asti kiñcidyadi mīmāṃsāpādukayā sma duktayā sidhyati tena triṣveteṣu prabandhaṣvapramattairantevāsibhissarvamapyavagantavyam avaśiṣṭamapyasmadukteṣu prabandhānatareṣu tatratatra draṣṭanyamiti|śabdānvayastu viśva mapi " dravyādravyaprabhedāt " ityādinā ta ttvamuktākalāpe viśadamabhihitam | ihā sminprabandhe śārīrakasya svarūpaṃ ddaḍhaghaṭitaṃ vyūḍhaṃ parasparasaṅgatyā bhedena vā āpādacūhamupavarṇitamityarthaḥ|tenedaṃ prabandhadvayaṃ śiṣyāṇāmupādeyamityatrāmṛtaddaṣṭāntenopapādayati tasmā diti| svakīya śrutamamṛtābdhi statra sañjātamidaṃ nibandhana dvayamamṛtamiva samudvāntamupa varṇitam| anyonyahastapradam parasparopakārakam| aśrāntabaddhaśraddhairācāryavadbhiḥ "ācāryavānpuruṣo veda"iti śrutayuktagarubhaktivinītairuttamādhi kāribhistatprasādapariśuddhena manasā dhārya miti||
uktānāmetāsāṃ sragdharāṇāṃ brahmālaṅkārakāriṇībhirdivyāpsarobhistulyatāmupapādayan māyāpayodheḥ pāre vartamānasya puruṣasya sūtratātparyaśilpairalaṅkṛtasya sarvairapi sattvottaraissambhāvanīyatvamupapādayati ittha miti| anvayastu itthaṃ śārīrakokte mārge samupanatāssragdharāḥ śraddhadhānaṃ śraddhayā yuktamenaṃ puruṣa mabhimukhaiśśuddhabhāvaissūribhiḥ prahita marcirādimārgeṇa nītam|atra sūribhirityatratyānāmadhyātmavidamupalakṣaṇam| ayamarthaḥabhīṣṭairvidvadbhirānītaṃ sragdharāstāvadalaṅkurvanti arcirādibhirnītaṃ divyāpsarasa ive ti| kairalaṅkurvantītyāha upaniṣatsūtratātparyaśilpai riti| śilpaśabdo 'yamābharaṇaviśeṣavācī|etāḥ kila sragdharāssūtreṣu prakāśitatātparyaprakāśanena puruṣamalaṅkṛtya virajātaraṇena paramapadaparyantaṃ sambhāvayantītyarthaḥ||
etatprabandhanirmāṇasya śrīraṅgarājadivyājñāviśeṣalabdhatvāt pāñcajanyamiva svātmānamevaṃ bhagavān mukharīcakāretyāha prajñe ti| prajñeti kācid varasrī tasyā dhampillamallīparimalamilitānāṃ prājñā nāmācāryāṇāṃ sevā, tathā samudyan samuditaśśuddhālokastattvajñānamityarthaḥ|atra śruti rityadhyātmapratipādakavedabhāgo viduṣāṃ śravaṇañca tantreṇābhidhīyate| svahṛdyai ssvābhimataiḥ etaiḥ padyaiḥ praṇavamahimavatpāñcajanyakrameṇa pāñcajanyavadityarthaḥ| pāñcajanyo hi saṃsthānena praṇavamahimavān |śabde ca tāratvāt praṇavamahimavān |pāñcajanyastu bhagavadādhmānena śabdāyate ahamapi bhagavatā prerita evaitāni padyāni vyarīracam|tena svenaiva prerita māmāsthāneṣu mukharīkṛtya sammodatesma santuṣyatismetyarthaḥ|ataḥ "pāñcajanyaṃ hṛṣīkeśaḥ" itivat parapakṣapratikṣeparūpeṣu māṃ muhurapi mukharayāñcakāretyarthaḥ||
itthaṃ nirmitasya svagranthasya prathamaṃ pārāśaryaprasādalabdhatvamanuvadannatmasārabhūtamakartṛtvābhimānaṃ puraskṛtya svācāryarūpaviśiṣṭena sarvavidyāpravartakena bhagavatā hayagrīveṇaiva viracitatvaṃ khyāpayati pārāśarya iti|
ayamatrānvayaḥ
avitathīnagamācāryanāmā munīndro bhagavān pārāśaryaḥ prabhūtādupaniṣadamṛtodanvatassārabhūtaṃ yat tadvedāntasū trairnirmathyādatta |ittham evamasmābhi rniṣkṛṣṭaṃ bhāṣyakārahṛ dayārūḍaṃ tadidamamṛtaṃ mama gurubhirvādihaṃsāmbu vāhaissaha śrāmānhayagrīva eva tadvaktā tatsvayameva vaktā| vakte ti tṛnpratyayāntaḥ|tenātra dvitīyānirdeśaḥ|atra "āvidhya matimanthānaṃ yena vedamahārṇavāt|jagaddhitāya janito mahābhāratacandramāḥ||" iti ślokārtho bhāvyaḥ||
jayati yatirājavāṇī pratibhaṭasiddhāntakṛntanakṛpāṇī|
śrutiyuvatīnāṃ veṇī divyapadārohabhavyaniśreṇī||
